text.body:
<1.1> oṃ nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam | devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet || 1 || śaradvikacapaṅkajaśriyamatīvavidveṣakaṃ milindamunisevitaṃ kuliśakaṃjacihnāvṛtam | sphuratkanakanūpuraṃ dalitabhaktatāpatrayaṃ caladdyutipadadvayaṃ hṛdi dadhāmi rādhāpateḥ || 2 || vadanakamalaniryadyasya pīyūṣamādyaṃ pibati janavaro yaṃ pātu so'yaṃ giraṃ me | badaravanavihāraḥ satyavatyāḥ kumāraḥ praṇataduritahāraḥ śāṅrgadhanvāvatāraḥ || 3 || kadācinnaimiṣāraṇye śrīgargo jñānināṃ varaḥ | āyayau śaunakaṃ draṣṭuṃ tejasvī yogabhāskaraḥ || 4 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya śaunako munibhiḥ saha | pūjayāmāsa pādyādyairupacārairvidhānataḥ || 5 || śrīśaunaka uvāca satāṃ paryaṭanaṃ dhanyaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ śāntaye smṛtam | nṛṇāmantastamohārī sādhureva na bhāskaraḥ || 6 || tasmānme hṛdi sambhūtaṃ saṃdehaṃ nāśaya prabho | katidhā śrīharerviṣṇoravatāro bhavatyalam || 7 || śrīgarga uvāca sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā brahman bhagavadguṇavarṇanam | śṛṇvatāṃ gadatāṃ yadvai pṛcchatāṃ vitanoti śam || 8 || atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam | yasya śravaṇamātreṇa mahādoṣaḥ praśāmyati || 9 || mithilānagare pūrvaṃ bahulāśvaḥ pratāpavān | śrīkṛṣṇabhaktaḥ śāntātmā babhūva nirahaṅkṛtiḥ || 10 || ambarādāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā nāradaṃ munisattamam | sampūjya cāsane sthāpya kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata || 11 || śrībahulāśva uvāca yo'nādirātmā puruṣo bhagavānprakṛteḥ paraḥ | kasmāttanuṃ samādhatte tanme brūhi mahāmate || 12 || śrīnārada uvāca gosādhudevatāvipradevānāṃ rakṣaṇāya vai | tanuṃ dhatte hariḥ sākṣādbhagavānātmalīlayā || 13 || yathā naṭaḥ svalīlāyāṃ mohito na parastathā | anye dṛṣṭvā ca tanmāyāṃ mumuhuste na saṃśayaḥ || 14 || śrībahulāśva uvāca katidhā śrīharerviṣṇoravatāro bhavatyalam | sādhūnāṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ hi kṛpayā vada māṃ prabho || 15 || śrīnārada uvāca aṃśāṃśoṃ'śastathāveśaḥ kalāpūrṇaḥ prakathyate | vyāsādyaiśca smṛtaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam || 16 || aṃśāṃśastu marīcyādiraṃśā brahmādayastathā | kalāḥ kapilakūrmādyā āveśā bhārgavādayaḥ || 17 || pūrṇo nṛsiṃho rāmaśca śvetadvīpādhipo hariḥ | vaikuṇṭho'pi tathā yajño naranārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 18 || paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavān svayam | asaṃkhyabrahmāṇḍapatirgoloke dhāmni rājate || 19 || kāryādhikāraṃ kurvantaḥ sadaṃśāste prakirtitāḥ | tatkāryabhāraṃ kurvantasteṃ'śāṃśā viditāḥ prabhoḥ || 20 || yeṣāmantargato viṣṇuḥ kāryaṃ kṛtvā vinirgataḥ | nānā''veṣāvatārāṃśca viddhi rājanmahāmate || 21 || dharmaṃ vijñāya kṛtvā yaḥ punarantaradhīyata | yuge yuge vartamānaḥ so'vatāraḥ kalā hareḥ || 22 || caturvyūho bhavedyatra dṛśyante ca rasā nava | ataḥ paraṃ ca vīryāṇi sa tu pūrṇaḥ prakathyate || 23 || yasminsarvāṇi tejāṃsi vilīyante svatejasi | taṃ vadanti pare sākṣātparipūrṇatamaṃ svayam || 24 || pūrṇasya lakṣaṇaṃ yatra taṃ paśyanti pṛthak pṛthak | bhāvenāpi janāḥ so'yaṃ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam || 25 || paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo nānya eva hi | ekakāryārthamāgatya koṭikāryaṃ cakāra ha || 26 || pūrṇaḥ purāṇaḥ puruṣottamottamaḥ parātparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ pareśvaraḥ | svayaṃ sadā''nandamayaṃ kṛpākaraṃ guṇākaraṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmyaham || 27 || śrīgarga uvāca tacchrutvā harṣito rājā romāñcī premavihvalaḥ | pramṛśya netre'śrupūrṇe nāradaṃ vākyamabravīt || 28 || śrībahulāśva uvāca paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo kena hetunā | āgato bhārate khaṇḍe dvāravatyāṃ virājate || 29 || tasya golokanāthasya golokaṃ dhāma sundaram | karmāṇyaparimeyāni brūhi brahman bṛhanmune || 30 || yadā tīrthāṭanaṃ kurvañchatajanmatapaḥparam | tadā satsaṅgametyāśu śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ || 31 || śrīkṛṣṇadāsasya ca dāsadāsaḥ kadā bhaveyaṃ manasā''rdracittaḥ | yo durlabho devavaraiḥ parātmā sa me kathaṃ gocara ādidevaḥ || 32 || dhanyastvaṃ rājaśārdūla śrīkṛṣṇeṣṭo haripriyaḥ | tubhyaṃ ca darśanaṃ dātuṃ bhakteśo'trāgamiṣyati || 33 || tvaṃ nṛpaṃ śrutadevaṃ ca dvijadevo janārdanaḥ | smaratyalaṃ dvārakāyāmaho bhāgyaṃ satāmiha || 34 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde kṛṣṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
<1.2> jihvāṃ labdhvāpi yaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kīrtanīyaṃ na kīrtayet | labdhvāpi mokṣaniḥśreṇiṃ sa nārohati durmatiḥ || 1 || atha te saṃpravakṣyāmi śrīkṛṣṇāgamanaṃ bhuvi | asminvārāha kalpe vai yadbhūtaṃ tacchṛṇu prabho || 2 || purā dānavadaityānāṃ narāṇāṃ khalu bhūbhujām | bhūribhārasamākrāṃtā pṛthvī gorūpadhāriṇī || 3 || anāthavadrudantīva vedayantī nijavyathām | kampayantī nijaṃ gātraṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā || 4 || brahmāthāśvāsya tāṃ sadyaḥ sarvadevagaṇairvṛtaḥ | śaṅkareṇa samaṃ prāgādvaikuṇṭhaṃ maṃdiraṃ hareḥ || 5 || natvā caturbhujaṃ viṣṇuṃ svābhiprāyaṃ jagāda ha | athodvignaṃ devagaṇaṃ śrīnāthaḥ prāha taṃ vidhim || 6 || śrībhagavānuvāca kṛṣṇaṃ svayaṃ vigaṇitāṇḍapatiṃ pareśaṃ sākṣādakhaṇḍamatidevamatīvalīlam | kāryaṃ kadāpi na bhaviṣyati yaṃ vinā hi gacchāśu tasya viśadaṃ padamavyayaṃ tvam || 7 || śrībrahmovāca tvattaḥ paraṃ na jānāmi paripūrṇatamaṃ svayam | yadi yonyastasya sākṣāllokaṃ darśaya naḥ prabho || 8 || śrīnārada uvāca ityukto'pi hariḥ pūrṇaḥ sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ saha | padavīṃ darśayāmāsa brahmāṇḍaśikharopari || 9 || vāmapādāṅguṣṭhanakhabhinnabrahmāṇḍamastake | śrīvāmanasya vivare brahma dravasamākule || 10 || jalayānena mārgeṇa bahiste niryayuḥ surāḥ | kaliṅgabimbavaccedaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ dadṛśustvadhaḥ || 11 || indrāyanaphalānīva luṭhantyanyāni vai jale | vilokya vismitāḥ sarve babhuvuścakitā iva || 12 || koṭiśo yojanordhvaṃ vai purāṇāmaṣṭakaṃ gatāḥ | divyaprākāraratnādi drumavṛndamanoharam || 13 || tadūrdhvaṃ dadṛśurdevā virajāyāstaṭaṃ śubham | taraṃgitaṃ kṣauma śubhraṃ sopānairbhāskaraṃ param || 14 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā pracalantaste tatpuraṃ jagmuruttamam | asaṃkhyakoṭimārtaṇḍa jyotiṣāṃ maṇḍalaṃ mahat || 15 || dṛṣṭvā pratāḍitākṣāste tejasā dharṣitāḥ sthitāḥ | namaskṛtvā'tha tattejo dadhyau viṣṇvājñayā vidhiḥ || 16 || tajjyotirmaṇḍale'paśyatsākāraṃ dhāma śāntimat | tasminmahādbhutaṃ dīrghaṃ mṛṇāladhavalaṃ param | sahasravadanaṃ śeṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā nemuḥ surāstataḥ || 17 || tasyotsaṃge mahāloko goloko lokavanditaḥ | yatra kālaḥ kalayatāmīśvaro dhāmamāninām || 18 || rājanna prabhavenmāyā manaścittaṃ matirhyaham | na vikāro viśatyeva na mahāṃśca guṇāḥ kutaḥ || 19 || tatra kandarpalāvaṇyāḥ śyāmasundaravigrahāḥ | dvāri gaṃtuṃ cābhyuditā nyaṣedhankṛṣṇapārṣadāḥ || 20 || śrīdevā ūcuḥ lokapālā vayaṃ sarve brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | śrīkṛṣṇadarśanārthāya śakrādyā āgatā iha || 21 || śrīnārada uvāca tacchrutvā tadabhiprāyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇāya sakhījanāḥ | ūcurdevapratīhārā gatvā cāntaḥpuraṃ param || 22 || tadā vinirgatā kācicchatacandrānanā sakhī | pītāṃbarā vetrahastā sāpṛcchadvāñchitaṃ surān || 23 || śrīśatacandrānanovāca kasyāṇḍasyādhipā devā yūyaṃ sarve samāgatāḥ | vadatāśu gamiṣyāmi tasmai bhagavate hyaham || 24 || śrīdevā ūcuḥ aho aṇḍānyutānyāni nāsmābhirdarśitāni ca | ekamaṇḍaṃ prajānīmo'tho'paraṃ nāsti naḥ śubhe || 25 || śrīśatacandrānanovāca brahmadeva luṭhantīha koṭiśo hyaṇḍarāśayaḥ | teṣāṃ yūyaṃ yathā devāstathāṇḍe'ṇḍe pṛthak pṛthak || 26 || nāmagrāmaṃ na jānītha kadā nātra samāgatāḥ | jaḍabuddhyā prahṛṣyadhve gṛhānnāpi vinirgatāḥ || 27 || brahmāṇḍamekaṃ jānanti yatra jātāstathā janāḥ | maśakā ca yathāntaḥsthā auduṃbaraphaleṣu vai || 28 || śrīnārada uvāca upahāsyaṃ gatā devā itthaṃ tūṣṇīṃ sthitāḥ punaḥ | cakitāniva tān dṛṣṭvā viṣṇurvacanamabravīt || 29 || śrīviṣṇuruvāca yasminnaṇḍe pṛśnigarbho'vatāro'bhūtsanātana | trivikramanakhodbhinne tasminnaṇḍe sthitā vayam || 30 || śrīnārada uvāca tacchrutvā taṃ ca saṃślāghya śīghramantaḥpuraṃ gatā punarāgatya devebhyo'pyājñāṃ dattvā gatāḥ puram || 31 || atha devagaṇāḥ sarve golokaṃ dadṛśuḥ param | tatra govardhano nāma girirājo virājate || 32 || vasantamāninībhiśca gopībhirgogaṇairvṛtaḥ | kalpavṛkṣalatāsaṅghai rāsamaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ || 33 || yatra kṛṣṇānadī śyāmā tolikākoṭimaṇḍitā | vaidūryakṛta sopānā svacchandagatiruttamā || 34 || vṛndāvanaṃ bhrājamānaṃ divyadrumalatākulam | citrapakṣimadhuvratairvaṃśīvaṭavirājitam || 35 || puline śītale vāyurmandagāmī vahatyalam | sahasradalapadmānāṃ rajo vikṣepayanmuhuḥ || 36 || madhye nijanikuñjo'sti dvātriṃśadvanasaṃyutaḥ | prākāraparikhāyukto'ruṇākṣayavaṭājiraḥ || 37 || saptadhā padmarāgāgrājirakuḍyavibhūṣitaḥ | koṭīndumaṇḍalākārairvitānairgulikādyutiḥ || 38 || patatpatākairdivyābhaiḥ puṣpamandiravartmabhiḥ | jātabhramarasaṅgīto mattabarhipikasvanaḥ || 39 || bālārkakuṇḍaladharāḥ śatacandraprabhāḥ striyaḥ | svacchandagatayo ratnaiḥ paśyantyaḥ sundaraṃ mukham || 40 || ratnājireṣu dhāvaṃtyo hārakeyūrabhūṣitāḥ | kvaṇannūpurakiṅkiṇyaścūḍāmaṇivirājitāḥ || 41 || koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo gāvo dvāri dvāri manoharāḥ | śvetaparvatasaṅkāśā divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 42 || payasvinyastaruṇyaśca śīlarūpaguṇairyutāḥ | savatsāḥ pītapucchāśca vrajaṃtyo bhavyamūrtikāḥ || 43 || ghaṇṭāmaṃjīrasaṃrāvāḥ kiṃkiṇījālamaṇḍitāḥ | hemaśṛṅgyo hematulyahāramālāsphuratprabhāḥ || 44 || pāṭalā haritāstāmrāḥ pītāḥ śyāmā vicitritāḥ | dhūmrāḥ kokilavarṇāśca yatra gāvastvanekadhā || 45 || samudravaddugdhadāśca taruṇīkaracihnitāḥ | kuraṃgavadvilaṅghadbhirgovatsairmaṇḍitāḥ śubhāḥ || 46 || itastataścalantaśca gogaṇeṣu mahāvṛṣāḥ | dīrghakandharaśṛṅgāḍhyā yatra dharmadhuraṃdharāḥ || 47 || gopālā vetrahastāśca śyāmā vaṃśīdharāḥ parāḥ | kṛṣṇalīlāṃ pragāyanto rāgairmadanamohanaiḥ || 48 || itthaṃ nijanikuñjaṃ taṃ natvā madhye gatāḥ surāḥ | jyotiṣāṃ maṇḍalaṃ padmaṃ sahasradalaśobhitam || 49 || tadūrdhvaṃ ṣoḍaśadalaṃ tato'ṣṭadalapaṅkajam | tasyopari sphuraddīrghaṃ sopānatrayamaṇḍitam || 50 || siṃhāsanaṃ paraṃ divyaṃ kaustubhaiḥ khacitaṃ śubhaiḥ | dadṛśurdevatāḥ sarvāḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ rādhayā yutam || 51 || divyairaṣṭasakhīsaṅghairmohinyādibhiranvitam | śrīdāmādyaiḥ sevyamānamaṣṭagopālasevitaiḥ || 52 || haṃsābhairvyajanāndolacāmarairvajramuṣṭibhiḥ | koṭicandrapratīkāśaiḥ sevitaṃ chatrakoṭibhiḥ || 53 || śrīrādhikālaṅkṛtavāmabāhuṃ svacchandavakrīkṛtadakṣiṇāṅghrim | vaṃśīdharaṃ sundaramandahāsaṃ bhrūmaṇḍalāmohitakāmarāśim || 54 || ghanaprabhaṃ padmadalāyutekṣaṇaṃ pralambabāhuṃ bahupītavāsasam | vṛndāvanonmattamilindaśabdairvirājitaṃ śrīvanamālayā harim || 55 || kāñjīkalākaṅkaṇanūpuradyutiṃ lasanmanohāri mahojjvalasmitam | śrīvatsaratnottama kuntalaśriyaṃ kirīṭahārāṅgadakuṇḍalatviṣam || 56 || dṛṣṭvā tamānandasamudramagnavatpraharṣitāścāśrukalākulekṣaṇāḥ | tataḥ surāḥ prāñjalayo natānanā nemurmurāriṃ puruṣaṃ parāyaṇam || 57 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīgolokadhāmavarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
<1.3> mune devā mahātmānaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā parātparam | agre kiṃ cakrire tatra tanme brūhi kṛpāṃ kuru || 1 || nārada uvāca sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ teṣāṃ vaikuṃṭho'pi haristataḥ | utthāyāṣṭabhujaḥ sākṣāllīno'bhūtkṛṣṇavigrahe || 2 || tadaiva cāgataḥ pūrṇo nṛsiṃhaścaṇḍavikramaḥ | koṭisūryapratīkāśo līno'bhūtkṛṣṇatejasi || 3 || rathe lakṣahaye śubhre sthitaścāgatavāṃstataḥ | śvetadvīpādhipo bhūmā sahasrabhujamaṃḍitaḥ || 4 || śriyā yuktaḥ svāyudhāḍhyaḥ pārṣadaiḥ parisevitaḥ | saṃpralīno babhūvāśu so'pi śrīkṛṣṇavigrahe || 5 || tadaiva cāgataḥ sākṣādrāmo rājīvalocanaḥ | dhanurbāṇadharaḥ sītāśobhito bhrātṛbhirvṛtaḥ || 6 || daśakoṭyarkasaṃkāśe cāmarairdolite rathe | asaṃkhyavānareṃdrāḍhye lakṣacakraghanasvane || 7 || lakṣadhvaje lakṣahaye śātakauṃbhe sthitastataḥ | śrīkṛṣṇavigrahe pūrṇaḥ saṃpralīno babhūva ha || 8 || tadaiva cāgataḥ sākṣādyajño nārāyaṇo hariḥ | prasphuratpralayāṭopajvaladagniśikhopamaḥ || 9 || rathe jyotirmaye dṛśyo dakṣiṇāḍhyaḥ sureśvaraḥ | so'pi līno babhūvāśu śrīkṛṣṇe śyāmavigrahe || 10 || tadā cāgatavān sākṣānnaranārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | caturbhujo viśālākṣo muniveṣo ghanadyutiḥ || 11 || taḍitkoṭijaṭājūṭaḥ prasphuraddīptimaṃḍalaḥ | munīndramaṇḍalairdivyairmaṇḍito'khaṇḍitavrataḥ || 12 || sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ teṣāmāścarya manasā nṛpa | so'pi līno babhūvāśu śrīkṛṣṇe śyāmasuṃdare || 13 || paripūrṇatamaṃ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇaṃ ca svayaṃ prabhum | jñātvā devāḥ stutiṃ cakruḥ paraṃ vismayamāgatāḥ || 14 || devā ūcuḥ kṛṣṇāya pūrṇapuruṣāya parātparāya yajñeśvarāya parakāraṇakāraṇāya | rādhāvarāya paripūrṇatamāya sākṣādgolokadhāma dhiṣaṇāya namaḥ parasmai || 15 || yogeśvarāḥ kila vadanti mahaḥ paraṃ tvāṃ tatraiva sātvatamanāḥ kṛtavigrahaṃ ca | asmābhiradya viditaṃ yadado'dvayaṃ te tasmai namo'stu mahasāṃ pataye parasmai || 16 || vyaṅgena vā na na hi lakṣaṇayā kadāpi sphoṭena yacca kavayo na viśaṃti mukhyāḥ | nirdeśyabhāvarahitaḥ prakṛteḥ paraṃ ca tvāṃ brahma nirguṇamalaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmaḥ || 17 || tvāṃ brahma kecidavayaṃti pare ca kālaṃ kecitpraśāṃtamapare bhuvi karmarūpam | pūrve ca yogamapare kila kartṛbhāvamanyoktibhirna viditaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ smaḥ || 18 || śreyaskarīṃ bhagavatastavapādasevāṃ hitvātha tīrthayajanādi tapaścaranti | jñānena ye ca viditā bahuvighnasaṅghaiḥ santāḍitāḥ kimu bhavanti na te kṛtārthāḥ || 19 || vijñāpyamadya kimu deva aśeṣasākṣī yaḥ sarvabhūtahṛdayeṣu virājamānaḥ | devairnamadbhiramalāśayamukta dehaistasmai namo bhagavate puruṣottamāya || 20 || yo rādhikāhṛdayasundaracandrahāraḥ śrīgopikānayanajīvanamūlahāraḥ | golokadhāmadhiṣaṇadhvaja ādidevaḥ sa tvaṃ vipatsu vibudhān paripāhi pāhi || 21 || vṛndāvaneśa girirājapate vrajeśa gopālaveṣakṛtanityavihāralīla | rādhāpate śrutidharādhipate dharāṃ tvaṃ govarddhanoddharaṇa uddhara dharmadhārām || 22 || śrīnārada uvāca ityukto bhavān sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo gokuleśvaraḥ | pratyāha praṇatāndevānmeghagaṃbhīrayā girā || 23 || śrībhagavānuvāca he surajyeṣṭha he śaṃbho devāḥ śṛṇuta madvacaḥ | yādaveṣu ca janyadhvamaṃśaiḥ strībhirmadājñayā || 24 || ahaṃ ca avatariṣyāmi hariṣyāmi bhuvo bharam | kariṣyāmi ca vaḥ kāryaṃ bhaviṣyāmi yadoḥ kule || 25 || vedā me vacanaṃ viprā mukhaṃ gāvastanurmama | aṃgāni devatā yūyaṃ sādhavo hyasavo hṛdi || 26 || yuge yuge ca bādhyeta yadā pākhaṃḍibhirjanaiḥ | dharmaḥ kraturdayā sākṣāttadātmānaṃ sṛjāmyaham || 27 || śrīnārada uvāca ityuktavantaṃ jagadīśvaraṃ hariṃ rādhā patiprāṇaviyogavihvalā | dāvāgninā duḥkhalateva mūrchitāśrukaṃparomāṃcitabhāvasaṃvṛtā || 28 || śrīrādhovāca bhuvo bharaṃ hartumalaṃ vrajerbhuvaṃ kṛtaṃ paraṃ me śapathaṃ śṛṇotvataḥ | gate tvayi prāṇapate ca vigrahaṃ kadācidatraiva na dhārayāmyaham || 29 || yadā tvamevaṃ śapathaṃ na manyase dvitīyavāraṃ pradadāmi vākpatham | prāṇo'dhare gantumatīva vihvalaḥ karpūradhūmaḥ kaṇavadgamiṣyati || 30 || śrībhagavānuvāca tvayā saha gamiṣyāmi mā śokaṃ kuru rādhike | hariṣyāmi bhuvo bhāraṃ kariṣyāmi vacastava || 31 || śrīrādhikovāca yatra vṛndāvanaṃ nāsti yatra no yamunā nadī | yatra govarddhano nāsti tatra me na manaḥsukham || 32 || śrīnārada uvāca vedanāgakrośabhūmiṃ svadhāmnaḥ śrīhariḥ svayam | govardhanaṃ ca yamunāṃ preṣayāmāsa bhūpari || 33 || tadā brahmā devagaṇairnatvā natvā punaḥ punaḥ | paripūrṇatamaṃ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇaṃ samuvāca ha || 34 || śrībrahmovāca ahaṃ kutra bhaviṣyāmi kutra tvaṃ ca bhaviṣyasi | ete kutra bhaviṣyanti kairgṛhaiḥ kaiśca nāmabhiḥ || 35 || śrībhagavānuvāca vasudevasya devakyāṃ bhaviṣyāmi paraḥ svayam | rohiṇyāṃ matkalā śeṣo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 36 || śrīsākṣādrukmiṇī bhaiṣmī śivā jāṃbavatī tathā | satyā ca tulasī bhūmau satyabhāmā vasuṃdharā || 37 || dakṣiṇā lakṣmaṇā caiva kālindī virajā tathā | bhadrā hrīrmitravindā ca jāhnavī pāpanāśinī || 38 || rukmiṇyāṃ kāmadevaśca pradyumna iti viśrutaḥ | bhaviṣyati na sandehastasya tvaṃ ca bhaviṣasi || 39 || naṃdo droṇo vasuḥ sākṣādyaśodā sā dharā smṛtā | vṛṣabhānuḥ sucandraśca tasya bhāryā kalāvatī || 40 || bhūmau kīrtiriti khyātā tasyā rādhā bhaviṣyati | sadā rāsaṃ kariṣyāmi gopībhirvrajamaṇḍale || 41 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde āgamanodyogavarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
<1.4> nandopanandabhavane śrīdāmā subalaḥ sakhā | stokakṛṣṇo'rjunoṃ'śaśca navanandagṛhe vidhe || 1 || viśālārṣabhatejasvī devaprasthavarūthapāḥ | bhaviṣyanti sakhāyo me vraje ṣaḍ vṛṣabhānuṣu || 2 || śrībrahmovāca kasya vai nandapadavī kasya vai vṛṣabhānutā | vada devapate sākṣādupanandasya lakṣaṇam || 3 || śrībhagavānuvāca gāḥ pālayanti ghoṣeṣu sadā govṛttayo'niśam | te gopālā mayā proktāsteṣāṃ tvaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śrṛṇu || 4 || nandaḥ proktaḥ sa gopālairnavalakṣagavāṃ patiḥ | upanandaśca kathitaḥ paṃcalakṣagavāṃ patiḥ || 5 || vṛṣabhānuḥ sa ukto yo daśalakṣagavāṃ patiḥ | gavāṃ koṭirgṛhe yasya nandarājaḥ sa eva hi || 6 || koṭyardhaṃ ca gavāṃ yasya vṛṣabhānuvarastu saḥ | etādṛśau vraje dvau tu sucandro droṇa eva hi || 7 || sarvalakṣaṇalakṣyāḍhyau goparājau bhaviṣyataḥ | śatacandrānanānāṃ ca sundarīṇāṃ suvāsasām | gopīnāṃ madvraje ramye śatayūtho bhaviṣyati || 8 || śrībrahmovāca he dīnabaṃdho he deva jagatkāraṇakāraṇa | yūthasya lakṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ tanme brūhi pareśvara || 9 || śrībhagavānuvāca arbudaṃ daśakoṭīnāṃ munibhiḥ kathitaṃ vidhe | daśārbudaṃ yatra bhavetso'pi yūthaḥ prakathyate || 10 || golokavāsinyaḥ kāścitkāścidvai dvārapālikāḥ | śṛṅgāraprakarāḥ kāścitkāścicchasyopakārakāḥ || 11 || pārṣadākhyāstathā kāścicchrīvṛndāvanapālikāḥ | govardhananivāsinyaḥ kāścitkuñjavidhāyikāḥ || 12 || me nikuñjanivāsinyo bhaviṣyanti vraje mama | evaṃ ca yamunāyūtho jāhnavīyūtha eva ca || 13 || ramāyā madhumādhavyā virajāyāstathaiva ca | lalitāyā viśākhāyā māyāyūtho bhaviṣyati || 14 || evaṃ hṛṣṭasakhīnāṃ ca sakhīnāṃ kila ṣoḍaśa | dvātriṃśacca sakhīnāṃ ca yūthā bhāvyā vraje vidhe || 15 || śrutarūpā ṛṣirūpā maithilāḥ kośalāstathā | ayodhyāpuravāsinyo yatra sītāpulindakāḥ || 16 || yāsāṃ mayā varo datto pūrve pūrve yuge yuge | tāsāṃ yūthā bhaviṣyanti gopīnāṃ madvraje śubhe || 17 || śrībrahmovāca etāḥ kathaṃ vraje bhāvyāḥ kena puṇyena kairvaraiḥ | durlabhaṃ hi padaṃ tāsāṃ yogibhiḥ puruṣottama || 18 || śrībhagavānuvāca śvetadvīpe ca bhūmānaṃ śrutayastuṣṭuvuḥ param | uśatībhirgirābhiśca prasanno'bhūtsahasrapāt || 19 || śrīhariruvāca varaṃ vṛṇīta yūyaṃ vai yanmanovāñchitaṃ mahat | yeṣāṃ prasanno'haṃ sākṣātteṣāṃ kiṃ durlabhaṃ hi tat || 20 || śrutaya ūcuḥ vāṅmanogocarātītaṃ tato na jñāyate tu tat | ānandamātramiti yadvadaṃtīha purāvidaḥ || 21 || tadrūpaṃ darśayāsmākaṃ yadi deyo varo hi naḥ | śrutvaitaddarśayāmāsa svaṃ lokaṃ prakṛteḥ param || 22 || kevalānubhavānandamātramakṣaramavyayam | yatra vṛṃdāvanaṃ nāma vanaṃ kāmadughairdrumaiḥ || 23 || manoramanikuñjāḍhyaṃ sarvartusukhasaṃyutam | yatra govardhano nāma sunirjharadarīyutaḥ || 24 || ratnadhātumayaḥ śrīmān supakṣigaṇasaṃvṛtaḥ | yatra nirmalapānīyā kālindī saritāṃ varā | ratnabaddhobhayataṭī haṃsapadmādisaṃkulā || 25 || nānārāsarasonmattaṃ yatra gopīkadaṃbakam | tatkadaṃbakamadhyasthaḥ kiśorākṛtiracyutaḥ || 26 || darśayitvā ca tāḥ prāha brūta kiṃ karavāṇi vaḥ | dṛṣṭo madīyo loko'yaṃ yato nāsti paraṃ varam || 27 || śrīśrutaya ūcuḥ kandarpakoṭilāvaṇye tvayi dṛṣṭe manāṃsi naḥ | kāminībhāvamāsādya smarakṣiptānyasaṃśayam || 28 || yayā tvallokavāsinyaḥ kāmatattvena gopikāḥ | bhajanti ramaṇaṃ mattvā cikīrṣājaninastathā || 29 || śrīhariruvāca durlabho durghaṭaścaiva yuṣmākaṃ tu manorathaḥ | mayānumoditaḥ samyak satyo bhavitumarhati || 30 || āgāmini viriṃcau tu jāte sṛṣṭyarthamudyate | kalpe sārasvate'tīte vraje gopyo bhaviṣyatha || 31 || pṛthivyāṃ bhārate kṣetre māthure mama maṇḍale | vṛndāvane bhaviṣyāmi preyānvo rāsamaṇḍale || 32 || jāradharmeṇa susnehaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ sarvato'dhikam | mayi saṃprāpya sarvā hi kṛtakṛtyā bhaviṣyatha || 33 || śrībhagavānuvāca tāśca gopyo bhaviṣyanti pūrvakalpavarānmama | anyāsāṃ caiva gopīnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu tadvidhe || 34 || surāṇāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya rākṣasānāṃ vadhāya ca | tretāyāṃ rāmacaṃdro'bhūdvīro daśarathātmajaḥ || 35 || sītāsvayaṃvaraṃ gatvā dhanurbhaṅgaṃ cakāra saḥ | uvāha jānakīṃ sītāṃ rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ || 36 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā maithilāḥ sarvāḥ purandhryo mumuhurvidhe | rahasyūcurmahātmānaṃ bhartā no bhava he prabho || 37 || tāmāha rāghavendrastu mā śokaṃ kuruta striyaḥ | dvāparānte kariṣyāmi bhavatīnāṃ manoratham || 38 || tīrthaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥ śaucaṃ samācarata tattvataḥ | śraddhayā parayā bhaktyā vraje gopyo bhaviṣyatha || 39 || iti tābhyo varaṃ dattvā śrīrāmaḥ karuṇānidhiḥ | kosalān prayayau dhanvī tejasā jitabhārgavaḥ || 40 || mārge ca kausalā nāryo rāmaṃ dṛṣṭvātisuṃdaram | manasā vavrire taṃ vai patiṃ kandarpamohanam || 41 || manasāpi varaṃ rāmo dadau tābhyo hyaśeṣavit | manorathaṃ kariṣyāmi vraje gopyo bhaviṣyatha || 42 || āgataṃ sītayā sārdhaṃ sainikaiḥ sahitaṃ raghum | ayodhyāpuravāsinyaḥ śrutvā draṣṭuṃ samāyayuḥ || 43 || vīkṣya taṃ mohamāpannā mūrchitāḥ premavihvalāḥ | tepustapastāḥ sarayūtīre rāmadhṛtavratāḥ || 44 || ākāśavāgabhūttāsāṃ dvāparānte manorathaḥ | bhaviṣyati na saṃdehaḥ kāliṃdītīraje vane || 45 || piturvākyādyadā rāmo daṃḍakākhyaṃ vanaṃ gataḥ | cacāra sītayā sārdhaṃ lakṣmaṇena dhanuṣmatā || 46 || gopālakopāsakāḥ sarve daṃḍakāraṇyavāsinaḥ | dhyāyantaḥ satataṃ māṃ vai rāsārthaṃ dhyānatatparāḥ || 47 || yeṣāmāśramamāsādya dhanurbāṇadharo yuvā | teṣāṃ dhyāne gato rāmo jaṭāmukuṭamaṃḍitaḥ || 48 || anyākṛtiṃ te taṃ vīkṣya paraṃ vismitamānasāḥ | dhyānādutthāya dadṛśuḥ koṭikandarpasannibham || 49 || ūcuste'yaṃ tu gopālo vaṃśīvetre vinā prabhuḥ | itthaṃ vicārya manasā nemuścakruḥ stutiṃ parām || 50 || varaṃ vṛṇīta munayaḥ śrīrāmastānuvāca ha | yathā sītā tathā sarve bhūyāḥsma iti vādinaḥ || 51 || śrīrāma uvāca yathā hi lakṣmaṇo bhrātā tathā prārthyo varo yadi | adyaiva saphalo bhāvyo bhavadbhirmatprasaṃgataḥ || 52 || sītopameyavākyena durghaṭo durlabho varaḥ | ekapatnīvrato'haṃ vai maryādāpuruṣottamaḥ || 53 || tasmāttu madvareṇāpi dvāparānte bhaviṣyatha | manorathaṃ kariṣyāmi bhavatāṃ vāñchitaṃ param || 54 || iti dattvā varaṃ rāmastataḥ paṃcavaṭīṃ gataḥ | parṇaśālā samāsādya vanavāsaṃ cakāra ha || 55 || taddarśanasmararujaḥ pulindyaḥ premavihvalāḥ | śrīmatpādarajo dhṛtvā prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyutāḥ || 56 || brahmacārīvapurbhūtvā rāmastatra samāgataḥ | uvāca prāṇasaṃtyāgaṃ mā kuruta striyo vṛthā || 57 || vṛndāvane dvāparānte bhavitā vo manorathaḥ | ityuktvā brahmacārī tu tatraivāntaradhīyata || 58 || atha rāmo vānarendrai rāvaṇādīnniśācarān | jitvā laṅkāmetya sītā puṣpakeṇa purīṃ yayau || 59 || sītāṃ tattyāja rājendro vane lokāpavādataḥ | aho satāmapi bhuvi bhavanaṃ bhūri duḥkhadam || 60 || yadā yadākarodyajñaṃ rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ | tadā tadā svarṇamayīṃ sītāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || 61 || yajñasītāsamūho'bhūnmandire rāghavasya ca | tāścaitanyaghanā bhūtvā rantuṃ rāmaṃ samāgatāḥ || 62 || tā āha rāghaveśendro nāhaṃ gṛhṇāmi he priyāḥ | tadocustāḥ premaparā rāmaṃ daśarathātmajam || 63 || kathaṃ cāsmānna gṛhṇāsi bhajantīrmaithilīḥ satīḥ | ardhāṅgīryajñakāleṣu satataṃ kāryasādhanīḥ || 64 || dharmiṣṭhastvaṃ śrutidharo'dharmavadbhāṣase katham | karaṃ gṛhītvā tyajasi tataḥ pāpamavāpyasi || 65 || śrīrāma uvāca samīcīnaṃ vacassatyo yuṣmābhirgaditaṃ ca me | ekapatnīvrato'haṃ hi rājarṣiḥ sītayaikayā || 66 || tasmādyūyaṃ dvāparānte puṇye vṛndāvane vane | bhaviṣyatha kariṣyāmi yuṣmākaṃ tu manoratham || 67 || śrībhagavān uvāca tā vraje'pi bhaviṣyanti yajñasītāśca gopikāḥ | anyāsāṃ caiva gopīnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu tadvidhe || 68 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde bhagavadbrahma saṃvāde udyogapraśnavarṇanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
<1.5> ramāvaikuṇṭhavāsinyaḥ śvetadvīpasakhījanāḥ | ūrdhvaṃ vaikuṇṭhavāsinyastathājitapadāśritāḥ || 1 || śrīlokācalavāsinyaḥ śrīsakhyo'pi samudrajāḥ | tā gopyo'bhibhaviṣyanti lakṣmīpativarādvraje || 2 || kāściddivyā adivyāśca tathā triguṇavṛttayaḥ | bhūmigopyo bhaviṣyanti puṇyairnānāvidhaiḥ kṛtaiḥ || 3 || yajñāvatāraṃ ruciraṃ ruciputraṃ divaspatim | mohitāḥ prītibhāvena vīkṣya devajanastriyaḥ || 4 || tāśca devalavākyena tapastepurhimācale | bhaktyā paramayā tā me gopyo bhāvyā vraje vidhe || 5 || antarhite bhagavati deve dhanvantarau bhuvi | oṣadhyo duḥkhamāpannā niṣphalā bhārate'bhavan || 6 || siddhyarthaṃ tāstapastepuḥ striyo bhūtvā manoharāḥ | caturyuge vyatīte tu prasanno'bhūddhariḥ param || 7 || varaṃ vṛṇīta cetyṛktaṃ śrutvā nāryo mahāvane | taṃ dṛṣṭvā mohamāpannā ūcurbhartā bhavātra naḥ || 8 || vṛndāvane dvāparānte latā bhūtvā manoharāḥ | bhaviṣyatha striyo rāse kariṣyāmi vacaśca vaḥ || 9 || śrībhagavānuvāca bhaktibhāvasamāyuktā bhūribhāgyā varāṃganāḥ | latāgopyo bhaviṣyanti vṛndāraṇye pitāmaha || 10 || jālandharyyaśca yā nāryo vīkṣya vṛndāpatiṃ harim | ūcurvāyaṃ hariḥ sākṣādasmākaṃ tu varo bhavet || 11 || ākāśavāgabhūttāsāṃ bhajatāśu ramāpatim | yathā vṛndā tathā yūyaṃ vṛndāraṇye bhaviṣyatha || 12 || samudrakanyāḥ śrīmatsyaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā ca mohitāḥ | tā hi gopyo bhaviṣyanti śrīmatsyasya varādvraje || 13 || āsīdrājā pṛthuḥ sākṣānmamāṃśaścaṇḍavikramaḥ | jitvā śatrūnnṛpaśreṣṭho dharāṃ kāmāndudoha ha || 14 || barhiṣmatībhavāstatra pṛthuṃ dṛṣṭvā purastriyaḥ | atreḥ samīpamāgatya tā ūcurmohavihvalāḥ || 15 || ayaṃ tu rājarājendraḥ pṛthuḥ pṛthulavikramaḥ | kathaṃ varo bhavenno vai tadvada tvaṃ mahāmune || 16 || atriruvāca godohaṃ kurutāśvadya pṛthvīyaṃ dhāraṇāmayī | sarvaṃ dāsyati vo durgaṃ manorathamahārṇavam || 17 || manorathaṃ praduduhurmanaḥpātreṇa tāśca gām | tasmādgopyo bhaviṣyanti vṛndāraṇye pitāmaha || 18 || kāmasenāmohanārthaṃ divyā apsaraso varāḥ | nārāyaṇasya sahasā babhūvurgandhamādane || 19 || bhartukāmāśca tā āha siddho nārāyaṇo muniḥ | manoratho vo bhavitā vrajogopyo bhaviṣyatha || 20 || striyaḥ sutalavāsinyo vāmanaṃ vīkṣya mohitāḥ | tapastaptā bhaviṣyanti gopyo vṛndāvane vidhe || 21 || nāgendrakanyā yāḥ śeṣaṃ bhejurbhaktyā varecchayā | saṃkarṣaṇasya rāsārthaṃ bhaviṣyaṃti vraje ca tāḥ || 22 || kaśyapo vasudevaśca devakī cāditiḥ parā | śūraḥ prāṇo dhruvaḥ so'pi devako'vatariṣyati || 23 || vasuścaivoddhavaḥ sākṣāddakṣo'krūro dayāparaḥ | hṛdīko dhanadaścaiva kṛtavarmā tvapāṃpatiḥ || 24 || gadaḥ prācīnabarhiśca maruto hyugrasena ut | tasya rakṣāṃ kariṣyāmi rājyaṃ dattvā vidhānataḥ || 25 || yuyudhānaścāmbarīṣaḥ prahlādaḥ sātyakistathā | kṣīrābdhiḥ śantanuḥ sākṣādbhīṣmo droṇo vasūttamaḥ || 26 || śalaścaiva divodāso dhṛtarāṣṭro bhago raviḥ | pāṇḍuḥ pūṣā satāṃ śreṣṭho dharmo rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 27 || bhīmo vāyurbaliṣṭhaśca manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvo'rjunaḥ | śatarūpā subhadrā ca savitā karṇa eva hi || 28 || nakulaḥ sahadevaśca smṛtau dvāvaśvinīsutau | dhātā bāhlīkavīraśca vahnirdroṇaḥ pratāpavān || 29 || duryodhanaḥ kaleraṃśo'bhimanyuḥ soma eva ca | drauṇiḥ sākṣācchivasyāpi rūpaṃ bhūmau bhaviṣyati || 30 || itthaṃ yadoḥ kauravāṇāmanyeṣāṃ bhūbhujāṃ nṛṇām | kule kule ca bhavataḥ svāṃśaiḥ strībhirmadājñayā || 31 || ye ye'vatārā me pūrvaṃ teṣāṃ rājñyo ramāṃśakāḥ | bhaviṣyā rājarājñīṣu sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa || 32 || śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā śrīharistatra brahmāṇaṃ kamalāsanam | divyarūpāṃ bhagavatīṃ yogamāyāmuvāca ha || 33 || devakyāḥ saptamaṃ garbhaṃ saṃnikṛṣya mahāmate | vasudevasya bhāryāyāṃ kaṃsatrāsabhayātpunaḥ || 34 || nandavraje sthitāyāṃ ca rohiṇyāṃ sanniveśaya | naṃdapatnyāṃ bhava tvaṃ vai kṛtvedaṃ karma cādbhutam || 35 || śrīnārada uvāca śrutvā brahmā devagaṇairnatvā kṛṣṇaṃ parātparām | bhūmimāśvāsya vāṇībhiḥ svadhāma ca samāyayau || 36 || paripūrṇatamaṃ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇaṃ viddhi maithila | kaṃsādīnāṃ vadhārthāya prāptoyaṃ bhūmimaṇḍale || 37 || romamātratanau jivhā bhavaṃtvitthaṃ yadā nṛpa | tadāpi śrīharestasya varṇyate na guṇo mahān || 38 || nabhaḥ patanti vihagā yathā hyātmasamaṃ nṛpa | tathā kṛṣṇagatiṃ divyāṃ vadantīha vipaścitaḥ || 39 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde avatāravyavasthā nāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||
<1.6> śrībahulāśva uvāca kaṃsaḥ ko'yaṃ daityo mahābalaparākramaḥ | tasya janmāni karmāṇi brūhi devarṣisattama || 1 || śrīnārada uvāca samudramathane pūrvaṃ kālanemirmahāsuraḥ | yuyudhe viṣṇunā sārddhaṃ yuddhe tena hato balāt || 2 || śukreṇa jīvitastatra saṃjīvinyā ca vidyayā | punarviṣṇuṃ yoddhukāma udyogaṃ manasākarot || 3 || tapastepe tadā daityo mandarācalasannidhau | nityaṃ dūrvārasaṃ pītvā bhajandevaṃ pitāmaham || 4 || divyeṣu śatavarṣeṣu vyatīteṣu pitāmahaḥ | asthiśeṣaṃ savalmīkaṃ varaṃ brūhītyuvāca tam || 5 || brahmāṇḍe ye sthitā devā viṣṇumūlā mahābalāḥ | teṣāṃ hastairna me mṛtyuḥ pūrṇānāmapi mā bhavet || 6 || brahmovāca durlabho'yaṃ varo daitya yastvayā prārthitaḥ paraḥ | kālāntare te prāptaḥ syānmadvākyaṃ na mṛṣā bhavet || 7 || śrīnārada uvāca kaumāre'pi mahāmallaiḥ satataṃ sa yuyodha ha | ugrasenasya patnyāṃ kau janma lebhe'suraḥ punaḥ || 8 || jarāsaṃdho magadheṃdro digjayāya vinirgataḥ | yamunānikaṭe tasya śibiro'bhūditastataḥ || 9 || dvipaḥ kuvalayāpīḍaḥ sahsradvipasattvabhūt | babhañja śrṛṅkhalāsaṅghaṃ dudrāva śibirānmadī || 10 || nipātayansa śibirāngṛhāṃśca bhūbhṛtastaṭān | raṃgabhūmyāmājagāma yatra kaṃso'pyayudhyata || 11 || palāyiteṣu malleṣu kaṃsastaṃ tu samāgatam | śuṇḍāśuṇḍe saṅgṛhītvā pātayāmāsa bhūtale || 12 || punargṛhītvā hastābhyāṃ bhrāmayitvograsenajaḥ | jarāsandhasya senāyāṃ cikṣepa śatayojanam || 13 || tadadbhutaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā prasanno magadheśvaraḥ | astiprāptī dadau kanye tasmai kaṃsāya śaṃsite || 14 || aśvārbudaṃ hastilakṣaṃ rathānāṃ ca trilakṣakam | ayutaṃ caiva dāsīnāṃ pāribarhaṃ jarāsutaḥ || 15 || dvaṃdvayodhī tataḥ kaṃso bhujavīryamadoddhataḥ | māhiṣmatīṃ yayau vīro'thaikākī caṇḍavikramaḥ || 16 || cāṇūro muṣṭikaḥ kūṭaḥ śalastośalakastathā | māhiṣmatīpateḥ putrā mallā yuddhajayaiṣiṇaḥ || 17 || kaṃsastānāha sāmnāpi dīyadhvaṃ raṃgameva he | ahaṃ dāso bhaveyaṃ vo bhavaṃto jayino yadi || 18 || ahaṃ jayī cedbhavato dāsānsarvānkaromyaham | sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ teṣāṃ nāgarāṇāṃ mahātmanām || 19 || iti pratijñāṃ kṛtvātha yuyudhe tairjayaiṣibhiḥ | yadāgataṃ sa cāṇūraṃ gṛhītvā yādaveśvaraḥ || 20 || bhūpṛṣṭhe pothayāmāsa śabdamuccaiḥ samuccaran | tadā''yāntaṃ muṣṭikākhyaṃ muṣṭibhiryudhi nirgatam || 21 || ekena muṣṭinā taṃ vai pātayāmāsa bhūtale | kūṭaṃ samāgataṃ kaṃso gṛhītvā pādayośca tam || 22 || bhujamāsphoṭya dhāvantaṃ śalaṃ nītvā bhujena saḥ | pātayitvā punarnītvā bhūmiṃ taṃ vicakarṣa ha || 23 || atha tośalakaṃ kaṃso gṛhītvā bhujayorbalāt | nipātya bhūmāvutthāpya cikṣepa daśayojanam || 24 || dāsabhāve ca tānkṛtvā taiḥ sārddhaṃ yādaveśvaraḥ | madvākyena yayāvāśu pravarṣaṇagiriṃ varam || 25 || tasmai nivedyābhiprāyaṃ yuyudhe vānareṇa saḥ | dvividenāpi viṃśatyā dinaiḥ kaṃso hyaviśramam || 26 || dvivido girimutpāṭya cikṣepa tasya mūrddhani | kaṃso giriṃ gṛhītvā ca tasyopari samākṣipat || 27 || dvivido muṣṭinā kaṃsaṃ ghātayitvā nabho gataḥ | dhāvankaṃsaśca taṃ nītvā pātayāmāsa bhūtale || 28 || mūrchitastatprahāreṇa paraṃ kalmaṣamāyayau | kṣīṇasattvaścūrṇito'sthidāsabhāvaṃ gatastadā || 29 || tenaivātha gataḥ kaṃsaḥ ṛṣyamūkavanaṃ tataḥ | tatra keśī mahādaityo hayarūpo ghanasvanaḥ || 30 || muṣṭibhistāḍayitvā taṃ vaśīkṛtyāruroha tam | itthaṃ kaṃso mahāvīryo maheṃdrākhyaṃ giriṃ yayau || 31 || śatavāraṃ cojjahāra girimutpāṭya daityarāṭ | punastatra sthitaṃ rāmaṃ krodhasaṃraktalocanam || 32 || pralayārkaprabhaṃ dṛṣṭvā nanāma śirasā munim | punaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tadaṃghryornipapāta ha || 33 || tataḥ śānto bhārgavo'pi kaṃsaṃ prāha mahogradṛk | he kīṭamarkaṭīḍiṃbha tuccho'si maśako yathā || 34 || adyaiva tvāṃ hanmi duṣṭa kṣatriyaṃ vīryamāninam | matsamīpe dhanuridaṃ lakṣabhārasamaṃ mahat || 35 || idaṃ ca viṣṇunā dattaṃ śaṃbhave traipure yudhi | śaṃbhoḥ karādiha prāptaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ vadhāya ca || 36 || yadi cedaṃ tanoṣi tvaṃ tadā ca kuśalaṃ bhavet | cedasya karṣaṇaṃ na syādghātayiṣyāmi te balam || 37 || śrutvā vacastadā daityaḥ kodaṇḍaṃ saptatālakam | gṛhītvā paśyatastasya sajjaṃ kṛtvātha līlayā || 38 || ākṛṣya karṇaparyaṃtaṃ śatavāraṃ tatāna ha | pratyañcāsphoṭanenaiva ṭaṅkāro'bhūttaḍitsvanaḥ || 39 || nanāda tena brahmāṇḍaṃ sapta lokairbilaiḥ saha | vicelurdiggajāstārā hyapatan bhūmimaṃḍale || 40 || dhanuḥ saṃsthāpya tatkaṃso natvā natvāha bhārgavam | he deva kṣatriyo nāsmi daityo'haṃ te ca kiṃkaraḥ || 41 || tava dāsasya dāso'haṃ pāhi māṃ puruṣottama | śrutvā prasannaḥ śrīrāmastasmai prādāddhanuśca tat || 42 || śrījāmadagnya uvāca yatkodaṇḍaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tadyena bhaṃgībhaviṣyati | paripūrṇatamo nātra so'pi tvāṃ ghātayiṣyati || 43 || śrīnārada uvāca atha natvā muniṃ kaṃso vicaransa madonmadaḥ | na ke'pi yuyudhustena rājānaśca baliṃ daduḥ || 44 || samudrasya taṭe kaṃso daityaṃ nāmnā hyaghāsuram | sarpākāraṃ ca phītkārairlelihānaṃ dadarśa ha || 45 || āgacchantaṃ daśantaṃ ca gṛhītvā taṃ nipātya saḥ | cakāra svagale hāraṃ nirbhayo daityarāḍ balī || 46 || prācyāṃ tu baṃgadeśeṣu daityo'riṣṭo mahāvṛṣaḥ | tena sārddhaṃ sa yuyudhe gajenāpi gajo yathā || 47 || śṛṅgābhyāṃ parvatānuccāṃścikṣepa kaṃsamūrddhani | kaṃso giriṃ saṃgṛhītvā cākṣipattasya mastake || 48 || jaghāna muṣṭināriṣṭaṃ kaṃso vai daityapuṃgavaḥ | mūrcchitaṃ taṃ vinirjitya tenodīcīṃ diśaṃ gataḥ || 49 || prāgjyotiṣeśvaraṃ bhaumaṃ narakākhyaṃ mahābalam | uvāca kaṃso yuddhārthī yuddhaṃ me dehi daityarāṭ || 50 || ahaṃ dāso bhaveyaṃ vo bhavanto jayino yadi | ahaṃ jayo cedbhavato dāsānsarvānkaromyaham || 51 || śrīnārada uvāca pūrvaṃ pralaṃbo yuyudhe kaṃsenāpi mahābalaḥ | mṛgendreṇa mṛgendro'drāvudbhaṭena yathodbhaṭaḥ || 52 || mallayuddhe gṛhītvā taṃ kaṃso bhūmau nipātya ca | punargṛhītvā cikṣepa prāgjyotiṣapuraṃ prati || 53 || āgato dhenuko nāmnā kaṃsaṃ jagrāha roṣataḥ | nodayāmāsa dūreṇa balaṃ kṛtvā'tha dāruṇam || 54 || kaṃsastaṃ nodayāmāsa dhenukaṃ śatayojanam | nipātya cūrṇayāmāsa tadaṅgaṃ muṣṭibhirdṛḍhaiḥ || 55 || tṛṇāvarto bhaumavākyātkaṃsaṃ nītvā nabho gataḥ | tatraiva yuyudhe daitya ūrdhvaṃ vai lakṣayojanam || 56 || kaṃso'nantabalaṃ kṛtvā daityaṃ nītvā tadāmbarāt | bhūmau sa pātayāmāsa bamantaṃ rudhiraṃ mukhāt || 57 || tuṇḍenātha grasantaṃ ca bakaṃ daityaṃ mahābalam | kaṃso nipātayāmāsa muṣṭinā vajraghātinā || 58 || utthāya daityo balavān sitapakṣo ghanasvanaḥ | krodhayuktaḥ samutpatya tīkṣṇatuṇḍo'grasacca tam || 59 || nigīrṇo'pi sa vajrāṅgo tadgale rodhakṛcca yaḥ | sadyaścaccharda taṃ kaṃsaṃ kṣatakaṇṭho mahābakaḥ || 60 || kaṃso bakaṃ saṃgṛhītvā pātayitvā mahītale | karābhyāṃ bhrāmayitvā ca yuddhe taṃ vicakarṣa ha || 61 || tatsvasāraṃ pūtanākhyāṃ yoddhukamāmavasthitām | tāmāha kaṃsaḥ prahasanvākyaṃ me śṛṇu pūtane || 62 || striyā sārdhamahaṃ yuddhaṃ na karomi kadācana | bakāsuraḥ syānme bhrātā tvaṃ ca me bhaginī bhava || 63 || tato'nantabalaṃ kaṃsaṃ vīkṣya bhaumo'pi dharṣitaḥ | cakāra sauhṛdaṃ kaṃse sāhāyyārthaṃ surānprati || 64 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde kaṃsabalavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭo'dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||
<1.7> atha kaṃsaḥ pralaṃbādyairanyaiḥ pūrvaṃ jitaiśca taiḥ | śaṃbarasya puraṃ prāgātsvābhiprāyaṃ nyavedayat || 1 || śaṃbaro hyativīryo'pi na yuyodha sa tena vai | cakāra sauhṛdaṃ kaṃse sarvairatibalaiḥ saha || 2 || triśṛṅgaśikhare śete vyomo nāmā'suro balī | kaṃsapādaprabuddho'bhūtkrodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ || 3 || kaṃsaṃ jaghāna cotthāya prabalairdṛḍhamuṣṭibhiḥ | tayoryuddhamabhūdghoramitaretaramuṣṭibhiḥ || 4 || kaṃsasya muṣṭibhiḥ so'pi niḥsattvo'bhūdbhramāturaḥ | bhṛtyaṃ kṛtvātha taṃ kasaḥ prāptaṃ māṃ praṇanāma ha || 5 || he deva yuddhakāṃkṣo'smi kva yāmi tvaṃ vadāśu me | provāca taṃ tadā gaccha daitya bāṇaṃ mahābalam || 6 || preritaśceti kaṃsākhyo mayā yuddhadidṛkṣuṇā | bhujavīryamadonnaddhaḥ śoṇitākhyaṃ puraṃ yayau || 7 || bāṇāsurastatpratijñāṃ śrutvā kruddho hyabhūnmahān | tatāḍa lattāṃ bhūmadhye jagarja ghanavadbalī || 8 || ājānubhūmigāṃ lattāṃ pātālāṃtamupāgatām | kṛtvā tamāha bāṇastu pūrvaṃ caināṃ samuddhara || 9 || śrṛtvā vacaḥ karābhyāṃ tāmujjahāra madotkaṭaḥ | pracaṃḍavikramaḥ kaṃsaḥ kharadaṇḍaṃ gajau yathā || 10 || tayā coddhṛtayotkhātā lokāḥ saptatalā dṛḍhāḥ | nipeturgirayo'nekā vicelurdṛḍhadiggajāḥ || 11 || yoddhuṃ tamudyataṃ bāṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā''gatya vṛṣadhvajaḥ | sarvānsaṃbodhayāmāsa provāca balinandanam || 12 || kṛṣṇaṃ vināparaṃ cainaṃ bhūmau ko'pi na jeṣyati | bhārgaveṇa varaṃ dattaṃ dhanurasmai ca vaiṣṇavam || 13 || śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā sauhṛdaṃ hṛdyaṃ sadyo vai kaṃsabāṇayoḥ | cakāra parayā śāntyā śivaḥ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ || 14 || atha kaṃso dikpratīcyāṃ śrutvā vatsaṃ mahāsuram | tena sārddhaṃ sa yuyudhe vatsarūpeṇa daityarāṭ || 15 || pucche gṛhītvā taṃ vatsaṃ pothayāmāsa bhūtale | vaśe kṛtvātha taṃ śailaṃ mlecchadeśāṃstato yayau || 16 || manmukhātkālayavanaḥ śrutvā daityaṃ mahābalam | niryayau saṃmukhe yoddhuṃ raktaśmaśrurgadādharaḥ || 17 || kaṃso gadāṃ gṛhītvā svāṃ lakṣabhāravinirmitām | prākṣipadyavanendrāya siṃhanādamathākarot || 18 || gadāyuddhamabhūdghoraṃ tadā hi kaṃsakālayoḥ | visphuliṃgān kṣaraṃtyau dve gade cūrṇībabhūvatuḥ || 19 || kaṃsaḥ kālaṃ saṃgṛhītvā pātayāmāsa bhūtale | punargṛhītvā niṣpātya mṛtatulyaṃ cakāra ha || 20 || bāṇavarṣaṃ prakurvantīṃ senāṃ tāṃ yavanasya ca | gadayā pothayāmāsa kaṃso daityādhipo balī || 21 || gajāṃsturagānsurathānvīrān bhūmau nipātya ca | jagarja ghanavadvīro gadāyuddhe mṛdhāṅgaṇe || 22 || tataśca dudruvurmlecchāstyaktvā svaṃ svaṃ raṇaṃ param | bhītān palāyitān mlecchānna jaghānātha nītimān || 23 || uccapādo dīrghajānuḥ staṃbhorurlaghimā kaṭiḥ | kapāṭavakṣāḥ pīnāṃsaḥ puṣṭaḥ prāṃśurbṛhadbhujaḥ || 24 || padmanetro bṛhatkeśo'ruṇavarṇo'sitāmbaraḥ | kirīṭī kuṃḍalī hārī padmamālī layārkaruk || 25 || khaḍgī niṣaṃgī kavacī mudgarāḍhyo dhanurdharaḥ | madotkaṭo yayau jetuṃ devānkaṃso'marāvatīm || 26 || cāṇūramuṣṭikāriṣṭaśalatośalakeśibhiḥ | pralaṃbena bakenāpi dvividena samāvṛtaḥ || 27 || tṛṇāvarttāghakūṭaiśca bhaumabāṇākhyaśaṃbaraiḥ | vyomadhenukavatsaiśca rurudhe so'marāvatīm || 28 || kaṃsādīnāgatāndṛṣṭvā śakro devādhipaḥ svarāṭ | sarvairdevaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ yoddhuṃ kṛddho viniryayau || 29 || tayoryuddhamabhūdghoraṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam | divyaiśca śastrasaṃghātairbāṇaistīkṣṇaiḥ sphuratprabhaiḥ || 30 || śastrāndhakāre saṃjāte rathārūḍho maheśvaraḥ | cikṣepa vajraṃ kaṃsāya śatadhāraṃ taḍiddyuti || 31 || mudgareṇāpi tadvajraṃ tatāḍāśu mahāsuraḥ | papāta kuliśaṃ yuddhe chinnadhāraṃ babhūva ha || 32 || tyaktvā vajraṃ tadā vajrī khaḍgaṃ jagrāha roṣataḥ | kaṃsaṃ mūrdhni tatāḍāśu nādaṃ kṛtvā'tha bhairavam || 33 || sa kṣato nābhavatkaṃso mālāhata iva dvipaḥ | gṛhītvā sa gadāṃ gurvīmaṣṭadhātumayīṃ dṛḍhām || 34 || lakṣabhārasamāṃ kaṃsaścikṣependrāya daityarāṭ | tāṃ samāpatatīṃ vīkṣya jagrāhāśu puraṃdaraḥ || 35 || tataścikṣepa daityāya vīro namucisūdanaḥ | cacāra yuddhe vidalannarīnmātalisārathiḥ || 36 || kaṃso gṛhītvā parighaṃ tatāḍāṃse'suradviṣaḥ | tatprahāreṇa devendraḥ kṣaṇaṃ mūrcchāmavāpa saḥ || 37 || kaṃsaṃ marudgaṇāḥ sarve gṛdhrapakṣaiḥ sphuratprabhaiḥ | bāṇaughaiśchādayāmāsurvarṣāsūryamivāṃbudaḥ || 38 || doḥsahasrayuto vīraścāpaṃ ṭaṃkārayanmuhuḥ | tadā tānkālayāmāsa bāṇairbāṇāsuro balī || 39 || bāṇaṃ ca vasavo rudrā ādityā ṛbhavaḥ surāḥ | jaghnurnānāvidhaiḥ śastraiḥ sarvato'driṃ samāgatāḥ || 40 || tato bhaumāsuraḥ prāptaḥ pralaṃbādyasurairnadan | tena nādena devāste nipeturmūrchitā raṇe || 41 || utthāyāśu tadā śakro jagāmāruhya tattvadṛk | nodayāmāsa kaṃsāya mattamairāvataṃ gajam || 42 || aṃkuśāsphālanāt kruddhaṃ pātayantaṃ padairdviṣaḥ | śuṇḍādaṇḍasya phūtkārairmardayantamitastataḥ || 43 || sravanmadaṃ caturdantaṃ himādrimiva durgamam | nadantaṃ śṛṅkhalāṃ śuṇḍāṃ cālayantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 44 || ghaṭāḍhyaṃ kiṃkiṇījālaratnakaṃbalamaṇḍitam | gomūtracayasindūrakastūrīpatrabhṛnmukham || 45 || dṛḍhena muṣṭinā kaṃsastaṃ tatāḍa mahāgajam | dvitīyamuṣṭinā śakraṃ sa jaghāna raṇāṅgaṇe || 46 || tasya muṣṭiprahāreṇa dūre śakraḥ papāta ha | jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ spṛṣṭvā gajo'pi vihvalo'bhavat || 47 || punarutthāya nāgendro dantaiścāhatya daityapam | śuṇḍādaṇḍena coddhṛtya cikṣepa lakṣayojanam || 48 || patito'pi sa vajrāṃgaḥ kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ | sphuradoṣṭho'tiruṣṭāṅgo yuddhabhūmiṃ samāyayau || 49 || kaṃso gṛhītvā nāgendraṃ saṃnipātya raṇāṃgaṇe | niṣpīḍya śūṇḍāṃ tasyāpi dantāṃścūrṇīcakāra ha || 50 || atha cairāvato nāgo dudrāvāśu raṇāṅgaṇāt | nipātayanmahāvīrān devadhānīṃ purīṃ gataḥ || 51 || gṛhītvā vaiṣṇavaṃ cāpaṃ sajjaṃ kṛtvātha daityarāṭ | devānvidrāyāmāsa bāṇaughaiśca dhanuḥsvanaiḥ || 52 || tataḥ surāstena nihanyamānā vidudruvurlīnadhiyo diśānte | kecidraṇe muktaśikhā babhūvurbhītāḥ sma itthaṃ yudhi vādinaste || 53 || kecittathā prāṃjalayo'tidīnavatsaṃnyastaśastrā yudhi muktakacchāḥ | sthātuṃ raṇe kaṃsanṛdevasaṃmukhe gatepsitāḥ kecidatīva vihvalāḥ || 54 || itthaṃ sa devānpragatānnirīkṣya tān nītvā ca siṃhāsanamātapatravat | sarvaistadā daityagaṇairjanādhipaḥ svarājadhānīṃ mathurāṃ samāyayau || 55 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde kaṃsadigvijayavarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||
<1.8> śrutvā tadā śaunaka bhaktiyuktaḥ śrīmaithilo jñānabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaḥ | natvā punaḥ prāha muniṃ mahādbhutaṃ devarṣivaryaṃ haribhaktiniṣṭhaḥ || 1 || bahulāśva uvāca tvayā kulaṃ kau viśadīkṛtaṃ me svānaṃdadoryadyaśasāmalena | śrīkṛṣṇabhaktakṣaṇasaṃgamena jano'pi satsyādbahunā kumusvit || 2 || śrīrādhayā pūrṇatamastu sākṣādgatvā vraje kiṃ caritaṃ cakāra | tadbrūhi me devaṛṣe ṛṣīśa tritāpaduḥkhātparipāhi māṃ tvam || 3 || śrīnārada uvāca dhanyaṃ kulaṃ yanniminā nṛpeṇa śrīkṛṣṇabhaktena parātpareṇa | pūrṇīkṛtaṃ yatra bhavānprajāto śuktau hi muktābhavanaṃ na citram || 4 || atha prabhostasya pavitralīlāṃ sumaṅgalāṃ saṃśṛṇutāṃ parasya | abhūtsatāṃ yo bhuvi rakṣaṇārthaṃ na kevalaṃ kaṃsavadhāya kṛṣṇaḥ || 5 || athaiva rādhāṃ vṛṣabhānupatnyāmāveśya rūpaṃ mahasaḥ parākhyam | kalindajākūlanikuñjadeśe sumandire sāvatatāra rājan || 6 || ghanāvṛte vyomni dinasya madhye bhādre site nāgatithau ca some | avākirandevagaṇāḥ sphuradbhistanmandire nandanajaiḥ prasūnaiḥ || 7 || rādhāvatāreṇa tadā babhūvurnadyo'malābhāśca diśaḥ praseduḥ | vavuśca vātā aravindarāgaiḥ suśītalāḥ sundaramandayānāḥ || 8 || sutāṃ śaraccandraśatābhirāmāṃ dṛṣṭvā'tha kīrtirmudamāpa gopī | śubhaṃ vidhāyāśu dadau dvijebhyo dvilakṣamānandakaraṃ gavāṃ ca || 9 || preṅkhe khacidratnamayūkhapūrṇe suvarṇayukte kṛtacandanāṅge | āndolitā sā vavṛdhe sakhījanairdine dine caṃdrakaleva bhābhiḥ || 10 || yaddarśanaṃ devavaraiḥ sudurlabhaṃ yajñairavāptaṃ janajanmakoṭibhiḥ | savigrahāṃ tāṃ vṛṣabhānumandire lalanti lokā lalanāpralālanaiḥ || 11 || śrīrāsaraṅgasya vikāsacandrikā dīpāvalībhirvṛṣabhānumandire | golokacūḍāmaṇikaṇṭhabhūṣaṇāṃ dhyātvā parāṃ tāṃ bhuvi paryaṭāmyaham || 12 || śrībahulāśva uvāca vṛṣabhānoraho bhāgyaṃ yasya rādhā sutābhavat | kalāvatyā sucandreṇa kiṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvajanmani || 13 || śrīnārada uvāca nṛgaputro mahābhāga sucandro nṛpatīśvaraḥ | cakravartī hareraṃśo babhūvātīva sundaraḥ || 14 || pitṝṇāṃ mānasī kanyāstisro'bhūvanmanoharāḥ | kalāvatī ratnamālā menakā nāma nāmataḥ || 15 || kalāvatīṃ sucandrāya hareraṃśāya dhīmate | vaidehāya ratnamālāṃ menakāṃ ca himādraye | pāribarheṇa vidhinā svecchābhiḥ pitaro daduḥ || 16 || sītābhūdratnamālāyāṃ menakāyāṃ ca pārvatī | dvayoścaritraṃ viditaṃ purāṇeṣu mahāmate || 17 || sucandro'tha kalāvatyā gomatītīraje vane | divyairdvādaśabhirvarṣaistatāpa brahmaṇastapaḥ || 18 || atha vidhistamāgatya varaṃ brūhītyuvāca ha | śrutvā valmīkadeśācca niryayau divyarūpadhṛk || 19 || taṃ natvovāca me bhūyāddivyaṃ mokṣaṃ parātparam | tacchrutvā duḥkhitā sādhvī vidhiṃ prāha kalāvatī || 20 || patireva hi nārīṇāṃ daivataṃ paramaṃ smṛtam | yadi mokṣamasau yāti tadā me kā gatirbhavet || 21 || enaṃ vinā na jīvāmi yadi mokṣaṃ pradāsyasi | tubhyaṃ śāpaṃ pradāsyāmi pativikṣepavihvalā || 22 || śrībrahmovāca tvacchāpādbhayabhīto'haṃ me varo'pi mṛṣā na hi | tasmāttvaṃ prāṇapatinā sārdhaṃ gaccha triviṣṭapam || 23 || bhuktvā sukhāni kālena yuvāṃ bhūmau bhaviṣyathaḥ | gaṃgāyamunayormadhye dvāparānte ca bhārate || 24 || yuvayo rādhikā sākṣātparipūrṇatamapriyā | bhaviṣyati yadā putrī tadā mokṣaṃ gamiṣyathaḥ || 25 || śrīnārada uvāca itthaṃ brahmavareṇātha divyenāmogharūpiṇā | kalāvatīsucandrau ca bhūmau tau dvau babhūvatuḥ || 26 || kalāvatī kānyakubje bhalandananṛpasya ca | jātismarā hyabhūddivyā yajñakuṇḍasamudbhavā || 27 || sucandro vṛṣabhānvākhyaḥ surabhānugṛhe'bhavat | jātismaro gopavaraḥ kāmadeva ivāparaḥ || 28 || sambandhaṃ yojayāmāsa nandarājo mahāmatiḥ | tayośca jātismarayoricchatoricchayā dvayoḥ || 29 || vṛṣabhānoḥ kalāvatyā ākhyānaṃ śṛṇute naraḥ | sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ kṛṣṇasāyujyamāpnuyāt || 30 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīrādhikājanmavarṇanaṃ nāma aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||
<1.9> tatraikadā śrīmathurāpure vare purohitaḥ sarvayadūttamaiḥ kṛtaḥ | śūrecchayā garga iti pramāṇikaḥ samāyayau sundararājamandiram || 1 || hīrākhaciddhemalasatkapāṭakaṃ dvipendrakarṇāhatabhṛṅganāditam | ibhasravannirjharagaṇḍadhārayā samāvṛtaṃ maṇḍapakhaṇḍamaṇḍitam || 2 || mahodbhaṭairdhīrajanaiḥ sakañcukairdhanurdharaiścarma kṛpāṇapāṇibhiḥ | rathadvipāśvadhvajinībalādibhiḥ surakṣitaṃ maṇḍalamaṇḍalībhiḥ || 3 || dadarśa garbho nṛpadevamāhukaṃ śvāphalkinā devakakaṃsasevitam | śrīśakrasiṃhāsana unnate pare sthitaṃ vṛtaṃ chatravitānacāmaraiḥ || 4 || dṛṣṭvā muniṃ taṃ sahasā''sanāśrayādutthāya rājā praṇanāma yādavaiḥ | saṃsthāpya sampūjya subhadrapīṭhake stutvā parikramya nataḥ sthito'bhavat || 5 || dattvā''śiṣaṃ gargamunirnṛpāya vai papraccha sarvaṃ kuśalaṃ nṛpādiṣu | śrīdevakaṃ prāha mahāmanā ṛṣirmahaujasaṃ nītividaṃ yadūttamam || 6 || śrīgarga uvāca śaurīṃ vinā bhuvi nṛpeṣu varastu nāsti cintyo mayā bahudinaiḥ kila yatra tatra | tasmānnṛdeva vasudevavarāya dehi śrīdevakīṃ nijasutāṃ vidhinodvahasva || 7 || śrīnārada uvāca kṛtvā tadaiva puri niścayanāgavallīṃ śrīdevakaṃ sakaladharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaḥ | gargecchayā tu vasudevavarāya putrīṃ kṛtvātha maṅgalamalaṃ pradadau vivāhe || 8 || kṛtodvahaḥ śauriratīva sundaraṃ rathaṃ prayāṇe samalaṅkṛtaṃ hayaiḥ | sārddhaṃ tayā devakarājakanyayā samāruhatkāṃcanaratnaśobhayā || 9 || svasuḥ priyaṃ kartumatīva kaṃso jagrāha raśmīṃścalatāṃ hayānām | uvāha vāhāṃścaturaṃgiṇībhirvṛtaḥ kṛpāsnehaparo'tha śaurau || 10 || dāsīsahasraṃ tvayutaṃ gajānāṃ satpāribarhaṃ niyutaṃ hayānām | lakṣaṃ rathānāṃ ca gavāṃ dvilakṣaṃ prādādduhitre nṛpa devako vai || 11 || bherīmṛdaṃgoddharagomukhānāṃ dhundhuryavīṇānakaveṇukānām | mahatsvano'bhūccalatāṃ yadunāṃ prayāṇakāle pathi maṅgalaṃ ca || 12 || ākāśavāgāha tadaiva kaṃsaṃ tvāmaṣṭamo hi prasavo'ñjasāsyāḥ | hantā na jānāsi ca yāṃ rathasthāṃ raśmīn gṛhītvā vahase'budhastvam || 13 || kusaṃganiṣṭho'tikhalo hi kaṃso haṃtuṃ svasāraṃ dhiṣaṇāṃ cakāra | kace gṛhītvā śitakhaḍgapāṇirgatatrapo nirdaya ugrakarmā || 14 || vāditrakārā rahitā babhūvuragre sthitāḥ syuścakitā hi paścāt | sarveṣu vā śvetamukheṣu satsu śauristamāhā''śu satāṃ variṣṭhaḥ || 15 || śrīvasudeva uvāca bhojendra bhojakulakīrtikarastvameva bhaumādimāgadhabakāsuravatsabāṇaiḥ | ślāghyā guṇāstava yudhi pratiyoddhukāmaiḥ sa tvaṃ kathaṃ tu bhaginīmasinātra hanyāḥ || 16 || jñātvā striyaṃ kila bakīṃ pratiyoddhukāmāṃ yuddhaṃ kṛtaṃ na bhavatā nṛpanītivṛttyā | sā tu tvayāpi bhaginīva kṛtā praśāṃtyai sākṣādiyaṃ tu bhaginī kimu te vicārāt || 17 || udvāhaparvaṇi gatā ca tavānujā ca bālā suteva kṛpaṇā śubhadā sadaiṣā | yogyo'si nātra mathurādhipa haṃtumenāṃ tvaṃ dīnaduḥkhaharaṇe kṛtacittavṛttiḥ || 18 || śrīnārada uvāca nāmanyatetthaṃ pratibodhito'pi kusaṅganiṣṭho'tikhalo hi kaṃsaḥ | tadā hareḥ kālagatiṃ vicārya śauriḥ prapannaṃ punarāha kaṃsam || 19 || śrīvasudeva uvāca nāsyāstu te deva bhayaṃ kadācidyaddevavāṇyā kathitaṃ ca tacchṛṇu | putrān dadāmīti yato bhayaṃ syānmā te vyathā'syāḥ prasavaprajātāt || 20 || śrīnārada uvāca śrutvā sa niścitya vaco'tha śaureḥ kaṃsaḥ praśaṃsyā''śu gṛhaṃ gato'bhūt | śauristadā devakarājaputryā bhayāvṛtaḥ san gṛhamājagāma || 21 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde vasudevavivāhavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||
<1.10> śrīnārada uvāca bhītaḥ palāyate nāyaṃ yoddhāraḥ kaṃsanoditāḥ | ayutaṃ śastrasaṃyuktā rurudhuḥ śaurimaṃdiram || 1 || śauriḥ kālena devakyāmaṣṭau putrānajījanat | anuvarṣaṃ cātha kanyāmekāṃ māyāṃ sanātanīm || 2 || kīrtimantaṃ sutaṃ hyādau jātamānakadundubhiḥ | nītvā kaṃsaṃ samabhyetya dadau tasmai parārthavit || 3 || satyavākyasthitaṃ śauriṃ kaṃso ghṛṇī hyabhūt | duḥkhaṃ sādhurna sahate satye kasya kṣamā na hi || 4 || kaṃsa uvāca eṣa bālo yātu gṛhametasmānna hi me bhayam | yuvayoraṣṭamaṃ garbhaṃ haniṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 5 || śrīnārada uvāca ityukto vasudevastu saputro gṛhamāgataḥ | satyaṃ nāmanyata manāgvākyaṃ tasya durātmanaḥ || 6 || tadāmbarādāgataṃ māṃ natvā pūjyograsenajaḥ | prapaccha devābhiprāyaṃ prāvocaṃ taṃ nibodha me || 7 || naṃdādyā vasavaḥ sarve vṛṣabhānvādayaḥ surāḥ | gopyo vedaṛcādyāśca saṃti bhūmau nṛpeśvara || 8 || vasudevādayo devā mathurāyāṃ ca vṛṣṇayaḥ | devakyādyāḥ striyaḥ sarvā devatāḥ santi niścayaḥ || 9 || saptavāraprasaṃkhyānādaṣṭamāḥ sarva eva hi | te hantuḥ saṃkhyayā'yaṃ vā devānāṃ vāmato gatiḥ || 10 || śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā taṃ mayi gate kṛtadaityavadhodyame | kaṃsaḥ kopāvṛtaḥ sadyo yadūn haṃtuṃ mano dadhe || 11 || vasudevaṃ devakīṃ ca baddhvā'tha nigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ | mamarda taṃ śilāpṛṣṭhe devakīgarbhajaṃ śiśum || 12 || jātismaro viṣṇubhayājjātaṃ jātaṃ jaghāna ha | iti duṣṭavibhāvācca bhūmau bhūtaṃ hyasaṃśayam || 13 || ugrasenastadā kruddho yādavendro nṛpeśvaraḥ | vārayāmāsa kaṃsākhyaṃ vasudevasahāyakṛt || 14 || kaṃsasya durabhiprāyaṃ dṛṣṭvottasthurmahābhaṭāḥ | ugrasenānugā rakṣāṃ cakruste khaḍgapāṇayaḥ || 15 || ugrasenānugāndṛṣṭvā kaṃsavīrāḥ samutthitāḥ | taiḥ sārddhamabhavadyuddhaṃ sabhāmaṃḍapamadhyataḥ || 16 || dvāradeśe'pi vīrāṇāṃ yuddhaṃ jātaṃ parasparam | khaḍgaprahārairayutaṃ janānāṃ nidhanaṃ gatam || 17 || kaṃso gṛhītvātha gadāṃ pituḥ senāṃ mamarda ha | kaṃsasya gadayā spṛṣṭvā kecicchinnalalāṭakāḥ || 18 || bhinnapādā bhinnamukhāśchinnāśāśchinnabāhavaḥ | adhomukhā ūrdhvamukhāḥ saśastrāḥ patitāḥ kṣaṇāt || 19 || vamanto rudhiraṃ vīrā mūrchitā nidhanaṃ gatāḥ | sabhāmaṃḍapamāraktaṃ dṛśyate kṣatajasravāt || 20 || itthaṃ madotkaṭaḥ kaṃsaḥ saṃnipātyodbhaṭān ripūn | krodhāḍhyo rājarājendraṃ jagrāha pitaraṃ khalaḥ || 21 || nṛpāsanātsaṃgṛhītvā baddhvā pāśaiśca taṃ khalaḥ | tanmitraiśca nṛpaiḥ sārddhaṃ kārāgāre rurodha ha || 22 || madhūnāṃ śūrasenānāṃ deśānāṃ sarvasaṃpadām | siṃhāsane copaviśya svayaṃ rājyaṃ cakāra ha || 23 || pīḍitā yādavāḥ sarve saṃbaṃdhasya miṣaistvaram | caturdiśāntaraṃ deśān viviśuḥ kālavedinaḥ || 24 || devakyāḥ saptame garbhe harṣaśokavivarddhane | vrajaṃ praṇīte rohiṇyāmanante yogamāyayā || 25 || aho garbhaḥ kva vigata ityūcurmāthurā janāḥ || 26 || atha vraje paṃcadineṣu bhādre svātau ca ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca site budhe ca | uccairgṛhaiḥ paṃcabhirāvṛte ca lagne tulā''khye dinamadhyadeśe || 27 || sureṣu varṣatsu supuṣpavarṣaṃ ghaneṣu muṃcatsu ca vāribindūn | babhūva devo vasudevapatnyāṃ vibhāsayannandagṛhaṃ svabhāsā || 28 || naṃdo'pi kurvan śiśujātakarma dadau dvijebhyo niyutaṃ gavāṃ ca | gopān samāhūya sugāyakānāṃ rāvairmahāmaṃgalamātanoti || 29 || dvaipāyano devaladevarātavasiṣṭhavācaspatibhirmayā ca | āgatya tatraiva samāsthito'bhūtpādyādibhirnandakṛtaiḥ prasannaḥ || 30 || naṃdarāja uvāca suṃdaro bālakaḥ ko'yaṃ na dṛśyo yatsamaḥ kvacit | kathaṃ paṃcadinājjātastanme brūhi mahāmune || 31 || śrīvyāsa uvāca ahobhāgyaṃ tu te naṃda śiśuḥ śeṣaḥ sanātanaḥ | devakyāṃ vasudevasya jāto'yaṃ mathurāpure || 32 || kṛṣṇecchayā tadudarātpraṇīto rohiṇīṃ śubhām | naṃdarāja tvayā dṛśyo durlabho yogināmapi || 33 || taddarśanārthaṃ prāpto'haṃ vedavyāso mahāmuniḥ | tasmāttvaṃ darśayāsmākaṃ śiśurūpaṃ parātparam || 34 || śrīnārada uvāca atha naṃdaḥ śiśuṃ śeṣaṃ darśayāmāsa vismitaḥ | dṛṣṭvā preṃkhasthitaṃ prāha natvā satyavatīsutaḥ || 35 || śrīvyāsa uvāca devādhideva bhagavankāmapāla namo'stu te | namo'nantāya śeṣāya sākṣādrāmāya te namaḥ || 36 || dharādharāya pūrṇāya svadhāmne sīrapāṇaye | sahasraśirase nityaṃ namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya te || 37 || revatīramaṇa tvaṃ vai baladevo'cyutāgrajaḥ | halāyudhaḥ pralaṃbaghnaḥ pāhi māṃ puruṣottama || 38 || balāya balabhadrāya tālāṃkāya namo namaḥ | nīlāṃbarāya gaurāya rauhiṇeyāya te namaḥ || 39 || dhenukārirmuṣṭikāriḥ kumbhāṇḍāristvameva hi | rukmyariḥ kūpakarṇāriḥ kūṭārirbalvalāntakaḥ || 40 || kālindībhedano'si tvaṃ hastināpurakarṣakaḥ | dvividāriryādavendro vrajamaṇḍalamaṃḍanaḥ || 41 || kaṃsabhrātṛprahantā'si tīrthayātrākaraḥ prabhuḥ | duryodhanaguruḥ sākṣātpāhi pāhi jagatprabho || 42 || jayajayācyuta deva parātpara svayamananta digantagataśruta | suramunīndraphaṇīndravarāya te musaline baline haline namaḥ || 43 || iha paṭhetsatataṃ stavanaṃ tu yaḥ sa tu hareḥ paramaṃ padamāvrajet | jagati sarvabalaṃ tvarimardanaṃ bhavati tasya jayaḥ svadhanaṃ dhanam || 44 || śrīnārada uvāca balaṃ parikramya śataṃ praṇamya tairdvaipāyano deva parāśarātmajaḥ | viśālabuddhirmunibādarāyaṇaḥ sarasvatīṃ satyavatīsuto yayau || 45 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde balabhadrajanmavarṇanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||
<1.11> śrīnārada uvāca paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavān svayam | viveśa vasudevasya manaḥ pūrvaṃ parātparaḥ || 1 || sūryenduvahnisaṃkāśo vasudevo mahāmanāḥ | babhūvātyantamahasā sākṣādyajña ivāparaḥ || 2 || devakyāmāgate kṛṣṇe sarveṣāmabhayaṃkare | rarāja tena sā gehe ghane saudāminī yathā || 3 || tejovatīṃ ca tāṃ vīkṣya kaṃsaḥ prāha bhayāturaḥ | prāpto'yaṃ prāṇahantā me pūrvameṣā na cedṛśī || 4 || jātamātraṃ haniṣyāmītyuktvā''ste bhayavihvalaḥ | paśyansarvatra ca hariṃ pūrvaśatruṃ vicintayan || 5 || aho vairānubandhena sākṣātkṛṣṇo'pi dṛśyate | tasmādvairaṃ prakurvanti kṛṣṇaprāptyarthamāsurāḥ || 6 || atha brahmādayo devā munīndrairasmadādibhiḥ | śaurigehopari prāptāḥ stavaṃ cakruḥ praṇamya tam || 7 || devā ūcuḥ yajjāgarādiṣu bhaveṣu paraṃ hyaheturhetuḥ svidasya vicaranti guṇāśrayeṇa | naitadviśanti mahadindriyadevasaṃghāstasmai namo'gnimiva vistṛtavisphuliṃgāḥ || 8 || naiveśituṃ prabhurayaṃ balināṃ balīyān māyā na śabda uta no viṣayīkaroti | tadbrahma pūrṇamamṛtaṃ paramaṃ praśāntaṃ śuddhaṃ parātparataraṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ smaḥ || 9 || aṃśāṃśakāṃśakakalādyavatāravṛndairāveśapūrṇasahitaiśca parasya yasya | sargādayaḥ kila bhavanti tameva kṛṣṇaṃ pūrṇātparaṃ tu paripūrṇatamaṃ natāḥ smaḥ || 10 || manvantareṣu ca yugeṣu gatāgateṣu kalpeṣu cāṃśakalayā svavapurbibharṣi | adyaiva dhāma paripūrṇatamaṃ tanoṣi dharmaṃ vidhāya bhuvi maṃgalamātanoṣi || 11 || yaddurlabhaṃ viśadayogibhirapyagamyaṃ gamyaṃ dravadbhiramalāśayabhaktiyogaiḥ | ānaṃdakaṃda caratastava mandayānaṃ pādāravindamakarandarajo dadhāmaḥ || 12 || pūrvaṃ tathātra kamanīyavapuṣmayaṃ tvāṃ kaṃdarpakoṭiśatamohanamadbhutaṃ ca | golokadhāmadhiṣaṇadyutimādadhānaṃ rādhāpatiṃ dharaṇidhuryadhanaṃ dadhāmaḥ || 13 || śrīnārada uvāca natvā hariṃ tadā devā brahmādyā munibhiḥ saha | gāyantastaṃ praśaṃsantaḥ svadhāmāni yayurmudā || 14 || atha maithilarājendra janmakāle hareḥ sati | aṃbaraṃ nirmalaṃ bhūtaṃ nirmalāśca diśo daśa || 15 || ujjvalāstārakā jātāḥ prasannaṃ bhūmimaṃḍalam | nadā nadyaḥ samudrāśca prasannāpaḥ sarovarāḥ || 16 || sahasradalapadmāni śatapatrāṇi sarvataḥ | vicakāni marutsparśaiḥ patadgandhirajāṃsi ca || 17 || teṣu nedurmadhukarā nadantaścitrapakṣiṇaḥ | śītalā mandayānāśca gaṃdhāktā vāyavo vavuḥ || 18 || ṛddhā janapadā grāmā nagarā maṃgalāyanāḥ | devā viprā nagā gāvo babhūvuḥ sukhasaṃvṛtāḥ || 19 || devadundubhayo nedurjayadhvanisamākulāḥ | yatra tatra mahārāja sarveṣāṃ maṃgalaṃ param || 20 || vidyādharāśca gaṃdharvāḥ siddhakinnaracāraṇāḥ | jaguḥ sunāyakā devāstuṣṭuvuḥ stutibhiḥ param || 21 || nanṛturdivi gandharvā vidyādharyyo mudānvitāḥ | pārijātakamandāramālatīsumanāṃsi ca || 22 || mumucurdevamukhyāśca garjantaśca ghanā jale | bhādre budhe kṛṣṇapakṣe dhātrarkṣe harṣaṇe vṛṣe | karṇe'ṣṭamyāmarddharātre nakṣatreśamahodaye || 23 || andhakārāvṛte kāle devakyāṃ śaurimandire | āvirāsīddhariḥ sākṣādaraṇyāmadhvare'gnivat || 24 || sphuradakṣavicitrahāriṇaṃ vilasatkaustubharatnadhāriṇam | paridhidyutinūpurāṃgadaṃ dhṛtabālārkakirīṭakuṃḍalam || 25 || caladadbhutavanhikaṃkaṇaṃ taḍidūrjitaguṇamekhalāñcitam | madhubhṛddhvanipadmamālinaṃ navajāṃbūnadadivyavāsasam || 26 || sataḍitghanadivyasaubhagaṃ calanīlālakavṛndabhṛnmukham | caladaṃśu tamoharaṃ paraṃ śubhadaṃ sundaramaṃbujekṣaṇam || 27 || kṛtapatravicitramaṃḍanaṃ satataṃ koṭimanojamohanam | paripūrṇatamaṃ parātparaṃ kalaveṇudhvanivādyatatparam || 28 || tamavekṣya sutaṃ yadūttamo harijanmotsavaphullalocanaḥ | atha viprajaneṣu cāśu vai niyutaṃ sanmanasā gavāṃ dadau || 29 || harimānakaduṃdubhiḥ stavaiḥ stavanaṃ taṃ praṇipatya vismitaḥ | akaroduditaprabhūdayo gatabhīḥ sūtigṛhe kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 30 || śrīvasudeva uvāca eko yaḥ prakṛtiguṇairanekadhāsi hartā tvaṃ janaka utāsya pālakastvam | nirliptaḥ sphaṭika ivādya dehavarṇaistasmai śrībhuvanapate namāmi tubhyam || 31 || edhaḥsu tvanala ivātra vartamāno yo'ntastho bahirapi cāmbaraṃ yathā hi | ādhāro dharaṇirivāsya sarvasākṣī tasmai te nama iva sarvago nabhasvān || 32 || bhūbhārodbhaṭaharaṇārthameva jāto godevadvijanijavatsapālako'si | gehe me bhuvi puruṣottamottamastvaṃ kaṃsānmāṃ bhuvanapate prapāhi pāpāt || 33 || śrīnārada uvāca paripūrṇatamaṃ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇaṃ śyāmasundaram | jñātvā natvātha taṃ prāha devakī sarvadevatā || 34 || śrīdevakyuvāca he kṛṣṇa he vigaṇitāṇḍapate pareśa golokadhāmadhiṣaṇadhvaja ādideva | pūrṇeśa pūrṇa paripūrṇatama prabho māṃ tvaṃ pāhi parameśvara kaṃsapāpāt || 35 || śrīnārada uvāca tacchrutvā bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam | sasmito devakīṃ śauriṃ prāha sa vṛjinārdanaḥ || 36 || śrībhagavānuvāca iyaṃ ca pṛśniḥ patidevatā ca tvaṃ pūrvasarge sutapā prajārthī | brahmājñayā divyatapo yuvābhyāṃ kṛtaṃ paraṃ nirjalabhojanābhyām || 37 || kāleṣu manvantarake vyatīte tapaḥ paraṃ tattapasaḥ prajārthī | tadā prasanno yuvayorabhūvaṃ varaṃ paraṃ brūta mayā tadoktam || 38 || śrutvā yuvābhyāṃ kathitaṃ tadaiva bhūyātsutastvatsadṛśaḥ kilāvayoḥ | tathāstu coktvātha gate mayi prajāpatī hyabhūta svakṛtena dampatī || 39|| na matsamaḥ ko'pi suto jagatyalaṃ vicārya tadvāmabhavaṃ pareśvaraḥ | śrīpṛśnigarbho bhuvi viśrutaḥ punardvitīyakāle'hamupendravāmanaḥ || 40 || tathā'bhavaṃ hyadyatame parātparo nītvā'tha māṃ prāpaya nandamandiram ato na bhūyādbhayamaugrasenataḥ sutāṃ samādāya sukhī bhaviṣyathaḥ || 41 || śrīnārada uvāca tūṣṇīṃ bhūtvā haristatra tadbhūyaḥ paśyatostayoḥ | dṛśyaṃ hyaprakaṭaṃ kṛtvā bālo'bhūtkau yathā naṭaḥ || 42 || preṃkhe dhṛtvā'tha taṃ śauriryāvadgantuṃ samudyataḥ | tavādvraje nandapatnyāṃ yogamāyā'jani svataḥ || 43 || tayā śayāne viśvasmin rakṣakeṣu svapatsu ca | dvāra udghāṭitāḥ sarvāḥ prasphuṭacchṛṅkhalārgalāḥ || 44 || nirgate vasudeve ca mūrdhni śrīkṛṣṇaśobhite | sūryodaye yathā sadyastamonāśo'bhavatsvataḥ || 45 || ghaneṣu vyomni varṣatsu sahasravadanaḥ svarāṭ | nivārayandīrghaphaṇairāsāraṃ śaurimanvagāt || 46 || ūrmyāvartākulāvegaiḥ siṃhasarpādivāhinī | sadyo mārgaṃ dadau tasmai kālindī saritāṃ varā || 47 || nandavrajaṃ sametyāsau prasuptaṃ sarvataḥ param | śiśuṃ yaśodāśayane nidhāyāśu dadarśa tām || 48 || tatsutāṃ samupādāya punargehājjagāma saḥ | tīrtvā śrīyamunāṃ śauriḥ svāgāre pūrvavatsthitaḥ || 49 || sutaṃ sutāṃ vā jātaṃ cājñātvā gopī yaśomatī | pariśrāntā svaśayane suṣvāpānandanidrayā || 50 || atha bāladhvaniṃ śrutvā rakṣakāḥ samupasthitāḥ | ūcuḥ kaṃsāya vīrāya gatvā tadrājamandiram || 51 || sūtīgṛhaṃ tvaraṃ prāgātkaṃso vai bhayakātaraḥ | svasātha bhrātaraṃ prāha rudatī dīnavatsatī || 52 || śrīdevakyuvāca sutāmekāṃ dehi me tvaṃ putreṣu pramṛteṣu ca | striyaṃ hantuṃ na yogyo'si bhrātastvaṃ dīnavatsalaḥ || 53 || te'nujāhaṃ hatasutā kārāgāre nipātitā | dātumarhasi kalyāṇa kalyāṇīṃ tanujāṃ ca me || 54 || śrīnārada uvāca aśrumukhyā mohitayā samācchādyātmajāṃ bahu | prārthito'ṅkādvinirbhartsya tāṃ sa ācicchide khalaḥ || 55 || kusaṅganirataḥ pāpaḥ khalo yadukulādhamaḥ | svasuḥ sutāṃ śilāpṛṣṭhe gṛhītvāṃghryornyapātayat || 56 || kaṃsahastātsamutpatya tvaraṃ sā cāṃbare gatā | śatapatre rathe divye sahasrahayasevite || 57 || cāmarāṃdolite śubhre sthitādṛśyata divyadṛk | sāyudhāṣṭabhujā māyā pārṣadaiḥ parisevitā | śatasūryapratīkāśā kaṃsamāha ghanasvanā || 58 || śrīyogamāyovāca paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavān svayam | jātaḥ kva vā tu te hantā vṛthā dīnāṃ dunoṣi vai || 59 || śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā taṃ tato devī gatā vindhyācale girau | yogamāyā bhagavatī bahunāmā babhūva ha || 60 || atha kaṃso vismito'bhūcchrutvā māyāvacaḥ param | devakīṃ vasudevaṃ ca mocayāmāsa bandhanāt || 61 || kaṃsa uvāca pāpo'haṃ pāpakarmāhaṃ khalo yadukulādhamaḥ | yuṣmatputraprahantāraṃ kṣamadhvaṃ me kṛtaṃ bhuvi || 62 || he svasaḥ śṛṇu me śaure manye kālakṛtaṃ tvidam | yena niścālyamāno vā vāyuneva ghanāvaleḥ || 63 || viśvasto'haṃ devavākye devāste'pi mṛṣāgiraḥ | na jānāmi kva me śatrurjātaḥ kau kathito'nayā || 64 || śrīnārada uvāca itthaṃ kaṃsastadaṃghryośca patito'śrumukho rudan | cakāra sevāṃ paramāṃ sauhṛdaṃ darśayaṃstayoḥ || 65 || aho śrīkṛṣṇacandrasya paripūrṇatamaprabhoḥ | dānadakṣaiḥ kaṭākṣaiśca kinna syādbhūmimaṃḍale || 66 || prātaḥkāle tadā kaṃsaḥ pralaṃbādīnmahāsurān | samāhūya khalastebhyo'vadaduktaṃ ca māyayā || 67 || kaṃsa uvāca jāto me hyaṃtakṛtadbhūmau kathito yogamāyayā | anirdaśānnirdaśāṃśca śiśūnyūyaṃ haniṣyatha || 68 || daityā ūcuḥ sajjasya dhanuṣo yuddhe bhavatā dvaṃdvayodhinā | ṭaṃkāreṇodgatā devā manyase taiḥ kathaṃ bhayam || 69 || goviprasādhuśrutayo devā dharmādayaḥ pare | viṣṇośca tanavo hyeṣāṃ nāśe daityabalaṃ smṛtam || 70 || jāto yadi mahāviṣṇuste śatruryo mahītale | ayaṃ caitadvadhopāyo gavādīnāṃ vihiṃsanam || 71 || itthaṃ mahodbhaṭā duṣṭā daiteyāḥ kaṃsanoditāḥ | dudruvuḥ khaṃ gavādibhyo jaghnurjātāṃśca bālakān || 72 || āsamudrādbhūmitale viśaṃtaśca gṛhe gṛhe | kāmarūpadharā daityāśceruḥ sarpā ivābhavan || 73 || utpathā udbhaṭā daityāstatrāpi kaṃsanoditāḥ | kapiḥ surāpo'lihato bhūtagrasta ivābhavan || 74 || vaideha maithila narendra upendrabhakta dharmiṣṭhamukhya sutapo janaka pratāpin | etatsatāṃ ca bhuvi helanamaṃga rājan sarvaṃ chinatti bahulāśva catuṣpadārthān || 75 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīkṛṣṇacandrajanmavarṇanaṃ nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||
<1.12> śrīnārada uvāca atha putrotsavaṃ jātaṃ śrutvā nanda uṣaḥkṣaṇe | brāhmaṇāṃśca samāhūya kārayāmāsa maṃgalam || 1 || savidhiṃ jātakaṃ kṛtvā nandarājo mahāmanāḥ | viprebhyo dakṣiṇābhiśca mudā lakṣaṃ gavāṃ dadau || 2 || krośamātraṃ ratnasānūnsuvarṇakhikharān girīn | sarasānsaptadhānyānāṃ dadau viprebhya ānataḥ || 3 || mṛdaṃgavīṇāśaṃkhādyā nedurduṃdubhayo muhuḥ | gāyakāśca jagurdvāre nanṛturvārayoṣitaḥ || 4 || patākairhemakalaśairvitānaistoraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ | anekavarṇaiścitraiśca babhau śrīnandamandiram || 5 || rathyā vīthyaśca dehalyo bhittiprāṃgaṇavedikāḥ | tolikāmaṃḍapasabhā rejurgandhijalāṃbaraiḥ || 6 || gāvaḥ suvarṇaśṛṅgyaśca hemamālālasadgalāḥ | ghaṃṭāmaṃjīrajhaṃkārā raktakaṃbalamaṃḍitāḥ || 7 || pītapucchāḥ savatsāśca taruṇīkaracihnitāḥ | haridrākuṃkumairyuktāḥ citradhātuvicitritāḥ || 8 || barhipucchairgandhajalairvṛṣā dharmaduraṃdharāḥ | itastato virejuḥ śrīnandadvāri manoharāḥ || 9 || govatsā hemamālāḍhyā muktāhāravirājitāḥ | itastato vilaṃghanto maṃjīracaraṇāṃ sitāḥ || 10 || śrutvā putrotsavaṃ tasya vṛṣabhānuvarastathā | kalāvatyā gajārūḍho nandamaṃdiramāyayau || 11 || nandā navopanandāśca tathā ṣaḍvṛṣabhānavaḥ | nānopāyanasaṃyuktāḥ sarve te'pi samāyayuḥ || 12 || uṣṇīṣopari mālāḍhyāḥ pītakaṃcukaśobhitāḥ | barhaguṃjābaddhakeśā vanamālāvibhūṣaṇāḥ || 13 || vaṃśīdharā vetrahastāḥ supatratilakārcitāḥ | baddhavarṇāḥ parikarā gopāste'pi samāyayuḥ || 14 || nṛtyantaḥ parigāyaṃto dhunvaṃto vasanāni ca | nānopāyanasaṃyuktāḥ śmaśrulāḥ śiśavaḥ pare || 15 || haiyaṃgavīnadugdhānāṃ dadhyājyānāṃ balīnbahūn | nītvā vṛddhā yaṣṭihastā nandamaṃdiramāyayuḥ || 16 || putrotsavaṃ vrajeśasya kathayantaḥ parasparam | premavihvalabhāvaiḥ svairānandāśrusamākulāḥ || 17 || jāte putrotsave nandaḥ svānaṃdāśrukulekṣaṇaḥ | pūjayāmāsa tān sarvāṃstilakādyairvidhānataḥ || 18 || gopā ūcuḥ he vrajeśvara he nanda jātaḥ putrotsavastathā | anapatyasyecchato'lamataḥ kiṃ maṃgalaṃ param || 19 || daivena darśitaṃ cedaṃ dinaṃ vo bahubhirdinaiḥ | kṛtakṛtyāśca bhūtāḥ smo dṛṣṭvā śrīnandanandanam || 20 || he mohaneti durāttamaṃkaṃ nītva gadiṣyasi | yadā lālanabhāveba bhavitā nastadā sukham || 21 || śrīnanda uvāca bhavatāmāśiṣaḥ puṇyājjātaṃ saukhyamidaṃ śubham | ājñāvartī hyahaṃ gopā gopānāṃ vrajavāsinām || 22 || śrīnandarājasutasaṃbhavamadbhutaṃ ca śrutvā visṛjya gṛhakarma tadaiva gopyaḥ | tūrṇaṃ yayuḥ sabalayo vrajarājagehānudyatpramodaparipūritahṛnmaho'ṅgāḥ || 23 || ānandamaṃdirapurātsvagṛhon vrajantyaḥ sarvā itastata uta tvaramāvrajantyaḥ | yānaślathadvasanabhūṣaṇakeśabandhā rejurnarendra pathi bhūparimuktamuktāḥ || 24 || jhaṃkāranūpuranavāṃgadahemacīramañjīrahāramaṇikuṃḍalamekhalābhiḥ | śrīkaṃṭhasūtrabhujakaṃkaṇabiṃdukābhiḥ pūrṇendumaṃḍalanavadyutibhirvirejuḥ || 25 || śrīrājikālavaṇarātriviśeṣacūrṇairgodhūmasarṣapayavaiḥ karalālanaiśca | uttārya bālakamukhopari cāśiṣastāḥ sarvā dadurnṛpa jagurjagaduryaśodām || 26 || gopya ūcuḥ sādhu sādhu yaśode te diṣṭyā diṣṭyā vrajeśvari | dhanyā dhanyā parā kukṣiryayā'yaṃ janitaḥ sutaḥ || 27 || icchā yuktaṃ kṛtaṃ te vai devena bahukālataḥ | rakṣa bālaṃ padmanetraṃ susmitaṃ śyāmasundaram || 28 || śrīyaśodā uvāca bhavadīyadayāśīrbhirjātaḥ saukhyaṃ paraṃ ca me | bhavatīnāmapi paraṃ diṣṭyā bhūyādataḥ param || 29 || he rohiṇi mahābuddhe pūjanaṃ tu vrajaukasām | āgatānāṃ satkulānāṃ yatheṣṭaṃ hīpsitaṃ kuru || 30 || śrīnārada uvāca rohiṇī rājakanyā'pi tatkarau dānaśīlinau | tatrāpi noditā dāne dadāvatimahāmanāḥ || 31 || gauravarṇā divyavāsā ratnābharaṇabhūṣitā | vyacaradrohiṇī sākṣātpūjayaṃtī vrajaukasaḥ || 32 || paripūrṇatame sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇe vrajamāgate | nadatsu naratūryeṣu jayadhvanirabhūnmahān || 33 || dadhikṣīraghṛtairgopā gopyo haiyaṃgavairnavaiḥ | siṣicurharṣitāstatra jaguruccaiḥ parasparam || 34 || bahirantapureḥ jāte sarvato dadhikardame | vṛddhāśca sthūladehāśca peturhāsyaṃ kṛtaṃ paraiḥ || 35 || sūtāḥ paurāṇikāḥ proktā māgadhā vaṃśaśaṃsakāḥ | vandinastvamalaprajñāḥ prastāvasadṛśoktayaḥ || 36 || tebhyo naṃdo mahārājaḥ sahasraṃ gāḥ pṛthak pṛthak | vāso'laṃkāraratnāni hayebhānakhilāndadau || 37 || vandibhyo māgadhebhyaśca sarvebhyo bahulaṃ dhanam | vavarṣa ghanavadgopo naṃdarājo vrajeśvaraḥ || 38 || nidhiḥ siddhiśca vṛddhiśca bhuktirmuktirgṛhe gṛhe | vīthyāṃ vīthyāṃ luṭhantīva tadicchā kasyacinna hi || 39 || sanatkumāraḥ kapilaḥ śukavyāsādibhiḥ saha | haṃsadattapulastyādyairmayā brahmā jagāma ha || 40 || haṃsārūḍho hemavarṇo mukuṭī kuṇḍalī sphuran | caturmukho vedakartā dyotayanmaṃḍalaṃ diśām || 41 || tathā tamanu bhutāḍhyo vṛṣārūḍho maheśvaraḥ | rathārūḍho raviḥ sākṣātgajārūḍhaḥ puraṃdaraḥ || 42 || vāyuśca khaṃjanārūḍho yamo mahiṣavāhanaḥ | dhanadaḥ puṣpakārūḍho mṛgārūḍhaḥ kṣapeśvaraḥ || 43 || ajārūḍho vītihotro varuṇo makarasthitaḥ | mayūrasthaḥ kārtikeyo bhāratī haṃsavāhinī || 44 || lakṣmī ca garuḍārūḍhā durgākhyā siṃhavāhinī | gorūpadhāriṇī pṛthvī vimānasthā samāyayau || 45 || dolārūḍhā divyavarṇā mukhyāḥ ṣoḍaśamātṛkāḥ | ṣaṣṭhī ca śibikārūḍhā khaḍginī yaṣṭidhāriṇī || 46 || maṃgalo vānarārūḍho bhāsārūḍho budhaḥ smṛtaḥ | gīṣpatiḥ kṛṣṇasārasthaḥ śukro gavayavāhanaḥ || 47 || śaniśca makarārūḍha uṣṭrasthaḥ siṃhikāsutaḥ | koṭibālārkasaṃkāśa āyayau nandamandiram || 48 || kolāhalasamāyuktaṃ gopagopīgaṇākulam | nandamandiramabhyetya kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā yayuḥ surāḥ || 49 || paripūrṇatamaṃ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇaṃ bālarūpiṇam | natvā dṛṣṭvā tadā devāścakrustasya stutiṃ parām || 50 || vīkṣya kṛṣṇaṃ tadā devā brahmādyā ṛṣibhiḥ saha | svadhāmāni yayuḥ sarve harṣitāḥ premavihvalāḥ || 51 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīnaṃdamahotsavavarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||
<1.13> śauryanāmayapṛcchārthaṃ karaṃ dātuṃ nṛpasya ca | putrotsavaṃ kathayituṃ naṃde śrīmathurāṃ gate || 1 || kaṃsena preṣitā duṣṭā pūtanā ghātakāriṇī | pureṣu grāmaghoṣeṣu caraṃtī ghargharasvanā || 2 || atha gokulamāsādya gopagopīgaṇākulam | rūpaṃ dadhāra sā divyaṃ vapuḥ ṣoḍaśavārṣikam || 3 || na ke'pi rurudhurgopāḥ suṃdarīṃ tāṃ ca gopikāḥ | śacīṃ vāṇīṃ ramāṃ raṃbhāṃ ratiṃ ca kṣipatīmiva || 4 || rohiṇyāṃ ca yaśodāyāṃ dharṣitāyāṃ sphuratkucā | aṃkamādāya taṃ bālaṃ lālayaṃtī punaḥ punaḥ || 5 || dadau śiśormahāghorā kālakūṭāvṛtaṃ stanam | prāṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ papau dugdhaṃ kaṭuṃ roṣāvṛto hariḥ || 6 || muṃca muṃca vadaṃtītthaṃ dhāvantī pīḍitastanā | nītvā bahirgatā taṃ vai gatamāyā babhūva ha || 7 || patannetrā śvetagātrā rudantī patitā bhuvi | nanāda tena brahmāṇḍaṃ saptalokairbilaiḥ saha || 8 || cacāla vasudhā dvīpaiḥ tadadbhutamivābhavat | ṣaṭkrośaṃ sā dṛḍhān dīrghān vṛkṣān pṛṣṭhatale gatān || 9 || cūrṇīcakāra vapuṣā vajrāṃgeṇa nṛpeśvara | vadantaste gopagaṇā vīkṣya ghoraṃ vapurmahat || 10 || asyā aṅguligo bālo na jīvati kadācana | tasyā urasi sānandaṃ krīḍantaṃ susmitaṃ śiśum || 11 || dugdhaṃ pītvā jṛṃbhamāṇaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā jagṛhuḥ striyaḥ | yaśodayā ca rohiṇyā nidhāyorasi vismitāḥ || 12 || sarvato bālakaṃ nītvā rakṣāṃ cakrurvidhānataḥ | kāliṃdīpuṇyamṛttoyairgopucchabhramaṇādibhiḥ || 13 || gomūtragorajobhiśca snāpayitvā tvidaṃ jaguḥ || 14 || gopya ūcuḥ śrīkṛṣṇaste śiraḥ pātu vaikuṇṭhaḥ kaṇṭhameva hi | śvetadvīpapatiḥ karṇau nāsikāṃ yajñarūpadhṛk || 15 || nṛsiṃho netrayugmaṃ ca jihvāṃ daśarathātmajaḥ | adharāvavatāṃ te tu naranārāṇāvṛṣī || 16 || kapolau pātu te sākṣātsanakādyāḥ kalā hareḥ | bhālaṃ te śvetavārāho nārado bhrūlate'vatu || 17 || cibukaṃ kapilaḥ pātu dattātreya uro'vatu | skaṃdhau dvāvṛṣabhaḥ pātu karau matsyaḥ prapātu te || 18 || dordaṇḍaṃ satataṃ rakṣetpṛthuḥ pṛthulavikramaḥ | udaraṃ kamaṭhaḥ pātu nābhiṃ dhanvantariśca te || 19 || mohinī guhyadeśaṃ ca kaṭiṃ te vāmano'vatu | pṛṣṭhaṃ paraśurāmaśca tavorū bādarāyaṇaḥ || 20 || balo jānudvayaṃ pātu jaṃghe buddhaḥ prapātu te | pādau pātu sagulphau ca kalkirdharmapatiḥ prabhuḥ || 21 || sarvarakṣākaraṃ divyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇakavacaṃ param | idaṃ bhagavatā dattaṃ brahmaṇe nābhipaṃkaje || 22 || brahmaṇā śaṃbhave dattaṃ śaṃbhurdurvāsase dadau | durvāsāḥ śrīyaśomatyai prādācchrīnandamandire || 23 || anena rakṣāṃ kṛtvāsya gopībhiḥ śrīyaśomatī | pāyayitvā stanaṃ dānaṃ viprebhyaḥ pradadau mahat || 24 || tadā naṃdādayo gopā āgatā mathurāpurāt | dṛṣṭvā ghorāṃ pūtanākhyāṃ babhūvurbhayavihvalāḥ || 25 || chitvā kuṭhāraistaddehaṃ gopāḥ śrīyamunātaṭe | anekāśca citāḥ kṛtvā dāhayāmāsureva tām || 26 || elālavaṃgaśrīkhaṃḍatagarāgarugaṃdhibhṛt | dhūmo dagdhasya dehasya pavitrasya samutthitaḥ || 27 || aho kṛṣṇamṛte kaṃ vā vrajāma śaraṇaṃ tviha | pūtanāyai mokṣagatiṃ dadau patitapāvanaḥ || 28 || śrībahulāśva uvāca keyaṃ vā rākṣasī pūrvaṃ pūtanā bālaghātinī | viṣastanā duṣṭabhāvā paraṃ mokṣaṃ kathaṃ gatā || 29 || śrīnārada uvāca baliyajñe vāmanasya dṛṣṭvā rūpamataḥ param | balikanyā ratnamālā putrasnehaṃ cakāra ha || 30 || etādṛśo yadi bhavedbālastaṃ hi śucismitam | pāyayāmi stanaṃ tena prasannaṃ me manastadā || 31 || baleḥ paramabhaktasya sutāyai vāmano hariḥ | manorathastu te bhūyān manasyapi varaṃ dadau || 32 || yaḥ pūtanāmokṣamimaṃ śṛṇoti kṛṣṇasya devasya parātparasya | bhaktirbhavetpremayutāpi tasya trivargaśuddhiḥ kimu maithileṃdra || 34 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde pūtanāmokṣo nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 ||
<1.14> ityevaṃ kathitaṃ divyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ varam | yaṃ śṛṇoti nato bhaktyā sa kṛtārtho na saṃśayaḥ || 1 || śrīśaunaka uvāca sudhākhaṃḍātparaṃ miṣṭaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ śubham | śrutvā tvanmukhataḥ sākṣātkṛtārthāḥ smo vayaṃ mune || 2 || śrīkṛṣṇabhaktaḥ śāṃtātmā bahulāśvaḥ satāṃ varaḥ | atho muniṃ kiṃ papraccha tanme brūhi tapodhana || 3 || śrīgarga uvāca atha rājā maithileṃdro harṣitaḥ premavihvalaḥ | nāradaṃ prāha dharmātmā paripūrṇatamaṃ smaran || 4 || śrībahulāśva uvāca dhanyo'haṃ ca kṛtārtho'haṃ bhavatā bhūrikarmaṇā | saṃgo bhagavadīyānāṃ durlabho durghaṭo'sti hi || 5 || śrīkṛṣṇastvarbhakaḥ sākṣādadbhuto bhaktavatsalaḥ | agre cakāra kiṃ citraṃ caritraṃ vada me mune || 6 || śrīnārada uvāca sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā rājan bhavatā kṛṣṇadharmiṇā | saṃgamaḥ khalu sādhūnāṃ sarveṣāṃ vitanoti śam || 7 || ekadā kṛṣṇajanmarkṣe yaśodā naṃdagehinī | gopīgopānsamāhūya maṃgalaṃ cākaroddvijaiḥ || 8 || raktāṃbaraṃ kanakabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāṅgaṃ bālaṃ pragṛhya kalitāṃjanapadmanetram | śyāmaṃ sphuraddharinakhāvṛtacaṃdrahāraṃ devān praṇamya sudhanaṃ pradadau dvijebhyaḥ || 9 || preṃkhe nidhāya nijamātmajamāśu gopī saṃpūjya maṃgaladine pratigopikāstāḥ | naivāśṛṇotsuruditasya sutasya śabdaṃ gopeṣu maṃgalagṛheṣu gatāgateṣu || 10 || tatraiva kaṃsakhalanodita utkacākhyo daityaḥ prabhaṃjanatanuḥ śakaṭaṃ sa etya | bālasya mūrdhni paripātayituṃ pravṛttaḥ kṛṣṇo'pi taṃ kila tatāḍa padāruṇena || 11 || cūrṇa gatetha śakaṭe patite ca daitye tyaktvā prabhaṃjanatanuṃ vimalo babhūva | natvā hariṃ śatahayena rathena yukto golokadhāma nijalokamalaṃ jagāma || 12 || naṃdādayo vrajajanā vrajagopikāśca sarve sametya yugapatpṛthukān tadāhuḥ | eṣa svayaṃ ca patitaḥ śakaṭaḥ kathaṃ hi jānītha he vrajasutāḥ sugatāśca yūyam || 13 || bālā ūcuḥ preṃkhastho'yaṃ kṣipanpādau rudandugdhārthameva hi | tatāḍa pādaṃ śakaṭe tenedaṃ patitaṃ khalu || 14 || śraddhāṃ na cakrurbālokte gopā gopyaśca vismitāḥ | traimāsikaḥ kva bālo'yaṃ kva caitadbhārabhṛttvanaḥ || 15 || bālamaṃke sā gṛhītvā yaśodā grahaśaṃkitā | kārayāmāsa vidhivadyajñaṃ vipraiḥ sutarpitaiḥ || 16 || śrībahulāśva uvāca ko'yaṃ pūrvaṃ tu kuśalī daitya utkacanāmabhāk | aho kṛṣṇapadasparśādgato mokṣaṃ mahāmune || 17 || śrīnārada uvāca hiraṇyākṣasuto daitya utkaco nāma maithila | lomaśasyāśrame gacchan vṛkṣāṃścūrṇīcakāra ha || 18 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sthūladehāḍhyamutkacākhyaṃ mahābalam | śaśāpa roṣayugvipro videho bhava durmate || 19 || sarpakaṃcukavaddeho'patatkarmavipākataḥ | sadyastaccaraṇopāṃte patitvā prāha daityarāṭ || 20 || utkaca uvāca he mune he kṛpāsiṃdho kṛpāṃ kuru mamopari | te prabhāvaṃ na jānāmi dehaṃ me dehi he prabho || 21 || śrīnārada uvāca tadā prasannaḥ sa munirdṛṣṭaṃ nayaśataṃ vidheḥ | satāṃ roṣo'pi varado varo mokṣārthadaḥ kimu || 22 || śrīlomaśa uvāca vātadehastu te bhūyātadvyatīte cākṣuṣāṃtare | vaivasvatāṃtare muktiḥ bhavitā ca padā hareḥ || 23 || śrīnārada uvāca tasmādutkacadaityastu mukto lomaśatejasā | sadbhyo namo'stu ye nūnaṃ samarthā varaśāpayoḥ || 24 || utsaṃge krīḍitaṃ bālaṃ lālayaṃtyekadā nṛpa | giribhāraṃ na sehe sā voḍhuṃ śrīnaṃdagehinī || 25 || aho girisamo bālaḥ kathaṃ syāditi vismitā | bhūmau nidhāya taṃ sadyo nedaṃ kasmai jagāda ha || 26 || kaṃsapraṇodito daityastṛṇāvarto mahābalaḥ | jahāra bālaṃ krīḍantaṃ vātāvartena suṃdaram || 27 || rajo'ndhakāro'bhūttatra ghoraśabdaśca gokule | rajasvalāni cakṣūṃṣi babhūvurghaṭikādvayam || 28 || tato yaśodā nāpaśyatputraṃ taṃ maṃdirājire | mohitā rudatī ghorān paśyaṃtī gṛhaśekharān || 29 || adṛṣṭe ca yadā putre patitā bhuvi mūrchitā | uccai ruroda karuṇaṃ mṛtavatsā yathā hi gauḥ || 30 || ruruduśca tadā gopyaḥ premasnehasamākulāḥ | aśrumukhyo naṃdasūnuṃ paśyaṃtyastā itastataḥ || 31 || tṛṇāvarto nabhaḥ prāpta ūrdhvaṃ vai lakṣayojanam | skaṃdhe sumeruvadbālaṃ manyamānaḥ prapīḍitaḥ || 32 || atha kṛṣṇaṃ pātayituṃ daityastatra samudyataḥ | galaṃ jagrāha tasyāpi paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam || 33 || muṃca muṃceti gadite daitye kṛṣṇo'dbhuto'rbhakaḥ | galagrāheṇa mahatā vyasuṃ daityaṃ cakāra ha || 34 || tajjyotiḥ śrīghanaśyāme līnaṃ saudāminī yathā | daityo'mbarānnipatitaḥ śilāyāṃ śiśunā saha || 35 || viśīrṇāvayavasyāpi patitasya svanena vai | vineduśca diśaḥ sarvāḥ kaṃpitaṃ bhūmimaṃḍalam || 36 || tatpṛṣṭhasthaṃ śiśuṃ tūṣṇīṃ rudaṃtyo gopikāstataḥ | dadṛśuryugapatsarvā nītvā mātre dadurjaguḥ || 37 || gopya ūcuḥ na yogyāsi yaśode tvaṃ bālaṃ lālayituṃ manāk | na ghṛṇā te kvaciddṛṣṭā kruddhāsi kathitena vai || 38 || prāpte'ndhakāre svārohātko'pi bālaṃ jahāti hi | tvayā nirghṛṇayā bhūmau dhṛto bālo mahābhaye || 39 || śrīyaśodovāca na jānāmi kathaṃ bālo bhārabhūto girīṃdravat | tasmānmayā kṛto bhūmau cakravāte mahābhaye || 40 || gopya ūcuḥ mā mṛṣā vada kalyāṇi he yaśode gatavyathe | ayaṃ dugdhamukho bālo laghuṃ kusumatūlavat || 41 || śrīnārada uvāca tadā gopyo'tha gopāśca naṃdādyā āgate śiśau | atīva modaṃ saṃprāpurvadantaḥ kuśalaṃ janaiḥ || 42 || yaśodā bālakaṃ nītvā pāyayitvā stanaṃ muhuḥ | āghrāyorasi vastreṇa rohiṇīṃ prāha mohitā || 43 || śrīyaśodovāca eko daivena datto'yaṃ na putrā bahavaśca me | tasyāpi bahavo'riṣṭā āgacchanti kṣaṇena vai || 44 || adya mṛtyumukhānmukto bhaviṣyatkimataḥ param | kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kutra vāso bhavedataḥ || 45 || vajrasārāśca ye daityā nirdayā ghoradarśanāḥ | vairaṃ kurvanti me bāle daiva daiva kutaḥ sukham || 46 || dhanaṃ deho gṛhaṃ saudho ratnāni vividhāni ca | sarveṣāṃ tu hyavaśaṃ vai bhūyānme kuśalī śiśuḥ || 47 || harerarcāṃ dānamiṣṭaṃ pūrtaṃ devālayaṃ śatam | kariṣyāmi tadā bālo'riṣṭebhyo vijayī yadā || 48 || ekabālena me saukhyamandhayaṣṭiriva priye | bālaṃ nītvā gamiṣyāmi deśe rohiṇi nirbhaye || 49 || śrīnārada uvāca tadaiva viprā vidvāṃsa āgatā naṃdamaṃdiram | yaśodayā ca naṃdena pūjitā āsanasthitāḥ || 50 || brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ mā śocaṃ kuru he naṃda he yaśode vrajeśvarī | kariṣyāmaḥ śiśo rakṣāṃ ciraṃjīvī bhavedayam || 51 || śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā dvijamukhyāste kuśāgrairnavapallavaiḥ | pavitrakalaśaistoyairṛgyajuḥsāmajaiḥ stavaiḥ || 52 || paraiḥ svastyayanairyajñaṃ kārayitvā vidhānataḥ | agniṃ sampūjyavidhivadrakṣāṃ vidadhire śiśoḥ || 53 || brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ dāmodaraḥ pātu pādau jānunī viṣṭaraśravāḥ | ūrū pātu harirnābhiḥ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam || 54 || kaṭiṃ rādhāpatiḥ pātu pītavāsāstavodaram | hṛdayaṃ padmanābhaśca bhujau govarddhanoddharaḥ || 55 || mukhaṃ ca mathurānātho dvārakeśaḥ śiro'vatu | pṛṣṭhaṃ pātvasuradhvaṃsī sarvato bhagavānsvayam || 56 || ślokatrayamidaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhenmānavaḥ sadā | mahāsaukhyaṃ bhavettasya na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || 57 || śrīnārada uvāca naṃdastebhyo gavāṃ lakṣaṃ suvarṇaṃ daśalakṣakam | sahasraṃ navaratnānāṃ vastralakṣaṃ dadau param || 58 || gateṣu dvijamukhyeṣu naṃdo gopānniyamya ca | bhojayāmāsa saṃpūjya vastraibhūṣairmanoharaiḥ || 59 || śrībahulāśva uvāca tṛṇāvartaḥ pūrvakāle ko'yaṃ sukṛtakṛnnaraḥ | paripūrṇatame sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇe līnatāṃ gataḥ || 60 || śrīnārada uvāca pāṇḍudeśodbhavo rājā sahasrākṣaḥ pratāpavān | haribhakto dharmaniṣṭho yajñakṛddānatatparaḥ || 61 || revātaṭe mahādivye latāvetrasamākule | nārīṇāṃ ca sahasreṇa ramamāṇo cacāra ha || 62 || durvāsasaṃ muniṃ sākṣādāgataṃ na nanāma ha | tadā munirdadau śāpaṃ rākṣaso bhava durmate || 63 || punastadaṃghryoḥ patitaṃ nṛpaṃ prādādvaraṃ muniḥ | śrīkṛṣṇavigrahasparśātparaṃ mokṣamavāpa ha || 65 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śakaṭāsuratṛṇāvartamokṣo nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||
<1.15> preṃkhe hariṃ kanakaratnamaye śayānaṃ śyāmaṃ śiśuṃ janamanoharamandahāsam | dṛṣṭyārtihāri maṣibiṃdudharaṃ yaśodā svāṃke cakāra dhṛtakajjalapadmanetram || 1 || pādaṃ pibaṃtamaticaṃcalamadbhutāṃgaṃ vaktrairvinīlanavakomalakeśabaṃdhaiḥ | śrīmannṛkeśarinakhasphuradararddhacandraṃ taṃ lālayantyatighṛṇā mudamāpa gopī || 2 || bālasya pītapayaso nṛpa jṛmbhitasya tattvāni cāsya vadane sakale'virājan | mātā surādhipamukhaiḥ prayutaṃ ca sarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā paraṃ bhayamavāpa nimīlitākṣī || 3 || rājanparasya paripūrṇatamasya sākṣātkṛṣṇasya viśvamakhilaṃ kapaṭena sā hi | naṣṭasmṛtiḥ punarabhūtsvasute ghṛṇārtā kiṃ varṇayāmi sutapo bahu naṃdapatnyāḥ || 4 || śrībahulāśva uvāca naṃdo yaśodayā sārddhaṃ kiṃ cakāra tapo mahat | yena śrīkṛṣṇacandro'pi putrībhūto babhūva ha || 5 || śrīnārada uvāca aṣṭānāṃ vai vasūnāṃ ca droṇo mukhyo dharāpatiḥ | anapatyo viṣṇubhakto devarājyaṃ cakāra ha || 6 || ekadā putrakāṃkṣī ca brahmaṇā nodito nṛpa | maṃdarādriṃ gatastaptuṃ dharayā bhāryayā saha || 7 || kaṃdamūlaphalāhārau tataḥ parṇāśanau tataḥ | jalabhakṣau tatastau tu nirjalau nirjane sthitau || 8 || varṣāṇāmarbude yāte tapastattapatordvayoḥ | brahmā prasannastāvetya varaṃ brūhītyuvāca ha || 9 || valmīkānnirgato droṇo dharayā bharyayā saha | natvā vidhiṃ ca saṃpūjya harṣitaḥ prāha taṃ prabhum || 10 || śrīdroṇa uvāca paripūrṇatame kṛṣṇe putrībhūte janārdane | bhaktiḥ syādāvayorbrahmansatataṃ premalakṣaṇā || 11 || yayāñjasā taraṃtīha dustaraṃ bhavasāgaram | nānyaṃ varaṃ vāṃchitaṃ syādāvayostapatorvidhe || 12 || śrībrahmovāca yuvābhyaṃ yācitaṃ yanme durghaṭaṃ durlabhaṃ varam | tathāpi bhūyātsaphalaṃ yuvayoranyajanmani || 13 || śrīnārada uvāca droṇo naṃdo'bhavadbhūmau yaśodā sā dharā smṛtā | kṛṣṇo brahmavacaḥ kartuṃ prāpto ghoṣe pituḥ purāt || 14 || sudhākhaṃḍātparaṃ miṣṭaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ śubham | gaṃdhamādanaśṛṅge vai nārāyaṇamukhācchrutam || 15 || kṛpayā ca kṛtārtho'haṃ naranārāyaṇasya ca | mayā tubhyaṃ ca kathitaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 16 || śrībahulāśva uvāca naṃdagehe hariḥ sākṣācchiśurūpaḥ sanātanaḥ | kiṃ cakāra balenāpi tanme brūhi mahāmune || 17 || śrīnārada uvāca ekadā śiṣyasahoto gargācāryo mahāmuniḥ | śauriṇā noditaḥ sākṣādāyayau naṃdamaṃdiram || 18 || naṃdaḥ saṃpūjya vidhivatpādyādyairmunisattamam | tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇanāma ha || 19 || śrīnanda uvāca adya naḥ pitaro devāḥ saṃtuṣṭā agnayaśca naḥ | pavitraṃ maṃdiraṃ jātaṃ yuṣmaccaraṇareṇubhiḥ || 20 || matputranāmakaraṇaṃ kuru dvija mahāmune | puṇyaistīrthaiśca duṣprāpyaṃ bhavadāgamanaṃ prabho || 21 || śrīgarga uvāca te putranāmakaraṇaṃ kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ | pūrvavārtāṃ gadiṣyāmi gaccha naṃda rahaḥsthalam || 22 || śrīnārada uvāca utthāpya gargo nandena bālābhyāṃ ca yaśodayā | ekāṃte govraje gatvā tayornāma cakāra ha || 23 || saṃpūjya gaṇanāthādīn grahānsaṃśodhya yatnataḥ | naṃdaṃ prāha prasannāṃgo gargācāryo mahāmuniḥ || 24 || rohiṇīnaṃdanasyāsya nāmoccāraṃ śṛṇuṣva ca | ramante yogino hyasminsarvatra ramatīti vā || 25 || guṇaiśca ramayan bhaktāṇstena rāmaṃ viduḥ pare | garbhasaṃkarṣaṇādasya saṃkarṣaṇa iti smṛtaḥ || 26 || sarvāvaśeṣādyaṃ śeṣaṃ balādhikyādbalaṃ viduḥ | svaputrasyāpi nāmāni śṛṇu naṃda hyatandritaḥ || 27 || sadyaḥ prāṇipavitrāṇi jagatāṃ maṃgalāni ca | kakāraḥ kamalākāṃta ṛkāro rāma ityapi || 28 || ṣakāraḥ ṣaḍguṇapatiḥ śvetadvīpanivāsakṛt | ṇakāro nārasiṃho'yamakāro hyakṣaro'gnibhuk || 29 || visargau ca tathā hyetau naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī | saṃpralīnāśca ṣaṭ pūrṇā yasmiñchuddhe mahātmani || 30 || paripūrṇatame sākṣāttena kṛṣṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | śuklo raktastathā pīto varṇo'syānuyugaṃ dhṛtaḥ || 31 || dvāparānte kalerādau bālo'yaṃ kṛṣṇatāṃ gataḥ | tasmātkṛṣṇa iti khyāto nāmnāyaṃ naṃdanaṃdanaḥ || 32 || vasavaśceṃdriyāṇīti taddevaścittameva hi | tasminyaśceṣṭate so'pi vāsudeva iti smṛtaḥ || 33 || vṛṣabhānusutā rādhā yā jātā kīrtimaṃdire | tasyāḥ patirayaṃ sākṣāttena rādhāpatiḥ smṛtaḥ || 34 || paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam | asaṃkhyabrahmāṇḍapatiḥ goloke dhāmni rājate || 35 || so'yaṃ tava
