śiśurjāto bhārāvataraṇāya ca | kaṃsādīnāṃ vadhārthāya bhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || 36 || anaṃtānyasya nāmāni vedaguhyāni bhārata | līlābhiśca bhaviṣyaṃti tatkarmasu na vismayaḥ || 37 || ahobhāgyaṃ tu te naṃda sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamaḥ | tvadgṛhe vartamāno'yaṃ śiśurūpaḥ parātparaḥ || 38 || ityuktvātha gate garge svātmānaṃ pūrṇamāśiṣām | mene pramuditaḥ patnyā naṃdarājo mahāmatiḥ || 39 || artha gargo jñānivaro jñānado munisattamaḥ | kāliṃdītīraśobhāḍhyāṃ vṛṣabhānupuraṃ gataḥ || 40 || chatreṇa śobhitaṃ vipraṃ dvitīyamiva vāsavam | daṃḍena rājitaṃ sākṣāddharmarājamiva sthitam || 41 || tejasā dyotitadiśaṃ sākṣātsūryamivāparam | pustakīmekhalāyuktaṃ dvitīyamiva padmajam || 42 || śobhitaṃ śuklavāsobhirdevaṃ viṣṇumiva sthitam | taṃ dṛṣṭvā muniśārdūlaṃ sahasotthāya sādaram || 43 || praṇamya śirasā sadyaḥ saṃmukho'bhūt kṛtāṃjaliḥ | muniṃ ca pīṭhake sthāpya pādyādyairupacāravit || 44 || pūjayāmāsa vidhivacchrīgargaṃ jñānināṃ varam | tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya vṛṣabhānuvaro mahān || 45 || śrīvṛṣabhānuruvāca satāṃ paryaṭanaṃ śāṃtaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ śāṃtaye smṛtam | nṛṇāmaṃtastamohārī sādhureva na bhāskaraḥ || 46 || tīrthībhūtā vayaṃ gopā jātāstvaddarśanātprabho | tīrthāni tīrthīkurvaṃti tvādṛśāḥ sādhavaḥ kṣitau || 47 || he mune rādhikānāma kanyā me maṃgalāyanā | kasmai varāya dātavyā vada tvaṃ me suniścitam || 48 || tvaṃ paryaṭannarka iva trilokīṃ divyadarśanaḥ | varo'nayā samo yo vai tasmai dāsyāmi kanyakām || 49 || śrīnārada uvāca hastaṃ gṛhītvā śrīgargo vṛṣabhānormahāmuniḥ | jagāma yamunātīraṃ nirjanaṃ suṃdarasthalam || 50 || kālindījalakallokakolāhalasamākulam | tatropaveśya gopeśaṃ munīṃdraḥ prāha dharmavit || 51 || śrīgarga uvāca he gopa guptamākhyānaṃ kathanīyaṃ na ca tvayā | paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam || 52 || asaṃkhyabrahmāṃḍapatirgolokeśaḥ parātparaḥ | tasmātparo varo nāsti jāto naṃdagṛhe patiḥ || 53 || śrīvṛṣabhānuruvāca ahobhāgyamahobhāgyaṃ naṃdasyāpi mahāmune | śrīkṛṣṇasyāvatārasya sarvaṃ tvaṃ vada kāraṇam || 54 || śrīgarga uvāca bhuvo bhārāvatārāya kaṃsādīnāṃ vadhāya ca | brahmaṇā prāthitaḥ kṛṣṇo babhūva jagatītale || 55 || śrīkṛṣṇapaṭṭarājñī yā goloke rādhikābhidhā | tvadgṛhe sāpi saṃjātā tvaṃ na jānāsi tāṃ parām || 56 || śrīnārada uvāca tadā praharṣito gopo vṛṣabhānuḥ suvismitaḥ | kalāvatīṃ samāhūya tayā sārddhaṃ vicārya ca || 57 || rādhākṛṣṇānubhāvaṃ ca jñātvā gopavaraḥ paraḥ | ānaṃdāśrukalāṃ muṃcanpunarāha mahāmunim || 58 || śrīvṛṣabhānuruvāca tasmai dāsyāmi he brahman kanyāṃ kamalalocanām | tvayā paṃthā darśito me tvayā kāryo'yamudvahaḥ || 59 || śrīgarga uvāca ahaṃ na kārayiṣyāmi vivāhamanayornṛpa | tayorvivāho bhavitā bhāṃḍīre yamunātaṭe || 60 || vṛṃdāvanasamīpe ca nirjane suṃdarasthale | parameṣṭhī samāgatya vivāhaṃ kārayiṣyati || 61 || tasmādrādhāṃ gopavara viddhyardhāṃgīṃ varasya ca | loke cūḍāmaṇiḥ sākṣādrājñīṃ golokamaṃdire || 62 || yūyaṃ sarve'pi gopālā golokādāgatā bhuvi | tathā gopīgaṇā gopā goloke rādhikecchayā || 63 || yaddarśanaṃ durlabhameva durghaṭaṃ devaiśca yajñairna ca janmabhiḥ kimu | savigrahāṃ tāṃ tava maṃdirājire lakṣyaṃti guptāṃ bahugopagopikāḥ || 64 || śrīnārada uvāca tadā ca vismitau rājan daṃpatī harṣitau param | rādhākṛṣṇaprabhāvaṃ ca śrutvā śrīgargamūcatuḥ || 65 || daṃpatī ūcatuḥ rādhāśabdasya he brahman vyākhyānaṃ vada tattvataḥ | tvatto na saṃśayacchettā ko'pi bhūmau mahāmune || 66 || śrīgarga uvāca sāmavedasya bhāvārthaṃ gaṃdhamādanaparvate | śiṣyeṇāpi mayā tatra nārāyaṇamukhācchrutam || 67 || ramayā tu rakāraḥ syādākārastvādigopikā | dhakāro dharayā hi syādākāro virajā nadī || 68 || śrīkṛṣṇasya parasyāpi caturddhā tejaso'bhavat | līlābhūḥ śrīśca virajā catasraḥ patnya eva hi || 69 || saṃpralīnāśca tāḥ sarvā rādhāyāṃ kuṃjamaṃdire | paripūrṇatamāṃ rādhāṃ tasmādāhurmaniṣiṇaḥ || 70 || śrīnārada uvāca rādhākṛṣṇeti he gopa ye japaṃti punaḥ punaḥ | catuṣpadārthaṃ kiṃ teṣāṃ sākṣātkṛṣṇo'pi labhyate || 71 || tadātivismito rājan vṛṣabhānuḥ priyāyutaḥ | rādhākṛṣṇaprabhāvaṃ taṃ jñātvā''naṃdamayo hyabhūt || 72 || itthaṃ gargo jñānivaraḥ pūjito vṛṣabhānunā | jagāma svagṛhaṃ sākṣānmunīndraḥ sarvavitkaviḥ || 73 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde naṃdapatnyāḥ viśvarūpadarśanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanāmakaraṇaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 ||
<1.16> śrīnārada uvāca gāścārayan nandanamaṅkadeśe saṃlālayan dūratamaṃ sakāśāt | kaliṃdajātīrasamīrakaṃpitaṃ naṃdo'pi bhāṃḍīravanaṃ jagāma || 1 || kṛṣṇecchayā vegataro'tha vāto ghanairabhūnmeduramaṃbaraṃ ca | tamālanīpadrumapallavaiśca patadbhirejadbhiratīva bhāḥ kau || 2 || tadāṃdhakāre mahati prajāte bāle rudatyaṃkagate'tibhīte | naṃdo bhayaṃ prāpa śiśuṃ sa bibhraddhariṃ pareśaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagāma || 3 || tadaiva koṭyarkasamūhadīptirāgacchatīvācalatī diśāsu | babhūva tasyāṃ vṛṣabhānuputrīṃ dadarśa rādhāṃ navanaṃdarājaḥ || 4 || koṭīṃdubiṃbadyutimādadhānāṃ nīlāṃbarāṃ suṃdaramādivarṇām | maṃjīradhīradhvaninūpurāṇāmābibhratīṃ śabdamatīva maṃjum || 5 || kāṃcīkalākaṃkaṇaśabdamiśrāṃ hārāṃgulīyāṃgadavisphuraṃtīm | śrīnāsikāmauktikahaṃsikībhiḥ śrīkaṃṭhacūḍāmaṇikuṃḍalāḍhyām || 6 || tattejasā dharṣita āśu naṃdo natvātha tāmāha kṛtāṃjaliḥ san | ayaṃ tu sākṣātpuruṣottamastvaṃ priyāsya mukhyāsi sadaiva rādhe || 7 || guptaṃ tvidaṃ gargamukhena vedmi gṛhāṇa rādhe nijanāthamaṃkāt | enaṃ gṛhaṃ prāpaya meghabhītaṃ vadāmi cetthaṃ prakṛterguṇāḍhyam || 8 || namāmi tubhyaṃ bhuvi rakṣa māṃ tvaṃ yathepsitaṃ sarvajanairdurāpam | śrīrādhovāva ahaṃ prasannā tava bhaktibhavānmaddarśanaṃ durlabhameva naṃda || 9 || śrīnaṃda uvāca yadi prasannāsi tadā bhavenme bhaktirdṛḍhā kau yuvayoḥ padābje | satāṃ ca bhaktistava bhaktibhājāṃ saṃgaḥ sadā me'tha yuge yuge ca || 10 || śrīnārada uvāca tathāstu coktvātha hariṃ karābhyāṃ jagrāha rādhā nijanāthamaṃkāt | gate'tha naṃde praṇate vrajeśe tadā hi bhāṃḍīravanaṃ jagāma || 11 || golokalokācca purā samāgatā bhūmirnijaṃ svaṃ vapurādadhānā | yā padmarāgādikhacitsuvarṇā babhūva sā tatkṣaṇameva sarvā || 12 || vṛṃdāvanaṃ divyavapurdadhānaṃ vṛkṣairvaraiḥ kāmadughaiḥ sahaiva | kaliṃdaputrī ca suvarṇasaudhaiḥ śrīratnasopānamayī babhūva || 13 || govardhano ratnaśilāmayo'bhūtsuvarṇaśṛṅgaiḥ paritaḥ sphuradbhiḥ | mattālibhirnirjharasuṃdarībhirdarībhiruccāṃgakarīva rājan || 14 || tadā nikuṃjo'pi nijaṃ vapurdadhatsabhāyutaṃ prāṃgaṇadivyamaṃḍapam | vasaṃtamādhuryadharaṃ madhuvratairmayūrapārāvatakokiladhvanim || 15 || suvarṇaratnādikhacitpaṭairvṛtaṃ patatpatākāvalibhirvirājitam | saraḥ sphuradbhirbhramarāvalīḍhitairvicarcitaṃ kāṃcanacārupaṃkajaiḥ || 16 || tadaiva sākṣātpuruṣottamottamo babhūva kaiśoravapurghanaprabhaḥ | pītāṃbaraḥ kaustubharatnabhūṣaṇo vaṃśīdharo manmatharāśimohanaḥ || 17 || bhujena saṃgṛhya hasanpriyāṃ harirjagāma madhye suvivāhamaṃḍapam | vivāhasaṃbhārayutaḥ samekhalaṃ sadarbhamṛdvārighaṭādimaṃḍitam || 18 || tatraiva siṃhāsana udgate vare parasparaṃ saṃmilitau virejatuḥ | paraṃ bruvaṃtau madhuraṃ ca daṃpatī sphuratprabhau khe ca taḍidghanāviva || 19 || tadāṃbarāddevavaro vidhiḥ prabhuḥ samāgatastasya parasya saṃmukhe | natvā tadaṃghrī hyuśatī girābhiḥ kṛtāñjaliścāru caturmukho jagau || 20 || śrībrahmovāca anādimādyaṃ puruṣottamottamaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacandraṃ nijabhaktavatsalam | svayaṃ tvasaṃkhyāṃḍapatiṃ parātparaṃ rādhāpatiṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmyaham || 21 || golokanāthastvamatīva līlo līlāvatīyaṃ nijalokalīlā | vaikuṃṭhanātho'si yadā tvameva lakṣmīstadeyaṃ vṛṣabhānujā hi || 22 || tvaṃ rāmacaṃdro janakātmajeyaṃ bhūmau haristvaṃ kamalālayeyam | yajñāvatāro'si yadā tadeyaṃ śrīdakṣiṇā strī pratipatnimukhyā || 23 || tvaṃ nārasiṃho'si ramā tadeyaṃ nārāyaṇastvaṃ ca nareṇa yuktaḥ | tadā tviyaṃ śāṃtiratīva sākṣācchāyeva yātā ca tavānurūpā || 24 || tvaṃ brahma ceyaṃ prakṛtistaṭasthā kālo yademāṃ ca viduḥ pradhānām | mahānyadā tvaṃ jagadaṃkuro'si rādhā tadeyaṃ saguṇā ca māyā || 25 || yadāṃtarātmā viditaścaturbhistadā tviyaṃ lakṣaṇarūpavṛttiḥ | yadā virāḍdehadharastvameva tadākhilaṃ vā bhuvi dhāraṇeyam || 26 || śyāmaṃ ca gauraṃ viditaṃ dvidhā mahastavaiva sākṣātpuruṣottamottama | golokadhāmādhipatiṃ pareśaṃ parātparaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmyaham || 27 || sadā paṭhedyo yugalastavaṃ paraṃ golokadhāmapravaraṃ prayāti saḥ | ihaiva sauṃdaryasamṛddhisiddhayo bhavaṃti tasyāpi nisargataḥ punaḥ || 28 || yadā yuvāṃ prītiyutau ca daṃpatī parātparau tāvanurūparūpitau | tathāpi lokavyavahārasaṅgrahādvidhiṃ vivāhasya tu kārayāmyaham || 29 || śrīnārada uvāca tadā sa utthāya vidhirhutāśanaṃ prajvālya kuṃḍe sthitayostayoḥ puraḥ | śruteḥ karagrāhavidhiṃ vidhānato vidhāya dhātā samavasthito'bhavat || 30 || sa vāhayāmāsa hariṃ ca rādhikāṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ saptahiraṇyaretasaḥ | tataśca tau taṃ praṇamayya vedavittau pāṭhayāmāsa ca saptamaṃtrakam || 31 || tato harervakṣasi rādhikāyāḥ karaṃ ca saṃsthāpya hareḥ karaṃ punaḥ | śrīrādhikāyāḥ kila pṛṣṭhadeśake saṃsthāpya maṃtrāṃśca vidhiḥ prapāṭhayan || 32 || rādhā karābhyāṃ pradadau ca mālikāṃ kiṃjalkinīṃ kṛṣṇagale'linādinīm | hareḥ karābhyāṃ vṛṣabhānujā gale | tataśca vahniṃ praṇamayya vedavit || 33 || saṃvāsayāmāsa supīṭhayośca tau kṛtāṃjalī maunayutau pitāmahaḥ | tau pāṭhayāmāsa tu paṃcamaṃtrakaṃ samarpya rādhāṃ ca piteva kanyakām || 34 || puṣpāṇi devā vavṛṣustadā nṛpa vidyādharībhirnanṛtuḥ surāṃganāḥ | gaṃdharvavidyādharacāraṇāḥ kalaṃ sakinnarāḥ kṛṣṇasumaṃgalaṃ jaguḥ || 35 || mṛdaṃgavīṇāmuruyaṣṭiveṇavaḥ śaṃkhānakā duṃdubhayaḥ satālakāḥ | nedurmuhurdevavarairdivi sthitairjayetyabhūnmaṅgalaśabdamuccakaiḥ || 36 || uvāca tatraiva vidhiṃ hariḥ svayaṃ yathepsitaṃ tvaṃ vada vipra dakṣiṇām | tadā hariṃ prāha vidhiḥ prabho me dehi tvadaṃghryornijabhaktidakṣiṇām || 37 || tathāstu vākyaṃ vadato vidhirhareḥ śrīrādhikāyāśca padadvayaṃ śubham | natvā karābhyāṃ śirasā punaḥ punarjagāma gehaṃ praṇataḥ praharṣitaḥ || 38 || tato nikuṃjeṣu caturvidhānnaṃ divyaṃ manojñaṃ priyayā pradattam | jaghāsa kṛṣṇaḥ prahasanparātmā kṛṣṇena dattaṃ kramukaṃ ca rādhā || 39 || tataḥ kareṇāpi karaṃ priyāyā harirgṛhītvā pracacāla kuṃje | jagāma jalpanmadhuraṃ prapaśyan vṛṃdāvanaṃ śrīyamunāṃ latāśca || 40 || śrīmallatākuṃjanikuṃjamadhye nilīyamānaṃ prahasaṃtameva | vilokya śākhāṃtaritaṃ ca rādhā jagrāha pītāṃbaramāvrajaṃtī || 41 || dudrāva rādhā harihastapadmā jhaṃkāramaṃghryoḥ pratikurvatī kau | nilīyamānā yamunānikuṃje punarvrajaṃtī harihastamātrāt || 42 || yathā tamālaḥ kaladhautavallyā ghano yathā caṃcalayā cakāsti | nīlo'drirājo nikaṣāśmakhanyā śrīrādhayā''dyastu tayā ramaṇyā || 43 || śrīrāsaraṃge janavarjite pare reme harī rāsarasena rādhayā | vṛṃdāvane bhṛṅgamayūrakūjallate caratyeva ratīśvaraḥ paraḥ || 44 || śrīrādhayā kṛṣṇahariḥ parātmā nanarta govarddhanakaṃdarāsu | mattāliṣu prasravaṇaiḥ sarobhirvirājitāsu dyutimallatāsu || 45 || cakāra kṛṣṇo yamunāṃ sametya varaṃ vihāraṃ vṛṣabhānuputryā | rādhākarāllakṣadalaṃ sapadmaṃ dhāvangṛhītvā yamunājaleṣu || 46 || rādhā hareḥ pītapaṭaṃ ca vaṃśīṃ vetraṃ gṛhītvā sahasā hasaṃtī | dehīti vaṃśīṃ vadato hareśca jagāda rādhā kamalaṃ nu dehi || 47 || tasyai dadau devavaro'tha padmaṃ rādhā dadau pītataṭaṃ ca vaṃśīm | vetraṃ ca tasmai haraye tayoḥ punarbabhūva līlā yamunātaṭeṣu || 48 || tataśca bhāṃḍīravane priyāyāścakāra śṛṅgāramalaṃ manojñam | patrāvalīyāvakakajjalādyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ suratnairvrajagoparatnaḥ || 49 || hareśca śṛṅgāramalaṃ prakartuṃ samudyatā tatra yadā hi rādhā | tadaiva kṛṣṇastu babhūva bālo vihāya kaiśoravapuḥ svayaṃ hi || 50 || naṃdena dattaṃ śiśumeva yādṛśaṃ bhūmau luṭhaṃtaṃ prarudaṃtamāyayau | hariṃ vilokyāśu ruroda rādhikā tanoṣi māyāṃ nu kathaṃ hare mayi || 51 || itthaṃ rudaṃtīṃ sahasā viṣaṇṇāmākāśavāgāha tadaiva rādhām | śocaṃ nu rādhe iha mā kuru tvaṃ manorathaste bhaviyā hi paścāt || 52 || śrutvātha rādhā hi hariṃ gṛhītvā gatā''śu gehe vrajarājapatnyāḥ | dattvā ca bālaṃ kila naṃdapatnyā uvāca dattaḥ pathi te ca bhartrā || 53 || uvāca rādhāṃ nṛpa naṃdagehinī dhanyā'si rādhe vṛṣabhānukanyake | tvayā śiśurme parirakṣito bhayānmeghāvṛte vyomni bhayāturo vane || 54 || saṃpūjitā ślāghitasadguṇā sā sunaṃditā śrīvṛṣabhānuputrī | tadā hyanujñāpya yaśomatīṃ sā śanaiḥ svagehaṃ hi jagāma rādhā || 55 || itthaṃ harerguptakathā ca varṇitā rādhāvivāhasya sumaṃgalāvṛtā | śrutvā ca yairvā paṭhitā ca pāṭhitā tānpāpavṛndā na kadā spṛśaṃti || 56 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīrādhikāvivāhavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||
<1.17> śrīnārada uvāca atha bālau kṛṣṇarāmau gauraśyāmau manoharau | līlayā cakraturalaṃ suṃdaraṃ naṃdamaṃdiram || 1 || riṃgamāṇau ca jānubhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ saha maithila | vrajatālpena kālena bruvaṃtau madhuraṃ vraje || 2 || yaśodayā ca rohiṇyā lālitau poṣitau śiśū | kadā vinirgatāvaṅkātkvacidaṅkaṃ samāsthitau || 3 || maṃjīrakiṃkiṇīrāvaṃ kurvaṃtau tāvitastataḥ | trilokīṃ mohayaṃtau dvau māyābālakavigrahau || 4 || krīḍantamādāya śiśuṃ yaśodājire luṭhaṃtaṃ vrajabālakaiśca | taddhūlilepāvṛtadhūsarāṃgaṃ cakre hyalaṃ prokṣaṇamādareṇa || 5 || jānudvayābhyāṃ ca samaṃ karābhyāṃ punarvrajanprāṃgaṇametya kṛṣṇaḥ | mātraṃkadeśe punarāvrajansan babhau vraje kesaribālalīlaḥ | taṃ sarvato haimanacitrayuktaṃ pītāṃbaraṃ kaṃcukamādadhānam | sphuratprabhaṃ ratnamayaṃ ca mauliṃ dṛṣṭvā sutaṃ prāpa mudaṃ yaśodā || 7 || bālaṃ mukuṃdamatisuṃdarabālakeliṃ dṛṣṭvā paraṃ mudamavāpuratīva gopyaḥ | śrīnaṃdarājavrajametya gṛhaṃ vihāya sarvāstu vismṛtagṛhāḥ sukhavigrahāstāḥ || 8 || śrīnaṃdarājagṛhakṛtrimasiṃharūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā vrajanpratiravannṛpa bhīruvadyaḥ | nītvā ca taṃ nijasutaṃ gṛhamāvrajaṃtīṃ gopyo vraje saghṛṇayā hyavadan yaśodām || 9 || gopya ūcuḥ krīḍārthaṃ capalaṃ hyenaṃ mā bahiḥ kārayāṃgaṇāt | bālakeliṃ dugdhamukhaṃ kākapakṣadharaṃ śubhe || 10 || ūrdhvadaṃtadvayaṃ jātaṃ pūrvaṃ mātuladoṣadam | asyāpi mātulo nāsti te sutasya yaśomati || 11 || tasmāddānaṃ tu kartavyaṃ vighnānāṃ nāśahetave | goviprasurasādhūnāṃ chaṃdasāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā || 12 || śrīnārada uvāca tadā yaśodārohiṇyau sutakalyāṇahetave | vastraratnanavānnānāṃ dānaṃ nityaṃ ca cakratuḥ || 13 || atha vraje rāmakṛṣṇau bālasiṃhāvalokanau | padbhyāṃ calaṃtau ghoṣeṣu vardhamānau babhūvatuḥ || 14 || śrīdāmasubalādyaiśca vayasyairvrajabālakaiḥ | yamunāsikate śubhre luṭhaṃtau sakutūhalau || 15 || kāliṃdyupavane śyāmaistamālaiḥ saghanairvṛte | kadaṃbakuṃjaśobhāḍhye ceratū rāmakeśavau || 16 || janayan gopagopīnāmānandaṃ bālalīlayā | vayasyaiścorayāmāsa navanītaṃ ghṛtaṃ hariḥ || 17 || ekadā hyupanaṃdasya patnī nāmnā prabhāvatī | śrīnandamandiraṃ prāptā yaśodāṃ prāha gopikā || 18 || prabhāvatyuvāca navanītaṃ ghṛtaṃ dugdhaṃ dadhi takraṃ yaśomati | āvayorbhedarahitaḥ tvatprasādācca me'bhavat || 19 || nāhaṃ vadāmi cānena steyaṃ kutrāpi śikṣitam | śikṣāṃ karoṣi na sute navanītamuṣi svataḥ || 20 || yadā mayā kṛtā śikṣā tadā dhṛṣṭastavāṃgajaḥ | gālipradānaṃ dattvāyaṃ dravati prāṃgaṇānmama || 21 || vrajādhīśasya putro'yaṃ bhūtvā steyaṃ samācaret | na mayā kathitaṃ kiṃcidyaśode tava gauravāt || 22 || śrīnārada uvāca śrutvā prabhāvatīvākyaṃ yaśodā naṃdagehinī | bālaṃ nirbhartsya tāmāha sāmnā premaparāyaṇā || 23 || śrīyaśodā uvāca gavāṃ koṭirgṛhe me'sti gorasairārdritācalā | na jāne dadhimuḍ bālo nātti so'tra kadācana || 24 || anena muṣitaṃ gavyaṃ tatsamaṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa me | te śiśau me śiśau bhedo nāsti kiṃcitprabhāvati || 25 || navanītamukhaṃ cainamatra tvaṃ hyānayiṣyasi | tadā śikṣāṃ kariṣyāmi bhartsanaṃ baṃdhanaṃ tathā || 26 || śrīnārada uvāca śrutvā vākyaṃ tadā gopī prasannā gṛhamāgatā | ekadā dadhicauryārthaṃ kṛṣṇastasyā gṛhaṃ gataḥ || 27 || vayasyairbālakaiḥ sārddhaṃ pārśvakuḍye gṛhasya ca | hastāddhastaṃ saṃgṛhītvā śanaiḥ kṛṣṇo viveśa ha || 28 || śikyasthaṃ gorasaṃ dṛṣṭvā hastāgrāhyaṃ hariḥ svayam | ulūkhale pīṭhake ca gopānsthāpyāruroha tam || 29 || tadapi prāṃśunā labhyaṃ gorasaṃ śikyasaṃsthitam | śrīdāmnā subalenāpi daṃḍenāpi tatāḍa ca || 30 || bhagnabhāṇḍātsarvagavyaṃ bṛhadbhūmau manoharam | jagāsa sabalo markairbālakaiḥ saha mādhavaḥ || 31 || bhagnabhāṃḍasvanaṃ śrutvā prāptā gopī prabhāvatī | palāyiteṣu bāleṣu jagrāha śrīkaraṃ hareḥ || 32 || nītvā mṛṣāśruṃ bhīruṃ ca gacchantī nandamaṃdiram | agre nandaṃ sthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā mukhe vastraṃ cakāra ha || 33 || harirviciṃtayannitthaṃ mātā daṃḍaṃ pradāsyati | dadhāra tadbālarūpaṃ svacchandagatirīśvaraḥ || 24 || sā yaśodāṃ sametyāśu prāha gopī ruṣānvitā | bhāṃḍaṃ bhagnīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ muṣitaṃ dadhyanena vai || 35 || yaśodā tatsutaṃ vīkṣya hasaṃtī prāha gopikām | vastrāṃtaṃ ca mukhādgopī dūrīkṛtya vadāṃhasaḥ || 36 || apavādo yadā deyo nirvāsaṃ kuru me parāt | yuṣmatputrakṛtaṃ cauryamasmatputrakṛtaṃ bhavet || 37 || janalajjāsamāyuktā dūrīkṛtya mukhāṃbaram | sāpi prāha nijaṃ bālaṃ vīkṣya vismitamānasā || 38 || niṣpadastvaṃ kutaḥ prāpto vrajasāro'sti me kare | vadantītthaṃ ca taṃ nītvā nirgatā nandamaṃdirāt || 39 || yaśodā rohiṇī naṃdo rāmo gopāśca gopikāḥ | jahasuḥ kathayaṃtaste dṛṣṭo'nyāyo vraje mahān || 40 || bhagavāṃstu bahirvīthyāṃ bhūtvā śrīnandanandanaḥ | prahasan gopikāṃ prāha dhṛṣṭāṃgaścaṃcalekṣaṇaḥ || 41 || śrībhagavān uvāca punarmāṃ yadi gṛhṇāsi kadācittvaṃ hi gopike | te bhartṛrūpastu tadā bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 42 || śrīnārada uvāca śrutvā sā vismitā gopī gatā gehe'tha maithila | tadā sarvagṛhe gopyo na gṛhṇanti hariṃ hriyā || 43 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde dadhisteyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||
<1.18> śrīnārada uvāca gopīgṛheṣu vicaran navanītacauraḥ śyāmo manoharavapurnavakaṃjanetraḥ | śrībālacaṃdra iva vṛddhigato narāṇāṃ cittaṃ haranniva cakāra vraje ca śobhām || 1 || śrīnaṃdanaṃdanamatīva calaṃ gṛhītvā gehaṃ nidhāya mumuhurnavanaṃdagopāḥ | satkaṃdukaiśca satataṃ paripālayaṃte gāyaṃta ūrjitasukhā na jagatsmarantaḥ || 2 || rājovāca navopanaṃdanāmāni vada devaṛṣe mama | ahobhāgyaṃ tu yeṣāṃ vai te pūrvaṃ ka ihāgatāḥ || 3 || tathā ṣaḍvṛṣabhānūnāṃ karmāṇi maṃgalāni ca | śrīnārada uvāca gayaśca vimalaḥ śrīśaḥ śrīdharo maṃgalāyanaḥ || 4 || maṃgalo raṃgavallīśo raṅgojirdevanāyakaḥ | navanaṃdāśca kathitā babhūvurgokule vraje || 5 || vītihotro'gnibhuk sāmbaḥ śrīkaro gopatiḥ śrutaḥ | vrajeśaḥ pāvanaḥ śāṃta upanaṃdāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 6 || nītivinmārgadaḥ śuklaḥ pataṃgo divyavāhanaḥ | gopeṣṭaśca vraje rājañjātāḥ ṣaḍvṛṣabhānavaḥ || 7 || goloke kṛṣṇacaṃdrasya nikuṃjadvāramāśritāḥ | vetrahastāḥ śyāmalāṃgā navanaṃdāśca te smṛtāḥ || 8 || nikuṃje koṭiśo gāvastāsāṃ pālanatatparāḥ | vaṃśīmayūrapakṣāḍhyā upanaṃdāśca te smṛtāḥ || 9 || nikuṃjadurgarakṣāyāṃ daṃḍapāśadharāḥ sthitāḥ | ṣaḍdvāramāsthitāḥ ṣaḍ vai kathitā vṛṣabhānavaḥ || 10 || śrīkṛṣṇasyecchayā sarve golokādāgatā bhuvi | teṣāṃ prabhāvaṃ vaktuṃ hi na samarthaścaturmukhaḥ || 11 || ahaṃ kimu vadiṣyāmi teṣāṃ bhāgyaṃ mahodayam | yeṣāmārohamāsthāya bālakelirbabhau hariḥ || 12 || ekadā yamunātīre mṛtkṛṣṇenāvalīḍhitā | yaśodāṃ bālakāḥ prāhuratti bālo mṛdaṃ tava || 13 || balabhadre ca vadati tadā sā naṃdagehinī | kare gṛhītvā svasutaṃ bhīrunetramuvāca ha || 14 || śrīyaśodā uvāca kasmānmṛdaṃ bhakṣitavān mahājña bhavānvayasyāśca vadaṃti sākṣāt | jyāyānbalo'yaṃ vadati prasiddhaṃ mā evamarthaṃ na jahāti neṣṭam || 15 || śrībhagavānuvāca sarve mṛṣāvādarathā vrajārbhakā mātarmayā kvāpi na mṛtprabhakṣitā | yadā samīcīnamanena vākpathaṃ tadā mukhaṃ paśya madīyamaṃjasā || 16 || śrīnārada uvāca atha gopī bālakasya paśyaṃtī suṃdaraṃ mukham | prasāritaṃ ca dadṛśe brahmāṃḍaṃ racitaṃ guṇaiḥ || 17 || saptadvīpānsapta siṃdhūnsakhaṃḍānsagirīndṛḍhān | ābrahmalokām̐llokām̐strīnsvātmabhiḥ savrajaiḥ saha || 18 || dṛṣṭvā nimīlitākṣī sā bhūtvā śrīyamunātaṭe | bālo'yaṃ me hariḥ sākṣāditi jñānamayī hyabhūt || 19 || tadā jahāsa śrīkṛṣṇo mohayanniva māyayā | yaśodā vaibhavaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ na sasmāra gatasmṛtiḥ || 20 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde brahmāṃḍadarśanaṃ nāma aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 ||
<1.19> śrīnārada uvāca ekadā gokule gopyo mamaṃthurdadhi sarvataḥ | gṛhe gṛhe pragāyantyo gopālacaritaṃ param || 1 || yaśodāpi samutthāya prātaḥ śrīnaṃdamaṃdire | bhāṃḍe rāyaṃ vinikṣipya mamaṃtha dadhi suṃdarī || 2 || maṃjīrarāvaṃ saṃkurvanbālaḥ śrīnaṃdanaṃdanaḥ | nanartta navanītārthaṃ rāyaḥśabdakutūhalāt || 3 || bālakelirbabhau nṛtyanmātuḥ pārśvamanubhraman | sunādikiṃkiṇīsaṃgha jhaṃkāraṃ kārayanmuhuḥ || 4 || haiyaṃgavīnaṃ satataṃ navīnaṃ yācansa māturmadhuraṃ bruvansaḥ | ādāya haste'śmasutaṃ ruṣā sudhīrbibheda kṛṣṇo dadhimaṃthapātram || 5 || palāyamānaṃ svasutaṃ yaśodā prabhāvatī prāpa na hastamātrāt | yogīśvarāṇāmapi yo durāpaḥ kathaṃ sa māturgrahaṇe prayāti || 6 || tathāpi bhakteṣu ca bhaktavaśyatā pradarśitā śrīhariṇā nṛpeśvara | bālaṃ gṛhītvā svasutaṃ yaśomatī babaṃdha rajjvātha ruṣā hyulūkhale || 7 || ādāya yadyadbahudāma tattatsvalpaṃ prabhūtaṃ svasute yaśodā | guṇairna baddhaḥ prakṛteḥ paro yaḥ kathaṃ sa baddho bhavatīha dāmnā || 8 || yadā yaśodā gatabandhanecchā khinnā niṣaṇṇā nṛpa khinnamānasā | āsīttadāyaṃ kṛpayā svabaṃdhe svacchaṃdayānaḥ svavaśo'pi kṛṣṇaḥ || 9 || eṣa prasādo na hi vīrakarmaṇāṃ na jñānināṃ karmadhiyāṃ kutaḥ punaḥ | māturyathā'bhūnnṛpa eṣu tasmānmuktiṃ vyadhādbhaktimalaṃ na mādhavaḥ || 10 || tadaiva gopyastu samāgatāstvaraṃ dṛṣṭvātha bhagnaṃ dadhimaṃthabhājanam | ulūkhale baddhamatīva dāmabhirbhītaṃ śiśuṃ vīkṣya jagurghṛṇāturāḥ || 11 || gopya ūcuḥ asmadgṛheṣu pātrāṇi bhinatti satataṃ śiśuḥ | tadapyenaṃ no vadāmaḥ kāruṇyānnaṃdagehini || 12 || gatavyathe hyakaruṇe yaśode he vrajeśvari | yaṣṭyā nirbhartsito bālastvayā baddho ghaṭakṣayāt || 13 || śrīnārada uvāca ityuktāyāṃ yaśodāyāṃ vyagrāyāṃ gṛhakarmasu | karṣannulūkhalaṃ kṛṣṇo bālaiḥ śrīyamunāṃ yayau || 14 || tattaṭe ca mahāvṛkṣau purāṇau yamalārjunau | tayormadhye gataḥ kṛṣṇo hasan dāmodaraḥ prabhuḥ || 15 || cakarṣa sahasā kṛṣṇastiryaggatamulūkhalam | karṣaṇena samūlau dvau petaturbhūmimaṃḍale || 16 || pātanenāpi śabdo'bhūtpracaṃḍo vajrapātavat | vinirgatau ca vṛkṣābhyāṃ devau dvāvedhaso'gnivat || 17 || dāmodaraṃ parikramya pādau spṛṣṭau svamaulinā | kṛtāṃjalī hariṃ natvā tau tu tatsaṃmukhe sthitau || 18 || devāvūcatuḥ āvāṃ muktau brahmadaṇḍātsadyaste'cyuta darśanāt | mābhūtte nijabhaktānāṃ helanaṃ hyāvayorhare || 19 || karuṇānidhaye tubhyaṃ jaganmaṃgalaśīline | dāmodarāya kṛṣṇāya goviṃdāya namo namaḥ || 20 || śrīnārada uvāca iti natvā hariṃ tau dvāvudīcīṃ ca diśaṃ gatau | tadaiva hyāgatāḥ sarve naṃdādyā bhayakātarāḥ || 21 || kathaṃ vṛkṣau prapatitau vinā vātaṃ vrajārbhakāḥ | vadatāśu tadā bālā ūcuḥ sarve vrajaukasaḥ || 22 || bālā ūcuḥ anena pātitau vṛkṣau tābhyāṃ dvau puruṣau sthitau | enaṃ natvā gatāvadya tāvudīcyāṃ sphuratprabhau || 23 || śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ na te śraddadhire tataḥ | mumoca naṃdaḥ svaṃ bālaṃ dāmnā baddhamulūkhale || 24 || saṃlālayansvāṃkadeśe samāghrāya śiśuṃ nṛpa | nirbhartsya bhāminīṃ naṃdo viprebhyo gośataṃ dadau || 25 || śrībahulāśva uvāca kāvimau puruṣau divyau vada devarṣisattama | kena doṣeṇa vṛkṣatvaṃ prāpitau yamalārjunau || 26 || śrīnārada uvāca nalakūbaramaṇigrīvau rājarājasutau parau | jagmaturnaṃdanavanaṃ maṃdākinyāstaṭe sthitau || 27 || apsarobhirgīyamānau ceraturgatavāsasau | vāruṇīmadirāmattau yuvānau dravyadarpitau || 28 || kadāciddevalo nāma munīṃdro vedapāragaḥ | nagnau dṛṣṭvā ca tāvāha duṣṭaśīlau gatasmṛtī || 29 || devala uvāca yuvāṃ vṛkṣasamau dṛṣṭau nirlajjau dravyadarpitau | tasmādvṛkṣau tu bhūyāstāṃ varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ bhuvi || 30 || dvāparāṃte bhārate ca māthure vrajamaṃḍale | kaliṃdanaṃdinītīre mahāvanasamīpataḥ || 31 || paripūrṇatamaṃ sākṣātkṛṣṇaṃ dāmodaraṃ harim | golokanāthaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūrvarūpau bhaviṣyathaḥ || 32 || itthaṃ devalaśāpena vṛkṣatvaṃ prāpitau nṛpa | nalakūbaramaṇigrīvau śrīkṛṣṇena vimocitau || 33 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde yamalārjunabhaṃgo nāma ekonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 ||
<1.20> śrīnārada uvāca ekadā kṛṣṇacaṃdrasya darśanārthaṃ parasya ca | durvāsā muniśārdūlo vrajamaṃḍalamāyayau || 1 || kāliṃdīnikaṭe puṇye saikate ramaṇasthale | mahāvanasamīpe ca kṛṣṇamārāddadarśa ha || 2 || śrīmanmadanagopālaṃ luṭhaṃtaṃ bālakaiḥ saha | parasparaṃ prayuddhyaṃtaṃ bālakeliṃ manoharam || 3 || dhūlidhūsarasarvāṃgaṃ vakrakeśaṃ digaṃbaram | dhāvaṃtaṃ bālakaiḥ sārddhaṃ hariṃ vīkṣya sa vismitaḥ || 4 || śrīmuniruvāca sa īśvaro'yaṃ bhagavānkathaṃ bālairluṭhan bhuvi | ayaṃ tu naṃdaputro'sti na śrīkṛṣṇaḥ parātparaḥ || 5 || śrīnārada uvāca itthaṃ mohaṃ gate tatra durvāsasi mahāmunau | krīḍankṛṣṇastatsamīpe tadaṃke hyāgataḥ svayam || 6 || punarvinirgato hyaṃkādbālasiṃhāvalokanaḥ | hasankalaṃ bruvankṛṣṇaḥ saṃmukhaḥ punarāgataḥ || 7 || hasatastasya ca mukhe praviṣṭaḥ śvasanairmuniḥ | dadarśānyaṃ mahālokaṃ sāraṇyaṃ janavarjitam || 8 || araṇyeṣu bhramaṃstatra kutaḥ prāpta iti bruvan | tadaivājagareṇāpi nigīrṇo'bhūnmahāmuniḥ || 9 || brahmāṃḍaṃ tatra dadṛśe salokaṃ sabilaṃ param | bhramandvīpeṣu sa muniḥ sthito'bhūtparvate site || 10 || tapastatāpa varṣāṇāṃ śatakoṭīḥ prabhuṃ bhajan | naimittikākhye pralaye prāpte viśvabhayaṃkare || 11 || āgacchaṃtaḥ samudrāste plāvayaṃto dharātalam | vahaṃsteṣu ca durvāsā na prāpāṃtaṃ jalasya ca || 12 || vyatīte yugasāhastre magno'bhūdvigatasmṛtiḥ | punarjaleṣu vicarannaṃḍamanyaṃ dadarśa ha || 13 || tacchidre ca praviṣṭo'sau divyāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ gatastataḥ | taḍaṃḍamūrdhni lokeṣu vidherāyuḥsamaṃ caran || 14 || evṃ chidraṃ tatra vīkṣya prāviśatsa hariṃ smaran | bahirvinirgato hyaṃḍāddadarśāśu mahājalam || 15 || tasmin jale tu lakṣyaṃte koṭiśo hyaṃḍarāśayaḥ | tato munirjalaṃ paśyan dadarśa virajāṃ nadīm || 16 || tatpāraṃ pragataḥ sākṣādgolokaṃ prāviśanmuniḥ | vṛṃdāvanaṃ govarddhanaṃ yamunāpulinaṃ śubham || 17 || dṛṣṭvā prasannaḥ sa munirnikuṃjaṃ prāviśattadā | gopagopīgaṇavṛtaṃ gavāṃ koṭibhiranvitam || 18 || asaṃkhyakoṭimārtaṃḍa jyotiṣāṃ maṃḍale tataḥ | divye lakṣadale padme sthitaṃ rādhāpatiṃ harim || 19 || paripūrṇatamaṃ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam | asaṃkhyabrahmāṃḍapatiṃ golokaṃ svaṃ dadarśa ha || 20 || śrīkṛṣṇāsyāpi hasataḥ praviṣṭastanmukhe muniḥ | punarvinirgato'paśyadbālaṃ śrīnaṃdanaṃdanam || 21 || kāliṃdīnikaṭe puṇye saikate ramaṇasthale | bālakaiḥ sahitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vicaraṃtaṃ mahāvane || 22 || tadā muniśca durvāsā jñātvā kṛṣṇaṃ parātparam | śrīnaṃdanaṃdanaṃ natvā natvā prāha kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 23 || muniruvāca bālaṃ navīnaśatapatraviśālanetraṃ biṃbādharaṃ sajalamegharuciṃ manojñam | maṃdasmitaṃ madhurasuṃdaramaṃdayānaṃ śrīnaṃdanaṃdanamahaṃ manasā namāmi || 24 || maṃjīranūpuraraṇannavaratnakāṃcī śrīhārakesarinakhapratiyaṃtrasaṃgham | dṛṣṭyā''rtihārimaṣibinduvirājamānaṃ vaṃde kaliṃdatanujātaṭabālakelim || 25 || pūrṇendusuṃdaramukhopari kuṃcitāgrāḥ keśā navīnaghananīlanibhāḥ sphuraṃti | rājaṃta ānataśiraḥkumudasya yasya naṃdātmajāya sabalāya namo namaste || 26 || śrīnaṃdanaṃdanastotraṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet | tannetragocaro yāti sānaṃdaṃ naṃdanaṃdanaḥ || 27 || śrīnārada uvāca iti praṇamya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ durvāsā munisattamaḥ | taṃ dhyāyanprajapanprāgādbadaryāśramamuttamam || 28 || itthaṃ devarṣivaryeṇa nāradena mahātmanā | kathitaṃ kṛṣnacaritaṃ bahulāśvāya dhīmate || 29 || mayā the kathitaṃ brahman yaśaḥ kalimalāpaham | catuṣpadārthadaṃ divyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 30 || śrīśaunaka uvāca bahulāśvo maithileṃdraḥ kiṃ papraccha mahāmunim | nāradaṃ jñānadaṃ śāṃtaṃ tanme brūhi tapodhana || 31 || śrīgarga uvāca nāradaṃ jñānadaṃ natvā mānado maithilo nṛpaḥ | punaḥ papraccha kṛṣṇasya caritaṃ maṃgalāyanam || 32 || śrībahulāśva uvāca śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsākṣātparamānaṃdavigrahaṃ | paraṃ cakāra kiṃ citraṃ caritraṃ vada me prabho || 33 || pūrvāvatāraiścaritaṃ kṛtaṃ vai maṃgalāyanam | aparaṃ kiṃ tu kṛṣṇasya pavitraṃ caritaṃ param || 34 || śrīnārada uvāca sādhu sādhu tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ caritraṃ maṃgalaṃ hareḥ | tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi vṛṃdāraṇye ca yadyaśaḥ || 35 || idaṃ golokakhaṃḍaṃ ca guhyaṃ paramamadbhutaṃ | śrīkṛṣṇena prakathitaṃ goloke rāsamaṃḍale || 36 || nikuṃje rādhikāyai ca rādhā mahyaṃ dadāvidam | mayā tubhyaṃ śrāvitaṃ ca dattaṃ sarvārthadaṃ param || 37 || idaṃ paṭhitvā viprastu sarvaśāstrārthago bhavet | śrutvedaṃ cakravartī syāt kṣatriyaścaṃḍavikramaḥ || 38 || vaiśyo nidhipatirbhūyācchūdro mucyeta baṃdhanāt | niṣkāmo yo'pi jagati jīvanmuktaḥ sa jāyate || 39 || yo nityaṃ paṭhate samyagbhaktibhāvasamanvitaḥ | sa gacchetkṛṣṇacaṃdrasya golokaṃ prakṛteḥ param || 40 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ golokakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde bhagavajjanmavarṇanaṃ durvāsaso māyādarśanaṃ śrīnaṃdanaṃdanastotravarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 ||
<2.1> kṛṣṇātīre kokilākelikīre guṃjāpuṃje devapuṣpādikuṃje | kaṃbugrīvau kṣiptabāhū calantau rādhākṛṣṇau maṃgalaṃ me bhavetām || 1 || ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāṃjanaśalākayā | cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīguruve namaḥ || 2 || śrīnārada uvāca ekadopadravaṃ vīkṣya naṃdo nandānsahāyakān | vṛṣabhānūpanaṃdāṃśca vṛṣabhānuvarāṃstathā || 3 || samāhūya parānvṛddhān sabhāyāṃ tānuvāca ha | naṃda uvāca kiṃ kartavyaṃ tu vadatotpātāḥ santi mahāvane || 4 || śrīnārada uvāca teṣāṃ śrutvātha sannando gopo vṛddhotimaṃtravit | aṃke nītvā rāmakṛṣṇau naṃdarājamuvāca ha || 5 || sannanda uvāca utthātavyamito'smābhiḥ sarvaiḥ parikaraiḥ saha | gaṃtavyaṃ cānyadeśeṣu yatrotpātā na saṃti hi || 6 || bālaste prāṇavatkṛṣṇo jīvanaṃ vrajavāsinām | vraje dhanaṃ kule dīpo mohano bālalīlayā || 7 || hā bakyā śakaṭenāpi tṛṇāvartena bālakaḥ | mukto'yaṃ drumapātena hyutpātaṃ kimataḥ param || 8 || tasmādvṛṃdāvanaṃ sarvaiḥ gaṃtavyaṃ bālakaiḥ saha | utpāteṣu vyatīteṣu punarāgmanaṃ kuru || 9 || nanda uvāca katikrośairvistṛtam tadvanaṃ vṛṃdāvanaṃ vrahāt | tallakṣaṇaṃ tatsukhaṃ ca vada buddhimatāṃ vara || 10 || sannanda uvāca prāgudīcyāṃ barhiṣado dakṣiṇasyāṃ yadoḥ purāt | paścimāyāṃ śoṇitapurān māthuraṃ maṃḍalaṃ viduḥ || 11 || viṃśadyojanavistīrṇaṃ sārdhaṃ yadyojanena vai māthuraṃ maṃḍalaṃ divyaṃ vrajamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || 12 || mathurāyāṃ śaurigṛhe gargācāryamukhācchrutam | māthuraṃ maṃḍalaṃ divyaṃ tīrtharājena pūjitam || 13 || vanebhyastatra sarvebhyo vanaṃ vṛṃdāvanaṃ varam | paripūrṇatamasyāpi līlākrīḍaṃ manoharam || 14 || vaikuṃṭhānnāparo loko na bhūto na bhaviṣyati | ekaṃ vṛṃdāvanaṃ nāma vaikuṃṭhācca parātparam || 15 || yatra govardhano nāma girirājo virājate | kālindīnikaṭe yatra pulinaṃ maṃgalāyanam || 16 || bṛhatsānurgiriryatra yatra nandīśvaro giriḥ | krośānāṃ ca caturviṃśadvistṛtaiḥ kānanairvṛtam || 17 || paśavyaṃ gopagopīnāṃ gavāṃ sevyaṃ manoharam | latākuṃjāvṛtaṃ tadvai vanaṃ vṛṃdāvanaṃ smṛtam || 18 || naṃda uvāca kadā vrajo'yaṃ sannaṃda tīrtharājena pūjitaḥ | etadveditumicchāmi paraṃ kautuhalaṃ hi me || 19 || sannaṃda uvāca śaṃkhāsuro mahādaityaḥ purā naimittike laye | svapato brahmaṇaḥ so'pi vedadhrugdaityapuṃgavaḥ || 20 || jitvā devān brahmalokāddhṛtvā vedān gato'rṇave | gateṣu teṣu vedeṣu devānāṃ ca gataṃ balam || 21 || tadā sākṣāddhariḥ pūrṇo dhṛtvā mātsyaṃ vapuḥ puram | naimittikalayāṃbhodhau yuyudhe tena yajñarāṭ || 22 || śūlaṃ cikṣepa haraye śaṃkho daityo mahābalaḥ | svacakreṇa hariḥ sākṣāttacchūlaṃ śatadhākarot || 23 || hariṃ tatāḍa śirasā śaṃkho viṣṇumuraḥsthale | tasya mūrddhaprahāreṇa na cacāla parātparaḥ || 24 || tadā gadāṃ samādāya matsyarūpadharo hariḥ | pṛṣṭhe jaghāna taṃ daityaṃ śaṃkharūpaṃ mahābalam || 25 || gadāprahāravyathitaḥ kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ | punarutthāya sarveśaṃ muṣṭinā sa tatāḍa ha || 26 || tadā viṣṇuḥ svacakreṇa saśṛṅgaṃ tacchiro dṛḍham | jahāra kupitaḥ sākṣādbhagavān kamalekṣaṇaḥ || 27 || jitvā śaṃkhaṃ devavaraiḥ sārdhaṃ viṣṇurvrajeśvara | prayāgametya sa harirvedān tān brahmaṇe dadau || 28 || yajñaṃ cakāra vidhivatsarvadevagaṇaiḥ saha | prayāgaṃ ca samāhūya tīrtharājaṃ cakāra ha || 29 || tatsākṣādakṣayavaṭaḥ kṛto līlātapatravat | munibhānusute'thormicāmaraistaṃ virejatuḥ || 30 || tadaiva sarvatīrthāni jaṃbūdvīpasthitāni ca | nītvā baliṃ samājagmustīrtharājāya dhīmate || 31 || tīrtharājaṃ ca saṃpūjya natvā tīrthāni sarvataḥ | svadhāmāni yayurnanda harau devairgate sati || 32 || tadaiva nāradaḥ prāpto munīndraḥ kalahapriyaḥ | siṃhāsane bhrājamānaṃ tīrtharājamuvāca ha || 33 || śrīnārada uvāca tīrthaiḥ prapūjitastvaṃ vai tīrtharāja mahātapaḥ | tubhyaṃ ca sarvatīrthāni mukhyānīha baliṃ daduḥ || 34 || vrajādvṛṃdāvanādīni nāgatānīha te puraḥ | tīrthānāṃ rājarājastvaṃ pramattaistaistiraskṛtaḥ || 35 || iti prabhāṣya taṃ sākṣādgate devarṣisattame | tīrtharājastadā kruddho harilokaṃ jagāma ha || 36 || natvā hariṃ parikramya puraḥ sthitvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ | sarvatīrthaiḥ parivṛtaḥ śrīnāthaṃ prāha tīrtharāṭ || 37 || tīrtharāja uvāca he devadeva prāpto'haṃ tīrtharājastvayā kṛtaḥ | baliṃ dadurme tīrthāni mathurāmaṃḍalaṃ vinā || 38 || pramattairvrajatīrthaiśca tairahaṃ tu tiraskṛtaḥ | tasmāttubhyaṃ ca kathitaṃ prāpto'haṃ tava maṃdire || 39 || śrībhagavānuvāca dharāyāṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ tvaṃ kṛtastīrtharāṇmayā | kiṃtu svasya gṛhasyāpi na kṛto rāṭ tvameva hi || 40 || kiṃ tvaṃ me maṃdiraṃ lipsuḥ mattavadbhāṣase vacaḥ | tīrtharāja gṛhaṃ gaccha śṛṇu vākyaṃ śubhaṃ ca me || 41 || mathurāmaṃḍalaṃ sākṣānmaṃdiraṃ me parātparam | lokatrayātparaṃ divyaṃ pralaye'pi na saṃhṛtam || 42 || sannanda uvāca iti śrutvā tīrtharājo vismito'bhūdgatasmayaḥ | āgatya natvā saṃpūjya māthuraṃ vrajamaṃḍalam || 43 || tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya svadhāma gatavān punaḥ | dharāyā mānabhaṃgārthaṃ pūrvametatpradarśitam | mayā tavāgre kathitaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 44 || naṃda uvāca dharāyā mānabhaṅgārthaṃ kena pūrvaṃ pradarśitam | etanme vada gopeśa māthuraṃ vrajamaṃḍalam || 45 || sannanda uvāca ādau vārāhakalpe'smin harirvārāharūpadhṛk | rasātalātsamuddhṛtya gāṃ babhau daṃṣṭrayā prabhuḥ || 46 || gacchantaṃ vārivṛndeṣu bhagavantaṃ rameśvaram | daṃṣṭrāgre śobhitā pṛthvī prāha devaṃ janārdanam || 47 || dharovāca deva kutra sthale tvaṃ vai sthāpanāṃ me kariṣyasi | jalapūrṇaṃ jagatsarvaṃ dṛśyate vada he prabho || 48 || vārāha uvāca yadā vṛkṣāḥ pradṛṣṭā hi bhavantyudvegatā jale | tadā te sthāpanā bhūyātpaśyantī gaccha bhūruhān || 49 || dharovāca sthāvarāṇāṃ tu racanā mamopari samāsthitā | anyāsti kiṃ vā dharaṇī tvahaṃ hi dhāraṇāmayī || 50 || sannanda uvāca vadantītthaṃ dadarśāgre jale vṛkṣān manoharān | vīkṣya pṛthvī hariṃ prāha sarvato vigatavismayā || 51 || dharovāca deva kasmiṃsthale vṛkṣāḥ santi hyete sapallavāḥ | idaṃ manasi me citraṃ vada yajñapate prabho || 52 || vārāha uvāca māthuraṃ maṃḍalaṃ divyaṃ dṛśyate'gre nitambini | golokabhūmisaṃyuktaṃ pralaye'pi na saṃhṛtam || 53 || sannanda uvāca tacchrutvā vismitā pṛthvī gatamānā babhūva ha | tasmānnanda mahābāho vrajo'yaṃ sarvato'dhikaḥ || 54 || śrutvedaṃ vrajamāhātmyaṃ jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ | tīrtharājātparaṃ viddhi māthuraṃ vrajamaṃḍalam || 55 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vṛndāvanakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśva saṃvāde vṛndāvana āgamanodyogavarṇanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
<2.2> nanda uvāca he sannanda mahāprājña sarvajño'si bahuśrutaḥ | vrajamaṃdalamāhātmyaṃ vadataste mukhācchrutam || 1 || girirgovardhano nāma tasyotpattiṃca me vada | kasmādenaṃ girivaraṃ girirājaṃ vadanti hi || 2 || yamuneyaṃ nadī sākṣātkasmātlokātsamāgatāḥ | tanmāhātmyaṃ ca vada me tvamasi jñānināṃ varaḥ || 3 || sannanda uvāca ekadā hastinapure bhīṣmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varam | papraccha pāṇḍuritthaṃ taṃ janānāṃ cānuśṛṇvatām || 4 || paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavān svayam | asaṃkhyabrahmāṃḍapatiḥ golokādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ || 5 || bhuvo bhārāvatārāya gacchan devo janārdanaḥ | rādhāṃ prāha priye bhīru gaccha tvamapi bhūtale || 6 || rādhovāca yatra vṛṃdāvanaṃ nāsti na yatra yamunā nadī | yatra govardhano nāsti tatra me na manaḥsukham || 7 || sannanda uvāca vedanāgakrośabhūmiṃ svadhāmnaḥ śrīhariḥ svayam | govardhanaṃ ca yamunāṃ preṣayāmāsa bhūpari || 8 || vedanāgakrośabhūmiḥ sāpi cātra samāgatā | caturviṃśadvanairyuktā sarvalokaiśca vanditā || 9 || bhāratātpaścimadiśi śālmalīdvīpamadhyataḥ | govardhano janma lebhe patnyāṃ droṇācalasya ca || 10 || govardhanopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire | himālayasumervādyāḥ śailāḥ sarve samāgatāḥ || 11 || natvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya pūjāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ | govardhanasya paramāṃ stutiṃ cakrurmahādrayaḥ || 12 || śailā ūcuḥ tvaṃ sākṣātkṛṣṇacaṃdrasya paripūrṇatamasya ca | goloke gogaṇairyukte gopīgopālasaṃyute || 13 || tvaṃ hi govardhano nāma vṛṃdāraṇye virājase | tvanno girīṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ girirājo'si sāṃpratam || 14 || namo vṛṃdāvanāṅkāya tubhyaṃ golokamauline | pūrṇabrahmātapatrāya namo govardhanāya ca || 15 || sannanda uvāca iti stutvātha girayo jagmuḥ svaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ tataḥ | śailo girivaraḥ sākṣādgirirāja iti smṛtaḥ || 16 || ekadā tīrthayāyī ca pulastyo munisattamaḥ | droṇācalasutaṃ śyāmaṃ giriṃ govardhanaṃ varam || 17 || mādhavīlatikāpuṣpaṃ palabhārasamanvitam | nirjharairnāditaṃ śāntaṃ kaṃdarāmaṃgalāyanam || 18 || tapoyogyaṃ ratnamayaṃ śataśṛṅgaṃ manoharam | citradhātuvicitrāṃgaṃ saṭaṃkaṃ pakṣisaṃkulam || 19 || mṛgaiḥ śākhāmṛgairvyāptaṃ mayūradhvanimaṃḍitam | muktipradaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ taṃ dadarśa mahāmuniḥ || 20 || tallipsurmuniśārdūlo droṇapārśvaṃ samāgataḥ | pūjito droṇagiriṇā pulastyaḥ prāha taṃ girim || 21 || pulastya uvāca he droṇa tvaṃ girindro'si sarvadevaiśca pūjitaḥ | divyauṣadhisamāyuktaḥ sadā jīvanado nṛṇām || 22 || arthī tavāṃtike prāptaḥ kāśīstho'haṃ mahāmuniḥ | govardhanaṃ sutaṃ dehi nānyairme'tra prayojanam || 23 || viśveśvarasya devasya kāśīnāmnā mahāpurī | yatra pāpī mṛtaḥ sadyaḥ paraṃ mokṣaṃ prayāti hi || 24 || yatra gaṃgā''gatā sākṣādviśvanātho'pi yatra vai | tatraiva sthāpayiṣyāmi jāto'yaṃ me manorathaḥ || 26 || sannanda uvāca pulastyavacanaṃ śrutvā svasutasnehavihvalaḥ | aśrupūrṇo droṇagiristaṃ muniṃ vākyamabravīt || 27 || droṇa uvāca putrasnehākulo'haṃ vai putro me'yamatipriyaḥ | te śāpabhayabhīto'haṃ vadāmyenaṃ mahāmune || 28 || he putra gaccha muninā bhārate karmake śubhe | traivargyaṃ labhyate yatra nṛbhirmokṣamapi kṣaṇāt || 29 || govardhana uvāca mune kathaṃ māṃ nayasi laṃbitaṃ yojanāṣṭakam | yojanadvayamuccāṃgaṃ paṃcayojanavistṛtam || 30 || pulastya uvāca upaviśya kare me tvaṃ gaccha putra yathāsukham | vāhayāmi kare tvāṃ vai yāvatkāśīṃ samāgataḥ || 31 || govardhana uvāca mune yatra sthale bhūmyāṃ sthāpanāṃ me kariṣyasi | kariṣyāmi na cotthānaṃ tadbhūmyāḥ śapatho mama || 32 || pulastya uvāca ahamāśālmalidvīpān maryādīkṛtya kausalam | na sthāpanāṃ kariṣyāmi śapathaste'pi me pathi || 33 || sannanda uvāca muneḥ karatale tasminnāruroha mahācalaḥ | praṇamya pitaraṃ droṇamaśrupūrṇākulekṣaṇaḥ || 34 || munistaṃ dakṣiṇakare dhṛtvā gacchan śanaiḥ śanaiḥ | svatejo darśayan nṝṇāṃ prāpto'bhūdvrajamaṃḍale || 35 || jātismaro giristatra prāhedaṃ pathi ciṃtayan | paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavān svayam || 36 || akhaṃḍabrahmāṇḍapatirvraje'trāvatariṣyati | bālalīlāṃ ca kaiśorīṃ ceṣṭāṃ gopālabālakaiḥ || 37 || dānalīlāṃ mānalīlāṃ hariratra kariṣyati | tasmānmayā na gantavyaṃ bhūmiśceyaṃ kalindajā || 38 || golokādrādhayā sārdhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo'trāgamiṣyati | kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyāmi kṛtvā taddarśanaṃ param || 39 || evaṃ vicārya manasā bhūri bhāraṃ dadau kare | tadā muniśca śrāṃto'bhūdbhūtapūrvaṃ gatasmṛtiḥ || 40 || karāduttārya taṃ śailaṃ nidhāya vrajamaṃḍale | laghuśaṃkājayārthaṃ hi gato'bhūdbhārapīḍitaḥ || 41 || kṛtvā śaucaṃ jale snātvā pulastyo munisattamaḥ | uttiṣṭheti muniḥ prāha giriṃ govardhanaṃ param || 42 || notthitaṃ bhūribhārāḍhyaṃ karābhyāṃ taṃ mahāmuniḥ | svatejasā balenāpi gṛhītumupacakrame || 43 || muninā saṃgṛhīto'pi girirājo girā''rdrayā | na calālāṃguliṃ kiṃcit tadapi droṇanandanaḥ || 44 || sannanda uvāca gaccha gaccha giriśreṣṭha bhāraṃ mā kuru mā kuru | mayā jñāto'si ruṣṭastvamabhiprāyaṃ vadāśu me || 45 || govardhana uvāca mune'tra me na doṣo'sti tvayā me sthāpanā kṛtā | kariṣyāmi na cotthānaṃ pūrvaṃ me śapathaḥ kṛtaḥ || 46 || sannanda uvāca pulastyo muniśārdūlaḥ krodhāt pracalitendriyaḥ | sphuradoṣṭho droṇaputraṃ śaśāpa vigatodyamaḥ || 47 || sannanda uvāca gire tvayātidhṛṣṭena na kṛto me manorathaḥ | tasmāttu tilamātraṃ hi nityaṃ tvaṃ kṣīṇatāṃ vraja || 48 || sannanda uvāca kāśīṃ gate pulastyarṣāvayaṃ govardhano giriḥ | nityaṃ saṃkṣīyate nanda tilamātraṃ dine dine || 49 || yāvadbhāgīrathī gaṃgā yāvadgovardhano giriḥ | tāvatkaleḥ prabhāvastu bhaviṣyati na karhicit || 50 || govardhanasya prakaṭaṃ caritraṃ nṛṇāṃ mahāpāpaharaṃ pavitram | mayā tavāgre kathitaṃ vicitraṃ sumuktidaṃ kau ruciraṃ na citram || 51 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vṛndāvanakhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde girirājotpattikathanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
<2.3> sannanda uvāca goloke hariṇā''jñaptā kālindī saritāṃ varā | kṛṣṇaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya gantumabhyudyatābhavat || 1 || tadaiva virajā sākṣādgaṅgā brahmadravodbhavā | dve nadyau yamunāyāṃ tu saṃpralīne babhūvatuḥ || 2 || paripūrṇatamāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ tasmāt kṛṣṇasya nandarāṭ | paripūrṇatamasyāpi paṭṭarājñīṃ vidurjanāḥ || 3 || tato vegena mahatā kālindī saritāṃ varā | bibheda virajāvegaṃ nikuṃjadvāranirgatā || 4 || asaṃkhyabrahmāṃḍacayaṃ spṛṣṭvā brahmadravaṃ gatā | bhindantī tajjalaṃ dīrghaṃ svavegena mahānadī || 5 || vāmapādāṃguṣṭhanakhabhinnabrahmāṃḍamastake | śrīvāmanasya vivare brahmadravasamākule || 6 || tasmin śrīgaṃgayā sārdhaṃ praviṣṭā'bhūtsaridvarā | vaikuṃṭhaṃ cājitapadaṃ saṃprāpya dhruvamaṃḍale || 7 || brahmalokamabhivyāpya patantī brahmamaṃḍalāt | tataḥ surāṇāṃ śataśo lokāllokaṃ jagāma ha || 8 || tataḥ papāta vegena sumerugirimūrdhani | girikūṭānatikramya bhittvā gaṃḍaśilātaṭān || 9 || sumerordakṣiṇadiśaṃ gantumabhyuditābhavat | tataḥ śrīyamunā sākṣācchrīgaṃgāyāṃ vinirgatā || 10 || gaṃgā tu prayayau śailaṃ himavantaṃ mahānadī | kṛṣṇā tu prayayau śailaṃ kalindaṃ prāpya sā tadā || 11 || kāliṃdīti samākhyātā kāliṃdaprabhavā yadā | kaliṃdagirisānūnāṃ gaṃḍaśailataṭān dṛḍhān || 12 || bhittvā luṭhantī bhūkhaṃḍe kṛṣṇā vegavatī satī | deśānpunantī kālindī prāptavān khāṃḍave vane || 13 || paripūrṇatamaṃ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇaṃ varamicchatī | dhṛtvā vapuḥ paraṃ divyaṃ tapastepe kalindajā || 14 || pitrā vinirmite gehe jale'dyāpi samāśritā | tato vegena kālindī prāptābhūdvrajamaṃḍale || 15 || vṛndāvanasamīpe ca mathurānikaṭe śubhe | śrīmahāvanapārśve ca saikate ramaṇasthale || 16 || śrīgokule ca yamunā yūthībhūtvātisuṃdarī | śrīkṛṣṇacaṃdrarāsārthaṃ nijavāsaṃ cakāra ha || 17 || atho vrajādvrajaṃtī sā vrajavikṣepavihvalā | premānandāśrusaṃyuktā bhūtvā paścimavāhinī || 18 || tatastrivāraṃ vegena natvātho vrajamaṃḍale | deśān punantī prayayau prayāgaṃ tīrthasattamam || 19 || punaḥ śrīgaṃgayā sārdhaṃ kṣīrābdhiṃ sā jagāma ha | devāḥ suvarṣaṃ puṣpāṇāṃ cakrurdivi jayadhvanim || 20 || kṛṣṇā śrīyamunā sākṣāt kālindī saritāṃ varā | samudrametya śrīgaṃgāṃ prāha gadgadayā girā || 21 || yamunovāca he gaṃge tvaṃ tu dhanyā'si sarvabrahmāṇḍapāvanī | kṛṣṇapādābjasaṃbhūtā sarvalokaikavanditā || 22 || ūrdhvaṃ yāmi harerlokaṃ gaccha tvamapi he śubhe | tvatsamānaṃ hi divyaṃ ca na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 23 || gaṃgovāca sarvatīrthamayī gaṃgā tasmāttvāṃ praṇamāmyaham | yatkiṃcidvā prakathitaṃ tatkṣamasva sumaṃgale || 24 || he kṛṣṇe tvaṃ tu dhanyā'si sarvabrahmāṇḍapāvanī | kṛṣṇavāmāṃsasaṃbhūtā paramānandarūpiṇī || 25 || paripūrṇatamā sākṣātsarvalokaikavanditā | paripūrṇatamasyāpi śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ || 26 || paṭṭarājñīṃ parāṃ kṛṣṇe kṛṣṇāṃ tvāṃ praṇamāmyaham | tīrthairdevairdurlabhā tvaṃ goloke'pi ca durghaṭā || 27 || ahaṃ yāsyāmi pātālaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasyājñayā śubhe | tvadviyogāturā'haṃ vai pānaṃ kartuṃ na ca kṣamā || 28 || yūthībhūtvā bhaviṣyāmi śrīvraje rāsamaṃḍale | yatkiṃcinme prakathitaṃ tatkṣamasva haripriye || 29 || itthaṃ parasparaṃ natvā dve nadyau yayaturdrutam | lokān pavitrīkurvantī pātāle svaḥsaridgatā || 30 || sāpi bhogavatīnāmnā babhau bhogavatīvane | yajjalaṃ satrinayanaḥ śeṣo mūrdhnā bibharti hi || 31 || atha kṛṣṇā savegena bhittvā saptādhimaṃḍalam | saptadvīpamahīpṛṣṭhe luṭhantī vegavattarā || 32 || gatvā svarṇamayīṃ bhūmiṃ lokālokācalaṃ gatā | tatsānugaṇḍaśailānāṃ taṭaṃ bhittvā kalindajā || 33 || tanmūrdhni cotpapātāśu sphāravajjaladhārayā | udgacchantī tadūrdhvaṃ sā yayau svargaṃ tu nākinām || 34 || ābrahmalokaṃ lokāṃstānabhivyāpya hareḥ padam | brahmāḍaraṃdhraṃ śrībrahma dravayuktaṃ sametya sā || 35 || puṣpavarṣaṃ pravarṣatsu deveṣu praṇateṣu ca | punaḥ śrīkṛṣṇagolokamāruroha saridvarā || 36 || kalindagirinandinīnavacaritrametat śubhaṃ śrutaṃ ca yadi pāṭhitaṃ bhuvi tanoti sanmaṃgalam | jano'pi yadi dhārayetkila paṭhecca yo nityaśaḥ sa yāti paramaṃ padaṃ nijanikuṃjalīlāvṛtam || 37 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vṛndāvanakhaṇḍe naṃdasannandasaṃvāde kālindyāgamanavarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
<2.4> sannandasya vacaḥ śrutvā gantuṃ nandaḥ samudyataḥ | sarvairgopagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ mudito'bhūnmahāmanāḥ || 1 || yaśodayā ca rohiṇyā sarvagopīgaṇaiḥ saha | aśvai rathairvīrajanairmaṇḍito vipramaṃḍalaiḥ || 2 || gobhiśca śakaṭairyukto vṛddhairbālaistathānugaiḥ | gāyakairgīyamānaśca śaṃkhaduṃdubhiniḥsvanaiḥ || 3 || putrābhyāṃ rāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ nandarājo mahāmatiḥ | rathamāruhya he rājan vanaṃ vṛṃdāvanaṃ yayau || 4 || vṛṣabhānuvaro gopo gajamāruhya bhāryayā | aṃke nītvā sutāṃ rādhāṃ gīyamānaśca gāyakaiḥ || 5 || mṛdaṃgatālavīṇānāṃ veṇūnāṃ kalaniḥsvanaiḥ | gopālagogaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ vṛndāraṇyaṃ jagāma ha || 6 || upanandāstathā nandāḥ tathā ṣaḍ vṛṣabhānavaḥ | sarvaiḥ parikaraiḥ sārdhaṃ jagmurvṛndāvanaṃ vanam || 7 || vṛṃdāvane saṃpraviśya gopāḥ sarve sahānugāḥ | ghoṣān vidhāya vasatīrvāsaṃ cakruritastataḥ || 8 || sabhāmaṇḍapasaṃyuktaṃ sadurgaṃ parikhāyutam | caturyojanavistīrṇaṃ saptadvārasamanvitam || 9 || sarovaraiḥ parivṛtaṃ rājamārgaṃ manoharam | sahasrakuñjaṃ ca puraṃ vṛṣabhānuracīkḷpat || 10 || śrīkṛṣṇo nandanagare vṛṣabhānupure'rbhakaiḥ | cacāra krīḍanaparo gopīnāṃ prītimāvahan || 11 || atha vṛndāvane rājan sarvagopālasammatau | babhūvaturvatsapālau rāmakṛṣṇau manoharau || 12 || cārayāmāsaturvatsān grāmasīmnyarbhakaiḥ saha | kālindīnikaṭe puṇye puline rāmakeśavau || 13 || nikuñjeṣu ca kuñjeṣu sampralīnāvitastataḥ | riṅgamāṇau ca kutrāpi nandaṃtau ceraturvane || 14 || kiṃkiṇījālasaṃyuktau siñcanmañjīranūpurau | nīlapītāmbaradharau hārakeyūrabhūṣitau || 15 || kṣepaṇaiḥ kṣipatau bālairvaṃśīvādanatatparau | mukhena kiṃkiṇīśabdaṃ kurvadbhirbālakaiśca tau || 16 || dhāvantau pakṣibhiśchāyāṃ rejatū rāmakeśavau | mayūrapakṣasaṃyuktau puṣpapallavabhūṣitau || 17 || ekadā vatsavṛndeṣu prāptaṃ vatsāsuraṃ nṛpa | kaṃsapraṇoditaṃ jñātvā śanaistatra jagāma ha || 18 || dhāvan gopeṣu sarvatra lāṃgūlaṃ cālayanmuhuḥ | daityaḥ paścimapādābhyāṃ harimaṃse tatāḍa ha || 19 || palāyiteṣu bāleṣu kṛṣṇastaṃ pādayordvayoḥ | gṛhītvā bhrāmayitvāśca pātayāmāsa bhūtale || 20 || punarnītvā karābhyāṃ taṃ kapitthe prāhiṇod hariḥ | tadā mṛtyuṃ gate daitye kapittho'pi mahādrumaḥ || 21 || kapitthān pātayāmāsa tadadbhutamivābhavat | vismiteṣu ca bāleṣu sādhu sādhviti vādiṣu || 22 || divi devā jayārāvaiḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire | taddaityasya mahajjyotiḥ kṛṣṇe līnaṃ babhūva ha || 23 || śrībahulāśva uvāca aho pūrvaṃ sukṛtakṛtko'yaṃ vatsāsuro mune | śrīkṛṣṇe līnatāṃ prāptaḥ śrīprapūrṇe parātpare || 24 || śrīnārada uvāca muruputro mahādaityaḥ pramīlo nāma devajit | vasiṣṭhasyāśrame prāpto nandinīṃ gāṃ dadarśa ha || 25 || tallipsurbrāhmaṇo bhūtvā yayāce gāṃ manoharām | tūṣṇīṃ sthite gauruvāca vasiṣṭhe divyadarśane || 26 || nandinī uvāca munīnāṃ gāṃ samāhartuṃ bhūtvā vipraḥ samāgataḥ | daityo'si murujastasmādgovatso bhava durmate || 27 || śrīnārada uvāca tadaiva vatsarūpo'bhūnmuruputro mahāsuraḥ | vasiṣṭhaṃ gāṃ parikramya natvā trāhītyuvāca ha || 28 || gauruvāca dvāparānte mahādaitya vṛṃdāraṇye yadā tava | govatseṣu gatasyāpi tadā muktirbhaviṣyati || 29 || śrīnārada uvāca paripūrṇatame sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇe patitapāvane | tasmāt vatsāsuro daityo līno'bhūt na hi vismayaḥ || 30 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vṛndāvanakhaṇḍe vatsāsuramokṣo nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
<2.5> ekadā cārayan vatsān sarāmo bālakairhariḥ | yamunānikaṭe prāptaṃ bakaṃ daityaṃ dadarśa ha || 1 || śvetaparvatasaṃkāśo bṛhatpādo ghanadhvaniḥ | palāyiteṣu bāleṣu vajratuṃḍo'grasaddharim || 2 || rudanto bālakāḥ sarve gataprāṇā ivābhavan | hāhākāraṃ tadā kṛtvā devāḥ sarve samāgatāḥ || 3 || iṃdro vajraṃ tadā nītvā taṃ tatāḍa mahābalam | tena ghātena patito na mamāra samutthitaḥ || 4 || brahmāpi brahmadaṃḍena taṃ tatāḍa mahābakam | tena ghātena patito mūrchito ghaṭikādvayam || 5 || vidhunvan svatanuṃ vegātajjṛmbhitaḥ punarutthitaḥ | na mamāra tadā daityo jagarja ghanavadbalī || 6 || trilocanastriśūlena taṃ jaghāna mahāsuram | chinnaikapakṣo daityo'pi na mṛto'tibhayaṃkaraḥ || 7 || vāyavyāstreṇa vāyustaṃ saṃjaghāna bakamataḥ | uccacāla bakastena punastatra sthito'bhavat || 8 || yamastaṃ yamadaṇḍena tāḍayāmāsa cāgrataḥ | tena daṇḍena na mṛto bako vai caṇḍavikramaḥ || 9 || daṇḍo'pi bhagnatāṃ prāgāt sa kṣato nābhavad bakaḥ | tadaiva cāgrataḥ prāptaścaṇḍāṃśuścaṇḍavikramaḥ || 10 || śatabāṇairbakaṃ daityaṃ saṃjaghāna dhanurdharaḥ | tīkṣṇaiḥ pakṣagatairbāṇairna mamāra bakastataḥ || 11 || dhanadastaṃ ca khaḍgena sutīkṣṇena jaghāna ha | chinnadvitīyapakṣo'bhūtanna mṛto daityapuṃgavaḥ || 12 || nīhārāstreṇa taṃ somaḥ saṃjaghāna mahābakam | śītārtto mūrchito daityo na mṛtaḥ punarutthitaḥ || 13 || āgneyāstreṇa taṃ hyagniḥ santatāḍa mahābakam | bhasmaromābhavaddaityo na mamāra mahākhalaḥ || 14 || apāṃ patistaṃ pāśena baddhvā kau vicakarṣa ha | karṣaṇātsa mahāpāpaḥ chinno'bhūtanna mṛtaśca vai || 15 || tatāḍa gadayā taṃ vai bhadrakālī tarasvinī | mūrchitastat prahāreṇa paraṃ kaśmalatāṃ yayau || 16 || kṣatamūrdhā samutthāya vidhunvan svatanuṃ punaḥ | jagarja ghanavadvīro bako daityo mahākhalaḥ || 17 || tadā śaktidharaḥ śaktiṃ tasmai cikṣepa satvaraḥ | tayaikapādo bhagno'bhūnna mṛtaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ varaḥ || 18 || tadā krodhena sahasā dhāvan daityastaḍitsvanaḥ | devān vidrāvayāmāsa svacaṃcvā tīkṣṇatuṇḍayā || 19 || agre palāyitān devānanvadhāvadbako'mbare | punastatra gato daityo nādayanmaṃḍalaṃ diśām || 20 || tadā devarṣayaḥ sarve sarve brahmarṣayo dvijāḥ | śrīnandanandanāyāśu saphalāṃ cāśiṣaṃ daduḥ || 21 || tadaiva kṛṣṇastanmadhye tatāna vapurujjvalam | caccharda kṛṣṇaṃ sahasā kṣatakaṃṭho mahābakaḥ || 22 || punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samāhartuṃ tīkṣṇayā tuṃḍayā'gatam | pucche gṛhītvā taṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pothayāmāsa bhūtale || 23 || punarutthāya tuṇḍaṃ svaṃ prasāryyāvasthitaṃ bakam | dadāra tuṃḍe hastābhyāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śākhāṃ gajo yathā || 24 || tadā mṛtasya daitasya jyotiḥ kṛṣṇe samāviśat | devatā vavṛṣuḥ puṣpaiḥ jayārāvaiḥ samanvitāḥ || 25 || gopālā vismitāḥ sarve kṛṣṇaṃ saṃśliṣya sarvataḥ | ūcustvaṃ kuśalībhūto mukto mṛtyumukhātsakhe || 26 || evaṃ kṛṣṇo bakaṃ hatvā sabalo bālakaiḥ saha | govatsairharṣito gāyannāyayau rājamaṃdire || 27 || paripūrṇatamasyāsya śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ | jagurgṛhe gatā bālāḥ śrutvedaṃ te'tivismitāḥ || 28 || śrībahulāśva uvāca ko'yaṃ daityaḥ pūrvakāle kasmātkena bako'bhavat | pūrṇabrahmaṇi sarveśe śrīkṛṣṇe līnatāṃ gataḥ || 29 || śrīnārada uvāca hayagrīvasuto daitya utkalo nāma he nṛpa | raṇe'marān vinirjitya śakrachatraṃ jahāra ha || 30 || tathā nṛṇāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ ca rājyaṃ hṛtvā mahābalaḥ | cakāra varṣāṇi śataṃ rājyaṃ sarvavibhūtimat || 31 || ekadā vicaran daityaḥ siṃdhusāgarasaṃgame | jājalermunisiddhasya parṇaśālāsamīpataḥ || 32 || jale nikṣipya baḍiśaṃ mīnānākarṣayan muhuḥ | niṣedhito'pi muninā nāmanyata sa durmatiḥ || 33 || tasmai śāpaṃ dadau siddho jājalirmunisattamaḥ | bakavattvaṃ jhaṣānatsi tvaṃ bako bhava durmate || 34 || tatkṣaṇādbakarūpo'bhūdbhraṣṭatejā gatasmayaḥ | patitaḥ pādayostasya natvā prāha kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 35 || utkala uvāca na jāne te tapaścaṃḍaṃ mune māṃ pāhi jājale | sādhunāṃ bhavatāṃ saṃgaṃ mokṣadvāraṃ paraṃ viduḥ || 36 || mitre śatrau samā māne'pamāne hemaloṣṭayoḥ | sukhe duḥkhasamā ye vai tvādṛśāḥ sādhavaśca te || 37 || kiṃ kiṃ na jātaṃ mahatāṃ darśanātkau mune nṛṇām | pārameṣṭhyaṃ ca sāmrājyamaindrayogapadaṃ labhet || 38 || jājale muniśārdūla traivargyaṃ kimabhūjjanaiḥ | sādhūnāṃ kṛpayā sākṣātpūrṇaṃ brahmāpi labhyate || 39 || śrīnārada uvāca tadā prasannaḥ sa munirjājalistamuvāca ha | varṣaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi tapastaptaṃ ca yena vai || 40 || vaivasvatāntare prāpte hyaṣṭāviṃśatime yuge | dvāparānte bhārate'pi māthure vrajamaṃḍale || 41 || paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavān svayam | vṛṃdāvane gavāṃ vatsān cārayan vicariṣyati || 42 || tadā tanmayatāṃ kṛṣṇe yāsyasi tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ hiraṇyākṣādayo daityā vaireṇāpi paraṃ gatāḥ || 43 || itthaṃ bakāsuro daitya utkalo jājalervarāt | śrīkṛṣṇe līnatāṃ prāptaḥ satsamgātkiṃ na jāyate || 44 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vṛndāvanakhaṇḍe bakāsuramokṣo nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||
<2.6> ekadā bālakaiḥ sākaṃ govatsāṃścārayan hariḥ | kālindīnikaṭe ramye bālakrīḍāṃ cakāra ha || 1 || aghāsuro nāma mahān daityastatra sthito'bhavat | krośadīrghaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā prasārya mukhamaṃḍalam || 2 || dūrādyaṃ parvatākāraṃ vīkṣya vṛndāvane vane | gopā jagmurmukhe tasya vatsaiḥ kṛtvāṃjalidhvanim || 3 || tadrakṣārthaṃ ca sabalaḥ tanmukhe prāviśaddhariḥ | nigīrṇeṣu savatseṣu bāleṣu tvahirūpiṇā || 4 || hāśabdo'bhūtsurāṇāṃ tu daityānāṃ harṣa eva hi | kṛṣṇo vapuḥ svaṃ vairājaṃ tatānāghodare tataḥ || 5 || tasya saṃrodhagāḥ prāṇāḥ śirop bhitvā vinirgatāḥ | tanmukhānnirgataḥ kṛṣṇo bālairvatsaiśca maithila || 6 || savatsakān śiśūn dṛṣṭvā jīvayāmāsa mādhavaḥ | tajjyotiḥ śrīghanaśyāme līnaṃ jātaṃ taḍidyathā || 7 || tadaiva vavṛṣurdevā puṣpavarṣāṇi pārthiva | evaṃ śrutvā munervākyaṃ maithilo vākyamabravīt || 8 || ko'yaṃ daityaḥ pūrvakāle śrīkṛṣṇe līnatāṃ gataḥ | aho vairānubandhena śīghraṃ daityo hariṃ gataḥ || 9 || śrīnārada uvāca śaṃkhāsurasuto rājan agho nāma mahābalaḥ | yuvātisundaraḥ sākṣāt kāmadeva ivāparaḥ || 10 || aṣṭāvakraṃ muniṃ yāntaṃ virūpaṃ malayācale | dṛṣṭvā jahāsa tamaghaḥ kurūpo'yamiti bruvan || 11 || taṃ śaśāpa mahāduṣṭaṃ tvaṃ sarpo bhava durmate | kurūpo vakragā jātiḥ sarpāṇāṃ bhūmimaṃḍale || 12 || tatpādayornipatitaṃ daityaṃ dīnaṃ gatasmayam | dṛṣṭvā prasannaḥ sa munirvaraṃ tasmai dadau punaḥ || 13 || aṣṭāvakra uvāca koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇastu tavodare | yadā''gacchetsarparūpāttadā muktirbhaviṣyati || 14 || śrīnārada uvāca aṣṭāvakrasya śāpena sarpo bhūtvā hyaghāsuraḥ | tadvarātparamaṃ mokṣaṃ gato devaiśca durlabham || 15 || vatsādbakamukhānmuktaṃ tato muktaṃ hyaghāsurāt | śrutvā katidinaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ yaśodā'bhūdbhayāturā || 16 || kalāvatīṃ rohiṇīṃ ca gopīgopān vayo'dhikān | vṛṣabhānuvaraṃ gopaṃ nandarājaṃ vrajeśvaram || 17 || navopanandānnandāśca vṛṣabhānūn prajeśvarān | samāhūya tadagre ca vacaḥ prāha yaśomatī || 18 || yaśodovāca kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kalyāṇaṃ me kathaṃ bhavet | matsute bahavo'riṣṭā āgacchanti kṣaṇe kṣaṇe || 19 || pūrvaṃ mahāvanaṃ tyaktvā vṛndāraṇye gatā vayam | etattyaktvā kva yāsyāmo deśe vadata nirbhaye || 20 || caṃcalo'yaṃ bālako me krīḍandūre prayāti hi | bālakāścaṃcalāḥ sarve na manyante vaco mama || 21 || bakāsuraśca me bālaṃ tīkṣṇatuṃḍo'grasadbalī | tasmānmuktantu jagrāhārbhakairdīnamaghāsuraḥ || 22 || vatsāsurastajjighāṃsuḥ so'pi daivena māritaḥ | vatsārthaṃ svagṛhādbālaṃ na bahiḥ kārayāmyaham || 23 || śrīnārada uvāca itthaṃ vadantīṃ satataṃ rudantīṃ yaśomatīṃ vīkṣya jagāda nandaḥ | āśvāsayāmāsasgargavākyaiḥ dharmārthaviddharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaḥ || 24 || nandarāja uvāca gargavākyaṃ tvayā sarvaṃ vismṛtaṃ he yaśomati | brāhmaṇānāṃ vacaḥ satyaṃ nāsatyaṃ bhavati kvacit || 25 || tasmāddānaṃ prakartavyaṃ sarvāriṣṭanivāraṇam | dānātparaṃ tu kalyāṇaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 26 || śrīnārada uvāca tadā yaśodā viprebhyo navaratnaṃ mahādhanam | svālaṃkārāṃśca bālasya sabalasya dadau nṛpa || 27 || ayutaṃ vṛṣabhānāṃ ca gavāṃ lakṣaṃ manoharam | dvilakṣamannabhārāṇāṃ nando dānaṃ dadau tataḥ || 28 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vṛndāvanakhaṇḍe aghāsuramokṣo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||
<2.7> athānyacchruṇu rājendra śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ | kaumāre krīḍanaścedaṃ paugaṇḍe kīrtanaṃ yathā || 1 || śrīkṛṣṇo'ghamukhānmṛtyo rakṣitvā vatsavatsapān | yamunāpulinaṃ gatvā prāhedaṃ harṣavardhanam || 2 || aho'tiramyaṃ pulinaṃ priyaṃ komalavālukam | śaratpraphullapadmānāṃ parāgaiḥ paripūritam || 3 || vāyunā trividhākhyena sugandhena sugandhitam | madhupadhvanisaṃyuktaṃ kuṃjadrumalatākulam || 4 || atropaviśya gopālā dinaikaprahare gate | bhojanasyāpi samayaṃ tasmātkuruta bhojanam || 5 || atra bhojanayogyā bhūrdṛśyate mṛduvālukā | vatsakāḥ salilaṃ pītvā te cariṣyanti śādvalam || 6 || iti kṛṣṇavacaḥ śrutvā tathetyāhuśca bālakāḥ | prakartuṃ bhojanaṃ sarve hyupaviṣṭāḥ sarittaṭe || 7 || atha kecitbālakāśca yeṣāṃ pārśve na bhojanam | te tu kṛṣṇasya karṇāntejagadurdīnayā girā || 8 || vayaṃ tu kiṃ kariṣyāmo'smatpārśve na tu bhojanam | nandagrāmantu dūraṃ hi gacchāmo vatsakairvayam || 9 || iti śrutvā hariḥ prāha mā śokaṃ kuruta priyāḥ | ahaṃ dāsyāmi sarveṣāṃ prayatnenāpi bhojanam || 10 || tasmānmadvākyaniratāḥ sarve bhavata bālakāḥ | iti kṛṣṇasya vacanātkṛṣṇapārśve ca te sthitāḥ | muktvā śikyāni sarve'nye bubhujuḥ kṛṣṇasaṃyutāḥ || 11 || cakāra kṛṣṇaḥ kila rājamaṃḍalīṃ gopālabālaiḥ purataḥ prapūritaiḥ | anekavarṇairvasanaiḥ prakalpitairmadhye sthito pītapaṭena bhūṣitaṃ || 12 || reje tataḥ so varagopadārakairyathāmareśo hyamaraiśca sarvataḥ | punaryathāmbhoruhakomalairmadhye tu vaideha suvarṇakarṇikā || 13 || kusumairaṅkuraiḥ kecitpallavaiśca dalaiḥ phalaiḥ | kṛṣṇastu kavalaṃ bhuktvā sarvān paśyannidaṃ jagau || 15 || anyānnidarśayan svādu nāhaṃ jānāmi vai sakhe | tathetyuktvā sa bālaśca nītvā'nyān kavalān dadau || 16 || bhuktvā te kathayāmāsuḥ prahasantaḥ parasparam | punastatrāpi subalo haraye kavalaṃ dadau || 17 || kṛṣṇastu kavalaṃ kiṃcidbhuktvā tatra jahāsa ha | ye bhuktakavalā bālāste sarve jahasuḥ sphuṭam || 18 || bālā ūcuḥ yasya mātāmahā mūḍhā śṛṇu nandakumāraka | na jñānaṃ bhojane tasya tasmātsvādu na vidyate || 19 || tato dadau ca kavalaṃ śrīdāmā mādhavāya ca | anyān sarvān bahuśreṣṭhaṃ jaguḥ sarve vrajārbhakāḥ || 20 || punaḥ kṛṣṇāya pradadau kavalaṃ ca varūthapaḥ | anyān bālān tathā sarvān kiṃcitkiṃcitprayatnataḥ | bhuktvā tu jahasuḥ sarve śrīkṛṣṇādyā vrajārbhakāḥ || 21 || bālāḥ ūcuḥ tādṛśaṃ bhojanañcāsya yādṛśaṃ subalasya vai || 22 || bhuktvātyudvignamanasaḥ sarve vayamataḥ kila | etaṃ pṛthakpṛthak sarve darśayantaḥ svabhojanam || 23 || hāsayanto hasantaśca cakruḥ krīḍāṃ parasparam | jaṭharasya paṭe veṇuṃ vetraṃ śṛṅgaśca kakṣake || 24 || vāme pāṇau ca kavalaṃ hyaṃgulīṣu phalāni ca | śirasā mukuṭaṃ bibhratskandhe pītapaṭaṃ tathā || 25 || hṛdaye vanamālāśca kaṭau kāñcīṃ tathaiva ca | pādayornūpurau bibhracchrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ hṛdi || 26 || tiṣṭhan madhye gopagoṣṭhyāṃ hāsayannarmabhiḥ svakaiḥ | svarge loke ca miṣati bubhuje yajñabhughariḥ || 27 || evaṃ kṛṣṇātmanātheṣu bhuṃjāneṣvarbhakeṣu ca | viviśurgahvare dūraṃ tṛṇalobhena vatsakāḥ || 28 || vilokya tān bhayatrastān gopān kṛṣṇa uvāca ha | yūyaṃ gacchantu māhaṃ tu hyāneṣye vatsakāniha || 29 || ityuktvā kṛṣṇa utthāya gṛhītvā kavalaṃ kare | vicikāya darīkuñjagahvare vatsakān svakān || 30 || tadaiva cāmbhojabhavaḥ samāgato vilokya muktiṃ hyagharākṣasasya ca | dadarśa kṛṣṇaṃ manasā yathāruci bhuṃjānamannaṃ vrajabālakaiḥ saha || 31 || dṛṣṭvā ca kṛṣṇaṃ manasā sa ūce tvayaṃ hi gopo na hi devadevaḥ | hariryadi syādbahukutsitānne kathaṃ rato vā vrajagopabālaiḥ || 32 || ityuktvā mohito brahmā māyayā paramātmanaḥ | draṣṭuṃ mañju mahattvaṃ tu manaścakre hyaho nṛpa || 33 || sarvān vatsānito gopānnītvā khe'vasthitaḥ purā | antardadhe vismito'jo dṛṣṭvāghāsuramokṣaṇam || 34 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vṛndāvanakhaṇḍe vatsavatsapālaharaṇaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||
<2.8> śrīnāradauvāca || ekadā sabalaḥ kṛṣṇaścārayangā manoharāḥ || gopālaiḥ sahitaḥ sarvairyayau tālavanaṃ navam || 1 || dhenukasya bhayādgopā na gatāste vanāntaram || kṛṣṇopi na gatastatra bala eko viveśa ha ||2|| nīlāṃbaraṃ kaṭau baddhā baladevo mahābalaḥ || paripakvaphalārthaṃ hi tadvane vicacāra ha||3|| bāhubhyāṃ kaṃpayaṃstālānphalasaṃghaṃ nipātayan || garjaṃśca nirbhayaḥ sākṣādanantonantavikramaḥ||4|| phalānāṃ patatāṃ śabdaṃ śrutvā krodhāvṛtaḥ kharaḥ || madhyāhne svāpakṛdduṣṭo bhīmaḥ kaṃsasakho balī ||5|| āyayau saṃmukhe yoddhuṃ baladevasya dhenukaḥ || balaṃ paścima pādābhyāṃ nihatyorasi satvaram ||6|| cakāra kharaśabdaṃ svaṃ paridhāvanmuhurmuhuḥ || gṛhītvā dhenukaṃ śīghraṃ balaḥ paścimapādayoḥ ||7|| cikṣepa tālavṛkṣe ca hastenaikenalīlayā || tena bhagnaśca tālopi tālānpārśvasthitānbahūn ||8|| pātayāmāsa rājendra tadadbhutamivābhavat || punarutthāya daityeṃdro balaṃ jagrāha roṣataḥ || 9 || yojanaṃ nodayāmāsa gajaṃ prati gajo yathā || gṛhītvā taṃ balaḥ sadyo bhrāmayitvātha dhenukam || 2.8.10 || bhūpṛṣṭhe pothayāmāsa mūrcchito bhagnamastakaḥ || kṣaṇena punarutthāya krodhasaṃyuktavigrahaḥ ||11|| mūrdhni kṛtvā catuḥśṛṃgaṃ dhṛtvā rūpaṃ bhayaṃkaram || gopānvidrāvayāmāsa śṛṃgaistīkṣṇairbhayaṃkaraiḥ ||12|| agre palāyitāngopāndudrāvāśu madotkaṭaḥ || śrīdāmā taṃ ca daṃḍena subalo muṣṭinā tathā ||13|| stokaḥ pāśena taṃ daityaṃ saṃtatāḍa mahābalam || kṣepaṇenārjunoṃśuśca daityaṃ lattikayā kharam ||14|| viśālarṣabha etyāśu pādena svabalena ca || tejasvī hyarddhacandreṇa devaprastha śca peṭakaiḥ ||15|| varūthapaḥ kaṃdukena saṃtatāḍa mahākharam || atha kṛṣṇopi taṃ nītvā hastābhyāṃ dhenukāsuram ||16|| bhrāmayitvāśu cikṣepa girigovarddhanopari || śrīkṛṣṇasya prahāreṇa mūrcchito ghaṭikādvayam || 17 || punarutthāya svatanuṃ vidhunvandārayanmukham || śṛṅgābhyāṃ śrīhariṃ nītvā dhāvandaityo na bhogataḥ ||18|| cacāra tena khe yuddhamūrdhvaṃ vai lakṣayojanam || gṛhītvā dhenukaṃ daityaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam || 19 || cikṣepādho bhūmimadhye cūrṇitāsthiḥ sa mūrcchitaḥ || punarutthāya śṛṅgābhyāṃ nādaṃ kṛtvātibhairavam ||2.8.20|| govardhanaṃ samutpāṭya śrīkṛṣṇe prāhiṇotkharaḥ || giriṃ gṛhītvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ ṇākṣipatta sya mastake ||21|| daityo giriṃ gṛhītvātha śrīkṛṣṇe prāhiṇodbalī|| kṛṣṇo govardhanaṃ nītvā pūrvasthāne samākṣipat ||22|| punardhāvanmahādaityaḥ śṛṅgābhyāṃ | dārayanbhuvam|| balaṃ paścimapādābhyāṃ tāḍayitvā jagarja ha|23| nanāda tena brahmāṃḍaṃ praijadbhūkhaṇḍamaṇḍalam|| hastābhyāṃ saṃgṛhītvā taṃ baladevo mahābalaḥ||24|| bhūpṛṣṭhe pothayāmāsa mūrcchitaṃ bhagnamastakam || punastatāḍa taṃ daityaṃ muṣṭinā hyacyutāgrajaḥ ||25|| tena muṣṭiprahāreṇa sadyo vai nidhanaṃ gataḥ || tadaiva vavṛṣurdevāḥ puṣpairnandanasaṃbhavaiḥ || 26 || dehādvinirgataḥ so'pi śyāmasundaravigrahaḥ || sragvī pītāṃbaro devo vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ ||27|| lakṣapārṣadasaṃyuktaḥ sahasra dhvajaśobhitaḥ || sahasracakradhvanibhṛddhayāyutasamanvitaḥ || 28 || lakṣacāmaraśobhāḍhyo'ruṇavarṇo'tiratnabhṛt || divyayojanavistīrṇo manoyāyī manoharaḥ ||29|| kiṃkiṇījālasaṃyukto ghaṭāmaṃjīrasaṃyutaḥ || hariṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya sabalaṃ divyarūpadhṛk || 2.8.30 || divyaṃ rathaṃ samāruhya dyotayanmaṃḍalandiśām || jagāma daityo he rājangolokaṃ prakṛteḥ param || 31 || śrīkṛṣṇo dhenukaṃ hatvā sabalo bālakaiḥ saha || tadyaśastu pragāyadbhirbabhau gokulagogaṇaiḥ || 32 || rājovāca || mune muktiṃ kathaṃ prāptaḥ pūrvaṃ ko dhenukāsuraḥ || kathaṃ kharatvamāpanna etanme brūhi tattvataḥ || 33 || śrīnārada uvāca || vairocanerbaleḥ putro nāmnā sāhasiko balī || nārīṇāṃ daśasāhasrai reme vai gandhamādane||34|| vāditrāṇāṃ nūpurāṇāṃ śabdobhūttadvane mahān|| guhāyāmāsthitasyāpi śrīkṛṣṇaṃ smarato muneḥ || 35 || durvāsaso'tha tenāpi dhyānabhaṃgo babhūva ha || nirgataḥ pādukārūḍho durvāsāḥ kṛśavigrahaḥ || 36 || dīrghaśmaśruryaṣṭi dharaḥ krodhapuṃjonaladyutiḥ || yasya śāpādviśvamidaṃ kaṃpate sa jagāda ha || 37 || durvāsā uvāca || uttiṣṭha gardabhākāra gardabho bhava durmate || varṣāṇāṃ tu caturlakṣaṃ vyatīte bhārate punaḥ || 38 || mādhure maṃḍale divye puṇye tālavane vane || baladevasya hastena muktiste bhavitā'sura || 39 || śrīnārada uvāca || tasmādbalasya hastena śrīkṛṣṇastaṃ jaghāna ha || prahlādāya varo datto na vadhyo me tavānvayaḥ || 2.8.40 || iti śrīmadgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vṛndāvanakhaṇḍe dhenukāsuramokṣo nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ||8||
<2.9> brahmovāca kṛṣṇāya meghavapuṣe capalāmbarāya piyūṣamiṣṭavacanāya parātparāya | vaṃśīdharāya śikhicaṃdrikayānvitāya devāya bhrātṛsahitāya namo'stu tasmai || 1 || kṛṣṇastu sākṣātpuruṣotamaḥ svayaṃ pūrṇaḥ pareśaḥ prakṛteḥ paro hariḥ | yasyāvatārāṃśakalā vayaṃ surā sṛjāma viśvaṃ kramato'sya śaktibhiḥ || 2 || sa tvaṃ sākṣātkṛṣṇacandrāvatāro nandasyāpi putratāmāgataḥ kau | vṛndāraṇye gopaveśena vatsān gopairmukhyaiścārayan bhrājase vai || 3 || hariṃ koṭikandarpalīlābhirāmaṃ sphuratkaustubhaṃ śyāmalaṃ pītavastram | vrajeśaṃ tu vaṃśīdharaṃ rādhikeśaṃ paraṃ sundaraṃ taṃ nikuṃje namāmi || 4 || taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaja harimādidevamasmin kṣetrajñaṃ kamiva viliptameghameva | svacchāṅgaṃ paramadhiyājñacaityarūpaṃ bhaktyādyairviśadavirāgabhāvasaṃghaiḥ || 5 || yāvanmanaśca rajasā prabalena vidvan saṃkalpa eva tu vikalpaka eva tāvat | tābhyāṃ bhavenmanasijastvabhimānayogastenāpi buddhivikṛtiṃ kramataḥ prayānti || 6 || vidyuddyutistvṛtuguṇo jalamadhyarekhā bhūtolmukaḥ kapaṭapāntharatiryathā ca | itthaṃ tathā'sya jagatastu sukhaṃ mṛṣeti duḥkhāvṛtaṃ viṣayaghūrṇamalātacakram || 7 || vṛkṣā jalena calatāpi calā ivātra netreṇa bhūricalitena caleva bhūśca | evaṃ guṇaḥ prakṛtijairbhramato janasthaṃ satyaṃ vadedguṇasukhādidameva kṛṣṇa || 8 || duḥkhaṃ sukhañca manasā prabhavañca supte mithyā bhavetpunaraho bhuvi jāgare'sya | itthaṃ vivekaghaṭitasya janasya sarvaṃ svapnabhramādṛtajagatsatataṃ bhaveddhi || 9 || jñānī visṛjya mamatāmabhimānayogaṃ vairāgyabhāvarasikaḥ satataṃ nirīhaḥ | dīpena dīpakaśatañca yathā prajātaṃ paśyet tathā''tmavibhavaṃ bhuvi caikatattvam || 10 || bhakto bhajedajapatiṃ hṛdi vāsudevaṃ nirdhūmavahniriva muktaguṇasvabhāvaḥ | paśyan ghaṭeṣu sajaleṣu yathendumekaṃ etādṛśaḥ paramahaṃsavaraḥ kṛtārthaḥ || 11 || stuvanti vedāḥ satatañca yaṃ sadā harermahimnaḥ kila ṣoḍaśīṃ kalām | kadāpi jānanti na te triloke vaktuṃ guṇāṃstasya jano'sti kaḥ paraḥ || 12 || vaktraiścaturbhistvahameva devaḥ śrīpañcavaktraḥ kila pañcavaktraiḥ | sahasraśīrṣāstu sahasravaktraiḥ ya stauti sevāṃ kurute ca tasya || 13 || viṣṇuśca vaikuṇṭhanivāsakṛcca kṣirodavāsī harireva sākṣāt | nārāyaṇo dharmasutastathāpi golokanāthaṃ bhajate bhavantam || 14 || aho'tidhanyo mahimā murārerjānanti bhūmau munayo na mānavāḥ | surāsurā vā manavo budhāḥ punaḥ svapne'pi paśyanti na tatpadadvayam || 15 || varaṃ hariṃ guṇākaraṃ sumuktidaṃ parātparam | rameśvaraṃ guṇeśvaraṃ vrajeśvaraṃ namāmyaham || 16 || tāmbūlasundaramukhaṃ madhuraṃ bruvantaṃ bimbādharaṃ smitayutaṃ sitakundadantam | nīlālakāvṛtakapolamanoharābhaṃ vande calatkanakakuṇḍalamaṇḍanārham || 17 || sundaraṃ tu tava rūpameva hi manmathasya manaso haraṃ param āvirastu mama netrayoḥ sadā śyāmalaṃ makarakuṇḍalāvṛtam || 18 || vaikuṇṭhalīlāpravaraṃ manoharaṃ namaskṛtaṃ devagaṇaiḥ paraṃ varam | gopālalīlābhiyutaṃ bhajāmyahaṃ golokanāthaṃ śirasā namāmyaham || 19 || yuktaṃ vasantakalakaṇṭhavihaṃgamaiśca saugandhikaṃ tvaraṇapallavaśākhisaṃgam | vṛndāvanaṃ sudhitadhīrasamīralīlaṃ gacchan harirjayati pātu sadaiva bhaktān || 20 || harati kamalamānaṃ lolamuktābhimānaṃ dharaṇirasikadānaṃ kāmadevasya bāṇam | śravaṇaviditayānaṃ netrayugmaprayāṇaṃ bhaja yaduta samakṣaṃ dānadakṣaṃ kaṭākṣam || 21 || śaraccandrākāraṃ nakhamaṇisamūhaṃ sukhakaraṃ suraktaṃ hṛtpūrṇaṃ prakaṭitatamaḥkhaṇḍanakaram | bhaje'haṃ brahmāṇḍesakalanarapāpābhidalanaṃ harerviṣṇordevairdivi bharatakhaṇḍe stutamalam || 22 || mahāpadme kiṃ vā paridhiriva cābhāti satataṃ kadādityasphūrjadrathacaraṇa itthaṃ dhvanidharaḥ | yathā nyastaṃ cakraṃ śatakiraṇayuktaṃ tu hariṇā sphuracchrīmañjīraṃ haricaraṇapadme tvadhigatam || 23 || kaṭyāṃ pītāmbaraṃ divyaṃ kṣudraghaṇṭikayā'nvitam | bhajāmyahaṃ cittaharaṃ kṛṣṇasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ || 24 || bhaje kṛṣṇakroḍe bhṛgumunipadaṃ śrīgṛhamalaṃ tathā śrīvatsāṅkaṃ nikaṣaruciyuktaṃ dyutiparam | gale hīrāhārān kanakamaṇimuktāvalidharān sphurat tārākārān bhramaravalibhārān dhvanikarān || 25 || vaṃśīvibhūṣitamalaṃ dvijadānaśīlaṃ siṃdrūravarṇamatikīcakarāvalīlam | hemāṃgulīyanikaraṃ nakhacaṃdrayuktaṃ hastadvayaṃ smara kadambasugandhapṛktam || 26 || śanaiścalan mānasarājahaṃsagrīvākṛtau kandhara uccadeśe | kādambinīmānaharau karau ca bhajāmi nityaṃ harikākapakṣau || 27 || kaladarpaṇavadviśadaṃ sukhadaṃ navayauvanarūpadharaṃ nṛpatim | maṇikuṇḍalakuntalaśāliratiṃ bhaja gaṇḍayugaṃ ravicandrarucim || 28 || khacitakanakamuktā raktavaidūryavāsaṃ madanavadanalīlā sarvasaundaryarāsam | aruṇavidhusakāśaṃ koṭisūryaprakāśaṃ ghaṭitaśikhisuvīṭaṃ naumi viṣṇoḥ kirīṭam || 29 || yaddvārideśe na gatirguhendra gaṇeśatārīreśadivākarāṇām | ājñāṃ vinā yānti na kuñjamaṇḍalaṃ taṃ kṛṣṇacandraṃ jagadīśvaraṃ bhaje || 30 || iti kṛtvā stutiṃ brahmā śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ | punaḥ kṛtāñjalirbhūtvā svavijñaptiṃ cakāra ha || 31 || aparādhaṃ tu putrasya mātṛvattvaṃ kṣamasva ca | ahaṃ tvannābhikamalātsambhavo'haṃ jagatpate || 32 || kāhaṃ lokapatiḥ kva tvaṃ koṭibrahmāṇḍanāyakaḥ | tasmādvrajapate deva rakṣa māṃ madhusūdana || 33 || māyayā yasya muhyanti devadaityanarādayaḥ | svamāyayā tanmohāya mūrkho'haṃ hyudyato'bhavam || 34 || nārāyaṇastvaṃ govinda nāhaṃ nārāyaṇo hare | brahmāṇḍaṃ tvaṃ vinirmāya śeṣe nārāyaṇaḥ purā || 35 || yasya śrībrahmaṇi dhāmni prāṇaṃ tyaktvā tu yoginaḥ | yatra yāsyanti tasmiṃstu sakulā pūtanā gatā || 36 || vatsānāṃ vatsapānāñca kṛtvā rūpāṇi mādhava | vicacāra vane tvaṃ tu hyaparādhānmama prabho || 37 || tasmātkṣamasva govinda prasīda tvaṃ mamopari | agaṇayyāparādhaṃ me sutopari pitā yathā || 38 || tvadabhaktā ratā jñāne teṣāṃ kleśo viśiṣyate | pariśramātkarṣakāṇāṃ yathā kṣetre tuṣārthinām || 39 || tvadbhaktibhāve niratā bahavastvadgatiṃ gatāḥ | yogino munayaścaiva tathā ye vrajavāsinaḥ || 40 || dvidhā ratirbhavedvarā śrutācca darśanācca vā | aho hare tu māyayā babhūva naiva me ratiḥ || 41 || ityuktvā'śrumukho bhūtvā natvā tatpādapaṃkajau | punarāha vidhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaktyā sarvaṃ kṣamāpayan || 42 || ghoṣeṣu vāsināmeṣāṃ bhūtvā'haṃ tvatpadāmbujam | yadā bhajeyaṃ sugatistadā bhūyānna cānyathā || 43 || vayaṃ tu gopadeheṣu saṃsthitāśca śivādayaḥ | sakṛtkṛṣṇaṃ tu paśyantastasmāddhanyāśca bhārate || 44 || ahobhāgyaṃ tu kṛṣṇasya mātāpitrostava prabho | tathā ca gopagopīnāṃ pūrṇastvaṃ dṛśyase vraje || 45 || muktāhāraḥ sarvaviśvopakāraḥ sarvādhāraḥ pātu māṃ viśvakāraḥ | līlāgāraṃ sūrikanyāvihāraḥ krīḍāpāraḥ kṛṣṇacandrāvatāraḥ || 46 || śrīkṛṣṇa vṛṣṇikulapuṣkara nandaputra rādhāpate madanamohana devadeva | saṃmohitaṃ vrajapate bhuvi te'jayā māṃ govinda gokulapate paripāhi pāhi || 47 || karoti yaḥ kṛṣṇahareḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ bhavejjgattīrthaphalaṃ ca tasya tu | te kṛṣṇalokaṃ sukhadaṃ parātparaṃ golokalokaṃ pravaraṃ gamiṣyati || 48 || śrīnārada uvāca ityabhiṣṭūya govindaṃ śrīmadvṛndāvaneśvaram | natvā trivāraṃ lokeśaścakāra tu pradakṣiṇam || 49 || tatra cālakṣito bhūtvā netreṇājñāṃ dadau hariḥ | punaḥ praṇamya svaṃ lokamātmabhūḥ pratyapadyata || 51 || atha kṛṣṇo vanācchīghramānayāmāsa vatsakān | yatrāpi puline rājan gopānāṃ rājamaṃḍalī || 52 || gopārbhakāśca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ vatsaiḥ sārdhaṃ samāgatam | kṣaṇārdhaṃ menire vīkṣya kṛṣṇamāyāvimohitāḥ || 53 || ta ūcurvatsakaiḥ kṛṣṇa tvaraṃ tvaṃ tu samāgataḥ | kuruṣva bhojanaṃ cātra kenāpi na kṛtaṃ prabho || 54 || tataśca vihasan kṛṣṇo'bhyavahṛtyārbhakaiḥ saha | darśayāmāsa sarvebhyaścarmājagarameva ca || 55 || sāyaṃkāle sarāmastu kṛṣṇo gopaiḥ parāvṛtaḥ | agre kṛtvā vatsavṛndaṃ hyājagāma śanairvrajam || 56 || govatsakaiḥ sitasitāsitapītavarṇai raktādidhūmraharitairbahuśīlarūpaiḥ | gopālamaṇḍalagataṃ vrajapālaputraṃ vande vanāt sukhadagoṣṭhakamāvrajantam || 57 || ānando gopikānāṃ tu hyāsītkṛṣṇasya darśane | yāsāṃ yena vinā rājan kṣaṇo yugasamo'bhavat || 58 || kṛtvā goṣṭhe pṛthagvatsān bālāḥ svaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ gatāḥ | jaguścāghāsuravadhamātmano rakṣaṇaṃ hare || 59 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vṛndāvanakhaṇḍe brahmastutiḥ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||
<2.10> śrīnārada uvāca gopecchayā rāmakṛṣṇau gopālau tau babhūvatuḥ | gāścārayantau gopālaiḥ vayasyaiśceraturvane || 1 || agre pṛṣṭhe tadā gāvaḥ carantyaḥ pārśvayordvayoḥ | śrīkṛṣṇasya balasyāpi paśyantyaḥ suṃdaraṃ mukham || 2 || ghaṃṭāmaṃjīrajhaṃkāraṃ kurvantyastā itastataḥ | kiṃkiṇījālasaṃyuktā hemamālālasadgalāḥ || 3 || muktāgucchairbarhipicchaiḥ lasatpucchācchakesarāḥ | sphuratāṃ navaratnānāṃ mālājālairvirājitāḥ || 4 || śṛṅgayorantare rājan śiromaṇimanoharāḥ | hemaraśmiprabhāsphūrjjat śṛṅgapārśvapraveṣṭanāḥ || 5 || āraktatilakāḥ kāścitpītapucchāruṇāṃghrayaḥ | kailāsagirisaṃkāśāḥ śīlarūpamahāguṇāḥ || 6 || savatsā mandagāminya ūdhobhāreṇa maithila | kuṃḍodhnyaḥ pāṭalāḥ kāścit lakṣantyo bhavyamūrtayaḥ || 7 || kāścitpītā vicitrāśca śyāmāśca haritāstathā | tāmrā dhūmrā ghanaśyāmā ghanaśyāme gatekṣaṇāḥ || 8 || laghuśṛṅgyo dīrghaśṛṅgya uccaśṛṅgyo vṛṣaiḥ saha | mṛgaśṛṅgyo vakraśṛṅgyaḥ kapilā maṃgalāyanāḥ || 9 || śādvalaṃ komalaṃ kāntaṃ vīkṣantyo'pi vane vane | koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo gāvaścarantyaḥ kṛṣṇapārśvayoḥ || 10 || puṇyaṃ śrīyamunātīraṃ tamālaiḥ śyāmalairvanam | nīpairnimbaiḥ kadambaiśca pravālaiḥ panasairdrumaiḥ || 11 || kadalīkovidārāmraiḥ jambubilvairmanoharaiḥ | aśvatthaiśca kapitthaiśca mādhavībhiśca maṃḍitam || 12 || babhau vṛndāvanaṃ divyaṃ vasantartumanoharam | nandanaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kṣipaccaitrarathaṃ vanam || 13 || yatra govardhano nāma sunirjharadarīyutaḥ | ratnadhātumayaḥ śrīmān mandāravanasaṃkulaḥ || 14 || śrīkhaṃḍabadarīraṃbhā devadāruvaṭairvṛtaḥ | palāśaplakṣāśokaiścāriṣṭārjunakadambakaiḥ || 15 || pārijātaiḥ pāṭalaiśca caṃpakaiḥ pariśobhitaḥ | karaṃjajālakuñjāḍhyaḥ śyāmairindrayavairvṛtaḥ || 16 || kalakaṃṭhaiḥ kokilaiśca puṃskokilamayūrabhṛt | gāścārayan tatra kṛṣṇo vicacāra vane vane || 17 || vṛndāvane madhuvane pārśve tālavanasya ca | kumudvane bāhule ca divyakāmavane pare || 18 || bṛhatsānugireḥ pārśve girernandīśvarasya ca | suṃdare kokilavane kokiladhvanisaṃkule || 19 || ramye kuśavane saumye latājālasamanvite | mahāpuṇye bhadravane bhāṃḍīropavane nṛpa || 20 || lohārgale ca yamunātīre tīre vane vane | pītavāsaḥparikaro naṭaveṣo manoharaḥ || 21 || vetrabhṛdvādayanvaṃśīṃ gopīnāṃ prītimāvahan | mayūrapicchabhṛnmaulī sragvī kṛṣṇo babhau nṛpa || 22 || agre kṛtvā gavāṃ vṛndaṃ sāyaṃkāle hariḥ svayam | rāgaiḥ samīrayanvaṃśīṃ śrīnandavrajamāviśat || 23 || veṇuvaṃśīdhvaniṃ śrutvā śrīvaṃśīvaṭamārgataḥ | gorajobhirnabho vyāptaṃ vīkṣya gehādvinirgatāḥ || 24 || dūrīkartuṃ hyādhibādhāmāhartuṃ sukhamuttamam | vismartuṃ na samarthāstaṃ draṣṭuṃ gopyaḥ samāyayuḥ || 25 || saṃkocavīthīṣu na saṃgṛhītaḥ śanaiścalan gogaṇasaṃkulāsu | siṃhāvaloko gajabālalīlairvadhūjanaiḥ paṃkajapatranetraḥ || 26 || sumaṃḍitaṃ maithilagorajobhirnīlaṃ paraṃ kuntalamādadhānaḥ hemāṅgadī maulivirājamāna ākarṇavakrīkṛtadṛṣṭibāṇaḥ || 27 || godhūlibhirmaṃḍitakundahāraḥ karṇopari sphūrjitakarṇikāraḥ | pītāṃbaro veṇuninādakāraḥ pātu prabhurvo hṛtabhūribhāraḥ || 28 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vṛndāvanakhaṇḍe śrīkṛṣṇa gocāraṇavarṇanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||
<2.11> śrīnārada uvāca ekadā sabalaḥ kṛṣṇaścārayan gā manoharāḥ | gopālaiḥ sahitaḥ sarvairyayau tālavanaṃ navam || 1 || dhenukasya bhayādgopā na gatāste vanāntaram | kṛṣṇo'pi na gatastatra bala eko viveśa ha || 2 || nīlāṃbaraṃ kaṭau baddhvā baladevo mahābalaḥ | paripakvaphalārthaṃ hi tadvane vicacāra ha || 3 || bāhubhyāṃ kaṃpayan tālān phalasaṃghaṃ nipātayan | garjaṃśca nirbhayaḥ sākṣādananto'nantavikramaḥ || 4 || phalānāṃ patatāṃ śabdaṃ śrutvā krodhāvṛtaḥ kharaḥ | madhyāhne svāpakṛdduṣṭo bhīmaḥ kaṃsasakho balī || 5 || āyayau saṃmukhe yoddhuṃ baladevasya dhenukaḥ | balaṃ paścimapādābhyāṃ nihatyorasi satvaram || 6 || cakāra kharaśabdaṃ svaṃ paridhāvan muhurmuhuḥ | gṛhītvā dhenukaṃ śīghraṃ balaḥ paścimapādayoḥ || 7 || cikṣepa tālavṛkṣe ca hastenaikena līlayā | tena bhagnaśca tālo'pi tālānpārśvasthitān bahūn || 8 || pātayāmāsa rājendra tadadbhutamivābhavat | punarutthāya daityeṃdro balaṃ jagrāha roṣataḥ || 9 || yojanaṃ nodayāmāsa gajaṃ prati gajo yathā | gṛhītvā taṃ balaḥ sadyo bhrāmayittvā'tha dhenukam || 10 || bhūpṛṣṭhe pothayāmāsa mūrchito bhagnamastakaḥ | kṣaṇena punarutthāya krodhasaṃyuktavigrahaḥ || 11 || mūrdhni kṛtvā catuḥśṛṅgaṃ dhṛtvā rūpaṃ bhayaṃkaram | gopān vidrāvayāmāsa śṛṅgaistīkṣṇairbhayaṅkaraiḥ || 12 || agre palāyitān gopān dudrāvāśu madotkaṭaḥ | śrīdāmā taṃ ca daṃḍena subalo muṣṭinā tathā || 13 || stokaḥ pāśena taṃ daityaṃ sa tatāḍa mahābalam | kṣepaṇenārjunoṃ'śuśca daityaṃ lattikayā kharam || 14 || viśālarṣabha etyāśu pādena svabalena ca | tejasvī hyardhacaṃdreṇa devaprasthaścapeṭakaiḥ || 15 || varūthapaḥ kaṃdukena saṃtatāḍa mahākharam | atha kṛṣṇo'pi taṃ nītvā hastābhyāṃ dhenukāsuram || 16 || bhrāmayitvā''śu cokṣepa girigovardhanopari | śrīkṛṣṇasya prahāreṇa mūrchito ghaṭikādvayam || 17 || punarutthāya svatunuṃ vidhunvan dārayanmukham | śṛṅgābhyāṃ śrīhariṃ nītvā dhāvandaityo nabhogataḥ || 18 || cakāra tena khe yuddhamūrdhvaṃ vai lakṣayojanam | gṛhītvā dhenukaṃ daityaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam || 19 || cikṣepādho bhūmimadhye cūrṇitāsthiḥ sa mūrcchitaḥ | punarutthāya śṛṅgābhyāṃ nādaṃ kṛtvātibhairavam || 20 || govardhanaṃ samutpāṭya śrīkṛṣṇe prāṇitotkharaḥ | giriṃ gṛhītvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prākṣipattasya mastake || 21 || detyo giriṃ gṛhītvā'tha śrīkṛṣṇe prāhiṇodbalī | kṛṣṇo govardhanaṃ nītvā pūrvasthāne samākṣipat || 22 || punardhāvan mahādaityaḥ śṛṅgābhyāṃ dārayanbhuvam | balaṃ paścimapādābhyāṃ tāḍayitvā jagarja ha || 23 || nanāda tena brahmāṃḍaṃ praijadbhūkhaṃḍamaṃḍalam | hastābhyāṃ saṃgṛhītvā taṃ baladevo mahābalaḥ || 24 || bhūpṛṣṭhe pothayāmāsa mūrcchitaṃ bhagnamastakam | punastatāḍa taṃ daityaṃ muṣṭinā hyacutāgrajaḥ || 25 || tena muṣṭiprahāreṇa sadyo vai nidhanaṃ gataḥ | tadeva vavṛṣurdevāḥ puṣpairnandanasaṃbhavaiḥ || 26 || dehādvinirgataḥ so'pi śyāmasundaravigrahaḥ | sragvī pītāṃbaro devo vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ || 27 || lakṣapārṣadasaṃyuktaḥ sahasradhvajaśobhitaḥ | sahasracakradhvanibhṛddhayāyutasamanvitaḥ || 28 || lakṣacāmaraśobhāḍhyo'ruṇavarṇo'tiratnabhṛt | divyayojanavistīrṇo manoyāyī manoharaḥ || 29 || kiṃkiṇījālasaṃyukto ghaṇṭāmaṃjīrasaṃyutaḥ | hariṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya sabalaṃ divyarūpadhṛk || 30 || divyaṃ rathaṃ samāruhya dyotayanmaṃḍalaṃ diśām | jagāma daityo he rājan golokaṃ kaṃprakṛteḥ param || 31 || śrīkṛṣṇo dhenukaṃ hatvā sabalo bālakaiḥ saha | tadyaśastu pragāyadbhirbabhau gokulagogaṇaiḥ || 32 || rājovāca mune muktiṃ kathaṃ prāptaḥ pūrvaṃ ko dhenukāsuraḥ | kathaṃ kharatvamāpanna etanme brūhi tattvataḥ || 33 || śrīnārada uvāca vairocanerbaleḥ putro nāmnā sāhasiko balī | nārīṇāṃ daśasāhasrai reme vai gandhamādane || 34 || vāditrāṇāṃ nūpurāṇāṃ śabdo'bhūttadvane mahān | guhāyāmāsthitasyāpi śrīkṛṣṇaṃ smarato muneḥ || 35 || durvāsaso'tha tenāpi dhyānabhaṅgo babhūva ha | nirgataḥ pādukā''rūḍho durvāsāḥ kṛśavigrahaḥ || 36 || dīrghaśmaśruryaṣṭidharaḥ krodhapuṃjānaladyutiḥ | yasya śāpādviśvamidaṃ kaṃpate sa jagāda ha || 37 || durvāsā uvāca uttiṣṭha gardabhākāra gardabho bhava durmate | varṣāṇāṃ tu caturlakṣaṃ vyatīte bhārate punaḥ || 38 || māthure maṃḍale divye puṇye tālavane vane | baladevasya hastena muktiste bhavitā'sura || 39 || nārada uvāca tasmādbalasya hastena śrīkṛṣṇastaṃ jaghāna ha | prahlādāya varo datto na vadhyo me tavānvayaḥ || 40 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vṛndāvanakhaṇḍe dhenukāsuramokṣo nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||
<2.12> balaṃ vinātha gopālaiś cārayan gā hariḥ svayam | kālindīkūlamāgatya yayau vāriviṣāvṛtam || 1 || kāliyena phaṇīndreṇa jalaṃ yatra vidūṣitam | pītvā nipeturvasavo gāvo gopā jalāntike || 2 || tadā tān jīvayāmāsa dṛṣṭyā pīyūṣapūrṇayā | ārdracitto hariḥ sākṣādbhagavān vṛjinārdanaḥ || 3 || kaṭau pītapaṭaṃ baddhvā nīpamāruhya mādhavaḥ | papātottuṃgaviṭapāttattoye viṣadūṣite || 4 || uccacāla jalaṃ duṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇasaṃghātaghūrṇitam | tatsarpamandire nadyāṃ bhṛṃgībhūtaṃ babhūva ha || 5 || tadaiva kāliyaḥ kruddhaḥ phaṇī phaṇaśatāvṛtaḥ | daśandantaiśca bhujayā cacchāda nṛpa mādhavam || 6 || kṛṣṇo dīrghaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā bandhanānnirgataśca tam | pucche gṛhītvā sarpeṃdraṃ bhrāmayitvā tvitastataḥ || 7 || jalenipātya hastābhyāṃ cikṣepāśu dhanuḥśatam | punarutthāya sarpendro lelihāno bhayaṃkaraḥ || 8 || vāmahaste hariṃ sarpo ruṣā jagrāha mādhavam | harirdakṣiṇahastena gṛhītvā taṃ mahākhalam || 9 || tajjale pothayāmāsa suparṇa iva pannagam | sarpo mukhaśataṃ dīrghaṃ prasārya punarāgataḥ || 10 || pucche gṛhītvā taṃ kṛṣṇaḥ cakarṣāśu dhanuḥśatam | kṛṣṇahastādviniṣkramya sarpastaṃ vyadaśatpunaḥ || 11 || tatāḍa muṣṭinā sarpaṃ trailokyabaladhārakaḥ | kṛṣṇamuṣṭiprahāreṇa mūrcchito vigatasmṛtiḥ || 12 || nataṃ kṛtvā''nanaśataṃ sthito'bhūt kṛṣṇasaṃmukhe | āruhya tatphaṇiśataṃ maṇivṛndamanoharam || 13 || nanarta naṭavatkṛṣṇo naṭaveṣo manoharaḥ | gāyan saptasvarai rāgaṃ saṃgītaṃ ca satālakam || 14 || puṣpairdeveṣu varṣatsu tāṃḍave naṭarājavat | vādayan sa mudā vīṇā''nakadundubhiveṇukān || 15 || satālaṃ padavinyāsaistatphaṇāṃ sojjvalān bahūn | babhaṃja śvasataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kāliyasya mahātmanaḥ || 16 || tadaiva nāgapatnyastā āgatā bhayavihvalāḥ | natvā kṛṣṇapadaṃ devamūcurgadgadayā girā || 17 || nāgapatnya ūcuḥ namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇacaṃdraya golokapataye namaḥ | asaṃkhyāṃḍādhipate paripūrṇatamāya te || 18 || śrīrādhāpataye tubhyaṃ vrajādhīśāya te namaḥ | namaḥ śrīnaṃdaputrāya yaśodānaṃdanāya te || 19 || pāhi pāhi paradeva pannagaṃ tvatparaṃ na śaraṇaṃ jagattraye | tvam padātparataro hariḥ svayaṃ līlayā kila tanoṣi vigraham || 20 || śrīnārada uvāca nāgapatnīstutaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kāliyaṃ vigatasmayam | visasarja hariḥ sākṣātparipūrṇatamaḥ svayam || 21 || pāhīti pravadaṃtaṃ taṃ kāliyaṃ bhagavān hariḥ | praṇataṃ saṃmukhe prāptaṃ prāha devo janārdanaḥ || 22 || śrībhagavānuvāca dvīpaṃ ramaṇakaṃ gaccha sakalatrasuhṛdvṛtaḥ | suparṇodyatanāttvāṃ vai nādyān matpādalāṃchitam || 23 || śrīnārada uvāca sarpaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tu saṃpūjya parikramya praṇamya tam | kalatraputrasahito dvīpaṃ ramaṇakaṃ yayau || 24 || atha śrutvā kāliyena saṃgrastaṃ naṃdanaṃdanam | tatrājagmurgopagaṇā naṃdādyāḥ sakalā janāḥ || 25 || jalādvinirgataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā mumudire janāḥ | āśliṣya svasutaṃ naṃdaḥ parāṃ mudamavāpa ha || 26 || sutaṃ labdhvā yaśodā sā sutakalyāṇahetave | dadau dānaṃ dvijātibhyaḥ snehasnutapayodharā || 27 || tatraiva śayanaṃ cakrurgopāḥ sarve pariśramāt | kāliṃdīnikaṭe rājan gopīgopagaṇaiḥ saha || 28 || veṇusaṃgharṣaṇodbhūto dāvāgniḥ pralayāgnivat | niśīthe sarvato gopān dagdhumāgatavān sphuran || 29 || gopā vayasyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sabalaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ | natvā kṛtāṃjaliṃ kṛtvā tamūcurbhayakātarāḥ || 30 || gopā ūcuḥ kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa mahābāho śaraṇāgatavatsala | pāhi pāhi vane kaṣṭāddāvāgneḥ svajanān prabho || 31 || śrīnārada uvāca svalocanāni mābhaiṣṭa nyamīlayata mādhavaḥ | ityuktvā vahnimapibaddevo yogeśvareśvaraḥ || 32 || prātargopagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ vismitairnaṃdanaṃdanaḥ | gogaṇaiḥ sahitaḥ śrīmadvrajamaṃḍalamāyayau || 33 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vṛndāvanakhaṇḍe kāliyadamanaṃ dāvāgnipānaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||
