śrīvṛṣabhānuvara uvāca gargasya vākyaṃ he gopa vadiṣyāmi samāhitaḥ | yena gopagaṇā yūyaṃ bhavatāśu gatavyathāḥ || 30 || asaṃkhyabrahmāṇḍapatirgolokeśaḥ parātparaḥ | tasmātparo varo nāsti jāto nandagṛhe śiśuḥ || 31 || bhuvo bhārāvatārāya kaṃsādināṃ vadhāya ca | brahmaṇā prārthitaḥ kṛṣṇo babhūva jagatītale || 32 || śrīkṛṣṇapaṭṭarājñī yā goloke rādhikā'bhidhā | tvadgehe sā'pi saṃjātā tvaṃ na jānāsī tāṃ parām || 33 || ahaṃ na kārayiṣyāmi vivāhamanayonṛpa | tayorvivāho bhavitā bhāṇḍīre yamunātaṭe || 34 || vṛndāvanasamīpe ca nirjane sundare sthale | parameṣṭhī samāgatya vivāhaṃ kārayiṣyati || 35 || tasmādrādhāṃ gopavara viddhyarddhāṅgīṃ parasya ca | lokacūḍāmaṇeḥ sākṣādrājñīṃ golokamandire || 36 || yūyaṃ sarve'pi gopālā golokādāgatā bhuvi | tathā gopīgaṇā gāvo gokule rādhikecchayā || 37 || evamuktvā gate sākṣādgargācārye mahāmunau | taddinādatha rādhāyāṃ sandehaṃ na karomyaham || 38 || vedavākyaṃ brahmavacaḥ pramāṇaṃ hi mahītale | iti vaḥ kathitaṃ gopāḥ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchatha || 39 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ girirājakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde gopavivādo nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<3.6> śrīnārada uvāca vṛṣabhānuvarasyedaṃ vacaḥśrutvā vrajaukasaḥ| ūcuḥ punaḥ śāntigatā vismitā muktasaṃśayāḥ || 1 || gopā ūcuḥ samīcīnaṃ varo rājan rādheyaṃ tu haripriyā | tatprabhāveṇa te dīrghaṃ vaibhavaṃ dṛśyate bhuvi || 2 || sahasraśo gajā mattāḥ koṭiśo'śvāśca caṃcalāḥ | rathāśca devadhiṣṇyābhāḥ śibikāḥ koṭiśaḥ śubhāḥ || 3 || koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo gāvo hemaratnamanoharāḥ | mandirāṇī vicitrāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca || 4 || sarvaṃ saukhyaṃ bhojanādi dṛśyate sāmprataṃ tava | kaṃso'pi dharṣito jāto dṛṣṭvā te balamadbhutam || 5 || kānyakubjapateḥ sākṣādbhalandananṛpasya ca | jāmātā tvaṃ mahāvīra kubera iva kośavān || 6 || tvatsamaṃ vaibhavaṃ nāsti nandarājagṛhe kvacit | kṛṣīvalo nandarājo gopatirdīnamānasaḥ || 7 || yadi nandasutaḥ sākṣātparipūrṇatamo hariḥ | sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ nastatparikṣāṃ kāraya prabho || 8 || śrīnārada uvāca teṣāṃ vākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā vṛṣabhānuvaro mahān | cakāra nandarājasya vaibhavasya parīkṣaṇam || 9 || koṭidāmāni muktānāṃ sthūlānāṃ maithileśvara | ekaikā yeṣu muktāśca koṭimaulyāḥ sphuratprabhāḥ || 10 || nidhāya tāni pātreṣu vṛṇānaiḥ kuśalairjanaiḥ | preṣayāmāsa nandāya sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ nṛpa || 11 || nandarājasabhāṃ gatvā vṛṇānāḥ kuśalā bhṛśam | nidhāya dāmapātrāṇi nandamāhuḥ praṇamya tam || 12 || vṛṇānā ūcuḥ vivāhayogyāṃ navakaṃjanetrāṃ koṭīndubimbadyutimādadhānām | vijñāya rādhāṃ vṛṣabhānumukhyaścakre vicāraṃ suvaraṃ vicinvan || 13 || tavāṃgajaṃ divyamanaṃgamohanaṃ govarddhanoddhāraṇadoḥsāmudbhaṭam | saṃvīkṣya cāsmānvṛṣabhānuvaṃditaḥ saṃpreṣayāmāsa viśāmpate prabho || 14 || varasya cāṃke bharaṇāya pūrvaṃ muktāphalānāṃ nicayaṃ gṛhāṇa | itaśca kanyārthamalaṃ pradehi saiṣā hi cāsmatkulajā prasiddhiḥ || 15 || śrīnārada uvāca dṛṣṭvā dravyaṃ paro nando vismito'pi vicārayan | praṣṭuṃ yaśodāṃ tattulyaṃ nītvā cāntaḥpuraṃ yayau || 16 || ciraṃ dadhyau tadā nando yaśodā ca yaśasvinī | etanmuktāsamānaṃ tu dravyaṃ nāsti gṛhe mama || 17 || loke lajjā gatā sarvā hāsaḥ syācceddhanoddhṛtam | kiṃ kartavyaṃ tatprati yacchrīkṛṣṇodvāhakarmaṇi || 18 || tato'yogyaṃ tadgrahaṇaṃ paścātkāryaṃ dhanāgame | evaṃ cintayatastasya nandasyaiva yaśodayā || 19 || alakṣya āgatastatra bhagavānvṛjinārdanaḥ | nītvā dāmaśataṃ teṣu bahiḥkṣetreṣu sarvataḥ || 20 || muktāphalāni caikaikamprākṣipatsvakareṇa vai | yathā bījāni cānnānāṃ svakṣetreṣu kṛṣīvalaḥ || 21 || atha nando'pi gaṇayan kalikānicayaṃ punaḥ | śataṃ nyūnaṃ ca taddṛṣṭvā sandehaṃ sa jagāma ha || 22 || śrīnanda uvāca nāsti pūrvaṃ yatsamānaṃ tatrāpi nyūnatāṃ gatam | aho kalaṃko bhavitā jñātiṣu sveṣu sarvataḥ || 23 || athavā krīḍanārtha hi kṛṣṇo yadi gṛhītavān | baladevo'thavā bālastau pṛcche dīnamānasaḥ || 24 || śrīnārada uvāca itthaṃ vicārya nando'pi kṛṣṇaṃ papraccha sādaram | prahasan bhagavānnandaṃ prāha govardhanoddharaḥ || 25 || śrībhagavānuvāca kṛṣīvalā vayaṃ gopāḥ sarvabījaprarohakāḥ | kṣetre muktāprabījāni vikīrṇīkṛtavāhanam || 26 || śrīnārada uvāca śrutvātha svātmajenoktaṃ taṃ nirbhartsya vrajeśvaraḥ | tāni netuṃ tatsahitastatkṣetrāṇi jagāma ha || 27 || tatra muktāphalānāṃ tu śākhinaḥ śataśaḥ śubhāḥ | dṛśyante dīrghavapuṣo haritpallavaśobhitāḥ || 28 || muktānāṃ stabakānāṃ tu koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo nṛpa | saṃghā vilaṃbitā rejurjyotīṃṣīva nabhaḥsthale || 29 || tadā'tiharṣito nando jñātvā kṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram | muktāphalāni divyāni pūrvasthūlasamāni ca || 30 || teṣāṃ tu koṭibhārāṇi nidhāya śakaṭeṣu ca | dadau tebhyo vṛṇānebhyo nandarājo vrajeśvaraḥ || 31 || te gṛhītvā'tha tatsarvaṃ vṛṣabhānuvaraṃ gatāḥ | sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nandavaibhavaṃ prajagurnṛpa || 32 || tadā'tivismitāḥ sarve jñātvā nandasutaṃ harim | vṛṣabhānuvaraṃ nemurniḥsandehā vrajaukasaḥ || 33 || rādhā hareḥ priyā jñātā rādhāyāśca priyo hariḥ | jñāto vrajajanaiḥ sarvaistaddinānmaithileśvara || 34 || muktākṣepaḥ kṛto yatra hariṇā nandasūnunā | muktāsarovarastatra jāto maithila tīrtharāṭ || 35 || ekaṃ muktāphalasyāpi dānaṃ tatra karoti yaḥ | lakṣamuktādānaphalaṃ samāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ || 36 || evaṃ te kathito rājan girirājamahotsavaḥ | bhuktimuktiprado nṝṇāṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 37 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ girirājakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde hariparīkṣaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<3.7> śrībahulāśva uvāca kati mukhyāni tīrthāni girirāje mahātmani | etadbrūhi mahāyogin sākṣāttvaṃ divyadarśanaḥ || 1 || śrīnārada uvāca rājan govardhanaḥ sarvaḥ sarvatīrthavaraḥ smṛtaḥ | vṛndāvanaṃ ca golokamukuṭo'driḥ prapūjitaḥ || 2 || gopagopīgavāṃ rakṣāpradaḥ kṛṣṇapriyo mahān | pūrṇabrahmātapatro yaḥ yasmāttīrthavarastu kaḥ || 3 || indrayāgaṃ vinirbharstya sarvairnijajanaiḥ saha | yatpūjanaṃ samārebhe bhagavān bhuvaneśvaraḥ || 4 || paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam | asaṃkhyabrahmāṇḍapatirgolokeśaḥ parātparaḥ || 5 || yasminsthitaḥ sadā krīḍāmarbhakaiḥ saha maithila | karoti tasya māhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ nālaṃ caturmukhaḥ || 6 || yatra vai mānasī gaṃgā mahāpāpaughanāśinī | govindakuṇḍaṃ viśadaṃ śubhaṃ candrasarovaram || 7 || rādhākuṇḍaḥ kṛṣṇakuṇḍo lalitākuṇḍa eva ca | gopālakuṃḍastatraiva kusumākara eva ca || 8 || śrīkṛṣṇamaulisaṃsparśānmaulicihnā śilā'bhavat | tasyā darśanamātreṇa devamaulirbhavejjanaḥ || 9 || yasyāṃ śilāyāṃ kṛṣṇena citrāṇi likhitāni ca | adyāpi citritā puṇyā nāmnā citraśilā girau || 10 || yāṃ śilāmarbhakaiḥ kṛṣṇo vādayan krīḍane rataḥ | vādanī sā śilā jātā mahāpāpaughanāśinī || 11 || yatra śrīkṛṣṇacandreṇa gopālaiḥ saha maithila | kṛtā vai kaṃdukakrīḍā tatkṣetraṃ kaṃdukaṃ smṛtam || 12 || dṛṣṭvā śakrapadaṃ yāti natvā brahmapadaṃ ca tat | viluṃṭhan yasya rajasā sākṣādviṣṇupadaṃ vrajet || 13 || gopānāmuṣṇiṣāṇyatra corayāmāsa mādhavaḥ | auṣṇiṣaṃ nāma tattīrthaṃ mahāpāpaharaṃ girau || 14 || tatraikadā vai dadhivikrayārthaṃ vinirgato gopavadhūsamūhaḥ | śrutvā kvaṇannūpuraśabdamārādrurodha tanmārgamanaṃgamohī || 15 || vaṃśīdharo vetravareṇa gopaiḥ puraśca tāsāṃ vinidhāya pādam | mahyaṃ karādānadhanāya dānaṃ dehīti gopīrnijagāda mārge || 16 || gopya ūcuḥ vakrastvamevāsi samāsthitaḥ pathi gopārbhakairgorasalampaṭo bhṛśam | mātrā ca pitrā saha kārayāmo balādbhavantaṃ kila kaṃsabandhane || 17 || śrībhagavānuvāca kaṃsaṃ haniṣyāmi mahogradaṇḍaṃ sabāṃdhavaṃ me śapatho gavāṃ ca | evaṃ kariṣyāmi yadoḥ pure balānneṣye sadāhaṃ girirājabhūmeḥ || 18 || śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā dadhipātrāṇi bālairnītvā pṛthak pṛthak | bhūpṛṣṭhe pothayāmāsa sānandaṃ nandanandanaḥ || 19 || aho eṣa paraṃ dhṛṣṭo nirbhayo nandanandanaḥ | niraṃkuśo bhāṣaṇīyo vane vīraḥ pure'balaḥ || 20 || bruvāmahe yaśodāyai nandāya ca kilādya vai | evaṃ vadantyastā gopyaḥ sasmitāḥ prayayurgṛhān || 21 || nīpapālāśapatrāṇāṃ kṛtvā droṇāni mādhavaḥ | jaghāsa bālakaiḥ sārddhaṃ picchalāni dadhīni ca || 22 || droṇākārāṇi patrāṇi babhūvuḥ śākhināṃ tadā | tatkṣetraṃ ca mahāpuṇyaṃ droṇaṃ nāma nṛpeśvara || 23 || dadhidānaṃ tatra kṛtvā pītvā patradhṛtaṃ dadhi | namaskuryānnarastasya golokānna cyutirbhavet || 24 || netre tvācchādya yatraiva līno'bhūnmādhavo'rbhakaiḥ | tatra tīrthaṃ laukikaṃ ca jātaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || 25 || kadambakhaṇḍatīrthaṃ ca līlāyuktaṃ hareḥ sadā | tasya darśanamātreṇa naro nārāyaṇo bhavet || 26 || yatra vai rādhayā rāse śṛṅgāro'kāri maithila | tatra govardhane jātaṃ sthale śṛṅgāramaṇḍalam || 27 || yena rūpeṇa kṛṣṇena dhṛto govardhano giriḥ | tadrūpaṃ vidyate tatra nṛpa śṛṅgāramaṇḍalam || 28 || abdāścatuḥsahasrāṇi tathā cāṣṭau śatāni ca | gatāstatra kalerādau kṣetre śṛṅgāramaṇḍale || 29 || girirājaguhāmadhyātsarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ nṛpa | svataḥ siddhaṃ ca tadrūpaṃ hareḥ prādurbhaviṣyati || 30 || śrīnāthaṃ devadamanaṃ taṃ vadiṣyanti sajjanāḥ | govardhane girau rājan sadā līlāṃ karoti yaḥ || 31 || ye kariṣyanti netrābhyāṃ tasya rūpasya darśanam | te kṛtārthā bhaviṣyanti maithilendra kalau janāḥ || 32 || jagannātho raṃganātho dvārakānātha eva ca | badrīnāthaścatuṣkoṇe bhāratasyāpi parvate || 33 || madhye govardhanasyāpi nātho'yaṃ vartate nṛpa | pavitre bhārate varṣe paṃca nāthāḥ sureśvarāḥ || 34 || saddharmamaṇḍapastambā ārtatrāṇaparāyaṇāḥ | teṣāṃ tu darśanaṃ kṛtvā naro nārāyaṇo bhavet || 35 || caturṇāṃ bhuvi nāthānāṃ kṛtvā yātrāṃ naraḥ sudhīḥ | na paśyeddevadamanaṃ sa na yātrāphalaṃ labhet || 36 || śrīnāthaṃ devadamanaṃ paśyedgovardhane girau | caturṇāṃ bhuvi nāthānāṃ yātrāyāḥ phalamāpnuyāt || 37 || airāvatasya surabheḥ pādacihnāni yatra vai | tatra natvā naraḥ pāpī vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti maithila || 38 || hastacihnaṃ pādacihnaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ | dṛṣṭvā natvā naraḥ kaścitsākṣātkṛṣṇapadaṃ vrajet || 39 || etāni nṛpa tīrthāni kuṃḍādyāyatanāni ca | aṃgāni girirājasya kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 40 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ girirājakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde girirājatīrthavarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<3.8> śrībahulāśva uvāca keṣu keṣu tadaṅgeṣu kiṃ kiṃ tīrthaṃ samāśritam || vada deva mahādeva tvaṃ parāvaravittamaḥ ||1|| śrīnārada uvāca yatra yasya prasiddhiḥ syāttadaṃgaṃ paramaṃ viduḥ || kramato nāstyaṃgacayo girirājasya maithila ||2|| yathā sarvagataṃ brahma sarvāṃgāni ca tasya vai || vibhūterbhāvataḥ śaśvattathā vakṣyāmi mānada ||3|| śṛṅgāramaṇḍalasyādho mukhaṃ govardhanasya ca || yatrānnakūṭaṃ kṛtavān bhagavān vrajavāsibhiḥ ||4|| netre vai mānasī gaṃgā nāsā candrasarovaraḥ || govindakuṇḍo hyadharaścibukaṃ kṛṣṇakuṇḍakaḥ ||5|| rādhākuṇḍaṃ tasya jihvā kapolau lalitāsaraḥ || gopālakuṇḍaḥ karṇaśca karṇāntaḥ kusumākaraḥ ||6|| maulicihnā śīlā tasya lalāṭaṃ viddhi maithila || śiraścitraśilā tasya grīvā vai vādanī śilā ||7|| kāṃdukaṃ pārśvadeśañca auṣṇiṣaṃ kaṭirucyate || droṇatīrthaṃ pṛṣṭhadeśe laukikaṃ codare smṛtam ||8|| kadambakhaṇḍamurasi jīvaḥ śṛṅgāramaṇḍalam || śrīkṛṣṇapādacihnaṃ tu manastasya mahātmanaḥ ||9|| hastacihnaṃ tathā buddhirairāvatapadaṃ padam || surabheḥ pādacihneṣu pakṣau tasya mahātmanaḥ ||10|| pucchakuṇḍe tathā pucchaṃ vatsakuṃḍe balaṃ smṛtam || rudrakuṇḍe tathā krodhaṃ kāmaṃ śakrasarovare ||11|| kuberatīrthe codyogaṃ brahmatīrthe prasannatām || yamatīrthe hyahaṃkāraṃ vadantītthaṃ purāvidaḥ ||12|| evamaṃgāni sarvatra girirājasya maithila || kathitāni mayā tubhyaṃ sarvapāpaharāṇi ca ||13|| girirājavibhūtiṃ ca yaḥ śṛṇoti narottamaḥ || sa gaccheddhāma paramaṃ golokaṃ yogidurlabham ||14|| samutthito'sau harivakṣaso girirgovardhano nāma girīndrarājarāṭ || samāgato hyatra pulastyatejasā yaddarśanājjanma punarna vidyate ||15|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ girirājakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde girirājavibhūtīvarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<3.9> śrībahulāśva uvāca aho govardhanaḥ sākṣādgirirājo haripriyaḥ | tatsamānaṃ na tīrthaṃ hi vidyate bhūtale divī || 1 || kadā babhūva śrīkṛṣṇavakṣaso'yaṃ girīśvaraḥ | etadvada mahābuddhe tvaṃ sākṣāddharimānasaḥ || 2 || śrīnārada uvāca golokotpattivṛttāntaṃ śṛṇu rājan mahāmate | catuṣpadārthadaṃ nṝṇāmādyalīlāsamanvitam || 3 || anādirātmā puruṣo nirguṇaḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ | paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānprabhuḥ || 4 || pratyagdhāmā svayaṃjyotī ramamāṇo nirantaram | yatra kālaḥ kalayatāmīśvaro dhāmamāninām || 5 || rājanna prabhavenmāyā na mahāṃśca guṇaḥ kutaḥ | na viśanti kvacidrājan manaścito matirhyaham || 6 || svadhāmni brahma sākāramicchayā vyaracīkarat | prathamaṃ cābhavaccheṣo bisaśveto bṛhadvapuḥ || 7 || tadutsaṃge mahāloko goloko lokavanditaḥ | yaṃ prāpya bhaktisaṃyuktaḥ punarāvartate na hi || 8 || asaṃkhyabrahmāṇḍapatergolokādhipateḥ prabhoḥ | punaḥ pādābjasaṃbhūtā gaṃgā tripathagāminī || 9 || punarvāmāṃsatastasya kṛṣṇā'bhūtsaritāṃ varā | reje śṛṅgārakusumairyathoṣṇiṅmudritā nṛpa || 10 || śrīrāsamaṇḍalaṃ divyaṃ hemaratnasamanvitam | nānāśṛṅgārapaṭalaṃ gulphābhyāṃ śrīhareḥ prabhoḥ || 11 || sabhāprāṃgaṇavīthībhirmaṇḍapaiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ | vasantamādhuryadharaḥ kūjatkokilasaṃkulaḥ || 12 || mayūraiḥ ṣaṭpadairvyāptaḥ sarobhiḥ parisevitaḥ | jāto nikuṃjo jaṃghābhyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ || 13 || vṛdāvanaṃ ca jānubhyāṃ rājan sarvavanottamam | līlāsarovaraḥ sākṣādūrubhyāṃ paramātmanaḥ || 14 || kaṭideśātsvarṇabhūmirdivyaratnakhacitprabhā | udare romarājiśca mādhavyo vistṛtā latāḥ || 15 || nānāpakṣigaṇairvyāptā dhvanadbhramarabhūṣitāḥ | supuṣpaphalabhāraiśca natāḥ satkulajā iva || 16 || śrīnābhipaṃkajāttasya paṃkajāni sahasraśaḥ | saraḥsu harilokasya tāni rejuritastataḥ || 17 || tribaliprāṃtato vāyurmandagāmyatiśītalaḥ | [1]jatrudeśācchubhā jātā mathurā dvārakāpurī || 18 || bhujābhyāṃ śrīharerjātāḥ śrīdāmādyaṣṭa pārṣadāḥ | nandāśca maṇibaṃdhābhyāmupanandāḥ karāgrataḥ || 19 || śrīkṛṣṇabāhumūlābhyāṃ sarve vai vṛṣabhānavaḥ | kṛṣṇaromasamudbhūtāḥ sarve gopagaṇā nṛpa || 20 || śrīkṛṣṇamanaso gāvo vṛṣā dharmadhurandharāḥ | buddheryavasagulmāni babhūvumaiṃthileśvara || 21 || tadvāmāṃsātsamudbhūtaṃ gauraṃ tejaḥ sphuratprabham | līlā śrīrbhūśca virajā tasmājjātā hareḥ priyāḥ || 22 || līlāvatī priyā tasya tāṃ rādhāṃ tu viduḥ pare | śrīrādhāyā bhujābhyāṃ tu viśākhā lalitā sakhī || 23 || sahacaryastathā gopyo rādhāromodbhavā nṛpa | evaṃ golokaracanāṃ cakāra madhusūdanaḥ || 24 || vidhāya sarva nijalokamitthaṃ śrīrādhayā tatra rarāja rājan | asaṃkhyalokāṇḍapatiḥ parātmā paraḥ pareśaḥ paripūrṇadevaḥ || 25 || tatraikadā sundararāsamaṇḍale sphuratkvaṇannūpuraśabdasaṃkule | succhatramuktāphaladāmajāvṛtasravadbṛhadbinduvirājitāṃgaṇe || 26 || śrīmālatīnāṃ suvitānajālataḥ svataḥ sravatsanmakarandagandhite | mṛdaṅgatāladhvaniveṇunādite sukaṇṭhagītādimanohare pare || 27 || śrīsundarīrāsarase manorame madhyasthitaṃ koṭimanojamohanam | jagāda rādhāpatimūrjayā girā kṛtvā kaṭākṣaṃ rasadānakauśalam || 28 || rādhovāca yadi rāse prasanno'si mama premṇā jagatpate | tadāhaṃ prārthanāṃ tvāṃ tu karomi manasi sthitām || 29 || śrībhagavānuvāca icchāṃ varaya vāmoru yā te manasi varttate | na deyaṃ yadi yadvastu premṇā dāsyāmi tatpriye || 30 || rādhovāca vṛndāvane divyanikuṃjapārśve kṛṣṇātaṭe rāsarasāya yogyam | rahaḥsthalaṃ tvaṃ kurutānmanojñaṃ manoratho'yaṃ mama devadeva || 31 || śrīnārada uvāca tathā'stu coktvā bhagavān rahoyogyaṃ vicintayan | svanetrapaṃkajābhyāṃ tu hṛdayaṃ saṃdadarśa ha || 32 || tadaiva kṛṣṇahṛdayādgopīvyūhasya paśyataḥ | nirgataṃ sajalaṃ tejo'nurāgasyeva cāṃkuram || 33 || patitaṃ rāsabhūmau tadvavṛdhe parvatākṛti | ratnadhātumayaṃ divyaṃ sunirjharadarīvṛtam || 34 || kadaṃbabakulāśokalatājālamanoharam | mandārakundavṛndāḍhyaṃ supakṣigaṇasaṃkulam || 35 || kṣaṇamātreṇa vaideha lakṣayojanavistṛtam | śatakoṭiryojanānāṃ laṃbitaṃ śeṣavatpunaḥ || 36 || ūrdhvaṃ samunnataṃ jātaṃ pañcāśatkoṭiyojanam | karīndravatsthitaṃ śaśvatpañcāśatkoṭivistṛtam || 37 || koṭiyojanadīrghāṃgaiḥ śṛṅgānāṃ śatakaiḥ sphurat | uccakaiḥ svarṇakalaśaiḥ prāsādamiva maithila || 38 || govardhanākhyaṃ taccāhuḥ śataśṛṅgaṃ tathāpare | evaṃbhūtaṃ tu tadapi varddhitaṃ manasotsukam || 39 || kolāhale tadā jāte goloke bhayavihvale | vīkṣyotthāya hariḥ sākṣāddhastenāśu tatāḍa tam || 40 || kiṃ varddhase bho pracchinnaṃ lokamācchādya tiṣṭhasi | kiṃ vā na caite vasituṃ tacchāntimakaroddhariḥ || 41 || saṃvīkṣya taṃ girivaraṃ prasannā bhagavatpriyā | tasmin rahaḥsthale rājan rarāja hariṇā saha || 42 || so'yaṃ girivaraḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇena praṇoditaḥ | sarvatīrthamayaḥ śyāmo ghanaśyāmaḥ surapriyaḥ || 43 || bhāratātpaścimadiśi śālmalīdvīpamadhyataḥ | govardhano janma lebhe patnyāṃ droṇācalasya ca || 44 || pulastyena samānīto bhārate vrajamaṇḍale | vaideha tasyāgamanaṃ mayā tubhyaṃ puroditam || 45 || yathā purā varddhitumutsuko'yaṃ tathā pidhānaṃ bhavitā bhuvo vā | vicintya śāpaṃ muninā pareśo droṇātmajāyeti dadau kṣayārtham || 46 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ girirājakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde girirājotpattivarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<3.10> śrīnārada uvāca atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam | yasya śravaṇamātreṇa mahāpāpaṃ praṇaśyati || 1 || vijayo brāhmaṇaḥ kaścidgautamītīravāsakṛt | āyayau svamṛṇaṃ netuṃ mathurāṃ pāpanāśinīm || 2 || kṛtvā kāryaṃ gṛhaṃ gacchan govardhanataṭīṃ gataḥ | vartulaṃ tatra pāṣāṇaṃ caikaṃ jagrāha maithila || 3 || śanaiḥ śanairvanoddeśe nirgato vrajamaṃḍalāt | agre dadarśa cāyāntaṃ rākṣasaṃ ghorarūpiṇam || 4 || hṛdaye ca mukhaṃ yasya trayaḥ pādā bhujāśca ṣaṭ | hastatrayaṃ ca sthūloṣṭho nāsā hastasamunnatā || 5 || saptahastā lalajjihvā kaṃṭakābhāstanūruhāḥ | aruṇe akṣiṇī dīrghe daṃtā vakrā bhayaṃkarāḥ || 6 || rākṣaso ghurghuraṃ śabdaṃ kṛtvā cāpi bubhukṣitaḥ | āyayau saṃmukhe rājan brāhmaṇasya sthitasya ca || 7 || girirājodbhavenāsau pāṣāṇena jaghāna tam | girirājaśilāsparśāttyaktvā'sau rākṣasīṃ tanum || 8 || padmapatraviśālākṣaḥ śyāmasundaravigrahaḥ | vanamālī pītavāsā mukuṭī kuṃḍalānvitaḥ || 9 || vaṃśīdharo vetrahastaḥ kāmadeva ivāparaḥ | bhūtvā kṛtāṃjalirvipraṃ praṇanāma muhurmuhuḥ || 10 || siddha uvāca dhanyastvaṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha paratrāṇaparāyaṇaḥ | tvayā vimocito'haṃ vai rākṣasatvānmahāmate || 11 || pāṣāṇasparśamātreṇa kalyāṇaṃ me babhūva ha | na ko'pi māṃ mocayituṃ samartho hi tvayā vinā || 12 || śrībrāhmaṇa uvāca vismitastava vākye'haṃ na tvāṃ mocayituṃ kṣamaḥ | pāṣāṇasparśanaphalaṃ na jāne vada suvrata || 13 || siddha uvāca girirājo hare rūpaṃ śrīmān govardhano giriḥ | tasya darśanamātreṇa naro yāti kṛtārthatām || 14 || gandhamādanayātrāyāṃ yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ | tasmātkoṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ girirājasya darśane || 15 || paṃcavarṣasahasrāṇi kedāre yattapaḥphalam | tacca govardhane vipra kṣaṇena labhate naraḥ || 16 || malayādrau svarṇabhāradānasyāpi ca yatphalam | tasmātkoṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ girirāje hi māsikam || 17 || parvate maṃgalaprasthe yo dadyāddhemadakṣiṇām | sa yāti viṣṇusārūpyaṃ yuktaḥ pāpaśatairapi || 18 || tatpadaṃ hi naro yāti girirājasya darśanāt | girirājasamaṃ puṇyamanyattīrthaṃ na vidyate || 19 || ṛṣabhādrau kūṭakādrau kolakādrau tathā naraḥ | suvarṇaśṛṅgayuktānāṃ gavāṃ koṭīrdadāti yaḥ || 20 || mahāpuṇyaṃ labhetso'pi viprānsaṃpūjya yatnataḥ | tasmāllakṣaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ girau govardhane dvija || 21 || ṛṣyamūkasya sahyasya tathā devagireḥ punaḥ | yātrāyāṃ labhate puṇyaṃ samastāyā bhuvaḥ phalam || 22 || girirājasya yātrāyāṃ tasmātkoṭiguṇaṃ phalam | girirājasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 23 || śrīśaile daśa varṣāṇi kuṇḍe vidyādhare naraḥ | snānaṃ karoti sukṛtī śatayajñaphalaṃ labhet || 24 || govardhane pucchakuṇḍe dinaikaṃ snānakṛnnaraḥ | koṭiyajñaphalaṃ sākṣātpuṇyameti na saṃśayaḥ || 25 || veṃkaṭādrau vāridhāre mahendre vindhyaparvate | yajñaṃ kṛtvā hyaśvamedhaṃ naro nākapatirbhavet || 26 || govardhane'sminyo yajñaṃ kṛtvā datvā sudakṣiṇām | nāke padaṃ saṃvidhāya sa viṣṇoḥ padamāvrajet || 27 || citrakūṭe payasvinyāṃ śrīrāmanavamīdine | pāriyātre tṛtīyāyāṃ vaiśākhasya dvijottama || 28 || kukurādrau ca pūrṇāyāṃ nīlādrau dvādaśīdine | indrakīle ca saptamyāṃ snānaṃ dānaṃ tapaḥkriyāḥ || 29 || tatsarvaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ bhavatītthaṃ hi bhārate | govardhane tu tatsarvamanantaṃ jāyate dvija || 30 || godāvaryāṃ gurau siṃhe māyāpuryāṃ tu kuṃbhage | puṣkare puṣyanakṣatre kurukṣetre ravigrahe || 31 || candragrahe tu kāśyāṃ vai phālgune naimiṣe tathā | ekādaśyāṃ śūkare ca kārtikyāṃ gaṇamuktide || 32 || janmāṣṭamyāṃ madhoḥ puryāṃ khāṇḍave dvādaśīdine | kārtikyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ tu vaṭeśvaramahāvaṭe || 33 || makarārke prayāge tu barhiṣmatyāṃ hi vaidhṛtau | ayodhyāsarayūtīre śrīrāmanavamīdine || 34 || evaṃ śivacaturdaśyāṃ vaijanāthaśubhe vane | tathā darśe somavāre gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame || 35 || daśamyāṃ setubandhe ca śrīraṅge saptamīdine | eṣu dānaṃ tapaḥ snānaṃ japo devadvijārcanam || 36 || tatsarvaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ bhavatīha dvijottama | tattulyaṃ puṇyamāpnoti girau govardhane vare || 37 || govindakuṇḍe viśade yaḥ snāti kṛṣṇamānasaḥ | prāpnoti kṛṣṇasārūpyaṃ maithilendra na saṃśayaḥ || 38 || aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca | mānasīgaṅgayā tulyaṃ na bhavaṃtyatra no girau || 39 || tvayā vipra kṛtaṃ sākṣādgirirājasya darśanam | sparśanaṃ ca tataḥ snānaṃ na tvatto'pyadhiko bhuvi || 40 || na manyase cenmāṃ paśya mahāpātakinaṃ param | govardhanaśilāsparśātkṛṣṇasārūpyatāṃ gatam || 41 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ girirājakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde girirājamāhātmyaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<3.11> śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvā siddhavākyaṃ brāhmaṇo vismayaṃ gataḥ| punaḥ papraccha taṃ rājan girirājaprabhāvavit || 1 || brāhmaṇa uvāca purā janmani kastvaṃ bhostvayā kiṃ kaluṣaṃ kṛtam | sarvaṃ vada mahābhāga tvaṃ sākṣāddivyadarśanaḥ || 2 || siddha uvāca purā janmani vaiśyo'haṃ dhanī vaiśyasuto mahān | ābālyāddyutanirato viṭagoṣṭhīviśāradaḥ || 3 || veśyārataḥ kumārgo'haṃ madirāmadavihvalaḥ | mātrā pitrā bhāryayāpi bhartsito'haṃ sadā dvija || 4 || ekadā tu mayā vipra pitarau garadānataḥ | māritau ca tathā bhāryā khaḍgena pathi māritā || 5 || gṛhītvā taddhanaṃ sarvaṃ veśyayā sahitaḥ khalaḥ | dakṣiṇāśāṃ ca gatavān dasyukarmā'tinirdayaḥ || 6 || ekadā tu mayā veśyā niḥkṣiptā hyaṃdhakūpake | dasyunā hi mayā pāśairmāritāḥ śataśo narāḥ || 7 || dhanalobhena bho vipra brahmahatyāśataṃ kṛtam | kṣatrahatyā vaiśyahatyāḥ śūdrahatyāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 8 || ekadā māṃsamānetuṃ mṛgān hantuṃ vane gatam | sarpo'daśatpadā spṛṣṭo duṣṭaṃ māṃ nidhanaṃ gatam || 9 || saṃtāḍya mudgarairghorairyamadūtā bhayaṃkarāḥ | baddhvā māṃ narakaṃ ninyurmahāpātakinaṃ khalam || 10 || manvantaraṃ tu patitaḥ kumbhīpāke mahākhale | kalpaikaṃ taptasūrmau ca mahāduḥkhaṃ gataḥ khalaḥ || 11 || caturaśītilakṣāṇāṃ narakāṇāṃ pṛthak pṛthak | varṣaṃ varṣaṃ nipatito nirgato'haṃ yamecchayā || 12 || tatastu bhārate varṣe prāpto'haṃ karmavāsanām | daśavāraṃ sūkaro'haṃ vyāghro'haṃ śatajanmasu || 13 || uṣṭro'haṃ janmaśatakaṃ mahiṣaḥ śatajanmasu | sarpo'haṃ janmasāhasraṃ mārito duṣṭamānavaiḥ || 14 || evaṃ varṣāyutāṃte tu nirjale vipine dvija | rākṣasaścedṛśo jāto vikarālo mahākhalaḥ || 15 || kasya śūdrasya dehaṃ vai samāruhya vrajaṃ gataḥ | vṛndāvanasya nikaṭe yamunā nikaṭācchubhāt || 16 || samutthitā yaṣṭihastāḥ śyāmalāḥ kṛṣṇapārṣadāḥ | taistāḍito dharṣito'haṃ vrajabhūmau palāyitaḥ || 17 || bubhikṣito bahudinaistvāṃ khāditumihāgataḥ | tāvattvayā tāḍito'haṃ girirājāśmanā mune || 18 || śrīkṛṣṇakṛpayā sākṣātkalyāṇaṃ me babhūva ha | śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ pravadatastasya golokācca mahārathaḥ || 19 || sahasrādityasaṃkāśo hayāyutasamanvitaḥ || 20 || sahasracakradhvanibhṛllakṣapārṣadamaṇḍitaḥ | maṃjīrakiṃkiṇījālo manoharataro nṛpa || 21 || paśyatastasya viprasya tamānetuṃ samāgataḥ | tamāgataṃ rathaṃ divyaṃ nematurvipranirjarau || 22 || tataḥ samāruhya rathaṃ sa siddho viraṃjayanmaithila maṇḍalaṃ diśām | śrīkṛṣṇalokaṃ prayayau parātparaṃ nikuṃjalīlālalitaṃ manoharam || 23 || vipro'pi tasmāt punarāgato giriṃ govardhanaṃ sarvagirindradaivatam | pradakṣiṇīkṛtya punaḥ praṇamya taṃ yayau gṛhaṃ maithila tatprabhāvit || 24 || idaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ sumuktidaṃ śrīgirirājakhaṇḍam | śrutvā janaḥ pāpyapi na pracaṇḍaṃ svapne'pi paśyedyamamugradaṇḍam || 25 || yaḥ śṛṇotigirirāja yaśasyaṃ goparāja navakelirahasyam | devarāja iva so'tra sameti nandarāja iva śāntimamutra || 26 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ girirājakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde girirājaprabhāvaprastāvavarṇane siddhamokṣa nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || iti śrīgirirājakhaṇḍaḥsamāptaḥ || 3 ||
<4.1> atasīkusumopameyakāṃtiryamunākūlakadaṃbamadhyavartī | navagopavadhūvilāsaśālī vanamālī viranotu maṃgalāni || 1 || parikarīkṛtapītapaṭaṃ hariṃ śikhikirīṭanatīkṛtakaṃdharam | lakuṭaveṇukaraṃ calakuṇḍalaṃ paṭutaraṃ naṭaveṣadharaṃ bhaje || 2 || bahulāśva uvāca śrutirūpādayo gopyo bhūtapūrvā varānmune | kathaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacandreṇa jātāḥ pūrṇamanorathāḥ || 3 || gopālakṛṣṇacaritaṃ pavitraṃ paramādbhutam | etadvada mahābuddhe tvaṃ parāvaravittamaḥ || 4 || śrīnārada uvāca śrutirūpāśca yā gopyo gopānāṃ sukule vraje | lebhire janma vaideha śeṣaśāyīvarācchrutāt || 5 || kamanīyaṃ nandasūnuṃ vīkṣya vṛndāvane ca tāḥ | vṛndāvaneśvarīṃ vṛndāṃ bhejire tadvarecchayā || 6 || vṛndādattādvarādāśu prasanno bhagavān hariḥ | nityaṃ tāsāṃ gṛhe yāti rāsārthaṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ || 7 || ekadā tu niśīthinyā vyatīte praharadvaye | rāsārthaṃ bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ prāptavān tadgṛhānnṛpa || 8 || tadā utkaṃṭhitā gopyaḥ kṛtvā tatpūjanaṃ param | papracchuḥ parayā bhaktyā girā madhurayā prabhum || 9 || gopya ūcuḥ kathaṃ na cāgataḥ śīghraṃ no gṛhān vṛjinārdana | utkaṃṭhitānāṃ gopīnāṃ tvayi candre cakoravat || 10 || śrībhagavānuvāca yo yasya citte vasati na sa dūre kadācana | khe sūryaṃ kamalaṃ bhūmau dṛṣṭvedaṃ sphuṭati priyāḥ || 11 || bhāṇḍīre me guruḥ sākṣāt durvāsā bhagavān muniḥ | āgato'dya priyāstasya sevārthaṃ gatavānaham || 12 || gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgururdevo maheśvaraḥ | guruḥ sākṣāt parabrahma tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 13 || ajñānatimirāṃdhasya jñānāṃjanaśalākayā | cakṣurumīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 14 || svaguruṃ māṃ vijānīyānnāvamanyeta karhicit | na martyabuddhyā seveta sarvadevamayo guruḥ || 15 || tasmāttatpūjanaṃ kṛtvā natvā tatpādapaṃkajam | āgato'haṃ vilaṃbena bhavatīnāṃ gṛhān priyāḥ || 16 || śrīnārada uvāca śrutvā tatparamaṃ vākyaṃ gopyaḥ sarvāstu vismitāḥ | kṛtāṃjalipuṭā ūcuḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ namrakaṃdharāḥ || 17 || gopya ūcuḥ paripūrṇatamasyāpi durvāsāste guruḥ smṛtaḥ | aho taddarśanaṃ kartuṃ mano naścodyataṃ prabho || 18 || adya deva niśīthinyā vyatīte praharadvaye | kathaṃ taddarśanaṃ bhūyādasmākaṃ parameśvara || 19 || tathā madhye dīrghanadī yamunā pratibandhikā | kathaṃ tattaraṇaṃ nāvaṃ ṛte deva bhaviṣyati || 20 || śrībhagavānuvāca avaśyameva gantavyaṃ bhavatībhiryadā priyāḥ | yamunāmetya caitadvai vaktavyaṃ mārgahetave || 21 || yadi kṛṣṇo bālayatiḥ sarvadoṣavivarjitaḥ | tarhi no dehi mārgaṃ vai kālindi saritāṃ vare || 22 || ityukte vacane kṛṣṇā mārgaṃ vo dāsyati svataḥ | sukhena tena vrajata yūyaṃ sarvā vrajāṃganāḥ || 23 || śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvā'tha tadvākyaṃ pātrairdīrghairvrajāṃganāḥ | ṣaṭpaṃcāśattamān bhogān nītvā sarvāḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 24 || yamunāmetya haryuktaṃ jagurānatakaṃdharāḥ | sadyaḥ kṛṣṇā dadau mārgaṃ gopībhyo maithileśvara || 25 || tena gopyo gatāḥ sarvā bhāṇḍīraṃ cātivismitāḥ | tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya muniṃ durvāsanaṃ ca tāḥ || 26 || natvā taddarśanaṃ cakruḥ puro dhṛtvā'śanaṃ vahu | me pūrvaṃ cāpi me pūrvamannaṃ bhojyaṃ tvayā mune || 27 || evaṃ vivadamānānāṃ gopīnāṃ bhaktilakṣaṇam | vijñāya muniśārdūlaḥ provāca vimalaṃ vacaḥ || 28 || muniruvāca gopyaḥ paramahaṃso'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo hi niṣkriyaḥ | tasmānmukhe me dātavyaṃ svaṃ svaṃ cāpyaśanaṃ karaiḥ || 29 || śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ vidārite tena mukhe gopyo'tiharṣitāḥ | ṣaṭpaṃcāśattamān bhogān svānsvān sarvāḥ samākṣipan || 30 || kṣipantīnāṃ ca gopīnāṃ paśyaṃtīnāṃ munīśvaraḥ | jaghāsa koṭiśo mārān bhogān sarvān kṣudhāturaḥ || 31 || vismitānāṃ ca gopīnāṃ paśyaṃtīnāṃ parasparam | itthaṃ śūnyāni pātrāṇi babhūvurnṛpasattama || 32 || atha gopyo muniṃ śāṃtaṃ natvā taṃ bhaktavatsalam | vismitāḥ praṇatāḥ prāhuḥ sarvāḥ pūrṇamanorathāḥ || 33 || gopya ūcuḥ mune āgamanātpūrvaṃ kṛṣṇoktavacasā nadīm | tīrtvā''gatāstvatsamīpaṃ darśanārthaṃ śubhecchayā || 34 || itaḥ kathaṃ gamiṣyāmaḥ sandeho'yaṃ mahānabhūt | tadvidhehi namastubhyaṃ yena paṃthā laghurbhavet || 35 || sukhenātaḥ pragantavyaṃ bhavatībhiryadā svataḥ | yamunāmetya caitadvai vaktavyaṃ mārgahetave || 36 || yadi dūrvārasaṃ pītvā durvāsāḥ kevalaṃ kṣitau | vratī niranno nirvāri vartate pṛthivītale || 37 || tarhi no dehi mārgaṃ vai kāliṃdi saritāṃ vare | ityukte vacane kṛṣṇā mārgaṃ vo dāsyati svataḥ || 38 || śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvā vaco gopyo natvā taṃ munipuṃgavam | yamunāmetya munyuktaṃ coktvā tīrtvā nadīṃ nṛpa || 39 || śrīkṛṣṇapārśvamājagmurvismitā maṃgalāyanāḥ || 40 || atha rāse gopavadhvaḥ sandehaṃ manasotthitam | papracchuḥ śrīhariṃ vīkṣya rahaḥ pūrṇamanorathāḥ || 41 || gopya ūcuḥ durvāsaso darśanaṃ bhoḥ kṛtamasmābhiragrataḥ | yuvayorvākyataścātra sandeho'yaṃ prajāyate || 42 || yathā gurustathā śiṣyo mṛṣāvādī na saṃśayaḥ | jārastvamasi gopīnāṃ rasiko bālyataḥ prabho || 43 || kathaṃ bālayatistvaṃ vai vada tadvṛjinārdana | kathaṃ dūrvārasaṃ pītvā durvāsā bahubhuṅmuniḥ | no jāta eṣa sandehaḥ paśyantīnāṃ vrajeśvara || 44 || śrībhagavānuvāca nirmamo nirahaṃkāraḥ samānaḥ sarvagaḥ paraḥ | sadā vaiṣamyarahito nirguṇo'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 45 || tathāpi bhaktān bhajato bhaje'haṃ vai yathā tathā | tathaiva sādhurjñānī vai vaiṣamyarahitaḥ sadā || 46 || na buddhibhedaṃ janayedajñānāṃ karmasaṃginām | joṣayetsarvakarmāṇi vidvān yuktaḥ samācaran || 47 || yasya sarve samāraṃbhāḥ kāmasaṃkalpavirjitāḥ | jñānāgnidagdhakarmāṇaṃ tamāhuḥ paṃḍitaṃ budhāḥ || 48 || nirāśīryatacittātmā tyaktasarvaparigrahaḥ | śārīraṃ kevalaṃ karma kurvannāpnoti kilbiṣam || 49 || na hi jñānena sadṛśaṃ pavitramiha vidyate | tatsvayaṃ yogasaṃsiddhaḥ kālenātmani vindati || 50 || brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṃgaṃ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ | lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāṃbhasā || 51 || tasmānmunistu durvāsā bahubhuk tvaddhite rataḥ | na tasya bhojanecchā syāddūrvārasamitāśanaḥ || 52 || śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvā vaco gopyaḥ sarvāstāśchinnasaṃśayāḥ | śrutirūpā jñānamayyo babhūvurmaithileśvara || 53 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrutirūpopākhyānaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.2> śrīnārada uvāca gopīnāmṛṣirūpāṇāmākhyānaṃ śṛṇu maithila | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktivivardhanam ||1|| vaṅgeṣu maṅgalo nāma gopa āsīnmahāmanāḥ | lakṣmīvāñchrutasampanno navalakṣagavāṃ patiḥ ||2|| bhāryāḥ pañcasahasrāṇi babhūvustasya maithila | kadāciddaivayogena dhanaṃ sarvaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam ||3|| caurairnītāstasya gāvaḥ kāścidrājñā hṛtā balāt | evaṃ dainye ca samprāpte duḥkhito maṅgalo'bhavat ||4|| tadā śrīrāmasya varāddaṇḍakāraṇyavāsinaḥ | ṛṣayaḥ strītvamāpannā babhūvustasya kanyakāḥ ||5|| dṛṣṭvā kanyāsamūhaṃ sa duḥkhī gopo'tha maṅgalaḥ | uvāca dainyaduḥkhāḍhya ādhivyādhisamākulaḥ ||6|| maṅgala uvāca kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi ko me duḥkhaṃ vyapohati | śrīrna bhūtirnābhijano na balaṃ me'sti sāmpratam ||7|| dhanaṃ vinā kathaṃ cāsāṃ vivāho hā bhaviṣyati | bhojane yatra sandeho dhanāśa tatra kīdṛśī ||8|| sati dainye kanyakāḥ syuḥ kākatālīyavadgṛhe | tasmātkasyāpi rājñastu dhanino balinastvaham ||9|| dāsyāmyetāḥ kanyakāśca kanyānāṃ saukhyahetave | kadarthīkṛtya tā kanyāḥ evaṃ buddhyā sthito'bhavat || tadaiva māthurāddeśādgopaścaikaḥ samāgataḥ ||10|| nārada uvāca tīrthayāyī jayo nāma vṛddhobuddhimatāṃ varaḥ | tanmukhānnandarājasya śrutaṃ vaibhavamadbhutam ||11|| nandarājasya balaye maṅgalo dainyapīḍitaḥ | vicintya preṣayāmāsa kanyakāścārulocanāḥ || 12 || tā nandarājasya gṛhe kanyakā ratnabhūṣitāḥ | gavāṃ gomayahāriṇyo babhūvurgovrajeṣu ca || 13 || śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sundaraṃ dṛṣṭvā kanyā jātismarāśca tāḥ | kālindīsevanaṃ cakrurnityaṃ śrīkṛṣṇahetave || 14 || athaikadā śyāmalāṅgī kālindī dīrghalocanā | tābhyaḥ svadarśanaṃ datvā varaṃ dātuṃ samudyatā || 15 || tā vavrire vrajeśasya putro bhūyātpatiśca naḥ | tathāstu coktvā kālindī tatraivāntaradhīyata || 16 || tāḥ prāptā vṛndakāraṇye kārtikyāṃ rāsamaṇḍale | tābhiḥ sārdhaṃ harī reme surībhiḥ surarāḍiva || 17 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde ṛṣirūpopākhyānaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||2|| hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu || mādhuryakhaṇḍaḥ tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ maithilī gopīgaṇānāṃ upākhyānam śrīnārada uvāca maithilīnāṃ gopikānāmākhyānaṃ śṛṇu maithila | daśāśvamedhatīrthasya phaladaṃ bhaktivardhanam || 1 || śrīrāmasya varājjātāḥ navanandagṛheṣu yāḥ | kamanīyaṃ nandasūnuṃ dṛṣṭvā tā mohamāsthitāḥ || 2 || mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi cakruḥ kātyāyanīvratam | upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kṛtvā devīṃ mahīmayīm || 3 || aruṇodayavelāyāṃ snātāḥ śrīyamunājale | nityaṃ sametā ājagmurgāyantyo bhagavadguṇān || 4 || ekadā tāḥ svavastrāṇi tīre nyasya vrajāṃganāḥ | vijarhruryamunātoye karābhyāṃ siṃcatīrmithaḥ || 5 || tāsāṃ vāsāṃsi saṃnīya bhagavān prātarāgataḥ | tvaraṃ kadaṃbamāruhya cauravanmaunamāsthitaḥ || 6 || tā na vīkṣya svavāsāṃsi vismitā gopakanyakāḥ | nīpasthitaṃ vilokyātha salajjā jahasurnṛpa || 7 || pratīcchantu svavāsāṃsi sarvā āgatya cātra vai | anyathā na hi dāsyāmi vṛkṣātkṛṣṇa uvāca ha || 8 || rājaṃtyastāḥ śītajale hasaṃtyaḥ prāhurānatāḥ || 9 || gopya ūcuḥ he nandanandana manohara goparatna gopālavaṃśanavahaṃsa mahārtihārin | śrīśyāmasundara tavoditamadya vākyaṃ kurmaḥ kathaṃ vivasanāḥ kila te'pi dāsyaḥ || 10 || gopāṅganāvasanamuṇnavanītahārī jāto vraje'tirasikaḥ kila nirbhayo'si | vāsāṃsi dehi na cenmathathurādhipāya vakṣyāmahe'nayamatīva kṛtaṃ tvayā'tra || 11 || śrībhagavānuvāca dāsyo mamaiva yadi sundaramandahāsā icchantu vaitya kila cātra kadaṃbamūle | nocetsamastavasanāni nayāmi gehāṃstasmātkariṣyatha mamaiva vaco'vilambāt || 12 || śrīnārada uvāca tadā tā nirgatāḥ sarvā jalādgopyo'tivepitāḥ | ānatā yonimācchādya pāṇibhyāṃ śītakarśitāḥ || 13 || kṛṣṇadattāni vāsāṃsi daduḥ sarvā vrajajāṃganāḥ | mohitāśca sthitāstatra kṛṣṇe lajjāyitekṣaṇāḥ || 14 || jñātvā tāsāmabhiprāyaṃ paramapremalakṣaṇam | āha mandasmitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ samantādvīkṣya tā vacaḥ || 15 || śrībhagavānuvāca bhavatībhirmārgaśīrṣe kṛtaṃ kātyāyanīvratam | madarthaṃ tacca saphalaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 16 || paraśvo'hani cāṭavyāṃ kṛṣṇātīre manohare | yuṣmābhiśca kariṣyāmi rāsaṃ pūrṇamanoratham || 17 || ityuktvā'tha gate kṛṣṇe paripūrṇatame harau | prāptānandā maṃdahāsā gopyaḥ sarvā gṛhān yayuḥ || 18 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde maithilyupākhyānaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.3> śrīnārada uvāca kauśalānāṃ gopikānāṃ varṇanaṃ śṛṇu maithila | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacaritāmṛtam || 1 || navopanandageheṣu jātā rāmavarādvraje | pariṇītā gopajanai ratnarabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 2 || pūrṇacandrapratīkāśā navayauvanasaṃyutāḥ | padminyo haṃsagamanāḥ padmapatravilocanāḥ || 3 || jāradharmeṇa susnehaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ sarvato'dhikam | cakruḥ kṛṣṇe nandasute kamanīye mahātmani || 4 || tābhiḥ sārddhaṃ sadā hāsyaṃ vrajavīthīṣu mādhavaḥ | smitaiḥ pītapaṭādānaiḥ karṣaṇaiḥ sa cakāra ha || 5 || dadhivikrayārthaṃ yāntyastāḥ kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti cābruvan | kṛṣṇe hi premasaṃyuktā bhramaṃtyaḥ kuṃjamaḍale || 6 || khe vāyau cāgnijalayormahyāṃ jyotirdiśāsu ca | drumeṣu janavṛndeṣu tāsāṃ kṛṣṇo hi lakṣyate || 7 || premalakṣaṇasaṃyuktāḥ śrīkṛṣṇahṛtamānasāḥ | aṣṭabhiḥ sāttvikairbhāvaiḥ saṃpannāstāśca yoṣitaḥ || 8 || premṇā paramahaṃsānāṃ padavīṃ samupāgatāḥ | kṛṣṇanandāḥ pradhāvantyo vrajavīthīṣu tā nṛpa || 9 || jaḍā jaḍaṃ na jānaṃtyo jaḍonmattapiśācavat | abruvantyo bruvantyo vā gatalajjā gatavyathāḥ || 10 || evaṃ kṛtārthatāṃ prāpptāstanmayā yāśca gopikāḥ | balādākṛṣya kṛṣṇasya cucuṃburmukhapaṃkajam || 11 || tāsāṃ tapaḥ kiṃ kathayāmi rājan pūrṇe pare brahmaṇi vāsudeve | yāścakrire prema hṛdiṃdriyādyairvisṛjya lokavyavahāramārgam || 12 || yā rāsaraṃge vinidhāya bāhuṃ kṛṣṇāṃsayoḥ premavibhinnacittāḥ | cakrurvaśe kṛṣṇamalaṃ tapastadvaktuṃ na śakto vadanaiḥ phaṇīndraḥ || 13 || yogena sāṃkhyena śubhena karmaṇā nyāyādivaiśeṣikatattvavittamaiḥ | yatprāpyate tacca padaṃ vedeharāṭ saṃprāpyate kevalabhaktibhāvataḥ || 14 || bhaktyaiva vaśyo harirādidevaḥ sadā pramāṇaṃ kila cātra gopyaḥ | sāṃkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ na kṛtaṃ kadāpi premṇaiva yasya prakṛtiṃ gatāḥ syuḥ || 15 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde kauśalopākhyānaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.5> śrīnārada uvāca ayodhyāvāsinīnāṃ tu gopīnāṃ varṇanaṃ śṛṇu | catuṣpadārthadaṃ sākṣātkṛṣṇaprāptikaraṃ param || 1 || sindhudeśeṣu nagarī caṃpakā nāma maithila | babhūva tasyāṃ vimalo rājā dharmaparāyaṇaḥ || 2 || kuvera iva kośāḍhyo manasvī mṛgarāḍiva | viṣṇubhaktaḥ praśāṃtātmā prahlāda iva mūrtimān || 3 || bhāryāṇāṃ ṣaṭsahasrāṇi babhūvustasya bhūpateḥ | rūpavatyaḥ kaṃjanetrā vaṃdhyātvaṃ tāḥ samāgatāḥ || 4 || apatyaṃ kena puṇyena bhūyān me'tra śubhaṃ nṛpa | evaṃ cintayatastasya bahavo vatsarā gatāḥ || 5 || ekadā yājñavalkyastu munīndrastamupāgataḥ | taṃ natvābhyarca vidhivannṛpastatsaṃmukhe sthitaḥ || 6 || ciṃtākulaṃ nṛpaṃ vīkṣya yājñavalkyo mahāmuniḥ | sarvajñaḥ sarvavicchāntaḥ pratyuvāca nṛpottamam || 7 || śrīyājñavalkya uvāca rājan kṛśo'si kasmāttvaṃ kā ciṃtā te hṛdi sthitā | saprasvageṣu kuśalaṃ dṛśyate sāṃprataṃ tava || 8 || vimala uvāca brahmaṃstvaṃ kiṃ na jānāsi tapasā divyacakṣuṣā | tathā'pyahaṃ vadiṣyāmi bhavato vākyagauravāt || 9 || ānapatyena duḥkhena vyāpto'haṃ munisattama | kiṃ karomi tapo dānaṃ vada yena bhavetprajā || 10 || śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvā yājñavalkyo dhyānastimitalocanaḥ | dīrghaṃ dadhyau muniśreṣṭho bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ viciṃtayan || 11 || śrīyājñavalkya uvāca asmin janmani rājendra putro naiva ca naiva ca | putryastava bhaviṣyanti koṭiśo nṛpasattama || 12 || rājovāca putraṃ vinā pūrvaṛṇānna ko'pi pramucyate bhūmitale munīndra | sadā hyaputrasya gṛhe vyathā syātparaṃ tvihāmutra sukhaṃ na kiṃcit || 13 || śrīyājñavalkya uvāca mā khedaṃ kuru rājendra putryo deyāstvayā khalu | śrīkṛṣṇāya bhaviṣyāya paraṃ dāyādikaiḥ saha || 14 || tenaiva karmaṇā tvaṃ vai devarṣipitṛṇāmṛṇāt | vimukto nṛpaśārdūla paraṃ mokṣamavāpsyasi || 15 || śrīnārada uvāca tadā'tiharṣito rājā śrutvā vākyaṃ mahāmuneḥ | punaḥ papraccha saṃdehaṃ yājñavalkyaṃ mahāmunim || 16 || rājovāca kasmin kule kutra deśe bhaviṣyaḥ śrīhariḥ svayam | kīdṛgrūpaśca kiṃvarṇo varṣaiśca katibhirgataiḥ || 17 || śrīyājñavalkya uvāca dvāparasya yugasyāsya tava rājyānmahābhuja | avaśeṣe varṣaśate tathā pañcadaśe nṛpa || 18 || tasmin varṣe yadukule mathurāyāṃ yadoḥ pure | bhādre budhe kṛṣṇapakṣe dhātrarkṣe harṣaṇe vṛṣe || 19 || bave'ṣṭamyāmardharātre nakṣatreśamahodaye | aṃdhakārāvṛte kāle devakyāṃ śaurimandire || 20 || bhaviṣyati hariḥ sākṣādaraṇyāmadhvare'gnivat | śrīvatsāṃko ghanaśyāmo vanamālyatisundaraḥ || 21 || pītāṃbaraḥ padmanetro bhaviṣyati caturbhujaḥ | tasmai deyā tvayā kanyā āyuste'sti na saṃśayaḥ || 22 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde ayodhyāpuravāsinyupākhyānaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.6> śrīnārada uvāca evamuktvā gate sākṣādyājñavalkye mahāmunau || atīva harṣamāpannau vimalaścampakāpatiḥ || 1 || ayodhyāpuravāsinyaḥ śrīrāmasya varācca yāḥ || babhūvustasya bhāryāsu tāḥ sarvāḥ kanyakāḥ śubhāḥ || 2 || vivāhayogyāstā dṛṣṭvā cintayan campakāpatiḥ || yājñavalkyavacaḥ smṛtvā dūtamāha nṛpeśvaraḥ || 3 || vimala uvāca mathurāṃ gaccha dūta tvaṃ gatvā śaurigṛhaṃ śubham || darśanīyastvayā putro vasudevasya sundaraḥ || 4 || śrīvatsāṃko ghanaśyāmo vanamālī caturbhujaḥ || yadi syāttarhi dāsyāmi tasmai sarvāḥ sukanyakāḥ || 5 || śrīnārada uvāca iti vākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā dūto'sau mathurāṃ gataḥ | papraccha sarvābhiprāyaṃ māthurāṃśca mahājanān || 6 || tadvākyaṃ māthurāḥ śrutvā kaṃsabhītāḥ subuddhayaḥ | taṃ dūtaṃ rahasi prāhuḥ karṇāṃte maṃdavāgyathā || 7 || māthurā ūcuḥ vasudevasya ye putrāḥ kaṃsena bahavo hatāḥ | ekā'vaśiṣṭāvarajā kanyā sā'pi divaṃ gatā || 8 || vasudevo'sti cātraiva hyaputro dīnamānasaḥ | idaṃ na kathanīyaṃ hi tvayā kaṃsabhayaṃ pure || 9 || śaurisaṃtānavārtāṃ yo vakti cenmathurāpure | taṃ daṃḍayati kaṃso'sau śauryaṣṭamaśiśo ripuḥ || 10 || śrīnārada uvāca janavākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā dūto vai campakāpurīm | gatvā'tha kathayāmāsa rājñe kāraṇamadbhutam || 11 || dūta uvāca mathurāyāmasti śauriranapatyo'tidīnavat | tatputrāstu purā jātāḥ kaṃsena nihatāḥ śrutam || 12 || ekāvaśiṣṭā kanyā'pi khaṃ gatā kaṃsahastataḥ | evaṃ śṛtvā yadupurānnirgato'haṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 13 || caran vṛndāvane ramye kālindīnikaṭe śubhe | akasmāllatikāvṛnde dṛṣṭaḥ kaścicchiśurmayā || 14 || tallakṣaṇasamo rājan gogopagaṇamadhyataḥ | śrīvatsāṃko ghanaśyāmo vanamālyatisundaraḥ || 15 || dvibhujo gopasūnuśca paraṃ tvetadvilakṣaṇam | tvayā caturbhujaścokto vasudevātmajo hariḥ || 16 || kiṃ kartavyaṃ vada nṛpa munivākyaṃ mṛṣā na hi | yatra yatra yathecchā te tatra māṃ preṣaya prabho || 17 || śrīnārada uvāca iti cintayatastasya vismitasya nṛpasya ca | gajāhvayātsindhudeśān jetuṃ bhīṣmaḥ samāgataḥ || 18 || taṃ pūjya vimalo rājā datvā tasmai baliṃ bahu | papraccha sarvābhiprāyaṃ bhīṣmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varam || 19 || vimala uvāca yājñavalkyena pūrvokto mathurāyāṃ hariḥ svayam | vasudevasya devakyāṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 20 || na jāto vasudevasya sakāśe'dya hariḥ paraḥ | ṛṣivākyaṃ mṛṣā na syātkasmai dāsyāmi kanyakāḥ || 21 || mahābhāgavataḥ sākṣāttvaṃ parāvaravittamaḥ | jitendriyo bālyabhāvādvīro dhanvī vasūttamaḥ | etadvada mahābuddhe kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā'tra vai || 22 || śrīnārada uvāca vimalaṃ prāha gāṃgeyo mahābhāgavataḥ kaviḥ | divyadṛgdharmatatvajñaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya prabhāvavit || 23 || bhīṣma uvāca he rājan guptamākhyānaṃ vedavyāsamukhācchrutam | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ śṛṇu harṣavivarddhanam || 24 || devānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya daityānāṃ hi vadhāya ca | vasudevagṛhe jātaḥ paripūrṇatamo hariḥ || 25 || ardharātre kaṃsabhayānnītvā śauriśca taṃ tvaram | gatvā ca gokule putraṃ nidhāya śayane nṛpa || 26 || yaśodānandayoḥ putrīṃ māyāṃ nītvā puraṃ yayau | vavṛdhe gokule kṛṣṇo gupto jñāto na kairnṛbhiḥ || 27 || so'dyaiva vṛdakāraṇye harirgopālaveṣadhṛk | ekādaśa samāstatra gūḍho vāsaṃ kariṣyati | daityaṃ kaṃsaṃ ghātayitvā prakaṭaḥ sa bhaviṣyati || 28 || ayodhyāpuravāsinyaḥ śrīrāmasya varācca yāḥ | tāḥ sarvāstava bhāryāsu babhūvuḥ kanyakāḥ śubhāḥ || 29 || gūḍhāya devadevāya deyāḥ kanyāstvayā khalu | na vilambaḥ kvacitkāryo dehaḥ kālavaśo hyayam || 30 || ityuktvā'tha gate bhīṣme sarvajñe hastināpuram | dūtaṃ svaṃ preṣayāmāsa vimalo nandasūnave || 31 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde ayodhyāpuravāsinyupākhyānaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.7> śrīnārada uvāca atha dūtaḥ sindhudeśān māthurānpunarāgataḥ | caran vṛndāvane kṛṣṇātīre kṛṣṇaṃ dadarśa ha || 1 || kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamya rahasi kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ śanaiḥ | pradakṣiṇīkṛtya dūto vimaloktamuvāca saḥ || 2 || dūta uvāca svayaṃ paraṃ brahma paraḥ pareśaḥ parairadṛśyaḥ paripūrṇadevaḥ | yaḥ puṇyasaṃghaiḥ satataṃ hi dūraḥ tasmai namaḥ sajjanagocarāya || 3 || govipradevaśrutisādhudharma rakṣārthamadyaiva yadoḥ kule'jaḥ | jāto'si kaṃsādivadhāya yo'sau tasmai namo'naṃtaguṇārṇavāya || 4 || aho paraṃ bhāgyamalaṃ vrajaukasāṃ dhanyaṃ kulaṃ nandavarasya te pituḥ | dhanyo vrajau dhanyamaraṇyametad yatraiva sākṣātprakaṭaḥ paro hariḥ || 5 || yadrādhikāsundarakaṇṭharatnaṃ yadgopikājīvanamūlarūpam | tadeva mannetrapathi prajātaṃ kiṃ varṇaye bhāgyamataḥ svakīyam || 6 || gupto vraje gopabhiṣeṇa cāsi kastūrikāmoda iva prasiddhaḥ | yaśaśca te nirmalamāśu śuklī karoti sarvatra gataṃ trilokīm || 7 || jānāsi sarvaṃ janacaityabhāvaṃ kṣetrajña ātmā kṛtivṛndasākṣī | tathāpi vakṣye nṛpavākyamuktaṃ paraṃ rahasyaṃ rahasi svadharmam || 8 || yā siṃdhudeśeṣu purī prasiddhā śrīcampakā nāma śubhā yathaindrī | tatpālako'sau vimalo yathendraḥ tvatpādapadme kṛtacittavṛttiḥ || 9 || sadā kṛtaṃ yajñaśataṃ tvadarthaṃ dānaṃ tapo brāhmaṇasevanaṃ ca | tīrthaṃ japaṃ yena susādhanena tasmai paraṃ darśanameva dehi || 10 || tatkanyakāḥ padmaviśālanetrāḥ pūrṇaṃ patiṃ tvāṃ mṛgayaṃtya ārāt | sadā tvadarthaṃ niyamavratasthāstvatpādasevāvimalīkṛtāṅgāḥ || 11 || gṛhāṇa tāsāṃ vrajadeva pāṇīn datvā paraṃ darśanamadbhutaṃ svam | gacchāśu sindhūn viśadīkuru tvaṃ vimṛśya kartavyamidaṃ tvayā hi || 12 || śrīnārada uvāca dūtavākyaṃ ca tacchrutvā prasanno bhagavānhariḥ | kṣaṇamātreṇa gatavān sadūtaścampakāṃ purīm || 13 || vimalasya mahāyajñe vedadhvanisamākule | sadūtaḥ kṛṣṇa ākāśātsahasā'vatatāra ha || 14 || śrīvatsāṃkaṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ sundaraṃ vanamālinam | pītāṃbaraṃ padmanetraṃ yajñavāṭāgataṃ harim || 15 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya vimalaḥ premavihvalaḥ | papāta caraṇopāṃte romāṃcī sankṛtāñjaliḥ || 16 || saṃsthāpya pīṭhake divye ratnṛhemakhacitpade | stutvā sampūjya vidhivadrājā tatsaṃmukhe sthitaḥ || 17 || gavākṣebhyaḥ prapaśyantīḥ sundarīrvīkṣya mādhavaḥ | uvāca vimalaṃ kṛṣṇo meghagaṃbhīrayā girā || 18 || śrībhagavānuvāca mahāmate varaṃ brūhi yatte manasi vartate | yājñavalkyasya vacasā jātaṃ maddarśanaṃ tava || 19 || vimala uvāca mano me bhramarībhūtaṃ sadā tvatpādapaṃkaje | vāsaṃ kuryād devadeva nānyecchā me kadācana || 20 || śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā vimalo rājā sarvaṃ kośadhanaṃ mahat | dvipavājirathaiḥ sārddhaṃ cakre ātmanivedanam || 21 || samarpya vidhinā sarvāḥ kanyakā haraye nṛpa | namaścakāra kṛṣṇāya vimalo bhaktitatparaḥ || 22 || tadā jayajayārāvo babhūva janamaṇḍale | vavṛṣuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi devatā gaganasthitāḥ || 23 || tadaiva kṛṣṇasārūpyaṃ prāpto'naṃgasphuraddyutiḥ | śatasūryapratīkāśo dyotayanmaṃḍalaṃ diśām || 24 || vainateyaṃ samāruhya natvā śrīgaruḍadhvajam | sabhāryaḥ paśyatāṃ nṝṇāṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ vimalo yayau || 25 || datvā muktiṃ nṛpataye śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam | tatsutāḥ sundarīrnītvā vrajamaṃḍalamāyayau || 26 || tatra kāmavane ramye divyamandirasaṃyute | krīḍantyaḥ kaṃdukaiḥ sarvāḥ tasthuḥ kṛṣṇapriyāḥ śubhāḥ || 27 || yāvatīśca priyā mukhyāḥ tāvad rūpadharo hariḥ | rarāja rāse vrajarāḍ añjayaṃstanmanāḥ prabhuḥ || 28 || rāse vimalaputrīṇāṃ ānandajalabindubhiḥ | cyutairvimalakuṇḍo'bhūt tīrthānāṃ tīrthamuttamam || 29 || dṛṣṭvā pītvā ca taṃ snātvā pūjayitvā nṛpeśvara | chitvā merusamaṃ pāpaṃ golokaṃ yāti mānavaḥ || 30 || ayodhyāvāsinīnāṃ tu kathāṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyānnaraḥ | sa vrajeddhāma paramaṃ golokaṃ yogidurlabham || 31 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde ayodhyāpuravāsinyupākhyānaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.8> śrīnārada uvāca gopīnāṃ yajñasītānāmākhyānaṃ śṛṇu maithila | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ kāmadaṃ maṅgalāyanam ||1|| uśīnaro nāma deśo dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi sthitaḥ | ekadā tatra parjanyo na vavarṣa samā daśa ||2|| dhanavantastatra gopā anāvṛṣṭibhayāturāḥ | sakuṭumbā godhanaiśca vrajamaṇḍalamāyayuḥ ||3|| puṇye vṛndāvane ramye kālindīnikaṭe śubhe | nandarājasahāyena vāsaṃ te cakrire nṛpa ||4|| teṣāṃ gṛheṣu sañjātā yajñasītāśca gopikāḥ | śrīrāmasya varā divyā divyayauvanabhūṣitāḥ ||5|| śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sundaraṃ dṛṣṭvā mohitāstā nṛpeśvara | vrataṃ kṛṣṇaprasādārthaṃ praṣṭuṃ rādhāṃ samāyayuḥ ||6|| gopya ūcuḥ vṛṣabhānusute divye he rādhe kañjalocane | śrīkṛṣṇasya prasādārthaṃ vada kiñcidvrataṃ śubham ||7|| tava vaśyo nandasūnurdevairapi sudurgamaḥ | tvaṃ jaganmohinī rādhe sarvaśāstrārthapāragā ||8|| śrīrādhovāca śrīkṛṣṇasya prasādārthaṃ kurutaikādaśīvratam | tena vaśyo hariḥ sākṣādbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||9|| gopya ūcuḥ saṃvatsarasya dvādaśyā nāmāni vada rādhike | māse māse vrataṃ tasyāḥ kartavyaṃ kena bhāvataḥ ||10|| śrīradhovāca mārgaśīrṣe kṛṣṇapakṣe utpannā viṣṇudehataḥ | muradaityavadhārthāya tithirekādaśī varā ||11|| māse māse pṛthagbhūtā saiva sarvavratottamā | tasyāḥ ṣaḍviṃśatiṃ nāmnāṃ vakṣyāmi hitakāmyayā ||12|| utpattiśca tathā mokṣā saphalā ca tataḥ param | putradā ṣaṭtilā caiva jayā ca vijayā tathā ||13|| āmalakī tathā paścānnāmnā vai pāpamocanī | kāmadā ca tataḥ paścātkathitā vai varūthinī ||14|| mohinī cāparā proktā nirjalā kathitā tataḥ | yoginī devaśayanī kāminī ca tataḥ param ||15|| pavitrā cāpyajā padmā indirā ca tataḥ param | pāśāṅkuśā ramā caiva tataḥ paścātprabodhinī ||16|| sarvasampatpradā caiva dve prokte malamāsaje | evaṃ ṣaḍviṃśatiṃ nāmnāmekādaśyāḥ paṭhecca yaḥ ||17|| saṃvatsaradvādaśīnāṃ phalamāpnoti so'pi hi | ekādaśyāśca niyamaṃ śṛṇutātha vrajāṅganāḥ || bhūmiśāyī daśabhyāṃ tu caikabhukto jitendriyaḥ || 18|| ekavāraṃ jalaṃ pītvā dhautavastro'tinirmalaḥ | brāhme muhūrta utthāya caikādaśyāṃ hariṃ nataḥ ||19|| adhamaṃ kūpikāsnānaṃ vāpyāṃ snānaṃ tu madhyamam | taḍāge cottamaṃ snānaṃ nadyāḥ snānaṃ tataḥ param ||20|| evaṃ snātvā naravaraḥ krodhalobhavivarjitaḥ | nālapettaddine nīcāṃstathā pākhaṇḍino narān ||21|| mithyāvādaratāṃścaiva tathā brāhmaṇanindakān | anyāṃścaiva durācārānagamyāgamane ratān ||22|| paradravyāpahārāṃśca paradārābhigāminaḥ | durvṛttān bhinnamaryādānnālapītsa vratī naraḥ ||23|| keśavaṃ pūjayitvā tu naivedyaṃ tatra kārayet | dīpaṃ dadyādgṛhe tatra bhaktiyuktena cetasā ||24|| kathāḥ śrutvā brāhmaṇebhyo dadyātsaddakṣiṇāṃ punaḥ | rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādgāyan kṛṣṇapadāni ca ||25|| kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ masūrāṃśca kodravaṃ caṇakaṃ tathā | śākaṃ madhu parānnaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithunam ||26|| viṣṇuvrate ca kartavye daśābhyāṃ daśa varjayet | dyūtaṃ krīḍāṃ ca nidrāṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ dantadhāvanam ||27|| parāpavādaṃ paiśunyaṃ steyaṃ hiṃsāṃ tathā ratim | krodhāḍhyaṃ hyanṛtaṃ vākyamekādaśyāṃ vivarjayet ||28|| kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ surāṃ kṣaudraṃ tailaṃ vitathabhāṣaṇam | puṣṭiṣaṣṭimasūrāṃśca dvādaśyāṃ parivarjayet ||29|| anīna vidhinā kuryāddvādaśīvratamuttamam ||30|| gopya ūcuḥ ekādaśīvratasyāsya kālaṃ vada mahāmate | kiṃ phalaṃ vada tasyāstu māhātmyaṃ vada tattvataḥ ||31|| śrīrādhovāca daśamī pañcapañcāśadghaṭikā cetpradṛśyate | tarhi caikādaśī tyājyā dvādaśīṃ samupoṣayet ||32|| daśamī palamātreṇa tyājyā caikādaśī tithiḥ | madirābindupātena tyājyo gaṅgāghaṭo yathā ||33|| ekādaśī yadā vṛddhiṃ dvādaśī ca yadā gatā | tadā parā hyupoṣyā syātpūrvā vai dvādaśīvrate ||34|| ekādaśīvratasyāsya phalaṃ vakṣye vrajāṅganāḥ | yasya śravaṇamātreṇa vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet ||35|| aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi dvijānbhojayate tu yaḥ | tatkṛtaṃ phalamāpnoti dvādaśīvratakṛnnaraḥ ||36|| sasāgaravanopetāṃ yo dadāti vasundharām | tatsahasraguṇaṃ puṇyamekādaśyā mahāvrate ||37|| ye saṃsārārṇave magnāḥ pāpapaṅkasamākule | teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya dvādaśīvratamuttamam ||38|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvaikādaśīvratakṛnnaraḥ | na paśyati yamaṃ raudraṃ yuktaḥ pāpaśatairapi ||39|| pūjayedyo hariṃ bhaktyā dvādaśyāṃ tulasīdalaiḥ | lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāmbhasā ||40|| aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca | ekādaśyupavāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||41|| daśa vai mātṛke pakṣe tathā vai daśa paitṛke | priyāyā daśa pakṣe tu puruṣānuddharennaraḥ ||42|| yathā śuklā tathā kṛṣṇā dvayośca sadṛśaṃ phalam | dhenuḥ śvetā tathā kṛṣṇā ubhayoḥ sadṛśaṃ payaḥ ||43|| merumandaramātrāṇi pāpāni śatajanmasu | ekā caikādaśī gopyo dahate tūlarāśivat ||44|| vidhivadvidhihīnaṃ vā dvādaśyāṃ dānameva ca | svalpaṃ vā sukṛtaṃ gopyo merutulyaṃ bhavecca tat ||45|| ekādaśīdine viṣṇoḥ śṛṇute yo hareḥ kathām | saptadvīpavatīdāne latphalaṃ labhate ca saḥ ||46|| śaṅkhoddhāre naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ gadādharam | ekādaśyupavāsasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm ||47|| prabhāse ca kurukṣetre kedāre badarikāśrame | kāśyāṃ ca sūkarakṣetre grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ ||48|| saṅkrāntīnāṃ caturlakṣaṃ dānaṃ dattaṃ ca yannaraiḥ | ekādaśyupavāsasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm ||49|| nāgānāṃ ca yathā śeṣaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ garuḍo yathā | devānāṃ ca yathā viṣṇurvarṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā ||50|| vṛkṣāṇāṃ ca yathāśvatthaḥ patrāṇāṃ tulasī yathā | vratānāṃ ca tathā gopyo varā caikādaśī tithiḥ ||51|| daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tapastapyati yo naraḥ | tattulyaṃ phalamāpnoti dvādaśīvratakṛnnaraḥ ||52|| itthamekādaśīnāṃ ca phalamuktaṃ vrajāṅganāḥ | kurutāśu vrataṃ yūyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchatha ||53|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnārada bahulāśva saṃvāde yajñasītopākhyāne ekādaśīmāhātmyaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8|| hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.9> gopya ūcuḥ vṛṣabhānusute subhru sarvaśāstrārthapārage | viḍaṃbayaṃtī tvaṃ vācā vācaṃ vācaspatermune || 1 || ekādaśīvrataṃ rādhe kena kena purā kṛtam | tadbrūhi no viśeṣeṇa tvaṃ sākṣāt jñānaśevadhiḥ || 2 || śrīrādhovāca ādau devaiḥ kṛtaṃ gopyo varamekādaśīvratam | bhraṣṭarājyasya lābhārthaṃ daityānāṃ nāśanāya ca || 3 || vaiśaṃtena purā rājñā kṛtamekādaśīvratam | svapitustāraṇārthāya yamalokagatasya ca || 4 || aksmālluṃpakenāpi jñātityaktena pāpinā | ekādaśī kṛtā yena rājyaṃ lebhe sa luṃpakaḥ || 5 || bhadrāvatyāṃ ketumatā kṛtamekādaśīvratam | putrahīnena sadvākyātputraṃ lebhe sa mānavaḥ || 6 || brāhmaṇyai devapatnībhirdattamekādaśīvratam | tena lebhe svargasaukhyaṃ dhanadhānyaṃ ca mānuṣī || 7 || puṣpadaṃtīmālyavaṃtau śakraśāpātpiśācatām | prāptau kṛtaṃ vrataṃ tābhyāṃ punargandharvatāṃ gatau || 8 || purā śrīrāmacandreṇa kṛtamekādaśīvratam | samudre setubaṃdhārthaṃ rāvaṇasya vadhāya ca || 9 || layāṃte ca samutpannā dhātṛvṛkṣatale surāḥ | ekādaśīvrataṃ cakruḥ sarvakalyāṇahetave || 10 || vrataṃ cakāra medhāvī dvādaśyāḥ pitṛvākyataḥ | apsaraḥsparśadoṣeṇa mukto'bhūnnirmaladyutiḥ || 11 || gaṃdharvo lalitaḥ patnyā gataḥ śāpātsa rakṣatām | ekādaśīvratenāpi punargaṃdharvatāṃ gataḥ || 12 || ekādaśīvratenāpi māṃdhātā svargatiṃ gataḥ | sagarasya kakutsthaśca mucakundo mahāmatiḥ || 13 || dhuṃdhumārādayaścānye rājāno bahavastathā | brahmakapālanirmukto babhūva bhagavānbhavaḥ || 14 || dhṛṣṭabuddhirvaiśyaputro jñātityakto mahākhalaḥ | ekādaśīvrataṃ kṛtvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ sa jagāma ha || 15 || rājñā rukmāṃgadenāpi kṛtamekādaśīvratam | tena bhūmaṇḍalaṃ bhuktvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ sapuro yayau || 16 || aṃbarīṣeṇa rājñā'pi kṛtamekādaśīvratam | nāspṛśadbrahmaśāpo'pi yo na pratihataḥ kvacit || 17 || hemamālī nāma yakṣaḥ kuṣṭhī dhanadaśāpataḥ | ekādaśīvrataṃ kṛtvā candratulyo babhūva ha || 18 || mahījitā nṛpeṇāpi kṛtamekādaśīvratam | tena putraṃ śubhaṃ labdhvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ sa jagāma ha || 19 || hariścandreṇa rājñā'pi kṛtamekādaśīvratam | tena labdhvā mahīrājyaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ sapuro yayau || 20 || śrīśobhano nāma purā kṛte yuge jāmātṛko'bhūnmucukundabhūbhṛtaḥ | ekādaśīṃ yaḥ samupoṣya bhārate prāptaḥ sa daivaiḥ kila maṃdarācale || 21 || adyāpi rājyaṃ kurute kuberavadrājñā yuto'sau kila candrabhāgayā | ekādaśī sarvatithīśvarīṃ parāṃ jānītha gopyo na hi tatsamā'nyā || 22 || śrīnārada uvāca iti rādhāmukhācchrutvā yajñasītāśca gopikāḥ | ekādaśīvrataṃ cakrurvidhivatkṛṣṇalālasāḥ || 23 || ekādaśīvratenāpi prasannaḥ śrīhariḥ svayam | mārgaśīrṣe pūrṇimāyāṃ rāsaṃ tābhiścakāra ha || 24 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde ekādaśīmāhātmyaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.10> śrīnārada uvāca puliṃdakānāṃ gopīnāṃ kariṣye varṇanaṃ hyataḥ | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyamadbhutaṃ bhaktivarddhanam || 1 || pulindā ūdbhaṭāḥ kecidviṃdhyādri vanavāsinaḥ | viluṃpaṃto rājavasu dīnānāṃ na kadācana || 2 || kupitasteṣu balavān vindhyadeśādhipo balī | akṣauhiṇībhyāṃ tānsarvān puliṃdānsa rurodha ha || 3 || yuyudhuste'pi khaḍgaiśca kuntaiḥ śūlaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ | śaktyarṣṭibhirbhṛśuṇḍībhiḥ śaraiḥ kati dināni ca || 4 || patraṃ te preṣayāmāsuḥ kaṃsāya yadubhūbhṛte | kaṃsapraṇodito daityaḥ pralaṃbo balavāṃstadā || 5 || yojanadvayamuccāṃgaṃ kālameghasamadyutim | kirīṭakuṃḍaladharaṃ sarpahāravibhūṣitam || 6 || pādayoḥ śṛṅkhalāyuktaṃ gadāpāṇiṃ kṛtāṃtavat | lalajjihvaṃ ghorarūpaṃ pātayantaṃ girīndrumān || 7 || kaṃpayaṃtaṃ bhuvaṃ vegātpralambaṃ yuddhadurmadam | dṛṣṭvā pradharṣito rājā sasainyo raṇamaṃḍalam || 8 || tyaktvā dudrāva sahasā siṃhaṃ vīkṣya gajo yathā | pralaṃbastān samānīya mathurāmāyayau punaḥ || 9 || pulindāste'pi kaṃsasya bhṛtyatvaṃ samupāgatāḥ | sakuṭuṃbāḥ kāmagirau vāsaṃ cakrurnṛpeśvara || 10 || teṣāṃ gṛheṣu saṃjātāḥ śrīrāmasya varātparāt | puliṃdyaḥ kanyakā divyā rūpiṇyaḥ śrīrivārcitāḥ || 11 || taddarśanasmararujaḥ puliṃdyaḥ premavihvalāḥ | śrīmatpādarajo dhṛtvā dhyāyaṃtyastamaharniśam || 12 || tāścāpi rāse saṃprāptāḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ parameśvaram | paripūrṇatamaṃ sākṣādgolokādhipatiṃ prabhum || 13 || śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbhojarajo devaiḥ sudurlabham | aho bhāgyaṃ puliṃdīnāṃ tāsāṃ prāptaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 14 || yaḥ pārameṣṭhyamakhilaṃ na mahendradhiṣṇyaṃ no sārvabhaumamaniśaṃ na rasādhipatyam | no yogasiddhimabhito na punarbhavaṃ vā vāñchatyalaṃ paramapādarajaḥ sa bhaktaḥ || 15 || niṣkiṃcanāḥ svakṛtakarmaphalairvirāgā yattatpadaṃ harijanā munayo mahāṃtaḥ | bhaktā juṣanti haripādarajaḥprasaktā anye vadanti na sukhaṃ kila nairapekṣyam || 16 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde pulindakopākhyānaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.11> śrīnārada uvāca anyāsāṃ caiva gopīnāṃ varṇanaṃ śṛṇu maithila | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ haribhaktivivarddhanam || 1 || nītivinmārgadaḥ śuklaḥ pataṃgo divyavāhanaḥ | gopeṣṭaśca vraje rājan jātā ṣaḍvṛṣabhānavaḥ || 2 || teṣāṃ gṛheṣu saṃjātā lakṣmīpativarātprajāḥ | ramāvaikuṇṭhavāsinyaḥ śrīsakhyo'pi samudrajāḥ || 3 || ūrdhvaṃ vaikuṇṭhavāsinyaḥ tathā'jitapadāśritāḥ | śrīlokācalavāsinyaḥ śrīsakhyo'pi samudrajāḥ || 4 || cintayantyaḥ sadā śrīmadgovindacaraṇāṃbujam | śrīkṛṣṇasya prasādārthaṃ tābhirmāghavrataṃ kṛtam || 5 || māghasya śuklapaṃcamyāṃ vasantādau hariḥ svayam | tāsāṃ premaparīkṣārthaṃ kṛṣṇo vai tadgṛhāngataḥ || 6 || vyāghracarmāṃbaraṃ bibhran jaṭāmukuṭamaṃḍitaḥ | vibhūtidhūsaro veṇuṃ vādayan mohayan jagat || 7 || tāsāṃ vīthīṣu saṃprāptiṃ vīkṣya gopyo'pi sarvataḥ | āyayurdarśanaṃ kartuṃ mohitāḥ premavihvalāḥ || 8 || atīva sundaraṃ dṛṣṭvā yoginaṃ gopakanyakāḥ | ūcuḥ parasparaṃ sarvāḥ premānandasamākulāḥ || 9 || gopya ūcuḥ ko'yaṃ śiśurnandasutākṛtirvā kasyāpi putro dhanino nṛpasya | nārīkuvāgbāṇavibhinnamarmā jāto virakto gatakṛtyakarmā || 10 || atīva ramyaḥ sukumāradeho manojavadviśvamanoharo'yam | aho kathaṃ jīvati cāsya mātā pitā ca bhāryā bhaginī vinainam || 11 || evaṃ tāḥ sarvato yūthībhūtvā sarvā vrajāṃganāḥ | papracchustaṃ yogivaraṃ vismitāḥ premavihvalāḥ || 12 || gopya ūcuḥ kastvaṃ yoginnāma kiṃ te kutra vāsastu te mune | kā vṛttistava kā siddhirvada no vadatāṃ vara || 13 || siddha uvāca yogeśvaro'haṃ me vāsaḥ sadā mānasarovare | nāmnā svayaṃprakāśo'haṃ nirannaḥ svabalātsadā || 14 || sārthe paramahaṃsānāṃ yāmyahaṃ he vrajāṃganāḥ | bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ vartamānaṃ vedmyahaṃ divyadarśanaḥ || 15 || uccāṭanaṃ māraṇaṃ ca mohanaṃ staṃbanaṃ tathā | jānāmi maṃtravidyābhiḥ vaśīkaraṇameva ca || 16 || gopya ūcuḥ yadi jānāsi yogiṃstvaṃ vārtāṃ kālatrayodbhavām | kiṃ vartate no manasi vada tarhi mahāmate || 17 || siddha uvāca bhavatīnāṃ ca karṇāṃte kathanīyamidaṃ vacaḥ | yuṣmadājñayā vā vakṣye sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāmiha || 18 || gopya ūcuḥ satyaṃ yogeśvaro'si tvaṃ trikālajño na saṃśayaḥ | vaśīkaraṇamaṃtreṇa sadyaḥ paṭhanamātrataḥ || 19 || yadi so'traiva cāyāti ciṃtito yo'sti vai mune | tadā manyāmahe tvāṃ vai maṃtriṇāṃ pravaraṃ param || 20 || siddha uvāca durlabho durghaṭo bhāvo yuṣmābhirgaditaḥ striyaḥ | tathāpyahaṃ kariṣyāmi vākyaṃ na calate satām || 21 || nimīlayata netrāṇi mā śocaṃ kuruta striyaḥ | bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho yuṣmākaṃ kāryameva ca || 22 || śrīnārada uvāca tatheti mīlitākṣīṣu gopīṣu bhagavānhariḥ | vihāya tadyogirūpaṃ babhau śrīnandanandanaḥ || 23 || netrāṇyunmīlya dadṛśuḥ sānandaṃ nandanandanam | vismitāstatprabhāvajñā harṣitā mohamāgatāḥ || 24 || māghamāse mahārāse puṇye vṛndāvane vane | tābhiḥ sārddhaṃ harī reme surībhiḥ surarāḍiva || 25 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde ramāvaikuṇṭha śvetadvīpordhvavaikuṇṭhājitapada śrīlokācalavāsinī śrīsakhīnāmupākhyānaṃ nāma ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.12> śrīnārada uvāca idaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ gopīnāṃ caritaṃ śubham | anyasāṃ caiva gopīnāṃ varṇanaṃ śṛṇu maithila || 1 || vītihotro'gnibhuk sāṃbaḥ śrīkaro gopatiḥ śrutaḥ | vrajeśaḥ pāvanaḥ śāṃta upanandā vrajebhavāḥ || 2 || dhanavaṃto rūpavaṃtaḥ putravaṃto bahuśrutāḥ | śīlādiguṇasaṃpanāḥ sarve dānaparāyaṇāḥ || 3 || teṣāṃ gṛheṣu saṃjātāḥ kanyakā devavākyataḥ | kāściddivyā adivyāśca tathā triguṇavṛttayaḥ || 4 || bhūmigopyaśca saṃjātāḥ puṇyairnānāvidhaiḥ kṛtaiḥ | rādhikāsahacaryastāḥ sakhyo'bhūvan videharāṭ || 5 || ekadā māninīṃ rādhāṃ tāḥ sarvā vrajagopikāḥ | ūcurvīkṣya hariṃ prāptaṃ holikāyā mahotsave || 6 || gopya ūcuḥ raṃbhoru candravadane madhumāninīśe rādhe vacaḥ sulalitaṃ lalane śṛṇu tvam | śrīholikotsavavihāramalaṃ vidhātumāyāti te puravane vrajabhūṣaṇo'yam || 7 || śrīyauvanonmadavidhūrṇitalocano'sau nīlālakālikalitāṃ sakapolagolaḥ | satpītakaṃcukaghanāṃtamaśeṣamārād ācālayandhvanimatā svapadāruṇena || 8 || bālārkamaulivimalāṃgadahāramudyadvidyutkṣipan makarakuṇḍalamādadhānaḥ | pītāṃbareṇa jayati dyutimaṇḍalo'sau bhūmaṇḍale sadhanuṣeva ghano divisthaḥ || 9 || ābīrakuṃkumarasaiśca viliptadeho haste gṛhītanavasecanayaṃtra ārāt | prekṣyaṃstavāśu sakhi vāṭamatīva rādhe tvadrāsaraṃgarasakelirataḥ sthitaḥ saḥ || 10 || nirgaccha phālgunamiṣeṇa vihāya mānaṃ dātavyamadya ca yaśaḥ kila holikāyai | kartavyamāśu nijamandiraraṅgavāripāṭīrapaṃkamakarandacayaṃ ca tūrṇam || 11 || uttiṣṭha gaccha sahasā nijamaṇḍalībhiryatrāsti so'pi kila tatra mahāmate tvam | etādṛśo'pi samayo na kadāpi labhyaḥ prakṣālitaṃ karatalaṃ viditaṃ pravāhe || 12 || śrīnārada uvāca atha mānavatī rādhā mānaṃ tyaktvā samutthitā | sakhīsaṃghaiḥ parivṛtā prakartuṃ holikotsavam || 13 || śrīkhaṇḍāgurukastūrīharidrākuṃkumadravaiḥ | pūritābhirdṛtībhiśca saṃyuktāstā vrajāṃganāḥ || 14 || raktahastāḥ pītavastrāḥ kūjan nūpuramekhalāḥ | gāyaṃtyo holikāgītīḥ gālībhirhāsyasaṃdhibhiḥ || 15 || ābīrāruṇacūrṇānāṃ muṣṭibhistā itastataḥ | kurvaṃtyaścāruṇaṃ bhūmiṃ digantaṃ cāṃbaraṃ tathā || 16 || koṭiśaḥ koṭiśastatra sphuraṃtyābīramuṣṭayaḥ | sugaṃdhāruṇacūrṇānāṃ koṭiśaḥ koṭiśastathā || 17 || sarvato jagṛhuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ karābhyāṃ vrajagopikāḥ | yathā meghaṃ ca dāminyaḥ saṃdhyāyāṃ śrāvaṇasya ca || 18 || tanmukhaṃ ca vilimpantyo'thābīrāruṇamuṣṭibhiḥ | kuṃkumāktadṛtībhistaṃ ārdrīcakrurvidhānataḥ || 19 || bhagavanapi tatraiva yāvatīrvrajayoṣitaḥ | dhṛtvā rūpāṇi tāvaṃti vijahāra nṛpeśvara || 20 || rādhayā śuśubhe tatra holikāyā mahotsave | varṣāsaṃdhyākṣaṇe kṛṣṇaḥ saudāminyā ghano yathā || 21 || kṛṣṇo'pi taddhastakṛtāktanetro datvā svakīyaṃ navamuttarīyam | tābhyo yayau nandagṛhaṃ pareśo deveṣu varṣatsu ca puṣpavarṣam || 22 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde holikotsave divyatriguṇavṛttibhūmigopyupākhyānaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.13> śrīnārada uvāca atha devāṃganānāṃ ca gopīnāṃ varṇanaṃ śṛṇu | catuṣpadārthadaṃ nṝṇāṃ bhaktivardhanamuttamam || 1 || babhūva mālave deśe gopo nando divaspatiḥ | bhāryāsahasrasaṃyukto dhanavān nītimānparaḥ || 2 || tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena mathurāyāṃ samāgataḥ | nandarājaṃ vrajādhīśaṃ śrutvā śrīgokulaṃ yayau || 3 || militvā goparājaṃ sa dṛṣṭvā vṛndāvanaśriyam | nandarājājñayā tatra vāsaṃ cakre mahāmanāḥ || 4 || yojanadvayamāśritya ghoṣaṃ cakre gavāṃ punaḥ | mudaṃ prāpa vraje rājan jñātibhiḥ sa divaspatiḥ || 5 || tasya devalavākyena sarvā devajanastriyaḥ | jātāḥ kanyā mahādivyā jvaladagniśikhopamāḥ || 6 || śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sundaraṃ dṛṣṭvā mohitāḥ kanyakāśca tāḥ | dāmodarasya prāptyarthaṃ cakrurmāghavrataṃ param || 7 || ardhodaye'rke yamunāṃ nityaṃ snātvā vrajāṃganāḥ | uccairjaguḥ kṛṣṇalīlāṃ premānandasamākulāḥ || 8 || tāsāṃ prasannaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo varaṃ brūhītyuvāca ha | tā ūcustaṃ paraṃ natvā kṛtāñjalipuṭāḥ śanaiḥ || 9 || gopya ūcuḥ yogīśvarāṇāṃ kila durlabhastvaṃ sarveśvaraḥ kāraṇakāraṇo'si | tvaṃ netragāmī bhavatātsadā no vaṃśīdharo manmathamanmathāṃgaḥ || 10 || tathā'stu coktvā harirādidevaḥ tāsāṃ tu yo darśanamātatāna | bhūyātsadā te hṛdi netramārge tathā sa āhūta ivāśu citte || 11 || paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo nānya eva hi | ekakāryārthamāgatya koṭikāryaṃ cakāra ha || 12 || parikarīkṛtapītapaṭaṃ hariṃ śikhikirīṭanatīkṛtakaṃdharam | lakuṭaveṇukaraṃ calakuṃḍalaṃ paṭutaraṃ nataveṣadharaṃ bhaje || 13 || bhaktyaiva vaśyo harirādidevaḥ sadā pramāṇaṃ kila cātra gopyaḥ | sāṃkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ na kṛtaṃ kadāpi premṇaiva yasya prakṛtiṃ gatāḥ syuḥ || 14 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde devajanastrī upākhyānaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.14> śrīnārada uvāca jālaṃdharīṇāṃ gopīnāṃ janmāni śṛṇu maithila | karmāṇi ca mahārāja pāpaghnāni nṛṇāṃ sadā || 1 || rajan saptanadītīre raṃgapattanamuttamam | sarvasaṃpadyutaṃ dīrghaṃ yojanadvayavartulam || 2 || raṃgojistatra gopālaḥ purādhīśo mahābalaḥ | putrapautrasamāyukto dhanadhānyasamṛddhimān || 3 || hastināpuranāthāya dhṛtarāṣṭrāya bhūbhṛte | haimānāmarbudaśataṃ vārṣikaṃ sa dadau sadā || 4 || ekadā tatra varṣāṃte vyatīte kila maithila | vārṣikaṃ tu karaṃ rājñe na dadau sa madotkaṭaḥ || 5 || milanārthaṃ na cāyate raṃgojau gopanāyake | vīrā daśa sahasrāṇi dhṛtarāṣṭrapraṇoditāḥ || 6 || baddhvā taṃ dāmabhirgopamājagmuste gajahvayam | kati varṣāṇi raṃgojiḥ kārāgāre sthito'bhavat || 7 || sanniruddhastāḍito'pi lobhī bhīrurna cābhavat | na dadau sa dhanaṃ kiṃciddhṛtarāṣṭrāya bhūbhṛte || 8 || kārāgārānmahābhīmātkadācitsa palāyitaḥ | rātrau raṃgapuraṃ prāgād raṃgojirgopanāyakaḥ || 9 || punastaṃ hi samāhartuṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrapraṇoditam | akṣauhiṇītrayaṃ rājan samarthabalavāhanam || 10 || tena sārddhaṃ sa bāṇaughaistīkṣṇadhāraiḥ sphuratprabhaiḥ | yuyudhe daṃśito yuddhe dhanuṣṭaṃkārayanmuhuḥ || 11 || śatrubhiśchinnakavacaḥ chinnadhanvā hatasvakaḥ | purametya mṛdhaṃ cakre raṃgojiḥ katibhirdinaiḥ || 12 || anāthaḥ śaraṇaṃ cecchan kaṃsāya yadūbhūbhṛte | dūtaṃ svaṃ preṣayāmāsa raṃgojirbhayapīḍitaḥ || 13 || dūtastu mathurāmetya sabhāṃ gatvā natānanaḥ | kṛtāñjaliścaugraseniṃ natvā prāha girā''rdrayā || 14 || raṃgojināmā nṛpa raṃgapattane gopo'sti nītijñavaraḥ purādhipaḥ | svaśatrusaṃruddhapuro mahādhibhṛd alabdhanāthaḥ śaraṇaṃ gatastava || 15 || tvaṃ dīnaduḥkhārtiharo mahītale bhaumadisaṃgītaguṇo mahābalaḥ | surāsurānudbhaṭabhūmipālakān vijitya yuddhe surarāḍiva sthitaḥ || 16 || candraṃ cakoraśca raviṃ kuśeśayo yathā śaracchīkarameva cātakaḥ | kṣudhāturo'nnaṃ ca jalaṃ tṛṣāturaḥ smaratyasau śatrubhaye tathā tvām || 17 || itthaṃ śrutvā vacastasya kaṃso vai dīnavatsalaḥ | daityakoṭisamāyukto mano gaṃtuṃ samādadhe || 18 || gomūtracayasindūrakastūrīpatrabhṛnmukham | vindhyādrisadṛśaṃ śyāmaṃ madanirjharasaṃyutam || 19 || pāde ca śṛṅkhalājālaṃ nadaṃtaṃ ghanavadbhṛśam | dvipaṃ kuvalayāpīḍaṃ samāruhya madotkaṭaḥ || 20 || cāṇūramuṣṭikādyaiśca keśivyomavṛṣāsuraiḥ | sahasā daṃśitaḥ kaṃsaḥ prayayau raṃgapattanam || 21 || yadūnāṃ ca kurūṇāṃ ca balayostu parasparam | bāṇaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ triśūlaiśca ghoraṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva ha || 22 || bāṇāṃdhakāre saṃjāte kaṃso nītvā mahāgadām | viveśa kurusenāsu vane vaiśvānaro yathā || 23 || kāṃścidvīrān sakavacān gadayā vajrakalpayā | pātayāmāsa bhūpṛṣṭhe vajreṇeṃdro yathā girim || 24 || rathānmamarda pādābhyāṃ pārṣṇighātena ghoṭakān | gaje gajaṃ tāḍayitvā gajānpronnīya cāṃghriṣu || 25 || skandhayoḥ kakṣayordhṛtvā sanīḍān ratnakaṃbalān | kāṃścidbalādbhrāmayitvā cikṣepa gagane balī || 26 || gajāñchuṇḍāsu connīya lolaghaṃṭāsamāvṛtān | cikṣepa saṃmukhe rājan mṛdhe vyomāsuro balī || 27 || rathān gṛhītvā sāśvāṃśca śṛṅgābhaṃ bhrāmayanmuhuḥ | cikṣepa dikṣu balavān daityo duṣṭo vṛṣāsuraḥ || 28 || balātpaścimapādābhyāṃ vīrānaśvānitastataḥ | pātayāmāsa rājeṃdra keśī daityādhipo balī || 29 || evaṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ yuddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai kurusainikāḥ | śeṣā bhayāturā vīrā jagmuste'pi diśo daśa || 30 || raṃgojiṃ sakuṭumbaṃ taṃ nītvā kaṃso'tha daityarāṭ | mathurāṃ prayayau vīro nādayan duṃdubhīñchanaiḥ || 31 || śrutvā parājayaṃ svasya kauravāḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ | daityānāṃ samayaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve vai maunamāsthitāḥ || 32 || puraṃ barhiṣadaṃ nāma vrajasīmni manoharam | raṃgojaye dadau kaṃso daityānāmadhipo balī || 33 || vāsaṃ cakāra tatraiva raṃgojirgopanāyakaḥ | babhūvustasya bhāryāsu jālaṃdharyo harervarāt || 34 || pariṇītā gopajanai rūpayauvanabhūṣitāḥ | jāradharmeṇa susnehaṃ śrīkṛṣṇe tāḥ pracakrire || 35 || caitramāse mahārāse tābhiḥ sākaṃ hariḥ svayam | puṇye vṛndāvane ramye reme vṛndāvaneśvaraḥ || 36 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde jālaṃdharyupākhyānaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.15> śrīnārada uvāca vraje śoṇapurādhīśo gopo nando dhanī mahān | bhāryāḥ pañcasahasrāṇi babhūvustasya maithila || 1 || jātā matsyavarāttāstu samudre gopakanyakāḥ | tathā'nyāśca trivācāpi pṛthivyā dohanānnṛpa || 2 || barhiṣmatīpuraṃdhryo yā jātā jātismarāḥ parāḥ | tathā'nyāpsaraso'bhūvan varānnārāyaṇasya ca || 3 || tathā sutalavāsinyo vāmanasya varātstriyaḥ | tathā nāgendrakanyāśca jātāḥ śeṣavarātparāt || 4 || tābhyo durvāsasā dattaṃ kṛṣṇāpañcāṃgamadbhutam | tena saṃpūjya yamunāṃ vavrire śrīpatiṃ varam || 5 || ekadā śrīharistābhirvṛndāraṇye manohare | yamunānikaṭe divye puṃskokilataruvraje || 6 || madhupadhvanisaṃyukte kūjatkokilasārase | madhumāse mandavāyau vasantalatikāvṛte || 7 || dolotsavaṃ samārebhe harirmadanamohanaḥ | kadambavṛkṣe rahasi kalpavṛkṣe manohare || 8 || kālindījalakallolakolāhalasamākule | taddolākhelanaṃ cakruḥ tā gopyaḥ premavihvalāḥ || 9 || rādhayā kīrtisutayā candrakoṭiprakāśayā | reje vṛndāvane kṛṣṇo yathā ratyā ratīśvaraḥ || 10 || evaṃ prāptāśca yāḥ sarvāḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ naṃdanaṃdanam | paripūrṇatamaṃ sākṣāttāsāṃ kiṃ varṇyate tapaḥ || 11 || nāgendrakanyā yāḥ sarvāḥ caitramāse manohare | balabhadraṃ hariṃ prāptāḥ kṛṣṇātīre tu tāḥ śubhā || 12 || idaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ gopīnāṃ caritaṃ śubham | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 13 || śrībahulāśva uvāca yamunāyāśca paṃcāṃgaṃ dattaṃ durvāsasā mune | gopībhyo yena govindaḥ prāptastadbrūhi māṃ prabho || 14 || śrīnārada uvāca atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam | yasya śravaṇamātreṇa pāpahāniḥ parā bhavet || 15 || ayodhyādhipatiḥ śrīmān māṃdhātā rājasattamaḥ | mṛgayāṃ vicaran prāptaḥ saubharerāśramaṃ śubham || 16 || vṛndāvane sthitaṃ sākṣātkṛṣṇātīre manohare | natvā jāmātaraṃ rājā saubhariṃ prāha mānadaḥ || 17 || māṃdhātovāca bhagavan sarvavitsākṣāttvaṃ parāvaravittamaḥ | lokānāṃ tamaso'ndhānāṃ divyasūrya ivāparaḥ || 18 || iha loke bhavedrājyaṃ sarvasiddhisamanvitam | amutra kṛṣṇasārūpyaṃ yena syāttadvadāśu me || 19 || saubhariruvāca yamunāyāśca pañcāgaṃ vadiṣyāmi tavāgrataḥ | sarvasiddhikaraṃ śaśvatkṛṣṇasārūpyakārakam || 20 || yāvatsūrya udeti sma yāvacca pratitiṣṭhati | tāvadrājyapradaṃ cātra śrīkṛṣṇavaśakārakam || 21 || kavacaṃ ca stavaṃ nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ paṭalaṃ tathā | paddhatiṃ sūryavaṃśendra pañcāṃgāni vidurbudhāḥ || 22 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīsaubharimāṃdhātṛsaṃvāde barhiṣmatīpuraṃdhryapsaraḥ sutalavāsinī nāgendrakanyopākhyānaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.16> māṃdhātovāca yamunāyāḥ kṛṣṇarājñyāḥ kavacaṃ sarvato'malam | dehi mahyaṃ mahābhāga dhārayiṣyāmyahaṃ sadā || 1 || saubhariruvāca yamunāyāśca kavacaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ nṛṇām | catuṣpadārthadaṃ sākṣācchṛṇu rājanmahāmate || 2 || kṛṣṇāṃ caturbhujāṃ śyāmāṃ puṇḍarīkadalekṣaṇām | rathasthāṃ sundarīṃ dhyātvā dhārayetkavacaṃ tataḥ || 3 || snātaḥ pūrvamukho mauni kṛtasaṃdhyaḥ kuśāsane | kuśairbaddhaśikho vipraḥ paṭhedvai svastikāsanaḥ || 4 || yamunā me śiraḥ pātu kṛṣṇā netradvayaṃ sadā | śyāmā bhrūbhaṃgadeśaṃ ca nāsikāṃ nākavāsinī || 5 || kapolau pātu me sākṣātparamānandarūpiṇī | kṛṣṇavāmāṃsasaṃbhūtā pātu karṇadvayaṃ mama || 6 || adharau pātu kālindī cibukaṃ sūryakanyakā | yamasvasā kandharāṃ ca hṛdayaṃ me mahānadī || 7 || kṛṣṇapriyā pātu pṛṣṭhaṃ taṭini me bhujadvayam | śroṇītaṭaṃ ca suśroṇī kaṭiṃ me cārudarśanā || 8 || ūrudvayaṃ tu raṃbhorurjānunī tvaṃghribhedinī | gulphau rāseśvarī pātu pādau pāpaprahāriṇī || 9 || aṃtarbahiradhaścordhvaṃ diśāsu vidiśāsu ca | samaṃtātpātu jagataḥ paripūrṇatamapriyā || 10 || idaṃ śrīyamunāśca kavacaṃ paramādbhutam | daśavāraṃ paṭhedbhaktyā nirdhano dhanavānbhavet || 11 || tribhirmāsaiḥ paṭheddhīmān brahmacārī mitāśanaḥ | sarvarājyādhipatyañca prāpyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 12 || daśottaraśataṃ nityaṃ trimāsāvadhi bhaktitaḥ | yaḥ paṭhetprayato bhūtvā tasya kiṃ kiṃ na jāyate || 13 || yaḥ paṭhetprātarutthāya sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet | aṃte vrajetparaṃ dhāma golokaṃ yogidurlabham || 14 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīsaubharimāṃdhātṛsaṃvāde śrīyamunākavacaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.17> māṃdhātovāca yamunāyāḥ stavaṃ divyaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ param | saubhare muniśārdūla vada māṃ kṛpayā tvaram || 1 || śrīsaubhariruvāca mārtaṃḍakanyakāyāstu stavaṃ śṛṇu mahāmate | sarvasiddhikaraṃ bhūmau cāturvargyaphalapradam || 2 || kṛṣṇavāmāṃsabhūtāyai kṛṣṇāyai satataṃ namaḥ | namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇarūpiṇyai kṛṣṇe tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ || 3 || yaḥ pāpapaṃkāṃbukalaṃkakutsitaḥ kāmī kudhīḥ satsu kaliṃ karoti hi | vṛndāvanaṃ dhāma dadāti tasmai nadanmilindādi kalindanandinī || 4 || kṛṣṇe sākṣātkṛṣṇarūpā tvameva vegāvarte vartase matsyarūpī | ūrmāvūrmau kūrmarūpī sadā te biṃdau biṃdau bhāti govindadevaḥ || 5 || vande līlāvatīṃ tvāṃ saganaghananibhāṃ kṛṣṇavāmāṃsabhūtāṃ | vegaṃ vai vairajākhyaṃ sakalajalacayaṃ khaṇḍayaṃtīṃ balātsvāt | chitvā brahmāṇḍamārāt suranagaranagān gaṇḍaśailādidurgān | bhitvā bhūkhaṇḍamadhye taṭanidhṛtavatīmūrmimālāṃ prayāntīm || 6 || divyaṃ kau nāmadheyaṃ śrutamatha yamune daṇḍayatyadritulyaṃ | pāpavyūhaṃ tvakhaṇḍaṃ vasatu mama girāṃ maṇḍale tu kṣaṇaṃ tat | daṇḍyāṃścākāryadaṇḍyā sakṛdapi vacasā khaṇḍitaṃ yadgṛhītaṃ | bhrāturmārtaṃḍasūnoraṭati puri dṛḍhaḥ te pracaṇḍo'tidaṇḍaḥ || 7 || rajjurvā viṣayāṃdhakūpataraṇe pāpākhudarvīkarī | veṇyuṣṇik ca virājamūrtiśiraso mālā'sti vā sundarī | dhanyaṃ bhāgyamataḥ paraṃ bhuvi nṛṇāṃ yatrādikṛdvallabhā | goloke'pyatidurlabhā'tiśubhagā bhātyadvitīyā nadī || 8 || gopīgokulagopakelikalite kālindi kṛṣṇaprabhe | tvatkūle jalalolagolavicalat kallolakolāhalaḥ | tvatkāṃtārakutūhalālikulakṛt jhaṃkārakekākulaḥ | kūjatkokilasaṃkulo vrajalatā laṃkārabhṛtpātu mām || 9 || bhavaṃti jihvāstanuromatulyā giro yadā bhūsikatā ivāśu | tadapyalaṃ yānti na te guṇāṃtaṃ saṃto mahāṃtaḥ kila śeṣatulyāḥ || 10 || kalindagirinandinīstava uṣasyayaṃ vāparaḥ śrutaśca yadi pāṭhito bhuvi tanoti sanmaṃgalam | jano'pi yadi dhārayetkila paṭhecca yo nityaśaḥ sa yāti paramaṃ padaṃ nijanikuñjalīlāvṛtam || 11 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīsaubharimāṃdhātṛsaṃvāde śrīyamunāstavo nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.18> māṃdhātovāca kṛṣṇāyāḥ paṭalaṃ puṇyaṃ kāmadaṃ paddhatiṃ tathā | vada māṃ muniśārdūla tvaṃ sākṣāt jñānaśevadhiḥ || 1 || saubhariruvāca paṭalaṃ paddhatiṃ vakṣye yamunāyā mahāmate | kṛtvā śrutvā'tha japtvā vā jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ || 2 || praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya māyābījaṃ tataḥ param | ramābījaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kāmabījaṃ vidhānataḥ || 3 || kālindīti caturthyaṃte devīpadamataḥ param | namaḥ paścātsaṃvidhārya japenmantramimaṃ naraḥ || 4 || japtvaikādaśalakṣāṇi maṃtrasiddhirbhavedbhuvi | janaiḥ prārthyāśca ye kāmāḥ sarve prāpyāḥ svataśca te || 5 || vidhāya ṣoḍaśadalaṃ padmaṃ siṃhāsane śubhe | karṇikāyāṃ ca kāliṃdīṃ nyasecchrīkṛṣṇasaṃyutām || 6 || jāhnavīṃ virajāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ candrabhāgāṃ sarasvatīm | gomatīṃ kauśikīṃ veṇīṃ siṃdhuṃ godāvarīṃ tathā || 7 || vedasmṛtiṃ vetravatīṃ śatadruṃ sarayūṃ tathā | pūjayen mānavaśreṣṭha ṛṣikulyāṃ kakudminīm || 8 || pṛthakpṛthak taddaleṣu nāmoccārya vidhānataḥ | vṛndāvanaṃ govarddhanaṃ vṛndāṃ ca tulasīṃ tathā | caturdikṣu vidhāyāśu pūjayennāmabhiḥ pṛthak || 9 || oṃnamo bhagavatyai kalindanandinyai sūryakanyakāyai yamabhaginyai śrīkṛṣṇapriyāyai yūthībhūtāyai svāhā | anena maṃtreṇa āvāhanādi ṣoḍaśopacārān samāhita upāharet || 10 || ityeva paṭalaṃ viddhi tubhyaṃ vakṣyāmi paddhatim | yāvatsaṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti puraścaraṇameva hi || 11 || tāvad bhaved brahmacārī japenmaunavratī dvijaḥ | yavabhojī bhūmiśāyī patrabhug jitamānasaḥ || 12 || kāmaṃ krodhaṃ tathā lobhaṃ mohaṃ dveṣaṃ visṛjya saḥ | bhaktyā paramayā rājan vartamānastu deśakaḥ || 13 || brāhme muhūrte utthāya dhyātvā devīṃ kaliṃdajām | aruṇodayavelāyāṃ nadyāṃ snānaṃ samācaret || 14 || mādhyāhne cāpi saṃdhyāyāṃ saṃdhyāvandanatatparaḥ | saptame niyame rājan kālindītīramāsthitaḥ || 15 || daśalakṣaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ saputrāṇāṃ mahātmanām | pūjayitvā gandhapuṣpairdatvā tebhyaḥ subhojanam || 16 || vastrabhūṣaṇasauvarṇapātrāṇi prasphuraṃti ca | dakṣiṇāśca śubhā dadyāttataḥ siddhirbhavet khalu || 17 || iti te paddhatiḥ proktā mayā rājan mahamate | kuru tvaṃ niyamaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 18 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīsaubharimāṃdhātṛsaṃvāde paṭalapaddhativarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.19> māndhātovāca nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ kṛṣṇāyāḥ sarvasiddhikaraṃ param | vada māṃ muniśārdūla tvaṃ sarvajño nirāmayaḥ || 1 || saubhariruvāca nāmnā sahasraṃ kāliṃdyā māndhātaste vadāmyaham | sarvasiddhikaraṃ divyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavaśakārakam || 2 || oṃasya śrīkālindīsahasranāmastotramaṃtrasya saubhariṛṣiḥ śrīyamunā devatāḥ anuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ māyābījamiti kīlakam ramābījamiti śaktiḥ śrīkaliṃdanandinī prasādasiddhyarthe jape viniyogaḥ | atha dhyānam | śyāmāmaṃbhojanetrāṃ saghanaghanaruciṃ ratnamañjīrakūjat kāñjīkeyurayuktāṃ kanakamaṇīmaye bibhratīṃ kuṇḍale dve | bhrājacchrīnīlavastra sphuradamalacaladdhārabhārāṃ manojñāṃ dhyāyenmārtaṃḍaputrīṃ tanukiraṇacayoddīptapābhirāmām || 3 || iti dhyānam | oṃkālindī yamunā kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇarūpā sanātanī | kṛṣṇavāmāṃsasaṃbhūtā paramānadarupiṇī || 4 || golokavāsinī śyāmā vṛndāvanavinodinī | rādhāsakhī rāsalīlā rāsamaṃḍalamaṃḍanī || 5 || nikuñjamādhavīvallī raṃgavallī manoharā | śrīrāsamaṇḍalībhūtā yūthībhūtā haripriyā || 6 || golokataṭinī divyā nikuñjatalavāsinī | dīrghormivega gaṃbhīrā puṣpapallavavāhinī || 7 || ghanaśyāmā meghamālā balākā padmamālinī | paripūrṇatamā pūrṇā pūrṇabrahmapriyā parā || 8 || mahāvegavatī sākṣānnikuñjadvāranirgatā | mahānadī maṃdagatirvirajā vegabhedanī || 9 || anekabrahmāṃḍagatā brahmadravasamākulā | gaṃgāmiśrā nirjalābhā nirmalā saritāṃ varā || 10 || ratnabaddhobhayataṭī haṃsapadmādisaṃkulā | nadī nirmalapānīyā sarvabrahmāṃḍapāvanī || 11 || vaikuṇṭhaparikhībhūtā parikhā pāpahāriṇī | brahmalokagatā brāhmī svargā svarganivāsinī || 12 || ullasantī protpataṃtī merumālā mahojjvalā | śrīgaṃgāṃbhaḥśikhariṇī gaṃḍaśailavibhedinī || 13 || deśānpunantī gacchantī vahaṃtī bhūmimadhyagā | mārtaṇḍatanujā puṇyā kalindagirinandinī || 14 || yamasvasā mandahāsā sudvijā racitāmbarā | nīlāṃbarā padmamukhī caraṃtī cārudarśanā || 15 || raṃbhorūḥ padmanayanā mādhavī pramadottamā | tapaścaraṃtī suśroṇī kūjannūpuramekhalā || 16 || jalasthitā śyāmalāṃgī khāṇḍavābhā vihāriṇī | gāṃḍīvibhāṣiṇī vanyā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ varamicchatī || 17 || dvārakāgamanā rājñī paṭṭarājñī paraṃgatā | mahārājñī ratnabhūṣā gomatītīracāriṇī || 18 || svakīyā ca sukhā svārthā svabhaktakāryasādhinī | navalāṅgābalā mugdhā varāṃgā vāmalocanā || 19 || ajñātayauvanā dīnā prabhākāntirdyutiśchaviḥ | suśobhā paramā kīrtiḥ kuśalā'jñātayauvanā || 20 || navoḍhā madhyagā madhyā prauḍhiḥ prauḍhā pragalbhakā | dhīrā'dhīrā dhairyadharā jeṣṭhā śreṣṭhā kulāṃganā || 21 || kṣaṇaprabhā cañcalārcā vidyutsaudāminī taḍit | svādhīnapatikā lakṣmīḥ puṣṭā svādhīnabhartṛkā || 22 || kalahāntaritā bhīruricchāprotkaṇṭhitākulā | kaśipusthā divyaśayyā goviṃdahṛtamānasā || 23 || khaṃḍitākhaṇḍaśobhāḍhyā vipralabdhābhisārikā | virahārtā virahiṇī nārī proṣitabhartṛkā || 24 || māninī mānadā prājñā mandāravanavāsinī | jhaṃkāriṇī jhaṇatkārī raṇanmañjīranūpurā || 25 || mekhalā'mekhalā kāñcī kāñcīnī kāñcanāmayī | kaṃcukī kaṃcukamaṇiḥ śrīkaṇṭhāḍhyā mahāmaṇiḥ || 26 || śrīhāriṇī padmahārā muktā muktaphalārcitā | ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūrā sphuradaṃgulibhūṣaṇā || 27 || darpaṇā darpaṇībhūtā duṣṭadarpavināśinī | kaṃbugrīvā kaṃbudharā graiveyakavirājitā || 28 || tāṭaṃkinī daṃtadharā hemakuṇḍalamaṇḍitā | śikhābhūṣā bhālapuṣpā nāsāmauktikaśobhitā || 29 || maṇibhūmigatā devī raivatādrivihāriṇī | vṛndāvanagatā vṛndā vṛndāraṇyanivāsinī || 30 || vṛndāvanalatā mādhvī vṛndāraṇyavibhūṣaṇā | sauṃdaryalaharī lakṣmīrmathurātīrthavāsinī || 31 || viśrāṃtavāsinī kāmyā ramyā gokulavāsinī | ramaṇasthalaśobhāḍhyā mahāvanamahānadī || 32 || praṇatā pronnatā puṣṭā bhāratī bharatārcitā | tīrtharājagatirgotrā gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgamā || 33 || saptābdhibhedinī lolā saptadvīpagatā balāt | luṭhantī śailān bhidyaṃtī sphuraṃtī vegavattarā || 34 || kāñcanī kañcanībhūmiḥ kāñcanībhūmibhāvitā | lokadṛṣṭirlokalīlā lokālokācalārcitā || 35 || śailodgatā svargagatā svargarcā svargapūjitā | vṛndāvanī vanādhyakṣā rakṣā kakṣā taṭīpaṭī || 36 || asikuṇḍagatā kacchā svacchandocchalitādijā | kuharasthā rathaprasthā prasthā śāṃtatarā''turā || 37 || aṃbucchaṭā śīkarābhā dardurā dārdurīdharā | pāpāṃkuśā pāpasiṃhī pāpadrumakuṭhāriṇī || 38 || puṇyasaṃghā puṇyakīrtiḥ puṇyadā puṇyavarddhinī | madhorvananadī mukhyā atulā tālavanasthitā || 39 || kumudvananadī kubjā kumudāṃbhojavarddhinī | plavarūpā vegavatī siṃhasarpādivāhinī || 40 || bahulī bahudā bahvī bahulā vanavanditā | rādhākuṇḍakalārādhyā kṛṣṇakuṇḍajalāśritā || 41 || lalitākuṇḍagā ghaṃṭā viśākhākuṇḍamaṃḍitā | govindakuṇḍanilayā gopakuṇḍataraṃgiṇī || 42 || śrīgaṃgā mānasī gaṃgā kusumāṃbarabhāvinī | govardhinī godhanāḍhyā mayūrī varavarṇinī || 43 || sārasī nīlakaṃṭhābhā kūjatkokilapotakī | girirājaprasūrbhūrirātapatrā''tapatriṇī || 44 || govardhanāṃkā godaṃtī divyauṣadhinidhiḥ sṛtiḥ | pāradī pāradamayī nāradī śāradī bhṛtiḥ || 45 || śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāṃkasthā kāmā kāmavanāñcitā | kāmāṭavī nandinī ca nandagrāmamahīdharā || 46 || bṛhatsānudyutiḥ protā nandīśvarasamanvitā | kākalī kokilamayī bhāṃḍīrakuśakauśalā || 47 || lohārgalapradā kārā kāśmīravasanāvṛtā | barhiṣadī śoṇapurī śūrakṣetrapurādhikā || 48 || nānā''bharaṇaśobhāḍhyā nānāvarṇasamanvitā | nānānārīkaṃdabāḍhyā raṃgā raṃgamahīruhā || 49 || nānālokagatābhyarciḥ nānājalasamanvitā | strīratnaṃ ratnanilayā lalanāratnarañjinī || 50 || raṃgiṇī raṃgabhūmāḍhyā raṃgā raṃgamahīruhā | rājavidyā rājaguhyā jagatkīrtirghanā'ghanā || 51 ||
