vilolaghaṃṭā kṛṣṇāṃgā kṛṣṇadehasamudbhavā | nīlapaṃkajavarṇābhā nīlapaṃkajahāriṇī || 52 || nilābhā nīlapadmāḍhyā nīlāṃbhoruhavāsinī | nāgavallī nāgapurī nāgavallīdalārcitā || 53 || tāmbūlacarcitā carcā makarandamanoharā | sakesarā kesariṇī keśapāśābhiśobhitā || 54 || kajjalābhā kajjalāktā kajjalī kalitāñjanā | alaktacaraṇā tāmrā lālā tāmrīkṛtāṃbarā || 55 || sindūritā'liptavāṇī suśrīḥ śrīkhaṃḍamaṃḍitā | pāṭīrapaṃkavasanā jaṭāmāṃsīrucāmbarā || 56 || āgaryyagurugandhāktā tagarāśritamārutā | sugandhitailarucirā kuntalāliḥ sakuntalā || 57 || śakuntalā'pāṃsulā ca pātivratyaparāyaṇā | sūryaprabhā sūryakanyā sūryadehasamudbhavā || 58 || koṭisūryapratīkāśā sūryajā sūryanandinī | saṃjñā saṃjñāsutā svecchā saṃjñāmodapradāyinī || 59 || saṃjñāputrī sphuracchāyā tapatī tāpakāriṇī | sāvarṇyānubhavā vedī vaḍavā saukhyadāyinī || 60 || śanaiścarānujā kīlā candravaṃśavivarddhinī | candravaṃśavadhūścadrā candrāvalisahāyinī || 61 || candrāvatī candralekhā candrakāṃtānugāṃśukā | bhairavī piṃgalāśaṃkī līlāvatyāgarīmayī || 62 || dhanaśrīrdevagāndhārī svarmaṇirguṇavarddhinī | vrajamallā bandhakārī vicitrā jayakāriṇī || 63 || gāndhārī mañjarī ṭoḍī gurjjaryyāsāvarī jayā | karṇāṭī rāgiṇī gaurī vairāṭī gauravāṭikā || 64 || catuścandrā kalā herī tailaṃgī vijayāvatī | tālī talasvarā gānā kriyāmātraprakāśinī || 65 || vaiśākhī cācalā cārurmācārī ghūghaṭī ghaṭā | vaihāgarī soraṭhīśā kaidārī jaladhārikā || 66 || kāmākaraśrīḥ kalyāṇī gauḍakalyāṇamiśritā | rājasaṃjīvinī helā mandārī kāmarūpiṇī || 67 || sāraṃgī mārutī hoḍhā sāgarī kāmavādinī | vaibhāsī maṃgalā cāndrī rāsamaṃḍalamaṃḍanā || 68 || kāmadhenuḥ kāmalatā kāmadā kamanīyakā | kalpavṛkṣasthalī sthūlā sudhāsaudhanivāsinī || 69 || golokavāsinī subhrūḥ yaṣṭibhṛddvārapālikā | śṛṅgāraprakarā śṛṅgā svacchā śayyopakārikā || 70 || pārṣadā susakhīsevyā śrīvṛndāvanapālikā | nikuñabhṛtkuṃjapuñjā guñjābharaṇabhūṣitā || 71 || nikuñjavāsinī proṣyā govardhanataṭībhavā | viśākhā lalitā rāmā nīrujā madhumādhavī || 72 || ekā naikasakhī śuklā sakhīmadhyā mahāmanāḥ | śrutirūpā ṛṣirūpā maithilāḥ kauśalāḥ striyaḥ || 73 || ayodhyāpuravāsinyo yajñasītāḥ puliṃdakāḥ | ramāvaikuṇṭhavāsinyaḥ śvetadvīpasakhījanāḥ || 74 || ūrdhvavaikuṇṭhavāsinyo dvivyā'jitapadāśritāḥ | śrīlokacalavāsinyaḥ śrīsakhyaḥ sāgarodbhavāḥ || 75 || divyā adivyā divyāṃgā vyāptāstriguṇavṛttayaḥ | bhūmigopyo devanāryo latā oṣadhivīrūdhaḥ || 76 || jālaṃdharyyaḥ sindhusutāḥ pṛthubarhiṣmatībhavāḥ | divyāṃbarā apsarasaḥ sautalā nāgakanyakāḥ || 77 || paraṃ dhāma paraṃ brahma pauruṣā prakṛtiḥ parā | taṭasthā guṇabhūrgītā guṇāguṇamayī guṇā || 78 || cidghanā sadasanmālā dṛṣṭirdṛśyā guṇākarī | mahattatvamahaṃkāro mano buddhiḥ pracetanā || 79 || ceto vṛttiḥ svāṃtarātmā caturthī caturakṣarā | caturvyūhā caturmūrtiḥ vyomavāyurado jalam || 80 || mahī śabdo raso gandhaḥ sparśo rūpamanekadhā | karmendriyaṃ karmamayī jñānaṃ jñānendriyaṃ dvidhā || 81 || tridhādhibhūtamadhyātmamadhidaivamadhisthitam | jñānaśaktiḥ kriyāśaktiḥ sarvadevādhidevatā || 82 || tatvasaṃghā virāṇmūrtiḥ dhāraṇā dhāraṇāmayī | śrutiḥ smṛtirvedamūrtiḥ saṃhitā gargasaṃhitā || 83 || pārāśarī saiva sṛṣṭiḥ pārahaṃsī vidhātṛkā | yājñavalkī bhāgavatī śrīmadbhāgavatārcitā || 84 || rāmāyaṇamayī ramyā purāṇapuruṣapriyā | purāṇamūrtiḥ puṇyāṃgā śāstramūrtirmahonnatā || 85 || manīṣā dhiṣaṇā buddhirvāṇī dhīḥ śemuṣī matiḥ | gāyatrī vedasāvitrī brahmāṇī brahmalakṣaṇā || 86 || durgā'parṇā satī satyā pārvatī caṃḍikāṃbikā | āryā dākṣāyaṇī dākṣī dakṣayajñavighātinī || 87 || pulojamā śacīndrāṇī devī devavarārpitā | vāyunā dhāriṇī dhanyā vāyavī vāyuvegagā || 88 || yamānujā saṃyamanī saṃjñā chāyā sphuraddyutiḥ | ratnadevī ratnavṛndā tārā taraṇimaṇḍalā || 89 || ruciḥ śāntiḥ kṣamā śobhā dayā dakṣā dyutistrapā | talatuṣṭirvibhā puṣṭiḥ santuṣṭiḥ puṣṭabhāvanā || 90 || caturbhujā cārunetrā dvibhujā'ṣṭabhujā'balā | śaṃkhahastā padmahastā cakrahastā gadādharā || 91 || niṣaṃgadhāriṇī carmakhaḍgapāṇirdhanurddharā | dhanuṣṭaṃkāraṇī yodhrī daityodbhaṭavināśinī || 92 || rathasthā garuḍārūḍhā śrīkṛṣṇahṛdayasthitā | vaṃśīdharā kṛṣṇaveṣā sragviṇī vanamālinī || 93 || kirīṭadhāriṇī yānā mandamandagatirgatiḥ | candrakoṭipratīkāśā tanvī komalavigrahā || 94 || bhaiṣmī bhīṣmasutā bhīmā rukmiṇī rūkmarūpiṇī | satyabhāmā jāṃbavatī satyā bhadrā sudakṣiṇā || 95 || mitravindā sakhīvṛndā vṛndāraṇyadhvajordhvagā | śṛṅgārakāriṇī śṛṅgā śṛṅgabhūḥ śṛṅgadā khagā || 96 || titikṣekṣā smṛtiḥspardhā spṛhā śraddhā svanirvṛtiḥ | īśā tṛṣṇā bhidā prītiḥ hiṃsāyācñāklamā kṛṣiḥ || 97 || āśā nidrā yoganidrā yoginī yogadā'yugā | niṣṭhā pratiṣṭhā śamitiḥ satvaprakṛtiruttamā || 98 || tamaḥprakṛtidurmarṣī rajaḥprakṛtirānatiḥ | kriyā'kriyā kṛtirglāniḥ sātvikyādhyātmikī vṛṣā || 99 || sevāśikhāmaṇirvṛddhirāhūtiḥ piṃgalodbhavā | nāgabhāṣā nāgabhūṣā nāgarī nagarī nagā || 100 || naurnauṃkā bhavanaurbhāvyā bhavasāgarasetukā | manomayī dārumayī saikatī sikatāmayī || 101 || lekhyā lepyā maṇimayī pratihemavinirmitā | śailī śailabhavā śīlā śīkarābhā calā'calā || 102 || asthitā susthitā tūlī vaidakī tāṃtrikī vidhiḥ | saṃdhyā saṃdhyābhravasanā vedasaṃdhiḥ sudhāmayī || 103 || sāyaṃtanī śikhā vedhyā sūkṣmā jīvakalākṛtiḥ | ātmabhūtā bhāvitā'ṇvī prahvī kamalakarṇikā || 104 || nīrājanī mahāvidyā kaṃdalī kāryasādhanī | pūjā pratiṣṭhā vipulā punaṃtī pāralaukikī || 105 || śuklaśuktirmauktikī ca pratītiḥ parameśvarī | virajoṣṇigvirāḍveṇī veṇukā veṇunādinī || 106 || āvartinī vārtikadā vārtā vṛttirvimānagā | rāsāḍhyā rāsinī rāsā rāsamaṇḍalavartinī || 107 || gopagopīśvarī gopī gopīgopālavanditā | gocāriṇī gopanadī gopānandapradāyinī || 108 || paśavyadā gopasevyā koṭiśo gogaṇāvṛtā | gopānugā gopavatī govindapadapādukā || 109 || vṛṣabhānusutā rādhā śrīkṛṣṇavaśakāriṇī | kṛṣṇaprāṇādhikā śaśvadrasikā rasikeśvarī || 110 || avaṭodā tāmraparṇī kṛtamālā vihāyasī | kṛṣṇā veṇī bhīmarathī tāpī revā mahāpagā || 111 || vaiyāsakī ca kāverī tuṃgabhadrā sarasvatī | candrabhāgā vetravatī ṛṣikulyā kakudminī || 112 || gautamī kauśikī sindhuḥ bāṇagaṃgā'tisiddhidā | godāvarī ratnamālā gaṃgā mandākinī balā || 113 || svarṇadī jāhnavī velā vaiṣṇavī maṃgalālayā | bālā viṣṇupadī proktā sindhusāgarasaṃgatā || 114 || gaṃgāsāgaraśobhāḍhyā sāmudrī ratnadā dhunī | bhāgīrathī svardhunī bhūḥ śrīvāmanapadacyutā || 115 || lakṣmī ramā ramaṇīyā bhārgavī viṣṇuvallabhā | sītā'rcirjānakī mātā kalaṃkarahitā kalā || 116 || kṛṣṇapādābjasaṃbhūtā sarvā tripathagāminī | dharā viśvaṃbharā'nantā bhūmirdhātrī kṣamāmayī || 117 || sthirā dharitrī dharaṇī urvī śeṣaphaṇasthitā | ayodhyā rāghavapurī kauśikī raghuvaṃśajā || 118 || mathurā māthurī paṃthā yādavī dhruvapūjitā | mayāyurbilvanīlodā gaṃgādvāravinirgatā || 119 || kuśāvartamayī dhrauvyā dhruvamaṇḍalamadhyagā | kāśī śivapurī śeṣā viṃdhyā vārāṇasī śivā || 120 || avaṃtikā devapurī projjvalojjayinī jitā | dvārāvatī dvārakāmā kuśabhūtā kuśasthalī || 121 || mahāpurī saptapurī nandigrāmasthalasthitā | śālagrāmaśilādityā śaṃbhalagrāmamadhyagā || 122 || vaṃśagopālinī kṣiptā harimandiravartinī | barhiṣmatī hastipurī śakraprasthanivāsinī || 123 || dāḍimī saiṃdhavī jaṃbūḥ pauṣkarī puṣkaraprasūḥ | utpalāvartagamanā naimiṣī naimiṣāvṛtā || 124 || kurujāṃgalabhūḥ kālī haimavatyarbudī budhā | śūkarakṣetraviditā śvetavārāhadhāritā || 125 || sarvatīrthamayī tīrthā tīrthānāṃ tīrthakāriṇī | hāriṇī sarvadoṣāṇāṃ dāyinī sarvasampadām || 126 || varddhinī tejasāṃ sākṣādgarbhavāsanikṛṃtanī | golokadhāmadhaninī nikuñjanijamaṃjarī || 127 || sarvottamā sarvapuṇyā sarvasauṃdaryaśṛṅkhalā | sarvatīrthoparigatā sarvatīrthādhidevatā || 128 || śrīdā śrīśā śrīnivāsā śrīnidhiḥ śrīvibhāvanā | svakṣā svaṃgā śatānaṃdā nandā jyotirgaṇeśvarī || 129 || nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ kāliṃdyāḥ kīrtidaṃ kāmadaṃ param | mahāpāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ āyurvarddhanamuttamam || 130 || ekavāraṃ paṭhedrātrau caurebhyo na bhayaṃ bhavet | dvivāraṃ prapaṭhenmārge dasyubhyo na bhayaṃ kvacit || 131 || dvitīyāṃ tu samārabhya paṭhetpūrṇāvadhiṃ dvijaḥ | daśavāramidaṃ bhaktyā dhyātvā devīṃ kaliṃdajām || 132 || rogī rogātpramucyeta baddho mucyeta bandhanāt | gurviṇī janayetputraṃ vidyārthī paṃḍito bhavet || 133 || mohanaṃ staṃbhanaṃ śaśvadvaśīkaraṇameva ca | uccāṭanaṃ ghātanaṃ ca śoṣaṇaṃ dīpanaṃ tathā || 134 || unmādanaṃ tāpanaṃ ca nidhidarśanameva ca | yadyadvāṃcchati cittena tattatprāpnoti mānavaḥ || 135 || brāhmaṇo brahmavarcasvī rājanyo jagatīpatiḥ | vaiśyo nidhipatirbhūyācchūdraḥ śrutvā tu nirmalaḥ || 136 || pūjākāle tu yo nityaṃ paṭhate bhaktibhāvataḥ | lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāṃbhasā || 137 || śatavāraṃ paṭhennityaṃ varṣāvadhimataḥ param | paṭalaṃ paddhatiṃ kṛtvā stavaṃ ca kavacaṃ tathā || 138 || saptadvīpamahīrājyaṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 139 || niṣkāraṇaṃ paṭhedyastu yamunābhaktisaṃyutaḥ | traivargyametya sukṛtī jīvanmukto bhavediha || 140 || nikuṃjalīlālalitaṃ manoharaṃ kaliṃdajākūlalatākadambakam | vṛndāvanonmattamiliṃdaśabditaṃ vrajetsa golokamidaṃ paṭhecca yaḥ || 141 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīsaubharimāṃdhātṛsaṃvāde śrīyamunāsahasranāmakathanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.20> śrīnārada uvāca iti kṛṣṇastavaṃ śrutvā māndhātā nṛpasattamaḥ | ayodhyāṃ prayayau vīro natvā śrīsaubhariṃ munim || 1 || idaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ gopīnāṃ caritaṃ śubham | mahāpāpahararaṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 2 || bahulāśva uvāca śrutaṃ tava mukhādbrahman gopīnāṃ varṇanaṃ param | yamunāyāśca paṃcāṃgaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 3 || śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sabalaḥ sākṣādgolokādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ | agre cakāra kaṃ līlāṃ lalitāṃ vrajamaṃḍale || 4 || śrīnārada uvāca ekadā cārayangāḥ svāḥ sabalo gopabālakaiḥ | bhāṃḍīre yamunātīre bālalīlāṃ cakāra ha || 5 || vihāraṃ kārayan bālaiḥ vāhyavāhakalakṣaṇam | vijahāra vane kṛṣṇo darśayangā manoharāḥ || 6 || tatrāgato goparūpī pralaṃbaḥ kaṃsanoditaḥ | na jñāto bālakaiḥ sopi hariṇā vidito'bhavat || 7 || vihāre vijayaṃ rāmaṃ netuṃ ko'pi na manyate | ūvāha taṃ pralaṃbo'sau bhāṃḍīrādyamunātaṭam || 8 || avaroharaṇato daityo mathurāṃ gaṃtumudyataḥ | dadhāra ghanavadrūpaṃ girīndra iva durgamaḥ || 9 || babhau balo daityapṛṣṭhe sundaro lolakuṇḍalaḥ | ākāśasthaḥ pūrṇacandraḥ sataḍijjalado yathā || 10 || daityaṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ vīkṣya baladevo mahābalaḥ | ruṣā'hananmuṣṭinā taṃ śirasyadriṃ yathā'dribhit || 11 || viśīrṇamastako daityo yathā vajrahato giriḥ | papāta bhūmau sahasā cālayan vasudhātalam || 12 || tajjyotirnirgataṃ dīrghaṃ bale līnaṃ babhūva ha | tadaiva vavṛṣurdevāḥ puṣpairnandanasaṃbhavaiḥ || 13 || abhūjjaya jayārāvo divī bhūmau nṛpeśvara | evaṃ śrībaladevasya caritaṃ paramādbhutam | mayā te kathitaṃ rājan kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 14 || bahulāśva uvāca ko'yaṃ daityaḥ pūrvakāle pralaṃbo raṇadurmadaḥ | baladevasya hastena muktiṃ prāpa kathaṃ mune || 15 || śrīnārada uvāca śivasya pūjanārthaṃ hi yakṣarāṭ svavane śubhe | kārayāmāsa puṣpāṇāṃ rakṣāṃ yakṣairitastataḥ || 16 || tadapyasyāpi jagṛhuḥ puṣpāṇi prasphuraṃti ca | tataḥ kruddho dadau śāpaṃ yakṣarāḍ dhanado balī || 17 || ye gṛhṇaṃtyasya puṣpāṇi sve cānye suramānavāḥ | bhavitāro'surāḥ sarve macchāpāt sahasā bhuvi || 18 || hūhūsuto'tha vijayo vicaran tīrthabhūmiṣu | vanaṃ caitrarathaṃ prāpto gāyan viṣṇuguṇānpathi || 19 || vīṇāpāṇirajānanvai gandharvaḥ sumanāṃsi ca | gṛhītvā so'suro jāto gandharvatvaṃ vihāya tat || 20 || tadaiva śaraṇaṃ prāptaḥ kuberasya mahātmanaḥ | natvā tatprārthanāṃ cakre kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ śanaiḥ || 21 || tasmai prasanno rājendra kubero'pi varaṃ dadau | tvaṃ viṣṇubhaktaḥ śāṃtātmā mā śokaṃ kuru mānada || 22 || dvāparāṃte ca te muktiḥ baladevasya hastataḥ | bhaviṣyati na sandeho bhāṃḍīre yamunātaṭe || 23 || śrīnārada uvāca hūhūsutaḥ sa gandharvaḥ pralaṃbo'bhūnmahāsuraḥ | kuberasya varādrājan paraṃ mokṣaṃ jagāma ha || 24 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde pralambavadho nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.21> śrīnārada uvāca atha krīḍāprasakteṣu gopeṣu sabaleṣu ca | tṛṇalobhena viviśurgāvaḥ sarvā mahadvanam || 1 || tā ānetuṃ gopabālāḥ prāptā muṃjāṭavīṃ parām | saṃbhūtastatra dāvāgniḥ pralayāgnisamo mahān || 2 || gobhirgopāḥ sametāste śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sabalaṃ harim | vadantaḥ pāhi pāhīti bhayārtāḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 3 || vīkṣya vahnibhayaṃ svānāṃ kṛṣṇo yogeśvareśvaraḥ | nyamīlayata mā bhaiṣṭa locanānītyabhāṣata || 4 || tathābhūteṣu gopeṣu tamagniṃ bhayakārakam | apibadbhagavāndevo devānāṃ paśyatāṃ nṛpa || 5 || evaṃ pītvā mahāvahniṃ nītvā gopālagogaṇam | prāpto'bhūt yamunāpāre śubhāśokavane hariḥ || 6 || tatra kṣutpīḍitā gopāḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sabalaṃ harim | kṛtāṃjalipuṭā ūcuḥ kṣudhārtāḥ smo vayaṃ prabho || 7 || tadā tānpreṣayāmāsa yajña āṃgirase hariḥ | te gatvā taṃ yajñavaraṃ natvocurvimalaṃ vaca || 8 || gopā ūcuḥ gopālabālaiḥ sabalaḥ samāgato gāścārayan śrīvrajarājanandanaḥ | kṣutsaṃyuto'smai sagaṇāya bhūsurāḥ prayacchatāśvannamanaṃgamohine || 9 || śrīnārada uvāca na kiṃcidūcuste sarve vacaḥ śrutvā dvijā nṛpa | gopā nirāśā āgatya ityūcuḥ sabalaṃ harim || 10 || gopā ūcuḥ tvamasyadhīśo vrajamaṃḍale balī śrīgokule nandapuro'gradaṇḍadhṛk | na vartate daṇḍamalaṃ madhoḥ puri pracaṃḍacaṃḍāṃśumahastava sphurat || 11 || śrīnārada uvāca punastān preṣayāmāsa tatpatnībhyo hariḥ svayam | yajñavāṭaṃ punargatvā natvā viprapriyāstadā | kṛtāṃjalipuṭā ūcurgopāḥ kṛṣṇapraṇoditāḥ || 12 || gopā ūcuḥ gopālabālaiḥ sabalaḥ samāgato gāścārayan śrīvrajarājanandanaḥ | kṣutsaṃyuto'smai sagaṇāya cāṃganāḥ prayacchatāśvannamanaṃgamohine || 13 || śrīnārada uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ samāgataṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ | cakrustathā'nnaṃ pātreṣu nītvā sarvā dvijāṃganāḥ || 14 || tyaktvā sadyo lokalajjāṃ kṛṣṇapārśvaṃ samāyayuḥ | aśokānāṃ vane ramye kṛṣṇātīre manohare || 15 || yathā śrutaṃ tathā dṛṣṭaṃ śrīharerrūpamadbhutam | prāpyānaṃdaṃ gatāḥ sarvāsturīyaṃ yogino yathā || 16 || śrībhagavānuvāca dhanyā yūyaṃ daśanārthamāgatā he dvijāṃganāḥ | pratiyāta gṛhāñchīghraṃ niḥśaṃkā bhūmidevatāḥ || 17 || yuṣmākaṃ tu prabhāveṇa patayo vo dvijātayaḥ | sadyo yajñaphalaṃ prāpya yuṣmābhiḥ saha nirmalāḥ || 18 || gamiṣyaṃti paraṃ dhāma golokaṃ prakṛteḥ param | atha natvā hariṃ sarvā ājagmuryajñamaṇḍale || 19 || śrīnārada uvāca tā dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇāḥ sarve svātmānaṃ dhik pracakrire | didṛkṣavaste śrīkṛṣṇaṃ kaṃsādbhītā na cāgatāḥ || 20 || bhuktvā'nnaṃ sabalaḥ kṛṣṇo gopālaiḥ saha maithila | gāḥ pālayannājagāma vṛndāraṇyaṃ manoharam || 21 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde dāvāgnimokṣa viprapatnīdarśanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.22> śrīnārada uvāca ekadā naṃdarājo'sau kṛtvā caikādaśīvratam | dvādaśyāṃ yamunāṃ snātuṃ gopālairjalamāviśat || 1 || taṃ gṛhītvā pāśibhṛtyaḥ pāśilokaṃ jagāma ha | tadā kolāhale jāte gopānāṃ maithileśvara || 2 || āśvāsya sarvān bhagavān gatavān vāruṇīṃ purīm | bhasmīcakāra sahasā purīdurgaṃ hariḥ svayam || 3 || koṭimārtaṃḍasaṃkāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā prakupitaṃ harim | natvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ pāśī parikramyāha dharṣitaḥ || 4 || varuṇa uvāca namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇacaṃdrāya paripūrṇatamāya ca | asaṃkhyabrahmāṃḍabhṛte golokapataye namaḥ || 5 || caturvyūhāya mahase namaste sarvatejase | namaste sarvabhāvāya parasmai brahmaṇe namaḥ || 6 || kenāpi mūḍhena mamānugena kṛtaṃ paraṃ helanamadya eva | tatkṣamyatāṃ bhoḥ śaraṇaṃ gataṃ māṃ pareśa bhūman paripāhi pāhi || 7 || śrīnārada uvāca iti prasanno bhagavān naṃdaṃ nītvā sujīvitam | saukhyaṃ prakāśayanbaṃdhūn vrajamaṃḍalamāyayau || 8 || nandarājamukhācchrutvā prabhāvaṃ śrīharestu tam | gopīgopagaṇā ūcuḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ nandanaṃdanam || 9 || yadi tvaṃ bhagavānsākṣāllokapālaiḥ supūjitaḥ | darśayāśu paraṃ lokaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ tarhi naḥ prabho || 10 || nītvā sarvān tataḥ kṛṣṇa etya vaikuṇṭhamaṃdiram | darśayāmāsa rūpaṃ svaṃ jyotirmaṃḍalamadhyagam || 11 || sahasrabhūjasaṃyuktaṃ kirīṭakaṭakojjvalam | śaṃkhacakragadāpadmavanamālāvirājitam || 12 || asaṃkhyakoṭimārtaṃḍa saṃkāśaṃ śeṣasaṃsthitam | cāmarāṃdoladivyābhaṃ brahmādyaiḥ parisevitam || 13 || tadaiva tān gopagaṇān pārṣadāste gadādharāḥ | ṛjuṃ kṛtvā natiṃ dhṛtvā dūre sthāpya prayatnataḥ || 14 || cakitāniva tānvīkṣya procuste pārṣadā girā | re re tūṣṇīṃ prabhavata mā vaktavyaṃ vanecarāḥ || 15 || bhāṣaṇaṃ mā prakuruta na dṛṣṭvā kiṃ sabhā hareḥ | vedā vadaṃti cātraiva sākṣāddeve sthite prabhau || 16 || iti śikṣāṃ gatā gopā harṣitā maunamāsthitāḥ | manasyūcurayaṃ kṛṣṇa uccasiṃhāsane sthitaḥ || 17 || asmān dūrādadhaḥkṛtvā 'smābhirvakti na karhicit | tasmādvrajādvaraṃ nāsti kopi loko na saukhyadaḥ || 18 || yatrānena svabhrātrāpi vārtā syāddhi parasparam | itipravadatastānvai nītvā śrībhagavān hariḥ | vrajamāgatavān rājan paripūrṇatamaḥ prabhuḥ || 19 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnārada bahulāśva saṃvāde nandādivaikuṇṭhadarśanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.23> śrīnārada uvāca ekadā nṛpa gopālāḥ śakaṭai ratnapūritaiḥ | vṛṣabhānūpanandādyā ājagmuścāṃbikāvanam || 1 || bhadrakālīṃ paśupatiṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | dadurdānaṃ dvijātibhyaḥ suptāstatra sarittaṭe || 2 || tatraiko nirgato rātrau sarpo nandaṃ pade'grahīt | kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti cukrośa nando'tibhayavihvalaḥ || 3 || tadolmukairgopabālāstodurājagaraṃ nṛpa | padaṃ so'pi na tatyāja sarpo'tha svamaṇiṃ yathā || 4 || tatāḍa svapadā sarpaṃ bhagavān lokapāvanaḥ | tyakttvā tadaiva sarpatvaṃ bhūtvā vidyādharaḥ kṛtī | natvā kṛṣṇaṃ parikramya kṛtāṃjalipuṭo'vadat || 5 || sudarśana uvāca ahaṃ sudarśano nāma vidyādharavaraḥ prabho | aṣṭāvakraṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā hasito'smi mahābalaḥ || 6 || mahyaṃ śāpaṃ dadau so'pi tvaṃ sarpo bhava durmate | tacchāpādadya mukto'ham kṛpayā tava mādhava || 7 || tvatpādapadmamakaraṃdarajaḥkaṇānāṃ sparśena divyapadavīṃ sahasāgato'smi | tasmai namo bhagavate bhuvaneśvarāya yo bhūribhāraharaṇāya bhūvo'vatāraḥ || 8 || śrīnārada uvāca iti natvā hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rājan vidyādharastu saḥ | jagāma vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ sarvopadrava varjitam || 9 || naṃdādyā vismitāḥ sarve jñātvā kṛṣṇaṃ pareśvaram | aṃbikāvanataḥ śīghramāyayurvrajamaṃḍalam || 10 || idaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ śubham | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 11 || bahulāśva uvāca aho śrīkṛṣṇacandrasya caritaṃ paramādbhutam | śrutvā mano me tacchrotumatṛptaṃ punaricchati || 12 || agre cakāra kāṃ līlāṃ līlayā vrajamaṃḍale | harirvrajeśaḥ paramo vada devarṣisattama || 13 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde sudarśanopākhyānaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<4.24> śrīnārada uvāca ekadā śailadeśeṣu sabalo bhagavānhariḥ | kṛtvā nilāyanakrīḍāṃ caurapālakalakṣaṇām || 1 || tatra vyomāsuro daityo bālānmeṣāyitān bahūn | nītvā nītvā'dridaryāṃ ca vinikṣipya punaḥ punaḥ || 2 || śilayā pidadhe dvāraṃ mayaputro mahābalaḥ | satyacauraṃ ca taṃ jñātvā bhagavān madhusūdanaḥ || 3 || gṛhītvā pātayāmāsa bhujābhyāṃ bhūmimaṃḍale || 4 || tadā mṛtyuṃ gato daityastajjyotirnirgataṃ sphurat | daśadikṣu bhramadrājan śrīkṛṣṇe līnatāṃ gatam || 5 || tadā jayajayārāvo divi bhūmau babhūva ha | puṣpāṇi vavṛṣurdevāḥ paramānaṃdasaṃvṛtāḥ || 6 || bahulāśva uvāca ko'yaṃ pūrvaṃ kuśalakṛdvyomo nāmātha tadvada | yena kṛṣṇe ghanaśyāme līno'bhūddāminī yathā || 7 || śrīnārada uvāca āsītkāśyāṃ bhīmaratho rājā dānaparāyaṇaḥ | yajñakṛnmānado dhanvī viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 8 || rājye putraṃ sanniveśya jagāma malayācalam | tapastatra samārebhe varṣāṇāṃ lakṣameva hi || 9 || tasyāśrame pulastyo'sau śiṣyavṛndaiḥ samāgataḥ | taṃ dṛṣṭvā notthito mānī rājarṣirna nato'bhavat || 10 || śāpaṃ dadau pulastyo'pi daityo bhava mahākhala | tatastaccaraṇopāṃte patitaṃ śaraṇāgatam || 11 || uvāca muniśārdūlaḥ pulastyo dīnavatsalaḥ | dvāparānte māthure ca puṇye śrīvrajamaṃḍale || 12 || yaduvaṃśapateḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇasya bhujaujasā | īpsitā yogibhirmuktirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 13 || śrīnārada uvāca so'yaṃ bhīmaratho rājā mayadaityasuto'bhavat | śrīkṛṣṇabhujavegena muktiṃ prāpa videharāṭ || 14 || ekadā gopabāleṣu daityo'riṣṭo mahābalaḥ | āgato nādayan khaṃ gāṃ taṭān śṛṅgairvidārayan || 15 || gopyo gopā gogaṇāśca vīkṣya taṃ dudruvurbhayāt | bhagavān daityahā devo mā bhaiṣṭaityabhayaṃ dadau || 16 || gṛhītvā taṃ tu śṛṅgeṣu nodayāmāsa mādhavaḥ | so'pi taṃ nodayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ yojanadvayam || 17 || pucche gṛhītvā taṃ kṛṣṇo bhrāmayitvā bhujaujasā | bhūpṛṣṭhe pothayāmāsa kamaṇḍalumivārbhakaḥ || 18 || ariṣṭaḥ punarutthāya krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ | śṛṅgaiśca rohitaṃ śailaṃ samutpāṭya mahākhalaḥ || 19 || garjayanghanavadvīraḥ kṛṣṇopari samākṣipat | kṛṣṇaḥ śailaṃ saṃgṛhitvā tasyopari samākṣipat || 20 || śailasyāpi prahāreṇa kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ | bhūmau tatāḍa śṛṅgāgrānnirgataṃ tairjalaṃ bhuvaḥ || 21 || śrīkṛṣṇastaṃ ca śṛṅgeṣu gṛhītvā bhrāmayanmuhuḥ | bhūpṛṣṭhe pothayāmāsa vātaḥ padmamivoddhṛtam || 22 || tadaiva vṛṣarūpatvaṃ tyaktvā vipravapurdharaḥ | natvā śrīkṛṣṇapādābjaṃ prāha gadgadayā girā || 23 || dvija uvāca bṛhaspateśca śiṣyo'haṃ varataṃturdvijottamaḥ | bṛhaspatisamīpe ca paṭhituṃ gatavānaham || 24 || pādau kṛtvā sthito'bhūvaṃ paśyatastasya saṃmukhe | tadā ruṣā''ha sa muniḥ vṛṣavatvaṃ sthitaḥ puraḥ || 25 || guruhelanakṛttasmāttvaṃ bṛṣo bhava durmate | tasya śāpādvṛṣo'bhūvaṃ baṃgadeśeṣu mādhava || 26 || asurāṇāṃ prasaṃgenā suratvaṃ gatavānaham | tvatprasādādvimukto'haṃ śāpato'surabhāvataḥ || 27 || śrīkṛṣṇāya namastubhyaṃ vāsudevāya te namaḥ | praṇatakleśanāśāya goviṃdāya namo namaḥ || 28 || śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā śrīhariṃ natvā sākṣācchiṣyo bṛhaspateḥ | dyotayanbhuvanaṃ rājan vimānena divaṃ yayau || 29 || idaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ khaṇḍaṃ mādhuryyamadbhutam | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ kṛṣṇaprāptikaraṃ param || 30 || kāmadaṃ paṭhatāṃ śaśvatkiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 31 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mādhuryakhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde vyomāsurāriṣṭāsuravadho nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 || hariḥ oṃ tatsacchrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<5.1> śrīnārada uvāca vasudevasutaṃ devaṃ kaṃsacāṇūramardanam | devakīparamānaṃdaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vande jagadgurum || 1 || bahulāśva uvāca mathurāyāṃ kiṃ caritraṃ kṛtavānbhagavānmune | kathaṃ jaghāna kaṃsākhyametanme brūhi tattvataḥ || 2 || śrīnārada uvāca athaikadā'haṃ mathurāṃ purīṃ parāṃ vilokituṃ cāgatavānnṛpeśvara | karttuṃ paraṃ daityavadhodyamaṃ hareḥ parasya sākṣānmanasā praṇoditaḥ || 3 || siṃhāsane ca prahṛte puraṃdarātsitātapatre calacārucāmare | sthitaṃ nṛpaṃ kaṃsamuraṃgaduḥsahaṃ prāvocamevaṃ śṛṇu tatprapūjitaḥ || 4 || yaśodāyāḥ sutā jātā yā tvaddhastāddivaṃ gatā | devakyāṃ kṛṣṇa utpanno rohiṇīnaṃdano balaḥ || 5 || svamitre naṃdarāje ca nyastau putrau bhavadbhayāt | tavārī rāmakṛṣṇau dvau vasudevena daityarāṭ || 6 || pūtanādyā hyariṣṭāṃtā daityā ye tvadbalotkaṭāḥ | yābhyāṃ hatā vanoddeśe te mṛtyū tau smṛtau kila || 7 || evamukto bhojapatiḥ krodhāccalitavigrahaḥ | jagrāha niśitaṃ khaḍgaṃ śauriṃ haṃtuṃ sabhātale || 8 || mayā nivāritaḥ so'pi vistṛtairnigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ | baddhvā taṃ bhāryayā sārddhaṃ kārāgāre rurodha ha || 9 || ityuktvā taṃ mayi gate keśinaṃ daityapuṃgavam | rāmakṛṣṇavadhārthāya preṣayāmāsa daityarāṭ || 10 || cāṇūrādīn samāhūya mahāmātraṃ dvipasya ca | kāryabhārakarām̐llokān prāhedaṃ bhojarāḍ balī || 11 || kaṃsa uvāca he kūṭa he tośalaka he cāṇūra mahābala | rāmakṛṣṇau ca me mṛtyū darśitau nāradena tu || 12 || bhavadbhiriha saṃprāptau hanyetāṃ mallalīlayā | mallabhūmiṃ ca saṃyuktāṃ kurutāśu śubhāvahām || 13 || dvipaṃ kuvalayāpīḍaṃ raṃgadvāri madotkaṭam | prasthāpya tena haṃtavyau mahāmātra mamāhitau || 14 || caturdaśyāṃ tu kartavyo dhanuryāgaḥ praśāntaye | amāvāsyādine lokā mallayuddhaṃ bhavediha || 15 || śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā svajanān kaṃso'krūramāhūya satvaram | rahasi prāha rājeṃdra maṃtraṃ maṃtrijanapriyam || 16 || kaṃsa uvāca bho bho dānapate maṃtrin śrṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ | gaccha naṃdavrajaṃ prātaḥ kuru kāryaṃ mahāmate || 17 || āsāte tatra me śatrū vasudevasutau kila | darśitau nāradenāpi devadevarṣiṇā bhṛśam || 18 || sopāyanairgopagaṇairnandarājādibhiḥ saha | mathurādarśanamiṣādrathenānaya mā ciram || 19 || dvipena vā mahāmallairghātayiṣyāmi tau śiśū | tatpaścānnaṃdarājaṃ ca vasudevasahāyakam || 20 || vṛṣabhānuvaraṃ paścānnavanandopanandakān | paścācchauriṃ haniṣyāmi devakaṃ tatsahāyakam || 21 || ugrasenaṃ ca pitaraṃ vṛddhaṃ rājyasamutsukam | tatpaścādyādavānsarvān haniṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 22 || ete devagaṇāḥ sarve jātā maṃtrin mahītale | śakunirme mahāmitro balī candrāvatīpatiḥ || 23 || bhūtasaṃtāpano hṛṣṭo vṛkaḥ śaṃbara eva ca | kālanābho mahānābho hariśmaśrustathaiva ca || 24 || ete mitrāṇi me saṃti madarthaṃ prāṇadā balāt | śvaśuro'pi jarāsaṃdho dvivido me sakhā smṛtaḥ || 25 || bāṇāsuraśca narako mayyeva kṛtasauhṛdaḥ | ete sarvāṃ mahīṃ jitvā baddhvā devānsavāsavān || 26 || kṣiptvā meruguhādurge kuberaṃ dravyanāyakam | trailokyarājyaṃ tu sadā kariṣyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 27 || kavīnāṃ tvaṃ kaviriva girāṃ gīṣpativadbhuvi | etatkāryaṃ ca kartavyaṃ tvayā dānapate tvaram || 28 || akrūra uvāca tvayā kṛto yadupate manorathamahārṇāvaḥ | daivecchayā'yaṃ bhavati goṣpadaṃ tadvinārṇavaḥ || 29 || kaṃsa uvāca visṛjya daivaṃ kurute baliṣṭho daivaṃ samāśritya hi nirbalaśca | kālātmanornityagayoḥ prabhāvānnirākulastiṣṭhatu karmayogī || 30 || śrīnārada uvāca evamuktvā maṃtrivaraṃ samutthāya sabhāsthalāt | kiṃcitprakupitaḥ kaṃsaḥ śanairaṃtaḥpuraṃ yayau || 31 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mathurākhaṃḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde kaṃsamaṃtro nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
<5.2> śrīnārada uvāca atha keśī mahādaityo hayarūpī madotkaṭaḥ | etya vṛdāvanaṃ ramyaṃ jagarjja ghanavadbalī || 1 || yasya pādapratāḍena nipetuḥ śākhino dṛḍhāḥ | pucchaghātena gagane khaṃḍaṃ khaṃḍaṃ yayurghanāḥ || 2 || taṃ vīkṣya duḥsahajavaṃ gopagopīgaṇā bhṛśam | bhayāturā maithilendra śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ || 3 || mā bhaiṣṭetyabhayaṃ datvā bhagavānvṛjinārdanaḥ | kaṭau pītāṃbaraṃ baddhvā haṃtuṃ daityaṃ pracakrame || 4 || hariṃ paścimapādābhyāṃ saṃtatāḍa mahāsuraḥ | cālayanpṛthivīṃ rājannādayan vyomamaṃḍalam || 5 || gṛhītvā pādayordaityaṃ bhrāmayitvā bhujena khe | cikṣepa yojanaṃ kṛṣṇo vātaḥ padmamivoddhṛtam || 6 || punarāgatavān so'pi krodhapūritavigrahaḥ | pucchena śrīhariṃ devaṃ saṃtatāḍa vrajāṃgaṇe || 7 || pucche gṛhītvā taṃ kṛṣṇo bhrāmayitvā bhujaujasā | yojanānāṃ śataṃ rājan cikṣepa gagane balāt || 8 || ākāśātpatitaḥ so'pi kiṃcidvyāyākulamānasaḥ | samutthāya punardaityo jagarja ghanavadbalī || 9 || saṭā vidhunvan romāṇi bālaṃ khe cālayanmuhuḥ | mahīṃ vidārayanpādairutpapāta hareḥ puraḥ || 10 || tatāḍa muṣṭinā taṃ vai bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ | tasya muṣṭiprahāreṇa mūrchito ghaṭikādvayam || 11 || mastakena galoddeśe samuddhṛtya hariṃ hayaḥ | bhūmaṃḍalādutpapāta gagane lakṣayojanam || 12 || tayoryuddhamabhūt ghoraṃ gagane praharadvayam | padairdadbhiḥ saṭābhiśca pucchatīkṣṇakhurairnṛpa || 13 || gṛhītvā taṃ harirdorbhyāṃ bhrāmayitvā tvitastataḥ | ākaśātpātayāmāsa kamaṃḍalumivārbhakaḥ || 14 || bhujaṃ praveśayāmāsa tanmukhe bhagavān hariḥ | tasyodare gato bāhuḥ vavṛdhe rogavadbhṛśam || 15 || tadā tu leṃḍaṃ kṛtavān ruddhavāyurmahāsuraḥ | khaṃḍībhūtodaraḥ sadyo mamāra hayarūpadhṛk || 16 || dehādvinirgataḥ sadyo mukuṭī kuṃḍalānvitaḥ | divyarūpadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ prāṃjaliḥ praṇanāma ha || 17 || kumuda uvāca śakrasyānucaro'haṃ vai kumudo nāma mādhava | tejasvī rūpavān vīro jiṣṇuśchatrabhramiṃ dadhan || 18 || vṛtrāsuravadhe pūrvaṃ brahmahatyāpraśāṃtaye | yajñaṃ cakrāra nākeśo vājimedhaṃ kratūttamam || 19 || aśvamedhahayaṃ śubhraṃ śyāmakarṇaṃ manojavam | tamārurukṣurduṣṭo'haṃ corayitvā talaṃ gataḥ || 20 || tato marudgaṇairnītaṃ pāśabaddhaṃ mahākhalam | śaśāpa māṃ balārātiḥ tvaṃ rakṣo bhava durmate || 21 || hayākṛtiste saṃbhūyādbhūmau manvaṃtaradvayam | tacchāpādadya mukto'haṃ sadyastvat sparśanātprabho || 22 || kiṃkaraṃ kuru māṃ deva tvadaṃghrau lagnamānasam | namastubhyaṃ bhagavate sarvalokaikasākṣiṇe || 23 || śrīnārada uvāca pradakṣiṇīkṛtya hariṃ pareśvaraṃ vimānamāruhya mahojjvalaṃ param | vaikuṇṭhalokaṃ kumudo yayau tvaraṃ virājayanmaithila maṃḍalaṃ diśām || 24 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mathurākhaṃḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde keśivadho nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||
<5.3> śrīnārada uvāca akrūro rathamāruhya kartuṃ kāryaṃ nṛpasya vai | praharṣito maithilendra prayayau naṃdagokulam || 1 || parāṃ bhaktiṃ hyupagataḥ śrīkṛṣṇe puruṣottame | evaṃ vicārayanbuddhyā pathi gacchanmahāmatiḥ || 2 || akrūra uvāca kiṃ bhārate vā sukṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā niṣkāraṇaṃ dānamalaṃ kratūttamam | tīrthāṭanaṃ vā dvijasevanaṃ śubhaṃ yenādya drakṣyāmi hariṃ pareśvaram || 3 || tapaḥ sutaptaṃ kimalaṃ purā kṛtaṃ satsevanaṃ bhaktiyutaṃ mayā kṛtam | yenaiva me darśanamadya durlabhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadevasya puro bhaviṣyati || 4 || teṣāṃ bhavo vai saphalo mahītale yannetragāmī bhagavānsureśvaraḥ | kṛtvā'tha taddarśanamadya durlabhaṃ sadyaḥ kṛtārtho bhavitā'smi sarvataḥ || 5 || śrīnārada uvāca itthaṃ saṃcitayankṛṣṇaṃ paśyanśakunamuttamam | saṃdhyāyāṃ gokulaṃ prāpto rathastho gāṃdinīsutaḥ || 6 || kṛṣṇapādābjacihnāni yavāṅkuśayutāni ca | tadrāgayukparāgāṇi rajāṃsi sa dadarśa kau || 7 || taddarśannautsukyabhaktibhāvānandasamākulaḥ | rathātsamutpatya teṣu luṭhaṃścāśru mumoca saḥ || 8 || yeṣāṃ śrīkṛṣṇadevasya bhaktiḥ syāddhṛdi maithila | teṣāmābrahmaṇaḥ sarvaṃ tṛṇavajjagataḥ sukham || 9 || rathāruḍhastato'krūraḥ kṣaṇānnandapuraṃ gataḥ | ghoṣeṣu sabalaṃ kṛṣṇamāgacchaṃtaṃ dadarśa ha || 10 || devau purāṇau puruṣau pareśau padmekṣaṇau śyāmalagauravarṇau | yathendranīladhvajavajraśailau samāśritau tau pathi rāmakṛṣṇau || 11 || bālārkamaulī vasanaṃ taḍidyutī varṣāśaranmegharucaṃ dadhānau | dṛṣṭvā sa tūrṇaṃ svarathādgato'dho tayornato bhaktiyutaḥ papāta || 12 || tadānanaṃ bāṣpakalākulekṣaṇaṃ romāṃcitaṃ vīkṣya hariḥ pareśvaraḥ | dorbhyāṃ samutthāpya ghṛṇāturo'śru mumoca bhaktaṃ parirabhya mādhavaḥ || 13 || evaṃ militvā sabalaśca taṃ hariḥ sadyaḥ samānīya varāsanaṃ dadau | nivedya gāṃ cātithaye subhojanaṃ rasāvṛtaṃ premayuto hyupāharat || 14 || tamāha naṃdaḥ parirabhya dorbhyāmaho kathaṃ jīvasi kaṃsarājye | gatatrapo yo nijaghāna bālān svasuḥ kathaṃ so'nyajaneṣu mohī || 15 || gṛhaṃ gate naṃdavare haristaṃ prapaccha sarvaṃ kuśalaṃ svapitroḥ | tathā yadūnāṃ kila bāṃdhavānāṃ kaṃsasya sarvāṃ viparītabuddhim || 16 || akrūra uvāca paraśvo'hani he deva haṃtuṃ śauriṃ samudyataḥ | khaḍgapāṇirbhojarājo nāradena nivāritaḥ || 17 || duḥkhitā bāṃdhavāḥ sarve yādavā bhayavihvalāḥ | sakuṭuṃbāḥ kaṃsabhayādbhūmandeśāṃtaraṃ gatāḥ || 18 || adyaiva yādavānhaṃtuṃ devāñjetuṃ samudyataḥ | anyatkimapi kau kartumicchate daityarāḍbalī || 19 || tasmādbhavadbhyāṃ gaṃtavyaṃ kuśalaṃ kartumavyayam | bhavaṃtau hi vinā kāryaṃ kiṃcinna syātsatāṃ prabhū || 20 || śrīnārada uvāca atha tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sabalo bhagavān hariḥ | nandarājamatenāha gopān kāryakarānidam || 21 || śrībhagavānuvāca naṃdarājo'pi sabalo vṛddhairgopagaṇairaham | nandā navopanandāśca tathā ṣaḍ vṛṣabhānavaḥ || 22 || mathurāṃ tu gamiṣyanti sarve prātaḥ samutthitāḥ | sarve tu gorasaṃ tasmāddadhidugdhaghṛtādikam || 23 || gṛhītvaikatra kartavyaṃ sopāyanamataḥ param | rathāṃśca śakaṭaiḥ sārddhaṃ samarthānkurutāśu vai || 24 || śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvā kāryakarā gopāḥ sarve gṛhe gṛhe | śrṛṇvaṃtīnāṃ gopikānāmūcuḥ sarvaṃ yathoditam || 25 || tacchrutvodvignahṛdayā gopyo virahavihvalāḥ | parasparaṃ vākyamūcuḥ sarvāstā hi gṛhe gṛhe || 26 || prasthānasya ca vārteyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ | vṛṣabhānuvarasyāpi gṛhe prāptā nṛpeśvara || 27 || gamiṣyato bharturatīva duḥkhitāḥ śrutvā'tha vārtāṃ sadasi hyakasmāt | saṃprāpa mūrcchāṃ vṛṣabhānunandinī raṃbheva bhūmau patitā maruddhatā || 28 || kāścitparimlānamukhaśriyo'bhavan prakaṃkaṇībhūta karāṅgulīyakāḥ | sadyaḥ ślathadbhūṣaṇakeśabaṃdhanāḥ citrārpitāraṃbha ivāvatasthire || 29 || śrīkṛṣṇa goviṃda hare murāre kāścidvadantyaḥ svagṛhe'tivihvalāḥ | visṛjya karmāṇi gṛhasya sarvato yogīva cānandagatā nṛpeśvara || 30 || kāścitsamarthāstu parasparaṃ vacaḥ sametya rājan yugapatsakhījanam | ūcuḥ skhaladgadgadakaṃṭhavācaḥ svataḥ sravadbāṣpakalāvahadṛśaḥ || 31 || gopya ūcuḥ aho'tinirbhohijanasya citraṃ paraṃ caritraṃ gadituṃ na yogyam | mukhena cānyaṃ hṛdi bhāvyamanyaddevo na jānāti kuto manuṣyaḥ || 32 || rāse'pi yadyadgaditaṃ tu tattadvihāya gaṃtuṃ samavasthito'yam | gate purīṃ prāṇapatāvaho'smin kiṃ kiṃ na kaṣṭaṃ bata no'bhaviṣyat || 33 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mathurākhaṃḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde akrūrāgamanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
<5.4> śrīnārada uvāca rājannevaṃ vadaṃtīnāṃ gopināṃ virahaṃ param | vijñāya bhagavāndevaḥ śīghraṃ tāsāṃ gṛhānyayau || 1 || yāvaṃtyo yoṣito rājaṃstāvadrūpadharo hariḥ | svayaṃ saṃbodhayāmāsa vāgbhiḥ sarvāḥ pṛthak pṛthak || 2 || śrīrādhāmaṃdiraṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā rādhāṃ ca mūrcchitām | rahaḥsthitāṃ sakhīsaṃghe nanāda muralīṃ kalam || 3 || śrutvā vaṃśīdhvaniṃ rādhā sahasotthāya cāturā | netra unmīlya dadṛśe śrīgoviṃdaṃ samāgatam || 4 || padminīva gatānandaṃ padminī padminīpatim | vīkṣyotthāyāgatā tasmai sādareṇāsanaṃ dadau || 5 || aśrupūrṇamukhīṃ dīnāṃ rādhāṃ kamalalocanām | śocaṃtīṃ bhagavānāha meghagaṃbhīrayā girā || 6 || śrībhagavānuvāca vimanāstvaṃ kathaṃ bhadre mā śocaṃ kuru rādhike | athavā gaṃtukāmaṃ māṃ śrutvā'si virahāturā || 7 || bhuvo bhārāvatārāya kaṃsādīnāṃ vadhāya ca | brahmaṇā prārthitaḥ sākṣājjāto'haṃ vai tvayā saha || 8 || mathurāṃ hi gamiṣyāmi hariṣyāmi bhuvo bharam | śīghramatrāgamiṣyāmi kariṣyāmi śubhaṃ tava || 9 || śrīnārada uvāca ityuktavaṃtaṃ jagadīśvaraṃ hariṃ rādhā patiṃ prāha viyogavihvalā | dāvāgninā dāvalateva mūrcchitā sukaṃparomāṃcita bhāvasaṃvṛtā || 10 || śrīrādhovāca bhuvo bharaṃ hartumalaṃ purīṃ vraja kṛtaṃ paraṃ me śapathaṃ śṛṇu tvataḥ | gate tvayi prāṇapate ca vigrahaṃ kadācidatraiva na dhārayāmyaham || 11 || yadāttha me tvaṃ śapathaṃ na manyase dvitīyavāraṃ pradadāmi vākpatham | prāṇo'dhare gantumatīva vihvalaḥ karpūradhūleḥ kaṇavadgamiṣyati || 12 || śrībhagavānuvāca vacanaṃ vai svanigamaṃ dūrīkartuṃ kṣamo'smyaham | bhaktānāṃ vacanaṃ rādhe dūrīkartuṃ na ca kṣamaḥ || 13 || śrīdāma śāpātpūrvasmādgoloke kalahānmama | śatavarṣaṃ te viyogo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 14 || mā śokaṃ kuru kalyāṇi varaṃ me smara rādhike | māsaṃ māsaṃ viyoge te darśanaṃ me bhaviṣyati || 15 || śrīrādhovāca māsaṃ prati viyoge me dātuṃ svaṃ darśanaṃ hare | cennāgamiṣyasi tadā'sūnduḥkhāt saṃtyajāmyaham || 16 || lokābhīrāma janabhūṣaṇa viśvadīpa kaṃdarpamohana jagadvṛjinārtihārin | ānandakanda yadunandana nandasūno adyāgamasya śapathaṃ kuru me purastvam || 17 || śrībhagavānuvāca raṃbhoru māsaṃ prati te viyoge cennāgamiṣye śapathaṃ gavāṃ me | niḥsaṃśayaṃ niṣkapaṭaṃ vacastvamavehi rādhe kathitaṃ mayā yat || 18 || yo mitratāṃ niṣkapaṭaṃ karoti niṣkāraṇo dhanyatamaḥ sa eva | vidhāya maitrīṃ kapaṭaṃ vidadhyāt taṃ laṃpaṭaṃ hetupaṭaṃ naṭaṃ dhik || 19 || karmendriyāṇīha yathā rasādīṃstathā sakāmā munayaḥ sukhaṃ yat | manāṅ na jānaṃti hi nairapekṣaṃ gūḍhaṃ paraṃ nirguṇalakṣaṇaṃ tat || 20 || jānaṃti saṃtaḥ samadarśino ye dāṃtā mahāṃtaḥ kila nairapekṣāḥ | te nairapekṣyaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ me jñāneṃdriyādīni yathā rasādīn || 21 || sarvaṃ hi bhāvaṃ manasaḥ parasparaṃ na hyekato bhāmini jāyate tataḥ | premaiva kartavyamato mayi svataḥ premṇā samānaṃ bhuvi nāsti kiṃcit || 22 || yathā hi bhāṃḍīravaṭe manoratho babhūva rādhe hi tathā bhaviṣyati | ahaitukaṃ prema ca sadbhirāśritaṃ taccāpi saṃtaḥ kila nirguṇaṃ viduḥ || 23 || ye rādhikāyāṃ tvayi keśave mayi bhedaṃ na kurvaṃti hi dugdhaśauklyavat | ta eva me brahmapadaṃ prayānti tadahaitukasphūrjitabhaktilakṣaṇāḥ || 24 || ye rādhikāyāṃ tvayi keśave mayi paśyanti bhedaṃ kudhiyo narā bhuvi | te kālasūtraṃ prapatanti duḥkhitā raṃbhoru yāvatkila caṃdrabhāskarau || 25 || śrīnārada uvāca evamāśvāsya tāṃ rādhāṃ sarvaṃ gopīgaṇaṃ tathā | āyayau naṃdabhavanaṃ bhagavānnayakovidaḥ || 26 || atha sūryodaye jāte naṃdādyāḥ śakaṭairbalim | nītvā rathānsamāruhya sarve śrīmathurāṃ yayuḥ || 27 || āruhya rāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ svaṃ rathaṃ gāṃdinīsutaḥ | prayāṇamakarodrājanmathurāṃ draṣṭumudyataḥ || 28 || kauṭiśaḥkoṭiśo gopyo mārge mārge samāsthitāḥ | paśyaṃtyastannirgamanaṃ krodhāḍhyā mohavihvalāḥ || 29 || krūra krūreti cākrūraṃ vadantyaḥ paruṣaṃ vacaḥ | rurudhuḥ sarvato yānaṃ yathārkaṃ sarathaṃ ghanāḥ || 30 || akrūrasya rathaṃ rājan nijaghnuryaṣṭibhirbhṛśam | aśvāṃstathā sārathiṃ ca bhagavadvirahāturāḥ || 31 || aśvāstatra samutpetustāḍitāsta itastataḥ | gopīdvyaṅgulighātena sārathiḥ patito rathāt || 32 || vihāya lajjāṃ lokasya samākṛṣya rathādbalāt | kaṃkaṇaisteḍurakrūraṃ paśyatoḥ kṛṣṇarāmayoḥ || 33 || gopīyūthabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā sabalo bhagavān hariḥ | gopīḥ saṃbodhayāmāsa rakṣitvā gāṃdinīsutam || 34 || saṃdhyāyāmāgamiṣyāmi mā śokaṃ kurutāṃganāḥ | paśyataścāsya maddhāsyaṃ mā kurvantu vrajaukasaḥ || 35 || ityevamuktvā sarathaḥ samāgato 'krūreṇa kṛṣṇo baladevasaṃyutaḥ | turaṃgamairvegamayairmanoharaiḥ yayau purīṃ yādavavṛndamaṇḍitām || 36 || yāvadrathaḥ keturutāśvareṇuḥ ālakṣyate tāvadatīva mohāt | sthitā hyabhūvanpathi citravattāḥ smṛtvā harervākyamutāgatāśāḥ || 37 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mathurākhaṃḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīmathurāprayāṇaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
<5.5> śrīnārada uvāca harirakrūrāmābhyāṃ mathuropavanaṃ gataḥ | yamunānikaṭaṃ sthitvā vāri pītvā rathaṃ yayau || 1 || akrūrastāvanujñāpya snātuṃ śrīyamunāṃ gataḥ | nityanaimittikaṃ kartuṃ viveśa vimale jale || 2 || jale cāgādhagaṃbhīre mahāvartasamākule | dadarśa rāmakṛṣṇau tau vadaṃtau gāṃdinīsutaḥ || 3 || vismatastau rathe'paśyatpunarvāri sthitau nṛpa | dadarśa tatra sarpendraṃ kuṃḍalībhūtamāsthitam || 4 || tasyotsaṃge mahālokaṃ golokaṃ lokavanditam | govardhanādriṃ yamunāṃ vṛndāraṇyaṃ manoharam || 5 || asaṃkhyakoṭimārtaṇḍajyotiṣāṃ maṃḍalaṃ prabhum | paripūrṇatamaṃ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam || 6 || koṭimanmathalāvaṇyaṃ rāsamaṃḍalamadhyagam | rādhayā sahitaṃ devaṃ tatrākrūro dadarśa ha || 7 || jñātvā kṛṣṇaṃ paraṃ brahma natvā natvā punaḥ punaḥ | kṛtāñjalipuṭo'krūraḥ stutiṃ cakre'tiharṣitaḥ || 8 || akrūra uvāca namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇacaṃdrāya paripūrṇatamāya ca | asaṃkhyāṃḍādhipataye golokapataye namaḥ || 9 || śrīrādhāpataye tubhyaṃ vrajadhīśāya te namaḥ | namaḥ śrīnaṃdaputrāya yaśodānaṃdanāya ca || 10 || devakīsuta goviṃda vāsudeva jagatpate | yadūttama jagannātha pāhi māṃ puruṣottama || 11 || vāṇī sadā te guṇavarṇane syāt karṇau kathāyāṃ mama dośca karmaṇi | manaḥ sadā tvaccaraṇāraviṃdayordṛśau sphuraddhāmaviśeṣadarśane || 12 || śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ saṃstuvatastasya paśyato vismitasya ca | tatraivāntardadhe kṛṣṇaḥ saloko bhagavānprabhuḥ || 13 || natvā taṃ ca tadākrūraḥ kṛtvā naimittikaṃ vidhim | jñātvā kṛṣṇaṃ paraṃ brahma vismito rathamāyayau || 14 || dinātyaye rāmakṛṣṇāvānayadgāṃdinīsutaḥ| rathena vāyuvegena snigdhagaṃbhīranādinā || 15 || purasyopavane tatra vīkṣya naṃdaṃ yadūttamaḥ | akrūraṃ prāha vihasanmeghagaṃbhīrayā girā || 16 || śrībhagavānuvāca mathurāyāṃ hi gaṃtavyaṃ bhavatā svarathena vai | gopālaiḥ sahitaḥ paścādāgamiṣyāmi mānada || 17 || akrūra uvāca devadeva jagannātha goviṃda puruṣottama | sahāgrajaḥ sagopālo gaccha me maṃdiraṃ prabho || 18 || pādāraviṃdarajasā pavitrīkuru madgṛham | tvāṃ vinā na gamiṣyāmi maṃdiraṃ svaṃ jagatpate || 19 || śrībhagavānuvāca gṛhaṃ tavāgamiṣyāmi hatvā vai yādavāhitam | sabalo bāṃdhavaiḥ sārddhaṃ kariṣyāmi tava priyam || 20 || śrīnārada uvāca atha tatra sthite kṛṣṇe so'krūro mathurāṃ gataḥ | nivedya cedaṃ kaṃsāya tataḥ svabhavanaṃ yayau || 21 || athāparāhṇe sabalaṃ govindaṃ bālakaiḥ purīm | draṣṭumabhyuditaṃ vīkṣya naṃdo vākyamathābravīt || 22 || ārjavena purīṃ vīkṣyāgantavyaṃ bhavatā kila | na gokulaṃ viddhi caināṃ kaṃsarājye mahābhaye || 23 || tathā'stu coktvā bhagavān vṛddhairnandapraṇoditaiḥ | gopālairbālakaiḥ sārddhaṃ sabalo gatavānpurīm || 24 || prāsādairgaganasparśairhemaratnakhacidgṛhaiḥ | śobhitāṃ durgasaṃyuktāṃ devadhānīmiva sthitām || 25 || kāliṃdīṃ ratnasopānaiścaladūrmikutūhalaiḥ | alakāmiva śobhāḍhyāṃ divyanārīnarairyutām || 26 || prekṣañchrīmathurāṃ kṛṣṇo dhanināṃ maṃdirāṇī ca | paśyan gopālakaiḥ sārddhaṃ rājamārgaṃ viveśa ha || 27 || śrutvā''gataṃ taṃ vasudevanaṃdanaṃ bahuśrutā vai mathurāpurāṃganāḥ | tyaktvā'tha karmāṇi visṛjya tāḥ śiśūn draṣṭuṃ vyadhāvannudadhiṃ yathā''pagāḥ || 28 || kāścittu harmyātkila jāladeśāt kuḍyāttu kāścitpaṭato gavākṣāt | vinirgatā dvārakapāṭadeśāt taccatvarāttaṃ dadṛśuḥ puraṃdhryaḥ || 29 || ekaṃ calatkuntalamānane sve kimagragānāṃ tu manāṃsi hartum | paścātkṛtaṃ maulitale dadhānaṃ kiṃ pṛṣṭhagānāṃ haraṇaṃ dvitīyam || 30 || pītāṃbarārddhaṃ balinaṃ sphuratkaṭāvarddhaṃ tadaṃse jalade yathā taḍit | padmaṃ kare sve hṛdi vaijayaṃtīṃ srajaṃ dadhānaṃ vasudevanandanam || 31 || vilokya sarvā mumuhuḥ purastriyo vilolapāṭhinanavīnakuṇḍalam | bālārkahemāṃgadabāhumaṃḍalaṃ rājannasaṃkhyāṃḍapatiṃ parātparam || 32 || puraṃdhrya ūcuḥ aho vṛdāvanaṃ ramyaṃ yatra sannihito hyayam | dhanyā gopagaṇāḥ sarve paśyaṃtyenaṃ manoharam || 33 || dhanyā goparamaṇyastāstābhiḥ kiṃ sukṛtaṃ kṛtam | pibaṃti yā rāsaraṃge muhuścāsyādharāmṛtam || 34 || śrīnārada uvāca rājamārge raṃgakāraṃ rajakaṃ yāṃtamunmadam | gopālānumatenaiva prāha taṃ madhusūdanaḥ || 35 || dehi no mitra vāsāṃsi rucirāṇi mahāmate | dātuste hi paraṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 36 || prajvalankṛṣṇavākyena dhṛtenāgniryathā bhṛśam | kaṃsabhṛtyo mahāduṣṭaḥ prāhedaṃ pathi mādhavam || 37 || rajaka uvāca īdṛśānyeva vastrāṇi pitṛbhirvaḥ pitāmahaiḥ | dhāritāni kimudvṛttāste tu kaupīnadhārakāḥ || 38 || yātāśu vanyā nagarātsarve vai jīvitecchayā | kārāgāre kārayāmi yuṣmān vastraharānaham || 39 || śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ pravadatastasya rajakasya yadūttamaḥ | jahāra mastakaṃ sadyaḥ karāgreṇaiva līlayā || 40 || tajjyotiḥ śrīghanaśyāme līnaṃ jātaṃ videharāṭ | sadyastadanugāḥ sarve vāsaḥkośān visṛjya vai || 41 || dudruvuḥ sarvato rājan śaratkāle yathā ghanāḥ | gṛhitvā''tmapriye vastre sthitayo rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ || 42 || jagṛhurgopabālāste rājamārgajanā api | taddhāraṇavido bālā vāsāṃsi rucirāṇi ca | astavyastaṃ paridadhuḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya prapaśyataḥ || 43 || vīkṣya tau vāyakaḥ kaścicchrīkṛṣṇabaladevayoḥ | vicitravarṇairvāsobhirdivyaṃ veṣaṃ cakāra ha || 44 || tathā'nyeṣāṃ śiśūnāṃ ca yathāyogyaṃ vidhāya saḥ | rājanparamayā bhaktyā punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ dadarśa ha || 45 || prasanno bhagavāṃstasmai prādātsārūpyamātmanaḥ | balaṃ śriyaṃ tathaiśvaryaṃ baladevo dadau punaḥ || 46 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mathurākhaṃḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde mathurāyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇapraveśo nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||
<5.6> śrīnārada uvāca atha gopālakaiḥ sārddhaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo naṃdanaṃdanaḥ | gṛhaṃ jagāma sabalaḥ sudāmno dāmamālinaḥ || 1 || dṛṣṭvā tau sa samutthāya namaskṛtya kṛtāñjaliḥ | puṣpasiṃhāsane sthāpya prāha gadgadayā girā || 2 || sudāmovāca dhanyaṃ kulaṃ me bhavanaṃ ca janma tvayayyāgate devakulāni sapta | mātuḥ pituḥ sapta priyayā vaikuṇṭhalokaṃ gatavaṃti manye || 3 || bhūbhāramāhartumalaṃ yadoḥ kule jātau yuvāṃ pūrṇatamau pareśvarau | namo yuvābhyāṃ mama dīnadīnaṃ gṛhaṃ gatābhyāṃ jagadīśvarau parau || 4 || śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā puṣparacanālaṃkārān madhupadhvanīn | nivedya makaraṃdāṃśca mālākāro nanāma ha || 5 || dhṛtvā tatpuṣpanicayaṃ sabalo bhagavān hariḥ | dattvā gopebhya ārāttaṃ prāha prahasitānanaḥ || 6 || garīyasī matpadābje bhaktirbhūyātsadā tava | madbhaktānāṃ tu saṃgaḥ syānmatsvarūpamihaiva hi || 7 || baladevo dadau tasmai śriyaṃ cānvayavardhinīm | utthāya tau tato rājannanyāṃ vīthīṃ prajagmatuḥ || 8 || yāṃtīṃ striyaṃ padmanetrāṃ pāṭīrālepabhājanam | vibhratīṃ yuvatīṃ kubjāṃ pathi papraccha mādhavaḥ || 9 || śrībhagavānuvāca kā tvaṃ kasya priyā subhru kasyārthaṃ caṃdanaṃ tvidam | dehyāvayoryena tava ciraṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati || 10 || sairaṃdhryuvāca dāsyasmi sundaravara kubjānāma mahāmate | maddhastotthaṃ ca pāṭīraṃ jātaṃ bhojapateḥ priyam || 11 || adyāpi kaṃsadāsyasmi sāṃprataṃ tava cāgrataḥ | hastiśuṇḍādaṇḍasame bhujadaṇḍe'sti me manaḥ || 12 || yuvāṃ vinā ko'nyatamo'nulepaṃ kartumarhati | yuvayostu samaṃ rūpaṃ trailokye na hi vidyate || 13 || śrīnārada uvāca ubhābhyāṃ sā dadau sāṃdraṃ harṣitā hyanulepanam | atha tāvaṃgarāgeṇa rāmakṛṣṇau virejatuḥ || 14 || jagṛhuścandanaṃ divyaṃ kiṃcitkiṃcidvrajārbhakāḥ | trivakrāmatha tāṃ kṛṣṇo ṛjvīṃ kartuṃ mano dadhe || 15 || ākramya padbhyāṃ prapade'ṅgulidvayaṃ prottānahastena vibhuḥ pareśvaraḥ | pragṛhya nṝṇāṃ cubuke prapaśyatāṃ vakrāṃ tanuṃ tāmudanīnamaddhariḥ || 16 || tadaiva sā yaṣṭisamānavigrahā dīptyā ca raṃbhāṃ kṣipatīva rūpiṇī | bhūtvā gṛhītvā''ha hariṃ tu vāsasi śucismitā jātamanojavihvalā || 17 || sairaṃdhryuvāca gacchāśu he sundaravarya madgṛhaṃ tyaktuṃ bhavaṃtaṃ kila notsahe'ham | prasīda sarvajña rasajña mānada tvayā bhṛśaṃ pronmathitaṃ mano mama || 18 || śrīnārada uvāca tadaiva gopā jahasuḥ parasparamaho kimetatkaratālaniḥsvanaiḥ | prahasya rāmasya hariḥ prapaśyatastadyācyamāno hyavadatparaṃ vacaḥ || 19 || śrībhagavānuvāca aho'tidhanyā mathurā purīyaṃ vasaṃti yatraiva janāstu saumyāḥ | ye'jñātapānthānsvagṛhaṃ nayaṃti dṛṣṭvā purīṃ dhāma tavāgamiṣye || 20 || śrīnārada uvāca evamuktvottarīyāṃtaṃ samākṛṣya girārdrayā | rājamārgaṃ vrajankṛṣṇo vaiśyānāḍhyāndadarśa ha || 21 || puṣpatāmbūlagaṃdhāḍhyaiḥ phalairdugdhaphalairharim | sampūjya svāsane sthāpya nemuragryadhiyo viśaḥ || 22 || vaiśyā ūcuḥ bhaveccedatra te rājyaṃ tāvakānsaratāttadā | vayaṃ tava prajā deva rājye prāpte na kaḥ smaret || 23 || śrīnārada uvāca papraccha susmito vaiśyānkodaṇḍasthānamacyutaḥ | na te tamūcuḥ sudhiyaḥ kodaṇḍe bhaṃgaśaṃkayā || 24 || tadrūpaguṇamādhuryamohitā ye ca māthurāḥ | kumāra paśyaihi dhanurityūcustaddidṛkṣavaḥ || 25 || tairdṛṣṭena pathā kṛṣṇaḥ praviṣṭo dhanuṣaḥ sthalam | maitrīṃ kurvan vayasyaiśca māthuraiḥ purabālakaiḥ || 26 || yathaidraṃ hemacitrāḍhyaṃ kodaṇḍaṃ saptatālakam | puruṣaiḥ pañcasāhasrairnetuṃ yogyaṃ bṛhṛdbharam || 27 || aṣṭadhātumayaṃ kliṣṭaṃ lakṣabhārasamaṃ param | caturdaśyāṃ paurajanairarcitaṃ yajñamaṇḍape || 28 || bhārgaveṇa purā dattaṃ yadurājāya mādhavaḥ | dadarśa kuṇḍalībhūtaṃ sākṣāccheṣamiva sthitam || 29 || vāryamāṇo nṛbhiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prasahya dhanurādade | paśyatāṃ tatra paurāṇāṃ sajjaṃ kṛtvā'tha līlayā || 30 || ākṛṣya karṇaparyaṃtaṃ dordaṃḍābhyāṃ harirdhanuḥ | babhaṃja madhyato rājannikṣudaṃḍaṃ gajo yathā || 31 || bhajyamānasya dhanuṣaṣṭaṅkāro'bhūttaḍitsvanaḥ | nanāda tena brahmāṃḍaṃ saptalokairbilaiḥ saha || 32 || vicelurdiggajāstārā rājadbhūkhaṇḍamaṃḍalam | tadaiva badhirībhūtā pṛthivyāṃ janamaṃḍalī || 33 || kaṃsasya hṛdayaṃ śabdo vidadāra ghaṭīdvayam | tadrakṣiṇaḥ prakupitā utthitā ātatāyinaḥ || 34 || gṛhītukāmāḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pratyūcurbadhyatāmiti | atha tānāgatān vīkṣya saśastrānbalakeśavau || 35 || kodaṇdaśakale nītvā jaghnaturdurmadānbhṛśam | śakalātiprahāreṇa kecidvīrāstu mūrchitāḥ || 36 || bhinnapādā bhinnanakhāḥ kecicchinnāṃsabāhavaḥ | vīrāḥ pañca sahasrāṇi nipeturbhūmimaṇḍale || 37 || vicelurmāthurāḥ sarve dudruvustaddidṛkṣavaḥ | puryāṃ kolāhale jāte nṛṇāṃ jātaṃ mahadbhayam || 38 || bhojarājasabhāchatramakasmānnipapāta ha | gopālaiḥ sabalaḥ kṛṣṇo dhāvañcāpasthalānnṛpa | āyayau nandanikaṭe sandhyākāle'tibhītavat || 39 || nirīkṣya goviṃdasurūpamadbhutaṃ vimohitā vai mathurāpurāṃganāḥ | visrastavāsaḥkabarāḥ smarādhayaḥ parasparaṃ prāhuridaṃ sakhījanam || 40 || puraṃdhrya ūcuḥ kaṃdarpakoṭidyutimāharaṃstvaraṃ svairaṃ caranvai mathurāpure hariḥ | nirīkṣyate yābhiratīva sākṣādaṅgeṣu sarveṣvapi naḥ samāviśat || 41 || kuśalā ūcuḥ krūrāḥ striyaḥ kiṃ na hi saṃti pattane nirīkṣyate yābhiranaṃgamohanaḥ | aṃgeṣu sarveṣvapi sarvasundaro nāsmābhirānandamayo nirīkṣyate || 42 || kasyaikadeśe madhuratvamīkṣyate tatrāsti netraṃ prapatatpataṃgavat | yastveva sarvāṃgamanoharaḥ sakhi sa eva netreṇa kathaṃ samīkṣyate || 43 || aṃge hyaṃge sundare naṃdasūnoḥ prāptaṃ prāptaṃ yatra yatrāpi netram | tasmāttasmānnāmavallabdhasaukhyaṃ lāvaṇyābdhau magnavallagnacittam || 44 || śrīnārada uvāca dṛṣṭvā dine yaṃ vrajarājanandanaṃ svapne'pi taddadṛśuḥ purastriyaḥ | gopyaḥ kathaṃ taṃ madhuraṃ na sasmaruryābhiḥ kṛtaṃ maithila rāsamaṃḍalam || 45 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mathurākhaṃḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīmathurādarśanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||
<5.7> śrīnārada uvāca rajakasya śiraśchedaṃ kaṃso vai rakṣiṇāṃ vadham | dhanurbhaṃgaṃ tataḥ śrutvā paraṃ trāsamupāgamat || 1 || tatkṣaṇāddurnimittāni vāmāṅgasphuraṇāni ca | prapaśyannaṅgabhaṅgāni na nidrāṃ prāpa daityarāṭ || 2 || svapne pretaiḥ samāyuktastailābhyakto digaṃbaraḥ | japāsraṅmahiṣāruḍho dakṣiṇāśāṃ jagāma saḥ || 3 || prātaḥkāle samutthāya kāryabhārakarāñjanān | āhūya kārayāmāsa mallakrīḍāmahotsavam || 4 || viśālājirasaṃyukte hemastaṃbhasamanvite | sabhāmaṇḍapadeśāgre raṃgabhūmirbabhūva ha || 5 || vitānairhemasaṃkāśairmuktādāmavilaṃbibhiḥ | sopānairhemamañcaiśca raṃgabhūmirbabhau nṛpa || 6 || rājamañce ratnamaye makarandārcite śubhe | śakrasiṃhāsanaṃ tatra sopabarhaṇamaṇḍalam || 7 || ātapatreṇa divyena caṃdramaṇḍalacāruṇā | haṃsābhairvyajanairyuktaścāmarairvajramuṣṭibhiḥ || 8 || daśahastocchritaṃ śaśvadviśvakarmavinirmitam | tadāruhya babhau kaṃso'driśṛṅge mṛgarāḍiva || 9 || gāyakāḥ prajagustatra nanṛturvārayoṣitaḥ | nedurmṛdaṃgapaṭahatālabheryānakādayaḥ || 10 || rājāno maṃḍaleśāśca paurā jānapadā nṛpa | dadṛśurmallayuddhaṃ te mañce mañce samāsthitāḥ || 11 || cāṇūro muṣṭikaḥ kūṭaḥ śalastośala eva ca | vyāyāmamudgarairyuktā yuyudhuste parasparam || 12 || nandarājādayo gopāḥ kaṃsāhūtā natānanāḥ | datvā baliṃ paraṃ tasmā ekasminmañca āśritāḥ || 13 || bāṇāsurajarāsandhanarakāṇāṃ purānnṛpa | anyeṣāṃ śaṃbarādīnāṃ sakāśādbhūbhujāṃ tathā || 14 || balayaścāyayū rājan yadurājāya tatra vai | atha tau rāmakṛṣṇau dvau māyābālakavigrahau || 15 || mallalīlādarśanārthaṃ yayatū raṃgamaṃḍapam | gomūtracayasiṃdūrakastūrīpatrabhṛnmukham | sravanmadamahāmattaṃ ratnakuṇḍalamaṃḍitam || 16 || gajaṃ kuvalayāpīḍaṃ raṃgadvāramavasthitam | vīkṣya kṛṣṇo mahāmātraṃ prāha gaṃbhīrayā girā || 17 || ākarṣayāṃga nāgendraṃ mārgaṃ kuru mamecchayā | nocetvāṃ pātayiṣyāmi sanāgaṃ bhūmimaṃḍale || 18 || mahāmātrastadā kruddho nodayāmāsa taṃ gajam | cītkāramutkaṭaṃ dikṣu kurvantaṃ nandasūnave || 19 || gṛhītvā taṃ hariṃ sadyaḥ śuṃḍādaṇḍena nāgarāṭ | ujjahāra tatastasmānnirgato bhārabhṛddhariḥ || 20 || tatpādeṣu vilīno'bhūtprabhransannitastataḥ | vṛndāvananikuñjeṣu vṛkṣeṣu ca yathā hariḥ || 21 || kare jagrāha taṃ nāgaḥ śuṇḍādaṇḍena cāṃghriṣu | niṣpīḍya śuṇḍāṃ hastabhyāṃ hariḥ paścādvinirgataḥ || 22 || tiryagbhūtaśca taṃ nāgo gṛhītumupacakrame | muṣṭinā taṃ ghātayitvā puro dudrāva mādhavaḥ || 23 || tamanvadhāvannāgendro mathurāyāṃ videharāṭ | kolāhale tadā jāte haristasmādito yayau || 24 || pucche gṛhītvā taṃ nāgaṃ baladevo mahābalaḥ | cakarṣa bhujadaṃḍābhyāṃ phaṇinaṃ garuḍo yathā || 25 || prahasanbhagavānkṛṣṇo gṛhītvā taṃ kare balāt | cakarṣa bhujadaṇḍābhyāṃ kūparajjuṃ yathā naraḥ || 26 || dvayorākarṣaṇānnāgo vihvalo'bhūnnṛpeśvara | mahāmātrāstadā sapta ruruhustaṃ gajaṃ balāt || 27 || nītā gajāstathā cānyaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ haṃtuṃ śatatrayam | aṃkuśāsphālanātkruddhaṃ mattebhaṃ punarāgatam || 28 || śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsākṣādbaladevasya paśyataḥ || 29 || śuṃḍādaṃḍe saṃgṛhītvā bhrāmayitvā tvitastataḥ | pātayāmāsa bhūpṛṣṭhe kamaṃḍalumivārbhakaḥ || 30 || dūre prapatitāstasya mahāmātrā itastataḥ | satāṃ prapaśyatāṃ nāgaḥ sadyo vai nidhanaṃ gataḥ || 31 || tajjyotiḥ śrīghanaśyāme līnaṃ jātaṃ videharāṭ | daṃtāvutpāṭya tasyāpi rāmakṛṣṇau mahābalau | nijaghnaturmahāmātrān mṛgānkesariṇo yathā || 32 || dvipe hate'pi ye cānye mahāmātrā itastataḥ | vidudruvuryathā meghā varṣākāle gate sati || 33 || evaṃ hatvā dvipaṃ gopaiḥ śeṣaistaiḥ prekṣaṇotsukaiḥ | jayārāvai rāmakṛṣṇau śramavārimadāṃkitau || 34 || pariśramāruṇamukhau raṃgaṃ viviśatustvaram | daṃtapāṇī mahāvegau yathāśāmanilānalau || 35 || mallāśca mallaṃ ca narā nareṃdraṃ striyaḥ smaraṃ gopagaṇā vrajeśam | pitā sutaṃ daṃḍadharaṃ hyasaṃto mṛtyaṃ ca kaṃso vivudhā virājam || 36 || tattvaṃ paraṃ yogivarāśca bhojā devaṃ tadā raṃgagataṃ balena | pṛthak pṛthagbhāvanayā hyapaśyansarve janāstaṃ paripūrṇadevam || 37 || hataṃ dvipaṃ vīkṣya ca tau mahābalau kaṃso manasvī bhayamāpa cetasi | maṃcasthitā harṣitamānasāśca caṃdraṃ cakorā iva te sukhaṃ yayuḥ || 38 || karṇe ca karṇaṃ vinidhāya nāgarā mahotsukāste hyavadanparasparam | etau hi sākṣātparameśvarau parau babhūvaturvai vasudevanaṃdanau || 39 || aho'tiramyaṃ vrajamaṃḍalaṃ paraṃ yatraiṣa sākṣādvicacāra mādhavaḥ | kṛtvā hi yaddarśanamadya durlabhaṃ vayaṃ kṛtārthāstu bhavema sarvataḥ || 40 || śrīnārada uvāca vadatsu pauralokeṣu nadattūryeṣu maithila | cāṇurastāvupavrajya rāmakṛṣṇāvuvāca ha || 41 || cāṇūra uvāca he rāma he kṛṣṇa yuvāṃ mahābalau rājñaḥ puro vai kurutaṃ mṛdhaṃ balāt | praharṣite rājani cedyadūttame kiṃ kīṃ na bhadraṃ bhavatīha vaśca naḥ || 42 || śrībhagavānuvāca puraiva bhadraṃ nṛpateḥ prasādato bālā vayaṃ tulyabalaiśca bālakaiḥ | bhūyānmṛdho no balavān yathocitamadharmayuddhaṃ kila mā bhavediha || 43 || cāṇūra uvāca bhavānna bālo na ca vā kiśoro balaśca sākṣādbalināṃ balīyān | sahasramattebhabalaṃ dadhāno dvipo bhavadbhyāṃ nihataḥ salīlam || 44 || śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ tasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānvṛjinārdanaḥ | cāṇūreṇāpi yuyudhe muṣṭikena balo balī || 45 || ākarṣaṇaṃ nodanaṃ ca bhujābhyāṃ bhujadaṇḍayoḥ | cakratuḥ paśyatāṃ nṝṇāṃ gajāviva jigīṣayā || 46 || hastābhyāṃ vapurutthāpya cāṇūrasya hariḥ svayam | atolayaddehabhāraṃ puṇyabhāraṃ yathā vidhiḥ || 47 || cāṇūrastaṃ hariṃ devaṃ karaṇaikena līlayā | ujjahāra mahāvīro bhūkhaṃḍaṃ nāgarāḍiva || 48 || grīvāyāṃ kila cāṇūraṃ bhujavegena mādhavaḥ | kaṭyāṃ coddhṛtya sahasā pātayāmāsa bhūtale || 49 || hastaiśca jānubhiḥ pādairbhujoro'ṅgulimuṣṭibhiḥ | jaghnatuḥ kṛṣṇacāṇūrau tathaiva balamuṣṭikau || 50 || śramavāriyute dṛṣṭvā śrīmukhe rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ | sānukaṃpāstadā prāhurgavākṣasthā nṛpastriyāḥ || 51 || striya ūcuḥ aho adharmaḥ sumahatsabhāyāṃ jātaḥ puro rājani vartamāne | kva vajratulyāṃgavṛtau hi mallau kva puṣpatulyau bata rāmakṛṣṇau || 52 || aho hyabhāgyaṃ hi puraukasāṃ no yuddhe tayordarśanamadya jātam | aho'tidhanyaṃ bata bhūri bhāgyaṃ vanaukasāṃ rāsarasena jātam || 53 || aho sthite rājani duṣṭacitte na ko'pi vaktuṃ kṣama eva sakhyaḥ | tasmāddhi naḥ puṇyabalena cettau tvaraṃ mṛdhe vai jayatāmarīnsvān || 54 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mathurākhaṃḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde kuvalayāpīḍavadho nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||
<5.8> śrīnārada uvāca ārdracittaṃ naṃdarājaṃ vanitānāṃ manoratham | smṛtvā śatrūn hantukāmaḥ cakre yuddhaṃ balāddhariḥ || 1 || gṛhītvā bhujadaṃḍābhyāṃ cāṇūraṃ gagane balāt | cikṣepa sahasā kṛṣṇo vātaḥ padmamivoddhṛtam || 2 || ākāśātpatitaḥ so'pi tārakeva hyadhomukhaḥ | utthāya muṣṭinā kṛṣṇaṃ tāḍayāmāsa vegataḥ || 3 || tasya muṣṭiprahāreṇa na cacāla parātparaḥ | sadyo gṛhītvā cāṇūraṃ pātayāmāsa bhūtale || 4 || bhinnadaṃtastu cāṇūraḥ krodhayukto madotkaṭaḥ | muṣṭidvayena śrīkṛṇaṃ tatāḍa hṛdi maithila || 5 || gṛhītvā karayostaṃ vai karābhyāṃ bhagavānsvayam | kaṃsasyāgre bhrāmayitvā sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ nṛpa || 6 || pātayāmāsa bhūpṛṣṭhe kamaṃḍalumivārbhakaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇasya prahāreṇa cāṇūro bhinnamastakaḥ || 7 || udvaman rudhiraṃ rājansadyo vai nidhanaṃ gataḥ | tathaiva muṣṭikaṃ mallaṃ muṣṭibhiryudhi durgamam || 8 || dhṛtvāṃghrau bhrāmayitvā khe baladevo mahābalaḥ | pātayāmāsa bhūpṛṣṭhe phaṇinaṃ garuḍo yathā | muṣṭiko nidhanaṃ prāpa prodvaman rudhiraṃ mukhāt || 9 || kūṭaṃ samāgataṃ vīkṣya baladevo mahābalaḥ | muṣṭinā pātayāmāsa vajreṇendro yathā girim || 10 || prāptaṃ śalaṃ nandasūnurlattayā taṃ tatāḍa ha | tīkṣṇayā tuṃḍayā rājankadrujaṃ garuḍo yathā || 11 || gṛhītvā tośalaṃ kṛṣṇo madhyataḥ saṃvidāryya ca | prākṣipatkaṃsamaṃcāgre viṭapaṃ sindhuro yathā || 12 || ete nipātitā raṃge sadyo vai nidhanaṃ gatāḥ | teṣāṃ jyotīṃṣi vaikuṇṭhe viviśuḥ paśyatāṃ satām || 13 || evaṃ śrīrāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ malleṣu nihateṣu ca | śeṣāḥ pradudruvurmallā bhayārtā jīvanecchayā || 14 || śrīdāmādīn vayasyāṃśca gopānākṛṣya mādhavaḥ | tai sārddhaṃ yuddhamārebhe sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ satām || 15 || kirīṭakuṇḍaladharau rāmakṛṣṇau sahārbhakaiḥ | viharaṃtau vīkṣya raṃge visismuḥ puravāsinaḥ || 16 || kaṃsaṃ vinā sarvamukhājjayaśabdo vinirgataḥ | sādhu sādhviti vādo'bhūnnedurduṃdubhayastataḥ || 17 || svasyājayaṃ vīkṣya kaṃso mahākrodhasamākulaḥ | varjayitvā tūryaghoṣaṃ prāha prasphuritādharaḥ || 18 || kaṃsa uvāca durbuddhiyuktau vasudevanaṃdanau prasahya niḥsārayatāśu matpurāt | haraṃtu sarvaṃ vrajavāsināṃ dhanaṃ badhnīta naṃdaṃ sahasā'tidurmatim || 19 || adyograsenasya pituḥ kubuddheḥ śaureḥ śiraścāśu hi chiṃdhi chiṃdhi | kau yatra tatrāpi tathā'tra vṛṣṇijātānsurāṃśān kila sūdayadhvam || 20 || śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ vikatthamānasya kaṃsasya yadunaṃdanaḥ | sahasotpatya taṃ mañcamāruhatkrodhapūritaḥ || 21 || mṛtyuṃ smāgataṃ vīkṣya mañcādutthāya satvaram | madoddhato bhartsayaṃstaṃ jagṛhe khaḍgacarmmaṇī || 22 || agrahītsahasā kaṃsaṃ dorbhyāṃ carmāsisaṃyutam | yathā tuṇḍavibhāgābhyāṃ saviṣaṃ phaṇinaṃ virāṭ || 23 || patatkhaḍgaścalaccarmā bhujabaṃdhādbalādbalī | viniryayau tārkṣyatuṇḍātpuṇḍarīko yathā phaṇī || 24 || maṃce tau balinau vegānmardayaṃtau parasparam | śailaśṛṅge yathā siṃhau śuśubhāte yathātatham || 25 || utpataṃtaṃ balātkaṃsaṃ śatahastaṃ mahāṃbare | agrahiccotpatan kṛṣṇaḥ śyenaṃ śyeno yathāṃbare || 26 || gṛhītvā bhujadaṇḍābhyāṃ pracaṃḍaṃ daityapuṃgavam | trailokyabaladhṛgdevo bhrāmayitvā tvitastataḥ || 27 || ākāśātpātayāmāsa maṃcopari ruṣānvitaḥ | bhagnadaṇḍo'bhavanmañcastaḍitpāte yathā drumaḥ || 28 || patito'pi sa vajrāṅga kiṃcidvyāyākulamānasaḥ | sahasotthāya yuyudhe śrīkṛṣṇena mahātmanā || 29 || nītvā taṃ bhujadaṇḍābhyāṃ maṃce kṣiptvā punaḥ prabhuḥ | āruhya hṛdayaṃ tasya mauliṃ jagrāha mādhava || 30 || sadyaḥ pragṛhya keśeṣu raṃgopari hariḥ svayam | maṃcāttaṃ pātayāmāsa śailādgaṃḍaśilāmiva || 31 || tasyopariṣṭhācchrīkṛṣṇaḥ sarvādhāraḥ sanātanaḥ | nipapāta svayaṃ vegādananto'naṃtavikramaḥ || 32 || itthaṃ dvayornipātena nimnaṃ bhūkhaṃḍamaṃḍalam | sthālīva sahasā rājañcakaṃpe ghaṭikādvayam || 33 || saṃparetaṃ bhojarājaṃ bhūmau taṃ vicakarṣa ha | yathā mṛgendro nāgendraṃ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ nṛpa || 34 || hāhākārastadaivāsīddhāvatāṃ bhūbhujāṃ nṛpa | vairabhāvena deveśaṃ bhajankaṃso mahābalaḥ || 35 || jagāma tasya sārūpyaṃ bhṛṃgiṇaḥ kīṭako yathā | kaṃsaṃ prapatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhrātaro'ṣṭau mahābalāḥ | sunāmasṛṣṭinyagrodhatuṣṭimadrāṣṭrapālakāḥ || 36 || suhunā kaṃkaśaṃkubhyāṃ krodhaprasphuritādharāḥ | khaḍgacarmadharā yoddhuṃ kṛṣṇopari samāyayuḥ || 37 || vīkṣya tānmudgaraṃ nītvā rohiṇīnaṃdano balaḥ | ārāccakāra huṃkāraṃ yathā siṃho mṛgānprati || 38 || huṃkāreṇaiva śastrāṇi teṣāṃ hastebhya ābhayāt | peturāmraphalānīva daṇḍaghātaiśca maithila || 39 || niḥśastrāste mahāvīrā muṣṭibhiḥ sarvato balam | teḍuḥ śailaṃ yathā nāgā śuṃḍādaṇḍairitastataḥ || 40 || sṛṣṭiṃ tathā sunāmānaṃ mudgareṇa balo'hanat | nyagrodhaṃ bhujavegena kaṃkaṃ vāmakareṇa vai || 41 || śaṃkuṃ suhuṃ tuṣṭimaṃtaṃ vāmapādena mādhavaḥ | rāṣṭrapālaṃ dakṣiṇena pādenābhijaghāna ha || 42 || aṣṭau nipetuḥ sahasā vṛkṣā vātahatā iva | teṣāṃ jyotirbhagavati līnaṃ jātaṃ videharāṭ || 43 || devadundubhayo nedurjayadhvanirabhūttadā | sadyo vai vavṛṣurdevāḥ puṣpairnaṃdanasaṃbhavaiḥ || 44 || vidyādharyaśca gaṃdharvyo nanṛturharṣavihvalāḥ | vidyādharaśca gaṃdharvāḥ kinnarāstadyaśo jaguḥ || 45 || brahmādyā munayaḥ siddhā vimānairdraṣṭumāgatāḥ | tuṣṭuvū rāmakṛṣṇau tau vāgbhiḥ śrutiparāyaṇāḥ || 46 || tāḍayaṃtya uro hastaiḥ astiprāptyādayaḥ striyaḥ | vinirgatāstā rurudurjātavaidhavyaduḥkhitāḥ || 47 || striya ūcuḥ hā nātha he yuddhapate kva gato'si mahābala| trailokyavijayī sākṣāddevānāmapi durjayaḥ || 48 || jātamātrāḥ svasuḥ putrā nirghṛṇena tvayā hatāḥ | anirdaśā nirdaśāścāpare'pi nihatā balāt || 49 || tena pāpena ghoreṇa daśāmetādṛśīṃ gataḥ || 50 || śrīnārada uvāca evamaśrumukhīrdīnā āśvāsya nṛpayoṣitaḥ | vidhāya yamunātīre citāḥ śrīkhaṃḍasaṃyutāḥ || 51 || hatānāṃ kārayitvā'sau kriyāṃ vai pāralaukikīm | sarvānsaṃbodhayāmāsa bhagavām̐llokabhāvanaḥ || 52 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mathurākhaṃḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde kaṃsavadho nāma aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||
<5.9> śrīnārada uvāca atha devau rāmakṛṣṇau devakīvasudevayoḥ | samīpaṃ jagmatuḥ sākṣādvṛṣṇibhiḥ parivāritau || 1 || svatastayorbandhanāni yayuḥ śithilatāṃ nṛpa | tau vīkṣya garuḍaṃ prāptaṃ nāgapāśaguṇā yathā || 2 || svaprabhāvavidau vīkṣya pitarau sabalo hariḥ | sadyastatāna svāṃ māyāṃ jaganmohakarīṃ balāt || 3 || rāmakṛṣṇau sutau jñātvā śaurirmohasamākulaḥ | devakyā sahāsotthāya sasvaje cāśrupūritaḥ || 4 || tāvāśvāsya hariḥ sadyo vṛṣṇibhiḥ parivāritaḥ | mātāmahaṃ tūgrasenaṃ cakāra mathurādhipam || 5 || āhūya yādavānkaṃsabhayāddeśāṃtaraṃ gatān | premṇā nivāsayāmāsa sakuṭumbān yadoḥ puri || 6 || naṃdarājaṃ gopagaṇaiḥ svagṛhān gaṃtumudyatam | natvā taṃ sabalaḥ prāha mohayanniva māyayā || 7 || atraiva vāsaṃ kuru tāta puryāṃ gaṃtuṃ yadīcchā manasotthitā syāt | paścādahaṃ vai sabalo yadūn vā vidhāya pārśvaṃ tava cāgamiṣye || 8 || śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ śrīrāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ naṃdarājaḥ prapūjitaḥ | āliṃgya śauriṃ gopālairyayau premāturo vrajam || 9 || dattaṃ śrīkṛṣṇajanmarkṣe dhenūnāṃ niyutaṃ purā | brāhmaṇebhyo dadau śaurirvastramālāsvalaṃkṛtam || 10 || śaurirgargaṃ samāhūya śrīkṛṣṇabaladevayoḥ | yajñopavītaṃ vidhivatkārayāmāsa dharmavit || 11 || rāmakṛṣṇau sarvavidyādhyayanaṃ kartumudyatau | guroḥ sāṃdīpaneḥ pārśvaṃ jagmaturjanavatparau || 12 || kṛtvā parāṃ guroḥ sevāṃ laghukālena mādhavau | sarvavidyāṃ jagṛhatuḥ sarvavidyāvidāṃ varau || 13 || gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dātumudyatau tau kṛtāñjalī | mṛtaṃ putraṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ tābhyāṃ vavre gururdvijaḥ || 14 || rathamāruhya tau dāṃtau śātakumbhaparicchadam | prabhāse cābdhinikaṭaṃ jagmaturbhīmavikramau || 15 || sadyaḥ prakaṃpitaḥ sindhū ratnopāyanamuttamam | nitvā taccaraṇopāṃte nipapāta kṛtāñjaliḥ || 16 || tamāha bhagavāñchīghraṃ putraṃ dehi gurormama | pracaṃḍormighaṭāṭopaistvayā tadgrahaṇaṃ kṛtam || 17 || samudra uvāca bhagavan devadeveśa na mayā bālako hṛtaḥ | hṛtaḥ paṃcajanenāsau śaṃkharūpāsureṇa vai || 18 || vasan sadā madudare baliṣṭho daityapuṃgavaḥ | jetuṃ yogyastvayā deva devānāṃ bhayakārakaḥ || 19 || śrīnārada uvāca tenekto bhagavānkṛṣṇo vāso baddhvā kaṭau dṛḍham | nipapāta mahāvegātsamudre bhīmanādini || 20 || śrīkṛṣṇasya nipātena trilokībhāradhāriṇaḥ | cakaṃpe'bdhirbhṛśaṃ vajrakūṭeneva videharāṭ || 21 || tataḥ paṃcajano daityo yoddhuṃ śrīkṛṣṇasaṃmukhe | āgataḥ sahasā vīraḥ śūlaṃ cikṣepa mādhave || 22 || haste gṛhītvā tacchūlaṃ tenaivābhijaghāna tam | tadghātena prapatito mūrcchito vārimaṃḍale || 23 || sahasotthāya deveśaṃ kiṃcidvyāyākulamānasaḥ | mūrdhnā tatāḍa pakṣīṃdraṃ svaphaṇena phaṇī yathā || 24 || paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣāt śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavān hariḥ | kruddho mūrddhani vegena muṣṭinā taṃ tatāḍa ha || 25 || kṛṣṇamuṣṭiprahāreṇa sadyo vai nidhanaṃ gataḥ | tajjyotiḥ śrīghanaśyāme līnaṃ jātaṃ videharāṭ || 26 || evaṃ hatvā paṃcajanaṃ śaṃkhaṃ nītvā tadaṃgajam | mahārṇavānnirgato'sau sahasā rathamāgamat || 27 || vāyuvegena yānena rāmakṛṣṇau manoharau | jagmatuḥ śamanasyāpi dīrghāṃ saṃyamanīṃ purīm || 28 || pāṃcajanyadhvanirlokaṃ pracaṃḍo meghaghoṣavat | pūrayāmāsa taṃ śrutvā cakaṃpe sasabho yamaḥ || 29 || caturaśītilakṣeṣu narakeṣu nipātitāḥ | yairyaiḥ śrutā dhvaniste te jagmurmokṣaṃ tu pāpinaḥ || 30 || yamaḥ sadyo baliṃ nītvā śrīkṛṣṇabaladevayoḥ | papāta caraṇopāṃte dharṣitaḥ sankṛtāñjaliḥ || 31 || yama uvāca he hare he kṛpāsindho rāma rāma mahābala | asaṃkhyabrahmāṃḍapatī paripūrṇatamau yuvām || 32 || devau purāṇau puruṣau mahāṃtau sarveśvarau sarvajagajjaneśau | adyaiva sarvopari vartamānau girā nijājñāṃ vadataṃ pareśau || 33 || śrībhagavānuvāca guruputraṃ lokapāla ānayasva mahāmate | rājyaṃ kuru yathānyāyaṃ maduktaṃ mānayan kvacit || 34 || śrīnārada uvāca tadaiva tenopānītaṃ guruputraṃ hariḥ svayam | gṛhītvā'vaṃtikāmetya dadau śrīgurave śiśum || 35 || gurvāśiṣā saṃyutau tau natvā taṃ hi kṛtāñjalī | rathamāruhya mathurāmāgatau yadupūjitau || 36 || ekadā sabalaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvakāraṇakārakaḥ | pāṃḍavānsaṃsmaranbhaktānakrūrabhavanaṃ yayau || 37 || akrūraḥ sahasotthāya parirabhya mudānvitaḥ | upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pūjayitvā'tha tau nṛpa || 38 || kṛtāṃjaliḥ puraḥ sthitvā jātapūrṇamanorathaḥ | uvācānaṃdajanitāṃ muṃcanbāṣpakalāṃ nṛpa || 39 || akrūra uvāca yuvābhyāṃ rāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ tābhyāṃ nityaṃ namo namaḥ | yābhyāṃ mārge yaduktaṃ me pūrṇaṃ tacca kṛtaṃ prabhū || 40 || lokābhirāmau janabhūṣaṇottamau cāṃtarbahiḥsarvajagatpradīpakau | goviprasādhuśrutidharmadevatārakṣārthamadyaiva yadoḥ kule gatau || 41 || kaṃsādidaityendravināśahetave golokalokātparipūrṇatejasau | samāgatau bhāratabhūmimaṃḍale yuvāṃ pareśau satataṃ nato'smyaham || 42 || śrībhagavānuvāca tvamāryavṛddho dhṛtimānahaṃ tava puraḥ śiśuḥ | saṃto naḥ svātmanaḥ ślāghyaṃ kurvaṃti hi mahāmate || 43 || pāṃḍavānāṃ hi kuśalaṃ draṣṭuṃ gaccha gajāhvayam | śīghramāgaccha tāndṛṣṭvā sarvān dānapate bhavān || 44 || śrīnārada uvāca evamuktvā tadā'krūraṃ bhagavān bhaktavatsalaḥ | sabalaḥ śauribhavanamāyayau sarvakāryakṛt || 45 || kauravendrapuraṃ gatvā'krūro dṛṣṭvā'tha pāṃḍavān | punarāgatya kṛṣṇāya vārtāṃ sarvāmavarṇayat || 46 || akrūra uvāca vinā yuvāṃ ko'pi na pāṃḍavānāṃ sahāyakṛtkaurava duḥkhabhoginām | mṛte ca pāṃḍau bhavatoḥ padāṃbuje vilagnacittā hi pṛthātmajā ye || 47 || śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvā'krūramukhāt śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānhariḥ | ardhaṃ rājyaṃ pāṃḍavebhyaḥ kauravāṇāṃ balāddadau || 48 || athoktaṃ vacanaṃ smṛtvā tadoddhavasamanvitaḥ | mahāmaṃgalasaṃyuktaṃ kubjāyā bhavanaṃ yayau || 49 || dṛṣṭvārācchrīhariṃ prāptaṃ kubjā rūpavatī tvaram | bhaktyā samarhayāmāsa pādyādyaiḥ prāṇavallabham || 50 || hemaratnakhacitkuḍye kubjāyā bhavanottame | babhau harī rūpavatyā vaikuṇṭhe ramayā yathā || 51 || paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam | yasyāḥ patirabhūdrājannaho tasyāstapo mahat || 52 || tatra sthitvā harirdevo dinānyaṣṭau videharāṭ | āyayau śauribhavanaṃ līlāmānuṣavigrahaḥ || 53 || iti śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ mathurāyāṃ videharāṭ | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyamāyurvarddhanamuttamam || 54 || catuṣpadārthadaṃ nṝṇāṃ śrīkṛṣṇavaśakārakam | mayā te kathitaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 55 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mathurākhaṃḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde yadusaukhyaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||
<5.10> bahulāśva uvāca śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ puṇyaṃ mayā tava mukhācchrutam | punaḥ śrotuṃ manaścādya tṛṣito vā jalaṃ gataḥ || 1 || kaṃsasya janmakarmāṇi tvayoktāni śrutāni me | keśyādidaityavaryāṇāṃ pūrvajanmakṛtaṃ śrutam || 2 || ko'yaṃ tu rajakaḥ pūrvamavadhīdyaṃ hariḥ katham | aho yasya mahajjyotiḥ kṛṣṇe līnaṃ babhūva ha || 3 || śrīnārada uvāca tretāyuge tvayodhyāyāṃ rāmarājye videharāṭ | cārāṇāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ kaścidrajako hyavadatpriyām || 4 || nāhaṃ bibharmi tvāṃ duṣṭāmuśatīṃ paraveśmagām | strīlobhī bibhṛyātsītāṃ rāmo nāhaṃ bhaje punaḥ || 5 || iti lokādbahumukhādvākyaṃ śrutvā'tha rāghavaḥ | sītāṃ tatyāja sahasā vane lokāpavādataḥ || 6 || tasmai daṃḍaṃ dātumicchāṃ na cakre rāghavottamaḥ | mathurāyāṃ dvāparāṃte rajakaḥ sa babhūva ha || 7 || kuvākyadoṣaśāṃtyarthaṃ taṃ jaghāna hariḥ svayam | tadapi pradadau mokṣaṃ tasmai śrīkaruṇānidhiḥ || 8 || dayāloḥ kṛṣṇacandrasya caritraṃ paramādbhutam | etatte kathitaṃ rājan kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 9 || bahulāśva uvāca purā vai vāyakaḥ ko'yaṃ nitarāṃ munisattama | yasmai dadau ca sārūpyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānhariḥ || 10 || śrīnārada uvāca mithilānagare pūrvaṃ vāyako haribhaktikṛt | śrīrāmodvāhasamaye sīradhvajanṛpājñayā || 11 || rāmalakṣmaṇaveṣārthaṃ vāsāṃsi racayan kila | laghusūtraiḥ parivayan kuśalo vastrakarmasu || 12 || koṭikandarpalāvaṇyau sundarau rāmalakṣmaṇau | tau vīkṣya vāyako rājanmohito'bhūnmahāmanāḥ || 13 || ahaṃ svahastairvastrāṇi tayoraṃgeṣu sarvataḥ | paridhānaṃ kārayāmi cakre cetthaṃ manoratham || 14 || manasā'pi varaṃ rāmo dadau tasmā aśeṣavit | dvāparāṃte bhārate ca bhaviṣyati manorathaḥ || 15 || śrīrāmasya varātso'yaṃ mathurāyāṃ babhūva ha | tayorveṣaṃ kārayitvā tatsārūpyaṃ jagāma ha || 16 || bahulāśva uvāca sudāmnā mālinā brahman kiṃ kṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ vada | yadgṛhaṃ jagmatuḥ sākṣādrāmakṛṣṇau manoharau || 17 || śrīnārada uvāca rājarājavanaṃ ramyaṃ nāmnā caitrarathaṃ śubham | tasya vai puṣpabaṭuko hemamālīti nāmabhāk || 18 || viṣṇubhaktirataḥ śānto dānī satsaṃgakṛnmahān | śrīviṣṇudevaprāptyarthaṃ devapūjāṃ cakāra ha || 19 || samāḥ paṃcasahasrāṇi padmānāṃ ca śatatrayam | nityaṃ nītvā dhūrjaṭaye puro dhṛtvā nanāma ha || 20 || ekadā'tiprasanno'bhūttryambakaḥ karuṇānidhiḥ | mālākāra mahābuddhe varaṃ brūhītyuvāca ha || 21 || hemamālī tadā devaṃ namaskṛtya kṛtāñjaliḥ | pradakṣiṇīkṛtya puraḥ sthitvā prāha natānanaḥ || 22 || hemamālyuvāca paripūrṇatamaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kvacinno gṛhamāgatam | paśyāmi dṛgbhyāṃ taṃ sākṣāttvadvareṇa bhavedidam || 23 || śrīmahādeva uvāca dvāparāṃte bhārate ca mathurāyāṃ mahāmate | manorathaste saphalo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 24 || śrīnārada uvāca maheśvaravareṇāsau hemamālī mahāmanāḥ | mālākāro dvāparāṃte sudāmā saṃbabhūva ha || 25 || tasmādasya gṛhaṃ sākṣāt jagmatū rāmakeśavau | śivavākyāmṛtaṃ kartuṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 26 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mathurākhaṃḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde rajakavāyakasudāmopākhyānaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||
<5.11> bahulāśva uvāca sairandhryā kiṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ tapaḥ paramadurghaṭam | yena prasannaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo devairapi sudurlabhaḥ || 1 || śrīnārada uvāca paṃcavaṭyā sthitaṃ rāmaṃ koṭikandarpasannibham | vīkṣya śūrpaṇakhā nāmnī rākṣasī mohitā bhṛśam || 2 || nirmohaṃ rāghavaṃ dṛṣṭvā'thaikapatnivratasthitam | krodhātsītāṃ bhakṣayituṃ dhāvatī rāvaṇasvasā || 3 || khaḍgena śitadhāreṇa lakṣmaṇo rāghavānujaḥ | jahāra tasyāḥ karṇau ca nāsāṃ sadyo ruṣānvitaḥ || 4 || chinnanāsā gatā laṃkāṃ rāvaṇāya nyavedayat | bhūyaḥ puṣkaratīrthe sā jagāma vimanā bhṛśam || 5 || tapaścakre śūrpaṇakhā varṣāṇāmayutaṃ jale | dhyāyaṃtī tryaṃbakaṃ devaṃ śrīrāmaṃ varamicchatī || 6 || tataḥ prasanno bhagavāndevadeva umāpatiḥ | etya tatpuṣkaraṃ tīrthaṃ varaṃ brūhītyuvāca ha || 7 || śūrpaṇakhovāca śrīrāmo me varo bhūyādvaraṃ dehi satāṃ priyaḥ | tvaṃ devadeva paramaḥ sarvāsāṃ āśiṣāṃ prabhuḥ || 8 || śrīśiva uvāca adyaiva saphalo na syādvaraste śṛṇu rākṣasi | dvāparāṃte māthure ca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 9 || śrīnārada uvāca saiva śūrpaṇakhā nāma rākṣasī kāmarūpiṇī | abhūcchrīmathurāyāṃ tu kubjānāma mahāmate || 10 || mahādeva vareṇāpi śrīkṛṣṇasya priyā'bhavat | idaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 11 || bahulāśva uvāca ko'yaṃ kuvalayāpīḍaḥ pūrvajanmani nārada | kathaṃ gajatvaṃ āpannaḥ śrīkṛṣṇe līnatāṃ gataḥ || 12 || śrīnārada uvāca baliputro mahākāyo nāmnā mandagatirbalī | sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭho lakṣanāgasamo balī || 13 || ekadā nirgataḥ so'pi raṃgayātrāṃ janeṣu ca | mattebhavajjanānvegādbhujābhyāṃ parimardayan || 14 || tadbāhuvegātpatitaḥ pathi vṛddhastrito muniḥ | kruddhaḥ śaśāpa taṃ mattaṃ baliṣṭhaṃ balinandanam || 15 || trita uvāca gajavattvaṃ madonmatto'bhūrjanānparimardayan | vicaran raṃgayātrāyāṃ tvaṃ gajo bhava durmate || 16 || evaṃ śaptastadā daityo nāmnā mandagatirbalī | patat kaṃcukavaddeho bhraṣṭatejā babhūva ha || 17 || muneḥ prabhāvavitsadyo daityo bhūtvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ | natvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tritaṃ munimuvāca ha || 18 || maṃdagatiruvāca he mune he kṛpāsindho tvaṃ yogīndro dvijottamaḥ | gajatvānme kadāmuktirbhaviṣyati vadāśu mām || 19 || tvādṛśānāṃ satāṃ mābhūt helanaṃ me kvacinmune | tvādṛśā munayo brahman samarthā varaśāpayoḥ || 20 || śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ prasāditastena trito nāma mahāmuniḥ | gatakrodho'bravīddaityaṃ kṛpālurbrāhmaṇottamaḥ || 21 || trita uvāca vacanaṃ me mṛṣā na syāt tvadbhaktyā harṣito'smyaham | te dāsyābhi varaṃ divyaṃ devānāmapi durlabham || 22 || mā śokaṃ kuru daityendra mathurāyāṃ hareḥ puri | śrīkṛṣṇahastātte muktirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 23 || śrīnārada uvāca so'yaṃ mandagatirdaityo gajo'bhūdviṃdhyaparvate | nāmnā kuvalayāpīḍo nāgāyutasamo bale || 24 || gṛhīto māgadhendreṇa balāllakṣagajairvane | so'yaṃ dattastu kaṃsāya pāribarhe videharāṭ || 25 || tritavākyāttasya dhāma śrīkṛṣṇe līnatāṃ gatam | idaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 26 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mathurākhaṃḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde kubjākuvalayāpīḍavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||
<5.12> bahulāśva uvāca cāṇūrādyāśca ye mallāste ke pūrvamihāgatāḥ | aho śrīkṛṣṇacandreṇa yeṣāṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva ha || 1 || śrīnārada uvāca rājan purā'marāvatyāmutathyo'sti mahāmuniḥ | tasyābhavan paṃca putrāḥ kāmadevasamaprabhāḥ || 2 || hitvā vidyāṃ cādhyayanaṃ japaṃ tena sahaiva te | gatvā balermallayuddhaṃ sadā'śikṣan madoddhatāḥ || 3 || brahmakarmaparibhraṣṭānvedādhyayanavarjitān | ruṣā prāha sa tānmattānutathyo munisattamaḥ || 4 || utathya uvāca śamo damastapaḥ śaucaṃ kṣāṃtirārjavameva ca | jñānaṃ vijñānamāstikyaṃ brahmakarma svabhāvajam || 5 || śauryaṃ tejo dhṛtirdākṣyaṃ yuddhe cāpyapalāyanam | dānamīśvarabhāvaśca kṣātraṃ karma svabhāvajam || 6 || kṛṣigorakṣyavāṇijyaṃ vaiśyakarmasvabhāvajam | paricaryātmakaṃ karma śūdrasyāpi svabhāvajam || 7 || brahmakarma parityaktā bhavaṃto brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ | mallayuddhaṃ kṣātrayuddhaṃ kathaṃ kuruta durjanāḥ || 8 || tasmādbhavaṃto śrūyāsurmallā vai bhāratājire | asurāṇāṃ prasaṃgena durjanā bhavatāśu hi || 9 || śrīnārada uvāca utathyasya sutāste vai jātā mallā mahītale | śrīkṛṣṇāṃgasparśamātrātparaṃ mokṣaṃ yayurnṛpa || 10 || cāṇūro muṣṭikaḥ kūṭaḥ śalastośala eva ca | eṣāṃ caritraṃ kathitaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 11 || bahulāśva uvāca kaṃsānujā bhrātaro'ṣṭau kaṃkanyagrodhakādayaḥ | te ke pūrvaṃ vada mune ye'pi mokṣaṃ paraṃ gatāḥ || 12 || śrīnārada uvāca alakāyāṃ purā yakṣo devayakṣa iti smṛtaḥ | jñānī jñānaparo mānyaḥ śivabhaktyā mahādyutiḥ || 13 || tasya cāṣṭau sutā jātā devakūṭo mahāgiriḥ | gaṃḍo daṇḍaḥ pracaṇḍaśca khaṃḍadaṇḍaḥ pṛthustathā || 14 || ekadā śivapūjāyāṃ devayakṣeṇa noditāḥ | sahasraṃ puṃḍarīkāṇi cāhartumaruṇodaye || 15 || puṣpāṇi mānasānnītvā śabditāni madhuvrataiḥ | āghrāya gaṃdhalobhena daduste janakāya vai || 16 || ucchiṣṭīkṛtadoṣeṇa śivapūjā tiraskṛtā | āsurīṃ yonimāpannā mūḍhāste janmabhistribhiḥ || 17 || hastābhyāṃ śaṃkarābhyāṃ ca baladevasya maithila | paraṃ mokṣaṃ gatāste vai doṣānmuktā videharāṭ || 18 || kaṃsānujānāṃ vyākhyānaṃ pūrvajanmabhavaṃ nṛpa | idaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 19 || śrībahulāśva uvāca koyaṃ purā paṃcajano daityaḥ śaṃkhavapurdharaḥ | tasya śaṅkho babhau brahman śrīkṛṣṇakarapaṅkaje || 20 || śrīnārada uvāca puraivaitānyupāṃgāni cakrādīni videharāṭ | trailokyanāthasya harerbabhūvustejasā hatāḥ || 21 || teṣāṃ śaṃkhaḥ pāṃcajanyaḥ prāpto rājanmahatpadam | papau tanmukhalagno'sau śrīkṛṣṇasyādharāmṛtam || 22 || akaroccaikadā mānaṃ manasi prāha śaṃkharāṭ | gṛhīto'haṃ hi hariṇā rājahaṃsasamadyutiḥ || 23 || śrīkṛṣṇo dakṣiṇāvartaṃ daghmau māṃ vijaye sati | yaddurlabhaṃ cābdhiputryāḥ śrīkṛṣṇasyādharāmṛtam || 24 || tattasmātsarvamukhyo'smi pibāmyahamaharniśam | iti mānayutaṃ śaṃkhaṃ pāṃcajanyaṃ videharāṭ || 25 || śaśāpa lakṣmīstaṃ krodhāttvaṃ daityo bhava durmate | so'yaṃ paṃcajano nāma daityo'bhūtsaritāṃ patau || 26 || vairabhāvena deveśaṃ punaḥ prāpto dareśvaraḥ | jyotirlīnaṃ tu deveśe vapuryasya kare vabhau | ahobhāgyaṃ viddhi tasya kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 27 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mathurākhaṃḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde cāṇūrādikaṃsabhrātṛpaṃcajanapūrvākhyānaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||
<5.13> bahulāśva uvāca agre cakāra kiṃ kāryaṃ mathurāyāṃ yadūttamaḥ | nivāsayitvā svajñātīn vadaitanmunisattama || 1 || śrīnārada uvāca paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣād bhagavān bhaktavatsalaḥ | sasmāra gokulaṃ dīnaṃ gopagopālasaṃkulam || 2 || ekadā''hūya rahasi sakhāyaṃ bhaktamuddhavam | uvāca bhagavāndevaḥ premagadgadayā girā || 3 || śrībhagavānuvāca gaccha śīghraṃ vrajaṃ he sakhe sundaraṃ śrīlatākuṃjapuṃjādibhirmaṃḍitam | śailakṛṣṇaprabhācāruvṛdāvanaṃ gopagopīgaṇairgokulaṃ saṃkulam || 4 || ekapatraṃ tu naṃdāya vai dīyatāṃ vā dvitīyaṃ yaśodākare caiva bhoḥ | vā tṛtīyaṃ tvidaṃ rādhikāyai sakhe tatra gatvā hi tanmaṃdiraṃ suṃdaram || 5 || vā caturthaṃ sakhibhyaḥ śiśubhyaḥ śubhaṃ kauśalaṃ dīyatāṃ patramevaṃ pṛthak bhoḥ sakhe | gopikānāṃ śatebhyaśca yūthebhya unmohitānāṃ ca deyāni patrāṇī ca || 6 || me pitā naṃdarājo ghṛṇī manmanā me ca mātā yaśodā smaratyāśu mām | vākyavṛndaiḥ śubhairnītivitvaṃ tayorme parāṃ prītimārāddvayorāvaha || 7 || matpriyā rādhikā madviyogāturā manyate māṃ vinā khaṃ jaganmohataḥ | madviyogādhimasyā maduktaiḥ padairmocaya tvaṃ bhavān dakṣiṇo vākpathe || 8 || gopabālāḥ sudāmādayo matpriyā māṃ sakhāyaṃ vinā te'pi mohāturāḥ | dehi teṣāṃ sukhaṃ mitravacchrīvraje svalpakālena tatrāgamiṣyāmyaham || 9 || gopikā madviyogādhivegāturā manmanaskāśca matprāptadehāsavaḥ | yā madarthe ca saṃtyaktalokābalāstāḥ kathaṃ nātra maṃtrin bibharmi svataḥ || 10 || tā asūn tyaktumatrodyatā uddhava yābhiradyāpi kṛcchrairdhṛtāścāsavaḥ | madviyogādhimāsāṃ maduktaḥ padairmocaya tvaṃ bhavāndakṣiṇo vākpathe || 11 || yena pūrvaṃ vrajādāgato'haṃ sakhe taṃ rathaṃ sāśvasūtaṃ raṇadghaṇṭikaṃ vai | me ca sārūpyamadyaiva pītāṃbaraṃ vaijayaṃtīsahasracchadaṃ paṃkajam || 12 || kuṇḍale divyaratnaprabhāmaṃḍite koṭibālārkadīptaṃ maṇiṃ kaustubham | me mahānādinīṃ cāruvaṃśīṃ śubhāṃ puṣpayuktāṃ ca yaṣṭiṃ jaganmohinīm || 13 || caṃdanaṃ suṃdaraṃ divyagaṃdhāvṛtaṃ barhamallādiveṣaṃ kvaṇannūpuram | maulimevaṃ gṛhāṇāṃgade uddhava gaccha gacchāśu cādyaiva madvākyataḥ || 14 || śrīnārada uvāca ityukta uddhavaḥ śīghraṃ namaskṛtya kṛtāṃjaliḥ | kṛṣṇaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya rathāruḍho vrajaṃ yayau || 15 || koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo gāvo yatra yatra manoharāḥ | śvetaparvatasaṃkāśā divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 16 || payasvinyastaruṇyaśca śīlarūpaguṇairyutāḥ | savatsāḥ pītapucchāśca vrajaṃtyo bhavyamūrtikāḥ || 17 || ghaṃṭāmaṃjīrajhaṃkārāḥ kiṃkiṇījālamaṃḍitāḥ | hematulyā hemaśṛṅgyo hāramālāḥ sphuratprabhāḥ || 18 || pāṭalā haritāstāmrāḥ pītāḥ śyāmā vicitritāḥ | dhūmrāḥ kokilavarṇāśca yatra gāvastvanekadhā || 19 || samudravaddugdhadāśca taruṇīkaracitritāḥ | kuraṅgavadvilaṅghadbhirgovatsairmaṃḍitāḥ śubhāḥ || 20 || itastataścalaṃtaśca gogaṇeṣu mahāvṛṣāḥ | dīrghakandharaśṛṅgāḍhyā yatra dharmadhuraṃdharāḥ || 21 || gopālā vetrahastāśca śyāmavaṃśīdharāḥ parāḥ | kṛṣṇalīlāḥ pragāyaṃto rāgairmadanamohanaiḥ || 22 || dūrāttamāgataṃ vīkṣya jñātvā kṛṣṇaṃ vrajārbhakāḥ | ūcuḥ parasparaṃ te vai kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ || 23 || gopā ūcuḥ naṃdasūnūḥ kilāyāti sakhā yo'yaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | meghaśyāmaḥ pītavāsāḥ sragvī kuṇḍalamaṃḍitaḥ || 24 || kaustubhi kuṃḍalī bibhratsatsahasradalapaṃkajam | tadeva mukuṭaṃ bibhratkoṭimārtaṃḍasannibham || 25 || ta evāśvā rathaḥ so'yaṃ kiṃkiṇījālamaṃḍitaḥ | balo nāsti rathe cāsminnekākī naṃdanaṃdanaḥ || 26 || śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ vadaṃto gopālāḥ śrīdāmādyā videharāṭ | kṛṣṇākṛtiṃ kṛṣṇasakhamāyayuḥ sarvato ratham || 27 || kṛṣṇo nāstīti vadataḥ ko'yaṃ sākṣāttadākṛtiḥ | tānnamaskṛtyaupagaviḥ parirabhyāvadatpathi || 28 || uddhava uvāca gṛhāṇa patraṃ śrīdāman kṛṣṇadattaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | śokaṃ mā kuru gopālaiḥ kuśalyāste hariḥ svayam || 29 || yādavānāṃ mahatkāryaṃ kṛtvā'tha sabalaḥ prabhuḥ | hrasvakālena cātrāpi bhagavānāgamiṣyati || 30 || śrīnārada uvāca paṭhitvā taddhastapatraṃ śrīdāmādyā vrajārbhakāḥ | bhṛśamaśrūṇi muṃcaṃtaḥ prāhurgadgadayā girā || 31 || gopā ūcuḥ pāṃtheti nirmohini naṃdasūnau tanurvibhūtiśca dhanaṃ balaṃ ca | sarvā dhiyaḥ kṛṣṇamṛte vraje naḥ śūnyaṃ prajātaṃ hi jagatsamastam || 32 || kṣaṇo yugatvaṃ ca ghaṭī mahāmate prayāti manvantaratāṃ vrajaukasām | yāmaśca kalpaṃ ca dinaṃ vinā hariṃ viyogaduḥkhairdviparārdhatāṃ gatam || 33 || aharniśaṃ taṃ na hi vismarāmahe duṣṭā ghaṭī sā prayayau yayā hi saḥ | mano harannuddhava no vanaukasāṃ vayasyabhāvena sadā kṛtāgasām || 34 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ mathurākhaṃḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde uddhavāgamanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 ||
<5.14> śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ premabharān gopān śrīkṛṣṇavirahāturān | uvāca premasaṃyukta uddhavo gatavismayaḥ || 1 || uddhava uvāca ahaṃ śrīkṛṣṇodāso'smi tatpriyastadrahaskaraḥ | bhavatāṃ kuśalaṃ draṣṭuṃ preṣito hariṇā tvaram || 2 || purīṃ gatvā'tha haraye nivedya virahaṃ tu vaḥ | taṃ prasannaṃ kariṣyāmi tadaṅghrau netravāribhiḥ || 3 || nātvā hariṃ hi bhavatāṃ samīpaṃ he vrajaukasaḥ | āgamiṣyāmyahaṃ śīghraṃ śapatho na mṛṣā mama || 4 || yūyaṃ prasannā bhavata mā śokaṃ kurutātha vai | asminvraje'pi gopālā drakṣyatha śrīpatiṃ harim || 5 || śrīnārada uvāca evamāśvāsya gopālān rathastho yadunandanaḥ | śrīdāmādyaiśva gopālaiḥ sahito harṣapūritaḥ || 6 || viveśa nandanagaraṃ sūrye sindhugate sati | āgataṃ hyuddhavaṃ śrutvā nandarājo mahāmatiḥ | parirabhya mudā śīghraṃ pūjayāmāsa harṣitaḥ || 7 || kaśipusthaṃ sthitaṃ śāṃtamuddhavaṃ kṛtabhojanam | kaśipustho naṃdarājaḥ prāha gadgadayā girā || 8 || nanda uvāca kaccitsakhā me puri śūrasena āste svaputraiḥ kuśalī mahāmate | kaṃse mṛte yādavapuṃgavānāṃ jātaṃ sakhe saukhyamataḥ paraṃ bhuvi || 9 || kaccitkadācitsabalo hi mādhavaḥ smaratyasau vā jananīṃ yaśomatīm | gopālagovardhanagogaṇānvrajaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ vā pulinaṃ taraṃgiṇīm || 10 || hā daiva kasminsamaye svanandanaṃ biṃbādharaṃ sundaramaṃbujekṣaṇam | drakṣyāmyahaṃ mandiracatvārājire 'rbhakairluṭhaṃtaṃ sabalaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 11 || kuṃjo nikuṃjo yamunā mahānadī govardhano'raṇyamidaṃ vanāni | gṛhairlatāvṛkṣagavāṃ gaṇaiḥ saha vinā mukuṃdaṃ viṣavattvidaṃ jagat || 12 || dhigjīvanaṃ me śayanaṃ ca bhojanaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinā padmadalāyatekṣaṇam | candraṃ vinā bhūmitale cakoravajjīvāmi tasyāgamanāśayā bhṛśam || 13 || hartuṃ bhuvo bharamatīva daivataiḥ saṃprārthitaṃ pūrṇatamaṃ mahāmate | jātaṃ satāṃ rakṣaṇatatparaṃ svayaṃ manye hi kṛṣṇaṃ sabalaṃ parātparam || 14 || śrīnārada uvāca saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya hariṃ pareśaṃ babhūva tūṣṇīṃ navanandarājaḥ | śiro nidhāyāpyupabarhaṇe sve hyutkaṃṭharomāṃcitavihvalāṃgaḥ || 15 || śrīnandanetrāṃbujavārisaṃtatī rājaṃstadā kṛṣṇasakhasya paśyataḥ | śayyāṃ savastrāmupabarhaṇāṃtāṃ kṛtvā''rdratāṃ prāṃgaṇa ācacāla || 16 || śrutvoddhavaṃ śrīmathurāpurāgataṃ kapāṭametyāśu yaśomatī satī | śṛṇvaṃtyalaṃ svasya sutasya varṇanaṃ snehasravat sustananetrapaṃkajā || 17 || vihāya lajjāṃ ghṛṇayā sutasya sā papraccha sarvaṃ kuśalaṃ tadoddhavam | āprokṣya vastreṇa dṛgaśrutasaṃtatiṃ sthite ca nande haribhāvavihvale || 18 || śrīyaśodovāca kvacitsmarati māṃ kṛṣṇo nandarājamathāpi vā | bhrātaraṃ naṃdarājasya sannandaṃ darśanotsukam || 19 || naṃdānavopanandāṃśca vṛṣabhānūn vrajeṣu ṣaṭ | yeṣāmārohamāsthāya bālakelirvane vane
