niścakrāma śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 2 || koṭicandrapratīkāśāṃ bhaiṣmīṃ kamalalocanām | akasmāddadṛśurvīrāḥ sunidhiṃ nirdhanā yathā || 3 || āśvārūḍhāśca rathino gajinaśca padātayaḥ | samāgatā rakṣiṇaste mumuhurvīkṣya rukmiṇīm || 4 || tadapāṃgasmitaistīkṣṇaiḥ bāṇaiḥ kāmadhanuścyutaiḥ | ujjhitāstrā nipetuḥ kāvarditāḥ sainikāstadā || 5 || rathena vāyuvegena ghaṇṭāmañjīranādinā | naiḥśreyasaṃbhavairaśvairyutenātipatākinā || 6 || śīghraṃ svasainyasaṃghaṭṭāttatsainyaṃ saṃvidārayat | vāyuryathā padmavanaṃ harirdārukasārathiḥ || 7 || strīkadambakametyāśu paśyatāṃ dviṣatāṃ prabhuḥ | samāropya rathaṃ bhaiṣmīṃ tārkṣyaputraḥ sudhāmiva || 8 || devānāṃ paśyatāṃ rājan rājakanyāṃ jahāra ha | divyaṃ śastrottamaṃ śārṅgaṃ dhanuṣṭaṃkārayanmuhuḥ || 9 || tato vegena mahatā svasainyaṃ cāgate harau | devadundubhayo neduryadudundubhayastadā || 10 || siddhāśca siddhakanyāśca śrīkṛṣṇasya rathopari | harṣitā vavṛṣurdevāḥ puṣpairnaṃdanasaṃbhavai || 11 || tato yayau jayārāvaiḥ śanai rāmayuto hariḥ | śrṛgālasaṃghamadhyācca kesarī bhāgahṛdyathā || 12 || tadā kolāhale jāte rumiṇīharaṇe sati | babhūva rakṣakāṇāṃ ca śastrāśastri parasparam || 13 || jarāsaṃdhavaśāḥ sarve mānino nṛpasattamāḥ | na sehire svābhibhavaṃ paraṃ jātaṃ yaśaḥkṣayam || 14 || aho dhigasmānsvayaśo hṛtaṃ gopaiśca dhanvinām | śrṛgālairiva siṃhānāmataḥ kiṃ syātparājayaḥ || 15 || evamuktvāḥ krodhaparā jagṛhuḥ śastrasaṃhatim | visṛjya krīḍanākṣādīn daṃśitāḥ sainyasaṃyutāḥ || 16 || akṣauhiṇīdvayenāpi pauṃḍrakaḥ krodhapūritaḥ | akṣauhiṇītrayeṇāpi mahāvīro vidūrathaḥ || 17 || akṣauhiṇīpañcayuto dantavakro'tidāruṇaḥ | akṣauhiṇītrayeṇāśu śālvo rājapureśvaraḥ || 18 || akṣauhiṇībhirdaśabhirjarāsaṃdho mahābalaḥ | āyayau saṃmukhe yoddhuṃ yādavānāṃ mahātmanām || 19 || anye'pi caidyapakṣīyā yoddhuṃ śrīkṛṣṇasaṃmukhe | dhanuṣṭaṃkārayaṃtaste samājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ || 20 || pralayābdhisamaṃ sainyaṃ samālokya yadūttamāḥ | tarttumājagmurārātte kṛṣṇakaivarttapotakāḥ || 21 || babhūva tumulaṃ yuddhamadbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam | sainyayośca svaparayordevadānavayoryathā || 22 || rathino rathibhistatra pattibhiḥ saha pattayaḥ | gajā gajairyuyudhire turagāśca turaṃgabhaiḥ || 23 || śastrāṃdhakāre saṃjāte rukmiṇīṃ bhayavihvalām | vilokya bhagavāndevo mā bhaiṣṭetyabhayaṃ dadau || 24 || baladevānujo vīro gado dhunvamahaddhanuḥ | viveśa śatrusaṃghaṭṭaṃ vanaṃ vahniriva prabhuḥ || 25 || gadabāṇavibhinnāṃgā rathinaśchinnakaṃcukāḥ | hatāśvā hatasūtāśca nipeturbhūmimaṇḍale || 26 || padātayaśchinnapadā gadabāṇāgatavyathāḥ | nipeturbhūtale rājan vṛkṣā vātahatā iva || 27 || aśvāruḍhāḥ ke'pi vīrā gadabāṇairvidāritāḥ | petū raṇāṃgaṇe sāśvā bṛhatīphalavannṛpa || 28 || gadabāṇairbhinnakumbhā madhye madhye vidāritāḥ | virejuḥ patitā bhūmau kūṣmāṃḍaśakalā iva || 29 || tataḥ palāyitaṃ sainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā śālvo mahābalaḥ | gadaṃ tatāḍa gadayā gadāyuddhaviśāradaḥ || 30 || gadāviddho gado dhanvī gadāyuddhaprabhāvavit | dhanuryuddhaṃ tu saṃtyajya tatkālānmanasā tvaram || 31 || parāṃ vyathāṃ gate yuddhe patito'pi samutthitaḥ | tadā'grajena yā dattā tāṃ gadā tu gado'grahīt || 32 || lakṣabhāramayī gurvī dṛḍhā kaumodakī yathā | tayā gado'hanacchālvaṃ vajreṇeṃdro yathā girim || 33 || gadāprahāramathite śālve nipatite bhuvi | pauṃḍrako'tha jarāsaṃdho dantavakro vidūrathaḥ || 34 || catvāra āyayustatra gadopari ruṣānvitāḥ | pauṃḍrako'pi mahāvīro gadasya rathagaṃ dhvajam || 35 || ciccheda daśabhirbāṇaiḥ kuvākyairmitratāmiva | dantavakrastu gadayā gadasyāpi rathaṃ śubham | cūrṇayāmāsa rājeṃdra daṇḍeneva sumṛddhaṭam || 36 || tathā'śvāṃśca jarāsaṃdhaḥ sārathi ca vidūrathaḥ | pātayāmāsa bhūpṛṣṭhe śitairbāṇairvideharāṭ || 37 || tato musalamādāya baladevastvaranbalī | vikarāle mukhe bhīme dantavakramatāḍayat || 38 || tato musalaghātena dantavakrasya yudhyataḥ | mukhe vakro'pi yo dantaḥ sa tu bhūmau papāta ha || 39 || tadā hasati daityārau rukmiṇīsahite harau | pauṃḍrakaṃ ca jarāsaṃdhaṃ tathā duṣṭaṃ vidūratham || 40 || jaghāna musalenāśu baladevo ruṣānvitaḥ | trayo'pi patitā yuddhe mūrchitāḥ kṣatajāplutāḥ || 41 || senāṃ samāgatāṃ sarvāṃ samākṛṣya halena vai | musalenāhanatkruddho baladevo mahābalaḥ || 42 || daśayojanaparyaṃtaṃ rathebhāśvapadātayaḥ | peśitāścūrṇitā bhūmau śayanā dharaṇīṃ gatāḥ || 43 || jarāsaṃdhādayaḥ sarve mṛtyuśeṣā nṛpāḥ pare | palāyitāścaidyametya procurnaṣṭotsavaṃ bhṛśam || 44 || bho bhoḥ puruṣaśārdūla daurmanasyamidaṃ tyaja | kimekena vivāhena bhavitā te śataṃ bhuvi || 45 || adyaiva dvārakāṃ gatvā baddhvā rāmaṃ samādhavam | ayādavīṃ kariṣyāmaḥ pṛthvīṃ sāgaramekhalām || 46 || evaṃ sambodhito mitraiścaidyo'gāccaṃdrikāpuram | yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ puraṃ sarve hataśeṣā nṛpāstataḥ || 47 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ dvārakākhaṃḍe śrīnārada bahulāśva saṃvāde rukmiṇīharaṇe yaduvijayo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<6.7> śrīnārada uvāca || rukmiṇyāharaṇaṃ śrutvā mitrāṇāṃ ca parābhavam || pratijñāmakarodrukmī śṛṇvatāṃ sarvabhūbhujām || 1 || ahatvā samare kṛṣṇamapratyūhya ca rukmiṇīm || kuṃḍinaṃ na pravekṣyāmi satyametadbravīmi vaḥ || 2 || ityuktvā kavacaṃ divyaṃ ghanamambudanirmitam || śirastrāṇāṃ siṃdhujaṃ ca sa dadhāra mahodbhaṭaḥ || 3 || sauvīrasya dhanuḥ śāli lāṭajaṃ ceṣudhidvayam || ādāya mlecchadeśasya khaḍgaṃ carma ca kauṭajam || 4 || yeṭharasya mahāśaktiṃ gurjjarāṭabhavāṃ gadām || parighaṃ vaṃgajaṃ dhṛtvā hastatrāṇaṃ ca kauṃkaṇam || 5 | baddhagodhāṃgulitrāṇaḥ kirīṭīratnakuṇḍalaḥ || rukmāṃgadastadā rukmī yuddhaṃ kartuṃ mano dadhe || 6 || jaitrarathaṃ samāruhya caṃcalāśvaniyojitam || pṛṣṭhatonvagamatkṛṣṇaṃ karṣannakṣauhiṇīṃ dvayam || 7 || punaḥ samāgatāṃ dṛṣṭvā senāṃ rāmo mahābalaḥ || tayā yuyodha samare yadusenāsamanvitaḥ || 8 || tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti deveśaṃ visṛjanparuṣaṃ vacaḥ|| saṃprāpnoti rathaṃ rukmī dhanuṣṭaṃkārayanmuhuḥ ||9|| tvaraṃ muṃca svasāraṃ me yadi jīvitumicchasi || na cettvāṃ sabalaṃ sadyo nayāmi yamasādanam || 6.7.10 || yayātiśāpasaṃmṛṣṭo gopālocchiṣṭabhugbhavān || jarāsaṃdhabhayādbhīto yavanāgrātpalāyitaḥ ||11|| ityuktveṣudhitaḥ kṛṣṇa bāṇaṃ cāpe nidhāya saḥ || niyamya karṇaparyaṃtaṃ nicakhāna harerhṛdi ||12|| saṃtāḍitopi bhagavānandhanurjyāṃ tasya nādinīm|| ciccheda sāyakenāśu garuḍaḥ pannago yathā || 13 || nidhāya śīghraṃ kodaṃḍaṃ śiṃjinīṃ svarṇabhūṣitām || rūkmī tu daśabhirbāṇaiḥ saṃjaghāna hariṃ raṇe ||14|| harirekena bāṇena śiṃjinī sahitaṃ dhanuḥ || ciccheda rukmiṇaḥ sadyo jñānenevāguṇāmayam || 15|| kṛṣṇo moghena bāṇena maṃdhyatastāṃ dvidhākarot || rukmiṇaṃ tu śatairbārṇaiḥ saṃ tatāḍa mṛdhe hariḥ || 16 || chinnadhanvātha vaidarbho mahāśaktiṃ sphuratprabhām || prāharaddharaye śaktiṃ vijñānāya yathā muniḥ ||17|| tatāḍa gadayā tāṃ vai gadādhārī gadāgrajaḥ || dvidhābhūtā mahāśakti rukmeḥ sūtaṃ jaghāna ha || 18 || kaumodakī gadā gurvī pataṃtī vegadhāriṇī || tadrathaṃ cūrṇayāmāsa sāśvaṃ śailaṃ yathā paviḥ || || 19 || prāharaddharaye sopi gadāṃ svāṃ bhīṣmakātmajaḥ || cakreṇa cūrṇayāmāsa bhagavānapi tāṃ punaḥ ||6.7.20|| parighaṃ vaṃgajaṃ nītvā rukmī rukmāṃgado balī || jaghāna śrīhariṃ skaṃdhe jagarja ghanavanmṛdhe || 21 || santāḍitopi bhagavānmālāhataiva dvipaḥ || tenaiva parigheṇāpi taṃ jaghāna raṇāṃgaṇe || 22 || parighābhihato rukmī kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ || bhartsayanmādhavaṃ hyājau jagrāha khaṅgacarmaṇī ||23|| tatkhaḍgaṃ carmaṇā chittvā svakhaḍgaṃ haraddhariḥ || khaḍgāgreṇa śirastrāṇaṃ kaṃcukaṃ cicchide mahat || 24 || hastatrāṇepi yugapadete chinnīkṛte mṛdhe || khaṅgamuṣṭikaraṃ dṛṣṭvā rukmiṇaṃ samupasthitam || 25 || gṛhītvā bhujadaṇḍābhyāṃ pātayitvā mahītale || tasyopari hariḥ sthitvā yathā siṃho mṛgopari || śitadhāraṃ nandakākhyaṃ khaḍgaṃ jagrāha roṣataḥ || 26 || dṛṣṭvā bhrātṛvadhodyuktaṃ rukmiṇī bhayavihvalā || patitvā pādayorbharturuvāca karuṇaṃ satī || 27 || śrīrukmiṇyuvāca || anantadeveśa jagannivāsa yogeśvarāciṃtya jagatpate tvam || haṃtuṃ na yogyaḥ karuṇāsamudra madbhrātaraṃ śālabhujammahābhujam || 28 || śrīnārada uvāca || paritrāsairvilapatīṃ duḥkhaśuṣyanmukhīṃ priyām || ruddhakaṇṭhīṃ satīṃ vīkṣya nyavarttata hariḥ svayam ||29|| baddhvā taṃ kaṭibaṃdhena khaḍgena śitadhāriṇā || vapanaṃ śmaśrukeśānāṃ cakārārddhamukhe hariḥ || 6.7.30 || akṣauhiṇīdvayaṃ jitvā rāmaḥ prāptaḥ sasainikaḥ || baddhaṃ virūpiṇaṃ dīnaṃ rukmiṇantu dadarśa ha || 31 || vimucya baddhaṃ sadayaḥ prāha nibhartsayanharim || asādhvidaṃ tvayā kṛṣṇa kṛtaṃ lokajugupsitam||32|| hāsyaṃ vaiśālibhadrāṇāṃ na hi caitādṛśaṃ bhavet || yasyāḥ sahodare mukhye virūpe ca tvayākṛte || 33 || kiṃ vadiṣyati sāpi tvāṃ bhrāturvairūpyaciṃtayā || mā śokaṃ kuru kalyāṇi svasthā bhava śucismite || 34 || āryaputri mahābuddhe mā śokaṃ kuru durmanāḥ || sarvakālakṛtaṃ manye priyamapriyameva vā || 35 || vāyorghanāvaliriva vaśe syādakhilaṃ jagat || taṃ kālamīśvaraṃ viddhi viṣṇuṃ kalayatāṃ prabhum || 36 || ahaṃ mameti bhāvoyaṃ jagato baṃdhakāraṇam || tābhyāṃ virahito bhāvo mokṣa eva na saṃśayaḥ ||37|| sukhaduḥkhaprado nānyaḥ puruṣasyātmavibhramaḥ || mitro dāsī na ripavaḥ saṃsāratamasā kṛtāḥ ||38|| evaṃ rāmeṇa devena bodhito bhīṣmakātmajaḥ || vaimanasyaṃ parityajya rukmiṇī ca yayau mudam || 39 || rukmī tu tābhyāmutsṛṣṭo vitathātmamanorathaḥ || smaranvirūpakaraṇaṃ tapase sa manodadhat ||6.7.40|| vārito maṃtrimukhyaiśca kuṃḍinaṃ na gataḥ punaḥ || cakre bhojakaṭaṃ nāma nivāsāya puraṃ param ||41|| rukmiṇyā saha goviṃdaḥ sarāmo yadubhirvṛtaḥ || dvārakāṃ prayayau rājannādayañjayaduṃdubhīn|| || 42 || jāte mahotsave puryyāṃ rukmiṇīṃ rucirānanām || upayeme vidhānena mārgaśīrṣe hariḥ svayam ||43|| harervivāhe sati rukmiṇīpateḥ śrīrukmiṇī bhūṣitarukmamaṃdirā || puraṃdarasyāpi yathāmarāvatī dvārāvatī puṇyavatī tathā babhau || 44 || bhaiṣmīvivāhasya kathāṃ vicitrāṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ śrāvayate ca bhaktyā || ihaiva bhakto vibhavena yuktaḥ sa eva muktiṃ pratiyāti muktaḥ || 45 || iti śrīmadgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīdvārakākhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīrukmiṇīvivāhonāma saptamodhyāyaḥ || 7 ||
<6.8> śrīnārada uvāca || anyāsāṃ kṛṣṇapatnīnāṃ maṃgalaṃ śṛṇu maithila || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyamāyurvarddhanamuttamam || 1 || satrājitāya sūryeṇa dattaḥ sākṣātsyamaṃtakaḥ || ugrasenāya sa maṇiḥ śrīkṛṣṇenābhiyācitaḥ || 2 || satrājitastaṃ na dadau dravyalobhena maithila || dinedine svarṇabhārānaṣṭau yaḥ sṛjati svataḥ || 3 || atha prasenastadbhrātā maṇiṃ kaṇṭhe nidhāya saḥ || saiṃdhavaṃ hayamāruhya mṛgayāṃ vyacaradvane ||4|| siṃhena māritaḥ sopi siṃho jāṃbavatā hataḥ || gṛhītvā taṃ maṇiṃ sadyo jāṃbavānsvaguhāṃ gataḥ || 5|| kṛṣṇena nihato bhrātā maṇigrīvo vanaṃ gataḥ || nāyātaḥ svasabhā madhye iti satrājito'bravīt || 6 || bhagavānduryaśo lipto nāgaraistu vanaṃ gataḥ || prasenamaśvaṃ siṃhaṃ ca haṃta prekṣya mahāmate || 7 || ṛkṣarājabilaṃ gatvā maṇiṃ hartuṃ svayaṃ hariḥ || yuddhaṃ kṛtvāṣṭaviṃśāhamajayadṛkṣanāyakam ||8|| tena dattā jāṃbavatī haraye kanyakā śubhā || maṇinā saha rājeṃdra dvārakāmāyayau hariḥ || 9 || satrājitāya pradadau maṇiṃ nirlāṃchanaḥ prabhuḥ|| vrīḍitovāṅmukho bhīto rājā satrājito maṇim||10|| gṛhītvāpi punastasmai śrīkṛṣṇāya mahātmane|| satyabhāmāṃ sutāṃ prādācchāṃtyarthaṃ maithileśvara||11|| pāṃḍavānāṃ sahāyārthamiṃdraprasthaṃ gato hariḥ|| tatra vai vārṣikānmāsānnyavātsīdbaṃdhuvatsalaḥ||12|| ekadā rathamāruhya harirgāṃḍīvinā saha|| sunīre yamunātīre mṛgayārthī viniryayau||13|| tapaścaraṃtī kāliṃdī śrīkṛṣṇaṃ varamicchatī| darśitā pāṃḍavenāpi tāṃ gṛhītvā jagāma ha||14|| dvārakāmetya kāliṃdīṃ sūryakanyāṃ manoharām|| upayeme vidhānena vitanvanmaṃgalaṃ param||15 āvaṃtyarājatanujāṃ mitravindāṃ manoharām || svayaṃvare tāṃ jahāra bhagavānrukmiṇīṃ yathā ||16|| nagnajitkanyakāṃ satyāṃ damitvā sapta govṛṣān || paśya tāṃ sarvalokānāmupayeme hariḥ svayam || 17 || kaikeyarājatanujāṃ bhadrāṃ tu bhagavānhariḥ || kāliṃdīmiva tāṃ śaśvadupayeme vidhānataḥ || 18 || bṛhatsena sutā rājanlakṣmaṇāṃ lakṣaṇairyutām || chittvā matsyamarīñjitvā jagrāha bhagavanhariḥ|||19|| tathā ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ śataṃ ca nṛpakanyakāḥ || bhaumaṃ hatvā tannirodhādāhṛtāścārudarśanāḥ || 6.8.20 || tāsāṃ muhūrta ekasminānā gāreṣu yoṣitām || savidhaṃ jagṛhe pāṇīnnānārūpaḥ svamāyayā || 21 || ekaikaśastāḥ kṛṣṇasya putrāndaśadaśā balāḥ || ajījananna navamānpituḥ sarvātmasaṃpadā||22|| rukmiṇyāṃ bhīmakanyāyāṃ pradyumnaḥ prathamobhavat || kāmadevāvatāroyaṃ pitṛvatsarvalakṣaṇaḥ || 23 || śabaro nirdayastokaṃ hatvābdhau taṃ samākṣipat || matsyodaregataḥ sopi na mamāra hareḥ sutaḥ || 24 || matsyodarānnirgatosau bhāryayā paripālitaḥ || jñātvā śatrukṛtāṃ vārtāṃ sa kārṣṇīṃ rūḍhayauvanaḥ ||25|| hatvā taṃ śaṃbaraṃ śatruṃ bhāryayā varayāyutaḥ || dvārakāmāyayau rājaṃścitraṃ karma ca tasya tat ||26|| sarukmiṇo duhitaraṃ hṛtvā bhojakaṭātpurāt || svayaṃvarasthalādrājannupayeme mahārathaḥ ||27|| tasmātsuto niruddhobhūnnāgāyutabalānvitaḥ || surajyeṣṭhāvatāroyaṃ śāradeṃdīvaraprabhaḥ || 28 || caturvyūhāvatārasya paripūrṇatamasya hi || evaṃ vicitraṃ caritaṃ vivāhānāṃ sumaṃgalam || 29 || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyamāyurvarddhanamuttamam || mayā te kathitaṃ rājankiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi||30|| iti śrīmadgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīdvārakākhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde sarvamahiṣyudvāhonāmāṣṭamodhyāyaḥ || 8 ||
<6.9> bahulāśva uvāca || triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātā dhanyā vai dvārakāpurī || paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo yatra vāsakṛt || 1 || śrīkṛṣṇasyāṃgasaṃbhūtā purī dvārāvatī śrutā || kasmādihāgatā brahmankasminkāle vada prabho || 2 || śrīnārada uvāca || | sādhusādhu tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ dvārakāgamakāraṇam || yacchrutvā śuddhatāṃ yāti lokaghātyapi pātakī ||3|| śaryātirnāma rājābhūccakravartī manoḥ sutaḥ || cakāra rājyaṃ dharmeṇa varṣāṇāmayutaṃ bhuvi ||4|| uttānabarhirānarto bhūriṣeṇa iti trayaḥ || śaryāterabhavanputrāḥ sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ varāḥ ||5|| uttānabarhiṣe pūrvāṃ bhūriṣeṇāyadakṣiṇām || paścimāṃ ca diśaṃ sarvāmānartāya dadau nṛpaḥ || 6 || mameyaṃ himahīkṛtsnā mayā dharmeṇa pālitā || balārjitā baliṣṭhena yūyaṃ tāṃ pālayiṣyatha || 7 || piturvacaḥ samākarṇya ānartto madhyamaḥ sutaḥ || jñānī jñānamayaṃ vākyamuvāca prahasanniva || 8 || ānarta uvāca || taveyaṃ na mahī kṛtsnā tvayā pālitā kvacit || na tvadbalārjitā rājanbaliṣṭho bhagavānvibhuḥ ||9|| mahī śrīkṛṣṇadevasya tenaiva paripālitā || tattejasā jitā kṛtsnā baliṣṭho na hareḥ samaḥ || 10 || sa eva viśvaṃ svakṛtaṃsṛjatyatti ca pāti ca || sa eva brahmaparamaṃ kālaḥ kalayatāṃ prabhuḥ || 11 || yoṃtaḥ praviśya bhūtāni bhūtairapyakhilāśrayaḥ || sa viśvākhyodhiyajñosau paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam||12|| yadbhayādvātivātoyaṃ sūryyastapati yadbhayāt|| yadbhayādvarṣate devo mṛtyuścarati yadbhayāt || 13 || paripūrṇatamaṃ sākṣāchrīkṛṣṇaṃ parameśvaram || bhaja sarvātmanā rājannahaṃkāravivarjitaḥ || 14 || nārada uvāca || jñānaṃ prāptopi śaryyātirākṣiptaḥ putravākcharaiḥ || ānarttaṃ svasutaṃ prāha ruṣāprasphuritādharaḥ|| 15 || śaryyātiruvāca || dūraṃ gaccha asadbuddhe guruvadbhāṣase katham|| yāvadbhūtaṃ tu me rājyaṃ tāvattvaṃ mā mahīṃ vasa ||16|| yastvayārādhitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sopi sarvasahāyakṛt || navīnāṃ kiṃ mahīṃ te vai bhagavāneva dāsyati || 17 || nārada uvāca || ityuktastu tadānarto rājānaṃ prāha mānadaḥ || yatra te ca mahī rājyaṃ tatra vāso na me bhavet || 18 || pitrā niḥsārito rājñāpyānartobdhitaṭaṃ gataḥ || velāmetya tapastepe varṣāṇāmayutaṃ jale ||19|| premalakṣaṇayā bhaktyā saṃtuṣṭo bhagavānhariḥ || tasmai svaṃ darśanaṃ dattvā varaṃ brūhītyuvāca ha || 20 || kṛtāṃjalipuṭobhūtvā''narta utthāya śīghrataḥ || nanāma kṛṣṇapādabjaṃ romāṃcī premavihvalaḥ || 21 || ānartta uvāca || namaste vāsudevāya namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca || pradyumnāyāniruddhāya sātvatāṃpataye namaḥ ||22|| pitrā niṣkāsito deva tvāmahaṃ śaraṇāgataḥ || dehi mahyaṃ bhūmimanyāṃ yatra vāso hi me bhavet || 23 || dhuvopi yatprasādena yayau sarvottamaṃ padam || tasmai namo bhagavate praṇatakleśahāriṇe || 24 || śrīnārada uvāca || ānartamānataṃ dīnaṃ bhagavāndīnavatsalaḥ || prasannaḥ śrīmukhenāha meghagaṃbhīrayā girā || 25 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || anyānamedinīloke kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā nṛpa || svavacastadṛtaṃ kartuṃ tvadbhaktyā paritoṣitaḥ || 26 || tasmāddaivasya lokasya vaikuṇṭhasya paraṃtapa || bhūkhaṇḍaṃ yojanaśataṃ dadāmi vilaṃ śubham || 27 || śrīnārada uvāca || ityuktvānartanṛpatiṃ bhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ || vaikuṇṭhācca sumutpāṭya bhūkhaṇḍaśatayojanam ||28|| cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ dhṛtvā samudre bhīmanādini || dadhāra bhagavāndevastasyopari videharāṭ ||29|| ānarto lakṣavarṣāṃtaṃ tatra rājyaṃ cakāra ha || putrapautrasamāyukto rājanvaikuṇṭhasaṃpadam || 30 || idaṃ śrutvātha śaryātiḥ pitā vai vismato'bhavat || ānarto nāma deśobhūdānartasya prasādataḥ||31|| revatastasya putrobhūcchrīśailasyagireḥ sutam|| samutpāṭya svahastābhyāmānarteṣu nyapātayat|32| sobhūdrevatanāmnāpi raivatonāma parvataḥ || kuśasthalīṃ vinirmāya rājyaṃ kṛtvātha raivataḥ ||33|| samādāya svakāṃ kanyāṃ brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha|| baladevavivāhepi tatkathā kathitā mayā ||34|| tasmāddvārāvatīṃ puṇyāṃ mokṣadvāraṃ viduḥ surāḥ ||35|| iti śrīmadgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīdvārakākhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde dvārakāgamanakāraṇaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ||9||
<6.10> śrīnārada uvāca || itthaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ dvārakāgamanakāraṇam || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 1 || bahulāśva uvāca || sarva tīrthamayī bhūmirdvārakā nagarī śubhā || tatra mukhyāni tīrthāni vada māṃ munisattama || 2 || śrīnārada uvāca || āprabhāsāttīrthamayī maryādīkṛtyayajñiyām || bhūmirmokṣapradā rājandvārakā yojanaiḥ śatam || 3 || dvārakāṃ nagarīṃ dṛṣṭvā naro nārāyaṇo bhavet || dvārakāyāṃ mṛtaḥ kopi gardabhopi caturbhujaḥ||4|| paśyañchṛṇvankathāṃ tasyā dvāraketi vadankvacit|| draṣṭādadyāttṛṇaṃ mṛtyuṃ gato yāti parāṃ gatim || 5 || ekadā raivataṃ bhaktaṃ premānandasamākulam || prekṣya svaṃ darśanaṃ dattvā hariraśrumukhobhavat ||6|| tannetrabiṃdusaṃbhūtā gomatī sā mahānadī || yasyā darśanamātreṇa brahmahatyā pramucyate ||7|| gomatītīrajaṃ puṇyaṃ rajo yo dhārayennaraḥ || śatajanmakṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ||8|| snānakāle gomatīti vadatyapi naraḥ kvacit || gomatyāṃ snānajaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate vai na saṃśayaḥ ||9|| makarasthe ravau māghe prayāge snānamācaret || śatāśvamedhajaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃprāpnoti videharāṭ || 10 || tatsahasraguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ gomatyāṃ makare ravau || gomatyāścaiva māhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ nālaṃ caturmukhaḥ || 11 || gomatyāṃ cakratīrtheṣu pāṣāṇani ca yāśca ye || te sarve cakratāṃ yāṃti pūjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ||12|| cakracihne cakratīrthe dvādaśyāṃ snānamācaret || cakrapāṇipadaṃ yāti pāpānāṃ bhājanopi hi || 13 || koṭijanmakṛtaiḥ pāpaiḥ patito yopi pātakī || cakratīrthasya sopānametya muktiṃ samāruheta || 14 || bahulāśva uvāca || gomatyāṃ hi mahānadyāṃ cakratīrthaṃ śubhārthadam || kathaṃ jātaṃ bahumataṃ tanme brūhi mahāmate || 15 || śrīnārada uvāca || atraivodāharaṃtīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa pāpahāniḥ paraṃ bhavet || 16 || alakeśo rājarājo nidhīśo dharmabhṛtprabhuḥ || vaiṣṇavaṃ yajñamārebhe kailāsottarabhūmiṣu ||17|| tasya yajñe svayaṃ viṣṇurāgato vai svadhāmataḥ || brahmā śivo jaṃbhabhedī varuṇo yādasāṃpatiḥ ||18|| vāyuryamo raviḥ somaḥ kṣitiḥ sarvajaneśvarī|| gandharvāpsarasaḥ siddhāḥ sarve tatra samāyayuḥ ||19|| devarṣayaḥ samājagmustathā brahmarṣayo nṛpa || dhanādhyakṣobhavattasya putrastu nalakūbaraḥ ||.20|| rakṣāyāṃ vīrabhadrobhūtsatsevāyāṃ gajānanaḥ || yathā marudgaṇāḥ sarve pariveṣaṇakāriṇaḥ ||21|| bāhuleyaḥ sabhāpūjāmakaroddharmatatparaḥ || ghaṇṭānādaḥ pārśvamauliḥ kuberasya tu maṃtriṇau ||22|| sarvaśāstravidāṃ śreṣṭhau dānādhyakṣau babhūvatuḥ || evaṃ hi vidhivadyajño babhūva paramotsavaḥ ||23|| adhvarāvabhṛthasnāto rājarājo mahāmanāḥ|| paraṃ bhāgaṃ ca devebhyo viprebhyo dakṣiṇāmadāt ||24|| evaṃ pūrṇedhvare mukhye tuṣṭe devarṣisattame || ājagāmātha durvāsā daṇḍī chatrī jaṭādharaḥ || 25 || krodhī kṛśaḥ pādukāṃghrirdīrghaśmaśruḥ kṛśodaraḥ|| darbhāsanasamitpātramṛgacarmadharaḥ paraḥ ||26|| tamāgataṃ samāgamya pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ || bhayabhītaḥ parikramya kuberaḥ praṇanāma ha || 27 || adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ madiraṃ ca me || adya me saphalo yajño brahmaṃstvayyāgate sati ||28|| itthaṃ saṃtoṣitastena durvāsā bhagavānmuniḥ || devamanuṣyadharmāṇaṃ prāha prahasitānanaḥ || 29 || tvaṃ rājarājo dharmātmā dānī vipraparāyaṇaḥ || kṛtaste vaiṣṇavo yajño viṣṇusaṃtoṣakāraṇaḥ|| || 30 || na yācito mayā tvaṃ vai kvāpi vaiśravaṇa prabho || adyaiva yācanāṃ kurve jñātvā tvāṃ dānisattamam || 31 || madyāñcāṃ saphalīkuryāstubhyaṃ dāsyāmi sadvaram || nocettvāṃ bhasmasātkurve śāpenātibhayena vai || 32 || vartaṃte tvadgṛhe sarve trailokyanidhayo nava || tānme prayaccha bhadraṃ te tadarthaṃ gatavānaham || 33 || nārada uvāca || etacchrutvā rājarājo dānaśīla udāradhīḥ || omiti pratigṛhṇīṣva prāha taṃ guhyakeśvaraḥ || 34 || evaṃ nidhīnpradāsyaṃtaṃ dānādhyakṣo nidhīśvaram || ghaṇṭānādaḥ pārśvamaulirūcaturlobhamohitau || 35 || dvāvūcatuḥ || ekoyaṃ brāhmaṇo lobhī nidhibhiḥ kiṃ kariṣyati || lakṣaṃ divyaṃ dehi cāsmai vṛttiṃ rakṣa tathottarām || 36 || nārada uvāca || tadvacaḥ paruṣaṃ śrutvā durvāsāḥ krodhavigrahaḥ || bhrūbhaṃgakuṭilībhūte raktanetre cakāra ha || 37 || sthālīva sarvabrahmāṃḍaṃ cacāla nimiṣadvayam || praṇataṃ dhanadaṃ vīkṣya tābhyāṃ śāpaṃ dadau muniḥ || 38 || muniruvāca || ghaṇṭānāda mahāduṣṭa pāpabuddheti lubdhaka || grāhavattvaṃ dhanagrāhī grāho bhava mahākhala || 39 || pārśvamaule pāpabuddhe dhanalobhamadānvitaḥ || gajavatpreraṇāṃ kurvaṃstvaṃ gajo bhava durmate || 40 || śrīnārada uvāca || tābhyāṃ śāpaṃ munirdattvā nidhiṃ nītvā kuberataḥ || varaṃ dadau punastasmai duvāsā durlabhaṃ param || 41 || asmāddānācca dviguṇā bhavaṃtu nidhayo nava || ityuktvā sa nidhiḥ prāgādaho tejīyasāṃ balam ||42|| iti śrīmadgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīdvārakā khaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde gomatyupākhyāne cakratīrthamāhātmyaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||
<6.11> nārada uvāca || kuberamantriṇau dīnau vipraśāpa vimohitau || tatra sākṣātsvayaṃ viṣṇuḥ prāha tau śaraṇaṃ gatau || 1 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || madarcāsaṃyute yajñe bhavatau duḥkhasaṃyutau || brāhmaṇānāṃ vacohaṃ vai dūrākartuṃ na ca kṣamaḥ || 2 || bhavataṃ grāhamātaṃgau yuddhaṃ hi yuvayoryadā || tadā vai matprasādena prakṛtiṃ svāṃ gamiṣyathaḥ || 3 || nārada uvāca || ityuktau hariṇā tau dvau rājarājasya maṃtriṇau || babhūvaturgrāhagajau jātismaraṇasaṃyutau || 4 || ghaṇṭānādobhavadgrāho gomattyāṃ ca śataṃsamāḥ || vikarālo mahābhīmaḥ śaśvadraudravapurddharaḥ ||5|| pārśvamaulirgajeṃdrobhūdraivatasya girervane || caturdaṃtaḥ kajjalābhaḥ pṛṣṭhaprocco dhanuḥśatam || 6 || vaṃjulaiḥ kurabaiḥ kundairbadarairvetraveṇubhiḥ || raṃbhābhūrjavaṭairyukte kovidā rāsanārjunaiḥ ||7|| mandārapāṭalāśokacūtacaṃpakacandanaiḥ || panasodumbarāśvattha kharjūrairbījapūrakaiḥ ||8|| priyālāmrātakāmraiśca kramukaiḥ parimaṃḍite || raivatasyavane dīrghe vicacāra mahāgajaḥ ||9|| ekadā mādhave māsi gajeṃdro girigahvarāt || snātuṃ tāṃ gomatīṃ gaṃgāmāyayau sagaṇo nadan ||6.11.10|| ciraṃ samavagāhyāpsu śuṇḍā daṃḍairitastataḥ || kareṇa kalabhānsarvānsnāpayāmāsa nāgarāṭ || 11 || mahāngrāhopi tatrastho balīyāndaivanoditaḥ || agrahīccaraṇe nāgaṃ krodhapūrita vigrahaḥ || 12 || tenaiva tadgṛhe nīto gajeṃdro baladarpitaḥ || samākṛṣya bahiḥ prāptaṃ punastena vikarṣitaḥ ||13|| kareṇavaśca kalabhāstaṃ saṃtārayitumakṣamāḥ || evaṃ tayoryudhyatośca karṣatorhi bahirmithaḥ || 14 || paṃcāśatpaṃcavarṣāṇi vyatīyuḥ paśyatāṃ satām || evaṃ kaśmalamāpanno gajo jātismaro mahān ||15|| premalakṣaṇayā bhaktyā haripādakṛtāśrayaḥ|| sasmāra śrīhariṃ devaṃ mṛtyupāśavaśaṃgataḥ || 15 || gajeṃdra uvāca || śrīkṛṣṇakṛṣṇasakhakṛṣṇavapurdadhāna kṛṣṇāya te praṇatirastu sureśaviṣṇo || pūrṇaprabho paramapāvanapuṇyakīrte māṃ pāhi pāhi parameśvara pāpapāśāt || 17 || nārada uvāca || evaṃ grāhagṛhītāṃgaṃ smaraṃtaṃ ca hariṃ hariḥ || jñātvāruhya khagaṃ vegādadhāvaddīnavatsalaḥ || 18 || svayaṃ khagātsamuttīryya dhāvañcakraṃ samākṣipat || cakre prāpte pūrvameva grāhasyāpi śirodbhutama || dainye prāpte vanamiva dehādbhinnaṃ babhūva ha || paścātprapatitaṃ cakraṃ gomatyāṃ ca hrade nadat || pāṣāṇanicayānsarvāṃścakrākārāṃścakāra ha||6.11.20|| tannemisaṃgharṣabhavaṃ cakratīrthaṃ śubhāvahama|| taccakradarśanādrājanbrahmahatyā pramucyate || 21 || grāhaśchinnaśiro bhūtvā pūrvarūpaṃ dadhāra ha || śrīkṛṣṇānugrahāddhastī divyarūpo babhūva saḥ||22|| parikramya hariṃ natvā stutvā devaṃ kṛtāṃjalī || kuberamaṃtriṇau tau dvau jagmatuḥ svapadaṃ punaḥ ||23|| deveṣu puṣpaṃ varṣatsu jayadhvaniṃ nadatsu ca || jagāma bhagavānsākṣātsvadhāmaprakṛteḥ param || 24 || cakratīrthakathāmenāṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti narottamaḥ || cakratīrthasnānaphalaṃ saṃprāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ||25|| gajagrāhakathāṃ puṇyāṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ || duḥsvapnaṃ naśyate tasya susvapnaṃ bhavati dhruvam || 25 || iti śrīmadgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīdvārakākhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde cakratīrthotpattau gajagrāhamokṣonāmaikādaśodhyāyaḥ || 11 ||
<6.12> śrīnārada uvāca || śaṃkhoddhāre tīrthamukhye svarṇadānaṃ dadāti yaḥ || sam̐gacchedvaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ sarvopadravavarjitam || 1 || śrīkṛṣṇabhaktaḥ śāṃtātmā trito nāma mahāmuniḥ || tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena prāpta ānartabhūmiṣu || 2 || dṛṣṭvā śubhaṃ saraḥ snātvā hareḥ pūjāṃ cakāra ha || tatpūjāyāṃ mahāśaṃkhaṃ sundarairlakṣaṇairvṛtam | 3 || corayāmāsa kakṣīvāṃstasya śiṣyotilobhataḥ || pūjāśaṃkhaṃ gataṃ vīkṣya kuddhaḥ prāha trito muniḥ || 4 || yena nītastu me śaṃkhaḥ sa śaṃkho bhavatu dhruvam|| tadeva śaṃkharūpobhūtkakṣīvāñchāpapīḍitaḥ||5|| utpādayornipatitaḥ pāhi māmityuvāca ha || śīghraṃ śāṃtastritaḥ prāha durmate kiṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā || steyadoṣādbhuṃkṣva pāpaṃ madvaco no mṛṣā bhavet ||6|| bhaja śrīkṛṣṇapādābjaṃ sa te mokṣaṃ kariṣyati || ityuktvātha gate rājantrite deve mahāmunau||7|| sarovare nipatitaḥ kakṣīvāñchaṃkharūpadhṛk|| pravadankṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti śatavarṣaṃ sthitobhavat ||8|| paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣādbhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ || āgatya sarasastīraṃ mā bhaiṣṭetyabhayaṃ dadau || 9 || tāṃ meghanādagaṃbhīrāṃ giraṃ śrutvā jalecaraḥ || cukrośa pāhi pāhīti devadava jagatpate || 6.12.10 || bhujageṃdra bhogarucā bhujena bhagavānprabhuḥ|| śaṃkhaṃ bhaktaṃ gajamiva projjahāra dayāparaḥ || 11 || tadaiva divyarūpobhūcchaṃkharūpaṃ vihāya saḥ || kṛtāṃjalirhariṃ natvā stutiṃ cakre yadā ca saḥ||12 || kakṣīvānuvāca || vāsudeva namastestu goviṃdapuruṣottama || dīnavatsala dīneśa dvārakeśa pareśvara || 13 || dhruve dhruvapadaṃdātre prahlādasyārtihāriṇe || gajasyoddhāriṇe tubhyaṃ balarbalivide namaḥ || 14 || draupadīcīrasaṃtrāṇakāriṇe haraye namaḥ || garāgnivanavāsebhyaḥ pāṃḍavānāṃ sahāyine ||15|| yādavatrāṇakartre ca śakrādābhīrarakṣiṇe || gurumātṛdvijānāṃ ca putradātre namonamaḥ ||16|| jarāsaṃdhanirodhārta nṛpāṇāṃ mokṣakāriṇe || nṛgasyoddhāriṇe sākṣātsudāmnodainyahāriṇe || 17|| vāsudevāya kṛṣṇāya namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca || pradyumnāyāniruddhāya caturvyūhāya te namaḥ ||18|| tvameva mātā ca pitā tvameva tvameva bandhuśca sakhā tvameva || tvameva vidyā draviṇaṃ tvameva tvameva sarvaṃ mama devadeva ||19|| śrīnārada uvāca || evaṃ stutvā hariṃ rājankakṣīvānpremapūritaḥ || vimānavaramāsthāya yādavānāṃ ca paśyatām || 6.12.20 || vibhrājayandaśadiśaḥ śatasūryasamaprabhaḥ || jagāma vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ sarvopadravavarjitam ||21|| śaṃkhoddhāraḥ kṛto yasminhariṇā maithileśvara || tasmāttīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ śaṃkhoddhāra prathāṃ gatam || 22 || śaṃkhoddhārakathāmetāṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti narottamaḥ || śaṃkhoddhārasnānaphalaṃ labhate vai na saṃśayaḥ || 23 || iti śrīmadgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīdvārakākhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śaṃkhoddhāramāhātmyaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||
<6.13> śrīnārada uvāca || prabhāsasyāpi māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu rājanmahāmate || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ tejasāṃ varddhanaṃ param || 1 || godāvāryāṃ gurau siṃhe harakṣetre ca kuṃbhage || ravigrahe kurukṣetre kāśyāṃ candragrahe tathā || 2 || yatpuṇyaṃ labhate rājansnānato dānato naraḥ || tasmācchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ prabhāse ca dinedine || 3 || yatra snātvā dakṣaśāpādgṛhīto yakṣmaṇoḍurāṭ| vimuktaḥ kilviṣātsadyo bheje bhūyaḥ kalodayam ||4|| mahāpuṇyatamā rājanyatra pratyaksarasvatī || tasyāṃ snātvā naraḥ pāpī sākṣādbrahmamayo bhavet ||5|| tattīre vartate rājannāmnā vai bodhapippalam || kṛṣṇena yatroddhavāya dattaṃ bhāgavataṃ śubham||6|| taṃ natvābhyarcya vidhivatspṛṣṭvā śrībodhapippalam || śṛṇoti yo bhāgavataṃ purāṇaṃ brahmasaṃmitam ||7|| ślokārdhaślokapādaṃ vā maunī niyatamānasaḥ || tasya pāṇau bhavedrājanvaiṣṇavaṃ paramaṃ padam || 8 || proṣṭhapadyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ hemasiṃhasamanvitam || dadāti ya bhāgavataṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim||9|| purāṇaṃ na śrutaṃ yaistu śrīmadbhāgavataṃ kvacit|| teṣāṃ vṛthā janmagataṃ narāṇāṃ bhūmivāsinām ||6.13.10|| yairna śrutaṃ bhāgavataṃ purāṇaṃ nārādhito yaiḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ|| hutaṃ mukhe naiva dharāmarāṇāṃ teṣāṃ vṛthā janma gataṃ narāṇām || 11 || dvārāvatyāṃ tīrtharājaṃ gaumatīsiṃdhusaṃgamam || yatra snātvā naro yāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ vimalaṃ padam||12|| śatāśvamedhajaṃ puṇyaṃ gaṃgāsāgara saṃgame || tasmātsahasraguṇitaṃ gomatīsiṃdhusaṃgame || 13 || atraivodāharaṃtīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa pāpatāpātpramucyate ||14|| āsīdgajāhvaye vaiśyo rājamārgapatiḥ paraḥ || mahāgauravasaṃyukto nidhīśo dhanado yathā ||15|| veśyāprasaṃganirato viṭagoṣṭhīviśāradaḥ|| dyūtakrīḍanakāsakto lobhamohamadānvitaḥ ||16|| mṛṣāvādī mahāduṣṭaḥ kukarmanirataḥ sadā || brāhmaṇebhyo na pitṛbhyo na devebhyo dhanaṃ dadau ||17|| hareḥ kathāṃ prekṣyadūrāddūraṃ vai niryayau tvaram || pitroḥ sevāpi na kṛtā na putrebhyo dhanaṃ dadau || 18 || tyaktvā bhāryāṃ sa bhinnobhūddhanāḍhyo durmatiḥ khalaḥ || veśyāprasaṃgāttasyāpi dhanārddhaṃ prakṣayaṃ gatam|| |9|| ardhaṃ tu taskarairnītaṃ kiṃcitpṛthvyāṃ gataṃ svataḥ || puṇyena varddhate lakṣmīḥ pāpena kṣīyate dhruvam ||6.13.20|| evaṃ sa nirdhano jāto veśyāsakto mahākhalaḥ || tasmingajāhvaye ramye cauryakarma cakāra ha || 21 || cauryakarma prakurvaṃtaṃ baddhvā taṃ dāmabhirnṛpaḥ || deśānniḥsārayāmāsa śaṃtanurnṛpatīśvaraḥ ||22|| vanepi nivansopi jīvahiṃsāṃ cakāra ha|| samā dvādaśa sāhasraṃ navavarṣayadāghanaḥ || 23 || paścimāṃ tu diśaṃ prāgādvaiśyo durbhikṣa pīḍitaḥ || vane vai māritaḥ sopi siṃhena talaghātataḥ ||24|| tadaiva yamadūtāstaṃ baddhvā pāśairadhomukham || kaśāghātaistāḍayaṃto ninyurmārgaṃ yamasya ca ||25|| atha kaścinmahāngṛdhro māṃsaṃ tasya bhujasya ca || gṛhītvā khaṃ gataḥ sadyaḥ khādaṃścaṃcupuṭena tam ||26|| nirāmiṣāḥ khagāścānye svāmiṣaṃ jagmurāturāḥ || evaṃ kolāhale jāte śaṃkhacihnādibhiḥ kṛte ||27|| na jahau mukhato māṃsaṃ paścimāśāṃ jagāma ha || tatsamenāpi gṛdhreṇa tīkṣṇatuṃḍena tāḍitāt || 28 || tanmukhātprapatanmāṃsaṃ gomatīsiṃdhusaṃgame || tīrthaplute tasya māṃse vaiśyoyaṃ pātakī mahān||29|| teṣāṃ pāśānsvayaṃ chittvā bhūtvā devaścaturbhujaḥ || paśyatāṃ yamadūtānāṃ vimānamadhiruhya saḥ || 6.13.30 || virājayandiśaḥ sarvā paraṃdhāma hareryayau || 31 || gomatīsiṃdhusaṃgasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇute naraḥ || sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ prayāti saḥ ||32|| iti śrīmadgargasahitāyāṃ śrīdvārakākhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśva saṃvāde prabhāsasarasvatībodhapippala gomatīsiṃdhusaṃgamamāhātmyanāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 ||
<6.14> śrīnārada uvāca dvārāvatyā samudrasya māhātmyaṃ śruṇu mānada | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ tatsnānaphaladaṃ smṛtam || 1 || mādhavyāṃ pūrṇamāsyāṃ yo vratī snātvā nadīpatim | natvā saṃpūjya vidhivadratnadānaṃ karoti yaḥ || 2 || tasya dehe trayo devā nivasaṃti mahīpate | yasya darśanamātreṇa naro yāti kṛtārthatām || 3 || taddehasparśanātsadyo brahmahatyā pramucyate | yatra yatra gataḥ so'pi tatra tatra ca bhūḥ śubhā || 4 || dṛṣṭvā taṃ ca mṛtaḥ pāpī jagadvadhakaro'pi hi | chinatti pāpapaṭalaṃ paraṃ mokṣaṃ prayāti hi || 5 || raivatasyātha śailasya māhātmyaṃ śrṛṇu mānada | sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ muktibhuktipradāyakam || 6 || gautamasya suto dhīmān medhāvī nāma vaiṣṇavaḥ | viṃdhyācale tapastepe varṣāṇāmayutaṃ śatam || 7 || taṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ sākṣādapāṃtaratamo muniḥ | noccacālāsanātso'pi medhāvī tapasotkaṭaḥ || 8 || apāṃtaratamastaṃ vai śaśāpa krodhapūritaḥ | satāmabhakta pāpātman svatapobalagarvitaḥ || 9 || śailavatte sthitiścātra tvaṃ śailo bhava durmate | ityuktvā'tha gate sākṣād apāṃtaratame munau || 10 || medhāvī śailatāṃ prāptaḥ śrīśailasya suto'bhavat | jātismaro mahābuddhirviṣṇubhakteḥ prabhāvataḥ || |11 || ekadā manmukhācchrutvā māhātmyaṃ dvārakāpuraḥ | provāca so'pi rājānaṃ raivataṃ gaccha satvaram || 12 || vada matprārthanāmuktāṃ tvaṃ mahādīnavatsalaḥ | so'yaṃ mahābalo rājā prasanno yadi vā bhavet || 13 || tena nītasya me vāso bhaviṣyati hareḥ puri | iti śrutvā mayā viṣṇubhaktānāṃ śāṃtikāriṇā || 14 || raivatāyaśu kathitaṃ tathoktaṃ paramaṃ vacaḥ | sa prasannaḥ prāha rājannatra ko'pi na parvataḥ || 15 || tatsthāpanāṃ kariṣyāmi samutpāṭya bhujābalāt | samunnīya dvārakāyāṃ pratijñāmakarodimām || 16 || etasmiṃstaccorayituṃ prayāte nṛpasattame | tatpūrvasmādahaṃ prāptaḥ śrīśailasya pure nṛpa || 17 || kalipriyeṇāpi mayā śrīśailāya mahātmane | kathitaḥ sarvavṛttāṃto nṛpacauryasamanvitaḥ || 18 || śrīśailaḥ putramohena nirbhartsyeti kva yāsi hi | sumeruṃ girirājaṃ ca himavantaṃ nageśvaram || 19 || śrīśailaḥ prāha dharmātmā putrasnehasamākulaḥ | eko daivena datto'yaṃ na putrā bahavaśca me || 20 || taṃ hartumāgate rājñi raivate vai mahābale | videśaṃ yāti putro me tena rājñā mahātmanā || 21 || putrasnehābhibhūto'haṃ yuvayoḥ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ | jitvā taṃ raivataṃ śīghraṃ putraṃ māṃ dātumarhatha || 22 || jāteśca kāraṇāttau dvau sumeruśca himācalaḥ | śailalakṣaiḥ parivṛtau yoddhumājagmaturdrutam || 23 || tato bhujābhyāṃ utpāṭya hanumāniva taṃ girim | ūrdhvaṃ kṛtvā balādrājā yadā gaṃtuṃ mano dadhe || 24 || tadaiva cāgatānvīkṣya girīñchastrāstradhāriṇaḥ | aṭṭahāsaṃ cakoroccaistaḍitpātamivātmanaḥ || 25 || nanāda tena brahmāṃḍaṃ saptalokerbilaiḥ saha | tadaiva teṣāṃ śastrāṇi hastebhyo nyapatansvataḥ || 26 || niḥśastrāste yadā śailāḥ kurvaṃtaḥ pradhvaniṃ muhuḥ | gacchaṃtaṃ sagiriṃ jaghnuḥ muṣṭibhirjānubhiḥ pathi || 27 || yathā purā hanūmaṃtamanuyātā mahābalam | taistāḍito'pi na jahau giriṃ rājā karāgrataḥ || 28 || manmukhācchrīhariḥ śrutvā śailodyogaṃ nṛpopari | sadyo bhaktasahāyārthaṃ bhagavān bhaktavatsalaḥ || 29 || āgatyākāśamārge'pi dattvā tejaḥ svakaṃ param | mābhaiṣṭetyabhayaṃ dattvā tvaramantaradhīyata || 30 || gate harau bhagavati bhagavattejasā'nvitaḥ | ekahaste giriṃ dhṛtvā muṣṭinā vajraghātinā || 31 || sumeruṃ saṃtatāḍāśu vajrīva balavattaraḥ | tasya muṣṭiprahāreṇa merurvihvalatāṃ gataḥ || 32 || himavantaṃ bāhuvegātpātayitvā mahītale | mamarda padbhyāṃ cānyāṃśca viṃdhyādīnraṇadurmadaḥ || 33 || viṃdhyādayaśca te sarve pādaghātena marditāḥ | bhayabhītā raṇaṃ tyaktvā dudruvuste diśo daśa || 34 || evaṃ jitvā śailasaṃghaṃ taṃ śaila śailasannibhaḥ | raivato'pi jayārāvairānarteṣu nyapātayat || 35 || so'bhūdraivatanāmāpi rājan raivatako'calaḥ | haribhaktaḥ śailamukhyo dvārāvatyāṃ virājate || 36 || tasya darśanamātreṇa brahmahatyā pramucyate | sparśanācchatayajñānāṃ phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 37 || yātrāṃ kṛtvā ca yasyāpi parikramya natānanaḥ | bhojanaṃ brāhmaṇe datvā yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam || 38 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ dvārakākhaṃḍe śrīnārada bahulāśva saṃvāde ratnākararaivatakācalamāhātmyaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<6.15> śrīnārada uvāca tasmin girau yajñatīrthaṃ raivatena kṛtaṃ purā | yatra kṛtvā yajñamekaṃ koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet || 1 || kapiṭaṃkaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ kapipātasamudbhavam | girau raivatake rājan sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 2 || bhaumāsurasakho duṣṭo dvivido nāma vānaraḥ | mārito yatra rāmeṇa muṣṭinā vajrapātinā || 3 || sadyo muktiṃ gataḥ so'pi satāṃ helanavānapi | tatra snātuṃ sadā devā āgacchanti nareśvara || 4 || kalaviṃkasya yātrāyāṃ koṭigodānajaṃ phalam | etasya dviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ daṇḍakākhye vane śubhe || 5 || tasmāccaturguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ saiṃdhavākhye mahāvane | jaṃbumārge pañcaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 6 || tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ puṣkarākhye vane smṛtam | tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ puṇyamutpalāvartayātrayā || 7 || tasmācca naimiṣāraṇye puṇyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ smṛtam | tasmācchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ kapiṭaṃke videharāṭ || 8 || nṛgakūpaṃ dvārakāyāṃ tirthānāṃ tīrthamuttamam | yasya darśanamātreṇa viprāvadhyātpramucyate || 9 || ajñānādbrāhmaṇasyāpi gāṃ dadau brāhmaṇāya saḥ | tena pāpena kūpe vai kṛkalāsavapurddharaḥ || 10 || nṛgo'pi dānināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ patito'tha caturyugam | śrīkṛṣṇena taduddhāraḥ kṛto vai paśyatāṃ satām || 11 || taddinānnṛgakūpaṃ tu tīrthībhūtaṃ mahīpate | kārtike pūrṇimāyāṃ tu tasmin snānaṃ samācaret || 12 || koṭijanmakṛtātpāpān mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | ekaṃ yatrāpi godānaṃ karoti vidhivannaraḥ || 13 || koṭigodānajaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate vai na saṃśayaḥ | gopībhūmeśca māhātmyaṃ śruṇu pāpaharaṃ param || 14 || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa karmabandhātpramucyate | gopīnāṃ yatra vāso'bhūttena gopībhuvaḥ smṛtāḥ || 15 || gopyaṃgarāgasaṃbhūtaṃ gopīcandanamuttamam | gopīcandanaliptāṃgo gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet || 16 || mahānadīnāṃ snānasya puṇyaṃ tasya dine dine | gopīcandanamudrābhirmudrito yaḥ sadā bhavet || 17 || aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca | sarvāṇi tīrthadānāni vratāni ca tathaiva ca | kṛtāni tena nityaṃ vai sa kṛtārtho na saṃśayaḥ || 18 || gaṃgāmṛddviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ citrakūṭarajaḥ smṛtam | tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ rajaḥ pañcavaṭībhavam || 19 || tasmācchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ gopīcandanakaṃ rajaḥ | gopīcandanakaṃ viddhi vṛndāvanarajaḥsamam || 20 || gopīcandanaliptāṃgaṃ yadi pāpaśatairyutam | taṃ netuṃ yamaḥ śakto yamadūtaḥ kutaḥ punaḥ || 21 || nityaṃkaroti yaḥ pāpī gopīcandanadhāraṇam | sa prayāti harerdhāma golokaṃ prakṛteḥ param || 22 || siṃdhudeśasya rājā'bhūddīrdhabāhuriti śrutaḥ | anyāyavartī duṣṭātmā veśyāsaṃgarataḥ sadā || 23 || tena vai bhārate varṣe brahmahatyāśataṃ kṛtam | daśa garbhavatīhatyāḥ kṛtāstena durātmanā || 24 || mṛgayāyāṃ tu bāṇaughaiḥ kapilāgovadhaḥ kṛtaḥ | saiṃdhavaṃ hayamāruhya mṛgayārthī gato'bhavat || 25 || ekadā rājyalobhena mantrī kruddho mahākhalam | jaghānāraṇyadeśe taṃ tīkṣṇadhāreṇa cāsinā || 26 || bhūtale patitaṃ mṛtyugataṃ vīkṣya yamānugāḥ | baddhvā yamapurīṃ ninyurharṣayantaḥ parasparam || 27 || saṃmukhe'vasthitaṃ vīkṣya pāpinaṃ yamarāḍ balī | citraguptaṃ prāha tūrṇaṃ kā yogyā yātanā'sya vai || 28 || citragupta uvāca caturaśītilakṣeṣu narakeṣu nipātyatām | niḥsandehaṃ mahārāja yāvaccaṃdradivākarau || 29 || anena bhārate varṣe kṣaṇaṃ na sukṛtaṃ kṛtam | daśagarbhavatīghātaḥ kapilāgovadhaḥ kṛtaḥ || 30 || tathā vanamṛgāṇāṃ ca kṛtvā hatyāḥ sahasraśaḥ | tammādayaṃ mahāpāpī devatādvijaniṃdakaḥ || 31 || śrīnārada uvāca tadā yamājñayā dūtā nītvā taṃ pāparūpiṇam | sahasrayojanāyāme taptataile mahākhale || 32 || sphuradatyucchalatphene kumbhīpāke nyapātayan | pralayāgnisamo vahniḥ sadyaḥ śītalatāṃ gataḥ || 33 || vaideha tannipatanātprahlādakṣepaṇādyathā | tadaiva citramācakhyuḥ yamadūtā mahātmane || 34 || anena sukṛtaṃ bhūmau kṣaṇavanna kṛtaṃ kvacit | citraguptena satataṃ dharmarājo vyaciṃtayat || 35 || sabhāyāmāgataṃ vyāsaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivannṛpa | natvā papraccha dharmātmā dharmarājo mahāmatiḥ || 36 || yama uvāca anena pāpinā pūrvaṃ na kṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ kvacit | sphuradagnyucchalatphene kuṃbhīpāke mahākhale || 37 || asya kṣepaṇato vahniḥ sadyaḥ śītalatāṃ gataḥ | iti sandehataścetaḥ khidyate me na saṃśayaḥ || 38 || śrīvyāsa uvāca sūkṣmā gatirmahārāja viditā pāpapuṇyayoḥ | tathā brahmagatiḥ prājñaiḥ sarvaśāstravidāṃ varaiḥ || 39 || daivayogādasya puṇyaṃ prāptaṃ vai svayamarthavat | yena puṇyena śuddho'sau tacchṛṇu tvaṃ mahāmate || 40 || kasyāpi hastato yatra patitā dvārakāmṛdaḥ | tatraivāyam mṛtaḥ pāpī śuddho'bhūttatprabhāvataḥ || 41 || gopīcandanaliptāṃgo naro nārāyaṇo bhavet | etasya darśanātsadyo brahmahatyā pramucyate || 42 || śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvā dharmarājaḥ tamānīya viśeṣataḥ | vimāne kāmage sthāpya vaikuṇṭhaṃ prakṛteḥ param || 43 || preṣayāmāsa sahasā gopīcandanakīrtivit | evaṃ te kathitaṃ rājan gopīcandanakaṃ yaśaḥ || 44 || gopīcandanamāhātmyaṃ ya śrṛṇoti narottamaḥ | sa yāti paramaṃ dhāma śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ || 45 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ dvārakākhaṃḍe śrīnārada bahulāśva saṃvāde kapiṭaṃkanṛgakūpa gopībhūmimāhātmyaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<6.16> śrīnārada uvāca siddhāśramasya māhātmyaṃ śruṇu rājan mahāmate | yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 1 || yatsparśanāddhareḥ sākṣāt na viyogo bhavetkvacit | taṃ ca siddhāśramaṃ nāma vadantīha purāvidaḥ || 2 || darśanādyasya sālokyaṃ sāmīpyaṃ sparśanāttathā | sārūpyaṃ snānato yāti sāyujyaṃ tannivāsataḥ || 3 || tattīrthasyāpi māhātmyaṃ śrutvā caṃdrānanāmukhāt | rādhā snātu manaścakre kṛṣṇavikṣepavihvalā || 4 || śrīsiddhāśramayātrāyāṃ sūryaparvaṇi mādhave | rādhā snātuṃ manaścakre utthāya kadalīvanāt || 5 || gopīnāṃ śatayūthena sarvagopagaṇaiḥ saha | śatavarṣe vyatīte tu śrīdāmnaḥ śāpakāraṇāt || 6 || śrīrādhā śibikārūḍhā chatracāmaravījitā | ānarteṣu mahātīrthaṃ yayau siddhāśramaṃ satī || 7 || tatraiva bhagavān sākṣādyādavaiḥ parimaṃḍitaḥ | strīṇāṃ ṣoḍaśasāhasrairyātrārthaṃ cāyayau nṛpa || 8 || baliṣṭhā ye ca gopālāḥ koṭiśaḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ | siddhāśramaṃ te jugupuḥ sarvato rādhikājñayā || 9 || śatayūthāstathā gopyo vetrahastā mahābalāḥ | siddhāśrame ca vidhivatsnāntīṃ rādhāṃ siṣevire || 10 || dvārakāvāsināṃ teṣāṃ sthitānāṃ snānamicchatām | śastravetraistāḍitānāṃ viviśurbhagavatstriyaḥ || 11 || keyaṃ snātīti papracchuryasyā vaibhavamaddhutam | yadgauravāttrasantīha sarve yādavapuṃgavā || 12 || aho kasya priyā ceyaṃ kā nāma kutra vāsinī | tvam sarvajño hi bhagavān vada no devakīsuta || 13 || śrībhagavānuvāca bṛṣabhānusutā sākṣādrādheyaṃ kīrtinandinī | vrajeśvarī maddayitā gopikādhīśvarī varā || 14 || snātuṃ siddhāśramaṃ prāptā vrajādgopīgaṇaiḥ saha | yadgauravāttrasantyete tasyā vaibhavamadbhutam || 15 || śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā satyabhāmā'tha bhāminī | śanaiḥ prāha sapatnīnāṃ rūpayauvanagarvitā || 16 || kiṃ nu rādhā rūpavatī nāhaṃ rūpavatī kimu | bahubhiryācitā pūrvaṃ rūpaudāryaguṇārcitā || 17 || madrūpakāraṇātsakhyaḥ śatadhanvā mṛto'bhavat | akrūraḥ kṛtavarmā ca purā tau dvau palāyitau || 18 || dine dine svarṇabhārānaṣṭau sa sṛjati svataḥ | durbhikṣamāryariṣṭāni sarvādhivyādhayo'śubhāḥ || 19 || na saṃti māyinastatra yatrāste'bhyarcito maṇiḥ | matpitrā pāribarhe'pi dattaḥ sākṣātsyamaṃtakaḥ || 20 || tena jātaṃ madgṛhe'pi sarvaṃ vaibhavamadbhutam | premṇā pareṇa śrīkṛṣṇagaruḍoparigāminī || 21 || bhaumāsuramahāyuddhaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ prāgjyotiṣaṃ puram | mamāpi kṛpayā yūyaṃ tatpurācca samāgatāḥ || 22 || prāptāḥ śrīkṛṣṇapatnītvaṃ sarvā eva na saṃśayaḥ | madgauravācca śakrāya chatraṃ dattamanena vai || 23 || kuṃḍale devamātre ca datte vai matpriyecchayā | airāvatabhavā nāgā bhaumāsurasamṛddhayaḥ || 24 || madicchayā samānītāḥ śrīkṛṣṇena mahātmanā | matkāraṇānmahāvairaṃ śakre'pi kṛtavān hariḥ || 25 || maddvāre vartate nityaṃ vṛkṣeṃdraḥ pārijātakaḥ | pātivratyenaiva mayā śrīkṛṣṇo'yaṃ vaśīkṛtaḥ || 26 || sarvopaskarasaṃyukto nāradāya samarpitaḥ | matsamānaṃ na kasyāstu gauravaṃ vaibhavaṃ tathā || 27 || rūpaudāryaṃ na kasyāstu rādhayāḥ kimu varṇanam | yadrūpopari caidyādyā anena yuyudhuryudhi || 28 || he subhru rukmiṇī sā tvaṃ kathaṃ rūpavatī na hi | sā gopakanyakā sakhyo yūyaṃ vai rājakanyakāḥ | dhanyā mānyāśca sarvā vai yūyaṃ mānavatīvarāḥ || 29 || evaṃ tu satyabhāmāyāṃ vadaṃtyāṃ maithileśvara | bhūtvā mānavatī sarvā rukmiṇyādyāḥ striyo varāḥ || 30 || kulakauśalaśīlārtharūpayauvanagarvitāḥ | śrīkṛṣṇaṃ mānadaṃ prāhuraṣṭa paṭṭamahāstriyaḥ || 31 || rājñya ūcuḥ śrutaṃ tava mukhātpūrvaṃ rādhārūpaṃ paraṃ smṛtam | yasyāṃ raktaḥ sadā tvaṃ vai tvayi raktā ca yā sadā || 32 || tāṃ rādhāṃ drṣṭumicchāmastvatpriyāṃ vrajavāsinīm | tvadviyogena saṃkhinnāṃ snātuṃ cātra samāgatām || 33 || śrīnārada uvāca tathā'stu coktvā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paṭṭastrīpariveṣṭitaḥ | ṣoḍaśastrīsahasrāḍhyo draṣṭuṃ rādhāṃ jagāma ha || 34 || śrīhemaśibire ramye patākādhvajamaṃḍite | caṃdramaṃḍalaśobhāḍhye vitānatanite śubhe || 35 || muktājavanikā yatra vastrairāstaraṇaṃ śubham | mālatīmakaraṃdāḍhyaṃ sarvato gaṃdhasaṃkulam || 36 || tena śrṛṃgāvalī cakre kalaṃ kolāhalaṃ param | tatra rādhā paṭṭarājñī śrīkṛṣṇahṛtamānasā || 37 || haṃsābhairvyajanairdivyairvījyamānā sakhījanaiḥ | chatradolādharaistatra vrajadbhistāmitastataḥ || 38 || bālārkakuṇḍaladharā vidyuddāmamanoharā | koṭicandrapratīkāśā tanvī komalavigrahā || 39 || aṃgulyagraiḥ śobhanaiḥ svaiḥ puṣpabhūmiṃ manoharam | śanaiḥ śanaiḥ pādapadmaṃ dhārayantyatikomalam || 40 || dūrāt tāṃ rādhikāṃ prekṣya kṛṣṇapatnyaḥ sahasraśaḥ | jagmurmūrchāṃ mahārāja tadrūpeṇātimohitāḥ || 41 || tattejasā hatarucaḥ sūryāttārāgaṇā yathā | gatarūpābhimānāstā ūcuḥ sarvāḥ parasparam || 42 || aho etādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ trilokyāṃ na hi cādbhutam | śrutaṃ yathā tathā dṛṣṭamadvitīyaṃ manoharam || 43 || evaṃ vadatyastāṃ prāptāḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya puraḥsarāḥ | gopīnāṃ rājaputrīṇāṃ netrāṇi parirebhire || 44 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ dvārakākhaṃḍe śrīnārada bahulāśva saṃvāde rādhārūpadarśanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<6.17> śrīnārada uvāca śrīkṛṣṇamāgataṃ vīkṣya paṭṭarājñīsamanvitam | tadā jayajayārāvaṃ cakrurgopyo'tiharṣitāḥ || 1 || sahasā śrīhariṃ rādhā parikramya kṛtāṃjaliḥ | padmābhābhyāṃ tu netrābhyāṃ ānaṃdāśrūṇi muṃcatī || 2 || syamantakakhacitpādaṃ ciṃtāmaṇīkhacittaṭam | padmarāgalasanmadhyaṃ candramaṇḍalavartulam || 3 || kaustubhaiḥ prakhacitpṛṣṭhaṃ kumbhamaṇḍalamaṇḍitam | pārijātakapuṣpāḍhyaṃ pīyūṣasrāvichatramat || 4 || dattvā siṃhāsanaṃ tasmai prāha prahasitānanā | adya me saphalaṃ janma cādya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ || 5 || adya me saphalo dharmo hare tvayyāgate sati | dhanyaṃ siddhāśramasnānaṃ saphalībhūtamadbhutam | mayā'pi na kṛtā bhaktistava bhaktasahāyinaḥ || 6 || bahavaśca sahāyā me tvayā deva kṛtā bhuvi | kaṃso'pi lokavijayī yena bhīto babhūva ha || 7 || sa mārito madvacanācchaṃkhacūḍastvayā hare | matpremṇā'pi tvayā deva vaibhavaṃ darśitaṃ vraje || 8 || śakrasya mānabhaṃgopi kṛto deva tvayā balāt | matkāraṇādvrajaṃ rakṣan dhṛtvā govardhanācalam || 9 || yathecchāliṃgito rāse gopībhistvaṃ vaśīkṛtaḥ | idaṃ te caritaṃ deva naralokaviḍaṃbanam || 10 || evaṃ vadantī sā rādhā tvaraṃ candrānanājñayā | sādareṇa hareḥ patnīrvīkṣya tā gauravaṃ dadau || 11 || bhaiṣmīṃ jāṃbavatīṃ bhāmāṃ satyāṃ bhadrāṃ ca lakṣmaṇām | kāliṃdīṃ mitraviṃdāṃ ca militvā sā parasparam || 12 || ṣoḍaśastrīsahasraṃ ca rohiṇīmukhameva ca | premānaṃdamayī dorbhyāṃ parirebhe mudānvitā || 13 || rādhovāca candro yathaiko bahavaścakorāḥ sūryo yathaiko bahavo dṛśaḥ syuḥ | śrīkṛṣṇacandro bhagavāṃstathaiko bhaktā bhaginyo bahavo vayaṃ ca || 14 || padmaprabhāvaṃ madhupo yathā hi ratnaprabhāvaṃ kila tatparīkṣit | vidyāprabhāvaṃ ca yathā hi vidvān kāvyaprabhāvaṃ ca yathā kavīṃdraḥ || 15 || yathā sahasreṣu janeṣu satsu rasaprabhāvaṃ rasikastathā hi | jānāti tattvena narendraputryaḥ kṛṣṇaprabhāvaṃ bhuvi kṛṣṇabhaktaḥ || 16 || śrīnārada uvāca rādhāvākyaṃ tadā śrutvā rukmiṇī bhīṣmanandinī | sapatnīsahitā prāha rādhāṃ kamalalocanām || 17 || rukmiṇyuvāca dhanyā'si rādhe vṛṣabhānuputri tvadbhaktibhāvena vaśīkṛto'yam | vadatyalaṃ yasya kathāṃ trilokī sa eva vārtāṃ vadati tvadīyām || 18 || śrutaṃ yathā te haribhāvalakṣaṇaṃ tathā hi dṛṣṭaṃ na hi citrameva hi | gacchāśu cāsmacchibirāṇī yatra hi tvāṃ netumatrāgatavatya ādṛtāḥ || 19 || śrīnārada uvāca evamuktvā bhīṣmasutā rādhāṃ kīrtisutāṃ sadā | samānīya svaśibire sādareṇa mahātmanā || 20 || śibire sarvatobhadre padmākiṃjalkavāsite | haime śirīṣamṛdule paryaṃke sopabarhaṇe || 21 || sukhaṃ nivāsayāmāsa vāsaḥ sraṅmaṃḍanādibhiḥ | saṃpūjya vidhivadrātrau sapatnīsahitā satī || 22 || gopīnāṃ śatayūthaṃ ca saṃpūjya ca pṛthakpṛthak | vārtālāpānbahuvidhānkṛtvā kṛṣṇapriyāstataḥ | sthāpayitvā'tha tāṃ jagmuḥ svaṃ svaṃ vai śibiraṃ mudā || 23 || kṛṣṇapārśvaṃ gatā bhaiṣmī dṛṣṭvā jāgradupasthitam | kathaṃ na śeṣe bho svāminniti kṛṣṇamuvāca ha || 24 || śrībhagavānuvāca pratyudgamaprasravaṇairāśvāsena vrajeśvari | arcitā hi tvayā subhruḥ prasannā sā'bhavatparam || 25 || sā ca nityaṃ hi pibati śayanādau payaḥ śubham | payaḥpānaṃ tu na kṛtamadya subhruḥ tayā kila || 26 || tena nidrā nayanayorna jātā'syā mahāmate | tasmānmamāpi prasvāpo na jāto bhīṣmakanyake || 27 || śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvā paraṃ bhaiṣmī sapatnībhiḥ samanvitā | nītvā dugdhaṃ tatsamīpaṃ prayayau paramādarāt || 28 || uṣṇaṃ dugdhaṃ sitāyuktam kacole haimane kṛtam | apāyayatparaṃ prītyā rādhāṃ bhīṣmakanaṃndinī || 29 || evamabhyarcya vidhivat datvā tāmbūlabīṭikām | satyabhāmādibhiḥ śaśvatsapatnībhiḥ samanvitā || 30 || āgatya kṛṣṇasāmīpyaṃ vadaṃtī svakṛtaṃ śubhā | bheje śrīrukmiṇī sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇapadapaṃkajam || 31 || saṃlālayaṃtī satataṃ komalaiḥ karapallavaiḥ | kṛṣṇapādatale chālānvīkṣya sā vismitā'bhavat || 32 || ucchālakāḥ kathaṃ jātāḥ tava pādatale prabho | adyaiva bhūtā bhagavanna vedmyatra hi kāraṇam || 33 || ṣoḍaśastrīsahasrāṇāṃ śrṛṇvaṃtīnāṃ hariḥ svayam | rādhābhaktiprakāśārthaṃ prasannaḥ prāha rukmiṇīm || 34 || śrībhagavānuvāca śrīrādhikāyā hṛdayāraviṃde pādāravindaṃ hi virājate me | aharniśaṃ praśrayapāśabaddhaṃ lavaṃ lavārddhaṃ na calatyatīva || 35 || adyoṣṇadugdhapratipānatoṃ'ghrāvucchālakāste mama procchalaṃti | maṃdoṣṇameva hi na dattamasmai yuṣmābhiruṣṇaṃ tu payaḥ pradattam || 36 || śrīnārada uvāca śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā rukmiṇyādyā striyo varāḥ | premṇā pādaṃ vimṛjyātha visismuḥ sarvato nṛpa || 37 || śrīrādhāyāḥ parā prītiḥ mādhave madhusūdane | tatsamānā na caikaiṣā advitīyā mahītale || 38 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ dvārakākhaṃḍe śrīnārada bahulāśva saṃvāde siddhāśrame śrīrādhākṛṣṇasamāgame rādhāpremaprakāśo nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<6.18> śrīnārada uvāca śrīrādhāyāḥ parāṃ prītiṃ jñātvā gopīgaṇasya ca | ūcurhariṃ rājaputryastarāsaprekṣaṇotsukāḥ || 1 || dhanyā gopyastu te bhaktāḥ premalakṣaṇasaṃyutāḥ | yāḥ prāptā rāsaraṃge vai tāsāṃ kiṃ varṇyate tapaḥ || 2 || vṛndāvane kṛto rāso vidhinā yena mādhava | taṃ vidhiṃ draṣṭumicchāmo yadi tvaṃ manyase prabho || 3 || tvaṃ cātraiva tathā rādhā gopyaḥ sarvā vrajāṃganāḥ | vayaṃ cātraiva deveśa rāso yogyo bhavediha || 4 || pūrṇaṃ kuru janannātha asmākaṃ tu manoratham | kṛto manoratho'nyo na rāsakrīḍāṃ vinā hare || 5 || iti tāsāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānprahasanniva | prāha tāḥ premasaṃyukto gīrbhiḥ saṃmohayanniva || 6 || śrībhagavānuvāca rāseśvaryāstu rādhāyā manaścedrantumaṃganāḥ | tadā rāso bhavedatra bhavatībhistu pṛcchyatām || 7 || iti śrutvā vacastasya rukmiṇyādyā nṛpātmajāḥ | rādhāmetya paraṃ premṇā prāhuḥ prahasitānanāḥ || 8 || rājñya ūcuḥ rambhoru candravadane vrajasundarīśe rāseśvari priyatame sakhi śīlarūpe | rādhe sukīrtikulakīrtikare śubhāṃge tvāṃ praṣṭumāgatavatīḥ sakalā vayaṃ sma || 9 || rāseśvaro'pi kila cātra rasapradāyī rāseśvarī tvamapi gopavarāṃganāśca | evaṃ vayaṃ sma iti sarvavidhau rasārthe rāsaṃ kuru priyatame ca tathā priyaṃ naḥ || 10 || śrīrādhovāca rāseśvarasya paramasya satāṃ kṛpālo rantuṃ mano yadi bhavettu tadā'tra rāsaḥ | śuśrūṣayā paramayā parayā ca bhaktyā saṃpūjya taṃ kila vaśīkuruta priyeṣṭāḥ || 11 || śrīnārada uvāca rādhāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā śrīkṛṣṇoktaṃ tathā'vadan | tathāstu coktvā sā rādhā prasanna'bhūnmahāmanāḥ || 12 || mādhave pūrṇimāyāṃ tu puṇye siddhāśrame śubhe | pradoṣakāle candrābhe rāsārambho babhūva ha || 13 || rāseśvarasya rāsārthe rāseśvaryā samanvitaḥ | rarāja rāse rasiko yathā ratyā ratīśvaraḥ || 14 || yāvatīrgopikāḥ sarvā yāvatī rājakanyakāḥ | tāvadrūpadharo reje ekaḥ kṛṣṇo dvayordvayoḥ || 15 || tālaveṇumṛdaṃgānāṃ kalakaṇṭhaiḥ sakhījanaiḥ | valgunū purakāñcīnāṃ miśraśabdo mahānabhūt || 16 || koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaḥ sragvī kuṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ | pītāṃbaradharo rājan kirīṭakaṭakāṃgadaḥ || 17 || rāseśvaryā samaṃ gāyan rāse rāseśvaraḥ svayam | strīgaṇaiḥ sahito rājaṃścandrastārāgaṇairyathā || 18 || evaṃ sarvā niśā rājan kṣaṇavadrāsamaṇḍale | vyatītā'bhūnmahārāja mahānandamayī śubhā || 19 || śrīrāsamaṃḍalaṃ dṛṣṭvā rukmiṇyādyāḥ striyo varāḥ | jagmustāḥ paramānaṃdaṃ sarvā pūrṇamanorathāḥ || 20 || paripūrṇatamaṃ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam | rāsāṃte rukmiṇīmukhyāḥ prāhuḥ premaparāyaṇāḥ || 21 || rājñya ūcuḥ dṛṣṭvā tvad rūpamādhuryaṃ rāsaraṃge manohare | gataṃ mano naḥ svānaṃdaṃ brahmānaṃdaṃ yathā muniḥ || 22 || etādṛśo'pi rāso'nyo na bhūto na bhaviṣyati | śatayūthastu gopīnāmatra mādhava vartate || 23 || patnyaḥ ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ sakhībhiḥ sahitā vayam | sakhīkoṭiyutāścātra aṣṭapaṭṭamahāstriyaḥ | vṛndāvane'pi naitādṛgbhūto vā mādhaveśvara || 24 || śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ kṛtābhimānānāṃ rājñīnāṃ prahasanhariḥ | prāhedaṃ pṛcchatāṃ rādhāṃ bhavatībhiḥ parasparam || 25 || satyabhāmādikāḥ sarvāḥ pṛcchaṃti tāṃ manoharām | kiṃcid hasaṃtī manasī prāha rādhā paraṃ vacaḥ || 26 || śrīrādhovāca nanu rāsaḥ paraṃ cātra bahustrīgaṇasaṃkulaḥ | pūrvarāsasamo na syād yastu vṛṃdāvane'bhavat || 27 || kva cātra vṛndāraṇyaṃ hi divyadrumalatākulam | premabhārānatalataṃ madhumattamadhuvratam || 28 || puṣpavyūhānvahantī yā yathoṣṇiṅmudritā śubhā | haṃsapadmasamākīrṇā kva cātra yamunā nadī || 29 || mādhavyastu latāḥ kvātra puṣpabhāranatāḥ parāḥ | kva pakṣiṇaḥ premaparā gāyanti madhurasvanam || 30 || lolālipuñjāḥ kuñjāḥ kva nikuñjā divyamaṃdirāḥ | kva vāyuḥ śītalo maṃdo vāti padmarajo haran || 31 || śrṛṃgairmanoharairuccairgirirgovardhano'calaḥ | sarvatra phalapuṣpāḍhyo darībhiḥ kva karīva saḥ || 32 || kālindīpuline ramye vāyunā'nvitasaikate | vaṃśīvetradharo mallaparibarhavirājitaḥ || 33 || kva cātra kṛṣṇaśrṛṃgāro vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ | śyāmānāmalakānāṃ ca vakrāṇāṃ gaṃdhadhāriṇām || 34 || calitaṃ halitaṃ kvātra kuṇḍalābhyāṃ parasparam | śrīmukhe kṛṣṇacaṃdrasya gaṃḍasthalamanohare || 35 || patrāvalīgaṃdhalobhādbhramadbhṛṃgāvalīyute | kva premṇā darśanaṃ caiva sparśanaṃ harṣaṇaṃ tathā || 36 || kāmeṣutigmakoṇaiśca netreḥ kvāpāṃgajo rasaḥ | ākarṣaṇaṃ kva hastābhyāṃ hastāddhastavisarjanam || 37 || vilīnatvaṃ nikuṃjeṣu saṃmukhena tu darśanam | grahaṇaṃ kvātra cīrāṇāṃ haraṇaṃ veṇuvetrayoḥ || 38 || kva premṇā cātra bāhubhyāṃ karṣaṇaṃ ca parasparam | punaḥ punastadgrahaṇaṃ bhuje caṃdanacarcitam || 39 || yatra yatra ca yā līlā tatra tatraiva śobhate | yatra vṛdāvanaṃ nāsti tatra me na manaḥsukham || 40 || śrīnārada uvāca rādhāvākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā sarvāḥ paṭṭamahāstriyaḥ | jahurmānaṃ svarāsasya vismitā harṣitāśca tāḥ || 41 || evaṃ siddhāśrame rāsaṃ kṛtvā śrīrādhikeśvaraḥ | nītvā gopīgaṇānsarvān rādhayā sahito hariḥ || 42 || sabhāryo bhagavān sākṣāddvārakāṃ praviveśa ha | kārayāmāsa rādhāyai maṃdirāṇī parāṇi ca || 43 || nivāsayitvā susukhaṃ sarvāstāśca vrajaukasaḥ | itthaṃ siddhāśramakathā mayā te kathitā nṛpa || 44 || sarvapāpaharā puṇyā sarveṣāṃ caiva mokṣadā || 45 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ dvārakākhaṃḍe śrīnārada bahulāśva saṃvāde siddhāśramamāhātmye rāsotsavo nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<6.19> śrīnārada uvāca || dvārāvatīmaṇḍalaṃ tu śatayojanavistṛtam || tasya pradakṣiṇā sarvā yojanānāṃ catuḥśatam ||1|| tanmadhyekṛṣṇaracitaṃ durgaṃ dvādaśayojanam || dvitīyaṃ ca bahirdurgaṃ navatiṃ ca duruttaram || krośaiḥ saṃghaṭṭitaṃ rājañchrīkṛṣṇena mahātmanā ||2|| tṛtīyaṃ ca tathā durgaṃ dyūnaiśca dviśatairnṛpa || krośaiḥ saṃghaṭṭitaṃ rājanratnaprāsādasaṃyutam || 3 || teṣāmaṃtaradurgepi śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ || maṃdirāṇi vicitrāṇi navalakṣāṇi saṃti hi ||4|| tatra rādhāmaṃdirasya dvāre līlāsarovaram || sarvatīrthottamaṃ rājangolokācca samāgatam || 5 || yasminsnātvā naraḥ pāpī vratī bhūtvā samāhitaḥ || aṣṭamyāṃ hemadānaṃ ca dattvā natvā vidhānataḥ ||6|| koṭijanmakṛtaiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || prāṇāṃte tannaraṃ netuṃ golokācca mahārathaḥ ||7|| sahasrādityasaṃkāśa āgacchati na saṃśayaḥ || daśakaṃdarpalāvaṇyo ratnakuṇḍalamaṃḍitaḥ || 8 || sragvī pītāṃbaraḥ śyāmaḥ sahasrārkasphuraddyutiḥ || sahasrapārṣadairyuktaścāmarāṃdolarājitaḥ ||9|| jayadhvanisamāyukto veṇuduṃdubhināditaḥ || bhūtvaivaṃ rathamāsthāya golokaṃ yātyasaṃśayam || 6.19.10 || atha tīrthāni cānyāni śṛṇu rājanmahāmate || śatottarāṇi tatraiva sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa || 11 || aṣṭabhiḥ sahitānyeva patnīnāṃ bhavanāni ca || tāni pradakṣiṇīkṛtya natvā natvā pṛthakpṛthak || 12 || jñānatīrthaṃ samāplutya spṛśedyaḥ pārijātakam || tasya jñānaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ bhaktirbhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 13|| śrīkṛṣṇo hṛdaye tasya vaseddhṛṣṭamanāḥ sadā || samṛddhisiddhayaḥ sarvāstaṃ bhajaṃti nisargataḥ || 14 || sa muktaḥ sa kṛtārthaḥ syādyaḥ paśyeddharimaṃdiram || tatsamo vaiṣṇavo nāsti tīrthaṃ ca tatsamaṃ nahi || 15 || paṃcayojanavistīrṇādbhagavanmaṃdirāttataḥ || dhanuḥśate kṛṣṇakuṇḍaḥ kṛṣṇatejaḥ samudbhavaḥ ||16|| yaṃ snātvā kuṣṭhato muktaḥ sāṃbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ|| tasya darśana mātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||17|| tasmādaṣṭādaśapade pūrvasyāṃ diśi maithila || sarvatīrthottamaṃ puṇyaṃ balabhadrasaro mahat || 18 || pṛthvīpradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā baladevo mahābala.|| yajñaṃ yatra vinirmāya revatyā virarāja ha ||19| tatra snātvā naraḥ sadyo mucyate sarvapātakāt || pṛthvīpradakṣiṇāyāśca phalaṃ tasya na durlabham || 6.19.20 || bhagavanmaṃdirādrājansahasradhanuragrataḥ || dakṣiṇasyāṃ mahātīrthaṃ gaṇanāthasya vartate ||21|| anirdaśe gate rājanpradyumna svasute tadā || gaṇeśapūjanaṃ yatra pūjayāmāsa rukmiṇī ||22|| tatra snātvā hemadānaṃ yo dadāti nṛpeśvara || putraprāptirbhavettasya vaṃśastasya vivarddhate || 23 || bhagavanmaṃdirādrājandigvibhāge ca paścime || dhanuṣi dviśate cāste dānatīrthaṃ paraṃ śubham ||24|| yatra śrīkṛṣṇacandrasya nityaṃ dānaṃ karoti yaḥ || tatra snātvā naro rājandvipalaṃ kāṃcanaṃ tathā || 29 || caturguṇaṃ tu rajataṃ paṭṭāṃbaraśataṃ tathā || tathā sahasramaulyāni navaratnāni yāni ca || 26 || yo dadāti naraśreṣṭhastasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca || 27 || dānatīrthasya puṇyasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || badrikāśramayātrāyāṃ yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ || 28 || saiṃdhavāraṇyayātrāyāṃ meṣasthe ca divākare || 29 || utpalāvartayātrāyāṃ vṛṣasthe bhāskare sati || snānaṃ dānaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavatīha na saṃśayaḥ || 6.19.30 || tasmātkoṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ dānatīrthe videharāṭ || māsamekaṃ ca yatsnānaṃ dānatīrthe karoti ha || 31 || tasya jātaṃ ca yatpuṇyaṃ citragupto na vetti tat || tasya tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ nālaṃ caturmukhaḥ ||32|| sarveṣāṃ caiva dānānāmaśvadānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam|| aśvadānādgajasyāpi gajadānādrathasya ca ||33|| rathadānātparaṃ rājanbhūmidānaṃ viśiṣyate || bhūmidānādannadānaṃ mahādānaṃ prakathyate || 34 || annadānasamaṃ dānaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || devarṣipitṛbhūtānāṃ tṛptirannena jāyate || 35 || dānatīrthe hyannadānaṃ yaḥ karoti mahāmanā || ṛṇatrayavimucyātha yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam || 35 || daśaiva mātṛke pakṣe rājeṃdra daśa paitṛke || priyāyā daśa pakṣe tu puruṣānuddharennaraḥ || 37 || caturbhujā divyarūpā nāgārikṛtaketanāḥ || sragviṇaḥ pītavastrāste prayāṃti harimaṃdiram || 38 || bhagavanmaṃdirādrājannuttarasyāṃ diśi śrutam || krośārddhe nṛpaśārdūla māyātīrthaṃ manoharam || 39 || virājate yatra nityaṃ durgā durgatināśinī || siṃhārūḍhā bhadrakālī caṃḍamuṇḍavināśinī || 6.19.40 || syamaṃtakaṃ samāhartumṛkṣarājabilaṃgate || putre ca devakī devīṃ pūjayāmāsa satphaleḥ ||41 || tadā jagāma priyayā samaṇirbhagavānhariḥ || tadbilāttatprasiddhaṃ syānmāyātīrthaṃ phalapradam || 42 || māyātīrthe ca yaḥ snātvā māyāṃ saṃpūjya mānavaḥ| sarvāṃ manorathaprāptiṃ prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ||43|| iti śrīmadgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīdvārakākhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśva saṃvāde prathamadurge līlāsarovara harimaṃdira jñānatīrtha kṛṣṇakuṇḍa balabhadrasaro gaṇeśatīrtha māhātmyaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 ||
<6.20> śrīnārada uvāca || dvitīyasyāpi durgasya pūrvadvāre videharāṭ || indratīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ kāmadaṃ siddhidāyakam || 1 || tatra snātvā naro rājanniṃdralokaṃ prayāti hi || ihaiva candra sādṛśyaṃ vaibhavaṃ prāpyate naraḥ ||2|| tathā vai dakṣiṇe dvāre sūryakuṇḍobhidhīyate|| yatra satrājitenāpi pūjitobhūtsyamaṃtakaḥ || 3 || tatra snātvā padmarāgaṃ yo dadāti nṛpeśvara || sūryaprabhavimānena sūryalokaṃ prayāti hi ||4|| tathā vai paścime dvāre brahmatīrthaṃ viśiṣyate || tatra snātvā naro rājansvarṇapātre ca pāyasam || ||5|| yo dadāti mahabuddhistasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || brahmahā pitṛhā goghno mātṛhācāryahāghavān ||6|| indraloke padaṃ dhṛtvā bibhradbrahmamayaṃ vapuḥ || candrābhena vimānena yāti brahmapadaṃ sa ca ||7|| tathā vai uttare dvāre kṣetraṃ syānnailalohitam || yatra sākṣānmahādevo rājate nīlalohitaḥ ||8|| devatā munayaḥ sarve tathā saptarṣayaḥ pare || vasaṃti yatra vaideha tathā sarve marudgaṇāḥ || 9 || nīlalohitaliṃgaṃ tu yatra saṃpūjya yatnataḥ || aiśvaryamatulaṃ lebhe rāvaṇo lokarāvaṇaḥ || 6.20.10 || kailāsasyāpi yātrāyāṃ yatphalaṃ labhate nṛpa || tasmācchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ nīlalohitadarśanāt ||11|| nīlalohitakuṇḍe vai snāti yastridinaṃ naraḥ || sa yāti śivalokākhyaṃ pāpāyutayutopi hi || 12 || saptasāmudrakaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ yatra virājate || tatra snātvā naraḥ pāpī pāpasaṃghaiḥ pramucyate || 13 || samānaṃ ca samudrāṇāṃ snānapuṇyaṃ labhettvaram || viṣṇurviriṃcyo giriśa indro vāyuryamo raviḥ ||14|| parjanyo dhanadaḥ somaḥ kṣitiragnirapāṃpatiḥ|| tatpārśveṣu sadā hyete tiṣṭhaṃti manujeśvara ||15|| saptakoṭīni tīrthāni brahmāṃḍe yāni kāni ca || sarvāṇi tatra tiṣṭhaṃti saptasāmudrake nṛpa ||16|| tatra snātvā naraḥ paścātkṛtvā sarvaparikramam || prāpnoti dvārakāyāśca yātrāyā saphalaṃ phalam || 17 || saptasāmudrakamṛtena yātrā phaladā smṛtā || saptasāmudrakatīrthaṃ viṣṇu rūpaṃ viduḥ surāḥ || 18 || itiśrīmadgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīdvārakākhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde dvitīyadurge indratīrtha brahmatīrtha sūryakuṇḍa nailalohita saptasamudra māhātmyaṃnāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 ||
<6.21> śrīnārada uvāca || tṛtīyasyāpi durgasya pūrvadvāre mahābalaḥ || rakṣatyaharniśaṃ rājanhanūmānaṃjanīsutaḥ|| 1 || taṃ prekṣya bhagavadbhaktaṃ hanūmaṃtaṃ mahābalam || jāyate bhagavadbhakto hanūmānaniva mānavaḥ||2|| tathā vai dakṣiṇadvāraṃ cakraṃ nāma sudarśanam| rakṣatyaharniśaṃ rājañchrīkṛṣṇa gatamānasam || 3 || tasya darśanamātreṇa bhavedbhakto hareḥ paraḥ || bhaktasyāpi sadā rakṣāṃ karoti hi sudarśanam ||4|| tathā vai paścimaṃ dvāraṃ jāṃbavānṛkṣarāḍbalī || rakṣatyaharniśaṃ rājanbhagavadbhaktisaṃyutaḥ ||5|| taṃ prekṣya bhagavadbhaktaṃ jāṃbavaṃtaṃ mahābalam || cirajīvī harerbhakto bhavatīha ca mānavaḥ || 6 || tathā vai cottaraṃ dvāraṃ viṣvakseno mahābalaḥ || rakṣatyaharniśaṃ rājañchrīkṛṣṇahṛdayo mahān ||7|| tasyadarśanamātreṇa naro yāti kṛtārthatām || śṛṇu rājanbahirdurgāttīrthaṃ piṃḍārakaṃ smṛtam ||8|| piṃḍārakasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇutādrājasattama || yasya smaraṇamātreṇa mahāpāpātpramucyate ||9|| arthasiddheriva dvāra raivatādrisamudrayoḥ|| madhye piṃḍārakakṣetraṃ tīrthānāṃ tīrthamuttamum || 10 || kraturājaṃ rājasūyaṃ yadurājo mahābalaḥ || cakāra yatra vaideha paripūrṇatamājñayā || 11 || sarvāṇi yatra tīrthāni samāhūtāni sarvataḥ || nivāsaṃ cakrire rājannugrasena kratūttame ||12|| tena piṃḍārakaṃ nāma sarvatīrthasya piṃḍataḥ || tatra snātvā naraḥ sadyo rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet ||13|| yatraiva tridinaṃ snātvā vratī bhūtvā samāhitaḥ || brāhmaṇebhyaḥ svarṇadānaṃ dattvā yaḥ praṇato bhavet || 14 || ihaiva naradevaḥ syātsa mahātmā na saṃśayaḥ || nityaṃ śṛṇoti satataṃ bandivadbhi yaśaḥsvayam ||15|| suvarṇaratnavastrādyaiḥ sucandravadanaiḥ paraiḥ || strīsaṃghaiḥ sevito nityaṃ hṛṣṭapuṣṭo mahā balaḥ || 16 || ahorātraṃ pratāḍyate dvāri dundubhayo ghanāḥ|| karīdrāṇāṃ ca cītkārairaśvaheṣaissamanvitam||17|| virājate rājasaṃghaiḥ prekṣayanprāṃgaṇājirama || ratnaprāsādanicayaṃ dhvajamaṇḍalamaṃḍitam||18|| mattakuñjarakarṇābhyāṃ tāḍitā bhṛgamaṇḍalī || alaṃkaroti taddvāraṃ maṃḍitaṃ maṃḍaleśvaraiḥ || 19 | piṃḍārakasnānamṛte kathaṃ rājyaṃ bhavediha || ante mokṣaṃ kathaṃ yāti naraḥ pāpayutopi hi ||20|| piṃḍārakasnānamṛte na śarma piṃḍārakasnānamṛte na karma|| piṃḍāraka snānamṛte na dharmaḥ piṃḍārakasnānamṛte na varma || 21 || piṃḍārakasnānamṛte viyogī piṃḍārakasnānakaro viyogī || piṃḍārakasnākaraḥ subhogī piṃḍāraka snānakaro na rogī ||22|| dvārāvatīṃ mādhavamāsamadhye pradakṣiṇīkṛtya namaskaroti || sarvā ihāmutra ca siddhayopi vaideha tatpāṇitale bhavanti || 23 || tīrthāplutodhaḥśayanaḥśuciśca maunī vratī vāyavabhojanena|| ārabhya caitrī kila paurṇamāsī yo mādhavīmetya karoti yātrām ||24|| tatpuṇyasaṃkhyāṃ gadituṃ na śakyaścaturmukho vedamayo vidhātā|| yo meghadhārāṃ gaṇayetkadācitkālena puṇyāni na kṛṣṇapuryāḥ || ||25|| yathā tithīnāṃ harivāsaraṃ ca yathāhi śeṣo phaṇināṃ phaṇīndraḥ || yathā garutmāndivi pakṣiṇāṃ ca yathā purāṇeṣu ca bhārataṃ ca ||26 || yathā hi deveṣu ca devadevaḥ śrīvāsudevo yadudevadevaḥ || tathā purī kṣetrasamastamadhye dvārāvatī puṇyavatī praśastā || 27 || ahoti dhanyā yadumaṃḍalībhirvirājate bhūmitale manoharā || vaikuṇṭhalīlādhikṛtā kuśasthalī yathā taḍidbhirjaladāvalirdivi ||28|| yatraiva sākṣātpuruṣaḥ pareśvaro dhṛtvā caturvyūhamalaṃ virājate|| yastūgrasenāya dadau nṛpeśatāṃ kṛṣṇāya tasmai haraye namonamaḥ ||29|| yadā svalokaṃ bhagavāngamiṣyati saṃplāvayiṣyatyatha tāṃ tadārṇave|| vaidehadivyaṃ harimaṃdiraṃ vinā tasminnivāsaṃ bhagavānkariṣyati ||6.21.30|| śṛṇvaṃti tatraiva kalau jaladhvaniṃ kṛṣṇoktamitthaṃ sasataṃ dinedine || bhavedavidyo yadi vā savidyo yo brāhmaṇo vai sa tu māmakī tanuḥ || 31 || bhūtvātha viprobdhitaṭādagādhaṃ gatvā gṛhītvā pratimāṃ parasya|| kṛtvā pratiṃṣṭhāṃ ca vidhāya saudhaṃ kariṣyate sthāpanamarka eṣaḥ ||32|| śrīdvārakānāthamiti svarūpaṃ paśyaṃti ye bhaktajanāḥ kalau yuge|| gacchaṃti te viṣṇupadaṃ nṛdeva yogīśvarāṇāmapi durlabhaṃ yat || 33 || idaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ nṛdeva māhātmyametatkila kṛṣṇapuryāḥ || śṛṇoti yaḥ śrāvayate ca bhaktyā śrīdvārakāvāsaphalaṃ labhetsaḥ||34|| śrīdvārakāyā nṛpakhaṇḍametanmayā tavāgre kathitaṃ supuṇyam|| kīrtikulaṃbhaktimatīva muktiṃ dadāti rājyaṃ ca sadaiva śṛṇvatām ||35|| iti śrīmadgargasahitāyāṃ śrīdvārakākhaṇḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde tṛtīyadurge piṃḍāraka māhātmyaṃnāmekaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||21||
<6.22> śrīnārada uvāca śrīkṛṣṇasya sakhā kaścit sudāmā nāma brāhmaṇaḥ | sa uvāsa svapuryāṃ tu satyā ca bhāryayāvṛtaḥ || 1 || virakto dhanahīnaśca vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ | samānaśīlayā patnyā cakre vṛttimayācitām || 2 || sa kadācit priyāṃ prāha sīdamānāṃ daridrataḥ | śrīkṛṣṇo dvārakānātho mitraṃ mama pativrate || 3 || mayā tenāpi paṭhitā vidyā sāndīpanergṛhe | punarna dṛṣṭaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo bhojavṛṣṇyandhakeśvaraḥ || 4 || trailokyanātho bhagavān duḥkhahā dīnavatsalaḥ | iti śrutvā vacastasya śuṣkavaktrā pativratā || 5 || jīrṇavastradharā dīnā patiṃ prāha bubhukṣitā | yadi brahman nanu hariḥ sakhā te kamalāpatiḥ || 6 || bubhukṣitaḥ kathaṃbhūto jīrṇakarpaṭadhāraṇaḥ | dvārakāyāṃ janā gatvā dṛṣṭvā sākṣācchrīyaḥ patim | dhanayuktāḥ samāyānti tasmātvaṃ gantumarhasi || 7 || sudāmovāca sarveṣāṃ śikṣako'haṃ tvaṃ tasmai śikṣāṃ pradāsyasi | viprasya viduṣo bhikṣā dhanaṃ prakathitaṃ priye || 8 || priyovāca sakhātu śrīpatiryasya nātidūre pravarttate | tamupehi sa te duḥkhaṃ dāridryaṃ nāśayiṣyati || 9 || gatā avasthā mama te duḥkhadāridrya bhuṃjatoḥ | dātuḥ kṛpānidheḥ kānta mitratāyāśca kiṃ phalam || 10 || sudāmovāca vidhinā likhitaṃ bhāgyaṃ tattathaiva bhaviṣyati | yātāyātena kiṃ bhadre harerdhyānaṃ karomyaham || 11 || yaddvāri deśe rājāno devagandharvakinnarāḥ | ājñāṃ vinā na yāsyanti dīnasya mama kā kathā || 12 || priyovāca vinājñāṃ naiva yāsyanti devagandharvakinnarāḥ | antaryāmī hariḥ śīghraṃ dūtaistvāmāhvayiṣyati || 13 || vipra uvāca dayālurīdṛśaḥ kṛṣṇo parantu śrṛṇu bhāmini | vipattikāle mitrasya na gacched gṛhamuttamam || 14 || kathaṃ tu yācanāṃ kurve cirāddṛṣṭvā svakaṃ priyam | nirlobhāttu bhavet prītiryācanāttu gamiṣyati || 15 || priyovāca duḥkhadāridryaharaṇaṃ śrīharedarśanaṃ kuru | yācanā naiva kartavyā sa te'rthaṃ bahu dāsyati | evaṃ tu priyayā vipro bahudhaivaṃ prabhāṣitaḥ || 16 || ayaṃ hi paramo lābhaḥ kṛtvā mitrasya darśanam | upāyanaṃ tu kiṃ dāsye lajjito'haṃ daridrataḥ || 17 || ityuktvā sā gatā śīghraṃ parageha tadā satī | taṇḍulāṃścaturo muṣṭin yācitvā svagṛhaṃ yayau || 18 || jīrṇakarpaṭakhaṇḍe ca baddhvā tān pataye dadau || 19 || tato gṛhītvā pṛthukāṃśca taṇḍulān kucailadhārī malinaśca durbalaḥ | jagāma kṛṣṇasya purīṃ śanaiḥ śanairbrahmaṇyadevaṃ manasā ca saṃsmaran || 20 || sottīrya sindhumuḍupena dadarśa tatra śrīdvārakāṃ haripuriṃ kanakairvicitrām | śreṇīsabhāvividhadurgagṛhaiḥ patākaiḥ śrṛṃgāṭakairatibalairyadubhiśca guptām || 21 || dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇapurīṃ vipro janānāpṛchya śrīhareḥ | śrīmandiraṃ tu kutrāste sarve vadata sāmpratam || 22 || iti śrutvā mādhavasya bhavanānāñca rakṣakāḥ | ūcuste vartate kṛṣṇaḥ sarveṣu mandireṣu ca || 23 || ityupaśrutya sadanaṃ praviśyaikatamaṃ dvijaḥ | brahmānandaṃ gataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ paryaṃkasthaṃ vilokya ca || 24 || sakhāyamāgataṃ jñātvā sahasotthāya mādhavaḥ | dorbhyāṃ militvā cānyonyaṃ premṇā hyaśrukalākulaḥ || 25 || svarṇapātreṇa tasyāpi pādau prakṣyālya tajjalam | gṛhītvā śirasā taṃ tu paryaṃka upaveśya ca || 26 || arcanaṃ kṛtavān gandhacandanāgurukuṃkumaiḥ | pakvānnairdhūpadīpaiśca madhuparkairvidhānataḥ || 27 || paścādāvedya tāmbūlaṃ gāñca svāgatamabravīt | vṛddhaṃ kucailaṃ malinaṃ durbalaṃ śvetamūrddhajam || 28 || mitravindā paryacaradvyajanena smitānvitā | śrīkṛṣṇasya priyāḥ sarvā vismitā jahasustadā || 29 || ūcuḥ parasparaṃ nāryaḥ prekṣya vipraṃ samarcitam | bhikṣuṇā hyavadhūtena kimanena kṛtaṃ tapaḥ || 30 || yena trailokyanāthena satkṛtaścāgrajo yathā | etasminnantare tau dvau kathayāñcakratuḥ kathāḥ | pūrvā gurukule jātā hastau gṛhya parasparam || 31 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śrṛṇu brahman prapaṭhitā sarvavidyā tvayā mayā | gurave dakṣiṇāṃ datvā punastvaṃ naiva dṛśyase || 32 || ahaṃ tu dvārakāṃ yāto jarāsandhabhayāt sakhe | kutra sthale tava vibho nivāso vada me khalu || 33 || kadācidindhanārthe vai gurudāraiḥ praṇoditāḥ | vidyārthino vayaṃ sarve vanaṃ jagmurbhayaṃkaram || 34 || vipattirabhavat tatra vātavarṣabhayaṃkarī | ravirastaṃ gato rātryāmandhakāro'bhavanmahān || 35 || sarvaṃ jalamayaṃ jātaṃ sthalaṃ naiva tu dṛśyate | vayaṃ parasparaṃ sarve gṛhītakarapaṃkajā || 36 || vidyutprakāśe paśyanto dikṣu sarvāsu babhramuḥ | tataḥ sūryodaye jāte guruḥ sāndīpanirmahān || 37 || jale śiṣyāṃśca śītārtān vanaṃ gatvā dadarśa ha | jalāt sarvān sthale kṛtvā gururaśrupariplutaḥ || 38 || uvāca bālakā yūyamasmadājñāparāyaṇāḥ | preṣṭhastu prāṇināmātmā tamanādṛtya matparāḥ || 39 || tasmādbhavadbhyaḥ santuṣṭo varaṃ dāsyāmi durlabham | bhavatāṃ cāpi sarvatra pūrṇāḥ santu manorathāḥ || 40 || vedaśāstrapurāṇāni kaṇṭhasthāni bhavantu hi | tasmādgurośca kṛpayā pūrṇo'haṃ sarvasaukhyataḥ || 41 || sudāmovāca devadeva gurustvaṃ tu koṭibrahmāṇḍanāyakaḥ | śrīpatestasya guruṣu vāso'tyantaviḍambanam || 42 || tataḥ sudāmā viprastu kṛṣṇāya paramātmane | pṛthukām̐staṇḍulān rājan na prāyacchadavāṅmukhaḥ || 43 || sarvātmā bhagavāṃstasya jñātvā''gamanakāraṇam | nāyaṃ viprastu śrīkāmo muktyarthaṃ māṃ tu sevate || 44 || bhāryāṃ pativratā duḥkhāddhanāśāṃ cāsya kurvatī | tasmāddhanaṃ kathaṃ dāsye adātrośca tayoraham || 45 || iti bruvan punarjñātvā hetormama sa taṇḍulān | pragṛhya gatavānatra lajjayā naiva dāsyati || 46 || tasmāttu yācanāṃ kurve viditvaivaṃ vaco'bravīt || 47 || kṛṣṇa uvāca gṛhān madarthe bhavatā kimānītamupāyanam | aṇvapyupāhṛtaṃ yacca bhaktyā bhūri bhaviṣyati || 48 || patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati | tadahaṃ bhaktyupahṛtamaśnāmi prayatātmanaḥ || 49 || itthamābhāṣya bhagavānadātuśca dvijanmanaḥ | cīrakhaṇḍāttaṇḍulāṃśca jahāra kimidaṃ svayam || 50 || etattvayopanītaṃ me sakhe paramaprīṇanam | viśvaṃ māṃ tarpayiṣyanti brahmannete ca taṇḍulāḥ || 51 || īdṛśā gokule bhuktāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ pṛthukataṇḍulāḥ | mātrā yaśodayā dattāḥ punastānnaiva dṛṣṭavān || 52 || ityekamuṣṭi jagdhvā ca bhūmijāṃ sampadaṃ dadau | dvitīyāṃ jagdhumārebhe dātuṃ pātālasampadām || 53 || tāvadvakṣasthalācchrīghaṃ jagṛhe śrīḥ karaṃ hareḥ | aparādhādvinā nātha kathaṃ māṃ tyaktumicchasi || 54 || etāvatā'laṃ śrīkṛṣṇa śakratulyo dvijo bhavet | dvijena nirdhanenāpi na jñātaṃ tadrahasyakam || 55 || sampūrṇañca dhanaṃ prāptaṃ svagṛhe viṣṇumāyayā | uṣitvā rajanīmekāṃ bhuktvā pītvā sukhaṃ gataḥ || 56 || śvobhūte svagṛhān gantuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ natvā mano dadhe | sa cājñapto bhagavatā vanditaḥ parirambhitaḥ || 57 || yācanā na kṛtā tena vrīḍitaḥ svagṛhān yayau | brahmaṇyatā mayā dṛṣṭā vipradevasya śrīpateḥ || 58 || ahaṃ daridraḥ kṛṣṇasya bāhubhyāṃ parirambhitaḥ | priyājuṣṭe ca paryaṃke bhrāteva sthāpito dvijaḥ || 59 || vījito vyajanenāpi rukmiṇyā satyabhāmayā | nirddhanastu dhanaṃ labdhvā śrīpatiṃ naiva saṃsmaret || 60 || itthaṃ karuṇayā mahyaṃ dhanaṃ kṛṣṇo na dattavān | itthaṃ vicārayan gacchan saṃsmaranbrāhmaṇīṃ ruṣā || 61 || gṛhāṇa dhanakoṭiñca gṛhaṃ gatvā bravīmyaham | brahmaṇyadevo dātā ca śrīkṛṣṇo'yaṃ mayā śrutaḥ || 62 || pratyakṣadṛṣṭaḥ kṛpaṇo garvito dhanapūritaḥ | śāpaṃ dāsye kathaṃ mitre dhanalobhādahaṃ vṛthā || 63 || yādṛśī me kṛtā prītistādṛśīṃ prāpayiṣyati | pitarāvasya kaṃsena kārāgare kṛtau purā || 64 || kṛṣṇastu nandasadane paragehe ca varddhitaḥ | sa dāsyati kathaṃ dravyaṃ dhanayukto'pi nirdhanaḥ || 65 || ratnaiḥ prapūritān gehān dṛṣṭvā vāñchāṃ na kārayet | lalāṭe likhitaṃ yadyanna tannyūnaṃ bhaviṣyati || 66 || iti saṃkathayan vipro nijapuryantike gataḥ | suvarṇadurgasaṃyuktāṃ kapāṭadhvajamaṇḍitām || 67 || toraṇaiḥ kalaśaiścitraiḥ prāsādaiḥ sujanairvṛtām | dvārakāmiva śobhāḍhyāṃ sarvaratnaiḥ prapūritām || 68 || dṛṣṭvā viprastu kimidaṃ kasya sthānamiti bruvan | rathyāṃ rathyāṃ bhramantaṃ taṃ pratyagṛhṇan striyo narāḥ || 69 || nāgacchantaṃ dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā kiṃkaryaḥ kiṃkarāstathā | svāminyai kathayāmāsuḥ śrutvā sā vismayaṃ gatā || 70 || bhartāramāgataṃ śrutvā patnī sambhramasaṃyutā | niścakrāmālayāttūrṇaṃ sākṣācchrīriva rūpiṇī || 71 || brāhmaṇī śibikārūḍhā dāsīdāsagaṇairvṛtā | bhramantamagrahīdvipraṃ darśayitvā svakaṃ mukham || 72 || dṛṣṭvā sphurantīṃ taruṇīñca bhāryāṃ svarṇāmbarai ratnavibhūṣaṇāḍhyām | yathendirāṃ rūpavatīṃ vimāne mudānvitaḥ kṛṣṇakṛpāñca mene || 73 || nijagehaṃ tayā yuktaḥ śrīkṛṣṇabhavanopamam | bhojanairdravyaratnaiśca paryaṃkavyajanāsanaiḥ || 74 || vitānaiḥ svarṇapātraiśca toraṇaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam | dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā sudāmā taruṇo'bhavat || 75 || bubhuje'lampaṭo vipraḥ samṛddhiṃ svāmahaitukīm | manasā jāyayā tyakṣyañjñānavairāgyabhaktitaḥ || 76 || cakāra tarkanāṃ vipraḥ kuto mama samṛddhayaḥ | datta brahmaṇyadevena devānāmapi durlabhāḥ || 77 || īdṛśīṃ sampadaṃ datvā nāvocat kimapi svayam | mama taṇḍulamuṣṭiñca prītyā pratyagrahīddhariḥ || 78 || tasya sakhyañca dāsyañca bhūyānme janmajanmani | tatpadāmburuhadhyānāt tariṣye'haṃ bhavārṇavam || 79 || vicintya cetthaṃ manasā sudāmā patnyāvṛtaḥ kṛṣṇapadāravinde | manaśca kṛtvā dhanameva viprān datvā harerdhāma paraṃ jagāma || 80 || etacchrīkṛṣṇadevasya caritaṃ śrṛṇuyānnaraḥ | dāridryānmucyate śīghraṃ bhakto bhagavato bhavet || 81 || śrīdvārakāyā nṛpa khaṇḍametanmayā tavāgre kathitaṃ supuṇyam | kīrtiṃ kulaṃ bhaktimatīva muktiṃ dadāti rājyañca sadaiva śrṛṇvatām || 82 || iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ dvārakākhaṃḍe śrīnārada bahulāśva saṃvāde sudāmavipropākhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 || hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<7.1> śrībhagavānuvāca namo bhagavate tubhyaṃ vāsudevāya sākṣiṇe || pradyumnāyāniruddhāya namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca ||1|| ajñānatimirāndhasya jñānāṃjanaśalākayā || cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīguruve namaḥ ||2|| śrīgarga uvāca itthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ mune || catuṣpadārthadaṃ nṝṇāṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ||3|| śaunaka uvāca bahulāśvo maithileṃdraḥ śrīkṛṣṇeṣṭo haripriyaḥ || kiṃ papracchātha devarṣiṃ tanme brūhi tapodhana ||4|| śrīgarga uvāca ugrasenaṃ yādaveṃdraṃ śrīkṛṣṇena kṛtaṃ mune || śrutvātivismito rājā nāradaṃ prāha maithilaḥ ||5|| bahulāśva uvāca ko vāyaṃ maruto rājā kena puṇyena bhūtale || yādaveṃdro mahābuddhirugraseno babhūva ha ||6|| yasya śrīkṛṣṇacandro'pi sahāyo'bhūddhariḥ svayam || tasyāho mahimānaṃ me brūhi devarṣisattama ||7|| śrīnārada uvāca sūryavaṃśodbhavo rājā cakravartī kṛte yuge || yajñaṃ cakāra vidhivanmaruto yo jagajjitaḥ ||8|| mahāsambhṛtasambhārairhimādreḥ pārśva uttare || saṃvartaṃ muniśārdūlaṃ guruṃ kṛtvā hi dīkṣitaḥ ||9|| paṃcayojanavistīrṇaḥ kuṇḍo'bhūdyasya cādhvare || yojanaṃ brahmakuṇḍastu gavyūtiḥ paṃca kuṃḍakāḥ ||10|| mekhalāgartavistāravedībhirnirmitā daśa || sahasrahastamuccāṅgo yajñastaṃbho babhau mahān ||11|| viṃśadyojanavistīrṇaḥ sauvarṇo yajñamaṇḍapaḥ || vitānatoraṇai reje kadalīṣaṃḍamaṇḍitaḥ ||12|| brahmarudrādayo devāḥ sagaṇāstatra cāgatāḥ || ṛṣayo munayaḥ sarve tasya yajñaṃ samāyayuḥ ||13|| hotāro daśa lakṣāṇi daśa lakṣāṇi dīkṣitāḥ || adhvaryavaḥ paṃcalakṣamudgātārastathā pare ||14|| āhūtāstatra vidvāṃsaścaturvedavido dvijāḥ || sarvaśāstrārtha tatvajñāḥ koṭiśo'nye prapūjitāḥ ||15|| hastiśuṇḍāsamāṃ dhārāṃ bhuktvā''jyasya hutāśanaḥ || ajirṇaṃ prāpa tadyajñe na citraṃ viddhi maithila ||16|| yebhyo bhāgaṃ vadantīha viśvedevāḥ sabhāsadaḥ || tebhyastebhyo dadurvā tāḥ pariveṣṭāra eva te ||17|| ke'pi jīvāstrilokyāṃ tu na babhūvurbubhukṣitāḥ || sarve devāstu somena hyajīrṇatvamupāgatāḥ ||18|| saṃvartāya dadau rājyaṃ jaṃbūdvīpasya cādhvare || gajānāṃ hemabhārāṇāṃ niyutāni caturdaśa ||19|| śatārbudaṃ hayānāṃ tu yajñāṃte dakṣiṇāṃ nṛpa || koṭiśo navaratnānāṃ mahārhāṇāṃ mahātmane ||20|| hayānāṃ paṃcasāhasraṃ gajānāṃ śatameva ca || śatabhāraṃ suvarṇānāṃ brāhmaṇe brāhmaṇe dadau ||21|| jalabhojanapātrāṇi haimāni prasphuraṃti ca || bhuktvā tāni visṛjyāśu gatāstuṣṭā dvijātayaḥ ||22|| vipratyaktaiḥ svarṇapātrairucchiṣṭairnṛpa varjitaiḥ || himādripārśve śailo'bhūdadyāpi śatayojanam ||23|| marutasya yathā yajño na tathānyasya karhicit || trilokyāṃ śṛṇu rājendra na bhūto na bhaviṣyati ||24|| yajñakuṇḍādvinirgatya paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam || ātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa marutāya mahātmane ||25|| tamālokya hariṃ natvā kṛtāṃjalipuṭo nṛpaḥ || gadituṃ na samartho'bhūdromāṃcī premavihvalaḥ ||26|| taṃ premapūritaṃ dṛṣṭvā patitaṃ pādayornatam || uvāca bhagavānsākṣānmeghagaṃbhīrayā girā ||27|| śrībhagavanuvāca rājaṃstvayāhaṃ vinayena toṣito niṣkāraṇairyajñaparaiḥ samarcitaḥ || varaṃ paraṃ brūhi mahāmate tvaraṃ dāsyāmi devairapi durlabhaṃ divi ||28|| śrīnārada uvāca śrutvā tu rājā marutaḥ kṛtāṃjaliḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya hariṃ parameśvaram || saṃpūjya bhaktyā viśadopacārakairnatvā bhṛśaṃ gadgadayā girābravīt ||29|| maruta uvāca na vedmyahaṃ tvaccaraṇāraviṃdato varaṃ paraṃ śrīpuruṣottamottama || sametya gaṃgā tṛṣitātidurdhiyaḥ khanaṃti kūpaṃ hi yathā naretarāḥ ||30|| tathāpi yāce tava vākyagauravātpādāraviṃdaṃ hṛdayāraviṃdāt || kadāpi me mā vrajatu vrajeśvara mūlaṃ caturṇāṃ vidurarthasaṃpadām ||31|| śrībhagavānuvāca dhanya'sti rājaṃstava nirmalā matiḥ pralobhitasyāpi varairna kāmabhṛt || tathāpi matto varayepsitaṃ varaṃ vinā phalaṃ bhaktasukhānna me sukham ||32|| maruta uvāca deyaṃ yadā me varamīpsitaṃ prabho vaikuṇṭhalokaṃ kurutāddharātale || rakṣa sthitaṃ māṃ nijabhaktavatsala tasminpure bhaktajanaiḥ paraiḥ saha ||33|| śrībhagavānuvāca asminmanau devamanorathābdhiṃ gateṣu viṃśeṣu yugeṣu cāṣṭau || gatvātha nākaṃ dharaṇīṃ sametya mayā hi govatsapadaṃ kariṣyasi ||34|| śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā bhagavānsākṣāttatraivāṃtaradhīyata || so'yaṃ tu maruto rājā hyugraseno babhūva ha ||35|| taṃ yajñaṃ kārayāmāsa rājasūyaṃ hariḥ svayam || kiṃ durlabhaṃ trilokyāṃ tu bhaktānāṃ maithileśvara ||36|| marutasyāpi caritaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti nṛpottama || tasya jñānaṃ savairāgyaṃ bhaktiyuktaṃ prajāyate ||37|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīmarutopākhyānaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||1||
<7.2> bahulāśva uvāca kathaṃ cakāra vidhivadrājasūyādhvaraṃ nṛpa || śrīkṛṣṇena sahāyena vadaitannitarāṃ mune ||1|| śrīnārada uvāca ugrasenaḥ sudharmāyāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ saṃpūjya caikadā || natvā prāha prasannātmā kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ śanaiḥ ||2|| ugrasena uvāca bhagavānnāradamukhācchrutaṃ yasya mahatphalam || taṃ yajñaṃ rājasūyākhyaṃ kariṣyāmi tavājñayā ||3|| tvatpādasevayā pūrve manorathamahārṇave || terurjagattṛṇīkṛtya nirbhayāḥ puruṣottama ||4|| śrībhagavānuvāca samyagvyavasitaṃ rājanbhavatā yādaveśvara || yajñena te jagatkīrtistrilokyāṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ||5|| āhūya yādavānsākṣātsabhāṃ kṛtvatha sarvataḥ || tāṃbūlabīṭikāṃ dhṛtvā pratijñāṃ kāraya prabho ||6|| mamāṃśā yādavāḥ sarve lokadvayajigīṣavaḥ || jitvārīnāgamiṣyaṃti hariṣyaṃti baliṃ diśām ||7|| śrīnārada uvāca athāṃdhakādīnāhūya śakrasiṃhāsane sthitaḥ || sudharmāyāṃ prāha nṛpo dhṛtvā tāṃbūlabīṭikām ||8|| ugrasena uvāca yo jayetsamare sarvāñjaṃbūdvīpasthitānnṛpān || manasvī śakrakodaṇḍī so'tti tāṃbūlabīṭikām ||9|| śrīnārada uvāca nṛpeṣu tūṣṇīṃ pragateṣu satsu śrīrukmiṇīnaṃdana eva cāgāt || jagrāha tāmbūlacayaṃ mahātmā natvā nṛpaṃ maithila śaṃbarāriḥ ||10|| pradmumna uvāca vijitya samare sarvāñjaṃbūdvīpasthitānnṛpān || gṛhītvā ca baliṃ tebhya āgamiṣyāmyahaṃ balāt ||11|| agamyāgamanaṃ babhrorbrāhmaṇasya gurostathā || hatyā bhrūṇasya me bhūyānna kuryāṃ karma cedidam ||12|| śrīnārada uvāca śrutvā vacaḥ śaṃbarāreḥ sādhu sādhviti yūthapāḥ || ūcusteṣāṃ paśyatāṃ ca taṃ jagrāha yadūttamaḥ ||13|| gargādyadukulācāryānmuhūrtaṃ bodhya yatnataḥ || tatsnānaṃ kārayāmāsa munibhirvedasūktibhiḥ ||14|| ugraseno'tha tilakaṃ pradyumnasya cakāra ha || baliṃ datvā namaścakruḥ sarve yādavayūthapāḥ ||15|| ugraseno dadau khaḍgaṃ pradyumnāya mahātmane || kavacaṃ pradadau sākṣādbaladevo mahābalaḥ ||16|| svatūṇābhyāṃ viniṣkṛṣya tūṇāvakṣayasāyakau || dhanuśca śārṅgadhanuṣaḥ samutpādya dadau hariḥ ||17|| kirīṭakuṃḍale divye pītaṃ vāso manoharam || chatraṃ ca cāmare sākṣācchūro vṛddho dadau punaḥ ||18|| śatacandraṃ dadau tasmai vasudevo mahāmanāḥ || uddhavaḥ pradadau sākṣānmālāṃ kiṃjalkinīṃ śubhām ||19|| akrūro dakṣiṇāvartaṃ śaṃkhaṃ vijayadaṃ dadau || śrīkṛṣṇakavacaṃ yaṃtraṃ gargācāryo dadau muniḥ ||20|| tadaiva hyāgataḥ śakro lokapālaiḥ sakautukaḥ || ājagmaturbrahmaśivau devarṣigaṇasaṃvṛtau ||21|| pradyumnāya dadau śūlī triśūlaṃ jvalanaprabham || brahmā dadau mahārāja padmarāgaṃ śiromaṇim || 22|| pāśī pāśaṃ śaktidharaḥ śaktiṃ śatruvimardinīm || vāyuśca vyajane divye yamo daṃḍaṃ dadau punaḥ ||23|| ravirgadāṃ mahāgurvīṃ kubero ratnamālikām || candrakāṃtamaṇiṃ candraḥ parighaṃ ca tanūnapāt ||24|| kṣitiśca pāduke prādāddive yogamaye pare || pradyumnāya dadau kuṃtaṃ bhadrakālī tarasvinī ||25|| hemāḍhyamuccaśikharaṃ sahasrahayasaṃyutam || viśvakarmakṛtaṃ sākṣādbrahmāṃḍāṃtarbahirgatam ||26|| sahasracakrasaṃyuktaṃ manovegaṃ ghanasvanam || maṃjīrakiṃkiṇījālaṃ ghaṃṭāṭaṃkārabhūṣaṇam ||27|| rathaṃ dadau mahādivyaṃ sahasradhvajaśobhitam || jaitraṃ ratnamayaṃ śukraḥ pradyumnāya mahātmane ||28|| śaṃkhaduṃdubhayo nedustālavīṇādayastadā || mṛdaṃgaveṇūsannādairjayadhvanisamākulaiḥ ||29|| vedaghoṣairlājapuṣpairmuktāvarṣasamanvitaiḥ || pradyumnasyopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire ||30|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde pradyumnavijayābhiṣeko nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||2||
