<7.3> śrīnārada uvāca atha natvā hariṃ kārṣṇirugrasenaṃ balaṃ gurum || nītvājñāṃ rathamāruhya kuśasthalyā viniryayau ||1|| tathā tamanugāḥ sarve yādavā uddhavādayaḥ || bhojavṛṣṇyaṃdhakamadhuśūrasenadaśārhakāḥ ||2|| tathā svabhrātaraḥ sarve gadādyāḥ kṛṣṇanoditāḥ || saputrā sabalāḥ sarve sāṃbādyāśca mahārathāḥ ||3|| kirīṭinaḥ kuṃḍalino lohakaṃcukamaṃḍitāḥ || caturaṃgabalopetāḥ koṭiśaste viniryayuḥ ||4|| kalāpihaṃsagaruḍamīnatāladhvajai rathaiḥ || sūryamaṃḍalasaṃkāśaiścaṃcalāśvaniyojitaiḥ ||5|| hemakuṃbhaiḥ saśikharairmuktātoraṇarājitaiḥ || viḍaṃbayadbhirnitarāṃ vāyuvegamataḥ param ||6|| cāmarāṃdolitairdivyairvīramaṃḍalamaṃḍitaiḥ || sauvarṇairdevadhiṣṇābhai rejurvīrā manoharāḥ ||7|| madacyutāścitramukhā hemajālasamanvitāḥ || mahodbhaṭā gajā uccaraṇadghaṇṭāruṇāṃbarāḥ ||8|| girīndraśikharā bhadrā dvipeṃdrān digvibhāvitān || viḍaṃbayanto dṛśyaṃte rājasainye dvipā nṛpa ||9|| kecidbhadrāstu kathitāḥ kecidbhadramṛgāḥ pare || viṃdhyācalabhavāḥ kecitkecitkāśmīrasaṃbhavāḥ ||10|| malayaprabhavāḥ keciddhimādriprabhavāḥ pare || mauraṃgaprabhavāḥ kecitkailāsavanasaṃbhavāḥ ||11|| airāvatakulebhāśca caturdaṃtā kalāpinaḥ || triśuṃḍā garuḍābhāśca gacchaṃti bhuvi cāṃbare ||12|| dhvajayuktāḥ koṭigajāḥ koṭiduṃdubhisaṃyutāḥ || koṭisainyā mahāmātyai ratnamaṃḍalamaṃḍitāḥ ||13|| garjayaṃto ghanaśyāmā nīḍoduṃbararājitāḥ || itastato virejuste bale'bdhau makarā iva ||14|| karairgulmānsamutpāṭya kṣepayaṃto'rkamaṃḍalam || kaṃpayaṃto bhuvaṃ pādairmadairārdrīkṛtācalāḥ ||15|| durgādrigaṃḍaśailādīnpātayaṃtaḥ śiraḥsthaleḥ || khaṃḍayaṃtaśca śatrūṇāṃ balametādṛśā gajāḥ ||16|| turaṃgā nirgatā rājan kecinmātsyāḥ kaliṃgajāḥ || auśīnarāḥ kauśalāśca vaidarbhāḥ kurujāṃgalāḥ ||17|| kāṃbojajāḥ sṛṃjayajāḥ kaikayāḥ kuṃtisaṃbhavāḥ || dāradāḥ keralā āṃgā bāṃgā vikaṭasaṃbhavāḥ ||18|| kauṃkaṇāḥ koṭakāḥ kecitkarṇāṭā gaurjarā hayāḥ || sauvīrāḥ saiṃdhavāḥ kecitpāṃcālā arbudāḥ pare ||19|| kācchāśca kecidānartā gāṃdhārā mālavādayaḥ || mahārāṣṭrabhavāḥ kecittailaṃgā jalasaṃbhavāḥ ||20|| paripūrṇatamasyāpi śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ || vājiśālāsu varttaṃte te'pi sarve vinirgatāḥ ||21|| śvetadvīpāśca vaikuṃṭhāttathā'jitapadā nṛpa || ramāvaikuṃṭhalokācca prāptā ye te'pi nirgatāḥ |||22|| hemahārasamāyuktā muktāmālāmanoharāḥ || śikhāmaṇimahāraśmisevitāḥ suparicchadāḥ ||23|| cāmarairmaṃḍitāḥ pucchamukhapādasphuratprabhāḥ || yādavānāṃ mahāsainye dṛśyante cedṛśā hayāḥ ||24|| vāyuvegā manovegā na spṛśaṃtaḥ padairbhuvam || apakvasūtreṣvatigā budbudeṣvapi maithila ||25|| vrajaṃtaḥ pāradamanu jāleṣūrṇābhaveṣu ca || dṛśyaṃte'pi nirādhārā sphārā vāriṣu maithila ||26|| gaṃḍaśailanadīdurgagartaprāsādasaṃcayān || vilaṃghayaṃtaḥ satataṃ caṃcalāste turaṃgamāḥ ||27|| māyūrīṃ taittarīṃ krauñcīṃ haṃsī ye khāṃjanīṃ gatim || kurvaṃto bhuvi nṛtyaṃto maithilendra itastataḥ ||28|| kecitsapakṣā divyāṃgāḥ śyāmakarṇā manoharāḥ || pītapucchāścaṃdravarṇā vājiśālāvinirgatāḥ ||29|| uccaiḥśravaḥkule jātāḥ sūryavājibhavāḥ pare || āśvinīsutavidyāḍhyā varuṇena prayojitāḥ ||30|| kecinmaṃdārabhāḥ keciccitravarṇā manoharāḥ || āśvinīpuṣpasaṃkāśāḥ svarṇābhā haritaprabhāḥ ||31|| padmarāgaprabhāḥ kecitsarvalakṣaṇalakṣitāḥ ||| koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo rājannanye'pi nirgatā hayāḥ ||32|| dhanurbhṛto bhaṭāḥ sainye saṃgrāme labdhakīrtayaḥ || śaktitriśūlāsigadāvarmapāśadharāḥ pare ||33|| varṣaṃtaḥ śastradhārābhiḥ pralayābdhisamā nṛpa || diggajā iva dṛśyaṃte mardayanto hyarīnmṛdhe ||34|| evaṃ vinirgataṃ rājan yadūnāṃ vipulaṃ balam || dṛṣṭvā surāsurāḥ sarve visismuḥ paramādbhutam ||35|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde yādavasainyagamanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||3||
<7.4> śrīnārada uvāca itthaṃ senāvṛtaṃ vīrāḥ pradyumnaṃ dhanvināṃ varam || śrīkṛṣṇabaladevābhyāmugrasena uvāca ha ||1|| ugrasena uvāca he pradyumna mahāprājña śrīkṛṣṇakṛpayā tvaram || vijitya nṛpatīn sarvān dvārakāmāgayiṣyasi ||2|| mattaṃ pramattamunmattaṃ suptaṃ bālaṃ jaḍaṃ striyam || prapannaṃ virathaṃ bhītaṃ na ripuṃ haṃti dharmavit ||3|| rājño hi paramo dharma ārtānāmārtinigrahaḥ || utpathānāṃ vadhaścetthamātatāyī vadhārhaṇaḥ ||4|| pumān yoṣiduta klība ātmasaṃbhāvito'dhamaḥ || bhūteṣu niranukrośo nṛpāṇāṃ tadvadho'vadhaḥ ||5|| naino rājñaḥ prajābharturdharmayuddhe vadho dviṣām || ādirājño nṛpānpūrvaṃ prāha svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ ||6|| yo raṇe nirbhayo bhūtvā kṛtvāṅghriṃ prāgato vyasuḥ || sa gaccheddhāma paramaṃ bhitvā mārtaṃḍamaṃḍalam ||7|| bhayādraṇāduparatastyaktvā yuddhe patiṃ ca yaḥ || vrajedyaḥ kṣatriyo bhūtvā sa mahārauravaṃ vrajet ||8|| senāṃ rakṣettu rājā hi senā rājānameva hi || sūtaḥ kṛcchragataṃ rakṣedrathinaṃ sārathiṃ rathī ||9|| yūyaṃ ca yādavāḥ sarve samarthabalavāhanāḥ || kārṣṇimevābhīrakṣaṃtu kārṣṇirvaḥ parirakṣatu ||10|| gāvo viprāḥ surā dharmacchaṃdāṃsi bhuvi sādhavaḥ || pūjanīyāḥ sadā sarvairmanuṣyairmokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥ ||11|| vedā viṣṇuvaco viprā mukhaṃ gāvastanurhareḥ || aṃgāni devatāḥ sākṣātsādhavo hyasavaḥ smṛtāḥ ||12|| śrīkṛṣṇo'yaṃ hariḥ sākṣātparipūrṇatamaḥ prabhuḥ || yeṣāṃ citte sthito bhaktyā teṣāṃ tu vijayaḥ sadā ||13|| śrīnārada uvāca śirasā jagṛhuḥ sākṣādugrasenasya śāsanam || praṇemuryādavāḥ sarve kṛtāṃjalipuṭā nṛpa ||14|| ugrasenaṃ nṛpaṃ śūraṃ vasudevaṃ balaṃ harim || nanāma kārṣṇiḥ śirasā gargācāryaṃ mahāmunim ||15|| śrīkṛṣṇabaladevābhyāṃ purīṃ yāte nṛpeśvara || digjayārthī hareḥ putraḥ prayayau yādavaiḥ saha ||16|| caturyojanalambītthaṃ rājamārgo'pi yasya vai || babhau hemamayaiḥ sarvaiḥ śibirairmaithileśvara ||17|| agrato vāhinīyuktaḥ kṛtavarmā mahābalaḥ || dhvajinīsahitaḥ paścādakrūro dhanvināṃ varaḥ ||18|| tatpaścāduddhavo maṃtrī pratimāpaṃcasaṃyutaḥ || tatpaścātkṛṣṇacaṃdrasya sutāstvaṣṭādaśa smṛtāḥ ||19|| yayurmahārathā rājan ye śatākṣauhiṇīyutāḥ || pradyumnaścāniruddhaśca dīptimānbhānureva ca ||20|| sāṃbo madhurbṛhadbhānuścitrabhānurvṛko'ruṇaḥ || puṣkaro vedabāhuśca śrutadevaḥ sunaṃdanaḥ ||21|| citrabhānurvirūpaśca kavirnyagrodha eva ca || tatpaścātprayayuḥ sarve gadādyāḥ kṛṣṇanoditāḥ ||22|| bhojavṛṣṇyaṃdhakamadhuśūrasenadaśārhakāḥ || ṛtubāṇakoṭisaṃkhyā yādavānāṃ prakathyate || tatsainyasaṃkhyāṃ nṛpate kaḥ kariṣyati bhūmiṣu ||23|| itthaṃ yadūnāṃ calatāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ vikarṣatāṃ tāṃ mahatīṃ ca senām || kodaṃḍaṭaṃkārayuto'bhavatkau dhuṃkāra ātāḍita duṃdubhīnām ||24|| ibheṃdracītkārahayeṃdraheṣaṇairnadadbhuśuṃḍīdṛḍhavīragarjanaiḥ || ḍhakkāninādairyadavastaḍitsvanaiḥ pracaṃḍameghā iva te viḍiṃḍire ||25|| rājadbhuvo maṃḍalameva diggajā mahatsvanaiste badhirīkṛtā iva || sadyo'tha durgaṃ ripavo vidudruvurniḥsāhasāḥ kau calatāṃ mahātmanām ||26|| kūrmāstu kiṃ kāviti ke vadaṃtaḥ kutaḥ kva gacchāma iti dravaṃtaḥ || upadravo hyeṣa vidhe kva yāti cacāla lokaiḥ sahitā caleti ||27|| chalena yajñasya hariḥ pareśvaro bhāraṃ videheśa bhuvo'vatārayan || yo'bhūccaturvyūhadharo yadoḥ kule tasmai namo'naṃtaguṇāya bhūbhṛte ||28|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde pradyumnadigvijayārthaṃ gamanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||4||
<7.5> śrībahulāśva uvāca kankāndeśān yayau jetuṃ kramataḥ śrīhareḥ sutaḥ || tasya karmāṇyudārāṇi brūhi devarṣisattama ||1|| aho śrīkṛṣṇacaṃdrasya kṛpā bhakteṣu cedṛśī || punāti praśrutā dhyātā pāpinaṃ saṃkulaṃ janam ||2|| śrīnārada uvāca sādhu sādhu tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ sādhu te vimalā matiḥ || caritaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktānāṃ punāti bhuvanatrayam ||3|| tatkāle meghadhārāśca bhūmeḥ sarvarajāṃsi ca || kaviścedgaṇayedrājan na hareḥ śrīmato guṇān ||4|| caturyojanamātraṃ hi chāyā yasya pradṛśyate || tena śvetātapatreṇa śobhito rukmiṇīsutaḥ ||5|| rathena śakradattena svasainyaparivāritaḥ || kacchadeśān yayau jetuṃ tripurāngiriśo yathā ||6|| kacchadeśādhipaḥ śubhro mṛgayārthī vinirgataḥ || senāṃ samāgatāṃ jñātvā purīṃ hālāṃ samāyayau ||7|| pradyumnasyāgatā senā gajapādapratāḍanaiḥ || cūrṇayaṃtī tarūndeśānpātayantī ca maithila ||8|| utthitaistadrajovṛndairandhībhūtaṃ nabho'bhavat || bhayaṃ prāpurjanāḥ sarve kacchadeśanivāsinaḥ ||9|| tadātiharṣitaḥ śubhro gajānāṃ hemamālinām || nītvā pañcaśataṃ sadyo hayānāmayutaṃ tathā ||10|| viṃśadbhāraṃ suvarṇānāmāgatasyāsya saṃmukhe || dattvā baliṃ nanāmāśu srajā baddhvā karadvayam || 11|| tasmai tuṣṭaḥ śaṃbarāriḥ pradadau ratnamālikām || saṃsthāpya rājye taṃ rājaṃstathā hi prakṛtiḥ satām ||12|| kaliṃgānprayayau jetuṃ rukmiṇīnandano balī || patatpatākaiḥ satsainyairmeghairiṃdra iva vrajan ||13|| kaliṃgarājaḥ svabalaiḥ samarthadvipavāhanaiḥ || niryayau saṃmukhe yoddhuṃ pradyumnasya mahātmanaḥ ||14|| kaliṃgamāgataṃ vīkṣyāniruddho dhanvināṃ varaḥ || rathenaikena tatsainyairyuyudhe yādavāgrataḥ ||15|| śatabāṇaiśca kāliṃgaṃ daśabhirdaśabhī rathān || ātaḍayadgajān vīraścāpaṃ ṭaṃkārayanmuhuḥ ||16|| svaśatravaśca sve sarve sādhu sādhviti vādinaḥ || āniruddhaḥ prayuyudhe pradyumnasya prapaśyataḥ ||17|| aniruddhasya bāṇaughaiḥ kecidvīrā dvidhā kṛtāḥ || gajāśca bhinnaśirasaḥ pādabhinnā hayā nṛpa ||18|| rathāśca cūrṇacaraṇā hatāśvā hatanāyakāḥ || rathisārathayo vātairnipetuḥ pādapā iva ||19|| palāyamānāṃ tāṃ senāṃ kaliṃgo vīkṣya maithila || ājagāma gajārūḍho vicchinnakavaco ruṣā ||20|| dvisaptatibhārayutāṃ gadāṃ cikṣepa satvaram || gajena pātayanvīrān jagarja ghanavadbalī ||21|| gadāprahārapatitaṃ kiṃcidvyākulamānasam || aniruddhaṃ mṛdhe vīkṣya yādavāḥ krodhapūritāḥ ||22|| tadaiva teḍuḥ kāliṃgaṃ bāṇaistīkṣṇaiḥ sphuratprabhaiḥ || samāṃsamudbhaṭaṃ śyenaṃ kurarāścaṃcubhiryathā ||23|| kāliṃgo'pi tadā kruddhaḥsajjaṃ kṛtvā dhanuḥ svayam || ṭaṃkārayanmuhurbāṇairbāṇāṃścūrṇīcakāra ha ||24|| gado gadāṃ samādāya baladevānujo balī || tadgajaṃ tāḍayāmāsa vāmahastena maithila ||25|| ardhacaṃdraprahāreṇa viśīrṇo'bhūdgajastathā || indravajraprahāreṇa gaṇḍaśailo yathā nṛpa ||26|| kāliṃgaḥ patito bhūtvā gṛhītvā mahatīṃ gadām || gadaṃ ca tāḍayāmāsa kāliṃgaṃ ca gadastadā ||27|| kaliṃgagadayostatra ghoraṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva ha || visphuliṃgān kṣarantyau dve gade cūrṇībabhūvatuḥ ||28|| gado gṛhītvā kāliṃgaṃ pātayitvā raṇāṃgaṇe || cakarṣa svakareṇāśu phaṇinaṃ garuḍo yathā ||29|| gadāprahāravyathitaścūrṇitāsthiḥ kaliṃgarāṭ || āyayau śaraṇaṃ so'pi pradyumnasya mahātmanaḥ ||30|| datvā baliṃ prāha kaliṃgarājastvaṃ devadevaḥ parameśvaro'si || kaḥ krodhavantaṃ prasaheta kau tvāṃ jano yathā daṇḍadharaṃ namaste ||31|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde kacchakaliṃgavijayo nāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||5||
<7.6> śrīnārada uvāca itthaṃ jitvātha kāliṃgaṃ pradyumno yādaveśvaraḥ || jagāma marudhanvānaṃ jalaṃ vaiśvānaro yathā ||1|| giridurgasamāyuktaṃ dhanvadeśādhipaṃ gayam || uddhavaṃ preṣayāmāsa jñātvā taṃ yādaveśvaraḥ ||2|| giridurge gataḥ sākṣāduddhavo buddhisattamaḥ || sabhāmetya gayaṃ prāha śṛṇu rājanmahāmate ||3|| ugraseno yādavendro rājarājeśvaro mahān || jaṃbūdvīpanṛpāñjitvā rājasūyaṃ kariṣyati ||4|| paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam || asaṃkhyabrahmāṃḍapatirmaṃtrī tasyābhavaddhariḥ ||5|| tena vai preṣitaḥ sākṣātpradyumno dhanvināṃ varaḥ || śīghraṃ tasmai baliṃ nītvā kulakauśalahetave ||6|| śrīnārada uvāca śrutvā kiṃcitprakupito vīryaśauryamadoddhataḥ || uddhavaṃ prāha nṛpatirgayo nāma mahābalaḥ ||7|| gaya uvāca baliṃ tasmai na dāsyāmi vinā yuddhaṃ mahāmate || alpakālena yadavo gatā vṛddhiṃ bhavādṛśāḥ ||8|| ityukta uddhavo rājañcchaṃbarāriṃ sametya saḥ || sarveṣāṃ yādavānāṃ ca śṛṇvatāṃ praśaśaṃsa ha ||9|| tadaiva rukmiṇīputro giridurgaṃ samāyayau || tatsainyairyādavaiḥ sārddhaṃ ghoraṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva ha ||10|| cūrṇayan gajapādaiśca nāgarān bhūjanāndrumān || akṣauhiṇībhyāṃ saṃyukto gayo yoddhuṃ viniryayau ||11|| rathino rathibhistatra gajavāhā gajaiḥ saha || āśvavāhairaśvavāhā vīrā vīraiḥ parasparam ||12|| yuyudhustīkṣṇabāṇaughaiścarmakhaḍgagadarṣṭibhiḥ || pāśaiḥ paraśvadhai rājañchataghnībhirbhuśuṃḍibhiḥ ||13|| manyamānāśca yadubhirgayavīrā bhayāturāḥ || sarve svaṃ svaṃ rathaṃ tyaktvā dudruvuste diśo daśa ||14|| palāyamāne svabale gayo nāma mahābalaḥ || ekākī prayayau yoddhuṃ dhanuṣṭaṃkārayanmuhuḥ ||15|| dīptimān kṛṣṇaputrastu dhanurbāṇai riporhayān || ekena sārathiṃ jaghne dvābhyāṃ ketuṃ samucchritam ||16|| rathaṃ ca bāṇaviṃśatyā kavacaṃ paṃcabhiḥ punaḥ || dhanustasyāpi ciccheda śatabāṇairmahābalaḥ ||17|| gayo'nyaddhanurādāya dīptimantaṃ hareḥ sutam || jaghāna bāṇaviṃśatyā jagarja ghanavadbalī ||18|| tatprahāreṇa samare kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ || dīptimānatha jagrāha śaktiṃ jyotirmayīṃ dṛḍhām ||19|| cikṣepa bhrāmayitvā tāṃ gayākhyāya mahātmane || sā'pi taddhṛdayaṃ bhitvā papau ca rudhiraṃ mahat ||20|| gayo'pi patito rājanmūrchito'bhūdraṇāṃgaṇe || dīptimāṃśca dhanuṣkoṭyā karṣayaṃstadgale ripum ||21|| pradyumnasya puraḥ prāgātkadrujaṃ garuḍo yathā || naraduṃdubhayo nedurdevadundubhayastadā || ākāśādvavṛṣurdevāḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi pārthivāḥ ||22|| tadaiva tenāpi samarpitāṃghriḥ śrīkṛṣṇaputro nṛpa śaṃbarāriḥ || avantikāṃ saṃprayayau mahātmā śrīkarṇikāṃ svarṇamayīmivāliḥ ||23|| śrutvā''gataṃ taṃ jayasenarājaḥ samarcayāmāsa sa mālavādhipaḥ || ānīya vṛddhānsubaliṃ mahātmane pradharṣito maithila tatprabhāvavit ||24|| rājādhidevīṃ svapituḥ pituḥ svasāṃ praṇamya tāṃ kṛṣṇasuto mahāmanāḥ || viṃdānuviṃdau parirabhya tatsutau babhau vṛto mālavadeśasaṃbhavaiḥ ||25|| pradyumno dhanvināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ purīṃ māhiṣmatīṃ yayau || yādavaiḥ svabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ narmadāṃ sa dadarśa ha ||26|| rājitāmaṃbukallolaiḥ śṛṅgāratilakāmiva || vahaṃtī puṣpanicayamuṣṇīṣaṃ mudrikāmiva ||27|| vetasīveṇutarubhiḥ puṣpitairmādhavairvṛtaiḥ || sphuradbhirmūrtimadbhiśca devaiḥ svarganadīmiva ||28|| tattīre śibirairyuktaḥ pradyumno yādaveśvaraḥ || sthito'bhūdyādavaiḥ sākaṃ devairiṃdra iva prabhuḥ ||29|| indranīlo mahārāja jñānī māhiṣmatīpatiḥ || svadūtaṃ preṣayāmāsa pradyumnāya mahātmane ||30|| pradyumnarājaśibire dūto gatvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ tatra sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nṛpa ||31|| dūta uvāca hastināpuranāthena dhārtarāṣṭreṇa dhīmatā || sthāpito'tibalo vīro baliṃ kasmai na dāsyati ||32|| suyodhanāya cecchābhirdravyaṃ yacchati no balāt || yoddhavyaṃ ca bhavadbhiśca viphalo hi raṇo'tra vai ||33|| śrīpradyumna uvāca yathā gayo dūta kaliṃgarāḍ yathā tathābhibhūto'pi baliṃ pradāsyati || nṛpaṃ na jānāti mahograsenakaṃ māhiṣmatīśo'yamatīva rājarāṭ ||34|| śrīnārada uvāca ukto dūtastadaivāśu gatvā māhiṣmatīpatim || sabhāyāṃ kathayāmāsa pradyumnakathitaṃ vacaḥ ||35|| yadūnāmudbhaṭaṃ sainyaṃ vīkṣya māhiṣmatīpatiḥ || gajānāṃ paṃcasāhasraṃ hayānāṃ niyutaṃ śubham ||36|| rathānāmayutaṃ jaitraṃ nītvā rājā vinirgataḥ || baliṃ dadau sametyāśu pradyumnāya mahātmane ||37|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde marudhanvamālavamāhiṣmatīdeśavijayo nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||6||
<7.7> śrīnārada uvāca pradyumno'tha mahāvīryo jitvā māhiṣmatīpatim || vikarṣanmahatīṃ senāṃ gurjarājaṃ samāyayau ||1|| gurjarasyādhipaṃ vīramṛṣyaṃ nāma mahābalam || jagrāha senayā kārṣṇistuṃḍayāhiṃ yathāviraṭ ||2|| sadyastasmādbaliṃ nītvā yādaveṃdro mahābalaḥ || vikarṣanmahatīṃ senāṃ cedideśāṃstato yayau ||3|| damaghoṣaścedirājo vasudevasvasuḥ patiḥ || śiśupālastasya putraḥ kṛṣṇaśatruḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||4|| ābhīyāya mahābuddhirdamaghoṣaṃ mahābalam || natvā prāha mahābuddhimuddhavo buddhisattamaḥ ||5|| uddhava uvāca rājandehi baliṃ tasmā ugrasenāya bhūbhṛte || vijitya nṛpatīn yo'sau rājasūyaṃ kariṣyati ||6|| śrīnārāda uvāca itthaṃ niśamya vacanaṃ damaghoṣasutaḥ khalaḥ || sphuradoṣṭho manyuparaḥ prāhedaṃ sadasi tvaram ||7|| śiśupāla uvāca duratyayā kālagatiraho citramidaṃ jagat || vidheḥ kālātmakasyāpi prājāpatye bhavetkaliḥ ||8|| kva rājahaṃsaḥ kākaḥ kva kva mūrkhaḥ kva ca paṃḍitaḥ || bhṛtyā vijeṣyanti nṛpaṃ cakravartinamīśvaram ||9|| yayātiśāpādyadavo bhraṣṭarājyapadāḥ smṛtāḥ || rājyaṃ svalpaṃ jalaṃ prāpya procchalaṃtyāpagā iva ||10|| avaṃśasaṃbhavo rājā mūrkhaputro hi paṃḍitaḥ || nirdhanaśca dhanaṃ prāpya tṛṇavanmanyate jagat ||11|| ugrasenaḥ katidinai rājatvaṃ samupāgataḥ || maṃtriṇā vāsudevena pūjitaḥ sa balānnṛpaḥ ||12|| tasya maṃtrī vāsudevo jarāsaṃdhabhayāddrutam || mathurāṃ svapurīṃ tyaktvā samudraṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||13|| ābhīrasyāpi nandasya pūrvaṃ putraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || vasudevo manyate taṃ matputro'yaṃ gatatrapaḥ ||14|| vasudevādgauravarṇādayaṃ śyāmaḥ kuto'bhavat || pitāmaho'pi gauraśca duḥkhahāsyamidaṃ vacaḥ ||15|| pradyumnaṃ tatsutaṃ jitvā sabalaṃ yādavaiḥ saha || kuśasthalīṃ gamiṣyāmi mahīṃ kartumayādavīm ||16|| śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā dhanurādāya tūṇau cākṣayasāyakau || gaṃtumabhyudyataṃ vīkṣya cedirājastamabravīt ||17|| damaghoṣa uvāca śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmi krodhaṃ mā kuru mā kuru || akasmādācaretkāryaṃ na siddhiṃ viṃdate hyasau ||18|| dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ na kṣamāsamam || tasmātsāma prakartavyaṃ sāmno na sadṛśaṃ sukham ||19|| dānena rājate sāma dānaṃ satkriyayā punaḥ || satkriyāpi tathā yogyaṃ guṇaṃ saṃprekṣya rājate ||20|| yādavāścedipāścaiva jñātisaṃbaṃdhinaḥ smṛtāḥ || cedipānāṃ ca vṛṣṇīnāṃ kaliṃ necchāmi tatvataḥ ||21|| śrīnārada uvāca śiśupālo bodhito'pi damaghoṣeṇa dhīmatā || novāca kiñcidvimanāstūṣṇiṃbhūto mahākhalaḥ ||22|| śrutiśravāścediparājarājñī svasā śubhā śūrasutasya rājan || sametya putraṃ śiśupālasaṃjñaṃ pratyāha samyagvinayānvitā sā ||23|| śrutiśravā uvāca mā putra khedaṃ kurutātkadācinmābhūtkaliścedipayādavānām || te mātulo'yaṃ kila śūrasūnurbhrātā ca te tatsuta eva kṛṣṇaḥ ||||24|| tasyātmajā ye'tra samāgatāste pradyumnamukhyāḥ śataśo mahāṃtaḥ || saṃpūjanīyāśca mayā bhavadbhiḥ saṃlālanīyā na hi yuddhayogyāḥ ||25|| ahaṃ gamiṣyāmi sahārdracittā netuṃ tvayā tāta samāgatāṃstān || drṣṭuṃ cirotkaṇṭhamanā mahotsavairnaitādṛśo'yaṃ samayaḥ kadācit ||26|| śiśupāla uvāca mama śatrū rāmakṛṣṇau yadavaḥ śatravaśca me || ghātayiṣyāmi tānsarvān yairahaṃ tu tiraskṛtaḥ ||27|| purā vai kuṃḍinapure yābhyāṃ me helanaṃ kṛtam || vivāho varito me vai rāmakṛṣṇāvarī mama ||28|| yadi teṣāṃ yādavānāṃ yuvāṃ pakṣaṃ kariṣyathaḥ || tadā tvāṃ saha pitrā ca nigṛhya nigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ ||29|| kārāgāre kārayāmi kaṃsaḥ svapitarau yathā || anyathā cedvadhiṣyāmi śapatho me tu durghaṭaḥ ||30|| śrīnārada uvāca tadvacaḥ paruṣaṃ śrutvā tūṣṇīṃ yāte'tha cedipe || tadvacaḥ svabalaṃ prāpya prāha sarvaṃ yathoditam ||31|| vāhinī dhvajinī caiva pratimākṣauhiṇīyutā || caturdhā śiśupālasya senā yuktā babhūva ha ||32|| bahulāśva uvāca vāhinyādyāśca yā senāstatsaṃkhyāṃ vada me prabho || ṛṣayo hi prajānaṃti bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavatparam ||33|| śrīnārada uvāca śataṃ dvipānāṃ rathināṃ sahasraṃ śatasaṃyutam || ayutaṃ turagāṇāṃ ca pattīnāṃ lakṣameva ca ||34|| senāyā lakṣaṇaṃ svalpaṃ dviguṇaṃ caturaṃgiṇī || catuḥśataṃ dvipānāṃ ca rathānāmayutaṃ tathā ||35|| caturlakṣaṃ hayānāṃ ca pattīnāmekakoṭayaḥ || lohakaṃcukasaṃyuktāḥ samarthabalavāhanāḥ ||36|| śastrāstrajñā yatra śūrā vāhinī sā budhaiḥ smṛtā || vāhinyā dviguṇībhutā dhvajinī sā prakīrtitā ||37|| dhvajinyā dviguṇī jñeyā pṛtanāṃ kathitā purā || sasāhaso'pi śūraḥ syātsāmaṃtaḥ śataśūrabhṛt ||38|| sāmantānāṃ śataṃ bibhratsa gajī kathito mṛdhe || samare sārathiṃ cāśvān rathaṃ rakṣedrathī ca yaḥ ||39|| senāṃ rakṣiti yo bāṇaiḥ kathyate sa mahārathī || svasenāṃ rakṣayañśatrūnsūdayan raṇamaṃḍale ||40|| yo'kṣauhiṇyā samaṃ yuddhyetsadā so'tirathī smṛtaḥ ||41|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde gurjararāṣṭrācedideśagamanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||7||
<7.8> śrīnārada uvāca nirgataḥ śiśupālo'sau sabalaścaṃdrakāpurāt || pitarau tau tiraskṛtya svabhāvo hyasatāmayam ||1|| vāhinīdhvajinībhyāṃ ca dyumacchaktau vinirgatau || pṛtanākṣauhiṇībhyāṃ tau raṃgapiṃgau ca maṃtriṇau ||2|| śiśupālamahāsainyaṃ pralayābdhisamaṃ nṛpa || saṃvīkṣya yadavastartuṃ cājagmuḥ kṛṣṇapotakāḥ ||3|| vāhinīsahitaḥ paścāddyumānnāmā mahābalaḥ || yuyudhe yādavaiḥ sārddhaṃ śiśupālapraṇoditaḥ ||4|| dvayośca sainyayorbāṇairaṃdhakāro'bhavadraṇe || hayapādarajovṛndaiḥ protthitaiśchādayannabhaḥ ||5|| hayāśca nṛpa dhāvantaḥ protpataṃto dvipānprati || dvipāśca sakṣatā yuddhe pātayaṃtaḥ padairdviṣaḥ ||6|| śuṇḍādaṇḍasya phūtkārairmardayanta itastataḥ || kastūrīpatrasiṃdūraraktakaṃbalamaṃḍitāḥ ||7|| bāṇairgadābhiḥ parighaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ śūlaiśca śaktibhiḥ || chinnāṅgāḥ pattayaḥ petuśchinnabāhvaṃghrijānavaḥ ||8|| kaścittīkṣṇāsinā rājan hayānyuddhe dvidhākarot || keciddaṃtān saṃgṛhītvā kuṃbheṣu kariṇāṃ gatāḥ ||9|| amātyaṃ hastivāhaṃ ca mardayanto mṛgendravat || ullaṃghayaṃta sahasā gajavṛṃdaṃ mahābalāḥ ||10|| khaḍgaprahāraṃ kurvaṃto vidārya parasainikān || hayaspṛṣṭā na dṛśyaṃte dṛśyaṃte te naṭā iva ||11|| sainyavegaṃ ca śatrūṇāṃ dṛṣṭvākrūraḥ samāyayau || cakāra durdinaṃ bāṇairbāṇaughaiścāpi nirgataiḥ || chādayāmāsa cākrūraṃ varṣāsūryamivāmbudaḥ ||12|| chitvā tadbāṇapaṭalamasinā gāṃdinīsutaḥ || śaktyā tatāḍa taṃ vīraṃ dyumaṃtaṃ krodhamūrchitam ||13|| tatprahāreṇa bhīnnāṃgo mūrchito ghaṭikādvayam || punarutthāya yuyudhe śiśupālasakhā balī ||14|| gṛhītvātha gadāṃ gurvīṃ lakṣabhāravinirmitām || tatāḍa hṛdi cākrūraṃ jagarja ghanavaddyumān ||15|| akrūre tatprahāreṇa kiṃcidvyākulamānase || yuyudhānastadā prāgājjyāśabdaṃ kārayanmuhuḥ ||16|| śirastasyāśu ciccheda bāṇenaikena līlayā || patite dyumati hyājau vīrāstasya vidudruvuḥ ||17|| tadaiva śaktaḥ saṃprāpto dṛṣṭvā senāṃ palāyitām || śūlaṃ cikṣepa sahasā yuyudhānāya dhīmate ||18|| yuyudhānaśca bāṇaughaistacchūlaṃ śatadhākarot || śakto gṛhītvā parighaṃ yuyudhānaṃ tatāḍa ha ||19|| yuyudhāno'rjunasakhaḥ kṣaṇaṃ mūrcchāmavāpa ha || tadaiva vīraḥ saṃprāptaḥ kṛtavarmā mahābalaḥ ||20|| śaktasyāpi rathaṃ sāśvaṃ bāṇaiścūrṇīcakāra ha || śakto'pi cūrṇayāmāsa gadayā tadrathaṃ param ||21|| kṛtavarmā rathaṃ tyaktvā śaktaṃ jagrāha roṣataḥ || pātayitvā bhūjābhyāṃ taṃ cikṣepa nṛpa yojanam ||22|| śakte ca patite yuddhe śiśupālapraṇoditau || raṃgapiṃgau maṃtriṇau tau pṛtanā'kṣauhiṇīyutau ||23|| bāṇavarṣaṃ prakurvaṃtau mardayaṃtāvarīnmṛdhe || ājagmaturmaithilendra yathā vātahutāśanau ||24|| udbhaṭaṃ tadbalaṃ vīkṣya yādavendrapituḥ samaḥ || ādāya cāpaṃ sadasi pradyumno vākyamabravīt ||25|| pradyumna uvāca ahaṃ gamiṣyāmi puro raṃgapiṃgamṛdhe janāḥ || raṃgapiṃgau ca dṛśyete mahābalaparākramau ||26|| śrīnārada uvāca etacchrutvā mahābāhurbhānuḥ kṛṣṇasuto balī || sarveṣāmagrato bhūtvā bhrātaraṃ prāha nītivat ||27|| bhānuruvāca trailokyaṃ dṛśyate prāptaṃ yadā te saṃmukhe prabho || tadā te cāpaṭaṃkāro bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||28|| kevalenāpi khaḍgena śirasī raṃgapiṃgayoḥ || chitvā cātra pravekṣyāmi kaliṃgaśakalāviva ||29|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde dyumacchaktavadho nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8||
<7.9> śrīnārada uvāca || ityuktvā śatruhā bhānurgṛhītvā khaṅgacarmaṇī || padātiḥ prayayau sainye vane vanyakarīvasaḥ||1|| bhānukhaṅgena śatrūṃstāñcchinnabāhūṃścakāra ha || dvipānhayānsaṃmukhasthānpaśvasthāṃśca dvidhākarot ||2|| khaṅgadvitīyo hyekākī reje chiṃdannarīmṛdhe || nīhārameghapaṭalairbhānurbhānurivasphuran||3|| hastināṃ chinnakuṃbhānāṃ bhānukhaṅgena maithila || muktā nipetuśca yathā tārakāḥ kṣīṇakarmaṇām||4|| lakṣamātreṇa tatsainyaṃ pātayitvā raṇāṃgaṇe || raṃgapiṃgo pariprāgādbhānurvīromahābalaḥ ||5|| kṛṣṇadattena khaṅgena rathau tau raṃgapiṃgayoḥ || chittvā hayānsanetṛṃśca bhānuryuddhedvidhākarot || 6 || khaṅgau nītvā raṃgapiṃgau teḍatustamahodbhaṭau || bhānucarmagatau khaḍgau bhaṃgībhūtau babhūvatuḥ || 7 || bhānukhaṅgaprahāreṇa śiraso raṃgapiṃgayoḥ || yugapatpetaturyuddhe tadadbhutamivābhavat || 8 || bhānustayośca śirasī nītvā pradyumnasaṃmukhe || āyayau vijayī vīraḥ ślāghitaḥ sainyanāyakaiḥ ||9| divi duṃdubhayo nedurnaraduṃdubhibhiḥ samam|| abhūjjayajayā rāvaḥ puṣpavarṣāḥ suraiḥ kṛtāḥ || 7.9.10 || raṃgapiṃgau mṛtau śrutvā śiśupālo ruṣānvitaḥ || jaitraṃ rathaṃ samāruhya yadūnāṃ saṃmukhaṃ yayau||1 1|| madacyudbhirgajai dīrghai ratnakaṃbalamaṃḍitaiḥ || svarṇanīḍasamāyuktailoṃlaghaṃṭākvaṇatsvanaiḥ || 12 || rathaiśca devadhiṣṇyābhairvāyuvegaisturaṃgamaiḥ || vidyādharasamairvīrairnādayanvasudhātalam ||13|| śiśupālabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā śakradatte rathe tataḥ || sarveṣāmagrataḥ kārṣṇiḥ prayayau dhanvināṃ vara ||14|| śaṃkhaṃ dadhmau hareḥ putro diśaḥ khaṃ nādayannṛpaḥ || tena nādena śatrūṇāṃ kaṃpo'bhūddhṛdi mānada ||15|| śiśupālamahāsainye prāsādaiva durgame || cakre nārācasopānaṃ sahasā rukmiṇīsutaḥ ||16|| damaghoṣasuto dhīmāndhanuṣṭaṃkārayanmuhuḥ || brahmāstraṃ saṃdadhe yadvai dattātreyeṇa śikṣitam || 17 || pracaṃḍaṃ sarvatastejo dṛṣṭvā śrīrukmiṇīsutaḥ|| brahmāstreṇāpi dyuddhesaṃjahāra sa līlayā || 18 || śiśupālo mahādhīmānaṃgārāstraṃ samādadhe|| jāmadagnyena yaddattaṃ maheṃdre parvate nṛpa||19|| tasmādaṃgāravarṣābhiḥ kārṣṇisenātivihvalā || parjanyāstraṃ mahādivyaṃ tadā kārṣṇiḥ samādadhe||7.9.20|| sthūlābhirmeghadhārābhiraṃgārāḥ śāṃtimāyayuḥ || śiśupālastadā kruddho gajāstraṃ taṃ samādadhe || 21 || yadagastyena muninā śikṣitaṃ malayācale || mahodbhaṭā gajā dīrghāḥ koṭiśastadvinirgatāḥ || 22 || te sainyaṃ pātayāmāsuḥ pradyumnasya mahātmanaḥ || hāhākāro mahānāsīdyadūnāṃ vāhinīṣu ca||23|| pradyumnotha raṇaślāghī nṛsiṃhāstraṃ samādadhe|| nṛsiṃhau nirgatā stasmānnādayanvasudhātalam ||24|| sphuratsaṭo dīrghabālo nakhalāṃgalabhīṣaṇaḥ || nanāda huṃkṛtaiḥ śabdairbhakṣayaṃstāngajānraṇe ||25|| vidārya gajakuṃbhāṃ tamutpatanbhagavānhariḥ || gajavṛṃdaṃ mardayitvā tatraivāṃtaradhīyata ||26|| cikṣepa parighaṃ roṣācchiśupālo mahābalaḥ|| ciccheda parighaṃ tadvai yamadaṃḍena mādhavaḥ || 27 || tataścaidyo ruṣāviṣṭo gṛhītvā khaṅgacarmaṇī || pradyumnaṃ tamupādhāvatpataṃga iva pāvakam || 28 || kārṣṇistatāḍa taṃ khaṅgaṃ yamadaṃḍena vegataḥ || cūrṇī babhūva tenāpi nistriṃśaścarmaṇā saha || 29 || pāśidattena pāśena sahasā yādaveśvaraḥ || damaghoṣasutaṃ baddhvā vicakarṣa raṇāṃgaṇe ||7.9.30|| śiśupālaṃ ghātayituṃ khaṅgaṃ jagrāha roṣataḥ || tadaiva tatkarau sākṣādgado jagrāha vegataḥ || 31 || gada uvāca || paripūrṇatamenāpi śrīkṛṣṇena mahātmanā || vadhyoyaṃ devavacanaṃ vacanaṃ mā vṛthā kuru || 32 || śrīnārada uvāca || tadā kolāhale jāte śiśupālasya baṃdhane || damaghoṣo baliṃ nītvā prāgātpradyumnasaṃmukhe || 33 || kārṣṇistamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā tyaktvā śastrāṇi śīghrataḥ || agrataścedipaṃ śaśvannanāma śirasā bhuvi||34|| militvā cāśiṣaṃ dattvā pradyumnāya mahātmane|| damaghoṣo mahārājaḥ prāha gadgadayā girā || 35 || damaghoṣa uvāca || pradyumna tvaṃ tu dhanyo'si śrīyadūnāṃ śiromaṇe || tatputreṇa kṛtaṃ yadvai tatkṣamasva dayānidhe || 36 || śrīpradyumna uvāca || mama doṣo na te cāyaṃ na te putrasya he prabho || sarvaṃ kālakṛtaṃ manye priyamapriyameva vā || 37 || || śrīnārada uvāca || ityukto damaghoṣo'pi pradyumnena prayaṃtritaḥ || śiśupālaṃ mocayitvā nītvāgāccaṃdrikāpurīm ||38|| pradyumnasya balaṃ śrutvā sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇatejasaḥ || na ke'pi yuyudhustena rājānaśca baliṃ daduḥ ||39|| iti śrīmadgargasaṃhitāyāṃ viśvajitkhaṃḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde raṃgapiṃgavadhe śiśupālayuddhe cedideśavijayonāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||
<7.10> śrīnārada uvāca manutīrthe tataḥ snātvā pradyumno yadubhiḥ saha || prayayau kauṃkaṇāndeśānduṃdubhīnnādayanmuhuḥ ||1|| kauṃkaṇastho'tha medhāvī gadāyuddhaviśāradaḥ || ekākī mallayuddhena parīkṣannāyayau balam ||2|| pradyumnaṃ sabalaṃ prāha śṛṇu me yādaveśvara || gadāyuddhaṃ dehi mahyaṃ madbalaṃ nāśaya prabho ||3|| pradyumna uvāca ekato hyekato vīrā balavaṃto mahītale || mānaṃ mā kuru he malla viṣṇumāyātidurgamā ||4|| vayaṃ tu bahavo vīrāstvamekākī samāgataḥ || adhamo'yaṃ mahāmalla dṛśyate yāhi sāṃpratam ||5|| malla uvāca yadā yuddhaṃ na kuruta bhavaṃto balaśālinaḥ || matpādo'dho'tra niryāṃtu tadā yāsyāmi sāṃpratam ||6|| śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ vadati malle vai sarve yādavapuṃgavāḥ || babhūvuḥ krodhasaṃyuktāḥ paśyatastasya maithila ||7|| gado gadāṃ samādāya baladevānujo balī || tasthau so'pi gadāṃ nītvā sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ nṛpa ||8|| gadāṃ variṣṭhāṃ cikṣepa gadāya sa mahābalaḥ || gadopari gadāṃ nītvā svagadāṃ prākṣipadgadaḥ ||9|| gadasya gadayā so'pi tāḍitaḥ patito bhuvi || mṛdhecchāṃ na cakārāśu hyudvaman rudhiraṃ mukhāt ||10|| koṃkaṇastho'tha medhāvī natvā prāha hareḥ sutam || parīkṣārthaṃ ca bhavatāmetatkāryaṃ mayā kṛtam ||11|| tvameva bhagavānsākṣātkuto'haṃ prākṛto janaḥ || kṣamasva me'parādhaṃ bho tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||12|| śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvātha baliṃ datvā namaskṛtya hareḥ sutam || koṃkaṇasthaḥ purīṃ prāgānmedhāvī kṣatriyottamaḥ ||13|| kuṭakādhipatiṃ mauliṃ mṛgayāyāṃ vinirgatam || jagrāha sa mahābāhuḥ sāṃbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ ||14|| kārṣṇistasmādbaliṃ nītvā daṃḍakākhyaṃ vanaṃ yayau || munīnāmāśramānpaśyansvasainyaparivāritaḥ ||15|| nirviṃdhyāṃ ca payoṣṇīṃ ca tāpīṃ snātvā hareḥ sutaḥ || śūrpārakaṃ mahākṣetramāryāṃ dvaipāyanīṃ tataḥ ||16|| ṛṣyamūkaṃ tataḥ paśyanpravarṣaṇagiriṃ gataḥ || parjanyo bhagavānsākṣānnityadā yatra varṣati ||17|| gokarṇākhyaṃ śivakṣetraṃ dṛṣṭvā kārṣṇiḥ svasainyakaiḥ || trigartānkeralān deśān yayau jetuṃ mahābalaḥ ||18|| ambaṣṭhaḥ keralādhīśaḥ śrutvā vārtāṃ tu manmukhāt || dadau tasmai baliṃ śīghraṃ pradyumnāya mahātmane ||19|| kṛṣṇāṃ veṇīṃ tadottīrya tailaṃgān viṣayān yayau || sainyapādarajovṛṃdairaṃdhīkurvannabhaḥsthalam ||20|| tailaṃgasyādhipo rājā viśālākṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || purasyopavane reme suṃdarīgaṇasaṃvṛtaḥ ||21|| mṛdaṃgādyaiśca vāditrairmadhuradhvanisaṃkulaiḥ || parairapsarasāṃ rāgairgīyamāno dyurāḍiva ||22|| taṃ prāha suṃdarī rāmā rājñī maṃdāramālinī || rajovyāptaṃ nabho vīkṣya śuṣyadbiṃbādharā parā ||23|| maṃdāramālinyuvāca rājanna jānāsi sadā vihārādaharniśaṃ kāmaviśālalolaḥ || ahaṃ na jānāmi kadāpi duḥkhaṃ mukhālakālibhramarāstaveṣā ||24|| dvārāvatīśādhvaranāgavallīcayaṃ samutthāpya diśo jayārtham || vijitya sarvānnṛpa cedipānsa samāgato'sau yadurājarājaḥ ||25|| dhuṃkāraśabdaṃ nṛṇu duṃdubhīnāṃ citkāraphūtkārayutaṃ dvipānām || kodaṃḍaṭaṃkāramayaṃ parāṇāṃ kalpāṃtasārasvatanādakāram ||26|| tvaraṃ baliṃ preṣaya śaṃbarāraye pradhāvatīḥ paśya narendra suṃdarīḥ || cyūtaprasūnāḥ śramavārivarṣaṇīrvanapraveśāsphuṭakeśamaṃḍanāḥ ||27|| patnīvākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā viśālākṣo'tiharṣitaḥ || pradyumnasammukhe so'pi baliṃ nītvā samāyayau ||28|| tena sampūjitaḥ sākṣātpradyumno dhanvināṃ varaḥ || snātvā paṃpāsarastīrthe mahārāṣṭraṃ tato yayau ||29|| mahārāṣṭrādhipo rājā vimalo nāma vaiṣṇavaḥ || bhaktyā paramayā kārṣṇiṃ pūjayāmāsa sarvataḥ ||30|| tathā hi karṇāṭapatiḥ sahasrajitsvataḥ samānīya baliṃ mahātmane || sampūjayāmāsa śubhārthahetave śrīśaṃbarāriṃ jagataḥ prabhuṃ param ||31|| pradyumno bhagavānsākṣādyādavaiḥ saha maithila || karūṣān viṣayānprāgājjetuṃ yogīva dehajān ||32|| mahāraṃgapure tatra vṛddhaśarmā mahāmatiḥ || bhartātha śrutadevāyā vasudevasvasurnṛpa ||33|| tasya putro daṃtavaktraḥ kṛṣṇaśatruḥ prakīrtitaḥ || śiśupāla iva kruddho yoddhuṃ cakre manaḥ svayam ||34|| mātrā pitrā vārito'pi daityo daityānanuvrataḥ || yādavān ghātayiṣyāmi ko'yamitthaṃ cakāra ha ||35|| ādāya sa gadāṃ gurvīṃ lakṣabhāravinirmitām || ekākī prayayau yoddhuṃ pradyumnabalasammukhe ||36|| daṃtavaktraḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ kajjalādrisamaprabham || lalajjihvaṃ ghorarūpaṃ tālavṛkṣadaśocchritam ||37|| kirīṭakuṇḍaladharaṃ hemavarṇavibhūṣitam || kiṃkiṇījālasaṃyuktaṃ calaccaraṇanūpuram ||38|| kaṃpayantaṃ bhuvaṃ vegātpātayantaṃ girīndrumān || ghātayaṃtaṃ svagadayā kṛtāṃtamiva durjanān ||39|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā yādavāḥ sarve bhayaṃ prāpurmṛdhāṃgaṇe || āgate daṃtavaktre ca mahānkolāhalo hyabhūt ||40|| pradyumnaḥ preṣayāmāsa tasyopari mahadbalam || aṣṭādaśākṣauhiṇīnāṃ dhanuṣṭaṃkārayan muhuḥ ||41|| bāṇaiḥ paraśvadhaiḥ rājañchataghnībhīrbhṛśuṃḍibhiḥ || taṃ teḍuryādavāḥ sarve sarvato'driṃ yathā gajāḥ ||42|| daṃtavakraḥ svagadayā karīṃdrānutkaṭānbahūn || pātayāmāsa rājeṃdra bhinnakuṃbhasthalān mṛdhe ||43|| kāṃścitpādeṣu connīya kiṃkiṇījālanāditān || saśṛṅkhalānsanīḍāṃstām̐llolaghaṃṭāraṇatsvanān ||44|| vātastūlamivākāśe cikṣepa śatayojanam || śūṃḍādaṃḍeṣu kāṃścidvai gṛhītvā daityapuṃgavaḥ ||45|| bhrāmayitvā gajāndikṣu nadataḥ prākṣipadruṣā || kāṃścidgajānvaṃśayośca kakṣayorubhayorapi ||46|| padbhyāmākramya śuśubhe daityaḥ kālāgnirudravat || rathānsasūtānsāśvāṃśca sadhvajānsamahārathān || cikṣepa gagane vīraḥ padmānīva prabhañjanaḥ ||47|| turagāṃśca padātīśca prākṣipadgagane balāt || adhomukhā ūrdhvamukhā rājaputrā mahābalāḥ ||48|| saśatrā ratnakeyurasaṃyuktāstārakā iva || ākāśātprapataṃtaste vamaṃto rudhiraṃ mukhāt ||49|| balaṃ viloḍayāmāsa gadayā daityapuṃgavaḥ || daṃṣṭrayā pralayābdhiṃ śrīvarāha iva maithila ||50|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde koṃkaṇakuṭakatrigartakeralatailaṃgamahārāṣṭrakarṇāṭavijaye kārūṣadeśagamanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||10||
<7.11> tadā śrīkṛṣṇaputrāṇāmaṣṭādaśa mahārathāḥ|| sakṣataṃ kārayāmāsurdantavaktraṃ mahābalam||1|| dantavaktro'tiśuśubhe sa kṣato raktadhārayā|| lākṣayeva yathā saudhaṃ prahāraṃ nānuciṃtayan||2|| kṛtavarmā ca bāṇaughaistaṃ jaghāna raṇāṃgaṇe|| yuyudhānaśca khaḍgena śaktyākrūro mahābalam||3|| sāraṇastaṃ kuṭhāreṇāhanattaṃ rohiṇīsutaḥ|| daṃntavaktro'pi gadayā yuyudhānaṃ tatāḍa ha||4|| kareṇa kṛtavarmāṇamakrūraṃ svāṅghriṇāhanat || sāraṇaṃ bhujavegena kārūṣo raṇadurmadaḥ||5|| akrūraḥ kṛtavarmā ca yuyudhāno'tha sāraṇaḥ || nipeturmūrchitā bhūmau marutā pādapā iva||6|| tato gadāṃ samādāya sāmbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ|| gadopari gadāṃ nītvā gadayā taṃ tatāḍa ha ||7|| daṃtavakro gadāṃ tyaktvā sāṃbaṃ jāṃbavatīsutam || gṛhītvā pātayāmāsa bhujābhyāṃ raṇamaṃḍale ||8|| sāṃbastadā samutthāya gṛhītvā pādayośca tam || apothayadbhūmipṛṣṭhe tadadbhutamivābhavat ||9|| daṃtavakraḥ samutthāya sāṭṭahāsaṃ tadākarot || nanāda tena brahmāṃḍaṃ saptalokairbilaiḥ saha ||10|| patākāḍhyena divyena sahasrādityavarcasā || sahasrahayayuktena pradyumnaṃ dhanvināṃ varam|| daṃtavaktro'pi taṃ vīkṣya prāhedaṃ paruṣaṃ vacaḥ||11|| dantavaktra uvāca yūyaṃ ca yādavāḥ sarve vṛṣṇayo hyaṃdhakādayaḥ|| alpasatvā janāstucchā vidrutāyuddhabhīravaḥ||12|| yayātiśāpasaṃbhraṣṭā bhraṣṭarājyā gatatrapāḥ|| eko'haṃ bahavo yuyaṃ yuṣmābhiśca kṛtaṃ mṛdham||13|| adharmavartibhistucchairdharmaśāstravilopibhiḥ || pūrvaṃ pitā te śrīkṛṣṇo nandasya paśurakṣakaḥ||14|| gopālocchiṣṭabhojī ca so'dya vai yādaveśvaraḥ|| hayyaṃgavīnadadhyājyadugdhatakrādikaṃ rasam||15|| corayāmāsa gopīnāṃ rasiko rāsamaṃḍale|| jarāsaṃdhabhayātso'pi samudraṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ||16|| so'dyaiva yadunātho'bhūdyo bhīruḥ kālasaṃmukhe|| tena dattaṃ svalparājyamugrasenaḥ sametya saḥ||17|| kariṣyatyalpasārārthe rājasūyaṃ kratūttamam || duratyayā kālagatirjātaṃ citramaho jagat|| adhyāste siṃhaśārdūlaṃ śṛgālo hyatidurbalaḥ||18|| śrīpradyumna uvāca purā vai kuṃḍinapure yadūnāṃ balamūrjitam || tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ na kiṃ tvatra paśyādyaiva viniṃdaka||19|| yuṣmānsaṃbaṃdhino jñātvā necche yuddham karūṣapa || balāttvaṃ yuddhamākārṣīrdharmaśāstraṃ tvayā kṛtam ||20|| naṃdo droṇo vasuḥsākṣājjāto gopakule'pisaḥ || gopālā ye ca goloke kṛṣṇaromasamudbhavāḥ ||21|| rādhāromodbhavā gopyastāśca sarvā ihāgatāḥ|| kāścitpuṇyaiḥ kṛtaiḥ pūrvaiḥ prāptāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ varaiḥparaiḥ||22|| paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam || asaṃkhyabrahmāṃḍapatirgolokeśaḥ parātparaḥ ||23|| yasminsarvāṇi tejāṃsi vilīyaṃte svatejasi || taṃ vadaṃti pare sākṣātparipūrṇatamaḥ svayam ||24|| ugraseno'tha rājeṃdro maruto nāma yaḥ purā || śrīkṛṣṇasya vareṇāsau yādaveṃdro babhūva ha ||25|| niraṃkuśo mahāmūrkho vinindasi mahadguṇam || sa na prārthayate kiṃcidyathā siṃhaḥ śivārutam ||26| śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ vacastadā śrutvā daṃtavaktro madotkaṭaḥ|| gadāṃ gurvīṃ samādāya prādravattadrathopari ||27|| gadayā pātayāmāsa sahasraṃ ghoṭakānnadan || ghoṭakā dudruvuḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ bhayaṃkaram||28|| pradyumno'pi gadāṃ nītvā taṃ tatāḍa dṛḍhaṃ hṛdi || tatprahāreṇa daityedraḥ kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ ||29|| tayośca gadayā yuddhaṃ ghorarūpaṃ babhūva ha || gadābhyāṃ praharaṃtau dvau mardayaṃtau parasparam ||30|| daṃtavaktro bhujābhyāṃ taṃ gṛhītvā śrīhareḥ sutam || bhūmau nipātayāmāsa siṃhaḥ siṃhamivaujasā ||31|| pradyumno'pi samutthāya gṛhītvā bhujayorbalāt || bhrāmayitvā bhujābhyāṃ taṃ pātayāmāsa bhūtale ||32|| pradyumnasya prahāreṇa so'patadrudhiraṃ vaman|| cūrṇitāsthiḥ khinnagātro mūrchito vihvalākṛtiḥ || girindra iva bhūpṛṣṭhe reje śakrāyudhāhataḥ|| tatprahāreṇa vasudhā cacāla sajalābhavat ||34|| vicelurdiggajāstārāḥ samudrāśca cakaṃpire || pātaśabdena rājendra trilokī badhirīkṛtā||35|| tadaiva kārūṣāpatirmahātmā śrīvṛddhaśarmā śrutadevayā ca || rājñyā mahāraṃgapurādyadūnāṃ samāyayau suṃdarasaṃdhikārī ||36|| datvā baliṃ maithila śaṃbarāraye sutaṃ gṛhītvā kṛtasaṃdhiragrataḥ || tathā yadūnāṃ pravaraiḥ prapūjitaḥ punarmahāraṃgapuraṃ samāyayau||37|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde daṃtavaktrayuddhe karuṣadeśavijayo nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||11||
<7.12> śrīnārada uvāca arṇavaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ snātvā pradyumno yādavādhipaḥ || uśīnarāṃstato jetumājagāma balaiḥ saha ||1|| koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo gāvo yatra deśe caraṃti hi || gopālamaṃḍalairyuktā vrajaṃtyo bhavyamūrtayaḥ ||2|| auśīnarāḥ kṣīrapānā gauravarṇā manoharāḥ || hayyaṃgavīnamādāya te yayuḥ kārṣṇisaṃmukhe ||3|| taiḥ pūjitaḥ śambarārirdadau tebhyo mahādhanam || gajān rathān hayān ratnavastrabhūṣādi harṣitaḥ ||4|| caṃpāvatī nāma purī maṇiratnasamanvitā || virājate yatra nṛpaiḥ sarpairbhogavatī yathā ||5|| caṃpāvatīpatirvīro nāmnā hemāṃgado nṛpaḥ || nītvā baliṃ sametyāśu śrīkārṣṇiṃ praṇanāma ha ||6|| tasmai tuṣṭaḥ śaṃbarārirmālāṃ kiṃjalkinīṃ dadau || sahasradalaśobhāḍhyaṃ padmaṃ divyaṃ dadau punaḥ ||7|| atha kārṣṇirmahābāhuḥ svasainyaparivāritaḥ || vidarbhānprayayau dhanvī duṃdubhīnnādayanmuhuḥ ||8|| bhīṣmakaḥ kuṃḍinapatirāgataṃ rukmiṇīsutam || ānīya pūjayāmāsa sasainyaṃ bahubhirdhanaiḥ ||9|| mātāmahaṃ tato natvā rukmiṇīnaṃdano balī || kuṃtadeśāṃśca daradānprayayau yādaveśvaraḥ ||10|| malayācalapāṭīravāyubhiḥ parisevitaḥ || śrīkhaṃḍaketakīpuṣpagaṃdhākte malayācale ||11|| agastyaṃ muniśārdūlaṃ pītābdhiṃ sa dadarśa ha || kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ kārṣṇirnamaskṛtya mahāmunim || sthito'bhūduṭaje sākṣādāśīrbhirabhinaṃditaḥ ||12|| śrīpradyumna uvāca dṛśyaṃ padārtha tu jagatsatyavadvartate katham || mukto brahmāṃśako bhūtvā baddhyate'yaṃ kathaṃ guṇaiḥ ||13|| etatpraśnaṃ mama brūhi nitarāṃ munisattama || tvaṃ sarvaviddivyacakṣuḥ sarvabrahmavidāṃ varaḥ ||14|| agastya uvāca tvaṃ sākṣātkṛṣṇacaṃdrasya paripūrṇatamasya ca || putro'si pṛcchase māṃ vai līlāmātramidaṃ vacaḥ ||15|| lokasaṃgrahamevārthaṃ kurvandevo hariryathā || tathā nṛṇāṃ ca kalyāṇaṃ kurvanvicarasi prabho ||16|| yathā satyasya sūryasya biṃbaṃ vāriṣu satyavat || dṛśyate satyavaddṛśyaṃ pradhānaparayostathā ||17|| kāce mukhaṃ guṇe sarpaṃ saikate jīvanaṃ yathā || tathāyaṃ sandehaguṇairbaddhyate prekṣatā svayam ||18|| pradyumna uvāca kathaṃ na baddhyate dehī yenopāyena tadvada || vairāgyeṇa dṛḍhenāpi brūhi brahmavidāṃ vara ||19|| agastya uvāca vivekaṃ yaḥ samāśritya bhajedbrahma sanātanam || manomayaṃ jaganmattvā sa vrajetparamaṃ padam ||20|| janmamṛtyū śokamohau jarābālayuvādayaḥ || ahaṃ mado vyādhibhayaṃ duḥkhaṃ śokaḥ kṣudhā ratiḥ ||21|| ādhirbhayaṃ tasya rājanna bhaveta kadācana || ātmā nirīho hyatanuḥ sarvataścānahaṃkṛtiḥ || śuddho guṇāśrayaḥ sākṣātparo niṣkala ātmadṛk ||22|| jñānātmakaḥ sadā pūrṇo vidito yo munīśvaraiḥ || taṃ brahma paramātmanaṃ jñātvāyaṃ vicaretsukhī ||23|| asmiñchayāne jāgarti sarvaṃ paśyati yaḥ pumān || nāyaṃ taṃ vetti paśyaṃtaṃ na paśyati kadācana ||24|| nabho'gnipavanāḥ koṣṭhakāṣṭhaprodgatareṇubhiḥ || na sajjaṃte guṇairbrahma varṇaśca sphaṭiko yathā||25|| lakṣaṇābhirdhvanivyaṃgyairjñāyate na kadācana || kutastu laukikairvākyaistasmai śrībrahmaṇe namaḥ ||26|| kecitkarma vadaṃtyenaṃ kecitkālaṃ tathā'pare || kartāraṃ yogamapare sāṃkhyaṃ brahma vadaṃti kam ||27|| kecittaṃ paramātmānaṃ vāsudevaṃ vadaṃti ke || pratyakṣeṇānumānena nigamenātmasaṃvidā ||28|| vicārya tadbrahma paraṃ niḥsaṃgo vicarediha || yathāṃbhasā pracalatā taravo'pi calā iva ||29|| cakṣuṣā bhrāmyamāṇena dṛśyate calatīva bhūḥ || tathā guṇānāṃ bhramaṇo bhramatā manasā yataḥ ||30|| bhrāmyamāṇaḥ sadā rājankareṇālātacakravat || kariṣyāmi karomīti mamedaṃ tava cābruvan || tvamahaṃ ca sukhī duḥkhī sadājñānavimohitaḥ ||31|| satvaṃ rajastama iti prakṛternātmano guṇāḥ || tairidaṃ jagadāvyāptamotaprotapaṭaṃ yathā ||32|| ūrdhvaṃ gacchaṃti satvasthā madhye tiṣṭhaṃti rājasāḥ || jaghanyaguṇavṛttisthā adho gacchaṃti tāmasāḥ ||33|| aṃdhakāre guṇātkārṣṇe sarpabuddhirbhavedyathā || ārānmarīcikāṃ vāri tathedaṃ manyate jagat ||34|| gatāgataṃ sukhaṃ viddhi yathā maṃḍalavartinām || tathā nṝṇāṃ ca tadduḥkhaṃ yathā narakavāsinām || ghanāvalirdehaguṇā ahorātramṛteryathā ||35|| yathā sārthaṃ tathā dṛśyaṃ na kiṃcitsarvadaiva hi || pakṣe jāte yathā nīḍātpāre yāte yathoḍupāt ||36|| jñāne prāpte tathā lokāddarpaṇātkiṃ prayojanam || tathā mārgaṃ nidhāyāśu vicaretsamadṛṅmuniḥ ||37|| yathendurudapātreṣu yathā'gniḥ kāṣṭhasaṃcaye || tathaiko bhagavānsākṣātparamātmā vyavasthitaḥ ||38|| ghaṭe maṭhe yathā''kāśo vartate'ntarbahirmahān || tathā parātmā nirlipto dehiṣu svakṛteṣu ca ||39|| yaḥ kṛṣṇabhaktaḥ śāṃtātmā jñānaniṣṭho virāgavān || taṃ na spṛśaṃtīha guṇāḥ kānīva bisinīdalam ||40|| jñānī sadānaṃdamayo bālavadvicarettanum || na paśyati dhṛtaṃ vāso madirāmadamattavat ||41|| sūryodaye yathā vastu gṛhe rājan pradṛśyate || dūrīkṛtya tathājñānaṃ sākṣāttattvaṃ tato bṛhat ||42|| yathendriyaṃ pṛthagdvārairartho bahuguṇāśrayaḥ || nāneyate tathā brahma vācibhiḥ śāstravartmabhiḥ ||43|| paraṃ padaṃ vadaṃtyetatkecidvai vaiṣṇavaṃ nṛpa || kecidvai vyāpya vaikuṃṭhaṃ śāṃtaṃ ke'pi tataḥ param ||44|| kaivalyaṃ tadbrahma kecitparamaṃ dhāma cāvyayam || akṣaraṃ ca parāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ golokaṃ prakṛteḥ param ||45|| kecinnikuṃjaṃ viśadaṃ vadantīha purāvidaḥ || jñānavairāgyabhaktibhyaḥ prāpnotīha na cānyataḥ ||46|| śrīkṛṣṇacaṇdrasya hareḥ parasya kaivalyanāthasya parātparasya || vrajetpadaṃ śrīpuruṣottamasya yatprāpya bhakto na nivartate'tha ||47|| śrīnārada uvāca iti bhāgavataṃ jñānaṃ śrutvā kārṣṇirmahāmunim || agastyaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhaktyā natvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ ||48|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde uśīnaravidarbhakuṃtadaradadeśavijaye agastyakārṣṇijñānaprastāvo nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||12||
<7.13> śrīnārada uvāca kṛtamālāṃ tāmraparṇīṃ snātvā śrīyādaveśvaraḥ || yadubhiḥ sainikaiḥ sārddhaṃ rājan rājapuraṃ yayau ||1|| śālvo rājapurādhīśaḥ śrutvā manmukhato yadūn || āgatān sa yayau śīghraṃ dvividaṃ vānarādhipam ||2|| dvivido hyatisaṃkruddho vīro mitrasahāyakṛt || śaṃbarāribalaṃ prāgāccālayan vasudhātalam ||3|| vidadāra nakhairdaṃtaiḥ patākādhvajapaṭṭakān || kāśmīrakaṃbalairyuktānsāmudrānsvarṇabhūṣitān ||4|| rathānutpātayāmāsa gajānāruhya vegataḥ || aśvānvidrāvayāmāsa bhrūbhaṃgairvānarasvanaiḥ ||5|| itthaṃ kolāhale jāte pradyumno dhanvināṃ varaḥ || ājagāma rathenāsau dhanuṣṭaṃkārayan muhuḥ ||6|| dvividastadrathasyārāduccakrāma madotkaṭaḥ || chatraṃ dhvajaṃ svapucchena kaṃpayansahayaṃ ratham ||7|| pradyumnaḥ svadhanuṣkoṭyā dhṛtvā kaṇṭhe cakarṣa ha || kapistadātikupito muṣṭinā taṃ tatāḍa ha ||8|| pradyumno dhanurādaya sajjaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || ākṛṣya karṇaparyantaṃ viśikhena tatāḍ tam ||9|| viśikhī bhrāmayitvā taṃ gagane śatayojanam || praharārddhena rājendra laṃkāyā saṃnyapātayat ||10|| rakṣobhiḥ saha tadyuddhaṃ babhūva ghaṭikādvayam || nyapātayatsa rakṣāṃsi pradyumno'tha yadūttamaḥ ||11|| nādayandundubhiṃ rājan vijitya jagṛhe balim || dakṣiṇāṃ mathurāṃ dṛṣṭvā trikūṭaṃ cāruroha ha ||12|| proccakrāma trikūṭātsa mainākaśikharopari || mainākātsiṃhalaṃ caitya bhārataṃ cāyayau punaḥ ||13|| śanaiḥ śanairvānareṃdro himācalagiriṃ gataḥ || himācalasya śikharātprāgjyotiṣapuraṃ yayau ||14|| matsāradeśādhipatiṃ pradyumno yādaveśvaraḥ || mahākṣetraṃ rāmakṛṣṇaṃ prayayau setubaṃdhanam ||15|| śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ samudraṃ makarālayam || vīkṣya kārṣṇirmahāvīrastasthau velāṃ sametya saḥ ||16|| sāṃbādīnsa samāhūyākrūrādyān yādavānsvakān || sabhāyāmuddhavaṃ prāha kārṣṇiryogeśvareśvaraḥ ||17|| pradyumna uvāca bibhīṣaṇo dvīpapatirmahojjvalo laṃkāpatiḥ kauṇapavṛndamukhyaḥ || vadātha kiṃ bhojavarāya maṃtrinna cedbaliṃ yacchati me vadāśu ||18|| uddhava uvāca tvaṃ devadevaḥ puruṣottamottamaḥ śrīkṛṣṇcandraḥ paramastvameva hi || tvaṃ pṛcchase loka iva prabho māṃ māyāpi te yogivarairduratyayā ||19|| brahmādayo yasya parānuśāsanaṃ vahanti mūrdhnā satataṃ pradharṣitāḥ || sa eva sākṣātpuruṣo'si bhūman dāsānudāso'smi vadāmi kiṃ te ||20|| śrīnārada uvāca ityuktaḥ paśyatāṃ teṣāṃ pradyumno bhagavānhariḥ || patraṃ gṛhītvā vyalikhatsaṃdeśaṃ maithileśvara ||21|| śrībhojarājāya baliṃ prayaccha balānna cenme vacanaṃ śṛṇu tvam || kodaṃḍamuktairviśikhaiśca setuṃ baddhvā''gamiṣyāmi sasainyasaṃghaḥ ||22|| likhitvedaṃ samādāya kodaṇḍaṃ caṇḍavikramaḥ || bāṇe patraṃ samādhāya karṇāṃtaṃ taṃ tatāna ha ||23|| prasphuṭaṃ sphoṭate naiva ṭaṃkāro'bhūttaḍitsvanaḥ || nanāda tena brahmāṇḍaṃ saptalokairbilaiḥ saha ||24|| kodaṇḍamukto viśikho dyotayanmaṇḍalaṃ diśām || vibhīṣaṇasabhāmadhye saṃpapāta taḍitsvanaḥ ||25|| tadaiva rākṣāsāḥ sarve protthitāścakitā iva || sakaṃcukāni śastrāṇi jagṛhurvegataḥ khalāḥ ||26|| patraṃ bāṇātsamākṛṣya paṭhitvātha bibhīṣaṇaḥ || vismito'bhūtsabhāmadhye rākṣaseṃdro mahābalaḥ ||27|| prāptaṃ tadaiva sadasi śukrācāryaṃ bibhīṣaṇaḥ || pūjayāmāsa pādyādyairnatvā prāha kṛtāṃjaliḥ ||28|| bibhīṣaṇa uvāca bhagavankasya bāṇo'yaṃ bhojarājastu kaḥ kṣitau || kiṃ balaṃ tasya me brūhi tvaṃ sākṣāddivyadarśanaḥ ||29|| śrīśukra uvāca atraivodāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa rājanpāpaṃ praśāmyati ||30|| purā hi brahmaṇaḥ putrāḥ sanakādyā divaṃ gatāḥ || viṣṇorlokaṃ yayurdivyaṃ caranto bhuvanatrayam ||31|| digaṃbarāñchiśūnmatvā jayo vijaya eva tān || dvārapālau rurudhaturvetreṇāṃtaḥpurasthitau ||32|| aśapaṃstau ca te kruddhāḥ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ || bhūyāstāmasurau duṣṭau śuddhau hi janmabhistribhiḥ ||33|| evaṃ śaptau svabhavanātpatantau bhūmimaṇḍale || jajñāte tau diteḥ putrau daityadānavapūjitau ||34|| hiraṇyakaśipurjyeṣṭho hiraṇyākṣo'nujastathā || bhagavān yajñavārāho bhūtvā kṣmāmuddharañjalāt ||35|| jaghāna muṣṭinā daityaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ mahābalam || hiraṇyakaśipuṃ sākṣānnṛsiṃhaścaṇḍavikramaḥ ||36|| dadāra jaṭhare taṃ vai kāyādhavasahāyakṛt || bhrātarau tau punarjātau keśinyāṃ viśravaḥsutau ||37|| rāvaṇaḥ kumbhakarṇaśca sarvalokaikatāpanau || sāyakai rāghavasyāpi petaturyuddhamaṃḍale ||38|| rākṣaseṃdrau mahāvegau sasainyau paśyatastava || tṛtīye'sminbhave jātau kṣatriyāṇāṃ kule kila ||39|| śiśupālo dantavaktro vartamānau mahābalau || paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam ||40|| asaṃkhyabrahmāṇḍapatirgolokeśaḥ parātparaḥ || jātastayorvadhārthāya yaduvaṃśe hariḥ svayam ||41|| yādaveṃdro bhūrilīlo dvārakāyāṃ virājate || yudhiṣṭhiramahāyajñe yuddhe śālvasya mādhavaḥ ||42|| śiśupālaṃ dantavaktraṃ haniṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || tasya putraḥ śaṃbarārirdigjayārthaṃ vinirgataḥ ||43|| vijeṣyati nṛpānsarvāñjaṃbūdvīpasthitānnṛpān || jiteṣu satsu deveṣu dvārakāyāṃ yadūttamaḥ || ugraseno bhojarājo rājasūyaṃ kariṣyati ||44|| tasyaiva kodaṇḍavinirgato balātpracaṇḍavego viśikhastvihāgataḥ || tannāmacihno'titaḍitsvano babhau pradyotayan rākṣasamaṇḍalaṃ diśām ||45|| śrīnārada uvāca śrīrāmabhakto'tha bibhīṣaṇo'sau vijñāya kṛṣṇaṃ nṛpa rāmacandram || nītvā baliṃ kauṇapavṛṃdamukhyaḥ samāyayau suṃdaraśatrusenām ||46|| tadā'vatīryārśu mahāṃbarātsphuradghanadyutirdīghavapurjayekṣaṇaḥ || pradakṣiṇīkṛtya hareḥ sutaṃ punaḥ kṛtāṃjaliḥ saṃmukha āsthito'bhūt ||47|| vibhīṣaṇa uvāca namo bhagavate tubhyaṃ vāsudevāya vedhase || pradyumnāyāniruddhāya namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca ||48|| namo matsāya kūrmāya varāhaya namo namaḥ || namaḥ śrīrāmacaṃdrāya bhārgavāya namo namaḥ ||49|| vāmanāya namastubhyaṃ nṛsiṃhāya namo namaḥ || namo buddhāya śuddhāya kalkaye cārtihāriṇe ||50|| śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā śrīhareḥ putraṃ pūjayāmāsa mānadaḥ || upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirbhaktyā paramayā''rdravāk ||51|| tasmai tuṣṭaḥ śaṃbarārirdadau jñānaṃ viraktimat || bhaktiṃ śāṃtikarīṃ sākṣādyāṃti duṣpremalakṣaṇām ||52|| brahmadattaṃ mahādivyaṃ padmarāgaṃ śiromaṇim || paulastyena purā dattaṃ ratnamālāṃ sphuratprabhām ||53|| candrakāntamaṇiṃ tasmai candradattaṃ dadau punaḥ || pītāṃbaraṃ paraṃ sākṣātpradyumnaḥ paramaḥ prabhuḥ ||54|| bibhīṣaṇo'tha pradyumnaṃ natvā datvā baliṃ tataḥ || jagāma laṃkāṃ sagaṇo rākṣaseṃdro mahābalaḥ ||55|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śālvamatsāralaṃkāvijayo nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||13||
<7.14> śrīnārada uvāca ṛṣabhādriṃ tato dṛṣṭvā śrīraṅgākhyaṃ hareḥ sutaḥ || kāmaḥ kārṣṇiḥ purīṃ kāṃcīṃ nadīṃ prācīṃ saridvarām ||||1|| kāverīṃ ca tadottīrya sahyādriviṣayaṃ yayau || yādavaiḥ sahitaḥ sākṣātpradyumno bhagavānhariḥ ||2|| śibireṣu samāyāntaṃ muktakeśaṃ digaṃbaram || avadhūtaṃ pradhāvantaṃ puṣṭāṃgaṃ rajasā''vṛtam ||3|| bālāstamanudhāvantastalaśabdairitastataḥ || kolāhalaṃ prakurvaṃto hasaṃto maithileśvara ||4|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā coddhavaṃ prāha karṣṇirbuddhimatāṃ varaḥ ||5|| pradyumna uvāca ko'yaṃ puṣṭavapurdhāvanbālonmattapiśācavat || tiraskṛto'pi hasati janairānandavānmahān ||6|| uddhava uvāca ayaṃ paramahaṃsākhyo'vadhūto vā hareḥ kalā || sadānaṃdamayaḥ sākṣaddattātreyo mahāmuniḥ ||7|| yasya prasādātparamāṃ siddhiṃ prāpuḥ pare nṛpāḥ || sahasrārjunamukhyā ye yadukāyādhavādayaḥ ||8|| śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvā śaṃbarārirnatvā saṃpūjya taṃ munim || saṃsthāpya cāsane divye papracchedaṃ yadūttamaḥ ||9|| pradyumna uvāca bhagavanme hṛdisthaṃ vai sandehaṃ nāśaya prabho || jagato brahmamārgāṃśca hetvaṃtaṃ brūhi tatvataḥ ||10|| dattātreya uvāca dṛśyate na vasuryāvattāvadulkāprayojanam || prāpte vaśe mahānaṃde'tholkāyāḥ kiṃ prayojanam ||11|| tāvadāste jagatsādho yāvattatvaṃ na vedyate || parasminbrahmaṇi prāpte jagataḥ kiṃ prayojanam ||12|| āsyabiṃbo yathā''darśe paśyate na paraṃ vapuḥ || pradhānārthe tathā jīvo jñānenāsau parātparam ||13|| yathā sūryodaye sarvaṃ vastu netreṇa dṛśyate || tathā jñānodaye brahmatatvaṃ jīvena sarvataḥ ||14|| śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvātha taṃ natvā pradyumno yādaveśvaraḥ || vaikuṇṭhādriṃ drāviḍeṣu yayau senāsamanvitaḥ ||15|| satyavāgdharmatatvajño rājarṣirdrāviḍeśvaraḥ || pradyumnaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ ||16|| śrīśailadarśanaṃ kṛtvā giriśālayamadbhutam || skaṃdaṃ vīkṣya tato rājan yayau paṃpāsarovare ||17|| godāvarīṃ bhīmarathīṃ gataḥ śrīdvārakeśvaraḥ || pradarśayanharestīrthaṃ maheṃdrādriṃ tato yayau ||18|| mahendrādristhitaṃ rāmaṃ bhārgavaṃ kṣatriyāṃtakam || natvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya tatra tasthau hareḥ sutaḥ ||19|| rāmastasyāśiṣaṃ datvā yādavānāṃ balāya vai || caturaṃgāya rājeṃdra yogenārhaṇamācarat ||20|| bhaktasūpaḥ pralehaśca rudikā dadhiśākajāḥ || śikhariṇyavalehaśca balakā cakṣukheriṇī ||21|| trikoṇaśarkarāyukto baṭako madhuśīrṣakaḥ || pheṇikā copariṣṭaśca śatapatra sachidrakaḥ ||22|| cakrābhacihnakāścetthaṃ sudhākuṇḍalikāḥ smṛtāḥ || ghṛtapūro vāyupūrastathā candrakalā smṛtāḥ ||23|| dadhisthalīśca karpūranāḍīsthaṃ khaṇḍamaṃḍalam || godhūmaparikhāścaiva suphalāḍhyāstathaiva ca ||24|| dadhirūpo modakaśca śākasaudhāna eva ca || maṃḍakāpāyasaṃ yuktaṃ dadhi goghṛtameva ca ||25|| haiyaṃgavīnamaṃḍūrī kupikā parpaṭastathā || śaktikā lasikā caiva suvṛtsaṃdhāya eva hī ||26|| suphalaiśca sitāyuktaiḥ phalāni vividhanī ca || yathā mohanabhogaiśca lavaṇaṃ ca tathaiva ca ||27|| kaṣāyo madhurastiktaḥ kaṭuramlastvanekadhā || ṣaṭpaṃcāśattamaścaiva hyete bhogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||28|| eteṣāṃ bhārgavaḥ śailānakārṣīdyogamāsthitaḥ || sainye saṃbhojite tatra hastanyūnā na te'bhavan ||29|| vaibhavaṃ bhārgavasyāpi dṛṣṭvā sarve'tivismitāḥ || pradyumnastaṃ namaskṛtya yādavaiḥ sahitastadā ||30|| sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ rājan papracchedaṃ hareḥ sutaḥ || pradyumna uvāca bhagavanbhavatā dattaṃ sarvebhyo bhojanaṃ param ||31|| samṛddhayaḥ siddhayaśca tvadaṃghrāvāsthitāḥ prabho || sarveṣāṃ haribhaktānāṃ priyo bhaktastu ko hareḥ || etanme brūhi vipreṃdra tvaṃ parāvaravittamaḥ ||32|| paraśurāma uvāca tvaṃ prabho kiṃ na jānāsi lokavatpṛcchase'tha mām || lokasaṃgrahamevārātkurvan vicarasi kṣitau ||33|| niṣkiṃcano haripadābjaparāgalubdhaḥ śrīmatkathāśravaṇakīrtanatatparo yaḥ || tadrūpasiṃdhulaharīvinimagnacittaḥ śrīkṛṣṇacaṃdradayitaḥ kathitaḥ sa bhaktaḥ ||34|| dāṃto mahānakhilajaṃgamavatsalo'yaṃ śāṃtastitikṣuratikāruṇikaḥ suhṛtsat || lokaṃ punāti nijapādarajobhirārācchrīkṛṣṇacaṃdradayitaḥ kathitaḥ pareśa ||35|| yaḥ pārameṣṭhyamakhilaṃ na maheṃdradhiṣṇyaṃ no sārvabhaumamaniśaṃ na rasādhipatyam || no yogasiddhimabhito na punarbhavaṃ vā vāṃchatyalaṃ paramapādarajaḥ sa bhaktaḥ ||36|| niṣkiṃcanāḥ svakṛtakarmaphalairvirāgā yattatpadaṃ harijanā munayo mahāṃtaḥ || bhaktā juṣaṃti haripādarajaḥprasaktā anye vidaṃti na sukhaṃ kila nairapekṣyam ||37|| bhaktātpriyo na viditaḥ puruṣottamasya śaṃbhurvidhirna ca ramā na ca rauhiṇeyaḥ || bhaktānanuvrajati bhaktanibaddhacittacūḍāmaṇiḥ sakalalokajanasya kṛṣṇaḥ ||38|| gacchannijaṃ janamanu prapunāti lokānāvedayanharijane svaruciṃ mahātmā || tasmādatīva bhajatāṃ bhagavānmukuṃdo muktiṃ dadāti na kadāpi subhaktiyogam ||39|| śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvā yādaveṃdro natvā śrībhārgavottamam || prācyāṃ diśi yayau rājan gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgamam ||40|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde drāviḍadeśavijayo nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||14||
<7.15> śrīnārada uvāca digjayasya miṣeṇāsau bhūbhāraṃ hārayanmuhuḥ || pradyumno bhagavānsākṣādaṃgadeśaṃ tato yayau ||1|| aṃgeśo'ntaḥpurādhīśo gṛhīto yādavairvane || so'pi tasmai baliṃ prādātpradyumnāya mahātmane ||2|| uḍḍīśaḍāmarādhīśo bṛhadbāhurmahābalaḥ || na dadau sa baliṃ tasmai pradyumnāya madotkaṭaḥ ||3|| pradyumnapreṣito vīraḥ sāmbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ || ekākī prayayau dhanvī rathenādityavarcasā ||4|| chādayāmāsa bāṇaughairḍāmaraṃ nagaraṃ nṛpa || giriṃ tuṣārapaṭalairjīmūta iva sarvataḥ ||5|| tadā tu ḍāmarādhīśo dharṣitaḥ sankṛtāṃjaliḥ || baliṃ dadau namaskṛtya pradyumnāya mahātmane ||6|| vaṃgadeśādhipo vīro vīradhanvā madotkaṭaḥ || āyayau saṃmukhe yoddhumakṣauhiṇyā''vṛto bali ||7|| caṃdrabhānurhareḥ putraḥ pradyumnasya prapaśyataḥ || bibheda tadbalaṃ bāṇaiḥ kuvākyairmitratāmiva ||8|| kariṇāṃ bāṇabhinnānāṃ śiraso mauktikāni ca || prasphuraṃti nipetuḥ kau rātrau tārāgaṇā iva ||9|| nipetū rathino'nekā gajāśvāśca padātayaḥ || tadbāṇaiśchinnaśirasaḥ kūṣmāṃḍaśakalā iva ||10|| kṣaṇamātreṇa tatsainyakṣatajānāṃ nadī hyabhūt || manasvināṃ harṣakarī trastānāṃ bhayakāriṇī ||11|| muṇḍaiḥ kabaṃdhairdhāvadbhirharikeyurakuṃḍalaiḥ || kirīṭaiḥ kaṃkaṇaiḥ śastrairmahāmārīva bhūrbabhau ||12|| kūṣmāṇḍonmādavetālā bhairavā brahmarākṣasāḥ || śirāṃsi jagṛhurvegāddharamālārthahetave ||13|| itthaṃ nipātite sainye vīradhanvā samāgataḥ || caṃdrabhānuṃ tatāḍāśu gadayā vajrakalpayā ||14|| tadgadātiprahāreṇa na cacāla hareḥ sutaḥ || caṃdrabhānurgadāṃ nītvā taṃ tatāḍa bhujāṃtare ||15|| gadāprahāravyathito mūrchito dharaṇītale || papāta pādapa iva prodvaman rudhiraṃ mukhāt ||16|| labdhasaṃjño muhūrtena vaṃgadeśādhipo nṛpaḥ || prayayau śaraṇaṃ so'pi pradyumnasya mahātmanaḥ ||17|| yāte dattabalau rājannagaraṃ vīradhanvani || brahmaputraṃ samuttīrya pradyumno'mitavikramaḥ ||18|| āśīmādhipatiṃ biṃbaṃ gṛhītvā yādaveśvaraḥ || balimādāya yadubhiḥ kāmarūpaṃ samāyayau ||19|| kāmarupeśvaraḥ puṃḍra aiṃdrajālaviśāradaḥ || nirgataḥ senayā sārddhaṃ yoddhuṃ pradyumnasaṃmukhe || 20|| āśīmānāṃ yadūnāṃ ca ghoraṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva ha || bāṇaiḥ kuṭhāraiḥ parighaiḥ śūlaiḥ khaḍgarṣṭiśaktibhiḥ ||21|| puṃḍro vidyāścakārāśu paiśācoragarākṣasīḥ || tato guhyakagaṃdharvāḥ sarvato maithileśvara ||22|| pradhāvaṃto raṇe rājanpiśācāḥ piśitāśanāḥ || koṭiśaḥ koṭiśoṃ'gārān kṣepayaṃto muhurmuhuḥ ||23|| kṣaṇamātreṇa tatsainyaṃ vamaṃto garalaṃ mukhāt || phūtkāramapi kurvaṃto daṃdaśūkāḥ samāgatāḥ ||24|| kharārūḍhā daṃtavakrā lalajjihvābhayaṃkarāḥ || carvayaṃto narān yuddhe dhāvaṃto rākṣasāstataḥ ||25|| yakṣāśca siṃhavadanā turaṃgavadanā nṛpa || chiṃdhi bhiṃdhīti garjaṃtaḥ śūlahastā itastataḥ ||26|| kṣaṇamātreṇa meghānāṃ samūhaiśchāditaṃ nabhaḥ || aṃdhakāro hyabhūdrājan rajasā vātavegataḥ ||27|| bhojavṛṣṇyaṃdhakamadhuśūrasenadaśārhakāḥ || bhayaṃ prāpurmahāyuddhe nyastaśastrā yadūttamāḥ ||28|| kṛṣṇadattaṃ dhanuḥ kārṣṇirādāya pratikāravit || sattvātmikāṃ mahāvidyāṃ bāṇaiḥ prāyuṅkta maithila ||29|| bāṇaiḥ piśācānuragān sayakṣān rakṣāṃsi gaṃdharvaghanāṃdhakārān || bibheda divyaiḥ prabhavairyathā hi nīhārameghān kiraṇairvivasvān ||30|| bāṇaiśca puṃḍraṃ sarathaṃ savāhanaṃ taṃ bhrāmayitvā ghaṭikādvayaṃ khe || nipātayāmāsa raṇe sapatnaṃ padmaṃ pṛthivyāmiva mārutaḥ kila |31|| buddhastadā taṃ śaraṇaṃ sametya pradharṣitaḥ sadya upāyanāni || lakṣairhayānāmayutairgajānāṃ yutāni dattvā praṇanāma kārṣṇim ||32|| vipāśāṃ sa tadottīrya sainyaiḥ śoṇanadaṃ nṛpa || kaikayānāyayau dhanvī pradyumno yadunaṃdanaḥ ||33|| kaikayasyādhipo rājā dhṛtaketurmahābalaḥ || vasudevasvasuḥ sākṣācchrutakīrteḥ patirmahān ||34|| pradyumnamarhayāmāsa dhṛtaketuḥ sa yādavam || bhaktyā paramayā rājañchrīkṛṣṇasya prabhāvavit ||35|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde kaikayavijayo nāma paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||15||
<7.16> śrīnārada uvāca duṃdubhīnnādayaṃstasmātpradyumno yadunaṃdanaḥ || maithilānāyayau rājaṃstava deśān sukhāvṛtān ||1|| suvarṇasaudhairatyuccaiḥ saghaṭai rājitāṃ purīm || mithilāṃ vīkṣya tāmārāduddhavaṃ prāha mādhavaḥ ||2|| pradyumna uvāca kasyaiṣā nagarī maṃtrin dṛṣyayate sāṃprataṃ mayā || rājate bahusaudhaiśca purī bhogavatī yathā ||3|| uddhava uvāca janakasya purī hyeṣā mithilā nāma mānada || mithileṃdro dhṛtistasyāṃ mahābhāgavataḥ kaviḥ ||4|| sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ śrīkṛṣṇeṣṭo haripriyaḥ || bahulāśvastasya suta ābālyādbhaktikṛddhareḥ ||5|| tasmai svaṃ darśanaṃ dātuṃ bhagavānāgamiṣyati || bahulāśvaṃ rājaputraṃ śrutadevaṃ dvijaṃ tathā ||6|| smaratyalaṃ dvārakāyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavān hariḥ || jetuṃ na śakyo deveṃdrairmanujaiśca kutaḥ prabho || dhṛtiḥ paramayā bhaktyā śrīkṛṣṇavaśakārakaḥ ||7|| śrīnārada uvāca tacchrutvā bhagavān kārṣṇiruddhavena samanvitaḥ || svaśiṣyamuddhavaṃ kṛtvā dhṛtiṃ draṣṭuṃ samāyayau ||8|| bhaktereva parīkṣāṃ hi kartuṃ tasya nṛpasya ca || dadarśa mithilāṃ kārṣṇiruddhavena samanvitaḥ ||9|| carmaśastradhṛtā vīrā mālātilakaśobhitāḥ || japantaḥ kṛṣṇanāmāni sarve vai yatra mālayā ||10|| likhitāni ca nāmāni dvāri dvāri harernṛṇām || tathā śrīkṛṣṇacitrāṇi likhitāni śubhāni ca ||11|| kuḍye kuḍye gṛhāṇāṃ ca gadāpadmāni mānada || daśāvatāracitrāṇi śaṃkhacakrāṇi yatra vai ||12|| tulasīmaṃdirāṇītthaṃ prāṅgaṇe ca gṛhe gṛhe || evaṃ paśyansa saudhāni mithilāyāṃ janān bahūn ||13|| mālātilakasaṃyuktān sarvānbhaktāndadarśa ha || tilakairdvādaśākhyaiśca yuktyaiḥ kuṃkumajairvṛtān ||14|| gopīcaṃdanamudrābhiścarcitāñchāṃtavigrahān || ūrdhvapuṃḍradharān viprān harimaṃdiracitritān ||15|| gadāṃ mudrāṃ lalāṭe ca ūrdhvaṃ vā harināmataḥ || cakraṃ śaṅkhaṃ ca kamalaṃ kūrmaṃ matsyaṃ bhujadvaye ||16|| dadhataśca dhanurbāṇaṃ mūrdhni śrīnaṃdakaṃ hṛdi || musalaṃ ca halaṃ rājannatha kārṣṇirdadaśa ha ||17|| yasyā vīthyāṃ bhāgavataṃ kecicchṛṇvaṃti mānavāḥ || itihāsaṃ bhārataṃ ca harivaṃśaṃ tathāpare ||18|| sanatkumāravāsiṣṭhayājñavalkyaparāśarāḥ || gargapaulastyadharmādisaṃhitāḥ ke paṭhaṃti vai ||19|| brāhmaṃ pādmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca śaivaṃ laiṃgaṃ sagāruḍam || nāradīyaṃ bhāgavatamāgneyaṃ skaṃdasaṃjñitam ||20|| bhaviṣyaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ savāmanam || vārāhamātsakaurmāṇi brahmāṇḍākhyaṃ tathaiva ca ||21|| vīthyāṃ vīthyāṃ sma śṛṇvanti janāḥ sarve gṛhe gṛhe || vālmīkikāvyaṃ kecidvai śrīrāmacaritāmṛtam ||22|| smṛtīḥ paṭhanti kecidvai kecidvedatrayīṃ dvijāḥ || kecitkurvaṃti yajñaṃ vai vaiṣṇavaṃ maṃgalāyanam ||23|| rādhākṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti ke vadanti muhurmuhuḥ || kecinnṛtyaṃti gāyaṃti harikīrtanatatparāḥ ||24|| mṛdaṃgatālavāditraiḥ kāṃsyavīṇāmanoharaiḥ || maṃdire maṃdire viṣṇoḥ kīrtanaṃ śrūyate janaiḥ ||25|| navalakṣaṇasaṃyuktāṃ bhaktiṃ yāṃ premalakṣaṇām || kurvaṃti maithilā rājan mithilāyāṃ gṛhe gṛhe ||26|| evaṃ tu nagarīṃ dṛṣṭvā pradyumno bhagavānhariḥ || rājadvāraṃ sametyāśu maithileśaṃ dadarśa ha ||27|| maithileśasabhāyāṃ tu vedavyāsaḥ śuko muniḥ || yājñavalkyo vasiṣṭhaśca gautamo'haṃ bṛhaspatiḥ ||28|| anye ca munayastatra vedamūrtidharā iva || dṛśyante dharmavaktāro hariniṣṭhā itastataḥ || 29|| maithileṃdro dhṛtistatra bhaktibhāvanatānanaḥ || balasya pādukāpūjāṃ kurute vidhivannṛpa ||30|| japanmuktikaraṃ nāma śrīkṛṣṇabaladevayoḥ || dṛṣṭvotthāya namaścakre saśiṣyaṃ brahmacāriṇam ||31|| taṃ pūjayitvā vidhivat pādyādyairmaithileśvaraḥ || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo rājā tadagre ca sthito'bhavat ||32|| janaka uvāca adya me sapalaṃ janma maṃdiraṃ viśadīkṛtam || devarṣipitaraḥ sarve saṃtuṣṭā āgate tvayi ||33|| nirvikalpāḥ samadṛśastvādṛśāḥ sādhavaḥ kṣitau || niḥśreyasāya bhagavandīnānāṃ vicaraṃti hi ||34|| brahmacāryuvāca dhanyo'si rājaśārdūla dhanyā te mithilāpurī || dhanyāḥ prajāśca te sarvā viṣṇubhaktisamanvitāḥ ||35|| janaka uvāca mameyaṃ nagarī nāsti na prajā na gṛhaṃ dhanam|| kalatraputrapautrādi sarvaṃ kṛṣṇasya caiva hi ||36|| paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam || asaṃkhyabrahmāṃḍapatirgoloke dhāmni rājate ||37|| vāsudevaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaḥ puruṣaḥ svayam || aniruddhastathā caikaścaturvyūho'bhavat kṣitau ||38|| kāyena manasā vācā buddhyā vāceṃdriyaiḥ kṛtam || tasmai samarpitaṃ śauklyaṃ mayā brahmanmahāmune ||39|| brahmacāryuvāca he vaideha mahābhāga viṣṇubhaktimatāṃ vara || tvadbhaktyā toṣitaḥ kṛṣṇastavaikatvaṃ pradāsyati ||40|| janaka uvāca dāso'haṃ kṛṣṇabhaktānāṃ tvādṛśānāṃ mahātmanām || muktiṃ necchāmi he brahmannekatāṃ hetuvarjitaḥ ||41|| brahmacāryuvāca karoṣyahaitukīṃ bhaktiṃ rājaṃstvaṃ hetuvarjitaḥ || nirguṇairbhaktibhāvaiśca premalakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥ ||42|| pradyumno bhagavānsākṣāddigjayārthaṃ vinirgataḥ || nāyātastava geheṣu saṃdeho me mahānabhūt ||43|| janaka uvāca pradyumno bhagavānsākṣādaṃtaryāmī hariḥ svayam || sarvagaḥ sarvavicchaśvadatra nāsti ca kiṃ prabho ||44|| brahmacāryuvāca jñānadṛṣṭyāpi cetkārṣṇiṃ manyase'tra niraṃtaram || tarhi darśaya taṃ devaṃ prahlāda iva divyadṛk ||45|| śrīnārada uvāca etacchrutvā tadā rājā mahābhāgavato dhṛtiḥ || aśrupūrṇamukho bhūtvā prāha gadgadayā girā ||46|| janaka uvāca yadi me śrīharerbhaktiranimittā kṛtā bhuvi || tarhi kārṣṇirhareḥ putraḥ prādurbhūyānmamāgrataḥ ||47|| yadi śrīkṛṣṇabhaktānāṃ dāso'haṃ yadi tatkṛpā || sarvatra yadi tadbhāvastarhi bhūyānmanorathaḥ ||48|| śrīnārada uvāca prādurbabhūvāśu tadaiva kārṣṇirvisṛjya sadyaḥ kila varṇarūpam || paśyatsu sarveṣu janeṣu śiṣyaḥ sa gadgado'bhūddharibhaktiniṣṭhaḥ ||49|| ghanaprabhaṃ padmadalāyatekṣaṇaṃ pralaṃbabāhuṃ jagatāṃ manoharam || pītāṃbaraṃ nīlaguḍālakālibhīḥ svalaṃkṛtaṃ śrīmukhapadmamaṃḍalam ||50|| śītartubālārkakirīṭakuṃḍalaṃ kācyaṃgadasphūrjitadivyavigraham || vilokya taṃ kṛṣṇasutaṃ kṛtāṃjalirnanāma sāṣṭāṃgamalaṃ dhṛtirnṛpaḥ ||51|| janaka uvāca aho'tidhanyaṃ mama bhūri bhāgyaṃ dattaṃ tvayā me nijadarśanaṃ hi || jāto'dya kāyādhavatulya ārādgṛhaṃ kṛtārtho'smi kulena bhūman ||52|| śrīpradyumna uvāca dhanyastvaṃ nṛpaśārdūla bhaktastvaṃ matprabhāvavit || bhaktibhāvaparīkṣārthaṃ prāpto'haṃ tava sāṃpratam ||53|| adyaiva mama sārūpyaṃ bhūyātte maithileśvara || balamāyuryaśaḥkīrtiriha loke bhavatvalam ||54|| śrīnārada uvāca tava pitrā ca dhṛtinā pūjitaḥ paśyatāṃ satām || prayayau śibirān rājan pradyumno bhaktavatsalaḥ ||55|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde janakopākhyānaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||16||
<7.17> śrīnārada uvāca athāto māgadhañjetuṃ pradyumno mīnaketanaḥ || girivrajaṃ jagāmāśu svasainyaiḥ parivāritaḥ ||1|| śrutvā''gataṃ hareḥ putraṃ digjayārthaṃ viśeṣataḥ || jarāsaṃdho māgadheṃdro mahākopaṃ cakāra ha ||2|| jarāsaṃdha uvāca tucchā ye yādavāḥ sarve yudhi viklavacetasaḥ || te'dya vai jagatīṃ jetuṃ nirgatā gatabuddhayaḥ ||3|| mathurāṃ svapurīṃ tyaktvā madbhayānmādhavo'pihi || samudraṃ śaraṇaṃ prāgātpitā cāsya durātmanaḥ ||4|| pravarṣaṇe rāmakṛṣṇau mayā bhasmīkṛtau balāt || chalāddudruvatustau dvau dvārakāyāṃ samāśritau ||5|| baddhvā tau cānayiṣyāmi sograsenau kuśasthalīm || ayādavīṃ kariṣyāmi pṛthvīṃ sāgaramekhalām ||6|| śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā nirgato rājā girivrajapurādbahiḥ || akṣauhiṇībhirviṃśatyā tisṛbhiḥ saṃyuto balī ||7|| gomūtracayasiṃdūrakastūrīpatrabhṛnmukhe || sravanmadaiścaturdaṃtairairāvatakulodbhavaiḥ ||8|| śuṇḍādaṇḍasya phūtkāraiḥ kṣepayadbhistarūnbahūn || babhau gajairmāgadheṃdro meghairiṃdra iva prabhuḥ ||9|| rathaiśca devadhiṣṇyābhaiḥ sadhvajairaśvanetṛbhiḥ || cāmarairdolitai rājaṃllolacakradhvanidyutiḥ ||10|| turaṅgamairvāyuvegaiścitravarṇairmadotkaṭaiḥ || sauvarṇapaṭṭahārādyaiḥ śikhāraśmyūrdhvacāmaraiḥ ||11|| sakaṃcukairvīrajanaiḥ khaḍgacarmadhanurdharaiḥ || vidyādharasamaiḥ prāgānmāgadheṃdro mahābalaḥ ||12|| dhuṃkārairduṃdubhīnāṃ ca diśo nedurdhanuḥsvanaiḥ || cacāla vasudhā sainyai rajobhiśchāditaṃ nabhaḥ ||13|| jarāsaṃdhasya tatsainyaṃ pralayābdhimivolbaṇam || vismitā yādavāḥ sarve babhūvurvīkṣya maithila ||14|| pradyumno bhagavānvīkṣya māgadheṃdrabalārṇavam || śaṃkhaṃ daghmau dakṣiṇākhyaṃ mā bhaiṣṭetyabhayaṃ dadat ||15|| tataḥ sāṃbo mahābāhuḥ pradyumnasya prapaśyataḥ || akṣauhiṇīnāṃ daśabhiryuyudhe māgadhena saḥ ||16|| gajā gajairyuyudhire rathibhī rathino mṛdhe || hayā hayaiḥ pattayaśca pattibhirmaithileśvara ||17|| babhūva tumulaṃ yuddhamadbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam || māgadhānāṃ yadūnāṃ cāsurāṇāṃ nirjarairyathā ||18|| aśvāruḍhāḥ ke'pi vīrā bhallahastā itastataḥ || mardayaṃto gajārūḍhāḥ karikumbhagatārcayaḥ ||19|| kecicchaktīstaḍidvarṇā gṛhītvā cikṣipurbalāt || tāḥ śaktayastvarīn bhitvā daṃśitān dharaṇīṃ gatāḥ ||20|| kecidvīrā nadantaḥ kau rathāṃgāni ca cikṣupuḥ || cicchidurvīrapaṭalaṃ nīhāraṃ ravayo yathā ||21|| bhiṃdipālairmudgaraiśca kuṭhārairasipaṭṭiśaiḥ || acchūrikārṣṭibhistīkṣṇairnistriṃśairyuyudhuśca khe ||22|| tomaraiśca gadabhiśca bāṇaiśchinnāni bhūtale || nipeturvīrakariṇāmaśvānāṃ ca śirāṃsi ca ||23|| kabaṃdhāstatra cotpetuḥ pātayanto hayānnarān || khaḍgahastāḥ pradhāvantaḥ saṃgrāmeṣu bhayaṃkarā ||24|| vīropari gatā vīrā nipetuśchinnabāhavaḥ || hayopari hayāḥ kecidbāṇaiḥ saṃchinnakaṃdharāḥ ||25|| vidyādharyaśca gaṃdharvyo vavrire hyaṃbare gatān || vīrānpatīnsamicchaṃtyastāsāṃ cābhūtkalirmahān ||26|| kṣātradharmāparāḥ kecidyuddhadattāsavo nṛpa || na calantaḥ padaṃ pṛṣṭhe sadā saṃgrāmaśālinaḥ ||27|| jagmuḥ paraṃ padaṃ te vai bhītvā mārtaṇḍamaṃḍalam || nanṛtuḥ śiśumāre vai maṃḍale ca naṭā iva ||28|| evaṃ sāṃbamahāvīrairmarditaṃ māgadhaṃ balam || dudrāva paśyatāṃ teṣāṃ kṛṣṇabhaktyā yathāśubham ||29|| kecidvai vṛkṇavarmāṇaśchinnacāpāstathāpare || palāyamānā dhāvaṃtastyaktakhaḍgarṣṭipāṇayaḥ ||30|| palāyamānaṃ svabalaṃ vīkṣya tanmāgadheśvaraḥ || dhanuṣṭaṃkārayanprāpto mā bhaiṣṭetyabhayaṃ dadau ||31|| svabalaṃ nodayāmāsa jarāsaṃdho dhanurjyayā || mahāmātyaḥ prerayati hyaṃkuśena gajaṃ yathā ||32|| sāṃbastadaiva samprāpto daśabhiścāpanirgataiḥ || bāṇairvivyādha samare māgadheṃdraṃ mahābalam ||33|| dhanurjyāmabdhikallolabhīmasaṃgharṣanādinīm || ciccheda daśabhirbāṇaiḥ sāṃbo jāṃbavīsutaḥ ||34|| dhanuranyatsamādāya jarāsaṃdho mahābalaḥ || dhanuḥ sāṃbasya ciccheda bāṇairdaśabhiragrataḥ ||35|| caturbhiścaturo vāhāndvābhyāṃ ketuṃ rathaṃ tribhiḥ || ekena sārathiṃ jaghne māgadheṃdro jarāsutaḥ ||36|| sa chinnadhanvā viratho hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ || punaranyaṃ samāsthāya rathaṃ sāṃbo mahābalaḥ ||37|| gṛhītvā cāpamatyugraṃ sajjaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || tadrathaṃ cūrṇayāmāsa sāṃbo bāṇaśatairapi ||38|| rathaṃ tyaktvā jarāsaṃdho gajamāruhya vegataḥ || babhau gaje māgadheṃdra indra airāvate yathā ||39|| citrapatravicitrāṃgaṃ kālāṃtakayamopamam || sāṃbāya nodayamāsa mattebhaṃ kruddhamānasaḥ ||40|| gṛhītvā sarathaṃ sāṃbaṃ śuṇḍādaṇḍena nāgarāṭ || kurvaṃścītkāravikalaścikṣepa navayojanam ||41|| tadā kolāhale jāte sāṃbasenāsu maithila || pradyumnapārśvācca gadaḥ prāpto'bhūdvegato balam ||42|| vināśayannaṃdhakāraṃ yathārka udayācalāt || jarāsaṃdhasyāpi gajaṃ muṣṭinā vasudevajaḥ ||43|| jaghāna śakro vajreṇa yathā proccadarībhṛtam || gajo muṣṭiprahāreṇa vihvalo dharaṇīṃ gataḥ ||44|| jagāma pañcatāṃ rājaṃstadadbhutamivāvabhavat || jarāsaṃdhaḥ samutthāya gadāmādāya vegataḥ ||45|| gadaṃ tatāḍa sahasā jagarja ghanavadbalī || tatprahāreṇa sa gado na cacāla raṇāṃgaṇāt ||46|| tvaraṃ gadāṃ samādāya lakṣabhāravinirmitām || atāḍayajjarāsaṃdhaṃ siṃhanādamathākarot ||47|| tatprahāreṇa vyathito bṛhadrathasuto balī || jarāsaṃdhaḥ samutthāya gṛhitvā sagadaṃ gadam ||48|| cikṣepa roṣato rājannākāśe śatayojanam || gado'pi māgadhaṃ nītvā bhrāmayitvā mahābalaḥ ||49|| cikṣepa gagane taṃ vai yojanānāṃ sahasrakam || ākāśātpatito rājā māgadho viṃdhyaparvate ||50|| utthāya yuyudhe tena gadenāpi mahābalaḥ || tadaiva sāṃbaḥ saṃprāpto gṛhītvā māgadheśvaram ||51|| bhūpṛṣṭhe pothayāmāsa siṃhaḥ siṃhamivaujasā || ekena muṣṭinā sāṃbaṃ dvitīyena gadaṃ tathā 52|| tatāḍa māgadho rājā jagarjāśu raṇāṃgaṇe || muṣṭiprahāravyathitau gadaḥ sāṃbaśca mūrchitau ||53|| hāhākāro mahānāsīttadaivāśu raṇāṃgaṇe || rathenātipatākena pradyumno yādaveśvaraḥ ||54|| akṣauhiṇīyutaḥ prāpto mā bhaiṣṭetyabhayaṃ dadau || jarāsaṃdho gadāṃ nītvā lakṣabhāravinirmitām ||55|| viveśa yadusenāyāmaraṇye'gniriva prabhuḥ || rathāngajansavīrāṃśca turaṅgānsaiṃdhavānbahūn ||56|| pātayamāsa rājeṃdra padmānīva mahāgajaḥ || jarāsaṃdhasya yā senā sāpi sarvā samāgatā ||57|| jaghāna niśitairbāṇairyadūnāṃ sarvato balam || pradyumno yuyudhe yuddhe nirbhayo yādaveśvaraḥ ||58|| nipātayannarīnbāṇairdhanuṣṭaṅkārayanmuhuḥ || tadaiva yadupuryāstu baladevaḥ samāgataḥ ||59|| prādurbabhūva tatrāpi sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ satām || samākṛṣya halāgreṇa māgadheṃdraṃ mahābalam ||60|| musalenāhanatkruddho baladevo mahābalaḥ || śatayojanaparyaṃtaṃ rathāśvagajapattayaḥ ||61|| patitā bhinnaśirasaḥ sarve vai nidhanaṃ gatāḥ || devaduṃdubhayo nedurnaradundubhayastathā ||62|| baladevopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakire || tadā jayajayārāvo yadūnāṃ svabale mahān ||63|| pradyumnādyāstato nemuḥ kāmapālaṃ gatavyathāḥ || itthaṃ jitvā māgadhendraṃ baladevo mahābalaḥ ||64|| prayayau dvārakāṃ rājanbhagavānbhaktavatsalaḥ || jarāsaṃdhasuto dhīmān sahadeva upāyanam ||65|| nītvā puraḥ śaṃbarārergiridurgādvinirgataḥ || aśvārbudaṃ rathānāṃ ca dvilakṣaṃ hastināṃ tathā ||66|| dadau ṣaṣṭisahasraṇi natvā kārṣṇiṃ prabhāvavit ||67|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde māgadhavijayo nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||17||
<7.18> śrīnārada uvāca atha kārṣṇirgayāmetya phalguṃ snātvā sasainikaḥ || anyāndeśāṃstato jetuṃ prasthānamakarotpunaḥ ||1|| śrutvā jitaṃ jarāsaṃdhaṃ tadātaṃkānnṛpāḥ pare || upāyanaṃ daduste vai bhayārtāḥ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ||2|| gomatīṃ sarayūṃ puṇyāmanusrotaṃ tato'gamat || tato bhāgīrathītīre kāśīmabhijagāma ha ||3|| pārṣṇigrāhaḥ kāśirājo gṛhīto mṛgayāṃ gataḥ || so'pi tasmai baliṃ prādācchrutvā tasya balaṃ mahat ||4|| pradyumnaḥ sainikaiḥ sārddhaṃ kośalānpragato balī || ayodhyānikaṭe rājannaṃdigrāme sthito'bhavat ||5|| kośalendro nagnajicca turaṃgaiśca gajai rathaiḥ || mahādhanaiḥ śaṃbarārimarhayāmāsa tattvavit ||6|| uttareśo dīpatamo nayapālādhipo gajaḥ || viśāleśo barhiṇaśca ete vai taṃ baliṃ daduḥ ||7|| naimiṣeśo harerbhaktaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya prabhāvavit || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā dadau tasmai baliṃ nṛpaḥ ||8|| prayāgaṃ gatavānkārṣṇistriveṇīṃ pāpanāśinīm || snātvā dadau mahādānaṃ tīrtharājaprabhāvavit ||9|| gajā viṃśatisāhasramaśvānāṃ daśalakṣakam || rathānāṃ ca caturlakṣaṃ gavāṃ tatra daśārbudam ||10|| hemamālāsamāyuktaṃ hemāṃbarasamanvitam || daśabhāraṃ suvarṇānāṃ muktānāṃ lakṣameva hi ||11|| dvilakṣaṃ navaratnānāṃ vastrāṇāṃ daśalakṣakam || kāśmīrakaṃbalānāṃ ca dvilakṣaṃ navakaṃbalam ||12|| brāhmaṇebhyo dadau kārṣṇistīrtharāje haripriye || kārūṣādhipatistatra pauṃḍrako nāma maithila ||13|| kṛṣṇaśatruḥ so'pi kārṣṇiṃ pūjayāmāsa śaṃkitaḥ || pradyumnaṃ cāgataṃ vīkṣya pāṃcāle kānyakubjake ||14|| bhayaṃ prāpurnṛpāḥ sarve durge durge kṛtārgalāḥ || viceluryādavātsarve bhayārtā durgamāśritāḥ ||15|| biṃdudeśādhipo rājā dīrghabāhurmahābalaḥ || śaṃbarāreḥ paraṃ sandhiṃ kartuṃ sainye samāyayau ||16|| dīrghabāhuruvāca yūyaṃ sarve yādavendrā āgatā jayino diśām || manorathaṃ me kurutāṃ bhaveyaṃ tuṣṭamānasaḥ ||17|| sajalasyāpi kācasya pātrasya śaravedhataḥ || na kṣaredbiṃdureko'pi bāṇastadadhitiṣṭhati ||18|| na pātraṃ śakalībhūtaṃ tanmadhye hastalāghavam || ye kurvaṃti pratijñāṃ me tebhyo dāsyāmi kanyakāḥ ||19|| yūyaṃ sarve yādavendrā dhanurvedaviśāradāḥ || mayāpi nāradamukhācchrutā pūrvaṃ mahābalāḥ ||20|| sarveṣāṃ vismitānāṃ ca pradyumno dhanvināṃ varaḥ || tathetyuvāca sadasi biṃdudeśādhipaṃ nṛpa ||21|| dīrghavaṃśau suvisthāpya guṇaṃ baddhvā tadantare || guṇe baddhvā kācakumbhaṃ sajalaṃ paśyatāṃ satām ||22|| dhanurgṛhītvā tadvīkṣya bāṇaṃ kārṣṇiḥ samādadhe || kācapātraṃ śaro bhitvā tasthau madhye'rddhaniḥsṛtaḥ ||23|| ekato mukhapuṅkhābhyāṃ raviraśmirivāṃbude || kācapātre babhau bāṇastadadbhutamivābhavat ||24|| na pātraṃ śakalībhūtaṃ trikuśasya phalaṃ yathā || na cālanaṃ kaṃpanaṃ ca biṃdusrāvo'pi nābhavat ||25|| pradyumno bhagavānbāṇaṃ dvitīyaṃ saṃdadhe punaḥ || so'pi pūrvaṃ samutsṛjya tatra tasthau videharāṭ ||26|| sāṃbo'pi dhanurādāya bāṇānpaṃca samādade || kācapātraṃ ca te bhitvā tasthustatrārdhaniḥsṛtāḥ ||27|| yuyudhāno dhanurnītvā bāṇamekaṃ samākṣipat || sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ teṣāṃ pātraṃ cūrṇībabhūva ha ||28|| uccakairjahasuḥ sarve yādavāḥ parasainikāḥ || tvaṃ mahānbāṇadhārīha kārtavīryārjuno yathā ||29|| arjuno bharato rāmastripuraghno hi vā bhavān || droṇo bhīṣmo'thavā karṇo jāmadagnya ivābhavat ||30|| anyatpātraṃ samādhāyāniruddho dhanvināṃ varaḥ || adho gatvā'tha taddṛṣṭvā bāṇaṃ cikṣepa lāghavāt ||31|| so'pi pātratalaṃ bhitvā tasthau tatrāpi niḥsṛtaḥ || tatpātrāddhastapañcordhvaṃ baddhvā pāṣāṇamaṃbare ||32|| dīptimān dhanurādāya bāṇamekaṃ samādadhe || so'pi pātratalaṃ bhitvā bāṇamutsṛjya cāgrataḥ ||33|| tāḍayitvā ca pāṣāṇaṃ punastatra samāśritaḥ || bāṇavegena tadapi biṃdusrāvo'pi nābhavat ||34|| gatāgatena yāvadvai biṃdusrāvo'pi nābhavat || tadā vīrāśca te sarve sādhu sādhviti vādinaḥ ||35|| bhānurdhanuḥ saṃgṛhītvā vīkṣya mīlitalocanaḥ || ārāccikṣepa nārācaṃ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ satām ||36|| so'pi pātraṃ tadā bhīttvā pātraṃ kṛtvā hyadhomukham || punarūrdhvamukhaṃ kṛtvā tasthau tatrārddhaniḥsṛtaḥ ||37|| bāṇavegena tadapi biṃdusrāvo'pi nābhavat || na pātraṃ śakalībhūtaṃ tadadbhutamivābhavat ||38|| evaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaputrā ye aṣṭādaśa mahārathāḥ || sarve te bibhiduḥ pātraṃ jalasrāvo'pi nābhavat ||39|| biṃdudeśādhipo rājā dīrghabāhuḥ suvismitaḥ || tebhyo'dātkanyakāḥ sṛṣṭā aṣṭādaśa sulocanāḥ ||40|| teṣāṃ vivāhasamaye śaṃkhabheryānakādayaḥ || nedurjaguśca gaṃdharvā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ ||41|| teṣāmupari devāste jayadhvanisamākulāḥ || vavṛṣuḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi cakruḥ ślāghāṃ divī sthitāḥ ||42|| gajānṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi hayānāmarbudaṃ tathā || daśalakṣaṃ rathānāṃ ca dāsīnāṃ lakṣameva ca ||43|| śibikānāṃ caturlakṣaṃ pāribarhe dadau nṛpaḥ || tāḥ prāhiṇoddvārāvatīṃ babhau karṣṇiryadūttamaḥ ||44|| dīrghabāhumanuprāpya niṣadhānprayayau tataḥ || niṣadhādhipatirvīrasenajinnāma maithila ||45|| upāyanaṃ dadau so'pi pradyumnāya mahātmane || tathāhi bhadrādhipatiḥ śrīkṛṣṇeṣṭo haripriyaḥ ||46|| pūjayāmāsa sabalaṃ bṛhatseno hareḥ sutam || māthurānśūrasenāṃśca madhūnprāptaḥ sasainikaḥ ||47|| svāgataiḥ pūjitaḥ kārṣṇirmathurāyāṃ yayau punaḥ || tataḥ pradakṣiṇikṛtya mathurāṃ savanāṃ kila ||48|| gopāngopīṃ yaśodāṃ ca nandarājaṃ vrajeśvaram || vṛṣabhānūpanaṃdāṃśca natvā kārṣṇirbabhau nṛpa ||49|| baliṃ ca naṃdarājāya datvā datvā punaḥ punaḥ || tai pūjitaḥ katidinaiḥ sthito'bhūnnaṃdagokule ||50|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde māthuraśūrasenadeśavijayo nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||18||
<7.19> śrīnārada uvāca atha kārṣṇirmahābāhurdhvajinībhiḥ samanvitaḥ || nādayanduṃdubhīndīrghāndīrghavegaḥ kurūn yayau ||1|| viṃśatiryojanānāṃ ca maryādīkṛtatadbale || tasthau tacchibirāṇāṃ ca vistāro daśayojanam ||2|| paṃcayojanamāśritya tadbale rājapaddhatiḥ || dhanāḍhyānāṃ ca vaiśyānāmāpaṇāni sahasraśaḥ ||3|| tathā ratnaparīkṣāṇāṃ vastravyāpārakāriṇām || kācakarā vāyakāśca raṃgakārāḥ kulālakāḥ ||4|| kuṃdakārāstūlakārāḥ paṭakārāstathaiva ca || ṭaṃkakārāścitrakārāḥ patrakārāśca nāpitāḥ ||5|| paṭṭakārā retikārāḥ parṇakārāśca śilpinaḥ || lākṣākārā mālinaśca rajakāstailinastathā ||6|| tāṃbūlaśodhinastatra citrapāṣāṇakarmakāḥ || annabharjakarāstatra kācabhedina eva hi ||7|| muktādīnāṃ ca ratnānāṃ sūkṣmāṇāṃ ratnavedhinaḥ || ete kārujanāḥ sarve dṛśyaṃte rājapaddhatau ||8|| kvacidbhānumatīrlīlā aiṃdrajālavidhāyakāḥ || kvacinnaṭāśca nṛtyaṃte yuddhaṃ bhallūkayoḥ kvacit ||9|| kvacittu vānarī līlā ḍamarūvādyasaṃyutāḥ || gāyaṃti kutracidrājansūtamāgadhavandinaḥ ||10|| vārāṃganāśca nṛtyaṃti bhūṣairdvādaśabhiryutāḥ || divyaiḥ ṣoḍaśaśṛṅgārairharaṃtyapsarasāṃ manaḥ ||11|| bandhūnāmapi senānāṃ mahāṃtakā gajāhvaye || cālanaṃ saṃbhramopetaṃ vihvalaiśca janairabhūt ||12|| vidudruvurjanāḥ sarve gṛheṣvāpātitārgalāḥ || kolāhalo mahānāsīdgehe gehe jane jane ||13|| vīryyaśauryyabalopetāḥ kauravāścakravartinaḥ || āsamudrāḥ kṣitīśeṃdrā jātāste'pyatiśaṃkitāḥ ||14|| pradyumnapreṣitaḥ sākṣāduddhavo buddhisattamaḥ || kauraveṃdrapuraṃ prāpto dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ dadarśa ha ||15|| madacyutāmāsya nṛpasya daṃtināṃ kastūrikākuṃkumagaṃḍaśālinām || siṃdūraśuṃḍāspadakarṇatāḍitaiḥ ṣaḍaṅghribhirmaṇḍitamaṃdirājiram ||16|| yaṃ bhīṣmakarṇaguruśalyakṛpaiśca bhūribāhlīkadhaumyaśakunaiḥ saha saṃjayena || duḥśāsanena vidureṇa ca lakṣmaṇena duryodhanena ca kṛpīsutasomadattaiḥ ||17|| śrīyajñaketusahitaiḥ sahitaṃ nṛpendraṃ līlātapatrasitacāmarahemapīṭhaiḥ || saṃsevitaṃ parisametya gajāhvayeśaṃ natvoddhavaḥ praṇata āha kṛtāṃjalistam ||18|| uddhava uvāca pradyumnena prakathitaṃ śṛṇu rājeṃdrasattama || ugrasenaḥ kṣitīśeṃdro yādaveṃdro mahābalaḥ ||19|| vijitya nṛpatīnsarvān rājasūyaṃ kariṣyati || preṣitastena senābhiḥ pradyumno rukmiṇīsutaḥ ||20|| jetuṃ mahodbhaṭān vīrāñjaṃbudvīpasthitānnṛpān || caidyaśālvajarāsaṃdhadaṃtavaktrādibhūpatīn ||21|| vijitya cāgataḥ kārṣṇistasmai yaccha baliṃ bahu || upāyanaṃ ca dātavyaṃ baṃdhūnāmaikyakāmyayā ||22|| mābhūtkurūṇāṃ vṛṣṇīnāṃ kalirnocedbhaviṣyati || tenoditaṃ me kathitaṃ tatkṣamasva nṛpeśvara || dūtasya hīnadoṣasya tvayoktaṃ yadvadāmi tat ||23|| śrīnārada uvāca tacchrutvā kauravāḥ sarve rājansaṃjātamanyavaḥ || vīryyaśauryyamadonnaddhā ūcuḥ prasphuritādharāḥ ||24|| kauravā ūcuḥ duratyayā kālagatiraho citramidaṃ jagat || siṃhopari pradhāvaṃti śṛgālā durbalā vane ||25|| asmatsakāśātsaṃbaṃdhā asmaddattanṛpāsanāḥ || dātṝṇāṃ pratikūlāstu dātṝṇāṃ phaṇīno yathā ||26|| vṛṣṇayo bhīravaḥ sarve yudhi viklavacetasaḥ || tathaiva śāsanaṃ kartuṃ pravṛttā hi gatahriyaḥ ||27|| ugraseno'lpavīryaśca jaṃbūdvīpasthitānnṛpān || vijityāho baliṃ nītvā rājasūyaṃ kariṣyati ||28|| yatra bhīṣmaśca karṇaśca droṇo duryodhanādayaḥ || tatra tvaṃ preṣito maṃtrī pradyumnena kubuddhinā ||29|| tasmādyāta purīmadhye yūyaṃ vai jīvanecchayā || na cedyāsyatha vaḥ sarvānnayāmo yamasādanam ||30|| śrīnārada uvāca itthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavimukhaiḥ kauravaiḥ paribhāṣitam || śrutvoddhavaḥ śambarārimetya sarvamuvāca ha ||31|| kauravoktaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā pradyumno dhanvināṃ varaḥ || pratiśārṅgaṃ saṃgṛhītvā roṣātprasphuritādharaḥ ||32|| pradyumna uvāca kauravānghātayiṣyāmi baṃdhūnapi madoddhatān || bāṇaistīkṣṇairyathā yogī niyamairdehajā rujaḥ ||33|| yadūnāṃ sainyacakreṣu baliṃ yo na pradāsyati || kauravebhyo'pi sa pumān piturmāturna caurasaḥ ||34|| śrīnārada uvāca tadaiva yādavāḥ sarve bhojavṛṣṇyaṃdhakādayaḥ || gajāhvayaṃ yayuḥ sainyai rājansaṃjātamanyavaḥ ||35|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde kauravopākhyānaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||19||
<7.20> śrīnārada uvāca tadaiva kauravāḥ sarve nirgatā dīptamanyavaḥ || svaiḥ svairbalaiḥ samāyuktā yoddhuṃ pradyumnasaṃmukhe ||1|| vijayadhvajasaṃyuktā ratnakaṃbalamaṇḍitāḥ || gajāḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi niryayuḥ svarṇaśṛṃkhalāḥ ||2|| pralayābdhimahāvartasaṃgharṣadhvanikāriṇām || gajāḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi duṃdubhīnāṃ vinirgatāḥ ||3|| gajā gāvo bṛhadbhallā lohakaṃcukamaṃḍitāḥ || śirasraṅmaulisaṃyuktā dvilakṣāṇi viniryayuḥ ||4|| hemakaṃkaṇakeyūrakirīṭavarakuṃḍalāḥ || gajasthāśca dvilakṣāṇi niryayuḥ svarṇakaṃcukāḥ ||5|| pītakaṃcukasaṃyuktāstiryaguṣṇīṣaśālinaḥ || gajasthāśca dvilakṣāṇi saṃgrāme labdhakīrtayaḥ ||6|| raktāṃbaradharāḥ kecidraktabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ || raktakaṃbalasaṃyuktairgajairuccairvinirgatāḥ ||7|| kṛṣṇāṃbaradharā nāgairharidvastrasamāvṛtāḥ || kecicchuklāṃbarāḥ kecinniryayuḥ pāṭalāṃbarāḥ ||8|| rathaiśca devadhiṣṇyābhairmṛgeṃdradhvajaśobhitaiḥ || patatpatākairatyuccairniryayuḥ koṭiśo nṛpāḥ ||9|| āṃgairbāṃgaiḥ saiṃdhavaiśca caṃcalaisturagairnṛpāḥ || manojavaiḥ svarṇabhūṣairniryayuḥ śastrasaṃvṛtāḥ ||10|| samaṃtānniryayurvīrā lohakaṃcukaṇḍītāḥ || vidyādharasamā rājansaṃkulā yuddhaśālinaḥ ||11|| jaguryaśaḥ kauravāṇāṃ sūtamāgadhavandinaḥ || bherīmṛdaṃgaiḥ paṭahairānakairyuddhaniḥsvanaiḥ ||12|| mṛgendradhvajasaṃyuktaiḥ śuklavāhaniyojitaiḥ || vyajanairvajradaṇḍaiśca cāmarāṃdolarājitaiḥ ||13|| caturyojanamātreṇa caṃdramaṇḍalacāruṇā || chatreṇa maṇḍite rājabhirdattena manohare ||14|| duryodhano babhau sainye mahati syaṃdane sthitaḥ || tathā'nye dhārtarāṣṭrāśca syandane syandane sthitāḥ ||15|| caturyojanamātraiśca chatrairmuktāvilaṃbibhiḥ || surathenātibhīṣmeṇa kṛpeṇa guruṇā saha ||16|| bāhlīkakarṇaśalyaiśca somadattena dhīmatā || aśvatthāmnā ca dhaumyena lakṣmaṇena dhanuṣmatā ||17|| śakuninā ca vīreṇa tathā duḥśāsanena ca || saṃjayena tathā sākṣādbhūriṇā yajñaketunā ||18|| suyodhano nṛpo reje yathā śakro marudgaṇaiḥ || indraprasthātpāṃḍuputraiḥ preṣitaṃ pṛtanādvayam ||19|| tadaiva cāgataṃ rājan kauravāṇāṃ sahāyakṛt || akṣauhiṇībhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ kurūṇāṃ calatāṃ tadā ||20|| cacāla bhūrdiśo nedū rajovyāptaṃ nabho'bhavat || tārakeva babhau sūryo gajāśvarathareṇūbhiḥ ||21|| aṃdhakāro'bhavadbhūmau devāḥ sarve'pi śaṃkitāḥ || yatra tatra gajānāṃ ca nodanābhiśca bhūruhāḥ ||22|| nipetusturagairvīraiḥ kṣaṇaṃ bhūkhaṇḍamaṇḍalam || senā kurūṇāṃ vṛṣṇīnāṃ yuyudhuśca parasparam ||23|| tīkṣṇaiḥ śastrairyathā sapta samudrāstaralairlaye || hayā hayairibhāścebhai rathino rathibhiḥ saha ||24|| śyenaiḥ śyenā iva kravye pattayaḥ pattibhirmṛdhe || mahāmātyairmahāmātyāḥ sūtāḥ sūtairnṛpairnṛpāḥ ||25|| yuyudhuḥ krodhasaṃyuktāḥ siṃhaiḥ siṃhā ivaujasā || khaḍgaiḥ kuṃtaiḥ śaktibhiśca bhallaiḥ paṭṭiśamudgaraiḥ ||26|| gadābhirmusalaiścakraistomarairbhiṃdipālakaiḥ || śataghnībhirbhuśuṇḍībhiḥ kuṭhāraiśca sphuratprabhaiḥ ||27|| cicchidurbāṇapaṭalaiḥ śirāṃsi krodhamūrcchitāḥ || bāṇāṃdhakāre saṃjāte pradyumno dhanvināṃ varaḥ ||28|| duryodhanena yuyudhe dhanuṣṭaṃkārayanmuhuḥ || aniruddhaśca bhīṣmeṇa dīptimāṃśca kṛpeṇa vai ||29|| bhānurdroṇena sāṃbāstu bāhlīkena nṛpeśvaraḥ || madhuḥ karṇena cāyudhyadbṛhadbhānuḥ śalena vai ||30|| citrabhānurhareḥ putraḥ somadattena dhīmatā || aśvatthāmnā vṛkaścaivāruṇo dhaumyena maithila ||31|| puṣkaro
