lakṣmaṇenāśu duryodhanasutena vai || vedabāhuḥ kṛṣṇasutaḥ śakunena mahāmṛdhe ||32|| duḥśāsanena samare śrutadevo hareḥ sutaḥ || tathā hi yuyudhe yuddhe saṃjayena sunaṃdanaḥ ||33|| vidureṇa gadaḥ sākṣātkṛtavarmā ca bhūriṇā || akrūro yuyudhe rājannāhave yajñaketunā ||34|| evaṃ parasparaṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva tumulaṃ mahat || kārṣṇirvilokayāmāsa duryodhanabalaṃ mahat ||35|| bāṇasaṃdhena vārāho daṃṣṭrayā ca yathārṇavam || bāṇasaṃbhinnakumbhānāṃ kariṇāṃ prapataṃti khāt ||36|| muktāphalāni rejuḥ kau rātrau tārāgaṇā iva || bāṇaiḥ saṃpātayāmāsū rathinaḥ sārathīn rathān ||37|| mahāmṛdhe maithileṃdra vegairvāto yathā tarūn || duryodhanastadā prāpto dhanuṣṭaṃkārayanmuhuḥ ||38|| pradyumnaṃ tāḍayāmāsa sāyakairdaśabhirmṛdhe || tānpraciccheda bhagavān pradyumno yādaveśvaraḥ ||39|| duryodhanaḥ punastasya kavace sāyakān daśa || nicakhāna svarṇapuṃkhān bhitvā varma tanau gatāḥ ||40|| sahasrairbāṇapaṭalaiḥ sahasrāśvāñjaghāna ha || ciccheda bāṇaśatakaiḥ kodaṇḍaṃ saguṇaṃ param ||41|| śaṃbarārermahāvīro dhṛtarāṣṭrasuto balī || pradyumnastaṃ rathaṃ tyaktvāthānyamāruhya satvaram ||52|| kṛṣṇadattaṃ dhanurnītvā sajjaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || ekaṃ bāṇaṃ samādhāya karṇāṃtaṃ tañcakarṣa ha ||43|| bhujadaṇḍasya vegena tadrathe nicakarṣa ha || gṛhītvā tadrathaṃ bāṇo bhrāmayitvā ghaṭīdvayam ||44|| ākāśātpātayāmāsa kamaṇḍalumivārbhakaḥ | patanena rathaḥ sadyaścūrṇībhūto babhūva ha ||45|| sasūtāśca hayāḥ sarve pañcatāṃ prāpuragrataḥ || anyaṃ rathaṃ samāsthāya dhārtarāṣṭro mahābalaḥ ||46|| pradyumnaṃ tāḍayāmāsa daśabhiḥ sāyakaimṛdhe || taistāḍito hareḥ putro mālāhata iva dvipaḥ ||47|| kṛṣṇadatte ca kodaṇde tathaikaṃ bāṇamādadhe || bāṇastaṃ sarathaṃ nītvā yāvatprāgānmahāṃbare ||48|| tāvadbāṇo dvitīyo'pi taṃ gṛhītvā yayau tvaram || tāvattṛtīyaḥ saṃprāpto nītvā taṃ maṃdirājire ||49|| dhṛtarāṣṭrasamīpe ca sarathaṃ sāśvasārathim || ākāśātpātayāmāsa padmakośamivānilaḥ ||50|| bāṇastaṃ pātayitvā tu raṇe kārṣṇiṃ samāyayau ||51|| patanena viśīrṇo'bhūdaṃgāra iva tadrathaḥ || suyodhano mūrcchito'bhūdudvaman rudhiraṃ mukhāt ||52|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde kauravayuddhavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||20||
<7.21> śrīnārada uvāca duryodhane gate tatra hāhākāro mahānabhūt || tadā devavrato bhīṣmo gāṃgeyaḥ prayayau tvaram ||1|| yadūnāṃ paśyatāṃ teṣāṃ dhanuṣṭaṅkārayanmuhuḥ || bhasmīkartuṃ yadubalaṃ vanaṃ vahniriva jvalan ||2|| sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭho mahābhāgavataḥ kaviḥ || vīrayūthāgraṇīryena rāmo'pi yudhi toṣitaḥ ||3|| śirastrī mukuṭī gauraḥ sitaśmaśruḥ pitāmahaḥ || yathā ṣoḍaśavarṣīyo yuddhāntaṃ vicaranbalāt ||4|| bāṇairnipātayāmāsāniruddhasya balaṃ mahat || kariṇaśchinnaśiraso hayāste bhinnakaṃdharāḥ ||5|| khaḍgahastā bhinnabāṇaiḥ pattayo'pi dvidhābhavan || rathāścūrṇīkṛtā yena hatasūtāśvanāyakāḥ ||6|| adhomukhā ūrdhvamukhāśchinnapādā nṛpātmajāḥ || khaḍgahastadhanurhastāḥ patitāśchinnabāhavaḥ ||7|| kecidvai chinnakavacā nipeturbhūmimaṇḍale || aśvairvīrairrathairnāgaiḥ patitaiḥ svarṇabhūṣitaiḥ ||8|| yuddhamaṇḍalamāreje vanaṃ vṛkṣairhatairyathā || śastradaṃtā bāṇakeśā dhvajavastrā karistanā ||9|| rathāṃgakuśalā rājanmahāmārīva bhūrbabhau || kṣatajasrāvasaṃbhūtā rathāśvanaravāhinī ||10|| āpagābhūnmahādurgā narairvaitaraṇī yathā || kūṣmāṇḍonmādavetālā nadanto bhairavaṃ svanam ||11|| haramālārthamāgatya jagṛhurnṛśirāṃsi ca || rathenātipatākenāniruddho dhanvināṃ varaḥ ||12|| svabalaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā prāgādbhīṣmaṃ mṛdhe mahān || pralayābdhimahāvartabhīmasaṃgharṣanādinīm ||13|| dhanurjyāṃ tasya ciccheda bāṇenaikena kārṣṇijaḥ || tuṇḍayā tīkṣṇayā rājan garuḍaḥ sarpiṇīṃ yathā ||14|| bhīṣmo'nyaddhanurādāya sajjaṃ kṛtvā tadātmavān || sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ tatra brahmāstraṃ saṃdadhe mṛdhe ||15|| tataḥ prāduṣkṛtaṃ tejaḥ pracaṇḍaṃ vīkṣya mādhavaḥ || svabalasyāpi rakṣārthaṃ brahmāstraṃ saṃdadhe svayam ||16|| dvādaśādityasaṃkāśe yuyudhāte parasparam || trīṃllokāndahatī dvīpe'niruddhastaṃ jahāra ha ||17|| gāṃgeyasyāpi kodaṇḍaṃ taḍidvarṇaṃ yadūttamaḥ || ciccheda sāyakaiḥ sūryo nīhāramīva raśmibhiḥ ||18|| bhīṣmo gṛhītvātha gadāṃ lakṣabhāramayīṃ dṛḍhām || prāhiṇodaniruddhāya siṃhanādaṃ tadākarot ||19|| gṛhītvā vāmahastena garutmāniva pannagīm || pradyumno bhagavānsākṣātprāhiṇotsvagadāṃ hṛdi ||20|| gadāprahāravyathito mūrcchitaḥ patito rathāt || babhau sūryo yathā''kāśādgāṃgeyo mṛdhamaṇḍale ||21|| kṛpācāryo'pi tatraivāniruddhāya mahātmane || śaktiṃ cikṣepa sahasā ruṣā prasphuritādharaḥ ||22|| dīptimānkṛṣṇaputrastu pathi ciccheda tāṃ nṛpa || khaḍgena śitadhāreṇa kuvākyeneva mitratām ||23|| droṇācāryo mahābāhurbhānūpari ruṣānvitaḥ || cikṣepa pārvataṃ cāstraṃ dhanuṣṭaṅkārayanmuhuḥ ||24|| pataṃtaḥ parvatā vyomnaścūrṇayaṃto dviṣadbalam || teṣāṃ pātena rājendra hāhākāro mahānabhūt ||25|| tadā hareḥ suto bhānurvāyavyāstraṃ samādadhe || tadvātenādrayaḥ sarve uḍḍītā hyabhavan raṇāt ||26|| bāhlīkastu tadā kruddho vahnyastraṃ saṃdadhe tataḥ || bhasmībhūtaṃ balaṃ jātaṃ vahnineva mahadvanam ||27|| pārjanyamādade tatra sāmbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ || tena śāṃtiṃ gato vahnirjñāneneva tvahaṃkṛtiḥ ||28|| karṇastato madhuṃ hitvā sāmbopari ruṣānvitaḥ || jaghāna bāṇaviṃśatyā jagarja ghanavadbalī ||29|| tadbāṇaiḥ sarathaḥ sāṃbo babhrāma ghaṭikādvayam || krośaṃ punaḥ prapatitaḥ kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ ||30|| punargadāṃ samādāya rathaṃ tyaktvā sametya saḥ || tatāḍa gadayā karṇaṃ sāṃbo jāṃbavīsutaḥ ||31|| gadāprahāravyathitaḥ patito dharaṇītale || mūrcchāṃ prāpa raṇe rājankarṇo vīro mahābalaḥ ||32|| sāmbo'pi svadhanurnītvā rathamāruhya vegataḥ || śalaṃ jaghāna viṃśatyā somadattaṃ ca paṃcabhiḥ ||33|| drauṇiṃ ca daśabhirbāṇairdhaumyaṃ ṣoḍaśabhistathā || lakṣmaṇaṃ daśabhistatra śakuniṃ pañcabhistathā ||34|| duḥśāsanaṃ ca viṃśatyā viṃśatyā saṃjayaṃ pṛthak || bhūriṃ bāṇaśatai rājanyajñaketuṃ śataiḥ śitaiḥ ||35|| bāṇairjaghāna samare jagarja ghanavadbalī || daśabhirdaśabhirnetṝnekaikena gajān hayān ||36|| pañcabhiḥ pañcabhirvīrān bāṇaiḥ sāṃbastatāḍa ha || vīkṣya jāṃbavatīsūnoḥ sāṃbasya karalāghavam ||37|| sve pare sainikāḥ sarve vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ || tadā bhīṣmaḥ samutthāya gṛhītvā dhanuruttamam ||38|| ciccheda daśabhirbāṇaiḥ sāṃbakodaṇḍamuttamam || bhīṣmo mahābalo vīro droṇācāryaśca sāyakaiḥ ||39|| karṇaḥ sadyo yadubalaṃ jaghnurjñānaṃ yathā guṇāḥ || duryodhanaḥ punaryoddhuṃ rathamāruhya mānadaḥ ||40|| akṣauhiṇībhirdaśabhirnādayannāyayau mṛdhe ||41|| devau puraṇau puruṣau tadāvirbabhūvaturmaithila rāmakṛṣṇau || suparṇatāladhvajaśāliyānau pradyotayantau paritau hi śastau ||42|| tadā jayārāvasamākulāḥ surā gaṃdharvamukhyāśca jagurmanoharam || suranakā duṃdubhayo vineduḥ śrīlājapuṣpairvavṛṣuḥ surastriyaḥ ||43|| tadaiva nemuryadavaḥ pareśvarau duryodhanādyāḥ kuravastu sarvataḥ || nighāya śastrāṇi dadurbaliṃ paraṃ sarve prasannāḥ kṛtahastasaṃpuṭāḥ ||44|| pradyumnamukhyān svasutān madoddhatān nirbhartsya vāgbhiḥ parameśvaro hariḥ || praṇamya devavratamukhyakauravān sametya duryodhanamūcatuḥ parau ||45|| śrīrāmakṛṣṇāvūcatuḥ rājan yadebhiḥ kila bālabuddhibhistatkṣamyatāṃ mā bhava durmanāḥ svataḥ || yadā tu kiṃcitparuṣaṃ prakīrtitaṃ prakīrtatāṃ nau bhavatāṃ nṛpeśvara ||46|| mābhūtkurūṇāṃ bhuvi yādavānāṃ kadāpi kiṃcitkalireva rājan || sambandhino jñātaya eva sarve nicaulavastrāṃtaravatpriyārthāḥ ||47|| śrīnārada uvāca pūjitau kurubhiḥ śaśvadrāmakṛṣṇau sureśvarau || pradyumnādyaiḥ sayadubhī rejaturmaithileśvara ||48|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīrāmakṛṣṇāgamanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||21||
<7.22> śrīnārada uvāca duryodhanaṃ śāṃtayitvā sānujaiḥ kurubhiḥ saha || jagmatuḥ pāṃḍavāndraṣṭumiṃdraprasthaṃ yadūttamau ||1|| iṃdraprasthāttato rājā''jātasatruryudhiṣṭhiraḥ || bhrātṛbhiḥ svajanaiḥ sārddhaṃ netuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ samāyayau ||2|| śaṃkhaduṃdubhinādena brahmaghoṣeṇa veṇubhiḥ || puṣpavarṣaṃ prakurvadbhiriṃdraprasthanivāsibhiḥ || rāmakṛṣṇau pariṣvajya dorbhyāṃ rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||3|| paramāṃ nirvṛtiṃ lebhe yogīvānaṃdasaṃvṛtaḥ || pradyumnādyā harisutāḥ praṇemuḥ śrīyudhiṣṭhiram ||4|| yudhiṣṭhiro'nujagrāha karābhyāṃ tānkṛtāśiṣaḥ || arjunaṃ bhīmasenaṃ ca parirabhya hariḥ svayam ||5|| papraccha kuśalaṃ teṣāṃ yamābhyāṃ cābhivaṃditaḥ || paripūrṇatamau sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇau ca svayaṃ hariḥ ||6|| asaṃkhyabrahmāṇḍapatī haridāsena pūjitau || prasthāpya yadumukhyāṃśca pradyumnādīn sasainikān ||7|| samagrāṃ jagatīṃ jetuṃ cājñāṃ dattvā vidhānataḥ || militvā sānujaṃ dharmaṃ sarveśau bhaktavatsalau ||8|| dvārakāṃ jagmatū rājan gauraśyāmau manoharau || itthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ nṛpa ||9|| catuṣpadārthadaṃ nṝṇāṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi | bahulāśva uvāca kuśasthalīṃ gate kṛṣṇe sabale puruṣottame ||10|| tataścakāra kiṃ sākṣātpradyumno bhagavānhariḥ || adbhutaṃ tasya caritaṃ śravaṇīyaṃ manoharam ||11|| muktānāmapi bhaktānāṃ jijñāsūnāṃ punaḥ kimu || arthārthināmarthadaṃ sadārtānāmartināśanam ||12|| caturvidhānāṃ jīvānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pāpanāśanam || kathaṃ digvijayaṃ kṛtvā digjayārthī hareḥ sutaḥ ||13|| ājagāma punaḥ sainyairetanme vada tatvataḥ || devarṣe tvaṃ brahmasuto bhagavānsarvadarśanaḥ || śrīkṛṣṇasya manaḥ pūrvaṃ tasmai te haraye namaḥ ||14|| śrīnārada uvāca sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā rājandhanyastvaṃ tatprabhāvavit || śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ śrotuṃ pātraṃ tvamasi bhūtale ||15|| kṛṣṇe yāte'jātaśatrū rakṣārthaṃ snehato nṛpa || śatrubhyaḥ śaṃkitaḥ kārṣṇiṃ prāyuṅktāśukirīṭinam ||16|| atha kārṣṇiryaduśreṣṭhaḥ phālgunena samaṃ nṛpa || vikarṣanmahatīṃ senāṃ trigartānprayayau tvaram ||17|| trigartādhīśvaro dhanvī suśarmā tena śaṃkitaḥ || upāyanaṃ dadau tasmai pradyumnāya mahātmane ||18|| virāṭena tathā rājñā pūjito yādaveśvaraḥ || sarasvatīṃ nadīṃ snātvā kurukṣetraṃ dadarśa ha ||19|| pṛthūdakaṃ biṃdusarastritaṃ kūpaṃ sudarśanam || snātvā sarasvatīṃ prāgāddatvā dānānyanekaśaḥ ||20|| sārasvatādhipo rājā kuśāṃbo na dadau balim || kauśāṃbīṃ nagarīmetya duryodhanavaśānugaḥ ||21|| cārudeṣṇaḥ sudeṣṇaśca cārudehaśca vīryavān || sucāruścāruguptaśca bhadracārustathāparaḥ ||22|| cārucaṃdro vicāruśca cāruśca daśamastathā || rukmiṇīnaṃdanā hyete pradyumnena praṇoditāḥ ||23|| siṃdhudeśahayārūḍhāḥ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ gatāḥ || kauśāṃbīṃ nagarīmetya rurudhuḥ sarvatastadā ||24|| bāṇaiḥ prāsādaśikharā dhvajakuṃbhāditolikāḥ || cūrṇībhūtā nipetuḥ kau laṃkāṭṭālā yathā mṛgaiḥ ||25|| bāṇāṃdhakāre ca kṛte rukmiṇīnaṃdanairyadā || tadopāyanapāṇiḥ sankuśāṃbo nirgataḥ purāt ||26|| kṛtāṃjaliḥ śaṃbarāriṃ datvā natvā baliṃ bahu || jugopa nagarīṃ rājā bhayārto bhayavihvalaḥ ||27|| tadaiva sauvīrapatiḥ sudeva ābhīranātho'pi vicitranāmā || citrāṅgadaḥ siṃdhupatirmahaujāḥ kāśmīrapo jāṃgalapaḥ sumeruḥ ||28|| lākṣeśvaro dharmapatirbiḍaujā gāṃdhāramukhyo'pi suyodhanasya || vaśe sthitāste'pi bhayātkilaite datvā baliṃ nemuratīva kārṣṇim ||29|| yayau kārṣṇirmahābāhuḥ svasainyaparivāritaḥ || arbudānmlecchadeśāṃśca jetuṃ kalkirivodbhaṭaḥ ||30|| kālasyāpi sutaścaṃḍo yavaneṃdro mahābalaḥ || kārṣṇiṃ samāgataṃ śrutvā saṃmukhātkopapūritaḥ ||31|| pitṛhaṃtuḥ sutaṃ hatvā yāsyāmyapacitiṃ pituḥ || itthaṃ vicāryya manasā mlecchānāṃ daśakoṭibhiḥ ||32|| madacyutaṃ pronnadantaṃ gajamāruhya raktadṛk || niryayau saṃmukhe yoddhuṃ pradyumnasya mahātmanaḥ ||33|| āgatāṃ mahatīṃ senāṃ śitabāṇapravarṣiṇīm || caṃḍapraṇoditaṃ dṛṣṭvā pradyumno vākyamabravīt ||34|| pradyumna uvāca senāṃ hatvāpi yaścāṇḍaṃ śirastrasahitaṃ śiraḥ || āneṣyate taṃ svabale kariṣyāmi dhvajāpatim ||35|| śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ kārṣṇau vadatyārātphālguno vānaradhvajaḥ || eko viveśa gāṃḍīvī dhanuṣṭaṅkārayanmuhuḥ ||36|| vīrān rathān gajānaśvānsaṃmukhasthāndvidhākarot || gāṃḍīvamuktairviśikhairgāṃḍīvī raṇadurmadaḥ ||37|| kecicchinnabhujāḥ petuḥ śaktikhaḍgarṣṭipāṇayaḥ || bhinnapādā bhinnanakhāḥ kecidvīrāḥ sakaṃcukāḥ ||38|| dudruvuḥ kariṇo yuddhe bhinnakakṣāśca sakṣatāḥ || gataghaṃṭāḥ ślathannīḍāḥ pātayaṃtaḥ karairgajān ||39|| jiṣṇubāṇairdvidhābhūtairgajairaśvai raṇāṃgaṇam || babhau kṣetraṃ śaṃkulayā kūṣmāṃḍaśakalairiva ||40|| tadaiva dudruvurmlecchāstyaktvā svaṃ svaṃ raṇāṃgaṇam || nabho'rkaraśmisaṃbhinnā nīhārapaṭalā iva ||41|| gajārūḍho mlecchapatiḥ śaktiṃ cikṣepa jiṣṇave || bhrāmayitvā maithileṃdra siṃhanādamathākarot ||42|| vidyullatāmivāyāṃtīṃ bāṇaiḥ kṛṣṇasakho balī || gāṃḍīvamuktai rājeṃdra līlayā śatadhācchinat ||43|| yaāvaccaṃḍo mahāmleccho dhanurjargrāha roṣataḥ || tāvacciccheda gāṃḍīvī bāṇenaikena līlayā ||44|| dvitīyaṃ dhanurādāya sa caṇḍaścaṇḍavikramaḥ || pralayābdhimahāvartabhīmasaṃgharṣanādinīm ||45|| ciccheda siṃjanīṃ jiṣṇorgarutmāniva pannagīm || bībhatsuḥ svamasiṃ nītvā sphuraṃtaṃ carmaṇā saha ||46|| jaghāna tadgajaṃ kuṃbhe śailamiṃdro yathā paviḥ || agnidattena khaḍgena bhinnakuṃbho gajo nadan ||47|| jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ spṛṣṭvā kaśmalaṃ paramaṃ yayau || caṃḍaḥ khaḍgaṃ gṛhītvātha prāhatya pāṃḍunaṃdanam ||48|| tatkhaḍgaṃ carmaṇonnīya prāhiṇottaṃ kurūdvahaḥ || saśirastraṃ śirastasya dehādbhinnaṃ babhūva ha ||49|| sajjaṃ kṛtvā dhanurjiṣṇurnidhāya viśikhe ca tat || ākṛṣya pātayāmāsa pradyumnasya bale mahat ||50|| tadā dundubhinādo'bhūjjayārāvasamākulaḥ || arjunasyopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire ||51|| tadaiva kārṣṇiḥ sabalasya jiṣṇuṃ cakāra nāthaṃ vijayadhvajasya || saṃvījyamānaṃ sitacāmarādyaiḥ kapidhvajaṃ yādavavṛṃdamukhyaiḥ ||52|| vegavānarbudādhīśaḥ pradyumnaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || upāyanaṃ dadau bhīrurnamaskṛtya kṛtāṃjaliḥ ||53|| mauraṃgeśo maṃdahāso hayānāṃ daśalakṣakam || datvā bhīrurnamaścakre pradyumnāya mahātmane ||54|| itthaṃ khaṃḍaṃ bhāratākhyaṃ jitvā kārṣṇiryadūttamaḥ || himādriṃ dakṣiṇīkṛtya prāgudīcīṃ diśaṃ yayau ||55|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde bahudigvijayo nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||22||
<7.23> śrīnārada uvāca nadā nadyaḥ samudrāśca rathavīthiṃ dadurnṛpa || dharṣitāstejasā tasmai sasainyāya mahātmane ||1|| kailāsagiripārśve ca varavīraśca mānuṣaḥ || bāṇasya śoṇitapuraṃ prayayau yādaveśvaraḥ ||2|| bāṇāsuro'tisaṃkruddho yadūn vīkṣyāgatānpunaḥ || akṣauhiṇībhirdvādaśabhiryuddhaṃ kartuṃ mano dadhe ||3|| tadeva sākṣātpuruṣaḥ purāṇo maheśvaro naṃdivṛṣasthito'sau || himādriputrīsahitastriśūlī sametya bāṇaṃ nṛpamāha devaḥ ||4|| śiva uvāca paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam || asaṃkhyabrahmāṃḍapatirgolokeśaḥ parātparaḥ ||5|| trayo vayaṃ tatkalā hi brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ || mūrdhnyājñāṃ yasya bibhrati tvādṛśānāṃ ca kā kathā ||6|| tasya pautrastvayā baddho'niruddho yena tejasā || chinnā bhujā na jānāsi saṃgrāme taṃ hariḥ svayam ||7|| tasmātteṣāṃ dānavānāṃ pūjanīyā hareḥ sutāḥ || aniruddhaḥ pūjanīyo jāmātā te na saṃśayaḥ ||8|| na dadāmi tvanujñāṃ te yuddhāyāsurapuṃgava || na cedyuddhaṃ kuru balādvṛthā dṛṣṭaṃ manastava ||9|| śrīnārada uvāca śivaprabodhito bāṇo'niruddhaṃ dhanvīnāṃ varam || samāhūya ca saṃpūjya pāribarhaṃ dadau punaḥ ||10|| sasainyaṃ sādareṇāpi pradyumnaṃ pūjya baṃdhuvat || gajāyutaṃ cāśvakoṭiṃ rathānāṃ paṃcalakṣakam ||11|| dadau bāṇo mahābāhuḥ pradyumnāya mahātmane || atha kārṣṇirmahārāja svasainyairyadubhiḥ saha ||12|| alakāṃ prayayau dhanvī purīm guhyakamaṃḍitām || śrīnaṃdālakanaṃdābhyāṃ gaṃgābhyāṃ parikhīkṛtā ||13|| ratnasopānayuktābhyāṃ yajñabhiḥ pariśobhitām || vidyādharībhiḥ paritaḥ kinnarībhirmanoharām ||14|| divyābhirnāgakanyābhiḥ purīṃ bhogavatīmiva || dhanado na dadau tasmai pradyumnāya baliṃ nṛpaḥ ||15|| hareḥ prabhavavidapi viṣṇormāyābalaṃ tvaho || lokapālo'smyahaṃ nityamityajñānavimohitaḥ ||16|| nodito balibhiryakṣairyuddhaṃ kartuṃ mano dadhe || nirdhano hi dhanaṃ prāpya tṛṇavanmanyate jagat ||17|| navānāṃ tu nidhīnāṃ kau patīnāṃ kimu varṇanam || tadaiva hemamukuṭo dūto dhanadanoditaḥ || kārṣṇimetya sabhāmadhye natvedaṃ prāha mānadaḥ ||18|| hemamukuṭa uvāca dhaneśvaro rājarājo lokapālo'lakeśvaraḥ || tena yatkathitaṃ rājañchṛṇu tvaṃ tadyadūttama ||19|| devarājo yathā śakraḥ smṛto divī yathā prabhuḥ || tathaiko rājarājo'haṃ kathito bhūtale mahān ||20|| manuṣyadharmā rājedraiḥ pūjito'haṃ sadā bhuvi || ugrasenena dātavyaṃ mahyaṃ sopāyanaṃ param ||21|| parāk tasmai na dāsyāmi yadurājāya bhūbhṛte || na manyase cetsaṃgrāmaṃ kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||22|| śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ dūtavacaḥ śrutvā pradyumno bhagavānhariḥ || cakāra kopaṃ raktākṣo ruṣā prasphuritādharaḥ ||23|| pradyumna uvāca vṛṣṇīṃdra rājarājeṃdraṃ rājarājo na vetti tam || śakrādīnāṃ tu yaḥ sākṣānmukuṭairghṛṣṭapādukaḥ ||24|| sudharmāṃ pārijātaṃ ca tasmā iṃdro dadau bhayāt || śyāmavarṇānhayānpāśī tasmai datvā nanāma ha ||25|| anena rājarājena bhīruṇā nidhayo nava || prāptāstaṃ hi na jānāti rājarājo mahābalam ||26|| vartate tatsabhāmadhye paripūrṇatamo hariḥ || asaṃkhyabrahmāṇḍapatiḥ śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam ||27|| yasyaikamūrdhni tilakaṃ dṛśyate maṃḍalaṃ bhuvaḥ || ugrasenasabhāmadhye so'pi nityaṃ virājate ||28|| ugrasenapreṣito'haṃ kuberāya mahātmane || nārācānāṃ baliṃ dātuṃ tatkariṣyāmi sāmpratam ||29|| śrīnārada uvāca evamuktvā gṛhītvā svaṃ kodaṇḍaṃ caṇḍavikramaḥ || cakāra bhujadaṇḍābhyāṃ ṭaṅkāraṃ vādayan guṇam ||30|| pratyaṃcāsphoṭanenaiva maṃḍito'bhūttaḍitsvanaḥ || nanāda tena brahmāṇḍaṃ saptalokairbilaiḥ saha ||31|| vicelurdiggajāstārā rājanbhūkhaṃḍamaṃḍalam || niṣaṃgāccharamākṛṣya pradyumno dhanvināṃ varaḥ ||32|| pratiśārṅge svadhanuṣi bāṇamekaṃ samādadhe || dvādaśādityasaṃkāśaṃ dyotayanmaṃḍalaṃ diśām ||33|| ciccheda guhyakeśasya bāṇaṃ chatraṃ ca cāmare || tadā kruddho rājarājo dṛṣṭvā citramidaṃ mahat ||34|| āruhya puṣpakaṃ sainyairyuddhakāmo viniryayau || ghaṃṭānādena yakṣeṇa maṃtriṇā pārśvamaulinā||35|| nalakūbaramaṇigrīvau śuśubhāte dhvajāgrataḥ || turaṃgavadanāḥ kecinmṛgeṃdravadanāḥ pare ||36|| śiśumāramukhāḥ kecitkecinnakramukhā iva || arddhapiṃgā arddhakṛṣṇā ūrdhvakeśā madotkaṭāḥ ||37|| vakradaṃtā lalajjihvā bṛhaddaṃṣṭrā mahābalāḥ || karālāsyāḥ sakavacāḥ khaḍgacarmadharāḥ parāḥ ||38|| śaktihastā ṛṣṭihastā bhuśuṃḍiparighāyudhāḥ | dhanurbāṇadharā yakṣāḥ kecitparaśupāṇayaḥ ||39|| yakṣāṇāṃ hastivāhānāṃ rathināmaśvināṃ tathā || virejurnirgatānāṃ ca maṃḍalāni sahasraśaḥ ||40|| śaṃkhadundubhinādaiśca sūtamāgadhavandibhiḥ || rejire śrīdavīrāḥ kau meghā iva taḍitsvanaiḥ ||41|| evaṃ yakṣeṣu matteṣu koṭiśo nirgateṣu ca || divyānmahāyogamayātsiddhakṣetrādvideharāṭ ||42|| āyayau tatsahāyārthaṃ pramathānāṃ balaṃ mahat || bhūtāśca pramathāḥ kecitkarālāsyā madotkaṭāḥ ||43|| ḍākinyo yātudhānāśca vetālāḥ savināyakāḥ || kūṣmāṃḍonmādasaṃyuktāḥ pretā mātṛgaṇāḥ pare ||44|| niśācarapiśācāśca brahmarākṣabhairavāḥ || nadaṃto bhairavaṃ nādaṃ chiṃdhi bhiṃdhīti vādinaḥ ||45|| itthaṃ tu bhūtāvalayaḥ koṭiśaścāyayustadā || rodasyācchādite bhūtā meghaiḥ sāṃvartakairiva ||46|| mayūrasthaḥ kārtikeyo mūṣakastho gaṇeśvaraḥ || pramathairgīyamānau tau ḍhakkāvāditraniḥsvanaiḥ ||47|| sarveṣāmagrataḥ prāptau vīrabhadreṇa saṃyutau || itthaṃ puṇyajanānāṃ tu gaṇānāṃ yadubhiḥ saha ||48|| babhūva tumulaṃ yuddhamadbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam || rathino rathibhistatra pattibhiḥ saha pattayaḥ ||49|| hayā hayairibhāścebhairyuyudhuste parasparam || rathebhāśvapadātīnāṃ caraṇairutthitaṃ rajaḥ ||50|| chādayāmāsa rājeṃdra sasūryaṃ vyomamaṃḍalam ||51|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde yakṣadeśaprayāṇaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||23||
<7.24> śrīnārada uvāca śastrāṃdhakāre saṃjāte maṇigrīvo mahābalaḥ || bibhedāribalaṃ bāṇaiḥ kuvākyairmitratāmiva ||1|| maṇigrīvasya bāṇaughairgajāśvarathapattayaḥ || nipetuḥ sakṣatā bhūmau vṛkṣā vātahatā iva ||2|| caṃdrabhānurhareḥ putro satyabhāmā''tmajo balī || maṇigrīvasya kodaṃḍaṃ paṃcabāṇaistadācchinat ||3|| daśabhīstadrathaṃ bhitvā jagarja ghanavadbalī || maṇigrīvo'pi cikṣepa śaktiṃ svāṃ candrabhānave ||4|| bhāsayaṃtī diśaḥ śaśvanmaholkāmiva maithila || agrahīccaṃdrabhānustāṃ vāmahastena līlayā ||5|| tayā jaghāna samare maṇigrīvaṃ mahābalam || punarjagarja samare caṃdrabhānurmahābalaḥ || 6|| tatprahāreṇa patite maṇigrīve pramūrchite || candrabhānuṃ bāṇajālairnalakūbaranoditāḥ ||7|| chādayāmāsurasurā varṣādityaṃ yathāṃbudāḥ || dīptimānkṛṣṇaputrastu khaḍgamudyamya vegavān ||8|| viveśa yakṣasenāsu nīhāreṣu yathā raviḥ || tasya khaḍgaprahāreṇa kecidyakṣā dvidhābhavan ||9|| kecidvai chinnaśirasaśchinnapādāṃsabāhavaḥ || bhinnahastāśchinnakarṇāśchinnoṣṭhāḥ peturāhave ||10|| teṣāṃ śirobhirbībhatsaiḥ sakirīṭaiḥ sakuṃḍalaiḥ || saśirastraiḥ sravadraktairmahāmārīva bhūrbabhau ||11|| śeṣā vidudruvuryakṣāḥ sakṣatā bhayavihvalāḥ || hāhākārastadā jāto yakṣasenāsu maithila ||12|| dhanuṣṭaṃkārayanprāpto daṃśito nalakūbaraḥ || rathenātipatākena mā bhaiṣṭetyabhayaṃ dadau ||13|| paṃcabhiḥ kṛtavarmāṇamarjunaṃ daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ || dīptimaṃtaṃ ca viṃśatyā tatāḍa nalakūbaraḥ ||14|| kṛtavarmā mahābāhurjaghāna nalakūbaram || paṃcabhirviśikhai rājannādayanmaṃḍalaṃ diśām ||15|| te bāṇāḥ kavacaṃ bhitvā tanuṃ bhitvā dharātalam || viviśuḥ paśyatāṃ teṣāṃ valmīke phaṇino yathā ||16|| vīkṣya tadbāṇabhinnāṃgaṃ mūrcchitaṃ nalakūbaraṃ || apovāha raṇātsūto hemamālīti nāmabhāk ||17|| ghaṃṭānādaḥ pārśvamauliḥ kuberasya ca maṃtriṇau || jaghnaturbāṇapaṭalairyadūnāmudbhaṭaṃ balam ||18|| svarṇapuṃkhaistīkṣṇamukhairgṛdhrapakṣairmanojavaiḥ || dyotayadbhirdiśaḥ sarvā mārtaṃḍakiraṇairiva ||19|| tato'rjuno mahāvīraḥ pratibāṇānsamādadhe || bāṇasaṃgharṣajā yuddhe visphuliṃgā sahasraśaḥ ||20|| virejurnṛpa khadyotacaṃcalālātacakravat || sarvaṃ tadbāṇapaṭalaṃ kṣaṇamātreṇa cācchinat ||21|| gāṃḍīvamuktaviśikhairgāṃḍīvī raṇadurmadaḥ || yojanadvayamātreṇa tadratho sadhvajo balāt ||22|| arjuno bāṇapaṭalaiścakāra śarapaṃjare || hatāvimāviti jñātvā sarve puṇyajanāstvaram ||23|| dudruvuḥ svaṃ raṇaṃ tyaktvā paraṃ hāheti vādinaḥ || tadā tu bhūtāvalayaḥ koṭiśaścāyayurmṛdhe ||24|| ḍākinyaḥ koṭiśo rājaṃścikṣipurvāraṇānmṛdhe || bhakṣayaṃtyo narānaśvām̐ścarvayaṃtyo rathānpṛthak ||25|| nare nare pṛthagbhūtā dhāvaṃto daśabhirdaśa || pramathāḥ pātayāmāsuḥ khaṭvāṃgena janānmuhuḥ ||26|| yātudhānāścarvayantaḥ śirāṃsi raṇamaṃḍale || vetālāśca kapālena pibaṃto rudhiraṃ bahu ||27|| vināyakāśca nṛtyaṃtaḥ pretā gāyaṃta eva hi || kūṣmāṃḍāśca tathonmādāḥ śirāṃsi jagṛhurmṛdhe ||28|| śivasya muṃḍamālārthaṃ vīrāṇāṃ svargagāminām || tathā mātṛgaṇā brahmarākṣasā bhairavā mṛdhe ||29|| śirāṃsi kaṃdukānīva kṣepayaṃto muhurmuhuḥ || hasaṃtaḥ prahasaṃtaśca sāṭṭahāsaṃ samākulāḥ ||30|| piśācā vikalāsyāśca kūrdantaḥ ke'pi kutsitam || piśācyaḥ kṣatajaṃ tūṣṇaṃ pāyayaṃtyaḥ śiśūnmṛdhe ||31|| mā rodīriti vādinyo netrāṇyapi dadāma ut || itthaṃ gaṇabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā baladevānujo balī ||32|| gado gadāṃ samādāya jagarja ghanavadbalī || lakṣabhārabhṛtā maurvyā gadayā tadbalaṃ mahat ||33|| pothayāmāsa hi gado vajreṇeṃdro yathā girīn || kūṣmāṃḍonmādavetālāḥ piśācā brahmarākṣasāḥ ||34|| nipeturmūrchitā bhūmau tadgadābhinnamastakāḥ || ḍākinībhinnadaṃtāśca pramathābhinnakaṃdharāḥ ||35|| yātudhānāṃśchinnamukhāṃścakāra samare gadaḥ || gadayā marditāḥ pretā dudruvuste diśo daśa ||36|| vārāhadaṃṣṭrayā bhagnā laye daityā yathā nṛpa || palāyite bhūtagaṇe vīrabhadraḥ samāgataḥ ||37|| gadaṃ tatāḍa gadayā baladevānujaṃ balī || gadopari gadāṃ nītvā gadaḥ svāṃ prāhīṇodgadām ||38|| tayoryuddhamabhūdghoraṃ gadābhyāṃ maithileśvara || visphuliṃgān kṣaraṃtyo dve gade cūrṇibabhūvatuḥ ||39|| mallayuddhaṃ tayorāsīnnodayaṃtaṃ parasparam || bhujaiśca jānubhiḥ pādaiḥ pātayaṃto girīn bahūn ||40|| karavīraṃ samutpāṭya vīrabhadro giriṃ balāt || aṭṭahāsaṃ tadā kurvan gadopari samakṣipat ||41|| gado giriṃ saṃgṛhītvā tasyopari samākṣipat || gṛhītvātha gadaṃ vīraṃ vīrabhadro balādbalī ||42|| cikṣepa caujasā rājannākāśe lakṣayojanam || gado'pi patito bhūmau kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ ||43|| gṛhītvā vīrabhadrākhyaṃ bhrāmayitvā mahābalaḥ || ojasā prākṣipacchīghramākāśe lakṣayojanam ||44|| vīrabhadrastu patitaḥ kailāsaśikharopari || gadāprahāravyathito mūrchito ghaṭikādvayam ||45|| kārtikeyastadā prāptaḥ śaktimudyamya vegavān || aniruddhāya sāṃbāya śaktiṃ cikṣepa satvaram ||46|| aniruddharathaṃ bhitvā sāṃbaṃ sāṃbarathaṃ punaḥ || gajān rathānsahasraṃ ca vīralakṣaṃ mṛdhāṃgaṇe ||47|| bhitvā nadaṃtī sphūrjaṃtī capaleva dīśo daśa || viveśa bhūmau phūtkāraṃ kurvatī pannagīva sā ||48|| tadā kruddho mahābāhuḥ sāṃbo jāmbavatīsutaḥ || kṛtvātha siṃjinīghoṣaṃ niṣaṃgādbāṇamādade ||49|| eko'pi sadbahistūṇāddaśarūpī babhūva ha || cāpe śataṃ karṣaṇe ca sahasraṃ rūpamādadhe ||50|| mokṣaṇe lakṣarūpāṇi koṭirūpāṇi koṭiṣu || anekarūpī viśikhaḥ śikhinaṃ śikhivāhanam ||51|| bhitvā bibheda vīrāṇāṃ koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo raṇe || kārtikeye ca bhinnāṃge kiṃcidvyākulamānase || gaṇeśvarastadā prāpto mūṣakastho gajānanaḥ ||52|| gomūtrapatramṛganābhivicitrakuṃbhaṃ śrīkuṃkumākalitasuṃdaravakratuṃḍam || siṃdūrapūritakapolamanoharābhaṃ karpūradhūlidhavalīkṛtakarṇavarṇam ||53|| vyālolakarṇahatamattamadhuvrataistaiḥ śrīgaṃḍajātamadirāmadavihvalāṃgai || saṃgītatālakusumākaragītarāgaiḥ saṃsevitaṃ gaṇapatiṃ kṛtabhālacaṃdram ||54|| bālārkavarṇamamalāṃgadahemahāragraiveyamaulikiraṇaiḥ paritaḥ sphuraṃtam || ākhusthamekadaśanaṃ gajabhavyamūrtiṃ pāśāṃkuśāṃbujakuṭhāracayaṃ dadhānam ||55|| prāṃśuṃ caturbhujamatīva mṛdhe pravṛttaṃ kāṃścitpragṛhya ca kareṇa dhṛtāṃkuśena || saṃmardayaṃtamurudhāraparaśvadhena śrībhārgavendramiva śastrabhṛtaḥ samastān ||56|| vīrebhavājirathasaṃghabalaṃ nipātya sāṃbaṃ pragṛhya sarathaṃ pradhanātkṣipaṃtam || taṃ vīkṣya vismitamanāḥ sagaṇo'tha kārṣṇiḥ putraṃ subuddhimaniruddhamuvāca samyak ||57|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde yakṣayuddhavarṇanaṃ nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||24||
<7.25> pradyumna uvāca śrīkṛṣṇasya kalā sākṣādgaṇeśo'yaṃ mahābalaḥ || jetuṃ na śakyo divijairmanuṣyaistu kuto bhuvi ||1|| vartate yasya nikaṭe tasya nāsti parājayaḥ || śrīkṛṣṇena varo dattaḥ purāsmai śaṃkarālaye ||2|| yadyayaṃ vartate cātra tadā na syājjayaśca naḥ || śatrupakṣagato'yaṃ vai śrīkṛṣṇasya varorjitaḥ ||3|| tasmāttvaṃ caṃḍamārjaro bhūtvā taṃ yuddhato balāt || vidrāvaya mahābuddhe phūtkāraiśca diśau daśa ||4|| yāvadbalaṃ vijeṣyāmi tāvadadvidrāvaya tvaram || śrīnārada uvāca athāniruddho bhagavāṃścaṃḍamārjārarūpadhṛk ||5|| alakṣito gaṇeśena na jñāto viṣṇumāyayā || phūtkāramutkaṭaṃ kurvan saṃpapātākhusaṃmukhe ||6|| vidārayanmukhaṃ rājansatataṃ nakharaiḥ kharaiḥ || vīśeṣaṇa sahaivākhurdṛṣṭvā''śu bhayavihvalaḥ || 7|| dudrāva tvaritaṃ rājan kaṃpito raṇamaṃḍalāt || tamanvagacchatkupito mārjāraḥ sthūlarūpadhṛk ||8|| mūṣakaṃ svamapovāha gaṇeśo'pi muhurmuhuḥ || nāyayau svaṃ raṇaṃ cākhuścaṃḍamārjārapīḍitaḥ ||9|| saptadvīpānsaptasiṃdhūn diśāsu vidiśāsu ca || dhāvan vai saptalokeṣu na lebhe śarma maithila ||10|| yatra yatra gataścākhurgaṇeśena samanvitaḥ || tatra tatra gato rājan mārjāraścaṃḍavikramaḥ ||11|| evaṃ samūṣake yāte gaṇeśe vidiśottaram || vismiteṣu sapakṣeṣu gaṇeṣu pramatheṣu ca ||12|| puṣpakasthaḥ kubero'sau māyāṃ cakre'tha gauhyakīm || gṛhītvā svadhanurdivyaṃ namaskṛtya maheśvaram ||13|| samaṃtraṃ kavacaṃ dhṛtvā bāṇasaṃghaṃ samādadhe || tadaiva chāditaṃ vyoma meghaiḥ sāṃvartakairiva ||14|| taḍitsvanairmahābhīmaistamo'bhūtstanayitnubhiḥ || biṃdavo hastisadṛśā nipetuḥ sopalā mṛdhe ||15|| dhārābhiratighorābhirvavṛṣurvāridāstataḥ || kṣaṇena siṃdhavaḥ sarve plāvayaṃto dharātalam ||16|| parvatairjīvasahitairdṛśyante raṇamaṃḍale || prākṛtāḥ pralayaṃ matvā yādavā bhayavihvalāḥ ||17|| tyakttvā śastrāṇi te'thocuḥ śrīkṛṣṇeti muhurmuhuḥ || jñātvā tāṃ gauhyakīṃ māyāṃ pradyumno bhagavānhariḥ ||18|| satvātmikāṃ ca svāṃ vidyāṃ sarvamāyopamardinīm || japtvā kṛtvā kāmabījaṃ bāṇamadhye nidhāya tat ||19|| mukhe ca praṇavaṃ dhṛtvā puṃkhe śrībījameva ca || ākṛṣya karṇaparyantaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ smṛtvā caturbhujam ||20|| cikṣepa viśikhaṃ cāpāddordaṃḍābhyāṃ taḍitsvanāt || kodaṃḍamukto viśikho dyotayanmaṃḍalaṃ diśām ||21|| jaghāna gauhyakīṃ māyāmaṃdhakāraṃ yathā raviḥ || bhayabhīto rājarājo puṣpakastho raṇāṃgaṇāt ||22|| palāyamāno yakṣaiśca kaṃpitaḥ svapurīṃ yayau || pradyumnasyopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire ||23|| jahasuryādavāḥ sarve jayārāvasamākulāḥ || tadātiharṣito rājan rājarājaḥ kṛtāṃjaliḥ ||24|| baliṃ nītvā yayau śīghraṃ pradyumnasyāpi saṃmukhe || gajeṃdrāṇāṃ dvilakṣaṃ ca dviśuṃḍādaṃḍaśālinām ||25|| dadbhiścaturbhiryuktānāmadrīnspardhayatāṃ madaiḥ || daśalakṣaṃ rathānāṃ ca muktātoraṇaśālinām ||26|| śatāśvayojitānāṃ ca raukmāṇāṃ sūryavarcasām || daśārbudaṃ tathā rājanhayānāṃ candravarcasām ||27|| śibikānāṃ caturlakṣaṃ māṇikyairagravarcasām || paṃjarasthāyināṃ rājañchārdūlānāṃ dvilakṣakam ||28|| citrakāṇāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ ca gavayānāṃ tathaiva ca || mṛgayāsārameyānāṃ koṭikoṭirvideharāṭ ||29|| śukānāṃ sārikāṇāṃ ca kalakaṃṭhapravādinām || haṃsānāṃ svarṇavarṇānāmanyeṣāṃ citrapakṣiṇām ||30|| paṃjarasthāyināṃ rājam̐llakṣaṃ lakṣaṃ nṛpeśvara || vimānaṃ viṣṇudattākhyaṃ muktādāmavilaṃbitam ||31|| aṣṭayojanamuccāṃgaṃ navayojanavistṛtam || lakṣakuṃbhadhvajopetaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmāṇā ||32|| kāmagaṃ svarṇaśikharaṃ sahasrādityasuprabham || sahasraṃ kulavṛkṣāṇāṃ kāmadhenuśataṃ tathā ||33|| ciṃtāmaṇīnāṃ ca śataṃ śataṃ divyāśmanāṃ tathā || yatsparśenāpi lohastu hematvaṃ yāti maithila ||34|| chatrāṇāṃ cāmarāṇāṃ ca hemasiṃhāsanaṃ śatam || tathāhi divyapadmānāṃ mālāṃkiṃjalkinīṃ śubhām ||35|| pīyūṣasya śataṃ droṇaṃ phalāni vividhāni ca || khacidratnasuvarṇānāṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ tu vāsasām ||36|| divyānāṃ kaṃbalānāṃ ca koṭīśaḥ pātrasaṃcayam || amoghānāṃ ca śastrāṇāṃ koṭisauvarṇaśālinām ||37|| gajairnarairbhāravāhaiḥ preritā nidhayo nava || dattvā baliṃ rājarājaḥ pradyumnāya mahātmane ||38|| dakṣiṇīkṛtya taṃ natvā prāhedaṃ harṣapūritaḥ || kubera uvāca namastubhyaṃ bhagavate puruṣāya mahātmane ||39|| anādaye sarvavide nirguṇāya mahātmane || pradhānapuruṣeśāya pratyagdhāmne namo namaḥ ||40|| svayaṃjyotiḥsvarūpāya śyāmalāṃgāya te namaḥ || namaste vāsudevāya namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca ||41|| pradyumnāyāniruddhāya sātvatāṃ pataye namaḥ || madanāya ca mārāya kaṃdarpāya namo namaḥ ||42|| darpakāya ca kāmāya paṃcabāṇāya te namaḥ || anaṃgāya namastubhyaṃ namaste śambarāraye ||43|| he manmatha namastubhyaṃ namaste mīnaketana || manobhavāya devāya namaste kusumeṣave ||44|| ananyaja namaste'stu ratibhartre namo namaḥ || namaste puṣpadhanuṣe makaradhvaja te namaḥ ||45|| smarāya prabhave nityaṃ jagadvijayakāriṇe || namo rukmavatībhartre suṃdarīpataye namaḥ ||46|| idaṃ kariṣyāmi karomi bhūmanmamedamastīti tavedamābruvan || ahaṃ sukhī duḥkhayutaḥ suhṛjjano loko hyahaṃkāravimohito'khilaḥ ||47|| pradhānakālāśayadehajairguṇaiḥ kurvan vikarmāṇi jano nibaddhyate || kāce'rbhakaṃ saikata eva jīvanaṃ guṇe ca sarpaṃ pratanoti so'kṣibhiḥ ||48|| kṛtaṃ mayā helanamadya mauḍhyatastvanmāyayā mohitacetasā prabho || na manyase bālakṛtaṃ piteva hi mābhūtpunarme matirīdṛśī manāk ||49|| sadā bhavettvaccaraṇāraviṃdayorbhaktiṃ parāṃ yāṃ ca vidurgarīyasīm || jñānaṃ ca vairāgyayutaṃ śivāspadaṃ dehi praśastaṃ nijasādhusaṃgamam ||50|| śrīnārada uvāca pradyumnasya śubhaṃ stotraṃ prātarutthāya yaḥ paṭhet || saṃkaṭe tasya satataṃ sahāyaḥ syāddhariḥ svayam ||51|| ityuktavaṃtaṃ yakṣeśaṃ pradyumno bhagavānhariḥ || tathāstūktvā dadau rājanpadmarāgaśiromaṇim ||52|| mā bhaiṣṭetyabhayaṃ datvā līlāchatraṃ sacāmaram || siṃhāsanaṃ maṇimayaṃ prādācchrīyādaveśvaraḥ ||53|| kārṣṇiṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya rājarājo dhaneśvaraḥ || jitaṃ śrutvā rājarājaṃ pradyumnena mahātmanā ||54|| na ke'pi yuyudhustena rājānaśca baliṃ daduḥ || atha kārṣṇirmahābāhurnādayandundubhīnbahūn ||55|| samastavāhinīyuktaḥ prāgjyotiṣapuraṃ yayau || bhaumāsurasuto nīlo dharṣitastasya tejasā ||56|| sadyastasmai baliṃ prādātpradyumnāya mahātmane || prāgjyotiṣapuradvāri dvivido nāma vānaraḥ ||57|| purā pradyumnabāṇena tāḍito yo mahābalaḥ || samutthāya ruṣāviṣṭo daśanairnakharaiḥ kharaiḥ ||58|| vidārya vīrānaśvāṃśca bhrūbhaṃgaiḥ prajagarja ha || lāṃgūlena rathānbaddhvā prākṣipallavaṇāṃbhasi || 59|| gṛhītvā sa gajāndorbhyāṃ vicikṣepāṃbare balāt || śatruṃ jñātvā kapiṃ kārṣṇiḥ pratiśārṅge śaraṃ dadhe ||60|| nītvā śarastaṃ sahasā bhrāmayitvāṃbare balāt || pūrvavatpātayāmāsa kiṣkiṃdhāyāṃ mahākapim ||61|| punarāgatavānbāṇaḥ pradyumnasyeṣudhau sphuran ||62|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde yakṣadeśavijayo nāma paṃcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||25||
<7.26> śrīnārada uvāca atha kārṣṇiṃ parāndeśāndivyadrumalatākulān || sahasrapatravadbhiśca sarobhiḥ śobhitān yayau ||1|| akṣauhīṇīśatayutaḥ pradyumnaścaṇḍavikramaḥ || yakṣairdiṣṭena mārgeṇa khaṇḍaṃ kiṃpuruṣaṃ yayau ||2|| raṃgavallīpuraṃ yatra hemakūṭagireradhaḥ || tasya kiṃpuruṣā ūcuḥ śaṃbarāreśca śṛṇvataḥ ||3|| kiṃpuruṣā ūcuḥ aho'tidhanyā mathurāpurī varā babhūva yasyāṃ parameśvaro hariḥ || aho'tidhanyaṃ satataṃ yadoḥ kulaṃ jāto hi yasminnakhilāṃḍapālakaḥ ||4|| dhanyaṃ ca tacchūrasutasya mandiraṃ golokanāthena manoharaṃ kṛtam || dhanyaṃ paraṃ māthuramaṃḍalaṃ suraiḥ sudurlabhaṃ yatra cacāra mādhavaḥ ||5|| mahāvanaṃ dhanyatamaṃ manoharaṃ piturgṛhādyatra gato hariḥ śiśuḥ || cacāra kṛṣṇaḥ śiśunā balena hi yaśodayā dugdhamukhaḥ sulālitaḥ ||6|| vṛṃdāvanaṃ puṇyatamaṃ parātparaśrīkṛṣṇapādāṃbujareṇurājitam || gāḥ pālayan yatra cacāra balo gopālabālaiḥ sabalaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ ||7|| yo dānalīlāṃ kila mānalīlāṃ śrīrāsalīlāṃ vrajasundarībhiḥ || vṛndāvane yatra cacāra kṛṣṇo yasyāpi gāyanti yaśastrilokāḥ ||8|| aho'tidhanyā vṛṣabhānunaṃdinī līlāvatī sā nijalokaśālinī || cacāra kṛṣṇena kalindanandinītaṭe milindadhvanisaṃkule vane ||9|| aho'tidhanyā'sti kalindanaṃdinī śrīkṛṣṇavāmāṃsasamudbhavā yā || taṭe milindadhvanisaṃkule vaṭe tatsparśanādyāti naraḥ kṛtārthatām ||10|| samudbhavo yo harivakṣaso girirgovarddhano nāma girīṃdrarājarāṭ || virājate sa vrajamaṃḍale paro yaddarśanāñjanma punarna vidyate ||11|| aho'tidhanyā yadumaṇḍalībhirvirājate bhūmitale manoharā || vaikuṇṭhalīlādhikṛtā kuśasthalī yathā taḍidbhirjaladāvalirdivi ||12|| yatraiva sākṣātpuruṣaḥ pareśvaro dhṛtvā caturvyūhamalaṃ virājate || yastūgrasenāya dadau nṛpeśatāṃ kṛṣṇāya tasmai haraye namo namaḥ ||13|| praṇoditastena nṛpeṇa dhīmatā jagadvijetuṃ makaradhvajo mahān || kṛtvātha taddarśanamadya durlabhaṃ vayaṃ kṛtārthā hi bhavema sarvataḥ ||14|| śrīnārada uvāca itthaṃ harirnṛpayaśo viśadaiścaritrairudyattrilokamalaṃ viśadīcakāra || pūrṇeṃduraśmimilitaistaralaiḥ sphuradbhiḥ prodyadbhirudgaja ivāmalasiṃdhudugdham ||15|| itthaṃ yaśaḥ svamamalaṃ nṛpa śaṃbarāriḥ śrutvātiharṣitatanuḥ pradadau dhanāni || keyurahāranavaratnamanoharāṇi tebhyaḥ kirīṭamaṇikuṇḍalakaṃkaṇāni ||16|| raṅgavallīpurādhīśaḥ subāhuścandravaṃśajaḥ || natvā baliṃ dadau so'pi pradyumnāya mahātmane ||17|| tasmai prasanno bhagavān pradyumno mīnaketanaḥ || datvā cūḍāmaṇiṃ divyaṃ papracchedaṃ mahāmanāḥ ||18|| śrīpradyumna uvāca raṅgavallīpurasyāpi nāma kena prakāśitam || etadbrūhi subāho me śrutaṃ pūrvaṃ tvayā kila ||19|| subāhuruvāca devāsuraiḥ purā rājanmathitaḥ kṣīrasāgaraḥ || vinirgatāni mathanādratnāni ca caturdaśa ||20|| niḥsṛtaṃ kalaśaṃ tasmātsudhāpūrṇaṃ manoharam || taṃ dadarśa hariḥ sākṣānnetrābhyāṃ puṣkarekṣaṇaḥ ||21|| tannetraharṣabinduśca kalaśe nipapāta ha || tasmādvṛkṣaḥ samudbhutastulasīti prakathyate ||22|| raṅgavallīti tannāma cakāra madhusūdanaḥ || atra kiṃpuruṣe khaṃḍe hemakūṭagireradhaḥ ||23|| tasyāśca raṅgavalyāḥ kau sthāpanāṃ sa cakāra ha || raṅgavallīmahāvṛkṣaḥ sadātraiva virājate ||24|| tannāmnā prasiddhamabhūdraṃgavallīpuraṃ tvidam || atra nityaṃ hi hanumānārṣṭiṣeṇena rāgiṇā ||25|| darśanārthaṃ samāyāti mahātmā rāmapūjakaḥ || śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvā śambarārī raṅgavallīṃ manoharam ||26|| dṛṣṭvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya deśānanyāñjagāma ha || hemakūṭataṭībhūtaṃ vanaṃ prāptaṃ bhayaṅkaram ||27|| jhillījhaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ siṃhacitrakanāditam || vanyaiḥ karīṃdraiḥ saṃyuktaṃ śivolūkarutāvṛtam ||28|| kīcakāśvatthamandāravaṭabhūrjasamākulam || kṛṣṇāharītakīvallībadaraiḥ saghanaṃ vanam ||29|| tasmādvinirgataḥ sarpo daśayojanalaṃbitaḥ || agrasadgajavṛṃdāni phūtkāraṃ kārayanmuhuḥ ||30|| hāhākāre tadā jāte senāyāṃ maithileśvara || pracaṃḍagaralairvātairbhasmībhūte diśāṃtare ||31|| bhānuḥ subhānuḥ svarbhānuḥ prabhānurbhānumāṃstathā || caṃdrabhānurbṛhadbhānuratibhānustathā'ṣṭamaḥ ||32|| śrībhānuḥ pratibhānuśca satyabhāmātmajā daśa || ete jaghnuḥ śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ sarpaṃ raudraṃ madotkaṭam ||33|| bāṇaiḥ saṃbhinnasarvāṃgaḥ patito dharaṇītale || sarparūpaṃ vihāyāśu gaṃdharvo'bhūtsphuraddyuti ||34|| natvā śrīkṛṣṇaputrāṃstān dyotayan maṃḍalaṃ diśām || puṣpairvarṣatsu deveṣu vimānena divaṃ yayau ||35|| bahulāśva uvāca gaṃdharvo'yaṃ tu kaḥ pūrvaṃ kena pāpena sarpatām || prāptaḥ kathaṃ vada mune tvaṃ parāvaravittamaḥ ||36|| śrīnārada uvāca ārṣṭiṣeṇasya yo bhrātā sumatirnāma sundaraḥ || rāmāyaṇaṃ hanumatā paṭhituṃ sa samāgataḥ ||37|| hemakūṭe hanumataḥ kurvato rāmasevanam || prātaḥkālātsamārabhya ghaṭikāśca caturdaśa ||38|| salakṣmaṇaṃ rāmacaṃdraṃ dhyāyato jānakīpatim || phūtkāraiḥ sarpavattasya dhyānabhaṃgaṃ cakāra ha ||39|| tadā kruddho mahāvīro hanumān vānareśvaraḥ || śāpaṃ dadau sumataye tvaṃ sarpo bhava durmate || 40|| tadaiva tasya caraṇau natvā prāha kṛtāṃjaliḥ || he deva pāhi pāhīti dīnaṃ māṃ śaraṇaṃ gatam ||41|| atha prasanno bhagavānsumatiṃ prāha dharmavit || dvāpārāṃte śaraistīkṣṇairhariputradhanuścyutaiḥ || bhinnadehaḥ svāṃ prakṛtiṃ yāsyasi tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||42|| gaṃdharvaḥ sumatirnāma vimukto'bhūdvideharāṭ || satāṃ śāpo'pi varavadvaro mokṣārthadaḥ kimu ||43|| atha kārṣṇirmahābāhuścaitradeśānmanoharān || vasantamādhavīvṛṃdaiḥ śobhītānsa jagāma ha ||44|| sahasradalapadmānāṃ ṣaṭpadadhvaniśālinām || patanti reṇavo yatra saraḥsvābīracūrṇavat ||45|| elālavaṃgalatikā kṣuṇṇāḥ sainyāṅghribhiḥ pathi || tena bhṛṅgāvalī reje karikarṇapratāḍitā ||46|| yatra vai puruṣā rājannāgāyutasamā bale || valīpalitadaurgaṃdhyasvedaklamavivarjitāḥ ||47|| tretāyugasamāḥ kālo vartate yatra nityaśaḥ || āyuścāyutavarṣāṇāṃ divyauṣadhinadīguṇaiḥ ||48|| pīyūṣatulyaṃ toyaṃ ca hemabhūmirvirājate || muktāvidrumavaiḍūryaratnotpattiśca yatra vai ||49|| suṃdaryaḥ pramadā rāmā nityayauvanabhūṣitāḥ || sphuraṃtyupavaneṣvārātsaudāminyo ghaneṣviva ||50|| yatra vai nagarī ramyā vasaṃtatilakā śubhā || śṛṅgāratilako nāma rājā yatra mahābalaḥ ||51|| jaitrān vīrān samāhūya gajamāruhya daṃśitaḥ || yoddhuṃ viniryayau yaśca pradyumnasyāpi saṃmukhe ||52|| sāṃbaḥ sumitraḥ purujicchatajicca sahasrajit || vijayaścitraketuśca vasumāndraviḍaḥ kratuḥ ||53|| jāṃbavatyāḥ sutā hyete cakrurnārācadurdinam || palāyiteṣu caiteṣu bāṇairbhinneṣu maithila ||54|| bāṇāṃdhakāre saṃjāte mahānkolāhalo hyabhūt || tadā śṛṅgāratilako gajārūḍho mahābalaḥ ||55|| triśūlena tada sāmbaṃ hṛdi vivyādha roṣataḥ | anyānsaṃpātayāmāsa śaraiḥ kodaṃḍanirgataiḥ ||56|| ekākī vicaran yuddhe vane vaiśvānaro yathā || tadā gadaḥ samāgatya tadgajaṃ sumadotkaṭam ||57|| śuṃḍādaṃḍe saṃgṛhītvā pātayāmāsa bhūtale || dūre prapatitaḥ śīghraṃ śṛṅgāratilako nṛpaḥ ||58|| sadyo bhayāturo bhūtvā yuddhe baddhāṃjaliḥ svataḥ || turaṃgāṇāmarbudaṃ ca rathānāṃ lakṣameva ca ||59|| gajānāmayutaṃ rājā pradyumnāya baliṃ dadau || itthaṃ kiṃpuruṣaṃ khaṃḍaṃ jitvā kārṣṇirmahābalaḥ ||60|| niṣādadarśitairmārgairharivarṣaṃ tato yayau ||61|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde kiṃpuruṣakhaṇḍavijayo nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||26||
<7.27> śrīnārada uvāca harivarṣaṃ nāma khaṇḍaṃ sarvasaṃpattisaṃyutam || tasya sīmāgiriḥ sākṣānniṣadho nāma maithila ||1|| vīrakodaṃḍaṭaṃkāraghoṣairvyāptavanāṃtarāt || uḍḍītāstu mahāgṛdhrāḥ krośamātravapurdharāḥ ||2|| tīkṣṇatuṃḍāḥ sagaruḍāḥ sarve dīrghāyuṣo nṛpa || agrasansainikānnagānhayāṃste'pi bubhukṣitāḥ ||3|| ākāśe pakṣibhirvyāpte jāte pakṣaprabhaṃjane || senāyāmaṃdhakāreṇa hāhākāro mahānabhūt ||4|| tadā kārṣṇirmahābāhustārkṣyamastraṃ samādadhe || tadbāṇānnirgataḥ sākṣādvainatenayaḥ khageśvaraḥ ||5|| senāyāmaṃdhakāreṇa vyāptāyāṃ patageśvaraḥ || kāṃścittuṃḍaprahāreṇa kāṃścitpakṣaiḥ sphuratprabhaiḥ ||6|| gṛdhrānkuliṃgāngaruḍo pātayāmāsa bhūtale || bhagnadarpāśchinnapakṣā bhakṣitāḥ pakṣiṇaśca te ||7|| bhayāturā dudruvaste tārkṣyeṇāpi diśo daśa || tataḥ kārṣṇirmahābāhurdaśārṇān viṣayān yayau ||8|| daśārṇadeśādhipatiḥ śubhāṃgaḥ sūryavaṃśajaḥ || nāgāyutasamo yuddhe niṣkauśāṃbīpurīpatiḥ ||9|| vedavyāsamukhācchrutvā pradyumnaṃ caṃḍapauruṣam || daśārṇāṃ tāṃ nadīṃ dīrghāṃ samuttīrya samāyayau ||10|| kṛtāṃjaliḥ śubhāṃgo'sau kirīṭena natānanaḥ || dadau baliṃ suratnānāṃ pradyumnāya mahātmane ||11|| pradyumno bhagavān sākṣātsarvagaḥ sarvadarśanaḥ || papracchedaṃ śubhāṃgaṃ taṃ lokasaṃgrahakāmyayā ||12|| pradyumna uvāca daśārṇo'yaṃ kathaṃ deśaḥ kena nāmnā babhūva ha || etanme brūhi he rājanniṣkauśāṃbīpurīpate ||13|| śubhāṃga uvāca hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hatvā nṛsiṃho bhagavānpurā || prahlādena tvihāgatya harivarṣe sthito'bhavat ||14|| prahlādaṃ bhagavānprāha nṛsiṃho bhaktavatsalaḥ || nṛsiṃha uvāca śāṃtasya tava bhaktasya mayā putra pitā hataḥ || tasmānna ghātayiṣyāmi vaṃśaṃ te hi mahāmate ||15|| śubhāṃga uvāca iti pravadato'kṣibhyāmānaṃdajalabiṃdavaḥ || patitā kau ca tai rājan saro'bhūnmaṃgalāyanam ||16|| tadā prāptavaro rājan prahlādo harṣavihvalaḥ || nṛsiṃhaṃ prāha dharmātmā natvā bhūtvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ ||17|| prahlāda uvāca mātuḥ piturmayā sevā na kṛtā sātvatāṃpate || ṛṇāttayoḥ kathaṃ mucye vadaitatparameśvara ||18|| nṛsiṃha uvāca mannetrajalasaṃbhūte tīrthe vai maṃgalāyane || snānaṃ kuru mahābhāga mucyase daśabhirṛṇaiḥ ||19|| mātuḥ pituśca bhāryāyāḥ sutānāṃ gurudevayoḥ || viprāṇāṃ ca prapannānāmṛṣīṇāṃ pitṛṇāmṛṇam ||20|| yaḥ snāsyati mahātīrthe sarvahelanatatparaḥ || ṛṇaiśca daśabhiḥ so'pi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||21|| śubhāṃga uvāca daśārṇamocane tīrthe snātvā kāyādhavo'nṛṇī || bhūtvādyāpi samāyāti snātuṃ tanniṣadhādgireḥ ||22|| daśārṇamocane tīrthe daśārṇo deśa ucyate || tatsrotaḥsu samudbhūtā daśārṇeyaṃ nadī smṛtā ||23|| śrīnārada uvāca tacchrutvā bhagavānkārṣṇiḥ sarvaiḥ paricaraiḥ saha || daśārṇamocane tīrthe dānaṃ snānaṃ cakāra ha ||24|| daśārṇamocanasyāpi kathāṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyānnṛpa || ṛṇaiśca daśabhiḥ so'pi mucyate muktibhāgbhavet ||25|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde daśārṇadeśavijayo nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||27||
<7.28> śrīnārada uvāca || atha kārṣṇirmahābāhuḥ sumeroruttarānkurūn|| yayau śṛṃgavataḥ pārśve vicitrānṛddhisaṃvṛtān ||1|| bhadrāṃ gaṃgāṃ tataḥ snātvā vārāhīṃ nagarīṃ yayau || kurukhaṇḍādhipastasyāṃ cakravartī guṇākaraḥ || 2|| mahāsaṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro devarṣigaṇasaṃvṛtaḥ || aśvamedhaṃ samārebhe daśamaṃ sa guṇākaraḥ || 3 || tenotsṛṣṭaṃ hayaṃ śvetaṃ śyāmakarṇamanoharam || tasya putro vīradhanvā rakṣituṃ nirgatobhavat ||4|| akṣauhiṇībhirdaśabhirmaṃḍitaścaṃḍavikramaḥ || vicacāra mahāvīro vīkṣyamāṇasturaṃgamam||5|| vīraścaṃdraśca senaśca citragurvegavānnṛpaḥ|| āmaḥ śaṃkurvasuḥśrīmānkuṃtīnāgnajiteḥ sutāḥ||6|| sarvatastaṃ hayaṃ śubhraṃ grahītvā harṣa pūritāḥ || kasyotsṛṣṭaṃ vadaṃtaste kārṣṇisainyaṃ samāyayuḥ || 7 || pradyumnastadbhālapatraṃ paṭhitvā vismitobhavat || sarve visismuryadavo gṛhītaparamāyudhāḥ || 8 || tadaiva senā saṃprāptā vicinvaṃtī hayaṃ nṛpa || dṛṣṭvā rajoyadubalāddūre tasthau suvismitā ||9|| guṇākare rājani caṇḍavikrame na dasyavaḥ syuḥ kurukhaṇḍa maṇḍale || gavāṃ na kālo na hi cakravātakaḥ kuto rajaḥprāptamahorkamaṇḍalam ||7.28.10|| evaṃ vadaṃtī paravāhinīsvataḥ kodaṃḍaghoṣaṃ daradasvanaṃ param|| karīṃdracītkāra turaṃgaheṣaṇaṃ vāditramiśraṃ samupāśṛṇottataḥ ||11|| tadoddhavaḥ kṛṣṇasutapraṇodito balaṃ sametyāśu sa vīradhanvanaḥ || praṇamya taṃ prāha rathāsthitaṃ nṛpaṃ guṇākarasyaurasamarkatejasam || 12 || ugrasenaḥ kṣitīśeṃdro dvārakeśo yadūttamaḥ || jaṃbūdvīpanṛpāñjitvā rājasūyaṃ kariṣyati || 13 || tena praṇodito vīraḥ pradyumno dhanvināṃ varaḥ || jitvā taṃ bhārataṃ khaṇḍaṃ tathā kiṃpuruṣaṃ nṛpaḥ ||14|| harivarṣaṃ tato jitvā kurukhaṇḍaṃ samāgataḥ || pradāsyati baliṃ sopi pradyumnāya mahātmane || 15 || akṣauhiṇīdaśayuto dhanadenāpi pūjitaḥ || upāyanaṃ tvayā deyaṃ pradyumnāya mahātmane || 16 || tena nītaṃ yajñapaśumāhartuṃ kaḥ kṣamaḥ kṣitau || śrīkṛṣṇacandro bhagavānsahāyastasya vidyate || 17 || śubhaṃ syāddānamānābhyāṃ na cedyuddhaṃ bhaviṣyati || vīradhanvovāca || guṇākaro nṛpeśo yaḥ śakreṇāpi prapūjitaḥ || 18 || na dāsyati baliṃ sopi pradyumnāya mahātmane || śṛṃgavatparvate ramye vārāho vidyate hariḥ || 19 || yasya sevāṃ sadā bhūmiḥ karoti paramādarāt || yasya kṣetre tapastepe dhyātvā devaṃ guṇākaraḥ || 7.28.20 || varṣāṇāmayute pūrṇe harirvārāharūpadhṛk || santuṣṭo nṛpatiṃ bhaktaṃ varaṃ brūhītyuvāca ha || 21 || rājovāca hariṃ natvā romāṃcapremavihvalaḥ || bhagavaṃstvāmṛte devo suronyopi narotha vā || 22 || māṃ jetā na bhavedbhūmāvīpsitoyaṃ varo mayā || tathāstu coktvā bhagavāṃstatraivāṃtaradhīyata || 23 || tasmāttasya yaśaḥ śīghraṃ kartavyaṃ mocanaṃ svataḥ || na cedbhavadbhiśca kaliṃ kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 24 || śrīnārada uvāca || ityukta uddhavastasmātsvāṃ senāmetya bhūpate || śaśaṃsa sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yadūnāṃ sadasi tvaram || 25 || śrutakarmā vṛṣo vīraḥ subāhurbhadraekalaḥ || śāṃtirdarśaḥpūrṇamāsaḥ somako vara eva ca || 26 || kālindīnaṃdanā hyete pradyumnasya prapaśyataḥ || akṣauhiṇībhirdaśabhirvṛtā yoddhuṃ samāgatāḥ || 27 || uttarekurubhiḥ sārddhaṃ yadūnāṃ caṃḍavikramaiḥ || babhūva tumulaṃ yuddhamabdhīnāmabdhibhiryathā || 28 || sphuradbhirniśitaiḥ śastrai rejire varipuṃgavāḥ || kṣaṇamātreṇa rudhiraprabhavā raudrarūpiṇī || 29 || nadī babhūva rājeṃdra śatayojanavistṛtā || vidudruvustadā śeṣā uttarākuravo janāḥ || 7.28.30 || śaratkāle yathā prāpte meghasaṃghā itastataḥ || pūrṇamāso mahāvīraḥ kāliṃdīnaṃdano balī || 31 || cūrṇayāmāsa bāṇaughaiḥ syaṃdanaṃ vīradhanvanaḥ || vīradhanvāpi viratho dhanuṣṭaṃkārayanmuhuḥ || 32 || jaghāna bāṇaviṃśatyā pūrṇamāsaṃ mahābalam || pūrṇamāsaḥ svabāṇena madhyatastāndvidhā'karot ||33|| vīradhanvātha ciccheda dhanurjyāṃ tasya nādinīm|| bāṇenaikena rājeṃdra kuvākyeneva mitratām||34|| lakṣabhāramayīṃ gurvī gadāmādāya satvaram || jaghāna vīradhanvānaṃ pūrṇamāso mahābalaḥ ||35|| gadāprahāravyathito vīradhanvā madotkaṭaḥ || parigheṇa jaghānā śu pūrṇamāsaṃ haresutaḥ ||36|| pūrṇamāsaḥ samutthāya pavanaṃ nāma parvatam || samutpāṭya sthito bhūtvā hastābhyāṃ śrīharesutaḥ||37|| bhrāmayitvātha cikṣepa vārāhyāṃ puri vegataḥ ||38|| vīradhanvā prapatito guṇākarakratusthale || mūrcchito bhagnavegobhūdudvamanrudhiraṃ mukhāt|| 39 || hāhākāro mahānāsīdvārāhyāṃ purivegataḥ || devaduṃdubhayo nedurnaraduṃdubhayastadā ||7.28.40|| pūrṇamāsopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire|| yajñādutthāya nṛpatiḥ putraṃ dṛṣṭvā ca mūrcchitam || 41 || gṛhītvā divyakodaṃḍaṃ yuddhaṃ kartuṃ mano dadhe || hotā dharmavidāṃ śreṣṭho munīṃdraḥ sarvavitkaviḥ || gaṃtumabhyutthitaṃ vīkṣya vāmadevastamabravīt || 42 || vāmadeva uvāca || rājaṃstvaṃ hi na jānāsi paripūrṇatamaṃ harim || surāṇāṃ mahadarthāya jātaṃ yadukule svayam || bhuvo bhārāvatārāya bhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || 43 || bhūtvā yadukule sākṣāddvārakāyāṃ virājate || tena kṛṣṇena putroyaṃ pradyumno yādaveśvaraḥ || ugrasenamakhārthāya jagajjetuṃ praṇoditaḥ || 44 || guṇākara uvāca || paripūrṇatamasyāpi śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ || lakṣaṇaṃ vada me brahmaṃstvaṃ parāvaravittamaḥ || 45 || || vāmadeva uvāca || yasminsarvāṇi tejāṃsi vilīyaṃte svatejasi || taṃ vadaṃti paraṃ sākṣātparipūrṇatamaṃ harim || 46 || aṃśāṃśoṃśastathāveśaḥ kalā pūrṇaḥ prakathyate || vyāsādyaiśca smṛtaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam ||47|| paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo nānya eva hi || ekakāryārthamāgatya koṭikāryaṃ cakāra ha || 48 || śrīnārada uvāca || śrutvā kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ baliṃ nītvā guṇākaraḥ || vairaṃ visṛjya pradyumnadarśanārthaṃ samāyayau || 49 || kārṣṇiṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya natvā dattvā baliṃ tataḥ || aśrupūrṇamukho bhūtvā prāha gadgadayā girā || 7.28.50 || guṇākara uvāca || adya me saphalaṃ janma kulaṃ medyadine śubham|| adya kratukriyāḥ sarvāḥ saphalāstava darśanāt||51|| tvadaṃghribhaktiḥ paramārthalakṣaṇā sadā bhavetsajjanasaṃgamātparā|| tvameva sākṣānnijabhaktavatsalaḥ pareśabhūmanparipāhi pāhi || 52 || pradyumna uvāca || jñānavairāgyasaṃyuktā bhaktiste premalakṣaṇā || madbhaktasaṃgamo bhūyācchrīḥ syādbhāgavatāṃ tviha || ||53|| śrīnārada uvāca || ityuktvā bhagavānkārṣṇiḥ prasanno bhaktavatsalaḥ || dadau tasmai nṛpataye hayamedhaturaṃgamam || 54 || iti śrīmadgargasaṃhitāyāṃ viśvajitkhaṃḍe nāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde uttarakurukhaṃḍavijayonāmāṣṭāviṃśodhyāyaḥ || 28 ||
<7.29> śrīnārada uvāca pradyumno'tha mahābāhurjitvā''rāduttarānkurun || hiraṇmayaṃ nāma khaṃḍaṃ jetuṃ kārṣṇirjagāma ha ||1|| yatra sīmāgirirdīrghaḥ sroto nāma sphuraddyutiḥ || tatra kūrmo hariḥ sākṣādaryamā yasya deśikaḥ ||2|| puṣpamālānadītīre nāmnā citravanaṃ mahat || sapuṣpaphalabhārāḍhyaṃ kandamūlanidhiḥ svataḥ ||3|| vānarāḥ saṃti tatrāpi vaṃśajā nalanīlayoḥ || nyastāḥ śrīrāmacandreṇa tretāyāṃ maithileśvara ||4|| sainyaghoṣaṃ ca taṃ śrutvā yuddhakāmā vinirgatāḥ || pradyumnasainye cotpeturbhrūbhaṃgaiḥ krodhamūrcchitāḥ ||5|| nakhairdaṃtaiśca lāṃgūlairgajānaśvānnarānnṛpa || lāṃgūlaiśca rathānbadhvā cikṣipuścāṃbare balāt ||6|| vijayadhvajanāthasya vijayaścārjunasya ca || rathaṃ baddhvātha lāṃgūle kecidutpeturaṃbare ||7|| kapidhvajadhvaje sākṣātkapīṃdro bhagavānprabhuḥ || krodhāḍhyaḥ phālgunasakhaḥ samagraṃ sarvato diśam ||8|| lāṃgūlena ca tānbaddhvā pātayāmāsa bhūtale || tadā praharṣitāḥ sarve jñātvā śrīrāmakiṃkarāḥ ||9|| nemustaṃ sarvato rājan kṛtāṃjalipuṭāḥ śanaiḥ || kecidāliṃganaṃ cakruḥ kecidutpeturojasā ||10|| keciccucuṃburlāṃgūlaṃ kecitpādaṃ ca vānarāḥ || tānāliṃgya mahāvīrāḥ spṛṣṭvā satpāṇinā punaḥ ||11|| datvā''śiṣaṃ tatkuśalaṃ papracchāthāṃjanīsutaḥ || natvā taṃ vānarāḥ sarve jagmuścitravanaṃ nṛpa ||12|| hanumānarjunasyāpi dhvaje hyaṃtaradhīyata || makarākhyāttato deśātpradyumno mīnaketanaḥ ||13|| yayau vṛṣṇivaraiḥ sārddhaṃ dundubhīn vādayanmuhuḥ || makarasya gireḥ pārśve dundubhidhvanibhistataḥ ||14|| madhubhakṣyā madhukarāḥ koṭiśaḥ prothitāḥ kila || tairdaṃśitaṃ balaṃ sarvaṃ hasticītkārasaṃyutam ||15|| tadā kārṣṇirmahābāhuḥ pavanāstraṃ samādadhe || tadvātatāḍītā rājangatāste'pi diśo daśa ||16|| tatra deśe janā rājan sarve vai makarānanāḥ || tatastu ḍiṃḍibho deśastatra hastimukhā janāḥ ||17|| evaṃ deśāṃstataḥ paśyaṃstriśṛṅgaviṣayāngataḥ || kārṣṇirdadarśa tatrāpi manuṣyā śṛṅgadhāriṇaḥ ||18|| triśṛṅgasya gireḥ pārśve nagarīṃ svarṇacarcikām || hemasaudhamayīṃ divyāṃ ratnaprākāramaṃḍitām ||19|| hiraṇyavarṇaiḥ puruṣaiḥ strījanaiśca taḍiddyubhiḥ || nāgaiśca nāgakanyābhiḥ purīṃ bhogavatīmiva ||20|| candrakāṃtānadītīre śobhitāṃ maṃgalālayām || kārṣṇiḥ samāyayau rājan yathā śakro'marāvatīm ||21|| tatra rājā mahāvīro nāmnā devasakho balī || sa manmukhādbalaṃ śrutvā baliṃ nītvā hiraṇmayam ||22|| pradyumnaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhaktyā paramayā punaḥ || taṃ papraccha mahābāhuḥ pradyumno bhagavānhariḥ ||23|| candravatte kathaṃ śobhā sarveṣāṃ ca vadāśu me || devasakhā uvāca aryamṇā pitṛpatinā kūrmarūpasya māpateḥ ||24|| aṅghrīprakṣalitau tena vāriṇābhūnmahānadī || śvetaparvataśṛṅgāccāvataraṃtī yadūttama ||25|| pramedhākhyo manusuto gopālo guruṇā kṛtaḥ || jaghāna kapilāṃ rātrāvasitāṃ siṃhaśaṃkayā ||26|| vasiṣṭhena tadā śaptaḥ śūdratvaṃ samupāgataḥ || kuṣṭhena pīḍitatanuḥ paryaṭaṃstīrthamācaran ||27|| asyāṃ nadyāṃ yadā snāto galatkuṣṭhānmanoḥ sutaḥ || mukto'bhūccandravattasya dehaśobhā babhūva ha ||28|| candrakāṃtā nadī ceyaṃ prasiddhā'bhūddhiraṇmaye || tasyāṃ mukto yataḥ snātvā galatkuṣṭhānmanoḥ sutaḥ ||29|| tataḥ snānaṃ ca kartāro vayaṃ sarve nṛpottama || rūpeṇa candratulyāḥ kau bhavāmo'tra na saṃśayaḥ ||30|| śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvā mahābāhu pradyumno yādavaiḥ saha || candrakāṃtāṃ nadīṃ snātvā dadau dānānyanekaśaḥ ||31|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde hiraṇmayakhaṃḍavijayo nāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||29||
<7.30> śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ khaṃḍaṃ jitvā kārṣṇirmahābalaḥ || jagāma ramyakaṃ khaṃḍaṃ devalokamiva sphuran ||1|| tasya sīmāgiriḥ sākṣānnīlo nāma nagādhirāṭ || tatrottare kāladeśe nagarī bhīmanādinī ||2|| kālanemisutastatra kalaṃko nāma rākṣasaḥ || tretāyuge rāmacandrādbhīto yuddhātpalāyitaḥ ||3|| laṃkāpuryyā ihāgatya vāsakṛdrākṣasaiḥ saha || rakṣasāmayutenāsau yuddhāya kṛtaniścayaḥ ||4|| kharārūḍhaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇo yadūnāṃ balamāyayau || yadūnāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca ghoraṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva ha ||5|| praghoṣo gātravān siṃho balaḥ prabala ūrdhvagaḥ || saha ojo mahāśaktiraparājita eva ca ||6|| lakṣmaṇānaṃdanā hyete śrīkṛṣṇasya sutāḥ śubhāḥ || sarveṣāmagrataḥ prāptā bāṇaistīkṣṇaiḥ sphuratprabhaiḥ ||7|| rākṣasānāṃ balaṃ jaghnurvāyuvegairyathā ghanam || bāṇaughaiśchinnabhinnāṃgā rākṣasā raṇadurmadāḥ ||8|| triśūlānāṃ mudgarāṇāṃ varṣaṃ cakrurmadotkaṭāḥ || kalaṃkastu tadā prāptaścarvayanvāraṇān rathān ||9|| hayānnarānsaśastrāstrānmukhe cikṣepa satvaram || gajānpādeṣu connīya sanīḍān ratnakaṃbalān ||10|| ghaṃṭānādasamāyuktānprākṣipaccāṃbare balāt || praghoṣaḥ śrīhareḥ putraḥ kapīṃdrāstraṃ samādadhe ||11|| tadbāṇanirgataḥ sākṣādvāyuputro mahābalaḥ || vātastūlamivākāśe cikṣepa śatayojanam ||12|| hanumaṃtaṃ tadā jñātvā kalaṃko rākṣaseśvaraḥ || lakṣabhāramayīṃ gurvīṃ gadāṃ cikṣepa nādayan ||13|| utpapāta kapirvegādgadā bhūmau papāta ha || ūtpatan vānarādhīśo bhrūbhaṃgaṃ kārayanmuhuḥ ||14|| muṣṭinā ghātayitvā taṃ kirīṭaṃ tasya cādade || kalaṃko'pi tadā tasmai triśūlaṃ svaṃ samādade ||15|| utpatansa kapirvegāt pṛṣṭhideśaṃ papāta ha || hanumāṃstaṃ tadā dorbhyāṃ pātayitvā mahītale ||16|| vaidūryaparvataṃ nītvā tasyopari samākṣipat || giripātena cūrṇāṃgo marditaḥ paṃcatāṃ yayau ||17|| tadā jayajayārāvaḥ śaṃkhadhvaniyuto'bhavat || hanumān bhagavān sākṣāttatraivāṃtaradhīyata ||18|| pradyumnasyopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire || atha kārṣṇirmahābāhuḥ svasainyaparivāritaḥ ||19|| manoharāṃ svarṇamayīṃ mānavīṃ nagarīṃ yayau || naiḥśreyasavanaṃ tatra kalpavṛkṣalatāvṛtam ||20|| haricaṃdanamaṃdārapārijātopaśobhitam || saṃtānamodasaṃmiśravāyubhiḥ surabhīkṛtam ||21|| ketakīcaṃpakalatākuṭajaiḥ parisevitam || mādhavīnāṃ latājālaiḥ puṣpitaiḥ saphalairvṛtam ||22|| nadadvihaṃgālikulairvaikuṃṭhamiva suṃdaram || yojanānāṃ paṃcaśataṃ laṃbitaṃ cārudhiṃ girim ||23|| adho'dhaḥ śobhitaṃ rājañchatayojanavistṛtam || puṃskokilaiḥ kokilaiśca mayūraiḥ sārasaiḥ śukaiḥ ||24|| cakravākaiścakoraiśca haṃsairdātyūhakūjitam || sarvartupuṣpaśobhāḍhyamākṣipannaṃdanaṃ vanam || 25|| mṛgaśāvā ramaṃte vai śārdūlaiḥ saha maithila || nakulāḥ phaṇibhiḥ sārddhaṃ yatra vairavivarjitāḥ ||26|| ayutaṃ sarasāṃ yatra bhramaradhvanisaṃyutam || sahasrapatraiḥ kamalaiḥ śatapatraiḥ sphuratprabhaiḥ ||27|| itastato vartamānamānaṃdamiva mūrtimat || tadvanaṃ suṃdaraṃ dṛṣṭvā nirgatānnagarījanān || papraccha vāṃchitaṃ sākṣātpradyumnaḥ sarvavitkaviḥ ||28|| śrīpradyumna uvāca kasyeyaṃ nagarī ramyā kasyedaṃ vanamadbhutam || vadatāśu savistāraṃ he lokāḥ puṇyaśāsanāḥ ||29|| janā ūcuḥ vaivasvato manurnāma yo hyevaṃ vartate nṛpa || mānave ca girau ramye matsyaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim ||30|| vartamānaṃ sadā natvā karoti vipulaṃ tapaḥ || tasyeyaṃ nagarī ramyā tasya naiḥśreyasaṃ vanam ||31|| vaikuṇṭhācca samānītā bhūmiścāyaṃ giristathā || yūyaṃ sarve'pi rājānastasya vaṃśabhavāḥ kṣitau || sūryavaṃśāṃtare rājaṃścandravaṃśāṃtare hi bhoḥ ||32|| śrīnārada uvāca kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vṛddhaṃ taṃ prapitāmaham || śrāddhadevaṃ manuṃ jñātvā vismito'bhūddhareḥ sutaḥ ||33|| śrutvā vacastadā sadyo bhrātṛbhiryadubhirvṛtaḥ || mānavādriṃ samāruhya śrāddhadevaṃ dadarśa ha ||34|| śatasūryaprabhaṃ kāṃtyā dyotayaṃtaṃ diśo daśa || mahāyogamayaṃ sākṣādrājeṃdraṃ śāṃtarūpiṇam ||35|| vedavyāsaśukādyaiśca vasiṣṭhadhiṣaṇādibhiḥ || parasparaṃ mahārāja śṛṇvantaṃ śrīhareryaśaḥ ||36|| nanāma karṣṇiryadubhiḥ sahaiva taṃ kṛtāṃjalistatra samāsthito'bhavat || manuḥ samutthāya hareḥ prabhāvaviddattvā''sanaṃ gadgadayā girābravīt ||37|| manuruvāca namaste vāsudevāya namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca || pradyumnāyāniruddhāya sātvatāṃ pataye namaḥ ||38|| anādirātmā puruṣastvameva tvaṃ nirguṇo'si prakṛteḥ parastvam || sadā vaśīkṛtya balātpradhānaṃ guṇaiḥ sṛjasyatsi ca pāsi viśvam ||39|| tato vivekaṃ sa vihāya sarvato matvākhilaṃ cātra manomayaṃ jagat || māyāparaṃ nirguṇamādipūruṣaṃ sarvajñamādyaṃ puruṣaṃ sanātanam ||40|| jāgarti yo'smiñchayanaṃ gate sati nāyaṃ jano veda sataḥ paraṃ tam || paśyaṃtamādyaṃ puruṣaṃ hi yajjano na paśyati svacchamalaṃ ca taṃ bhaje ||41|| yathā nabho'gniḥ pavano na sajjate ghaṭe na kāṣṭhe na rajobhirāvṛtaiḥ || tathā bhavānsarvaguṇaiśca nirmalo varṇairyathā syātsphaṭiko mahojjvalaḥ ||42|| vyaṃgena vā lakṣaṇayā ca vākpathairarthaṃ padaṃ sphoṭaparāyaṇaiḥ param || na jñāyate yaddhaninottamena sadvācyena tadbrahma kutastu laukikaiḥ ||43|| vadanti kecidbhuvi karmakatṛ yatkālaṃ ca kecitparayogameva tat || kecidvicāraṃ pravadanti yacca tadbrahmeti vedāṃtavido vadanti ||44|| yaṃ na spṛśaṃtīha guṇā na kālajā jñānendriyaṃ cittamano na buddhayaḥ || mahanna vedo vadatīti tatparaṃ viśaṃti sarve'nalavisphuliṃgavat ||45|| hiraṇyagarbhaṃ paramātmatatvaṃ yadvāsudevaṃ pravadanti saṃtaḥ || evaṃvidhaṃ tvāṃ puruṣottamottamaṃ matvā sadāhaṃ vicarāmyasaṅgaḥ ||46|| śrīnārada uvāca manorvākyaṃ tadā śrutvā pradyumno bhagavānhariḥ || mandasmito manuṃ prāha gīrbhiḥ saṃmohayanniva ||47|| pradyumna uvāca tvaṃ no guruḥ kṣatriyāṇāmādirājaḥ pitāmahaḥ || matpūjanīyo vṛddho'si ślāghyo dharmadhuraṃdharaḥ ||48|| vaḥ prajāśca vayaṃ rājan rakṣyāḥ pālyāśca sarvataḥ || bhavatā tapyate divyaṃ tapastena jagatsukham ||49|| mṛgyastvatsadṛśaḥ sādhuḥ paramātmā hariḥ svayam || nṛṇāmaṃtastamohārī sādhureva na bhāskaraḥ ||50|| śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā bhagavān kārṣṇiranujñāpya praṇamya tam || parikramya manuṃ rājan svayaṃ bhūmau jagāma ha |51|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde mānavadeśavijayo nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||30||
<7.31> śrīnārada ūcuḥ itthaṃ tu ramyakaṃ khaṃḍaṃ jitvā kārṣṇirmahābalaḥ || sumeroḥ pūrvadigbhāge ketumālaṃ jagāma ha ||1|| tasya sīmāgiriḥ sākṣānmālyavānnāma maithila || caturnāmnī yatra gaṃgā mahāpātakanāśinī ||2|| girermālyāvataḥ pārśve purī manmathaśālinī || ratnaprākārasaudheśca devadhānīva śobhitā ||3|| yatra vai puruṣā rājankāmadevasamaprabhāḥ || śāradendīvaraśyāmāḥ padmapatranibhekṣaṇāḥ ||4|| pītāṃbaradharā nāryaḥ puṣpahāramanoharāḥ || krīḍaṃti kaṃdukairyatra kāminyo navayauvanāḥ ||5|| yaddehāmodapavano mattālikulanāditaḥ || gaṃdhīkaroti bhūbhāgaṃ samantācchatayojanām ||6|| tatpurīvāsino lokā nirgatāste bahuśrutaḥ || jaguryaśaḥ śrīmurāreḥ pradyumnasyāpi śṛṇvatāḥ ||7|| ketumālavāsina ūcuḥ āsīttu śeṣaśayano jagadārttihārī sākṣātpradhānapuruṣeśvara ādidevaḥ || yaḥ prārthitaḥ suravarairbhuvanāvanāya tasmai namo bhagavate puruṣottamāya ||8|| jāto gataḥ pitṛgṛhātpitarau vimokṣya naṃdālayaṃ śiśutanuḥ sa tu naṃdapatnyā || saṃlālitaḥ saghṛṇayā bahumaṃgalaśrīḥ prāṇaprahāramakarotkila pūtanāyāḥ ||9|| bālo babhañja śakaṭaṃ śayanaṃ prakurvandaityaṃ nipātya mahadadbhutakaṃ ca pṛṣṭhe || mātre pradarśya nijarūpamalaṃkṛto'bhūdgargeṇa saṃkathitasuṃdarabhāgyalakṣmīḥ ||10|| saṃlālito vrajajanairnavanītacauraḥ śyāmo manoharavapurmṛdulaḥ sa bālaḥ || bhitvā jaghāsa dadhipātramatīva dadhno vṛkṣau babhaṃja jananīlaghudāmabaddhaḥ ||11|| vṛṃdāvane sa vicaran saha vatsagopairvatsāsuraṃ ca vinipātya kapitthavṛkṣaiḥ || sadyo vigṛhya kharatuṇḍapuṭe ca dorbhyāṃ daityaṃ dadāra sa bakaṃ tṛṇavattaṭinyām ||12|| saṃdhārayaṃśca śiśubhirbahuvatsasaṃghān veṇuṃ kvaṇanmadanamohanaveṣabhṛdyaḥ || gopānaghāsuramukhe prahitāñjugopa gogopavatsapavapuḥ sa cakāra sadyaḥ ||13|| kṣetrajña ātmapuruṣo bhagavānanaṃtaḥ pūrṇaḥ pradhānapuruṣeśvara ādidevaḥ || dhṛtvā vapuḥ sa viharanvrajabālakeṣu sammohayanvidhimajo vicacāra kṛṣṇaḥ ||14|| cikṣepa dhenukamasau balinaṃ balena tāle pragṛhya sahasā phaṇikāliyākhyam || babhrāma vahnimapibaddanujaṃ pralaṃbaṃ sadyo jaghāna sa balī dṛḍhamuṣṭinā ca ||15|| saṃcārayanvrajavadhūrmadhuraṃ kvaṇan yo veṇuṃ vane vrajavadhūnijagītakīrtiḥ || divyāṃbarāṇi sa jahāra varāṃganānāṃ viprāṃganābhirabhitaḥ kṛtabhaktabhojaḥ ||16|| deve ca varṣati paśūnkṛpayā rirakṣurgovardhanaṃ prakṛtabāla ivocchilīṃdhram || bibhradgiriṃ sa gajarāḍiva kaṃjamekahaste śacīpativacobhirataḥ stuto'bhūt ||17|| nandaṃ jugopa varuṇātsvajanāya lokaṃ divyaṃ paraṃ ca tamaso divi darśayitvā || śrīrāsamaṇḍalagato vrajasundarīṇāṃ reme pulindataṭinīpuline'ṅganābhiḥ ||18|| mānaṃ haranmadanayauvanamāninīnāmaṃtardadhe vrajavadhūnijagītakīrtiḥ || sragvī manoharavapurvirahāturāṇāṃ sākṣāddharirmadanamohana āvirāsīt ||19|| vṛndāvane śabararājavarāṃganābhirviṣṇurvibhūtibhiriva dyubhirādidevaḥ || reme stutaḥ suravaraiḥ sa ca rāsaraṃge keyūrakuṇḍalakirīṭaviṭaṃkaveṣaḥ ||20|| naṃdaṃ vimokṣya phaṇine pradadau ca mokṣaṃ divyaṃ maṇiṃ sa ca jahāra ha śaṃkhacūḍāt || gopastuto vṛṣabharūpadharaṃ hyariṣṭaṃ bhūmau nipātya nijaghāna kareṇa śṛṅge ||21|| kaṃsaḥ paraṃ bhayamavāpa ca tena keśī saṃpreṣitaḥ saghanameghavapuḥ pracaṃḍaḥ || utsṛjya taṃ ca tarasā punarāpataṃtaṃ śrībāhunā mukhagatena jaghāna kṛṣṇaḥ ||22|| yo nāradena bahuvarṇitabhāgyalakṣmīrvyomasuro vyasurakāri pareṇa yena || akrūravarṇitamahodaya ādidevo gopījanātivirahāturacittacauraḥ ||23|| śvāphalkaye hitakarāya nijaṃ svarupamaṃtardadhe jalacaye sa ca darśayitvā || sa prāpa tatra mathuropavanaṃ pareśo gopālakaiśca sabalo mathurāṃ dadarśa ||24|| svairaṃ caranmadhupure rajakaṃ nikṛtya kṛṣṇaḥ pradāya ca varānatha vāyakāya || mālākṛtaṃ samanukaṃpya cakāra kubjāmṛjvīṃ dhanuśca sahasā namayanbabhaṃja ||25|| dvāri dvipañca vinihatya narendra mallau hatvā pragṛhya vinipātya sa raṃgabhūmau || kaṃsaṃ haristu pitarāvatha mocayitvā baṃdhānnṛpaṃ puri cakāra mahograsenam ||26|| naṃdaṃ prasādya bahudānakaro yadūstānāhūya tarpya sudhanaiśca nivedayitvā || vidyāmadhītya sa dadau pramṛtaṃ hyapatyaṃ kṛtvā vadhaṃ danujapañcajanasya kṛṣṇaḥ ||27|| gopījanānsamanugṛhya sa coddhavenākrūreṇa hāstinapure tvatha pāṃḍuputrān || kṛṣṇo vijitya balinaṃ ca jarāsutaṃ ca bhasmīcakāra mucakundadṛśā''tmakālam ||28|| nirmāya cādbhutapuraṃ sthitaye'tra kṛṣṇo ninye ca kuṇḍinapurātkila bhīṣmakanyām || putreṇa śaṃbaramariṃ nijaghāna cādādrājñe maṇīṃ yudhi vijitya sa ṛkṣarājam ||29|| bhāmāpatiḥ sa ca śiraḥ śatadhanvanastu hṛtvā hyuvāha savituśca sutāṃ pareśaḥ || āvaṃtyarājatanujāṃ sa jahāra kṛṣṇaḥ satyāṃ svayaṃvaragṛhe vṛṣabhāndamitvā ||30|| kaikeyarājatanujāṃ sa jahāra bhadrāṃ śrīlakṣmaṇāmakhilabhadrapate sutāṃ ca || bhaumaṃ vijitya sabalaṃ yudhi śastrasaṃghairninye ca ṣoḍaśasahasravarāṃganāśca ||31|| bhāmecchayā surataruṃ ca sabhāṃ sudharmāṃ śakraṃ vijitya sa jahāra kalatramitraḥ || yo rukmiṇaṃ ca nijaghāna balena goṣṭhyāṃ bāṇasya bāhunicayaṃ śatadhācchinatsaḥ ||32|| tenograsenakratave'tha jagadvijetuṃ saṃpreṣito nijasutaḥ kila śaṃbarāriḥ || yo'trāgato bhuvi vijitya nṛpānsamastān śrīketumālapataye ca namo'stu tasmai ||33|| śrīnārada uvāca prasannaḥ śrīhariḥ kārṣṇiḥ kuṃḍale kaṭakāni ca || hīrān maṇīn gajānaśvān dadau tebhyo mahāmanāḥ ||34|| puryāṃ manmathaśālinyāṃ vyatisaṃvatsaro mahān || pradyumnāya baliṃ prādānnamaskṛtya prajāpatiḥ ||35|| atha kārṣṇirmahābāhurdivyaṃ kāmavanaṃ yayau || janairagamyaṃ gamyaṃ ca prajāpatiduhitṛbhiḥ ||36|| suṃdaraṃ manmathākrīḍaṃ vṛtaṃ kāmāstratejasā || nārīṇāṃ yatra patati vyasurgarbho na vatsaram ||37|| tadā parātkāmavanādvinirgataḥ śrīpuṣpadhanvā nṛpa paṃcasāyakaḥ || pītāmbaraśyāmatanurmanoharastatāna kodaṃḍaguṇadhvaniṃ smaraḥ ||38|| yadbāṇato yādavapuṃgavāḥ svataḥ sasainikāḥ sāśvagajāḥ padātibhiḥ || nipeturārātkila kāmavihvalāstadbāṇavegasya na varṇanaṃ bhavet ||39|| athāśu kārṣṇirjagadīśvareśvaraḥ pralīnatāṃ prāpa jale jalaṃ yathā || sadyo visismuryadavaḥ sasainikā vijñāya pūrṇaṃ nṛpa rukmiṇīsutam ||40|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde manmathadeśa vijayo nāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||31||
<7.32> śrīnārada uvāca atha kārṣṇirmahābāhuḥ ketumālaṃ vijitya saḥ || bhadrāśvaṃ prayayau dhanvī khaṃḍaṃ yogasamṛddhimat ||1|| yasya sīmāgiriḥ sākṣādrājate gandhamādanaḥ || sītānāmnī yatra gaṃgā vahaṃtī pāpanāśinī ||2|| vedakṣetre mahātīrthe sarvapāpapramocane || hayagrīvo mahābāhuryatra saṃnihito hariḥ ||3|| bhadraśravā dharmasutastasya sevāṃ karoti hi || gaṃgātīrasya puline pradyumnasya mahātmanaḥ || babhūvuḥ śibiravyūhā hemāṃbaramanoharāḥ ||4|| bhadraśravā dharmasuto mahātmā bhadrāśvadeśādhipatirmahaujāḥ || pradakṣiṇīkṛtya nanāma bhaktyā datvā baliṃ kṛṣṇasutāya cāha ||5|| bhadraśravā uvāca tvaṃ sākṣādbhagavānpūrṇaḥ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam || sādhūnāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya jagajjetuṃ vinirgataḥ ||6|| bhagavañchaṃbaro nāma daityaḥ pūrvaṃ jitastvayā || tasya bhrātā mahāduṣṭaḥ kanīyānutkacaḥ smṛtaḥ ||7|| gokule kṛṣṇacaṃdreṇa māritaḥ śakaṭasthitaḥ || tasya bhrātā mahāduṣṭo jyeṣṭho'sti śakunirbalī ||8|| jetuṃ yogyastvayā deva nānyairapi kadācana || śrīpradyumna uvāca kasya vaṃśe samudbhūtaḥ śakunirnāma daityarāṭ ||9|| kasminpure sthitistasya balaṃ kiṃ vada dharmaja || bhadraśravā uvāca kaśyapasya munerdityāmādidaityau babhūvatuḥ ||10|| hiraṇyakaśipurjyeṣṭho hiraṇyākṣo'nujastathā || hiraṇyākṣasya tasyāpi babhūvurnava putrakāḥ ||11|| śakuniḥ śaṃbaro hṛṣṭo bhūtasaṃtāpano vṛkaḥ || kālanābho mahānābho hariśmaśrustathotkacaḥ ||12|| devakūṭāddakṣiṇe hi jaṭharasya gireradhaḥ || purī candrāvatī nāma daityānāṃ durgamaṃḍitā ||13|| śakunistatra vasati bhrātṛbhiḥ ṣaḍbhirāvṛtaḥ || yadā yadā hi munayo yajñārambhaṃ prakurvate ||14|| tadā tadā hi tenāpi bhaṃgo'kāri yadūttama || yasmācca saṃti śakrādyā udvignāḥ sātvatāṃpate ||15|| jetuṃ yogyastvayā deva devadhrugdaityapuṃgavaḥ || tvayā jitaṃ jagatsarvaṃ bhaktānāṃ śāṃtikāraṇāt ||16|| pradyumnāya namastubhyaṃ caturvyūhāya te namaḥ || goviprasurasādhūnāṃ chaṃdasāṃ pataye namaḥ ||17|| śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ samprārthitaḥ sākṣātpradyumno bhagavān hariḥ || devāya bhadraśravase mā bhaiṣṭetyabhayaṃ dadau ||18|| atha kārṣṇirmahābāhuḥ svasainyaparivāritaḥ || purīṃ caṃdrāvatīṃ gantuṃ prasthānamakarottadā ||19|| manmukhācchakuniḥ śrutvā prāgacchaṃtaṃ yadūttamam || daityānāṃ sadasi prāha śūlamudyamya daityarāṭ ||20|| śakuniruvāca diṣṭyā diṣṭyā hi śatrurme pradyumno'tra samāgataḥ || jetuṃ yogyo maya daityā bhrāturmayyasti prāgṛṇam ||21|| bhrātā me śaṃbaro nāma yena pūrvaṃ ca māritaḥ || tasmāttaṃ ghātayiṣyāmi pradyumnaṃ yadubhiḥ saha || 22|| tasmādyāta balaṃ tasya vidhvastaṃ kurutāsurāḥ || paścātpuraṃdarādhīśaṃ ghātayiṣyāmi nirjarān ||23|| śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvā vacastasya daityo hṛṣṭo mahābalaḥ || āyayau saṃmukhe yoddhuṃ daityakoṭisamāvṛtaḥ ||24|| pradyumno bhagavānsākṣāllīlāmānuṣavigrahaḥ || mahatyāḥ sarvasenāyā gṛdhravyūhaṃ cakāra ha ||25|| gṛdhracaṃcau vartamāno'niruddho dhanvināṃ varaḥ || grīvāyāmarjunaḥ pṛṣṭhe sāṃbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ ||26|| pādayorubhayo rājannāsthitau dīptimadgadau || kārṣṇiḥ sākṣāttadudare pucche bhānurhareḥ sutaḥ ||27|| babhūva tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ sītāgaṃgātaṭe nṛpa || daityānāṃ yadubhiḥ sārddhamabdhīnāmabdhibhiryathā ||28|| bāṇaistriśūlairmusalairmudgaraistomararṣṭibhiḥ || vavṛrṣurdānavāḥ sarve dhārābhiriva vāridāḥ ||29|| rurodha sūryaṃ cākāśaṃ sainyapādarajo bhṛśam || rājansvabāṇaṃ ca yathā vāridāḥ prāvṛḍudbhavāḥ ||30|| vṛko harṣo'nilo gṛdhro varddhano'nnāda eva ca || mahāśaḥ pavano vahniḥ kṣudiśca daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ ||31|| mitraviṃdātmajā hyete yuyudhurdānavaiḥ saha || bāṇāṃdhakāre saṃjāte vṛko nāma hareḥ sutaḥ ||32|| sarveṣāmagrataḥ prāpto dhanuṣṭaṃkārayanmuhuḥ | daityānbibheda bāṇaughaiḥ kuvākyairmitratāmiva ||33|| gajān rathān hayān vīrānpātayāmāsa bhūtale || nipetuśchinnakavacāśchinnacāpā raṇāṃgaṇe ||34|| vṛkabāṇairbhinnapādā vṛkṣā vātahatā iva || adhomukhā ūrdhvamukhā bāṇaughaiśchinnabāhavaḥ ||35|| rejū raṇāṃgaṇe rājan bhāṃḍavyūhā ivāhatāḥ || dvidhābhūtā gajā bāṇaiḥ patitā raṇamaṃḍale ||36|| virejuśchurikāviddhāḥ kūṣmāṃḍaśakalā iva || tadaiva hṛṣṭaḥ saṃprāptaḥ siṃhārūḍho mahābalaḥ ||37|| bibheda kavacaṃ tasya siṃjinīṃ daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ || caturbhiścaturo vāhāndvābhyāṃ sūtaṃ dhvajaṃ tathā ||38|| tribhī rathaṃ ca bāṇānāṃ viṃśatyā danujādhipaḥ || chinnadhanvā vṛko bhūtvā hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ ||39|| anyaṃ rathaṃ samārūḍho dhanurjagrāha roṣataḥ || tāvattasya dhanurhṛṣṭaściccheda samare'suraḥ ||40|| tadā gadāṃ samādāya vṛko yādavapuṃgavaḥ || tatāḍa mūrdhni pañcāsyaṃ daityaṃ pṛṣṭhasthitaṃ punaḥ ||41|| mṛgendraḥ krodhasaṃpūrṇaḥ samutpatya raṇāṃgaṇe || anekānpātayāmāsa nakhairdaṃtaiḥ karairapi ||42|| huṃkāraṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā lalajjihvaḥ sphuratsaṭaḥ || vṛkaṃ saṃpātayāmāsa raṃbhādaṃḍaṃ gajo yathā ||43|| gṛhītvā tu vṛko dorbhyāṃ pātayitvā mahītale || tasyopari nadaṃstasthau mallo mallaṃ yathā nṛpa ||44|| utpataṃtaṃ punaḥ siṃhaṃ carvayantaṃ tanuṃ balāt || tatāḍa muṣṭinā taṃ vai mitraviṃdātmajo balī ||45|| tasya muṣṭiprahāreṇa kesarī paṃcatāṃ gataḥ || tadā kruddho hṛṣṭadaityaḥ śūlaṃ cikṣepa satvaram ||46|| śūlaṃ sphuranmaholkābhaṃ ciccheda tvasinā vṛkaḥ || tīkṣṇayā tuṃḍayā rājanphaṇinaṃ garuḍo yathā ||47|| hṛṣṭo'pi svamasiṃ nītvā nādayan svaṃ mahābalam || jaghāna taṃ vṛkaṃ mūrdhi kaṃpayan vasudhātalam ||48|| khaḍgakośe tataḥ khaḍgamupadhārya vṛko balī || kaṃdhare svena khaḍgena taṃ tatāḍa sphuracchucam ||49|| khaḍgacchinnaṃ śirastasya daitasya patitaṃ bhuvi || reje kamaṃḍalumiva sakirīṭaṃ sakuṃḍalam || 50|| hṛṣṭe mṛte tadā daityāḥ śeṣā sarve palāyitāḥ || bhayāturā mahārāja yayuścaṃdrāvatīṃ purīm ||51|| devaduṃdubhayo nedurnaraduṃdubhayastadā || śrīvṛkasyopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire ||52|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde hṛṣṭadaityavadho nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||32||
<7.33> śrīnārada uvāca hṛṣṭaṃ nipatitaṃ śrutvā śakuniḥ krodhamurchitaḥ || bhrātṝnsaṃpreṣayāmāsa devānāṃ bhayakārakān ||1|| bhūtasaṃtāpano nāma gajamāruhya nirgataḥ || vṛkaḥ kharaṃ samāruhya kālanābho'tha sūkaram ||2|| mahānābho mattapuṣṭaṃ hariśmaśrustimiṃgilam || vaijayaṃtaṃ rathaṃ jaitraṃ mayadaityavinirmitam ||3|| paṃcayojanavistīrṇaṃ sahasrāśvaniyojitam || māyāmayaṃ kāmagaṃ ca patākāśatasaṃvṛtam ||4|| sahasrakalaśāḍhyaṃ ca muktādāmavilaṃbitam || ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyaṃ śatacaṃdrasamojjvalam ||5|| sahasracakrasaṃyuktam ghaṃṭākāravibhūṣaṇam || āruhya śakuniḥ paścādyoddhukāmo viniryayau ||6|| akṣauhiṇībhirdvādaśabhirdaityānāṃ maithileśvara || dhanuḥsvanairvīraśabdairaśvaheṣārathasvanaiḥ ||7|| cītkārairhastināmāśāmaṇḍalaṃ tu jagarja ha || daityasenāprayāṇena cakaṃpe maṇḍalaṃ bhuvaḥ ||8|| nipeturgirayo'nekā viceluḥ siṃdhavo nṛpa || nipātitārgalā devairbabhūvāśvamarāvatī ||9|| tatsainyaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā pradyumno dhanvināṃ varaḥ || balī dhairyadharaḥ kārṣṇiḥ prāhedaṃ yadupuṃgavān ||10|| pradyumna uvāca idaṃ śariraṃ bhuvi pāṃcabhautikaṃ phenopamaṃ karmaguṇādinirmitam || gatāgataṃ kālavaśaṃ kadāpi budhā na śocaṃti yathārbhakaiḥ kṛtam ||11|| gacchaṃti cordhvaṃ kila sātvikā janā madhye ca tiṣṭhaṃti hi rājasā narāḥ || adhaḥ pragacchaṃti hi tāmasāḥ pare muhurmuhuste vicaraṃti karmabhiḥ ||12|| bibhetyayaṃ vā kila sarvato yathā netrabhrameṇācalatīva bhūrvṛthā || tathā ca sarvaṃ manasā kṛtaṃ jagatkāce'rbhakaṃ hyabharka āvṛto yathā ||13|| yathā sukhaṃ maṃḍalavartināṃ calaṃ tathāsti pātālanivāsināmapi || tathāmarāṇāṃ kratubhiḥ kṛtaṃ smaretsarvaṃ tyajettatṛṇavatparo janāḥ ||14|| ṛtorguṇā dehaguṇāḥ svabhāvā ahardinaṃ yāṃti yathā tathā janaḥ || dṛśyaṃ ca yadyanna hi kiṃcidasti yathā vraje gacchati pāṃthasaṃgamam ||15|| dṛṣṭaṃ yathā vastu yadolkayā tathā pare gate kiṃ hyubhayaprayojanam || vidhāya mārgaṃ vicarecchivasya paśyanhi sarvatra hariṃ pareśvaram ||16|| yatheṃdureko jalapātravṛndago yathāgnireko viditaḥ samiccaye || tathā parātmā bhagavānanekavatso'ntarbahiḥ syātsukṛteṣu dehiṣu ||17|| yo jñānaniṣṭho'tivirāgamāśritaḥ śrīkṛṣṇabhaktastvanapekṣako'pi yaḥ || tapovanaṃ vāpi gṛhaṃ gṛhaṃ vanaṃ spṛśaṃti taṃ te triguṇā na sarvataḥ ||18|| tato yatistvadhyagamatparātparaṃ sukhī sadā''nandamayastu bālavat || dehena paśyatyuta sarvakāraṇaṃ dhṛtaṃ ca vāso madirāmadāṃdhavat ||19|| sūryodaye sarvatamo viliyate pradṛśyate vastu gṛhe yathā janaiḥ || jñānodaye'jñānatamaḥ pralīyate saṃbhrājate brahma paraṃ tanau tathā ||20|| yathendriyāṇāṃ ca pṛthak ca vartmabhirnonnīyate'rthastriguṇāśrayaḥ paraḥ || ekaṃ hyanaṃtasya parasya dhāma tattathā munīnāṃ kila śāstravartmibhiḥ ||21|| paraṃ padaṃ ke'pi vadanti vaiṣṇavaṃ ke vāpi vaikuṇṭhaparaṃ pareśam || śāṃtiṃ ca yatke'pi tamaḥparaṃ bṛhatkaivalyameke pravadanti dhāmake ||22|| yadakṣaraṃ ke'pi diśaṃ vadaṃti ke golokamādyaṃ pravadantyathāpare || kecinnikuñjaṃ nijalīlayā''vṛtaṃ prāpnoti kṛṣṇasya padaṃ ca tanmuniḥ ||23|| śrīnārada uvāca iti kārṣṇervacaḥ śrutvā sarve yādavapuṃgavāḥ || śastrāṇi jagṛhurhṛṣṭā tajjñāne dhairyavarddhane ||24|| babhūva tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ daityānāṃ yadubhiḥ saha || sītāgaṃgātaṭe cābdhau rakṣasāṃ kapibhiryathā ||25|| rathino rathibhistatra pattibhiḥ pattayo nṛpa || aśvavāhairaśvavāhā yuyudhuśca gajā gajaiḥ ||26|| kecitkarīṃdrā unmattā mahāmātyaiḥ praṇoditāḥ || girīndrā iva dṛśyante muktānāṃ meghaḍaṃbaraiḥ ||27|| śuṇḍādaṇḍaiśca phūtkāraiḥ sacītkāraiḥ saśṛṅkhalaiḥ || pātayaṃto rathānaśvān vīrān rājan raṇāṃgaṇe ||28|| śuṇḍādaṇḍaiḥ saṃgṛhītvā rathānsāśvānsasārathīn || nipātya bhūmāvutthāpya cikṣipuścāṃbare balāt ||29|| kāṃścinmamarduḥ pādābhyāṃ saṃvidārya karairdṛḍhaiḥ || sakṣatāśca gajā rājanpradhāvanto raṇāṃgaṇe ||30|| sapakṣaturagā rājannaśvavāhapraṇoditāḥ || ullaṅghayanto'tha rathān gajakumbhāṃtare gatāḥ ||31|| kecidaśvairmahāvīrāḥ śaktihastā madotkaṭāḥ || jaghnurgajasthānnṛpatīnmṛgeṃdrā iva yūthapān ||32|| aśvārūḍhāḥ ke'pi senāṃ saṃvidārya vinirgatāḥ || khaḍgavegaiḥ padmavanaṃ līlābhirvāyavo yathā ||33|| kecitparasparaṃ sāśvairutpatanto raṇāṃgaṇe || khaḍgairjaghnuryathā kravye caṃcubhiḥ pakṣiṇo'mbare ||34|| kecitkhaḍgaiḥ paraśubhiḥ keciccakraiḥ padātayaḥ || cicchidurniśitairbhallairphalānīva śirāṃsi ca ||35|| saṃgrāmajidbṛhatsenaḥ śūraḥ praharaṇo vijit || jayaḥ subhadro vāmaśca satyako'śvayureva hi ||36|| bhadrāyāśca sutā hyete śrīkṛṣṇasyaurasāḥ śubhāḥ || sarveṣāmagrataḥ prāptā yuyudhurdaityapuṃgavaiḥ ||37|| bhūtasaṃtāpano nāma gajārūḍho mahāsuraḥ || yadusainye mahārāja cakre nārācadurdinam ||38|| bāṇāṃdhakāre ca kṛte bhūtasaṃtāpanena vai || saṃgrāmajittadā prāptaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya suto balī ||39|| vivyādha bāṇaśatakairbhūtasaṃtāpano balī || pralayārṇavasaṃghoṣabhīmasaṃghaṭṭanādinīm ||40|| dhanurjyāṃ tasya ciccheda bhūtasaṃtāpano balī || saṃgrāmajiddhanuścānyadgṛhītvā svaṃ taḍitprabham ||41|| sajjaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena śataṃ bāṇānsamādadhe || te bāṇāstaddhanurjyāṃ ca kavacaṃ lohanirmitam ||42|| bhitvā chitvā tanuṃ tasya gajaṃ bhitvāvaniṃ gatāḥ || bāṇaprahāravyathitaḥ kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ ||43|| gajaṃ svaṃ nodayāmāsa bhūtasantāpano balī || kālāṃtakasamaṃ nāgaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃgrāmajidbalī ||44|| gṛhītvā svamasiṃ divyaṃ saṃjaghāna raṇāṃgaṇe || tasya khaḍgaprahāreṇa śūṇḍādaṇḍo dvidhābhavat ||45|| cītkāramutkaṭaṃ kurvan madaṃ saṃsrāvayankaṭāt || bhūtasaṃtāpanaṃ tyaktvā bhuvanaṃ kaṃpayan gajaḥ ||46|| nipātayanmahāvīrānghaṃṭānādairnadanmuhuḥ || na balātstaṃbhito daityaiḥ purīṃ caṃdrāvatīṃ yayau ||47|| kolāhalo mahānāsīdvrajannevaṃ gaje cyute || bhūtasaṃtāpanaścakraṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya sutāya vai ||48|| cikṣepa niśitaṃ śīghraṃ grīṣmamārtaṃḍavatsphurat || tadāgataṃ bhramaddṛṣṭvā cakraṃ bhadrātmajo balī ||49|| svacakreṇa mahārāja līlayā śatadhācchinat || jaṭharasya gireḥ śṛṅgaṃ samutpāṭya mahāsuraḥ ||50|| cikṣepa kṛṣṇaputrāya nādayan vyomamaṃḍalam || saṃgrāmajicca tacchṛṅgaṃ gṛhītvā bhujayorbalāt ||51|| tatāḍa tena rājeṃdra bhūtasantāpanaṃ raṇe || bhūtasantāpano daityaḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ jaṭharaṃ girim ||52|| gṛhītvā saṃgare tasthāvudbhaṭo daityapuṃgavaḥ || anena ghātayiṣyāmi tvāṃ raṇe pravadanmukhāt ||53|| devakūṭaṃ samutpāṭya giriṃ ca śrīhareḥ sutaḥ || anena ghātayiṣyāmi tvāṃ raṇe pravadanmukhāt ||54|| tasthau tatsammukhe rājaṃstadadbhutamivāmavat || kṣipantaṃ parvataṃ daityaṃ bhūtasantāpanaṃ nṛpa ||55|| tatāḍa giriṇā svena raṇe saṃgrāmajidbalī || jaṭharo devakūṭaśca dvau girī daityamastake ||56|| patitau bhūribhārāḍhyau vajrasaṃgharṣanādinau ||57|| bhūtasantāpanastābhyāṃ patitaḥ pañcatāṃ gataḥ || tajjyotiḥ saṃgrāmajiti līnaṃ jātaṃ videharāṭ || 58|| śrīsaṃgrāmajitaḥ sainye nedurduṃdubhayastadā || bhadrātmajoparī surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire ||59|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde bhūtasantāpanadaityavadho nāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||33||
<7.34> śrīnārada uvāca saṃgrāmajinmahāyuddhe bhūtasantāpane mṛte || hāhākāro mahānāsīddaityasenāsu maithila ||1|| śakunirvṛkaḥ kālanābho mahānābhastathaiva ca || hariśmaśruśca pañcaite samprāptā raṇamaṃḍale ||2|| kārṣṇiḥ śakunināyuddhyadaniruddho vṛkeṇa vai || kālanābhena sāṃbastu mahānābhena dīptimān ||3|| hariśmaśrvasureṇāpi bhānuḥ kṛṣṇasuto balī || sarveṣāmagrataḥ prāpto'niruddho dhanvināṃ varaḥ ||4|| vibheda bāṇairdaityāṃśca vajreṇeṃdro yathā girīn || aniruddhaśarairdaityāśchinnapādāṃsajānavaḥ ||5|| nipeturmūrcchitā bhūmau vṛkṣā vātahatā iva || aniruddhaśaraistīkṣṇaiḥ saṃchinnā meghaḍaṃbarāḥ ||6|| chinnakumbhā bhinnaśuṃḍāḥ patitā raṇamaṃḍale || rugṇadantāśchinnakakṣāḥ śailā vajrahatā iva ||7|| dvidhābhūtā gajāḥ petuḥ sphuratkāśmīrakaṃbalāḥ || kariṇāṃ bhinnakumbhānāṃ muktā rejuḥ sphuratprabhāḥ ||8|| bāṇāṃdhakāre rājendra rātrau tārāgaṇā iva || pradharṣitāḥ ke'pi vīrā aniruddhaśarānvitā ||9|| nipeturmūrchitā bhūmau tadadbhutamivābhavat || kecitkau rathinaḥ petusteṣāṃ śūnyā rathāḥ sthitāḥ ||10|| kapitthasya phalānīva hastakoṣṭhagatāni ca || kṣaṇamātreṇa rājendra daityānāṃ vāhinīṣu ca ||11|| nadī babhūva saṃgrāme bhīṣaṇā kṣatajasravāt || dvipagrāhā coṣṭrakharakabaṃdhāsyādikacchapā ||12|| śiśumārarathā keśaśaivālā bhujasarpiṇī || karamīnā mauliratnahārakuṇḍalaśarkarā ||13|| śastraśakticchatraśaṃkhā cāmaradhvajasaikatā || rathāṃgavartasaṃyuktā senādvayataṭāvṛtā ||14|| śatayojanavistīrṇā babhau vaitaraṇī yathā || pramathā bhairavā bhūtā vetālā yoginīgaṇāḥ ||15|| aṭṭahāsaṃ prakṛrvaṃto nṛtyaṃto raṇamaṇḍale || pibanto rudhiraṃ śaśvatkapālena nṛpeśvara ||16|| harasya muṇḍamālārthaṃ jagṛhuste śirāṃsi ca || siṃhārūḍhā bhadrakālī ḍākinīśatasaṃvṛtā ||17|| bhakṣyayantī raṇe daityānaṭṭahāsaṃ cakāra ha || vidyādharyastvaṃbarasthā gaṃdharvyo'psarasastathā ||18|| kṣātradharmasthitān vīrān vavrire devarūpiṇaḥ || parasparaṃ kalirbhūtvā tāsāṃ patyarthamaṃbare ||19|| mamānurupo nāyaṃ va iti vihvalacetasām || kecidvīrā dharmaparā raṇaraṅgānna cālitāḥ ||20|| yayurviṣṇupadaṃ divyaṃ bhitvā mārtaṃḍamaṇḍalam || aniruddhaṃ ripuṃ dṛṣṭvā keciddaityāḥ palāyitāḥ ||21|| kecitsvaṃ svaṃ raṇaṃ tyaktvā dudruvuste diśo daśa || tadā vṛko mahādaityaḥ kharārūḍho bhayaṃkaraḥ ||22|| ājagāma nadan yuddhe dhanuṣṭaṃkārayanmuhuḥ || aniruddhasyāpi cāyaṃ siṃjinīsahitaṃ dhanuḥ ||23|| ciccheda daśabhirbāṇairvṛko'pi raṇadurmadaḥ || chinnadhanvāniruddhastu dvitīyaṃ dhanurādade ||24|| ciccheda daśabhirbāṇairvṛkacāpaṃ mahābalaḥ || vṛkastriśūlamudyamya ruṣā prasphuritādharaḥ || lalajjihvaḥ pratyuvācāniruddhaṃ dhanvināṃ varam ||25|| vṛkadaitya uvāca adyaiva tvāṃ haniṣyāmi kṣatriyaṃ svasthavikramam || tvayā senā hatā me'dya paśya vikramamadbhutam ||26|| aniruddha uvāca ye vadanti mukheneha te kurvaṃti na kiṃcana || adyaiva tvāṃ haniṣyāmi paśya me vikramaṃ param ||27|| na cettvāṃ ghātayiṣyāmi śṛṇutācchapathaṃ mama || vipragobhrūṇabālānāṃ hatyā me syātsadaiva hi ||28|| śrīnārada uvāca vṛko'pi śapathaṃ kṛtvā kharārūḍho mahābalaḥ || jaghāna taṃ triśūlenāniruddhaṃ dhanvināṃ varam ||29|| tacchūlaṃ vāmahastena gṛhītvā kārṣṇinandanaḥ || tatāḍa sahasā rājan vṛkadaityaṃ mahābalam ||30|| tadāsuraḥ kopapūrṇo muktvātha mahatīṃ gadām || cūrṇayāmāsa sahasā cāniruddharathaṃ balāt ||31|| prādyumniḥ śitadhāreṇa khaḍgenāribhujadvayam || ciccheda bhidureṇāśu śailapakṣau yathā vṛṣā ||32|| tadābhinnabhujo daityaḥ padbhyāmākaṃpayanbhuvam ||33|| vistīrṇaṃ vadanaṃ kṛtvā lalajjihvaṃ bhayaṃkaram || karāladaṃṣṭraḥ prapibannākāśaṃ daityapuṃgavaḥ ||34|| timiṃ timiṃgila iva prāgrasatkārṣṇinandanam || daityodare kṛṣṇapautraḥ śrīkṛṣṇasyānukaṃpayā ||35|| na mamāra mahārāja kārṣṇirmīnodare yathā || vṛkodare yathā kṛṣṇo yathā gopā hyaghodare ||36|| bakodare yathā kṛṣṇo yathā vṛtrodare vṛṣā || hāhākāre tadā jāte yadusainye videharāṭ ||37|| gado gadāṃ samādāya baladevānujo balī || tatāḍa mastake daityaṃ vṛkaṃ nāma mahābalam ||38|| tadā hataśirā daityo reje kṣatajabiṃdubhiḥ || garikairjaladhārābhiryathā viṃdhyācalo nṛpa ||39|| phālgunaḥ svamasiṃ nītvā tatpādau cāñjasāharat || chinnāṃghriḥ sa papātorvyāṃ chinnapakṣo yathā giriḥ ||40|| aniruddhastadudaraṃ bhītvā khaḍgena nirgataḥ || jahāra tacchiraścāyaṃ yathā vajreṇa vṛtrahā ||41|| tadā jayajayārāvo yadusainye babhūva ha || devadundubhayo nedurnaradundubhayastathā ||42|| aniruddhopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire || kathitaṃ hyadbhutaṃ caitatkiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ||43|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde vṛkadaityavadho nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||34||
<7.35> bahulāśva uvāca aho atyadbhutaṃ yuddhaṃ mune prādyumninā kṛtam || vṛke hate mahādaitye kiṃ babhūva raṇe punaḥ ||1|| śrīnārada uvāca vṛkadaityaṃ hataṃ vīkṣya kālanābho mahāsuraḥ || kroḍārūḍho raṇaṃ prāgaddhanuṣṭaṃkārayanmuhuḥ ||2|| akrūraṃ bāṇaviṃśatyā gadaṃ ca daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ || arjunaṃ daśabhirbāṇairyuyudhānaṃ ca pañcabhiḥ ||3|| daśabhiḥ kṛtavarmāṇaṃ kārṣṇiṃ bāṇaśatena vai || aniruddhaṃ ca viṃśatyā dīptimaṃtaṃ ca pañcabhiḥ ||4|| sāṃbaṃ ca śatabāṇaiśca vivyādha samare'suraḥ || tadbāṇairvyākulā vīrā babhūvurghaṭikādvayam ||5|| hayāśca pañcatāṃ prāptāścūrṇībhūtā raṇāṃgaṇe || taddhastalāghavaṃ dṛṣṭvā prasanno rukmiṇīsutaḥ ||6|| kālanābhaṃ sādhupadaiḥ pūjayāmāsa saṃgare || pradyumnaḥ svaṃ dhanurnītvā bāṇamekaṃ samādadhe ||7|| kodaṇḍamukto viśikhastatkroḍaṃ dīrgharūpiṇam || samunnīya bhrāmayitvā svarloke lakṣayojanam ||8|| ākāśātpātayāmāsa samudre bhīmanādini || pradyumno bhagavānsākṣāddvitīyaṃ bāṇamādadhe ||9|| so'pi bāṇaḥ samunnīya kālanābhaṃ mahābalam || bhrāmayanpātayāmāsa caṃdrāvatyāṃ balātpuri ||10|| kālanābhaḥ prapatitaḥ kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ || gṛhītvā'tha gadāṃ gurvīṃ lakṣabhāravinirmitām ||11|| raṇaṃ prāpto yadubalaṃ pothayāmāsa daityarāṭ || gajān rathānhayān vīrān gadayā vajrakalpayā ||12|| pātayāmāsa vegena mahāvāto yathā tarūn || kāṃścitkarābhyāṃ pronnīya cikṣepa gagane balāt ||13|| aṃbarātte nipetuḥ kau rājan varṣopalā iva || tadā gadāṃ samādāya sāṃbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ ||14|| tatāḍa mūrdhni taṃ daityaṃ kālanābhaṃ mahāsuram || tayoryuddhamabhūdghoraṃ gadābhyāṃ raṇamaṇḍale ||15|| visphuliṃgānkṣaraṃtyau dve gade cūrṇībabhūvatuḥ || anye gade samādāya tasthatuḥ saṃgare ca tau ||16|| kālanābhastadā prāha sāṃbaṃ jāṃbavatīsutam || ekenāpi prahāreṇa hanmi tvāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||17|| pūrvaṃ prahāra kuru me iti sāmbo'vadadraṇe || kālanābho'tha gadayā sāṃbamūrdhni tatāḍa ha ||18|| gadopari gadāṃ nītvā sāṃbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ || jaghāna gadayā daityaṃ kālanābhamuraḥsthale ||19|| gadayā bhinnahṛdaya udvaman rudhiraṃ mukhāt || vyasuḥ
