papāta bhūpṛṣṭhe vajrāhata ivācalaḥ ||20|| abhūjjayajayārāvaḥ sādhuvādaḥ satāṃ nṛpa || devadundubhayo nedurnaradundubhayastathā ||21|| sāṃbasenopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire || vidyādharyaśca gaṃdharvā nanṛtuśca jagurmudā ||22|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde kālanābhadaityavadho nāma paṃcastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||35||
<7.36> śrīnārada uvāca kālanābhe'tha patite mahān kolāhalo'bhavat || uṣṭrārūḍho mahānābho daityaḥ prāpto raṇāṅgaṇe ||1|| mukhādagniṃ samasṛjanmāyāvī daityapuṃgavaḥ || tenāgninā bhūmivṛkṣā jajvaluśca diśo daśa ||2|| vīrāṇāṃ kaṃcukoṣṇīṣakaṭibandhāṅgarakṣakāḥ || prajajvalurmahārāja muñjapuṣpapratūlavat ||3|| samudrapaṭṭanabhavaiḥ pītāruṇasitāsitaiḥ || haritaiścitravarṇaiśca sūkṣmaiḥ kāśmīrajairapi ||4|| hemaratnakhacadbhiśca kambalaiḥ sahitā gajāḥ || prajajvalurmṛdhe rājan vṛkṣaiḥ śailā ivāgninā ||5|| śikhā ratnaiścāmaraiśca hārairhaimaiḥ paricchadaiḥ || utpatanto hayā yuddhe mṛgā iva davāgninā ||6|| sainyaṃ bhayāturaṃ dṛṣṭvā dīptimān kṛṣṇanandanaḥ || māyāvahnipraśāṃtyarthaṃ parjanyāstraṃ samādadhe ||7|| bāṇādvinirgatā meghāḥ sāṃvartakagaṇā iva || vavṛṣurjaladhārābhirnadanto bhairavaṃ ravam ||8|| āsāreṇa mahārāja prāvṛṭkālo'bhavatkṣitau || puṃskokilāḥ kokilāśca mayūrāḥ sārasādayaḥ ||9|| maṃḍūkāḥ prajagurgīrbhiridragopāśca rejire || indracāpena dāminyā maithilendra babhau nabhaḥ ||10|| itthaṃ śāṃtiṃ gate vahnau mahānābho mahāsuraḥ || prāhīṇonniśitaṃ śūlaṃ ruṣā dīptimate tvaram ||11|| śūlaṃ sarpamivāyāṃtaṃ dīptimān rohiṇīsutaḥ|| ciccheda tvasinā yuddhe phaṇinaṃ garuḍo yathā ||12|| daśaṃtaṃ codbhaṭaṃ coṣṭraṃ mahānābhasya vāhanam || dīptimān svena khaḍgena saṃjaghāna raṇāṅgaṇe ||13|| dvidhābhūtaḥ papātorvyāṃ khaḍgasaṃchinnakaṃdharaḥ || jagāma pañcatāmuṣṭro mahānābhasya paśyataḥ ||14|| mahānābho mahādaityo gajamāruhya vegataḥ || śūlahastaḥ punaḥ prāgānnādayanvyomamaṇḍalam ||15|| dīptimānaśvamāruhya saindhavaṃ caṃcalāsitam || taḍitprabheṇa khaḍgena babhau śrīkṛṣṇanaṃdanaḥ ||16|| turaṃgaṃ pārṣṇighātena protpatan dharaṇītalāt || ārūḍho gajakuṃbhāṃtaṃ giriśṛṅgaṃ yathā hariḥ ||17|| khaḍgena śitadhāreṇa dīptimānkṛṣṇanandanaḥ || mahānābhasya sahasā śiraḥ kāyādapāharat ||18|| bāṇavarṣaṃ prakurvaṃtīṃ senāṃ tasya durātmanaḥ || jaghāna dīptimān siṃho gajayūthaṃ yathāsinā ||19|| kecitkhaḍgenābhihatāḥ śeṣā daityāḥ palāyitāḥ || devā dīptimato mūrdhniṃ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire ||20|| jaguḥ kinnaragaṃdharvā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ || ṛṣayo munayo devāstuṣṭuvurśrīhareḥ sutam ||21|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde mahānābhavadho nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||36||
<7.37> śrīnārada uvāca mahānābhaṃ mṛtaṃ śrutvā senāṃ vīkṣya palāyitām || daityastimiṃgilārūḍho hariśmaśruḥ samāyayau ||1|| hariśmaśrustadā daityo ruṣā prasphuritādharaḥ || uvāca paruṣaṃ vākyaṃ yādavānāṃ ca śṛṇvatām ||2|| hariśmaśruruvāca yūyaṃ sarve'pi me śaktyā manuṣyāḥ svalpavikramāḥ || śastrairjayaṃto dīnā vai pauruṣaṃ kiṃ bhavādṛśe ||3|| bhavatāṃ balavān ko'pi vinā śastraṃ mayā saha || karotu mallayuddhaṃ vai pauruṣaṃ yena dṛśyate ||4|| śrīnārada uvāca itthaṃ daityavacaḥ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā tatprodbhaṭaṃ vapuḥ || sarve babhūvuste tūṣṇīṃ praśaṃsaṃtaḥ parasparam ||5|| sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ bhānuḥ satyabhāmātmajo balī || tyaktvā śastrāṇī sahasā tasthau kṛṣṇaṃ smaran raṇe ||6|| timiṃgilātsamuttīrya hariśmaśrurmahābalaḥ || tasthau tatsaṃmukhe rājan bhujamāsphoṭya yatnataḥ ||7|| bhujābhyāṃ ca bhujau baddhvā nodanāṃ cakraturbalāt || daṃtairgajāviva vane praharantau parasparam ||8|| nodayāmāsa taṃ bhānuṃ sa daityaḥ śatayojanam || bhujābhyāṃ rājarājedra siṃhaḥ siṃhamivaujasā ||9|| tataḥ punaḥ kṛṣṇasuto hariśmaśruṃ mahāsuram || nodayāmāsa sahasā sahasraṃ yojanaṃ balāt ||10|| kandhare svabhujāṃ kṛtvā kaṭau ca vinidhāya tam || bhānuṃ jānau saṃgṛhītvā pātayāmāsa daityarāṭ ||11|| bhānustaṃ pṛṣṭhadeśe'pi sannidhāya bhujaujasā || gṛhītvā jaṃghayordaityaṃ pātayāmāsa bhūtale ||12|| atha tau punarutthāya bhujavāsphoṭya tasthatuḥ || tvaraṃ tau balinau rājansuparṇaphaṇināviva ||13|| daityo bhujaujasā nītvā bhānuṃ śrīkṛṣṇanandanam || cikṣepa dhṛtvā caraṇāvākāśe lakṣayojanam ||14|| ākāśātpatito bhānuḥ kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ || prahlāda iva śailāṃgādrakṣitā kṛpayā hareḥ ||15|| hariśmaśruṃ saṃgṛhītvā dīrghaśmaśrau hareḥ sutaḥ || bhrāmayitvātha cikṣepa vyomni taṃ lakṣayojanam ||16|| ākāśātpatitaḥ so'pi kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ || mukhe kṛtvā svakaṃ kūrcaṃ muṣṭinā taṃ tatāḍa ha ||17|| muṣṭāmuṣṭi raṇaṃ rājan babhūva ghaṭikādvayam || niṣpiṣṭāṃgo hariśmaśrurgrāvāṇaṃ bhānumūrddhani ||18|| cikṣepa ca mahāvegādraktākṣaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ || bhānurdrumaṃ saṃgṛhītvā prākṣipattasya mastake ||19|| so'pi drumaṃ saṃgṛhītvā prāhiṇodbhānumūrddhani || hariśmaśrurmahādaityo raktākṣaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ ||20|| gajaṃ gṛhītvā śuṇḍāyāṃ tena bhānuṃ tatāḍa ha || bhānuścānyaṃ gajaṃ nītvā gṛhītvā tadgajaṃ kare ||21|| hariśmaśruṃ mahādaityaṃ gajenābhyahanaddṛḍham || cītkāramatha kurvaṃtaṃ gajaṃ nītvā nipātya tam ||22|| tasya dantau samutpāṭya tābhyāṃ bhānuṃ tatāḍa ha || bhānumākāśavāgāha kūrce mṛtyuḥ kilāsya ca ||23|| vareṇa śivadattena projjhito'yaṃ mahāsuraḥ || iti śrutvā vaco bhānurdhāvan krodhaprapūritaḥ ||24|| saṃgṛhītvā bhujābhyāṃ taṃ pādayoḥ praṇadanmuhuḥ || bhrāmayitvā mahārāja sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ satām ||25|| pātayāmāsa bhūpṛṣṭhe kamaṇḍalumivārbhakaḥ || mukhātkūrcaṃ samunnīya samutpāṭya karaujasā ||26|| tatāḍa muṣṭinā mūrdhni hariśmaśruṃ mahāsuram || tadā mṛtyuṃ gate daitye hariśmaśrau nṛpeśvaraḥ ||27|| devadundubhayo nedurnaradundubhayastathā || abhūjjayajayarāvo nanṛturdevanāyakāḥ || 28|| prasannā divijā rājanpuṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire || itthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaputrāṇāṃ vikramaḥ paramādbhutaḥ ||29|| mayā te kathitaḥ puṇyaḥ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ||30|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde hariśmaśrudaityavadho nāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||37||
<7.38> bahulāśva uvāca hariśmaśrvādikān bhrātṝn mṛtān jñātvā mahāsuraḥ || śakuniḥ kiṃ cakārāgre vada tanmunisattama ||1|| śrīnārada uvāca hariśmaśrau hate rājan śakuniḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ || raṇāṅgaṇe prāha daityān bhrātṛśokapariplutaḥ ||2|| śakuniruvāca he paulomakālakeyāḥ sarve śṛṇutu madvacaḥ || aho daivabalaṃ yena kinna bhuyādviparyayaḥ ||3|| kālanābhena me bhrātrā samudramathane yamaḥ || jitaḥ pūrvaṃ so'pi daivānmanuṣyairiha māritaḥ ||4| śaṃbaraḥ sūryajitsākṣātkārṣṇinā śiśunā jitaḥ || utkacaḥ śakrajetāpi mahābala mahābalaḥ ||5|| so'pi bālena kṛṣṇena mārito nāradācchrutam || samudramathane pūrvamasurāṇāṃ ca paśyatām ||6|| vahnirjito hi yenāpi hṛṣṭaḥ so'pi nipātitaḥ || yasyāgre varuṇaḥ pūrvaṃ yuddhabhītaḥ palāyitaḥ ||7|| bhūtasaṃtāpanaḥ so'pi māritastucchavikramaiḥ || yena pūrvaṃ mahāyuddhe vikramaistoṣitaḥ śivaḥ ||8|| sa vṛko vṛṣṇibhistucchairmāritaḥ saṅgare'tra vai || mahānābhena me bhrātrā divi vāyurvinirjitaḥ ||9|| mānuṣairyādavairatra māritaḥ so'pi sāṃpratam || hā daiva yena svarloke jitaḥ śakrasuto balī ||10|| nipātitaḥ so'pi cātra hariśmaśruśca mānavaiḥ || tasmādayādavīṃ pṛthvīṃ kariṣye śapatho mama ||11|| jarāsaṃdhena śālvena dantavaktreṇa dhīmatā || śiśupālena mitreṇa yuṣmābhiḥ sahito hyaham ||12|| sutalācca samāhūtairdānavaiścaṇḍavikramaiḥ || devān jetuṃ gamiṣyāmi bāṇāsurasamanvitaḥ ||13|| kārṣṇyādīnudbhaṭānsarvānvṛṣṇīñjitvā durātmanaḥ || sastrīkānamarānbaddhvā kṣipe meruguhāmukhe ||14|| goviprasurasādhūṃśca chandāṃsi ca tapasvinaḥ || yajñaṃ śrāddhaṃ titikṣūṃśca nānātīrthakarānpunaḥ ||15|| haniṣyāmi na sandehaścariṣyāmi sukhaṃ tataḥ || dhanyaḥ kaṃso mahāvīryo devānāṃ vijayī balī ||16|| na vidyate bhūmitale mitraṃ me paramaḥ suhṛt || śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā śakuniryuddhe dānaveṃdro mahābalaḥ ||17|| āyayau sahasā daityaḥ pradyumnasyāpi saṃmukhe || mahādhanuḥ samādāya lakṣabhārasamaṃ dṛḍham ||18|| mayena nirmitaṃ tajjyāṭaṃkāraṃ sa cakāra ha || dhanuṣṭaṅkāraśabdena diggajā badhirīkṛtāḥ ||19|| nipeturgirayo'nekā viceluḥ siṃdhavo nṛpa || nanāda sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ cakaṃpe maṇḍalaṃ bhuvaḥ ||20|| vīropari gatā vīrā jyāghoṣeṇātivihvalāḥ || raṇādvidudruvurnāgā utpatanto hayā mṛdhe ||21|| evaṃ palāyitāḥ sarve hyakasmādbhayavihvalāḥ || tadā gadādayo vīrā ājagmuḥ syaṃdane sthitāḥ ||22|| dhanuṣṭaṃkārayantaste mahābalaparākramāḥ || śakunirdaśabhīrbāṇairvivyādhārjunamāhave ||23|| gāṃḍīvī sarathastasmāccatuṣkrośe papāta ha || gadaṃ ca bāṇaviṃśatyā śakuniryuddhadurmadaḥ ||24|| cikṣepa sarathaṃ rājannādayan vyomamaṇḍalam || catvāriṃśaccharairvīro'niruddhaṃ dhanvināṃ varam ||25|| vivyādha sarathaṃ rājannādayan vyomamaṇḍalam || sāśvo ratho'niruddhasya ṣoḍaśakrośamāsthitaḥ ||26|| sāṃbaṃ ca śitabāṇaiśca tatāḍa śakunirmṛdhe || sāṃbo'pi saratho rājannaṃbare samarāṃgaṇāt ||27|| dvātriṃśadyojanaṃ mārgaṃ nipapāta videharāṭ || kārṣṇiṃ samāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā śakuniḥ krodhapūritaḥ ||28|| sahasā bāṇapaṭalaiḥ saṃjaghāna raṇāṃgaṇe || pradyumnasya ratho rājansambhramanghaṭikādvayam ||29|| śatakrośe papātorvyāṃ kamaṇḍalurivāhataḥ || sarve visismuḥ śakunerbalaṃ dṛṣṭvātha yādavāḥ ||30|| jaghnurnānāvidhaiḥ śastrairdaityamadriṃ yathā gajāḥ || gado'rjuno'niruddhastu sāṃbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ ||31|| dhanuṣṭaṃkārayaṃtaste punaryuddhaṃ samāgatāḥ || atha kārṣṇirmahābāhurvāyuvege rathe sthitaḥ ||32|| dhanuṣṭaṃkārayan rājan prāpto'bhūdraṇamaṇḍale || pralayārṇavasaṃghaṭṭabhīmasaṃgharṣanādinīm ||33|| dhanurjyāṃ śakuneḥ kārṣṇiściccheda daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ || sahasraiśca sahasrāśvān rathaṃ ca viśikhaiḥ śataiḥ ||34|| sārathiṃ bāṇaviṃśatyā pātayāmāsa bhūtale || tato rathaṃ samutthāpya hayairarnyairniyojitam ||35|| anyasūtaṃ rathe kṛtvā rathamāruhya daityarāṭ || saṃdadhe siñjanīṃ rājan kodaṇḍe caṃḍavikrame ||36|| śataṃ bāṇānsamākṛṣya niṣaṃgātpṛṣṭhato gatān || cāpe nidhāya karṇāṃtamākṛṣya prāha manmatham ||37|| śakuniruvāca sarveṣāṃ ghātayiṣyāmi śatrumukhyaṃ madotkaṭam || paścātsenāṃ haniṣyāmi yadūnāṃ svasthatejasām ||38|| pradyumna uvāca sadā vayaḥ kālabalena dehināṃ prayāti chāyeva sukhe muhurmuhuḥ || tathā ca duḥkhaṃ ca sukhaṃ gatāgataṃ ghanāvalirvāyubalena khe yathā ||39|| kṛtāṃ kṛṣiṃ siṃcati yāṃ hi sarvataśchinatti dātreṇa yathā kṛṣīvalaḥ || tathā hi kālaḥ svakṛtāṃ janāvaliṃ duratyayaḥ pāti guṇairviluṃpati ||40|| idaṃ kariṣyāmi karomi bhūyo mamedamastīti tadevamābruvan || ahaṃ sukhī duḥkhayutaḥ suhṛjjano lokastvahaṃkāravimohito'sura ||41|| dhanyastvaṃ rājaśārdūla munīn vāgbhirviḍaṃbayan || svabhāvo dustyajo nṝṇāṃ pṛthagbhūtastribhirguṇaiḥ ||42|| śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ bruvāṇāvanyonyaṃ pradyumnaśakunī mṛdhe || yuyudhāte maithilendra śakravṛtrāviva sthitau ||43|| iti tau dhanuṣo muktān viśikhānsūryaraśmivat || ciccheda kārṣṇirbāṇena kuvākyeneva mitratām ||44|| lakṣabhāramayīṃ gurvīṃ gṛhītvā mahatīṃ gadām || jaghāna mūrdhni pradyumnaṃ śakuniryuddhadurmadaḥ ||45|| pradyumno bhagavānsākṣādgadayā vajrakalpayā || kācapātraṃ yathā daṇḍastadgadāṃ śatadhā'karot ||46|| atha daityo ruṣāviṣṭastriśūlaṃ ca sphuradrucā || pradyumnasyāhananmūrdhni śabdamuccaiḥ samuccaran ||47|| triśūlena hareḥ putrastriśūlaṃ śatadhācchinat || kuṃtaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ śakunaye prāhiṇodrukmiṇīsutaḥ ||48|| kuṃtena viddhahṛdayaḥ kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ || parigheṇa hareḥ putraṃ saṃtatāḍa raṇāṃgaṇe ||49|| yamadaṇḍaṃ tato nītvā rukmiṇīnaṃdano balī || cūrṇīcakāra daityasya parighaṃ paramādbhutam ||50|| caṃcalāśvāṃśca sahasā yamadaṇḍena vegataḥ || sārathiṃ syandanaṃ divyaṃ pātayāmāsa bhūtale ||51|| sūte mṛtyuṃ gate sāśve cūrṇībhūte rathe nṛpa || parighe ca mahādaityaḥ khaḍgaṃ jagrāha roṣataḥ ||52|| pradyumno'pi mahāvīro yamadaṇḍena maithila || dvidhā cakāra tatkhaḍgaṃ pannagaṃ garuḍo yathā ||53|| yamadaṇḍena taṃ daityaṃ skaṃdhe kārṣṇistatāḍa ha || tasyāghātena śakuniḥ sadyo mūrcchāmavāpa ha ||54|| daityasenāṃ viśeśāśu śrīkṛṣṇaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ || nipātayan mahāvīrānvanaṃ vaiśvānaro yathā ||55|| gajāṃsturaṃgāṃśca rathāndaityāṃstānātatāyinaḥ || pātayāmāsa yamavadyamadaṇḍena mādhavaḥ ||56|| chinnapādāśchinnamukhāśchinnāṃgāśchinnabāhavaḥ || dvaiteyā danujā yuddhe mūrcchitā nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ||57|| yamarūpadharaṃ dṛṣṭvā pradyumnaṃ bhīmavikramam || tyaktvā svaṃ svaṃ raṇaṃ keciddudruvaste diśo daśa ||58|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śakuniyuddhavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||38||
<7.39> śrīnārada uvāca śakuniḥ punarutthāya svabalaṃ vīkṣya pothitam || jagrāha sa mahārāja lakṣabhārasamaṃ dhanuḥ ||1|| nidhāya bāṇaṃ niśitaṃ kodaṇḍe caṇḍavikrame || kārṣṇiṃ prāha raṇe rājañchakunirdaityarāḍbalī ||2|| śakuniruvāca karma pradhānaṃ jagatītale mahatkarmaiva sākṣādgururīśvaraḥ prabhuḥ || uccāvacatvaṃ bhavatīha karmaṇā tenaiva rājan vijayaḥ parājayaḥ ||3|| gavāṃ sahasreṣu yathā hi vatsakaḥ svamātaraṃ viṃdati paśyatāṃ satām || tathā hi yenāpi kṛtaṃ śubhāśubhaṃ nareṣu tiṣṭhatsu tameva gacchati ||4|| tato vijeṣyāmi dṛḍhena karmaṇā ripuṃ bhavantaṃ śapathaḥ kṛto mayā || sadyaḥ kuru tvaṃ pratikārameva tadyenāpi na syādbhuvi te parājayaḥ ||5|| śrīpradyumna uvāca karma pradhānaṃ yadi manyase bhavān kālaṃ vinā tarhi phalaṃ na vidyate || kṛte ca pāke yadi vighnatā kvacit sadā baliṣṭhaṃ samayaṃ viduḥ pare ||6|| pākaprakāre sati pākasādhanaṃ kadāpi kartāramṛte na jāyate || vadanti kartāramataḥ paraṃ pare na karma kālaṃ śṛṇu daityapuṃgava ||7|| yogaṃ viduḥ ke'pi yadā hyayogataḥ kathaṃ bhavetkau kila pākasādhanam || sarvaṃ hi vā yogamṛte vṛthā bhavetkāle tathā karmaṇī kartari sthite ||8|| yogaṃ tathā karmaṇi kartari sthite kāle vidhiḥ sāṃkhyamṛte vṛthā bhavet || pākaprakārādyavicārakṛdyadā na tarhi pākasya yathā prasādhanam ||9|| yogakarmavidhikārakasaṃkhyairbrahmapūruṣamṛte na hi kiṃcit || taṃ namāmi paripūrṇatamāṃśaṃ yena viśvamakhilaṃ viditaṃ khe ||10|| śakuniruvāca he pradyumna mahābāho tvaṃ sākṣājjñānaśevadhiḥ || tava darśanamātreṇa naro yāti kṛtārthatām ||11|| ye tvasaṃgaṃ samāsādya vārtāṃ kurvanti nityaśaḥ || teṣāṃ tu mahimānaṃ hi vaktuṃ nālaṃ caturmukhaḥ ||12|| śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā śakunirdaityo māyāvī daityarāḍbalī || śikṣitaṃ mayadaityena rauravāstraṃ samādadhe ||13|| mahoragā daṃdaśūkā vṛścikāśca viṣotkaṭāḥ || koṭiśo garuḍā bāṇānnīlakaṃṭhāḥ kalāpinaḥ ||14|| tairdarśitaṃ balaṃ sarvaṃ phūtkārairmattatāṃ gatam || vīkṣya kārṣṇīrmahābuddhirgaruḍāstraṃ samādadhe ||15|| koṭiśo garuḍā bāṇānnīlakaṃṭhāḥ kalāpinaḥ || anye ca pakṣiṇo bhīmā nirgatāstasya paśyataḥ ||16|| agrasannuragānyuddhe dandaśūkānsavṛścikān || tīkṣṇatuṇḍā bṛhatpakṣāḥ kṣaṇātte'dṛśyatāṃ gatāḥ ||17|| daityo'pi rākṣasīṃ māyāṃ gāṃdharvī gauhyakīṃ punaḥ || paiśācīṃ saṃdadhe rājañchakuniryuddhadurmadaḥ ||18|| tadbāṇanirgatā bhūtāstathā pretāśca koṭiśaḥ || aṃgārānmumucuste vai karālāḥ kṛṣṇarūpiṇaḥ ||19|| jñātvātha tāmasīṃ māyāṃ paiśācīṃ mīnaketanaḥ || sattvāstraṃ saṃdadhe bāṇe yuddhakāṃkṣī hareḥ sutaḥ ||20|| tasmādvinirgatā rājan koṭiśo viṣṇupārṣadāḥ || jaghnuḥ piśācīṃ tāṃ māyāṃ pannagīṃ garuḍo yathā ||21|| māyāṃ daityo'pi māyāvī gauhyakīṃ saṃdadhe punaḥ || saṃbhūtāḥ koṭiśo meghā garjato bhīmarūpiṇaḥ ||22|| viṣṭhāṃ mūtraṃ ca rudhiraṃ medomajjāsthivarṣiṇaḥ || jñātvātha gauhyakīṃ māyāṃ pradyumno bhagavānhariḥ ||23|| tannāśārthaṃ mahārāja kolāstraṃ saṃdadhe tviṣau || tadgaṇādyajñavārāho nirgato ghargharasvanaḥ ||24|| saṭā vidhūya vegena daṃṣṭrayā tīkṣṇayā ghanān || vidārayanraṇe reje veṇūnmattagajo yathā ||25|| daityo'tha māyāṃ gāṃdharvīṃ cakāra raṇamaṇḍale || yuddhaṃ na dṛśyate tadvaddhemasaudhāni koṭiśaḥ ||26|| vastrālaṃkārayuktāni babhūvuḥ paśyatāṃ satām || vidyādharyaśca gandharvā gāyanto nṛtyatatparāḥ ||27|| mṛdaṅgatālavāditrairmohanai rāgamiśritaiḥ || hāvabhāvakaṭākṣaiśca toṣayaṃtyo janānnṛpa ||28|| mohinyaḥ sundarī rāmāḥ śyāmāḥ kamalalocanāḥ || tāsāṃ lāvaṇyarāgābhyāṃ mohaṃ yāteṣu vṛṣṇiṣu ||29|| gāṃdharvīṃ mohinīṃ māyāṃ jñātvā kārṣṇirmahābalaḥ || saṃdadhe tatprahārārthe jñānāstraṃ raṇamaṇḍale ||30|| jñānodaye tadā jāte mohanāśo nṛpeśvara || nāśaṃ gatāyāṃ māyāyāṃ śakuniḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ ||31|| rākṣasīṃ saṃdadhe māyāṃ māyāvī daityapuṃgavaḥ || sapakṣaiḥ parvatai rājan kṣaṇāttacchāditaṃ nabhaḥ ||32|| mahāṃdhakāro'bhūtpṛthvyāṃ parārddhaṃ ca ghanairiva || dagdhavṛkṣaśilāsthīni kabaṃdharudhirāṇi ca ||33|| gadāparighanistriṃśamusalādīni sarvataḥ || aṃbarādbabhramuḥ śailā meghā iva videharāṭ ||34|| rakṣogaṇāḥ śūlahastāśchindhi bhiṃdhīti vādinaḥ || yātudhānāśca śataśo bhakṣayanto dvipānhayān ||35|| siṃhavyāghravarāhāśca dṛśyaṃte raṇamaṇḍale || mardayanto nakhairnāgāṃścarvayaṃto vapūṃṣi vai ||36|| palāyamānaṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā kārṣṇīrmahābalaḥ || jetuṃ tāṃ rākṣasīṃ māyāṃ nṛsiṃhāstraṃ samādadhe ||37|| āvirbhūto hariḥ sākṣānnṛsiṃho raudrarūpadhṛk || sphuratsaṭo lalajjihvo nakhalāṃgūlabhūṣitaḥ ||38|| caladbālo bhīṣaṇāsyo huṅkāreṇātibhīṣaṇaḥ || siṃhanādaṃ ca kurvan vai saṃsthito raṇamaṇḍale ||39|| nanāda tena brahmāṃḍaṃ saptalokairbilaiḥ saha || vicelurdiggajāstārā rājadbhūkhaṃḍamaṇḍalam ||40|| gṛhītvā hyaṃbare śailānsavṛkṣānnakharaḥ kharaiḥ || pātayāmāsa bhūpṛṣṭhe daityānāṃ ca prapaśyatām ||41|| rakṣogaṇānsaṃgṛhītvā pāṭayāmāsa vegataḥ || yātudhānagaṇānpadbhyāṃ sa mamarda harirmṛdhe ||42|| siṃhānvyāghrānvarāhāṃśca saṃvidārya nakhaiḥ kharaiḥ || cikṣepa gagane viṣṇustatraivāṃtardadhe punaḥ ||43|| nāśaṃ gatāyāṃ māyāyāṃ rākṣasyāṃ rukmiṇīsutaḥ || śaṃkhaṃ daghmau vijayadaṃ maulendraṃ ca raṇāṃgaṇe ||44|| abhūjjayajayārāvo dundubhidhvanimiśritaḥ || pradyumnasyopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire ||45|| svamāyāyāṃ nirgatāyāṃ śakunirdaityapuṃgavaḥ || sarathaḥ sainikaiḥ sārddhaṃ tatraivāṃtarhito'bhavat ||46|| māyāṃ cakāra daiteyīṃ mayadaityapradarśitām || hastiśuṇḍāsamāṃ dhārāṃ varṣato'titaḍitsvanāḥ ||47|| sāṃvarttakagaṇā meghā ājagmuḥ paśyatāṃ satām || kṣaṇātsarve samudrāste caṇḍavātena vepitāḥ ||48|| kṣubhitā urmisaṅgharṣāvartaiḥ plāvitabhūrujāḥ || bhūmaṇḍalaṃ sapadi tatplāvitaṃ cātmabhiḥ samam ||49|| dṛṣṭvātha yādavāḥ sarve prāpustatra bhayaṃ bahu || vadanto rāmakṛṣṇeti vismṛtasvaparākramāḥ ||50|| kṣaṇamātreṇa rājeṃdra tūṣṇīṃbhūtāḥ parājitāḥ || tadā kārṣṇirmahābāhuḥ kodaṇḍe caṇḍavikrame || bāṇaṃ nidhāya sahasā śrīkṛṣṇāstraṃ samādadhe ||51|| navārkakoṭidyutimanmahanmaho vīraṃ jayanmaithila vai diśo daśa || samāgataṃ tatra kuśasthalīpuraḥ svayaṃ paraṃ svārthamivātmavāṃchitam ||52|| tasminpare tejasi nūtanāṃbudacchaviṃ suvarṇāṃbujareṇuvāsasam || bhṛṃgāvalīkūjitakuntalāvaliṃ srajaṃ dadhānaṃ navavaijayantīm ||53|| śrīvatsaratnottamacāruvakṣasamaṃ caturbhujaṃ padmaviśālavīkṣaṇam || sphuratkirīṭaṃ varahāranūpuraṃ lasannavārkadyutihemakuṇḍalam ||54|| vilokya devaṃ yadavo'tiharṣitāḥ paraṃ praṇemuḥ kṛtahastasaṃpuṭāḥ || pracakrire maithila puṣpavarṣiṇo'marā jayārāvamatīva sarvataḥ ||55|| sa daityaśakuneḥ sajjaṃ kodaṃḍaṃ prācchinadruṣā || śārṅgamuktena tacchārṅgī bāṇenaikena līlayā ||56|| sa chinnadhanvā śakunistyaktvā yuddhaṃ pradharṣitaḥ || hetisaṃhatimānetuṃ yayau candrāvatīṃ purīm ||57|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīkṛṣṇāgamanaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||39||
<7.40> śrīnārada uvāca daitye gate'tha śakunau bhagavānkamalekṣaṇaḥ || kārṣṇyādiyādavānsarvānāhūyetthamuvāca ha ||1|| śrībhagavānuvāca daityo'yaṃ śakuniḥ pūrvaṃ sumeroḥ pārśva uttare || caturyugaṃ varjitānnastapasātoṣayacchivam ||2|| caturyuge vyatīte tu sākṣāddevo maheśvaraḥ || prasanno darśanaṃ datvā varam brūhītyuvāca ha ||2|| natvātha śakunirdaityaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ śanaiḥ || hṛṣṭaromāśrupūrṇākṣaḥ prāha gadgadayā girā ||4|| mṛtaḥ sanbhūmisaṃsparśādbhūyātsaṃjīvitaḥ prabho || ākāśe me mṛtirdeva mā bhūyādghaṭikādvayam ||5|| daityenokto haraḥ sākṣāddatvā tasmai varadvayam || paṃjarasthaṃ śukaṃ datvā prāha daityaṃ natānanam ||6|| jīvakalpaṃ śukaṃ cainaṃ rakṣa daitya sadānagha || asminmṛte ca jñātavyaṃ nidhanaṃ svaṃ tvayāsura ||7|| iti dattvā varaṃ tasmai rudraścāṃtaradhīyata || tasmāttasya vadho durge bhaviṣyati śuke mṛte ||8|| śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā vīrasadasi bhagavāndevakīsutaḥ || suparṇaṃ śīghramāhūya prāha prahasitānanaḥ ||9|| śrībhagavānuvāca śṛṇu tārkṣya mahābuddhe gaccha caṃdrāvatīṃ purīm || śatayojanavistīrṇāṃ daityasenāsamākulām ||10|| prāsādairgaganasparśairhemaratnamanoharaiḥ || vicitropavanārāmaiḥ śobhitāṃ daityapuṃgavaiḥ ||11|| durge durge dvāradeśe rakṣitāṃ daityapuṃgavaiḥ || tāṃ draṣṭuṃ garuḍo rājansūkṣmarūpaṃ dadhāra ha ||12|| alakṣito daityavṛṃdaiḥ paśyanprāsādatolikāḥ || teṣūtpatannutpataṃśca śakunermaṃdire gataḥ ||13|| prekṣañchukaṃ daityajīvaṃ kṣaṇaṃ tatra sthito'bhavat || yuddhārthaṃ daṃśitaṃ tatra śakuniṃ daityapuṃgavam ||14|| nānāśastradharaṃ vīraṃ krodhapūritamānasam || gṛhītvā taṃ parikare prāha rājanmadālasā ||15|| madālasovāca rājansarve'pi suhṛdo'nukūlā bhrātarastava || māritāḥ saṃgare bharttaḥ prodbhaṭā daityapuṃgavāḥ ||16|| mā yāhi yoddhuṃ yadubhirāgato bhagavānhariḥ || dehi tasmai baliṃ sadyo yena śreyo hyavāpsyasi ||17|| śakuniruvāca haniṣyāmi yadūnsainyairme hatā bhrātaro balāt || mṛtyurme nāsti bhūmadhye śivasyāpi vareṇa me ||18|| upadvīpe caṃdranāmni pataṃge parvate śubhe || me jīvarūpī tu śuko vartate sāṃprataṃ priye ||19|| śaṃkhacūḍena sarpeṇa rakṣito'harniśaṃ śukaḥ || etatko'pi na jānāti kathaṃ mṛtyuśca me bhavet ||20|| śrīnārada uvāca śukavārtāṃ tataḥ śrutvā garuḍo divyavāhanaḥ || upadvīpaṃ tu caṃdrākhyaṃ gantuṃ tasmānmano dadhe ||21|| utpatan garūḍo vegātsamudrasya taṭe gataḥ || dvīpaṃ vicinvaṃścaṃdrākhyamākāśe vicaran khagaḥ ||22|| śatayojanavistīrṇe samudre bhīmanādini || pakṣirāṭ siṃhalaṃ prāpa latāvṛṃdamanoharam ||23|| tatra papraccha garuḍaḥ kiṃ nāmāsya janānprati || siṃhalo'yamiti śrutvā garuḍaḥ protpatan khagaḥ ||24|| laṃkā prāpto mahāvegāttrikūṭaśikhare nṛpa || laṅkāṃ prāpya tato vegātpāṃcajanyaṃ jagāma ha ||25|| pāṃcajanyābdhinikaṭe kṣudhitaḥ pakṣirāḍ balī || prasahya mīnān jagrāha tīkṣṇayā tuṃḍayā bhṛśam ||26|| tatra caiko mahānnakro laṃbito yojanadvayam || pracaṃḍavego garuḍastīkṣṇayā tuṃḍayā ca tam ||27|| balena garuḍastasya cakārākarṣaṇaṃ taṭe || tayorākarṣaṇaṃ rājanmitho'bhūdghaṭikādvayam ||28|| pracaṃḍavego garuḍastīkṣṇayā tuṃḍayā ca tam || tatāḍa pṛṣṭhe dhṛṣṭāṃgaṃ daṃḍena yamarāḍyathā ||29|| nakrarūpaṃ vihāyāśu so'bhūdvidyādharo mahān || natvā śrīgaruḍaṃ sākṣātprāha prahasitānanaḥ ||30|| vidyādhara uvāca ahaṃ vidyādharaḥ pūrvaṃ nāmnā vai hemakuṃḍalaḥ || ākāśagaṃgāyāṃ snātuṃ gato divijamaṃḍale ||31|| tatra snānaṃ prakurvaṃtaṃ kakutthaṃ munisattam || pāde gṛhītvā hāsyena jalāṃtargatavānaham ||32|| māṃ śaśāpa kakuttho'pi tvaṃ nakro bhava durmate || mayā prasāditaḥ śīghraṃ prasannaḥ san varaṃ dadau ||33|| tārkṣyatuṃḍaprahāreṇa nakratvāttvaṃ vimucyase || tasya śāpādadya muktaḥ kṛpayā tava suvrata ||34|| śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā ca gate svarge vidyādhre hemakuṃḍale || uḍḍito garuḍastasmātpakṣābhyāṃ vyomamaṃḍale ||35|| hariṇākhyaṃ copadvīpaṃ prāptavān vegataḥ khagaḥ || apāṃtaratamāstatra karoti vipulaṃ tapaḥ ||36|| tasyāśrame khageśasya pakṣacaṃdraṃ papāta ha || taṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha garuḍamapāṃtaratamā muniḥ ||37|| pakṣaṃ nidhāya me mūrdhni gaccha pakṣinyathāsukham || pakṣaṃ nītvā gatastarkṣyo dhṛtvā tanmastake ca tam ||38|| tatsamānānpakṣacandrānanekānsa dadarśa ha || prāhātivismitaṃ tārkṣyamapāṃtaramā muniḥ ||39|| yadā yadā hi śrīkṛṣṇāvatāro'bhūttadā tadā || pakṣo'pi garuḍasyātra patatyekaḥ sadā khaga ||40|| kalpe kalpe kṛṣṇacaṃdrāvatāraḥ pakṣaḥ pakṣo mūrdhni me so'pi so'pi || ānaṃtyādvā''dyantavantaṃ vadaṃti pakṣinmūrdhnā naumi kṛṣṇāya tasmai ||41|| śrīnārada uvāca tacchrutvā vismitastārkṣyo natvā taṃ munipuṃgavam || dvīpaṃ ramaṇakaṃ prāgādutpatan vyomamaṃḍalāt ||42|| sarpebhyo'pi baliṃ nītvā dvīpamāvartakaṃ gataḥ || tatra divye sudhākuṃḍe sudhāṃ pītvā virāḍbalī ||43|| śukladvīpaṃ tu saṃprāptaḥ prapaccha dvīpacaṃdrabhāk || mayā praṇoditaḥ pakṣī prayayāvuttarāṃ diśam ||44|| candradvīpaṃ tu saṃprāptaḥ parvate patageśvaraḥ || jaladurgaṃ vahnidurgaṃ vainateyo dadarśa ha ||45|| jaladurgaṃ caṃcupaṭe sarvaṃ kṛtvā virāḍbalī || vahnidurgaṃ ca tenāpi sāṃtvayāmāsa maithila ||46|| darīmukhe śayānā ye daityā lakṣaṃ samutthitāḥ || taiḥ sārddhaṃ samabhūdyuddhaṃ tārkṣyasya ghaṭikādvayam ||47|| kāṃścitpādanakhairyuddhe vidadāra khageśvaraḥ | kāṃściddaityānsvapakṣābhyāṃ pātayāmāsa bhūtale ||48|| kāṃściccaṃcupuṭenāpi gṛhītvā pakṣirāḍbalī || pātayitvā gireḥ pṛṣṭhe cikṣepa gagane balāt ||49|| kecinmṛtāstathā śeṣā dudruvuste diśo daśa || itthaṃ daityavadhaṃ kṛtvā darīmadhye gataḥ khagaḥ ||50|| cakāra pādavikṣepaṃ śaṃkhacūḍopari sphurat || śaṃkhacūḍo'pi garuḍaṃ dṛṣṭvā so'tipradharṣitaḥ ||51|| śukaṃ jale paṃjarasthaṃ śīghraṃ tyaktvā palāyitaḥ || caṃcudeśena taṃ nītvā śukaṃ sadyaḥ sapaṃjaram ||52|| protpatannaṃbare rājan yuddhe gantuṃ mano dadhe || palāyitānāṃ daityānāṃ tāvatkolāhalo mahān ||53|| śuko nītaḥ śuko nīto vadatāmaṃbare nṛpa || tacchabdo dikṣu sainyānāṃ gataśabdastu śṛṇvatām ||54|| divi bhūmau sarvato'pi brahmāṃḍe'pi prapūritaḥ || śuko nīta iti śrutvā śakuniḥ śaṃkito'suraiḥ ||55|| śūlaṃ dhṛtvā tataḥ sadyaścaṃdrāvatyāṃ samutthitaḥ || garuḍena śuko nītaḥ śrutvā kruddhaḥ samanvayāt ||56|| tacchūlatāḍitastārkṣyo na jahau mukhataḥ śukam || saptadvīpānsaptasiṃdhūnnirīkṣansa gataḥ khagaḥ ||57|| tamanvadhāvaddaityeṃdro dikṣu dikṣu nabhoṃtare || bhramannāgāṃtako rājannākāśe koṭiyojanam ||58|| daityatriśūlakṣatabhṛnna jahau mukhataḥ śukam || sapaṃjaraḥ śuko rājannākāśe lakṣayojanam ||59|| papātopalavadvegātsumerorgirimūrddhani || paṃjaro'gātkhagastatra viśīrṇo'bhūdvyasuḥ śukaḥ ||60|| garuḍo'tha mahāyuddhe kṛṣṇapārśvaṃ samāgataḥ || daityaḥ khinnamanā rājanpurīṃ candrāvatīṃ yayau ||61|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde garuḍāgamo nāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||40||
<7.41> śrīnārada uvāca daityāna śeṣān samānīya nānāyuddhadharo balī || uccaiḥśravasamūhāya hayaṃ divya manoharam ||1|| dhanuṣṭaṃkārayanvīraḥ śakuniḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ || āyayau saṃmukhe yoddhuṃ śrīkṛṣṇasyāpi saṃmukhe ||2|| punaḥ prāptaṃ daityasainyaṃ śakuniṃ yuddhadurmadam || taṃ vīkṣya vṛṣṇayaḥ sarve jagṛhuḥ svāyudhāni ca ||3|| daityānāṃ yadubhiḥ sārddhaṃ ghoraṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva ha || vīraiḥ saṃyuyudhurvīrāḥ siṃhāḥ siṃhairivāhave ||4|| sarveṣāmagrataḥ prāptaḥ kodaṃḍaṃ nādayanmuhuḥ || śakunirmeghavadrājan cakre nārācadurdinam ||5|| bāṇāṃdhakāre saṃjāte bhagavān garuḍadhvajaḥ || śārṅgī śārṅgeṇa dhanuṣā yatheṃdreṇa ghano babhau ||6|| śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsākṣācchakunerasurasya ca || ciccheda bāṇapaṭalaṃ bāṇenaikena līlayā ||7|| ākṛṣya karṇaparyaṃtaṃ kodaṃḍaṃ śakunirmṛdhe || tatāḍa daśabhirbāṇaiḥ śrīkṛṣṇahṛdi maithila ||8|| pralayābdhimahāvartabhīmasaṃgharṣanādinīm || dhanurjyāṃ śakunaiḥ śauriściccheda daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ || 9|| māyāvī śakunirdaityaḥ śatarupī babhūva ha || yuyodha hariṇā yuddhe sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ nṛpa ||10|| sahasrāṇi svarūpāṇi dhṛtvā sākṣāddhariḥ svayam || yuyudhe tena daityena tadadbhutanivābhavat ||11|| mayadaityena racitaṃ triśūlaṃ jvalanaprabham || bhrāmayitvātha haraye prāhiṇoddaityarāḍ balī ||12|| tataḥ kruddho mahābāhuḥ paripūrṇatamo hariḥ || ciccheda taṃ tīkṣṇatuṃḍaṃ pannagaṃ garuḍo yathā ||13|| tataḥ kruddho mahābāhurgadāṃ cikṣepa mūrddhani || hayāttaṃ pātayāmāsa gadayā vajrakalpayā ||14|| gadāprahāravyathitaḥ kṣaṇaṃ mūrcchāṃ gato'suraḥ || gṛhītvā svāṃ gadāṃ yuddhe yuyudhe mādhavena vai ||15|| tayoryuddhamabhūdghoraṃ gadābhyāṃ raṇamaṃḍale || abhuccaṭacaṭārāvo vajraniṣpeṣavatkila ||16|| śrīkṛṣṇagadayā tasya cūrṇībhūtā gadā bhuvi || vireje'ṅgāravattatra sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ mṛdhe ||17|| giridaryāṃ yathā siṃhau vane mattau gajāvubhau || raṇamadhye tathā tau dvau yuyudhāte parasparam ||18|| śrīkṛṣṇaṃ nodayāmāsa śakuniḥ śatayojanam || haristaṃ preṣayāmāsa sahasrayojanaṃ bhuvi ||19|| gṛhītvā bhujayostaṃ vai jaṃghābhyāṃ bhuvaneśvaraḥ || pātayāmāsa bhūpṛṣṭhe kamaṃḍalumivārbhakaḥ ||20|| kiṃcidvyathāṃ gato daityo gṛhītvā jārudhiṃgirim || prāhiṇocca durācāraḥ śakuniryuddhadurmadaḥ ||21|| samāgataṃ giriṃ vīkṣya bhagavānkamalekṣaṇaḥ || jayaśabdaṃ prakurvaṃtāvanyonyaṃ tāḍayan girim ||22|| cūrṇayāmāsatū rājaṃstathā caṃdrāvatīṃ purīm || tadā daityo'tisaṃkruddho gṛhītvā khaḍgacarmaṇī ||23|| āyayau saṃmukhe rājañchrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ || śārṅgī śāṃrṅgaṃ saṃgṛhītvāthārddhacaṃdramukhaṃ śaram ||24|| saṃdadhe sahasā yuddhe grīṣmamārtaṃḍasannibham || śārṅgamukto divyabāṇo dyotayanmaṃḍalaṃ diśām ||24|| śakunermastakaṃ chittvā bhūmiṃ bhitvā talaṃ gataḥ || vyasurbhūtvā tadā daityaḥ patito raṇamaṇḍale ||26|| bhūmisparśātsajīvo'bhūtkṣaṇamātreṇa maithila || kareṇādāya muṃḍaṃ svaṃ svakabaṃdhe nidhāya saḥ ||27|| yuddhaṃ kartuṃ samuttasthau tadadbhutamivābhavat || itthaṃ kṛṣṇena nihataḥ saptavāraṃ mahāsuraḥ ||28|| bhūmisparśātsajīvo'bhūdrāhuvatpunarutthitaḥ || ekākī yādavakulaṃ saṃhāraṃ kartumudyataḥ ||29|| viveśāśu mahādaityo vane vahniriva prabhuḥ || saturaṃgānmahāvīrānsaśastrānutkaṭān gajān ||30|| saṃgṛhītvā bhujābhyāṃ khaṃ prākṣipallakṣayojanam || kāṃścidgajānmukhe dhṛtvā skandhayorubhayorapi ||31|| kakṣayorubhayordaityo babhau kālāgnirudravat || padbhyāṃ karābhyāṃ daityasya trāsaṃ yāte mahāmṛdhe ||32|| hāhākāro mahānāsīcchrīkṛṣṇsya mahātmanaḥ || tadaiva bhagavānsākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo viśvarakṣakaḥ || sudarśanāstraṃ prāyuṃkta sādhūnāṃ rakṣaṇāya vai ||33|| taddhastamuktaṃ niśitaṃ sudarśanaṃ layārkakoṭidyutimajjvalatprabham || jahāra sadyaḥ śakunerdṛḍhaṃ śiro yathā ca vṛtrasya pavirmahāmṛdhe ||34|| tāvadgṛhītvā śakuniṃ mahāmṛdhe cikṣepa sadyo mṛtamaṃbare balāt || utkṣepaṇaṃ bhoḥ kuruteṣubhirdivi yadūn girā śrīpatirityuvāca ||35|| śrīnārada uvāca itthaṃ harervacaḥ śrutvā sarve yādavapuṃgavāḥ || aṃbarātprapataṃtaṃ te teḍurbāṇaiḥ sphuratprabhaiḥ ||36|| daityo dīptimato bāṇairaṃbare śatayojanam || gataḥ kaṃdukavadrājannūrdhvaṃ lokasya paśyataḥ ||37|| sāṃbasyāpi sa bāṇena sahasraṃ yojane gataḥ || punastamāpataṃtaṃ khāñjaghāna tviṣuṇārjunaḥ ||38|| tena bāṇena daityeṃdro yojanaṃ cāyutaṃ gataḥ || aniruddhasya bāṇena lakṣayojanamāsthitaḥ ||39|| pradyumnasyāpi bāṇena niyutaṃ yojanaṃ gataḥ || punastamāpataṃtaṃ khādvikṣya yogeśvareśvaraḥ ||40|| bāṇaṃ samādadhe tena gataḥ khe koṭiyojanam || evaṃ khe saṃsthite daitye vyatīte praharadvaye ||41|| dvitīyenāpi bāṇena taṃ jaghāna hariḥ svayam || sabāṇastaṃ bhrāmayitvā dikṣu vai koṭiyojanam ||42|| samudre pātayāmāsa vātaḥ padmamiva prabhuḥ || evaṃ mṛte tadā daitye tajjyotirnirgataṃ sphurat ||43|| sarvato'pi bhramadrājan śrīkṛṣṇe līnatāṃ gatam || tadā jayajayārāvo divi bhūmāvavartata ||44|| vidyādharyaśca gadharvyo nanṛtuḥ khe sukhānvitāḥ || jaguḥ kinnaragaṃdharvāstuṣṭuvuḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ ||45|| ṛṣayo munayaḥ sarve praśaśaṃsurhariṃ param || brahmarudreṃdrasūryādyāḥ sarve tatra samāgatāḥ ||46|| śrīkṛṣṇasyopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire ||47|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śakunidaityavadho nāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||41||
<7.42> śrīnārada uvāca palāyiteṣu śeṣeṣu daityeṣu raṇamaṃḍalāt || vīṇāveṇumṛdaṃgādīnnādayanduṃdubhīnhariḥ ||1|| gīyamāno yādaveṃdraḥ sūtamāgadhavandibhiḥ || svaputrairyādavaiḥ sārddhaṃ svasainyaparivāritaḥ ||2|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmaśārṅgacāpavirājitaḥ || praviveśa suraiḥ sārddhaṃ purīṃ caṃdrāvatīṃ prabhuḥ ||3|| duḥkhārtā bhartari mṛte rudaṃtī karuṇaṃ bahu || aṃke gṛhītvā śakuneḥ sutaṃ rājñī madālasā ||4|| śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇe bālaṃ nidhāyāśu kṛtāṃjaliḥ || aśrupūrṇamukhī dīnā hariṃ natvā jagāda ha ||5|| madālasovāca bhārāvatārāya bhuvi prabho tvaṃ jāto yadūnāṃ kula adideva || grasiṣyase yāni bhavaṃ nidhāya guṇairna lipto'si namāmi tubhyam ||6|| madātmajaṃ pālaya bhītabhītamamuṣya hastaṃ kuru śīrṣṇi deva || bhartrā kṛtaṃ me kila te'parādhaṃ kṣamasva deveśa jagannivāsa ||7|| śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvo bhagavāṃstasya mūrdhni kṛtvā karadvayam || sarvaṃ candrāvatīrājyaṃ dadau tasmai mahāmuniḥ ||8|| datvā kalpāṃtamāyuṣyaṃ bhaktijñānaṃ viraktimat || śakuneḥ śiśave kṛṣṇaḥ svamālāṃ pradadau śubhām ||9|| uccaiḥśravo hayo ratnaṃ kāmadhenuḥ suradrumaḥ || āhṛtā ye śakuninā purā yuddhe puraṃdarāt ||10|| puraṃdarāya tānprādātprayatnācchrījanārdanaḥ || goviprasurasādhūnāṃ chaṃdasāṃ pālakaḥ svayam ||11|| bahulāśva uvāca ke'mī daityāḥ pūrvakāle śakunyādyā mahābalāḥ || devarṣe me paraṃ citraṃ kasmānmokṣamupāgatāḥ ||12|| śrīnārada uvāca brahmakalpe purā rājan gaṃdharveśaḥ purāvasuḥ || āsīttasya śubhāḥ putrā babhūvurnuva caurasāḥ ||13|| kaṃdarpasamalāvaṇyā divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ || nityaṃ jagurbrahmaloke gītavādyaviśāradāḥ ||14|| mandāro mandaro mando mandahāso mahābalaḥ || sudevaḥ sudhanaḥ saudhaḥ śrībhānuriti viśrutāḥ ||15|| ekadā mohataḥ putrīṃ vāgdevīṃ vīkṣya vedhasaḥ || jahasuste svamanasi purāvasusutāśca ye ||16|| surajyeṣṭhāparādhena gatā yoniṃ ca tāmasīm || vārāhe'tha hiraṇyākṣapatnyāṃ te jajñire nava ||17|| śakuniḥ śaṃbaro hṛṣṭo bhūtasaṃtāpano vṛkaḥ || kālanābho mahānābho hariśmaśrustathotkacaḥ ||18|| ekadā gṛhamāyāṃtamapāṃtaratamaṃ munim || natvā saṃpūjya vidhivatpapracchuridamādarāt ||19|| daityā ūcuḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ svamukhādbrahman kaivalyeśo hariḥ svayam || dadāti mokṣaṃ bhagavān bhaktānāṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ ||20|| asmābhirna kṛtā bhaktirāsurīṃ yonimāsthitaiḥ || duḥsaṃganiratairduṣṭaiḥ kathaṃ mokṣo bhavediha ||21|| upāyaṃ vada no brahmankalyāṇasya parasya ca || kalyāṇārthaṃ vicarasi dīnānāṃ jagati prabho ||22|| apāntaratamā uvāca guṇānāmapṛthagbhāvairye bhajaṃti hariṃ param || te te prāpuḥ paraṃ daityā nirguṇaṃ mokṣanāyakam ||23|| aikyaṃ ca sauhṛdaṃ snehaṃ bhayaṃ krodhaṃ smayaṃ tathā || vidhāya pūrvaṃ satataṃ śrīkṛṣṇe līnatāṃ gatāḥ ||24|| pṛśnigarbhasya saṃbaṃdhātprajānāṃ patayo yathā || kāyādhavaḥ sauhṛdācca snehācca sutapā muniḥ ||25|| bhayāddhiraṇyakaśipuḥ krodhādvaśca pitāsuraḥ || smayācca śrutayaḥ prāpuryogināṃ durlabhaṃ param ||26|| yena kenāpi bhāvena śrīkṛṣṇe dhārayenmanaḥ || bhaktiyogena taddhāma yadebhiḥ prāpyate surāḥ ||27|| śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvāṃtarhite rājannapāntaratame munau || cakrurvairaṃ śakunyādyāḥ paripūrṇatame harau ||28|| te prāpurvairabhāvena śrīkṛṣṇaṃ parameśvaram || na citraṃ viddhi rājeṃdra kīṭaḥ peśaskṛtaṃ yathā ||29|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śakunyādidaityānāṃ pūrvajanmaparicayo nāma dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||42||
<7.43> śrīnārada uvāca itthaṃ khaṃḍaṃ tu bhadrāścaṃ jitvā śrīyādaveśvaraḥ || yadubhīḥ sainikaiḥ sārddhamilāvṛtamathāyayau ||1|| vibhāti yatraiva girīṃdrarājo bhūpadmagolasya ca karṇikeva || sphuraddyutiḥ svarṇamayaḥ sumeruḥ surālayo maithila ratnasānuḥ ||2|| taṃ sarvato maṃdaramerusuṃdarau supārśva evaṃ kumudaścaturthakaḥ || vibhāti saiko giribhirnageśvaraścatuṣpadārthaiśca manorathā iva ||3|| jāṃbūnadaṃ jaṃbubhavaṃ hi yatra yataḥ svataḥ siddhibhavaṃ suvarṇam || yatrāruṇodākhyanadī ca jātā yadvāripānādbhuvi nāmayitvam ||4|| kadaṃbajā madhudhārāśca paṃca yāsāṃ tu pānena nṛṇāṃ kadāpi || śītoṣṇavaivarṇyapariśramādyā daurgandhyabhāvā na bhavaṃti rājan ||5|| yadudbhavāḥ kāmadughā nadāśca ratnānnavāsaḥśubhabhūṣaṇāni || śayyāsanādīni phalāni yāni divyāni tāni tvatha cārpayaṃti ||6|| evaṃ ca yatrordhvavanaṃ prasiddhaṃ saṃkarṣaṇo yatra virājate'tha || śivaḥ sadāsau ramate priyābhiḥ strībhāvatāṃ yāṃti janāstu tatra ||7|| haimāṃbujaiḥ śītavasaṃtavāyubhiḥ kāśmīravṛkṣaiśca lavaṃgajālaiḥ || devadrumāmodamadāṃdhaṣaṭpadairilāvṛtaṃ khaṃḍamatīva reje ||8|| paśyan bhuvaṃ svarṇamayīṃ manoharāṃ vaidūryaratnāṃkuravṛṃdacitritām || ilāvṛtaṃ pūrṇamalaṃkṛtaiḥ surairvijitya khaṃḍaṃ jagṛhe baliṃ hariḥ ||9|| śrīśobhano nāma purā kṛtena jāmātṛko'bhūnmucukuṃdabhūbhṛtaḥ || ekādaśīṃ yaḥ samupoṣya bhārate prāptaḥ sa devaiḥ kila maṃdarācale ||10|| adyāpi rājyaṃ kurute kuberavadrājñaḥ suto'sau kila candrabhāgayā || nītvā baliṃ devavarasya saṃmukhe samāyayau maithila suṃdaraḥ paraḥ ||11|| pradakṣiṇīkṛtya hariṃ yadūttamaṃ pādāraviṃde patito'tha śobhanaḥ || bhaktyā praṇamyāśu baliṃ mahātmane datvā yayau maithila maṃdarācalam ||12|| bahulāśva uvāca śobhane ca nṛpe yāte bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ || agre cakāra kiṃ devo vada devarṣisattama ||13|| śrīnārada uvāca sarovaraṃ paraṃ divyaṃ tasminmandarasānuni || sauvarṇapaṅkajaṃ vīkṣya kirīṭī prāha mādhavam ||14|| arjuna uvāca kāṃcanībhirlatābhiśca sauvarṇeḥ paṃkajairvṛtam || vada māṃ devakīputra kasyedaṃ kuṃḍamadbhutam ||15|| śrībhagavānuvāca pṛthuḥ pūrvo rājarājaḥ svāyaṃbhuvakulodbhavaḥ || tatāpa sa tapo divyaṃ tasyedaṃ kuṇḍamadbhutam ||16|| asya pītvā jalaṃ sadyaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || snātvā taddhāma paramaṃ yāti pārtha naretaraḥ ||17|| śrīnārada uvāca atraiva bhagavānsākṣāttapobhūmiṃ jagāma ha || sarūpāstatra nṛtyaṃti sarvāstā hyaṣṭasiddhayaḥ ||18|| tā vīkṣya coddhavaḥ prāha bhagavaṃtaṃ sanātanam || uddhava uvāca kasyeyaṃ sutapobhūmirmandarācalasannidhau || mūrtimatyo virājaṃtyaḥ kāḥ striyo vada he prabho ||19|| śrībhagavānuvāca svāyaṃbhuvena manunā tapaścātra kṛtaṃ purā || tasyeyaṃ sutapobhūmiradyāpi śreyasī bahu ||20|| sadātraiva hi vartaṃte nārīrūpāṣṭasiddhayaḥ || atra prāptasya kasyāpi tatastāśca bhavaṃti hi ||21|| atra kṣaṇena tapasā devatvaṃ yāti mānavaḥ || tapobhūmeśca māhātmyaṃ vaktuṃ nālaṃ caturmukhaḥ ||22|| śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ svasainyaparivāritaḥ || jagāma protkaṭāndeśāndundubhīnnādayanmuhuḥ ||23|| hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo yatra tepe tapaḥ purā || yatra līlāvatī nāma vartate kāṃcanī purī ||24|| līlāvatīśvaraḥ sākṣādvītihotro hutāsanaḥ || nityaṃ rājyaṃ prakurute mūrtimān bhuvi suvrataḥ || 25|| so'pi śrīkṛṣṇacaṃdrāya puruṣāya mahātmane || baliṃ datvā parāṃ śaśvatstutiṃ cakre dhanaṃjayaḥ ||26|| itthaṃ paśyandevadevaḥ sarvaṃ varṣamilāvṛtam || jagāma vedanagaraṃ jaṃbūdvīpaṃ manoramam ||27|| mūrtimān yatra nigamo dṛśyate sarvadaiva hi || tatsabhāyāṃ sadā vāṇī vīṇāpustakadhāriṇī ||28|| gāyantī kṛṣṇacaritaṃ subhagaṃ maṃgalāyanam || urvaśīpūrvacityādyā nṛtyaṃtyapsaraso nṛpa ||29|| hāvabhāvakaṭākṣaiśca toṣayantyaḥ śrutīśvaram || ahaṃ viśvāvasuścaiva tuṃbaruśca sudarśanaḥ ||30|| tathā citraratho hyete vāditrāṇi muhurmuhuḥ || veṇuvīṇāmṛdaṅgāni muruyaṣṭiyutāni ca ||31|| tāladundubhibhiḥ sārddhaṃ vādayanti yathāvidhi || hrasvadīrghaplutodāttānudāttasvaritā nṛpa ||32|| sānunāsikabhedaśca tathā niranunāsikaḥ || etairaṣṭādaśairbhaidairgīyante śrutayaḥ paraiḥ ||33|| mūrtimanto virājaṃte tatra vedapure nṛpa || aṣṭau tālāḥ svarāḥ sapta tathā grāmatrayaṃ nṛpa ||34|| vasanti vedanagare mūrtimantaḥ sadaiva hi || bhairavo meghamallāro dīpako mālakaṃsakaḥ ||35|| śrīrāgaścāpi hiṃḍolo rāgāḥ ṣaṭ saṃprakīrtitāḥ || pañcabhiśca priyābhiśca tanujairaṣṭabhiḥ pṛthak ||36|| mūrtimantastu te tatra vicaranti nareśvara || bhairavo babhrūvarṇaśca mālakaṃsaḥ śukadyutiḥ ||37|| mayūradyutisaṃyukto meghamallāra eva hi || suvarṇābho dīpakaśca śrīrāgo'ruṇavarṇabhṛt || hiṃḍolo divyahaṃsābho rājate mithileśvara ||38|| bahulāśva uvāca tālānāṃ ca svarāṇāṃ ca grāmāṇāṃ munisattama || nṛtyānāṃ kati bhedā vai nāmabhiḥ sahitān vada ||39|| śrīnārada uvāca rūpakaścañcarīkaśca tālaḥ paramaṭhaḥ smṛtaḥ || virāṭakamaṭhaścaiva mallakaśca jhaṭijjuṭā ||40|| niṣādarṣabhagāṃdhāraṣaḍjamadhyamadhaivatāḥ || pañcamaścetyamī rājan svarāḥ sapta prakīrtitāḥ ||41|| mādhuryamatha gāṃdhāraṃ dhrauvyaṃ grāmatrayaṃ smṛtam || rāsaṃ ca tāṃḍavaṃ nāṭyaṃ gāṃdharvaṃ kainnaraṃ tathā ||42|| vaidyādharaṃ gauhyakaṃ ca nṛtyamākrūrasaṃ nṛpa || hāvabhāvānubhāvaiśca daśabhiścāṣṭabhedavat ||43|| sāregamapadhanīti svaragamyaṃ padaṃ smṛtam || etatte kathitaṃ rājan kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ||44|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde vedanagaravarṇanaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||43||
<7.44> bahulāśva uvāca rāgiṇīnāṃ ca nāmāni vada devaṛṣe mama || tathā vai rāgaputrāṇāṃ tvaṃ parāvaravittamaḥ ||1|| śrīnārada uvāca kālena deśabhedena kriyayā svaramiśrayā || bhedā budhaiḥ ṣaṭpañcāśatkoṭyo gītasya kīrtitāḥ ||2|| aṃtarbhedā anaṃtāhi teṣāṃ santi nṛpeśvara || viddhyenaṃ rāgamānandaṃ śabdabrahmamayaṃ harim ||3|| tasmānmukhyāśca bhedāḥ kau vadiṣyāmi tavāgrataḥ || bhairavī piṃgalā śaṃkī līlāvatyagarī tathā ||4|| bhairavasyāpi rāgasya rāgiṇyaḥ pañca kīrtitāḥ || maharṣiśca samṛddhaśca piṃgalo māgadhastathā ||5|| bilāvalaśca vaiśākho lalitaḥ pañcamastathā || bhairavasyāṣṭa putrā ye gīyaṃte ca pṛthak pṛthak ||6|| citrā jayajayāvaṃtī vicitrā kathitā punaḥ || vṛjallārṣyaṃdhakākārī rāgiṇyo'pi manoharāḥ ||7|| meghamallārarāgasya kathitā pañca maithila || śyāmakāraḥ soraṭhaśca naṭo ḍāyana eva ca ||8|| kedāro vrajaraṃhasyo jaladhārastathaiva ca || vihāgaścetyaṣṭa putrā kathitāḥ pūrvasūribhiḥ ||9|| kaṃcukī maṃjarī ṭoḍī gurjarī śābarī tathā ||10|| dīpakasyāpi rāgasya rāgiṇyaḥ paṃca viśrutāḥ || kalyāṇaḥ śubhakāmaśca gauḍakalyāṇa eva ca ||11|| kāmarūpaḥ kānhareti rāmasaṃjīvanastathā || sukhanāmā mandahāsaḥ putrāścāṣṭau videharāṭ ||12|| rāgasya dīpakasyāpi kathitā rāgapaṇḍitaiḥ || gāṃdhārī vedagāṃdhārī dhanāśrīsvarmaṇistathā ||13|| guṇāgarīti rāgiṇyaḥ pañcaitā maithileśvara || mālakośasya rāgasya kathitā rāgamaṇḍale ||14|| meghaścamacalo mārumācāraḥ kauśikastathā || candrahāro ghuṃghuṭaśca vihāro nanda eva ca ||||15|| mālakośasya rāgasya cāṣṭaputrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || vairāṭi caiva karṇāṭī gaurī gaurāvaṭī tathā ||16|| catuścandrakalā caiva rāgiṇyaḥ pañca viśrutāḥ || śrīrāgasyāpi rājendra kathitāḥ pūrvasūribhiḥ ||17|| sāraṃgaḥ sāgaro gauro marutpañcaśarastathā || govindaśca hamīraśca gīrbhīraśca tathaiva ca ||18|| śrīrāgasyāpi rājendra hyaṣṭau putrā manoharāḥ || vasantī airajā herī tailaṃgī sundarī tathā ||19|| hiṃḍolasyāpi rāgasya rāgiṇyaḥ pañca viśrutāḥ || maṃgalaśca vasantaśca vinodaḥ kumudastathā ||20|| evaṃ ca vihito nāma vibhāsaḥ svaramaṇḍalaḥ || putrāścāṣṭau samākhyātā maithilendra vicakṣaṇaiḥ ||21|| bahulāśva uvāca śabdabrahma hareḥ sākṣānnigamasya mahātmanaḥ || rāgamaṇḍala ityevaṃ hiṃḍolasya pṛthak pṛthak ||22|| aṃgāni vada me deva kāni kāni mahītale || śrīnārada uvāca mukhaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ proktaṃ piṃgalaḥ pāda ucyate ||23|| mīmāṃsaśāstraṃ hastau ca jyotirnetraṃ prakīrtitam || āyurvedaḥ pṛṣṭhadeśo dhanurveda uraḥsthalam ||24|| gāṃdharvaṃ rasanaṃ viddhi mano vaiśeṣikaṃ smṛtam ||25|| sāṃkhyaṃ buddhirahaṃkāro nyāyavādaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || vedāṃtaṃ tasya cittaṃ hi vedasyāpi mahātmanaḥ ||26|| rāgarūpamimaṃ rājan vihāraṃ viddhi maithila || etatte kathitaṃ rājan kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ||27|| bahulāśva uvāca tasminvedapure ramye kiṃ cakāra hariḥ svayam || etanme vada devarṣe tvaṃ sākṣāddivyadarśanaḥ ||28|| śrīnārada uvāca āyāṃtaṃ vedanagaraṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ yādaveśvaram || nigamo'pi baliṃ nītvā sarasvatyā tayā saha ||29|| gaṃdharvairapsarobhiśca grāmatālaiḥ svaraiḥ saha || rāgaiḥ sabhedaiḥ sahitaḥ praṇanāma kṛtāṃjaliḥ ||30|| prasanno bhagavānsākṣāddevadevo janārdanaḥ || vedaṃ prāha yadūnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ satām 31|| śrībhagavānuvāca nigama tvaṃ varaṃ brūhi yatte manasi vartate || durlabhaṃ kiṃ trilokeṣu bhaktānāṃ harṣite mayi ||32|| veda uvāca yadi deva prasanno'si sarve ye me supārṣadāḥ || teṣāṃ deva nijaṃ rūpaṃ darśayātra pareśvara ||33|| yadrūpaṃ te ca goloke svadhāmni prasphuraddyutau || vṛṃdāvane ca tadrāse tasya darśanakāṃkṣiṇaḥ ||34|| śrīnārada uvāca śrutvā vedavacaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam || svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa rādhayā sahitaṃ param ||35|| tadrūpaṃ suṃdaraṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve vai mūrcchanāṃ gatāḥ || pūritāḥ sāttvikairbhāvairvismṛtya svatanoḥ sukham ||36|| tadāpi harṣitāḥ sarve vāditrairmadhurasvanaiḥ || jagustatpurato rājannanṛtuḥ paśyatāṃ satām ||37|| yathā śrutaṃ tathā dṛṣṭaṃ mādhuryaṃ rūpamadbhutam || tathaiva cakrurvedādyā varṇanaṃ maithileścara ||38|| veda uvāca sajjñānamātraṃ sadasatparaṃ bṛhacchaśvatpraśāṃtaṃ vibhavaṃ samaṃ mahat || tvāṃ brahma vaṃde vasudurgamaṃ parāṃ sadā svadhāmnā paribhūtakaitavam ||39|| sarasvatyuvāca mahaḥ paraṃ tvāṃ kila yogino viduḥ savigrahaṃ tatra vadaṃti sātvatāḥ || dṛṣṭaṃ tu yatte padayordvayaṃ me kṣemasya bhūyānmahasāmadhīśvaram ||40|| gandharvā ūcuḥ śyāmaṃ ca gauraṃ viditaṃ svadhāmnā kṛtaṃ tvayā dhāma nijecchayā hi || virājase nityamalaṃ ca tābhyāṃ ghano yathā mecakadāminībhyām ||41|| apsarasa ūcuḥ yathā tamālaḥ kaladhautavallyā ghano yathā caṃcalayā cakāsti || nīlo'drirājo nikaṣāśmakhanyā śrīrādhayā''dyastu tathā ramaṇyā ||42|| grāmā ūcuḥ yasya padasya parāgaṃ śaṃbhū ramā kavidevaiḥ || icchati cetāsi rādhā taṃ bhaja mādhavapādam ||43|| tālā ūcuḥ yena baliḥ sadviharettadbalimeva haret || taṃ bhaja pādaṃ tu hareścetasi tapte kuhare ||44|| gānā ūcuḥ ūtkṣipaṃti bahirduḥkhaṃ santo yaccharaṇaṃ gatāḥ || rādhāmādhavayordivyaṃ dadhāma padapaṃkajam ||45|| svarā ūcuḥ śaradvikacapaṃkajaśriyamatīva vidveṣakaṃ milīndamunileḍhitaṃ kuliśakajacihnāvṛtam || sphuratkanakanūpuraṃ dalitabhaktatāpatrayaṃ caladdyutipadadvayaṃ hṛdi dadhāmi rādhāpate ||46|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde vedādistutivarṇanaṃ nāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||44||
<7.45> śrīnārada uvāca bhairavādyā rāgagaṇāḥ puraḥ prāptā hareḥ prabhoḥ || rūpānurūpāvayavāṃ tanuṃ dṛṣṭvātiharṣitāḥ ||1|| yatra yatra ca teṣāṃ vai dṛṣṭiḥ prāptā harestanau || tatra sthitā ca nirgantuṃ lāvaṇyānna śaśāka ha ||2|| aho śrīkṛṣṇacandrasya rūpamatyadbhutaṃ hareḥ || dṛṣṭopavarṇanaṃ tasya cakruste'pi pṛthak pṛthak ||3|| bhairava uvāca bhaja harijānudvayamiti lakṣmīḥ || bhajati sadāṃke kamalakarābhyām ||4|| meghamallāra uvāca ūrū viṣṇo rambhākhaṃḍau hemastaṃbhau dhyāye vaṃdyau || ojaḥ pūrṇau śobhāyuktau vastrapītau kṛṣṇasyobhau ||5|| dīpaka uvāca sakalasukhakaraṃ kanakarucidharam || prathitaharipadaṃ bhajata kaṭitale ||6|| mālakośa uvāca kaṭī keśavādyā harerasti tatra nṛṇāṃ netrayordṛṣṭimānaṃ haraṃti || paraṃ kaṃpitā maṃdagacchatsamīraiḥ sunamreṇa sā sarvacetoharettham ||7|| śrīrāga uvāca nābheḥ saraḥ puṣkarakuṇḍavacca tallasattrivallyūrmimanoharaṃ padam || romāvaliprojjhitakāmakānanaṃ bhajāmi nityaṃ hṛdi rādhikāpateḥ ||8|| hiṃḍola uvāca akṣarapaṃktiḥ kiṃnvalipaṃktiḥ pippalapatre mohanamālā || kiṃ kamale yacchyāmalarekhā kiṃ hyudare romāvalirekhā ||9|| bhairavarāgiṇya ūcuḥ pītapaṭaṃ yatkṛṣṇahareriṃdradhanurvaddīptiyutam || kāñcanaśilpaiścārucitadbhajannṝṇāṃ duḥkhaharam ||10|| bhairavaputrā ūcuḥ catuḥsamudrā iva viśvapūrakā ānandadā eva catuṣpadārthavat || te bāhavo lokavitānadaṇḍavajjayanti bhūdhāraṇadiggajā iva ||11|| meghamallārarāgiṇya ūcuḥ aruṇabiṃbaphaladyutimaṇḍitaṃ bhaja hareradharaṃ madhuraṃ manaḥ || navajapādalamallasuvigrahaṃ sakalavallabhabhūmipateḥ prabhoḥ ||12|| meghamallāraputrā ūcuḥ karpūraketakasumauktikahīrakāṇāṃ śrīkhaṃḍacaṃdracapalāmṛtamallikānam || teṣāṃ ruceśca paribhāvamakāri pūrvaṃ yā daṃtapaṃktiramalā smaratāṃ parasya ||13|| dīpakarāgiṇya ūcuḥ nayanayugalajātaṃ pātu no'harniśaṃ te madanaśaraparokṣaṃ sarvalāvaṇyadīkṣam || parihṛtasuravṛkṣaṃ koṭiśo lakṣalakṣaṃ nijajanakṛtarakṣaṃ dānadakṣaṃ kaṭākṣam ||14|| dīpakaputrā ūcuḥ kiṃ vā kuliṃgayugalaṃ navapadmamadhye duḥkhakṣāyāya vasatāṃ niśitāsiyugmam || jaitraṃ dhanurjayati kiṃ makaradhvajasya bhrūmaṇḍalaṃ kimatha caṃdramukhe parasya ||15|| mālakośarāgiṇya ūcuḥ parinṛtyati indumaṃḍale phaṇipatnyāviva lolakuṇḍale || kamale makarandanirbhare bhramarālīva sugaṇḍamaṇḍale ||16|| mālakośaputrā ūcuḥ ravireva khamaṇḍale kimu yadubhartustvathavā ghane taḍit || adhitiṣṭhati gaṇḍamaṇḍalaṃ dyutikhaṇḍaṃ kaladhautakuṇḍalam ||17|| śrīrāgiṇya ūcuḥ kaliṃgayoḥ khaṃjanayoḥ kilārādāpatyatāṃ yuddhamabhūdalīnām || teṣāṃ gataḥ kīra uṣaḥpraphulle cakāsti padme'ruṇabiṃbalipsuḥ ||18|| śrīrāgaputrā ūcuḥ parikarīkṛtapītapaṭaṃ hariṃ śikhikirīṭanatīkṛtakaṃdharam || laguḍaveṇukaraṃ calakuṃḍalaṃ paṭutaraṃ nataveṣadharaṃ bhaje ||19|| hiṃḍolarāgiṇya ūcuḥ atasīkusumopameyakāṃtiryamunākūlakadambamadhyavartī || navagopavadhūvihāraśālī vanamālī vitanotu maṃgalāni ||20|| hiṃḍolaputrā ūcuḥ hare matsamaḥ pātakī nāsti bhūmau tathā tvatsamo nāsti pāpāpahārī || iti tvāṃ ca matvā jagannāthadevaṃ yathecchā bhavette tathā māṃ kuru tvam ||21|| śrīnārada uvāca iti rāgakṛtaṃ dhyānaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti paṭhetsadā || tannetragocaro yāti bhagavān bhaktavatsalaḥ ||22|| itthaṃ svaṃ darśanaṃ datvā vedādibhyo hariḥ svayam || babhūva paśyataṃ teṣāṃ śārṅgapāṇiścaturbhujaḥ ||23|| kṛtvā tu darśanaṃ viṣṇorgate deve gaṇaiḥ saha || sainye sutaṃ śaṃbarāriṃ sthāpayitvā yadūttamam ||24|| dvārakāṃ svāṃ purīṃ gaṃtuṃ manaścakre parātparaḥ ||25|| mañjīraghaṃṭākalakiṃkiṇīkalaṃ sukāṃsyapātradhvaninā rathena || sugrīvamukhyaiḥ sa ca cañcalāśvairniyojitairmaithila dārukeṇa ||26|| yutena sadratnamatā śrutisvanaiḥ prabhaṃjanaijadgaruḍadhvajena || vihāya tāṃ vedapurīṃ parātmā yayau purīṃ yādavavṛṃdamaṃḍitām ||27|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śrīkṛṣṇadhyānavarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||45||
<7.46> atha kṛṣṇe bhagavati purīṃ dvārāvatīṃ gate || pradyumnaḥ sainikaiḥ sārddhaṃ nadaṃ kāmadughaṃ yayau ||1|| śatayojanavistīrṇā gaṃdharvāṇāṃ manoharā || vasaṃtamālati nāmnā hemaratnamayī purī ||2|| lavaṃgalatikājālairelākāśmīradeśakaiḥ || jātīphalādijāvitrīśrīkhaṃḍapārijātakaiḥ ||3|| mattālināditā bhṛṃgaiḥ śabditā citrapakṣibhiḥ || gaṃdharvai rājitā bhavyairnāgairbhogavatī yathā ||4|| pataṃgo nāma tatraiva gaṃdharveśo mahābalaḥ || karoti rājyaṃ sukṛtī śakravadbalapauruṣam ||5|| śrutvā pradyumnamāyātaṃ digjayārthaṃ vinirgatam || gaṃdharvairudbhaṭairyukto yuddhaṃ kartuṃ mano dadhe ||6|| rathāśvagajavīraiśca gaṃdharvairdaśakoṭibhiḥ || pataṃga āgato yoddhuṃ pradyumnasyāpi saṃmukhe ||7|| gaṃdharvairyadubhiḥ sārddhaṃ ghoraṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva ha || bhallairgadābhiḥ parighairmudgaraistomararṣṭibhiḥ ||8|| bāṇāṃdhakāre saṃjāte pataṃgo'tiratho balī || dhanuṣṭaṃkārayan prāpto jagarja ghanavadbalī ||9|| gado gadāṃ samādāya baladevānujo balī || tadbalaṃ pothayāmāsa vajreṇeṃdro yathā girin ||10|| gadasya gadayā kecidgaṃdharvāḥ patitā raṇe || rathāścūrṇīkṛtāḥ sarve mātaṃgā bhinnamastakāḥ ||11|| aśvārūḍhāḥ ke'pi vīrāḥ patitā raṇamūrddhani || adhomukhā ūrdhvamukhā gaṃdharvāśchinnabāhavaḥ ||12|| kṣaṇamātreṇa tatsainye rudhirāṇāṃ nadī hyabhūt || pramathā haramālārthaṃ śirāṃsi jagṛhurmṛdhe ||13|| siṃhārūḍhā bhadrakālī ḍākinī śatasaṃvṛtā || kapālenāpi rudhiraṃ pibaṃti dṛśyate mṛdhe ||14|| evaṃ yuddhe gadakṛte gandharvāṇāṃ palāyatām || gaṃdharveśastadā prāpto hastilakṣabalānvitaḥ ||15|| gadaṃ tatāḍa gadayā pataṃgo hṛdi maithila || gado'pi taṃ svagadayā pataṃgaṃ hṛdi caujasā ||16|| tayośca gadayā yuddhaṃ babhūva ghaṭikādvayam || visphuliṃgān kṣaraṃtyau dve gade cūrṇībabhūvatuḥ ||17|| lakṣabhāramayīṃ gurvīṃ gadāmādāya satvaram || gadaṃ tatāḍa śirasi pataṃgo raṇadurmadaḥ ||18|| gadāprahāreṇa gadaḥ kṣaṇaṃ mūrchāmavāpa ha || evaṃ kṛte ghoramṛdhe pataṃgena mahātmanā ||19|| tadaiva dvārakāpuryyāstejaḥ saṃghaṭṭamāgatam || dadṛśuryādavāḥ sarve koṭimārtaṃḍasannibham ||20|| tasmiṃstejasi gaurāṃgo baladevo mahābalaḥ || āvirbabhūva sahasā bhagavān bhaktavatsalaḥ ||21|| gaṃdharvāṇāṃ balaṃ sarvaṃ samākṛṣya halena vai || tatāḍa musalaṃ kruddho balo nīlāṃbaro balī ||22|| rathān gajāṃsturaṃgāṃśca vīrāḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varāḥ || nipeturyugapatsarve cūrṇitāścopalā iva ||23|| pataṃgo virathastasmādbhītabhītaḥ purīṃ yayau || punaryoddhuṃ yādavaiśca senāvyūhaṃ cakāra ha ||24|| śatayojanavistīrṇāṃ gaṃdharvāṇāṃ mahāpurīm || vasaṃtamālatīṃ sarvāmudvidārya halena vai ||25|| vicakarṣa balaḥ kruddho nade kāmadughe nṛpa || hāhākārastadaivāsīnnagaryāṃ patittairgṛhe ||26|| tiryakpotamivāghūrṇāṃ nagarī vīkṣya satvaram || pataṃgaḥ sarvagaṃdharvairhaṣitaḥ sankṛtāṃjaliḥ ||27|| khaciddhemasuvarṇānāṃ muktātoraṇaśālinām || daśayojanavistīrṇīkṛtānāṃ viśvakarmaṇā ||28|| kāmagānāṃ patākābhiryutānāṃ kuṃbhakoṭibhiḥ || sahasrārkaprakāśānāṃ vimānānāṃ dvilakṣakam ||29|| caturlakṣaṃ gavāṃ caiva turaṃgāṇāṃ daśārbudam || elālavaṃgakāśmīrajātīphalaphalaiḥ saha ||30|| sudhāphalānāṃ divyānāṃ koṭiśo bhājanāni ca || nītvā baliṃ samādāya datvā natvā pradharṣitaḥ ||31|| kṛtāñjaliḥ prāha balaṃ balabhadraprasādavit || pataṃga uvāca rāma rāma mahāvīrya na jāne tava vikramam || yasyaikamūrdhni tilakaṃ dṛśyate bhūmimaṃḍalam ||32|| devādhideva bhagavan kāmapāla namo'stu te || namo'naṃtāya śeṣāya sākṣādrāmāya te namaḥ ||33|| jayajayācyuta deva parātpara svayamanaṃtadigaṃtagataśrute || suramunīṃdraphaṇīṃdravarāya te musaline balinai haline namaḥ ||34|| śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ stutaḥ pataṃgena balabhadro mahābalaḥ || prasannacetā gaṃdharvaṃ mā bhaiṣṭetyabhayaṃ dadau ||35|| sthāpayitvā bale kārṣṇiṃ praṇataṃ yādaveśvaraḥ || yādavaiḥ prastutaḥ śīghraṃ purīṃ dvārāvatīṃ yayau ||36|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde vasaṃtamālatīkarṣaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||46||
<7.47> śrīnārada uvāca pradyumno'tha mahāvīro nādayan jayadundubhim || yadubhiḥ sainikaiḥ sārddhaṃ madhudhārātaṭaṃ yayau ||1|| suvarṇādritaṭībhūte vane vaiśravase śubhe || suvarṇavarṇahaṃsāḍhye kāṃcanīlatikāvṛte ||2|| hemāvatīṣu droṇīṣu devadurgāsu maithila || dānavānāmagamyāsu gaṃgāvetravatīṣu ca ||3|| dānavebhyaḥ prabhītānāṃ kvacitsvargātpalāyinām || aṣṭānāṃ lokapālānāṃ nidhayo yatra saṃti hi ||4|| tatra śakrasakho deva ādhipatyābhirakṣakaḥ || śrutvā''gataṃ ca pradyumnaṃ yuddhaṃ kartuṃ mano dadhe ||5|| pradyumnapreṣitaḥ sākṣāduddhavo buddhisattamaḥ || papraccha dṛṣṭamārgaiśca janaistasya puraṃ yayau ||6|| natvā devaṃ śakrasakhaṃ sabhāyāmuddhavaḥ prabhuḥ || pradyumnakathitaṃ prāha vistarānmaṃtriṇāṃ varaḥ ||7|| uddhava uvāca ugraseno yādaveṃdro dvārakeśo nṛpeśvaraḥ || jaṃbūdvīpanṛpān jitvā rājasūyaṃ kariṣyati ||8|| tena praṇodito jetuṃ rukmiṇīnaṃdano balī || jitvā sa bhāratādīni khaṃḍāni svasya tejasā ||9|| adyaivelāvṛtaṃ prāpto jetuṃ kārṣṇirmahābalaḥ || tasmai yaccha baliṃ śīghraṃ kulakauśalahetave || na cedyuddhaṃ hi bhavatā rājansarvavidāṃ vara ||10|| śakrasakha uvāca śṛṇu dūta sadā devaiḥ pūjito'haṃ naraiḥ kimu || siddho'haṃ vai mahāvīro nāgalakṣasamo bale ||11|| aṣṭānāṃ lokapālānāmādhipatyābhirakṣakaḥ || kubera iva kośāḍhyaḥ puraṃdara ivodbhaṭaḥ ||12|| ugrasenena dātavyaṃ mahyaṃ copāyanaṃ param || purā tasmai na dāsyāmi yadurājāya bhūbhṛte ||13|| uddhava uvāca yathā tiraskṛtiṃ prāptaḥ kubero yadutejasā || yathā śṛṅgāratilakaścaitradeśādhipo balī ||14|| śubhāṃgo harivarṣeśa uttareśo guṇākaraḥ || yathā daityasakho rājā laṃkeśo rākṣaseśvaraḥ |15|| saṃvatsaraḥ ketumālaḥ śakunyādyā mahāsurāḥ || tathābhūtastvaṃ hi rājan baliṃ tasmai pradāsyasi ||16|| śrīnārada uvāca ityuddhavavacaḥ śrutvā kruddhaḥ śakrasakho balī || uddhavaṃ pratyuvācātha śṛṇu bhāgavatottama ||17|| yāvadbaliṃ pradasyāmi tāvattvaṃ saṃsthito bhava || anyathā te gatirnāsti satyaṃ satyaṃ mahāmate ||18|| uddhava uvāca vayaṃ tu maṃtripravarāḥ pūrṇajñānapradā varāḥ || macchikṣaṇaṃ na manyaṃte teṣāṃ no maṃgalaṃ bhavet ||19|| śrīnārada uvāca evaṃ sa dṛṣṭarodhena rodhayāmāsa coddhavam || uddhavaṃ nāgataṃ rājan yadūnāmanuśocatām ||20|| dināni katicittatra vyatīyustamapaśyatām || manmukhāttadupākarṇya pradyumno bhagavānhariḥ ||21|| jetuṃ śakrasakhaṃ prāgāttripuraṃ tryambako yathā || yadubhirbhrātṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ sa sainyaparivāritaḥ ||22|| suvarṇādriguhādvārātsaṃprāpto makaradhvajaḥ || vīrakodaṇḍaṭaṃkārairdundubhidhvanimiśritaiḥ ||23|| aśvaheṣairhastinādairvineduśca diśo daśa || sainyapādarajobhiśca yuyudhe yādavaiḥ saha ||24|| babhūva tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ chāditaṃ vyomamaṃḍalam || vīkṣya sarve merudevā bhayaṃ prāpurnṛpeśvara ||25|| atha śakrasakhaḥ kruddho rathārūḍho mahābalaḥ || akṣauhiṇībhirdaśabhiryuyudhe yādavaiḥ saha ||26|| babhūva tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ devānāṃ yadubhiḥ saha || prākṛtapralaye rājannudadhīnāṃ dhvaniryathā ||27|| śastrāṃdhakāre saṃjāte sāraṇo rohiṇīsutaḥ || baladevānujo vīro daṃśito gajasaṃsthitaḥ ||28|| sarveṣāmagrataḥ prāpto dhanuṣṭaṃkārayanmuhuḥ || tadbalaṃ pothayāmāsa bāṇaiḥ kodaṃḍanirgataiḥ ||29|| śrīsāraṇasya bāṇaughaiḥ kecidvīrā dvidhākṛtāḥ || tiryagbhūtā rathā yuddhe nipetuḥ pādapā iva ||30|| gajānāṃ bhinnakuṃbhānāṃ mauktikānyapataṃstadā | bāṇāndhakāre saṃjāte rātrau tārāgaṇā iva ||31|| saṃchidyamānairaśvaiśca vīrairnāgai raṇāṃgaṇam || babhau bhūtagaṇairyuktaṃ yathā''krīḍamumāpateḥ ||32|| sāraṇasya balaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve devāḥ palāyitāḥ || saṃchinnabhinnakodaṃḍā abhitaḥ śīrṇakaṃcukāḥ ||33|| palāyamānaṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā śakrasakho balī || dhanuṣṭaṃkārayanprāpto jagarja ghanavadbalāt ||34|| arjunaṃ daśabhirbāṇairviṃśatyā bhānumeva ca || sāṃbaṃ bāṇaśatairyuddhe'niruddhaṃ ca śataiḥ śaraiḥ ||35|| dviśataiśca gadaṃ vīraṃ sahasraiḥ sāraṇaṃ tathā || tatāḍa samare vīro dhanvī śakrasakho balī ||36|| tadbāṇaiḥ sarathā vīrā babhramurghaṭikādvayam || cakravatkuṃbhakārasya tadadbhūtamivābhavat ||37|| hayāśca paṃcatāṃ prāptāḥ ślathadbaṃdhā rathā bhramāt || rathinaḥ khinnamanasaḥ sūta mūrcchāṃ gatā mṛdhe ||38|| sa cānyaṃ rathamāruhya dhanuṣṭaṃkārayanbalāt || dhanuḥ śakrasakhasyāpi ciccheda daśabhīḥ śaraiḥ ||39|| dvābhyāṃ sūtaṃ śatairaśvānsahasraistadrathaṃ śaraiḥ || cūrṇayāmāsa rājendra sāṃbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ ||40|| sa cchinnadhanvā viratho hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ || nāgeṃdraṃ mattamāruhya śūlaṃ jagrāha roṣataḥ ||41|| vivyādha sāṃbaṃ śūlena hṛdi śakrasakho balī || tena ghātena sāṃbo'pi kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ ||42|| yojane pādavikṣepaṃ kajjalādrisamaprabham || caturyojanamuccāṃgaṃ yojanārddharadadvayam ||43|| mahaccītkāraṃ kurvaṃtaṃ triśūṇḍādaṃḍamaṃḍalaiḥ || śrṛṃkhale pātayaṃtaṃ taṃ caturyojanavistṛtaiḥ ||44|| gajān vīrānmardayaṃtaṃ rathānaśvānitastataḥ || daṃtaiḥ pādairghātayaṃtaṃ kālāṃtakayamopamam ||45|| āgataṃ vīkṣya nāgeṃdraṃ śatruṇā noditaṃ param || vicaraṃtaṃ mṛdhādbhītā yadusenā vidudruvuḥ ||46|| gado gadāṃ samādāya baladevānujo balī || jaghāna tadgajaṃ kuṃbhe gadayā vajrakalpayā ||47|| tadghātabhinnakuṃbho hi gajo yuddhe papāta ha || chinnapakṣo yathā śailastadadbhutamivābhavat ||48|| atha śakrasakho yāvadgadāṃ jagrāha roṣataḥ || tāvattatāḍa gadayā gadaḥ śakrasakhaṃ hṛdi ||49|| tena ghātena sagajo patito mūrchito'bhavat || punarutthāya sa gadaṃ bhujābhyāṃ jagṛhe mṛdhe ||50|| gadaśakrasakhau yuddhe yuyudhāte parasparam || raṃge mallāviva vanye vanyau tau vāraṇāviva |51|| bhujābhyāṃ taṃ samutthāpya baladevānujo balī || cikṣepa tatpure vīraṃ balāttaṃ śatayojanam ||52|| tadā jayajayārāvo yadusainye babhūva ha || jayadundubhayo neduḥ praśaśaṃsurmuhurjanāḥ ||53|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde śakrasakhayuddhaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||47||
<7.48> śrīnārada uvāca svapure patito mūrcchāṃ gataḥ śakrasakho bhṛśam || uttasthau ca kṣaṇaṃ tatra kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ ||1|| atha kārṣṇiṃ paraṃ brahma jñātvā śakrasakhastvaran || svasakāśādbalaṃ nītvā yadūnāṃ ca balaṃ yayau ||2|| airāvatakulebhāśca triśuṃḍā daṃḍadaṃtinaḥ || caturdaṃtā śvetavarṇāḥ sahasrāṇi madacyutaḥ ||3|| hemādriprabhavā nāgā yojanadvayavigrahāḥ || koṭiśaḥ parvatākārā unmattā diggajā iva ||4|| divyāsyā divyagatayaḥ koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo nṛpa || śatārbudā rathā divyāḥ śātakauṃbhamayāḥ parāḥ ||5|| ayutāni vimānānāṃ yojanadvayaśālinām || niyutaṃ kāmadhenūnāṃ pārijātasahasrakam ||6|| karidantakhacitstaṃbhahemaratnakhacitpadāḥ || muktāstaḍāgasaṃvṛddhā guṇayaṃtrasphuratprabhāḥ ||7|| mallikāmakarandārdrāḥ śirīṣakusumākulāḥ || payaḥphenanibhāḥ śayyāḥ koṭiśaḥ sopabarhaṇāḥ ||8|| vitānāni vicitrāṇi bhittivastrāṇi koṭiśaḥ || āsanāni mṛdusparśacitravarṇāni sarvaśaḥ ||9|| dīrghāṇi copabarhāṇi viśvakarmakṛtāni ca || muktāstabakahemādyaiḥ khacitāni sahasraśaḥ ||10|| sahasraśo javanikāḥ śibikāścaiva koṭiśaḥ || chatrāṇāṃ cāmarāṇāṃ ca divyasiṃhāsanaiḥ saha ||11|| vyajanānāṃ tathā koṭī rājyaśrībhūṣaṇāni ca || pīyūṣāṇāṃ droṇakoṭiḥ sudharmā ca sabhā tathā ||12|| evaṃ ca sarvatobhadrapadmānīti sahasrakam || hīrakāṇāṃ ca haritāṃ muktānāṃ ca tathaiva hi ||13|| gomedānāṃ koṭibhārā nīlakānāṃ tathaiva ca || adityacaṃdrakāṃtīnāṃ vaidūryāṇāṃ sahasraśaḥ ||14|| syamantakamaṇīnāṃ ca koṭibhārāḥ samāgatāḥ || tathā vai padmarāgāṇāṃ bhārā viddhyarbudaṃ nṛpa ||15|| jāṃbūnadasuvarṇānāṃ hāṭakānāṃ tathaiva ca || suvarṇādrisuvarṇānāṃ koṭibhāraśca koṭiśaḥ ||16|| rājyaṃ navavidhīnsarvāndevānāṃ maithileśvara || aṣṭānāṃ lokapālānāmādhipatyādhirakṣakaḥ ||17|| nītvoddhavaṃ śakrasakho dattvaivaṃ balimadbhutam || kauśalyahetave kārṣṇiṃ praṇanāma kṛtāṃjaliḥ ||18|| tasmai tuṣṭaḥ śaṃbarāriḥ pradadau ratnamālikām || saṃsthāpya rājye taṃ rājanneṣā hi prakṛtiḥ satām ||19|| itthaṃ śakrasakhaṃ jitvā pradyumnāya baliṃ dadau || śibirāṇāṃ samūho'bhūdaruṇodānadīmanu ||20|| mahādhanakhacidbhiśca vitānaiḥ śatayojanam || patatpatākairdivyābhairbhūnyastavijayadhvajaiḥ ||21|| vireje śibiravyūho laharībhiḥ payodadhiḥ || ākāśādāgataṃ tatra gajārūḍhaṃ purandaram ||22|| sasainyaṃ sahasā rājanduṃdubhidhvanisaṃyutam || saṃvīkṣya vegato vīrā jagṛhuḥ śastrasaṃhatim ||23|| punarindraṃ ca taṃ jñātvā babhūvurharṣitā nṛpāḥ || śrīpradyumnaṃ sabhāmadhye kathayanmaghavā tadā ||24|| śṛṇu rājanmahābāho tvaṃ parāvaravittamaḥ || līlāvatī nāma purī śubhā hemādrisānuṣu ||25|| vidyādhareśaḥ sukṛtī tatra rājyaṃ karoti hi || tatkanyā suṃdarīnāmā śatacandranibhā śubhā ||26|| āgatā devatāḥ sarvāstasyā rājansvayaṃvare || lokapālāstathā sarve saṃprāptā divyavigrahāḥ ||27|| yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mūrcchitāhaṃ syāṃ sa me bhartā bhaviṣyati || giretyevaṃ prajalpaṃtī suṃdaraṃ varamicchatī ||28|| tatrāpi gaccha sahasā bhrātṛbhiḥ saha kautuke || svayaṃvaraṃ paśya varaṃ devalokaiśca maṇḍitam ||29|| śrīnārada uvāca tacchrutvā bhagavānkārṣṇiryādavairbhrātṛbhiḥ saha || purandareṇa sahasā purīṃ līlāvatīṃ yayau ||30|| viśālājirasaṃyukte khacidratnamanohare || candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcite ||31|| muktāyuktaistoraṇaiśca vitānaiḥ sumahādhanaiḥ || jāṃbūnadāsanaiḥ sākṣādiṃdraloka ivāpare ||32|| tasminsvayaṃvare tasthau pradyumno divya āsane || giriśaśṛṅge yathā siṃhaḥ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ nṛpa ||33|| vrajeśā munayastatra devā rudragaṇāstathā || maruto ravayaścaiva vasavo hyagnayo'śvinau ||34|| yamo'tha varuṇaḥ somo dhanadaḥ śakra eva hi || siddhā vidyādharāścaiva gaṃdharvaḥ kinnarāstathā ||35|| anye samāgatāḥ sarve ratnābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || jahurvaivāhikīmāśāṃ pradyumnaṃ vīkṣya maithila ||36|| sā suṃdarī tatra suratnamālayā ratiṃ ca raṃbhāṃ kṣipatīva nirgatā || vāṇī ramāṃ rupavatīṃ pulomajāṃ viḍaṃbayantīva babhau varāṃganā ||37|| yāṃ vīkṣya sarveṣu sadaḥsu sarvato mohaṃ prayāteṣu tathaiva maithila || śrīḥ sarvalokasya ca paśyato varaṃ vicinvatī sā capaleva cāṃbudam ||38|| divyāṃbaraṃ padmadalāyatekṣaṇaṃ pradyumnavīraṃ naralokasundaram || sametya mūrcchāṃ samavāpa sundarī vidyādharī sā punarāpa saṃjñām ||39|| samutthitā sātvataharṣavihvalā tasthau sumālāṃ vinidhāya tadgale || vidyādhareśaḥ sukṛtī ca sundarīṃ sutāṃ dadau maithila śaṃbarāraye ||40|| nadatsu tūryyeṣu tadaiva nirjarā na sehire vīkṣya vivāhamaṃgalam || taṃ sarvataḥ saṃrurudhuḥ svayaṃvaraṃ pracaṇḍameghā iva bhāskaraṃ param ||41|| krodhāvṛtāṃstānamarāndhanurdharān madoddhatān vīkṣya hareḥ svayaṃvaram || śrīkṛṣṇadattaṃ saśaraṃ dhanuḥ svayaṃ varaṃ gṛhītvā yadubhirjagarja ha ||42|| taccāpamuktairviśikhaiḥ sphuratprabhaiśchinnāyudhā maithila śīrṇakañcukāḥ || vidudruvuste ca diśo daśāmarā nīhārameghā iva sūryaraśmibhiḥ ||43|| pradyumno bhagavānsākṣāditthaṃ jitvā svayaṃvaram || vijityelāvṛtaṃ khaṃḍaṃ bhārataṃ gaṃtumudyataḥ ||44|| bhātṛbhiryadubhiḥ sainyaiḥ sarvamaṃtrijanaiḥ saha || āyayau bhārataṃ khaṃḍaṃ nādayan jayadundubhīn ||45|| paśyandeśānanekāṃśca jaṃbūdvīpajayo balī || ānartāndvārakāndeśān prāpto'bhūtsa hareḥ sutaḥ ||46|| pradyumnapreṣitaḥ sākṣāduddhavo buddhisattamaḥ || praṇanāmograsenaṃ taṃ sabhāyāṃ śrīhariṃ balī ||47|| varṣe varṣe'pi yajjātaṃ jaṃbudvipajayaṃ tathā || tatsarvaṃ hi yathāyogyaṃ kathayāmāsa coddhavaḥ ||48|| śrīkṛṣṇabaladevābhyāṃ sarvairvṛddhajanaiḥ saha || pradyumnaṃ taṃ samānetumugraseno vinirgataḥ ||49|| gītavāditraghoṣeṇa brahmaghoṣeṇa bhūyasā || muktāvarṣairlājapuṣpaiḥ pāṭhārāvaiḥ sumaṃgalaiḥ ||50|| vāraṇendraṃ puraskṛtya sauvarṇaiḥ kalaśairnṛpa || gaṃdharvairvāramukhyābhiḥ śaṃkhadundubhiveṇubhiḥ ||51|| gaṃdhākṣatairhemapātraiḥ puṣpadhūpairyavāṃkuraiḥ || ugrasenaḥ śaṃbarāreḥ saṃmukhaṃ cājagāma ha ||52|| khaḍgaṃ nītvograsenasya puro dhṛtvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ || nanāma kārṣṇiryadubhirbhrātṛbhiḥ saha maithila ||53|| śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sabalaṃ natvā sarvān vṛddhānpraṇamya ca || gargācāryaṃ nanāmāśu pradyumno mīnaketanaḥ ||54|| saṃślāghyābhyarcya vidhivadbrāhmaṇairvedasūktibhiḥ || āropya vāraṇe kārṣṇimugrasenaḥ purīṃ yayau ||55|| maṃgalaṃ dvārakāyāṃ ca sarvatrābhūdgṛhe gṛhe || itthaṃ nṛpa te kathitaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ||56|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde pradyumnadvārakāgamanaṃ nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||48||
<7.49> bahulāśva uvāca kathaṃ cakāra vidhivadrājasūyādhvaraṃ nṛpaḥ || etanme brūhī viprendra tvaṃ parāvaravittamaḥ ||1|| śrīnārada uvāca athograseno nṛpatiḥ sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || śrīkṛṣṇena sahāyena kraturājaṃ cakāra ha ||2|| gargādyadukulācāryānmuhūrtaṃ bodhya yatnataḥ || baṃdhubhyaḥ pradadau rājansuhṛdbhyo'pi nimaṃtraṇam ||3|| bhaktyā paramayā''hūtā ṛṣayo munayo dvijāḥ || ājagmurdvārakāṃ sarve putraśiṣyaiḥ samāvṛtāḥ ||4|| vedavyāsaḥ śukaḥ sākṣānmaitreyo'tha parāśaraḥ || pailaḥ sumaṃturdurvāsā vaiśaṃpāyana ityapi ||5|| jaiminirbhārgavo rāmo dattātreyo'sito muniḥ || aṃgirā vāmadevo'trirvasiṣṭhaḥ kaṇva eva ca ||6|| viśvāmitraḥ śatānando bhāradvājo'tha gautamaḥ || kapilaḥ sanakādyāśca vibhāṃḍaśca patañjaliḥ ||7|| droṇaḥ kṛpaḥ prāḍvipākaḥ śāṃḍilyo munisattamaḥ || anye ca munayo rājansaśiṣyāśca samāgatāḥ ||8|| brahmā śivo jaṃbhabhedī devā rudragaṇāstathā || ādityā marutaḥ sarve vasavo hyagnayo'śvinau ||9|| yamo'tha varuṇaḥ somo dhanado gaṇanāyakaḥ || siddhā vidyādharāścaiva gaṃdharvāḥ kinnarādayaḥ ||10|| gaṃdharvāpsarasaḥ sarvā vidyādharyyaḥ samāgatāḥ || vetālā dānavā daityāḥ pralhādo balinā saha ||11|| rakṣobhirbhīṣaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ laṃkādhīśo vibhīṣaṇaḥ || sarvaiśca vānaraiḥ sārddhaṃ hanumān vāyunandanaḥ ||12|| ṛkṣaiśca daṃṣṭribhiḥ sārddhaṃ jāṃbavānṛkṣarāḍbalī || sarvaiśca pakṣibhiḥ sārddhaṃ garuḍaḥ pakṣirāḍbalī ||13|| sarvaiḥ sarīsṛpaiḥ sārddhaṃ vāsukirnāgarāḍbalī || gorūpadhāriṇī pṛthvī sarvābhiḥ kāmadhenubhiḥ ||14|| sarvaiḥ śailairmūrtimadbhiḥ sumeruśca himācalaḥ || gulmavṛkṣalatābhiśca vaṭaḥ sākṣātprayāgarāṭ ||15|| mahānadībhiḥ sahitā śrīgaṃgā yamunānadī || pārāvārāḥ sapta tathā ratnopāyanasaṃyutāḥ ||16|| ājagmurugrasenasya rājasūyasya cādhvare || saptasvarāstrayo grāmā navāraṇyā navoṣarāḥ ||17|| caturdaśaiva guhyāni vikhyātāni mahītale || tīrtharājaḥ prayāgaśca puṣkaraṃ badrikāśramaḥ ||18|| siddhāśramo vinaśanaṃ kuṇḍaiḥ sarvaiḥ sarovaraiḥ || vanāni daṇḍakādīni sarvaiścopavanaiḥ saha ||19|| kṣetraiḥ samagrairvimalairete tatra samāyayuḥ || śrīmadgovardhano nāma girirājo vrajāddharim ||20|| vṛndāvanavrajavanaiḥ saraḥ kuṇḍaiḥ samāyayau || kīrtiryaśomatiḥ sākṣādgopībhirgopikeśvarī ||21|| śrīrādhā śibikārūḍhā sakhīsaṃghaiśca koṭibhiḥ || śatayūthaśca gopīnāṃ dvārakāṃ prayayau mudā ||22|| tāsāṃ vāso yatra yatra gopībhūmiśca sābhavat || tadaṃgarāja saṃjātaṃ gopīcandanameva hi ||23|| gopīcaṃdanaliptāṃgo naro nārāyaṇo bhavet || caturvarṇāstathā sarve ājagmustasya cādhvare ||24|| dhṛtarāṣṭro buddhicakṣuḥ sākṣadduryodhanaḥ kaliḥ || śālvo bhīṣmaśca karṇaśca kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||25|| bhīmo'rjuno'tha nakulaḥ sahadevastathāpare || damaghoṣo vṛddhaśarmā jayaseno mahānṛpaḥ ||26|| dhṛṣṭaketurbhīṣmakaśca nāgnajitkauśaleśvaraḥ || bṛhatseno dhṛtiḥ sākṣānmaithileśaḥ pitāmahaḥ ||26|| anye'pi tatra rājānaḥ suhṛtsaṃbaṃdhibāṃdhavāḥ || sahastrībhistathā pautreḥ putrairājagmuradhvaram ||28|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde svajananimaṃtraṇaṃ nāmaikonapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||49||
<7.50> śrīnārada uvāca arthasiddheriva dvāre raivatādrisamudrayoḥ || madhye piṃḍārake kṣetre yajñāraṃbho babhūva ha ||1|| pañcayojanavistīrṇaḥ kuṇḍo'bhūdyasya cādhvare || yojanaṃ brahmakuṇḍastu gavyūtiḥ pañca kuṇḍakāḥ ||2|| mekhalāgarttavistāravedībhinirmitāḥ śubhāḥ || sahasrahastamuccāṃgo yajñastaṃbho babhau mahān ||3|| pañcayojanavistīrṇaḥ sauvarṇo yajñamaṃḍapaḥ || vitānatoraṇe reje kadalīkhaṃḍamaṇḍitaḥ ||4|| bhojavṛṣṇyaṃdhakamadhuśūrasenadaśārhakaiḥ || devaiśca sahito rājā babhau śakra ivādhvare ||5|| yajñāvatāraḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paripūrṇatamo'dhvare || babhau putraiśca pautraiśca paramātmeva bhūtibhiḥ ||6|| mahāsaṃbhṛtasaṃbhāre rājasūye'dhvare vare || gargācāryaṃ guruṃ kṛtvā yadurājo hi dīkṣitaḥ ||7|| hotāro daśa lakṣāṇi daśa lakṣāṇi dīkṣitāḥ|| adhvaryyavaḥ pañcalakṣamudgātārastathāpare ||8|| hastiśuṇḍāsamā dhārā bhuktvā''jyasya hutāśanaḥ || ajīrṇaṃ prāpya tadyajñe citraṃ vibudha maithila ||9|| ke'pi jīvāstrilokyāṃ tu na babhūvurbubhukṣitāḥ || sarve devāstu somena hyajīrṇatvamupāgatāḥ ||10|| rucimatyā dharmapatnyograseno yadurāḍ balī || adhvarāvabhṛthasnānaṃ tīrthe piṃḍārake'karot ||11|| vyāsādyairmunibhiḥ snāto vidhivadvedasūktibhiḥ || yathā dakṣiṇayā yajño rucimatyā babhau nṛpa ||12|| devadundubhayo nedurnaradundubhayastathā || ugrasenopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire ||13|| gajānāṃ hemabhārāṇāṃ niyutāni caturdaśa || śatārbudaṃ hayānāṃ tu yajñāṃte dakṣiṇāṃ parām ||14|| koṭiśo navaratnānāṃ mahāhārāṃbaraiḥ saha || gargācāryāya munaye gṛhopaskarasaṃyutām ||15|| ugraseno dadau rājā yādaveṃdro mahāmanāḥ || gajānāṃ tatra sāhasraṃ hayānāmayutaṃ tathā ||16|| viṃśadbhāraṃ suvarṇānāṃ brāhmaṇe brāhmaṇe dadau || maruttasya mahāyajñe tyaktapātrā yathā dvijāḥ ||17|| tathograsenasya kratau saṃtuṣṭā harṣitā gatāḥ || saṃtuṣṭā devatāḥ sarvāḥ prāptabhāgā divaṃ gatāḥ ||18|| bhūridravyā vandinaśca jayarāvā gṛhaṃ gatāḥ || rakṣodaityā vānarāśca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ pakṣiṇastathā ||19|| nāgāḥ saṃtuṣṭamanasaḥ sarve svaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ yayuḥ || gāvāḥ śailā vṛkṣasaṃghā nadyastīrthāśca siṃdhavaḥ ||20|| saṃtuṣṭāḥ prāptabhāgā ye te sarve svaṃ gṛhaṃ yayuḥ || rājāno ye samāhūtāḥ pāribarheṇa bhūyasā ||21|| pūjitā dānamānābhyāṃ te'pi svaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ gatāḥ || naṃdādyā gopamukhyā ye śrīkṛṣṇena prapūjitāḥ ||22|| harṣitāḥ premadānābhyāṃ te'pi sarve vrajaṃ yayuḥ || etatte kathitaṃ rājanmahāyajñasya maṇḍalam ||23|| yatra śrīkṛṣṇacaṃdro'sti tatra kiṃ saphalaṃ na hi || ye śṛṇvanti kathāmetāṃ paṭhaṃti satataṃ narāḥ ||24|| dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca mokṣasteṣāṃ prajāyate ||25|| pūrṇaḥ pareśaḥ parameśvaraḥ prabhuḥ punātu vo yaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ || śrṛṇvanti ye tasya kathāṃ vicitrāṃ kurvaṃti tīrthaṃ svakulaṃ narāste ||26|| chalena yajñasya hariḥ pareśvaro bhāraṃ videheśa bhuvo'vatārayat || yo'bhūccaturvyūhadharo yadoḥ kule tasmai namo'nantaguṇāya bhūbhṛte ||27|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ śrīviśvajitkhaṇḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde rājasūyayajñotsavavarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||50||
<8.1> bahulāśva uvāca śrutaṃ tava mukhādbrahman maṃgalaṃ paramādbhutam || sudhākhaṃḍātparaṃ miṣṭaṃ khaṇḍaṃ viśvajitaṃ param ||1|| paripūrṇatamasyāpi śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ || ṣoḍaśastrīsahasrāṇāṃ putrā daśadaśābhavan ||2|| teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca babhūvuḥ koṭiśo mune || rajāṃsi bhūmergaṇayenna kaviśceddhareḥ kulam ||3|| revatyāṃ baladevasya rāmasyāpi mahātmanaḥ || putrodayaḥ kathaṃ nu syādetanme brūhi tatvataḥ ||4|| śrīnārada uvāca bāḍhamuktaṃ bhagavataḥ saṃkarṣaṇasyācyutāgrajasya balabhadrasya rāmasya kāmapālasya kathāṃ sarvathā tavāgre kathayiṣyāmi ||5|| atha kadācitprāḍvipāko nāma munīṃdro yogīndro duryodhanagururgajāhvayaṃ nāma puramājagāma ||6|| suyodhanena saṃpūjitaḥ paramādareṇa sopacāreṇa mahārhasiṃhāsane sthito'bhūt ||7|| taṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇipatya kṛtāṃjaliḥ puraḥ sthito manaḥsandehaṃ smṛtvā dhārtarāṣṭra iti hovāca ||8|| saṃkarṣaṇaḥ sākṣādbalabhadraḥ kiṃ kāraṇātkasmāllokātkena prārthito bhūlokānājagāma yenedaṃ puraṃ tiryagbhūtamabhavattasya mama gurorgadāśikṣākarasyāho tatraprabhāvaṃ nitarāṃ vadatāt ||9|| prāḍvipāka uvāca yuvarāja kurūdvaha yaduvarasya prabhāvaṃ śṛṇu yacchravaṇe pāpahāniḥ paraṃ bhūyāt ||10|| asmindvāparāṃte nṛpavyājadaityānīkakoṭibhirbhūribhārākrāntā bhurgaurbhūtvā svayaṃbhuvaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagāma ||11|| tadupacārī suraśreṣṭhaḥ sarvasuragaṇaiḥ samṛḍo vaikuṇṭhanāthaṃ puraskṛtya śrīvāmanavāmapādāṃguṣṭhanakhanirbhinnordhvāṃḍakaṭāhavivaramārgeṇa barhirnigatya koṭiśoṃḍanicayaṃ brahmadrave saṃprekṣan virajātīraṃ prāptavān ||12|| athāgre'saṃkhyakoṭimārtaṃḍajyotiṣāṃ maṇḍalamavekṣya dhātā natvā dhyātvā tatrānaṃtaṃ sahasravadanaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ guṇalakṣaṇalakṣitaṃ devaiḥ saha dadarśa ||13|| tadbhogakuṇḍalībhūtotsaṃgevṛndāraṇyakāliṃdīgovardhanādrikuñjanikuñjalatātarupuñjagopālagopīgokulasaṃkulaṃ lalitaṃ golokaṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtaṃ sametya tatra nijakuṃje nijājñāṃ nītvāṃtaḥprāpya sākṣātparipūrṇatamaṃ svayaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacaṃdramasaṃkhyabrahmāṃḍapatiṃ śrīrādhāpatiṃ śyāmalacchaviṃ pītāṃbaravanamālāvaṃśīdharaṃ kvaṇatkanakanūpurakiṃkiṇīkaṭakāṃgadahārasphuratkaustubhāṃgulīyakaiḥ sarvataḥ parisphuratkoṭibālamārtaṃḍamaṇḍalaṃ kirīṭakuṇḍalamaṇḍitagaṃḍasthalamalakālibhirvibhrājamānamukhāraviṃdaṃ namaskṛtya vidhiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvaṃ bhūbhāravṛttāṃtaṃ kathayāṃbabhūva ||14|| teṣāṃ vijñaptiṃ vijñāya bhūmibhāraharaṇārthaṃ bhagavānsvajanān sarvadevān yathātathamājñāṃ datvānantaṃ sahasravadanamiti hovāca ||15|| aṃga purā tvamapi vasudevasya devakyāṃ bhūtvā rohiṇyudarādāvirbhava paścāddevakyāḥ putratāmahaṃ prāpsyāmi ||16|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ balabhadrakhaṇḍe duryodhanaprāḍvipākasaṃvāde baladevāvatārakāraṇaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||1|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<8.2> prāḍvipāka uvāca ityuktaḥ sahasravadano gaṃtumabhyuditaḥ svasabhāyāṃ sthito'bhūt || tadaiva siddhacāraṇagandharvāḥ sarvatastaṃ natakaṃdharā babhūvuḥ ||1|| atha sumatiḥ sārathirdivyaṃ rathaṃ tālāṃkaṃ sāśvaṃ samānīya sammukhaṃ sthito'bhūt ||2|| parasainyavidāraṇaṃ musalaṃ daityadamanaṃ halaṃ te tūrṇaṃ purastādupatasthatuḥ brahmamayaṃ nāma varma copatasthe ||3|| atha tatra śrībalabhadrasabhāyāṃ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ ramāvaikuṇṭhātsamāgataḥ pāṇīnipataṃjalyādibhirmunibhiḥ stūyamānaḥ sahasraphaṇamaulivirājamānaḥ siddhacāraṇacāmarasaṃsevyamānaḥ śeṣastamanaṃtaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ stutvā tadvigrahe saṃlīno'bhūt ||4|| athājitavaikuṇṭhātsamāgato'jaikapādahirbudhnyabahurūpamahadādibhiḥ saṃveṣṭito ghoraiḥ pretavināyakaiḥ saṃveṣṭitaḥ śeṣaḥ sahasravadanaḥ samāgatya sa sabhāyāmanaṃtaṃ stutvā tasmin saṃlīno'bhūt ||5|| atha śvetadvīpātsamāgataḥ kumudakumudākṣādibhiḥ pārṣadapravaraiḥ sasevyamānaḥ sahasraphaṇamaulivirājamānaḥ sitācalābho nīlāṃbaro nīlakuṃtalābho bhīmābhaḥ sarveṣāṃ paśyatāmanaṃtavigrahe so'pi saṃlīno'bhūt ||6|| atha tadaivelāvṛtakhaṇḍātsamāgatastrīgaṇārbudasahasrairbhavānīnāthaiḥ samāvṛttaḥ śeṣaḥ sahasravadanamaulimaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ prasphuratkirīṭakaṭakāṃgadaḥ sabhāmetyānaṃtavigrahe saṃpralīno'bhūt ||7|| atha pātālasyādhastāddvātriṃśadyojanasahasrāṃtarātsamāgato bhagavatastāmasīkalaḥ sākṣātsahasravadanakirīṭamārtaṃḍamaṇḍalamaṇḍito vedavyāsaparāśarasanakasanandanasanātanasanatkumāranāradasāṃkhyāyanapulastyabṛhaspatimaitreyādimaharṣibhiḥ saṃśobhito vāsukimahāśaṃkhaśvetadhanaṃjayadhṛtarāṣṭrakuhakakāliyatakṣakakaṃbalāśvataradevadattādibhirnāgeṃdraiścāmarapāṇibhiḥ saṃsevyamāno mṛgamadāgarukuṃkumacaṃdanapaṅkāvalipyamānābhirnāgakanyābhiḥ siddhacāraṇagaṃdharvavidyādharagaṇairupagīyamāno hāṭakeśvaratripurabalakālakeyakalinivātakavacairanuyāyibhiḥ puraḥsarai rudraikādaśavyūhairnābhikāmadhenuvaruṇaiḥ paścātprayāyibhirvīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgatāladundubhidhvaniśabdāyamānaḥ phaṇīndro nāgeṃdraiva tūrṇagatirvirājate yasyaikaphaṇe cedaṃ kṣitimaṇḍalaṃ siddhārtha iva lakṣate so'pyāgatya mahānantavigrahe saṃlīno'bhūt ||8|| taccitraṃ dṛṣṭvā tatsabhāpārṣadāḥ sarve taṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ jñātvāvanatā vismitā babhūvuḥ ||9|| athānaṃtavadano mahānaṃtaḥ saṃkarṣaṇo bhagavān pārṣadān siddhānuvāca ||10|| ahaṃ bhūmibhāraharaṇārthaṃ bhuvi gamiṣyāmi tasmādyūyaṃ yādaveṣu bhaviṣyatha ||11|| bhoḥ prabalodbhaṭasumate sārathe bhavatātraiva sthīyatāṃ śokaṃ mā kurutāt yadā yuddhārthī tvatsmaraṇaṃ kariṣyāmi tadā taṃ divyaṃ tālāṃkaṃ rathaṃ nītvā matsamīpamāgamiṣyasi ||12|| he halamusale yadā yadā yuvayoḥ smaraṇaṃ kariṣyāmi tadā tadā matpura āvirbhūte bhavatam ||13|| bho varma tvamapi cāvirbhava | he munayaḥ pāṇinyādayo he koṭiśo rudrā he bhavānīnātha he ekādaśa rudrā he gandharvā || he vāsukyādināgendrā he nivātakavacā he varuṇa he kāmadheno bhūmyāṃ bharatakhaṃḍe yadukule'vataraṃtaṃ māṃ yūyaṃ sarve sarvadā etya mama darśanaṃ kuruta ||14|| prāḍvipāka uvāca ityājñaptāḥ sarve svaṃ svaṃ dhāma samājagmusteṣu gateṣu nāgakanyāyūthān bhagavānanantaḥ prāha yuṣmākamabhiprāyo mayā jñātastapasā gopālānāṃ gṛheṣu janmāni prāpya maddarśanaṃ kuruta ||15|| kadācitkaliṃdanaṃdinīkūle vihāramādhuryyamūle yuṣmābhiḥ saha rāsamaṇḍalaṃ kariṣyāmi yuṣmākaṃ manorathaḥ saphalo bhaviṣyati ||16|| atha nivātakavacānāṃ rājā kaliḥ svāmipādakṛtamastakāṃjaliḥ pradattapuṣpāvaliḥ śrībhagavantaṃ pratyuvāca ||17|| ahaṃ hi kariṣyāmi mayyājñāṃ kuru || bhagavan yatra tvaṃ gamiṣyāmi tatrāpyahaṃ gamiṣyāmi ha vāva tvadviyogena mahān khedo bhaviṣyati sahaiva māṃ naya tvaṃ bhaktavatsalo'si ||18|| evaṃ saṃprārthito bhagavānanantaḥ kaliṃ rājānaṃ svabhaktaṃ prasannaḥ pratyuvāca sukhena tvaṃ matsahehāgaccha bharatakhaṇḍe kauravendrāṇāṃ kule dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putro bhūtvā duryodhano nāma cakravartī bhaviṣyasi tvatsahāyamahaṃ kariṣyāmi gadāśikṣāṃ ca dāsyāmi ||19|| ityuktaḥ kalistaṃ namaskṛtya svadhāma gatavān saiṣa kalistvaṃ jāto'si viṣṇumāyayā svātmānaṃ na smarasi ||20|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ balabhadrakhaṇḍe prāḍvipākaduryodhanasaṃvāde saṃkarṣaṇagamanamaṃtro nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||2|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<8.3> prāḍvipāka uvāca athāgatā koṭiśaraccaṃdramaṃḍalapratīkāśā nāgalakṣmīrmahārathasthā sakhī koṭimaṇḍalamaṇḍitā saṃkarṣaṇaṃ mahānaṃtaṃ bhartāraṃ sabhāyāṃ prāha ||1|| ahamapi tvayā sahaiva bhagavan bhuvamāgamiṣyāmi tvadviyogāturā prāṇānna dhārayāmi ||2|| iti bāṣpakaṃṭhīṃ priyāṃ saṃprekṣa bhagavānanaṃtaḥ sarvabhaktaduḥkhanivāraṇo maheṃdravāraṇa iva bhogāvāraṇa iti hovāca ||3|| raṃbhoru tvaṃ revatīvigrahe saṃlīnā bhūtvā bhūlokaṃ bhajatānmā śokaṃ kurutāt ||4|| tacchrutvā nāgalakṣmīḥ pratyuvāca revatī kā kasya sutā kva vartamānā nitarāṃ vadaitattacchrutvā bhagavānanaṃtaḥ sasmitaḥ svapriyāṃ pratyuvāca ||5|| ādisarge kaśyapasya kadrusuto hyahaṃ jātaḥ śrīkṛṣṇājñayā tvakhaṃḍabhūkhaṃḍamaṃḍalaṃ gajarāḍiva caikaphaṇe kamaṇḍalumiva dhṛtvā sarvato'dhastādvirājamāno'haṃ babhūva ||6|| atha mayi sthite cakṣuṣaḥ putro'tibalaścākṣuṣo nāma manuḥ saptadvīpabhūkhaṃḍamaṃḍaleṣu maṇḍalapatibhirghṛṣṭapādapuṃḍarīkaḥ puraṃdarādibhirlaṃghitacaṃḍaśāsanaḥ pracaṃḍadordaṃḍāvikhaṃḍitāridordaṃḍaḥ sarvaguṇamaṃḍitaḥ samrāḍbabhūva ||7|| tasya manoḥ sudyumnādyāḥ putrā babhūvuḥ || tasya yajñakuṃḍasamudbhavā kanyā jyotiṣmatī jātā ||8|| ekadā snehāccākṣuṣaḥ putrīṃ papraccha kīdṛśaṃ varamicchasīti vada || sā tadovāca yaḥ sarveṣāṃ balavānsa me varo bhūyāt ||9|| tacchrutvā rājā śakraṃ balavaṃtaṃ jñātvā tamājuhāva || tadaiva sadyaḥ samāgataṃ vajriṇaṃ puraḥsthitaṃ sādareṇāsanaṃ datvā manuḥ prāha ||10|| tvattaḥ ko'pi balavān vartate na vā tatsatyaṃ vada na cetsmṛtiḥ "na hi satyātparo dharma iti hovāca bhūriyam || sarvaṃ soḍhumalaṃ manye ṛte'līkaparaṃ naram" ||11|| indra uvāca ahaṃ balavānnāsmi matto balavān vāyurasti tena sahāyena kārya karomītyuktvā gate śakre rājā vāyumājuhāvāha ca tvattaḥ ko'pi balavān vartate satyaṃ vadatāt ||12|| vāyuruvāca matto balavaṃtaḥ parvatāḥ saṃti madvegena noḍḍīyamānā ityuktvā gate vāyau rājā parvatānājuhāvāha ca bhavadbhyaḥ ko'pi kau balavān vartate tatsatyaṃ vadata ||13|| parvatāḥ prāhurasmaddhāraṇādbhūkhaṃḍaṃ balavadvartate yatra vayaṃ sthitāḥ smaḥ || parvateṣu gateṣu bhūkhaṃḍamaṃḍalaṃ samāhūya rājā prāha tvattaḥ ko'pi balavān vartate na vā satyaṃ vada ||14|| tacchrutvā bhūkhaṇḍa uvāca matto balavānsaṃkarṣaṇo bhagavān vartate || so'yaṃ sadā'nanto'naṃtaguṇārṇava ādidevo vāsudevaḥ sahasravadano nāgeṃdra iva bhavyavapuḥ kailāsa iva śuklaprakāśaḥ koṭisūryapratibhāsaḥ koṭikaṃdarpahārilāvaṇyena vibhrājamānaḥ kamalapatrākṣaḥ kamalakarṇikādivyavimalamālānirmalaparilobhitamadhukaranikarasaṃgīyamānaḥ siddhacāraṇagaṃdharvavidyādharavaragaṇairupagīyamānaḥ surāsuroragamunigaṇaiḥ saṃdhyāyamānaḥ sarvopari virājamāna āste ||15|| yasyaikasminmūrdhni sagirisaritsamudravanajīvakoṭimaṇḍitaṃbhūkhaṃḍamaṃḍalamahaṃ dṛśe || yannāmānukīrtanāttrilokyāṃ trailokyaghātyapi kaivalyaṃ prāpnoti ||16|| evaṃprabhāvo bhagavān sarvato balavānsarvakāraṇakāraṇaḥ sarveśvaro duraṃtavīryyo mūle rasāyāḥ sthitastasmātparaḥ ko'pi nāsti ||17|| mahānaṃta uvāca ityuktvā gate bhūkhaṃḍe cākṣuṣaḥ kanyā jyotiṣmatī mama mādhuryaprabhāvaṃ vijñāya pitrājñāṃ gṛhītvā viṃdhyācale matprāptyarthaṃ varṣāṇāṃ lakṣāṇi brahmatapastepe ||18|| grīṣme paṃcāgnitaptā varṣāsu sarvāsāradhāriṇī śiśira ākaṃṭhamagnā śītodake bhūtvā sthaṇḍīlaśāyinī babhūva ||19|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ balabhadrakhaṇḍe jyotiṣmatyupākhyānaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||3|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<8.4> śrīmahānaṃta uvāca atha jyotiṣmatīṃ śatacaṃdrapratīkāśāṃ navayauvanāṃ suṃdarīṃ tapasvinīṃ vīkṣya śakrayamadhanadāgnivaruṇasomasūryamaṃgalabudhabṛhaspatiśukraśanayaḥ sarve tadrūpoddīpitakāmasaṃmohita cittāstadāśrametya tāmūcuḥ ||1|| he suṃdarī raṃbhoru dhanyā'si kasyārthaṃ tapaḥ karoṣi te vayastapayogyaṃ nāsti mano'bhiprāyaṃ svakamasmākaṃ vadeti tacchrutvā jyotiṣmatyuvāca bhagavānanaṃtaḥ sahasravadano mama bhartā bhūyādetarthaṃ tapastapāmīti tadvacaḥ śrutvā sarve jahasuḥ pṛthak pṛthak teṣāṃ pūrvamiṃdra idamāha ||2|| iṃdra uvāca sarparājaṃ varaṃ kartuṃ kiṃ vṛthā tapase śubhe || devarājaṃ varaya māṃ svataḥ prāptaṃ śatakratum ||3|| yama uvāca yamarājaṃ varaya māṃ daṇḍanetāramāgatam || sarvottamā tvaṃ matpatnī pitṛloke bhaviṣyasi ||4|| dhanada uvāca rājarājaṃ hi māṃ viddhi nidhīśaṃ he varāṃgane || tvaṃ bhajāśu viśālākṣi tyaja saṃkarṣaṇe ratim ||5|| agniruvāca sarvadevamukhaṃ viddhi sarvayajñapratiṣṭhitam || bhaja māṃ tvaṃ viśālākṣi vihāyānyatra vāsanām ||6|| varuṇa uvāca lokapālaṃ varaya māṃ pāśinaṃ yadasāṃ patim || saptānāṃ hi samudrāṇāṃ vaibhavaṃ paśya bhāmini ||7|| sūrya uvāca jagaccakṣuḥ sadā'haṃ vai caṃḍāṃśuścākṣuṣātmaje || vihāya pātālagatiṃ vara māṃ svarṇabhūṣaṇam ||8|| soma uvāca dvijarājaścauṣadhīśo nakṣatreśaḥ sudhākaraḥ || kāminībalado'haṃ vai bhaja māṃ gajagāmini ||9|| maṃgala uvāca iyaṃ mahī hi me mātā pitā sākṣādurukramaḥ || maṃgalaṃ bhaja māṃ bhadre bhūtvā bhūri bhavārthinī ||10|| budha uvāca budho'haṃ buddhimān vīraḥ kāminīrasavarddhanaḥ || visṛjya sarvanākeśān ramasva tvaṃ mayā saha ||11|| bṛhaspatiruvāca gīṣpatirdhiṣaṇo'haṃ vai surācāryo bṛhaspatiḥ || sākṣāddevagururloke bhaja māṃ manyase śubhe ||12|| śukra uvāca sākṣāddaityaguruḥ kāvyo bhārgarvo'haṃ mahāmate || svaśreyastu vicāryyaivaṃ bhava madbhāminī bhṛśam ||13|| śaniruvāca sarveṣāṃ balavān bhadre ahaṃ devopari sthitaḥ || tyaja śokaṃ varaya māṃ lokabhasmakaraṃ dṛśā ||14|| mahānanta uvāca atha jyotiṣmatī teṣāṃ vacāṃsi śrutvā'ruṇanetrā sphuradadharacaladbhrūbhaṃgā prodyadroṣāgniprakarṣocchalacchaṭā māṃ paraṃ sasmāra paraṃ krodhaṃ ca cakāra ||15|| tena sakhaṃḍaṃ mahīmaṃḍalaṃ brahmāṃḍamapi paraṃ cābrahmalokān
