dṛḍhamejatsarvato mahadbhayaṃ babhūva ||16|| tadaiva śakrādyāḥ śāpabhayabhītāḥ prakampitāḥ kṛtabalipāṇayaḥ pādapadme pārito nipetuḥ pāhi pāhīti jagustairitthaṃ śāṃtā'pi jyotiṣmati pṛthak pṛthak tān śaśāpa ||17|| jyotiṣmatyuvāca chalayitumiha māṃ samāgatastvaṃ bhava khala paṃguradhaḥsamīkṣaṇaśca || kṛśatanuratikṛṣṇakutsitābho bhava sahasā'sitamāṣatailabhakṣī ||18|| he śukra akṣṇā bhava kāṇa āśu strīsaṃjñakastvaṃ bhava gīṣpate'tra || he saumya te vāradinaṃ hi śūnyaṃ vadanti gacchanti na ke kadācit ||19|| he maṃgala tvaṃ bhava vānarānano niśākara tvaṃ bhava rājayakṣmavān || tvaṃ bhagnadanto bhava bho divākara pāśin ruciste bhavatāñjalaṃdharī ||20|| tvaṃ sarvabhakṣo bhavatāduṣarbudha manuṣyadharman hṛtapuṣpako bhava || vaivasvasta tvaṃ bahumānabhaṅgo bhavāśu yuddhe prabalena rakṣasā ||21|| māṃ hartumāgatya surādhama sthitaḥ karoṣi niṃdāṃ paramātmano girā || tava priyāṃ ko'pi nṛpo hariṣyati kariṣyati svargasukhaṃ gate tvayi ||22|| pāśena baddhaṃ yudhi nirjitaṃ tvāṃ balādgṛhītvā khalu ko'pi rākṣāsaḥ || laṃkāṃ purīmetya divaspate vai kārāgṛhe'ndhe kila kārayiṣyati ||23|| śrīmahānanta uvāca atha ha vāva tayā śaptānāṃ devānāṃ madhye kupitaḥ śakro'pi tāṃ śaśāpa || kopakāriṇi saṃkarṣaṇaṃ varamapi prāpyatra janmani hyanyatra vā kadācittava putrotsavo mābhūt || evamuktvā śakro'pi tattejasā dharṣītaḥ sarvadevagaṇaiḥ saha svargaṃ jagāma || punaḥ sā tapastepe ||24|| atha tattapo dṛṣṭvā brahmā brahmavidbhirbrāhmaṇairbrāhmayādibhiḥ saṃvṛtaḥ sarvajagatkāraṇabhūtaḥ svabhavanāddhaṃsayānenāgatavān ||25|| aṃbare sthitvā tāmāha he jyotiṣmati cākṣuṣātmaje tvattapaḥ saphalaṃ jātaṃ tena siddhā'si paramahaṃ prasanno'smi varaṃ brūhīti ||26|| tacchrutvā''kaṇṭhajalādvinirgatya brahmāṇaṃ praṇipatya stutvā kṛtāṃjalirityabravīt || he bhagavan yadi prasanno'si kileha saṃkarṣaṇo bhagavān sahasravadano mama varo bhūyāditi śrutvā ha vāva vibudharṣabhaḥ pratyuvāca ||27|| he putri tava manoratho durlabho'sti tathāpi pūrṇa kariṣyāmyadyaiva vaivasvatamanvataraḥ prāpto'sti hyasya trinavacaturyugavikalpite kāle sati tatra varaḥ saṃkarṣaṇo bhagavān bhaviṣyati ||28|| tacchrutvā jyotiṣmatī brahmāṇamāha devadeva bhagavān mahān kālo vartate mama manorathaḥ śīghraṃ bhūyātvaṃ kartuṃ samarthaḥ na cettubhyaṃ śāpaṃ dāsyāmi yathā devebhyo dattaḥ ||29|| iti prokto brahmā śāpabhītaḥ kṣaṇaṃ vicārya punarāha he rājaputri tvamānartapatereva tasya kuśasthalyāṃ putrī bhava || tasmin janmani trinavacaturyugavikalpitaḥ kālaḥ kenacitkāraṇena kṣaṇavadbhaviṣyati iti tasyai varaṃ datvā brahmā tatraivāṃtaradhīyata ||30|| atha sā'pyānarteṣu kuśasthalīpure revatasya bhāryāyāṃ janma lebhe || tatra jyotiṣmatī revatī nāma rupaudāryyaguṇamaṇḍitā navaśaratkaṃjanetrā vivāhayogyā babhūva ||31|| tāṃ revataḥ snehenāṃtaḥpure sabhārya uvāca kīdṛśaṃ varamicchasīti vacaḥ śrutvā sā tadovāca sarveṣāṃ balavānsa me varo bhūyāt ||32|| iti śrutvā rājā revataḥ sabhāryo'pi sutāṃ nītvā divyaṃ rathamāruhya balavantaṃ varaṃ dīrghāyuṣaṃ paripraṣṭuṃ lokānullaṃghya brahmalokaṃ gatavān ||33|| tatra kṣaṇamāsthito'bhūttena kṣaṇena bhūloke'dyaiva trinavacaturyugavikalpitaḥ kālo jātaḥ || sā'dyaiva brahmaloke vartate raṃbhoru tasyā tvaṃ saṃlīnā bhūtvā''veśāvatāriṇī dvārakāṃ prāpya ramasva ||34|| prāḍvipāka uvāca itthaṃ tadvākyaṃ śrutvā nāgalakṣmīḥ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ bhartāramanujñāpya brahmalokametya revatīvigrahe svāveśaṃ cakāra ||35|| atha saṃkarṣaṇ bhagavān bhūri bhūmibhāraharaṇārthaṃ lokanamaskṛtādgolokadhāmasakāśādavatatāredaṃ balabhadrasya bhagavata āgamanaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ sarvaduritāpaharaṇaṃ maṃgalāyanaṃ yuvarāja kauraveṃdra kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasīti ||36|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ balabhadrakhaṇḍe jyotiṣmatyupākhyāne revatyupākhyānaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||4|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<8.5> duryodhana uvāca munīndrāho ahaṃ dhanyo'smi purā saṃkarṣaṇasya bhakto'smi tvayā smārito bhagavato vāsudevasya saprabhāvaṃ māhātmyaṃ paramādbhutaṃ śrutamatrāvatārau bhūtvā bhūmyāṃ rāmakṛṣṇau pituḥ purātkathaṃ vraje gatavaṃtau vrajavāsibhirna jñātau kathamabhūtāṃ ca taducyatām ||1|| prāḍvipāka uvāca athaikadā mathurāyāṃ yadupuryyāmugrasenāgrajo devako devakīṃ sutāṃ vasudevāya dadāvatha varavadhvoḥ prayāṇakāle kaṃsa ugrasenātmajastayoḥ syaṃdanaṃ nodayāmāsa ||2|| tadaiva devavāṇī kaṃsamāha || re yāṃ vahase'syāścāṣṭamo garbho hi tvāṃ haniṣyatīti śrutvā sa mahāsuraḥ kālanemisutaḥ kaṃsaḥ khaḍgapāṇirbhaginīṃ haṃtuṃ pravṛttaḥ ||3|| tadaiva vasudevastaṃ bodhayitvā prāhaināṃ mā mārayāsyāḥ putrānsamarpayiṣye yataste bhayaṃ jātaṃ mamāpi || iti śrutvā tadvākyasāravitkaṃsastau kārāgāre kārayitvā niścinto'pyabhavat ||4|| atha devakyāḥ prathamaṃ jātaṃ putra kaṃsāya vasudevaḥ pradadau || taṃ satyavādinaṃ jñātvā kaṃso'rbhakaṃ na jaghāna ||5|| aṃkānāṃ vāmato gatistathā devānāṃ tasmādayaṃ vā śatruḥ sarve yādavā devāḥ saṃti tava vadhamicchaṃtīti nāradavākyātpunarjāṃtaṃ jātamapi nirjaghāna ||6|| atha kaṃsabhayātpalāyitānāṃ yadūnāṃ mahānkaṣṭo babhūva || atha saptamo garbho devakyā bhagavānanaṃto hyabhavat || tattejaḥ śrīkṛṣṇājñayā yogamāyā devakyudarātsaṃnikṛṣya vasudevasya bhāryāyāṃ kaṃsabhayādgokulasthitāyāṃ rohiṇyāmarpayitumājagāma ||7|| tatraite ślokāḥ devakyā saptame garbhe harṣaśokavivarddhane || vrajaṃ praṇīte rohiṇyāmanaṃte yogamāyayā || aho garbhaḥ kva vigata ityūcurmāthurā janāḥ ||8|| atha vraje paṃcadineṣu bhādre svātau ca ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca site budhe ca || uccairgrahaiḥ paṃcabhirāvṛte ca lagne tulā''khye dinamadhyadeśe ||9|| sureṣu varṣatsu ca puṣpavarṣaṃ dhaneṣu muṃcatsu ca vāribiṃdūn || babhūva devo vasudevapatnyāṃ vibhāsayannaṃdagṛhaṃ svabhāsā ||10|| naṃdo'pi kurvañchiśujātakarma dadau dvijebhyo niyutaṃ gavāṃ ca || gopānsamāhūya sugāyakānāṃ rāvairmahāmaṃgalamātatāna ||11|| athāṣṭamo devakyāḥ paripūrṇatamo bhagavān śrīkṛṣṇacandro'vatatāra || tadaiva tadājñayā niśīthe preṃkhe nidhāya naṃdapatnyāṃ jātāyāṃ yoganidrāyāṃ saṃsupte jagati sati yamunāmuttīrya mahāvanametya yaśodāśayane sutaṃ nidhāya tāṃ sutāmādāya punarvasudevo gṛhānāyayau ||12|| atha kārāgāre bāladhvaniṃ śrutvā śatrubhītaḥ kaṃsaḥ samāgatya jātamātrāṃ kanyāṃ gṛhītvā śilāpṛṣṭhe pātayāmasa ||13|| tadaiva taddhastātsamutpattyāṃbare yoganidrā bhūtvā siddhacāraṇagaṃdharvamunigaṇaiḥ stūyamānā kaṃsamidamāha he khala tava pūrvaśatruryatra kva vā jāto vṛthā devakīvasudevau dīnau dunoṣītyuktvā sā viṃdhyācalaṃ jagāma ||14|| ityukto vismitaḥ kaṃso devakīṃ vasudevaṃ ca vimucya pūtanādīn daityānsamāhūya cānirdaśānnirdaśā nbālānhaṃtumājñāṃ cakāra te'pi tathā cakruḥ ||15|| atha naṃdo'pi putrajanmotsavaṃ śrutvā mahotsavaṃ cakāraivaṃ kaṃsabhayamiṣeṇa vrajaṃ prāptau rāmakṛṣṇau svamāyayālakṣitau vrajavāsināṃ kṛpāṃ kartuṃ jātamātrāvadbhutāṃ bālalīlāṃ cakratuḥ || kauravendra bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi kim ||16|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ balabhadrakhaṇḍe śrībalabhadraśrīkṛṣṇajanmotsavo nāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||5|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<8.6> duryodhana uvāca munīṃdra rāmo'naṃto'naṃtalīlaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo'pi ca bhūmyāṃ bhūtvā rarāja || tasya saṃkṣepeṇa caritraṃ vada || vraje kiṃ mathurāyāṃ kiṃ dvārakāyāṃ kimatra kimanyatra kiṃ cakāra ||1|| prāḍvipāka uvāca atha ha vāva śrīkṛṣṇo jātamātro'dbhutāṃ līlāṃ pūtanāmokṣaśakaṭāsuratṛṇāvartavadhayutāṃ viśvarūpadarśanadadhicauryyabrahmāṃḍadarśanayamalārjunadrumakhaṃḍabhaṃgādisaṃyuktāṃ durvāsaso māyādarśanavaibhavāṃ śrīmadgargācāryavarṇitarādhākṛṣṇanāmaudāryyamāhātmyayuktāṃ surajeṣṭhakāritavṛṣabhānuvaranaṃdinīvivāharāsamaṃḍalakathāmaṃḍitāṃ cakāra ||2|| tataḥ śrīvṛndāvanāgamane sati vatsāsurabakāsurādyasurāṇāṃ vadhaṃ kṛtvā gopālaiḥ saha gocāraṇe vṛṃdāvanādivaneṣu vicacāra ||3|| atha tālavane dhenukāsuraṃ kharasvanaṃ svapadbhyāṃ tāḍayaṃtaṃ bhujadaṃḍābhyāṃ gṛhītvā mahābalo baladevastālavṛkṣe taṃ pātayitvā punarāpataṃtaṃ bhūpṛṣṭhe pothayāmāsa || mūrcchito bhagnamastakaḥ sadyastanmuṣṭiprahāreṇa nidhanaṃ jagāma ||4|| atha śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kāliyadamanadāvāgnipānādīni caritrāṇi kṛtvā śrīrādhāpremaprakāśaprītiparīkṣaṇavṛṃdāvanavihāradānamānalīlāhāvabhāvayuktāṃ śaṃkhacūḍavadhādiśivāsuryyupākhyānakathāṃ kathanīyāṃ līlāṃ cakāra ||5|| athaikadā girirājapūjane kṛte bhagnabaliriṃdraḥ sāṃvartameghamaṇḍalairvrajamaṇḍale vavarṣa || tadā bhagavān bhayāturaṃ vrajaṃ vīkṣya mābhaiṣṭetyabhayaṃ datvā ekakareṇa girirājaṃ samutpāṭyocchilīṃdhraṃ bāla iva dadhāra ha vāva saptavarṣīyaḥ saptāhaṃ susthiraṃ sthitaḥ ||6|| athendraḥ sarvadevagaṇairbhayabhītaḥ śrīkṛṣṇacaṃdraśrīmatpādāraviṃdadvayaṃ praṇamya kirīṭena nataḥ stutvā tadabhiṣekaṃ kṛtvā maheṃdrarāṭ surabhisuramunibhiḥ sārddhaṃ svargaṃ jagāma ||7|| tadadbhutaṃ govardhanoddhāraṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā gopā visismyustebhyo muktāropaṇādivaibhavaṃ saṃdarśayāmāsuḥ ||8|| atha śrutirūparṣirūpā maithilā kauśalāyodhyāpuravāsinī yajñasītāpulindakāramāvaikuṇṭhaśvetadvīpordhvavaikuṇṭhājitapadaśrīlokācalavāsinī sakhī divyādivyātriguṇavṛttibhūmigopījanadevaśrījālaṃdharībarhiṣmatīpuraṃdhryapsaraḥsutalavāsinīnāgendrakanyādibhirgopīyūthaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak śrīkṛṣṇo vrajamaṇḍale rāsamaṃḍalaṃ cakāra ||9|| ekadā gāścārayansabalaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo gopālabālairbhāṃḍīre bālalīlāṃ vāhyavāhakalakṣaṇāṃ kṛtavān || tatra pralambo goparūpī daityo vihāre vihāravijayaṃ rāmaṃ svapṛṣṭhe nidhāyovāha ||10|| atha ha vāva mathurāṃ gaṃtumudyataṃ girīṃdrasya sadṛśadehaṃ tamudvīkṣya pṛṣṭagato baladevo mahābalo ruṣā muṣṭinā śirasi mahādriṃ yathādribhittatāḍa tena sadyo viśīrṇamastako vajrahato giririva sa daityo bhūmyāṃ nipapāta ||11|| ekadā grīṣme muṃjāraṇyagatāsu goṣu gopāleṣu ca satsu sadyaḥ saṃbhūto dāvāgniḥ pralayāgniriva vavṛdhe || tataḥ kṛṣṇarāmeti vadataḥ pāhi pāhīti gopālān śaraṇaṃ gatān vīkṣya locanāni nimīlayatāśu mābhaiṣṭetyuktvā tamagnimapibat ||12|| atha ha vāva bhāṃḍīrādyamunātīre gopālagogaṇaṃ nītvā prāpto'bhūttatrāśokavane yajñapatnyānītaṃ bhojanaṃ kṛtavān ||13|| atha caikadā vraje nandarāje varuṇagraste varuṇasya mānabhaṃgaṃ kṛtvā nandādibhyo gopebhyo'pi sarvalokanamaskṛtaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ darśayāmāsa ||14|| athāṃbikāvane śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sarasvatītīre nandaṃ grasaṃtaṃ sudarśanaṃ sarpaṃ kilākhilalokapālavanditena śrīmaccaraṇāraviṃdena spṛṣṭvā sarpadehāttaṃ mocayāmāsa ||15|| atha sabalaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo nilāyanakrīḍāyāṃ corarūpaṃ vyomāsuraṃ kaṃsasakhaṃ bhujadaṃḍābhyāṃ gṛhītvā daśadiśāsu bhrāmayan bhūpṛṣṭhe pothayāmāsa ||16|| tathāriṣṭāsuraṃ kaṃsapraṇoditaṃ vṛṣarūpaṃ śṛṅgayoḥ samuddhṛtya pātayāmāsa || atha nāradamukhācchrutaśrīkṛṣṇakathena kaṃsena praṇoditaṃ keśinaṃ śrīkṛṣṇastanmukhe svabhujapraveśena saṃmamardetthamanekā līlāḥ sahasā vrajamaṃḍale balena kārayāmāsa ||17|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ balabhadrakhaṇḍe prāḍvipākaduryodhanasaṃvāde rāmakṛṣṇavrajalīlāvarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||6|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<8.7> prāḍvipāka uvāca atha mathurāyāṃ rāmakṛṣṇau yāni caritrāṇi kṛtavantau tāni saṃkṣepeṇa yuvarāja śṛṇutāt || atha kālanemisutena kaṃsena prayukto'krūro rāmakṛṣṇau samānetuṃ vrajamaṇḍalamāgatavān ||1|| tatra gaṃtumabhyudyitaṃ nandarājasūnuṃ vīkṣya gopīgaṇā virahāturā babhūvuḥ || pṛthak pṛthak tānāśvāsya bhagavān rathamāruhya sabalo'krūreṇa yadupurīṃ gacchanmārge yamunājaleṣu śvāphalkāya svadhāma darśayāmāsa ||2|| atha pūrvāhṇe mathuropavane sthitvāparāhṇe mathurāpurīṃ sarvato dadarśa || atha rāmakṛṣṇau devau purāṇau puruṣau līlayā naṭavaraveṣadharau didṛkṣavaḥ paurāśca puraṃdhryaḥ karmāṇi tyaktvā vyadhāvannāpagā udadhimiva tau koṭikaṃdarpaharaṃ sauṃdaryaṃ svaṃ saṃdarśayantau ceto harantau viceratuḥ sma ||3|| atha bhagavān rājamārge tadyācitavastrāṇyadāsyaṃtaṃ rajakaṃ raṃgakāraṃ karāgreṇa sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ nirjaghāna tathā vastraveṣaṃ kurvate vāyakāya svasārūpyaṃ pradāt ||4|| tataḥ sairaṃdhrīṃ kubjāṃ trivakrāṃ caṃdanādānamiṣeṇarjvīṃ trilokasundarīṃ kṛtvā tato vaiśyajanānsamābhāṣya mathurārbhakaiḥ sahito dhanuḥsthale viveśa || atha hemacitraṃ saptatālakaṃ sahasraśaḥ puruṣairnetumaśakyaṃ bṛhadbhāraṃ cāṣṭadhātumayalakṣabhārasamaṃ yajñamaṃḍapadhṛtaṃ kaṃsāya bhārgaveṇa dattaṃ sākṣāccheṣamiva kuṃḍalībhūtaṃ kodaṇḍaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vīkṣya prasahyādade ||5|| tadaiva paśyatāṃ lokānāṃ sajyaṃ kṛtvā līlayā''kṛṣya karṇaparyantaṃ dordaṃḍābhyāṃ yathekṣudaṃḍaṃ vetaṃḍaḥ śuḍādaṃḍena kodaṃḍaṃ madhyato babhaṃja ||6|| bhajyamānadhanuṣaṣṭaṅkāreṇa saptalokabilaiḥ saha sarvaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ nanāda || tatastārā diggajāśca viceluḥ || sarvaṃ bhūkhaṃḍamaṃḍalaṃ sthālīva ghaṭikādvayamātraṃ pracakaṃpe ||7|| athāparāhṇe raṃgabhūmidvāri dvipaṃ kuvalayāpīḍaṃ sametya kṣaṇaṃ bālalīlayā yuddhaṃ kṛtvā śuṇḍādaṃḍe saṃgṛhītvā tvitastato bhrāmayitvā bālakaḥ kamaṃḍalumiva bhūpṛṣṭhe taṃ pātayāmāsa ||8|| tamitthaṃ nihatya raṃgabhūmau kaṃsasabhāyāṃ janatāyai yathābhāvaṃ darśanaṃ datvā mallayuddhaṃ kṛtvā cāṇūramuṣṭikakūṭaśalatośalakān kaṃsasyāgre sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ bhūpṛṣṭhe rāmakṛṣṇau pātayāmāsatuḥ ||9|| atha tatkarma vīkṣya durvacanāni vikatthamānasya kaṃsasya madhusūdanaḥ sahasotpatya mañcaṃ mahonnataṃ samāruroha ||10|| tataḥ satvaraṃ mṛtyumivāgataṃ vīkṣya maṃcādutthāya taṃ nirbhartsayannunmanā drutaṃ kaṃsaḥ khaḍgacarmaṇī jagṛhe || hariḥ sahasā carmāsisaṃyuktaṃ kaṃsaṃ saviṣaṃ phaṇīṃdramiva tuṃḍavibhāgābhyāṃ virāḍiva dordaṃḍābhyāṃ balātsamagrahīt ||11|| atha tārkṣyatuṇḍātphaṇīva kaṃso bhujabaṃdhādbalādvinirgatya patatkhaḍgacarmā punarudyato'bhūtpunarmañce balinau vegānmardayantau śaile siṃhāviva śuśubhāte ||12|| tato balādutpataṃtaṃ kaṃsaṃ śatahastamaṃbare kṛṣṇa utpatan śyenaṃ śyena iva taṃ samagrahīt || punargacchaṃtaṃ daityapuṃgavaṃ pracaṃṇḍabhujadaṇḍābhyāṃ gṛhītatrailokyādhāra itastato bhrāmayitvā mahāṃbarānmaṃcopari pātayāmāsa ||13|| tatastaḍitpātāddrumakhaṃḍa iva bhagnadaṃḍo maṃco babhūva || sa vajrāṃgaḥ patito'pi kiṃcidvyākulaḥ sahasotthāya mahātmanā punaryuyudhe || punastaṃ bhujadaṃḍābhyāṃ bhagavān gṛhītvā maṃce kṣiptvā hṛdayamāruhya tanmauliṃ gṛhītvā sadyaḥ keśeṣu gṛhya maṃcādraṃgopari pātayitvā śailādgaṃḍaśilāmiva tasyopariṣṭātsanātanaḥ sarvādhāro'naṃtavikramo vegātsvayaṃ nipapāta || tayornipātena nimnībhūtaṃ bhūkhaṃḍamaṃḍalaṃ sthālīva daṃḍatrayaṃ sahasā cakaṃpe ||14|| atha saṃparetaṃ bhojarājaṃ yadurājo bhūmigataṃ nāgendraṃ mṛgendra iva sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ vicakarṣa || tadaiva bhūbhujāṃ hāhākāra asīdaho vairabhāvena yaṃ bhajankaṃso'pi tasya sārupyaṃ bhṛṃgiṇaḥ kīṭaka iva jagāma ||15|| tataḥ kaṃsaṃ mṛtaṃ sahasā vīkṣya samāgatāṃstasyānujān khaḍgacarmadharān dṛṣṭvā balabhadro mudgaraṃ nītvā sarvato'bhijaghāna|| tadā devaduṃdubhayo nedurjayadhvaniścābhūddevāḥ puṣpairvavṛṣurvidyādharyo nanṛturvidyādharagandharvakinnarā jaguḥ ||16|| atha sarvānāśvāsya pitarau vimokṣyograsenāya rājyaṃ datvopavītaṃ prāpya saṃdīpanādvidyā adhitya tasmai mṛtaṃ sutaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ datvā śaṃkhaṃ hatvā mathurāmetya vasan vrajaśāṃtyai coddhavaṃ preṣayitvā punaḥ svayaṃ vrajaṃ gatvā rādhāyai gopībhyaśca darśanaṃ datvā rāsamadhye ṛbhumokṣaṃ kṛtvā punarmathurāyāṃ māthureśo rarāja || rāmo'pi kolavadhaṃ kṛtvā tasyāṃ virarājeti tayormathurāyāṃ sahasraśaḥ pavitrāṇi caritrāṇi babhūvuḥ ||17|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ balabhadrakhaṇḍe mathurālīlāvarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||7|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<8.8> prāḍvipāka uvāca atha yuvarāja dhārtarāṣṭra tayordvārakālīlā saṃkṣepeṇa śṛṇutāt || tataḥ kaṃsasya pārokṣyaṃ sauhṛdaṃ kurvataṃ samāgataṃ jarāsaṃdhaṃ jitvā dvārakākhyaṃ samudre durgaṃ nirmāya tatraikarātreṇa jñātīnsamādhāya mucakuṃdadṛśā kālaṃ ghātayitvā punaśca rāmakṛṣṇau pravarṣaṇādrimetya tasmāddvārakāyāṃ jagmatuḥ ||1|| atha brahmalokātsamāgato raivataḥ sutāṃ ratnayutāṃ vidhivadbalaśāline balabhadrāya datvā tapaḥ kartuṃ badaryākhyaṃ vanaṃ gatavān ||2|| atha śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śatrūṇāṃ paśyatāṃ kuṃḍinapurādrukmiṇīṃ jahāra tathā jāṃbavatīṃ satyabhāmāṃ kāliṃdīṃ mitraviṃdāṃ nāgnijitīṃ bhadrāṃ lakṣmaṇāṃ ca bhaumaṃ hatvā ṣoḍaśasahasraṃ śataṃ ca rājakanyā uvāha ||3|| rājan bhīṣmakakanyāyāṃ rukmiṇyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya putraḥ prathamaṃ kāmadevāvatāraḥ pitṛsamasuṃdara āsīt || tasmādaniruddhaḥ surajyeṣṭhāvatāro'bhūt ||4|| athaikadograsenarājasūyādhvare nāgavallīṃ gṛhītvā digvijayārthī nirgataḥ pradyumno yādavairbhrātṛbhiḥ saha jaṃbūdvīpe navakhaṇḍavijayaṃ kurvan kāmadughanadasamīpe vasaṃtamālatīpurādhiśena pataṃgena gaṃdharvarājena yuyudhe ||5|| tatra gadāyuddhe gadāmādāya gado baladevānujo gadādharaṃ svagadayā pataṅga tatāḍa || so'pi taṃ hṛdi caujasā jaghānetthaṃ tayorgadāyuddhaṃ ghaṭikādvayaṃ babhūva|| tataḥ pataṃgagadāprahāreṇa gado yuddhe kṣaṇaṃ mūrcchāṃ jagāma ||6|| tadā hāhākāre jāte koṭimārtaṃḍasannibho balabhadra āvirbhūtvā gaṃdharvāṇāṃ sarvaṃ balaṃ halāgreṇa samākṛṣya tadupari kliṣṭamuśalatāḍanaṃ cakāra || tena yugapatsarvaṃ sainyaṃ sabhaṭadviparathaṃ cūrṇībabhūva ||7|| atha pataṃgo'pi viratho bhayabhītastasmātpurīṃ gatvā punaryoddhuṃ yādavaiḥ senāvyūhaṃ cakāra || tacchrutvā kruddho balabhadro gaṃdharvāṇāṃ mahāpurīṃ śatayojanavistīrṇāṃ vasaṃtamālatīnāmnīṃ sarvāṃ halena saṃvidārya sahasā kāmadughe nade saṃkarṣaṇo vicakarṣa ||8|| atha ha vāva patitairgṛhairhāhākāre jāte tiryakpotamivāghūrṇāṃ samastāṃ nagarīṃ vīkṣya gaṃdharvaigaṃdhaveśaḥ pataṃgaḥ kṛtāṃjalirdharṣito viśvakarmakṛtānāṃ vimānānāṃ dvilakṣaṃ gajānāṃ caturlakṣaṃ cāśvaśatārbudaṃ ca divyānāṃ ratnānāṃ bhāraṃ daśaśatārbudaṃ ca baliṃ nītvā balaśāline balāya dattvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇanāma ||9|| atha tathā sāṃbamokṣārthaṃ balabhadra ihāgato bhavatāṃ paśyatāṃ puramidaṃ halāgreṇa saṃvidārya śrīgaṃgāṃ sākṣātsaṃkarṣaṇo vicakarṣa || tathaiva nāgakanyābhirgopībhirnirmite rāsamaṃḍale kālindiṃ halāgreṇa vicakarṣa ||10|| athaikadā dvivido nāma vānaraḥ sugrīvasacivo bhaumasakho nāradena prerito hariṃ yoddhukāmo'vataradraivatakācalametya balena ghaṭikācatuṣṭayaṃ yuyudhe || drumadaṇḍaśilāmuṣṭibhirvinighnantaṃ taṃ balabhadro musalena mūrdhni nijaghāna || punarna mṛtaṃ muṣṭinā ghātayitvā palāyaṃtaṃ bhujadaṃḍābhyāṃ gṛhītvā raivatakācalapṛṣṭhe pātayitvācyutāgrajo dṛḍhena muṣṭinā hṛdi taṃ tatāḍa || tatpatanena saṭaṃkaḥ śaileṃdraḥ kamaṃḍaluriva cakaṃpe ||11|| atha ha vāva rājannadya bhavatāṃ pāṃḍavaiḥ saha yuddhodyamaṃ śrutvā tīrthābhiṣekavyājena brāhmaṇairnāgaraiḥ sahitaḥ purādvinirgato dvārakāṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya siddhāśramaprabhāsayoḥ snātvā paścimāyāṃ diśi sarasvatīpratisrotaḥ saiṃdhavāraṇyajaṃbūmārgotpalāvartārbudahemavaṃtasiṃdhūnupaspṛśya pṛthagbiṃdusarastritakūpasudarśanātritauśanasāgneyavāyavasaudāsaguhatīrthaśrāddhadevādīni tīrthāni snātvottarasyāṃ diśi kailāsakaravīramahāyogagaṇeśakauberaprāgjyotiṣaraṃgavallīsītārāmakṣetracaitradeśavasaṃtatilakādaśārṇabhadrākūrmatīrthapuṣpamālācitravanacaṃdrakāṃtānaiḥśreyasamanuparvatacakṣuḥkāmaśālinīkāmavanavedakṣetrasītāpṛthutīrthatapobhūmilīlāvatīvedanagaragāṃdharvaśakrabhīmarathīśrījāhnavīkāliṃdīharidvārakurukṣetramathurāpuṣkareṣu snātvā punastasmācchāṃbhalaṃ saukaraṃ prāpya cānyāni kurvan tīrthāni sākṣātsaṃkarṣaṇo naimiṣāraṇyaṃ jagāma ||12|| taṃ samāgataṃ vīkṣya śaunakādayo munayaḥ samutthāya vavaṃdire cārcayan ||13|| tatra vedavyāsaśiṣyaṃ romaharṣaṇamapratyutthāyinaṃ vīkṣya karasthena kuśāgreṇa taṃ jaghāneti tadā hāhetivādino munīn vīkṣya lokapāvano'pi lokasaṃgrahārtha dvādaśa māsān tīrthasnānena viśuddhaye mano dadhe ||14|| tatrelvalasuto balvalo nāma daitya upāvṛte parvaṇi pāṃsuvarṣaṇapracaṃḍena vāyunā pūyaśoṇitaviṇmūtrasurāmāṃsadurgandhena samāgataḥ khe dṛṣṭo'bhūt || atha lalajjihvaṃ vajrāṃgaṃ bhinnakajjalāṃjanacayakṛṣṇaṃ taptatāmraśmaśrubhayaṃkaraṃ brahmaśāṃtaye halāgreṇa samākṛṣya gaganānmusalena mūrdhni balabhadrastaṃ tatāḍa || tattāḍanenākāśātso'pi kamaṃḍaluriva vyasuḥ papāta ||15|| atha prasannā munayo'pi rāmaṃ saṃstutyāvitathāśiṣaḥ prayujya vṛtraghnaṃ vibudhā ivābhyaṣiṃcan tairabhyanujñātaḥ sarayūkauśikīmānasasarovaragaṃḍakīgautamīṣu snātvāyodhyānaṃdigrāmabarhiṣmatībrahmāvartādīnyupaspṛśya tīrtharājaṃ prayāgaṃ jagāma || tatrāyutagajadānaṃ cakāra ||16|| tataścitrakūṭavindhyācalakāśīvipāśāśoṇamithilāgayādiṣu snātvā gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgamaṃ jagāma || tatra suvarṇa śṛṅgāmbarasaṃyuktaṃ pṛthak suvarṇaratnabhārasahitaṃ gavāṃ koṭiśataṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prādāt || tataḥ kramaśo dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi mahendrādrisaptagodāvarīveṇīpaṃpābhīmarathīskaṃdakṣetraśrīśailarveṃkaṭakāṃcīkāverīśrīraṃgarṣabhādrisamudrasetukṛtamālātāmraparṇīmalayācalakulācaladakṣiṇasiṃdhuphālgunapaṃcāpsarogokarṇaśūrpārakātāpīpayoṣṇīnirvindhyādaṇḍakarevāmāhiṣmatyavaṃtikādīni tīrthāni sākṣātsaṃkarṣaṇaḥ kariṣyati sma || tatastvatsahāyārthaṃ viśasane cāgamiṣyati ||17|| idaṃ balabhadracaritraṃ pavitraṃ sarvapāpābhiharaṇaṃ tīrthayātrāvarṇanaṃ nitarāṃ mayā varṇitaṃ sarvamaṃgalakāraṇaṃ kauraveṃdra kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ||18|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ balabhadrakhaṇḍe prāḍvipākaduryodhanasaṃvāde dvārakālīlāvarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<8.9> duryodhana uvāca muniśārdūla bhagavānbalabhadro nāgakanyābhirgopībhiḥ kadā kāliṃdīkūle vijahāra ||1|| prāḍvipāka uvāca ekadā dvārakānagarāddhitālāṃkaṃ rathamāsthāya surāndidṛkṣuḥ paramutkaṃṭho nandarājagokulagogopālagopīgaṇasaṃkulaḥ saṃkarṣaṇa āgataścirotkaṃṭhābhyāṃ nandarājayaśodābhyāṃ pariṣvakto gopīgopālagobhirmilitvā tatra dvau māsau vāsantikau cāvātsīt ||2|| atha ca yā nāgakanyāḥ pūrvoktāstā gopakanyā bhūtvā balabhadraprāptyarthaṃ gargācāryādbalabhadrapañcāṃgaṃ gṛhītvā tenaiva siddhā babhūvuḥ || tābhirbaladeva ekadā prasannaḥ kālindīkūle rāsamaṇḍalaṃ samārebhe || tadaiva caitrapūrṇimāyāṃ pūrṇacandro'ruṇavarṇaḥ sampūrṇaṃ vanaṃ rañjayan vireje ||3|| śītalā mandayānāḥ kamalamakaraṃdareṇuvṛṃdasaṃvṛtāḥ sarvato vāyavaḥ parivavuḥ || kaliṃdagirinandinīcalallaharībhirānandadāyinī pulinaṃ vimalaṃ hyācitaṃ cakāra || tathā ca kuñjaprāṃgaṇanikuñjapuñjaiḥ sphurallalitapallavapuṣpaparāgairmayūrakokilapuṃskokilakūjitairmadhupamadhuradhvanibhirvrajabhūmirvibhrājamānā babhūva ||4|| tatra kvaṇadghaṇṭikanūpuraḥ sphuranmaṇimayakaṭakakaṭisūtrakeyūrahārakirīṭakuṃḍalayorupari kamalapatrairnīlāṃbaro vimalakamalapatrākṣo yakṣībhiryakṣarāḍiva gopībhirgoparāḍrāsamaṇḍale reje ||5|| atha varuṇapreṣitā vāruṇī devī puṣpabhāragaṃdhalobhimiliṃdanāditavṛkṣakoṭarebhyaḥ pataṃtī sarvato vanaṃ surabhīcakāra || tatpānamadavihvalaḥ kamalaviśālatāmrākṣo makaradhvajāveśacaladdhuryyāṅgabhaṅgo vihārakhedaprasvedāṃbukaṇairgaladgaṃḍasthalapatrabhaṅgo gajeṃdragatirgajendraśuṇḍādaṃḍasamadordaṃḍamaṇḍito gajībhirgajarājendra ivonmattaḥ siṃhāsane nyastahalo musalapāṇiḥ koṭīṃdupūrṇamaṇḍalasaṃkāśaḥ prodgamadratnamañjīrapracalanūpuraprakvaṇatkanakakiṃkiṇībhiḥ kaṃkaṇasphurattāṭaṃkapuraṭahāraśrīkaṃṭhāṃgulīyaśiromaṇibhiḥ praviḍaṃbinīkṛtasarpiṇīśyāmaveṇīkuntalalalitagaṃḍasthalapatrāvalibhiḥ sundarībhirbhagavān bhuvaneśvaro vibhrājamāno virarāja atha ca reme ||6|| atha ha vāva kālindīkūlakāṃtāraparyaṭanavihārapariśramodyatsvedabiṃduvyāptamukhāraviṃdaḥ snānārthaṃ jalakrīḍārthaṃ yamunāṃ dūrātsa ājuhāva || tatastvanāgatāṃ taṭinīṃ halāgreṇa kupito vicakarṣa iti hovāca ||7|| adya māmavajñāya nāyāsi mayāhūtāpi musalena tvāṃ kāmacāriṇīṃ śatadhā neṣya evaṃ nirbhartsitā sā bhūribhītā yamunā cakitā tatpādayoḥ patitovāca ||8|| rāma rāma saṃkarṣaṇa balabhadra mahābāho tava paraṃ vikramaṃ na jāne || yasyaikasminmūrdhni sarṣapavatsarvaṃ bhūkhaṇḍamaṇḍalaṃ dṛśyate || tasya tava paramanubhāvamajānaṃtī prapannāṃ māṃ bhoktuṃ yogyo'si || tvaṃ bhaktavatsalo'si ||9|| ityeva yācito balabhadro yamunāṃ tato vyamuñcatpunaḥ kareṇubhiḥ karīva gopībhirgoparāḍ jale vijagāha || punarjalādvinirgatya taṭasthāya balabhadrāya sahasā yamunā copāyanaṃ nīlāṃbarāṇi hemaratnamayabhūṣaṇāni divyāni ca dadau ha vāva tāni gopīyūthāya pṛthak pṛthak vibhajya svayaṃ nīlāṃbare vasitvā kāṃcanīṃ mālāṃ navaratnamayīṃ dhṛtvā maheṃdro vāraṇeṃdra iva balabhadro vireje ||10|| itthaṃ kauravendra yādavendrasya ramataḥ sarvā vāsantikīrniśā vyatītā babhūvuḥ || bhagavato balabhadrasya hastināpuramiva vīryaṃ sūcayatīva hyadyāpi ca kṛṣṭavartmanā yamunā vahati || imāṃ rāmasya rāsakathāṃ yaḥ śrṛṇoti śrāvayati ca sa sarvapāpapaṭalaṃ chitvā tasya parasparamānandapadaṃ pratiyāti || kiṃ bhūya śrotumicchasi ||11|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ balabhadrakhaṇḍe prāḍvipākaduryodhanasaṃvāde rāmarāsakrīḍāvarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ||9|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<8.10> duryodhana uvāca bhagavan gargācāryeṇa gopīyūthāya kathaṃ dattaṃ balabhadrapañcāṅgaṃ tatkṛpayā vadatāt || tvaṃ sarvajño'si ||1|| prāḍvipāka uvāca kauravendra ekadā gargācāryaḥ kaliṃdanandinīṃ snātuṃ gargācalādvrajamaṃḍalaṃ cājagāma || tatraikāṃte marullīlaijallalitalatātarupallavapuṣpagaṃdhamattamiliṃdapuñje kāliṃdīkūlakalitanikuṃje śrīrāmakṛṣṇadhyānatatparaṃ gargācāryaṃ praṇamya nāgendrakanyāḥ sma iti jātismarā gopakanyāḥ śrīmadbalabhadraprāptyarthaṃ sevanaṃ papracchustāsāṃ paramāṃ bhaktiṃ vīkṣya paddhatipaṭalastotrakavacasahasranāmāni gopīyūthāya sa pradadau || kiṃ bhūyastvaṃ tadgrahaṇaṃ kartumicchasi vadatāt ||2|| duryodhana uvāca rāmasya paddhatiṃ brūhi yathā siddhiṃ vrajāmyaham || tvaṃ bhaktavatsalo brahman gurudeva namostu te ||3|| prāḍvipāka uvāca rāmamārgasya niyamaṃ śṛṇu pārthivasattama || yena prasanno bhavati balabhadro mahāprabhuḥ ||4|| sahasravadano devo bhagavān bhuvaneśvaraḥ || na dānairna ca tīrthaiśca bhaktyā labhyastvananyayā ||5|| satsaṃgametyāśu śikṣedbhaktiṃ vai śrīharerguroḥ || sa siddhaḥ kathito jātaṃ yasya vai premalakṣaṇam ||6|| brāhme muhūrte cotthāya rāmakṛṣṇeti ca bruvan || natvā guruṃ bhuvaṃ caiva tato bhūmyāṃ padaṃ nyaset ||7|| vāryyupaspṛśya rahasi sthito bhūtvā kuśāsane || hastāvutsaṃga ādhāya svanāsāgranirīkṣaṇaḥ ||8|| dhyāyetparaṃ hariṃ devaṃ balabhadraṃ sanātanam || gauraṃ nīlāṃbaraṃ hṛdyaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam ||9|| evaṃ dhyānaparo nityaṃ prītyarthaṃ halinaḥ prabhoḥ || trikālasaṃdhyākṛcchuddho maunī krodhavivarjitaḥ ||10|| akāmī gatalobhaśca nirmohaḥ satyavāgbhavet || dvivāraṃ jalapānārthī ekabhukto jitendriyaḥ ||11|| kṣaumāmbaro bhūmiśāyī bhūtvā pāyasabhojanaḥ || evaṃ nirjitaṣaḍvargo bhavedekāgramānasaḥ ||12|| tasya prasanno bhavati sadā saṃkarṣaṇo hariḥ || paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣātsarvakāraṇakāraṇaḥ ||13|| itthaṃ śrībalabhadrasya kathitā paddhatirmayā || kauravendra mahābāho kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ||14|| duryodhana uvāca munīṃdra devadevasya paṭalaṃ brūhi me prabhoḥ || yena sevāṃ kariṣyāmi tatpadāmbujayoḥ sadā ||15|| prāḍvipāka uvāca balasya paṭalaṃ guhyaṃ viddhi siddhipradāyakam || ekāṃte brahmaṇā dattaṃ nāradāya mahātmane ||16|| praṇavaṃ pūrvamuddhṛtya kāmabījaṃ tataḥ param || kāliṃdībhedanapadaṃ saṃkarṣaṇamataḥ param ||17|| caturthyaṃtaṃ dvayaṃ kṛtvā svāhāṃ paścādvidhāya ca || maṃtrarājamimaṃ rājan brahmoktaṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaram ||18|| japellakṣaṃ vratī bhūtvā sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa || ihāmutra parāṃ siddhiṃ saṃprāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ ||19|| atha japtasya maṃtrasya mahāpūjāṃ samācaret || dvātriṃśatpatrasaṃyuktaṃ karṇikākesarojjvalam ||20|| bhavyaṃ kaṃjaṃ pañcavarṇaṃ likhitvā sthaṃḍile śubhe || tasyopari nyasedrājan hemasihāsanaṃ śubham || tasmin śrībaladevasya paramarcāṃ prapūjayet ||21|| oṃ namo bhagavate puruṣottamāya vāsudevāya saṃkarṣaṇāya sahasravadanāya mahānantāya svāhā || anena mantreṇa śikhābandhanaṃ kṛtvā sarvatastaṃ praṇamya tatsaṃmukho bhūtvā svayaṃ nato bhavet || oṃ jayajayānaṃta balabhadra kāmapāla tālāṃka kāliṃdībhaṃjana āvirāvirbhūya mama sammukho bhaveti || anena maṃtreṇāvāhanaṃ kuryāt || oṃnamaste'stu sīrapāṇe halamusaladhara rauhiṇeya nīlāṃbara rāma revatīramaṇa namaste'stu || anena maṃtreṇāsanapādyārghyasnānamadhuparkadhūpadīpayajñopavitanaivedyavastrabhūṣaṇagaṃdhapuṣpākṣatapuṣpāñjalinīrājanādīnupacārān prakalpayet || oṃviṣṇave madhusūdanāya vāmanāya trivikramāya śrīdharāya hṛṣikeśāya padmanābhāya dāmodarāya saṃkarṣaṇāya vāsudevāya pradyumnāyāniruddhāya adhokṣajāya puruṣottamāya śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ || iti pādagulphajānūrukaṭyudarapārśvapṛṣṭhibhujākaṃdharanetraśirāṃsi pṛthak pṛthak pūjayāmīti maṃtreṇa sarvāṅgapūjāṃ kuryāt || atha śaṃkhacakragadāpadmāsidhanurbāṇahalamusalakaustubhavanamālāśrīvatsapītāṃbaranīlāṃbaravaṃśīvetragaruḍāṃkatālāṃkarathadārukasumatikumudakumudākṣaśrīdāmādīn praṇavapūrveṇa caturthyaṃtena namaḥ saṃyuktena nāmamaṃtreṇa pṛthak pṛthak saṃpūjya || tathā viṣvaksenavedavyāsadurgāvināyakadikpālagrahādīn kamale sarvataḥ sve sve sthāne saṃpūjayet || punaḥ parisamūhanādisthālīpākavidhānena vaiśvānaraṃ saṃpūjya pūrvoktena mūlamantreṇa paṃcaviṃśatisahasrāṇyāhutīrjuhuyāt || tathāṣṭau sahasrāṇi dvādaśākṣareṇa tathāṣṭau sahasrāṇi caturvyūhamantreṇāhutīrjuhuyāt || tato'gniṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya namaskṛtyācāryaṃ mahārhavastrasuvarṇābharaṇatāmrapātrasavatsagosuvarṇadakṣiṇābhiḥ saṃpūjya tathā brāhmaṇānbhojanādyaiḥ saṃpūjya nagarajanebhyo bhojanaṃ datvā''cāryānpraṇamet || itthaṃ balasya paṭalānusāreṇa yo'nusmarati ihāmutra siddhisamṛddhibhiḥ saṃvṛto bhavati || śrīrāmapaṭalaṃ guhyaṃ mayā te hyanuvarṇitam || sarvasiddhipradaṃ rājan kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ||22|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ balabhadrakhaṇḍe prāḍvipākaduryodhanasaṃvāde paddhatipaṭalavarṇanaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||10|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<8.11> duryodhana uvāca stotraṃ śrībaladevasya prāḍvipāka mahāmune || vada māṃ kṛpayā sākṣātsarvasiddhipradāyakam ||1|| prāḍvipāka uvāca stavarājaṃ tu rāmasya vedavyāsakṛtaṃ śubham || sarvasiddhipradaṃ rājañchṛṇu kaivalyadaṃ nṛṇām ||2|| devādideva bhagavan kāmapāla namo'stu te || namo'nantāya śeṣāya sākṣādrāmāya te namaḥ ||3|| dharādharāya pūrṇāya svadhāmne sīrapāṇaye || sahasraśirase nityaṃ namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya te ||4|| revatīramaṇa tvaṃ vai baladevācyutāgrajaḥ || halāyudha pralaṃbaghna pāhi māṃ puruṣottama ||5|| balāya balabhadrāya tālāṃkāya namo namaḥ || nīlāṃbarāya gaurāya rauhaṇeyāya te namaḥ ||6|| dhenukārirmuṣṭikāriḥ kūṭārirbalvalāṃtakaḥ || rukmyariḥ kūpakarṇāriḥ kumbhāṃḍāristvameva hi ||7|| kāliṃdībhedano'si tvaṃ hastināpurakarṣakaḥ || dvividāriryādaveṃdro vrajamaṃḍalamaṃḍanaḥ ||8|| kaṃsabhātṛprahantasi tīrthayātrākaraḥ prabhuḥ || duryodhanaguruḥ sākṣātpāhi pāhi prabho tvataḥ ||9|| jaya jayācyutadeva parātpara svayamanantadigaṃtagataśruta || suramunīṃdraphaṇīndravarāya te musaline baline haline namaḥ ||10|| yaḥ paṭhetsatataṃ stavanaṃ naraḥ sa tu hareḥ paramaṃ padamāvrajet || jagati sarvabalaṃ tvarimardanaṃ bhavati tasya dhanaṃ svajanaṃ dhanam ||11|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ balabhadrakhaṇḍe balabhadrastavarājavarṇanaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||11|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<8.12> duryodhana uvāca gopībhyaḥ kavacaṃ dattaṃ gargācāryeṇa dhīmatā || sarvarakṣākaraṃ divyaṃ dehi mahyaṃ mahāmune ||1|| prāḍvipāka uvāca snātvā jale kṣaumadharaḥ kuśāsanaḥ pavitrapāṇiḥ kṛtamantramārjanaḥ || smṛtvātha natvā balamacyutāgrajaṃ saṃdhārayeddharmasamāhito bhavet ||2|| golokadhāmādhipatiḥ pareśvaraḥ pareṣu māṃ pātu pavitrakīrtanaḥ || bhūmaṇḍalaṃ sarṣapavadvilakṣyate yanmūrdhni māṃ pātu sa bhūmimaṇḍale ||3|| senāsu māṃ rakṣatu sīrapāṇiryuddhe sadā rakṣatu māṃ halī ca || durgeṣu cāvyānmusalī sadā māṃ vaneṣu saṃkarṣaṇa ādidevaḥ ||4|| kaliṃdajāvegaharo jaleṣu nīlāṃbaro rakṣatu māṃ sadāgnau || vāyau ca rāmo'vatu khe balaśca mahārṇave'nantavapuḥ sadā mām ||5|| śrīvāsudevo'vatu parvateṣu sahasraśīrṣā ca mahāvivāde || rogeṣu māṃ rakṣatu rauhiṇeyo māṃ kāmapālo'vatu vā vipatsu ||6|| kāmātsadā rakṣatu dhenukāriḥ krodhatsadā māṃ dvividaprahārī || lobhātsadā rakṣatu balvalārirmohātsadā māṃ kila māgadhāriḥ ||7|| prātaḥ sadā rakṣatu vṛṣṇidhuryaḥ prāhṇe sadā māṃ mathurāpurendraḥ || madhyandine gopasakhaḥ prapātu svarāṭ parāhṇe'vatu māṃ sadaiva ||8|| sāyaṃ phaṇīṃdro'vatu māṃ sadaiva parātparo rakṣatu māṃ pradoṣe || pūrṇe niśīthe ca durantavīryaḥ pratyūṣakāle'vatu māṃ sadaiva ||9|| vidikṣu māṃ rakṣatu revatīpatirdikṣu pralaṃbāriradho yadūdvahaḥ || ūrdhvaṃ sadā māṃ balabhadra ārāttathā samantādbaladeva eva hi ||10|| antaḥ sadāvyātpuruṣottamo bahirnāgendralīlo'vatu māṃ mahābalaḥ || sadāṃtarātmā ca vasan hariḥ svayaṃ prapātu pūrṇaḥ parameśvaro mahān ||11|| devāsurāṇāṃ bhayanāśanaṃ ca hutāśanaṃ pāpacayendhanānām || vināśanaṃ vighnaghaṭasya viddhi siddhāsanaṃ varmavaraṃ balasya ||12|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ balabhadrakhaṇḍe stotrakavacavarṇanaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||12|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<8.13> duryodhana uvāca balabhadrasya devasya prāḍvipāka mahāmune || nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ me brūhi guhyaṃ devagaṇairapi ||1|| prāḍvipāka uvāca sādhu sādhu mahārāja sādhu te vimalaṃ yaśaḥ || yatpṛcchase paramidaṃ gargoktaṃ devadurlabham ||2|| nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ divyānāṃ vakṣyāmi tava cāgrataḥ || gargācāryeṇa gopībhyo dattaṃ kṛṣṇātaṭe śubhe ||3|| oṃasya śrībalabhadrasahasranāmastrotramaṃtrasya gargācārya ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭup chandaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ paramātmā devatā balabhadra iti bījaṃ revatīti śaktiḥ anaṃta iti kīlakaṃ balabhadraprītyarthe jape viniyogaḥ || atha dhyānam sphuradamalakirīṭaṃ kiṃkiṇīkaṃkaṇārhaṃ caladalakakapolaṃ kuṃḍalaśrīmukhābjam || tuhinagirimanojñaṃ nīlameghāṃbarāḍhyaṃ halamusalaviśālaṃ kāmapālaṃ samīḍe ||4|| oṃ balabhadro rāmabhadro rāmaḥ saṃkarṣaṇo'cyutaḥ || revatīramaṇo devaḥ kāmapālo halāyudhaḥ ||5|| nīlāṃbaraḥ śvetavarṇo baladevo'cyutāgrajaḥ || pralaṃbaghno mahāvīro rauhiṇeyaḥ pratāpavān ||6|| tālāṃko musalī halī hariryaduvaro balī || sīrapāṇiḥ padmapāṇirlaguḍī veṇuvādanaḥ ||7|| kāliṃdibhedano vīro balaḥ prabala ūrdhvagaḥ || vāsudevakalānantaḥ sahasravadanaḥ svarāṭ ||8|| vasurvasumatībhartā vāsudevo vasūttamaḥ || yadūttamo yādavendro mādhavo vṛṣṇivallabhaḥ ||9|| dvārakeśo māthureśo dānī mānī mahāmanāḥ || pūrṇaḥ purāṇaḥ puruṣaḥ pareśaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||10|| paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣātparamaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || anantaḥ śāśvataḥ śeṣo bhagavānprakṛteḥ paraḥ ||11|| jīvātmā paramātmā ca hyaṃtarātmā dhruvo'vyayaḥ || caturvyūhaścaturvedaścaturmūrtiścatuṣpadaḥ ||12|| pradhānaṃ prakṛtiḥ sākṣī saṃghātaḥ saṃghavān sakhī || mahāmanā buddhisakhaśceto'haṃkāra āvṛtaḥ ||13|| indriyeśo devātātmā jñānaṃ karma ca śarma ca || advitīyo dvitīyaśca nirākāro nirañjanaḥ ||14|| virāṭ samrāṭ mahaughaśca dhāraḥ sthāsnuścariṣṇumān || phaṇīndraḥ phaṇirājaśca sahasraphaṇamaṇḍitaḥ ||15|| phaṇīśvaraḥ phaṇī sphūrtiḥ phūtkārī cītkaraḥ prabhuḥ || maṇihāro maṇidharo vitalī sutalī talī ||16|| atalī sutaleśaśca pātālaśca talātalaḥ || rasātalo bhogitalaḥ sphuraddanto mahātalaḥ ||17|| vāsukiḥ śaṃkhacūḍābho devadatto dhanaṃjayaḥ || kaṃbalāśvo vegataro dhṛtarāṣṭro mahābhujaḥ ||18|| vāruṇīmadamattāṅgo madaghūrṇitalocanaḥ || padmākṣaḥ padmamālī ca vanamālī madhuśravāḥ ||19|| koṭikaṃdarpalāvaṇyo nāgakanyāsamarcitaḥ || nūpurī kaṭisūtrī ca kaṭakī kanakāṃgadī ||20|| mukuṭī kuṇḍalī daṇḍī śikhaṇḍī khaṃḍamaṃḍalī || kaliḥ kalipriyaḥ kālo nivātakavaceśvaraḥ ||21|| saṃhārakadrurdravayuḥ kālāgniḥ pralayo layaḥ || mahāhiḥ pāṇiniḥ śāstrabhāṣyakāraḥ patañjaliḥ ||22|| kātyāyanaḥ pakvimābhaḥ sphoṭāyana uraṅgamaḥ || vaikuṃṭho yājñiko yajño vāmano hariṇo hariḥ ||23|| kṛṣṇo viṣṇurmahāviṣṇuḥ prabhaviṣṇurviśeṣavit || haṃso yogeśvaraḥ kūrmo vārāho nārado muniḥ ||24|| sanakaḥ kapilo matsyaḥ kamaṭho devamaṃgalaḥ || dattātreyaḥ pṛthurvṛddha ṛṣabho bhārgavottamaḥ ||25|| dhanvantarirnṛsiṃhaśca kalirnārāyaṇo naraḥ || rāmacandro rāghavendraḥ kośalendro raghūdvahaḥ ||26|| kākutsthaḥ karuṇāsiṃdhū rājendraḥ sarvalakṣaṇaḥ || śūro dāśarathistrātā kausalyānandavarddhanaḥ ||27|| saumitrirbharato dhanvī śatrughnaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ || niṣaṃgī kavacī khaḍgī śarī jyāhatakoṣṭhakaḥ ||28|| baddhagodhāṅgulitrāṇaḥ śaṃbhukodaṇḍabhaṃjanaḥ || yajñatrātā yajñabhartā mārīcavadhakārakaḥ ||29|| asurāristāṭakārirvibhīṣaṇasahāyakṛt || pitṛvākyakaro harṣī virādhārirvanecaraḥ ||30|| munirmunipriyaścitrakūṭāraṇyanivāsakṛt || kabaṃdhahā daṇḍakeśo rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ ||31|| mataṃgavanasaṃcārī netā paṃcavaṭīpatiḥ || sugrīvaḥ sugrīvasakho hanumatprītamānasaḥ ||32|| setubandho rāvaṇārirlaṃkādahanatatparaḥ || rāvaṇyariḥ puṣpakastho jānakīvirahāturaḥ ||33|| ayodhyādhipatiḥ śrīmām̐llavaṇāriḥ surārcitaḥ || sūryavaṃśī caṃdravaṃśī vaṃśīvādyaviśāradaḥ ||34|| gopatirgopavṛṃdeśo gopo gopīśatāvṛtaḥ || gokuleśo gopaputro gopālo gogaṇāśrayaḥ ||35|| pūtanārirbakāriśca tṛṇāvartanipātakaḥ || aghārirdhenukāriśca pralaṃbārirvrajeśvaraḥ ||36|| ariṣṭahā keśiśatrurvyomāsuravināśakṛt || agnipāno dugdhapāno vṛṃdāvanalatāśritaḥ ||37|| yaśomatīsuto bhavyo rohiṇīlālitaḥ śiśuḥ || rāsamaṃḍalamadhyastho rāsamaṃḍalamaṃḍanaḥ ||38|| gopikāśatayūthārthī śaṃkhacūḍavadhodyataḥ || govardhanasamuddhartā śakrajidvrajarakṣakaḥ ||39|| vṛṣabhānuvaro naṃda ānando nandavardhanaḥ || nandarājasutaḥ śrīśaḥ kaṃsāriḥ kāliyāṃtakaḥ ||40|| rajakārirmuṣṭikāriḥ kaṃsakodaṇḍabhaṃjanaḥ || cāṇūrāriḥ kūṭahaṃtā śalāristośalāṃtakaḥ ||41|| kaṃsabhrātṛnihantā ca mallayuddhapravartakaḥ || gajahantā kaṃsahantā kālahantā kalaṅkahā ||42|| māgadhāriryavanahā pāṃḍuputrasahāyakṛt || caturbhujaḥ śyāmalāṃgaḥ saumyaścaupagavipriyaḥ ||43|| yuddhabhṛduddhavasakhā mantrī mantraviśāradaḥ || vīrahā vīramathanaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ ||44|| revatīcittahartā ca revatīharṣavarddhanaḥ || revatīprāṇanāthaśca revatīpriyakārakaḥ ||45|| jyotirjyotiṣmatībhartā raivatādrivihārakṛt || dhṛtinātho dhanādhyakṣo dānādhyakṣo dhaneśvaraḥ ||46|| maithilārcitapādābjo mānado bhaktavatsalaḥ || duryodhanagururgurvīgadāśikṣākaraḥ kṣamī ||47|| murārirmadano mando'niruddho dhanvināṃ varaḥ || kalpavṛkṣaḥ kalpavṛkṣī kalpavṛkṣavanaprabhuḥ ||48|| syamantakamaṇirmānyo gāṃḍīvī kauraveśvaraḥ || kumbhāṇḍakhaṇḍanakaraḥ kūpakarṇaprahārakṛt ||49|| sevyo raivatajāmātā madhumādhavasevitaḥ || baliṣṭhapuṣṭasarvāṃgo hṛṣṭaḥ puṣṭaḥ praharṣitaḥ ||50|| vārāṇasīgataḥ kruddhaḥ sarvaḥ pauṃḍrakaghātakaḥ || sunandī śikharī śilpī dvividāṃganiṣūdanaḥ ||51|| hastināpurasaṃkarṣī rathī kauravapūjitaḥ || viśvakarmā viśvadharmā devaśarmā dayānidhiḥ ||52|| mahārājacchatradharo mahārājopalakṣaṇaḥ || siddhagītaḥ siddhakathaḥ śuklacāmaravījitaḥ ||53|| tārākṣaḥ kīranāsaśca bimboṣṭhaḥ susmitacchaviḥ || karīndrakaradordaṃḍaḥ pracaṃḍo meghamaṇḍalaḥ ||54|| kapāṭavakṣāḥ pīnāṃsaḥ padmapādasphuraddyutiḥ || mahavibhūtirbhūteśo baṃdhamokṣī samīkṣaṇaḥ ||55|| caidyaśatruḥ śatrusaṃdho daṃtavaktraniṣūdakaḥ || ajātaśatruḥ pāpaghno haridāsasahāyakṛt ||56|| śālabāhuḥ śālvahantā tīrthayāyī janeśvaraḥ || naimiṣāraṇyayātrārthī gomatītīravāsakṛt ||57|| gaṃḍakīsnānavānsragvī vaijayantīvirājitaḥ || amlānapaṃkajadharo vipāśī śoṇasaṃplutaḥ ||58|| prayāgatīrtharājaśca sarayūḥ setubandhanaḥ || gayāśiraśca dhanadaḥ paulastyaḥ pulahāśramaḥ ||59|| gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgārthī saptagodāvarīpatiḥ || veṇi bhīmarathī godā tāmraparṇī vaṭodakā ||60|| kṛtamālā mahāpuṇyā kāverī ca payasvinī || pratīcī suprabhā veṇī triveṇī sarayūpamā ||61|| kṛṣṇā paṃpā narmadā ca gaṃgā bhāgīrathī nadī || siddhāśramaḥ prabhāsaśca bindurbindusarovaraḥ ||62|| puṣkaraḥ saiṃdhavo jaṃbū naranārāyaṇāśramaḥ || kurukṣetrapatī rāmo jāmadagnyo mahāmuniḥ ||63|| ilvalātmajahantā ca sudāmāsaukhyadāyakaḥ || viśvajidviśvanāthaśca trilokavijayī jayī ||64|| vasantamālatīkarṣī gado gadyo gadāgrajaḥ || guṇārṇavo guṇanidhirguṇapātro guṇākaraḥ ||65|| raṃgavallījalākāro nirguṇaḥ saguṇo bṛhat || dṛṣṭaḥ śruto bhavadbhūto bhaviṣyaccālpavigrahaḥ ||66|| anādirādirānandaḥ pratyagdhāmā nirantaraḥ || guṇātītaḥ samaḥ sāmyaḥ samadṛṅ nirvikalpakaḥ ||67|| gūḍhāvyūḍho guṇo gauṇo guṇābhāso guṇāvṛtaḥ || nityo'kṣaro nirvikāro'kṣaro'jasrasukho'mṛtaḥ ||68|| sarvagaḥ sarvavitsārthaḥ samabuddhiḥ samaprabhaḥ || akledyo'cchedya āpūrṇo śoṣyo dāhyo nivartakaḥ ||69|| brahma brahmadharo brahmā jñāpako vyāpakaḥ kaviḥ || adhyātmako'dhibhūtaścādhidaivaḥ svāśrayāśrayaḥ ||70|| mahāvāyurmahāvīraśceṣṭārūpatanusthitaḥ || prerako bodhako bodhī trayoviṃśatiko gaṇaḥ ||71|| aṃśāṃśaśca narāveśo'vatāro bhūparisthitaḥ || maharjanastapaḥsatyaṃ bhūrbhuvaḥsvariti tridhā ||72|| naimittikaḥ prākṛtika ātyaṃtikamayo layaḥ || sargo visargaḥ sargādirnirodho rodha ūtimān ||73|| manvantarāvatāraśca manurmanusuto'naghaḥ || svayaṃbhūḥ śāṃbhavaḥ śaṃkuḥ svāyaṃbhuvasahāyakṛt ||74|| surālayo devagirirmerurhemārcito giriḥ || giriśo gaṇanāthaśca girīśo girigahvaraḥ ||75|| viṃdhyastrikūṭo mainākaḥ suvelaḥ pāribhadrakaḥ || pataṃgaḥ śiśiraḥ kaṃko jārudhiḥ śailasattamaḥ ||76|| kālaṃjaro bṛhatsānurdarībhṛnnaṃdikeśvaraḥ || saṃtānastarurājaśca mandāraḥ pārijātakaḥ ||77|| jayaṃtakṛjjayaṃtāṃgo jayantīdigjayākulaḥ || vṛtrahā devalokaśca śaśī kumudabāṃdhavaḥ ||78|| nakṣatreśaḥ sudhāsiṃdhurmṛgaḥ puṣyaḥ punarvasuḥ || hasto'bhijicca śravaṇo vaidhṛtirbhāskarodayaḥ ||79|| aindraḥ sādhyaḥ śubhaḥ śuklo vyatīpāto dhruvaḥ sitaḥ || śiśumāro devamayo brahmaloko vilakṣaṇaḥ ||80|| rāmo vaikuṇṭhanāthaśca vyāpī vaikuṇṭhanāyakaḥ || śvetadvīpo jitapado lokālokācalāśritaḥ ||81|| bhūmirvaikuṇṭhadevaśca koṭibrahmāṃḍakārakaḥ || asaṃkhyabrahmāṃḍapatirgolokeśo gavāṃ patiḥ ||82|| golokadhāmadhiṣaṇo gopikākaṃṭhabhūṣaṇaḥ || śrīdhāraḥ śrīdharo līlādharo giridharo dhurī ||83|| kuṃtadhārī triśūlī ca bībhatsī ghargharasvanaḥ || śūlasūcyarpitagajo gajacarmadharo gajī ||84|| aṃtramālī muṇḍamālī vyālī daṃḍakamaṇḍaluḥ || vetālabhṛdbhūtasaṃghaḥ kūṣmāṃḍagaṇasaṃvṛtaḥ ||85|| pramatheśaḥ paśupatirmṛḍānīśo mṛḍo vṛṣaḥ || kṛtāṃtakālasaṃghāriḥ kūṭaḥ kalpāṃtabhairavaḥ ||86|| ṣaḍānano vīrabhadro dakṣayajñavighātakaḥ || kharparāśī viṣāśī ca śaktihastaḥ śivārthadaḥ ||87|| pinākaṭaṃkārakaraścalajjhaṃkāranūpuraḥ || paṃḍitastarkavidvānvai vedapāṭhī śrutīśvaraḥ ||88|| vedāṃtakṛtsāṃkhyaśāstrī mīmāṃsī kaṇanāmabhāk || kāṇādirgautamo vādī vādo naiyāyiko nayaḥ ||89|| vaiśeṣiko dharmaśāstrī sarvaśāstrārthatattvagaḥ || vaiyākaraṇakṛcchaṃdo vaiyāsaḥ prākṛtirvacaḥ ||90|| pārāśarīsaṃhitāvitkāvyakṛnnāṭakapradaḥ || paurāṇikaḥ smṛtikaro vaidyo vidyāviśāradaḥ ||91|| alaṃkāro lakṣaṇārtho vyaṃgyaviddhanavaddhvaniḥ || vākyasphoṭaḥ padasphoṭaḥ sphoṭavṛttiśca sārthavit ||92|| śṛṅgāra ujjvalaḥ svaccho'dbhuto hāsyo bhayānakaḥ || aśvattho yavabhojī ca yavakrīto yavāśanaḥ ||93|| prahlādarakṣakaḥ snigdha ailavaṃśavivarddhanaḥ || gatādhiraṃbarīṣāṃgo vigādhirgādhināṃ varaḥ ||94|| nānāmaṇisamākīrṇo nānāratnavibhūṣaṇaḥ || nānāpuṣpadharaḥ puṣpī puṣpadhanvā prapuṣpitaḥ ||95|| nānācaṃdanagaṃdhāḍhyo nānāpuṣparasārcitaḥ || nānāvarṇamayo varṇo nānāvastradharaḥ sadā ||96|| nānāpadmakaraḥ kauśī nānākauśeyaveṣadhṛk || ratnakaṃbaladhārī ca dhautavastrasamāvṛtaḥ ||97|| uttarīyadharaḥ parṇo ghanakaṃcukasaṃghavān || pītoṣṇīṣaḥ sitoṣṇīṣo raktoṣṇīṣo digaṃbaraḥ ||98|| divyāṃgo divyaracano divyalokavilokitaḥ || sarvopamo nirupamo golokāṅgīkṛtāṅgaṇaḥ ||99|| kṛtasvotsaṃgago lokaḥ kuṇḍalībhūta āsthitaḥ || māthuro māthurādarśī calatkhaṃjanalocanaḥ ||100|| dadhihartā dugdhaharo navanītasitāśanaḥ || takrabhuk takrahārī ca dadhicauryakṛtaśramaḥ ||101|| prabhāvatībaddhakaro dāmī dāmodaro damī || sikatābhūmicārī ca bālakelirvrajārbhakaḥ ||102|| dhūlidhūsarasarvāṃgaḥ kākapakṣadharaḥ sudhīḥ || muktakeśo vatsavṛṃdaḥ kāliṃdīkūlavīkṣaṇaḥ ||103|| jalakolāhalī kūlī paṅkaprāṃgaṇalepakaḥ || śrīvṛṃdāvanasaṃcārī vaṃśīvaṭataṭasthitaḥ ||104|| mahāvananivāsī ca lohārgalavanādhipaḥ || sādhuḥ priyatamaḥ sādhyaḥ sādhvīśo gatasādhvasaḥ ||105|| raṃganātho viṭhṭhaleśo muktinātho'ghanāśakaḥ || sukirtiḥ suyaśāḥ sphīto yaśasvī raṃgaraṃjanaḥ ||106|| rāgaṣaṭko rāgaputro rāgiṇīramaṇotsukaḥ || dīpako meghamalhāraḥ śrīrāgo mālakośakaḥ ||107|| hindolo bhairavākhyaśca svarajātismaro mṛduḥ || tālo mānapramāṇaśca svaragamyaḥ kalākṣaraḥ ||108|| śamī śyāmī śatānandaḥ śatayāmaḥ śatakratuḥ || jāgaraḥ supta āsuptaḥ suṣuptaḥ svapna urvaraḥ ||109|| urjaḥ sphūrjo nirjaraśca vijvaro jvaravarjitaḥ || jvarajijjvarakartā ca jvarayuk trijvaro jvaraḥ ||110|| jāṃbavān jaṃbukāśaṃkī jaṃbūdvīpo dvipārihā || śālmaliḥ śālmalidvīpaḥ plakṣaḥ plakṣavaneśvaraḥ ||111|| kuśadhārī kuśaḥ kauśī kauśikaḥ kuśavigrahaḥ || kuśasthalīpatiḥ kāśīnātho bhairavaśāsanaḥ ||112|| dāśārhaḥ sātvato vṛṣṇirbhojo'dhakanivāsakṛt || aṃdhako dundubhirdyotaḥ pradyotaḥ sātvatāṃ patiḥ ||113|| śūraseno'nuviṣayo bhojavṛṣṇyaṃdhakeśvaraḥ || āhukaḥ sarvanītijña ugraseno mahogravāk ||114|| ugrasenapriyaḥ prārthyaḥ pārtho yadusabhāpatiḥ || sudharmādhipatiḥ sattvaṃ vṛṣṇicakrāvṛto bhiṣak ||115|| sabhāśīlaḥ sabhādīpaḥ sabhāgniśca sabhāraviḥ || sabhācaṃdraḥ sabhābhāsaḥ sabhādevaḥ sabhāpatiḥ ||116|| prajārthadaḥ prajābhartā prajāpālanatatparaḥ || dvārakādurgasaṃcārī dvārakāgrahavigrahaḥ ||117|| dvārakāduḥkhasaṃhartā dvārakājanamaṃgalaḥ || jaganmātā jagattrātā jagadbhartā jagatpitā ||118|| jagadbaṃdhurjagadbhrātā jaganmitro jagatsakhaḥ || brahmaṇyadevo brahmaṇyo brahmapādarajo dadhat ||119|| brahmapādarajaḥsparśī brahmapādaniṣevakaḥ || viprāṃghrijalapūtāṃgo viprasevāparāyaṇaḥ ||120|| vipramukhyo viprahito vipragītamahākathaḥ || viprapādajalārdrāṅgo viprapādodakapriyaḥ ||121|| viprabhakto vipragururvipro viprapadānugaḥ || akṣauhiṇīvṛto yoddhā pratimāpaṃcasaṃyutaḥ ||122|| caturoṃ'girāḥ padmavartī sāmaṃtoddhṛtapādukaḥ || gajakoṭiprayāyī ca rathakoṭijayadhvajaḥ ||123|| mahārathaścātiratho jaitraṃ syaṃdanamāsthitaḥ || nārāyaṇāstrī brahmāstrī raṇaślāghī raṇodbhaṭaḥ ||124|| madotkaṭo yuddhavīro devāsurabhayaṃkaraḥ || karikarṇamarutprejatkuṃtalavyāptakuṃḍalaḥ ||125|| agrago vīrasaṃmardo mardalo raṇadurmadaḥ || bhaṭaḥ pratibhaṭaḥ procyo bāṇavarṣī sutoyadaḥ ||126|| khaḍgakhaṃḍitasarvāṃgaḥ ṣoḍaśābdaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ || vīraghoṣaḥ kliṣṭavapurvajrāṃgo vajrabhedanaḥ ||127|| rugṇavajro bhagnadaṃḍaḥ śatrunirbhatsanodyataḥ || aṭṭahāsaḥ paṭṭadharaḥ paṭṭarājñīpatiḥ paṭuḥ ||128|| kalaḥ paṭahavāditro huṃkāro garjitasvanaḥ || sādhurbhaktaparādhīnaḥ svataṃtraḥ sādhubhūṣaṇaḥ ||129|| asvataṃtraḥ sādhumayaḥ sādhugrastamanā manāk || sādhupriyaḥ sādhudhanaḥ sādhujñātiḥ sudhāghanaḥ ||130|| sādhucārī sādhucittaḥ sādhuvāsī śubhāspadaḥ || iti nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ tu balabhadrasya kīrtitam || 131|| sarvasiddhipradaṃ nṝṇāṃ caturvargaphalapradam || śatavāraṃ paṭhedyastu sa vidyāvān bhavediha ||132|| indirāṃ ca vibhūtiṃ cābhijanaṃ rūpameva ca || balamojaśca paṭhanātsarvaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ ||133|| gaṃgākūle'tha kāliṃdikūle devālaye tathā || sahasrāvartapāṭhena balātsiddhiḥ prajāyate ||134|| putrārthī labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam || baṃdhātpramucyate baddho rogī rogānnivartate ||135|| ayutāvartapāṭhe ca puraścaryāvidhānataḥ || homatarpaṇagodānaviprārcanakṛtodyamāt ||136|| paṭalaṃ paddhatiṃ stotraṃ kavacaṃ tu vidhāya ca || mahāmaṃḍalabhartā syānmaṃḍito maṃḍaleśvaraiḥ ||137|| mattebhakarṇaprahitā madagaṃdhena vihvalā || alaṃkaroti taddvārāṃ bhramadbhṛṃgāvalī bhṛśam ||138|| niṣkāraṇaḥ paṭhedyastu prītyarthaṃ revatīpateḥ || nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ rājeṃdra sa jīvanmukta ucyate ||139|| sadā vasettasya gṛhe balabhadro'cyutāgrajaḥ || mahāpātakyapi janaḥ paṭhennāmasahasrakam ||140|| chittvā merusamaṃ pāpaṃ bhuktvā sarvasukhaṃ tviha || parātparaṃ mahārāja golokaṃ dhāma yāti hi ||141|| śrīnārada uvāca iti śrutvā'cyutāgrajasya baladevasya paṃcāṃgaṃ dhṛtimān dhārtarāṣṭraḥ saparyayā sahitayā parayā bhaktyā prāḍvipākaṃ pūjayāmāsa || tamanujñāpyāśiṣaṃ datvā prāḍvipāko munīṃdro gajāhvayātsvāśramaṃ jagāma ||142|| bhagavato'naṃtasya balabhadrasya parabrahmaṇaḥ kathāṃ yaḥ śṛṇute śrāvayate tayā''naṃdamayo bhavati ||143|| idaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ nṛpendra sarvārthadaṃ śrībalabhadrakhaṃḍam || śṛṇoti yo dhāma hareḥ sa yāti viśokamānaṃdamakhaṃḍarūpam ||144|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ balabhadrakhaṇḍe prāḍvipākaduryodhanasaṃvāde balabhadrasahasranāmavarṇanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||13|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<9.1> bahulāśva uvāca hareḥ śrīkṛṣṇacaṃdrasya bhaktimārgastu yaḥ paraḥ || taṃ vadāśu mune mahyaṃ yena bhakto bhavāmyaham ||1|| śrīnārada uvāca bhaktimārgaṃ vadiṣyāmi vedavyāsamukhācchrutam || yena prasanno bhavati bhagavān bhaktavatsalaḥ ||2|| śaṅkhaṃ vijitya kṛṣṇena bhujadaṃḍabaloddhṛtam || dvārāvatyāṃ sabhā divyā sudharmā nāma maithila ||3|| yatra maṃḍapadeśasya vaidūryastaṃbhapaṃktayaḥ || rājaṃte koṭiśo rājan viśvakarmavinirmitāḥ ||4|| padmarāgakhacidbhūmau śreṇyo vai vidrumācitāḥ || yatra citravitānāni bhrājante mauktikālibhiḥ ||5|| siṃhāsanāni kuḍyāni kālameghataḍiddyubhiḥ || jāṃbūnadasuvarṇānāṃ sphuratkuṇḍalakoṭibhiḥ ||6|| bālārkaratnakeyurakāṃcīkaṃkaṇanūpuraiḥ || śatacaṃdrapratīkāśāḥ sphuratkuṇḍalamaṇḍitāḥ ||7|| gāyaṃti yatra gaṃdharvyo vidyādharyo mudānvitāḥ || nṛtyaṃtyaḥ kalavāditraiḥ sparddhāvatyaḥ parasparam ||8|| yasyāścaturṣu koṇeṣu devavṛkṣairmanoramaiḥ || naṃdanaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ dhrauvyaṃ caitrarathaṃ vanam ||9|| lakṣāṇi yatra rājendra sarāṃsi vimalāni ca || sahasradalapadmāni bhramaraiḥ saṃkulāni ca ||10|| daśayojanavistīrṇā paṃcayojanamūrdhvagā || etādṛśī sudharmā''ste patākādhvajamaṃḍitā ||11|| yatra praviṣṭaḥ puruṣa ātmānaṃ manyate param || yatsiṃhāsanamāsādya śakro'hamiti manyate ||12|| yadyattrailokyacāturyaṃ tasya dehe pravartate || yāvattiṣṭhettatra tāvadūrmiṣaṭkaṃ na caiva hi ||13|| yāvaṃtaśca janāstatra praviśanti narottama || svaprabhāveṇa sahasā tāvatī sā prakāśate ||14|| ṣaṭpaṃcāśatkoṭisaṃkhyā yādavā yatra sānugāḥ || taccatvarasyaikadeśe dṛśyaṃte te ca maithila ||15|| paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānsvayam || yatrāste tasya rājeṃdra varṇanaṃ kaḥ karoti hi ||16|| atha tasyāṃ sudharmāyāṃ yadukoṭisamāvṛtaḥ || ugraseno gīyamānaḥ sūtamāgadhavandibhiḥ ||17|| ākāśādāgataḥ sākṣādvedavyāso mahāmuniḥ || pārāśaryo ghanaśyāmastaḍitpiṃgajaṭādharaḥ ||18|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya yadurājaḥ kṛtāṃjaliḥ || natvā''sanaṃ sopacāraṃ datvā tatsaṃmukho'bhavat ||19|| ugrasena uvāca adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ gehamadya me || adya me saphalo dharmo brahmaṃstvayyāgate sati ||20|| sadānaṃdeṣu kuśalaṃ kṛṣṇeneṣṭaṃ bhavatsu hi || vada me kuśalaṃ deva yena svastho bhavāmyaham ||21|| yatra yatra vrajaṃtaste tvādṛśāḥ sādhavaḥ prabho || tatra tatra bhavetsiddhirlaukikī pāralaukikī ||22|| yatra kṣaṇaṃ sthitāḥ saṃtastatra sākṣātsvayaṃ hariḥ || kimu lokaguṇā brahmānpārāśarya mahāmune ||23|| mayā tu puṇyaṃ yajño vā kiṃ kṛtaṃ pūrvajanmani || yena vai dvārakārājyaṃ prāpto'haṃ munipuṅgava ||24|| bhavādṛśā vipramukhyā gṛhamāyāṃti nityaśaḥ || tasmātparaṃ hi sukṛtaṃ jāne svasya na saṃśayaḥ ||25|| vyāsa uvāca dhanyo'si rājaśārdūla dhanyā te vimalā matiḥ || paraṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā rājansukṛtaṃ pūrvajanmani ||26|| purā tvaṃ maruto rājan kṛtvā yajñaṃ jagajjitam || niṣkāraṇo'bhūrmanasā prasanno'bhūddharistadā ||27|| animittena bhāvena prāptaṃ cedaṃ paraṃ tava || paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo bhagavānhariḥ ||28|| asaṃkhyabrahmāṃḍapatirgolokeśaḥ parātparaḥ || so'yaṃ bhaktyā vaśībhūtaḥ svavaśastava maṃdire ||29|| aho bhojapate muktiṃ dadāti bhajatāṃ hariḥ || na karhicidbhaktiyogaṃ durlabhaṃ viddhi taṃ nṛpa ||30|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vijñānakhaṃḍe śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvāde vyāsāgamanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||1||
<9.2> ugrasena uvāca dhanyo'smyanugṛhīto'smi tava varṇananirvṛtaḥ || hṛdudbhūtaṃ ca saṃdehaṃ dūrīkartuṃ bhavān kṣamaḥ ||1|| karmaṇāṃ sanimittānāṃ kā gatiḥ kiṃ ca lakṣaṇam || kati bhedā hi teṣāṃ vai vada brahman yathā tathā ||2|| vyāsa uvāca guṇaiḥ sarvāṇi karmāṇi sanimittāni saṃti hi || tānyeva cānimittāni rājan tyaktaphalāni hi ||3|| sanimittaṃ ca yatkarma baṃdhanaṃ viddhi yādava || animittaṃ ca yatkarma mokṣadaṃ paramaṃ śubham ||4|| satvaṃ rajastama iti guṇāḥ prakṛtisaṃbhavāḥ || tairvyāptaṃ hi jagatsarvaṃ sarvārthamiva viṣṇunā ||5|| satve pralīnāḥ svaryāṃti naralokaṃ rajolayāḥ || tamolayāstu narakaṃ yāṃti kṛṣṇaṃ hi nirguṇāḥ ||6|| paṃcāgnitaptā atapan ye rājan vrajavāsinaḥ || lokaṃ saptaṛṣīṇāṃ tu te yāṃti gatakalmaṣāḥ ||7|| saṃnyāsāśramakartārastridaṃḍadhṛtapāṇayaḥ || jitendriyamanodharmāḥ satyalokaṃ vrajaṃti hi ||8|| aṣṭāṃgayogayogīṃdrā nirmalā urdhvaretasaḥ || janalokaṃ maharlokaṃ yāṃti te nātra saṃśayaḥ ||9|| yajñakartā śakraloke vasate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ || dānī cāṃdramasaṃ lokaṃ vratī sauraṃ vrajatyalam ||10|| tīrthayāyī cāgnilokaṃ satyasaṃdhaśca vāruṇam || vaiṣṇavāścāpi vaikuṇṭhaṃ śaivāḥ śaivaṃ vrajaṃti hi ||11|| pitṝn yajaṃti ye nityaṃ sukhaiśvaryaprajepsavaḥ || dakṣiṇena pathā''ryyamṇā pitṛlokaṃ vrajaṃti te ||12|| svarlokaṃ vai tathā smārtāḥ paṃcapūjanasaṃyutāḥ || prajāpatiyajo yāṃti dakṣādīṃśca prajāpatīn ||13|| bhūtāni yāṃti bhūtejyā yakṣān yakṣayajastathā || ye yasya bhaktāstallokānyāṃti rājanna saṃśayaḥ ||14|| tathā pāparatā rājanduḥsaṃgavaśavartinaḥ || yamalokaṃ ca te yāṃti nirayairdāruṇairvṛtam ||15|| punarāvartino lokāḥ sarve cābrahmalokataḥ || punarāvartino lokān viddhi rājan mahāmate ||16|| karmaṇāṃ sanimittānāṃ mārgameṣa gatāgataḥ || tāvatpramodate svarge yāvatpuṇyaṃ samāpyate ||17|| kṣīṇapuṇyaḥ patatyarvāganicchankālacālitaḥ || yādavendra mahābāho tasmātkarmaphalaṃ tyajet ||18|| bhakto niṣkāraṇo bhūtvā jñānavairāgyasaṃyutaḥ || premalakṣaṇayā vācā haribhaktajanapriyaḥ ||19|| bhajecchrīkṛṣṇapādābjamabhayaṃ haṃsasevitam || yoḥ mṛtyuḥ sarvalokānāṃ balātsaṃhārakārakaḥ ||20|| sa yatra bhagavaddhāmni gataḥ sanmṛtyumāpnuyāt ||21|| ugrasena uvāca sarve lokā hi bhagavanpunarāvartinaḥ smṛtāḥ || tebhyo jātaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ manaso me na saṃśayaḥ ||22|| śrīkṛṣṇadhāma paramaṃ yato nāvartate gataḥ || tallokaṃ vada me brahman kva cāste sarvataḥ param ||23|| śrīvyāsa uvāca brahmāṃḍebhyo bahirddhāma śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ || yadgatā na nivartaṃte tadgolokaṃ viduḥ param ||24|| brahmāṃḍo'yaṃ jīvasaṃghaḥ pañcāśatkoṭiyojanaiḥ || vistṛtaḥ parato dvābhyāṃ śatakoṭivilaṃghitaḥ ||25|| yadaṃtaragato rājan lakṣyate paramāṇuvat || tadaṃtaragatāścānye koṭiśo hyaṃḍarāśayaḥ ||26|| na tadbhāsayate sūryo na śaśāṃko na pāvakaḥ || kāmakrodhaśca lobhaśca na moho yatra yāti ca ||27|| na yatra śoko na jarā na mṛtyurnārtireva ca || na pradhānaṃ na kālaśca viśaṃte ca guṇāḥ kutaḥ ||28|| śabdabrahmāpyanirvācyaṃ tadvarṇayitumakṣamaḥ || śrīkṛṣṇatejaḥsaṃbhūtāstatra saṃti ca pārṣadāḥ ||29|| akiṃcanāśca ye dāṃtāḥ śāṃtā vai samacetasaḥ || śrīkṛṣṇacaṃdrapādābjāmakaraṃdarasālayāḥ ||30|| premalakṣaṇayā bhaktyā sadā niṣkāraṇāḥ parāḥ || lokānullaṃghya taddhāma yāṃti rajanna saṃśayaḥ ||31|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vijñānakhaṃḍe śrīvyāsograsenasaṃvāde lokagatinirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||2||
<9.3> ugrasena uvāca śrutaṃ tava mukhādbrahman guṇakarmagatirmayā || punarāvartino lokāstathā saṃti viniścatāḥ ||1|| niṣkāraṇāddhareḥ sākṣātsevanāddhāma uttamam || labhate durlabhaṃ divyaṃ bhaktānāṃ tacchrutaṃ mayā ||2|| bhaktiyogaḥ katividho vada me vadatāṃ vara || yena prasanno bhavati bhagavān bhaktavatsalaḥ ||3|| śrīvyāsa uvāca dvārāvatīśa dhanyo'si śrīkṛṣṇeṣṭo haripriyaḥ || pṛcchase bhaktiyogaṃ tvaṃ dhanyā te vimalā matiḥ ||4|| yaṃ śrutvā nirmalo bhūyādviśvaghātyapi pātakī || taṃ bhaktiyogaṃ viśadaṃ tubhyaṃ vakṣyāmi yādava ||5|| bhaktiyogo dvidhā rājan saguṇaścaiva nirguṇaḥ || saguṇaḥ syādbahuvidho nirguṇaścaikalakṣaṇaḥ ||6|| saguṇaḥ syādbahuvidho guṇamārgeṇa dehinām || tairguṇaistrividhā bhaktā bhavanti śṛṇu tānpṛthak ||7|| hiṃsā daṃbhaṃ ca mātsaryyaṃ cābhisaṃdhāya bhinnadṛk || kuryādbhāvaṃ harau krodhī tāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||8|| yaśa aiśvaryaviṣayānabhisaṃdhāya yatnataḥ || arcayedyo hariṃ rājan rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||9|| uddīśya karmanirhāramapṛthagbhāva eva hi || mokṣārthaṃ bhajate viṣṇuṃ sa bhaktaḥ sātvikaḥ smṛtaḥ ||10|| jijñāsurārto jñānī ca tathā'rthārthī mahāmate || caturvidhā janā viṣṇuṃ bhajaṃte kṛtamaṃgalāḥ ||11|| evaṃ bahuvidhenāpi bhaktiyogena mādhavam || bhajaṃti sanimittāste janāḥ sukṛtinaḥ pare ||12|| lakṣaṇaṃ bhaktiyogasya nirguṇasya tathā śṛṇu || tadguṇaśrutimātreṇa śrīkṛṣṇe puruṣottame ||13|| paripūrṇatame sākṣātsarvakāraṇakāraṇe || manogatiravicchinnā khaṃḍitā'haitukī ca yā ||14|| yathābdhāvaṃbhasā gaṃgā sā bhaktirnirguṇā smṛtā || nirguṇānāṃ ca bhaktānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu mānada ||15|| sārvabhaumaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ śakradhiṣṇyaṃ tathaiva ca || rasādhipatyaṃ yogarddhiṃ na vāñchanti harerjanāḥ ||16|| hariṇā dīyamānaṃ vā sālokyaṃ yādaveśvara || na gṛhṇaṃti kadācitte satsaṃgānaṃdanirvṛtāḥ ||17|| sāmīpyaṃ te na vāṃchaṃti bhagavadvirahāturāḥ || saṃnikṛṣṭe na tatprema yathā dūratare bhavet ||18|| sārupyaṃ dīyamānaṃ vā samānatvābhimāninaḥ || nairapekṣyānna vāṃchaṃti bhaktāstatsevanotsukāḥ ||19|| ekatvaṃ cāpi kaivalyaṃ na vāṃchaṃti kadācana || evaṃ cettarhi dāsatvaṃ kva svāmitvaṃ parasya ca ||20|| nirapekṣāśca ye śāṃtā nirvairāḥ samadarśinaḥ || ākaivalyāllokapadagrahaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ viduḥ ||21|| nairapekṣyaṃ mahānaṃdaṃ nirapekṣā janāḥ hareḥ || jānaṃti hi yathā nāsā puṣpāmodaṃ na cakṣuṣī ||22|| sakāmāśca tadānaṃdaṃ jānaṃti hi kathaṃcana || rasakartā tathā hasto rasasvādaṃ na vetti hi ||23|| tasmādrājanbhaktiyogaṃ viddhi cātyaṃtikaṃ padam || bhaktānāṃ nirapekṣāṇāṃ paddhatiṃ kathayāmi te ||24|| smaraṇaṃ kirtanaṃ viṣṇoḥ śravaṇaṃ pādasevanam || arcanaṃ vaṃdanaṃ dāsyaṃ sakhyamātmanivedanam ||25|| kurvaṃti satataṃ rājan bhaktiṃ ye premalakṣaṇām || te bhaktā durlabhā bhūmau bhagavadbhāvabhāvanāḥ ||26|| kurvanto mahatopekṣāṃ dayāṃ hīneṣu sarvataḥ || samāneṣu tathā maitrīṃ sarvabhūtadayāparāḥ ||27|| kṛṣṇapādābjamadhupāḥ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ || kṛṣṇaṃ smaraṃti prāṇeśaṃ yathā proṣitabhartṛkāḥ ||28|| śrīkṛṣṇasmaraṇādyeṣāṃ romaharṣaḥ prajāyate || ānaṃdāśrukalāścaiva vaivarṇyaṃ tu kvacidbhavet ||29|| śrīkṛṣṇa goviṃda hare bruvantaḥ ślakṣṇayā girā || aharniśaṃ harau lagnāste hi bhāgavatottamāḥ ||30|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vijñānakhaṃḍe śrīvyāsograsenasaṃvāde nirguṇabhaktiyogavarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||3||
<9.4> śrīvyāsa uvāca khe vāyau salile vahnau mahyāṃ jyotirgaṇeṣu ca || śrīkṛṣṇadevaṃ paśyaṃto harṣitāśca punaḥ punaḥ ||1|| śrīkṛṣṇo rādhikānāthaḥ koṭikaṃdarpamohanaḥ || tannetragocaro yāti bruvañchrīnaṃdanaṃdanaḥ ||2|| sadānaṃdaṃ ca te dṛṣṭvā prahasaṃti praharṣitāḥ || kvacidvadaṃti dhāvaṃti naṃdaṃti ca kvacittathā ||3|| kvacidgāyaṃti nṛtyaṃti kvacittūṣṇīṃ bhavanti ca || kṛṣṇacaṃdrasvarūpāste kṛtārthā vaiṣṇavottamāḥ ||4|| teṣāṃ darśanamātreṇa naro yāti kṛtārthatām || na kālo na yamasteṣāṃ daṃḍaṃ dātuṃ na ca kṣamaḥ ||5|| gadā kaumodakī vāme dakṣīṇe ca sudarśanam || agre śārṅgadhanuḥ paścātpāṃcajanyo ghanasvanaḥ ||6|| naṃdakaśca mahākhaḍgaḥ śatacandreṣavaḥ śitāḥ || etānyāyudhamukhyāni tāṃśca rakṣaṃtyaharniśam ||7|| tathopari mahāpadmaṃ chāyāṃ kartuṃ punaḥ punaḥ || garuḍaḥ pakṣavātena śramahartā satāmapi ||8|| yatra yatra gatāḥ saṃtastatra tatra svayaṃ hariḥ || tīrthīkurvan bhūmibhāgaṃ śrīmatpādābjareṇubhiḥ ||9|| kṣaṇaṃ yatra sthitāḥ saṃtastatra tīrthāni saṃti hi || tatra ko'pi mṛtaḥ pāpī yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||10|| dūrātsaṃprekṣya kṛṣṇeṣṭā nādhayo vyādhayastathā || bhūtapretapiśācāśca palāyaṃte diśo daśa ||11|| nadyo nadāḥ parvatāśca samudrāśca tathāpare || mārgaṃ daduśca sādhubhyo'napekṣebhyaḥ samaṃtataḥ ||12|| sādhūnāṃ jñānaniṣṭhānāṃ viraktānāṃ mahātmanām || ajātaśatrūṇāṃ teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ puṇyavarjitaiḥ ||13|| yasminkule kṛṣṇabhakto jāyate brahmalakṣaṇam || tatkulaṃ vimalaṃ viddhi malīmasamapi svataḥ ||14|| rājan śrīkṛṣṇabhaktastu pitṝndaśa kulodbhavān || priyāpakṣe'pi daśa ca mātṛpakṣe tathā daśa ||15|| puruṣānuddharedrājannirayātpāpabaṃdhanāt || sādhusaṃbaṃdhinaścānye bhṛtyā dāsāḥ suhṛjjanāḥ ||16|| śatravo bhāravāhaśca tadgṛhe pakṣiṇastathā || pipīlikāśca maśakāstathā kīṭapataṅgakāḥ ||17|| abrahmaṇye'kṛṣṇasāre sauvīre kīkaṭe tathā || mlecchadeśe'pi deveśa bhakto lokānpunāti hi ||18|| sāṃkhyayogaṃ vinā rājaṃstīrthadharmamakhairvinā || sādhusaṃsarginaste'pi prayāṃti harimandire ||19|| itthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇabhaktānāṃ māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ mayā || catuḥpadārthadaṃ nṝṇāṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ||20|| ugrasena uvāca paripūrṇatame sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇe paramātmani || dantavaktrasya duṣṭasya jyotirlīnaṃ babhūva ha ||21|| aho mahadidaṃ citraṃ sāyūjyaṃ mahatāmapi || yogyaṃ syādvipramukhyeṃdra kathaṃ cānyena śatruṇā ||22|| śrīvyāsa uvāca mamāhamiti vaiṣamyaṃ bhūtānāṃ triguṇātmanām || krodhādyairvartate rājanna harau paramātmani ||23|| harau kenāpi bhāvena mano lagnaṃ karoti yaḥ || yāti tadrūpatāṃ so'pi bhṛṃgiṇaḥ kīṭako yathā ||24|| snehaṃ kāmaṃ bhayaṃ krodhamaikyaṃ sauhṛdameva ca || kṛtvā tanmayatāṃ yāṃti sāṃkhyayogaṃ vinā janāḥ ||25|| snehānnaṃdayaśodādyā vasudevādayo'pare || kālādgopyo hariṃ prāptā na tu brahmatayā nṛpa ||26|| tadrūpaguṇamādhuryabhāvasaṃlagnamānasāḥ || bhayātkaṃsastava sutastatsāyūjyaṃ jagāma ha ||27|| krodhādayaṃ daṃtavaktraḥ śiśupālādayo'pare || aikyācca yādavā yūyaṃ sauhṛdācca vayaṃ tathā ||28|| tasmātkenāpyupāyena manaḥ kṛṣṇe niveśayet || aharniśaṃ hi smaraṇaṃ bhavecchatrorna karhicit ||29|| śatrubhāvaṃ harau tasmātkurvaṃti danujādayaḥ ||30|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vijñānakhaṃḍe śrīvyāsograsenasaṃvāde bhaktimāhātmyaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||4||
<9.5> śrīvedavyāsa uvāca vatsāghadhenukabakībakakeśikālāriṣṭapralaṃbakapibalvalaśaṅkhaśālvāḥ || vaireṇa yaṃ kimuta bhaktiyutā narendra prāpuḥ paraṃ prakṛtipūruṣayoḥ pumāṃsam ||1|| pūrvāsurāvatibalau madhukaiṭabhākhyau svarṇākṣahemakaśipū ca tathāparau ca || vairaṃ vidhāya nṛpa rāvaṇakuṃbhakarṇau viṣṇoḥ kilāpaturalaṃ paramaṃ padaṃ hi ||2|| ke ke na viṣṇūpadamāgatavaṃta ādau prahlādabāṇabaliyakṣavibhīṣaṇādyāḥ || satsaṃgasaṃganiratā bahumānapātraśrīmatpadābjamakaraṃdarajovilubdhāḥ ||3|| devarṣigīṣpativasiṣṭhaparāśarādyāḥ sāṃkhyāyanāsitaśukāḥ sanakādayaśca || niṣkāraṇā bhuvi caraṃtyaraviṃdanetrapādāraviṃdamakaraṃdamilindamukhyāḥ ||4|| yatyutkālāṃgabharatārjunamaithilāśca gādhipriyavratayadupramukhāṃbarīṣā || niṣkāraṇāḥ paramahaṃsavarāścāranti śrīkṛṣṇacandracaritāmṛtapānamattāḥ ||5|| maṃdodarī ca śabarī ca mataṃgaśiṣyāstārā tathātrivanitā nipuṇā tvahalyā || kuntī tathā drupadarājasutā subhaktā etāḥ paraṃ paramahaṃsasamāḥ prasiddhāḥ ||6|| sugrīvavālisutavātasutarkṣarājanāgārigṛdhravarakākabhuśuṇḍimukhyāḥ || kubjādivāyakasudāmaguhādāyo'nye tatsaṃgametya haribhaktavarā babhūvuḥ ||7|| kṛṣṇaṃ na rodhayati dharma tapo na yogaḥ sāṃkhyaṃ na yajña uta tīrthayamavratāni || chandāṃsi pūrtaniyamāvatha dakṣiṇā ca neṣṭaṃ na dānamatha bhaktimṛte na kaścit ||8|| yajñavratādhyayanatīrthataponiyogairiṣṭasvadharmaniyamādikasāṃkhyayogaiḥ || yatprāpyate tadakhilaṃ bhavatīha bhaktyā bhakteḥpadaṃ hi karhicinna bhavetkilaibhiḥ ||9|| uddhāriṇī yamapurasya ca viśvarūpāduttāriṇī bhavamahārṇavavārivegāt || saṃhāriṇī viṣayasaṃcitakarmaṇā ca satkāriṇī haripadasya parātparasya ||10|| śrīkṛṣṇadarśanarasotsukabhāvarājadudyadvasaṃtaparamotsavapaṃcamīyam || divyā latātiphalapallavabhāranamrā saṃrājate hi satataṃ kusumākarasya ||11|| saṃmohakālaghanamadhyataḍitsphurantī śāstrārthadarśavacasāṃ padadīpikeyam || dīpāvalirvijayate jayakārtikasya jetuṃ guṇān vijayino daśamī jayasya ||12|| sāṃkhyaṃ ca yoga iti pārśvagate hi daṃḍe kīlāni cātra śataśo guṇabhāvabhedāḥ || asyā kramānnavakathāśravaṇādayaśca śreṇīyamasti saralā bhagavatpadasya ||13|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vijñānakhaṃḍe śrīvyāsograsenasaṃvāde bhaktyutkarṣavarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||5||
<9.6> ugrasena uvāca karmagraho gṛhastho'yaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ || sevāṃ vai kena vidhinā kuryāttadbrūhi me mune ||1|| bhaktyaṃkuro yasya nāsti vāsti tasya na varddhate || tasya kena prakāreṇa prasannaḥ syāddhariḥ svayam ||2|| śrīvyāsa uvāca yadi bhaktyaṃkuro na syātsatsaṃgena sa jāyate || balādvivarddhate tasmātsatāṃ saṃgaṃ samācaret ||3|| kṛṣṇasevāvidhiṃ tubhyaṃ vakṣyāmi sulabhaṃ param || yayā gṛhastho'yaṃ śīghraṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prāpnuyānnṛpa ||4|| ācāryyaṃ kulasaṃbhūtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadhyānatatparam || etādṛśaṃ guruṃ kṛtvā siddho bhavati mānavaḥ ||5|| guroḥ sevāvidhiṃ śikṣecchrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ ||6|| viṣṇudīkṣāvihīnasya sarvaṃ bhavati niṣphalam || nirgurordarśanaṃ kṛttvā hatapuṇyo bhavennaraḥ ||7|| uttarābhimukhaṃ śaśvatkārayeddharimaṃdiram || tatra siṃhāsanaṃ procyaṃ sapīṭhaṃ kuṃbhamaṇḍitam ||8|| saccidānanda nāma syātsopānatrayabhūṣitam || mahārhavastrairācchannaṃ tatra tulyāsanaṃ mṛdu ||9|| pārśvopabarhaṇayutaṃ sphuraddhemāṃbarāvṛtam || nānācitrayutaiḥ kuḍyairantaḥpaṭasamanvitaiḥ ||10|| sarvatomaṃḍalaistadvattoraṇaiḥ samalaṃkṛtam || gavākṣavāriyantrāḍhyaṃ catuḥśālasujālakaiḥ ||11|| rājataprāṅgaṇo deśaḥ sabhāmaṇḍapamaṇḍitaḥ || tatra prāṅgaṇamadhye tu tulasīmandīraṃ śubham ||12|| mandirasya bahirdvāri kārayeddīpikādvayam || tathā vai kṛtrimaṃ rājan siṃhadvayamadhiṣṭhitam ||13|| suvarṇaśikharasyādhaścakraṃ ca śikharopari || dvāre'pi harināmāni prālekhyāni śubhāni ca ||14|| śaṃkhaṃ padmaṃ gadāṃ śārṅgamālekhyaṃ bhittipārśvayoḥ || iṣudhī ca tathā bāṇaḥ savye dakṣiṇa eva ca ||15|| tathā mandirapṛṣṭhe vai śatacaṃdraṃ ca naṃdakam || halaṃ ca musalaṃ caiva lekhanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||16|| siṃhāsanasya pṛṣṭhe tu gopyo gāvastathaiva ca || gopālāstatra sopāne kapāṭe vijayo jayaḥ ||17|| dehalyāṃ kalpavṛkṣaśca stambheṣu ca latāṃ śubhām || yatra tatra ca kuḍyeṣu śrīgaṃgā pāpahāriṇī ||18|| vṛṃdāvanaṃ govardhanaṃ yamunāpulināni ca || tathā vai cīraharaṇamālekhyaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam ||19|| citrakūṭaḥ pañcavaṭī lekhanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃ jānakīharaṇaṃ vinā ||20|| daśāvatāracitrāṇi naranārāyaṇāśramaḥ || saptapuryyastrayo grāmā navāraṇyaṃ navoparāḥ ||21|| evaṃ likhitvā citrāṇi mandiraṃ kārayedbudhaḥ || vaṃśībhāvodyatakaraṃ vakrībhūtāṃghridakṣiṇam ||22|| kiśorākṛti kṛṣṇasya rūpaṃ sevyatamaṃ smṛtam || tatpratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāyāśu guruhastena maṃdire ||23|| bhaktaḥ paramayā bhaktyā sthāpayettatparo bhavet || tatprasāde ca rasanāṃ ghrāṇaṃ ca tulasīdale || nyasetkarṇau tatkathāyāmevaṃ sevāparo bhavet ||24|| aharniśaṃ kṛṣṇasevāṃ yaḥ karoti ca bhāvavit || taṃ premalakṣaṇaṃ bhaktaṃ vidurbhāgavatottamāḥ ||25|| aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca || rājan śrīkṛṣṇasevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm ||26|| śrīkṛṣṇadeśikasyāpi yaḥ kuryāddarśanaṃ naraḥ || koṭijanmakṛtaiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||27|| dehāṃte taṃ samānetuṃ śyāmasundaravigrahāḥ || rathaṃ nītvā pradhāvanti golokātkṛṣṇapārṣadāḥ ||28|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vijñānakhaṃḍe śrīvyāsograsenasaṃvāde harimaṃdirapratiṣṭhāvarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||6||
<9.7> śrīvedavyāsa uvāca brāhme muhūrte cotthāya kaśipośca mudā nṛpa || gurornāma ca goviṃdanāmāni pravadanmuhuḥ ||1|| bhūmiṃ natvā nyasetpādaṃ jalaṃ spṛṣṭvā harerjanaḥ || upaviśyāsane śīghraṃ sakāmo yo yathāsukham ||2|| hastāvutsaṃga ādhāya śvāsajitprāṇamāsthitaḥ || jñānamudrādharaṃ śāṃtaṃ śrīguruṃ svastikāsanam ||3|| dhyātvā kṛṣṇaṃ paraṃ dhyāyedbhakta ekāgramānasaḥ || kiśoraṃ śyāmalaṃ hṛdyaṃ vaṃśīvetravibhūṣitam ||4|| evaṃ kṛtvā harerdhyānaṃ punargacchedbahiḥsthalam || tacchaucaṃ śṛṇu rājendra gṛhasthasya yathātatham ||5|| aśvakrāṃteti maṃtreṇa mṛtsnayā ca jalena ca || ekā liṃge gude tisrastathā vāmakare daśa ||6|| etaccaturguṇaṃ proktaṃ yatīnāṃ harisevinām || tadardhaṃ rogipāṃthānāṃ strīśūdrāṇāṃ tadardhakam ||8|| śaucakarmavihīnasya sakalā niṣphalāḥ kriyāḥ || mukhaśuddhivihīnasya maṃtrā na phaladāḥ smṛtāḥ ||9|| āyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ prajāḥ paśuvasūni ca || brahmaprajñāṃ ca medhāṃ ca tvanno dehi vanaspate ||10|| iti maṃtraṃ samuccārya kuryādvai dantadhāvanam || haritaharyamaṃtreṇa sūryaṃ natvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ ||11|| praṇameddharibhaktāṃśca prahlādādīnsamāhitaḥ || tulasīmṛttikāṃ nītvā tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret ||12|| paṭhitavyaṃ prayatnena śrīgaṃgāyamunāṣṭakam || ayodhyā mathurā māyā kāśī kāṃcī avaṃtikā ||13|| purī dvārāvatī caiva saptaitā mokṣadāyikāḥ || śāligrāmo mahāyoge śaṃbhalo harimandire ||14|| naṃdigrāmaḥ kauśale tu trayo grāmāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || daṃḍakaṃ saidhavāraṇyaṃ jaṃbumārgaṃ ca puṣkalam ||15|| utpalāvartamāraṇyaṃ naimiṣaṃ kurujāṃgalam || arbudaṃ hemavaṃtaṃ ca navāraṇyāni vai viduḥ ||16|| etāni tīrthanāmāni samuccārya punaḥ punaḥ || itthaṃ snātvā tato bibhradaṃbaraṃ kṣaumamuttamam ||17|| dvādaśāṃstilakān bibhradaṣṭamudrādharaḥ paraḥ || kṛtasaṃdhyaḥ śucirmaunī gatvā śrīkṛṣṇamaṃdiram ||18|| ghaṃṭāvādyaṃ jayārāvaṃ talaśabdaṃ vidhāya ca || uttaṣṭhottiṣṭha goviṃda yoganidrāṃ vihāya ca ||19|| uktvāpīmāṃ smṛtiṃ rājan bhakta utthāpayeddharim || maṃgalārtiṃ samādāya bhrāmayaṃstanmukhopari ||20|| nivedya bahupakvānnaṃ natvā natvā punaḥ punaḥ || tataḥ snānaṃ kārayitvā deśakālaprabhāvavit ||21|| śṛṅgāraṃ bhāvavitkṛtvā vastrabhūṣaṇamaṃgalaiḥ || ārtikyaṃ tu tataḥ kṛtvā bhojyānnaṃ ca vidhāya ca ||22|| tato dhṛtvā mahābhogaṃ nānārasamayaṃ param || mahābhogārtikaṃ kṛtvā kārayecchayanaṃ hareḥ ||23|| tataḥ prasādaṃ paramaṃ tulasīgaṃdhamiśritam || bhuñjīta yo harernityaṃ sa kṛtārtho na saṃśayaḥ ||24|| rājabhogārtikaṃ kṛtvā kārayecchayanaṃ hareḥ || śaṃkhanādena vidhivadbhogaṃ dhṛtvā yathāvidhi ||25|| tataḥ saṃdhyārtikaṃ kṛtvā dugdhādīnvinivedya ca || tataḥ pradoṣasamaye punarārtikamācaret ||26|| dhṛtvā bhogaṃ paraṃ miṣṭaṃ kārayecchayanaṃ hareḥ || rājasī caiva rājendra rajaseveyamasti vai ||27|| sarvaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacaṇdrasya sevāsaṃlagnamānasaḥ || tārayitvā kulaśataṃ yāti cātyaṃtikaṃ padam ||28|| janmāṣṭamī ca kṛṣṇasya śrīrāmanavamī tathā || rādhāṣṭamyannakūṭaṃ ca dvādaśī vāmanasya ca ||29|| caturdaśī nṛsiṃhasya tathānantacaturdaśī || eṣu kāleṣu kṛṣṇasya mahāpūjāṃ samācaret ||30|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vijñānakhaṃḍe śrīvyāsograsenasaṃvāde rājasasevāvarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||7||
<9.8> śrīvyāsa uvāca atha snātvā ca kṛtvā ca nityanaimittikīṃ kriyām || pañcavarṇasamāyuktaṃ śuddhe sthaṇḍilamaṇḍale ||1|| dvātriṃśaddalasaṃyuktaṃ kārṇikākesarojjvalam || vidhāya kamalaṃ sthāpya vidhivadvedasūktibhiḥ ||2|| karṇikāyāṃ nyasedrājanhareḥ siṃhāsanaṃ śubham || tatra rādhāṃ ramāṃ sthāpya bhūdevīṃ virajāṃ tathā ||3|| tanmadhye sthāpayetsākṣācchrīkṛṣṇaṃ puruṣottamam || tathāṣṭadalamadhye tu rādhikāṣṭasakhīḥ śubhāḥ ||4|| tato'ṣṭadalamadhye tu śrīkṛṣṇasya tathā sakhīn || tathā ṣoḍaśaparṇeṣu sakhīnāṃ ca dvayaṃ dvayam ||5|| kamalasya ca pārśveṣu śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ tathā || padmaṃ ca naṃdakaṃ śārṅgaṃ bāṇāṃśca musalaṃ halam ||6|| kaustubhaṃ vanamālāṃ ca śrīvatsaṃ nīlamaṃbaram || pītāṃbaraṃ tathā vaṃśīṃ vetraṃ ca sthāpayedbudhaḥ ||7|| tataḥ pārśveṣu tālāṃkaṃ garuḍāṃkaṃ rathaṃ tathā || sumatiṃ dārukaṃ sūtaṃ garuḍaṃ kumudaṃ tathā ||8|| caṃḍaṃ caiva pracaṃḍaṃ ca balaṃ caiva mahābalam || kumudākṣaṃ balaṃ caiva sthāpayedyatnataḥ sudhīḥ ||9|| tathā dikṣu ca dikpālānsaṃsthāpya ca pṛthak pṛthak || viṣvaksenaṃ śivaṃ māṃ ca vidhiṃ durgāṃ vināyakam ||10|| navagrahāṃśca varuṇaṃ tathā ṣoḍaśa mātṛkāḥ || tatpadmāgre vītihotraṃ sthaṃḍile sthāpayedbudhaḥ ||11|| āvāhanamāsanaṃ ca pādyamarghyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || snānaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ ca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathaiva ca ||12|| yajñopavītaṃ vastraṃ ca bhūṣaṇaṃ gaṃdhameva ca || puṣpaṃ tathākṣatāṃścaiva naivedyaṃ ca manoharam ||13|| ācamanaṃ pradātavyaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tathā || pradakṣiṇāṃ prārthanāṃ ca tathā nīrājanaṃ smṛtam ||14|| namaskāraṃ tataḥ kuryātkarmaṇā ca pṛthak pṛthak || āvāhane tu puṣpāṇi āsane tu kuśadvayam || pādye śyāmāṃ ca dūrvāṃ ca viṣṇukrāṃtāṃ tathaiva ca || saugaṃdhikāni puṣpāṇi arghye yogyāni yādava ||16|| caṃdanośīrakarpūrakuṃkumāgurumiśritam || etādṛśaṃ jalaṃ yogyaṃ snāne rājanmahāmate ||17|| madhuparke hyāmalakamaraviṃdaṃ tathā matam || dhūpe gaṃdhāṣṭakaṃ deyaṃ dīpe karpūrameva ca ||18|| yajñopavītaṃ pītaṃ ca vastre pītāṃbaraṃ matam || bhūṣaṇe caiva sauvarṇaṃ gaṃdhe kuṃkumacandane ||19|| tulasīmaṃjarī puṣpe'kṣateṣu syustu taṃḍulāḥ || naivedye tu rasāḥ ṣaṭ ca bhogā nānāvidhā matāḥ ||20|| jale gaṃgājalaṃ yogyaṃ yamunājalameva ca || jātīphalaṃ ca kaṃkolamaṃte cācamane nṛpa ||21|| tāṃbūle coṣaṇaṃ tvelā dakṣiṇāyāṃ tu hāṭakam || pradakṣiṇāyāṃ bhramaṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ nīrājane gavām ||22|| prārthanāyāṃ harerbhaktiḥ premalakṣaṇasaṃyutā || namaskāre mahārāja sāṣṭāṃganatavigrahaḥ ||23|| dvādaśākṣaramaṃtreṇa śikhāṃ baddhvā śuciḥ pumān || upacarānpuraskṛtya śrīmukhe saṃmukho bhavet ||24|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vijñānakhaṃḍe śrīvyāsograsenasaṃvāde mahāpūjāvidhivarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8||
<9.9> śrīvyāsa uvāca upacārasya maṃtrāṇi vedoktāni śubhāni ca || tubhyaṃ vakṣyāmi rājeṃdra śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥ ||1|| athāvāhanam golokadhāmādhipate ramāpate goviṃda dāmodara dīnavatsala || rādhāpate mādhava sātvatāṃ pate siṃhāsane'sminmama saṃmukho bhava ||2|| athāsanam śrīpadmarāgasphuradūrdhvapṛṣṭhaṃ mahārhavaidūryakhacitpadābjam || vaikuṇṭha vaikuṇṭhapate gṛhāṇa pītaṃ taḍiddhāṭakakumbhakhaṇḍam ||3|| atha pādyam paraṃ sthitaṃ nirmalaraukmapātre samāhṛtaṃ biṃdusarovarāddhi || yogeśa vedeśa jagannivāsa gṛhāṇa pādyaṃ praṇamāmi pādau ||4|| atha arghyam jalajacampakapuṣpasamanvitaṃ vimalamarghyamanarghadarasthitam || pratigṛhāṇa ramāramaṇa prabho yadupate yadunātha yadūttama ||5|| atha snānam kāśmīrapāṭīravimiśritena sumallikośīravatā jalena || snānaṃ kuru tvaṃ yadunātha deva goviṃda gopālaka tīrthapāda ||6|| atha madhuparkasnānam madhyāhnacaṃdrārkabhavaṃ malāpahaṃ sitāṃgasaṃparkamanoharaṃ param || gṛhāṇa viṣṇo madhuparkamenaṃ saṃdṛśya pītāṃbara sātvatāṃ pate ||7|| atha vastram vibho sarvataḥ prasphuratprojjvalaṃ ca sphuradraśmiramyaṃ paraṃ durlabhaṃ ca || svato nirmitaṃ padmakiṃjalkavarṇaṃ gṛhaṇāṃbaraṃ deva pītāṃbarākhyam ||8|| atha yajñopavītam suvarṇābhamāpītavarṇaṃ sumaṃtraiḥ paraṃ prokṣitaṃ vedavinnirmitaṃ ca || śubhaṃ paṃcakāryeṣu naimittikeṣu prabho yajña yajñopavītaṃ gṛhāṇa ||9|| atha bhūṣaṇam kanakaratnamayaṃ mayanirmitaṃ madanarukkadanaṃ sadanaṃ rucām || uṣasi pūṣasuvarṇavibhūṣaṇaṃ sakalalokavibhūṣaṇa gṛhyatām ||10|| atha gaṃdham saṃdhyeṃduśobhaṃ bahumaṃgalaṃ śrīkāśmīrapāṭīrakapaṃkayuktam || svamaṃḍanaṃ gandhacayaṃ gṛhāṇa samastabhūmaṇḍalabhārahārin ||11|| athākṣatān brahmāvarte brahmaṇā pūrvamuptān brāhmaistoyaiḥ siṃcitānviṣṇunā ca || rudreṇārādrakṣitān rākṣasebhyaḥ sākṣādbhūmannakṣatāṃstvaṃ gṛhāṇa ||12|| atha puṣpāṇi mandārasantānakapārijātakalpadrumaśrīharicandanānām || gṛhāṇa puṣpāṇi hare tulasyā miśrāṇi sākṣānnavamaṃjarībhiḥ ||13|| atha dhūpam lavaṃgapāṭīrajacūrṇamiśraṃ manuṣyadevāsurasaukhyadaṃ ca || sadyaḥ sugaṃdhīkṛtaharmyadeśaṃ dvārāvatībhūpa gṛhāṇa dhūpam ||14|| atha dīpam tamohāriṇaṃ jñānamūrtiṃ manojñaṃ lasadvartikarpūrapūraṃ gavājyam || jagannātha deva prabho viśvadīpa sphurajjyotiṣaṃ dīpamukhyaṃ gṛhāṇa ||15|| atha naivedyam rasaiḥ śarairbhedavidhivyavasthitaṃ rasai rasāḍhyaṃ ca yaśomatīkṛtam || gṛhāṇa naivedyamidaṃ surocakaṃ gavyāmṛtaṃ sundara nandanandana ||16|| atha jalam gaṃgottarīvegabalātsamuddhṛtaṃ suvarṇapātreṇa himāṃśuśītalam || sunirmalābhaṃ hyamṛtopamaṃ jalaṃ gṛhāṇa rādhāvara bhaktavatsala ||17|| athācamanam rādhāpate śrīvirajāpate prabho śriyaḥ pate sarvapate ca bhūpate || kaṃkolajātīphalapuṣpavāsitaṃ paraṃ gṛhāṇācamanaṃ dayānidhe ||18|| atha tāṃbūlam jātīphalailāsulavaṃganāgavallīdalaiḥ pūgaphalaiśca saṃyutam || muktāsudhākhādirasārayuktaṃ gṛhāṇa tāṃbūlamidaṃ rameśa ||19|| atha dakṣiṇā nākapālavasupālamaulibhirvaṃditāṃghriyugala prabho hare || dakṣiṇāṃ parigṛhāṇa mādhava lokadakṣa varadakṣiṇāya te ||20|| atha nīrājanam prasphuratparamadīptimaṃgalaṃ godhṛtāktanavapaṃcavartikam || ārtikaṃ parigṛhāṇa cārtihan puṇyakīrtiviśadīkṛtāvane ||21|| atha namaskāraḥ namo'stvanaṃtāya sahasramūrtaye sahasrapādākṣiśirorubāhave || sahasranāmne puruṣāya śāśvate sahasrakoṭīyugadhāriṇe namaḥ ||22|| atha pradakṣiṇā samastatīrthayajñadānapūrtakādijaṃ phalam || labhetparasya śāśvataṃ karoti yaḥ pradakṣiṇām ||23|| atha prārthanā hare matsamaḥpātakī nāsti bhūmau tathā tvatsamo nāsti pāpāpahārī || iti tvaṃ ca matvā jagannātha deva yathecchā bhavette tathā māṃ kuru tvam ||24|| atha stutiḥ saṃjñānamātraṃ sadasatparaṃ mahacchaśvatpraśāṃtaṃ vibhavaṃ samaṃ mahat || tvāṃ brahma vaṃde hi sudurgamaṃ paraṃ sadā svadhāmnā paribhūtakaitavam ||25|| evaṃ saṃpūjya deveśamebhirmaṃtrairmahāmate || praṇamya viṣṇuṃ sarvāṃgapūjāṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ ||26|| oṃ namo nārāyaṇāya puruṣāya mahātmane || viśuddhasatvadhīsthāya mahāhaṃsāya dhīmahī ||27|| iti maṃtreṇa prāṇāyāmaṃ kṛtvā oṃ viṣṇave madhusūdanāya vāmanāya trivikramāya śrīdharāya hṛṣīkeśāya padmanābhāya dāmodarāya saṃkarṣaṇāya vāsudevāya pradyumnāya aniruddhāya adhokṣajāya puruṣottamāya śrīkṛṣṇāya namaḥ || iti pādagulphajānūrukaṭyudarapṛṣṭhabhujākaṃdharakarṇanāsikādharanetraśiraḥsu pṛthak pṛthak pūjayāmīti sarvāṅgapūjāṃ kuryāt || tathā sakhīsakhaśaṃkhacakragadāpadmāsidhanurbāṇahalamusalādīn tathā kaustubhavanamālāśrīvatsapītāṃbaranīlāṃbaravaṃśīvetrādīn tathā tālāṃkagaruḍāṃkarathadārukasumatisārathigaruḍakumudanaṃdasunaṃdacaṃḍamahābalakumudākṣādīn || praṇavapūrveṇa caturthyantena namaḥsaṃyuktena nāmnā tathā viṣvaksenaśivavidhidurgāvināyakadikpālavaruṇanavagrahamātṛkādīnmaṃtraiḥ pūjayet || oṃ namo vāsudevāya namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca || pradyumnāyāniruddhāya sātvatāṃ pataye namaḥ ||28|| iti maṃtreṇa śatamāhutīrjuhuyāt || devaṃ pradakṣīṇīkṛtya mahābhogaṃ nidhāya ca || praṇameddaṃḍavadbhūmau maṃtrametamudīrayet ||29|| dhyeyaṃ sadāparibhavaghnamabhīṣṭado'haṃ tīrthāspadaṃ śivaviraṃcinutaṃ śaraṇyam || bhṛtyārtihan praṇatapāla bhavābdhipotaṃ vaṃde mahāpuruṣa te caraṇāraviṃdam ||30|| iti natvā hariṃ rājanpunarnīrājanaṃ hareḥ || kārayedvidhivadbhakto haribhaktajanaiḥ saha ||31|| ghaṭīvādyaraṇadghaṇṭākāṃsyavīṇādikīcakaiḥ || karatālamṛdaṅgādyaiḥ kīrtanaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ ||32|| nṛtyanti śrīhareragre bhaktā vai premavihvalāḥ || jayadhvanisamāyuktāḥ satkathāgānatatparāḥ ||33|| punaḥ prabhuṃ namaskṛtya maṃdire tapanojjvale || śayanaṃ kārayetsamyak śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ ||34|| evaṃ karoti śrīkṛṣṇasevāṃ yo lagnamānasaḥ || praṇamaṃti ca taṃ rājandevatāḥ svargasaṃbhavāḥ ||35|| so'pi rājendra nāke'pi padaṃ dhṛtvā harerjanaḥ || aṃte yāti paraṃ dhāma golokaṃ yogidurlabham ||36|| iti śrīkṛṣṇasevāyā vidhānaṃ varṇitaṃ mayā || catuḥpadārthadaṃ nṝṇāṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ||37|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vijñānakhaṃḍe śrīvyāsograsenasaṃvāde śrīkṛṣṇasevāvidhānavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ||9||
<9.10> ugrasena uvāca siddho'smyanugṛhīto'smi tvayā śrīkṛṣṇarūpiṇā || śrīkṛṣṇapaddhatiḥ sākṣācchrutā vai vidhivanmayā ||1|| aho lokā mahāmūḍhā lobhamohamadānvitāḥ || nāpnuvaṃti hi vairāgyaṃ bhajaṃti na hariṃ kvacit ||2|| bhagavannasya jagato mohakāraṇamadbhutam || kathaṃ jātaṃ vada vibho kathametannivartate ||3|| śrīvyāsa uvāca yathāṃbhasi prāptamado vidhoḥ khatastatprekṣate kevalameva vegataḥ || tathā hi bimba paramasya māyayā mametyahaṃ bhāvagate pravartate ||4|| pradhānakālāśayadehajairguṇaiḥ kurvanvikarmāṇi jano nibaddhyate || kāce'rbhakaṃ saikata eva jīvanaṃ guṇe ca sarpaṃ pratanoti so'kṣibhiḥ ||5|| rājan jaganmohamayaṃ rajomayaṃ tamomayaṃ satvamayaṃ tathā kvacit || manovilāsaṃ vikṛtaṃ ca vibhramaṃ viddhyāśvidaṃ lolamalātacakravat ||6|| idaṃ kariṣyāmi karomyabhūvaṃ mamedamastīti ca vedamābruvan || ahaṃ sukhī duḥkhayutaḥ suhṛjjano lokastvahaṃkāravimohito mataḥ ||7|| ugrasena uvāca vada me kṛpayā brahmam̐llakṣaṇaṃ paramātmanaḥ || katidhā kavayaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ vadaṃti japavartmani ||8|| śrīvyāsa uvāca sanātanasyātra na mṛtyujanmanī na śokamohau na jarāyuvādayaḥ || ahaṃmado vyādhiyuto bhayaṃ sukhaṃ śucaḥ kṣudhecchā na ratirna cādhayaḥ || 9|| ātmā nirīho hyatanuḥ sa sarvago nāhaṃkṛtiḥ śuddhabalo guṇāśrayaḥ || svayaṃ paro niṣphala ātmamaṃgalo jñānātmako yo vidito munīśvaraiḥ ||10|| jāgarti yo'smiñchayanaṃ gate sati nāyaṃ jano veda sa veda taṃ hitam || paśyantamādyaṃ puruṣaṃ hi yaṃ jano na paśyati svacchamalaṃ ca taṃ bhaje ||11|| yathā nabho'gniḥ pavano na sajjate ghaṭe na kāṣṭhe na rajobhirāvṛtaḥ || tathā pumānsarvaguṇaiśca nirmalo varṇairyathā syātsphaṭikopamojjvalaḥ ||12|| vyaṃgena vā lakṣaṇayā ca vākpathairarthaiḥ padasphoṭaparāyaṇaiḥ param || na jñāyate tadguṇinottamena sadvācyaṃ tato brahma kutastu laukikaiḥ ||13|| vadanti kecidbhuvi karmakartṛ yatkālaṃ ca kecitparameva śobhanam || kecidvicāraṃ pravadanti yacca tadbrahmeti vedāṃtavido vadanti hi ||14|| yaṃ na spṛśaṃtīha guṇā na kālajā māyendriyaṃ cittamano na buddhayaḥ || mahanna vedo vadatīti tatparaṃ viśanti sarve'nalavisphuliṃgavat ||15|| hiraṇyagarbhaḥ paramātmatattvaṃ yadvāsudevaṃ pravadanti santaḥ || vicāryya taddevavarasvarūpaṃ visṛjya mohaṃ vicaredasaṅgaḥ ||16|| yathendureko jalapātravṛṃdago yathāgnireko viditaḥ samiccaye || tathā parātmā bhagavānanekavidantarbahiḥ syātsvakṛteṣu dehiṣu ||17|| sūryodaye naiśatamo vilīyate pradṛśyate vastu gṛhe yathā janaiḥ || jñānodaye jñānatamaḥ pralīyate saṃprāpyate brahma paraṃ tanau tathā ||18|| yathendriyāṇāṃ ca pṛthakpravṛttibhirnāneva te'rthotiguṇāśrayaḥ paraḥ || ekaṃ hyanaṃtasya parasya dhāma tattathā munīnāṃ kila śāstradharmabhiḥ ||19|| sākṣāddhariryaḥ puruṣottamottamaḥ śrīkṛṣṇacandro nijabhaktavatsalaḥ || kaivalyanātho nṛgamujjahāra taṃ pūrṇaṃ svayaṃ brahma paraṃ namāmyaham ||20|| śrīnārada uvāca ityuktvā tamanujñāpya bhagavānbādarāyaṇaḥ || paśyatāṃ yādavānāṃ ca tatraivāṃtaradhīyata ||21|| idaṃ mayā te kathitaṃ haribhaktivivarddhanam || vijñānakhaṃḍaṃ viśadaṃ śrotṝṇāṃ mokṣadaṃ smṛtam ||22|| gargācāryeṇa kathitā nāmneyaṃ gargasaṃhitā || sarvadoṣaharā puṇyā caturvargaphalapradā ||23|| golokavṛṃdāvanayorgirīśvaramādhuryayoḥ śrīmathurāpurasya ca || dvārāvatīviśvajitorhalāyudhavijñānayoḥ khaṃḍacayāḥ pṛthaṅ nava ||24|| śrīkṛṣṇamūrtiḥ paramai rasairyathā yathā ca bhūmirbharatādibhirbhṛśam || tathā hi śaśvanmunigargasaṃhitā vibhāti khaṃḍairnavabhirnṛpeśvara ||25|| yathā hi ratnairnavabhirvirājate devāṃgulau taptasuvarṇamudrikā || tathā caturvargaphalaprade vidhau sargairvisargaimunigargasaṃhitā ||26|| narendra śaśvanmunisaṃhitāṃ ye śṛṇvanti bhaktyā hi janāḥ punītāḥ || ihaiva saukhyaṃ paramāpnuvaṃtastatastu golokapuraṃ prayāṃti ||27|| kṛtvātha pītāmbaravandanaṃ tvimāṃ śṛṇoti vaṃdhyā bahulālasā bhṛśam || hṛsvena kālena gṛhāṃgaṇe śiśūnsañcārayantī vicaratyaharniśam ||28|| rogī pumān rogagaṇātpramucyate bhīto bhayādbaṃdhagataśca baṃdhanāt || śrutvā kathāṃ nirdhana eti vaibhavaṃ mūrkho bhavetpaṃḍita eva satvaram ||29|| yaḥ kārtike māsi nṛpaḥ śriyā yutaḥśṛṇoti śaśvanmunigargasaṃhitām || sa cakravartī bhavitā na saṃśayo narendrahastoddhṛtacārupādukaḥ ||30|| manojavaiḥ siṃdhuturaṅgamairnavairdvipaiśca viṃdhyācalasaṃbhavaiḥ paraiḥ || vaitālikodgītayaśā mahītale niṣevito vāravadhūjanaiḥ saha ||31|| suvarṇaśṛṅgaṃ varatāmrapṛṣṭhaṃ sabhūṣaṇaṃ raupyakhuraṃ savatsam || dadāti khaṃḍaṃ prati godvayaṃ yaḥ prāpnoti sarvaṃ hi manorathaṃ saḥ ||32|| niṣkāraṇo'sau śṛṇute videharāṭ sarvāmimāṃ vai munigargasaṃhitām || hṛtpuṇḍarīke vasate'sya sarvadā śrīkṛṣṇacaṃdro nijabhaktavatsalaḥ ||33|| śrīgarga uvāca ityuktvā tamanujñāpya nārado devadarśanaḥ || sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ brahmannaṃbaraṃ gatavānmuniḥ ||34|| bahulāśvo mahārājaḥ śrīkṛṣṇe lagnamānasaḥ || sarvatastu kṛtārtho'bhūcchrutvemāṃ saṃhitāṃ hareḥ ||35|| tava paśnopari brahmankathitā saṃhitā mayā || śrutā vā paṭhitā kaiścitkoṭiyajñaphalapradā ||36|| śrīśaunaka uvāca dhanyo'haṃ ca kṛtārtho'haṃ tvatsaṃgena mahāmune || prāpnomi paramāṃ bhaktiṃ śrīkṛṣṇapremavarddhinīm ||37|| viśadahṛdi munīnāṃ mānase rājahaṃsaḥ sakalasukhavirājannādamādhuryyavaṃśaḥ || jagati vikaladaṃśaḥ śūravaṃśāvataṃsaḥ karabalahatakaṃsaḥ pātu vaḥ satpraśaṃsaḥ ||38|| ityuktvā tānmunīnsarvān gargācāryo mahāmuniḥ || anujñāpya prasannātmā gaṃtumabhyudyato'bhavat ||39|| navasargavisargāḍhyāṃ svargabhṛdgargasaṃhitām || caturvargapradāmuktvā gargo gargācalaṃ yayau ||40|| śaradvikacapaṃkajaśriyamatīva vidveṣakaṃ miliṃdamunileḍhitaṃ kuliśakañjacihnāvṛtam || sphuratkanakanūpuraṃ dalitabhaktatāpatrayaṃ caladdyutipadadvayaṃ hṛdi dadhāmi rādhāpateḥ ||41|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ vijñānakhaṃḍe
