śrīnāradabahulāśvasaṃvādāṃtargataśrīvyāsograsenasaṃvāde parabrahmanirūpaṇaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||10||
<10.1> maṃgalācaraṇam nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam || devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet ||1|| namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇacaṃdrāya namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca || namaḥ pradyumnadevāyāniruddhāya namo namaḥ ||2|| śrīgarga uvāca sabhāyāmāgataṃ vīkṣya romaharṣaṇanandanam || śaunakaḥ paripapraccha praṇipatyābhivādya ca ||1|| śaunaka uvāca tvanmukhātsarvaśāstrāṇi purāṇāni mahāmate || nānāharicaritrāṇi śrutāni vimalāni vai ||2|| purā gargeṇa kathitā mamāgre gargasaṃhitā || rādhāmādhavayoryasyāṃ mahimā bahu varṇitaḥ ||3|| adyāhaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvattaḥ kṛṣṇakathāṃ punaḥ || sarvaduḥkhaharāṃ saute kathayasva vicārya ca ||4|| śrīgarga uvāca aṣṭāśītisahasraiśca munibhī raumaharṣaṇiḥ || pṛṣṭaḥ provāca kṛṣṇasya smaranpādāṃbujaṃ hareḥ ||5|| sautiruvāca aho śaunaka dhanyo'si yasya te matirīdṛśī || kṛṣṇacaṃdrapadadvandvamakaraṃdaspṛhāvatī ||6|| saṃgamaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca devāḥ śreṣṭhaṃ vadaṃti hi || pāpakṣayakarī yasmācchrīkṛṣṇasya kathā bhavet ||7|| anaṃtaṃ kṛṣṇacaṃdrasya caritaṃ kalmaṣāpaham || kiṃcijjānāti brahmā ca tathā kiṃcidumāpatiḥ ||8|| maśako mādṛśaḥ ko'pi vāsudevakathārṇave || mohitā na vadiṣyanti yatra brahmādayaḥ surāḥ ||9|| śrīgargo yādaveṃdrasya hyugrasenasya bhūpateḥ || aśvamedhaṃ kratuvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā pratyāha caikadā ||10|| dhanyo rājā yādaveṃdro yaścakāra kratūttamam || śrīkṛṣṇasyājñayā puryāṃ tenāhaṃ vismayaṃ gataḥ ||11|| mayā vai saṃhitāyāṃ ca kathāḥ kṛṣṇasya varṇitāḥ || paripūrṇatamasyāpi yathā dṛṣṭā yathā śrutāḥ ||12|| tasyāṃ vai vājimedhasya kathā na kathitā mayā || adyāhaṃ kathayiṣyāmi hayamedhakathāṃ punaḥ ||13|| yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa narāṇāṃ hi kalau yuge || bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca bhagavāñchīghrameva prayacchati ||14|| ityuktvā śrīmunirgargaḥ kṛṣṇabhaktyā ca śaunaka || ugrasenasya yajñasya caritraṃ sa hyacīklṛpat ||15|| hayamedhacaritrasya sumerurnāma sundaram || dhṛtvā gargastu bhagavānkṛtakṛtyo'bhavanmune ||16|| kṛtvā kathāmaṣṭadinena śrīmuniryadorgururbuddhimatāṃ varaḥ paraḥ || athāyayau vai mathurāṃ hareḥ purīṃ vrajaṃ nṛpeṃdraṃ ca nirīkṣituṃ khalu ||17|| aṃbarādāgataṃ tatra gargaṃ jñānavatāṃ varam || vīkṣyotthāya namaścakre vajranābho dvijaiḥ saha ||18|| svarṇasiṃhāsanaṃ dattvāvanijya tatpadāmbuje || arcayitvā puṣpasragbhirmiṣṭānnaṃ ca nyavedayat ||19|| tatpādasalilaṃ nītvā śīrṣe dhṛtvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ || bhūtvā śrīvajranābhastu śyāmaḥ paṃkajalocanaḥ ||20|| puṣṭadeho bṛhadbāhurvīraḥ ṣoḍaśavārṣikaḥ || iti hovāca svaguruṃ śatasiṃhasamodbhaṭaḥ ||21|| vajranābha uvāca namastubhyaṃ svāgataṃ te brahmankiṃ karavāma te || manye tvāṃ bhagavadrūpa brahmarṣīṇāṃ varaṃ param || 22|| gururvidhirgurū rudro gurureva bṛhaspatiḥ || gururnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣāttasmai śrīgurave namaḥ ||23|| narāṇāṃ ca muniśreṣṭha darśanaṃ tava durlabham || asmākaṃ nitarāṃ deva viṣayāsaktacetasām ||24|| gargācārya kulācārya tejasvin yogabhāskara || tvaddarśanādapi vayaṃ pāvitāḥ sakuṭuṃbakāḥ ||25|| śrutvā yadūnāmṛṣabhasya vākyaṃ munīṃdravaryastu mahānmahātmā || smaranhareḥ śrīcaraṇāraviṃdaṃ mudā nṛpeṃdraṃ nijagāda sadyaḥ ||26|| yuvarāja mahārāja yaduvaṃśaśiromaṇe || tvayā sādhu kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ pālitā pṛthivījanāḥ ||27|| sthāpitaśca tvayā vatsa dharmo vai pṛthivītale || viṣṇurātaśca te mitraṃ nṛpāścānye vaśāḥ smṛtāḥ ||28|| dhanyastvaṃ rājaśārdūla dhanyā te mathurā purī || dhanyāśca te prajāḥ sarvā dhanyā vai vrajabhūśca te ||29|| bhuṃkṣva bhogānbhajankṛṣṇaṃ balaṃ pradyumnameva ca || aniruddhaṃ ca niḥśaṃko bhūtvā rājyaṃ kuru prabho ||30|| sūta uvāca iti vākyaṃ samākarṇya gargasya nṛpasattamaḥ || saṃkarṣaṇaṃ ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pitaraṃ ca pitāmaham ||31|| viraheṇa smaran rājā cāśrupūrṇamukho'bhavat || taṃ nṛpaṃ duḥkhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sthitaṃ bhūmāvadhomukham ||32|| gargastu vismitaḥ prāha duḥkhaṃ praśamayanniva || garga uvāca kasmādrodiṣi rājeṃdra bhayaṃ kiṃ te mayi sthite ||33|| kāraṇaṃ svasya duḥkhasya vada sarvaṃ mamāgrataḥ || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rājā na prāha duḥkhitaḥ ||34|| punaḥ pṛṣṭaśca guruṇā prāha gadgadayā girā || rājovāca māṃ tyaktvā yādavāḥ sarve kṛṣṇasaṃkarṣaṇādayaḥ ||35|| gatā deva paraṃ lokaṃ tenāhaṃ duḥkhito'bhavam || svāmyamātyasuhṛdrāṣṭrakośadurgabalāni ca || ekākinaśca me brahmannete prītikarā na hi ||37|| mayā caritraṃ kṛṣṇasya na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ vada || dṛṣṭo yādavasaṃhāraḥ tasmādduḥkhaṃ na yāti me ||37|| caturvyūhena hariṇā yā purī śobhitā purā || sāpi magnā samudre tu kṛṣṇo bhakteḥ paraṃ gataḥ ||38|| kasya hetoḥ kimarthaṃ ca jīvāmi śiṣyavatsala || adya yāsyāmi gahanaṃ rājyaṃ kartuṃ na me manaḥ ||39|| sūta uvāca tato munīnāmṛṣabho mahātmā śrutvā giraṃ yādavasattamasya || saṃślāghya duḥkhaṃ śamayan hi tuṣṭo gargo'bravīdbhūpativajranābham ||40|| garga uvāca vṛṣṇipravara madvākyaṃ śṛṇu śokavināśanam || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sāvadhānatayā śubham ||41|| yo rājate kuśasthalyāṃ kṛṣṇacandro hariḥ purā || virājate sa sarvatra bhaktyā taṃ paśya bhūpate ||42|| adya te kathayiṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradāṃ kathām || śṛṇu tvaṃ vasudhānātha śrīkṛṣṇabalayoḥ param ||43|| sūta uvāca ityuktvā bhagavāngargo vajrāya svāṃ ca saṃhitām || kathayāmāsa vipreṃdra puṇyāṃ navadinaiḥ kila ||44|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāmaśvamedhacaritre sumerau gargavajranābhasaṃvāde prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ||1|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.2> sūta uvāca iti śrutvā vajranābhirmuneḥ śrīgargasaṃhitām || bhṛśaṃ mumodātha guruṃ pratyuvāca praṇamya ca ||1|| adya śrīkṛṣṇcandrasya caritraṃ tu śrutaṃ mayā || tvanmukhānmuniśārdūla tena duḥkhāśca me gatāḥ || 2|| me manastu kṛpānātha punaḥ śrotuṃ hareryaśaḥ || atṛptasyāpi kṛṣṇasya vadasva caritaṃ param ||3|| dvārvatyāmugrasenena hayamedhaḥ kṛtaḥ purā || taccaritraṃ vada mune kiṃcitpūrvaṃ śrutaṃ mayā ||4|| anuvratānāṃ śiṣyāṇāṃ sutānāṃ ca munīśvara || brūyurguhyamanāpṛṣṭaṃ guravaḥ karuṇāmayāḥ ||5|| śrīsūta uvāca evaṃ bhāṣitamākarṇya yādavānāṃ gururmuniḥ || prītaḥ pratyāha rājendraṃ smaranpādāmbujaṃ hareḥ ||6|| garga uvāca dhanyastvaṃ kṛṣṇacandrasya pādayorbhaktirīdṛśī || jātā te yādavaśreṣṭha diṣṭyā tu durlabhā nṛṇām ||7|| kathayāmyatra te rājannitihāsaṃ śṛṇuṣva vai || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||8|| dvāpāre pīḍitā rājan dharā bhāreṇa pāpinām || brahmāgre kathayāmāsa so'pi śrutvā hariṃ yayau ||9|| gatvā ca kathayāmāsa śrutvā śrīrādhikāpatiḥ || mahīmāśvāsya devaiśca bhāraṃ hartuṃ mano dadhe ||10|| vivāho vasudevasya madhupuryāmabhūttataḥ || kaṃsabodhanaṣaṭputravadhaḥ kasaṃbhayaṃ nṛpa ||11|| māyājñāmanudevādistutiḥ kṛṣṇasamudbhavam || varṇanaṃ rūpakṛṣṇasya vasudevasya saṃstutiḥ ||12|| devakyādipurākṛtyakathanaṃ jagadīśituḥ || gokulānayanaṃ kanyāpātanaṃ tadvibhāṣaṇam ||13|| sāṃtvanaṃ vasudevasya mocanaṃ bhāryayā saha || kaṃsadurmaṃtradaityeṣu sādhu bāla upadravaḥ ||14|| prādurbhūte vraje kṛṣṇe vrajarājamahotsavaḥ || mathurāgamanaṃ naṃdavasudevasamāgamaḥ || 15|| pūtanāsupayaḥpānaṃ nandagopādivismayaḥ || śakaṭavyatyaye daityacakravātavadhaḥ śiśoḥ ||16|| saṃlālane mukhe dhātryā jṛmbhaṇe viśvadarśanam || rāmakeśavayornāmnoḥ kāraṇaṃ keliretayoḥ ||17|| dhaurtyaṃ gopavadhūgehe prasaṃgānmṛdabhakṣaṇam || darśanaṃ viśvarūpasya nandabhāgyapurākathā ||18|| cauryaṃ haiyaṅgavasyātha bandhanaṃ dāmabhirbalāt || yamalārjunayoḥ śāpo bhaṃgaścaiva stutistayoḥ ||19|| bālakrīḍopanandādimaṃtraṇaṃ gamanaṃ tataḥ || vṛndāvane tayoḥ krīḍā vayasyairvatsacāriṇoḥ ||20|| vatsāsurasya ca vadho bakāghāsurayopi || bhojanaṃ sakhibhistīre yamunāyā harermudā ||21|| vatsāghāharaṇaṃ dhātrā kṛṣṇatvaṃ vatsapālayoḥ || brahmaṇo gamanaṃ paścātstutiḥ kṛṣṇaratirgatiḥ ||22|| gocāraṇe mahākrīḍā dhenukādivadhastathā || vraja āgamanaṃ kṛṣṇagopīnetramahotsavaḥ ||23|| mṛtān viṣāṃbhaḥpānena gopānharirajīvayat || kālīyadamane stotraṃ tadbhāryāṇāṃ pralāpanam ||24|| hrade kālīyasambandhakathanaṃ vahnimocanam || krīḍāpralaṃbanidhanaṃ dāvāgnermocanaṃ gavām ||25|| varṣāśaradvarṇanaṃ ca gopīnāṃ vacanāmṛtam || vrataṃ gokulakanyānāṃ vastrāṇāṃ haraṇaṃ mudā ||26|| vanabhāgyakathā gopaprārthanā preṣaṇaṃ makhe || viprabhāryāprasādaśca paścāttāpo dvijanmanām ||27|| yāgabhaṃgo mahendrasya dhṛtirgovardhanasya ca || surendragarvaharaṇaṃ gargajātakavarṇanam ||28|| gopaśaṃkāpagamanamiṃdradhenvābhiyācitam || nandasya mokṣaṇaṃ gopavaikuṇṭhagamanaṃ tataḥ ||29|| pañcādhyāyaniśākrīḍā sarpānnaṃdasya mokṣaṇam || śaṃkhacūḍavadhaḥ paścādgopīgītaṃ vṛṣārdanam ||30|| kaṃsanāradasaṃvādaḥ kaṃsākrūrakathā tataḥ || keśino nidhanaṃ kṛṣṇānnāradarṣikathā tataḥ ||31|| vyomāsuravadho'krūrāgamanaṃ gokuleṣu ca || darśanānaṃdahṛṣṭātmā romāṃco gadgadā giraḥ ||32|| saṃvādo rāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ varṇitaṃ kaṃsaceṣṭitam || rāmakṛṣṇaprayāṇaṃ ca tathā gopīpralāpanam ||33|| mathurāgamanaṃ madhye hrade kṛṣṇasya darśanam || stutiḥ purā gatiḥ paścāddarśanaṃ purasaṃpadaḥ ||34|| rajakasya śiraśchedo vāyakasya varādayaḥ || sudāmno varadānaṃ ca kubjāsaṃdarśanaṃ hareḥ ||35|| dhanurbhaṃgaḥ sainyavadhaḥ kaṃsadurhetudarśanam || raṃgotsavaḥ kuvalayāpīḍayuddhavighātanam ||36|| darśanaṃ rāmakṛṣṇasya paurāṇāṃ premavardhanam || mallānāṃ nidhanaṃ raṃge kaṃsasya saha bandhubhiḥ ||37|| pitrośca sāṃtvanaṃ sarvasuhṛdāṃ caiva toṣaṇam || ugrasenābhiṣekaṃ ca naṃdādivrajapreṣaṇam ||38|| īṣaddvijātisaṃskāraṃ paṭhanaṃ ca gurorgṛhe || mṛtaputrapradānaṃ ca guroḥ paṃcajanārdanam ||39|| punarāgamanaṃ śaurermadhupuryāṃ mahotsavaḥ || uddhavapreṣaṇaṃ gopīvilāpaparisāṃtvanam ||40|| melanārthaṃ tu kṛṣṇasyāgamanaṃ naṃdagokule || punarvai koladaityasya vadhaḥ paścātprakīrtitaḥ ||41|| kubjāratistathākrūrapreṣaṇaṃ gajasāhvaye || pāṃḍaveṣu ca vaiṣamyaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya bodhanam ||42|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāmaśvamedhacaritre sumerau kṛṣṇalīlāvarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||2|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.3> garga uvāca jāmātṛvadhasaṃtaptajarāsaṃdhacamūvadhaḥ || bahuśaḥ senayoryuddhe dvārakādurgakāraṇam ||1|| yavanasya vadhaṃ dṛṣṭvā mucakuṃdasya saṃstutiḥ || varaṃ datvā tato mlecchavadhaṃ kṛtvā dhane tataḥ ||2|| nīyamāne vane dṛptajarāsaṃdhātpalāyanam || raivato revatīṃ kanyāṃ baladevasamarpaṇam ||3|| rukmiṇīpriyasaṃdeśaśravaṇādakhilānnṛpān || nirjitya nirgamo gehāt hṛtavānaṃbikāgṛhāt ||4|| nṛpaiḥ sāṃtvanaṃ caidyasya tato rukmīsamāgamaḥ || yuddhāpekṣāparādhādvai muṃḍanaṃ tasya kṛṣṇataḥ ||5|| rukmiṇīduḥkhaśamanaṃ rāmavākyācca mokṣaṇam || tato vivāho rukmiṇyā vidhivatsvapure mudā ||6|| pradyumnotpattikathanaṃ haraṇaṃ sūtikāgṛhāt || māyāvatyoktavṛttāṃtaṃ śaṃbarasya vadhastataḥ ||7|| punarāgamanaṃ gehe saṃtoṣo dvārakaukasām || sūryātsyamaṃtakaprāptiryācanaṃ tasya vai hareḥ ||8|| tatsaṃbandhātprasenasya vadho'kīrtirharestathā || tanmārjanāya ṛkṣasya gṛheśu gamanaṃ hareḥ ||9|| yuddhe jñātvā lokanāthaṃ jāṃbavatyāḥ samarpaṇam || satrājitāya ca maṇiḥ prāptā śrīhariṇā bilāt ||10|| vivāhaḥ satyabhāmāyāḥ pāribarhe tathā maṇiḥ || rāmeṇa saha kṛṣṇasya gamanaṃ hastināpure ||11|| akrūrakṛtavarmabhyāṃ śatadhanvā tu preritaḥ || satrājitaṃ jaghānāśu so'pi kṛṣṇena māritaḥ ||12|| rāmastu mithilāyāṃ ca gadāśikṣā suyodhane || akrūre maṇidānaṃ ca śakraprasthe harirgataḥ ||13|| kālindyā saṃgatiḥ śaurervivāhaḥ svapure tataḥ || vivāho mitravindāyāḥ satyāyāśca tathaiva ca ||14|| bhadrāyā lakṣmaṇāyāśca vivāho hariṇā tataḥ || pārijātaṃ tu satyāyai śakraṃ jitvā dadau hariḥ ||15|| vajranābhiruvāca priyāyai dattavānkasmācchakraṃ jitvā suradrumam || śrīkṛṣṇastatkathāṃ sarvāṃ mune me brūhi vistarāt ||16|| śrīgarga uvāca pārijātaikakusume cānīte nāradātkadā || datte sati śrīrukmiṇyai satyā tu duḥkhitābhavat ||17|| tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kupitāṃ prāha krodhāgāragatāṃ hariḥ || mā śoca kuru dāsyāmi pārijātadrumaṃ ca te ||18|| tadaiva kathitaṃ sarve kṛṣṇāgre bhaumaceṣṭitam || śakreṇa śrutvā bhagavānprāha paśyankṛtāṃjalim ||19|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca matpriyāṃ duḥkhitāṃ paśya rudantīṃ vṛtrasūdana ||19|| pārijātasya vṛkṣārthe kiṃ kariṣyāmyahaṃ vada || yadāsyai pārijātasya vṛkṣaṃ dāsyasi tvaṃ hare ||20|| tadā bhaumaṃ sasainyaṃ ca haniṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || kṛṣṇabhāṣitamākarṇya prahasanprāha vāsavaḥ ||21|| indra uvāca pārijātadrumāḥ sarve vartaṃte nandane ca ye || gṛhāṇa tānsvataḥ kṛṣṇa tvaṃ hatvā narakāsuram ||22|| tathāstu coktvā bhagavānsatyabhāmāsamanvitaḥ || garuḍaskaṃdhamārūḍhaḥ prāgjotiṣapuraṃ yayau ||23|| satyabhāmā hariṃ prāha svargamiṃdre gate sati || satyovāca pūrvaṃ gṛhāṇa śakrāttvaṃ drumarājaṃ jagatpate ||24|| kārye bhūte sati hare na kariṣyati tvatpriyam || priyāvākyaṃ samākarṇya priyaḥ prāha priyāṃ vacaḥ ||25|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca sa pārijātaṃ yadi na pradāsyati prayācyamānastu mayāmareśvaraḥ || tataḥ śacīvyāmuditānulepane gadāṃ vimokṣyāmi puraṃdarorasi ||26|| ityuktvā bhagavānkṛṣṇo bhaumāsurapuraṃ gataḥ || nānādurgaiḥ saptabhiśca veṣṭitaṃ ca mahāsuraiḥ ||27|| sarvānbibheda durgān vai gadācakraśarādibhiḥ || jaghāna murudaityaṃ ca tatputrāñśastrasaṃyutān ||28|| śastrāstravarṣaṃ muṃcaṃtaṃ sasainyaṃ narakaṃ hariḥ || kṣiptvā cakraṃ dvidhā cakre garuḍena jaghāna ca ||29|| hatvā bhaumaṃ jagannātho vararatnāni yādavaḥ || jagrāha tatra kanyānāṃ samūhaṃ vai dadarśa ha ||30|| daityasiddhanṛpāṇāṃ ca sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa || śatādhikāni kanyāśca preṣayāmāsa svāṃ purīm ||31|| gṛhītvātha maṇiṃ chatraṃ devamātuśca kuṇḍale || pārijātadrumārthe vai yayāviṃdrapurīṃ hariḥ ||32|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāmaśvamedhacaritre sumerau kṛṣṇakathāvarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||3|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.4> garga uvāca gatvā svargaṃ tu śakrāya datvā chatraṃ maṇiṃ tathā || adityai kuṇḍale kṛṣṇo datvābhiprāyamabravīt ||1|| ābhiprāyaṃ harerjñātvā vāsavo na dadau drumam || devāñjitvā tadā pārijātaṃ jagrāha mādhavaḥ ||2|| sūta uvāca iti śrutvā kathāṃ rājā yādavo vismayānvitaḥ || papraccha svaguruṃ bhūyaḥ śraddadhāno harerguṇe ||3|| brahmañśakrastu deveṃdro jānankṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ param || aparādhaṃ tu kṛtavānsa kathaṃ brūhi tattvataḥ ||4|| kṛṣṇāgre kathitaṃ satyabhāmayā śakraceṣṭitam || tasmānme vistarādyuddhamindramādhavayorvada ||5|| garga uvāca adityā saṃstutaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śakravākyācca nandanam || vanaṃ gatvā pārijātānsaṃdadarśa bahūndrumān ||6|| teṣāṃ madhye mahāvṛkṣaṃ maṃjarīpuñjadhāriṇam || kṣīrodamathanājjātaṃ padmagaṃdhasamanvitam ||7|| surāṇāṃ sukhadaṃ tāmrapallavaiḥ pariveṣṭitam || vane vibhūṣaṇaṃ divyaṃ varaṃ svarṇasamatvacam ||8|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā mādhavaṃ prāha satyabhāmā ca māninī || enaṃ gṛhṇāmyahaṃ kṛṣṇa śreṣṭhaṃ sarvaṃ vane drumam ||9|| ityuktaḥ priyayotpāṭya pārijātaṃ garutmati || līlayā''ropayāmāsa prahasañjagadīśvaraḥ ||10|| tadaiva kupitāḥ sarve vanapālāḥ samutthitāḥ || dhanurbāṇadharāḥ kṛṣṇamūcuḥ prasphuritādharāḥ ||11|| indrapriyāyā vṛkṣaśca hṛtaḥ kasmāttvayā nara || yadṛcchayā kilāsmākaṃ tṛṇīkṛtya kva yāsyasi ||12|| indrāṇīprītaye devaiḥ purā hyudadhimaṃthane || utpādito'yaṃ na kṣemī gṛhītvainaṃ bhaviṣyasi ||13|| girīṇāṃ yena sarveṣāṃ pakṣāḥ pūrvaṃ nipātitāḥ || taṃ kiṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ vīraṃ jitvā vṛkṣaṃ nayiṣyasi ||14|| tasmādgaccha mahāvīra pārijātaṃ vihāya ca || na dāsyāmo drumaṃ tubhyaṃ śakrasyānucarā vayam ||15|| yadā dāsyati tubhyaṃ vai pārijātaṃ puraṃdaraḥ || na niṣedhaṃ kariṣyāmo vanapālā vayaṃ tadā ||16|| teṣāṃ bhāṣitamākarṇya satyabhāmā ruṣānvitā || tūṣṇīṃbhūte sati harāvabhītā prāha tānnṛpa ||17|| satyovāca kā śacī pārijātasya kaḥ śakro vā sureśvaraḥ || sāmānyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ yadīśo'mṛtamaṃthane ||18|| samutpannaḥ suraḥ kasmādeko gṛhṇāti vāsavaḥ || yathā sudhā yathaiveṃduryathā śrīrvanacāriṇaḥ ||19|| sāmānyaḥ sarvalokasya pārijātastathā drumaḥ || bhartubāhumahāgarvā ruṇaddhyenaṃ mṛṣā śacī ||20|| tatkathyatāmalaṃ kṣāntyā satyāhārapratidrumam || kathyatāṃ ca drutaṃ gatvā paulomyai vacanaṃ mama ||21|| satyabhāmā vadatyetadatigarvoddhatākṣaram || yadi tvaṃ dayitā bharturyadi vaśyaḥ patistava ||22|| madbharturharato vṛkṣaṃ tatkāraya nivāraṇam || jānāmi te patiṃ śakraṃ yuṣmāñjānāmi tatvataḥ ||23|| pārijātaṃ tathāpyenaṃ mānuṣī harayāmi te || garga uvāca kṛṣṇapriyāyā vacanaṃ vanapālā niśamya ca ||24|| indrāṇīnikaṭaṃ gatvā procuḥ sarvaṃ yathoditam || rakṣakāṇāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā śacī prāha ruṣānvitā ||25|| kṛṣṇaṃ nivāraṇārthāya na yāsyaṃtaṃ puraṃdaram || śacyuvāca madīyaṃ pārijātaṃ vai mādhavena balīyasā ||26|| gṛhītaṃ svapriyārthe vai tvāṃ tṛṇīkṛtya vajriṇam || tasmānmocaya vṛkṣeśaṃ pākasūdana vṛtrahan ||27|| satyabhāmāvaśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vinirjitya mahāraṇe || tvayā vai pūrvamadrīṇāṃ pakṣā vajreṇa śātitāḥ ||28|| bhayaṃ visṛjya yuddhāya gaccha tasmātsurairvṛtaḥ || iti śrutvā śacīvākyaṃ śakro namucisūdanaḥ ||29|| na cakāra tu yuddhāya mano bhayasamanvitaḥ || tataśca bahuśaḥ patnyā preritaḥ kopayuktayā ||30|| tadā kopena śrīkṛṣṇaṃ nindanprāha madānvitaḥ || indra uvāca yena te parijātaṃ vai gṛhītaṃ sundarānane ||31|| mṛdhe taṃ pātayiṣyāmi vajreṇa śataparvaṇā || ityuktvā vāsavo rājannāruhyairāvataṃ gajam ||32|| śuṇḍādaṃḍaistribhiryuktaṃ raktakaṃbalamaṃḍitam || caturbhiḥ śobhitaṃ dantairhimādrisadṛśaṃ śubham ||33|| svarṇaśṛṅkhalayā juṣṭaṃ śuśubhe nirjarairvṛtaḥ || tathā marudgaṇāḥ sarve yamāgnivaruṇādayaḥ ||34|| rudrāśca dvādaśātmāno vasavo dhanadādayaḥ || vidyādharāśca gaṃdharvāḥ sādhyāḥ pitṛgaṇādayaḥ ||35|| tatastriṃśatkoṭisaṃkhyāḥ śakrasyānucarāḥ surāḥ || ete samāgatāḥ kruddhā yoddhuṃ śrīkṛṣṇasaṃmukhe ||36|| āhūtāḥ ke'pi śakreṇa sahāyārthaṃ tu svātmanaḥ || tathā tu nāradenāpi keciddevāstu preṣitāḥ ||37|| tataḥ parighanistriṃśagadāśūlaparaśvadhaiḥ || babhūvustridaśāḥ sajjāḥ śakre vajrakare sthite ||38|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāmaśvamedhacaritre sumerau pārijātaharaṇaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||4|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.5> garga uvāca atha dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇacandro gajendropari śobhitam || iṃdraṃ devaparīvāraṃ yuddhāya samupasthitam ||1|| śaṃkhaṃ daghmau svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śabdenāpūrayandiśaḥ || mumoca ca śaravrātaṃ sahasāyudhasaṃmitam ||2|| tato diśaśca gaganaṃ dṛṣṭvā bāṇaśatānvitam || mumucurvibudhāḥ sarve śarāścakrāyudhopari||3|| ekaikamastraṃ śastraṃ ca surairmuktaṃ sahasradhā || svabāṇairbhagavānkṛṣṇaściccheda nṛpa līlayā ||4|| pāśinaścāhipāśaṃ ca cicchide pannagāśanaḥ || yamarājena prahitaṃ daṃḍaṃ lokabhayaṃkaram ||5|| gadayā pātayāmāsa bhūmau kṛṣṇastu līlayā || cakreṇa dhanadasyāpi śibikāṃ tilako bahu ||6|| cakāra kṛṣṇaḥ sūryaṃ ca kopadṛṣṭyā hataujasam || mahāgnimāgataṃ vīkṣya mukhena ca papau hariḥ ||7|| tato rudragaṇairmuktāñśūlāṃściccheda vai ruṣā || cakreṇa ca harī rudrānpātayāmāsa bāhunā ||8|| tato marudgaṇā devāḥ sādhyā vidyādharāstathā || mumucurbāṇapaṭalānmādhavopari bhūpate ||9|| śaravarṣaṃ pramuṃcaṃtīṃ senāṃ sarvāṃ samāgatām || vilokya satyabhāmā tu bhayaṃ prāpa tadā mṛdhe ||10|| tāṃ bhītāṃ prāha goviṃdaḥ satye tvaṃ mā bhayaṃ kuru || āgatāṃ śakrasenāṃ vai haniṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||11|| ityuktvā bhagavānkruddho bāṇaiḥ śārṅgadhanuścyutaiḥ || tāḍayāmāsa vibudhānkroṣṭūnsiṃho nakhairyathā ||12|| tataḥ pratyāha garuḍaṃ kaṃsahā kopapūritaḥ || vainateya tvayā yuddhaṃ na kṛtaṃ raṇamaṃḍale ||13|| tacchrutvā tu sabhāryaṃ ca skandhe saṃdhārayanharim || kopādviṣṇurathaḥ sadyaḥ pakṣābhyāṃ nakharāṃkuraiḥ ||14|| tuṃḍena bhakṣayandevāṃstāḍayanvicacāra vai || tataśca dudruvurdevā hanyamānā garutmatā ||15|| atha bāṇairmahīpāla iṃdropendrau mahābalau || parasparaṃ ca varṣaṃtau dhārābhiriva toyadau ||16|| airāvatena rājeṃdra suparṇo yuyudhe tadā || gajastārkṣyaṃ tu daśanairjaghāna garuḍastathā ||17|| gajaṃ tu tuṃḍapakṣaiśca chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ cakāra ha || suraiḥ samastairyuyudhe vajriṇā ca yadūttamaḥ ||18|| bhagavānmaghavaṃtaṃ vai maghavā madhusūdan || bāṇairvavṛṣatuḥ kruddhāvanyonyavijigīṣiṇau ||19|| chinneṣvastreṣu bāṇeṣu śastreṣvastreṣu ca tvaram || vajraṃ jagrāha maghavā bhagavām̐ścakrameva ca ||20|| hāhākārastadaivāsīttrailokye sacarācare || vajracakradharau vīkṣya sureśvaranareśvarau ||21|| jagrāha vāmahastena kṣiptaṃ vajraṃ ca vajriṇā || na mucoca hariścakraṃ tiṣṭha tiṣṭhetyuvāca ca ||22|| lajjitaṃ vajrahīnaṃ ca tārkṣyeṇa kṣatavāhanam || bhītaṃ palāyamānaṃ cālokya satyā jahāsa vai ||23|| śacī vīkṣyāgataṃ śakraṃ prāha kopena pūritā || ekākinā mādhavena pradhane tu vinirjitaḥ ||24|| mahāsainyayutastvaṃ vai tasmātte dhigbalaṃ sura || ahaṃ gatvā raṇe kṛṣṇaṃ vinirjitya suradrumam ||25|| mocayāmi na saṃdehaḥ paśya tvaṃ ca surādhama || garga uvāca ityuktvā śibikāṃ śīghramāruhya kupitā śacī ||26|| yoddhukāmā yayau rājanpunaḥ suragaṇairvṛtā || tāmāgatāṃ vīkṣya kṛṣṇo yuddhāya na dadhe manaḥ ||27|| tataḥ satyā hariṃ prāha ruṣā prasphuritādharā || adya yuddhaṃ kariṣyāmi śacyā sārddhamahaṃ prabho ||28|| tacchrutvā prahasankṛṣṇo dattvā tasyai sudarśanam || sthāpayitvā suparṇe ca jagrāha dyutaruṃ svayam ||29|| yadā haripriyā kruddhā yuddhaṃ kartuṃ samāgatā || tadā sarvatra brahmāṃḍe cāsītkolāhalo mahān ||30|| bhayaṃ prāpuḥ surāḥ sarve vidhiśakrādayo nṛpa || tadaiva gīṣpatī rājannāyayau śakranoditaḥ ||31|| āgatya vārayāmāsa yoddhukāmāṃ pulomajām || bṛhaspatiruvāca śacī śṛṇu madīyaṃ vai vacanaṃ bahubuddhidam ||32|| kṛṣṇastu bhagavānsākṣātsatyabhāmā ca dhīmatī || tayā sārddhaṃ kathaṃ yuddhaṃ kariṣyasi haripriye ||33|| tasmādavajñāṃ saṃtyajya ṛbhukṣe tvaṃ gṛhaṃ vraja || satyāṃ vai pārijātaṃ ca datvā rakṣa surānbhayāt ||34|| yadbhayādvāti pavano vahnirdahati yadbhayāt || bhayādyanmṛtyuścarati bradhno vrajati yadbhayāt ||35|| yasmādbibheti brahmā vai kapardī ca puraṃdaraḥ || taṃ na jānāsi kṛṣṇaṃ vai bhaumaṃ hatvā samāgatam ||36|| garga uvāca iti śrutvā śacī vākyaṃ bhāmāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca lajjayā || natvā jagāma sadanamātmanaṃ ca vigarhatī ||37|| tataḥ śakraṃ namaṃtaṃ ca vrīḍitaṃ vīkṣya mādhavaḥ || uvāca śakra mā vrīḍāṃ gate ca bhidure kuru ||38|| dvaṃdvayuddhe hi caikasya bhaviṣyati parājayaḥ || iti śrutvā ca provāca vacanaṃ pākaśāsanaḥ ||39|| indra uvāca yasmiñjagatsakalametadanādimadhye yasmādyataśca na bhaviṣyati sarvabhūtāt || tenodbhavapralayapālanakāraṇena vrīḍā kathaṃ bhavati devi nirākṛtasya ||40|| sakalabhuvanasūtermūrtiranyātisūkṣmā viditasakalavedyairjñāyate yasya nānyaiḥ || tamajamakṛtamīśaṃ śāśvataṃ svecchayainaṃ jagadupakṛtimartyaṃ ko vijetuṃ samarthaḥ ||41|| ityuktvā satyabhāmāṃ vai śakrastūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha || tataḥ prahasya bhagavānprāha gaṃbhīrayā girā ||42|| bhavāndevādhipaḥ śakra vayaṃ bhūminivāsinaḥ || kṣaṃtavyamaparādhaṃ tadbhavatā ca kṛtaṃ mayā ||43|| bhoḥ śakra pārijātaśca nīyatāmucitāspadam || gṛhīto'yaṃ mayā satyabhāmāvacanakāraṇāt ||44|| gṛhāṇa kuliśaṃ cedaṃ prahitaṃ yattvayā mayi || tavaivāstraṃ śunāsīra tadvairiṣu nivāraṇam ||45|| indra uvāca kṛṣṇa kiṃ mohayasi māṃ naro'hamiti kiṃ vada || jānīmastvāṃ jagannāthaṃ na tu sūkṣmavido vayam ||46|| yo'si so'si jagattrāṇa pravṛttau nātha saṃsthitiḥ || viśvasya śalyaniṣkarṣaṃ karoṣi garuḍadhvaja ||47|| ayaṃ ca nīyatāṃ kṛṣṇa pārijātaḥ kuśasthalīm || naraloke tvayā tyakte nāyaṃ saṃsthāsyate bhuvi ||48|| āgamiṣyati govinda svayameva triviṣṭapam || śrīgarga uvāca tacchrutvā vajriṇe vajraṃ dattvā so'pyājagāma kau ||49|| dvārakāṃ dvārakānāthaḥ stūyamānaḥ sureśvaraiḥ || upādhmāya tataḥ kaṃbuṃ saṃsthito dvārakopari ||50|| utpādayāmāsa mudaṃ dvārakāvāsināṃ nṛpa || suparṇādavatīryātha kṛṣṇo bhāmāsamanvitaḥ ||51|| pārijātaṃ ca niṣkūṭe sthāpayāmāsa līlayā || juṣṭaṃ suradrumaṃ kṛṣṇo bhramaraiḥ svargapakṣibhiḥ ||52|| athaikasminmuhūrte vai mādhave mādhavaḥ svayam || uvāha rājakanyāśca pṛthaggeheṣu dharmataḥ ||53|| ṣoḍaśastrīsahasrāṇi aṣṭādhikaśatāni ca || tāvaṃti cakre rūpāṇi paripūrṇatamo hariḥ ||54|| ekaikasyāṃ daśa daśa kṛṣṇo'jījanadātmajān || yāvatya ātmano bhāryā amoghagatirīśvaraḥ ||55|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāmaśvamedhakhaṃḍe śrīgargavajranābhasaṃvāde pārijātānayanaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ ||5|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.6> śrīgarga uvāca punaste kathayiṣyāmi yaśaḥ saṃkṣepato hareḥ || cakāra hāsyaṃ bhagavānrukmiṇyā saha cādbhutam ||1|| aniruddhavivāhe cāvadhīdbhrātrā tu rukmiṇam || ūṣāsvapnakathā citralekhayā haraṇaṃ hareḥ ||2|| pautrasya bandhanaṃ cāpi bāṇayādavasaṃyugaḥ || kṛṣṇaśaṃkarayoryuddhe jvarasaṃstavanaṃ tataḥ ||3|| bāṇabāhucchido rudrastutirbāṇasya rakṣaṇe || ūṣāprāptirnṛgākhyānaṃ balasya ca vrajāgamam ||4|| gopīvilāpo rāmasya stutirgopībhireva ca || yamunākarṣaṇaṃ kāśīpatipauṃḍrakaghātanam ||5|| kṛtyotpattirdāhanaṃ ca kāśyāḥ kapivadhastataḥ || sāṃbasya bandhane rāmavikramo gajasāhvaye ||6|| ugrasenarājasūye jaghāna śakuniṃ hariḥ || nāradena harerlīlādarśanaṃ gṛhamedhinām ||7|| āhnikaṃ vāsudevasya rājadūtena vai stutiḥ || indraprasthe ca gamanamuddhavena ca yādavaiḥ ||8|| jarāsandhaṃ ca bhīmena nijaghāna girivraje || sahadevābhiṣekaṃ ca rājabhiśca kṛtā stutiḥ ||9|| rājasūye hareḥ pūjā śiśupālavadhastathā || duryodhanābhimānasya bhaṃgaḥ pradyumnaśālvayoḥ ||10|| yuddhaṃ trinavarātraṃ ca kṛṣṇasyāgamanaṃ tataḥ || śālvasya dantavaktrasya tadbhrāturlīlayā vadhaḥ ||11|| tato gajāhvaye rājandurdyūtena ca kauravaiḥ || vinirjito bhrātṛyuktaḥ sabhāryastu yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||12|| vanaṃ jagāma saṃsthāpya pṛthāṃ ca viduragṛhe || gatvāraṇye nivāsaṃ vai cakāra bahubhirdinaiḥ ||13|| tataśca pālayāmāsa mahīṃ duryodhano mudā || prajāstaṃ nābhyanandansma pāṃḍuputre gate sati ||14|| araṇye vartamānānvai pāṃḍavānduḥkhakarṣitān || militvā''śvāsayāmāsa hyanaṃtaścaikadā hariḥ ||15|| dṛṣṭvātha pāṃḍavānkṛṣṇo hyājagāma kuśasthalīm || ugrasenasudharmāyāṃ śaśaṃsa ceṣṭitaṃ ca tat ||16|| tacca śrutvā yādavāśca procuḥ sarve hi vismitāḥ || yādavā ūcuḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa dīnā bhrātṛsutā aho ||17|| durdyūtena vinirjityādharmānniṣkāsitā gṛhāt || svādharmeṇa vinaśyaṃti kauravā rājyalolupāḥ ||18|| pāṃḍavebhyastu bhagavāṃstasmāddāsyati saṃpadam || garga uvāca iti śrutvā yādavānāṃ vākyaṃ ca madhusūdanaḥ ||19|| āyayau vai svabhavanaṃ sāyaṃkāle nṛpeśvara || āgataṃ svātmajaṃ vīkṣya namaṃtaṃ devakī mudā ||20|| datvā''śiṣaṃ bhojanaṃ ca kārayāmāsa vai satī ||21|| tataḥ sa cāyayau kṛṣṇaḥ svastrīṇāṃ maṃdirāṇi ca || priyābhiḥ pūjitastatra cakāra śayanaṃ kila ||22|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāmaśvamedhakhaṃḍe śrīkṛṣṇacaritravarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ ||6|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.7> garga uvāca devarṣiścaikadā rājandṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ ca keśavam || svavīṇāṃ vādayankṛṣṇagāthāṃ gāyansamāyayau ||1|| brahmalokātsarvalokānpaśyanbhāskarasannibhaḥ || sākaṃ tuṃbaruṇā piṃgajaṭābhāreṇa śobhitaḥ ||2|| kiṃcicchyāmo mṛgākṣaśca kāśmīratilakairvṛtaḥ || pītena dhautavastreṇa tathā pītāṃbareṇa ca || raṃgavallīmālayā ca vrajastrīcaṃdanena ca || vṛddhaḥ paṃcadaśābdaiśca maṃḍitaḥ śuśubhe bahu ||4|| dṛṣṭvā tamāgataṃ rājā śakrasiṃhāsane sthitaḥ || sudharmāyāṃ sa cotthāya natvā siṃhāsanaṃ dadau ||5|| tadaṃghrī cāvanijyātha kṛtvā pūjanamuttamam || tajjalaṃ mastake dhṛtvā cograsenastamabravīt ||6|| ugrasena uvāca adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ sadanaṃ ca me || adyame saphalaścātmā devarṣe tava darśanāt ||7|| namastasmai bhagavate nāradāya mahātmane || kāmakrodhavihīnāya ṛṣīṇāṃ pravarāya ca ||8|| kimarthamāgato'si tvamājñāṃ kuru mamopari || niśamya vacanaṃ tasya ṛṣirnirjaradarśanaḥ ||9|| uvāca nṛpaśārdūlaṃ manasā nodito hareḥ || nārada uvāca yādaveṃdra mahārāja dhanyastvaṃ pṛthivīpate ||10|| tvadbhaktyā kau nivasati balena saha keśavaḥ || rājasūyaḥ kratuvaraḥ purā madvacanāttvayā ||11|| kṛtaḥ śrīkṛṣṇakṛpayā dvārakāyāṃ sukhena ca || yena triloke te kīrtirnṛpa vistāritā bhuvi ||12|| rājasūyāśvamedhau ca kaṭhinau maṃḍaleśvaraiḥ || haribhaktasya rājendra sulabhau cakravartinaḥ ||13|| dvayormadhye kṛtaścaiko rājasūyastvayā nṛpa || tathā yudhiṣṭhireṇāpi kṛtaḥ kṛṣṇājñayā tataḥ ||14|| dvāparāṃte bhārate tu hayamedhaḥ kratūttamaḥ || na kṛtaḥ kena rājñāpi muktidastvaghanāśanaḥ ||15|| dvijahā viśvahā goghno vājimedhena śuddhyati || tasmādvaraṃ ca yajñānāṃ hayamedhaṃ vadaṃti hi ||16|| niṣkāraṇaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha vājimedhaṃ karoti yaḥ || vrajetsuparṇaketoḥ sa sadanaṃ siddhadurlabham ||17|| iti devarṣivacanamugraseno niśamya ca || hayamedhaṃ yajñavaraṃ kartuṃ cakre matiṃ nṛpa ||18|| tadaiva saha rāmeṇa kṛṣṇaṃ vīkṣyāgataṃ nṛpaḥ || pūjayitvā''sane sthāpya sākaṃ ca ṛṣiṇābravīt ||19|| ugrasena uvāca devadeva jagannātha jagadīśa jaganmaya || vāsudeva trilokeśa śṛṇuṣva vacamaṃ mama ||20|| matputreṇa ca kaṃsena bālakāśca sahasraśaḥ || vināparādhena hare māritāśca mahāsuraiḥ ||21|| tasya muktiśca goviṃdaṃ kathaṃ bhavati pāpinaḥ || kasmim̐loke gataḥ kaṃso bālāghātī vadasva me ||22|| tasya pāpenāhamapi bhīto'smi jagadīśvara || putrasya pāpena pitā narake patati dhruvam ||23|| pituḥ pāpena patati niraye hi tathā sutaḥ || tasmācca kiṃ kāriṣye'hamupāyaṃ vada mādhava ||24|| kathitaṃ nāradenādya tacchṛṇuṣva jagatpate || viprahā viśvahā goghno hayamedhena śudhyati ||25|| tasmin yajñe mano me'sti yadi cājñāṃ pradāsyasi || garga uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā mudā madanamohanaḥ ||26|| manasi prāha saṃpaśyandharāṃ bhāreṇa pīḍitām || aho mayā tu bahuśo dharābhāro'vatāritaḥ ||27|| tathāpi sati kau madhye so'śvamedhena naśyati || nāhaṃ haniṣye śatrūn vai svahastena mṛdhāṃgaṇe ||28|| iti pratijñā tu kṛtā vidūrathavadhe mayā || tasmācca preṣayiṣyāmi svaputrān yādavāṃstathā ||29|| jetuṃ vasuṃdharāṃ sarvāṃ hayamedhamiṣeṇa ca || iti vārtāṃ vajranābhe viṣvakseno vicārya ca ||30|| sudharmāyāṃ ca prahasannugrasenamuvāca vai || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca mayā hato mahārāja kaṃso vaikuṃṭhamaṃdiram ||31|| gato bhūtvā mamākāraḥ nityaṃ vasati tatra vai || tathā tvamapi rājeṃdra vipāpo darśanānmama ||32|| tathāpi hayamedhaṃ tvaṃ yaśo'rthe kuru bhūpate || yajñena te mahatkīrtiḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca bhaviṣyati ||33|| iti tatkathitaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ || uvāca paramaṃ vākyamugraseno mudā nṛpa ||34|| rājovāca adya deva kariṣye'hamaśvamedhaṃ kratūttamam || sa bhaviṣyati śīghraṃ vai goviṃda kṛpayā tava ||35|| hayamedhasya ca vidhiṃ sarvaṃ me brūhi vistarāt || iti śrutvā ca tadvākyamavocadviṣṭaraśravāḥ ||36|| hayamedhavidhiṃ pṛccha devarṣiṃ nāradaṃ prati || sa tavāgre ca vadati sarvajñātā yadūdvaha ||37|| iti vākyaṃ hareḥ śrutvā yadurājo mudānvitaḥ || sabhāyāṃ saṃsthitaṃ rājandevarṣiṃ nijagāda ha ||38|| turaṃgaḥ kīdṛśo bhāvyaḥ katisaṃkhyā dvijottamāḥ || dakṣiṇā kīdṛśī brahman vada me kīdṛśaṃ vratam ||39|| ugrasenasya vacanamākarṇya devadarśanaḥ || smayamāna iva prāha prītyā kṛṣṇaṃ vilokayan ||40|| śrīnārada uvāca caṃdravarṇaṃ raktamukhaṃ pītapucchaṃ manoharam || sarvāṃgasuṃdaraṃ divyaṃ śyāmakarṇaṃ sulocanam ||41|| pravadaṃti mahārāja yajñe'sminhayamīdṛśam || madhumāse pūrṇimāyāṃ mocyo'yaṃ ghoṭako nṛpa ||42|| mahāvīraiḥ pālanīyo varṣamātraṃ hayottamaḥ || aśvasyāgamanaṃ yāvadbhaviṣyati svake pure ||43|| nivaseddhairyasaṃyuktastāvatkartā prayatnataḥ || yatra yatra purīṣaṃ ca mūtraṃ ca kurute hayaḥ ||44|| kartavyaṃ havanaṃ viprairdātavyaṃ gosahasrakam || saṃlikhya kāṃcanaṃ patraṃ svanāmabalacihnitam ||45|| hayasya bhāle baddhvā ca kathanīyamidaṃ vacaḥ || sarve śṛṇuta rājāno vimukto'sti hayo mayā ||46|| kaścidbhūyaḥ śyāmakarṇaṃ pratigṛhṇātu cedbalāt || gṛhṇāti yastaṃ mānena sa jetavyo balātsvayam ||47|| viprā viṃśatisāhasrā yajñādau kīrtitā nṛpa || vedajñāḥ sarvaśāstrajñāḥ kulīnāśca tapasvinaḥ ||48|| atra te kathayiṣyāmi samarthastvaṃ śṛṇuṣva ca || vājimedhe mahārāja viprāṇāṃ dīrghadakṣiṇām ||49|| turagāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca gajānāṃ śatameva ca || dviśataṃ syaṃdanānāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca gavāṃ tathā ||50|| viṃśadbhāraṃ suvarṇānāṃ pradātavyaṃ dvije dvije || yajñasyādau tathā cāṃte īdṛśī dakṣiṇā matā ||51|| asipatravrataṃ kṛtvā brahmacaryasamanvitaḥ || kau patnyā sārddhamekatra kuryācca śayanaṃ nīśi ||52|| varṣamātraṃ mahārāja kartavyaṃ vratamīdṛśam || dīnānāṃ ca pradātavyamannaṃ vā bahuśo dhanam ||53|| vidhinānena rājeṃdra kratureṣa bhaviṣyati || asipatravratayuto bahuputraphalapradaḥ ||54|| bhīṣmaṃ vinā hi madanaṃ ko vijetuṃ bhavennaraḥ || tasmādbhītā na kurvaṃti kaṭhinaṃ cainamadbhutam ||55|| kāmaṃ prativijetuṃ vai śaktiste vidyate yadi || kuru gargaṃ samāhūya yajñāraṃbhaṃ nṛpottama ||56|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāmaśvamedhakhaṃḍe yajñodyogavarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||7|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.8> śrīgarga uvāca iti tadvākyamākarṇya spaṣṭākṣarasamanvitam || rājarṣiḥ prāha devarṣiṃ vismitaḥ prahasanniva ||1|| rājovāca mune yajñaṃ kariṣye'haṃ yajñayogyaṃ turaṃgamam || gatvā mamāśvaśālāyāṃ hayānāṃ tvaṃ vilokaya ||2|| nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā tathetyuktvā ca nāradaḥ || vājiśālāṃ yayau tena dugdhābhāñjalasannibhān ||3|| sa gatvā tatra turagāndhūmravarṇānmanoharān || śyāmavarṇānkṛṣṇavarṇānpadmavarṇāndadarśa vai ||4|| tathā cānyatra śālāyāṃ mugdhābhāñjalasannibhān || haridrābhānkuṃkumābhānpalāśakusumaprabhān ||5|| tathā citravicitrāṃgānsphaṭikāṃgānmanojavān || tathā cānyatra śālāyāṃ kausuṃbhāṃgāñśukaprabhān ||6|| iṃdragopanibhāngaurāndivyānpūrṇaśaśiprabhān || siṃdūrāṃgānagnivarṇānbālasūryasamānnṛpa ||7|| īdṛśāṃśca hayāndṛṣṭvā nārado vismayānvitaḥ || uvāca kṛṣṇasahitamugrasenaṃ hasanniva ||8|| nārada uvāca vājinaste mahārāja sarve hi bahusuṃdarāḥ || īdṛśā naiva svarloke pṛthivyāṃ ca rasātale ||9|| vartate vājiśālāyāṃ kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā tava || eko'pi śyāmakarṇastu teṣāṃ madhye na dṛśyate ||10|| śrīgarga uvāca niśamya vākyaṃ devarṣernṛpastu duḥkhito'bhavat || yajño bhaviṣyati kathaṃ manasīti vicārayan ||11|| udāsīnaṃ nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ || avocatprahasañśīghraṃ meghagaṃbhīrayā girā ||12|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca śṛṇu madvacanaṃ rājansarvaṃ śokaṃ vihāya ca || gatvā mamāśvaśālāṃ vai śyāmakarṇaṃ vilokaya ||13|| ityudīritamākarṇya kṛṣṇena ca surarṣiṇā || hareśca vājiśālāṃ hi jagāma nṛpasattamaḥ ||14|| dadarśa tāṃ sa gatvā ca yajñayogyānsahasraśaḥ || śyāmakarṇānpītapucchāṃścandravarṇānmanojavān ||15|| sarvāṃgasuṃdarāndivyām̐staptahemamukhāñśubhān || etāndṛṣṭvā hayān rājā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ||16|| harṣeṇa mahatā yuktaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ natvābravīdvacaḥ || rājovāca śyāmakarṇāśca bahuśo mayā cādya nirīkṣitāḥ ||17|| durlabhaṃ kiṃ jagannātha tvadbhaktānāṃ dharātale || yathā manorathaḥ pūrvaṃ prahlādasya dhruvasya ca ||18|| āsīttvatkṛpayā kṛṣṇa tathā mama manorathaḥ || iti śrutvā harī rājan śārṅgī bhūpamavocata ||19|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ekaṃ tvaṃ śyāmakarṇānāmaśvānāṃ candravarcasām || gṛhītvā nṛpaśārdūla kuru yajñaṃ mamājñayā ||20|| garga uvāca śrutvā vākyaṃ hariṃ prāha kariṣye'haṃ kratūttamam || ityuktvā tena sahito nāradena sabhāṃ yayau ||21|| tataḥ kṛṣṇamanujñāpya nāradaḥ sahatumburuḥ || rājānamāśiṣaṃ datvā svayaṃbhūsadanaṃ yayau ||22|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāmaśvamedhakhaṃḍe turaṃgadarśanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.9> garga uvāca atha rājā kuśasthalyāṃ gate devarṣisattame || svadūtānpreṣayāmāsa māmānetuṃ nṛpeśvara ||1|| ta ūcurugrasenasya mamāgre vacanaṃ narāḥ || dūtā ūcuḥ devadeva mune brahmanbhūdevānāṃ śiromaṇe ||2|| asmākaṃ vacanaṃ sarvaṃ kṛpayā śṛṇu vistarāt || kṛṣṇecchayā dvārakāyāmugrasenena bho mune ||3|| nirūpitaṃ kratuvaraṃ tava śiṣyeṇa dhīmatā || tvamāgaccha mune śīghraṃ tasmin yajñamahotsave ||4|| śrīgarga uvāca teṣāmahaṃ vacaḥ śrutvā jagmivāndvārakāṃ purīm || gargācalānnṛpaśreṣṭha yajñakautukasaṃyutaḥ ||5|| tato dṛṣṭā purī dūrāccānarte dvārakā mayā || nānādrumagaṇairjuṣṭā nānācopavanairyutā ||6|| nānātaḍāgairvāpībhirnānāpakṣigaṇaistathā || nīlaraktasitāṃbhojaiḥ pītapadmaiḥ sarovarāḥ || rājaṃte kumudaiścaiva śukapuṣpairnṛpeśvara ||7|| bilvaiḥ kadaṃbairnyagrodhaiḥ śālaistālaistamālakaiḥ || bakulairnāgapunnāgaiḥ kovidāraiśca pippalaiḥ || jambīrairhārasiṃgārairāmrairāmrātakairapi ||8|| ketakībhirgostanībhiḥ kadalībhiśca jambubhiḥ || śrīphalaiḥ piṃḍakharjūraiḥ khadiraiḥ patrabiṃdubhiḥ ||9|| agaraistagaraiścaiva candanai raktacandanaiḥ || palāśaiśca kapitthaiśca plakṣairvetraiśca veṇubhiḥ ||10|| mallikābhiryūthikābhirmodinībhirmahīruhaiḥ || tathā madanabāṇaiśca sahasrāṃśumukhadrumaiḥ ||11|| priyāvaṃśairgulmavaṃśaiḥ karṇikāraiśca puṣpitaiḥ || sahasrākhyaiḥ kandukairvai cāgastyaiśca sudarśanaiḥ ||12|| candrakākhyaiśca kundaiśca karṇapuṣpaiśca dāḍimaiḥ || anujīrairnāgaraṃgairāḍukījānakīphalaiḥ ||13|| pūgīphalairbadāmaiśca tūlai rājādanaidrumaiḥ || elābhiḥ sevatībhiśca tathā vai devadārubhiḥ ||14|| īdṛśaiśca mahāvṛkṣaiḥ śobhitā nagarī hareḥ || kūjaṃti yatra rājendra mayūrāḥ sārasāḥ śukāḥ ||15|| haṃsāḥ pārāvatāścaiva kapotāḥ kokilāstathā || sārikāścakravākāśca khaṃjanāścaṭakāḥ kila ||16|| ete pakṣigaṇāḥ sarve vaikuṇṭhācca samāgatāḥ || kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ gāyaṃti yatra hi ||17|| itthaṃ paśyan vrajanrājandadarśa dvārakāmaham || tāmraraupyasuvarṇaiśca tribhirdurgaiśca veṣṭitām ||18|| giriṇā raivatenāpi devavṛkṣamayenaca ca || ratnākareṇa gomatyā''vṛtāṃ parikhabhūtayā ||19|| kṛṣṇasya nagarīṃ ramyāṃ kṛtakautukatoraṇām || mudāyuktajanākīrṇāṃ suvarṇabhavanairyutām ||20|| tathā hāṭakahaṭṭābhiḥ patākābhiśca maṃḍitām || viṣṇośca maṃdiraiḥ proccairmaheśasyālayairyutām ||21|| yadubhiśca mahāśūrairvimānaiśca sahasraśaḥ || śataśṛṅgāṭakaiścaiva kalaśairbharmakarburaiḥ ||22|| rathyābhirmaṃdurābhiśca daṃtiśālābhireva ca || gośālābhiśca śālābhiḥ suraupyapathibhiryutām ||23|| prāsādairnavalakṣaiśca kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ || tathā ṣoḍaśasāhasrairbhavanairveṣṭitāṃ purīm ||24|| dvāre dvāre dvārakāyāṃ śūrā vīrāśca koṭiśaḥ || rakṣaṃtyaharniśaṃ rājansarvaśastradharāḥ kila ||25|| pragāyaṃti janāḥ sarve śrīkṛṣṇabaladevayoḥ || gṛhe gṛhe ca nāmāni śṛṇvanti caritāni ca ||26|| itthaṃ vilokayansarvānsudharmāyāmahaṃ gataḥ || kṛṣṇeti pādukārūḍhastulasīmālayā japan ||27|| athograseno rājarṣirdṛṣṭvā māṃ ca samāgatam || samutthāya mudāyuktaḥ śakrasiṃhāsanātkila ||28|| ṣaṭpaṃcāśatkoṭisaṃkhyairyādavaiḥ saha bhūpate || natvā siṃhāsane sthāpya pūjayāmāsa cāhukaḥ ||29|| madaṃghrī cāvanijyātha yādavānāṃ ca sannidhau || pādodakaṃ svaśirasi dhṛtvā prāha nṛpeśvaraḥ ||30|| ugesena uvāca vipreṃdra nāradamukhācchrutaṃ yasya mahatphalam || taṃ yajñamaśvamedhākhyaṃ kariṣye'haṃ tavājñayā ||31|| yasyāṃghrisevayā pūrve manorathamahārṇavam || terurjagattṛṇīkṛtya sa kṛṣṇaścātra varttate ||32|| śrīgarga uvāca yādaveṃdra mahārāja samyagvyasitaṃ tvayā || hayamedhena te kīrtistrilokyāṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ||33|| kaḥ prayāsyati rakṣārthaṃ turagasya nṛpeśvara || bahavaḥ śatravaḥ saṃti tasmāttaṃ niścayaṃ kuru ||34|| varṣamātraṃ prakartavyamasipatravrataṃ tvayā || tadā tu kuśalenāpi bhaviṣyati kratūttamaḥ ||35|| pradyumnena rājasūye jitā sarvā mahī purā || turaṅgāsyādya rakṣārthaṃ taṃ punaḥ kiṃ niyokṣyasi ||36|| iti madvacanaṃ śrutvā rājā ciṃtāparāyaṇaḥ || dadarśa saṃsthitaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ harim ||37|| tadaiva bhagavāndṛṣṭvā śokenāpūritaṃ nṛpam || tāmbūlavīṭakaṃ nītvā prahasannidamabravīt ||38|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca bhoḥ śūrā yādavāḥ sarve balino raṇakovidāḥ || ugrasenasya cāgre vai śṛṇvantu mama bhāṣitam ||39|| yo mocayati rājabhyo hayamedhaturaṃgamam || mahārathī manasvī ca so'yaṃ gṛhṇātu vīṭakam ||40|| iti śrutvā harervākyaṃ yādavā yuddhakovidāḥ || parasparaṃ prapaśyanto gatamānāḥ punaḥ punaḥ ||41|| saṃsthito ghaṭikāmātraṃ reje tāmbūlabīṭakaḥ || kṛṣṇasya suṃdare haste yathā tāmarase śukaḥ ||42|| tataśca sarveṣu gateṣu tūṣṇīmūṣāpatiścāpadharo mahātmā || pragṛhya tāṃbūlacayaṃ nṛpendra natvā ca kṛṣṇaṃ nijagāda sadyaḥ ||43|| śrīaniruddha uvāca ahaṃ hi śyāmakarṇasya rājanyebhyaśca pālanam || kariṣyāmi jagannātha tasmānmāṃ tvaṃ niyojaya ||44|| na kariṣye ghoṭakasya pālanaṃ yadi tacchṛṇu || pratijñāṃ mama goviṃda dīnasya dīnavatsala ||45|| brāhmaṇīgamanātkṣatrī vaiśyasya śūdra eva ca || yāṃ gatiṃ prāpnuyānnūnaṃ tāmahaṃ duḥkhadāyinīm ||46|| vipraṃ kṛtvā guruṃ pūrvaṃ paścāttaṃ yo na sevate || sa yāti yāṃ gatiṃ deva prāpnuyāṃ tāmahaṃ dhruvam ||47|| garga uvāca iti tadvākyamākarṇya yādavā vismayaṃ gatāḥ || tadaiva kṛṣṇaḥ saṃtuṣṭo jagrāha pautrameva ca ||48|| tato hariḥ sudharmāyāmaniruddhaṃ kṛtāṃjalim || sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ prāha ghananirhādayā girā ||49|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca aniruddha turaṃgasya varṣamātraṃ ca pālanam || rājanyebhyaśca kṛtvā tvaṃ punarāgaccha cātra vai ||50|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhacaritre sumerau gargāgamanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ ||9|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.10> śrīgarga uvāca iti bruvati śrīkṛṣṇe haṃsasthaścaturānanaḥ || ājagāma kuśasthalyāmīśvareṇa samanvitaḥ ||1|| tata indraḥ kuberaśca yamo varuṇa eva ca || vāyurvāyusakhāścaiva nairṛtaśca niśākaraḥ ||2|| ete samāyayū rājankṛṣṇadarśanakāṃkṣayā || tataśca dvādaśādityā vetālāśca marudgaṇāḥ ||3|| viśvedevāśca sādhyāśca gaṃdharvāḥ kinnarāstathā || vidyādharāśca munayaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭumāyayuḥ ||4|| tatrāgatānāṃ devānāmugrasenena mādhavaḥ || yathāvidhyupasaṃgamya sarveṣāṃ mānamādadhe ||5|| āsaneṣūpaviṣṭeṣu sabhāyāṃ nirjareṣvatha || ślāghāṃ cakāra sarveṣāṃ līlānaravapurhariḥ ||6|| atha brahmā hareḥ pārśve sthitaḥ śakreṇa noditaḥ || pratyuvāca jagannāthaṃ balabhadrasamanvitam ||7|| brahmovāca pautraste bālakaḥ kṛṣṇa rājanyebhyaśca pālanam || kaṭhinaṃ śyāmakarṇasya kariṣyati kathaṃ hare ||8|| mā taṃ preṣaya tasmāttvaṃ rakṣaṇāya hayasya vai || vighnāśca bahavaḥ santi pradyumnaṃ preṣayasva ca ||9|| saṃkarṣaṇaṃ vā govinda hyathavā rakṣa tvaṃ hayam || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā nijagau prahasanhariḥ ||10|| śrībhagavānuvāca aniruddho haṭhādyāti manniṣedhaṃ na manyate || tasmāttannikaṭe gatvā niṣedhaṃ kuru yatnataḥ ||11|| kṛṣṇasya vākyamākarṇya vidhiścaṃdrasamanvitaḥ || yayau nivāraṇārthāyāniruddhaṃ kārṣṇinandanam ||12|| yadā gatau samīpe tu surajyeṣṭhakalānidhī || vigrahe hyaniruddhasya sadyastau līnatāṃ gatau ||13|| babhūvurvismitāḥ sarve śivaśakrādayaḥ surāḥ || yādavā munayaścaiva hyugrasenādayo nṛpāḥ || 14|| vajranābha tvatpitaraṃ saṃstuvanti gaṇāḥ kila || paripūrṇatamaṃ tasmādaniruddhaṃ vadaṃti hi ||15|| garga uvāca athograseno nṛpatiḥ sabhātalādutthāya kṛṣṇaṃ manasā praṇamya ca || svāṃtaḥpuraṃ sundararatnaveṣṭitaṃ jagāma rājankratukautukāvṛtaḥ ||16|| gatvā hyaṃtapure rājā surendrasadanopame || paryaṃkasthāṃ rucimatīṃ śacītulyāṃ varānanām ||17|| dāsībhiḥ sevitāṃ rājñīṃ vastrālaṃkāraveṣṭitām || vījitāṃ cāmaraiḥ śuklairdadarśa nṛpasattamaḥ ||18|| sā vilokyāgataṃ tatra svapatiṃ yādaveśvaram || utthāya cādaraṃ rājan cakāra vidhinā kila ||19|| tataḥ sthitvā sa paryaṃke vṛṣṇīśo svāṃ priyāṃ parām || provāca prahasan vāṇyā ghanaśabdagabhīrayā ||20|| hayamedhaṃ kariṣye'haṃ priye kṛṣṇājñayā'dya vai || naro yasya pratāpena labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam ||21|| garga uvāca iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā putraduḥkhena duḥkhitā || smaraṃtī kṛpaṇā putrānpratyuvāca nṛpeśvaram ||22|| rājñyuvāca putradarśanahīnāyā rājanme sarvasaṃpadaḥ || na rocaṃte suraiḥ prārthyāḥ sukhena tvaṃ kratuṃ kuru ||23|| yadi yajñapratāpena putro bhavati sundaraḥ || tadā prasannacittāhaṃ bhaviṣyāmi nṛpeśvara ||24|| tasyā vākyaṃ samākarṇya nṛpaḥ khinnamanā hyabhūt || punarāha priyāṃ tatra śraddhāṃ śrāddhasuro yathā ||25|| rājovāca śṛṇu bhadre tvimāmāśāṃ putrāṇāṃ bahuduḥkhadām || tvaktvā vimuktidaṃ sākṣātkṛṣṇaṃ bhaja parātparam ||26|| ahaṃ vṛddhastu tvaṃ vṛddhā kathaṃ putro bhaviṣyati || tasmādajñānajaṃ śokaṃ tyaja baṃdhanakāraṇam ||27|| śrutvā tu yādaveṃdrasya vākyaṃ vijñānadaṃ param || rājan rucimatī prāha yadūnāṃ pravaraṃ patim ||28|| rucimatyuvāca rājan yajñapratāpena prāpyate vāñchitaṃ phalam || ahaṃ tu kāmaye draṣṭuṃ hataputrānsamāgatān ||29|| yadi tvamīdṛśaṃ vākyaṃ mṛtānāṃ darśanaṃ kutaḥ || vadiṣyasi madagre hi tato'nyacchṛṇu manmukhāt ||30|| kṛṣṇena dattaṃ tatputraṃ gurave gurudakṣiṇām || tadvatsvaputrān rājeṃdra kāmaye draṣṭumāgatān ||31|| garga uvāca iti śrutvā''hvayāmāsa māṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ bṛhacchravāḥ || tayoḥ saparyāṃ mahatīmāgatābhyāṃ cakāra ha ||32|| tau pūjayitvābhiprāyaṃ tābhyāṃ sarvaṃ nyavedayat || ugrasenasya vākyaṃ vai śrutvā madvacanāddhariḥ ||33|| upaśakro yathā śakraṃ prāha tadvannṛpeśvara || śrībhagavānuvāca śṛṇu rājam̐stava sutāḥ pradhane nihatāḥ purā ||34|| te sarve divyadehena vartante divi devavat || tasmātvaṃ nṛpaśārdūla putraśokaṃ vihāya ca ||35|| aśvamedhaṃ kratuvaraṃ kuru dhairyeṇa bhūpate || darśayiṣyāmyahaṃ sarvān yajñasyāṃte ca te sutān ||36|| niśamya kṛṣṇavacanamurvīśaḥ svāṃ priyāṃ mudā || āśvāsya ca śubhairvākyaiḥ sudharmāṃ sujanairyayau ||37|| āgataṃ tu nṛpaṃ vīkṣya śrīkṛṣṇena samanvitam || dikpālāśca praṇemurvai rāmeśānādayaḥ surāḥ ||38|| ugrasenasya bhūpasya vajranābhe tapaḥ param || kiṃ varṇayāmi yaṃ sarve śrīkṛṣṇādyā namaṃti hi ||39|| yādaveṃdrastu sarvān vai devānnatvā vilajjitaḥ || śakrasiṃhāsane divye nāruroha vicārayan ||40|| tadaiva kṛṣṇo bhagavāngṛhītvā pāṇinā nṛpam || svabhaktaṃ sthāpayāmāsa tasmin vai vāsavāsane ||41|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhacaritre rājarājñīsaṃvāde daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||10|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.11> śrīgarga uvāca atha rājā sudharmāyāṃ vāsudevena noditaḥ || saṃsthitānṛtvijo vavre mūrdhnā''namya prasādya ca ||1|| parāśaraśca vyāsaśca devalaścyavano'sitaḥ || śatānando gālavaśca yājñavalkyo bṛhaspatiḥ ||2|| agastyo vāmadevaśca maitreyo lomaśaḥ kaviḥ || ahaṃ kraturjaiminiśca vaiśampāyana eva ca ||3|| pailaḥ sumaṃtuḥ kaṇvaśca bhṛgū rāmo'kṛtavraṇaḥ || madhucchaṃdā vītahotro kavaṣo dhaumya āsuriḥ ||4|| jābālirvīrasenaśca pulastyaḥ pulahastathā || durvāsāśca marīciśca hyekataśca dvitastritaḥ ||5|| aṃgirā nāradaścaiva parvataḥ kapilo muniḥ || jātūkarṇyo hyutathyaśca saṃvartaśca mṛgīsutaḥ ||6|| śāṃḍilyaḥ prāḍvipākāśca kahoḍaḥ surato manuḥ || kacaḥ sthūlaśirāścaiva sthūlākṣaḥ pratimardanaḥ ||7|| bakadālbhyaśca kauṃḍinyo raibhyo droṇaḥ kṛpastathā || prakaṭākṣo yavakrīto vasudhanvā ca mitrabhūḥ ||8|| apāṃtaratamo datto mārkaṃḍeyo mahānuniḥ || jamadagniḥ kaśyapaśca bharadvājaśca gautamaḥ ||9|| atrirmunirvasiṣṭhaśca viśvāmitraḥ pataṃjaliḥ || kātyāyaniḥ pāṇiniśca vālmīkyādyāśca ṛtvijaḥ ||10|| pūjitā yādaveṃdreṇa prasannāste'bhavannṛpa || tataḥ sarve ṛtvijaśca nṛpamūcūrnimaṃtritāḥ ||11|| munaya ūcuḥ ugrasena mahārāja surāsuranamaskṛta || yajñaṃ kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā kuru so'pi bhaviṣyati ||12|| iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā parituṣṭākhileṃdriyaḥ || sarvānvai kratusaṃbhārānājahārāṃdhakeśvaraḥ ||13|| tataḥ kṛṣṭvā yajñabhūmiṃ viprāḥ kanakalāṃgalaiḥ || piṃḍārake yathānyāyaṃ dīkṣāyāṃ cakrire nṛpam ||14|| caturyojanaparyaṃtaṃ vilikhya bahuśo mahīm || yajñasyārthe nṛpastatra racayāmāsa maṃḍapān ||15|| yonimekhalayā yuktaṃ madhyakuṃḍaṃ vidhāya ca || tasminvai sthāpayāmasa vidhinā jātavedasam ||16|| ratnānekairviracitāṃ patākābhiryutāṃ sabhām || mama vākyādvajranābhe racayāmāsa cāhukaḥ ||17|| atha dṛṣṭvā sabhāṃ kṛṣṇo nijagau svasutaṃ prati || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca pradyumna śṛṇu madvākyaṃ tanniśamya kuru tvaram ||18|| gatvā śastradharaiḥ śūrairyatnena hayamānaya || śrīgarga uvāca iti śrutvā harervākyaṃ pradyumno dhanvināṃ varaḥ ||19|| tathetyuktvā hayaṃ netuṃ vājiśālāṃ jagāma ha || tataḥ kṛṣṇena rakṣārthaṃ svaputrāśca hayasya vai ||20|| preṣitā vājiśālāyāṃ bhānusāṃbādayo nṛpa || sa gatvā vājiśālāyāṃ rukmiṇīnandano balī ||21|| svarṇaśṛṃkhalayā baddhāñchyāmakarṇānsahasraśaḥ || vilokyaikaṃ svahastena yajñayogyaṃ turaṃgamam ||22|| prahasanmocayāmāsa baṃdhanānnṛpa līlayā || sahayo niryayau mukto śālāyāśca śanaiḥ śanai ||23|| raktānano pītapucchaḥ śyāmakarṇo manoharaḥ || sragbhirmuktāphalānāñca śobhito divyadarśanaḥ ||24|| śvetātapatreṇa yuto cāmaraiḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ || agrato madhyataścaiva pṛṣṭhataśca hareḥ sutāḥ ||25|| sevaṃte harirājaṃ vai surāḥ sarve hariṃ yathā || tathānyai rakṣamāṇastu maṇḍaleśaisturaṃgamaḥ ||26|| prāpto'tha maṃḍapaṃ kurvankhurakṣatatalāṃ mahīm || nṛpo vīkṣyāgataṃ tatra śyāmakarṇaṃ mudānvitaḥ ||27|| preṣayāmāsa māṃ rājankriyākartavyatāṃ prati || so'haṃ nṛpaṃ ca saṃsthāpya rucimatyā samanvitam ||28|| piṃḍārake prayogaṃ vai kārayāmāsa dharmataḥ || nṛpaścaitre pūrṇimāyāṃ dīkṣito'jinasaṃvṛtaḥ ||29|| asipatravrataṃ rājansa cakāra madājñayā || ahaṃ tu yādavendrasya kulapūrvagururmuniḥ ||30|| sarveṣāṃ caiva viprāṇāmācāryo hyabhavaṃ nṛpa || atha vipra brahmaghoṣaiḥ śrīkṛṣṇasyājñayā sthitāḥ ||31|| sarve prapūjayāmāsurheraṃbādīnsurānpṛthak || tataḥ sarve munigaṇāḥ saṃsthāpya turagaṃ nṛpa || kāśmīracandanenāpi puṣpasragbhiśca taṃdulaiḥ ||32|| nīrājanādibhirdhūpaiḥ sudhākuṇḍalakādibhiḥ || pūjayitvā hayaṃ bhūpaṃ dānārthe tu hyanodayan ||33|| tataḥ śrutvā''hukaḥ śīghraṃ pūrvaṃ mahyaṃ dadau dhanam || ekalakṣaṃ turaṅgāṇā sahasraṃ hastinā tathā ||34|| dvisahasraṃ rathānāṃ ca dhenūnāṃ lakṣameva ca || śatabhāraṃ suvarṇānāmīdṛśīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ nṛpaḥ ||35|| nimaṃtritebhyo viprebhya ugraseno nṛpastataḥ || yathoktāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ rājanpradadau tāṃ ca tvaṃ śṛṇu ||36|| ghoṭakānāṃ sahasraṃ ca dvipānāṃ śatamevaca || rathānāṃ dviśataṃ caiva sahasraṃ ca gavāṃ tathā ||37|| viṃśadbhāraṃ ca hemānāmīdṛśīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ punaḥ || athāgatebhyo viprebhyo natvā rājā vidhānataḥ ||38|| gajamekaṃ rathaṃ gāṃ ca svarṇabhāraṃ ca ghoṭakam || ekaikasmai ca viprāya dakṣiṇāṃ pradadau nṛpaḥ ||39|| evaṃ kṛtvā tu dānaṃ vai lalāṭe turagasya ca || kamanīyaṃ kuṃkumādyaiḥ svarṇapatraṃ babaṃdha ha ||40|| tatrāhamugrasenasya pratāpaṃ vīryamūrjitam || tato'likhaṃ sabhāyāṃ vai yādavānāṃ ca paśyatām ||41|| candravaṃśe yadukule ugraseno virājate || indrādayaḥ suragaṇā yasyādeśānuvartinaḥ ||42|| sahāyo yasya bhagavāñśrīkṛṣṇo bhaktapālakaḥ || asti vai dvārakāpuryāṃ tadbhaktyā nivasanhariḥ ||43|| tadvākyāddhayamedhaṃ sa ugraseno nṛpeśvaraḥ || cakravartī haṭhādyajñaṃ svayaśo'rthe karoti hi ||44|| mocitastena turago hayānāṃ pravaraḥ śubhaḥ || tadrakṣakaḥ kṛṣṇapautro'niruddho vṛkadaityahā ||45|| gajāśvarathavīrāṇāṃ senāsaṃghasamanvitaḥ || rājāno ye kariṣyaṃti rājyaṃ kau śūramāninaḥ ||46|| te gṛhṇaṃtu yajñahayaṃ svabalātpatraśobhitam || taṃ mocayati dharmātmā gṛhītaṃ ca hayaṃ nṛpaiḥ ||47|| svabāhubalavīryeṇāniruddho līlayā haṭhāt || tasyānyathā ca padayoḥ patitva yāṃtu dhanvinaḥ ||48|| iti patre ca likhite daghmuḥ śaṃkhānyadūttamāḥ || kāṃsyatālamṛdaṃgādyā nedurbheryaśca gomukhāḥ ||49|| maṃgalāni caritrāṇi śrīkṛṣṇabaladevayoḥ || gaṃdharvāstatra gāyaṃti nanṛturapsaraso mudā ||50|| athāniruddhaṃ turagasya pālane bhūtvā prasannaḥ kila kārṣṇinandanam || samādideśācyutameva saṃsthitaṃ yadūttamānāmadhipasya paśyataḥ ||51|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhacaritre sumerau hayapūjanaṃ nāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||11|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.12> garga uvāca atha rājā kuśasthalyāṃ pūjayitvā turaṃgamam || mumoca brahmaghoṣeṇa vidhinā baddhacāmaram ||1|| sudhākuṇḍalikāḥ so'pi bhuktvā turagarāṭ tataḥ || niryayau svarṇamālābhiḥ śobhitaḥ kuṃkumena ca ||2|| rakṣaṇārthaṃ hayasyārthe cādareṇa nṛpeśvaraḥ || aniruddhaṃ vṛkahaṇamūce rakṣārthamudyatam ||3|| ugrasena uvāca śrīkṛṣṇapautra prādyumne tvayā yatkathitaṃ vacaḥ || pālanārthe turaṃgasya svecchayā tatkuru tvaram ||4|| madrājasūye pūrvaṃ vai pradyumnena jitā mahī || tvaṃ tu śūro'si balavāndhanvī tasyātmajo mahān ||5|| vṛkastu śakunerbhrātā mahādaityo hatastvayā || rājānaśca jitāḥ sarve bhīṣmo yuddhe hi toṣitaḥ ||6|| aho mṛgāṃkalokeśau yasminsaṃlīnatāṃ gatau || tasmātvāmṛṣayaḥ sarve paripūrṇaṃ vadaṃti hi ||7|| tasmātpālaya tvaṃ vīra senāyā ca parīvṛtaḥ || rājanyebhyaśca sarvebhyo hayamedhaturaṃgamam ||8|| arbhakānvirathānbhītānprapannāndīnamānasān || suptānpramattānunmattānraṇe tānmā nipātaya ||9|| śrīkṛṣṇasya pratāpena nirvighnaṃ te'stu kārṣṇija || sāśvastvaṃ punarāgaccha kuśalī senayānvitaḥ ||10|| garga uvāca tataḥ śrutvāniruddhastu nṛpasya vacanaṃ śubham || tathetyuktvā hayasyāpi pālanārthaṃ mano dadhe ||11|| athāniruddhaṃ te viprāḥ kṛṣṇacandrājñayā tvaram || taṃ maṃtraiḥ snāpayitvā ca pūjāṃ cakrurmudānvitāḥ ||12|| aniruddhasya tilakaṃ kṛtvā rājā vidhānataḥ || baliṃ datvā ca yuddhāya karavālaṃ dadau tataḥ ||13|| śūro dadau ratnamālāṃ tasmai śauriśca kuṃḍale || baladevaśca kavacaṃ svacakraṃ harireva ca ||14|| pradyumnaścāniruddhāya kṛṣṇadattaṃ dhanurdadau || tathā svatūṇau rājeṃdra tasmai cākṣayasāyakau ||15|| svatriśūlātsamutpāṭya triśūlaṃ pramathādhipaḥ || uddhavaśca kirīṭaṃ vai pītavastraṃ ca devakaḥ ||16|| pracetā nāgapāśaṃ ca śaktiṃ śaktidharaḥ kila || śvasano vyajane divye svadaṃḍaṃ yamarāṭ punaḥ ||17|| hīrahāraṃ rājarājo parighaṃ tu dhanaṃjayaḥ || bhadrakālī gadāṃ gurvīṃ dadau kuntaṃ divākaraḥ ||18|| bhūḥ pāduke yogamayyau padmaṃ divyaṃ gaṇādhipaḥ || śaṃkhaṃ ca dakṣiṇāvartamakrūro vijayapradam ||19|| sahasravājisaṃyuktaṃ viśvakarmavinirmitam || sahasracakraṃ svarṇāḍhyaṃ brahmāṃḍāṃtarbahirgatim ||20|| chatreṇa śatakuṃbhaiśca patākābhiḥ śatairapi || śobhitaṃ meghanirghoṣaṃ ghaṃṭāmaṃjīranāditam ||21|| manovegaṃ mahādivyaṃ jaitraṃ ratnamayaṃ ratham || aniruddhāya pradadau dvārakāyāṃ puraṃdaraḥ ||22|| kaṃbudundubhayo neduḥ kāṃsyavīṇādayastadā || mṛdaṃgaveṇavo rāgairjayadhvanisamākulaiḥ ||23|| brahmaghoṣairlājapuṣpairmuktāvarṣasamanvitaiḥ || aniruddhopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire ||24|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe aniruddhavijayābhiṣeko nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||12|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.13> śrīgarga uvāca atha natvā gurūnso'pi prāyātpraṣṭuṃ ca devakīm || rohiṇīṃ rukmiṇīṃ bhāmāmanyāḥ sarvā haripriyāḥ ||1|| natvā ratiṃ rukmivatīmahaṃ gacchāmyuvāca ha || rājñā''diṣṭaḥ pālanārthaṃ hayasya saha yādavaiḥ ||2|| tāśca gadgadabhāṣiṇyastaṃ pariṣvajya karṣṇijam || āśiṣaṃ pradadū rājaṃstasmai ca praṇatāya vai ||3|| natvā tāśca yayau so'pi bhāryāṇāṃ bhavanāni ca || tamāgataṃ svabhartāraṃ tistraḥ patnyo vilokya ca ||4|| ādaraṃ tasya tāścakrurvirahātkhinnamānasāḥ || āśvāsayitvā tāḥ so'pi cājagāma sabhāṃ kila ||5|| āthādhvarārthe rājeṃdra munibhiḥ kṛtamaṃgalaḥ || sarvānnṛṣīngurūṃśacaiva nṛpendraṃ śūrameva ca || 6|| vasudevaṃ ca halinaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ svapitaraṃ tathā || anyāṃśca yādavānpūjyānaniruddhaḥ praṇamya ca ||7|| pūjito nāgaraiḥ sarvairdhanuṣyāṇiḥ śarī nṛpa || baddhagodhāṃgulitrāṇaḥ kavacī kuṇḍalāvṛtaḥ ||8|| upānadgūḍhapādaśca paṃcāsyasamavikramaḥ || karavāladharaścarmī kirīṭī śaktihastakaḥ ||9|| mahāvīraḥ suvarṇasya hyalaṃkārairalaṃkṛtaḥ || puraṃdararathenāpi niryayau svapurādbahiḥ ||10|| gītavāditraghoṣeṇa brahmaghoṣeṇa kārṣṇijam || yāsyaṃtaṃ cāmarairyuktaṃ dadṛśuḥ puravāsinaḥ ||11|| tataḥ śrīkṛṣṇacaṃdreṇa preṣitā uddhavādayaḥ || bhojavṛṣṇyaṃdhakamadhuśūrasenadaśārhakāḥ ||12|| atha rājā yadūnprāhāniruddhasya ca yādavāḥ || sahāyārthaṃ tu pradhane vadatātkaḥ prayāsyati ||13|| ugrasenavacaḥ śrutvā sāṃbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ || sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ natvā nṛpaṃ vacanamabravīt ||14|| sāṃba uvāca aniruddhasya rājendra sahāyamahameva ca || mahāraṇe ca śatrubhyaḥ kariṣye sarvadā kila ||15|| yadyahaṃ tasya rakṣāṃ vai na kariṣye raṇāṃgaṇe || pratijñāṃ mama rājeṃndra śṛṇuṣva satyavādinaḥ ||16|| tyājyāṃ tu daśamīviddhāṃ yaḥ kṛtvaikādaśīṃ naraḥ || prayāti yāṃ gatiṃ rājaṃstāmahaṃ prāpnuyāṃ dhruvam ||17|| gohantṝṇāṃ gatiryā tu yā gatirbrahmaghātinām || sā gatirmama bhūyādvai na kuryāṃ karma cedidim ||18|| garga uvāca ityuktvā vacanaṃ so'pi yayau cāṃtaḥpuraṃ tataḥ || natvā ca mātaraṃ sarvamabhiprāyaṃ nyavadeyat ||19|| śrutvā sā taṃ pariṣvajya virahādāśiṣaṃ dadau || tato mātṝstu tāḥ sarvā natvā patnīgṛhaṃ gataḥ ||20|| sā tamāyāṃtamālokya lakṣmaṇā varalakṣaṇā || dattvāsanaṃ bāṣpakaṃṭhī na tu kiṃciduvāca ha ||21|| āśvāsayitvā tāṃ sāṃbo hyabhiprāyamavarṇayat || iti śrṛtvā patiṃ prāha virahātkhinnamānasā ||22|| lakṣmaṇovāca aniruddhasya turago rakṣaṇīyastvayā pate || yuddhaṃ hi saṃmukhaṃ kāryaṃ vimukhaṃ na kadācana ||23|| tvadbhrātṝṇāṃ striyaḥ saṃti mānavatyaḥ sahasraśaḥ || saṃgrāme yadi te nātha niśamya ca parājayam ||24|| smitānanā bhaviṣyaṃti dṛṣṭvā māṃ ca tava priyām || tadā duḥkhatamenātha maraṇaṃ tu bhaviṣyati ||25|| śrutvaitadvacanaṃ sāṃbo pratyuvāca priyāṃ hasan || sāṃba uvāca pradhane mama saṃprāptaṃ trailokyaṃ saṃmukhaṃ kila ||26|| śroṣyase tvaṃ mayā bhadre sarvaṃ ca vidalīkṛtam || yadi sāṃbo raṇācchūro vimukho jāyate śubhe ||27|| tadā so'stu svapāpena brahmavipraviniṃdakaḥ || punastvahaṃ na paśyāmi candrākāraṃ tavānanam ||28|| garga uvāca ityāśvāsya priyāṃ sāṃbo dvitīyāṃ ca prayatnataḥ || abhimanyuṃ subhadrāṃ ca militvā niryayau gṛhāt ||29|| cāpī naistriṃśakaḥ sajjo syaṃdanī yādavairvṛtaḥ || prāptaścopavane sāṃbo'niruddho yatra vartate ||30|| tataḥ svabhrātaraḥ sarve śrīkṛṣṇena gadādayaḥ || preṣitā ātmajāścaiva bhānudīptimadādayaḥ ||31|| sarve hi dhanvinaḥ śūrā daṃśitā yuddhakovidāḥ || caturaṃgabalopetā nirjagmuḥ koṭiśaḥ purāt ||32|| tālahaṃsamīnabarhimṛgarājadhvajai rathaiḥ || divyaiśca kanakāṃgaiśca caturvājisamanvitaiḥ ||33|| mahoccairdevadhiṣṇyābhaiśchatracāmarasaṃyutaiḥ || sūryābhaiśca suvarṇasya kumbhairjālakatoraṇaiḥ ||34|| rejuḥ sarve kṛṣṇasutāḥ kuśasthalyā vinirgatāḥ || tataśca niryayū rājanhemanīḍāśca hastinaḥ ||35|| gomūtracayasiṃdūrakastūrīpatrabhṛnmukhāḥ || aṃjanābhā kajjalābhā ghanaśyāmā madacyutāḥ ||36|| rājīvamūlasadṛśāḥ śukladaṃtā mṛgadvipāḥ || mahoccāḥ parvatākārā raṇadghaṃṭā mahodbhaṭāḥ ||37|| airāvatakulebhāśca tisraḥ śuṇḍāśca pāṇḍurāḥ || caturdaṃtāstu kṛṣṇena bhaumānnītāśca niryayuḥ ||38|| dhvajayuktā lakṣagajā lakṣaduṃdubhisaṃyutāḥ || lakṣāḥ śūnyā mahāmātyaiḥ svarṇakaṃbalamaṃḍitāḥ ||39|| tataḥ śūraiśca saṃyuktā gajeṃdrā ekakoṭayaḥ || itastato virejuste bale'bdhau makarā yathā ||40|| utpāṭya gulmāñchuṃḍaiśca kṣepayaṃto nabhastale || mahīṃ pādaiḥ kapayaṃta ārdrīkṛtya madairapi ||41|| prāsādadurgaśailāṃgānpātayaṃtaḥ śiraḥsthalaiḥ || ripūṇāṃ ca balaṃ sarvaṃ khaṇḍayaṃto mahabalāḥ ||42|| śyāmapītakṛṣṇaśuklaraktavarṇaiśca kaṃbalaiḥ || suvarṇaśṛṅkhalairyuktā rejuretādṛśā gajāḥ ||43|| tatasturaṃgamā ye vai nāradena vilokitāḥ || te sarve nirgatā rājansvarṇahāraiśca saṃyutāḥ ||44|| kecidvai caṃcalāṃgāśca dhūmravarṇā manoharāḥ || śyāmavarṇāḥ padmavarṇāḥ kṛṣṇavarṇāḥ sukaṃdharāḥ ||45|| dugdhābhā ghoṭakāḥ kecittathā kīlālasannibhāḥ || haridrābhāḥ kuṃkumābhāḥ pālāśakusumaprabhāḥ ||46|| keciccitravicitrāṃgāḥ sphaṭikāṃgā manojavāḥ || haridvarṇāstāmravarṇāḥ kausuṃbhābhāḥ śukaprabhāḥ ||47|| indragopanibhā gaurā divyāḥ pūrṇeṃdusannibhāḥ || sindūrāṃgāścāgnivarṇā ravibālasamaprabhāḥ ||48|| ete turaṃgamā rājansarvadeśātsamāgatāḥ || puryāṃ kṛṣṇapratāpena te tu sarve vinirgatāḥ ||49|| kṛṣṇasya vājiśālāsu ye vartaṃte ca te hayāḥ || vaikuṇṭhavāsinaścaiva śvetadvīpanivāsinaḥ ||50|| kecinmayūravarṇāśca nīlakaṇṭhanibhāstathā || vidyudvarṇāstārkṣyavarṇāḥ sarve pakṣairalaṃkṛtāḥ ||51|| śikhāmaṇidharāḥ śuklacāmaraiḥ samalaṃkṛtāḥ || sragbhirmuktāphalānāṃ ca raktavastrairvibhūṣitāḥ ||52|| svarṇena maṃḍitāḥ pucchamukhapaṭṭasphuratprabhāḥ || sarvāṃgasundarā divyā nirgatāste sahasraśaḥ ||53|| na spṛśantaḥ padairbhūmiṃ hyete kṛṣṇahayā nṛpa || caṃcalā vāyuvegāśca manovegā manoharāḥ ||54|| budbudeṣvatigāścaiva pakvasūtreṣu bhūpate || lūtājāleṣu kecidvai calaṃtaḥ pāradaṃ hyanu ||55|| sphārā vāriṣu dṛśyaṃte nirādhārā nṛpeśvara || anye'pi nirgatā rājanmlecchadeśabhavā hayāḥ ||56|| śatayojanagāścaiva koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo nṛpa || gartadurganadīsaudhaśailādīṃśca harerhayāḥ || ullaṃghayaṃto nṛpate savīrāste turaṃgamāḥ ||57|| tataśca niryayuḥ sarve dvārakāyāḥ padātinaḥ || dhanvino daṃśitāḥ śūrā mahābalaparākramāḥ ||58|| khaḍgacarmadharā uccā lauhakaṃcukamaṃḍitāḥ || saṃgrāme bahuśatrūṇāṃ jetāro gajasannibhāḥ ||59|| itthaṃ vinirgataṃ sainyaṃ yādavānāṃ nirīkṣya ca || devadaityanarāḥ sarve vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ ||60|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe yadusainyanirgamanaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||13|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.14> garga uvāca atha tanmilanārthaṃ vai ugrasenājñayā nṛpa || vasudevaḥ kāmapālaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kārṣṇireva ca ||1|| anye'pi yādavā rājan rathaiḥ sarve viniryayuḥ || gatvāniruddhaṃ dadṛśuḥ senayā tu parīvṛtam ||2|| pradyumnāya rājasūye yā nītiḥ kathitā purā || tāṃ sarvāmaniruddhāya kathayāmāsa mādhavaḥ ||3|| iti śrutvā ca kṛṣṇasya śāsanaṃ sarvayādavāḥ || śirasā jagṛhū rājannaniruddhādayo mudā ||4|| atha gargaṃ munīṃścaiva vasudevaṃ halāyudham || śrīkṛṣṇacandraṃ kārṣṇiṃ ca prādyumniḥ praṇanāma ha ||5|| vasudevarāmakṛṣṇapradyumnādyāḥ śubhāśiṣam || aniruddhāya datvā ca praviṣṭāste purīṃ rathaiḥ ||6|| athāniruddhasya hayo deśe deśe gato nṛpa || na ke'pi jagṛhustaṃ vai bhayātkṛṣṇasya bhūmipāḥ ||7|| yatra yatra gato vājī tatra tatra sasainikaḥ || kārṣṇijaḥ pṛṣṭhatastasya jetuṃ śatrūngataḥ kila ||8|| itthaṃ vilokayanrājyānaniruddhaturaṃgamaḥ || rājitāṃ narmadātīre yayau māhiṣmatīṃ purīm ||9|| cāturvarṇyasamākīrṇāmaśmadurgeṇa maṃḍitām || sadanairgaganasparśairmaheśasyālayairvṛtām ||10|| indranīlena rājñāpi pālitāṃ pañcayojanam || śālaistālaistamālaiśca vaṭairbilvaiśca pippalaiḥ ||11|| taḍāgaiścaiva vāpībhirghuṣṭāṃ pakṣigaṇaistathā || īdṛśīṃ nagarīmaśvo dadarśopavane gataḥ ||12|| iṃdranīlasya tanayo nāmnā nīladhvajo balī || puryāḥ sahasravīraiśca mṛgayārthī vinirgataḥ ||13|| tato dadarśa turagaṃ sapatraṃ nṛpanaṃdanaḥ || praphullite copavane kadaṃbasya tale sthitam ||14|| caraṃtaṃ cāmarairyuktaṃ saurabheyīpayaḥprabham || strīṇāṃ kuṃkumahastaiśca muktāhārairalaṃkṛtam ||15|| hayaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājasutā svavāhādavatīrya ca || keśeṣu taṃ nijagrāha harṣeṇa nṛpa līlayā ||16|| tatpatraṃ vācayāmāsa yādaveṃdreṇa yatkṛtam || dvārakādhipatī rājā sarvaśūraśiromaṇiḥ ||17|| nānyo'sti tatsamaḥko'pi cakravartībṛhacchravāḥ || vimocitasturagarāṭ tenāsau patrasaṃyutaḥ ||18|| pālyamāno'niruddhena gṛhṇaṃtu sabalā nṛpāḥ || tasyānyathā prapadayoḥ patitvā yāṃtu kṣatriyāḥ ||19|| ityabhiprāyamālokya kopenāha nṛpātmajaḥ || aniruddho dhanurddhārī dhanvino na vayaṃ smṛtāḥ ||20|| matpitari sthite mahyāṃ kastu garvaṃ samācaret || śrīgarga uvāca ityuktvā sa hayaṃ nītvā prayayau nṛpasannidhau ||21|| kathayāmāsa vṛttāṃtaṃ pituragre hayasya ca || śrutvā putrasya vacanamiṃdranīlo mahīśvaraḥ ||22|| śivabhakto mahāmānī putraṃ prāha mahābalaḥ || iṃdranīla uvāca samarthena purā dattaṃ rājasūye kratūttame ||23|| pradyumnāya baliṃ kiṃcitkumaṃtrivacanānmayā || adyāniruddhastu hayaṃ pālayanpunarāgataḥ ||24|| aho daivabalaṃ yena kinna bhūyādviparyyayaḥ || gatā vṛddhiṃ dvārakāyāmalpakālena vṛṣṇayaḥ ||25|| tasmātsarvānvijeṣyāmi kārṣṇijapramukhānyadūn || śyāmakarṇaṃ na dāsyāmi tasmai mānavṛtāya ca ||26|| pālayiṣyati māṃ yuddhe bhaktyā saṃtoṣitaḥ śivaḥ || ityuktvā senayā yukto vīro māhiṣmatīpatiḥ ||27|| svarṇadāmnā hayaṃ baddhvā yuddhaṃ kartuṃ mano dadhe || tato'niruddhaḥ saṃprāpto turagaṃ ca vilokayan ||28|| akṣauhiṇīśatayuto narmadāyāstaṭe nṛpa || sāṃbo madhubṛhadbāhuścitrabhānurvṛko'ruṇaḥ ||29|| saṃgrāmajitsumitraśca dīptimānbhānureva ca || vedabāhuḥ puṣkaraśca śrutadevaḥ sunaṃdanaḥ ||30|| virūpaścitrabāhuśca nyagrodhaśca kavistathā || ete samāyayū rājannaniruddhasahāyinaḥ ||31|| gadaśca sāraṇo'krūraḥ kṛtavarmā hi coddhavaḥ || yuyudhāno sātyakiśca śūrā ete ca vṛṣṇayaḥ ||32|| sahāyamaniruddhasya kartuṃ sarve samāgatāḥ || sthitvā te narmadatīre bhojavṛṣṇyaṃdhakādayaḥ ||33|| śyāmakarṇamapaśyaṃtastvabruvan vismayānvitāḥ || kena nītāḥ sapatrāśca ugrasenasya bhūpateḥ ||34|| tasmānmitrāṇi so'pyatra śyāmakarṇo na dṛśyate || rājasūye purā yasmai naradaityasurādayaḥ ||35|| navakhaṃḍādhipāścaiva nirjitaśca baliṃ daduḥ || yasya vai śāsanaṃ caṃḍaṃ tiraskṛtya kudhīrnṛpaḥ ||36|| turagaṃ hatavānmānātsa steno daṃḍamarhati || sarveṣāmiti vākyaṃ tu śrutvā dṛṣṭvā purīṃ puraḥ ||37|| uddhavaṃ maṃtriṇāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prāha rukmavatīsutaḥ || aniruddha uvāca nagarīyaṃ naditīre kasya bhūpasya rājate ||38|| turaṃgamo gato'styasyāmiti manye tvahaṃ kila || iti tadvākyamākarṇya prāha kṛṣṇasakho mudā ||39|| uddhava uvāca iṃdranīlasya nagarī nāmnā māhiṣmatī śubhā || maheśapūjanaratā varṇā yasyāṃ vasaṃti hi ||40|| nṛpeṇānena vṛṣṇīśa narmadāyāstaṭe purā || dvādaśavarṣaparyaṃtaṃ pūjito narmadeśvaraḥ ||41|| tataḥ śivaḥ prasanno'bhūdupacāraiśca ṣoḍaśaiḥ || tasmai svadarśanaṃ dattvā varārthaṃ tamanodayat ||42|| maheśasya vacaḥ śrutvā nṛpo māhiṣmatīpatiḥ || bhūtvā kṛtāṃjalī rudraṃ prāha gadgadayā girā ||43|| īśāna tvāṃ namasye'haṃ narmadeśaṃ jagadgurum || puruṣāṇāṃ sakāmānāṃ kāmarūpasuradrumam ||44|| tvattaḥ pradātuḥ kāṃkṣe'haṃ varametanmaheśvara || devadaityanarebhyastvaṃ rakṣa māṃ sarvadā bhayāt ||45|| iti tadvākyamākarṇya kṛttivāsā mudānvitaḥ || tathāstu coktvā rājeṃdra tataścāṃtaradhīyata ||46|| tasmādeṣa nṛpaḥ śūro hayaṃ tubhyaṃ na dāsyati || vinā yuddhena rudrasya varātkaṃdarpanaṃdana ||47|| itthamaupagavervākyamaniruddho niśamya ca || balī dhairyeṇa pratyāha yādavānāṃ ca śṛṇvatām ||48|| nṛpasyaitasya rudrastu sahāyaste hyudāhṛtaḥ || tathā kṛṣṇastu bhagavāñchṛṇu maṃtrinmamopari ||49|| ityuktvā yādavaiḥ sārddhaṃ vīro rukmavatīsutaḥ || hayasya mocanārthaṃ vai nṛpaṃ jetuṃ mano dadhe ||50|| tataḥ parighanistriṃśagadācāpaparaśvadhaiḥ || babhūvuryādavāḥ sajjāḥ prādyumnau daṃśite sthite ||51|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe aniruddhaprayāṇaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||14|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.15> śrīgarga uvāca athendranīlasya suto mahābalo hyakṣauhiṇībhistribhireva saṃyutaḥ || yadūnvijetuṃ svapurādvinirgato pituśca vākyādbahuroṣapūritaḥ ||1|| tamāgataṃ vīkṣya nṛpasya putraṃ śrīkṛṣṇapautrastu dhanurgṛhītvā || yuddhaṃ prakartuṃ prayayau sa eko vṛtraṃ vijetuṃ ca yathā viḍaujāḥ ||2|| gatvāniruddhaḥ saṃgrāme śatrūṇāmupari tvaram || mumoca bāṇapaṭalānsarveṣāṃ trāsayanmanaḥ ||3|| tataśca dudruvuḥ sarve nīlaketośca sainikāḥ || raṇādbhītāḥ svaśaṃkhaṃ ca daghmau pradyumnanaṃdanaḥ ||4|| palāyamānāṃ svāṃ senāṃ dṛṣṭvā nīladhvajo balī || cāpaṃ ṭaṃkārayañchīghramāyayau raṇamaṃḍale ||5|| senāṃ svāṃ nodayāmāsa punaḥ so'pi dhanurjyayā || dviṣāṃ madhye'niruddhaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā nīladhvajo balī ||6|| dhanuṣṭaṃkārayanprāpto hyakṣauhiṇyāvṛto ruṣā || viṃśadbāṇairnīlaketuṃ paṃcabhiḥ paṃcabhī rathān ||7|| atāḍayadgajāṃścaiva tathā saturagānnarān || bhūmyāṃ nipetuste sarve sāṃbabāṇaiḥ pratāḍitāḥ ||8|| gajopari gajāḥ kecidrathopari rathāstathā || hayopari hayāścaiva naropari narāśca vai ||9|| tatkṣaṇenāpyabhūdbhūmī rudhiraughapariplutā || patitaiśchinnabhinnaiśca dvipāśca rathapattibhiḥ ||10|| tataḥ prabhagnaṃ svabalaṃ vilokya nīladhvajo bhūpadhanurgṛhītvā || bāṇānvimuṃcankila yādavānāṃ jetuṃ mano yasya sa cāgamadvai ||11|| sa gatvā pradhane rājandaśabāṇai ruṣānvitaḥ || cāpaṃ sāṃbasya ciccheda prema durvacanairiva ||12|| caturbhiścaturo vāhāndvābhyāṃ ketuṃ rathaṃ śataiḥ || ekena jaghne sūtaṃ sa indranīlasuto balī ||13|| evaṃ kṛtvā ca virathaṃ sāṃbaṃ vai nṛpanaṃdanaḥ || punaḥ samāgatāṃ tasya senāṃ bāṇairjaghāna ha ||14|| atha nīladhvajasyāpi senā sarvā samāgatā | yādavānāṃ balaṃ saṃkhye jaghāna niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ || 15 || tataḥ samabhavadyuddhamubhayoḥ senayormṛdhe || nistriṃśaiḥ parighairbāṇairgadāparuṣaśaktibhiḥ ||16|| sāṃbo'nyaṃ rathamāruhya sajjaṃ kṛtvā dhanurdṛḍham || tadrathaṃ cūrṇayāmāsa śatabāṇai raṇe balī ||17|| sa cchinnadhanvā viratho gadāmudyamya vegavān || abhyadhāvadraṇe kruddho sāṃbasyopari mānada ||18|| tadaiva sāṃbaṃ sahasāvatīryātha rathādgadām || nītvā nīladhvajasyāpi saṃmukhe gatavān ruṣā ||19|| tatāḍa gadayā sāṃbamāgataṃ vīkṣya bhūpajaḥ || na cacāla prahāreṇa mālāhatagajo yathā ||20|| tataḥ sāṃbastu gadayā tatāḍa nṛpanandanam || tatprahāreṇa patito mūrchāṃ prāpto raṇe tu saḥ ||21|| sainikā dudruvustasya hāhākāraṃ samuccaran || tato yuddhāya saṃkruddha indranīlaḥ samāgataḥ ||22|| sākamakṣauhiṇībhyāṃ ca vimuṃcandhanuṣā śarān || tamāgataṃ vilokyātha madhuḥ kṛṣṇasuto balo ||23|| dhānuṣko virathaṃ cakra indranīlaṃ śilīmukhaiḥ || senāṃ samāgatāṃ tasya yuyudhāno'rjunapriyaḥ ||24|| śarairvivyādha samare maitrīṃ durvacanairiva || tataśca yādavairmukto nṛpo māhiṣmatīṃ yayau ||25|| gatvā puryāṃ ca duḥkhārtaḥ sasmāra svapatiṃ śivam || atha tasmai śivaḥ sākṣāddatvā darśanamuttamam ||26|| papraccha sarvavṛttāṃtaṃ śrutvā sa tu nyavedayat || itthaṃ niśamya vacanaṃ pratyāha pramatheśvaraḥ ||27|| śiva uvāca śokaṃ mā kuru rājeṃdra madvaro'pi mṛṣā na hi || daivadaityanarāḥ sarve tvā vijetuṃ na ca kṣamāḥ ||28|| ete kṛṣṇasutā rājañchrīkṛṣṇasyāṃśasaṃbhavāḥ || na devā ye mahārāja na daityā na ca mānuṣāḥ ||29|| etairvinirjitastvaṃ tu durmanā bhava mā nṛpa || aparādhaṃ tu kṛṣṇasya kartuṃ nārhasi bhūpate ||30|| samāgatebhya etebhyastasmāttvaṃ vidhinā nṛpa || śīghraṃ prayaccha bhadraṃ te hayamedhaturaṃgamam ||31|| ityuktvāṃtardadhe rudro nṛpo jñātvā jagatpateḥ || māhātmyaṃ ca mudā yukto gṛhītvā kratuvāhanam ||32|| nīladhvajena sahito ratnānyādāya bhūriśaḥ || svarṇabhāraśataṃ caiva mataṃgajasahasrakam ||33|| niyutaṃ ghoṭakānāṃ ca hyādāya syaṃdanāyutam || yatrāniruddhaḥ prayayau namaskartuṃ janairvṛtaḥ ||34|| aniruddhasya nikaṭe gatvā rājā vidhānataḥ || sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa natvā vacanamabravīt ||35|| indranīla uvāca namaḥ kṛṣṇāya rāmāya pradyumnāya mahātmane || namo namo'niruddhāya sātvatāṃ pravarāya ca ||36|| ādeśo dīyatāṃ mahyaṃ kiṃ karomyasurārdana || aniruddhastu taṃ prāha mayā saha nṛpottama ||37|| śatrubhyaśca mitrahayaṃ pālaya tvaṃ hi māmakam || garga uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā tathetyuktvā nṛpo nṛpa ||38|| nīladhvajāya rājyaṃ tu datvā gaṃtuṃ mano dadhe ||39|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe aniruddhavijayavarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||15|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.16> garga uvāca atha muktastu turago deśānsarvānvilokayan || uśīnare ca viṣaye prāptaścaṃpāvatīṃ purīm ||1|| rājñā hemāṃgadenāpi pālitāṃ durgamaṃḍitām || cāturvarṇyajanākīrṇāṃ prāsādaiḥ pariveṣṭitām ||2|| yatra hemāṃgado rājā putreṇa haṃsaketunā || rājyaṃ karoti sukṛtirmahāśūrajanairvṛtaḥ ||3|| gṛhītastena turago'niruddhasya mahātmanaḥ || svapuryāṃ līlayā rājan yādavānagaṇayya ca ||4|| baddhvā hemāṃgado rājā svarṇadāmnā ca vājinam || dvāreṣu ca kapāṭādīndattvā krodhena pūritaḥ ||5|| yādavānāṃ vināśāya durgabhittiṣu mānada || śataghnyaśca dvilakṣāṇi dhṛtvā yuddhāya vai manaḥ ||6|| tataḥ prāpto'niruddhastu sasainyo'śvaṃ vilokayan || caṃpāvatyā hyupavane śibiro'bhūcca tasya vai ||7|| atha pradyumnatanayastatrādṛṣṭvā turaṃgamam || uddhavaṃ kṛṣṇacandrasya sakhāyamidamabravīt ||8|| aniruddha uvāca kasyeyaṃ nagarī mantrīnkena nīto hayo mama || tvaṃ jānāsi mahābuddhe kathayasva vicārya ca ||9|| itthaṃ niśamya tadvākyamuddhavo buddhisattamaḥ || jñātvā vārtāṃ ca śatrūṇāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt ||10|| uddhava uvāca iyaṃ caṃpāvatī nāmnā nagarī dvārakeśvara || haṃsadhvajena putreṇa yatra hemāṃgado nṛpaḥ ||11|| karoti rājyaṃ tenāpi gṛhītasturagastava || eṣa rājā mahāśūro yajñasyāśvaṃ na dāsyati ||12|| puryāṃ sthitvā bhuśuṇḍībhirbahu yuddhaṃ kariṣyati || na nirgamiṣyati bahiryuddhāya sa nṛpaḥ purāt ||13|| tasmāttavecchā nṛpate yathā bhūyāttathā kuru || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa uvāca ruṣānvitaḥ ||14|| aniruddha uvāca ahaṃ sarvānhaniṣyāmi durgayuktānbahūndviṣaḥ || lauhaśaktisamairbāṇaiḥ prahārārddhena sattama ||15|| itthaṃ tadvākyamākarṇya yādavaḥ krodhapūritaḥ || purīṃ haṃtuṃ yayau śīghraṃ mumoceṣūṃśca koṭiśaḥ ||16|| aṃdhakānāṃ ca bāṇaughaiḥ puryāṃ kolāhalo'pyabhūt || śatravaḥ śaṃkitāḥ sarve vīrā haṃsadhvajādayaḥ ||17|| tato nṛpasya vacanādvīrāste sāhasena vai || durgabhittiṣvathāruhya yādavāndadṛśurbahiḥ ||18|| dṛṣṭvā te ca bhayaṃ prāpuḥ sannaddhān yadupuṃgavān || śastravarṣaṃ prakurvantaḥ sarvataḥ parimaṃḍitān ||19|| tebhyaḥ śataghnīrvyasṛjaṃścaturdikṣu ca vahninā || sarvāneva haniṣyāmo na dāsyāmo hayaṃ vayam ||20|| athāniruddhasenāyāṃ hāhākāro mahānabhūt || vihvalā vṛṣṇayaḥ sarve śataghnībhiḥ pratāḍitāḥ ||21|| saṃchinnabhinnasarvāṃgāḥ kecidyuddhātpalāyitāḥ || kecinmūrchāṃ gatā rājankecidvai nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ||22|| kecitprajvalitā yuddhe bhasmībhūtāstathāpare || kecidvai pādahīnāśca karahīnā vibāhavaḥ ||23|| niḥśastrāḥ patitāścaiva kecijjvalitakaṃcukāḥ || hāheti vādinaḥ kecidrāmakṛṣṇeti vādinaḥ ||24|| śataghnībhirviśīrṇāṅgā gajāḥ kecinmṛdhāṅgaṇe || dudruvantaśca patitā mūrchitā nidhanaṃ gatāḥ ||25|| utpatanto dudruvaṃtaśchinnadehāsturaṅgamāḥ || mṛdhe mṛtyuṃ gatāḥ kecidviśīrṇāḥ patitā rathāḥ ||26|| agninā pūritaṃ sarvaṃ yadusainyaṃ bhayānakam || dṛṣṭvāniruddhaḥ saṅgrāme śuśoca saṃsmaranharim ||27|| tataḥ kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā buddhiṃ prāpta uṣāpatiḥ || pratiśārṅgaṃ gṛhītvā vai niṣaṅgāccharameva ca ||28|| nītvā nidhāya kodaṇḍe parjanyāstraṃ samādadhe ||29|| bāṇe pramukte sati vai balāhakaḥ samāgato vai yadusainyamaṇḍale || jalaṃ vavarṣātha yadūnprapālayankṛpīṭayoniṃ kila śāṃtayannṛpa ||30|| tataste'gnibhayānmuktā śītalāṅgāśca vṛṣṇayaḥ || ślāghāṃ kṛtvāniruddhasya yuddhaṃ kartuṃ samutthitāḥ ||31|| tānpratyāhāniruddhastu hyahaṃ yāsye purīṃ prati || arveṇa pakṣayuktenaiko vijetuṃ dviṣāṃ patim ||32|| garga uvāca iti śrutvā vacastasya sāṃbādyāḥ kṛṣṇanandanāḥ || procuḥ sarve ca taṃ rājannaṣṭādaśa mahārathāḥ ||33|| hariputrā ūcuḥ gaṃtuṃ nārhasi tvaṃ rājañśatrūṇāṃ nagarīṃ prati || prayāsyāmo vayaṃ sarve vijetuṃ cātatāyinam ||34|| ityuktvā kupitāḥ sarve sahasā''ruhya ghoṭakān || sapakṣāndhanvino vīrā daṃśitā yuddhakovidāḥ ||35|| ullaṃghayitvā prākāraṃ puryāṃ prāptā hareḥ sutāḥ || gatvā jaghnurdviṣaḥ sarvānbāṇairuragasannibhaiḥ ||36|| te śatravastu sahasā nṛpasya vacanānnṛpa || yuddhārthe dhanvinaḥ kruddhā āgatā ekakoṭayaḥ ||37|| tānāgatānbahūnvīrānkupitānudyatāyudhān || sāṃbo madhurbṛhadbāhuścitrabhānurvṛko'ruṇaḥ ||38|| saṅgrāmajitsumitraśca dīptimānbhānureva ca || vedabāhuḥ puṣakaraśca śrutadevaḥ sunaṃdanaḥ ||39|| virūpaścitrabāhuśca nyagrodhaśca kavistathā || ete kṛṣṇasutāḥ sarve jaghnurbāṇairnirīkṣya ca ||40|| tataḥ puryāṃ ca vīrāṇāṃ rudhireṇa bhayaṃkarā || nadī babhūva rājeṃdra puradvārādviniḥsṛtā||41|| tāmāgatāṃ nadīṃ ghorāmaniruddhastu śaṃkitaḥ || pratyuvāca ruṣā rājanmukhena pariśuṣyatā ||42|| matpitṛbhrātaraḥ sarve raṇe kiṃ nihatā aho || tasmādasmānplāvayituṃ nadī ghorā samāgatā ||43|| etāmagnimayairbāṇaiḥ śoṣayiṣye na saṃśayaḥ || pātayiṣyāmi nagarīmahaṃ girisamairgajaiḥ ||44|| tato'niruddhavacanāddhastipairlakṣahastinaḥ || mahoccāśca madonmattāḥ kajjalādrisamaprabhāḥ ||45|| karairgulmānsamutpāṭya kṣepayaṃtaśca tatpure || kaṃpayaṃto bhuvaṃ pādaiḥ puropari samāgatāḥ ||46|| gatvā te kuṃjarāḥ sarve hemāṅgadapurīṃ ruṣā || sarvataḥ pātayāmāsuḥ śīghraṃ kumbhasthalairnṛpa ||47|| kapāṭāḥ patitāḥ sarve dvārāṇāṃ dṛḍhaśṛṅkhalāḥ || durgasya pātitāḥ puryā gajaiḥ pāṣāṇabhittayaḥ ||48|| pātayitvā kapāṭādīndurgaṃ caiva harergajāḥ || puryāṃ prāptā nṛpaśreṣṭha ripugehānnyapātayan ||49|| hāhākāro mahānāsīccaṃpāvatyāṃ tadaiva hi || bhayabhītā janāḥ sarve nṛpādyā vismayaṃ gatāḥ ||50|| tadā tu dharṣito rājā srajā baddhvā karadvayam || sammukhe hariputrāṇāmāyayau pāhi māṃ bruvan ||51|| tamāgataṃ nṛpaṃ vīkṣya raṇe sāṃbastu dharmavit || bhrātṝnnivārayāmāsa dīnahantṝṃśca hastipān ||52|| nivārayitvā sarvānsa rājānamidamabravīt || sāṃba uvāca āgaccha rājanbhadraṃ te nītvā mama turaṅgamam ||53|| gacchāniruddhanikaṭe tataḥ śreyo bhaviṣyati || iti śrutvā sa tadvākyaṃ nītvā yajñaturaṅgamam || hariputrairyuto rājā niścakrāma purādbahiḥ ||54|| gatvāniruddhanikaṭe sākaṃ putreṇa bhūpatiḥ || hayaṃ nivedayāmāsa svarṇakoṭiṃ ca mānadaḥ ||55|| aniruddhastu rajendra nītividdīnavatsalaḥ || tatkarau mālayā baddhau mocayitvedamabravīt ||56|| mayā saha nṛpaśreṣṭha pālayainaṃ turaṅgamam || rājanyebhyaśca śatrubhyaḥ kṛṣṇasya prītihetave ||57|| śrutvāniruddhasya vaco mahātmā hemāṅgado buddhimatāṃ variṣṭhaḥ || datvā ca rājyaṃ svasutāya prītyā gaṃtuṃ manastatra cakāra tena ||58|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe caṃpāvatīvijayavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||16||
<10.17> garga uvāca athāniruddhasya hayo vimukto yadupravīraiśca mahojjvalāṃgaḥ || uśīnarādvīravarānprapaśyanvinirgataḥ so'pi śanaiḥ śanaiśca ||1|| evaṃ sa vicaran rājan rāṣṭre rāṣṭre hayottamaḥ || nṛpaiśca bahubhī rājangṛhītaśca vimocitaḥ ||2|| iṃdranīlaṃ jitaṃ śrutvā tathā hemāṃgadaṃ nṛpam || nṛpāścānye maṇḍaleśāḥ prāptaṃ na jagṛhurhayam ||3|| vīrahīnānbahūndeśānvilokya turagottamaḥ || yadṛcchayā nṛpaśreṣṭha strīrājyaṃ tu jagāma ha ||4|| rājanyakanyā kācidvai surūpā nāma sundarī || rājyaṃ sā kurute svairaṃ rājā tatra na jīvati ||5|| tatra deśe striyaṃ prāpya yastāṃ bhajati kāmataḥ || ūrdhvaṃ saṃvatsarādrājanna kadāpi sa jīvati ||6|| tatpure turago gatvā hyudyāne puṣpasaṃkule || lavaṃgalatikavṛnde svelāgaṃdhasamākule ||7|| pakṣibhirmadhupairghuṣṭe sthito'bhūcciṃciṇītale || dadṛśuḥ strījanāḥ sarve śyāmakarṇaṃ manoharam ||8|| brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā drṣṭuṃ samāgatāḥ || hayaṃ dṛṣṭvā striyo gatvā svāminīmavadannṛpa ||9|| śrutvā rājñī rathe sthitvā chatracāmaravījitā || nārīkoṭisamāyuktā hayaṃ drṣṭuṃ samāyayau ||10|| aśvaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca tatpatraṃ vācayitvā ruṣānvitā || punaḥ pure hayaṃ baddhvā yuddhaṃ kartuṃ mano dadhe ||11|| kāścinnāryo gajārūḍhā rathārūḍhāḥ samāyayuḥ || hayārūḍhāstathā kāściddaṃśitāḥ śastrasaṃyutāḥ ||12|| tāḥ sarvā kupitā vīkṣya śastravarṣaṃ prakurvatīḥ || āgato hyaniruddhastu hemāṃgadamuvāca ha ||13|| aniruddha uvāca rājannetāśca kā nāryo yuddhaṃ kartuṃ samāgatāḥ || vistareṇāpi kathaya yena me syācchivaṃ tviha ||14|| hemāṃgada uvāca atra deśe ca kurute rājñī rājyaṃ nṛpeśvara || na jīvati nṛpo rājye tasmātstrībhiḥ samanvitā ||15|| hayaṃ gṛhītvā te sā ca saṃgrāmaṃ kartumāgatā || iti śrutvāniruddhastu rājānamidamabravīt ||16|| aniruddha uvāca kasmātstrī kurute rājyaṃ rājā kasmānna jīvati || etāṃ vistarato vārtāṃ yattvaṃ jānāsi tadvada ||17|| iti tadvākyamākarṇya rājā hemāṃgado'bravīt || saṃsmaran yājñavalkyasya svagurośca padāṃbujam ||18|| yādaveṃdra purāvṛttaṃ yājñavalkyamukhācchrutam || caṃpakāyāṃ mayā pūrvaṃ kathayiṣyāmi tacchṛṇu ||19|| purā kṛtayuge rājannatra deśe babhūva ha || nārīpāla iti khyāto rājā tu maṃḍaleśvaraḥ || ||20|| tasyāsīnmohinī bhāryā siṃhaladvīpasaṃbhavā || padminī haṃsagamanā pūrṇacaṃdranibhānanā ||21|| tasyāḥ sauṃdaryajaladhau magno bhūtvā mahīpatiḥ || aharniśamavijñāya reme tāṃ śatavatsaraiḥ ||22|| na cākāra prajānāṃ vai nyāyaṃ kāmena mohitaḥ || tadā sarvāḥ prajā rājanbabhūvurduḥkhapīḍitāḥ ||23|| prajānāṃ kadanaṃ vīkṣya mohinī nṛpavallabhā || nyāyaṃ cakāra sarvāsāṃ svaśaktyā yādaveśvara ||24|| ekadā taṃ nṛpaṃ drṣṭumaṣṭāvakro mahāmuniḥ || ājagāma nṛpasyāpi prāptaścāṃtaḥpure kila ||25|| tamāgataṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā nṛpaḥ strīlagnamānasaḥ || vijahāsa kurupo'yaṃ kasmātprāpta iti bruvan ||26|| tato ruṣā muniḥ prāha śṛṇu mūḍha napuṃsaka || munīnāṃ strījito bhūtvāpamānaṃ kiṃ kariṣyasi ||27|| tvaddeśe ca sadā rājyaṃ nāryaḥ kurvantu nityaśaḥ || na jīvati nṛpo rājye tasmādgaccha tvamālayāt ||28|| atra deśe striyaṃ prāpya yastāṃ bhajati nityaśaḥ || sa tu saṃvatsarāṃte vai na jīvati na saṃśayaḥ ||29|| garga uvāca ityuktvā svāśramaṃ so'pi prayayau munisattamaḥ || gate munau nṛpastatra klībo'bhūttasya śāpataḥ ||30|| sarvaṃ munikṛtaṃ jñātvā garhayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ || ātmānamātmanā caiva sa dīno duḥkhaduḥkhitaḥ ||31|| nārīpāla uvāca kiṃ kṛtaṃ maṃdabhāgyena strījitena mayā hyaho || munīnāṃ pūjanaṃ tyaktvā tathā nirayayāyinam ||32|| adya māṃ pāpinaṃ duṣṭaṃ yamadūtairvilokitam || dṛṣṭvā vaitaraṇīyogyaṃ kaḥ pratāpātpramokṣyati ||33|| ityuktvā sa gṛhaṃ tyaktvā vicacāra vane vane || bhajanvimuktidaṃ viṣṇuṃ lebhe cāṃte hareḥ padam ||34|| atra deśe ca rājāno rājyaṃ śāpabhayānvitāḥ || na kariṣyaṃti nāryyaśca kariṣyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ ||35|| śrīgarga uvāca evaṃ tayoḥ kathatornāryaḥ kruddhāḥ samāgatāḥ || vyamuṃcandhanuṣairbāṇānpuṃścalyaḥ krodhapūritāḥ ||36|| tāḥ strīrvīkṣyāniruddhastu vismito'bhūdbhayānvitaḥ || kathaṃ kariṣye yuddhaṃ vai strībhiḥ sārddhamiti bruvan ||37|| tadaiva tasya nikaṭe surūpā maṃḍaleśvarī || strībhiḥ prāptā cāniruddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā vacanamabravīt ||38|| rājñyuvāca tiṣṭha tiṣṭha raṇe vīra kuru yuddhaṃ mayā saha || senāyuktastathāpi tvaṃ kiṃ śocasi vṛthā raṇe ||39|| ahaṃ tvāṃ māninaṃ jitvā pradhane vṛṣṇibhiryutam || krīḍāmṛgaṃ kariṣyāmi madanajvarapīḍitā ||40|| iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvāniruddho bhayavihvalaḥ || pratyāha dīnayā vācā sarvavinmaṃḍaleśvarīm ||41|| turagaṃ kṛṣṇacaṃdrasya sarvadevadeveśvarasya ca || mahyaṃ prayaccha he rājñi kratorarthe tu svecchayā ||42|| nāhaṃ kariṣye yuddhaṃ vai tvayā sārddhaṃ varānane || gaccha dvārāvatīṃ tasmāddarśanārthaṃ hareśca vai ||43|| yannāmasmaraṇādbhadre naro yāti kṛtārthatām || tasya vai darśanasyāpi phalaṃ kiṃ kathayāmi te ||44|| iti sā cāniruddhena bodhitā nipuṇena vai || pūrvavārtāṃ smarantyāha brahmāṇaṃ mohinī yathā ||45|| surūpovāca ahaṃ purābhavaṃ deva svarveśyā pūrvajanmani || mohinī nāma vikhyātā kaṃjāṃgā kaṃjalocanā ||46|| ekadā haṃsayānena vrajaṃtaṃ padmasaṃbhavam || dṛṣṭvā tannikaṭe gatvā bhaja māmityuvāca ha ||47|| yadā na jagṛhe brahmā śāpaṃ datvā tadā hyaham || gatvā kakudmatītīre cakāra duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ||48|| tapasā toṣito brahmā tapo'nte ca samāgataḥ || tapasvinīṃ prasannātmā varaṃ brūhītyuvāca ha ||49|| tacchrutvā mohinī prāha devadeva namo'stu te || varaṃ varaya lokeśa dīnāṃ māṃ tapasi sthitām ||50|| yadi māṃ tvaṃ na gṛhṇāsi duḥkhitāṃ śaraṇāgatām || tadā roṣeṇa tyakṣyāmi tapasā ca kṛśāṃ tanum ||51|| iti śrutvā vidhiḥ prāha śokaṃ mā kuru bhāmini || anyajanmani te bhadre bhaviṣyati manorathaḥ || 52|| ahaṃ pautro bhaviṣyāmi dvārakāyāṃ hareśca vai || suvarṇaścāniruddhākhyaḥ strīrājye tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi ||53|| tato gṛhṇāmi tvāṃ bhadre nānṛtaṃ vacanaṃ mama || iti śrutvā ca tadvākyaṃ jātāhaṃ pṛthivītale ||54|| brahmā tvaṃ yādavaśreṣṭha madarthe ca samāgataḥ || garga uvāca vākyaṃ tasyāḥ samākarṇya yādavā vismayaṃ yayuḥ ||55|| aniruddhastu dharmātmā pratyāha vimalaṃ vacaḥ || aniruddha uvāca gaccha śrīdvārakāṃ bhadre tatra gṛhṇāmi tvāṃ priyām || adya yāsyāmi turagaṃ rājanyebhyaśca pālayan ||56|| tataḥ sā tasya vākyena pramilāṃ maṃtriṇīṃ varām || rājye kṛtvā turaṃgaṃ ca dattvā dvārāvatīṃ yayau ||57|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe strīrājyavijayo nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||17|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.18> garga uvāca atha mukto'niruddhena kratorvājī payaḥprabhaḥ || siṃhaladvīpanikaṭe vicacāra yadṛcchayā ||1|| tṛṣārtasturagastatra dṛṣṭvā vāpīṃ jalānvitām || vṛkṣaiśca bahubhirguptāṃ dṛṣṭvā toyaṃ papau svayam ||2|| vāpyāmaśvaṃ vilokyātha bhīṣaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ || vācayitvā ca tatpatraṃ jagrāha turagaṃ mudā ||3|| tadaiva yādavāḥ sarve taṃ paśyantaḥ samāgatāḥ || rākṣasena gṛhītaṃ vai dadṛśuḥ kratuvājinam ||4|| tataste kauṇapaṃ prāhuryādavā yuddhaśālinaḥ || yādavā ūcuḥ kastvaṃ śrīyādaveṃdrasya hyugrasenasya bhūpateḥ ||5|| siṃhasya vastu kroṣṭeva hayaṃ nītvā kva yāsyasi || tiṣṭha tiṣṭha raṇaṃ dhūrta asmābhiḥ kuru dhairyataḥ ||6|| turagaṃ mocayiṣyāmo vadhiṣyāmo raṇe ca tvām || śakunirbhrātṛsahito narako bāṇa eva ca ||7|| kalaṃkaścaiva rājāna ete'smābhirvināśitāḥ || tasmānna gaṇayiṣyāmo yuddhe tvāṃ ca tṛṇopamam ||8|| gaccha gaccha hayaṃ dattvā ghātayāmo na cetkhalu || teṣāṃ bhāṣitamākarṇya bhīṣaṇaḥ surabhīṣaṇaḥ ||9|| śūlī gadādharaḥ khaḍgī tānpratyāha ruṣānvitaḥ || bhīṣaṇa uvāca ke yūyaṃ pratiyoddhāro mama bhakṣyā narāḥ smṛtāḥ ||10|| saṃmukhe rākṣasānāṃ te kiṃ kariṣyaṃti pauruṣam || yadā viśvajitaṃ yajñaṃ yādavena kṛtaṃ purā ||11|| tadāhaṃ kauṇapānnetuṃ laṅkāyāṃ ca gataḥ kila || yadāhaṃ rākṣāsānnītvā svapuryāṃ ca samāgataḥ ||12|| tadā'śṛṇonnāradādvai yajñaṃ pūrṇaṃ babhūva ha || punarvai hayamedhasya prayāsaṃ ca vṛthā kṛtam ||13|| yuṣmatsu madgṛhītaṃ ca turagaṃ mocayaṃti ke || tasmāddhayāśāṃ tyaktvā tu yūyaṃ gacchata gacchata ||14|| na cetsarvānprabhakṣyaṃti caturlakṣā mamānugāḥ || atra sthānātsamudre tu purī dvādaśayojane ||15|| upalaṃkā ca nāmnā
