vai varttate mama nirmitā || niśācaragaṇairyuktā sarpairbhogavatī yathā ||16|| ityuktvā sa hayaṃ nītvā sahasā svapurīṃ yayau || ākāśamārgeṇa nṛpa śokaṃ cakruśca yādavāḥ ||17|| aniruddhastataḥ prāha bhojarājaturaṃgamam || niśācareṇa nītaṃ vai mocayāmo vayaṃ katham ||18|| iti śrutvā ca sāṃbādyāḥ pratyāhurnayakovidāḥ || śokaṃ mā kuru te rājansthiteṣvasmāsu kiṃ bhayam ||19|| hayāḥ sapakṣāstvatsainye vimānāni śarāstathā || śūrāḥ saṃti mahāvīrā lokadvayajigīṣavaḥ ||20|| aśvairvayaṃ gamiṣyāmaḥ setuṃ kṛtvāthavā śaraiḥ || viṣṇudattena vā rājañchatrūṇāṃ nagarīṃ prati ||21|| sarveṣāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvāniruddho dhanvināṃ varaḥ || uddhavaṃ maṃtriṇāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ samāhūyedamabravīt ||22|| aniruddha uvāca kiṃ kariṣyāmyahaṃ maṃtriñchyāmakarṇe gate sati || tvacchāsane bhagavataḥ prerito'haṃ vadasva tat ||23|| matpitṛbhrātaraḥ sarve upāyaṃ pravadaṃti hi || yadi dāsyasi tvaṃ cājñāṃ tadā sarvaṃ karomyaham ||24|| uddhavastadvacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca vilajjitaḥ || ahaṃ kṛṣṇasya putrāṇāṃ pautrāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||25|| sadā dāso'smi nitarāmājñāvartī vadāmi kim || yadicchā tava caiteṣāṃ kuru sā ca bhaviṣyati ||26|| tataḥ prāhāniraddhastu yāsye'haṃ daityapattanam || akṣauhiṇīdaśayuto viṣṇudattena yādavāḥ ||27|| sāraṇaḥ kṛtavarmā ca yuyudhānaśca sātyakiḥ || akrūrasahitā ete senāṃ rakṣaṃtu cātra hi ||28|| ityuktvā sa vimānaṃ tvāruroha saha senayā || aṣṭādaśairhareḥ putrairuddhavena gadena ca ||29|| reje tato bhāskarabiṃbatulyaṃ dhaneśayānaṃ svabalena nītam || śrīkṛṣṇapautreṇa yadupravīrairyathā ca rāmeṇa purā kapīndraiḥ ||30|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe vimānārohaṇaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||18|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.19> śrīgarga uvāca atha rukmāvatī putro mahatyā senayā vṛtaḥ || upalaṃkāṃ vimānena prayayau dhanado yathā ||1|| yadubhistatra gatvā sa śarairāśīviṣopamaiḥ || babhaṃja nagarīṃ rājanvanānyupavanāni ca ||2|| krīḍāsthānāni dvārāṇi sadanāṭṭālatolikāḥ || gopurāṇi vimānāgrānnipetuḥ śastravṛṣṭayaḥ ||3|| musalāḥ śaktayaścaiva parighāśca śarāḥ śilāḥ || caṇḍavāyurabhūdrājan rajasā''cchāditā diśaḥ ||4|| ityardyamānā yadubhirbhīṣaṇasya purī bhṛśam || nābhyapadyata kalyāṇaṃ yathā śālvaiśca dvārikā ||5|| hāhākārastadaivāsīnnagaryāṃ nṛpasattama || asurā bhīṣaṇādyāśca babhūvurbhayavihvalāḥ ||6|| bādhyamānāṃ ca nagarīṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasapuṃgavaḥ || mābhaiṣṭetyabhayaṃ dattvā rākṣasaiḥ saha niryayau ||7|| tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ yādavānāṃ niśācaraiḥ || tatpuryāṃ caiva laṃkāyāṃ kapibhī rakṣasāṃ yathā ||8|| vṛṣṇīnāṃ caiva bāṇaughai rākṣasāśchinnakaṃdharāḥ || nipetustu samudre vai vṛkṣā vātahatā iva ||9|| kecitpṛthivyāṃ patitāḥ kecitpuryyamadhomukhāḥ || kecidūrdhvamukhā rājankecidvai paṃcatāṃ gatāḥ ||10|| tatra teṣāṃ śoṇitena durnadīca bhayaṃkarā || babhūva sā ca duṣpārā mahāvaitaraṇi yathā ||11|| tatra teṣāṃ balaṃ vīkṣya bhīṣaṇo vismayaṃ gataḥ || tiraścīnena netreṇa dṛṣṭvā prāha yadūnidam ||12|| bhavadbhiśca kṛtaṃ yuddhamākāśānnirbalairiva || aślāghanīyaṃ ca vṛthā yūyaṃ mānaṃ kariṣyatha ||13|| yuṣmākaṃ yadi deheṣu śaktiścedvidyate śṛṇu || mahītale tadāgatya mayā kuruta vai raṇam ||14|| ityākarṇya vacaḥ so'pi kārṣṇijaḥ karuṇāmayaḥ || vimānaṃ bhūtale kṛtvā pratyuvāca mahāsuram ||15|| aniruddha uvāca sahasā tvaṃ mayā sārddhaṃ raṇaṃ kuru mahāraṇe || kiṃ vicāreṇa bhavati bhayaṃ tyaktvā mahāsura ||16|| iti tadvākyamākarṇya bhīṣaṇo bhīmavikramaḥ || dhanuṣā paṃca nārācāṃstasyopari mumoca ha ||17|| aniruddho nirīkṣyātha svabāṇaistāndvidhākarot || ciccheda ca dhanustasya śareṇaikena līlayā ||18|| so'pyanyaṃ dhanurādāya sajjaṃ kṛtvā niśācaraḥ || sarpākāraiḥ śataśarairjaghāna kārṣṇinaṃdanam ||19|| rathastu tasya bhagno'bhūtsārathī paṃcatāṃ gataḥ || hayā mṛtyuṃ gatāḥ sarve prādyumnirmūrcchito'bhavat ||20|| tadaiva vṛṣṇayaḥ sarve sphuritādharapallavāḥ || svanāthaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭveṣūn muñcantaḥ samāgatāḥ ||21|| tānāgatānbahūndṛṣṭvā cāpaṃ dhṛtvāsuro ruṣā || gadayā pothayāmāsa daṃṣṭrayeva mṛgānhariḥ ||22|| gadāprahāravyathitā yādavāḥ patitā bhuvi || saṃbhinnacchinnasarvāṅgāḥ kecinnipatitā raṇe ||23|| tato gṛhītvā svagadāṃ gadaḥ saṃkarṣaṇānujaḥ || tāḍayāmāsa samare bhīṣaṇasya ca mūrddhani || 24|| gadāprahāravyathitaḥ sa papāta mahītale || cālayan vasudhāṃ rājan yathā vajrahato giraḥ ||25|| bhīṣaṇaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā mūrcchitaṃ bhagnaśīrṣakam || asurāste gadaṃ haṃtuṃ prāptāḥ śastradharāḥ kila ||26|| tānsarvānpothayāmāsa gadayā vajrakalpayā || rāmānujo yathā rājannṛsiṃho daṃṣṭrayā gajān ||27|| athotthito'niruddhastu bruvandhanvī kṣaṇena vai || bhīṣaṇo mama śatrurvai kva gataḥ sa mahā khalaḥ ||28|| utthitaṃ ca hareḥ pautraṃ dṛṣṭvā yādavapuṃgavāḥ || cakrurjayajayārāvaṃ devāḥ sarve ca harṣitāḥ ||29|| tato nāradavākyādvai bako nāma niśācaraḥ || bhīṣaṇasya pitāraṇyātkruddhastatrājagāma ha ||30|| kajjalādrisamo rājantālavṛkṣadaśotthitaḥ || lalajihvaśca durnetrastriśūlī ca gadādharaḥ ||31|| hastinaṃ vāmahastena gṛhītvā ca mukhena vai || prabhakṣan rudhirākrāṃtaḥ piśācasadṛśo mahān ||32|| padbhyāṃ tālapramāṇābhyāṃ kaṃpayanpṛthivītalam || bhayapradaśca devānāṃ janakālo vyadṛśyata ||33|| tamāyāṃtaṃ vilokyātha śaṃkitāstatra yādavāḥ || procuḥ parasparaṃ sarve smṛtvā kṛṣṇapadāṃbujam ||34|| yādavā ūcuḥ ko'yaṃ mitrāṇi gadata nikaṭe ca samāgataḥ || mahābībhatsarūpī vai kṛtāṃta iva nirbhayaḥ ||35|| iti bruvatsu sarveṣu āsītkolāhalo mahān || prasannastaṃ nirīkṣyātha babhūvuste niśācarāḥ ||36|| bhīṣaṇaṃ mūrcchitaṃ dṛṣṭvā bako rākṣasapuṃgavaḥ || śuśoca rājansaṃgrāme hā daiveti muhurvadan ||37|| tato mūrcchāṃ muhūrtena vihāya bhīṣaṇo nṛpa || utthitastu bruvanvākyaṃ gadaḥ kutra gato bhayāt ||38|| svaputramutthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā puruṣādastu harṣitaḥ || āliṃgyāśvāsayāmāsa suvākyairvākyakovidaḥ ||39 || bhīṣaṇaḥ pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā sahāyārthaṃ samāgatam || namaścakre mahārāja bhūtvā sa ca prasannadhīḥ ||40|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe bakāgamanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||19|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.20> garga uvāca athāsurāṇāṃ madhye vai sthitvā rājan ruṣānvitaḥ || ābhiprāyaṃ bhīṣaṇaṃ ca bakaḥ papraccha rākṣasaḥ ||1|| kimarthaṃ yādavaiḥ sārddhaṃ yuddhamāsīttṛṇopamaiḥ || tvaṃ ca yatra gato mūrcchāṃ rākṣasā nihatā aho ||2|| ityuktaḥ sa bakenāpi bhūtvā rājannavāṅmukhaḥ || hayamedhaturaṃgasya vārtāṃ sarvāmavarṇayat ||3|| śrutvā putrasya vacanaṃ gṛhītvā svagadāṃ bakaḥ || viveśa yadusainye vai jvalanastu yathā vane ||4|| padbhyāṃ mamarda pāṇibhyāṃ yādavānsaṃmukhe gatān || bhujābhyāṃ gadayo siṃho prasuptām̐śca mṛgānyathā ||5|| hayām̐ścikṣepa gagane gajām̐ścaiva rathām̐stathā || narām̐śca bhakṣayan yuddhe śabdaṃ cakre bako balī ||6|| nanāda tena lokaiśca viśvaṃ śabdena yādava || jātā ca badhirībhūtā pṛthivyāṃ janamaṇḍalī ||7|| atha tasyāpi yuddhena viparītena yādavāḥ || hāhetivādinaḥ sarve babhūvuḥ khinnamānasāḥ ||8|| bādhyamānāṃ ca svāṃ senāṃ rākṣasena durātmanā || bhṛśaṃ nirīkṣya tapto'bhūtsāṃbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ ||9|| gṛhītvā paṃca nārācānkodaṃḍe caṇḍavikramaḥ || nidhāyāśu mumocātha bakasyopari mānada ||10|| te bāṇāstaccharīraṃ vai bhitvā rājanmahītalam || viviśuste tu gatvā vai papurbhogavatījalam ||11|| sa hatastu śarai rājanpapāta cālayanmahīm || punarutthāya ca bako nanāda jaladasvanaḥ ||12|| punarjāṃbavatīputro jaghne taṃ paṃcabhiḥ śaraiḥ || tairbāṇairvibhramanso'pi laṃkāyāṃ nipapāta ha ||13|| āgatya triśikhaṃ rakṣastriśūlaṃ jvalanaprabham || rājansāṃbāya cikṣepa prasūnamiva hastine ||14|| triśūlamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā sāṃbo bāṇena līlayā || ciccheda pradhane śīghraṃ nāgaṃ nāgāṃtako yathā ||15|| tato nītvā gadāṃ gurvīṃ bakastu raṇadurmadaḥ || sāṃbasya turagān rājañjaghāna sārathiṃ tathā ||16|| rathaṃ caiva patākāṃ ca hatvā sāṃbamuvāca ha || rathamanyaṃ samāruhya yuddhaṃ kuru mayā saha ||17|| virathaṃ tvāmadharmeṇa na haniṣyāmyahaṃ raṇe || itīrito'sau daityena hasankiṃcidruṣānvitaḥ ||18|| śīghraṃ jaghāna gadayā hṛtkapāṭe bakasya ca || gadāhato bako yuddhe kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ ||19|| agaṇayya tataḥ sāṃbaṃ yadusainye viveśa ha || sa gatvā tatra gadayā gajavājirathānnarān ||20|| kauṇapaḥ pothayāmasa mṛgeṃdrastu yathā mṛgān || hāhākārastadaivāsīdyadusainye nṛpeśvara ||21|| tato vilokya roṣeṇa rājan rukmavatīsutaḥ || tatrāgato'bhayaṃ kurvan rathenākṣauhiṇīyutaḥ ||22|| aniruddha uvāca kiṃ kariṣyasi he mūḍha tyaktvā vīrasya saṃmukham || bhītānāṃ māraṇe ślāghā na bhaviṣyati te'sura ||23|| yadi śaktiśca tvaddehe vidyate śṛṇu madvacaḥ || matsaṃmukhe samāgatya kuru yuddhaṃ prayatnataḥ ||24|| iti śrutvāniruddhasya vākyaṃ rājanbakāsuraḥ || ruṣā sphuratsarpa iva yuddhārthaṃ śīghramāyayau ||25|| āgataṃ taṃ vilokyāthāniruddho dhanvināṃ varaḥ || nārācairdaśabhī rājañjaghāna pradhane ruṣā ||26|| te śarāstaccharīraṃ vai śīghraṃ bhitvā bahirgatāḥ || punaste bhīṣaṇaṃ bhitvā viviśurvai mahītalam ||27|| tataḥ papāta sa bako bhīṣaṇena samanvitaḥ || pṛthivyāṃ mūrcchito bhūtvā yathā vajrahato giriḥ ||28|| tadā jayajayarāvo yadusainye babhūva ha || nedurduṃdubhayaścaiva bheryyaḥ śaṃkhāśca gomukhāḥ ||29|| tataśca rākṣasāḥ sarve krodhapūritamānasāḥ || svanāthau patitau dṛṣṭvā yadūnhaṃtuṃ samāyayuḥ ||30|| tataḥ samabhavadyuddhamubhayoḥ senayormṛdhe || bāṇaiḥ khaḍgairgadābhiśca śaktibhirbhiṃdipālakaiḥ ||31|| rākṣasānāṃ balaṃ tīvraṃ dṛṣṭvā rājanhareḥ sutāḥ || aṣṭādaśa ca sāṃbādyā nijaghnurniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ||32|| tatra teṣāṃ ca bāṇaughaiḥ kauṇapāḥ patitā mṛdhe || kecinmṛtyuṃ gatāḥ keciddudruvurjīvitaiṣiṇaḥ ||33|| athotthito muhūrtena bako rājanbhayaṃkaraḥ || tvaraṃ jagāma śatroścāniruddhasya tu saṃmukhe ||34|| tatra gatvā gadāṃ gurvīṃ cikṣepa tacchiropari || bāhunā ca bako rājanhato'sīti bruvan vacaḥ ||35|| tāmāgatāṃ vilokyātha yamadaṃḍena mādhavaḥ || ciccheda sahasā rājankuvākyeneva mitratām ||36|| tataḥ kruddho bako yuddhe prasārya mukhamaṇḍalam || dudrāva taṃ bhakṣayituṃ rāhuścandramiva kvacit ||37|| āgataṃ taṃ nirīkṣyāthāniruddho dhanvināṃ varaḥ || yamadaṃḍaṃ punarnītvā tāḍayāmāsa tena tam ||38|| tato bhagnaśirā bhūtvā hyudvamanrudhiraṃ mukhāt || cālayanvasudhāṃ rājanpatito mūrcchito'bhavat ||39|| tataśca bhīṣaṇo roṣātpitaraṃ vīkṣya mūrcchitam || parigheṇa raṇe rājannijaghāna tu yādavān ||40|| tato'niruddho balavānnāgapāśena roṣataḥ || cakarṣa bhīṣaṇaṃ baddhvā nāgaṃ viṣṇuratho yathā ||41|| taṃ baddhaṃ pāśinaḥ pāśairbhagnamānamadhomukham || vinirjitaṃ hīnabalaṃ sāṃbo vacanamabravīt ||42|| asurendrāniruddhasya hayamedhaturaṃgamam || śīghraṃ prayaccha bhadraṃ te purīṃ gatvā vidhānataḥ ||43|| aniruddhaṃ hareḥ pautraṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ || nṝṇāṃ pradarśayan rūpaṃ vicaraṃtaṃ miṣeṇa ca ||44|| yaṃ namaṃti samāgatya devadaityanarāḥ surāḥ || taṃ viddhi kṛṣṇasadṛśaṃ nṝṇāṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ||45|| tena tvaṃ nirjito yuddhe duḥkhaṃ mā kuru rākṣasa || asmābhiḥ sahito gaccha kartuṃ kṛṣṇasya darśanam ||46|| garga uvāca bodhitaḥ so'pi sāṃbena muktaḥ pāśaiśca vāruṇaiḥ || purīṃ gatvā dadau tasmai dravyayuktaṃ turaṃgamam ||47|| tataḥso'pyaniruddhena turaṃgasya tu pālane || prārthito bhīṣaṇo rājanpratyuvāca vicārya tam ||48|| bhīṣaṇa uvāca yadā bhavati caitanyo matpitā surapālaka || tadāhaṃ tasya vacanādāgamiṣye na saṃśayaḥ ||49|| itīrito'sau kila bhīṣaṇena pradyumnaputraḥ kratuvāhanaṃ ca || kṛtvā vimāne yadusenayā vai svayaṃ samāruhya jagāma khaṃ hi ||50|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe upalaṃkāvijayo nāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||20|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.21> garga uvāca tataḥ prāptaḥ svasenāyāṃ vimānastha uṣāpatiḥ || śīghraṃ cākāśamārgeṇa nādayañjayadundubhīn ||1|| dṛṣṭvā tānāgatānsarve hyakrūrādyāśca yādavāḥ || militvā kuśalaṃ sarvaṃ papracchuste nyavedayan ||2|| tatastyaktvā vimūrcchāṃ vai bakastu sahasotthitaḥ || adṛṣṭvā yādavāṃstatra putraṃ papraccha roṣataḥ ||3|| tataḥ pitre bhīṣaṇo vai vārtāṃ sarvāmavarṇayat || śrutvā vacaḥ prāha bako ruṣā prasphuritādharaḥ ||4|| ahaṃ jānāmi yadavo vimānena kuśasthalīm || madbhayācca gatāḥ putra yathā siṃhabhayānmṛgāḥ ||5|| tasmādayādavīṃ pṛthvīṃ kariṣye'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ || haniṣyāmi yadūnsarvāngatvā kṛṣṇasya dvārakām ||6|| bhīṣaṇa uvāca manyuṃ niyaccha bho rājannasmākaṃ samayo na hi || prasīdati yadā devo tadā jeṣyāma yādavān ||7|| garga uvāca bodhitaḥ so'pi putreṇa tūṣṇīṃ bhūtvā bakāsuraḥ || vicacāra vane rājan vanajaṃtūnprabhakṣayan ||8|| tatasturaṃgaṃ vidhinābhiṣicya dānāni dattvā dvijapuṃgavebhyaḥ || vimocayāmāsa punarjayāya pradyumnaputro vijayo nṛpendra ||9|| hayastu muktaḥ kila kārṣṇijena svaraṃ prakurvannṛpa dhaivataṃ ca || paśyansa deśānbahuvīrayuktānbhadrāvatīṃ nāma purīṃ jagāma ||10|| tatra bhadrāvatīmaśvo nānācopavanairvṛtām || giridurgeṇa rājeṃdra tathā rajatamaṃdiraiḥ ||11|| mahāvīrajanairyuktāṃ yauvanāśvena pālitām || dṛḍhāṃ lauhakapāṭaiśca nṛpasyāgre sthito'bhavat ||12|| taṃ gṛhītvā tu tasyāpi vārtāṃ jñātvā nṛpeśvaraḥ || yuddhaṃ kartuṃ ca kupitaḥ sasainyo niryayau purāt ||13|| sasainyamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā yauvanāśvaṃ mahābalam || āhūya maṃtriṇaṃ prāha kṛṣṇabhaktaṃ hi kārṣṇijaḥ ||14|| aniruddha uvāca ko'yaṃ samāgato maṃtrinsaṃmukhe saha senayā || hayaharttā śatrumukhyo tatsarvaṃ kathayasva ca ||15|| uddhava uvāca nṛpo'yaṃ yauvanāśvākhyo marudhanvapateḥ sutaḥ || atra rājyaṃ ca kurute mṛte pitari sattama ||16|| ayaṃ ṣoḍaśavarṣīyo kumaṃtrivacanādraṇam || kariṣyati mahārāja māraṇīyaḥ sa na tvayā ||17|| iti śrutvā tathetyuktvā yauvanāśvena kārṣṇijaḥ || yuddhaṃ cakāra pradhane yathā nāgena nāgahā ||18|| taṃ tu te virathaṃ cakre hatvā cākṣauhiṇītrayam || pratyāha vimalaṃ vākyaṃ yauvanāśvamuṣāpatiḥ ||19|| aniruddha uvāca rājanprayaccha turagaṃ yuddhaṃ kuru na cenmayā || vākyaṃ śrutvā hareḥ pautraṃ jñātvā rājā bhayānvitaḥ ||20|| arpayāmāsa vidhinā tasmai yajñaturaṃgamam || bhūttvā kṛtāṃjalī rājā prārthitastena cābravīt ||21|| yauvanāśva uvāca dvārakāyāṃ yadā yajño bhaviṣyati nṛpeśvara || tadāhaṃ cāgamiṣyāmi kṛṣṇasyāṃghrī vilokitum ||22|| tataśca kṛtvā taṃ rājye vaṃditastena kārṣṇijaḥ || mumuce vājinaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vijayī vijayāya ca ||23|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe bhadrāvatīvijayo nāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||21|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.22> garga uvāca yadupravīrasya turaṃgamo vai vilokayan rājapuraṃ jagāma || nirikṣya mārge sapharāṃ nadīṃ ca hyavaṃtikāyā vipine sthito'bhūt ||1|| tadaiva tatrāgatavānmahātmā sāndīpaniḥ kṛṣṇagururdvijendraḥ || snātuṃ gṛhācchrītulasīsrajāḍhyaḥ sadhautavastraḥ prajapanhi kṛṣṇam ||2|| dadarśa tatrāpi jalaṃ pibaṃtaṃ turaṃgamaṃ vai dhavalaṃ sapatram || vākyaṃ bruvanneṣa kratośca vājī vimocitaḥ kena nṛpeśvareṇa ||3|| tatra snānaṃ prakurvaṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā biṃndu nṛpātmajam || hayasyārthe munirgatvā nodayāmāsa taṃ nṛpa ||4|| tataḥ savīrairbahubhiśca rājan rājādhidevītanayaśca śūraḥ || jagrāha vāhaṃ sahasā nirīkṣya natvā guruṃ tadvacasā prasannaḥ ||5|| hayaṃ gṛhītvā gurave darśayāmāsa harṣitaḥ || sa patraṃ vācayitvā''ha nṛpaṃ sāṃdīpanirmudā ||6|| sāṃdīpaniruvāca ugrasenasya turagaṃ viddhi prādyumnipālitam || yadṛcchayā''gataṃ rājankārṣṇijo'trāgamiṣyati ||7|| āgamiṣyaṃti bahavo yādavā yuddhaśālinaḥ || mitraviṃdātmajāścaiva paśyaṃtaste turaṃgamam ||8|| pūjanīyāstvayā sarve kṛṣṇacandrasya nandanāḥ || madvākyādyuddhabuddhiṃ tvaṃ tyaktvā dehi turaṃgamam ||9|| iti śrutvā gurorvākyaṃ dhanvī śūro nṛpātmajaḥ || hayaṃ netuṃ mano yasya tatra tūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha ||10|| tadaiva yadusenāyāḥ śabdo'bhūllokamānahā || mahānādaṃ duṃdubhīnāṃ ṭaṃkāraṃ dhanuṣāṃ tathā ||11|| cītkāraṃ daṃtināṃ caiva hayānāṃ heṣaṇaṃ tathā || jhaṇatkāraṃ rathānāṃ ca vīrāṇāṃ garjanaṃ tathā ||12|| śataghnīnāṃ mahāśabdaṃ lokānāṃ bhayadāyakam || śrutvā rājakumārastu vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ||13|| tataḥ samāgatāḥ sarvai rathibhiśca gajairhayaiḥ || bhojavṛṣṇyaṃdhakamadhuśūrasenadaśārhakāḥ ||14|| rajobhiśca nabho vyāptaṃ kurvataścalitāṃ mahīm || kena nītaḥ kutra gato hayaḥ sarve'bruvanvacaḥ ||15|| tataśca dadṛśuḥ sarve ghoṭakaṃ baddhacāmaram || mahādbhute copavane puṣpitadrumasaṃkule ||16|| gṛhītaṃ līlayā tatra nṛpaputreṇa biṃdunā || dṛṣṭvāniruddhaṃ nikaṭe gatvā sarve hyavarṇayan ||17|| iti śrutvā'niruddhastu vismitaḥ prahasannṛpa || uddhavaṃ preṣayāmāsa bindoḥ pārśve ca dharmavit ||18|| tataḥ puryāṃ mahārāja cāsītkolāhalo mahān || bhayabhītā janāḥ sarve senāṃ vīkṣya bhayaṃkarām ||19|| atha vai bhrātaraṃ drṣṭuṃ hyanubiṃdurbhayānvitaḥ || koṭivīragaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ svapuryā niryayau bahiḥ ||20|| dṛṣṭvā yajñahayaṃ tatra sapatraṃ ca payaḥprabham || bhrātrā gṛhītaṃ ca bhayānniṣedhaṃ sa cakāra ha ||21|| anubiṃduruvāca yadūnāṃ kṛṣṇadevānāṃ bhrātarmocaya ghoṭakam || sambandhasya miṣeṇāpi kulakauśalahetave ||22|| yādavānāṃ balaṃ paśya devadaityanarāsurāḥ || purā yajñe rājasūye sarve bhrātarnvinirjitāḥ ||23|| iti tadvākyamākarṇya bindurjyeṣṭho'vadharṣitaḥ || āgataṃ hyuddhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā hayasthaṃ pratyuvāca ha ||24|| biṃduruvāca mayā gṛhītasturago mitrāṇāṃ milanāya ca || tasmānnimaṃtritāḥ sarve sthitiṃ kuruta cātra vai ||25|| iti śrutvoddhavo rājanbiṃduṃ saṃślāghya harṣitaḥ || aniruddhasya nikaṭe gatvā sarvamuvāca ha ||26|| śrutvāniruddhastadvākyaṃ bhūtvā rājan prasannadhīḥ || senayāvaṃtikāyāṃ ca nadītīre'vasatkila ||27|| aneke śibirā rājaṃstatra vai daśayojane || nānāvarṇāḥ sakalaśā hyabhūvannadbhutāḥ śubhāḥ ||28|| bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca lehyaṃ ca coṣyametaiśca bhojanaiḥ || āgatebhyaśca sarvebhyo biṃdurarhaṇamāharat ||29|| tathā caiva tṛṇānnādīnpaśubhyo dattavānnṛpaḥ || īdṛgvidhaṃ ca satkāraṃ vṛṣṇīnāṃ sa cakāra ha ||30|| nṛpo rājādhidevī ca dvau tathā nṛpanaṃdanau || bhṛśaṃ mumudire sarve vīkṣya sarvānhareḥ sutān ||31|| tato niśāyāṃ kila kārṣṇiputro vidyāguraṃ ca svapitāmahasya || āhūya natvā''sanameva dattvā pratyāha kṛtvā varapūjanaṃ ca ||32|| bhagavandvārakāyāṃ ca kṛṣṇavākyātkratūttamam || karoti hayamedhākhyaṃ cakravartī yadūttamaḥ ||33|| tasminkratuvare brahmankṛpāṃ kṛtvā mamopari || tvaṃ tu gaccha muniśreṣṭha putreṇa ca samanvitaḥ ||34|| aniruddhasya vacanaṃ śrutvā sāṃdīpanirmuniḥ || kṛṣṇadarśanakāṃkṣī ca calituṃ sa mano dadhe ||35|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe avaṃtikāgamanaṃ nāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||22|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.23> garga uvāca atha sāṃdīpaniṃ tatra kṛṣṇapautro'bravīdvacaḥ || smṛtvā tu kiṃcitsaṃdehaṃ guruṃ vṛddhaśravā iva ||1|| aniruddha uvāca bhagavanbrūhi me sāraṃ yenānaṃde ramāmyaham || vihāya cāsya jagataḥ sukhānsvapnopamānmune ||2|| itīrito'niruddhena rājansāṃdīpanirmuniḥ || pratyāha prahasanprītyā kumāraḥ pṛthunā yathā ||3|| sāṃdīpaniruvāca ādidevastvamevāsīcchrīharernābhipaṃkajāt || tasmāttavāgre lokeśa kathayiṣyāmi kiṃ tvaham ||4|| tathāpi varṇayiṣyāmi rājaṃstvadvākyagauravāt || kalyāṇārthaṃ narāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ dīnacetasām ||5|| tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ ca yadrājam̐stacchṛṇuṣva mukhānmama || kṛṣṇacaṃdrasya padayoḥ sāramasti hi sevanam ||6|| yayoḥ pūjanamātreṇa dhruvo dhruvapadaṃ yayau || prahlādaścāṃbarīṣaśca gayaścaiva yadustathā ||7|| tasmāttvamapi rājeṃndra śrīkṛṣṇasya ca sevanam || sarveṣāṃ sārarūpaṃ yanmanasā kuru yatnataḥ ||8|| yūyaṃ loke bhūribhāgāḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya ca vaṃśajāḥ || jñātisaṃbaṃdhinaścaiva jīvanmuktā haripriyāḥ ||9|| kecijjānaṃti śrīkṛṣṇaṃ tanayaṃ ke'pi bhrātaram || pitaraṃ ke'pi mitraṃ ca kiṃ kartavyaṃ paraṃ ca taiḥ ||10|| aniruddha uvāca kaḥ kartā cāsya jagata ādirūpaḥ sanātanaḥ || yasmādāsītpūrvamidaṃ tanme varṇaya vistarāt ||11|| kena kenāpi rūpeṇa bhagavāñjagadīśvaraḥ || yuge yuge mune dharmaṃ karotīti vadasva naḥ ||12|| sāṃdīpaniruvāca uttpatiśca nirodhaśca yasmādāsīdyadūdvaha || sa īśvaraḥ parabrahma bhagavāneka eva ca ||13|| yuge yuge bhavaṃtyete dakṣādyā nṛpasattama || punaścaiva niruddhyaṃte vidvām̐statra na muhyati ||14|| rājankṛṣṇaḥ paraṃ brahma yataḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat || jagaccayo yatra cedaṃ yasmim̐śca layameṣyati ||15|| tadbrahma paramaṃ dhāma sadasatparamaṃ padam || yasya sarvamabhedena jagadetaccarācaram ||16|| sa eva mūlaprakṛtirvyaktarūpī jagacca saḥ || tasminneva layaṃ sarvaṃ yāti tatraiva tiṣṭhati ||17|| yataḥ pradhānapuruṣau yataścaitaccarācaram || kāraṇaṃ sakalasyāsya sa me kṛṣṇaḥ prasīdatu ||18|| caturyuge'pyasau viṣṇuḥ sthitivyāpāralakṣaṇaḥ || yugavyavasthāṃ kurute yathā rājendra tacchṛṇu ||19|| kṛte yuge paraṃ jñānaṃ kapilādisvarūpadhṛk || dadāti sarvabhūtātmā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ ||20|| cakravartisvarūpeṇa tretāyāmapi sa prabhuḥ || duṣṭānāṃ nigrahaṃ kurvanparipāti jagattrayam ||21|| vedamekaṃ caturbhedaṃ kṛtvā sa śatadhā vibhuḥ || karoti bahulaṃ bhūyo vedavyāsasvarūpadhṛk ||22|| vedāṃśca dvāpare nyasya kaleraṃte punarhariḥ || kalkisvarūpī durvṛttānmārge sthāpayati prabhuḥ ||23|| evaṃ kṛṣṇo jagatsarvaṃ jagatpāti karoti ca || haṃti cāṃteṣvanaṃtātmā nānyasmādvyatirekataḥ ||24|| namo'stu haraye tasmai yasmādbhinnamidaṃ jagat || dhyeyaḥ sa jagatāmādyaḥ sa prasīdatu me'vyayaḥ ||25|| tasmānnṛpeṃdra haripautra manomayaṃ ca sarvaṃ vihāya jagataśca sukhaṃ ca duḥkham || mokṣapradaṃ suravaraṃ kila sarvadaṃ tvaṃ dvārāvatīnarapatiṃ bhaja kṛṣṇacaṃdram ||26|| iti kṛṣṇasya hareśca vṛttasāraṃ kathayati yāśca śṛṇoti bhaktiyuktaḥ || sa vimalamatireti nātmamohaṃ bhavati ca saṃsmaraṇeṣu bhaktiyogyaḥ ||27|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe vairāgyakathanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||23|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.24> garga uvāca itīdaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvāniruddhastu mudānvitaḥ || niveśya kṛṣṇapadayoḥ svamanaḥ prāha taṃ munim ||1|| gataḥ śatruśca me mohastvadvākyenāsinā vibho || adya tvaṃ gaccha kṛṣṇasya purīṃ putreṇa saṃyutaḥ ||2|| tasya vākyaṃ samākarṇya mudā sāṃdīpanirmuniḥ || kṛṣṇadattena putreṇa rathastho dvārakāṃ yayau ||3|| sa puryāṃ rāmakṛṣṇābhyāmādareṇa nivāsitaḥ || pūjito yādavaiḥ sarvairbhojeṃdreṇa vidhānataḥ ||4|| atha pradyumnatanayaḥ śyāmakarṇaṃ mahojjvalam || svarṇaśṛṅkhalayā baddhe mumoca vijayāya ca ||5|| hayaśca śīghraṃ pravrajannṛpendra yaśo bruvān rājapure gataḥ saḥ || yatrānuśālvo nṛpatiśca rājyaṃ śālvasya bhrātā kurute ca nityam ||6|| tatra vai turagaṃ prāptamanuśālvo yadṛcchayā || gṛhītvā vācayāmāsa tatpatraṃ ca praharṣitaḥ ||7|| ābhiprāyaṃ nirīkṣyaiva tiraścīnena cakṣuṣā || svasainikānpratyuvāca ruṣā prasphuritādharaḥ ||8|| diṣṭyā diṣṭyā śatravo me sarve cātra samāgatāḥ || ghātayiṣyāmi tānsarvānyairme bhrātā ca māritaḥ ||9|| ityuktvā senayā yukto niścakrāma purādbahiḥ || akṣauhiṇībhirdaśabhistṛṇīkṛtya tu yādavān ||10|| tadaiva vṛṣṇayaḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā senāṃ samāgatām || bāṇavarṣāṃ pramuṃcaṃtīṃ mumucuste śarāṃśca vai ||11|| ubhayoḥ senayoryuddhaṃ tataḥ samabhavanmṛdhe || khaḍgairbāṇairgadābhiśca śaktibhirbhiṃdipālakaiḥ ||12|| palāyamānāṃ svāṃ senāmanuśālvo mahābalaḥ || vārayitvā nadan yuddhe cājagāma rathena vai ||13|| tamāgataṃ vilokyātha dīptimānkṛṣṇanandanaḥ || tena sārddhaṃ raṇaṃ karttuṃ tadaiva saṃmukho'bhavat ||14|| dīptimaṃtaṃ raṇe vīkṣya dhanuṣā daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ || tatāḍāmarṣitaḥ so'pi dvipaṃ dvīpī nakhairiva ||15|| tāḍitastaiḥ śaraughaistu rudhirokṣitabāhunā || nītvā śarāsanaṃ sadyo bāṇāñjagrāha roṣataḥ ||16|| nidhāya kila kodaṃḍe daśa bāṇānmumoca ha || te śarāstaccharīraṃ vai bhitvā rājanbahirgatāḥ ||17|| yathā tṛṇagṛhaṃ rājansahasā pannagāśanāḥ || tairbāṇairnihato yuddhe'nuśālvo mūrcchito'bhavat ||18|| tatrāgatya hareḥ putro bhānuḥ sarvān ripūñcharaiḥ || nīhārābhrānbhānuriva chinnabhinnāṃścakāra ha ||20|| tataśca dudruvuḥ sarve'nuśālvasya tu sainikāḥ || tadaiva tasya maṃtrī vai pracaṇḍo tāma roṣataḥ ||21|| śaktyā jaghāna samare satyabhāmātmajaṃ nṛpa || bhānośca hṛdayaṃ bhittvā sā viveśa mahītale ||22|| sa cāpi mūrcchito bhūttvā nipapāta rathādraṇe || sa evaṃ kautukaṃ vīkṣya sāṃbastatra ruṣā jvalan ||23|| śīghraṃ gṛhītvā kodaṃḍamājagāma rathena vai || pracaṇḍasya rathaṃ sāṃbaḥ saturaṃgaṃ sasārathim ||24|| sadhvajaṃ śatabāṇaiśca sarvaṃ cūrṇīcakāra ha || rathe bhagne gadāṃ nītvā pracaṇḍo raṇadurmadaḥ ||25|| ājagāma ripuṃ haṃtuṃ pataṃga iva pāvakam || āgataṃ taṃ vilokyātha candrārkākāravarcasā ||26|| śareṇaikena sāṃbastu jahāra tacchiro mṛdhe || hāhākārastadaivāsīttatsenayāṃ nṛpeśvara ||27|| athotthito'nuśālvastu mūrcchāṃ tyaktvā muhūrtataḥ || dadarśa maṃtriṇaṃ tatra sāṃbena nihataṃ mṛdhe ||28|| nirīkṣya rathamāruhya dhanvī khaḍgī ca daṃśitaḥ || śilīmukhaiścaturbhiśca sāṃbasya caturo hayān ||29|| dvābhyāṃ ketuṃ tribhiḥ sūtaṃ paṃcabhiśca śarāsanam || triṃśadbhiśca śarairyānaṃ jaghāna samare nṛpaḥ ||30|| sa chinnadhanvā viratho hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ || rathaṃ cānyaṃ samāruhya reje jāṃbavatīsutaḥ ||31|| tato gṛhītvā kodaṃḍaṃ śatabāṇairamarṣitaḥ || tatāḍa sa ripuṃ yuddhe sarpaṃ pakṣairyathā virāṭ ||32|| yānastasyāpi bhagno'bhūtturaṃgāḥ paṃcatāṃ gatāḥ || sūto mṛtyuṃ gato yuddhe'nuśālvo mūrcchito'bhavat ||33|| tatastatsainikāḥ sarve gṛdhrapakṣaiḥ sphuratprabhaiḥ || āśīviṣasamairbāṇaiḥ sāṃbaṃ jaghnū ruṣānvitāḥ ||34|| sāṃbamekaṃ raṇe vīkṣya madhuḥ kṛṣṇasuto ruṣā || pārāvatasamenāpi hayenāgatavānmṛdhe ||35|| sākaṃ sāṃbena tānsarvānnistriṃśena ripūnkhalān || praharārddhena rājendra mārayanvicacāra ha ||36|| tato'nuśālva utthāya dṛṣṭvā svasya parājayam || salilena śucirbhūtvā haṃtuṃ sarvānmano dadhe ||37|| brahmāstraṃ saṃdadhe roṣānmayadaityena śikṣitam || ajānaṃstasya nāśaṃ ca saṃprāpte prāṇasaṃkaṭe ||38|| tasyāpi dāruṇaṃ tejo trīṃllokānpradahanmahat || cacāra hyaṃtarikṣe ca dvādaśādityasannibham ||39|| tattejasā durviṣaheṇa sarve saṃdahyamānā yadavaśca bhītāḥ || prādyumnipārśvaṃ prayayurbruvanto rakṣasva duḥkhānnṛhare mahātman ||40|| tataḥ kṛtvābhayaṃ rājan vīro rukmāvatīsutaḥ || brahmāstreṇa tu brahmastraṃ jahāra pradhane ruṣā ||41|| vahnyastraṃ so'pi cikṣepa vahninā pūritaṃ nabhaḥ || dahyamānā ca bhūstatra jvālābhiriva khāṃḍavam ||42|| tato'niruddho balavān vāruṇāstraṃ punardadhe || pracaṃḍameghadhārābhirvahniḥ śītalatāṃ gataḥ ||43|| maṇḍūkāḥ kokilāścaiva mayūrāḥ sārasādayaḥ || pratyanaṃdanmahāmeghairvarṣāṃ jñātvā punaḥ punaḥ ||44|| tato'nuśālvo māyāvī pavanāstraṃ samādadhe || dṛṣṭvāniruddho yuyudhe parvatāstreṇa sarvataḥ ||45|| tato bhārasahasrāḍhyaṃ nītvā so'pi gadāṃ mṛdhe || aniruddhaṃ śūramaṇīṃ kruddho vacanamabravīt ||46|| tvatsainye nāsti rājeṃdra gadāyuddhaviśāradāḥ || yadi cāsti tarhi mahyaṃ taṃ tu śīghraṃ pradarśaya ||47|| iti tadvākyamākarṇya gadādhārī gado mahān || uvāca cāgrato bhūtvāniruddhasya prapaśyataḥ ||48|| atra vai bahavaḥ saṃti sarvaśastraviśāradāḥ || mānaṃ mā kuru daityeṃdra tvamekākī raṇe'si hi ||49|| na manyase tvaṃ madvākyaṃ mayā sākaṃ raṇe'sura || kuru pūrvaṃ gadāyuddhaṃ tato'nyāndraṣṭumarhasi ||50|| ityuktvā sa gadāṃ nītvā lakṣabhāramayīṃ dṛḍhām || tathānuśālvaṃ jaghne tu mūrdhni vakṣasthale nṛpa ||51|| anuśālvastu gadayā jaghāna samare gadam || tato'nyonyaṃ gadābhyāṃ ca jaghnatuḥ krodhamūrcchitau ||52|| tato gadaḥ samutthāpyānuśālvaṃ gagane'kṣipat || bhrāmayitvā śataguṇaṃ nipapāta mahītale ||53|| tato'nuśālva utthāya gṛhītvā rohiṇīsutam || bhūmau mamarda rājeṃdra tadadbhutamivābhavat ||54|| gado gajaṃ gṛhītvaikamanuśālvopari cākṣipat || tamāyāṃtaṃ gajaṃ nītvā cikṣepa sa balānuje ||55|| jānubhirmuṣṭibhirghoraiḥ prahāraistau ca jaghnatuḥ || marditau tāvubhau mahyāṃ patitau mūrcchanāṃ gatau ||56|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe rājapuravijayo nāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||24|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.25> garga uvāca evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tayoryuddhaṃ yādavāḥ parasainikāḥ || ūcuḥ parasparaṃ dhanyo'nuśālvastu gado mahān ||1|| iti bruvatsu sarveṣu gadastatraiva cotthitaḥ || kva gataḥ kva gataḥ śatrurhatvā māṃ ca bruvan raṇāt ||2|| tato'nuśālvaṃ hastena gṛhītvā''kṛṣya roṣataḥ || aniruddhasya nikaṭe pātayāmāsa vegataḥ ||3|| patitaṃ mūrcchitaṃ dṛṣṭvā hyaniruddhastvadhomukham || kārayāmasa caitanyaṃ vyajanaiḥ salilena ca ||4|| tadaiva sa prabuddho'bhūdanuśālvo'sureśvaraḥ || dṛṣṭvāgre sundaraṃ so'pi kṛṣṇapautraṃ ghanaprabham ||5|| natvā pratyāha vacanaṃ tvaṃ tu me prāṇarakṣakaḥ || aniruddha hareḥ pautra aparādhaṃ kṣamasva me ||6|| oṃ namo vāsudevāya namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇāya ca || pradyumnāya namastubhyamaniruddhāya te namaḥ ||7|| gṛhāṇa vai turaṅgaṃ tamahaṃ yāsyāmi pālayan || ityuktvā svapuraṃ gatvā dadau tasmai turaṃgamam ||8|| ayutaṃ hastināṃ caiva hayānāṃ niyutaṃ tathā || arddhalakṣaṃ rathānāṃ ca śibikānāṃ sahasrakam ||9|| uṣṭrāṇāṃ hi sahasraṃ ca gavayānāṃ sahasrakam || paṃjare saṃsthitānāṃ ca siṃhānāṃ dvisahasrakam ||10|| mṛgayāsārameyāṇāṃ sahasraṃ nṛpasattama || śibirāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca śiñjināṃ niyutaṃ tathā ||11|| javanikānāmayutaṃ dhenūnāṃ lakṣameva ca || sahasrabhāraṃ svarṇānāṃ rajatānāṃ caturguṇam ||12|| muktānāṃ bhāramekaṃ cāniruddhāya dadau nṛpaḥ || aniruddhastatastasmai maṇihāraṃ dadau mudā ||13|| anuśālvaḥ svarājye tu kṛtvā vai sacivaṃ varam || yādavaiḥ sahitaḥ so'pi deśānanyāñjagāma ha ||14|| tato vimuktasturago maṇikāṃcanabhūṣitaḥ || deśānanyān vīrayuktānpaśyanbabhrāma bhūpate ||15|| anuśālvaṃ jitaṃ śrutvā yauvanāścaṃ ca bhīṣaṇam || rājāno'nye maṃḍaleśāḥ prāptaṃ na jagṛhurhayam ||16|| ityevaṃ bhramatastasya turagasya viśāṃ pate || māsāśca pragatāḥ ṣaḍvai tādṛśāścāvaśeṣitāḥ ||17|| hayo maṇipureśena gṛhītaśca vimocitaḥ || tathā ratnapureśena hyaniruddhabhayānnṛpa ||18|| rāṣṭrānsarvānaśūrāṃśca vihāya turagottamaḥ || yayau prācīṃ diśaṃ rājanbalvalo yatra daityarāṭ ||19|| so'pi daityo hayasyāpi vārtāṃ śrutvā ca nāradāt || yajñaṃ śīghraṃ nāśayitvā naimiṣāccājagāma ha ||20|| sthitaṃ triveṇyāṃ salilaṃ pibaṃtaṃ prayāgatīrthe kratuvāhanaṃ ca || vilokya rājankila balvalākhyo jagrāha śīghraṃ hyagaṇayya kṛṣṇam ||21|| tadaiva vṛṣṇayaḥ sarve daṃḍakaṃ ca vyalokayan || cārmaṇvatīṃ samuttīrya citrakūṭaṃ samāyayuḥ ||22|| rāmakṣetre ca dānāni kṛtvāśvaṃ cāvalokayan || tasyāpi pṛṣṭhato lagnā ājagmustīrthavāsavam ||23|| dadṛśustatra turagaṃ sapatraṃ yadusattamāḥ || gṛhītaṃ svabalādrājannasureṇa durātmanā ||24|| tataste balvalaṃ dṛṣṭvā nīlāṃjanacayopamam || yojanadvayamuccāṃgamugramaṃgāralocanam ||25|| taptatāmraśikhāśmaśrudaṃṣṭrograbhrukuṭīmukham || brahmadruhaṃ lalañjihvaṃ gajāyutasamaṃ balam ||26|| tamūcuryādavā roṣātsphuritādharapallavāḥ || kastvaṃ yajñapaśuṃ nītvā hyasmākaṃ ca kva yāsyasi ||27|| tasmānmocaya taṃ śīghraṃ na ceddhanmo raṇe ca tvām || iti śrutvāsuraścāha vacaḥ śṛṇuta me narāḥ ||28|| balvala uvāca ahaṃ tu balvalo daityo devānāṃ duḥkhadāyakaḥ || yasyāgre mānuṣāḥ sarve bhavaṃti bhayavihvalāḥ ||29|| iti śrutvā ca yadavo jaghnurbāṇaiśca balvalam || sa hatastaiśca sahasā sahayo'ntardadhe nṛpa ||30|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe balvalena turagaharaṇaṃ nāma paṃcaviśo'dhyāyaḥ ||25|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.26> garga uvāca atha sarve yadugaṇā gate kratupaśau nṛpa || śokaṃ cakruḥ kva gacchāmaḥ kariṣyāmaśca kiṃ bhuvi ||1|| na tatpratividhiṃ sarve'niruddhādyā vidustataḥ || tadā nāradarūpī vai bhagavānāgamannṛpa ||2|| tamāgataṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā'niruddho yādavairvṛtaḥ || pūjayitvāsane sthāpya prītaḥ prāha munīśvaram ||3|| aniruddha uvāca bhagavan yajñaturago balvalena duratmanā || nītaḥ kutra gataḥ sarvaṃ vada me vadatāṃ vara ||4|| tvaṃ paryaṭannarka iva trilokīṃ divyadarśanaḥ || antaścaro vāyuriva hyātmasākṣī ca sarvavit || tasmātkathaya sarvaṃ me śrutvā so'pyāha mādhavam ||5|| nārada uvāca rājaṃstava turaṃgo vai balvalena niveśitaḥ ||6|| upadvīpe pāṃcajanye siṃdhumadhye nṛpeśvara || mṛte mitre ca śakunau yādavānāṃ vadhāya ca ||7|| sutalācca samāhūya daityavṛndānmahāsuraḥ || rājyaṃ karoti tatrāpi śivasya varadarpitaḥ ||8|| iti śrutvāniruddhastu vacaḥ provāca śaṃkitaḥ || aniruddha uvāca tasmai candralalāmena kiṃ dattaṃ pravaraṃ varam ||9|| tanmamākhyāhi devarṣe kasmātsaṃtoṣito'bhavat || tato babhāṣe sa muniḥ śṛṇu rājan vaco mama ||10|| kailāse caikadā daityo hyekapādena saṃsthitaḥ || varṣadvādaśaparyaṃtaṃ tapaścakre sudāruṇam ||11|| tataśca toṣito devo varaṃ brūhītyuvāca ha || tacchrutvā sa uvācātha sadāśiva namo'stu te ||12|| mahāmṛdhe ca māṃ deva pālayasva kṛpānidhe || tathāstu coktvā devastu tatraivāṃtardadhe nṛpa ||13|| sa daityo pāṃcajanyo vai rājyaṃ cakre balāttataḥ || svatastubhyaṃ na turagaṃ vinā yuddhena dāsyati ||14|| aniruddhastu provāca hatvā duṣṭaṃ ca balvalam || sasainyaṃ ca muniśreṣṭha mocayiṣye turaṃgamam ||15|| sa śivasya vareṇāpi yadi yuddhaṃ kariṣyati || na pālayiṣyati mṛdhe śivaḥ kṛṣṇadviṣaṃ khalam ||16|| ityuktvā cāniruddho vai prayāṇārthe jayāya ca || yādavebhyaśca sarvebhyaḥ sahasā''jñāṃ cakāra ha ||17|| tato'nujñāpya devarṣiḥ yuddhakautukasaṃyutaḥ || yayau cākāśamārgeṇa tatra sthānaṃ nṛpeśvara ||18|| tadaiva yādavāḥ sarve sajjībhūtā ruṣānvitāḥ || snātvā kṛtvā ca dānāni tīrtharāje vidhānataḥ ||19|| upadvīpaṃ yayū rājan rathibhiśca gajairhayaiḥ || dvilakṣā mārgakārāśca mārgaṃ cakrurdine dine ||20|| bhiṃdipālaiśca sarvatra senāyāḥ pūrvameva hi || sukhena yatra gacchaṃti gajavājituraṃgamāḥ ||21|| padātayaśca rājeṃdra mārge niṣkaṇṭake tvaram || itthaṃ tu yadusenāyāḥ śeṣo bhāreṇa pīḍitaḥ || iti hovāca manasi kiṃ babhūva dharātale ||22|| aniruddho'grato bhūtvālakṣitaḥ prayayau nṛpa ||23|| hayarakṣāpadeśādvai nāśayanniva pāpinaḥ || yatra yatra gato rājanhayasyārthe ca kārṣṇijaḥ ||24|| tatra tatropaśṛṇvānaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya yaśo'khilam || ślāghāṃ ye vai kariṣyaṃti goviṃdabaladevayoḥ ||25|| dadau tebhyaśca ratnāni vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca || yatkiṃcittasya sainyeṣu vasumātramanuttamam ||26|| tatsarvamadadātprītaḥ kṛṣṇagāthāhṛtāśayaḥ || itthaṃ śṛṇvanharergāthāṃ kāśīṃ paśyangayāṃ tathā ||27|| kurvandānāni rājendra kāṣṭhāṃ prācīṃ jagāma saḥ || itthaṃ bhayaṃkarīṃ senāṃ yādavānāṃ vilokya ca ||28|| girivrajapurādhīśaḥ sahadevastu śaṃkitaḥ || bhūtvā kṛtāṃjalirnītvā ratnāni vividhāni ca ||29|| aniruddhasya padayoḥ papāta bhayavihvalaḥ || aniruddhastatastasmai ratnamālāṃ dadau mudā ||30|| rājye kṛtvā ca taṃ śīghraṃ śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ || samanvito vṛṣṇivarairjagāma kapilāśramam ||31|| snātvā ca tatraiva yadupravīro bhāgīrathīsāgarasaṃgame ca || vilokya siddhaṃ kapilaṃ munīdraṃ sasenayā so'pi namaścakāra ||32|| tatrasthānāddakṣiṇasyāṃ siṃdhutīre ca tasya vai || babhūvuḥ śibirā rājannuccāḥ prāsādasannibhāḥ ||33|| śibireṣvaniruddhādyā yādavāstatra sānugāḥ || cakrurnivāsaṃ rājendra śūrāḥ sarve jayaiṣiṇaḥ ||34|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe turagārthamupadvīpagamanaṃ nāma ṣaḍviśo'dhyāyaḥ ||26|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.27> garga uvāca athāniruddho yadurāṭ prātaḥkāle viśāṃ pate || uddhavaṃ tu samāhūya prāha gaṃbhīrayā girā ||1|| kati dūraṃ pāṃcajanyaṃ tanmamākhyāhi sattama || yasminmadīyo turago nīto daityena varttate ||2|| ityudāhṛtamākarṇya maṃtrī kṛṣṇasuhṛtsakhaḥ || manasā kṛṣṇapādābjaṃ smṛtvā provāca mādhavam ||3|| prabho sarvajña bhagavannahaṃ tvadvākyagauravāt || kathayiṣyāmi lokeśa yathā mārge śrutaṃ tathā ||4|| triṃśadyojanavistīrṇātsāgarātpārameva ca|| upadvīpaṃ pāṃcajanyaṃ dakṣiṇe'sti nṛpeśvara ||5|| uddhavasya vacaḥ śrutvāniruddho dhanvināṃ varaḥ || balī dhairyadharaḥ kruddho prāhedaṃ yadupuṃgavān ||6|| aniruddha uvāca ahaṃ yāsyāmi pāraṃ vai tasmādyādavasattamāḥ || setuṃ kuruta śīghraṃ tu sāgarasya śarairapi ||7|| iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā yādavā yuddhakovidāḥ || sāgare mumucurbāṇānprahasaṃtaḥ parasparam ||8|| tataḥ sarve jalacarāstīkṣṇabāṇaiḥ pratāḍitāḥ || kolāhalaṃ prakurvaṃto dudruvuste caturdiśam ||9|| na keṣāṃ pragatā bāṇāḥ pāraṃ vai sāgarasya ca || iti vai kathitaṃ vākyaṃ khasthena ca surarṣiṇā ||10|| tadākrūro hṛdīkaśca sātyakiścoddhavo balī || kṛtavarmā sāraṇaśca yuyudhānādayo nṛpa ||11|| hemāṃgada iṃdranīlo'nuśālvādyāśca bhūpate || gatamānā babhūvurvai nāradoktaṃ niśamya ca ||12|| tato'niruddho balavānsmarankṛṣṇapadāṃbujam || pratiśārṅgaṃ gṛhītvā vai divyānbāṇānmumoca ha ||13|| tato dṛṣṭvā ṛṣiḥ prāha hyaniruddhaśilīmukhāḥ || pāraṃ gatvā samudrasya viviśuste ca tattaṭam ||14|| iti śrutvā ṛṣervākyaṃ sāṃbādīptimadādayaḥ || mumucuste śarān rājaṃsteṣāṃ pāraṃ gatāḥ śarāḥ ||15|| śareṣu ca śarā rājankoṭiśaḥ koṭiśaḥ kila || viviśurvīkṣya sarve'pi dhanvino vismayaṃ gatāḥ ||16|| cakruḥ setuṃ ca te sarve triṃśadyojanalaṃbitam || dṛḍhaṃ jalāccāṃtarikṣamekayojanavistṛtam ||17|| baddhvā tataśca te setuṃ caturbhiḥ praharairapi || aniruddhādayo rātrau suṣupuḥ śibireṣu vai ||18|| tasmādvai putrapautrāṇāṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ || śūrāṇāṃ kṛṣṇabiṃbānāṃ kiṃ balaṃ kathayāmyaham ||19|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe setubaṃdhanaṃ nāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||27|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.28> garga uvāca kṛtvā tu śaucādikameva karma prabhātakāle yadunandanaśca || jagāma pāraṃ yadubhiśca siṃdho rāmo yathā vai kapibhirnṛpendra ||1|| dadṛśustatra te gatvāniruddhādyāśca yādavāḥ || upadvīpaṃ pāṃcajanyaṃ śatayojanavistṛtam ||2|| rājate tatra rājendra nāmnā vai cāsurī purī || viṃśadyojanavistīrṇā daityavṛndasamākulā ||3|| punnāgairnāgacaṃpaiśca tilakairdevadārubhiḥ || aśokaiḥ pāṭalairāmrairmaṃdāraiḥ kovidārakaiḥ ||4|| niṃbujaṃbūkadaṃbaiśca priyālapanasaistathā || sālaistālaistamālaiśca mallikājātiyūthikaiḥ ||5|| nīpaiḥ kadaṃbairbakulaiścaṃpakairmadanābhidhaiḥ || śobhitā nagarī ramyā ratnaprāsādasaṃyutā ||6|| yadūnsamāgatāñchrutvā mayaṃ māyāvinaṃ khalaḥ || preṣayāmāsa gaṇituṃ yādavānāṃ mahātmanām ||7|| sa cāpi śukarupeṇa gatvā dṛṣṭvā yadūttamān || āgatya svapurīmadhye balvalaṃ vismito'bravīt ||8|| maya uvāca kaḥ kariṣyati saṃkhyāṃ vai vṛṣṇīnāṃ balināṃ nṛpa || niyutānāṃ ca niyutakoṭinā''ste sa kārṣṇijaḥ ||9|| setuṃ kṛtvā śaraiḥ sindhoḥ prāptāḥ sarve tavopari || teṣāṃ paśya balaṃ rājandevavismayakārakam ||10|| sāgarasya śaraiḥ setuṃ na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ kṛtam || vṛddhena ca mayā rājaṃstvadagre'dya vilokitam ||11|| rāghaveṇa purā setuṃ pāṣāṇairdrumaveṣṭitam || svanāmnaśca pratāpena laṃkāyā nikaṭe kṛtam ||12|| tatsarvaṃ ca mayā dṛṣṭamadya dṛṣṭaṃ hi cādbhutam || śrīkṛṣṇena purā rājankaṃsādyāḥ śakunādayaḥ ||13|| māritāḥ saṃgare daityā nṛpāḥ sarve vinirjitāḥ || kṛṣṇastu bhagavānsākṣādbrahmaṇā prārthitaḥ purā ||14|| golokādāgato bhūmau bhaktānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || akṛtānāṃ ca nāśāya kuśasthalyāṃ virājate ||15|| tasmādyadūttamāḥ sarve'niruddhādyā mahābalāḥ || bhīṣaṇaṃ ca bakaṃ jitvā hyanyāñjitvātra cāgatāḥ ||16|| putrāḥ pautrāśca kṛṣṇasya jñātayaśca yadūttamāḥ || ākāśaṃ jetumicchaṃti kā vārtā bhūtalasya ca ||17|| aniruddhāya tasmādvai turagaṃ dehi balvala || daityānāṃ hataśeṣāṇāṃ kulakauśalyahetave ||18|| tato'niruddhāya hayaṃ ca datvāsuradviṣāṃ vai sukhahetave ca || śrīkṛṣṇacaṃdraṃ prabhajaṃśca bhuṃkṣva rājyaṃ svakīyaṃ tapasā nu labdham ||19|| evaṃ śubhaiśca vacanairbodhyamāno'pi balvalaḥ || niḥśvasyovāca roṣeṇa mayaṃ kṛṣṇaparāṅmukhaḥ ||20|| balvala uvāca vinā yuddhena tvaṃ daitya kathaṃ bhīto bhaviṣyasi || vadiṣyasi mamāgre tvaṃ śūrahāsyakaraṃ vacaḥ ||21|| tvaṃ buddhibalahīnaśca vṛddhatvācchaṭhatāṃ gataḥ || tasmāttvadīyaṃ vacanaṃ nāhaṃ gṛhṇāmi sāṃpratam ||22|| yadi kṛṣṇo hariḥ sākṣādete kṛṣṇasya vaṃśajāḥ || mamāgre śivabhaktasya kiṃ kariṣyaṃti pauruṣam || 23|| bhayaṃ mā kuru tasmātvaṃ māyāḥ kutra gatāstava || ahaṃ tavāśrayeṇāpi yuddhaṃ kartuṃ vrajāmi vai ||24|| aniruddho mahāśūraḥ śūrāḥ kiṃ na vayaṃ smṛtāḥ || sthite mayi mahīmadhye ko'yaṃ garvo'bhavanmahat ||25|| phalaṃ garvasya prāpnotu mama nirmuktasāyakaiḥ || adya me niśitā bāṇā aniruddhaṃ ca māninam ||26|| prakurvaṃti raṇe daitya raktāṃgaṃ chinnakaṃcukam || yathā kiṃśukavṛkṣaṃ vai vasaṃtadivasāḥ kila ||27|| dārayaṃtu kapolāni nārācā mama hastinām || hayānpaśyaṃtu śataśo rudhiraughapariplutān ||28|| pibaṃtu yoginīvṛṃdā rudhirāṇi nṛmastakaiḥ || kālī bhavatu saṃtuṣṭā madvairikravyabhakṣaṇaiḥ || 29|| mama bāhubalaṃ sarve paśyaṃtu subhaṭāḥ kila || mahākodaṃḍanirmuktabhallakoṭīrvimuṃcataḥ ||30|| iti tadvākyamākarṇya mayo māyī mahāmatiḥ || jānankṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ madāṃdhaṃ cedamabravīt ||31|| maya uvāca yadā vijeṣyasi raṇe kṛṣṇaputrāṃśca yādavān || āgamiṣyati śrīkṛṣṇo jetuṃ tvāṃ vā balaśca vai ||32|| iti śrutvā mahādaityaḥ satyaṃ hitakaraṃ vacaḥ || kālapāśena saṃbaddho na jagrāha ruṣā jvalan ||33|| balvala uvāca mamārī rāmakṛṣṇau ca śatravo vṛṣṇayaśca me || tānsarvānmārayiṣyāmi yairme mitrāśca māritāḥ || 34|| hatvā ca yādavānatra paścādyajñaṃ karomyaham || tasya digvijayenāpi vijeṣyāmi hareḥ purīm ||35|| maya uvāca mānaṃ mā kuru daityendra kālarūpasasturaṃgamaḥ || prāptastava pure haṃtuṃ hataśeṣānmahāsurān ||36|| aniruddhaśarāḥ sarve sadyastava purīṃ nṛpa || chinnāṃ bhinnāṃ śūrahīnāṃ kariṣyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ ||37|| hiraṇyākṣādayo daityā rāvaṇādyā niśācarāḥ || māritā yena saḥ kṛṣṇo jāto yadukule śrutam ||38|| kiṃcidrājyasya mānena tvaṃ na jānāsi balvala || prayaccha turagaṃ tasmai na yuddhasamayo'sti hi ||39|| balvala uvāca ahaṃ jānāmi tvadvārtāṃ yuddhaṃ tairna kariṣyasi || aniruddhaṃ gaccha tasmāttvaṃ vibhīṣaṇavatkila ||40|| garga uvāca balvalasya vacaḥ śrutvā mayo māyāvidāṃ varaḥ || prativyoḍhuṃ tatra dukhamidamevānvapadyata ||41|| vairabhāvena pūrvaṃ vai vaikuṇṭhaṃ bahavo gatāḥ || niśācarāśca daityāśca taṃ bhāvaṃ yaḥ karoti hi ||42|| itthaṃ vicārya sahasā sa uvāca mahāsuram || maya uvāca adya tvāṃ ca mahāvīraṃ na niṣedhaṃ karomyaham ||43|| yuddhaṃ kuru raṇe gatvā yadūnmāraya sāyakaiḥ || ahameva kariṣyāmi yuddhaṃ tvadvākyato mṛdhe || ityuktvā vacanaṃ so'pi virarāma praharṣayan ||44|| ūrdhvakeśo nadaḥ siṃhaḥ kuśāmbādyāśca maṃtriṇaḥ || ūcuḥ prakupitāḥ sarve catvāro balvalaṃ nṛpa ||45|| maṃtriṇa ūcuḥ pūrvaṃ vayaṃ gamiṣyāmo haṃtuṃ sarvān yadūttamān || bahubhirdivasai rājansaṃgrāmaṃ na kṛtaṃ yataḥ ||46|| cintāṃ mā kuru rājendra mayadaityena saṃyutaḥ || kṣaṇena mārayiṣyāmo koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo narān ||47|| garga uvāca teṣāṃ bhāṣitamākarṇya balvalastu mudānvitaḥ || cakārājñāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha raṇārthe raṇakovidaḥ ||48|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe daityamantravarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||28|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.29> śrīgarga uvāca atha yuddhāya rājeṃdra catvāraḥ kila maṃtriṇaḥ || daityakoṭisamāyuktā nirjagmurdaṃśitāḥ purāt ||1|| sarve hi dhanvinaḥ śūrā vidyādharasamāḥ kila || khaḍgaiḥ śūlairgadābhiśca parighairmudgarairnṛpa ||2|| ekaghnībhirdaśadhnībhiḥ śataghnībhirbhuśuṇḍibhiḥ || kuṃtaiśca bhiṃdipālaiśca cakrasāyakaśaktibhiḥ ||3|| saṃyutāḥ sarvaśastraiśca lauhakaṃcukamaṃḍitāḥ || rathairgajaisturaṃgaiśca gavayairmahiṣairmṛgaiḥ ||4|| uṣṭraiḥ kharaiḥ sūkaraiśca vṛkaiḥ siṃhaiśca kroṣṭubhiḥ || mahāgṛdhraiḥ śaṃkhacillairmakaraiśca timiṃgilaiḥ ||5|| etaiśca vāhanai rājansaṃyuktā raṇakarkaśāḥ || śaṃkhaduṃdubhinādena vīrāṇāṃ garjanena ca ||6|| śataghnīnāṃ ca śabdena cacāla vasudhā bhṛśam || itthaṃ bhayaṃkarīṃ senāmasurāṇāṃ vilokya ca ||7|| bhayaṃ prāpuḥ surāḥ sarve mahendradhanadādayaḥ || yādavāste'pi balino nirjitā yaiśca bhūḥ purā ||8|| viṣaṇṇamanaso'bhūvandaityasenāṃ nirīkṣya ca || pradyumnena rājasūye caṃdrāvatyāṃ purā nṛpa ||9|| yādavebhyaḥ prakathitaṃ yannītirdhairyavarddhanam || tatsarvaṃ kathayāmāsa yadubhyaḥ kārṣṇijaḥ punaḥ ||10|| garga uvāca iti śrutvā ca yadavaḥ śastrāṇi jagṛhustvaram || mṛtyuṃ varaṃ manyamānā vijayācca palāyanāt ||11|| tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ daityānāṃ yadubhiḥ saha || pāṃcajanye ca laṃkāyāṃ rakṣasāṃ kapibhiryathā ||12|| rathino rathibhistatra pattibhiḥ pattayo mṛdhe || hayā hayairibhāścebhairyuyudhuste parasparam ||13|| kecidvai daṃtino mattāḥ śuṇḍādaṇḍairitastataḥ || jaghnū rathāṃsturaṃgāṃśca vīrānrājanmahāmṛdhe ||14|| śuṇḍādaṇḍaiḥ saṃgṛhītvā rathānsāśvānsasārathīn || nipātya bhūmāvutthāpya gagane cikṣipurbalāt ||15|| kāṃścinmamarduḥ pādābhyāṃ saṃvidārya karairdṛḍhaiḥ || sākṣatāśca gajā rājanpradhāvaṃto raṇāṃgaṇāt ||16|| turagāstatra dhāvaṃtaḥ savīrāste nṛpeśvara || ullaṃghayaṃtaśca rathānprotpataṃto gajānprati ||17|| aṃbaṣṭhaṃ gajinaṃ yuddhe marddayaṃtaśca siṃhavat || utpataṃtaśca turagā gajavṛṃdaṃ mahābalāḥ ||18|| asiprahāraṃ kurvaṃto vidārya ca ripūnbahūn || vājipṛṣṭhe na dṛśyaṃte te dṛśyaṃte naṭā iva ||19|| kecidvīrāstu khaḍgaiśca dvidhākurvaṃsturaṃgamān || keciddaṃtānsaṃgṛhītvā kumbheṣu kariṇāṃ gatāḥ ||20|| turagasthāḥ ke'pi balaṃ saṃvidārya vinirgatāḥ || khaḍgavegaiḥ kaṃjavanaṃ līlābhirvāyavo yathā ||21|| babhūva tumulaṃ yuddhamadbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam || bāṇairgadābhiḥ parighaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ śūlaiśca śaktibhiḥ ||22|| yuddhe gajāśca garjaṃti harṣaṃti turagā bhṛśam || hāhā vīrāḥ prakurvaṃti nadaṃti rathanemayaḥ ||23|| sainyapādarajovṛndairaṃdhībhūtaṃ nabho'bhavat || tatra svīyo na pārakyo dṛśyate ca mṛdhāṃgaṇe ||24|| parasparaṃ ca bāṇaughaiḥ kecidvīrā dvidhā kṛtāḥ || tiryagbhūtā rathā yuddhe nipetuḥ pādapā iva || vīropari gatā vīrā hayopari hayāśca vai ||25|| utpetustatra śūrāṇāṃ kabaṃdhāśca bhayaṃkarāḥ || pātayaṃto khaḍgahastā hayān vīrānmahāraṇe ||26|| hastināṃ bhinnakuṃbhānāṃ mauktikā nipatanti khāt || śastrāṃdhakāre pradhane rātrau tārāgaṇā iva ||27|| tataśca senayormadhye rudhirāṇāṃ nadī hyabhūt || vetālāḥ śivamālārthaṃ jagṛhuste śirāṃsi ca ||28|| mṛgeṃdrasthā mahākālī ḍākinībhiḥ samāgatā || kapālenāpi rudhiraṃ pibaṃtī dṛśyate mṛdhe ||29|| ḍākinyo rudhiraṃ taptaṃ pāyayaṃtyaḥ sutānmṛdhe || mārodīriti vādinyo netrāṇyapi tadā mṛjan ||30|| vidyādharyastvaṃbarasthā gaṃdharvyo'psarasastathā || kṣatradharmasthitāñchūrānvavrire devarūpiṇaḥ ||31|| parasparaṃ kalirabhūttāsāṃ patyarthamaṃbare || mamānurūpo nāyaṃ va iti vihvalacetasām ||32|| ke'pi śūrā dharmaparā raṇādrājanna cālitāḥ || jagmuste vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ bhitvā tapanamaṃḍalam ||33|| kecidvīrā mahāyuddhaṃ dṛṣṭvā yuddhātpalāyitāḥ || taptabālukamārgeṇa jagmuste nirayaṃ nṛpa ||34|| evaṃ daityānmahāvīrāñjaghnuḥ sarve yaduttamāḥ || tathā yadūnmahāyuddhe nānāśastraiśca dānavāḥ || 35|| raṇe mṛtyuṃ gatāḥ sarve rājandaityāśca koṭiśaḥ || tathā mṛtyuṃ gatā yuddhe yādavāśca sahasraśaḥ ||36|| bāṇāṃdhakāre saṃjāte'niruddho dhanvināṃ varaḥ || ūrdhvakeśena yuyudhe yathā vṛtreṇa vāsavaḥ ||37|| naṃdena ca gado rājansiṃhena vṛka eva ca || kuśāṃbena ca sāṃbo vai yuyudhe raṇamaṇḍale ||38|| evaṃ parasparaṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva tumulaṃ mahat || ūrdhvakeśastadā rājandhanuṣṭaṃkārayanmuhuḥ ||39|| kārṣṇijaṃ tāḍayāmāsa nārācairdaśabhirmṛdhe || tānpraciccheda bhagavāndhanvī rukmāvatīsutaḥ ||40|| ūrdhvakeśaḥ punastasya kavace sāyakāndaśa || nicakhāna svarṇapuṃkhānbhitvā varma tanau gatān ||41|| caturbhiśca śaraistasya jaghāna caturo hayān || ciccheda bāṇairviṃśadbhiḥ kodaṃḍaṃ saguṇaṃ param ||42|| aniruddhasya rājeṃdra balvalasyānugo balī || aniruddhastu taṃ tyaktvā rathaṃ cānyaṃ samāruhat ||43|| śakradattaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha pratiśārṅgadharo mahān || kṛṣṇadatte ca kodaṃḍe śaramekaṃ nidhāya ca ||44|| tadrathe nicakhānātha ruṣāḍhyo hastalāghavāt || sāyakastadrathaṃ nītvā bhrāmayitvā ghaṭīdvayam ||45|| gaganātpātayāmāsa kācapātraṃ yathārbhakaḥ || aṃgāravadrathastasya viśīrṇo'bhūddhayāśca vai ||46|| sasūtāśca nṛpaśreṣṭha paṃcatāṃ prāpuragrataḥ || ūrdhvakeśastu patanānmūrcchito'bhūdraṇāṃgaṇe ||47|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe yādavāsurasaṃgrāmavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||29|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.30> garga uvāca tadotthitaścordhvakeśo rathaṃ cānyaṃ samāśritaḥ || aniruddhasya saṃgrāme yāvadāyāti saṃmukham ||1|| tāvadbabhañja niśitairnārācaistadrathaṃ punaḥ || sa bhagnaṃ syaṃdanaṃ dṛṣṭvā punaranyaṃ samāśritaḥ ||2|| so'pi bhagnaḥ śarairāśu kārṣṇijena raṇe nṛpa || evaṃ nava rathā bhagnā ūrdhvakeśasya vai raṇe ||3|| tataḥ kruddho raṇe daityaḥ śaktiṃ cikṣepa satvaram || dṛṣṭvā tāmāgatāṃ vīro nārācairdaśadhācchinat ||4|| ūrdhvakeśastadā saṃkhye sthitvā rukmamaye rathe || ājagāma sa vegenāniruddhaṃ pratiyodhitum ||5|| kārṣṇijaṃ paṃcabhirbāṇaistāḍayāmāsa harṣitaḥ || śaraistairnihataḥ so'pi kaśmalaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ||6|| saṃkruddho dhanurudyamya citravājāñcharāndaśa || mumoca hṛdaye tasya sahasā hastalāghavāt ||7|| śarāste papuretasya rudhiraṃ bahudāruṇāḥ || pītvā peturyathā bhūmau kūṭasākṣyasya pūrvajāḥ ||8|| ūrdhvakeśaḥ punaḥ kruddhaḥ tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti ca bruvan || bāṇaistu daśasaṃkhyaiśca tatāḍa tasya mūrdhani ||9|| sāyakāste'niruddhasya hyuṣṇīṣe pariniṣṭhitāḥ || virājante sma rājendra daśaśākhāstaroriva ||10|| na vivyathe sa tairbāṇairyuddhe rukmavatīsutaḥ || yathā puṣpaiśca prahato dvirado nṛpasattama ||11|| bāṇāñchataṃ svadhanuṣi nidhāyākṛṣya mādhavaḥ || citravājānsvarṇapuṃkhānmumoca bahuroṣataḥ ||12|| te bāṇāstasya sarvāṃgaṃ bhittvā śīghramadhogataḥ || rudhirāktā yathā rājankṛṣṇabhaktiparāṅmukhāḥ ||13|| śarasaṃghaiśca sa hato paṃcatāṃ pradhane gataḥ || hāhākāraśca tatsainye babhūva nṛpasattama ||14|| tadā jayajayārāvo yādavānāṃ babhūva ha || aniruddhopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣāṃ pracakrire ||15|| ūrdhvakeśastu pradhanāddivyadehena yādava || yayau vimānamāruhya svargaṃ sukṛtināṃ padam ||16|| bhrātāraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā nadaḥ śokena pūritaḥ || kuñjarastho gadaṃ bāṇaiḥ kuñjarasthaṃ jaghāna ha ||17|| āgatānsāyakāndṛṣṭvā dhanurdhārī gado mahān || tānpraciccheda bāṇenāniruddhasya prapaśyataḥ ||18|| nadastadaiva saṃkruddho bhrātṛśokapariplutaḥ || akarodvigajaṃ bāṇaiḥ saṃgrāme rohiṇīsutam ||19|| gajastu śatabāṇaiśca bhinnāṃgaḥ paṃcatāṃ gataḥ || nipapāta gado bhūmau tadadbhutamivābhavat ||20|| tataḥ kruddho gadāṃ nītvā haṃtuṃ śatruṃ raṇe gadaḥ || ājagāma jvalacchīghraṃ siṃhaḥ sihaṃ vane yathā ||21|| āgataṃ taṃ gṛhītvā tu śuṇḍādaṃḍena tadgajaḥ || cikṣepa sa gadaṃ rājannākāśe śatayojanam ||22|| patitaḥ khātsamutthāya śuṇḍadaṃḍaṃ pragṛhya saḥ || pātayāmāsa bhūpṛṣṭhe bhrāmayitvā gajaṃ gadaḥ ||23|| gajo mṛtyuṃ gato yuddhe vismito'bhūnmahāsuraḥ || jagrāha svagadāṃ gurvīṃ ślāghāṃ kṛtvā gadasya ca ||24|| śīghraṃ tamāhvayāmāsa gadaṃ vīraṃ gadādharam || tathā so'pi nadaṃ daityaṃ saṃgrāmārthe viśāṃ pate ||25|| nadaḥ pratyāha vacanaṃ tvaṃ manuṣyo'si yādava || tasmāllajjāṃ kariṣyāmi kathaṃ yuddhaṃ kariṣyasi ||26|| pūrvaṃ prahāraṃ kuru me paścāttvaṃ tu na jīvasi || iti śrutvā gadaḥ prāha yathā vṛtraṃ puraṃdaraḥ ||27|| gada uvāca na kiṃcitte prakurvaṃti ye vadanti mukhaina vai || na vadaṃti raṇe śūrā darśayaṃti parākramam ||28|| iti śrutvā nadaḥ kruddho gadasya hṛdaye nadan || tāḍayāmāsa rājendra gariṣṭhāṃ mahatīṃ gadām ||29|| gadayā tāḍito vīro na cacāla mṛdhe gadaḥ || madonmatto yathā hastī bālena mālayā hataḥ ||30|| kathayāmāsa vīrāgryo dānavaṃ vīkṣya lajjitam || sahasvaikaṃ prahāraṃ me yadi vīraḥ paraṃtapa ||31|| ityuktvā nijaghānātha lalāṭe gadayā bhṛśam || sa cāpi taṃ ruṣā skaṃdhe tāḍayāmāsa dharmavit ||32|| evaṃ bhṛśaṃ prakurvaṃtau gadāyuddhaviśāradau || gadāyuddhaṃ prakurvāṇau parasparavadhaiṣiṇau ||33|| anyonyaghātavimatau krodhayuktau jayodyatau || na kau vai tatra jīyate na prahīyate ko'pi tu ||34|| bhāle skaṃdhe tathā mūrdhni hṛdi gātreṣu sarvataḥ || rudhiraughaplutau klinnau kiṃśukāviva puṣpitau ||35|| tayorāsīnmahāyuddhaṃ gadābhyāmeva saṃyuge || visphuliṃgānkṣaraṃtyau dve gade cūrṇībabhūvatuḥ ||36|| tayoryuddhamabhūddhoraṃ bāhubhyāṃ gadadaityayoḥ || tadā rāmānujaḥ kruddho bhujābhyāmupagṛhya tam ||37|| pātayāmāsa bhūpṛṣṭhe mahiṣaṃ harirāḍyathā || tadā daityastu tasyāpi hṛdi jaghne pramuṣṭinā ||38|| tadā so'pi śirasyekaṃ muṣṭiṃ baddhvā jaghāna ha || muṣṭibhirjānubhiḥ pādaistālasphoṭaiśca bāhubhiḥ ||39|| parasparaṃ jaghnatustau saṃdaṣṭādharapallavau || tataḥ kruddho raṇe daityo gadasya caraṇaṃ balāt ||40|| gṛhītvā bhrāmayitvā ca pātayāmāsa bhūtale || tadā gadaḥ samutthāya gṛhītvā caraṇaṃ ripoḥ ||41|| bhrāmayitvā gajopasthe nijaghāna ruṣā jvalan || punardaityaṃ samutthāya gṛhītvā rohiṇīsutam ||42|| cikṣepa caujasā rājangagane śatayojanam || patito'pi sa vajrāṃgaḥ kiṃcidvyākulamānasaḥ ||43|| cikṣepa gagane daityaṃ yojanānāṃ sahasrakam || pati'topi samutthāya punaryuddhaṃ cakāra saḥ ||44|| gado nadaṃ nado gadaṃ nijaghnatuḥ parasparam || pramuṣṭibhiśca dāruṇairmahadraṇe nṛpeśvara ||45|| daṃḍādaṃḍi muṣṭāmuṣṭi keśākeśi nakhānakhi || daṃtādaṃtyubhayoryuddhaṃ ghorameva babhūva ha ||46|| itthaṃ niyuddhamānau tau prakurvaṃtau raṇaṃ punaḥ || pāde pādaṃ hṛdi hṛdaṃ kare karaṃ mukhe mukham 47|| anyonyamitthaṃ saṃlagnau parasparavadhaiṣiṇau || balākrāṃtāvubhau tau dvau patitau ca mumūrcchatuḥ ||48|| itthaṃ dṛṣṭvā tayoryuddhaṃ yādavāścaiva dānavāḥ || gado dhanyo nado dhanyaḥ procurvākyamidaṃ nṛpa ||49|| gadaṃ nipatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā'niruddhaḥ śokapūritaḥ || caitanyaṃ kārayāmāsa jalena vyajanena ca ||50|| tadaiva so'pi rājendra utthitaḥ kṣaṇamātrataḥ || kva nadaḥ kva nado yāto tyaktvā yuddhaṃ bhayānmama ||51|| nirīkṣya dānavaṃ tatra mūrchitaṃ paṃcatāṃ gatam || cakrurjayajayārāvaṃ yādavāścaiva devatāḥ ||52|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe ūrdhvakeśanadadaityavadho nāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||30|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<20.31> garga uvāca svasyāḥ parājayaṃ dṛṣṭvā siṃho daityo ruṣānvitaḥ || nijaghāna vṛkaṃ bāṇai rathasthaṃ kharavāhanaḥ ||1|| dṛṣṭvā samāgatānbāṇanvṛko vai kṛṣṇanandanaḥ || ciccheda tānsvabāṇaiśca līlayā pradhane nṛpa ||2|| punaścikṣepa bāṇānvai tāṃśca ciccheda kṛṣṇajaḥ || tataḥ kruddho raṇe rājansiṃhanāmāsureśvaraḥ ||3|| śarāsane samādhatta vasusaṃkhyāñchilīmukhān || caturbhisturagānvīro vṛkasya hyanayatkṣayam ||4|| ekena dhvajamatyugraṃ ciccheda tarasā hasan || ekena sāratheḥ kāyācchiro bhūmāvapātayat ||5|| ekena saguṇaṃ cāpamacchinatpradhane ruṣā || ekena hṛdi vivyādha vṛkasya vegavānnṛpa ||6|| tasya karmādbhutaṃ dṛṣṭvā vīrā vismayamāgatāḥ || vṛkastadaiva sahasā daityaṃ śaktyā jaghāna ha ||7|| sā śaktistattanuṃ bhittvā kharaṃ bhittvā vinirgatā || viveśa bhūtale rājanvivaraṃ pannago yathā ||8|| kharo mṛtyuṃ gatastatra daityaḥ śīghraṃ papāta ha || jagarja punarutthāya siṃhaḥ siṃha iva sphuṭam ||9|| gṛhītvā viśikhaṃ śūlaṃ cikṣepa sa vṛkopari || tamāpataṃtaṃ jagrāha vṛko vāmakareṇa vai ||10|| tenaiva śatruṃ nijaghāna rājankṛṣṇasya putro bahuroṣayuktaḥ || nirbhinnadeho nipapāta bhūmau hāhā prakurvansa jagāma mṛtyum ||11|| hāhākārastadaivāsīddānavānāṃ raṇāṃgaṇe || puṣpavarṣaṃ surāścakruḥ jayārāvaṃ yadūttamāḥ ||12|| tadā kuśāṃbaḥ saṃkruddho sāṃbādīn yādavānmṛdhe || rathasthaḥ śīghramāgatya sarvānvivyādha sāyakaiḥ ||13|| tasya bāṇaiśca bahavaḥ petuśchinnā mahāgajāḥ || tiryagbhūtā rathā yuddhe turagāśchinnakaṃdharāḥ ||14|| tathā padātayastatra śirohīnā vibāhavaḥ || itthaṃ sa mārayanrājannanekānvicacāra ha ||15|| evaṃ parākramaṃ dṛṣṭvā sāṃbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ || kuśāṃbaṃ cāhvayāmāsa yuddhārthe yuddhakovidaḥ ||16|| sāṃba uvāca āgaccha vīra sahasā mayā saha raṇaṃ kuru || kimanyaistrāsitairdīnairnihataiḥ koṭibhirnaraiḥ ||17|| ityuktavantamālokya kuśāṃbaḥ prahasanbalī || jaghāna hṛdaye tasya vasusaṃkhyāñchilīmukhān ||18|| tadamṛṣyanhareḥ putraḥ svakodaṃḍe dadhañcharān || tatāḍa saptabhiḥ śatruṃ dānavaṃ vakṣaso'ntare ||19|| ubhau samarasaṃrabdhāvubhāvapi jayaiṣiṇau || rejāte tau hi saṃgrāme yathā ṣaṇmukhatārakau ||20|| sāṃbaḥ kuśāṃbaṃ pradhane kuśāṃbaḥ sāṃbameva ca || anyonyaṃ sarpasadṛśairbāṇairapi vavarṣatuḥ ||21|| bāṇāndhanuṣi saṃdhāya śatasaṃkhyānsphuratprabhān || akarodvirathaṃ taiśca sāṃbaṃ chinnaśarāsanam ||22|| sa chinnadhanvā viratho hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ || āruroha rathaṃ cānyaṃ kupitaścāpasaṃyutaḥ ||23|| sāṃba uvāca kutra yāsyasi tvaṃ daitya kṛtvā dīrghaṃ parākramam || kṣaṇamātraṃ raṇe sthitvā paśya me vikramaṃ param ||24|| ityuktvā sāyakaṃ cograṃ svakodaṃḍe nidhāya ca || maṃtrayitvā ca maṃtreṇa tadrathe nicakhāna ha ||25|| alātacakravadbhūmau tena bāṇena tadrathaḥ || babhrāma yojane śīghraṃ sasūtaḥ saturaṃgamaḥ ||26|| bhramaṃtaṃ sarathaṃ daityaṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha hasanmukhaḥ || sāṃbo jāṃbavatīputro bāṇaṃ kṛtvā śarāsane ||27|| sāṃba uvāca tvādṛśāśca mahāvīrāḥ svargayogyā bhavaṃti hi || na rājaṃte mahīmadhye śakratulyaparākramāḥ ||28|| tasmācca mama bāṇena dvitīyena divaṃ vraja || sarathastvaṃ sadehaśca matkṛpāto'sureśvara ||29|| gaganaprāpakaṃ cāstramityuktvā vimumoca saḥ || śareṇa tena saratho vibhramanbhūtalānnṛpa ||30|| lokānbahūnatikramya jagāma ravimaṃḍalam || sahayaḥ sūtasahitastatra sūryasya jvālayā ||31|| dagdho'bhūttadrathaḥ sadyo daityo dagdhakalevaraḥ || papāta bhūtale puryāṃ balvalasya ca sannidhau ||32|| tasminnipatite pāpe gate mṛtyuṃ ca dānave || hāhākāraṃ tataścakrurdaityāḥ sarve bhayānvitāḥ ||33|| yādavānāṃ tataḥ sainye nedurduṃdubhayo muhuḥ || puṣpavarṣaṃ mudā cakruḥ sāṃbasyopari nirjarāḥ ||34|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe siṃhakuśāṃbovadho nāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||31|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.32> garga uvāca atha vai balvalaṃ daityaṃ śocaṃtaṃ kāṃcanāsane || mayaḥ pratyāha vacanaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ kuṃbhaśrutiryathā ||1|| adya dṛṣṭaṃ tvayā rājan yadūnāṃ balameva hi || daityavṛndaiśca nihatāścatvāro maṃtriṇastava ||2|| avaśeṣastvamevāsi hyathavāhaṃ ca tvatpure || tasmāttavecchā daityeṃdra yathā bhūyāttathā kuru ||3|| balvalaḥ prāha vacanamadya yāsyāmyahaṃ raṇe || śīghraṃ haṃtuṃ yadūnsarvāṃstvaṃ gupto bhava mandire ||4|| hariḥ kṛṣṇastu naṃdasya purā putraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || vasudevo manyate taṃ matputro'yaṃ gatatrapaḥ ||5|| haiyaṃgavīnadugdhājyadadhitakrādikaṃ tu saḥ || corayāmāsa gopīnāṃ rasiko rāsamaṇḍale ||6|| jarāsutabhayātso'pi samudraṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || mārito mātulo yena kiṃ kariṣyati pauruṣam ||7|| iti tadvākyamākarṇya mayaḥ prakupito'bravīt || maya uvāca yasmādbibheti brahmā ca śivo māyā puraṃdaraḥ ||8|| bhayadaṃ nirbhayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ taṃ viniṃdasi niṃdaka || kṛṣṇaṃ niṃdati yo mūḍho hyajñānācca kusaṃgataḥ ||9|| kumbhīpāke sa patati yāvadvai brahmaṇo vayaḥ ||10|| caṇḍapālaśiśupālamaṇḍalībhañjanaṃ danujadarpakhaṇḍanam || mādhavaṃ madanamohanaṃ paraṃ tvaṃ bhajasva kulakauśalāya ca ||11|| mayasya vacanaṃ śrutvā jñānaṃ prāpto'pi balvalaḥ || kṣaṇaṃ vicārya rājendra provāca prahasanniva ||12|| balvala uvāca jānāmyahaṃ viśvapatiṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ śeṣaṃ balaṃ vai madanaṃ ca kārṣṇim || atrāgataṃ padmabhavaṃ hi caiṣāṃ vadhyā vayaṃ tena hayo hṛto'yam ||13|| eṣāṃ bāṇaiśca nihato yadāhaṃ nidhanaṃ gataḥ || tadā sukhena yāsyāmi śīghraṃ viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||14|| purā ca vairabhāvena vaikuṇṭhaṃ bahavo gatāḥ || dānavā rākṣasāścaiva taṃ ca bhāvaṃ karomyaham ||15|| ityuktvā daṃśito bhūtvā dānavānāṃ śiromaṇiḥ || svasainyapālakaṃ tūrṇaṃ samāhūyedamabravīt ||16|| paṭahena mamājñāṃ tvaṃ puryāṃ dehi prayatnataḥ || aniruddhena yuddhāya vīreṣu sainyapālaka ||17|| ye mamājñāṃ na manyante te vadhārhā raṇaṃ vinā || ātmajā vā bhrātaro vā hyanyeṣāṃ caiva kā kathā ||18|| iti śrutvā sa tadvākyaṃ rathyāṃ rathyāṃ gṛhe gṛhe || paṭahenāpi tasyājñāṃ ghoṣayāmāsa vegataḥ ||19|| śrutvā paṭahanirghoṣaṃ daityāḥ śīghraṃ bhayāturāḥ || gṛhītvā sarvaśastrāṇi hyājagmuste sabhātalam ||20|| sainyapālastataḥ pūrvaṃ lakṣadaityaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ || rathena kavacī dhanvī nirjagāma purādbahiḥ ||21|| durnetro durmukhaścaiva duḥkhabhāvaśca durmadaḥ || ete vai maṃtriṇāṃ putrāścatvāraste viniryayuḥ ||22|| mataṃgajairmahāmattaiścaṃcalāṃgaisturaṃgamaiḥ || rathaiśca devadhiṣṇyābhairvidyādharasamairnaraiḥ ||23|| sadyaḥ kāmagayānena mayadattena balbalaḥ || svayaṃ jagāma yuddhārthe caturlakṣairmahāsuraiḥ ||24|| sainyapālasya putrastu bhojanaṃ kurute gṛhe || bubhikṣitaśca yuddhāya śīghraṃ so'pi na nirgataḥ ||25|| nāgataṃ taṃ vilokyātha sainye balvalasainikāḥ || nṛpāya kathayāmāsustasya vārtāṃ ca śaṃkitāḥ ||26|| tatastadvacanādvīrā baddhvā taṃ dāmabhī ruṣā || nṛpāgre cānayāmāsuḥ praphullavadanekṣaṇāḥ ||27|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhartsayitvā ca balvalaścaṇḍaśāsanaḥ || bhuśuṇḍīṃ vadane cāpi mārayāmāsa vegataḥ ||28|| daityāḥ sarve bhayaṃ prāpurvadhaṃ tasya nirīkṣya ca || sainyapālastu saṃgrāme mṛtaṃ putraṃ niśamya ca ||29|| rathātpapāta duḥkhārtastāḍayanmastakaṃ karaiḥ || vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ so'pi putraduḥkhena duḥkhitaḥ ||30|| hā putra vīra pitaraṃ tyaktvā māṃ jaraṭhaṃ raṇe || gataḥ śataghnīmārgeṇa svarge māmavilokya ca ||31|| vinā yuddhena he putra kva gato nṛpaśāsanāt || ityevaṃ vilapaṃstatra ruroda raṇamaṇḍale ||32|| tataśca maṃtriṇāṃ putrāḥ śocaṃtaṃ procuragrataḥ || maṃtriputrā ūcuḥ rodanaṃ mā kuru raṇe śūro'si tvaṃ tu pālaka ||33|| duḥkhe kṛte ca tvatpārśve nāgamiṣyati vai mṛtaḥ || ājanmataśca jaṃtūnāṃ mṛtyurbhavati sāṃpratam ||34|| dhīrāstatra na śocaṃti mūrkhāḥ śocaṃti nityaśaḥ || garbhe'pi ca mṛtāḥ kecitkecidvai janmamātrataḥ ||35|| bālatve yauvanatve ca vṛddhatve kecideva hi || kecicchastreṇa rogeṇa duḥkhena patanena ca ||36|| sarve mṛtyuṃ gamiṣyaṃti daivātkarmavaśā narāḥ || ko vā kasya pitā putraḥ ko vā kasya priyā prasūḥ ||37|| saṃyunakti vidhātā vai viyunakti ca karmaṇā || saṃyoge paramānando viyoge prāṇasaṃkaṭam ||38|| śaśvadbhavati mūḍhasya nātmārāmasya niścitam || ātmaghātī yadā bhūtvā prāṇāṃstyajasi duḥkhitaḥ ||39|| punarjanma ca nirayaṃ vrajiṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || tasmādyadūttamaiḥ sārddhaṃ yuddhaṃ kuru mahāraṇe ||40|| kṣatriyasya paraṃ śreyo dharmayuddhānna vidyate || dharmayuddhena saṃgrāme ye hatāḥ śatrusaṃmukhe ||41|| vrajaṃti te viṣṇupadaṃ lokānsarvānvihāya ca || garga uvāca evaṃ saṃbodhito daityaiḥ śokaṃ sarvaṃ vihāya ca ||42|| sarvānvīrānāgatāṃśca dadarśa roṣapūritaḥ || dṛṣṭvā sarvānsa saṃgrāme śīghraṃ prāha ruṣā jvalan ||43|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe sainyapālasutavadho nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||32|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.33> sainyapāla uvāca atrāgatāśca sarve'pi dhanvino yuddhadurmadāḥ || yuvarājo nṛpasuto raṇe cātra na dṛśyate ||1|| sa kiṃ kariṣyati gṛhe mārayitvā ca matsutam || sa bhuśuṇḍīmukhenāpi tanmārgaṃ kiṃ na yāsyati ||2|| ityuktvā roṣatāmrākṣo grahītuṃ nṛpanandanam || jagāma nagarīṃ śīghraṃ sainyapālaḥ praharṣitaḥ ||3|| sa rājaputro madirāṃ pītvā vai bhojanāṃtare || cakāra śayanaṃ rātrau vismṛto madavihvalaḥ ||4|| tatpatnī bodhayāmāsa bhartāraṃ nṛpanandanam || śrutvā paṭahanirghoṣaṃ rudatī bhayavihvalā ||5|| uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha he vīra prātaḥkālo babhūva ha || tvatpituḥ śāsanaṃ puryyāṃ bherīghoṣeṇa śrūyate ||6|| ye na yāsyaṃti yuddhārthaṃ te vadhārhāḥ sutādayaḥ || tasmātprayāhi śīghraṃ tvaṃ gatvā tāta vilokaya ||7|| priyayā bodhitaḥ so'pi caitanyo na babhūva ha || punaḥ sā bodhayāmāsa sasainye balvale gate ||8|| tataḥ sa nidrāṃ ca vihāya cotthitaḥ sadyo gṛhītvā saśaraṃ dhanuḥ kila || śivaṃ gaṇeśaṃ manasā ca saṃsmarañjagāma yuddhāya rathena bhūpajaḥ ||9|| tamāgataṃ vīkṣya nṛpasya nandanamuvāca roṣeṇa tu sainyapālakaḥ || kathaṃ tvayā daityavarasya śāsanaṃ vilopitaṃ kena balena māṃ vada ||10|| matsutastvādṛśo bhūtvā śīghraṃ nāgatavānmṛdhe || sa mārito balvalena śataghnīpramukhena ca ||11|| tasmādgaccha pituḥ pārśvaṃ satyavādī pitā tava || mārayiṣyati śīghraṃ vai netuṃ tvāṃ preṣito'smyaham ||12|| vacastīkṣṇaṃ samākarṇya bhayācchuṣkamukhastu saḥ || pituḥ sakāśātsa yayau sudhanvā duḥkhito yathā ||13|| dadarśa pitaraṃ gatvā daityavṛṃdaiḥ samāvṛtam || rathasthaṃ kupitaṃ tatra hyaniruddhajayotsukam ||14|| dṛṣṭvā tātaṃ namaskṛtya vrīḍito bhayavihvalaḥ || adhomukhaḥ sthito bhūmau dānaveṃdrasya paśyataḥ ||15|| balvalaḥ kupitaḥ prāha daṃtāndaṃtairviniṣpiṣan || ājñābhaṃgastvayā kena kṛtaḥ svātmavighātane ||16|| tasmādvibhītaṃ kila yuddhamaṇḍalādgṛhe gataṃ prāṇaparīpsayā sutam || kunandanaṃ śatrusamaṃ malīmasaṃ hitvā śataghnīvadanena hanmyaham ||17|| ityuktvā svasutaṃ vīro duḥkhādaśrupariplutaḥ || khinnaḥ pratyāha manasi pratijñā kiṃ kṛtā mayā ||18|| aho vināparādhena sainyapālasuto hataḥ || tena pāpena matputro mariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||19|| mocayiṣye yadi sutaṃ vīraṃ mṛtyumukhādbalāt || tadā matsainikāḥ sarve māṃ śapaṃti hasaṃti ca ||20|| śocaṃtamitthaṃ nṛpatiṃ ca duḥkhitaṃ svaputraśokena tu khinnamānasam || vilokya roṣeṇa hasannamarṣito hyuvāca vākyaṃ kila sainyapālakaḥ ||21|| sainyapāla uvāca enaṃ māraya śīghraṃ tvaṃ svaputraṃ ca kunandanam || paścādbhavati saṃgrāmo yādavānāṃ ca dānavaiḥ ||22|| tvaṃ satyavādī daityeṃdra idaṃ karma ca dāruṇam || na kariṣyasi duḥkhena nirayaste bhaviṣyati ||23|| satyādrāmasamaṃ putraṃ tatyāja kosaleśvaraḥ || hariścaṃdraḥ priyāṃ putraṃ svātmānaṃ caiva bhūpate ||24|| baliścaiva mahīṃ sarvāṃ jīvanaṃ ca virocanaḥ || svakīrtiṃ ca śibiścaiva dadhīciḥ svatanuṃ tathā ||25|| pṛṣadhraṃ tu guruścaiva raṃtidevaśca bhojanam || ājñābhaṃgakaraṃ putraṃ tathā māraya tvaṃ nṛpa ||26|| tvayā pūrvaṃ ca yatproktaṃ svaputramapi bhrātaram || ājñābhaṃgakaraṃ hanmi śīghramanyasya kā kathā ||27|| tasmindeśe ca vastavyaṃ yasminbhūpaśca satyavāk || tasmindeśe na vastavyaṃ yasminbhūpo hyasatyavāk ||28|| garga uvāca iti tadvākyamākarṇya balvalaḥ khinnamānasaḥ || māraṇārthaṃ tu tasyāpi tasmai cājñāṃ cakāra ha ||29|| tato jagāma duḥkhāḍhyo yadūnāṃ saṃmukhe tu saḥ || sainyapālastu tasyājñāṃ tatputrāgre nyavedayat ||30|| śrutvā pratyāha vacanaṃ śīghraṃ tasmai kunaṃdanaḥ || rājaputra uvāca kartavyā ca nṛpasyājñā tvayā paravaśena vai ||31|| rāmeṇa tu hṛtaṃ śīrṣaṃ svamātuḥ piturājñayā || sainyapāla pratīto'haṃ kṛtādharmakriyā mayā ||32|| maraṇānna bhayaṃ mahyaṃ śataghnyāṃ ca niveśaya || ityuktvā rājaputrastu svakirīṭaṃ tathāṃgadam ||33|| muktāhāraṃ svarṇahāraṃ kuṇḍale kaṭakāni ca || brāhmaṇebhyo dadau sarvaṃ te duḥkhādāśiṣaṃ daduḥ ||34|| tataḥ snātvā sa tīrthasya lepayitvā ca mṛttikām || tulasīpallavaṃ mālāṃ mukhe kaṇṭhe nidhāya ca ||35|| bruvañchrīkṛṣṇa rāmeti cakāra smaraṇaṃ hareḥ || sainyapālastu taṃ śīghraṃ gṛhītvā bhujayorbalāt ||36|| kārayāmāsa rājeṃdra śataghnīvadane ruṣā || hāhākārastadaivāsītsainikā rurudurbhṛśam ||37|| ruroda balvalastatra ruruduste dvijātayaḥ || dṛṣṭvā śataghnīṃ tatrāpi prataptāṃ madapūritām ||38|| tāmragolakasaṃyuktāmagniyuktāṃ bhayaṃkarām || sa rājaputraḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sarvavyāpinamīśvaram ||39|| aśrupūrṇamukho bhūtvā pratyāha vimalaṃ vacaḥ ||40|| kṛṣṇaṃ mukundamaraviṃdadalāyatākṣaṃ śaṃkhendukuṃdadaśanaṃ naranāthaveṣam || iṃdrādidevagaṇavaṃditapādapadmaṃ prāṇaprayāṇasamaye ca hariṃ smarāmi ||41|| śrīkṛṣṇa goviṃda hare murāre śrīkṛṣṇa goviṃda kuśasthalīśa || śrīkṛṣṇa goviṃda vrajeśa bhūpa śrīkṛṣṇa goviṃda bhayātprapāhi ||42|| smaraṇāttava govinda grāhānmukto mataṃgajaḥ || svāyaṃbhuvaśca prahlādo hyaṃbarīṣo dhruvastathā ||43|| ānarttaścaiva kakṣīvānmṛgeṃdrādbahulā tathā || raivataścaṃdrahāsaśca tathāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ ||44|| pūrvaṃ bhavati me mṛtyuḥ saṃgrāmaṃ ca vinā hyaho || na toṣitaśca pradhane'niruddho viśikhairmayā ||45|| na toṣitā yādavāśca na dṛṣṭāḥ kṛṣṇanaṃdanāḥ || śārṅgamuktaiśca viśikhairna dehaḥ śakalīkṛtaḥ ||46|| kunandanasya śūrasya stenasyevābhavadgatiḥ || tvadbhaktaṃ māṃ ca pāpiṣṭhāstasmātsarve hasaṃti hi ||47|| yaṃ vīkṣya bhūmau ca palāyate vai yamo mariṣyaṃti vināyakāśca || niraṃkuśaṃ kṛṣṇajanaṃ ca pūjyaṃ kathaṃ śataghnī kila māṃ haniṣyati ||48|| garga uvāca itthaṃ vadati śūre vai sainyapālasya cājñayā || śataghnīṃ mumuce kaściddhāhāśabdastadābhavat ||49|| smaraṇātkṛṣṇacaṃdrasya citramekaṃ babhūva ha || śataghnī śītalā jātā jvālā śāṃtiṃ gatā nṛpa ||50|| dṛṣṭvā''ścaryaṃ ca tatrāpi janāḥ sarve nṛpādayaḥ || visiṣmū rājaśārdūla sainyapālastadābravīt ||51|| śataghnyāṃ śuṣkamadirā golakena samanvitā || na vidyate tvasau tasmānna mṛto raṇamaṇḍale ||52|| iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā procurvīrā ruṣānvitāḥ || ayaṃ niṣkilbiṣaḥ śūraḥ kṛṣṇabhakto mahāmatiḥ ||53|| rakṣitastena duḥkhādvai punarhaṃtuṃ ca nārhasi || teṣāṃ vākyaṃ samākarṇya sainyapālo ruṣānvitaḥ ||54|| dadarśa rājaputraṃ vai śataghnīvadane sthitam || japaṃtaṃ kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti srajā mīlitalocanam || 55|| dṛṣṭvā taṃ ca punarhaṃtuṃ śataghnīṃ mumuce khalaḥ || sā śataghnī tadā bhinnā śabdo vajranipātavat ||56|| babhūva sainyapālastu golakena mṛto'bhavat || tathā tadanugāstasya jvālayā jvalitāḥ kila ||57|| hāhāśabdaṃ prakurvaṃto dudruvuḥ kecideva hi || kecidvai badhirībhūtāḥ keciddhūmena vihvalāḥ ||58|| tataśca dadṛśuḥ sarve nṛpaputraṃ ca nirbhayam || cakrurjayajayārāvaṃ balvalādyā nṛpeśvara ||59|| daityā ūcuḥ yaṃ ca rakṣati śrīkṛṣṇastaṃ ko bhakṣati mānavaḥ || bhaktaṃ haṃtuṃ cāgato yaḥ sa vinaśyati daivataḥ ||60|| tasmātkṛṣṇasamo nāsti yenāyaṃ rakṣito bhayāt || sarve vayaṃ namasyāmastaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ bhaktavatsalam ||61|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe rājaputrajīvanaṃ nāma trayatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||33|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.34> garga uvāca atha vai balvalaḥ putraṃ rohayitvā rathe mudā || tena sārddhaṃ sasainyastu yuddhārthaṃ prayayau tvaram ||1|| nānāśastradharāḥ sarve nānāvāhanasaṃsthitāḥ || nānā kañcukasaṃyuktā nānārupā bhayaṃkarāḥ ||2|| gajeṃdrasadṛśāḥ puṣṭā mṛgeṃdrasamavikramāḥ || kaṃpayataśca pṛthivīṃ vṛṣṇīnāṃ saṃmukhe yayuḥ ||3|| tānāgatānbahūndaityānaniruddhastu śaṃkitaḥ || rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ cakravyūhamakalpayat ||4|| sarvato yādavāḥ śūrāḥ sarvaśastradharāḥ kila || gajai rathaisturaṃgaiśca babhūvuḥ parimaṃḍitāḥ ||5|| teṣāṃ madhye sthitā rājanniṃdranīlādayo nṛpāḥ || akrūrakṛtavarmādyāsteṣāṃ madhye sthitāḥ śubhāḥ ||6|| teṣāṃ madhye ca rājeṃdra gadādyāḥ kṛṣṇabhrātaraḥ || teṣāṃ madhye mahāvīrāḥ sāṃbādīptimadādayaḥ ||7|| cakravyūhaṃ vinirmāya cedṛśaṃ tatra bhūpate || tanmadhye kārṣṇiputrastu daṃśitaḥ saṃsthito'bhavat ||8|| babhūva tumulaṃ yuddhaṃ tatra siṃdhutaṭe nṛpa || yadubhirdānavānāṃ ca hyabdhīnāmabdhibhiryathā ||9|| rathino rathibhistatra gajavāhā gajaiḥ saha || aśvavāhairaśvavāhā vīrā vīraiḥ parasparam ||10|| yuyudhustīkṣṇabāṇaiśca khaḍgacarmagadarṣṭibhiḥ || pāśaiḥ paraśvadhai rājañchataghnībhirbhuśuṇḍibhiḥ ||11|| hanyamānāśca yadubhirbalvalasya ca sainikāḥ || sarve svaṃ svaṃ raṇaṃ tyaktvā dudruvuste bhayānvitāḥ ||12|| rurodha gaganaṃ sūryaṃ sainyapādarajo bhṛśam || aṃdhakāre mahādaityā raṇātsarve parāṅmukhāḥ ||13|| kecinnipatitāḥ kūpe kecidgarte hyadhomukhāḥ || kecittaḍāge vāpyāṃ vai yadūnāṃ sāyakairhatāḥ ||14|| tato dṛṣṭvā balaṃ bhagnaṃ balvalo roṣapūritaḥ || caturbhirmaṃtriṇāṃ putraiḥ svaputreṇājagāma ha ||15|| aniruddho balvalena tatrāyuddhyanmahāmṛdhe || durnetreṇa bṛhadvāhurdurmukhenāruṇo balī ||16|| nyagrodho duḥsvabhāvena durmadena kavistathā || kunandanena saṃgrāme kṛṣṇaputraḥ sunaṃdanaḥ ||17|| evaṃ babhūva saṃgrāmo devavismayakārakaḥ || pragatāstatra rājeṃdra sarve kārtikavāsarāḥ ||18|| balvalaḥ kupito rājandhanuṣṭaṃkārayanmuhuḥ || iṃdranīlaṃ tribhirbāṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhirhemāṃgadaṃ mṛdhe ||19|| anuśālvaṃ ca daśabhirakrūraṃ daśabhistathā || gadaṃ dvādaśabhirbāṇairyuyudhānaṃ ca paṃcabhiḥ ||20|| paṃcabhiḥ kṛtavarmāṇamuddhavaṃ daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ || kārṣṇijaṃ śatabāṇaiśca vivyādha samare'suraḥ ||21|| taccharaiḥ sarathāḥ sarve babhramurghaṭikādvayam || turagāḥ paṃcatāṃ prāptāścūrṇībhūtā rathā raṇe ||22|| taddhastalāghavaṃ dṛṣṭvā yādavā vismayaṃ gatāḥ || rathānāruruhuḥ sarve'niruddhādyāśca mānada ||23|| balvalo'pi yayau rājannanyānvīrānvilokitum || aniruddhastataḥ prāha krodhādaruṇalocanaḥ ||24|| tiṣṭha tiṣṭha mamāgre'dya darśayitvā parākramam || kutra yāsyasi he daitya paśya manniśitāñcharān ||25|| iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā yuvarājaḥ kunandanaḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ śīghraṃ balvalasya ca paśyataḥ ||26|| rājaputra uvāca daityeṃdraṃ ca raṇe draṣṭuṃ tvaṃ ca nārhasi kārṣṇija || tasmānmadīyaṃ ca balaṃ pūrvaṃ paśya mṛdhāṃgaṇe ||27|| aniruddha uvāca tvaṃ bālo'si daityaputra yuddhaṃ kartuṃ ca nārhasi || tasmācca svagṛhaṃ gatvā krīḍanaṃ kuru kṛtrimaiḥ ||28|| rājaputra uvāca atra paśya mahāvīrairbālasya mama krīḍanam || gṛhe yadi kariṣyāmi tatra ko'pi na paśyati ||29|| ityuktvā caṇḍakodaṇḍe dadhāra śatasāyakān || tatāḍa kārṣṇījaṃ taiśca rathasthaṃ darśayanbalam ||30|| tairbāṇaiḥ sarathaḥ so'pi sasūtaḥ saturaṃgamaḥ || vibhramannabhamārgeṇa papāta kapilāśrame ||31|| hāhākārastadaivāsīdaniruddhe gate sati || tataḥ kruddhāśca taṃ haṃtuṃ sāṃbādyā āyayurmṛdhe ||32|| āgatāṃstānbahūndṛṣṭvā yuvarājaḥ praharṣitaḥ || sāṃbaṃ ca daśabhirbāṇaiḥ paṃcabhiśca madhuṃ tathā ||33|| bṛhadbāhuṃ tribhirbāṇaiścitrabhānuṃ ca paṃcabhiḥ || vṛkaṃ ca daśabhiryuddhe saptabhiścāruṇaṃ śaraiḥ ||34|| paṃcabhiḥ saṃgrāmajitaṃ sumitraṃ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ || dīptimaṃtaṃ tribhirbāṇairbhānuṃ ca daśabhirmṛdhe ||35|| vedabāhuṃ paṃcabhiśca puṣkaraṃ saptabhiḥ śaraiḥ || aṣṭabhiḥ śrutadevaṃ ca saṃmukhasthaṃ sunandanam ||36|| viṃśatyā sāyakaistīkṣṇairvirūpaṃ daśabhistathā || citrabāhuṃ ca navabhirnyagrodhaṃ daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ ||37|| kaviṃ ca navabhirbāṇaistatāḍa pradhane balī || śaṃkhaṃ daghmau mudāyukto nandamānī kunandanaḥ ||38|| tadbāṇairvibhramaṃtaśca sarathāḥ saturaṃgamāḥ || petuḥ kecidyojane ca paṃcakrośe dviyojane ||39|| hāhākāre tadā yāte senāyāṃ nṛpasattama || ruruduryādavāḥ sarve rāmakṛṣṇeti vādinaḥ ||40|| tadā gadādayaḥ sarve muṃcaṃto niśitāñcharān || indranīlādayaścaiva hyājagmuḥ krodhapūritāḥ ||41|| dṛṣṭvā samāgatān vīrānrājaputro mahābalaḥ || vivyādha sāyakaiḥ sarve hyabhūvanmūrcchitā raṇe ||42|| tatpaścādyādavāñchūrānbāṇaughairbalvalātmajaḥ || tatāḍa taccharai rājanbahavaḥ paṃcatāṃ gatāḥ ||43|| saṃgrāme tasya bāṇaughai rudhirāṇāṃ nadī hyabhūt || hastino yatra magnāśca sajīvāste mriyaṃti ca ||44|| hāhākārastadaivāsītsenāyāṃ ca nabhastale || mahendravaruṇādyāśca bhayaṃ prāpuśca vismitāḥ ||45|| jayaṃ dṛṣṭvāsurā sarve babhūvurmuditānanāḥ || garga uvāca atha vai mūrcchitaṃ dṛṣṭvāniruddhaṃ kapilo muniḥ ||46|| hatayānaṃ nipatitaṃ śaranirbhinnavakṣasam || cakāra taṃ tu caitanyaṃ hastena tapasā muniḥ ||47|| tataḥ so'pi samutthāya siddhaṃ natvā yadūttamaḥ || setumārgeṇājagāma yadūnsarvānpraharṣayan ||48|| athānyaṃ rathamāruhya pratiśārṅgadharo balī || nicakhāna śaraṃ caikaṃ rājaputrarathe ruṣā ||49|| sa śarastadrathaṃ nītvā sasūtaṃ saturaṃgamam || caturmuhūrtaparyaṃtaṃ bhrāmayāmāsa cāmbare ||50|| tataśca dadṛśuḥ sarve dānavāścaiva vṛṣṇayaḥ || gagane vibhramaṃtaṃ vai sarathaṃ ca kunaṃdanam ||51|| atha sāṃbādayo vīrā rathānāruhya vegataḥ || anuśālvādayaścaivājagmuḥ sarve dhanurdharāḥ ||52|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe daityayādavayuddhavarṇanaṃ nāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||34|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.35> garga uvāca atha vai tatra saṃgrāme'nuśālvo durmukhena ca || yuyudhe cendranīlastu durnetreṇa durātmanā ||1|| hemāṃgado durmadena duḥsvabhāvena sāraṇaḥ || evaṃ parasparaṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva raṇamaṇḍale ||2|| sāraṇo gadayā daityaṃ mārayāmāsa vegataḥ || hemāṃgadastribhirbāṇaistatāḍa durmadaṃ mṛdhe ||3|| sa svabāṇairmṛdhe taṃ tu so'pi śaktyā jaghāna tam || indranīlaśca durnetraṃ jaghāna līlayā śairaiḥ ||4|| durmukhaṃ cānuśālvo vai cakāra virathaṃ śaraiḥ || sa cānyaṃ rathāmāruhya cakre taṃ virathaṃ śaraiḥ ||5|| parigheṇānuśālvastu jaghāna durmukhaṃ mṛdhe || durnetre duḥsvabhāve ca durmukhe durmade hate ||6|| avaśeṣā dudruvurvai daityāḥ prāṇaparīpsayā || tataḥ papāta cākāśādrājaputraśca vibhraman ||7|| mūrcchito'bhūdraṇe rājannudvaman rudhiraṃ mukhāt || rathaścāṃgāravattasya bhagno'bhūtturagā hatāḥ ||8|| tataśca balvalaḥ kruddhaḥ putraṃ dṛṣṭvā ca mūrcchitam || mumoca dhanuṣā bāṇānaniruddhāya vegataḥ ||9|| tānāgatāndaśa śarāndṛṣṭvā rukmavatīsutaḥ || svabāṇaistīkṣṇadhāraiśca ciccheda svarṇabhūṣitaiḥ || 10|| tato daityo ruṣāviṣṭaścāpe dhṛtvā punaḥ śaram || uvāca mādhavaṃ yuddhe pradyumnaṃ śakuniryathā ||11|| balvala uvāca anena bāṇena yadupravīra dhanurdharaṃ tvāṃ raṇamāninaṃ ca || mṛdhe haniṣye na vadāmyasatyaṃ rakṣasva prāṇānyadi jīvitecchā ||12|| so'pi śrutvā svakodaṃḍe śaramekaṃ nidhāya ca || pratyāha prahasanvākyaṃ pradyumnaḥ śakuniṃ yathā ||13|| aniruddha uvāca kaḥ kena hanyate jaṃtustathā kaḥ kena rakṣyate || haniṣyati sadā kālastathā rakṣati duḥkhataḥ ||14|| ahaṃ karomi kartāhaṃ hartāhaṃ pālako'pyaham || yo vadeccedṛśaṃ vākyaṃ sa vinaśyati kālataḥ ||15|| nāhaṃ tvāṃ tu vijeṣyāmi na vijeṣyasi tvaṃ tu mām || tvāṃ māṃ jeṣyati viśvātmā kālorūpo jagatpatiḥ ||16|| na jāne kasya kurute jayaṃ vā ca parājayam || kālastaṃ manasā vaṃde vijayārthe ca dānava ||17|| tasmādeva hi manasā kālaṃ hi balināṃ varam || madvākyācca mahā'jñānaṃ vihāya tvaṃ raṇaṃ kuru ||18|| iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā balvalo vismayānvitaḥ || tamāha toṣitaḥ prīto yathā tvāṣṭro marutpatim ||19|| balvala uvāca karma pradhānaṃ bhūmadhye karmaiva gururīśvaraḥ || uccāvacatvaṃ bhavati karmaṇā vai yadūttama ||20|| sahasreṣu gavāṃ vatsaḥ yathā viṃdati mātaram || tathā śubhāśubhaṃ yena kṛtaṃ tiṣṭhatsu paśyati ||21|| tato jeṣyāmi saṃgrāme bhavaṃtaṃ dṛḍhakarmaṇā || mayā kṛtaśca śapathaḥ pratīkāraṃ kuru tvaram ||22|| aniruddha uvāca pradhānaṃ manyase karma vinā kālena tatphalam || na vidyate yathā pāke kṛte syādvighnatā kvacit ||23|| pākaprakāre pākaśca vinā kartrā na jāyate || tasmādvadaṃti kartāraṃ karmakālātparaṃ varam ||24|| sa kartā kṛṣṇacaṃdrastu golokeśaḥ parātparaḥ || yena vai nirmitāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ||25|| balvala uvāca śrīkṛṣṇapautra dhanyastvamṛṣīn vākyairviḍaṃbayan || tribhirguṇaiḥ pṛthagbhūtaḥ svabhāvo dustyajo nṛṇām ||26|| sāvadhānatayā cādya paśya prāṇaharaṃ śaram || saṃprāptaṃ yādavaśreṣṭha kṛtvā yuddhe manaḥ svakam ||27|| ityuktvā vyasṛjanmāyāṃ svabāṇena mayasya ca || tadābhavattamastīvraṃ tatra ko'pi na lakṣyate ||28|| na ca svīyo na pārakyo vidāmāsa janānbahūn || śilāḥ parvatatuṃgābhāḥ pataṃti subhaṭopari ||29|| vārbhirhatāśca sarve'pi vyākulāśca samaṃtataḥ || vidyuto vilasaṃtyatra garjanti vāridā bhṛśam ||30|| varṣaṃti rudhiraṃ coṣṇaṃ muṃcaṃti saśakṛñjalam || gaganātpatamānāni kabaṃdhāni śirāṃsi ca ||31|| tadā vyākulitāḥ sarve parasparabhayāturāḥ || palāyanaparā jātāḥ saṃgrāme ca yadūttamāḥ ||32|| tadāniruddhaḥ pradhane smṛtvā kṛṣṇapadadvayam || māyāṃ tāṃ sa vidhūyātha mohanāstreṇa līlayā ||33|| tadā diśaḥ prasedustāḥ sūryastvapariveṣavān || meghā yathāgataṃ yātāścapalāḥ śāṃtimāgatāḥ ||34|| tadā daityaśca purato dṛśyate dānavairyutaḥ || nānāyudhadharo rājanmāyāvī caṇḍavikramaḥ ||35|| brahmāstraṃ saṃdadhe kruddho yādavānāṃ vadhāya ca || brahmāstreṇa tu brahmāstraṃ jahāra mādhavaḥ punaḥ ||36|| tataśca balvalaḥ kruddho gāṃdharvīṃ mohinīṃ parām || vijayārthe ca saṃgrāme māyāṃ so'pi cakāra ha ||37|| gaṃdharvanagaraṃ yatra dṛśyate nṛpasattama || na dṛśyate ca saṃgrāmaḥ svarṇasaudhāni koṭiśaḥ ||38|| babhūvustatra gaṃdharvyo nṛtyaṃtyo gānatatparāḥ || vīṇātālamṛdaṃgaiśca kalakaṃṭhaiśca kaṃdukaiḥ ||39|| hāvabhāvakaṭākṣaiśca kaṭiveṇīnidarśanaiḥ || toṣayantyo janānsarvānsundaryaḥ kañjalocanāḥ ||40|| tāsāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca sauṃdaryaṃ yādavāḥ smaravihvalāḥ || ūcuḥ parasparaṃ sarve dhṛtvā śastrāṇi bhūtale ||41|| vayaṃ kutrāgatāḥ sarve svarloke kiṃ tu daivataḥ || yatra nṛtyaṃti sundaryaḥ kalakaṇṭhyo manoharāḥ ||42|| āsāṃ lāvaṇyajaladhau vayaṃ magnāḥ smarāturāḥ || kathaṃ bhaviṣyati jayo raṇaṃ cātra na dṛśyate ||43|| iti bruvatsu sarveṣu balvalaḥ krodhapūritaḥ || śīghraṃ nistriṃśamādaya haṃtuṃ sarvānsamāyayau ||44|| āgatya khaḍgena yadupravīrānvimohitānso'pi sahasraśaśca || jaghāna yuddhe yadi te nipeturdṛṣṭvāniruddhastu ruṣā tamūce ||45|| kiṃ kariṣyasi saṃgrāme'dharmaṃ sadbhirvigarhitam || mohitānāṃ māraṇe ca na ślāghā te bhaviṣyati ||46|| yadi śaktiḥ śarīre'sti mayā sārdhaṃ raṇaṃ kuru || iti tadvākyamākarṇya balvalo baladarpitaḥ || ājagāma padātirvai khaḍgacarmadharo nadan ||47|| tamāpataṃtaṃ sa nirīkṣya roṣādrathādavaplutya manojaputraḥ || kṛtāṃtadaṇḍena jaghāna daityaṃ yathā mahendro bhidureṇa śailam ||48|| nirbhinnahṛdayo daityaḥ papāta cālayanmahīm || caturvāsaraparyaṃntaṃ mūrcchito'bhūdraṇāṃgaṇe ||49|| tadā nipatite daitye māyā śāṃtiṃ gatā svataḥ || yuddhaṃ pradṛśyate tatra yādavā vismayaṃ gatāḥ ||50|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe 'niruddhajayo nāma paṃcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||35|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.36> garga uvāca kunandano'pi saṃmūrcchāṃ tyaktvāgādraṇamaṇḍale || rathasthaḥ krodhasaṃyuktaḥ pravarṣandhanuṣā śarān ||1|| dṛṣṭvā tamāgataṃ vīro'niruddhaḥ paravīrahā || papraccha sevakāṃstasya vārtāṃ roṣeṇa dīpitaḥ ||2|| sevakāste tataḥ procureṣa balvalanandanaḥ || tvayā sārddhaṃ mahārāja yuddhaṃ kartuṃ samāgataḥ ||3|| śrutvāniruddhaḥ provāca haniṣye'haṃ kunandanam || tadaiva tamuvācātha kṛṣṇaputraḥ sunandanaḥ ||4|| sunandana uvāca rājanko'yaṃ daityaputraḥ kvedaṃ parimitaṃ balam || jeṣye'haṃ tvatpratāpena tasmādgacchāmyahaṃ prabho ||5|| rājañchṛṇu pratijñāṃ me tavānaṃdapradāyinīm || na cetkunandanaṃ jeṣye bahusaṃgrāmakovidam ||6|| kṛṣṇasya caraṇāṃbhojamadhvāsvādaviyoginam || yatpāpañca bhavettanme na jaye yadi dānavaṃ ||7|| yo guruṃ bhavahartāraṃ pitaraṃ ca na sevate || yadaghaṃ tu bhavettasya tanme bhūyāñjayena vai ||8|| iti pratijñāmākarṇyāniruddhastasya bhūpate || jaharṣa citte taṃ vīraṃ nirddideśa raṇaṃ prati ||9|| ityājñapto'niruddhena caikākī kṛṣṇanandanaḥ || jagāma daṃśitastatra yatrāste balvalātmajaḥ ||10|| kunandanastamājñāya tvāgataṃ pradhane ruṣā || pratyujjagāma vīrāgryo rathī śūraśiromaṇiḥ ||11|| anyonyaṃ tau sammilitau rathasthau cāpadhāriṇau || rejāte rājaśārdūla yathā damanapuṣkalau ||12|| ubhau sāyakabhinnaṃgāvubhau rudhiraviplutau || muñcaṃtau śarakoṭīśca saṃdhaṃtau tarasā śarān || 13|| ādānenaiva sandhānaṃ mocanaṃ ca na bhūpate || dṛśyate tau mahāśūrau kuṇḍalīkṛtakārmukau ||14|| tadrathaṃ rājaputrastu bhrāmakāstreṇa śobhinā || bhūtale bhrāmayāmāsa kuṃbhakārasya cakravat ||15|| bhrāṃtvā muhūrtamātraṃ tu tadratho vājisaṃyutaḥ || sthitiṃ lebhe tataḥ kārṣṇirjaghāna tadrathe śaram ||16|| sayānastena bāṇena khe babhrāma mataṃgavat || papāta kau viśīrṇo'bhūdyathā vai kācabhājanam ||17|| utthitaḥ so'pi viratho hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ || anyaṃ rathaṃ samāruhya yāvadāyāti saṃmukham ||18|| babhaṃja tāvadbāṇaiśca tadrathaṃ kṛṣṇanandanaḥ || evaṃ sapta rathā bhagnā daityaputrasya vai raṇe ||19|| tadā kunandanaḥ saṃkhye sthitvā yāne vicitrite || āyayau nṛpa vegena kṛṣṇaputraṃ niyodhitum ||20|| āgatya daśabhirbāṇaistāḍayāmāsa taṃ mṛdhe || śaraisteḥ so'pi nihataḥ paraṃ kaśmalatāṃ gataḥ || tataḥ sa dhanurudyamya gṛhītvā daśa sāyakān || mumoca tasya hṛdaye kruddhaḥ kṛṣṇātmajo balī ||22|| te śarā rudhiraṃ pītvā nipeturvai mahītale || yathā hi pitaro rājannarake kūṭasākṣiṇaḥ || 23|| kunaṃdanaḥ sunandanaṃ sunandanaḥ kunandanam || mahadraṇe mahaccharairnijaghnatuḥ parasparam ||24|| evaṃ hi tau dvau śarabhinnagātrau raktāplutau cāpadharau ruṣāḍhyau || pracakraturyuddhavaraṃ śaraiśca kuśāṃbasāṃbāviva saṃyuge vai ||25|| tataḥ kṛṣṇātmajo vīraḥ kodaṃḍe svarṇanirmite || mṛgāṃkārddhamukhaṃ bāṇaṃ dhṛtvā śīghraṃ tamabravīt ||26|| sunandana uvāca śṛṇu madvacanaṃ vīra bāṇenānena tvacchiraḥ || sadyaśchinnaṃ kariṣye'haṃ śiro rakṣa balī yadi ||27|| yadi madvacanaṃ satyaṃ pradhane tvaṃ na manyase || tadā śṛṇu pratijñāṃ me tava mṛtyuviṣūcikām ||28|| satīṃ ca gurupatnīṃ ca yo dūṣayati kāmataḥ || sa yāti yātanāṃ yāṃ vai yamarājasya sannidhau ||29|| sā yātanā ca me bhūyātsatyaṃ mama pratiśrutam || yaḥ samarthaśca svaguruṃ pitaraṃ ca na pālayet ||30|| tasya pāpaṃ mamaivāstu na haniṣye ca tvāṃ raṇe || iti śrutvā ca tadvākyaṃ daitya āha ruṣā jvalan ||31|| rājaputra uvāca bibhemi nāhaṃ raṇātsaṃgrāme śatrusammukhe || prāṇināṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ mṛtyurbhavati sāṃpratam ||32|| yadi muṃcasi saṃgrāme madvadhārthe mahāśaram || tadāhaṃ svaśareṇāpi śīghraṃ chedmi na saṃśayaḥ ||33|| ekādaśyāṃ ca ye mānādannaṃ bhuṃjaṃti bhūtale || mātaraṃ bhrātṛpatnīṃ ca bhaginīṃ ca sutāṃ tathā || pāpaṃ teṣāṃ mamaivāstu na chedmi yadi tvaccharam ||34|| iti tasya vacaḥ spaṣṭaṃ śrutvā śaṃkitamānasaḥ || pratyuvāca punarvākyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ so'pi saṃsmaran ||35|| sunandana uvāca mayā kṛṣṇāṃghriyugalaṃ sevitaṃ manasā yadi || kapaṭena vinā tarhi satyaṃ bhūyādvaco mama
