||36|| svapatnīṃ ca vinā vīra nānyāṃ paśyāmi kāmataḥ || tena satyena saṃgrāme vākyaṃ bhūyādṛtaṃ mama ||37|| ityuktvā sāyakaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ vimumoca sunandanaḥ || maṃtrayitvā ca maṃtreṇa mahākālānalopamam ||38|| pramuktaṃ vīkṣya viśikhaṃ svabāṇena nṛpātmajaḥ || sadyaściccheda hi yathā sarpaṃ pakṣeṇa pakṣirāṭ ||39|| chinne tasmiñchare rājanhāhākārastadābhavat || cacāla pṛthivī lokairdevāste vismayaṃ gatāḥ ||40|| parārddhaḥ patito bāṇaḥ pūrvārddhaḥ phalasaṃyutaḥ || śiraściccheda daityasya taroḥ skaṃdhaṃ yathā gajaḥ ||41|| kirīṭakuṇḍalairyuktaṃ patitaṃ tasya mastakam || nirīkṣya hāhāśabdaṃ vai cakrurdaityāśca duḥkhitāḥ ||42|| kunandanakabaṃdhastu śīghramutthāya saṃyuge || khaḍgena muṣṭibhiḥ pādairbahūñchatrūñjaghāna ha ||43|| tataśca yadusenāyāṃ nedurduṃdubhayo muhuḥ || sunaṃdanopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire ||44|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe daityaputravadhavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||36|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.37> vajranābhiruvāca kunaṃdane hate brahmanbalvale mūrcchite raṇe || na kṛtaṃ tu sahāyaṃ vai rudreṇa karuṇātmanā ||1|| kasmānna cāgato rudro yajñaḥ pūrṇaḥ kathaṃ bhavet || kathaṃ vimuktasturagastanme vyākhyātumarhasi ||2|| sautiruvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā gargo jñānavatāṃ varaḥ || smṛtvā sarvāṃ kathāṃ brahmannuvāca yadusattam ||3|| garga uvāca balvale mūrcchite rājanhate śūre kunandane || mahākopaṃ śivaścakre preritastu surarṣiṇā ||4|| āruhya naṃdinaṃ kruddho bhaktarakṣākaraḥ śivaḥ || candrarekhāṃ vahanmūrdhni jaṭājūṭāṃtare nṛpa ||5|| sarpahārairmuṇḍahārairbhasmalipto bhayaṃkaraḥ || daśabāhuḥ pañcamukho netraiḥ pañcadaśairvṛtaḥ ||6|| siṃhacarmāṃbaradharo madamatto bhayaṃkaraḥ || triśūlapaṭṭiśadharo dhanurbāṇadharaḥ paraḥ ||7|| kuṭhārapāśaparighabhiṃdipālairvibhūṣitaḥ || sahasraravisaṃkāśaḥ sarvabhūtagaṇāvṛtaḥ ||8|| haṃtuṃ sarvānvṛṣṇivarānkārṣṇijapramukhānmṛdhe || kailasādāyayau śīghraṃ cālayanpṛthivītalam ||9|| kolāhalo mahānāsīdākāśe bhūtale nṛpa || devadaityanarāḥ sarve bhayaṃ prāpuśca vismitāḥ ||10|| sagaṇaṃ saparīvāramāgataṃ vīkṣya śaṃkaram || kruddhaṃ pralayakartāraṃ bhayaṃ prāpuryadūttamāḥ ||11|| aniruddhasya ca mukhaṃ nistejaskamabhūdbhayāt || cakaṃpe hṛdayaṃ tasya duḥkhitasya raṇāṃgaṇe ||12|| tataḥ pratyāha vacanaṃ niṣṭhuraṃ sarvayādavān || śūlaṃ gṛhītvā hastena girīśaḥ krodhapūritaḥ ||13|| śaṃkara uvāca aniruddhaḥ kutra gato gataḥ kutra sunandanaḥ || sāṃbādayaḥ kutra gatā bhaktaṃ hatvā kunandanam ||14|| balvalaṃ mūrcchitaṃ kṛtvā madbhaktaṃ daityasattamam || tasyānugānmṛdhe hatvā kutra yāsyaṃti vṛṣṇayaḥ ||15|| tasmātsarvānhaniṣyāmi madbhaktānāṃ ripūnmṛdhe || ahaṃ viṣṇurvidhiścaite bhaktaṃ rakṣaṃti duḥkhataḥ ||16|| garga uvāca ityudīryyāniruddhaṃ sa preṣayāmāsa bhairavam || tvaṃ hi yoddhuṃ gaccha śūra kārṣṇijaṃ jayinaṃ mṛdhe ||17|| sunaṃdanaṃ naṃdinaṃ ca preṣayāmāsa roṣataḥ || gadaṃ ca vīrabhadraṃ vai sāṃbaṃ ca śikhivāhanam ||18|| bhānuña bhṛṃgiṇaṃ yuddhe virūpākṣaḥ samādiśat || yadūṃśca preṣayāmāsa bhūtapretāṃstataḥ śivaḥ ||19|| tataste rudravacanādbhūtapretavināyakāḥ || bhairavāḥ pramathāścaiva vetālā brahmarākṣasāḥ ||20|| unmādāścaiva kūṣmāṇḍā ājagmuḥ koṭiśo mṛdhe || bhūtāni jaghnuścāṃgārairyādavāśca vināyakāḥ ||21|| paṭṭiśairbhairavāḥ śūlaiḥ khaṭvāṃgaiḥ pramathāḥ kila || janānaśvāngṛhītvā tu bhakṣyaṃti brahmarākṣasāḥ ||22|| yātudhānāścararvayanto manuṣyāṇāṃ śirāṃsi ca || kapālaistatra vetālāḥ pibaṃto rudhiraṃ raṇe ||23|| piśācāstatra nṛtyanti pretā gāyaṃti eva hi || śirāṃsi kaṃdukānīva kṣepayaṃto muhurmuhuḥ ||24|| aṭṭahāsaṃ prakurvantaḥ pradhāvaṃta itastataḥ || gajānrathāṃścarvayanto dṛśyante raṇamaṃḍale ||25|| raktaṃ piśācyo ḍākinyaḥ pāyayaṃtyaḥ sutānmṛdhe || mārodīriti vādinya akṣīṇi ca tadā'mṛjan ||26|| unmādāścaiva kūṣmāṃḍā nirmāya muṇḍakaiḥ srajaḥ || saṃyacchaṃti maheśāya śūrāṇāṃ svargagāminām ||27|| hāhākārastadaivāsīdyadusainye nṛpeśvara || dudruvaṃto bhayādaśvā dhāvaṃtastatra daṃtinaḥ ||28|| vīrāḥ prapatitā yuddhe gatā mṛtyuṃ sahasraśaḥ || dṛṣṭvā cetthaṃ gaṇabalaṃ dīptimānmādhavātmajaḥ ||29|| cāpe nidhāya viśikhānmumuce paramādbhutam || te śarā viviśustigmā bhūtapretavināyakān ||30|| koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo rājanyathāraṇyaṃ śikhaṇḍinaḥ || tataśca dudruvurbhinnāḥ sarve bhūtagaṇāḥ śaraiḥ ||31|| kecinnipatitā yuddhe kecidvai nidhanaṃ gatāḥ || na hatāśca śaraiḥ ke'pi patitāḥ pūrvameva ca ||32|| palāyite pretagaṇe bhairavaḥ krodhapūritaḥ || triśūlī sārameyastha ājagāma kṛtāṃtavat ||33|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā kālarūpaṃ ca bhairavaṃ tu bhayaṃkaram || na ko'pi yuyudhe tenāniruddho yuyudhe nṛpa ||34|| aniruddhaḥ paṃcaśaraistatāḍa bhairavaṃ mṛdhe || sa cāpi parigheṇāpi babhañja tadrathaṃ varam ||35|| so'pyanyaṃ rathamāruhya sajjaṃ kṛtvā dhanurdṛḍham || tatāḍa daśabhirbāṇai raudraṃ māyāvinaṃ mṛdhe ||36|| tairbāṇairnihataḥ so'pi kiṃcitkaśmalatāṃ gataḥ || triśūlaṃ triśikhaṃ tasmai cikṣepa jvalanaprabham ||37|| śūlaṃ samāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā bāṇaiściccheda kārṣṇijaḥ || chinnaṃ svīyaṃ triśūlaṃ vai dṛṣṭvā rudrasuto balī ||38|| sasṛje māyayā tatra mukhādanalameva ca || tenāgninā jajvaluśca mahī vṛkṣā diśo daśa ||39|| padātīnāṃ rathānāṃ ca hayānāṃ daṃtināṃ tathā || jajvaluśca śarīrāṇi muñjapuṣpapratūlavat ||40|| kecitprajvalitā vīrāḥ kecidvai bhasmatāṃ gatāḥ || agninā pūritaṃ sainyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kecitsmaraṃti hi ||41|| senāṃ bhayāturāṃ dṛṣṭvāniruddho dhanvināṃ varaḥ || dadhāra viśikhaṃ cāpe jñātvā māyāṃ vinirmitām ||42|| maṃtrayitvā ca maṃtreṇa parjanyāstreṇa sāyakam || mumoca gagane śīghraṃ smarankṛṣṇapadāṃbujam ||43|| śare mukte samāgatya meghāḥ pravavṛṣurjalam || agniḥ śāṃtiṃ gato rājanyathā prāvṛṭ tathā babhau ||44|| śikhaṃḍinaḥ kokilāśca cātakāḥ sārasādayaḥ || maṇḍūkādyāśca prajaguriṃdragopā virejire ||45|| puraṃdarasya cāpena saudāminyā babhau nabhaḥ || prayāsaṃ niṣphalaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhairavo bhairavaṃ ravam ||46|| cakāra svamukhenāpi sarveṣāṃ trāsayanmanaḥ || nanāda tena brahmāṃḍaṃ saptalokairbilaiḥ saha ||47|| vicelurdiggajāstārā rājadbhūkhaṇḍamaṇḍalam || tadaiva badhirībhūtā babhūvuḥ patitā narāḥ ||48|| punaśca bhairavaḥ kruddho hastaṃ hastena pīḍayan || niṣpiṣannadharaṃ daṃtairlelihānaḥ svajihvayā ||49|| netrābhyāṃ raktavarṇābhyāṃ paśyansarpairvibhūṣitaḥ || jagrāha paraśuṃ tīkṣṇaṃ tṛṇīkṛtya yadūttamam ||50|| tadaiva jṛṃbhaṇāstreṇāniruddho raṇakovidaḥ || bhairavaṃ mohayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇa iva śaṃkaram ||51|| tenāstreṇa raṇe rājannaniruddhasya paśyataḥ || papāta bhūtale raudro jṛṃbhito nidrito'bhavat ||52|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe bhairavamohanaṃ nāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||37|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.38> garga uvāca tadā mṛtyuṃjayaḥ kruddho bhairavaṃ vīkṣya nidritam || vṛṣabhaṃ prerayāmāsa kārṣṇijaṃ śūramāninam ||1|| tadaiva vṛṣabhaḥ kopācchṛṃgābhyāṃ mārayanyadūn || daṃtaiḥ paścimapādābhyāṃ senāyāṃ vicacāra ha ||2|| tvaraṃ jaghāna śṛṅgeṇa saṃmukhasthaṃ sunandanam || śṛṅgeṇa bhinnahṛdayaḥ papāta paṃcatāṃ gataḥ ||3|| tadā''jagāma saṃkruddho'niruddho gajasaṃsthitaḥ || dhanurdharo daṃśitaśca mābhairmābhairiti bruvan ||4|| dṛṣṭvā tatra hataṃ vīraṃ kṛṣṇaputraṃ sunandanam || prāpto duḥkhaṃ mṛdhe'tyaṃtaṃ kaṃpitaḥ śokapūritaḥ ||5|| hate tasminmahāvīre śocaṃtaṃ taṃ śivo'bravīt || mā kṛthāstvaṃ raṇe śokamaniruddha mahābala ||6|| raṇamadhye pātanaṃ ca śūrāṇāṃ kīrtaye smṛtam || tasmāttvamapi saṃgrāme mayā yuddhyasva yatnataḥ ||7|| prayātān rakṣasva prāṇānmamāgre yuddhakāṃkṣayā || garga uvāca iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā śokaṃ tyaktvā yadūttamaḥ ||8|| nicakhāna paṃca bāṇān śivasya mastake nṛpa || nārācāste maheśasya jaṭājūṭeṣu niṣṭhitāḥ ||9|| dṛśyaṃte gṛdhrapakṣāḍhyāḥ śākhā iva vanaspateḥ || tato rudraḥ svakodaṃḍe bāṇamekaṃ nidhāya ca ||10|| ciccheda tena sahasā tasya cāpasya śiṃjinīm || aniruddhaḥ punaḥ śīghraṃ sajyaṃ kṛtvā dhanurdṛḍham ||11|| ugracāpasya ciccheda śiṃjinīṃ sāyakena ca || tataḥ śrutvā tayoryuddhamadbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam ||12|| vimānasthāśca śakrādyā ājagmuḥ kautukānvitāḥ || ūcuḥ parasparaṃ khasthā nirīkṣya bhayavihvalāḥ ||13|| devā ūcuḥ amū lokatrayasyāpi hyutpattilayakārakau || etayośca raṇaṃ tasmādviphalaṃ raṇamaṇḍale ||14|| ko vijeṣyati saṃgrāmaṃ prāpsyate kaḥ parājayam || garga uvāca tatastridinaparyaṃtaṃ yuddhamāsīttayorbhṛśam ||15|| punaḥ śarāsanaṃ rudraḥ sajjaṃ kṛtvā ruṣānvitaḥ || brahmāstraṃ saṃdadhe tatra lokapralayakārakam ||16|| brahmāstreṇa tu brahmāstraṃ bhidurāstreṇa pārvatam || parjanyāstreṇa cāgneyamaniruddho jahāra ha ||17|| tadā prakupito'tyaṃtaṃ pinākī prajvalanniva || triśikhena triśūlena jaghāna kārṣṇinandanam ||18|| sa triśūlaśca taṃ bhittvā gajaṃ bhittvā vinirgataḥ || sthito'bhūcca tayormadhye ūrdhvapuṃkha adhomukhaḥ ||19|| gajo mṛtyuṃ gato yuddhe'niruddho mūrcchito'bhavat || petatustau ca saṃlagnau bhinnavakṣasthalau mṛdhe ||20|| hāhākārastadaivāsīdruruduḥ sarvayādavāḥ || rudrasyāgre yathā bhītā yamasyāgre ca pāpinaḥ ||21|| aniruddhaṃ nipatitaṃ mṛtyutulyaṃ vimūrcchitam || śrutvā yayau śaṃkitaśca sāṃbaḥ skaṃdaṃ vihāya ca ||22|| mūrcchitaṃ yaduvīraṃ tu vīkṣya krodhapariplutaḥ || aśrupūrṇamukhaḥ sāṃbaḥ śarvaṃ prāha dhanurdharaḥ ||23|| kasmātkariṣyase rudra dānavānāṃ hi pālanam || hatvāniruddhaṃ saṃgrāme vīraṃ caiva sunandanam ||24|| vede bhāgavate śāstre purā vipraiḥ śrutaṃ mayā || śrīkṛṣṇākhyaṃ paraṃ nityaṃ śivaṃ seviti vaiṣṇavaḥ ||25|| mṛṣā jātaṃ hi tatsarvaṃ kārṣṇije patite sati || sunandanaḥ kṛṣṇasutaḥ so'pi yuddhe tvayā hataḥ ||26|| vṛthā kariṣyase yuddhaṃ dhiktvāṃ tasmānmaheśvara || ahaṃ tvāṃ pātayiṣyāmi raṇe kṛṣṇaparāṅmukham ||27|| kṣurapraiḥ sāyakaiḥ śīghraṃ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha raṇe śiva || etadvacaḥ samākarṇya prasannaḥ śaṃkaro'bravīt ||28|| śiva uvāca dhanyastvaṃ yādavaśreṣṭha satyaṃ vadati no bhavān || mannāthaḥ kṛṣṇacandro'yaṃ devadānavavaṃditaḥ ||29|| kunaṃdane ca nihate balvale mūrcchite raṇe || sahāyārthamahaṃ vīra bhaktarakṣārthamāgataḥ ||30|| satyaṃ kartuṃ svavacanaṃ kiṃcitkopena pūritaḥ || karomi pradhane yuddhaṃ bhaktapriyacikīrṣayā ||31|| itthaṃ vadati bhūteśe sāṃbo roṣaprapūritaḥ || tatāḍa śīghraṃ cāpena kṣurapraiḥ sāyakairmṛḍam ||32|| tairbāṇairnihato rudro na kiṃcitkaśmalaṃ gataḥ || yathā mataṃgajaḥ puṣpairjagrāha svadhanuḥ śivaḥ ||33|| tatāḍa niśitairbāṇairyuddhe jāṃbavatīsutam || sāṃbaḥ śivaṃ śivaḥ sāṃbaṃ jaghnatustau parasparam ||34|| dṛṣṭvā yuddhaṃ tayorlokasaṃhāraṃ menire'smarāḥ || bhūtale gagane rājanmahānkolāhalo'bhavat ||35|| bhītāśca vṛṣṇayastatra nāthaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ smaraṃti hi ||36|| tadā hariḥ śrīyadupālakaśca jñātvā yadūnāṃ ca mahāvipattim || rathena tatrāgatavān ripughno yuktena vai sūtaturaṃgamaiśca ||37|| śyāmaḥ kirīṭī navakaṃjanetro navārkakoṭidyutimādadhānaḥ || kaumodakīśaṃkharathāṃgapadmakodaṃḍabāṇairniyuto'sidhārī ||38|| śrīvatsacihnena tu kaustubhena pītāmbaraṇepi ca mālayā''ḍhyaḥ || nīlālakaiḥ kuṇḍalakaṅkaṇadyairvibhūṣitaḥ koṭimanojatulyaḥ ||39|| samudgaladbhiḥ sitaphenaśīkarānmuktāphalānīva ca rājahaṃsakaiḥ || sugrīvamukhyairativegavattarairhayairyutaḥ sundarasāmagāyanaiḥ ||40|| dṛṣṭvā svanāthaṃ yadavaḥ svāgataṃ harṣavihvalāḥ || babhūvuḥ sukhinaḥ sarve śītabhītā raviṃ yathā ||41|| tadā jayajayārāvo yadusainye babhūva ha || pracakrire puṣpavarṣaṃ gaganasthāśca devatāḥ ||42|| dṛṣṭvā sāṃbastu śrīkṛṣṇaṃ sahāyārthaṃ samāgatam || papāta pādayostasya cāpaṃ tyaktvā praharṣataḥ ||43|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe śrīkṛṣṇāgamanaṃ nāmāṣṭātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||38|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.39> garga uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā harastatra bhītaḥ śaṃkitamānasaḥ || tyaktvā cāpatriśūlādīnbhaktyā śrīnāthamabravīt ||1|| śaṃkara uvāca oṃ avinayamapanaya viṣṇo damaya manaḥ śamaya viṣayamṛgatṛṣṇām || bhūtadayāṃ vistāraya tāraya saṃsārasāgarataḥ ||2|| divyadhunīmakaraṃde parimalaparibhogasaccidānaṃde || śrīpatipadāraviṃde bhavabhayakhedacchide vaṃde ||3|| satyapi bhedāpagame nātha tavāhaṃ na māmakīnastvam || sāmudro hi taraṃgaḥ kvacana samudro na tāraṃgaḥ ||4|| uddhṛtanaga nagabhidanuja danujakulāmitra mitraśaśidṛṣṭe || dṛṣṭe bhavati prabhavati na bhavati kiṃ bhavatiraskāraḥ ||5|| matsyādibhiravatārairavatāravatā'vatā vasudhām || parameśvara paripālyo bhavatā bhavatāpabhīto'ham ||6|| dāmodara guṇamaṃdira sundaravadanāraviṃda govinda || bhavajaladhimathanamaṃdara paramaṃ daramapanaya tvaṃ me ||7|| nārāyaṇa karuṇāmaya śaraṇaṃ karavāṇi tāvakau caraṇau || iti ṣaṭpadī madīye vadanasaroje sadā vasatu ||8|| iti stutaḥ śaṃkareṇa prītaḥ saṃkarṣaṇānujaḥ || papraccha sarvābhiprāyaṃ namantaṃ candraśekharam ||9|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca kiṃ kṛtaste'parādho vai matputreṇa kubuddhinā || yatastvayā hataḥ saṃkhye'niruddho mūrcchitaḥ kṛtaḥ ||10|| hataṃ yadubalaṃ kasmātkasmāttvaṃ cāgato raṇe || kasmādyuddhaṃ ca kṛtavāṃstanme vyākhyātumarhasi ||11|| itthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavacanaṃ niśamya pramatheśvaraḥ || uvāca lajjito bhūtvā vicārya madhusūdanam ||12|| śaṃkara uvāca devadeva jagannātha rādhikeśa jaganmaya || pāhi pāhi kṛpākārinnistrapaṃ māṃ kṛtāgasam ||13|| tvaṃ na jānāsi kiṃ deva kathayiṣyāmi kiṃ tvaham || bhaktasya pālanaṃ kartuṃ māyayā tava mohitaḥ ||14|| ahamāgatavāndeva tvaṃ sarvaṃ kṣaṃtumarhasi || śāstāhaṃ sarvalokasya mānāditi mayā hare ||15|| māritāḥ saṃgare śūrā vṛṣṇayaḥ kṛṣṇadevatāḥ || tasmātsaṃtaḥ svayaṃ tyaktvā paramaiśvaryamīpsitam ||16|| dhyāyaṃte satataṃ kṛṣṇapādābjaṃ te nirāpadam || sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ nṛṇāṃ tāvadyāvatkṛṣṇe na mānasam ||17|| kṛṣṇe manasi sañjāte bhetti khaḍgo duratyayaḥ || narāṇāṃ karmavṛkṣāṇāṃ mūlacchedaṃ karoti yaḥ ||18|| madbhaktibaladarpiṣṭhā matprabhuṃ tvāṃ yadūttamam || na manyaṃte ca te sarve yāsyaṃti nirayaṃ dhruvam ||19|| ityuktvā śaṃkarastūṣṇīṃ bhūtvā kṛṣṇasya pādayoḥ || papāta daṃḍavadbhaktyā hyaśrupūrṇākulekṣaṇaḥ ||20|| utthāpyāśvāsya taṃ rudraṃ pārśvatastatpradarśanāt || militvā bhagavānkṛṣṇa āluloka sudhārdradṛk ||21|| āha kṛṣṇaḥ surāḥ sarve kurvaṃti bhaktapālanam || tvayā jugupsitaṃ karma kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhaktapālane ||22|| mamāsi hṛdaye tvaṃ tu bhavato hṛdaye hyaham || āvayoraṃtaraṃ nāsti mūḍhāḥ paśyaṃti durddhiyaḥ ||23|| tvāṃ namaṃti ca madbhaktāstvadbhaktā māṃ sadāśiva || ye na manyaṃti madvākyaṃ yāsyaṃti narakaṃ ca te ||24|| ityuktvā bhagavānkṛṣṇo hataṃ putraṃ sunandanam || dṛṣṭyā pīyūṣavarṣiṇyā jīvayāmāsa saṃyuge ||25|| tatpaścādaniruddhasya hṛdayācchūlameva ca || śanaiḥ śanaiḥ samākṛṣya jīvayāmāsa taṃ hariḥ ||26|| tatpaścādyādavānsarvānnihatānsaṃyuge bhṛśam || ajīvayatsudhādṛṣṭyā kṛṣṇastu prabhurīśvaraḥ ||27|| tāvatsaduṃdubhiravaṃ puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ divaukasaḥ || utsāhalakṣaṇāṃ cakruḥ prasādya garuḍadhvajam ||28|| prabhuṃ trailokyanetāraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā yadūttamāḥ || utthāya saṃbhramāccakrurjayārāvaṃ mudānvitāḥ ||29|| athotthito balvalastu mahādevana rakṣitaḥ || kva gataścāniruddho vai bruvanvākyaṃ ruṣānvitaḥ ||30|| tataḥ śarveṇa daityastu bodhito vacanaiḥ śubhaiḥ || jñātvā kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ mudito'bhūnmahāmanāḥ ||31|| tataḥ praṇamya goviṃdaṃ stutvā daityastu balvalaḥ || turagaṃ pradadau rājanbahudravyeṇa saṃyutam ||32|| tato yajñahayaṃ nītvā putrapautrasamanvitaḥ || setumārgeṇa kṛṣṇastu prayayau paścimāṃ diśam ||33|| kṛṣṇe gate bhagavati rājye saṃsthāpya balvalam || kailāsaṃ prayayau rudraḥ sagaṇastu sabhairavaḥ ||34|| etatkṛṣṇacaritraṃ tu ye śṛṇvanti gṛhe janāḥ || teṣāṃ sahāyaṃ bhagavānkariṣyati sadā hariḥ ||35|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe 'niruddhavijayavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||39|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.40> garga uvāca muktasturaṃgaḥ kṛṣṇena patracāmarabhūṣitaḥ || prayayau sa bahūndeśānnetrābhyāṃ ca vilokayan ||1|| balvalaṃ nirjitaṃ śrutvā nānādeśādhipā nṛpāḥ || hayaṃ na jagṛhuḥ prāptaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya bhayānnṛpa ||2|| itthaṃ vrajanbhārate vai yaduvīraturaṃgamaḥ || ekamāsena rājeṃdra prāpto'bhūdvrajamaṇḍale ||3|| tataḥ kṛṣṇāṃ samuttīrya dṛṣṭvā vṛndāvanaṃ vanam || tamālasya tale rājansthito'bhūddhayasattamaḥ ||4|| dūrvāṃ caraṃtaṃ turagaṃ vilokya vihāya gāste kila gopabālāḥ || samāyayuste nṛpa kautukena hayasya pārśve karatāḍanaiśca ||5|| iti paśyatsu sarveṣu śrīdāmā gopanāyakaḥ || jagrāha līlayā rājañcaraṃtaṃ caṃcalaṃ hayam ||6|| gopāśena hayaṃ baddhvā gale gopaiḥ samanvitaḥ || kenotsṛṣṭo vadanvākyaṃ nandasya nikaṭaṃ yayau ||7|| āgataṃ vājinaṃ dṛṣṭvā nando'pi harṣapūritaḥ || tatpatraṃ vācayitvā''ha sarvāngadgadayā girā ||8|| ugrasenahayaścaiṣa pure mama samāgataḥ || pālito hyaniruddhena matpautreṇa sarvataḥ ||9|| gṛhṇāmi yajñaturagaṃ mitrāṇāṃ milanāya ca || tataḥ prapautraṃ paśyāmi kṛṣṇākāraṃ priyaṃkaram ||10|| ityuktvā nandarājastu drṣṭuṃ gopaiḥ samanvitaḥ || kathayitvā yaśodāgre'bhiprāyaṃ niryayau purāt ||11|| tadaiva yādavāḥ sarve bhojavṛṣṇyaṃdhakādayaḥ || hayasya pṛṣṭhato lagnāstatrājagmurnṛpeśvara ||12|| vilokayaṃto nayapālatīrthe tathā ca mārge mithilāmayodhyām || barhiṣmatīṃ caiva hi kānyakubjaṃ sāṃkarṣaṇaṃ gokulameva rājan ||13|| mārtaṃḍakanyāṃ mathurāṃ purīṃ ca virājate yatra tu keśavaśca || vṛṃdāvane nandapure nṛpeṃdra samāgatāḥ kṛṣṇayutāśca sarve ||14|| nandagrāmaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā rathastho nandanaṃdanaḥ || sarveṣāmagrato bhūtvā hyāyayau yādavairvṛtaḥ ||15|| dadarśa tatra purato gopālaiḥ pitaraṃ hariḥ || saṃsthitaṃ tu puraskṛtya vāraṇendramalaṃkṛtam ||16|| vāditraiḥ śaṃkhaśabdaiśca jayaśabdairnṛpeśvara || puṣpālaṃkārakalaśalājādyaiḥ paribhūṣitam ||17|| tataśca yādavāḥ sarve nemurnaṃdaṃ nirīkṣya ca || harṣāśruviplutā rājannuddhavādyāśca tatra vai ||18|| tadaiva nandarājasya dakṣiṇāṃgamathāsphurat || uvāca dṛṣṭvā manasi hyuttamaṃ śakunaṃ nṛpa ||19|| adya paśyāmi netrābhyāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kiṃ priyavādinam || yasmānmamākṣiḥ sphurati dakṣiṇaśca priyaṃkaraḥ || 20|| mannetragocaraḥ kṛṣṇo yadā bhūyāttadā hyahyam || gavāṃ lakṣaṃ pradāsyāmi brāhmaṇebhyo hyalaṃkṛtam ||21|| ityuktvā vacanaṃ naṃdo virarāma yadā nṛpa || tadāśṛṇotsvaputrasyāgamanaṃ vrajavāsibhiḥ ||22|| śrīkṛṣṇāgamanaṃ śrutvā nando virahaviplutaḥ || paśyanhariṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vicacāra rudanniva ||23|| vadankṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti girā gadgadayā bhṛśam || he kṛṣṇacandra kva gato duḥkhitaṃ māṃ na paśyasi ||24|| tato nirīkṣya pitaraṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ pitṛvatsalaḥ || avaplutya rathāttūrṇaṃ papāta caraṇau pituḥ ||25|| śrīnandarājastanayaṃ samutthāpya cirāgatam || snāpayāmāsa salilaiḥ kṛtvā vakṣasi netrayoḥ ||26|| akṣibhyāṃ kṛṣṇacandrastu mumocāśru ghṛṇāturaḥ || śrīdāmādīnsakhīndṛṣṭvā paścātpremapariplutaḥ ||27|| pṛthakpṛthakparirebhe kṛṣṇapremaparipluptaḥ || bhaktānāṃ ko'sti māhātmyamaho vaktuṃ dharātale ||28|| nandādyā rurudurgopāḥ śrīkṛṣṇādyāśca yādavāḥ || pravaktuṃ na samarthāste sarve virahaviklavāḥ ||29|| aśrupūrṇamukhaḥ kṛṣṇo gopāngadgadayā girā || sarvānāśvāsayāmāsa premānaṃdasamākulān ||30|| paripūrṇatamaṃ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇaṃ jagadīśvaram || tādṛśaṃ dadṛśuḥ sarve yādṛśo mathurāṃ gataḥ ||31|| navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ kiśoravayasaṃ śiśum || śaratprabhātakamalakāṃtimocanalocanam ||32|| śaratpūrṇeṃnduśobhāḍhyaṃ śobhāsvācchādanānanam || koṭimanmathalāvaṇyaṃ līlānaṃditasundaram ||33|| sasmitaṃ muralīhastaṃ dvibhujaṃ hyatisundaram || taḍidvastradharaṃ devaṃ matsyakuṇḍalinaṃ harim ||34|| candanokṣitasarvāṃgam kaustubhena virājitam || ājānumālatīmālāvanamālāvibhūṣitam ||35|| mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca sadratnamukuṭojjvalam || pakvabiṃbādharoṣṭhaṃ ca nāsikonnataśobhanam ||36|| evaṃ kṛṣṇasya rājendra rūpaṃ naitrairvrajaukasaḥ || papurānandasaṃmagnāḥ pīyūṣaṃ mānavā iva ||37|| aniruddhaṃ tato nandaḥ sāṃbādīṃścaiva yādavān || āśiṣaṃ pradadau rājanprītaḥ premapariplutaḥ ||38|| tataḥ sarvaiśca yadubhiḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ || viveśa svapuraṃ nando gataduḥkho mahāmatiḥ ||39|| avaplutya rathātkṛṣṇaḥ sāṃbādyaiḥ paribhūṣitaḥ || tvaraṃ svamāturbhavanamānaṃdaṃ pradadanyayau ||40|| dṛṣṭvā svamātaraṃ kṛṣṇo gṛhadvāre samāgatām || rudatīṃ bāṣpakaṇṭhī tāṃ nanāma prarudanhariḥ ||41|| yaśodā tasya jananī svaprāṇebhyaḥ priyaṃ sutam || upagūhya dadau tasmai girā gadgadayā''śiṣaḥ ||42|| nandastathopanaṃdaśca tathā ṣaḍvṛṣabhānavaḥ || vṛṣabhānuvaraścaiva hyete draṣṭuṃ samāyayuḥ ||43|| tatrāgatānāṃ gopānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇo yādavairvṛtaḥ || yathāvidhyupasaṃgamya sarveṣāṃ mānamādadhe ||44|| te tu kṛṣṇasya kuśalaṃ papracchurmuditānanāḥ || teṣāṃ kṛṣṇastu bhagavānpapraccha kuśalaṃ param ||45|| tataśca yamunātīre vṛṃdāraṇye nṛpeśvara || babhūvuḥ śibirāḥ sarve'niruddhasya mahātmanaḥ ||46|| śibireṣvaniruddhādyā sāṃbādyāścoddhavādayaḥ || nivāsaṃ cakrire kṛṣṇaḥ sthito'bhūnnaṃdapattane ||47|| āgatebhyaśca sarvebhyo naṃdaḥ kṛṣṇena saṃyutaḥ || bhojanaṃ pradadau rājanpaśubhyaśca tṛṇāni ca ||48|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe vrajapraveśo nāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||40|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.41> śrīgarga uvāca āhūto rādhayā kṛṣṇaḥ sandhyāyāṃ nandanaṃdanaḥ || jagāma śaśvadekānte śītalaṃ kadalīvanam ||1|| raṃbhādalaiścaṃdanasya paṃkayuktaṃ manoharam || sphārāsphurannabhragehaṃ yamunāvāyuśīkaram ||2|| etādṛśaṃ rādhikāyāḥ sundaraṃ meghamaṃdiram || sarvaṃ duḥkhāgninā nityaṃ bhasmībhūtaṃ babhūva ha ||3|| śrīdāmaśāpena nṛpa duḥkhena vṛṣabhānujā || tanuṃ rakṣati tatrāpi kṛṣṇāgamanahetave ||4|| niśamya kṛṣṇaṃ svavane samāgataṃ sakhīmukhācchrīvṛṣabhānunaṃdinī || ānetumutthāya varāsanāttvaraṃ dvāre sakhībhirnṛpa sā jagāma ha ||5|| dadau hyāsanapādyādyānupacārānvrajeśvarī || vadaṃtī kuśalaṃ vākyaṃ kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇaṃ vrajeśvaram ||6|| paripūrṇatamaṃ dṛṣṭvā paripūrṇatamā nṛpa || jahau virahajaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃyoge harṣapūritā ||7|| cakāra svasyāḥ śṛṅgāraṃ vastrālaṃkāracaṃdanaiḥ || kuśasthalyāṃ gate nāthe śṛṅgāro na kṛtastayā ||8|| purā tayā na bhuktaṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ miṣṭabhojanam || kṛtaṃ na śayyāśayanaṃ kvaciddhāsyaṃ na vā kṛtam ||9|| siṃhāsane sthitaṃ rādhā devaṃ madanamohanam || harṣāśrūṇi pramuṃcaṃtī jagau gadgadayā girā ||10|| rādhovāca gokulaṃ mathurāṃ tyaktvā gataḥ kasmātkuśasthalīm || vada tanme hṛṣīkeśa tvaṃ sākṣādgokuleśvaraḥ ||11|| kṣaṇaṃ yugasamaṃ nātha jānāmi tvadviyogataḥ || ghaṭīṃ manvaṃtarasamāṃ dviparārddhasamaṃ dinam ||12|| kasminkukāle viraho me babhūva ca duḥkhadaḥ || yena tvaccaraṇau deva na paśyāmi sukhapradau ||13|| yathā rāmaṃ tu sīteva mānasaṃ varaṭeva ca || tathā rāseśvaraṃ tvāṃ tu mānadaṃ hi samutsahe ||14|| sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajña kiṃ duḥkhaṃ kathayāmyaham || śatavarṣaṃ gataṃ nātha viyogo na gato mama ||15|| ityuktvā vacanaṃ rājansvāminī svāminaṃ param || viyogakhinnā duḥkhāni smaraṃtī sā ruroda ha ||16|| dṛṣṭvā priyāṃ rudaṃtīṃ tāṃ priyaḥ prāha priyaṃ vacaḥ || tasmāśca śamayanvākyaiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kaśmalameva ca ||17|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca na kartavyastvayā rādhe śokaśca tanuśoṣakaḥ || tejaścaikaṃ dvidhābhūtabhāvayoḥ ṛṣayo viduḥ ||18|| yatrāhaṃ tvaṃ sadā tatra yatra tvaṃ hyahameva ca || viyoga āvayornāsti māyāpuruṣayoryathā ||19|| bhedaṃ hi cāvayormadhye ye paśyaṃti narādhamāḥ || dehāṃte narakānrādhe te prayāṃti svadoṣataḥ ||20|| athātastvaṃ tu māṃ rādhe nityaṃ drakṣyasi cāṃtike || prabhāte cakravākīva cakravākaṃ priyaṃkaram ||21|| kiṃcitkālena dayite gopagopībhireva ca || sākaṃ tvayākṣaraṃ brahma śrīgolokaṃ vrajāmyaham ||22|| garga uvāca mādhavasya vacaḥ śrutvā gopībhiḥ saha rādhikā || prasannā pūjayāmāsa rameśaṃ ca ramā yathā ||23|| śrīrādhayā punaḥ kṛṣṇo rāsārthaṃ prārthito nṛpa || prasranno vṛṃdakāraṇye rāsaṃ kartuṃ mano dadhe ||24|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe rādhākṛṣṇamelanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||41|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.42> śrīgarga uvāca hemaṃte māsi pūrvasminrākāyāṃ rādhikeśvaraḥ || vaṃśīṃ vaśakarīṃ daghmau yathā vṛndāvane purā ||1|| dhvanirbabhūva tasyāśca sarveṣāmāharanmanaḥ || niśamya gopyaḥ saṃkhinnāḥ kāmakhedena tatrasuḥ ||2|| ruṃdhannaṃbubhṛtaścamatkṛtiparaṃ kurvanmuhustvaṃbaraṃ dhyānāddhaṃtanayansanaṃdanamukhānvismerayanvedhasam || autsukyādbalibhirbaliṃ caṭulayanbhogeṃdramāghūrṇayanbhiṃdannaṃḍakaṭāhabhittimabhito babhrāma vaṃśīdhvaniḥ ||3|| athodagāccaṃdramāstu carṣaṇīnāṃ śuco mṛjan || yathā priyāyā rājeṃdra videśādāgataḥ priyaḥ ||4|| tadaiva yamunā rājaṃstanuṃ divyaṃ dadhāra ha || vṛndāvanaṃ girīṃdrañca vrajabhūmiñca mānada ||5|| kṛṣṇā nadī jayati yatra maṇīṃdramuktāmāṇikyaśubhraharitā karatolikābhiḥ || vaidūryanīlakahariddharivajrapītasopānamaṇḍapayutābhiratisphurantī ||6|| svacchaṃdasūtpatitamatsyagaṇairvahaṃtī sacchyāmalena vapuṣāghagaṇaṃ haraṃtī || uttuṃgalolalaharī kamalairlasaṃtī kṛṣṇā nadī jayati kṛṣṇagṛhe luṭhaṃtī ||7|| govardhanaṃ bhaja girīṃ śatacaṃdrayuktaṃ maṃdāracandanalatāvṛtakalpavṛkṣam || śrīrāsamaṇḍalayutaṃ maṇimaṃḍapāḍhyaṃ koṭīramaṃjulanikuṃjakuṭīrakoṭim ||8|| vṛndāvanaṃ ca yamunātaṭanīratīrasaṃpṛktamaṃdagamanairatigaṃdhavātaiḥ || tatkaṃpitaṃ ca surabhīkṛtasarvadeśaṃ śrīkhaṃḍakuṃkumamṛdāgurucarcitaṃ tam ||9|| juṣṭaṃ vasantanavapallavapuṣparaṃgairmaṃdāracandanasucampakanīpaniṃbaiḥ || āmrātakāmrapanasāgurunāgaraṃgaiḥ śrītālapippalavaṭairnavanārikelaiḥ ||10|| kharjūraśrīphalalavaṃgavirājamānamaṃjīraśālakatamālakadaṃbayuktam || santānakuṃdabadarīkadalīsitāḍhyaṃ śrīśālmalībakulaketakisacchirīṣam ||11|| sanmodinījalajavṛndamanoharābhaṃ vṛndārakaṃ varavanaṃ tulasīlatāḍhyām || śrīmallikāmṛtalatāmadhumādhavībhiḥ saṃrājitaṃ smara nṛpeṃdra vrajasya madhye ||12|| vaṃśīvaṭaṃ ca kalakaṃṭhavihaṃgamaiśca kṛṣṇātaṭe ca pulinaṃ kila bālukāḍhyām || śrīpāṭalairmadhukakiṃśukasatpriyālairauduṃbaraiḥ kramukadrākṣakapitthayuktam ||13|| śrīkovidārapicumaṃdalatārjunaiśca plakṣairaśokasaralaiḥ suradārubhiśca || jaṃbūsuvetranalakubjakasvarṇayūthīpunnāganāgakuṭajaiḥ kurabairvṛtaṃ ca ||14|| cakrāhvasārasaśukaiḥ sitarājahaṃsaiḥ kāraṃḍavaiśca jalakukkuṭakūjitaṃ ca ||15|| dātyūhakokilakapotakanīlakaṇṭhairnṛtyanmayūrakalarāvavṛtaṃ smara tvam ||16|| śyāmācakorakalakhaṃjanasārikābhiḥ pārāvatairbhramaratittiratittirībhiḥ || śrīkāṃcanīmadhulatāmadhuyūthikābhiḥ saṃveṣṭitaṃ hariṇamarkaṭamarkaṭībhiḥ ||17|| śrīpadmarāgaśikharaṃ ca nikuṃjagehaṃ śrīkaustubheṃdramaṇirājivirājamānam || koṭīṃdumaṃḍalavitānagaṇaiśca haimaiḥ śrīpaṭṭasūtraracitairmaṇitoraṇāḍhyam ||18|| muktāvṛtaiḥ kanakapītapatatpatākaiḥ pārāvataiḥ sitapatatribhirāvṛtañca || maṃdārakundakaravīrakayūthikānāṃ mālāvicitraracitaṃ navacaṃpakānām ||19|| nāgeśapadmaharicaṃdanapallavānāṃ śrīmālatīkurabakāṃcanayūthikānām || mālābhirāvṛtamanaṃgaharaṃ gṛhaṃ tatsadratnadarpaṇavṛtaṃ sitacāmaraiśca ||20|| siṃhāsanaiśca navapallavapuṣpayuktaiḥ śayyāsanaiḥ kanakavidrumapādavṛndaiḥ || śrīcaṃdanāgurujalairmakaraṃdasaṃghaiḥ kastūrikāmuditakuṃkumacarcitaṃ tat ||21|| ejadvasaṃtatarupallavameva vātaiḥ śītairgajeṃdragamanaiḥ surabhīkṛtāṃgam || etādṛśaṃ harinikuṃjagṛhaṃ smara tvaṃ sannamraśākhataruyuktamatīva puṣpaiḥ ||22|| śrīveṇugītaṃ bahukāmavarddhanaṃ niśamya sarvā vrajayoṣito nṛpa || śrīkṛṣṇakāṃtena gṛhītamānasā visṛjya karmāṇi samāyayurvane ||23|| ruddhā yāḥ patibhī rājankṛṣṇena hṛtamānasāḥ || sthūlaṃ śarīraṃ tāstyaktvā tvaraṃ kṛṣṇāṃtikaṃ yayuḥ ||24|| siṃhāsane hemadukūlasaṃyute madhye sthitaṃ sundaranandanandanam || śrīsundarī rādhikayā samaṃ paraṃ gale dadhānaṃ madhumālatīsrajam ||25|| śyāmaṃ prabhātārkakirīṭinaṃ hariṃ sphuratprabhaṃ śrīmuralīmanoharam || pītāṃbaraṃ manmatharāśimohanaṃ vrajastriyastaṃ dadṛśuḥ samāgatāḥ ||26|| dṛṣṭvā priyāḥ priyatamaṃ matsyakuṇḍalinaṃ harim || gopyo mūrcchāṃ gatāḥ sadyo bhūpa cālakṣitodyamāḥ ||27|| sāṃtvayāmāsa tāḥ kṛṣṇo miṣṭavākyaiḥ sudhāsamaiḥ || tadā gopyo vanoddeśe sarvāścaitanyatāṃ gatāḥ ||28|| kṛṣṇaṃ gadgadayā vācā stutvā bhītāḥ striyo varāḥ || tyaktvā virahajaṃ duḥkhaṃ goviṃdaṃ dadṛśuḥ priyam ||29|| vṛndāvane bhrājamāne mālatīvanasaṃkule || divyadrumalatājāle madhupadhvaninādite ||30|| vicacāra hariḥ sākṣāddevo madanamohanaḥ || padmābhaṃ padmahastena gṛhītvā rādhikākaram ||31|| prahasanbhagavānsākṣādāyayau yamunātaṭam || kṛṣṇātīre nikuṃje vai śrīkṛṣṇo niṣasāda ha ||32|| tasmingṛhe madhupateḥ śṛṇu gopikānāṃ śrīkṛṣṇacandracaraṇasmaraṇāvṛtānām || jhaṃkāranūpurajhaṇatkarakaṃkaṇānāṃ maṃjīraratnavicalatkaṭikiṃkiṇīnām ||33|| smeradyutisphuṭacamatkṛtagaṃḍadeśaiḥ śrīdaṃtapaṃktivilasattaḍitālileśaiḥ || koṭīrahāraharitāṃgadabhūṣitānāṃ bālārkamaṃḍalavikuṃḍalamaṃḍitānām ||34|| tāsāṃ tu kāpi yuvatī kathitā ca mugdhā madhyāpi kāpi taruṇī rucirā pragalbhā || kācittaruṃ vinayatī madhuraṃ hasaṃtī kācitsakhī madayutā suvane vrajaṃtī ||35|| saṃtāḍya tāmapi kareṇa tu kāpyadhāvatsaṃgṛhya kāpi bhuvane kamalairjaghāna || kācicchlathatkanakahāramupājahāra kācitpramuktakabarī tu vihāramattā ||36|| śrījāhnavī ca yamunā madhu mādhavī ca śīlā ramā śaśimukhī virajā suśīlā || candrānanā ca lalitā tvacalā viśākhā māyā'lpa eva kathitā bhavane tvasaṃkhyāḥ ||37|| līlātapatramatimauktikadāmajālaṃ nītvā calaṃti maṇibhūmiṣu tatra kāścit || śrīcāmaravyajanadaṃḍadharā vayasyāḥ kāścidvrajaṃti dhṛtapītapatatpatākāḥ ||38|| nṛtyaṃti tatra hariveṣadharāstu kāścidvīṇākarā madhuratālamṛdaṃgahastāḥ || vaṃśīdharāśca vṛṣabhānusutāḥ suveṣāḥ keyūrakuṇḍalayutā maṇivetrahastāḥ ||39|| saddhāvabhāvarasatālayutasmitāktairjhaṃkāranūpurayutairviśadaiḥ kaṭākṣaiḥ || saṃgītanṛtyaviditairbhrukuṭīvibhaṃgai rādhāṃ hariṃ ca satataṃ paritoṣayaṃtyaḥ ||40|| tasminnikuñjabhavane yamunātaṭe'pi vaṃśīvaṭe vanadharānikaṭe hariṃ tam || śrīrādhayā ca girirājataṭaṃ vrajaṃtaṃ naṃdātmajaṃ ca naṭaveṣadharaṃ smara tvam ||41|| śrīpadmarāganakhadīptipadāravindaṃ jhaṃkāranūpuradharaṃ sphuradaṃgadeśam || kurvaṃtameva tu padāruṇabhūmideśaṃ śrīmatparāgasurucālamitastatastu ||42|| lakṣmīkarābjaparilālitajānudeśaṃ raṃbhoru pītavasanaṃ tu kṛśodarābham || romāvalibhramaranābhisarastrirekhaṃ kāṃcīdharaṃ bhṛgupadaṃ maṇīkaustubhāḍhyam ||43|| śrīvatsahāraruciraṃ navameghanīlaṃ pītāṃbaraṃ karikarasphuṭabāhudaṇḍam || ratnāṃgadaṃ ca maṇīkaṃkaṇapadmahastaṃ śrīrājahaṃsavarakaṃdharaśobhamānam ||44|| śrīkambukaṇṭhalalitaṃ vilasatkapolaṃ madhyaṃ tu nimnacibukaṃ kila kundadaṃtam || biṃbādharaṃ smitalasacchukacaṃcunāsaṃ pīyūṣakalpavacanaṃ pracalatkaṭākṣam ||45|| śrīpuṇḍarīkadalanetramanaṃgalīlaṃ bhrūmaṇḍalasmitaguṇāvṛtakāmacāpam || vidyucchaṭocchalitaratnakirīṭakoṭiṃ mārtaṃḍamaṃḍalavikuṇḍamaṃḍitābham ||46|| vaṃśīdharaṃ tvahivilolaguḍālakāḍhyaṃ rādhāpatiṃ sajalapadmamukhaṃ calaṃtam || kaṃdarpakoṭighanamānaharaṃ kṛśāṃgaṃ vaṃśīvaṭe naṭavaraṃ bhaja sarvathā tvam ||47|| āraktaraktanakhacandrapadābjaśobhāṃ mañjīranūpuraraṇatkaṭikiṃkiṇīkām || śrīghaṃṭikākanakakaṃkaṇaśabdamuktāṃ rādhāṃ dadhāmi tarupuñjanikuñjamadhye ||48|| nīlāṃbaraiḥ kanakaraśmitaṭasphuradbhiḥ śrībhānujātaṭamarudgaticaṃcalāṃgaiḥ || sūkṣmasvarūpalalitairatigauravarṇāṃ rāseśvarīṃ bhaja manoharamaṃdahāsām ||49|| bālārkamaṃḍalamahāṃgadaratnahārāṃ tāṭaṃkatoraṇamaṇīṃdramanoharābhām || śrīkaṇṭhabhālasumanonavapaṃcadāmnīṃ ratnāṃgulīyalalitāṃ vrajarājapatnīm ||50|| cūḍāmaṇidyutilasatsphuradarddhacaṃdrāṃ graiveyakālapanapatravicitrarūpām || śrīpaṭṭasūtramaṇīpaṭṭacaladdvidāmnīṃ sphūrjjatsahasradalapadmadharāṃ bhajasva ||51|| śrībāhukaṃkaṇalasatkucaratnadīptiṃ śrīnāsikābharaṇabhūṣitagaṇḍadeśām || sadyauvanālasagatiṃ kalasarpaveṇīṃ madhyeṃdukoṭivadanāṃ sphuṭacaṃpakābhām ||52|| saddhāvabhāvasahitāṃ navapadmanetrāṃ sphūrjjatsmitadyutikalāṃ pracalatkaṭākṣām || kṛṣṇapriyāṃ lalitakuntalapuṃjalābhāṃ maṃdārahāramadhurabhramarīravāḍhyām ||53|| śrīkhaṃḍakuṃkumamṛdāguruvārisiktāṃ śrībiṃdukīrucirapatravicitracitrām || saṃtānapatrarucirāmalamaṃjanābhāṃ rāseśvarīṃ gajagatiṃ bhaja padminīṃ tām ||54|| etādṛśīṃ rativarāṃ tu sametya kṛṣṇo gacchannikuñjavanajālavilokānāya || dhāvaṃti tatra maṇichatradharāśca gopyo nītvā tathā camaracārupatatpatākāḥ ||55|| ṣaḍrāgameva varadhaivatamadhyamādyairgāyaṃtamādipuruṣaṃ bhaja nandaputram || ṣaṭtriṃśatastadanuvarttitarāgiṇīnāṃ vaṃśīvareṇa lalitena varaṃ vrajaṃtam ||56|| śṛṅgāravīrakaruṇādbhutahāsyaraudrabībhatsaśāṃtakabhayānakanityayuktam || bhaktapriyaṃ vrajavadhūmukhapadmabhṛṃgaṃ yogīndrahṛtkamalavisphuradaṃghriyugmam ||57|| kṣetrajñamādipuruṣaṃ svadhiyajñarūpaṃ sarveśvaraṃ sakalakāraṇakāraṇeśam || kṛṣṇaṃ hariṃ prakṛtipūraṣayoḥ pumāṃsaṃ sarvaṃ nirastakapaṭaṃ nijatejaseha ||58|| yaṃ vai stuvaṃti śivadharmasureśaśeṣalokeśasiddhidagaṇeśasurādayo'pi || rādhāramāprakṛtibhūvirajāsvarādyā vedā bhajaṃti satataṃ tamahaṃ bhajāmi ||59|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe rāsakrīḍāyāṃ dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||42|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.43> garga uvāca vṛṃdāvane vṛkṣalatālisaṃkule maṃdānile vījati śītale nṛpa || raṃdhrāṇi veṇoḥ kila pūrayanharirmuhurharatyeva divaukasāṃ manaḥ ||1|| veṇugītaṃ tataḥ śrutvā śrīrādhā kīrtinaṃdinī || bhujābhyāṃ nandasūnuṃ vai jagrāhānaṃgavihvalā ||2|| gokulasya cakorīṃ tāṃ kṛṣṇo gokulacandramāḥ || dṛṣṭvā kusumaparyaṃke tayā reme haranmanaḥ ||3|| śrīkṛṣṇasya vihāreṇa brahmānandena svāminī || mudaṃ lebhe mahātyaṃtaṃ tathā svāmī vaśīkṛtaḥ ||4|| ramaṇīyaṃ ratikaraṃ rāse rāmā rameśvaram || jagṛhuḥ sarvato rājañchatayūthāśca yoṣitaḥ ||5|| tābhiḥ sārddhaṃ harī ramyo reme vai rāsamaṇḍale || tāvadrūpadharo rājan yāvatyo vrajayoṣitaḥ ||6|| virahiṇyaśca tāḥ sarvā viraheṇa vihāriṇaḥ || brahmānaṃdena sanmartyā ānandaṃ lebhire yathā ||7|| śrīkarābhyāṃ śrīkarābhyāṃ śrīśaḥ śrīśyāmasundaraḥ || dadhāra hṛdaye sarvāstābhirbhaktyā vaśīkṛtaḥ ||8|| svedayuktānyānanāni tāsāṃ prītyā vrajeśvaraḥ || prāmṛjatpītavastreṇa kiṃ vadāmi tapaḥphalam ||9|| vinā sāṃkhyena yogena tapasā śravaṇena ca || vinā tīrthena dānena prāptāḥ kāmena tā harim ||10|| tato gopījanāḥ sarvā mānavatyaḥ parasparam || kuvākyaṃ kathayāmāsuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tṛptā vihārataḥ ||11|| asmām̐styaktvā purā kṛṣṇo gataḥ śrīmathurāṃ purīm || vilokituṃ rūpiṇīśca sundarīḥ strīśca sundaraḥ ||12|| na dṛṣṭāstena suṃdaryo jagāma dvārakāṃ punaḥ || na dṛṣṭāstena tāstatra vivāhaṃ kṛtavānpunaḥ ||13|| rukmiṇīṃ bhīṣmakasutāṃ na matvā tāṃ tu rūpiṇīm || punarvivāhānkṛtavānsahasrāṇī ca ṣoḍaśa ||14|| na matvā rūpiṇīstāśca śokaṃ kurvanpunaḥ punaḥ || vrajamāgatavānsakhyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo'smānvilokitum ||15|| dṛṣṭvā rūpāṇi cāsmākaṃ sarvadraṣṭā rameśvaraḥ || prasanno'bhūttathā sakhyo yathā rāse hariḥ purā ||16|| tasmādvayaṃ ca sarvāsāṃ sundarīṇāṃ varāḥ smṛtāḥ || sunetrāścaṃdravadanāḥ śaśvatsusthirayauvanāḥ || asmattulyāśca rūpiṇyo naiva devāṃganāśca khe || yābhiḥ śīghraṃ kaṭākṣaiśca kṛṣṇaḥ kāmī vaśīkṛtaḥ ||18|| aho vai yena haṃsena muktāḥ pūrvaṃ prabhakṣitāḥ || sa evānyatkathaṃ vastu bhakṣayiṣyati duḥkhataḥ ||19|| na saṃti muktāḥ sarvatra saṃti mānasarovare || tathā varastriyo bhūmau na saṃti saṃti cātra hi ||20|| garga uvāca iti mānavatīnāṃ ca svātmārāmo jagatpatiḥ || vacaḥ śṛṇvanrādhayā ca tatraivāṃtaradhīyata ||21|| nirddhano'pi dhanaṃ labdhvā mānaṃ prakurute nṛpa || yasya nārāyaṇaḥ prāpto tasya kiṃ kathayāmyaham ||22|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe rāsakrīḍāyāṃ tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||43|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.44> vajranābhiruvāca adbhutaṃ kṛṣṇacaritaṃ mayā tvanmukhataḥ śrutam || kiṃ cakrurgopikāstāsāṃ sa kathaṃ darśanaṃ dadau ||1|| tatsarvaṃ muniśārdūla mahyaṃ śraddhālave vada || dhanyāste ye hi śṛṇvaṃti karṇe kṛṣṇakathāṃ sadā ||2|| mukhena kṛṣṇacandrasya nāmāni prajapaṃti hi || hastaiḥ śrīkṛṣṇasevāṃ vai ye prakurvaṃti nityaśaḥ ||3|| nityaṃ kurvaṃti kṛṣṇasya dhyānaṃ darśanameva ca || pādodakaṃ prasādaṃ ca ye prabhuñjaṃti nityaśaḥ ||4|| itīdṛśena bhāvena śrameṇa jagadīśvaram || ye bhajaṃti muniśreṣṭha te prayāṃti hareḥ padam ||5|| saṃsāre ye prabhuñjaṃti bhogānnānāvidhānmune || śravaṇādīnna kurvaṃti dehasaukhyena durmadāḥ ||6|| te cāṃte yamadūtaiśca gṛhītāśca bhayānakaiḥ || patitāḥ kālasūtre vai yāvadraviniśākarau ||7|| sūta uvāca ityuktavaṃtaṃ rājānaṃ pratyuvāca muniśvaraḥ || gadgadasvarayā vāṇyā praśaṃsya caritaṃ hareḥ ||8|| garga uvāca kṛṣṇe cāṃtarhite rājaṃstvaraṃ sarvāśca gopikāḥ || ācakṣāṇāśca taṃ taptāḥ hariṇyo hariṇaṃ yathā ||9|| antarhitaṃ hariṃ jñātvā gopyaḥ sarvāśca pūrvavat || yūthībhūtā vicikyurvai sarvatastaṃ vane vane ||10|| papracchurbhūruhānsarvānmilitvā tu parasparam || hatvā hyasmānkaṭākṣeṇa kva gato naṃdanadanaḥ ||11|| tadasmākaṃ ca vadata yūyaṃ sarve vaneśvarāḥ || mārtaṃḍakanye tvajire gopālo gāśca cārayan ||12|| nityaṃ cakāra līlāṃ tu sa gataḥ kutra no vada || śataśṛṅgagirīṃdrastvaṃ śrīnāthena dhṛtaḥ purā ||13|| vāmahaste rakṣaṇārthaṃ vāsavādvrajavāsinām || na jahāti haristvāṃ tu svaputraṃ hṛdayodbhavam ||14|| sa gato vada kutrāste vihāya vipine ca naḥ || he mayūrāśca hariṇā he gāvo he mṛgāḥ khagāḥ ||15|| kirīṭī hyalakī kṛṣṇo yuṣmābhiḥ kiṃ vilokitaḥ || vadanta so'pi kutrāste vane kasminmanoharaḥ ||16|| etaistu vākyaiḥ saṃtuṣṭāḥ kaṭhināstīrthavāsinaḥ || uttaraṃ naiva dāsyaṃti sarve te mohitāḥ kila ||17|| garga uvāca evaṃ sarvā hi pṛcchantyaḥ kṛṣṇacandraṃ vane vane || vadaṃtyaḥ kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti babhūvustanmayāstataḥ ||18|| cakruḥ kṛṣṇacaritrāṇi tatra kṛṣṇamayāḥ striyaḥ || yamunāvālukāyāṃ ca padāni dadṛśurhareḥ ||19|| vajradhvajāṃkuśādyaiśca cihnitāni mahātmanaḥ || tatpadānyanusāreṇa paśyantyaḥ prayayuḥ svaram ||20|| kṛṣṇāṃghrireṇavo nītvā mūrdhni dhṛtvā vrajastriyaḥ || padānyanyāni dadṛśuścānyacihnayutāni hi ||21|| nirīkṣyāhuḥ priyāsārddhaṃ gataḥ priyatamo hyasau || evaṃ vadaṃtyaḥ paśyantyo gopyastālavanaṃ gatāḥ ||22|| vrajannagre vrajeṃdrastu vrajeśvaryā vraje nṛpa || kolāhalaṃ ca gopīnāṃ śrutvā pratyāha svaminīm || 23|| śīghraṃ gaccha priye tvaṃ tu koṭicandrasamaprabhe || āgatā vrajanāryo hi netuṃ tvāṃ māṃ ca sarvataḥ ||24|| tataḥ priyā hareḥ pūrvaṃ śṛṅgāraṃ kusumairnṛpa || cakāra suṃdaraṃ divyaṃ vṛndāraṇye ca pūrvavat ||25|| naṃdasūnuḥ priyāyāśca divyaṃ śrṛṃgārameva ca || cakāra bahubhiḥ puṣpairbhāṃḍīre ca yathā purā ||26|| keśaprasādhanādyaiśca sraktāṃbūlānulepanaiḥ || suṃdarī suṃdareṇāpi babhūvātyaṃtasundarī ||27|| tataḥ kṛṣṇastu muditaḥ puṣpavṛkṣatale nṛpa || śayyāṃ puṣpamayīṃ kṛtvā tayā reme rameśvaraḥ ||28|| vṛndāvane govardhane kṛṣṇāyāḥ puline tathā || naṃdīśvare bṛhatsānau tathā rohitaparvate ||29|| araṇyeṣu dvādaśasu sarvatra vrajamaṃḍale || kāṃtayā vicarankāṃto vaṃśīvaṭatale sthitaḥ ||30|| tatra śuśrāva gopīnāṃ vadantīnāṃ ravaṃ param || svāminyā saha rājeṃdra śrīgopījanavallabhaḥ ||31|| punaḥ prāha priyāṃ premṇā gaccha gaccha priye tvaram || kṛṣṇavākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā prāha bhūtvā ca māninī ||32|| rādhovāca na samarthā pracalituṃ kvacidgehānna nirgatā || naya māṃ te mano yatra durbalāṃ dīnavatsala ||33|| iti tadvākyamākarṇya rāmāṃ rāmānujastataḥ || svena pītāṃbareṇāpi vījayāmāsa svedataḥ ||34|| pragṛhya pāṇinā prāha sarpa rājñi yathāsukham || iti sā hariṇā proktā matvātmānaṃ varaṃ param ||35|| hitvāsau strījanān rātrau bhajate māṃ rahaḥsthale || iti matvā tu haraye bhūtvā tūṣṇīṃ vrajeśvarī ||36|| vastreṇānanamācchādya pṛṣṭhaṃ datvā sthitābhavat || punarāha haristāṃ tu priye gaccha mayā saha ||37|| bhajāmi tvāmahaṃ bhadre viyogārtāṃ tu śāpataḥ || vihāya gopīḥ sarvāśca lagnāstvāṃ tu bhajāmyaham ||38|| tvaṃ tu me skaṃdhamāruhya sukhaṃ vraja rahaḥsthale || ityuktvā māninīṃ mānī skaṃdhayānamabhīpsatīm ||39|| tyaktvā hyantadardhe rājansvātmārāmaḥ svalīlayā || antarhite bhagavati sahasā sā vadhūrnṛpa ||40|| anvatapyata duḥkhārttā gatamānā ruroda ha || tatastadrodanaṃ śrutvā vaṃśīvaṭataṭe tvaram ||41|| ājagmurgopikāḥ sarvā dadṛśustāṃ ca duḥkhitām || cakruḥ striyastadaṃgeṣu vāyuṃ vyajanacāmaraiḥ ||42|| snāpayitvā tu tāṃ premṇā kāśmīrasalilena ca || siṣicurmakaraṃdaistāṃ candanadravaśīkaraiḥ ||43|| punarvākyaiḥ samāśvāsya gopyaḥ karmasu kovidāḥ || niśamya tanmukhādyānaṃ goviṃdasya ca mānataḥ ||44|| māninyo gopikāḥ sarvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ || vihāya mānaṃ tāḥ sarvā āgatya pulinaṃ nṛpa || svarairjaguḥ kṛṣṇaguṇām̐stadāgamanahetave ||45|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe rāsakrīḍāyāṃ catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||44|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.45> gopya ūcuḥ adharabimbaviḍaṃbitavidrumaṃ madhuraveṇuninādavinoditam || kamalakomalanīlamukhāṃbujaṃ tamapi gopakumāramupāsmahe ||1|| śyāmalaṃ vipinakelilampaṭaṃ komalaṃ kamalapatralocanam || kāmadaṃ vrajavilāsinīdṛśāṃ śītalaṃ matiharaṃ bhajāmahe ||2|| taṃ visaṃcalitalocanāṃcalaṃ sāmikuḍmalitakomalādharam || vaṃśavalgitakarāṃgulīmukhaṃ veṇunādarasikaṃ bhajāmahe ||3|| īṣadaṃkuritadaṃtakuṃḍalaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ bhuvanamaṃgalaśriyam || ghoṣasaurabhamanoharaṃ harerveṣameva mṛgayāmahe vayam ||4|| astuḥ nityamaraviṃdalocanaḥ śreyase hi tu surārcitākṛtiḥ || yasya pādasarasīruhāmṛtaṃ sevyamānamaniśaṃ munīśvaraiḥ ||5|| gopakai racitamallasaṃgaraṃ saṃgare jitavidagdhayauvanam || ciṃtayāmi manasā sadaivataṃ daivataṃ nikhilayogināmapi ||6|| ullasannavapayodameva taṃ phūllatāmarasalocanāṃcalam || ballavīhṛdayapaśyatoharaṃ pallavādharamupāsmahe vayam ||7|| yaddhanaṃjayarathasya maṇḍanaṃ khaṃḍanaṃ tadapi sañcitainasām || jīvanaṃ śrutigirāṃ sadāmalaṃ śyāmalaṃ manasi me'stu tanmahaḥ ||8|| gopikāstanavilolalocanaprāṃtalocanaparaṃparāvṛtam || bālakelirasalālasaṃ bhramaṃ mādhavaṃ tamaniśaṃ vibhāvaye ||9|| nīlakaṇṭhakṛtapicchaśekharaṃ nīlameghatulitāṃgavaibhavam || nīlapaṃkajapalāśalocanaṃ nīlakuṃtaladharaṃ bhajāmahe ||10|| ghoṣayoṣidanugītavaibhavaṃ komalasvaritaveṇuniḥsvanam || sārabhūtamabhirāmasaṃpadāṃ dhāma tāmarasalocanaṃ bhaje ||11|| mohanaṃ manasi śārṅgiṇaṃ paraṃ nirgataṃ kila vihāya māninīḥ || nāradādimunibhiśca sevitaṃ naṃdagopatanayaṃ bhajāmahe ||12|| śrīharistu ramaṇībhirāvṛto yastu vai jayati rāsamaṇḍale || rādhayā saha vane ca duḥkhitāstaṃ priyaṃ hi mṛgayāmahe vayam || 13|| devadeva vrajarājanandana dehi darśanamalaṃ ca no hare || sarvaduḥkhaharaṇaṃ ca pūrvavatsaṃnirīkṣya tava śulkadāsikāḥ ||14|| kṣititaloddharaṇāya dadhāra yaḥ sakalayajñavarāhavapuḥ param || ditisutaṃ vidadāra ca daṃṣṭrayā sa tu sadoddharaṇāya kṣamo'stu naḥ ||15|| manumatādrucijo divijaiḥ saha vasu dudoha dharāmapi yaḥ pṛthuḥ || śrutimapāddhṛtamatsyavapuḥ paraṃ sa śaraṇaṃ kila no'stvaśubhakṣaṇe ||16|| avahadabdhimaho girimūrjitaṃ kamaṭharūpadharaḥ paramastu yaḥ || asuharaṃ nṛhariḥ tamadaṃḍayatsa ca hariḥ paramaṃ śaraṇaṃ ca naḥ ||17|| nṛpa baliṃ chalayandalayannarīnmunijanānanugṛhya cacāra yaḥ || kurupuraṃ ca halena vikarṣayanyaduvaraḥ sa gatirmama sarvathā ||18|| vrajapaśūngirirājamathoddharanvrajapagopajanaṃ ca jugopa yaḥ || drupadarājasutāṃ kurukaśmalādbhavatu taccaraṇābjaratiśca naḥ ||19|| viṣamahāgnimahāstravipadgaṇātsakalapāṃḍusutāḥ parirakṣitāḥ || yaduvareṇa pareṇa ca yena vai bhavatu taccaraṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ ca naḥ ||20|| mālāṃ barhimanojñakuntalabharāṃ vanyaprasūnoṣitāṃ śaileyāguruklṛptacitratilakāṃ śaśvanmanohāriṇīm || līlāveṇuravāmṛtaikarasikāṃ lāvaṇyalakṣmīmayīṃ bālāṃ bālatamālanīlavapuṣaṃ vaṃdāmahe devatām ||21|| garga uvāca iti strībhī rudaṃtībhī revatīramaṇānujaḥ || āvirbabhūva cāhūtastāsāṃ madhye ca bhaktitaḥ ||22|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe rāsakrīḍāyāṃ pañcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||45|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.46> garga uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ samāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā tāḥ samutthāya harṣitāḥ || cakrurjayajayārāvaṃ gopyo duḥkhaṃ visṛjya ca ||1|| dṛṣṭvā saṃmūrcchitāṃ rādhāṃ gopibhiḥ prārthito hariḥ || caitanyārthe vraje tatra cakāra muralīravam ||2|| notthitāṃ rādhikāṃ dṛṣṭvā śrīrādhāvallabho hariḥ || tasyai saṃśrāvayāmāsa veṇugītaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||3|| tataḥ samutthitā rādhā smṛtvā duḥkhaṃ viyogajam || babhūva mūrcchitā rājanmādhavasya prapaśyataḥ ||4|| tataḥ kṛṣṇasya vacanātsadyaścandrānanā sakhī || candrāvalīṃ pratyuvāca prasannā kṛṣṇaveṇunā ||5|| candrānanovāca kṛṣṇacandraḥ purā nirgato mānato hyāgataḥ so'pi rādhe yugāṃte punaḥ || nāśayansarvaduḥkhāni te sannidhau saṃjagau veṇunā devakīnaṃdanaḥ ||6|| chuṃgachuṃge ninādaṃ mṛdaṃge kalaṃ vādyamāne surastrījanaiḥ sevitaḥ || rāsaramyāṅgaṇe nṛtyakṛnmādhavaḥ saṃjagau veṇunā devakīnaṃdanaḥ ||7|| cārucāmīkarābhāsivāsā vibhurvaijayaṃtībharābhāsitorasthalaḥ || naṃdavṛndāvane gopikāmadhyagaḥ saṃjagau veṇunā devakīnaṃdanaḥ ||8|| cārucaṃdrāvalīlocanācuṃbito gopagovṛndagopikāvallabhaḥ || kaṃsavaṃśāṭavīdāhadāvānalaḥ saṃjagau veṇunā devakīnaṃdanaḥ ||9|| bālikātālikātālalīlālayāsaṅgasaṃdarśitabhrūlatāvibhramaḥ || gopikāgītadattāvadhānaḥ svayaṃ saṃjagau veṇunā devakīnaṃdanaḥ ||10|| maulimālāṃgadaiḥ kiṃkiṇīkuṇḍalairbhūṣito naṃdano naṃdarājasya ca || prītikṛtsundaro devi prītyā tava saṃjagau veṇunā devakīnaṃdanaḥ ||11|| pārijātaṃ samuddhṛtya rādhāvaro ropayāmāsa bhāmābhayādaṃgaṇe || vallavīvṛndavṛndārikākāmukaḥ saṃjagau veṇunā devakīnaṃdanaḥ ||12|| ṛkṣarājaṃ vinirjitya nītvā maṇiṃ saṃdadau bhītavadbhūmināthāya ca || so'pi rāse samāgatya rāseśvaro saṃjagau veṇunā devakīnaṃdanaḥ ||13|| garga uvāca iti śrutvā rādhikā tu mahimāṃ veṇūvādinaḥ || prasannā hi samutthāya parirebhe priyaṃ priyā ||14|| vṛndāvaneśo goviṃdo reme vṛndāvane vane || vṛndāvananivāsinyā paśyanvṛndāvanadrumān ||15|| tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ ca jagṛhuḥ sarvato vrajayoṣitaḥ || varṣākāle nṛpaśreṣṭha saudāminyo yathā ghanam ||16|| yāvatīstatra gopyaśca tāvadrūpadharo hariḥ || yamunāpulinaṃ rājam̐stābhiḥ sākaṃ samāyayau ||17|| babhūvurmuditā nāryo yathā ca śrutayaḥ purā || svavastraiḥ kṛṣṇacandrāya hyāsanaṃ tā acīklṛpan ||18|| śrīrādhāramaṇastasminnāsane saha rādhayā || niṣasāda hyaho rājaṃstābhirbhaktyā vaśīkṛtaḥ || 19|| goloke yādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa tādṛśam || gopīnāṃ rādhayā sārddhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ trailokyamohanam ||20|| dṛṣṭvā gokulacandrasya surūpaṃ paramādbhutam || svātmānaṃ nāvidangopyo brahmānandena nirvṛtāḥ ||21|| sthale kṛtvā vihāraṃ tu viveśa yamunājalam || tābhīrbhaktyā vaśībhūto gopībhiḥ saha rādhayā ||22|| vārāṃ vihāraṃ bhagavānstrībhiḥ sārddhaṃ cakāra ha || mandākinyāṃ yathā śakro hyapsarobhirvṛto divi ||23|| mādhavo mādhavīṃ rājan mādhavī mādhavaṃ jale || anyonyaṃ tau siṣicatuḥ salile salilaistvaram ||24|| kabarīkeśapāśābhyāṃ pracyutaiḥ kusumairbabhau || yamunācitravarṇaiśca yathoṣṇiṅmudritā nṛpa ||25|| rā vidyādharyo devapatnyaḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire || praślathadvastranīvyastā mohaṃ prāptāḥ smarāturāḥ ||26|| atha kṛṣṇo vārilīlāṃ kṛtvā vai līlayā yutaḥ || jalānniṣkramya rājeṃdra giriṃ govardhanaṃ yayau ||27|| anujagmurgopikāstaṃ sahacaryo nṛpeśvara || kāścidvyajanahastāśca kāściccāmaravāhakāḥ ||28|| kāścittāṃbūlahastāśca kāściddarpaṇavāhakāḥ || kāścidbhūṣaṇahastāśca kāścitkusumavāhakāḥ ||29|| kāściccaṃdanahastāśca kāścidbhājanavāhakāḥ || kāścidyāvakahastāśca kāścidaṃbaravāhakāḥ ||30|| kāścinmṛdaṃgahastāśca kāścitkāṃsyadharāśca vai || murayaṣṭidharāḥ kāścitkāścidvīṇādharāḥ parāḥ ||31|| karatālakarāḥ kāścitkāścidgānaparāyaṇāḥ || ṣaṭtriṃśadrāgarāgiṇyo vrajastrīrūpadhārakāḥ ||32|| golokādbhārate pūrvamāgatā rādhayā saha || jagustā nanṛtustatra śrīrādheśvarasannidhau ||33|| nanarta madhye tāsāṃ ca kṛṣṇo madanamohanaḥ || pragāyanveṇunā gītaṃ trilokīṃ mohayanhariḥ ||34|| vāditraiḥ kiṃkiṇībhiśca valayanūpurakaṃkaṇaiḥ || gītairmiśritaśabdo'bhūttumulo rāsamaṃḍale ||35|| devāśca devapatnyaśca rāsaṃ dṛṣṭvā harerapi || babhūvarmūrcchitā rājangagane smarapīḍitāḥ ||36|| caṃdrikāyāṃ tu candrasya caturaścaṃcalaścalan || caṃdrāvalyā babhau caiva ghanaścaṃcala eva ca ||37|| rādhāyāstatra śṛṅgāraṃ sragbhiryāvakakajjalaiḥ || cakre kamalapatrādyairgirau giridharo mahān ||38|| kuṃkumāgurukastūrīcandanādyaiśca rādhikā || cakre kamalapatraṃ vai śrīkṛṣṇasyānane varam ||39|| tataśca sasmitā rādhā sasmitaṃ bhagavanmukham || paśyantī nāgavallyāśca bīṭakaṃ pradadau mudā ||40|| priyāpradattaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ bubhuje naṃdanaṃdanaḥ || kṛṣṇadattaṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ cakhāda radhikā mudā ||41|| kṛṣṇacarvitatāṃbūlaṃ nītvā rādhā balātpunaḥ || jaghāsa bhaktyā sā śīghraṃ satī patiparāyaṇā ||42|| priyācarvitatāṃbūlaṃ yayāce bhagavānhariḥ || rādhā dadau na taṃ bhītā papāta tatpadāṃbuje ||43|| padmā padmāvatī naṃdī ānandī sukhadāyinī || caṃdrāvalī caṃdrakalā vaṃdyā hyetā haripriyāḥ ||44|| vṛndāvane haristābhirvasaṃtartuprapūrite || nānāprakāraṃ śṛṅgāraṃ sa cakāra manojavat ||45|| kāścitpibaṃti gopyastu śrīkṛṣṇasyādharāmṛtam || kāścidvāliṃganaṃ cakruḥ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ ||46|| tataḥ kṛṣṇastu bhagavāngopīnāṃ kucakuṃkumaiḥ || suvarṇavarṇo bhūtvā vai reje madanamohanaḥ ||47|| punargopījanaiḥ sārddhaṃ śrīgopījanavallabhaḥ || rāsaṃ cakāra rājeṃdra sundare kadalīvane ||48|| evaṃ hemantarajanī gopīnāṃ rāsamaṇḍale || vyatītā kṣaṇavadrājannityānaṃdena tatra vai ||49|| atha naṃdasya sadanaṃ rāsaṃ kṛtvā yayau hariḥ || vṛṣabhānupuraṃ rādhā tathā gopyo gṛhānyayuḥ ||50|| na jānaṃti vraje gopā rāsavārtāṃ harerapi || svānsvāndārānsvapārśvasthānmanyamānā nṛpeśvara ||51|| idaṃ śṛṅgāracaritaṃ rādhāmādhavayoḥ param || ye paṭhaṃti ca śṛṇvanti te vrajiṣyaṃti cākṣaram ||52|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe rāsakrīḍāsaṃpūrtirnāma ṣaṭcatvāriśo'dhyāyaḥ ||46|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.47> garga uvāca idaṃ kṛṣṇsya caritaṃ guptaṃ śāstreṣu varṇitam || mayā tavāgre rājeṃdra athānyacchṛṇu vistarāt ||1|| evaṃ sthitvā dinānyaṣṭau śrīkṛṣṇo naṃdapattane || ānaṃdaṃ pradadannṝṇāṃ punargantuṃ mano dadhe ||2|| yaśomatī kṛṣṇamātā prāṇebhyo'pi priyaṃ sutam || gantumabhyuditaṃ dṛṣṭvā rurodoccairyathā purā ||3|| rurudustatra gopyaśca bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇāḥ || smaraṃtyaḥ pūrvaduḥkhāni gehe gehe nṛpeśvara ||4|| yāvatyo vrajanāryaśca tāvadrūpadharo hariḥ || pṛthagāśvāsayāmāsa tathā rādhāṃ sa kovidaḥ ||5|| mātaraṃ prāha bhagavānmātaḥ śokaṃ tu mā kuru || śīghramatrāgamiṣyāmi kārayitvā kratūttamam ||6|| tvaṃ na manyase cenmātarnityaṃ drakṣasi cāṃtike || putrarūpaṃ ca māṃ bhaktyā kṛtāṃtabhayabhañjanam ||7|| evaṃ tāṃ tu samāśvāsya niṣkramya sadanāddhariḥ || gopairyukto'śrupūrṇākṣaḥ pautrasenāṃ jagāma ha ||8|| gatvāniruddhasenāyāṃ yādavānhayamocane || dadāvājñāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha sākṣānnārāyaṇo hariḥ ||9|| noditaḥ kṛṣṇacandreṇa hayaṃ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ || punurmumoca tatpautro vijayārthe hi pūrvavat ||10|| yādavāścāniruddhādyā naṃdaṃ natvāśrupūritāḥ || gaṃtumāruruhuḥ sarve vāhanāni ca kṛcchrataḥ ||11|| kṛṣṇākārānkṛṣṇaputrānkṛṣṇapautrām̐śca sundarān || gaṃtumabhyuditānsarvānkṛṣṇena sahitānyadūn ||12|| dṛṣṭvā te rurudurgopā goviṃdavirahāturāḥ || smaraṃtaḥ pūrvaduḥkhāni śuṣkakaṃṭhauṣṭhatālukāḥ ||13|| ruroda naṃdarājo'pi bāṣpavyākulalocanaḥ || na kiṃcidūce duḥkhārto mukhena pariśuṣyatā ||14|| sarvānāśvāsayāmāsa kṛṣṇo'pyaśrupariplutaḥ || āyāsya iti vākyaiśca militvā tu pṛthakpṛthak ||15|| caitramāse yadā yajño dvārakāyāṃ bhaviṣyati || āhvayiṣyāmi gopālā yuṣmānsarvānna saṃśayaḥ ||16|| gopālā gokule nityaṃ gopālaṃ māṃ hi drakṣyatha || tasmānnivāsaṃ kuruta atraiva vrajamaṇḍale ||17|| evamāśvāsya tairdattaṃ pāribarhaṃ pragṛhya ca || naṃdaṃ natvā rathe sthitvā prāyādvṛṣṇivarairhariḥ ||18|| nandādyā duḥkhitā gopāḥ kṛṣṇasya caraṇāṃbuje || kṣiptaṃ manaḥ punarhartumanīśā gokulaṃ yayuḥ ||19|| gopā gopyāśca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ premamagnāśca nityaśaḥ || samīpe nṛpa paśyaṃti yogināmapi durlabham ||20|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe vrajādanyatra gamanaṃ nāma saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||47|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.48> śrīgarga uvāca kṛṣṇāṃ samuttīrya tataḥ prapaśyañjagāma vājī kurupattanañca || karoti rājyaṃ nṛpacakravartī vaicitravīryo balavānhi yatra ||1|| tato dadarśa turagaḥ kauravāṇāṃ puraṃ varam || taṃ nānopavanairyuktaṃ taḍāgaiśca sarovaraiḥ ||2|| durgeṇa gaṃgayā yuktaṃ tathā parikhayā nṛpa || suvarṇaraupyasadanairmahāśūrajanairvṛtam ||3|| suyodhanasya purādvinirgato haṃtuṃ mṛgānvai vanagocarānnṛpa || dadarśa yajñasya hayaṃ sapatrakaṃ rathasthito vīrajanairvibhūṣitaḥ ||4|| dṛṣṭvā turaṃgamaṃ prītaḥ svarathādavatīrya ca || mānī duryodhano rājaṃstvaraṃ jagrāha līlayā ||5|| karṇabhīṣmakṛpadroṇabhūriduḥśāsanādibhiḥ || yuktastadbhālapatraṃ ca vācayāmāsa harṣitaḥ ||6|| caṃdravaṃśe yadukula ugraseno virājate || indrādayaḥ suragaṇā yasyādeśānuvartinaḥ ||7|| sahāyo yasya bhagavāñchrīkṛṣṇo bhaktapālakaḥ || asti vai dvārakāpuryāṃ tadbhaktyā nivasanhariḥ ||8|| tadvākyāddhayamedhaṃ sa ugraseno nṛpeśvaraḥ || cakravartī haṭhādyajñaṃ svayaśo'rthe karoti hi ||9|| mocitastena turago hayānāṃ pravaraḥ śubhaḥ || tadrakṣakaḥ kṛṣṇapautro'niruddho vṛkadaityahā ||10|| gajāśvarathavīrāṇāṃ senāsaṃghasamanvitaḥ || rājāno ye kariṣyaṃti rājyaṃ kau śūramāninaḥ ||11|| te gṛhṇaṃtu yajñahayaṃ svabalātpatraśobhitam || taṃ mocayati dharmātmā gṛhītaṃ ca hayaṃ nṛpaiḥ ||12|| svabāhubalavīryeṇāniruddho līlayā haṭhāt || tasyānyathā ca pādayoḥ patitvā yāṃtu dhanvinaḥ ||13|| garga uvāca tatpatraṃ vācayitvaivaṃ kauravāste tu śatravaḥ || ūcuḥ parasparaṃ kruddhā mānino raktalocanāḥ ||14|| kauravā ūcuḥ aho kiṃ likhitaṃ dhṛṣṭairbhālapatre hayasya ca || na saṃti kiṃ hi rājāno yādavānāṃ ca saṃmukhe ||15|| rājasūye purāsmābhiryādavā ye vinirjitāḥ || hayamedhaṃ kariṣyaṃti punaste gatabuddhayaḥ ||16|| tasmātsarvānvijeṣyāmo na dāsyāmasturaṃgamam || paścādvayaṃ kariṣyāmo hayamedhaṃ kratūttamam ||17|| ka ugrasenaḥ kaḥ kṛṣṇo hayarakṣākarastu kaḥ || yādavaiḥ sahitā hyete kiṃ kariṣyaṃti pauruṣam ||18|| kṛṣṇādyā yādavāḥ sarve vihāya mathurāṃ purīm || gatāḥ samudraṃ śaraṇaṃ yuddhaṃ tyaktvā bhayācca naḥ ||19|| rājyaṃ dattaṃ purā hyeṣāmasmābhiśca kṛpānvitaiḥ || kṛtaghnāste ca manyaṃte svātmānaṃ cakravartinam ||20|| pāṃḍavānāṃ ca sammānādyādavā na hi māritāḥ || niṣkāsitāśca te'smābhiḥ pāṃḍavāḥ śatravaḥ kila ||21|| yadūnadya vinirjitya saṃgrāme ca palāyitān || darśayāmaścāhukāya sahasā cakravartitām ||22|| evaṃ śrīkṛṣṇavimukhā vācaḥ sarve vadaṃti hi || tṛptāste kauravā rājañchriyā rājavibhūtibhiḥ ||23|| tataśca jagṛhuḥ sarve nānāśastrāṇi vegataḥ || hayaṃ praveśayāmāsuḥ pure tatra tu saṃsthitāḥ ||24|| gate ca turage dūraṃ sāṃbaḥ kṛṣṇena noditaḥ || tvaraṃ kṛṣṇāṃ samuttīrya gaṃbhīrāṃ mārgadāyinīm ||25|| akṣauhiṇībhirdaśabhiḥ pṛṣṭhato daṃśito ruṣā || hastināpuramakrūrayuyudhānādibhiryayau ||26|| evaṃ te yādavāḥ sarve hastināpurasannidhau || āyātā hayahartṝṃśca kauravāndadṛśuḥ sthitān ||27|| ūcuste vīkṣya balino lokadvayajigīṣavaḥ || tānsarvāṃśca tṛṇīkṛtya yādavāḥ kṛṣṇadevatāḥ ||28|| aho babaṃdha kaścāśvaṃ kasya hṛṣṭaḥ kṛtāṃtarāṭ || prāpsyate kastu saṃgrāme nārācaiḥ paramāṃ vyathām ||29|| aho vai kiṃ na jānaṃti vṛṣṇīndraṃ cakravartinam || ugrasenaṃ rājarājaṃ devadānavavaṃditam ||30|| rājasūyasya karttāramadvitīyaṃ nṛpeśvaram || nṛpāḥ svātmavināśāya gṛhṇaṃti turagaṃ tataḥ ||31|| hemāṃgadaśceṃdranīlo bako bhīṣaṇa eva ca || balvalaśca nṛpāḥ sarve raṇe'smābhirvinirjitāḥ ||32|| iti śrutvā kauravāste krodhaprasphuritādharāḥ || pratyūcustānhi paśyaṃtastiraścīnaiśca cakṣubhiḥ ||33|| kauravānugā ūcuḥ gṛhītasturago'smābhiryūyaṃ kiṃ nu kariṣyatha || yuṣmānsarvānnayiṣyāmaḥ sāyakairyamasādanam ||34|| ugrasenaḥ katidinai rājyaṃ labdhvā tu kṛṣṇataḥ || mānaṃ karoti taṃ baddhvā rājyaṃ kurmo vayaṃ kila ||35|| aniruddhastu kutrāste hyasmākaṃ ca bhayādgataḥ || vadatainaṃ śarairyuddhe pūjayāmo na saṃśayaḥ ||36|| garga uvāca iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā yādavāḥ krodhamūrcchitāḥ || cikṣipuḥ sāyakāṃścāpaiḥ kauravāṇāṃ mukheṣu ca || 37|| kecidbabhūvurbāṇaiśca chinnajihvāśca kauravāḥ || bhagnadaṃtāśchinnamukhā vamaṃto rudhiraṃ bahu ||38|| duryodhanaṃ chinnamukhā nihatāste yayurdrutam || pṛṣṭāste kathayāmāsuryādavaiḥ prakṛtaṃ ca tat || 39|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe kauravaiḥ śyāmakarṇagrahaṇaṃ nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||48|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.49> duryodhanaḥ svavīrāṇāṃ bhīṣmadroṇakṛpādibhiḥ || dṛṣṭvā mukhāni bhagnāni kopaṃ kṛtvedamabravīt ||1|| aho vai yādavāstucchā āgatā mṛtyusaṃmukhe || kiṃ na jānaṃti te mūḍhā dhṛtarāṣṭrabalaṃ mahat ||2|| ityuktvā preṣayāmāsuḥ svāṃ senāṃ caturaṃgiṇīm || gajāśvarathavīraiśca yuktāṃ yuddhe ca yādavān ||3|| sā cacāla mahāsenā kaṃpayaṃtī mahītalam || akṣauhiṇībhirdaśabhistrāsayaṃtī balādripūn ||4|| āyāṃtīṃ tāṃ tato dṛṣṭvā sāṃbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ || svāṃ senāṃ nodayāmāsa harṣādvīrairvibhūṣitaḥ ||5|| tataśca kauravāḥ sarve rakṣaṇārthaṃ tu svātmanaḥ || krauṃcavyūhaṃ vinirmāya tatra sarve hi saṃsthitāḥ ||6|| āsīttasya mukhe bhīṣmo grīvāyāṃ droṇa eva ca || pakṣayoḥ karṇaśakunī tasya pucche suyodhanaḥ ||7|| madhye tasya mahāsenā caturaṃgabalairyutā || kṛtaṃ hi dadṛśurvyūhaṃ krauñcaṃ vai śatrudurjayam ||8|| krauṃcavyūhaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā yadavo yuddhaśaṃkitāḥ || ūcurhe sāṃba tvamapi kuru vyūhaṃ prayatnataḥ ||9|| iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā sāṃbaḥ saṃgrāmakovidaḥ || na cakāra raṇe vyūhaṃ kauravānagaṇayya ca || 10|| yuddhaṃ kartuṃ pracalite te dve sene yadā nṛpa || tadā muhūrtaparyaṃtaṃ cakaṃpe vasudhā bhṛśam ||11|| jaghnurbheryyaśca śaṃkhāśca hyubhayoḥ senayostadā || ṭaṃkārāścaiva cāpānāṃ śrūyaṃte tatra tatra ha ||12|| garjanti dantinastatra hayā heṣaṃti tatra ha || śabdaṃ śūrāḥ prakurvaṃti naṃdaṃti rathanemayaḥ ||13|| sainyapādarajobhiśca hyaṃdhakāro'bhavadraṇe || malinaṃ gaganaṃ bhūtvā sūryastatra na dṛśyate ||14|| ubhayoḥ senayoryuddhaṃ tataḥ samabhavadbhṛśam || bāṇairgadābhiḥ parighaiḥ śataghnībhiśca śaktibhiḥ ||15|| parasparaṃ te yuyudhurāhave niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ || gajā gajai rathā rathairhayā hayairnarā naraiḥ ||16|| śarāṃdhakāre saṃjāte sāṃbo bāṇairdhanurddharaḥ || raṇe bhīṣmeṇa yuyudhe'krūraḥ karṇena tatra ca || 17|| yuyudhānaḥ śakuninā droṇācāryeṇa sāraṇaḥ || duryodhanena saṃgrāme sātyakiḥ śīghrameva ca ||18|| balī duḥśāsanenāpi kṛtavarmā tu bhūriṇā || evaṃ parasparaṃ hyāsītsaṃgrāmo bhayakārakaḥ ||19|| tataḥ sāṃbastu saṃkruddhaḥ sajjaṃ kṛtvā dhanurdṛḍham || ṭaṃkārayāmāsa tadā śūrāṇāṃ kampayanhṛdi ||20|| śrīkṛṣṇaṃ prathamaṃ natvā mumuce sāyakāndaśa || tānāgatāñcharānbhīṣmaściccheda svaśarairapi ||21|| raṇe sāṃbaḥ punastasya kavace sāyakāndaśa || nicakhāna svarṇamayānnādaṃ kṛtvā tu siṃhavat ||22|| caturbhiḥ sāyakaistasya nijaghne caturo hayān || ciccheda bāṇairdaśabhistatkodaṃḍaṃ guṇānvitam ||23|| sa chinnadhanvā viratho hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ || utthāya bhīṣmaḥ sahasā gadāṃ jagrāha roṣataḥ || 24|| sāṃbaḥ prāha tvayā sārddhaṃ kathaṃ yuddhaṃ karomyaham || padātinā rathaṃ cānyaṃ tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi saṃyuge ||25|| saśastraṃ syaṃdanaṃ yuddhe tvaṃ gṛhāṇa kurūdvaha || jaya māṃ nistrapaṃ mūḍhaṃ vṛddhastvaṃ pujya eva ca ||26|| sa uvāca tataḥ sāmbaṃ krodhātprasphuritādharaḥ || daṃtāndatairlihannoṣṭhaṃ jihvayā raktalocanaḥ ||27||| tvaddatte syaṃdane sthitvā yadā yuddhaṃ karomyaham || tadā bhavati me'kirtiḥ pāpaṃ nirayameva ca ||28|| pratigrahaparā viprā dātāraśca vayaṃ smṛtāḥ || dattaṃ rājyaṃ yadubhyaśca purāsmābhiḥ kṛpālubhiḥ ||29|| śrutvā tadvacanaṃ sāṃbaḥ pratyuvāca ruṣānvitaḥ || bhayādrājyaṃ pradāsyaṃti rājāno maṃḍaleśvarāḥ ||30|| nirīkṣya bhūmau śāstāraṃ saṃsthitaṃ cakravartinam || ityevaṃ vākyamākarṇya bhīṣmaḥ śūraśiromaṇiḥ || 31|| jaghāna gadayā gurvyā sāṃbavakṣasthale nṛpa || gadāprahāravyathitaḥ sāṃbaḥ saṃmūrcchito'bhavat ||32|| sārathistaṃ rathe kṛtvāpovāha śaṃkito raṇāt || kolāhalastadaivāsīdyadusainye nṛpeśvara || 33|| bhīṣmo'nyaṃ rathamāruhya daṃśitaḥ saśarāsanaḥ || yayau suyodhanaṃ śīghraṃ yādavānmārayanpathi ||34|| saṃgrāme tatra rājendra sātyakiśca suyodhanam || cakre bāṇaiśca virathaṃ gṛdhapakṣaiḥ sphuratprabhaiḥ ||35|| viratho'pi rathaṃ cānyaṃ sa samāruhya vegataḥ || taṃ śatruṃ virathaṃ cakre śarairāśīviṣopamaiḥ ||36|| sa cānyaṃ rathamāruhya sātyakiḥ śīghravikramaḥ || bāṇenaikena tadyānaṃ cikṣepa nṛpa yojanam ||37|| rathaḥ papāta bhūmadhye sasūtaḥ saturaṃgamaḥ || aṃgāravadviśīrṇo'bhūnmūrcchito'bhūtsuyodhanaḥ ||38|| tadā droṇastu saṃkruddho bāṇenāgnimayena ca || jaghāna sātyakiṃ yuddhe svaśatruṃ tu vihāya vai ||39|| rathastu tasya dagdho'bhūtsaturaṃgaḥ sasārathiḥ || abhavanmūrcchitaḥ so'pi dagdhāṃgo bāṇajvālayā ||40|| kṛtavarmā tataḥ kruddho bhūriṃ jitvā raṇāṃgaṇe || ājagāma nadan rājandroṇopari ruṣānvitaḥ ||41|| sa gatvā pradhane roṣāddroṇācāryaṃ śarairapi || cakre padātinaṃ vīro niḥśastraṃ chinnakaṃcukam ||42|| tataḥ karṇastu saṃkruddhastyaktvākrūraṃ raṇāṃgaṇe || tatāḍa kṛtavarmāṇaṃ śaktyā śaktīva tārakam ||43|| sā śaktistattanuṃ bhitvā viveśa dharaṇītale || nirbhinnahṛdayo bhūtvā kṛtavarmā papāta ha ||44|| yuyudhānastataḥ kopānnirjitya śakuniṃ mṛdhe || karṇasyopari rājendra hyājagāma rathena ca ||45|| gatvā śarāsanenāpi mumuce sāyakāndaśa || vīkṣya tānāgatānkarṇo nijaghāna svasāyakaiḥ ||46|| saṃghṛṣṭāstatra saṃgrāme tayorbāṇāḥ parasparam || visphuliṃgānkṣaraṃtaste bhramante'lātacakravat ||47|| yuyudhānastataḥ kopātkarṇasya jagatīpate || jaghāna kavace bāṇānkākapakṣayutāñchitān ||48|| te śarāḥ karṇakavace na lagnāḥ patitā bhuvi || rājanpāpasya kartāro na svarge niraye yathā ||49|| tataḥ prahasya karṇastu yuyudhānaṃ ca vismitam || cakāra virathaṃ yuddhe śarairnānāstrayojitaiḥ ||50|| duḥśāsanaṃ baliṃ caiva kṛtvā yuddhe vimūrcchitam || āyayau saṃyuge karṇaṃ rathenānalavarcasā ||51|| āgataṃ balinaṃ dṛṣṭvā karṇo bhāskaranaṃdanaḥ || pavanāstreṇa bāṇena taṃ cikṣepa savāhanam ||52|| papāta yojane so'pi sāṃbastatrāgamatpunaḥ || aṃdhakāraṃ śaraiḥ kurvankauravānmārayan ruṣā ||53|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe yadukurusaṃgrāmavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||49|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.50> garga uvāca tadaiva vṛṣṇayaḥ sarve bhojavṛṣṇyaṃdhakādayaḥ || māthurā śūrasenādyāḥ samuttīrya yamasvasām ||1|| rajobhiśca nabho vyāptaṃ kurvaṃtaśca mahītalam || cālayaṃtaśca balino mahāsaṃgrāmakarkaśāḥ ||2|| vilokayaṃtasturagaṃ sarvataste mahābalāḥ || ājagmuścāniruddhādyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇādyā nṛpeśvara ||3|| vṛṣṇayastatra yuddhasya mahāghoṣaṃ bhayaṃkaram || śarāsanānāṃ ṭaṃkāraṃ śataghnīnāṃ ravaṃ tathā ||4|| śūrāṇāṃ garjanaṃ caiva śastrāṇāṃ caṭcaṭaṃ tathā || kolāhalaṃ ca hākāraṃ śrutvā te vismayaṃ yayuḥ ||5|| matvā te yuddhamāsīdvai yādavānāṃ ca kauravaiḥ || śaṃkitā aniruddhādyāḥ kṛṣṇādyā āyayurdrutam ||6|| śrīkṛṣṇamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvāniruddhādyaiḥ samanvitam || sasainyaṃ ca sahāyārthaṃ nemuḥ sāṃbādayo nṛpa ||7|| kṛṣṇe samāgate nedurbheryyaḥ śaṃkhāśca gomukhāḥ || puṣpavarṣaṃ jayārāvaṃ devāścakruśca yādavāḥ ||8|| dṛṣṭvāniruddhaṃ pradhane samāgataṃ hyakṣauhiṇībhiḥ śatabhiḥ samanvitam || pracālayaṃtaṃ vasudhāṃ mahābalaṃ vidudruvuste tu bhayācca kauravāḥ ||9|| pralayābdhisamaṃ sainyamaṃdhakānāṃ vilokya ca || bhītāśca dudruvurvaiśyā gehe gehe kṛtārgalāḥ ||10|| brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā vṛṣalāḥ strījanāstathā || duryodhanaṃ śapaṃtaśca rurudurnirgatā gṛhāt ||11|| tato vihāya mūrcchāṃ vai mṛdhe duḥśāsanāgrajaḥ || sadyaḥ supta ivottasthau yadusainyaṃ dadarśa ha ||12|| dṛṣṭvā bhayaṃkarāṃ senāṃ yādavānāṃ suyodhanaḥ || svapuraṃ śaṃkito bhūtvā padbhyāṃ bhītastvaraṃ yayau ||13|| karṇabhīṣmakṛpadroṇabhūriduryodhanādayaḥ || sabhāyāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ vai natvā sarvamavarṇayan ||14|| svānāṃ parājayaṃ śrutvā yādavānāṃ jayaṃ tathā || kṛṣṇasyāgamanaṃ caiva nṛpo viduramabravīt ||15|| dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca akṣauhiṇīśatayute vāsudeve samāgate || kupite'dya vayaṃ vīra kariṣyāmaśca kiṃ vada ||16|| nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya viduro'bravīt || vidura uvāca purā rāmeṇa caikena kupitena gajāhvayam ||17|| vikarṣitaṃ ca gaṃgāyāṃ tasya bhrātā hi cāgataḥ || hṛtkaṃjakośāddevakyāṃ jāto yaḥ sa harirnṛpa ||18|| yena vai saṃyuge rājankaṃsādyāḥ śakunādayaḥ || māritā bahavo daityā nirjitāśca nṛpāḥ surāḥ ||19|| tasmādyuddhasya samayo nāsti rājanvilokaya || kaurave śyāmakarṇaṃ tu kṛṣṇāya dātumarhasi ||20|| mābhūtkurūṇāṃ vṛṣṇīnāṃ kalaho nāśakārakaḥ || evaṃ rājā bodhitastu vidureṇānujena vai ||21|| uvāca kauravānprājño deśakālocitaṃ vacaḥ || dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca gatvā kṛṣṇasya nikaṭe turagaṃ dātumarhatha ||22|| saṃmukhe devadevasya yuddhaṃ kartuṃ ca nārhatha || yādavānāṃ sahāyārthamāgataṃ kupitaṃ harim ||23|| yūyaṃ prasannaṃ kuruta gatvā tannikaṭaṃ śanaiḥ || kauraveṃdrasya vacanaṃ kauravāste niśamya ca ||24|| vividhānupacārāṃśca gaṃdhākṣatayutānkila || gṛhītvā divyavastrāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca ||25|| vadaṃtaḥ puṇyanāmāni rāmakeśavayormudā || padbhirviniryayuḥ sarve kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ bhayānvitāḥ ||26|| āgatānkauravāndṛṣṭvā yādavāḥ krodhapūritāḥ || nānāśastrāṇi jagṛhustatra yuddhāya vegataḥ ||27|| ūcustānkauravāḥ sarve vayaṃ yuddhāya nāgatāḥ || kariṣyāmaśca kṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ duḥkhanāśanam ||28|| iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā yādavā vismayaṃ gatāḥ || kṛṣṇāya kathayāmāsuḥ kauravāṇāṃ viceṣṭitam ||29|| tataḥ kṛṣṇasya vacasā kauravānyadusattamāḥ || āhvayāmāsuste prītā niḥśastrānāgatānnṛpa ||30|| āhūtāste tu hariṇā gatvā śrīkṛṣṇasannidhau || lajjayāvāṅmukhāḥ sarve praṇamyocuḥ pṛthakpṛthak ||31|| pūrvaṃ droṇa uvācātha kṛṣṇabhadra jagatpate || rakṣa māṃ kauravān rakṣa māyayā tava mohitān ||32|| kṛpācārya uvāca majjanmanaḥ phalamidaṃ madhukaiṭabhāre matprārthanīyamadanugraha eṣa eva || tvadbhṛtyabhṛtyaparicārakabhṛtyabhṛtya bhṛtyasya bhṛtya iti māṃ smara lokanātha ||33|| karṇa uvāca bhaktasyārthe dhanaṃ kṣīṇaṃ svadāragatayauvanam || svāmikārye gatāḥ prāṇā aṃte tiṣṭhaṃtu mādhava ||34|| bhūriruvāca yācāmahe varada kiṃcidananyalabhyaṃ nātha prasīda sumukhī yadi divyadṛṣṭiḥ || asmābhiraṃjalirayaṃ vivaśairnibaddha eṣaiva me bhavatu deva bhavāṃtare'pi ||35|| duryodhana uvāca jānāmi dharmaṃ na ca me pravṛttirjānāmi pāpaṃ na ca me nivṛttiḥ || kenāpi devena hṛdi sthitena yathā niyukto'smi tathā karomi ||36|| yaṃtrasya guṇadoṣeṇa kṣamyatāṃ madhusūdana || ahaṃ yantro bhavānyaṃtrī mama doṣo na dīyatām ||37|| bhīṣma uvāca rāgāṃdhagopījanacuṃbitābhyāṃ yogīndrabhogīṃdraniveśitābhyām || ātāmrapaṃkeruhakomalābhyāṃ cābhyāṃ padābhyāmayañjalirme ||38|| vidura uvāca āsteti vikrayakṛtāṃ sukṛtāni tāni ye brahmabālamiva tatparipālayaṃti || yaddaityadevamunibhirmanasāpyagamyaṃ yanneti neti ca vadanna hi veda vedaḥ ||39|| śrīgarga uvāca evaṃ saṃprārthitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kauravaiḥ śaraṇāgataiḥ || prītaḥ pratyāha tān rājanmeghanirhādayā girā ||40|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca āryā śṛṇuta madvākyamahamāgatavān yataḥ || yuddhaṃ vārayituṃ cātra nāradena praṇoditaḥ ||41|| na manyante mamājñāṃ vai matputrāśca niraṃkuśāḥ || dīrghāṇāṃ ca prakurvaṃti hyaparādhaṃ ca dūṣaṇam ||42|| yūyaṃ dhanyāśca mānyāśca milanārthaṃ samāgatāḥ || matputraiśca kṛtaṃ yadvai tatsarvaṃ kṣantumarhatha ||43|| ugrasenahayaṃ vīrāḥ kṛpayā ca vimucyatām || pālanārthaṃ tu tasyāpi yūyaṃ gacchata gacchata ||44|| yādavāḥ kauravā mitrāḥ kalahaṃ tu parasparam || prakartuṃ naiva cārhanti pūrvaprema vilokya ca ||45|| evaṃ te kṛṣṇadevena miṣṭavākyaiśca toṣitāḥ || turagaṃ ca daduḥ prītāḥ pāribarheṇa saṃyutam ||46|| datvā turaṃgamaṃ sarve kauravāḥ khinnamānasāḥ || svapuraṃ viviśū rājanbhīṣmo gantuṃ mano dadhe ||47|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe hastināpuravijayo nāma paṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||50|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.51> garga uvāca atha kṛṣṇastu bhagavānyādavānāṃ ca pālanam || kṛtvā militvā prayayau rathenāpi kuśasthalīm ||1|| kṛṣṇe gate'niruddhastu hayaṃ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ || baṃdhanānmocayāmāsa vijayārthe nṛpeśvara ||2|| muktasturaṃgaḥ prayayau deśāndeśānvilokayan || pṛṣṭhatastasya rājeṃdra tvaraṃ jagmuśca vṛṣṇayaḥ ||3|| duryodhanaṃ jitaṃ śrutvā bhūpāstu taṃ turaṃgamam || prāptaṃ na jagṛhū rāṣṭre kṛṣṇasya balino bhayāt ||4|| athāvrajatturaṃgo'yaṃ śṛṇvanpaśyannitastataḥ || saṃprāpto'bhūddvaitavane yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ||5|| bhrātṛbhirbhāryayā sārddhaṃ vanavāsaṃ karoti hi || tasminvane bhīmaseno vanadvīpagaṇaiḥ saha ||6|| nityaṃ karoti krīḍāṃ vai bālaḥ krīḍanakairiva || dadarśa turagaṃ tatra taṃ vanaṃ gahvaraṃ mahat ||7|| nyagrodhāśvatthabilvaiśca kharjūrapanasaistathā || bakulaiḥ saptaparṇaiśca tiṃdukaistilakairapi ||8|| śālaistālaistamālaiśca badarīlodhrapāṭalaiḥ || babbūraśālmalīveṇūpalāśādibhīranvitam ||9|| āgataṃ ghoṭakaṃ dṛṣṭvā durjare nirjane vane || varāhamṛgaśārdūlavṛkasarpagaṇairyute ||10|| jhillījhaṃkārasaṃyukte gṛdhracillādibhiryute || vṛte tathā bhujaṃgaiśca valmīkādarddhaniḥsṛtaiḥ ||11|| śṛgālamarkamahiṣagavayādibhiranvite || nīlagogajabhallūkamārjārairvanamānuṣaiḥ || 12|| yukte bhayaṃkare rājanbhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ || aśvaṃ jagrāha keśeṣu sapatraṃ nṛpa līlayā ||13|| kenotsṛṣṭaṃ vadanvākyaṃ svāśramaṃ prayayau śanaiḥ || tadaiva cāniruddhādyā ājagmuḥ sarvayādavāḥ ||14|| paśyaṃto yajñagandharvamaraṇye nṛpa kṛcchrataḥ || dṛṣṭvā gṛhītaṃ turagamūcuste tu parasparam ||15|| aho vanacaro hyeṣa dṛśyate bhīmasenavat || bṛhadbāhurmahāpuṣṭo mahocco raktalocanaḥ ||16|| mahāgauraḥ kṛcchradharo dhūlilipto gadādharaḥ || itthaṃ bruvaṃtaste sarve punarūcuśca taṃ janam ||17|| kastvaṃ śrīrājarājanyahayaṃ nītvā kva yāsyasi || tasmānmocaya śīghraṃ tvāṃ na ceddhanmo śilīmukhaiḥ ||18|| iti tadvākyamākarṇya hayaṃ baddhvā ca gahvare || jagāma svagadāṃ gurvīṃ bhārāyutasamanvitām ||19|| tayā jaghāna saṃgrāme yādavānbhīmavikramaḥ || nipeturvṛṣṇayastatra bhīmena nihatāśca ye ||20|| aniruddhastataḥ kruddho dṛṣṭvā tasya parākramam || sahasravāraṇānmattānnodayāmāsa śatrave ||21|| tataḥ sadiggajaiḥ so'pi bhūbhṛcchikharasannibhaiḥ || pātito dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe viṣāṇairavapīḍyate ||22|| tato bhīmaḥ samutthāya krodhatprasphuritādharaḥ || mattāngajāñjaghānātha gadayā vajrakalpayā ||23|| kāṃściccikṣepa gagane kām̐ścidbhūmau vyapothayat || kām̐ścinmamarda pādābhyāṃ gajānkām̐ścidgajeṣu ca ||24|| tataśca dudruvuḥ sarve vāraṇā bhayavihvalāḥ || tadā''jagāma saṃkruddho gadastatra gadādharaḥ ||25|| gatvā tatsannidhau so'pi jñātvā bhīmaṃ tu śaṃkitaḥ || uvāca natvā he vīra kastvaṃ vada mamāgrataḥ ||26|| so'bravīdbhīmaseno'haṃ jitvā dyūtena he gada || duryodhanena ripuṇā purānniṣkāsitā vayam ||27|| atrasthānādyojane tu bhrātṛbhiśca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ || karoti vanavāsaṃ vai hyaho daivasya māyayā ||28|| vane varṣā gatāścāṣṭau catvārastvavaśeṣitāḥ || varṣamātraṃ kariṣyāmo'jñātavāsaṃ vayaṃ punaḥ ||29|| arjunastu gataḥ svargamāhūto vāsavena ca || ahaṃ na jāne tu kadā''gamiṣyati mahītale ||30|| gada tvaṃ tu yadūnāṃ ca kuśalaṃ kathayasva naḥ || turagaḥ kasya bhūpasya kimarthaṃ yūyamāgatāḥ ||31|| ityuktvā mīmasenastu rurodāśrupariplutaḥ || duryodhanakṛtānkleśānsaṃsmaranduḥkhapūritaḥ ||32|| iti śrutvā sa tadvākyaṃ taṃ samāśvāsya duḥkhitaḥ || bhīmāya kathayāmāsa vārtāṃ sarvāṃ ca vistarāt ||33|| śrutvā bhīmastu mudito'niruddhādyairyadūttamaiḥ || samanvitastu prayayau dharmaputrasya sannidhau ||34|| āgatānyādavāñchrutvājātaśatruḥ praharṣitaḥ || ānetuṃ niryayau rājannakulādyaiḥ samanvitaḥ ||35|| nemustaṃ yādavāḥ sarve so'pi datvā varāśiṣam || nivāsayāmāsa mudā sarvāndvaitavane nṛpa ||36|| āgatebhyaśca sarvebhyo yathāyogyaṃ yathāruci || pradadau bhojanaṃ rājā sthālyā bhāskaradattayā ||37|| uṣitvā rajanīmekāṃ prabhāte kārṣṇinaṃdanaḥ || kratornimaṃtraṇaṃ dattvā pāḍavebhyaḥ paraṃtapa ||38|| yādavaiḥ sahitaḥ śīghraṃ mocayitvā turaṃgamam || yayau sārasvatāndeśān turagasya ca pṛṣṭhataḥ ||39|| aśūrām̐śca bahūndeśāṃstyaktvā turagarāṭ tataḥ || svecchayā vicaran rājan yayau kauṃtalakaṃ puram ||40|| tasminpure mahārāja candrahāsaśca vaiṣṇavaḥ || pālito yaḥ kulindena keralādhipateḥ sutaḥ ||41|| kṛṣṇadevaprasādena rājyaṃ tatra karoti hi || kathāstasyāpi bhaktasya rājañjaiminibhārate ||42|| arjunāgre vistarādvai nāradena tu varṇitāḥ || tasminpure narāḥ sarve kṛṣṇabhaktā vasaṃti hi ||43|| brahmaṇyāḥ puṇyakarttāraḥ paradāraparāṅmukhāḥ || svadāraniratāḥ sarve kṛṣṇapūjanatatparāḥ ||44|| goviṃdagāthāṃ śṛṇvaṃti purāṇāni tathaiva ca || japaṃti tatra nāmāni rādhāmādhavayormudā ||45|| tulasīmālikābhiśca hyūrdhvapuṃḍradharā dvijāḥ || gopīcandanakāśmīrairharimaṃdiracarcitāḥ || 46|| śyāmabiṃdudharāḥ sarve śrīdharāḥ kecideva hi || tilakairdvādaśairyuktāścāṣṭamudrādharāḥ parāḥ ||47|| gṛhasthāḥ śītalāṃ mudrāṃ gopīcandasaṃyutām || nityaṃ viprādayo varṇāḥ prabhāte dhārayanti hi ||48|| agnisaṃskāraṇārthaṃ tu viraktāḥ kecideva hi || taptamudrāṃ dhārayaṃti kecitsaṃnyāsinastathā ||49|| tasminpure hayaḥ paśyanprāpto'bhūdrājamaṃdire || yatra rājati rājā tu candrahāsaśca candravat ||50|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe kauṃtalapuragamanaṃ nāmaikapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||51|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.52> garga uvāca samāgataṃ yajñahayaṃ vilokya śrīcandrahāso vrajacandradāsaḥ || sadyo gṛhītvā kila tasya patraṃ sa vācayāmāsa tadaiva hṛṣṭaḥ ||1|| tatpatraṃ vācayitvā''ha mahābhāgavato nṛpa || aho paśyāmi netrābhyāṃ pautraṃ śrīparamātmanaḥ ||2|| kena puṇyena pūrveṇa kṛṣṇatulyaṃ yadūttamam || mayā na dṛṣṭaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo māyāmānuṣavigrahaḥ ||3|| sahitaḥ kārṣṇijenāhaṃ tasmādgacchāmi dvārakām || tatra paśyāmi śrīkṛṣṇaṃ balaṃ pradyumnameva ca ||4|| ugrasenaṃ mahārājaṃ śrīkṛṣṇenāpi pūjitam || ityuktvā niryayau rājā hyaniruddhaṃ vilokitum ||5|| gṛhītvā copacārām̐śca gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatādikān || divyavastrāṇi ratnāni gṛhītvā turagaṃ ca saḥ ||6|| savaḥ purajanaiḥ sārddhaṃ mālātilakaśobhitaiḥ || gītavāditraghoṣaiśca padbhyāṃ rājā jagāma ha ||7|| āgataṃ taṃ nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā nāgaraiḥ sahitaṃ nṛpa || aniruddho mudāyukto maṃtriṇaṃ cedamabravīt ||8|| aniruddha uvāca ko'yaṃ rājā mahāmaṃtrinsarvaiḥ purajanaiḥ saha || āgato milanārthaṃ vā tasya vārtāṃ vadasva naḥ ||9|| uddhava uvāca nṛpo'yaṃ caṃdrahāsākhyo keralādhipateḥ sutaḥ || mṛtayormātṛpitrośca kuliṃdenānupālitaḥ ||10|| ābālyātkṛṣṇacandrasya bhaktastenāpi rakṣitaḥ || duṣṭabuddheḥ pradhānasya sutāṃ yaḥ pariṇītavān ||11|| yasmai kuntalako rājā rājyaṃ datvā vanaṃ yayau || tasyākhyānaṃ dvārakāyāṃ mayā kṛṣṇamukhācchrutam ||12|| yasmai svadarśanaṃ dātuṃ śrīkṛṣṇo'trāgamiṣyati || uddhavasya vacaḥ śrutvā vismito'bhūdyadūttamaḥ ||13|| gatvāniruddhanikaṭe candrahāso janairvṛtaḥ || śyāmakarṇaṃ dadau prīto dhanāni bahuśastathā ||14|| gajānāmarddhalakṣaṃ ca rathānāṃ lakṣameva ca || turagāṇāmekakoṭiṃ mudrāṇāṃ hi sahasrakam ||15|| gavayānāṃ sahasraṃ ca śibikānāṃ sahasrakam || dhenūnāṃ daśalakṣaṃ ca śiñjānāmayutaṃ tathā ||16|| ekakoṭiṃ suvarṇānāṃ raupyāṇāṃ ca caturguṇam || lakṣamābharaṇānāṃ ca mādhavāya dadau nṛpaḥ ||17|| candrahāsa uvāca namo'niruddhāya surottamāya śrīkṛṣṇapautrāya janeśvarāya || pradyumnaputrāya yadūttamāya devāya pūrṇāya namaḥ parāya ||18|| iti bhaktavacaḥ śrutvā prasanno madanātmajaḥ || saṃślāghya pradadau tasmai pradīptāṃ ratnamālikām || 19|| candrahāsastu rājendra rājye kṛtvā tu maṃtriṇam || svapurādyādavaiḥ sārddhaṃ gaṃtuṃ cālaṃ mano'karot ||20|| uṣitvā tatpure sarve hyekarātraṃ yadūttamāḥ || prātaḥkāle yayū rājaṃścandrahāsena saṃyutāḥ ||21|| jagāma hyagratastebhyo turagaḥ patraśobhitaḥ || tataḥ saptavatīṃ dṛṣṭvā hyāvarttaśatasaṃkulām ||22|| taṭaṃ taraṃgairnighnaṃtīṃ dīrghavegāṃ duratyayām || naukābhiḥ saṃyutāṃ dṛṣṭvā vīraḥ pradyumnanandanaḥ ||23|| akṣauhiṇīśatayutaḥ pāraṃ gaṃtuṃ mano dadhe || sa pūrvaṃ gajamāruhya sāṃbādyaiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ ||24|| nāvaṃ tyaktvā nṛpaśreṣṭha praviveśa nadījale || prathamaṃ salilaṃ tasyāṃ samalaṃ ca babhūva ha ||25|| tataḥ paṃkadravā bhūmiścitrametadbabhūva ha || hasaṃto yādavāḥ sarve vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ ||26|| atha vrajaṃsturaṃgastu sa jagāma śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || nārāyaṇasaro yatra madhye siṃdhusamudrayoḥ ||27|| papau tirthajalaṃ tatra turagaśca tṛṣāturaḥ || tatastatrāyayuḥ sarve'niruddhādyā yadūttamāḥ ||28|| dharmadveṣakarānnīcānmlecchāñjitvā mṛdhāṃgaṇe || dṛṣṭvā turaṃgamaṃ tatra snānaṃ cakruḥ sarovare ||29|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇasarogamanaṃ nāma dvipaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||52|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.53> garga uvāca paśyannṛpānmahāvīrānugrasenaturaṃgamaḥ || vicaranbhārate varṣe deśānanyāñjagāma ha ||1|| evaṃ vicaratastasya hayasya ca viśāṃ pate || āgataḥ phālguno māsaḥ sarveṣāṃ gṛhadarśikaḥ ||2|| āgataṃ phālgunaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāniruddhastu śaṃkitaḥ || uvāca maṃtripravaramuddhavaṃ buddhisattamam ||3|| aniruddha uvāca caitre śrīyādaveṃdrastu maṃtrin yajñaṃ kariṣyati || vayaṃ tu kiṃ kariṣyāmo divasā bahavo na hi ||4|| bhūmau turaṃgaharttāro nṛpāḥ ke ke'vaśeṣitāḥ || teṣāṃ ca vada nāmāni mahyaṃ śuśrūṣave tvaram ||5|| uddhava uvāca na saṃti bhūtale śūrā gagane saṃti vā hare || tasmādyadupurīṃ gaccha svarṇadvārāṃ ca dvārakām ||6|| iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā hyaniruddhaḥ praharṣitaḥ || tasyāpi vacanaṃ rājannaśvāgre punarabravīt ||7|| evaṃ tadvākyamākarṇya sarvajñātā turaṃgamaḥ || prayayau dvārakāṃ śīghraṃ kiṣkiṃdhāṃ hanumāniva ||8|| tasyāpi pṛṣṭhataḥ śūrā dudruvuste turaṃgamaiḥ || vāyuvegairmanovegairbhānusāṃbādayo nṛpa ||9|| gṛhītvā turagaṃ sarve baddhvā taṃ svarṇadāmabhiḥ || senāyāmantare kṛtvā śaṃkitāḥ svapurīṃ yayuḥ ||10|| gītavāditraghoṣaiśca nādayaṃtaśca duṃdubhīn || cālayaṃtaśca pṛthivīṃ trāsayantaḥ khalān ripūn ||11|| vrajaṃtaṃ yādavaiḥ sārddhaṃ turagaṃ vīkṣya nāradaḥ || dūtavatkalahārthāya prayayau śakrasannidhim ||12|| tasyāgre kathayāmāsa vājivārtāṃ sa vistarāt || śrutvā śakrastu rājeṃdra hayaṃ hartuṃ mano dadhe ||13|| āyayau bhūtale śīghraṃ drṣṭuṃ bhūtvā tirohitaḥ || aho viṣṇormāyayā ca sarve muhyaṃti devatāḥ ||14|| kuberabrahmaśakrādyā bhūjanānāṃ tu kā kathā || sa gatvā tatra vṛṣṇīnāṃ senāṃ sarvāṃ dadarśa ha ||15|| pralayābdhisamāṃ raudrāṃ vṛtāṃ śūraiśca koṭibhiḥ || yādavānāṃ mahāsenāmudbhaṭāṃ vīkṣya śaṃkitaḥ ||16|| yayau kṛṣṇabhayādrājañchīghraṃ śakro'marāvatīm || kṛṣṇadevasya kṛpayā yuddhasyāśāṃ visṛjya ca ||17|| atha vrajaṃtī caturaṃgiṇībhiḥ senāniruddhasya mahātmanaśca || gajai rathairvai turagairnaraiśca reje maghonaḥ pṛtaneva svarge ||18|| gajāḥ sarve pṛthagbhūtāḥ pṛthagbhūtā rathāstathā || pṛthagbhūtāsturaṃgāśca pṛthagbhūtā padātayaḥ ||19|| anujagmurdvārakāṃ te harṣitāḥ kṛṣṇapotakāḥ || jaṃbūdvīpasya jetāro lokadvayajigiṣavaḥ ||20|| agne vāhaṃ puraskṛtya vāditrairvividhairapi || gītanṛtyādibhī rājansaṃyuktāste yadūttamāḥ ||21|| aniruddhastu sāṃbādyairiṃdranīlādibhirnṛpa || candrahāsādibhirbhūpaiḥ sahasrairabhibhūṣitaḥ ||22|| sāṃbasyānumatenāpi cānarte saṃpraviśya ca || uddhavaṃ preṣayāmāsa dvārakāṃ yojanadvayāt ||23|| evaṃ praṇoditaḥ so'pi natvā rukmavatīsutam || śibikāṃ śīghramāruhya harṣitaḥ prayayau purīm ||24|| yatrāste hyugrasenastu munibhiḥ parivāritaḥ || śreṣṭhe piṃḍārakakṣetre sabhāmaṃḍapabhūṣite ||25|| vasudevādayo yatra rāmakṛṣṇādayo nṛpa || pradyumnādyāśca balino yajñaṃ rakṣanti nityaśaḥ ||26|| gatvā nṛpasabhāṃ tatra yādaveṃdraṃ praṇamya ca || vasudevaṃ balaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pradyumnādīn yadūttamān ||27|| sarvānnatvā yathāyogyaṃ teṣāmagre sa saṃsthitaḥ || kathayāmāsa vṛttāṃtaṃ pṛṣṭastairhṛṣṭamānasaiḥ ||28|| uddhava uvāca āgatastava rājeṃdra nirvighnena turaṃgamaḥ || āgatāścāniruddhādyāḥ kuśalena yadūttamāḥ ||29|| goviṃdasyāpi kṛpayā cedranīlaḥ samāgataḥ || hemāṃgadaḥ surūpā ca hyāgatā maṇḍaleśvarī ||30|| nirjitastu bako yuddhe bhīṣaṇena samanvitaḥ || binduścaivānuśālvaśca svapurāddvau samāgatau ||31|| upadvīpe pāṃcajanye balvalo nirjito'suraiḥ || tasminyuddhe maheśena hyaniruddhasunandanau ||32|| nihatau ca ruṣāḍhyena yādavāścaiva māritāḥ || tatra gatvā tvasau kṛṣṇo jīvayāmāsa yādavān ||33|| tasmātkṛṣṇasya kṛpayā vayaṃ sarve samāgatāḥ || nirjitāḥ kauravāḥ sarve bhīṣmo hyatra samāgataḥ ||34|| dṛṣṭvā dvaitavane'smābhiḥ pāṃḍavā duḥkhakarśitāḥ || vraje gopagaṇāścaiva kṛṣṇavikṣepavihvalāḥ ||35|| ābālyātkṛṣṇabhaktastu caṃdrahāsaḥ samāgataḥ || bhītāśca bahavo bhūpā āgatāste bhayāttava ||36|| garga uvāca iti kṛṣṇaguṇāñchrutvā hyuddhavādyādaveśvaraḥ || na kiṃcidūce premṇā tu magnaścānandasāgare ||37|| maṇihāraṃ dadau tasmai ratnāni cāṃbarāṇī ca || śibikāvāraṇarathahayādīnuddhavāya saḥ || 38|| tataḥ kṛṣṇastu bhagavāñchīghramutthāya harṣitaḥ || sakhyā sārddhaṃ sabhāyāṃ ca cakāra pariraṃbhaṇam ||39|| ugrasena uvācātha govindaṃ harṣapūritaḥ || ānetaṃ cāniruddhaṃ vai gaccha śrīkṛṣṇa yādavaiḥ ||40|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe uddhavāgamanaṃ nāma tripaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||53|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.54> garga uvāca athograsenavacanādvasudevādayo nṛpa || netuṃ viniryayuḥ sarve hyaniruddhaṃ samāgatam ||1|| gajai rathaisturaṃgaiśca śibikābhiryadūttamāḥ || śrīkṛṣṇabaladevādyāḥ pradyumnādyā nṛpeśvara ||2|| uddhavādyā gajasthāśca hayaṃ draṣṭuṃ vinirgatāḥ || devakīpramukhā nāryo mātaraḥ kṛṣṇarāmayoḥ ||3|| śibikābhirvicitrābhirniryayurnṛpasattama || rukmiṇīsatyabhāmādyā nāryaḥ kṛṣṇasya eva hi ||4|| śibikābhiryayuḥ sarvāḥ sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa || lājānāṃ mauktikānāṃ ca kusumānāṃ nṛpeśvara || varṣāṃ kartuṃ yayuḥ śīghraṃ gajasthāśca kumārikāḥ ||5|| kalaśairjalahāriṇyo niryayurjalapūritaiḥ || saubhāgyavatyo brāhmaṇyo gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatāṃkuraiḥ ||6|| vārāṃganāśca rūpiṇyo nṛtyaṃ kartuṃ viniryayuḥ || śobhitāḥ sarvaśṛṅgārairgāyaṃtyaśca guṇānhareḥ ||7|| śaṃkhaduṃdubhinādena brahmaghoṣeṇa yādavāḥ || vāraṇeṃdraṃ puraskṛtya gargādyairmunibhiryutāḥ ||8|| vilokayaṃtaḥ svapurīṃ patākābhiśca maṃḍitām || siktamārgāṃ gaṃdhajalai raṃbhātoraṇaśobhitām ||9|| pradīptāṃ maṇidīpaiśca vitānairvividhairapi || divyanārīnarairyuktāṃ suvarṇasavanairvṛtām ||10|| pakṣiṇāṃ kalaśabdena dhūmreṇāgurugaṃdhinā || śobhitāṃ kṛṣṇanagarīṃ śakrasyevāmarāvatīm ||11|| itthaṃ vilokayaṃtaste prāptāḥ śīghraṃ ca yādavāḥ || yatrāniruddhaḥ sahayo varttate senayā''vṛtaḥ ||12|| tāndṛṣṭvā cāniruddhastu svarathādavatīrya ca || puraskṛtya hayaṃ cāgre nṛpaiḥ sārddhaṃ samāyayau ||13|| pūrvaṃ natvā kulācāryaṃ vasudevaṃ balaṃ tathā || śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pitaraṃ caiva tebhyaścāśvaṃ dadau punaḥ ||14|| śubhāśiṣo daduste tu prītāḥ premapariplutāḥ || tvayā sādhu kṛtaṃ vatsa sarvāñjitvā ripūnnṛpān ||15|| ānayāmāsa turagaṃ madhye saṃvatsarasya ca || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvāniruddhaḥ prāha māṃ punaḥ ||16|| kṛpayā tava vipreṃdra mārge mārge mṛdhe mṛdhe || bahubhiḥ śatrubhiścāśvo gṛhīto'pi vimocitaḥ ||17|| guroranugraheṇaiva sukhī bhavati mānavaḥ || tasmādguruṃ ca vidhinā yathāśaktyā prapūjayet ||18|| bhūpāstataḥ samāgatya samīpe rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ || nemuḥ pṛthakpṛthaksarve prītāḥ premapariplutāḥ ||19|| sarvāndṛṣṭvā natānbhūpāñchrīkṛṣṇo balasaṃyutaḥ || caṃdrahāsaṃ ca gāṃgeyaṃ binduṃ caivānuśālvakam ||20|| hemāṃgadaṃ cedranīlaṃ parirebhe harirmudā || kṛṣṇabhaktātparaḥ ko'pi tasmādbhūmau na vidyate ||21|| tato'niruddhaṃ jayinaṃ samāgataṃ gaje samāropya kuśasthalīṃ yayau || śauriḥ prasannaḥ kila sarvayādavaiḥ putraiśca pautrairmuditairnṛpeśvara ||22|| puṣpāṇāṃ makaraṃdānāṃ varṣāṃ cakruḥ surastriyaḥ || lājānāṃ mauktikānāṃ ca kuñjarasthāḥ kumārikāḥ ||23|| nṛtyavāditragītena brahmaghoṣeṇa śobhitāḥ || paśyaṃtaḥ siktamārgāṃ tāṃ purīmpiṇḍārakaṃ yayuḥ ||24|| nṛpāḥ sarve yadūnāṃ ca vaibhavaṃ devadurlabham || vilokya vaibhavaṃ svaṃ svaṃ garhayaṃti ca vismitāḥ ||25|| yajñasthalaṃ te dadṛśurdhūmreṇa dhṛtagaṃdhinā || vyāptaṃ brāhmaṇaghoṣeṇa hyasipatravratena ca ||26|| nirikṣya tatra bhūpālamugrasenaṃ yadūttamam || puraṃdarasamaṃ dāṃtaṃ puṣṭaṃ gauraṃ sphuratprabham ||27|| kuśāsanasthaṃ subhagaṃ niyame nyastabhūṣaṇam || saṃyuktaṃ mṛgaśṛṅgeṇa mṛgacarmaṇi bhāryayā ||28|| kurvantaṃ pūjanaṃ cāgnerghṛtagaṃdhākṣatādibhiḥ || maṇḍape munibhiryuktaṃ dhūmreṇāruṇalocanam ||29|| taṃ sarve cāniruddhādyāḥ kṛtvāgre yajñaghoṭakam || vāhanebhyaḥ samuttīrya nemuḥ prītāḥ pṛthakpṛthak ||30|| tataḥ śrīyadurājastu sarvāndṛṣṭvā nṛpānyadūn || sarveṣāmādadhe mānaṃ yathāyogyaṃ yathābalam ||31|| aniruddhastato natvā śīghraṃ bhūtvā kṛtāṃjaliḥ || sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ prāha jaṃbūdvīpapatiṃ nṛpam ||32|| aniruddha uvāca enaṃ paśya mahārāja indranīlaṃ nṛpottamam || pādayoḥ patitaṃ premṇā samutthāpaya devavat ||33|| hemāṃgadaṃ cānuśālvaṃ binduṃ śrīcandrahāsakam || enaṃ devavrataṃ paśya cāgataṃ tava sannidhau ||34|| mama rakṣākaraṃ paśya sāṃbaṃ jāṃbavatīsutam || rudreṇa nihataṃ māṃ ca paśya kṛṣṇena jīvitam ||35|| tathā rudrahataṃ paśya jīvitaṃ ca sunandanam || anyānpaśya yadūnsarvānkṛṣṇasya
