kṛpayā''gatān ||36|| gṛhāṇa yajñaturagaṃ nirvighnena samāgatam || dattaṃ yuddhāya nistriṃśaṃ taṃ gṛhāṇa namo'stu te ||37|| iti tadvākyamākarṇya yadurājaḥ praharṣitaḥ || saṃślāghya taṃ nṛpāṃścaiva yathāyogyāśiṣaṃ dadau ||38|| pūjayitvā nṛpānsarvāṃstato bhīṣmamuvāca ha || ehi bhīṣma mayā sārddhaṃ kuru tvaṃ pariraṃbhaṇam ||39|| ityuktvā taṃ samutthāya parirebhe yadūttamaḥ || tataste dānamānābhyāṃ pūjitā yadavo nṛpāḥ ||40|| nivāsaṃ cakrire prītā dvārakāyāṃ gṛhe gṛhe || tato dṛṣṭvāniruddhaṃ vai prāptaṃ sāṃbādibhirnṛpa ||41|| devakī rohaṇī caiva rukmiṇyādyāḥ striyo varāḥ || anyāśca rukmavatyādyāḥ pariṣvajya mudaṃ yayuḥ ||42|| surūpā rocanā hyūṣā rājannetā mudaṃ gatāḥ || sāṃbaślāghāṃ tataḥ śrutvā suyodhanasutā bhṛśam ||43|| mudaṃ yayau svanetrābhyāṃ muṃcaṃtī harṣajaṃ jalam || babhūva maṃgalaṃ rājandvārakāyāṃ gṛhe gṛhe || sasainye nṛpaśārdūla hyaniruddhe samāgate ||44|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe turagāgamanaṃ nāma catuṣpaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||54|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.55> garga uvāca atha vai maṇḍape ramye dvārairaṣṭabhiranvite || patatpatāke kuṇḍāḍhye yājñikairaṣṭakairyute ||1|| palāśajairbilvajaiśca tathā śleṣmātakairnṛpa || vedikābhistathā yūpaiścaṣālairapi bhūṣite ||2|| srukcarmakuśamusalolūkhalādyairviśāṃpate || anyaiḥ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhārairnānāvastubhiranvite ||3|| ugrasenastu rājarṣirṛṣirbhirvedapāragaiḥ || yādavaiścāmarāvatyāṃ reje śakra ivāmaraiḥ ||4|| āhūtāḥ kṛṣṇacandreṇa gopā nandādayastataḥ || vṛṣabhānuvarādyāṃśca śrīdāmādyāḥ samāyayuḥ ||5|| yaśomatī rādhikā ca hyanyāḥ sarvā vrajastriyaḥ || dvārakāmāyayuḥ prītāḥ śibikābhī rathairapi ||6|| āhūto dhṛtarāṣṭrastu kauravaiśca sutairyutaḥ || ājagāma kuśasthalyāṃ nṛpāścānye samāgatāḥ ||7|| yudhiṣṭhiro bhīmasenaścārjuno nakulastathā || sahadevo vanādete hyājagmurbhāryayā saha ||8|| śrīkṛṣṇena samāhūtāḥ preṣayitvā ca nāradam || śakrādayo'ṣṭau dikpālā vasavo ravayastathā ||9|| yajñe sanatkumārādyā rudrāścaikādaśāpi hi || marudgaṇāśca vetālā gaṃdharvāḥ kinnarāstathā ||10|| viśvedevāśca sādhyāśca sarve vidyādharāstathā || devāśca devapatnyaśca gandharvyo'psarasastathā ||11|| ājagmurdvārakāṃ rājankṛṣṇadarśanakāṃkṣayā || kailāsaśca samāhūtaḥ sarvamaṃgalayā śivaḥ ||12|| sutalāddaityavṛndaiśca prahlādo balireva ca || vibhīṣaṇo bhīṣaṇaśca mayo balvala eva ca ||13|| jāṃbavāndaṃṣṭribhiḥ sārddhaṃ hanūmānvānarairyutaḥ || pakṣibhiḥ pakṣirāṭ tatra tathā sarpaiśca vāsukiḥ ||14|| dhenubhiḥ sahitā rājandhenurūpadharā dharā || meruḥ śailairhimagirirvaṭaḥ sākṣāddrumairvṛtaḥ ||15|| ratnākarā ratnayutā nadībhiḥ svardhunī tathā || tīrthaiḥ sarvaiśca rājeṃdra tīrtharājaśca puṣkaraḥ ||16|| ete sarve samāhūtā ājagmurmuditāḥ kratau || tataḥ kṛṣṇena cāhūtā vrajabhūmiḥ samāgatā ||17|| kṛṣṇayajñotsavaṃ drṣṭuṃ yamunā śamanasvasā || sarvāndṛṣṭvā''gatānprīto vāsayāmāsa cāhukaḥ ||18|| śibireṣu maṃdireṣu vimāneṣu vaneṣu ca || athācāryaḥ kṛto vyāso bakadālbhyo vidhirmayā ||19|| ṛtvijaśca kṛtā divyā ye vai pūrvaṃ nimaṃtritāḥ || atha yajñe'niruddhastu śrīkṛṣṇasyecchayā nṛpa ||20|| vidhervidhośca svasyāpi kṛtvā rūpatrayaṃ babhau || dṛṣṭvā līlāṃ kārṣṇijasya devāśca yadavo nṛpāḥ ||21|| vismitāḥ kathayāmāsuḥ karṇe karṇe parasparam || vyāsaḥ pratyāha rājānaṃ śṛṇu yādavasattama ||22|| upaviṣṭā nṛpā viprā yathāsthāne vibhāgaśaḥ || catuṣṣaṣṭirdampatīnāṃ yāṃtu vai gomatītaṭe ||23|| āhartuṃ salilaṃ tasyā mayā''diṣṭaṃ yathocitam || adityāḥ kaśyapaścaiva vasiṣṭho'ruṃdhatīyutaḥ ||24|| droṇācāryastu kṛpyā ca hyatriścaivānasūyayā || rukmiṇyā kṛṣṇacandrastu revatyā rāma eva ca ||25|| māyāvatyā ca pradyumna uṣayā kārṣṇijastathā || subhadrayārjunaścaiva sāṃbo lakṣmaṇayā tathā ||26|| tathā hemāṃgadādyāśca yāṃtu vai svasvabhāryayā || śrīgarga uvāca evaṃ te vyāsavacanātsapatnīkā dvijā nṛpāḥ ||27|| ānetuṃ gomatītoyaṃ prayayurbaddhapallavāḥ || devakīṃ rohiṇīṃ kuntīṃ gāṃdhārīṃ ca yaśomatīm ||28|| puraskṛtya tu jagrāha kuṃbho bhaiṣmyā yuto hariḥ || tathā rāmastu revatyā sastrīkā ye'pi bhūmipāḥ ||29|| suvarṇaraupyakalaśaiḥ sapuṣpaiśca sapallavaiḥ || rukmiṇyā sahitaṃ yāṃtaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā samāgame ||30|| nāradaḥ kalahaṃ kartuṃ satyabhāmāgṛhaṃ yayau || dṛṣṭvā caikāṃ harerbhāryāṃ saṃpṛṣṭaḥ sa tayābravīt ||31|| nārada uvāca ādaraṃ sadane nāsti satrājitasute tava || gataḥ kṛṣṇastu rukmiṇyā cāhartuṃ gomatījalam ||32|| bahubhiryācitā tvaṃ tu pārijātakahāriṇī || kṛṣṇasaṃkalpakaraṇī maṇiyuktā ca māninī ||33|| īdṛśīṃ tvāṃ varārohāṃ garuḍopari gāminīm || vihāya bhaiṣmyā śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śobhāṃ draṣṭuṃ jagāma ha ||34|| yasyāḥ putraśca pradyumno yasyāḥ pautro'niruddhakaḥ || sā darśayati bho mātarvārtāṃ mānaṃ ca gauravam ||35|| garga uvāca iti śrutvā prāṇanāthaṃ rukmiṇyā sahitaṃ gatam ||36|| ruroda duḥkhitā rājansatyabhāmā ruṣānvitā || tadaiva kṛṣṇo bhagavāñjñātvā nāradaceṣṭitam ||37|| satyabhāmāgṛhaṃ śīghraṃ rupeṇaikena cāgatam || gatvā pratyāha vacanaṃ sarvajñātā rameśvaraḥ ||38|| na gato'haṃ samāje vai rukmiṇyā sahitaḥ priye || āgato bhojanaṃ kartuṃ gato rāmaśca bhāryayā ||39|| iti tadvākyamākarṇya satyabhāmā mudaṃ gatā || bhīto nārada utthāya gehaṃ cānyaṃ jagāma ha ||40|| gatvā jāṃbavatīgehaṃ tasyāgre sarvamabravīt || śrutvā hasaṃtī sā prāha mṛṣā mā vada he mune ||41|| karoti śayanaṃ gehe śrīnātho bhojanāṃtare || iti śrutvā śaṃkitastu tvaraṃ nirgatya nāradaḥ ||42|| mitraviṃdāgṛhe gatvā pratyuvāca vilokayan || nārada uvāca na gatāsi nṛpasthānaṃ mātargehe sthitāsi kim ||43|| āhartuṃ gomatītoyaṃ prayāti yatra mādhavaḥ || bhaiṣmīṃ satyāṃ jāṃbavatīṃ saha neṣyati tatra vai ||44|| mitraviṃdovāca keśavasya priyāḥ sarvā gaṃtāsau yāṃ vihāya ca || sā na jīvati kṛṣṇastu pautraṃ lālayati gṛhe ||45|| tato muniḥ samutthāya sarvāṇi maṃdirāṇi ca || babhrāma kṛṣṇabhāryāṇāṃ sakṛṣṇānītyamanyata ||46|| punarvicārya devarṣirgopīnāṃ maṃdirāṇi ca || prayayau kathituṃ vārtāṃ rādhikāyai ca mānada ||47|| tatra dīvyaṃtamakṣaiśca rādhayā naṃdanandanam || gopībhiḥ sahitaṃ vīkṣya ṛṣirgaṃtuṃ mano dadhe ||48|| tadaiva kṛṣṇa utthāya gṛhītvā pāṇinā munim || tatraiva sthāpayāmāsa pūjayitvā yathāvidhi ||49|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca kiṃ kariṣyasi vipreṃdra vṛthā bhramasi mohitaḥ || gehe gehe svapatnīnāṃ mayā tvaṃ tu vilokitaḥ ||50|| mayā dhṛtāni rūpāṇi tvadbhayādṛṣisattama || nāhaṃ dāsye damaṃ tubhyaṃ vipratvātprārthayāmyaham ||51|| sarveṣāṃ caiva devo'haṃ mama devāśca brāhmaṇāḥ || ye druhyanti dvijānmūḍhāḥ saṃti te mama śatravaḥ ||52|| ye pūjayaṃti viprāṃśca mama bhāvena bhūjanāḥ || te bhuñjaṃti sukhaṃ cātra hyante yāsyaṃti tatpadam ||53|| māyayā mama puryāṃ tvaṃ mohitaścāpi mā khidaḥ || sarve muhyaṃti devarṣe brahmarudrādayaḥ surāḥ ||54|| iti tadvākyamākarṇya saṃstutaḥ sa mahāmuniḥ || āyayau maṇḍape tūṣṇīṃ bhūtvā ṛtvigjanairvṛte ||55|| atha te gomatītīraṃ jagmuḥ kṛṣṇādayo nṛpāḥ || rukmiṇyādyāḥ striyaścaiva vāditrairvividhairapi ||56|| nārīṇāṃ caiva vṛndena gāyaṃtīnāṃ hareryaśaḥ || valayānāṃ nūpurāṇāṃ śabdo'bhūnmadhuradhvaniḥ ||57|| pūjayitvā jalasurānvyāsaḥ sārddhaṃ mayā muniḥ || kalaśaṃ toyasaṃyuktamanasūyākare dadau ||58|| tataśca jagṛhuḥ kumbhān revatyādyāśca yoṣitaḥ || notthitāḥ kalaśāḥ sarve komalaiśca karairapi ||59|| dhārayaṃti kathaṃ kumbhaṃ puṣpabhāreṇa pīḍitāḥ || tataśca jahasū rājño nṛpāṇāṃ ca parasparam ||60|| kathaṃ yāmo yajñavāṭamityūcuḥ kalaśairvinā || rukmiṇyādyāḥ striyaḥ sarvāstā ūcurmanasā harim ||61|| he śrīkṛṣṇa jagannātha bhaktakaṣṭavināśana || sabalastvaṃ cakradhārī hyasmānpālaya saṃkaṭe ||62|| evaṃ bruvaṃtyo jagṛhuḥ sakalānbhāravarjitān || sve sve śirasi saṃdhāya saṃyuktairmaṇimauktikaiḥ ||63|| yajñavāṭaṃ samājagmurnāryyaḥ śīghraṃ sabhartṛkāḥ || yatra bheryaśca śaṃkhādyā vādyaṃte paṇavādayaḥ ||64|| ānīya gomatītoyaṃ prāpitāstatra te nṛpa || śyāmakarṇena sahitā yatra vai yādaveśvaraḥ ||65|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe gomatījalānayanaṃ nāma paṃcapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||55|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.56> garga uvāca || ugrasenasya yajñe vai hayamedhe mahātmanaḥ || tasyāsanparicaryāyāṃ bāṃdhavā premabaṃdhanāḥ || 1 || tataścakāra yadurāṇ nānākarmasubāṃdhavān || bhīmaṃ mahānasādhyakṣaṃ dharmaṃ dharmasya pālane || 2 || śuśrūṣaṇe satāṃ jiṣṇuṃ nakulaṃ dravyasādhane || pūjane sahadevaṃ ca dhanādhyakṣaṃ suyodhanam || 3 || dāne ca dāninaṃ karṇaṃ draupadīṃ pariveṣaṇe || rakṣāyāṃ kṛṣṇaputrānvai hyaṣṭādaśamahārathān ||4|| yuyudhānaṃ vikarṇaṃ ca hṛdīkaṃ viduraṃ tathā || akrūramuddhavaṃ caiva nānākarmasu bhūpatiḥ || 5 kṛtvā pratyāha śrīkṛṣṇaṃ devtvaṃ kiṃ kariṣyasi || śrutvā kṛṣṇa uvācātha bāhmaṇānāṃ karomyaham || 6 || pādaprakṣālanaṃ rājanniṃdraprasthe kṛtaṃ mayā || iti śrutvā ca brahmādyā jahasurbhūjanāstathā || 7 || garga uvāca || ityuktvā bhagavānsākṣādṛṣīṇāṃ ca tapasvinām || pādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayāmāsa tānnṛpa ||8|| āsaneṣūpaviṣṭāste vāsāṃsi paridhāya ca || tilakairdvādaśairyuktā divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ||9|| nānāmatānāṃ mālābhiryuktāḥ karpūravīṭakān || bhuktvā te rejire yajñe devā iva mahīsurāḥ||10.56.10|| tatorthino bhikṣavaśca viraktāśca bubhukṣitāḥ|| kurvaṃti yācanāṃ sarve dūradeśātsamāgatāḥ || 11 || dadasvānnaṃ dadasvānnaṃ dadasvānnaṃ nareśvara || upānahaśca pātrāṇi vastrāṇi kaṃbalāni ca||12|| ugrasenasya yajñe vai munivṛṃdairnṛpairvṛte || teṣāṃ tāṃ karuṇāṃ vācaṃ niśamya yadusattamaḥ || 13 || suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ caiva vastrāṇi bhājanāni ca || gajāśvarathagochatra śibikādīni harṣitaḥ ||14|| yeṣāṃyeṣāṃ priyaṃ yadvai tebhyastebhyo dadau nṛpaḥ || ugrasenaḥ kṛtasnānaḥ kratukarmaṇi dīkṣitaḥ ||15|| asipatravratadharo rucimatyā babhau tataḥ || viprā viṃśatisāhasrā vedaśāstraviśāradāḥ || 16 || vyāsagargādayaścaiva kārayaṃti kratūttamam || hastiśuṇḍāsamādhārā hyagnikuṃḍe papāta ha ||17|| ghṛtasya ca nṛpaśreṣṭha munibhirbrahmavādibhiḥ|| tadyajñe kṛṣṇakṛpayā hyanalo jīrṇatāṃ yayau||18|| tataḥ provāca vahnistu sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nṛpam || prasannohaṃ prasannohaṃ paśuṃ mama prayaccha vai || 19 || niśamya cāgnervacanaṃ sabhāyāṃ śrīyādavendro munibhiḥ samaṃ ca || baddhaṃ turaṃgaṃ tapanīya yūpe hiraṇyadāmnā ca tamāha bhūpaḥ || 10.56.20 || ugrasena uvāca || agnervākyaṃ śṛṇu haya śuddhaṃ tvāṃ ca paśuṃ kratoḥ || bhakṣayiṣyati vahnistu ghṛtaistṛptopi cādhvare || 21 || nṛpasya vacanaṃ śrutvā śyāmakarṇasturaṃgamaḥ || kṛṣṇaṃ vilokayanprīto kaṃpayāmāsa svānanam ||22|| tato hayamataṃ jñātvā vedavyāsaḥ samaṃ mayā || maṇḍape munibhiryukte śrīkṛṣṇādyairnṛpairvṛte || 23 || brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyai vaiśyaiḥ śūdrairyajñadidṛkṣubhiḥ || strībhiryute pralaṃbaghnaṃ prāha dvaipāyano muniḥ || 24 || vyāsa uvāca || uttiṣṭa balabhadra tvaṃ karavālaṃ pragṛhya ca || chiṃdhikaṃ vājinaścāgneḥ prītaye hyadhunā tvaram ||25|| nihate turage rāma havane ca kṛte sati || yajñāvatāraḥ kṛṣṇastu prasanno bhavati kratau || 26 || garga uvāca || evaṃ vyāsavacaḥ śrutvā balaḥ khaḍgena satvaram || śiro hayasya ciccheda tacchiro gaganaṃ yayau || 27 || gatvārddhaṃ nṛpaśārdūla līnaṃ tadravimaṃḍale || deva daitya narāḥ sarve taddṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ gatāḥ||28|| hayasya hṛdaye śūlaṃ nijaghāna hasanhariḥ || makaraṃdasamādhārā rājam̐statra vinirgatā ||29|| tataśca nirgatā jyotisturagasya kalevarāt || paśyatāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ viveśa madhusūdane ||10.56.30 || paścādbhūtvā ca karpūra śarīraṃ patitaṃ paśoḥ || gātrā cyutāyathā rājanvibhūtiḥ śaṃkarasya ca || 31 || dṛṣṭvā ca karpūrasamūhamadbhutaṃ sabhāṃ sugaṃdhena vṛtāṃ ca dvārakām || vyāsādayaste munayaḥ praharṣitā ūcurnṛpaṃ vai kratukarmaṇisthitam ||32|| diṣṭyā te nṛpaśārdūla saphalobhūtkratūttamaḥ || karpūreṇāpi havanaṃ kariṣyāmaśca tvaṃ kuru| || 33 || ityuktvā ṛtvijaḥ sarve yajñakuṃḍe ca tatkṣaṇāt || ghanasāraṃ hi juhuvuḥ pūrvaṃ yajñeśvarāya ca || 34 || yatra yajñeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇaścaturvyūhadharaḥ paraḥ || reje putraiśca pautraiśca tatra kiṃ durlabhaṃ nṛpa || 35 || tasminyajñe mahendrāya vacaḥ prakathitaṃ mayā || gṛhāṇa śakra yajñesminkarpūrasyāhutiṃ vibho ||36 || ehi rājñārpitāṃ caināṃ kalāvagre hi durlabhām || iti śrutvā ca vacanaṃ śakraḥ provāca sasmitam||37|| punargṛhṇāmi munayo dharmarājakratūttame || kulakṣaye gajapure pradattāmāhutiṃ dvijaiḥ || 38 || iti śrutvā harervākyaṃ satyaṃ matvā munīśvarāḥ|| sarvāndevānnṛpaśreṣṭha hyadhvare cāhutiṃ daduḥ||39|| agnaye svāheti mantraiśca sarvānevāhutīrdaduḥ ||10.56.40|| karpūrahavanenāpi prītaṃ viśvaṃ carācaram|| ugrasenastu rājā vai nirṛṇobhūnmahādhvare||41|| ugraseno dvijottamaiḥ || kṛṣṇādyairyādavairbhūpaistīrthe piṇḍārake karot ||42|| bhāryayā sahitaḥ snātvā vedoktavidhinā nṛpaḥ|| dhṛtvā kṣaumāṃbaraṃ reje yajño dakṣiṇayā yathā || 43 || devaduṃdubhayo nedurnaraduṃdubhayastadā || ugrasenopari surāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire ||44|| kārayitvā svadhāpānaṃ prāśayitvā yathākramam || sarvebhyaśca puroḍāśaṃ dattvā śeṣamathāsṛjat || 45 || ugrasenaṃ ca vāditraistuṣṭuvurvaṃdino mudā || tato nīrājanaṃ cakurdevakyādyāśca yoṣitaḥ || 46 || alaṃkārāśca ratnāni vastrāṇi vividhāni ca || nīrājanāṃte pradadau tābhyaḥ prīto nṛpeśvaraḥ || 47 || iti śrīmadgargasaṃhitāyāmaśvamedhakhaṇḍe yajñapūrtau nṛpasyābhiṣekonāma ṣadapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 56 ||
<10.57> garga uvāca tataḥ kṛṣṇena bhīmena prārthayitvā dvijānnṛpān || bhojayāmāsa yadurāḍbhojanairvividhairapi ||1|| sacchaṣkulīpāyasataṇḍulābhaiḥ saṃyāvakāpūpasusūpakādyaiḥ || satpheṇikādyaistu nimantrya viprānsaṃbhojayāmāsa viśeṣamannam ||2|| śikhariṇīghṛtapūrasuśaktikāḥ supaṭinīdadhipūpakalapsikāḥ || suvṛtasuṃdaracandrasuhālikā baṭakamodakaparpaṭakairadāt ||3|| kecitphalāśanāstatra śuṣkaparṇāśanāstathā || kecijjalāśanā viprāḥ keciddūrvārasāśanāḥ ||4|| kecidvātāśanā rājañjanmataśca tapasvinaḥ || bhojanānāṃ ca nāmāni te na jānaṃti vismitāḥ ||5|| bhaktaṃ ca menire kecinmālatyāḥ kusumāni ca || modakām̐śca dvijāḥ keciduduṃbaraphalāni ca ||6|| pāyasaṃ pheṇikāṃ dṛṣṭvā candrabiṃbaṃ ca menire || parpaṭānpheṇikā dṛṣṭvā patrāṇi kiṃśukasya vai ||7|| menire'rkaphalānīti dṛṣṭvā ca madhuśīrṣakān || pralehikāṃ lapsikāṃ ca ṛṣayaścaṃdanadravam ||8|| dṛṣṭvā te miṣṭacūrṇaṃ vai bālukāṃ munisattamāḥ || iti matvā dvijāḥ sarve bubhujurbhojanāni ca ||9|| kecitpibaṃti dugdhaṃ tu keciddrākṣārasaṃ tathā || kecidāmrarasaṃ viprāḥ prahasaṃti luṭhaṃti vai ||10|| tataḥ kṛṣṇastu bhagavānbhīmena prahasanmudā || cakāra hāsyaṃ viprāṇāṃ saṃsthitānāṃ tapasvinām ||11|| bhojanānāṃ ca nāmāni munayo vadata tvaram || tānprayacchāmi yuṣmabhyaṃ bhīmena sahito'pyaham ||12|| śrīkṛṣṇabhīmayorvākyaṃ niśamya munisattamāḥ || na kiṃcidūcurmuditāḥ prapaśyantaḥ parasparam ||13|| tailaṃgakarṇāṭakagurjjarādyānanyāndvijāngauḍasanāḍhyakādīn || saṃpūjya hemāṃbararatnavṛndairnṛpeśvaro vipravarānnanāma ha ||14|| ekalakṣaṃ hayānāṃ ca gajānāṃ ca sahasrakam || dvisahasraṃ rathānāṃ ca gavāṃ lakṣaṃ vidhānataḥ ||15|| śatabhāraṃ suvarṇānāmīdṛśīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ nṛpa || ugrasenastu yajñāṃte pūrvaṃ mahyaṃ dadau kila ||16|| madarddhaṃ bakadālbhyāya dadau vyāsāya vai tathā || turagāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca gajānāṃ śatameva ca ||17|| dviśataṃ syaṃdanānāṃ ca dhenūnāṃ ca sahasrakam || viṃśadbhāraṃ suvarṇānāmīdṛśaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ punaḥ ||18|| nimaṃtritebhyo viprebhya ugraseno dadau mudā || gajamekaṃ rathaṃ gāṃ ca svarṇabhāraṃ ca ghoṭakam ||19|| dvibhāraṃ rajataṃ caiva yādaveṃdraḥ praharṣitaḥ || īdṛśīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ rājanbrāhmaṇe brāhmaṇe dadau ||20|| mahādhvare kṛṣṇapurī tadā babhau mahītale khe hyamarāvatī yathā || tadā''gatā māgadhasūtakādayo vandījanā gāyakavārayoṣitaḥ ||21|| tadā nṛpadvāri mahotsavo'bhūnmṛdaṃgavīṇāmurayaṣṭiveṇubhiḥ || sutālaśaṃkhānakaduṃdubhisvanaiḥ saṃgītanṛttyādikavādyagītakaiḥ ||22|| jaguḥ sukaṇṭhairnanṛtuḥ sutālaiḥ saṃgītagītākṣarasāmagītaiḥ || kausuṃbhavastrāṇi vicālayantyaḥ saṃgītanṛtyena parisphuraṃtyaḥ ||23|| vandījanā māgadhagāyakāśca ye cāgatāstebhya upāgatebhyaḥ || prādāddhiraṇyaṃ bahuratnavṛndaṃ tathā''gatā hyapsarasaśca tābhyaḥ ||24|| sūtebhyo māgadhebhyaśca sarvebhyo bahulaṃ dhanam || vavarṣa ghanavadrājā hayamedhapraharṣitaḥ ||25|| tatpaścādyādaveṃdrastu hyugraseno mahīśvaraḥ || niyutaṃ turagāṇāṃ ca sahasraṃ hastināṃ tathā ||26|| śibikānāṃ śataṃ caiva kuṇḍale kaṭakāni ca || ta triṃśadbhāraṃ suvarṇānāṃ bhūpe bhūpe dadau mudā ||27|| dviguṇena yadūnsarvānnaṃdādīṃścaiva bhūpatiḥ || yaśodādyāśca gopyaśca devakyādyā yadustriyaḥ ||28|| rukmiṇyādyā rādhikādyāḥ paṭṭarājño harerapi || divyāṃbarairalaṃkārai rājñā sarvāśca toṣitāḥ ||29|| punardadau ca gargāya rājā grāmaśataṃ mudā || sa sargo brāhmaṇebhyaśca pradadau hi kramādṛṣiḥ ||30|| tataḥ saṃpūjayāmāsa kṛṣṇaṃ saṃkarṣaṇānvitam || vastrālaṃkāratilakaiḥ sragbhirnīrājanādibhiḥ ||31|| uvāca kṛṣṇaḥ prahasanmahyaṃ rājanmahādhvare || samarthena tvayā hyatra na dattaṃ kiṃcideva hi ||32|| iti śrutvā nṛpaḥ prāha rāmeṇa saha mādhavaḥ || yathoktāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ śīghraṃ gṛhāṇa jagadīśvara ||33|| ityuktvā pradadau rājā harṣitaḥ premavihvalaḥ || phalaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇakare rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ ||34|| tadā jayajayārāvo dvārakāyāṃ babhūva ha || sadyaḥ surāśca saṃtuṣṭāḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ pracakrire ||35|| sarvāśca devatāstuṣṭāḥ prāptabhāgā divaṃgatāḥ || rakṣodaityā daṃṣṭriṇaśca khagā markā bileśayāḥ ||36|| śailā gāvo vṛkṣasaṃghā nadyastīrthāni sindhavaḥ || saṃtuṣṭāḥ prāptabhāgā ye sarve svaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ gatāḥ ||37|| pūjitā dānamānābhyāṃ rājāno ye samāgatāḥ || jagmuḥ svaṃ svaṃ gṛhaṃ sainyaiḥ kaṃpayanto mahītalam ||38|| sarve gopāśca nandādyā yaśodādyā vrajastriyaḥ || kṛṣṇena pūjitā rājanvirahārtā vrajaṃ yayuḥ ||39|| evaṃ rājā yādaveṃdro manorathamahārṇavam || dustaraṃ ca samuttīrya harīṇā''sīdgatavyathaḥ ||40|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe viśvabhojyadakṣiṇāvarṇanaṃ nāma saptapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||57|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.58> śrīgarga uvāca tataḥ sarve samāhūtāḥ śrīkṛṣṇena mahātmanā || vaikuṇṭhādāyayuḥ śīghraṃ kaṃsādyā nava bhrātaraḥ ||1|| dṛṣṭvā tānāgatānsarve vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ || te samāgatya śrīkṛṣṇaṃ balaṃ pradyumnameva ca ||2|| aniruddhaṃ ca kaṃsādyā nemuḥ sarve pṛthakpṛthak || dadarśa cograsenastu sudharmāyāṃ sutānnṛpa ||3|| śakrasiṃhāsanastho vai rucimatyā samanvitaḥ || kaṃsādīnsvasutānprītaḥ kṛṣṇākārāṃścaturbhujān ||4|| śaṃkhacakragadāpadmairbhūṣitānpītavāsasaḥ || kṛṣṇapārśve sthitānputrānāhvayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ||5|| tataḥ kṛṣṇastu bhagavānkaṃsādīnprāha sasmitaḥ || paśya svamātāpitarau yuṣmākaṃ darśanotsukau ||6|| gatvā samīpe he vīrā yūyaṃ namata bhaktitaḥ || iti kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ kṛṣṇabhṛtyā niśamya ca ||7|| ūcuḥ praharṣitāḥ sarve kaṃkanyagrodhakādayaḥ || kaṃsādyā ūcuḥ īdṛśāḥ pitaro'smākamīdṛśyo mātaraśca vai ||8|| bahavaścābhavannātha bhramatāṃ tava māyayā || hariḥ pitā tu jīvasya śrutireṣā sanātanī ||9|| tasmāccānyaṃ na paśyāmo vayaṃ tvannikaṭe sthitāḥ || purā vilokitastvaṃ vai saṃgrāme balasaṃyutaḥ ||10|| paścāñjātau dvārakāyāṃ na dṛṣṭau kārṣṇikārṣṇijau || tasmāddraṣṭuṃ caturvyūhaṃ vayamatra samāgatāḥ ||11|| śrīkṛṣṇo balabhadraśca śrīpradyumna uṣāpatiḥ || paripūrṇatamā ete hyaho'smābhirvilokitāḥ ||12|| kena pūrveṇa puṇyena dṛṣṭo yo durlabhaḥ satām || paripūrṇaścacaturvyūho na jānīmo vayaṃ kila ||13|| he saṃkarṣaṇa he kṛṣṇa he pradyumna uṣāpate || mūḍhānāṃ naḥ kubuddhīnāmaparādhaṃ kṣamasva ca ||14|| gaccha goviṃda vaikuṇṭhaṃ śūnyaṃ te dhāma sundaram || dhanyā tvayā dvārakā tu vaikuṇṭhācca kṛtādhikā ||15|| yadarcitaṃ brahmaśacīśavahnibhirādityagaurīśamarudyamādibhiḥ || paulastyatāreśajaleśapūjitaṃ pādāraviṃdaṃ satataṃ bhajāmahe ||16|| munīṃdralakṣmīsurabhaktasātvataiḥ supūjitaṃ caṃdanagaṃdhadhūpakaiḥ || lājākṣataiścāṃkurapūgacarcitaṃ pādāraviṃdaṃ satataṃ bhajāmahe ||17|| garga uvāca ityuktvā te ca kaṃsādyā vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayurnṛpa || sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ rājā vismito'bhūtsabhāryayā ||18|| iti śrīgargasaṃhitāyāṃ hayamedhakhaṇḍe kaṃsādidarśanaṃ nāmāṣṭapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||58|| hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.59> garga uvāca athograseno nṛpatiḥ putrasyāśāṃ virajya ca | vyāsaṃ papraccha sandehaṃ jñātvā viśvaṃ manomayam || 1 || ugrasena uvāca brahmankena prakāreṇa hitvā ca jagataḥ sukham | bhajetkṛṣṇaṃ paraṃbrahma tanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 2 || vyāsa uvāca tvadagre kathayiṣyāmi satyaṃ hitakaraṃ vacaḥ | ugrasena mahārāja śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥ || 3 || sevanaṃ kuru rājendra rādhāśrīkṛṣṇayoḥ param | nityaṃ sahasranāmabhyāmubhayorbhaktitaḥ kila || 4 || sahasranāma rādhāyā vidhirjānāti bhūpate | śaṅkaro nāradaścaiva kecidvai cāsmadādayaḥ || 5 || ugrasena uvāca rādhikā nāmasāhasraṃ nāradācca purā śrutam | ekānte divyaśibire kurukṣetre ravigrahe || 6 || na śrutaṃ nāmasāhasraṃ kṛṣṇasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ | vada tanme ca kṛpayā yena śreyo'hamāpnuyām || 7 || garga uvāca śrutvograsenavacanaṃ vedavyāso mahāmuniḥ | praśasya taṃ prītamanā prāha kṛṣṇaṃ vilokayan || 8 || vyāsa uvāca śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi sahasraṃ nāma sundaram | purā svadhāmni rādhāyai kṛṣṇenānena nirmitam || 9 || śrībhagavānuvāca idaṃ rahasyaṃ kila gopanīyaṃ datte ca hāniḥ satataṃ bhaveddhi | mokṣapradaṃ sarvasukhapradaṃ śaṃ paraṃ parārthaṃ puruṣārthadaṃ ca || 10 || rūpaṃ ca me kṛṣṇasahasranāma paṭhettu madrūpa iva prasiddhaḥ | dātavyamevaṃ na śaṭhāya kutra na dāmbhikāyopadiśetkadāpi || 11 || dātavyamevaṃ karuṇāvṛtāya gurvaṃghribhaktipraparāyaṇāya | śrīkṛṣṇabhaktāya satāṃ parāya tathā madakrodhavivarjitāya || 12 || oṃ asya śrīkṛṣṇasahasranāmastotramaṃtrasya nārāyaṇaṛṣiḥ | bhujaṅgaprayātaṃ chandaḥ | śrīkṛṣṇacandro devatā | vāsudevo bījaṃ | śrīrādhā śaktiḥ | manmathaḥ kīlakaṃ | śrīpūrṇabrahmakṛṣṇacandrabhaktijanmaphalaprāptaye jape viniyogaḥ || || chaṃdaḥ śrībhujaṅgaprayāta atha dhyānam śikhimukuṭaviśeṣaṃ nīlapadmāṅgadeśaṃ vidhumukhakṛtakeśaṃ kaustubhāpītaveśam | madhuraravakaleśaṃ śaṃ bhaje bhrātṛśeṣaṃ vrajajanavaniteśaṃ mādhavaṃ rādhikeśam || 13 || iti dhyānam harirdevakīnandanaḥ kaṃsahaṃtā parātmā ca pītāmbaraḥ pūrṇadevaḥ | rameśastu kṛṣṇaḥ pareśaḥ purāṇaḥ sureśo'cyuto vāsudevaśca devaḥ || 14 || dharābhārahartā kṛtī rādhikeśaḥ paro bhūvaro divyagolokanāthaḥ | sudāmnastathā rādhikāśāpaheturghṛṇī māninī mānado divyalokaḥ || 15 || lasadgopaveṣo hyajo rādhikātmā calatkuṇḍalaḥ kuntalī kuntalasrak | rathasthaḥ kadā rādhayā divyaratnaḥ sudhāsaudhabhūcāraṇo divyavāsāḥ || 16 || kadā vṛndakāraṇyacārī svaloke mahāratnasiṃhāsanasthaḥ praśāntaḥ | mahāhaṃsabhaiścāmarairvījyamānaścalacchatramuktāvalīśobhamānaḥ || 17 || sukhī koṭikandarpalīlābhirāmaḥ kvaṇannūpurālaṅkṛtāṃghriḥ śubhāṃghriḥ | sujānuśca raṃbhāśubhoruḥ kṛśāṅgaḥ pratāpī bhuśuṇḍāsudordaṇḍakhaṇḍaḥ || 18 || japāpuṣpahastaśca śātodaraśrīrmahāpadmavakṣasthalaścandrahāsaḥ | lasatkundadantaśca bimbādharaśrīḥ śaratpadmanetraḥ kirīṭojjvalābhaḥ || 19 || sakhīkoṭibhirvartamāno nikuñje priyārādhayā rāsasakto navāṅgaḥ | dharābrahmarudrādibhiḥ prārthitaḥ saddharābhāradūrīkṛto'rthaṃ prajātaḥ || 20 || yadurdevakīsaukhyado bandhanacchitsaśeṣo vibhuryogamāyī ca viṣṇuḥ | vraje nandaputro yaśodāsutākhyo mahāsaukhyado bālarūpaḥ śubhāṅgaḥ || 21 || tathā pūtanā mokṣadaḥ śyāmarūpo dayālustvanobhañjanaḥ pallavāṃghriḥ | tṛṇāvarttasaṃhārakārī ca gopo yaśodāyaśo viśvarūpapradarśī || 22 || tathā gargadiṣṭaśca bhāgyodayaśrīrlasadbālakeliḥ sarāmaḥ suvācaḥ | kvaṇannūpuraiḥ śabdayugriṅgamāṇastathā jānuhastairvrajeśāṅgaṇe vā || 23 || dadhispṛkca haiyaṅgavīdugdhabhoktā dadhisteyakṛddugdhabhugbhāṇḍabhettā | mṛdaṃ bhuktavāngopajo viśvarūpaḥ pracaṇḍāṃśucaṇḍaprabhāmaṇḍitāṅgaḥ || 24 || yaśodākarairbaṃdhanaṃ prāpta ādyo maṇigrīvamuktiprado dāmabaddhaḥ | kadā nṛtyamāno vraje gopikābhiḥ kadā nandasannandakairlālyamānaḥ || 25 || kadā gopanandāṃkagopālarūpī kalindāṅgajākūlago varttamānaḥ | ghanairmārutaiścchinnabhāṇḍīradeśe gṛhīto varo rādhayā nandahastāt || 26 || nikuñje ca golokalokāgate'pi mahāratnasaṅghaiḥ kadambāvṛte'pi | tadā brahmaṇā rādhikāsadvivāhe pratiṣṭhāṃ gataḥ pūjitaḥ sāmamaṃtraiḥ || 27 || rasī rāsayuṅmālatīnāṃ vane'pi priyārādhayā rādhitārthaṃ rameśaḥ | dharānātha ānandadaḥ śrīniketo vaneśo dhanī sundaro gopikeśaḥ || 28 || kadā rādhayā prāpito nandagehe yaśodākarairlālito mandahāsaḥ | bhayī kvāpi vṛndārakāraṇyavāsī mahāmandire vāsakṛddevapūjyaḥ || 29 || vane vatsacārī mahāvatsahārī bakāriḥ suraiḥ pūjito'ghārināmā | vane vatsakṛdgopakṛdgopaveṣaḥ kadā brahmaṇā saṃstutaḥ padmanābhaḥ || 30 || vihārī tathā tālabhugdhenukārī sadā rakṣako goviṣārttipraṇāśī | kalindāṅgajākūlagaḥ kāliyasya damī nṛtyakārī phaṇeṣvaprasiddhaḥ || 31 || salīlaḥ śamījñānadaḥ kāmapūrastathā gopayuggopa ānandakārī | sthirī hyagnibhukpālako bālalīlaḥ surāgaśca vaṃśīdharaḥ puṣpaśīlaḥ || 32 || pralambaprabhānāśako gauravarṇo balo rohiṇījaśca rāmaśca śeṣaḥ | balī padmanetraśca kṛṣṇāgrajaśca dhareśaḥ phaṇīśastu nīlāmbarābhaḥ || 33 || mahāsaukhyado hyagnihāravrajeśaḥ śaradgrīṣmavarṣākaraḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ | vraje gopikāpūjitaścīrahartā kadambe sthitaścīradaḥ sundarīśaḥ || 34 || kṣudhānāśakṛdyajñapatnīmanaspṛkkṛpākārakaḥ kelikartāvanīśaḥ | vraje śakrayāgapraṇāśī mitāśī śunāsīramohaprado bālarūpī || 35 || gireḥpūjako nandaputro hyagadhraḥ kṛpākṛcca govardhanoddhārināmā | tathā vātavarṣāharo rakṣakaśca vrajādhīśagopāṅganāśaṅkitaḥ san || 36 || agendropari śakrapūjyaḥ stutaḥ prāṅ mṛṣāśikṣako deva govindanāmā | vrajādhīśarakṣākaraḥ pāśipūjyo'nujairgopajairdivyavaikuṇṭhadarśī || 37 || calaccāruvaṃśīkvaṇaḥ kāminīśo vraje kāmīnīmohadaḥ kāmarūpaḥ | rasākto rasī rāsakṛdrādhikeśo mahāmohado māninīmānahārī || 38 || vihārī varo mānahṛdrādhikāṅgo dharādvīpagaḥ khaṇḍacārī vanasthaḥ | priyo hyaṣṭavakrarṣidraṣṭā sarādho mahāmokṣadaḥ padmahārī priyārthaḥ || 39 || vaṭasthaḥ suraścandanāktaḥ prasakto vrajaṃ hyāgato rādhayā mohinīṣu | mahāmohakṛdgopikāgītakīrtī rathasthaḥ paṭī duḥkhitākāminīśaḥ || 40 || vane gopikātyāgakṛtpādacihnapradarśī kalākāraḥ kāmamohī | vaśī gopikāmadhyagaḥ peśavācaḥ priyāprītikṛdrāsaraktaḥ kaleśaḥ || 41 || rasāraktacitto hyanantasvarūpaḥ srajā saṃvṛto ballavīmadhyasaṃsthaḥ | subāhuḥ supādaḥ suveśaḥ sukeśo vrajeśaḥ sakhā vallabheśaḥ sudeśaḥ || 42 || kvaṇatkiṅkiṇījālabhṛnnūpurāḍhyo lasatkaṅkaṇo hyaṅgadī hārabhāraḥ | kirīṭī calatkuṇḍalaścāṅgulīyasphuratkaustubho mālatīmaṇḍitāṅgaḥ || 43 || mahānṛtyakṛdrāsaraṅgaḥ kalāḍhyaścaladdhārabho bhāminīnṛtyayuktaḥ | kalindāṅgajākelikṛtkuṃkumaśrīḥ surairnāyikānāyakairgīyamānaḥ || 44 || sukhāḍhyastu rādhāpatiḥ pūrṇabodhaḥ kaṭākṣasmitī valgitabhrūvilāsaḥ | suramyo'libhiḥ kuntalālolakeśaḥ sphuradbarhakundasrajā cāruveṣaḥ || 45 || mahāsarpato nandarakṣāparāṃghriḥ sadā mokṣadaḥ śaṅkhacūḍapraṇāśī | prajārakṣako gopikāgīyamānaḥ kakudmipraṇāśaprayāsaḥ surejyaḥ || 46 || kaliḥ krodhakṛtkaṃsamaṃtropadeṣṭā tathākrūramaṃtropadeśī surārthaḥ | balī keśihā puṣpavarṣo'malaśrīstathā nāradāddarśito vyomahantā || 47 || tathākrūrasevāparaḥ sarvadarśī vraje gopikāmohadaḥ kūlavartī | satī rādhikābodhadaḥ svapnakartā vilāsī mahāmohanāśī svabodhaḥ || 48 || vraje śāpatastyaktarādhāsakāśo mahāmohadāvāgnidagdhaḥ patiśca | sakhībandhanānmohitākrūra ārātsakhīkaṅkaṇaistāḍitākrūrarakṣī || 49 || rathastho vraje rādhayā kṛṣṇacandraḥ sugupto gamī gopakaiścārulīlaḥ | jale'krūrasandarśito divyarūpo didṛkṣuḥ purīmohinīcittamohī || 50 || tathā raṅgakārapraṇāśī suvastraḥ srajī vāyakaprītikṛnmālipūjyaḥ | mahākīrtidaścāpi kubjāvinodī sphuraccaṇḍakodaṇḍarugṇapracaṇḍaḥ || 51 || bhaṭārtipradaḥ kaṃsaduḥsvapnakārī mahāmallaveṣaḥ karīndraprahārī | mahāmātyahā raṅgabhūmipraveśī rasāḍhyo yaśaḥspṛgbalī vākpaṭuśrīḥ || 52 || mahāmallahā yuddhakṛtstrīvaco'rthī dharānāyakaḥ kaṃsahantā yaduḥ prāk | sadā pūjito hyugrasenaprasiddho dharārājyado yādavairmaṇḍitāṅgaḥ || 53 || guroḥ putrado brahmavidbrahmapāṭhī mahāśaṅkhahā daṇḍadhṛkpūjya eva | vraje hyuddhavapreṣito gopamohī yaśodāghṛṇī gopikājñānadeśī || 54 || sadā snehakṛtkubjayā pūjitāṅgastathākrūragehaṃgamī maṃtravettā | tathā pāṇḍavapreṣitā'krūra eva sukhī sarvadarśī nṛpānandakārī || 55 || mahākṣauhiṇīhā jarāsandhamānī nṛpo dvārakākārako mokṣakartā | raṇī sārvabhaumastuto jñānadātā jarāsandhasaṅkalpakṛddhāvadaṃghriḥ || 56 || nagādutpataddvārikāmadhyavartī tathā revatībhūṣaṇastālacihnaḥ | yadū rukmiṇīhārakaścaidyavedyastathā rukmirūpapraṇāśī sukhāśī || 57 || anantaśca māraśca kārṣṇiśca kāmo manojastathā śambarārī ratīśaḥ | rathī manmatho mīnaketuḥ śarī ca smaro darpako mānahā pañcabāṇaḥ || 58 || priyaḥ satyabhāmāpatiryādaveśo'tha satrājitapremapūraḥ prahāsaḥ | mahāratnado jāmbavadyuddhakārī mahācakradhṛkkhaḍgadhṛgrāmasaṃdhiḥ || 59 || vihārasthitaḥ pāṇḍavapremakārī kalindāṅgajāmohanaḥ khāṇḍavārthī | sakhā phālgunaprītikṛnnagrakartā tathā mitravindāpatiḥ krīḍanārthī || 60 || nṛpapremakṛdgojitaḥ saptarūpo'tha satyāpatiḥ pāribarhī yatheṣṭaḥ | nṛpaiḥ saṃvṛtaścāpi bhadrāpatistu vilāsī madhormāninīśo janeśaḥ || 61 || śunāsīramohāvṛtaḥ satsabhāryaḥ satārkṣyo murāriḥ purīsaṅghabhettā | suvīraḥśiraḥkhaṇḍano daityanāśī śarī bhaumahā caṇḍavegaḥ pravīraḥ || 62 || dharāsaṃstutaḥ kuṇḍalacchatrahartā mahāratnayugrājakanyābhirāmaḥ | śacīpūjitaḥ śakrajinmānahartā tathā pārijātāpahārī rameśaḥ || 63 || gṛhī cāmaraiḥ śobhito bhīṣmakanyāpatirhāsyakṛnmāninīmānakārī | tathā rukmiṇīvākpaṭuḥ premagehaḥ satīmohanaḥ kāmadevāparaśrīḥ || 64 || sudeṣṇaḥ sucārustathā cārudeṣṇo'paraścārudeho balī cāruguptaḥ | sutī bhadracārustathā cārucandro vicāruśca cārū rathī putrarūpaḥ || 65 || subhānuḥ prabhānustathā candrabhānurbṛhadbhānurevāṣṭabhānuśca sāmbaḥ | sumitraḥ kratuścitraketustu vīro'śvaseno vṛṣaścitraguścandrabimbaḥ || 66 || viśaṅkurvasuśca śruto bhadra ekaḥ subāhurvṛṣaḥ pūrṇamāsastu somaḥ | varaḥ śāntireva praghoṣo'tha siṃho balo hyūrdhvagovardhanonnāda eva || 67 || mahāśo vṛkaḥ pāvano vahnimitraḥ kṣudhirharṣakaścānilo'mitrajicca | subhadro jayaḥ satyako vāma āyuryaduḥ koṭiśaḥ putrapautraprasiddhaḥ || 68 || halī daṇḍadhṛgrukmihā cāniruddhastathā rājabhirhāsyago dyūtakartā | madhurbrahmasūrbāṇaputrīpatiśca mahāsundaraḥ kāmaputro balīśaḥ || 69 || mahādaityasaṃgrāmakṛdyādaveśaḥ purībhañjano bhūtasaṃtrāsakārī | mṛdhī rudrajidrudramohī mṛdhārthī tathā skandajitkūpakarṇaprahārī || 70 || dhanurbhañjano bāṇamānaprahārī jvarotpattikṛtsaṃstutastu jvareṇa | bhujāchedakṛdbāṇasaṃtrāsakartā mṛḍaprastuto yuddhakṛdbhūmibhartā || 71 || nṛgaṃ muktido jñānado yādavānāṃ rathastho vrajapremapo gopamukhyaḥ | mahāsundarīkrīḍitaḥ puṣpamālī kalindāṅgajābhedanaḥ sīrapāṇiḥ || 72 || mahādaṃbhihā pauṇḍramānaprahārī śiraśchedakaḥ kāśirājapraṇāśī | mahākṣauhiṇīdhvaṃsakṛccakrahastaḥ purīdīpako rākṣasīnāśakartā || 73 || ananto mahīdhraḥ phaṇī vānarāriḥ sphuradgauravarṇo mahāpadmanetraḥ | kurugrāmatiryyaggato gauravārthaḥ stutaḥ kauravaiḥ pāribarhī sasāmbaḥ || 74 || mahāvaibhavo dvārakeśo hyanekaścalannāradaḥ śrīprabhādarśakastu | maharṣistuto brahmadevaḥ purāṇaḥ sadā ṣoḍaśastrīsahasrasthitaśca || 75 || || gṛhī lokarakṣāparo lokarītiḥ prabhurhyugrasenāvṛto durgayuktaḥ | tathā rājadūtastato bandhabhettā sthito nāradaprastutaḥ pāṇḍavārthī || 76 || nṛpairmantrakṛdhyuddhavaprītipūrṇo vṛtaḥ putrapautraiḥ kurugrāmagantā | ghṛṇī dharmarājastuto bhīmayuktaḥ parānandado maṃtrakṛddharmajena || 77 || diśājidbalī rājasūyārthakārī jarāsandhahā bhīmasenasvarūpaḥ | tathā viprarūpo gadāyuddhakartā kṛpālurmahābandhanacchedakārī || 78 || nṛpaiḥ saṃstuto hyāgato dharmagehaṃ dvijaiḥ saṃvṛto yajñasaṃbhārakartā | janaiḥ pūjitaścaidyadurvākkṣamaśca mahāmohado'reḥ śiraścchedakārī || 79 || mahāyajñaśobhākaraścakravartī nṛpānandakārī vihārī surārī | sabhāsaṃvṛto mānahṛtkauravasya tathā śālvasaṃhārako yānahantā || 80 || sabhojaśca vṛṣṇirmadhuḥ śūraseno daśārho yadurhyaṃdhako lokajicca | dyumanmānahā varmadhṛgdivyaśastrī svabodhaḥ sadā rakṣako daityahantā || 81 || tathā dantavaktrapraṇāśī gadā dhṛgjagattīrthayātrākaraḥ padmahāraḥ | kuśī sūtahantā kṛpākṛtsmṛtīśo'malo balvalāṅgaprabhākhaṇḍakārī || 82 || tathā bhīmaduryodhanajñānadātāparo rohiṇīsaukhyado revatīśaḥ | mahādānakṛdvipradāridryahā ca sadā premayukśrīsudāmnaḥ sahāyaḥ || 83 || tathā bhārgavakṣetragantā sarāmo'tha sūryoparāgaśrutaḥ sarvadarśī | mahāsenayā cāsthitaḥ snānayukto mahādānakṛnmitrasammelanārthī || 84 || tathā pāṇḍavaprītidaḥ kuntijārthī viśālākṣamohapradaḥ śāntidaśca | vaṭe rādhikārādhano gopikābhiḥ sakhīkoṭibhī rādhikāprāṇanāthaḥ || 85 || sakhīmohadāvāgnihā vaibhaveśaḥ sphuratkoṭikandarpalīlāviśeṣaḥ | sakhīrādhikāduḥkhanāśī vilāsī sakhīmadhyagaḥ śāpahā mādhavīśaḥ || 86 || śataṃ varṣavikṣepahṛnnandaputrastathā nandavakṣogataḥ śītalāṅgaḥ | yaśodāśucaḥ snānakṛdduḥkhahantā sadāgopikānetralagno vrajeśaḥ || 87 || stuto devakīrohiṇībhyāṃ surendro raho gopikājñānado mānadaśca | tathā saṃstutaḥ paṭṭarājñībhirārāddhanī lakṣmaṇāprāṇanāthaḥ sadā hi || 88 || tribhiḥ ṣoḍaśastrīsahasrastutāṅgaḥ śuko vyāsadevaḥ sumantuḥ sitaśca | bharadvājako gautamo hyāsuriḥ sadvasiṣṭhaḥ śatānanda ādyaḥ sarāmaḥ || 89 || muniḥ parvato nārado dhaumya indro'sito'trirvibhāṇḍaḥ pracetāḥ kṛpaśca | kumāraḥ sanandastathā yājñavalkyo ṛbhurhyaṅgirā devalaḥ śrīmṛkaṇḍaḥ || 90 || marīcī kratuścaurvako lomaśaśca pulastyo bhṛgurbrahmarāto vasiṣṭhaḥ | naraścāpi nārāyaṇo datta eva tathā pāṇiniḥ piṅgalo bhāṣyakāraḥ || 91 || sakātyāyano viprapātañjaliścātha gargo gururgīṣpatirgautamīśaḥ | munirjājaliḥ kaśyapo gālavaśca dvijaḥ saubhariścarṣyaśṛṅgaśca kaṇvaḥ || 92 || dvitaścaikataścāpi jātūdbhavaśca ghanaḥ kardamasyātmajaḥ kardamaśca | tathā bhārgavaḥ kautsakaścāruṇastu śuciḥ pippalādo mṛkaṇḍasya putraḥ || 93 || sapailaḥstathā jaiminiḥ satsumanturvaro gāṅgalaḥ sphoṭagehaḥ phalādaḥ | sadā pūjito brāhmaṇaḥ sarvarūpī munīśo mahāmohanāśo'maraḥ prāk || 94 || munīśastutaḥ śaurivijñānadātā mahāyajñakṛccābhṛtasnānapūjyaḥ | sadā dakṣiṇādo nṛpaiḥ pāribarhī vrajānandado dvārikāgehadarśī || 95 || mahājñānado devakīputradaścāsuraiḥ pūjito'hīndrasenādṛtaśca | sadā phālgunaprītikṛtsatsubhadrāvivāhe dvipāśvaprado mānayānaḥ || 96 || bhuvaṃ darśako maithilena prayukto dvijenāśu rājñā sthito brāhmaṇaiśca | kṛtī maithile lokavedopadeśī sadāvedavākyaiḥ stutaḥ śeṣaśāyī || 97 || parīkṣāvṛto brāhmaṇaiścāmareṣu bhṛguprārthito daityahā ceśarakṣī | sakhā cārjunasyāpi mānaprahārī tathā vipraputraprado dhāmagantā || 98 || vihārasthito mādhavībhiḥ kalāṅgo mahāmohadāvāgnidagdhābhirāmaḥ | yadurhyugraseno nṛpo'krūra eva tathā coddhavaḥ śūrasenaśca śūraḥ || 99 || hṛdīkaśca satrājitaścāprameyo gadaḥ sāraṇaḥ sātyakirdevabhāgaḥ | tathā mānasaḥ sañjayaḥ śyāmakaśca vṛko vatsako devako bhadrasenaḥ || 100 || nṛpo'jātaśatrurjayo mādriputro'tha bhīṣmaḥ kṛpo buddhicakṣuśca pāṇḍuḥ | tathā śantanurdevabāhlīka evātha bhūriśravāścitravīryo vicitraḥ || 101 || śalaścāpi duryodhanaḥ karṇa eva subhadrāsuto viṣṇurātaḥ prasiddhaḥ | sa janmejayaḥ pāṇḍavaḥ kauravaśca tathā sarvatejā hariḥ sarvarūpī || 102 || vrajaṃ hyāgato rādhayā pūrṇadevo varo rāsalīlāparo divyarūpī | rathastho navadvīpakhaṇḍapradarśī mahāmānado gopajo viśvarūpaḥ || 103 || sanandaśca nando vṛṣo vallabheśaḥ sudāmārjunaḥ saubalastoka eva | sa kṛṣṇoṃ'śukaḥ sadviśālarṣabhākhyaḥ sutejasvikaḥ kṛṣṇamitro varūthaḥ || 104 || kuśeśo vaneśastu vṛndāvaneśastathā māthureśādhipo gokuleśaḥ | sadāgogaṇo gopatirgopikeśo'tha govardhano gopatiḥ kanyakeśaḥ || 105 || anādistu cātmā hariḥ pūruṣaśca paro nirguṇo jyotirūpo nirīhaḥ | sadā nirvikāraḥ prapañcātparaśca sa satyastu pūrṇaḥ pareśastu sūkṣmaḥ || 106 || dvārakāyāṃ tathā cāśvamedhasya kartā nṛpeṇāpi pautreṇa bhūbhārahartā | punaḥ śrīvraje rāsaraṅgasya kartā harīrādhayā gopikānāṃ ca bhartā || 107 || sadaikastvanekaḥ prabhāpūritāṅgastathā yogamāyākaraḥ kālajicca | sudṛṣṭirmahattattvarūpaḥ prajātaḥ sakūṭastha ādyāṅkuro vṛkṣarūpaḥ || 108 || vikārasthitaśca hyahaṅkāra eva sa vai kārakastaijasastāmasaśca | namo diksamīrastu sūryaḥ praceto'śvivahniśca śakro hyupendrastu mitraḥ || 109 || śrutistvakca dṛgghrāṇajihvāgiraśca bhujāmeḍhrakaḥ pāyuraṅghriḥ saceṣṭaḥ | dharāvyomavārmārutaścaiva tejo'tha rūpaṃ raso gandhaśabdaspṛśaśca || 110 || sacittaśca buddhirvirāṭ kālarūpastathā vāsudevo jagatkṛddhatāṅgaḥ | tathāṇḍe śayānaḥ saśeṣaḥ sahasrasvarūpo ramānātha ādyo'vatāraḥ || 111 || sadā sargakṛtpadmajaḥ karmakartā tathā nābhipadmodbhavo divyavarṇaḥ | kavirlokakṛtkālakṛtsūryarūpo nimeṣo bhavo vatsarānto mahīyān || 112 || tithirvāranakṣatrayogāśca lagno'tha māso ghaṭī ca kṣaṇaḥ kāṣṭhikā ca | muhūrtastu yāmo grahā yāminī ca dinaṃ carkṣamālāgato devaputraḥ || 113 || kṛto dvāparastu tritastatkalistu sahasraṃ yugastatra manvantaraśca | layaḥ pālanaṃ satkṛtistatparārdhaṃ sadotpattikṛddvyakṣaro brahmarūpaḥ || 114 || tathā rudrasargastu kaumārasargo muneḥ sargakṛddevakṛtprākṛtastu | śrutistu smṛtiḥ stotramevaṃ purāṇaṃ dhanurveda ijyātha gāndharvavedaḥ || 115 || vidhātā ca nārāyaṇaḥ satkumāro varāhastathā nārado dharmaputraḥ | muniḥ kardamasyātmajo datta eva sa yajño'maro nābhijaḥ śrīpṛthuśca || 116 || sumatsyaśca kūrmaśca dhanvantariśca tathā mohinī nārasiṃhaḥ pratāpī | dvijo vāmano reṇukāputrarūpo munirvyāsadevaḥ śrutistotrakartā || 117 || dhanurvedabhāgrāmacandrāvatāraḥ sasītāpatirbhārahṛdrāvaṇāriḥ | nṛpaḥ setukṛdvānarendraprahārī mahāyajñakṛdrāghavendraḥ pracaṇḍaḥ || 118 || balaḥ kṛṣṇacandrastu kalkiḥ kaleśastu buddhaḥ prasiddhastu haṃsastathāśvaḥ | ṛṣīndro'jito devavaikuṇṭhanātho hyamūrtiśca manvantarasyāvatāraḥ || 119 || gajoddhāraṇaḥ śrīmanurbrahmaputro nṛpendrastu duṣyantajo dānaśīlaḥ | sadṛṣṭaḥ śruto bhūta evaṃ bhaviṣyadbhavatsthāvaro jaṅgamo'lpaṃ mahacca || 120 || iti śrībhujaṅgaprayātena coktaṃ hare rādhikeśasya nāmnāṃ sahasram | paṭhedbhaktiyukto dvijaḥ sarvadā hi kṛtārtho bhavetkṛṣṇacandrasvarūpaḥ || 121 || mahāpāparāśiṃ bhinatti śrutaṃ yatsadā vaiṣṇavānāṃ priyaṃ maṅgalaṃ ca | idaṃ rāsarākādine cāśvinasya tathā kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīmadhya eva || 122 || tathā caitramāsasya rākādine vātha bhādre ca rādhāṣṭamīsaddine vā | paṭhedbhaktiyuktastvidaṃ pūjayitvā caturdhā sumuktiṃ tanoti praśastaḥ || 123 || paṭhetkṛṣṇapuryāṃ ca vṛndāvane vā vraje gokule vāpi vaṃśīvaṭe vā | vaṭe vā kṣaye vā taṭe sūryaputryāḥ sa bhakto'tha golokadhāma prayāti || 124 || bhajedbhaktibhāvācca sarvatra bhūmau hariṃ kutra cānena gehe vane vā | jahāti kṣaṇaṃ no haristaṃ ca bhaktaṃ suvaśyo bhavenmādhavaḥ kṛṣṇacandraḥ || 125 || sadā gopanīyaṃ sadā gopanīyaṃ sadā gopanīyaṃ prayatnena bhaktaiḥ | prakāśyaṃ na nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ hareśca na dātavyamevaṃ kadā lampaṭāya || 126 || idaṃ pustakaṃ yatra gehe'pi tiṣṭhedvasedrādhikānātha ādyastu tatra | tathā ṣaḍguṇāḥ siddhayo dvādaśāpi guṇaistriṃśatairlakṣaṇaistu prayānti || 127 || iti śrīmadgargasaṃhitāyāmaśvamedhakhaṇḍe śrīkṛṣṇasahasranāmavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 59 || hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.60> śrīgarga uvāca iti śrutvā vyāsamukhātkṛṣṇanāmnāṃ sahasrakam | saṃpūjya taṃ yādavendro bhaktyā kṛṣṇe mano dadhe || 1 || tataḥ sa mithilāyāṃ ca bahulāśvaśrutadevayoḥ | dattvā svadarśanaṃ kṛṣṇa āyayau dvārakāṃ purīm || 2 || tataśca pāṃḍavāḥ sarve draupadyā saha bhāryayā | dvārakāyā vinirgatya viceruste vane vane || 3 || bhuktvā ca vanavāsaṃ te'jñātavāsaṃ tathaiva ca | virāṭanagare sarve sasainyāste'bhavannṛpa || 4 || tataśca kauravāḥ sarve śrīkṛṣṇenāpi prārthitāḥ | na teṣāṃ pradadū rājyamardhārdhaṃ ca tadardhakam || 5 || pāṃḍavānāṃ kauravāṇāṃ jñātvā yuddhaṃ janārdanaḥ | nirāyudho'bhūdyātrāyāṃ balo'hansūtabalvalau || 6 || tataḥ sarve kurukṣetre dharmakṣetre praviśya ca | kauravāḥ pāṃḍavāścaiva yuddhaṃ cakruḥ parasparam || 7 || jayaḥ kṛṣṇasya kṛpayā pāṃḍavānāṃ babhūva ha | bhārate ca mṛtāḥ sarve kauravāḥ kṛtakilbiṣāḥ || 8 || tataśca nava varṣāṇi dharmo rājyaṃ cakāra ha | hayamedhatrayaṃ cakre tena śuddho'bhavannṛpaḥ || 9 || tataḥ kṛṣṇecchayā rājandvārakāyāṃ kilaikadā | yādavebhyaśca sarvebhyo vipraśāpo'bhavanmahān || 10 || tataḥ kṛṣṇastu bhagavānprapannāyoddhavāya ca | aśvatthe kathayāmāsa śrīmadbhāgavataṃ param || 11 || tato babhūva saṃgrāmo yādavānāṃ parasparam | nihatāste prabhāse vai śastrairnānāvidhairapi || 12 || balaḥ śarīraṃ mānuṣyaṃ tyaktvā dhāma jagāma ha | devām̐statrāgatāndṛṣṭvā hariraṃtaradhīyata || 13 || vraje gatvā harirnaṃdaṃ yaśodāṃ rādhikāṃ tathā | gopāngopīrmilitvā''ha premṇā premī priyānsvakān || 14 || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca gaccha naṃda yaśode tvaṃ putrabuddhiṃ vihāya ca | golokaṃ paramaṃ dhāma sārdhaṃ gokulavāsibhiḥ || 15 || agre kaliyugo ghoraścāgamiṣyati duḥkhadaḥ | yasminvai pāpino martyā bhaviṣyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 16 || strīpuṃsorniyamo nāsti varṇānāṃ ca tathaiva ca | tasmādgacchāśu maddhāma jarāmṛtyuharaṃ param || 17 || iti bruvati śrīkṛṣṇe rathaṃ ca paramādbhutam | pañcayojanavistīrṇaṃ pañcayojanamūrdhvagam || 18 || vajranirmalasaṃkāśaṃ muktāratnavibhūṣitam | mandirairnavalakṣaiśca dīpairmaṇimayairyutam || 19 || sahasradvayacakraṃ ca sahasradvayaghoṭakam | sūkṣmavastrācchāditaṃ ca sakhīkoṭibhirāvṛtam || 20 || golokādāgataṃ gopā dadṛśuste mudānvitāḥ | etasminnaṃtare tatra kṛṣṇadehādvinirgataḥ || 21 || devaścaturbhujo rājankoṭimanmathasannibhaḥ | śaṃkhacakradharaḥ śrīmām̐llakṣmyā sārdhaṃ jagatpatiḥ || 22 || kṣīrodaṃ prayayau śīghraṃ rathamāruhya suṃdaram | tathā ca viṣṇurūpeṇa śrīkṛṣṇo bhagavān hariḥ || 23 || lakṣmyā garuḍamāruhya vaikuṇṭhaṃ prayayau nṛpa | tato bhūtvā hariḥ kṛṣṇo naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī || 24 || kalyāṇārthaṃ narāṇāṃ ca prayayau badrikāśramam | paripūrṇatamaḥ sākṣācchrīkṛṣṇo rādhayā yutaḥ || 25 || golokādāgataṃ yānamāruroha jagatpatiḥ | sarve gopāśca nandādyā yaśodādyā vrajastriyaḥ || 26 || tyaktvā tatra śarīrāṇi divyadehāśca te'bhavan | sthāpayitvā rathe divye naṃdādīnbhagavānhariḥ || 27 || golokaṃ prayayau śīghraṃ gopālo gokulānvitaḥ | brahmāṃḍebhyo bahirgatvā dadarśa virajāṃ nadīm || 28 || śeṣotsaṃge mahālokaṃ sukhadaṃ duḥkhanāśanam | dṛṣṭvā rathātsamuttīrya sārdhaṃ gokulavāsibhiḥ || 29 || viveśa rādhayā kṛṣṇaḥ paśyannyagrodhamakṣayam | śataśṛṅgaṃ girivaraṃ tathā śrīrāsamaṇḍalam || 30 || tato yayau kiyaddūraṃ śrīmadvṛndāvanaṃ vanam | vanairdvādaśabhiryuktaṃ drumaiḥ kāmadughairvṛtam || 31 || nadyā yamunayā yuktaṃ vasaṃtānilamaṃḍitam | puṣpakuñjanikuñjaṃ ca gopīgopajanairvṛtam || 32 || tadā jayajayārāvaḥ śrīgoloke babhūva ha | śūnyībhūte purā dhāmni śrīkṛṣṇe ca samāgate || 33 || tataśca yadupatnyaśca citāmāruhya duḥkhataḥ | patilokaṃ yayuḥ sarvā devakyādyāśca yoṣitaḥ || 34 || baṃdhūnāṃ naṣṭagotrāṇāṃ cakāra sāṃparāyikam | gītājñānena svātmānaṃ śāṃtayitvā sa duḥkhataḥ || 35 || arjunaḥ svapuraṃ gatvā tamuvāca yudhiṣṭhiram | sa rājā bhrātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ yayau svargaṃ ca bhāryayā || 36 || plāvayaddvārakāṃ sindhū raivatena samanvitām | vihāya nṛpaśārdūla gehaṃ śrīrukmaṇīpateḥ || 37 || adyāpi śrūyate ghoṣo dvārvatyāmarṇave hareḥ | avidyo vā savidyo vā brāhmaṇo māmakī tanuḥ || 38 || viṣṇusvāmī raveraṃśaḥ kalerādau mahārṇave | gatvā nītvā harerarcāṃ dvārvatyāṃ sthāpayiṣyati || 39 || taṃ dvārakeśaṃ paśyaṃti manujā ye kalau yuge | sarve kṛtārthatāṃ yāṃti tatra gatvā nṛpeśvaraḥ || 40 || yaḥ śṛṇoti caritraṃ vai golokārohaṇaṃ hareḥ | muktiṃ yadūnāṃ gopānāṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 41 || iti śrīmadgargasaṃhitāyāmaśvamedhakhaṇḍe rādhākṛṣṇayorgolokārohaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 60 || hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.61> vajranābhiruvāca brahmannārāyaṇo kṛṣṇo bhagavānprakṛteḥ paraḥ | tasya rūpaṃ kathaṃ śyāmaṃ tanme vyākhyātumarhasi || 1 || tvādṛśā munayo bahmañjānaṃti caritaṃ hareḥ | tathā kṛṣṇasya devasya na vayaṃ karmamohitāḥ || 2 || sūta uvāca ityākarṇya vacastena saṃstutaḥ sa munirmune | tattvajñānāya tattvajñaḥ karuṇaḥ pratyabhāṣata || 3 || garga uvāca śyāmaṃ tu śṛṅgārarasasya rūpaṃ śrīkṛṣṇadevaṃ kathitaṃ munīṃdraiḥ | lāvaṇyasaṃghācca tathojjvalatvācchyāmaṃ surūpaṃ hi tathā hareśca || 4 || yathā dūrato dṛśyate śyāmarūpaṃ ghaṭāyāstathedaṃ nadasyāpi garte | yathā''kāśarūpaṃ mahacchyāmalaṃ vā jalaṃ cāmbaraṃ cojjvalaṃ nāpi kṛṣṇam || 5 || yathā dhautavastre pare śyāmalā hi chavirdṛśyate caiva bhāvaiḥ parasya | tathā koṭikaṃdarpalīlāśayatvāddhareḥ śyāmarūpaṃ tu saṃto vadaṃti || 6 || vajranābhiruvāca tava vākyānmuniśreṣṭha saṃdehaśca gato mama | agre brahmankalirghora āgamiṣyati bhūtale || 7 || tasminmartyāḥ kīdṛśāśca bhaviṣyanti mune vada | tvaṃ jānāsi bhaviṣyaṃ ca tasmāttvāṃ praṇamāmyaham || 8 || kalerdaśasahasrāṇi jagannāthastu tiṣṭhati | tadarddhaṃ jāhnavītoyaṃ tadarddhaṃ grāmadevatāḥ || 9 || tataḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti pāpinaḥ kalimohitāḥ | narakāṃste prayāsyanti sarve cālpāyuṣo narāḥ || 10 || viprāḥ svakanyāṃ dāsyanti brāhmaṇāya ca maulyataḥ | kṣatriyāścaiva putrīṃ svāṃ mārayiṣyanti lolupāḥ || 11 || mṛṣā kurvanti vāṇijyaṃ vaiśyā brahmasvatatparāḥ | śūdrāśca mlecchasaṃgena dūṣayiṣyanti brāhmaṇān || 12 || brāhmaṇā śāstrahīnāśca rājyahīnāśca kṣatriyāḥ | vaiśyāśca dravyahīnā vai śūdrā nāthasya duḥkhadāḥ || 13 || dine vyavāyaniratā viratā dharmakarmaṇi | striyaḥ svacchandagāminyaḥ puruṣā yonilampaṭāḥ || 14 || pitṝṇāmarcanaṃ caiva vedānāmṛtvijāṃ tathā | viṣṇośca vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca tulasyāśca gavāṃ tathā || 15 || na prāyeṇa kariṣyanti mānavāḥ kalimohitāḥ | gaṇikāsu parastrīṣu paravitteṣu mohitāḥ || 16 || ekavarṇā bhaviṣyanti mahāśūdrasamāḥ kila | sasyahīnā bhavetpṛthvī śilāvṛṣṭyā niraṃtaram || 17 || phalahīno'pi vṛkṣaśca jalahīnā sarittathā | prajābhistāḍito bhūpo bhūpena tāḍitāḥ prajāḥ || 18 || rājovāca kenopāyena jīvānāṃ kalau muktirbhaviṣyati | tanmamākhyāhi viprendra tvaṃ parāvaravittamaḥ || 19 || garga uvāca yudhiṣṭhiro vikramaśca tathā vai śālivāhanaḥ | vijayābhinandanaścaiva tathā nāgārjuno nṛpaḥ || 20 || tathā kalkiśca bhagavānete vai śakabaṃdhinaḥ | kariṣyanti kalau bhūpā dharmasthāpanameva ca || 21 || abhūdyudhiṣṭhiro rājā bhaviṣyanti nṛpāśca te | adharmaṃ nāśayiṣyanti bhūtvā vai cakravartinaḥ || 22 || vāmanaśca vidhiḥ śeṣaḥ sanako viṣṇuvākyataḥ | dharmārthahetave caite bhaviṣyanti dvijāḥ kalau || 23 || viṣṇusvāmī vāmanāṃśastathā mādhvastu brahmaṇaḥ | rāmānujastu śeṣāṃśo niṃbārkaḥ sanakasya ca || 24 || ete kalau yuge bhāvyāḥ saṃpradāyapravartakāḥ | saṃvatsare vikramasya catvāraḥ kṣitipāvanāḥ || 25 || saṃpradāyavihīnā ye mantrāste niṣphalāḥ smṛtāḥ | tasmācca gamanaṃ hyasti saṃpradāya narairapi || 26 || pāpakṣayakarī yatra śrīkṛṣṇasya kathā bhavet | vaiṣṇavairvipramukhyaiśca nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaiḥ || 27 || kṛte tu lipyate deśastretāyāṃ grāma eva ca | dvāpare ca kulaṃ proktaṃ kalau kartaiva lipyate || 28 || dhyāyankṛte yajan yajñaistretāyāṃ dvāpare'rcayan | yadāpnoti tadāpnoti kalau saṃkīrtya keśavam || 29 || kṛte yaddaśabhirvarṣaistretāyāṃ hāyanena ca | dvāpare caikamāsena hyahorātreṇa tatkalau || 30 || ghore kaliyuge prāpte sarvadharmavivarjite | vāsudevaparā martyāste kṛtārthā na saṃśayaḥ || 31 || te sabhāgyā manuṣyeṣu kṛtārthā nṛpa niścitam | smaranti smārayante ye harernāmāni vai kalau || 32 || kṛṣiśca sarvavacano ṇakāraścātmavācakaḥ | sarvātmā ca paraṃ brahma tena kṛṣṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 33 || saṃjapya brahma paramaṃ vedasāraṃ parātparam | paraṃ nāstīti nāstīti kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam || 34 || tāvadgarbhe vasetkāmī tāvatī yamayātanā | tāvadgṛhī ca bhogārthī yāvatkṛṣṇaṃ na sevate || 35 || naśvaro viṣamaḥ satyaṃ bhogaśca bandhavo bhuvi | svayaṃ tyaktāḥ sukhāyaiva duḥkhāya tyājitāḥ paraiḥ || 36 || śrutvā daivānmahanniṃdāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasmaraṇādbudhaḥ | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nānyathā rauravaṃ vrajet || 37 || na kāṣṭhe vidyate devo na śilāyāṃ na kāṃcane | yatra bhāvastatra haristasmādbhāvaṃ hi kārayet || 38 || sakṛduccaritaṃ yena kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam | baddhaḥ parikarastena mokṣāya gamanaṃ prati || 39 || sarogatā sādhujaneṣu vairaṃ paropatāpo dvijavedaniṃdā | atyantakopaḥ kaṭukā ca vāṇī narasya cihnaṃ narake gatasya || 40 || svargāgatānāmiha jīvaloke catvāri cihnāni sadā vasanti | dānaprasaṃgo madhurā ca vāṇī devārcanaṃ brāhmaṇapūjanaṃ ca || 41 || rājovāca vrateṣu kiṃ varaṃ brahmansatsu tīrtheṣu kiṃ mahat | deveṣu pūjanīyeṣu ko mukhyaḥ kathayasva naḥ || 42 || garga uvāca ekādaśī varā hyasti vrateṣu yadunandana | bhāgīrathī ca tīrtheṣu devabhakteṣu vaiṣṇavaḥ || 43 || sureṣu viṣṇurbhagavānpūjanīyeṣu śrīguruḥ | imāṃ vārtāṃ na manyante kuṃbhipāke patanti te || 44 || rājovāca ekādaśyāstu mahātmyamanyeṣāṃ caiva me mune | kathayasva prasādena gurudeva namo'stu te || 45 || garga uvāca kathayiṣyāmyahaṃ sarvaṃ śṛṇuṣva yadunandana | ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyamannaṃ caiva phalaṃ tathā || 46 || yathoktavidhinā kuryyādekādaśīṃ mudā naraḥ | tadā sā tasya phaladā bhaveta nṛpasattama || 47 || vrajanābhiruvāca phalāhāraṃ ca kurvanti ye narā harivāsare | teṣāṃ gatiḥ kā bhavati tanno varṇaya vistarāt || 48 || ṛṣiruvāca samastaṃ copavāsena yathoktaṃ labhate phalam | phalāhāreṇa cārddhaṃ syātkiṃcinnyūnaṃ jalena ca || 49 || annānsarvānvarjayitvā godhūmādyānnṛpeśvara | ekādaśyāṃ prakurvīta phalāhāraṃ mudā naraḥ || 50 || annaṃ bhunakti yo rājannekādaśyāṃ narādhamaḥ | iha loke sa cāṃḍālo mṛtaḥ prāpnoti durgatim || 51 || dadhi dugdhaṃ tathā miṣṭaṃ kūṭaṃ karkaṭikāṃ tathā | vāstūkaṃ padmamūlaṃ ca rasālaṃ jānakīphalam || 52 || gaṃgāphalaṃ patraniṃbūndāḍimañca viśeṣataḥ | śṛṅgāṭakaṃ nāgaraṃgaṃ saiṃdhavaṃ kadalīphalam || 53 || āmrātakamārdrakaṃ ca tūlaṃ ca badarīphalam | jaṃbūphalamāmalakaṃ paṭolaṃ trikuśaṃ tathā || 54 || ratālūṃ śarkarākaṃdamikṣudaṃḍaṃ tathaiva ca | drākṣādīni hi cānyāni pavitraṃ ca phalaṃ tathā || 55 || ekavāraṃ ca rājendra bhoktavyaṃ harivāsare | tṛtīye prahare'tīte prasthasya ca palasya ca || 56 || dvijāya cārddhaṃdātavyamarddhamātmani bhojanam | dvivāraṃ jalamaśnīyādekavāraṃ phalaṃ tathā || 57 || samācarejjāgaraṇaṃ pūjayitvā janārdanam | dvivāraṃ vā trivāraṃ vā yo naro harivāsare || 58 || karoti ca phalāhāraṃ tasya kiṃcitphalaṃ na hi | annabhuktena yatpāpaṃ jātaṃ paṃcadaśairdinaiḥ || 59 || ekādaśyupavāsena tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ bhavet | bhojanaṃ brāhmaṇe dattvā hyupavāsaṃ samācaret || 60 || śrutvā tasyāśca māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate | dravyārthī labhate dravyaṃ sutārthī labhate sutam | mokṣārthī labhate mokṣamekādaśyā vratena vai || 61 || iti śrīmadgargasaṃhitāyāmaśvamedhakhaṇḍe ekādaśīmāhātmyaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 61 || hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
<10.62> garga uvāca tapaḥ kṛtaṃ purā yena durjjaraṃ pūrvajanmani | iha loke ca tasyāśu gurorbhaktirhi jāyate || 1 || guroḥ sevāṃ na kurute svaguruṃ yo na manyate | yaḥ samarthaśca patati kuṃbhīpāke ca sarvadā || 2 || gurorabhaktaṃ pragataṃ dṛṣṭvā goghno bhavennaraḥ | snātvā gaṃgāṃ ca yamunāṃ tadā bhavati nirmalaḥ || 3 || dravyalābhastu śiṣyasya bhavedvai yatra yatra ca | daśāṃśaṃ ca gurostasmingṛhadravye tathā hi naḥ || 4 || taṃ bhuṃjati balācchiṣyo na dāsyati guruṃ pṛthak | sa mahārauravaṃ yāti hīnaḥ sarvasukhairiha || 5 || harau kurvanti ye nityaṃ bhaktiṃ ca navalakṣaṇam | saṃsārasāgaraṃ rājaṃste taraṃti sukhena vai || 6 || jñātiṃ vidyāṃ mahattvaṃ ca rūpaṃ yauvanameva ca | yatnena parivarjeta paṃcaite bhaktikaṃṭakāḥ || 7 || bhaktyā kṛṣṇasya rājendra prasādaṃ caraṇodakam | ye gṛhṇanti bhaveyurbhūpāvanā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 8 || gaṃgā pāpaṃ śaśī tāpaṃ dainyaṃ kalpatarurharet | pāpaṃ tāpaṃ tathā dainyaṃ sadyaḥ sādhusamāgamaḥ || 9 || tāvadbhramanti saṃsāre pitaraḥ piṃḍatatparāḥ | yāvadvaṃśe sutaḥ kṛṣṇabhaktiyukto na jāyate || 10 || sa kiṃ guruḥ sa kiṃ tātaḥ sa kiṃ putra sa kiṃ sakhā | sa kiṃ rājā sa kiṃ baṃdhurna dadyādyo harau matim || 11 || vidyādhanāgārakalābhimānino rūpādidārāsutanityabuddhayaḥ | dṛṣṭvānyadevānphalakāminaśca jīvanmṛtāste na bhajanti keśavam || 12 || hayamedhacaritrasya sumeruḥ kathito mayā | vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇacaritraiśca tavāgre nṛpasattama || 13 || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa kṛṣṇabhaktirbhaviṣyati | narāṇāṃ nṛpaśārdūla śokamohabhayāpahā || 14 || anena caritenāpi labhate vāṃchitaṃ phalam | dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutaṃ bhaktiṃ tathā śatrukṣayaṃ naraḥ || 15 || tasmādbhajāśu rājendra śrīkṛṣṇaṃ jagadīśvaram | bhaktyā gṛhe vā vipine jñātvā viśvaṃ manomayam || 16 || āyuste naravīra vardhatu sadā hemaṃtarātriryathā lokānāṃ priyadarśano bhava sadā hemaṃtasūryo yathā | śatrūṇāmatiduḥsaho bhava sadā hemaṃtatoyaṃ yathā nāśaṃ yāṃtu tavārayo'pi satataṃ hemaṃtapadmaṃ yathā || 17 || sūta uvāca iti śrutvā vajranābhirharṣitaḥ premavihvalaḥ | smarankṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ natvā gurumathābravīt || 18 || dhanyo'haṃ ca kṛtārtho'haṃ bhavatā karuṇātmanā | śrutvā kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ lagnaṃ kṛṣṇe ca no manaḥ || 19 || sūta uvāca ityuktvā pūjayāmāsa gargācāryaṃ nṛpottamaḥ | gandhākṣataiḥ puṣpahāraistathā jālakamālayā || 20 || gajai rathaisturaṃgaiśca śibikābhiśca maṃdiraiḥ | raupyāṇāṃ caiva bhāraiśca svarṇabhāraiśca śaunaka || 21 || tathā ratnaiśca grāmaiśca hyātmanā harṣapūritaḥ | pradakṣiṇāpraṇāmaiśca tathā nīrājanādibhiḥ || 22 || tataśca garga utthāya dattvā vajrāya cāśiṣam | bhūpena vaṃditaḥ so'pi yayau dakṣiṇayā yutaḥ || 23 || sa gatvā yamunātīre tīrthe viśrāṃtisaṃjñake | māthurebhyaśca viprebhyo muniḥ sarvaṃ dhanaṃ dadau || 24 || gargavākyāttato vajro mathurāyāṃ munīśvaraiḥ | cakāra hayamedhaṃ vai yathā nāgapureśvaraḥ || 25 || tataḥ sa mathurāyāṃ ca dīrghaviṣṇuṃ ca keśavam | vṛndāvane ca goviṃdaṃ haridevaṃ girīśvare || 26 || gokule gokuleśaṃ ca gokulādyojane balam | sthāpayāmāsa vajrastu hareśca pratimāśca ṣaṭ || 27 || balasya pratimāścānyāḥ pañca vai vrajamaṇḍale | nṛṇāṃ śubhāya vajrastu sthāpayāmāsa harṣitaḥ || 28 || abdāścatuḥsahasrāṇi kalau pañca śatāni ca | gate girivare hi śrīnāthaḥ prādurbhaviṣyati || 29 || taṃ pūjayiṣyati vraje viṣṇusvāmī ravestanuḥ | vallabhādyāśca tacchiṣyāścānye gokulasvāminaḥ || 30 || śrīmadbhāgavatānmuktiṃ dṛṣṭvā vajraḥ parīkṣitaḥ | vairāgyeṇāpi munayo rājyaṃ tyaktuṃ mano dadhe || 31 || tadāyayau caupagavirnaranārāyaṇāśramāt | pādukāṃ mastake bibhratkṛṣṇacandrasya vaiṣṇavaḥ || 32 || bhūpena vaṃditaḥ so'pi pratyutthānāsanādibhiḥ | kathayāmāsa vajrāgre śrīmadbhāgavataṃ mudā || 33 || śrutvoddhavādbhāgavataṃ vajraḥ provāca harṣitaḥ | śrutā mayā purā tāta susabhāyāṃ parīkṣitaḥ || 34 || samādhibhāṣā vyāsasya śukadevena varṇitā | punastvayāpi kathitā kṛtārtho'haṃ babhūva ha || 35 || ityuktvā vajranābhistu svarājyaṃ pratibāhave | dattvā jagāma golokaṃ vimānenāpi coddhavaḥ || 36 || cakāra rājyaṃ dharmeṇa mathurāyāṃ ca dakṣiṇe | pratibāhuḥ sutastasya cottare janamejayaḥ || 37 || agre kaliyugo brahmannāgamiṣyati dāruṇaḥ | paraṃtu caikaṃ nirvāhaṃ dṛśyate pāpanāśanam || 38 || yāvadbhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ yāvadgokulasvāminaḥ | yāvadgovardhano gaṃgā tāvatkaliyugaṃ na hi || 39 || bhāratānāṃ ca khaṇḍānāṃ jaṃbūdvīpe yathā mune | madhye saṃrājate meruḥ sauvarṇaḥ padmapuṣpavat || 40 || tathā golokakhaṇḍānāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ mahāmune | hayamedhacaritrasya madhye merurvirājate || 41 || asya śravaṇamātreṇa viprahā gurutalpagaḥ | strīrājapitṛgohantā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 42 || viprastu labhate vidyāṃ rājyaṃ rājanya eva ca | śravaṇācca dhanaṃ vaiśyo dharmaṃ śūdrastathaiva ca || 43 || nadīṣu ca yathā gaṃgā deveṣu bhagavānyathā | tīrtheṣu vai rīrtharāja iyaṃ vai saṃhitāsu ca || 44 || asyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa tṛptiṃ yāti narotamaḥ | na sajjetānyaśāstreṣu yathā bhāgavatānmune || 45 || tasmādbhajata pādābjaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ | kalyāṇārthaṃ ca munayo bhaktaduḥkhaharasya ca || 46 || śrīgarga uvāca iti śrutvā śaunakādyā munayaścaritaṃ hareḥ | ślāghāṃ vai sūtaputrasya cakrurharṣitamānasāḥ || 47 || saṃsārasāgare magnaṃ dīnaṃ māṃ karuṇānidhe | kālagrahagṛhītāṃgaṃ trāhi viṣṇo namo'stu te || 48 || anugṛhṇīṣva naḥ sādho tvaṃ hyanāthasya vallabhaḥ | trailokyasyābhayaṃ dadyādyathā svāmī tathā kuru || 49 || śrīguroḥ kṛpayā hi śrīmadanamohanasevayā | babhūva vāṅmama harestasyā caritamīritam || 50 || vālmīkyādyāśca vyāsādyā laghūktāṃ kavitāṃ mama | paśyantu dṛṣṭvā yūyaṃ cāparādhaṃ kṣaṃtumarhatha || 51 || śrīmādhavaṃ vrajapatiṃ navameghagātraṃ rādhāpatiṃ surapatiṃ muralīdharañca | bhaktārtihañca paramārthamanantadevaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ namāmi śirasā manasā ca bhaktyā || 52 || ṣaḍviṃśacca śatā rāmā trisaptāśītisupriyāḥ | ślokāścaritramerorvai śrīkṛṣṇasya mahātmanaḥ || 53 || iti śrīmadgargasaṃhitāyāmaśvamedhakhaṇḍesumerusaṃpūrtirnāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 62 || aśvamedhakhaṇḍaḥ samāptaḥ samāpto'yaṃ graṃthaḥ hariḥ oṃ tatsat śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
